We had our breakfast with the same waitress as the night before telling us how tired she was and how demanding the customers were and that we should have stayed and had our drinks at the lodge (are prisoners?)We were on our way out to our trip when we were approached by the management who informed us that they hadn't noticed our modifiied booking(which was modified on the 27/4/12 to include another night, this was now the 3/6 ) and that our room was booked for another guest, and that we could stay but in a caravan (without the facilities we had)in the grounds, they would phone round and find another hotel for us(on a hoilday weekend and at our expense).I wonder what they would have done if we had already been away on our trip. I went to settle the bill and to ask for @ least half price to paid. The management had left a young barmaid to deal with their incompetance and it would have been unfair to make demands of her. We left in disgust. We had been here before but never again. This an embrassment. I have emailed them my grievance and they have not been gracious enough to email me. We could have been loyal customers and had recommened it to other people that is now retracted. As said by another customer, this could be a great place if managed much better but as it is, it should close.

author: irondoc
title: Quaint cottages, comfortable
text: I stayed here with my daughter and my brothers family on a recent visit to the Scottish highlands. The lodge is just outside Crianlarich and is in a beautiful rural setting. The rooms are a series of connectes small cottages. There is interior wood walls, and comfortable beds. Some have two bedrooms,some with bunks. Perfect for a small family. The accomodations were very nice, but I wouldn't say large. The lodge has a small pub where you check in. There's a pool table, free wifi, and even a room with various board games and books. Breakfast is a sit down affair and is included and served after you order. Typical Engilsh bfast of eggs, toast, bacon or sausage etc. Don't be late though. We tried to sleep till just before the closing time of 10am, and the hostess/owner made it clear she was none too happy. She was a bit surly and blustered about as if being put out. On the other hand, the staff had no trouble getting us an extra mattress and bedsheets in one room so my daughter could stay in the same room with her cousins. But in the evening we were sitting in the pud with a small local crowd who were freindly enough and there was even some live (if not great) music. Overall, the stay was enjoyable in a beautiful location

author: GlasgowHopalong17
title: Nightmare!!!
text: My nephew and I were walking the West Highland Way, and booked in to the Ben More Lodge Hotel for one night. Wrong Decision! It looked fine on the internet, but ........... It was horrendous. " Mingin" is the best word to describe it. It was filthy. There was dirt on the verandah before we got into the room. the bathroom was dirty, and the shower had mould round it. We would have turned right round and walked out if we had had the strength. We went for something to eat. Next big mistake. The meal was from a menu offering two choices - cheeseburger and chips or curry. It was the worst meal we had ever had. Or so we thought. The breakfast was worse. I ordered the full Scottish breakfast without the egg - what I got was a slice of sausage, a slice of bacon and a quarter of a tomato. That was it. We got a jug of hot water and sachets of coffee. The milk came in wee sachets of UHT long life milk. NEVER AGAIN.

author: kusey
title: Not Quite the Bates Motel, but very close!"
text: My husband and I stayed at the Ben More Lodge after a fine meal at the Drover's Inn. We were on our way from Glasgow to Spean Bridge to stay with friends in a cottage there. This was just a stop on the road for us on our way to the Highlands. What a complete disappointment! The room was not very clean at all. When were opened the door to our closet, there was a hole in the floor and what appeared to be a "catch 'em alive" mouse trap. Perhaps it was some kind of a roach trap. Either way, we did not investigate any farther. The mattress was lumpy and the room just was not clean! Luckily, we could get up in the morning and leave fast!!! Breakfast was in the restaurant/bar. The carpet was dirty and the rest of the building was suspect. Breakfast was fine and the staff was friendly enough. My husband visited with the owner, who said that they had only had the place for about three weeks. Hope they make some improvements and fast!!!

author: MiloG
title: A real gem, loaded with character
text: I find myself observing a lot on this site that you get out what you put in. If you travel about expecting every hotel to be the Ritz, you're only setting yourself up for diappointment. The Ben More is a perfect example of a place where that attitude will kill a potentially wonderful experience. It's in the Highlands of Scotland - you won't get, and shouldn't want, some kind of city-break experience. What we got, and loved, was a personable character-loaded stay with a lot of fond memories. It's difficult to overstate how friendly everyone was. And when the weather closed in they did everything they could to make our stay more comfortable. First up, the food is great, and with a bif roaring log fire the Highland winter night stayed just the right distance away. The bar staff were chatty and pleasant - sometimes things got busy and we had to wait for a drink, but it was no big deal. There was never any feeling we were being ignored. The lodges are small but cozy - and very VERY warm. Great beds and perfect darkness gave us a couple of great sleeps, which is one of the main reasons you escape the rat-race in the first place. I'll admit the Ben More isn't for everybody. But if you like the idea of a welcoming bar, good food, and the chance of conversation with fellow guests and even some locals - along with a folk duet chancing by and playing a show for us just because they felt like it (VERY entertaining, Broadsword!)... this place could give you one of those wonderful unexpected once-in-a-lifetime experiences. We'll be back!

author: FinDiva
title: Best Last Min Adventure
text: We decided on a last minute (highly unorganised) skiing trip to Scotland on Friday night and had a quick browse on the internet. Four BnB's turned us away as we would be arriving late but on calling Ben More Lodge everything was "No problem". We even arrived later than expected and still it was, "No problem at all". On arrival (having received excellent directions and advice on the route) we were made to feel very very welcome and encouraged to sit in by a roaring log fire whilst we chatted about the area and all that it offered. We were helped with our enquiry's about where to ski and how the weather might be, and the owners knew everything and anything there was to know about the local area. We slept in a toasty warm Lodge with a huge bed, plenty tea and coffee stuff and the TV on, ready for us. Breakfast was legendary, we didn't need to eat again until tea time and we could see the food was was local produce, the meat/dairy carefully chosen reflecting the experience and knowledge of the chef and the owner. We felt like family members immediately and imagine our astonishment when we were offered the owners 4x4 Jeep to ensure we got to our destination that first day. Their efforts to make our short break as enjoyable as possible were unlimited despite our own lack of organisation and decision-making! After a hard days skiing, and a fabulous hot shower in our Lodge (they had even thought to put the heating on well ahead of our return so that the chalet was toasty warm) we ordered dinner in the bar. A varied and interesting menu was on offer, from traditional Scottish fayre to home made pakora's and curry. Servings were generous, perfect after a days ski-ing but plates were cleared as it was so delicious! The food was so fresh and meat juicy and tender, and again nothing was too much trouble for them in ensuring our enjoyment. Local visitors to the bar were friendly and welcoming, providing advice on local "hidden treasures' and offering to show us themselves. We were so sad to leave the next day, and felt like we had made some real friends. The Ben More Lodge will most certainly get another visit from us, and we would have no hesitation in recommending it as a base for a guaranteed superb break in Scotland.

author: DreamTraveller69
title: Calm amidst the chaos
text: When on holiday, it is always difficult to decide whether your hotel should be in the midst of all the attractions or whether we need to book a stay away from all the hustle to ensure a peaceful vacation. Your stay at the Kotra will save you from that dilemma. This was a family holiday and we were a group of 12 including children. On our way to the hotel I was wondering if the property would be anything like all the good reviews I had read about it. The busy narrow roads of the old city leading to the hotel made me even more anxious. Lanes so narrow that an SUV can't even get to the hotel. Big cars can go up to a certain point and from there on you need to transfer in to a 3 wheeler/rickshaw to get to the hotel. This is where the drawbacks end while staying at Kotra Haveli. Once you step in to the property you will know exactly why people have all the good things to say about it. From your welcome to check in to explaining the near-by attractions to arranging your city tours, the staff at the Kotra will ensure you experience the real essence of ATITHI DEVO BHAVA (Guest is next to God) The rooms are spacious, bathrooms clean and common areas well maintained. The best part about the property is its roof top restaurant which offers magnificent view of the City Palace and panoramic views of the old city. There was an issue with the air-con in one of the rooms and the staff were prompt in attending to this issue though they could not rectify it. We were immediately offered another room but as the weather was still bearable we opted not to move as the children were well settled in that room. We had breakfast as part of our package and though not elaborate, the spread was decently sufficient offering good Indian breakfast along with decent continental options. We also had dinner on one of evenings we were there and the meal was delicious with decent sized portions. The location is great and many attractions are at walking distance with the local bazaar close-by for some good bargains. You can take a stroll with many restaurants and ice cream/juice parlors around you will always be hydrated. If you are mentally prepared about the initial chaos to get to the hotel you will only have good memories to take from Kotra Haveli. If you are not, the staff at Kotra will ensure you forget about all that chaos and make it special for you.

author: abhinav1708
title: Good stay
text: I have stayed in this hotel for three nights. Pros 1. Location - all major points of Udaipur are at walkable distance and you can cover them all in a single day on foot. 2. Helpful reception staff - the staff at reception is quite helpful, they have explained to us the itinerary to follow which helped us a lot. 3. Rooms are spacious with all basic amenities. 4 Breakfast - items are limited but good in taste and different each day. Needs Improvement 1. Housekeeping staff - Housekeeping staff I found them ignorant, there was some dust on the tables which I found it daily after room cleaning, one day they forgot to keep towels in the room after cleaning, bathroom was also not properly cleaned. 2. Room layout - I found room to be overcrowded, some things were not required like side bed table and bed extensions which were blocking TV view. 3. Make guests more aware regarding attractions and market closing days - well we should know this beforehand and should not rely on the hotel but it would be nice it hotel can make their guests aware of closing hours/days. 4. Taxi - Taxi suggested by the hotel was between average and good. The driver has called us two times to hathipole market saying that he can't come to the hotel. Overall a good hotel with excellent location.

author: Krunalshah1684
title: Overall a good experience
text: Visited this hotel for a quick one night stay with office colleague. Location...The best part of the hotel is the location. 2 min walk from car park, just 50mtr walk to jagdish temple, in the heart of market and an amazing feel of old city. Travel Tip: Bargain hard..this place is visited by many foreigners... An indian can easily bargain upto 50%-60% from original price. However, there are few shops which dont do or barely bargain... Nothing wrong in trying. Hotel & Services : Very comfy bed..quite spacious...large bed.. the room where we stayed..can easily feet 3 healthy build guys. Rooms were clean however, all the washrooms have drainage smell which was irritating. View from rooftop is spectacular specially at night while entire city and city palace is lit. Breakfast was sufficient and tasty. We had 1 juice, bread, butter, pancake, aloo parotha, poha, egg bhurji, banana, tea coffee, corn flakes. The only complaint is abt late chexk in. We had to wait good 45 mins. Rooms were given at 11:45 where check in was at 11am. Overall a good hotel and highly recommended for location and kind of rooms they offer at this price.

author: Paradise684057
title: Excellent Hotel and good location
text: We travelled as a family with kid and stayed there for two nights. Reasonable price with good discount from Clear trip. The check in was smooth and the room was neat and clean with all the required amenities provided (Hot water, towels, soap solution, kettle with coffee and tea bags, ac, tv). Restaurant at roof top and lift is available. Buffet breakfast was good. Limited options but it is complete. Prices are reasonable for ala carte. Good service. About the location, it is nearby to many of the tourist attractions (Jagdish mandir, city palace, bagore ki haveli, lake pichola). A map was provided at the reception with which you can see all the places at ease either by walking or by taking auto in between. Most of the roads in Udaipur are similar to hill stations, either upwards or downwards. Also hired cab from hotel for kumbalgarg fort and other places nearby Udaipur. OVERALL COMPLETELY STATISFIED WITH THE HOTEL AND WILL SURELY RECOMMEND. Don't forget to taste the poha, kachori and tea on the way to Jagdish temple from the hotel. Very cheap and tasty.

author: mohitjaipur
title: Awesome stay...
text: I am so much impressed by courtesy of staff & hotel facilities that i am bound to share the review. What should I say , the best hotel in town. Rich haveli look with all modern amenities. Staff is very customer friendly , cooperative. Location is bang on. Without a doubt you can go for this hotel. The owner , Mahendra Singh ji is a truly professional and knowledgeable man. Food is awesome here. I will share one incident that made my trip. We returned late to hotel at night and were too hungry. Although they closed the orders for dinner but on our request they arranged dinner for us that too CANDLE LIGHT DINNER on rooftop. It was timing for staffs dinner but they first accommodated guest even though it was too late. Hats off!! Must try : RAJASTHANI THALI . Sharing pics of my room and dinner.

author: 946muntaserm
title: Just perfect
text: It was the first week of October 2018 when we decided to do a road trip to Udaipur from Pune. While researching for a place to stay in the heart of the city, we settled on Kotra Haveli on the recommendation of a friend - and what a decision it was! It may not seem too big or fancy from the outside, but once you step in, the fact that this is a proper Haveli is more than evident. The layout, decor and abundance of marble everywhere makes you feel like royalty even if you're on a budget. The rooms are big and spacious with humongous beds that are topped with super comfortable mattresses. The rooms we stayed in were air-conditioned and had access to a television set as well - though we ended up not switching on the TV throughout our 4-day stay at all! It's not just the rooms that are mesmerising though - the little balconies/verandah right outside the rooms overlooking the inner courtyard of the Haveli is a great place to chill/regroup with friends; as is the terrace of the Haveli where candlelight dinners are hosted too. The view from the top is breathtaking, with a clear view not just of the city, but also of the Udaipur City Palace which is just a stone's throw away. It is Kotra Haveli's location that really impressed us - everything is just walking distance away - from the City Palace to Ganghor Ghat, the market and many other places of tourist value. One word of caution if you're planning to drive in your own car - the hotel itself doesn't have enough parking space, but there is a safe, government approved covered parking area 2 mins away. While of this was great, there was one particular aspect of Kotra Haveli that really sealed the deal for us and we're sure we'll go back there in the future. The hospitality at Kotra Haveli is to be experienced to be believed, especially that received from the owner Mahendra Panwar. He is polite, courteous, helpful and goes out of his way to make sure your stay is memorable. This attitude passes on to the rest of the staff as well, who always greet you with a smile no matter how many times you call upon them. And then there's the food - healthy, hygienic, delicious and super value for money. All of this combined just left each and every one of us extremely content with our stay in Udaipur and without a doubt, we recommend Kotra Haveli for your stay in Udaipur!

author: NJaiswal
title: Excellent Hospitality
text: This is a wonderful property( no pichola lake view though ) very close to the action. Rooms are huge and very clean. Cost mattresses. This is indeed a haveli though needs some fixing of paints and colour. The breakfast given is good. The highlight is the staff behaviour , been to so many places but none come close to the way these guys interact with you. The lady at the reception ( did not ask her name to avoid giving any false impression) is extremely well mannered and one of the most soft spoken persons that I have talked to. She needs special mention for it, she is extremely patient and responds to any query efficiently.Other guys are equally good. I had 2 rooms for 2 nights 5 Person.. and for 3rd day , I had booked only one room because I had to checkout at 6 PM. These guys allowed us to use both the rooms and didn't even ask to hurry up the checking out . Many hotels are strict and would have asked me to vacate one of the rooms. Site can be reached by auto but cars can not enter. The cars need to be parked about 200 mts outside in the government parking. Overall great experience.

author: OmarM2327
title: Beautiful Place to stay!!
text: The hotel is located right in the heart of Udaipur city and is easy to find. Being in the heart of city the market and tourist attractions are accessible by foot. The rooms are clean and one noteworthy thing about the rooms is that all rooms are designed uniquely. No 2 rooms are the same. The staff is very helpful and prompt. The rates of the room were reasonable. The breakfast provided to us was delicious and on time. I would recommend all tourists staying here to have Lal Maas from the hotel itself. They have a rooftop candle-light seating arrangement which provides you a view of City Palace. Talking about the owner Mr. Mahinder Singh, he is an amazing person. Very friendly and guided us with an entire map of the city and planned an entire itenary for us so that we could cover maximum places in our limited time period. Kudos to him. I would give all stars to the hotel and staff and hospitality provided to us. Hope to visit again next year.

author: CharlieHollers
title: Good place and good price
text: I enjoyed my stay here, rooms are comfortable for the price. The boy serving food and running bags works so hard and really goes above and beyond to ensure you have a good stay. I bought some huge pieces of rock salt and asked him to crush them up a bit for me, he came back 15 minutes later with it all in a really fine powder, such a legend! WIFI: Wifi is super lacking and barely works from the rooms but is fine in the communal courtyard. BREAKFAST Breakfast needs work, it is advertised from 7am (or 7.30?) but the buffet style breakfast was never ready until 9am which is a real pain if you want to get out early and make the most of the day. Even as they do begin to bring food out it comes out as it is cooked so sometimes parts of the breakfast you want are 30 mins apart from each other. Great Chai! And also very tasty Poha when it does finally come. Apparently you can order custom breakfast but no one tells you this at check in, perhaps my whole experience would have been significantly different if I’d known. FOOD IN GENERAL: Incredible food from the menu for lunch or dinners, can absolutely recommend the Indian options and also fantastic honey lemon ginger tea. SAFETY: There is a cupboard in the room where you can lock your valuables which is super awesome and a lot more than I have found in other places in India. Thanks for this! ARRIVING: If you are coming by car, cars can only take you so far before you hit central Udaipur and only Tuk tuks and bikes are allowed on the narrow lanes. Don’t be disheartened! Thinking I’d find it, I walked for a long time with a heavy bag and ultimately just asked a Tuk Tuk to take me, I had to really haggle but Rs50 is worth it to be delivered outside the front door. He Haveli is really hidden away. LOCATION: Really good and central, easy to walk anywhere you might want to go, close to clothes washing, the lake, eating options, one of the main temples and street after street of great shopping.

author: Srbh99
title: Gem of a place in the heart of the city
text: Just checked out after 4 nights, we are a family of 4 and the room size was quite adequate. A comfy mattress on the floor ensured that I had a good night's sleep with the wife and kids taking the bed. There was adequate storage space in the room and enough electric points to charge multiple devices. TV had all the required channels and a refrigerator was not required at least in this weather. The minor niggle was the lack of an electric kettle, we had enquired and carried our own so no issues there. The linen was clean and fresh and so were the towels, soap and a small bath gel were provided and we had carried our own personal care items. The bathroom was large with running hot and cold water and was quite clean. We also had multiple meals and both quality inn and quantity of the food was quite good, in spite of multiple options we quite enjoyed eating here specially in the evenings with tired kids to manage The breakfast was tasty with variety, toast, fruits and 2/3 other items. The service here can get a bit harried with multiple guests but that's a minor niggle. I think the best part of the stay is the fantastic service, there is genuine warmth and hospitality across all the staff and sometimes this can be the difference between a good and great trip. The location is excellent with the City Palace, Jagdish Temple just a stroll away and other locations also very convenient to access.The shopping around the area is excellent and one of the highlights. We used Autos and Uber for slightly far off places. Will highly recommend Kotra Haveli and would love to visit again. P.S - Just an observation of the traffic scene especially in this old part of town can be a little overwhelming, people are speeding up and down very narrow streets on bikes etc and with kids you need to be extra careful. .

author: Pieush
title: Value for Money w.r.t location and services
text: Stayed @ Kotra Haveli, Udaipur in Oct.’16 for 3 days. We had booked OLA cab from Airport to Kotra Haveli. The cab dropped us @ Jagadish Temple cross, as the driver said it’s difficult to take the cab to the exact location. However, the haveli is situated just a minute walk from Jagdish Temple cross. We didn’t have any problem locating it. The location of Haveli is amazing as, most of the tourist attractions are @ walkable distance from it. The staff was welcoming and courteous and made sure that our stay was comfortable. Would like to mention Mr. Mahendra Singh, who helped us plan our excursions @Udaipur such that the time was best utilised - and it was. Room was neat and clean. Food served was excellent. Recommend Rajasthani Thali which was super awesome. Rooftop dining made it even better. Night view from Rooftop is beautiful. Overall, Kotra Haveli is value for money w.r.t its location and services.

author: bhansalivikram
title: Kota haveli the best in udaipur.
text: Had visited during Diwali last year. Was doubtful how the hotel would be? But to my surprise was the best hotel in udaipur. Every thing is excellent about the hotel. Excellent view from the terrace. Excellent food. Excellent hospitality. Excellent room. Every thing is excellent about the hotel. All the major attractions of udaipur is at a walking distance from the hotel. All major attractions can also be viewed from the terrace. I can sit the whole night on the terrace looking at the view of city palace, Jagdish temple and few temples on the mountain. If udaipur then Kota haveli is must. Waiting to visit again. Special thanks to our driver Mr Naresh with his expertise was able to give us the best joyride in the small lanes of jaipur Also for guiding us for not to miss things in jaipur. Want a good driver he is the catch.

author: R7568GKmonikas
title: Hidden jewel...excellent services..an ever smiling staff
text: A beautiful heritage property very nicely maintained. Very clean rooms. You can see the City Palace from your window. We were received by a smiling staff who gave us a room 1 hour earlier than the check in time. They were very helpful. We stayed for two nights. The location is very near (walking distance) from all the must see sites. You can visit Jagdish Temple, City Palace, Bagore ki Haveli and Lake Pichola in one day and you do not even need a taxi. The market is just outside. Their rooftop restaurant has an amazing view of the palace. It looks surreal at night when the palace is lighted. For the first time ever I can say that the breakfast spread was great.Though some people might say limited options but in my opinion fresh fruits, sandwiches, cornflakes, poori bhaji / paranthas are very good options if they are fresh. Even dinner was prepared after the order was placed. Yummy home cooked food. All in all an awesome experience. Kudos to Mr Ajay Singh, Mr Mahendra Singh and Mr Arshdev Singh who are doing a very good job along with their staff. PS- Special mention of their pet mithoo who kept our son entertained.

author: bhag6
title: Perfect choice of Kotra Haveli
text: Padharo sa is Rajasthani word mean If some guest is coming to you and you are very happy to welcoming them. We stayed here 03-04-05-06-07-08 Dec. 2015 and experience was awesome. Location: 50Meter from Jadish tample, City palace: 150Meter, Gangaura ghat 500Meter, Gulab bagh, 750Meter approx. and lake Pichola 1 Km approx. , all attraction on walk, so no more expense on transportation. Food: Awesome is only word which can define food quality here and taste too, They have roof top arrangement for having dinner with breath taking city view and city palace view. Most of Veg and Non veg option is available, I tried both and loved the food served. Service: If you are staying here you will fell like hotel staff is working for you only to make your stay with all possible comfort, Mahendra Singh ji And Mr. Ajay Singh ji (Owner) will meet you once or twice in a day at least to know that you are not facing any issue there and enjoying your stay. Really such type of behavior I not found in past 30 stayed hotel, Thanks to Mahendra Singh ji and staff to make our stay very memorable. Price: Very much affordable in compare with other hotels as per location , I stayed in approx. 10-12hotels near by as I am visiting Udaipur every month, but never got such a good response any where. Room: Room size is great and same as shown in hotel site, Bathroom is large enough if I compare with other with good toiletries. AC was working very good and good view of city from room. Bad was very comfortable and Almira provided and location is very good. Wi-Fi: Great speed and FREE :) Breakfast: Great taste and many options in INR 250.00 per person. In short like to say best experience had this time out of all my visit. :) Many thanks to Kotra Haveli team.

author: 416CarolineS
title: Classic Udaipur Stay
text: Kotra Haveli is a hidden gem in the midst of all attractions. Its a homestay with all the amenities one would need to feel at home. The place is well maintained, clean,secure and very classic style. The amenities are sufficient for any kind of traveler. The rooms are spacious, clean, hot water is available 24hrs, towels are fresh, aircon, tv, water and many such small luxuries are made available. The place is also wifi enabled.The food prepared on the premises is very tasty, fresh and definitely done with love. The menu is versatile. The managers of the place are very helpful, social and definitely worth going back for! Our special Thanks to Mr Mahendra Ji for all his help and care in making our first visit to Udaipur a great success and one of fond memories. Now, the location of this haveli is the second selling point after, of course, the very thoughtful and calming interiors of this haveli, Your bang in the middle of all the attractions and restaurants and lakes and shopping places. Yes, there are several other places too but we are glad we choose Kotra cos of its uniqueness and the beautiful palace view u get from your room window. We walked everyday to most of our tourist spots and cafe's from our homestay since its central to everything.Shopping places like Bapu baazar, Hathipole and silver markets near clock tower are all walkable distance,but you can also hire a auto if you want to experience a joy ride! Kotra Haveli is truly a well designed and carefully managed homestay that anyone who wants to experience Udaipur from a more local perspective, should stay here! It will be our choice for our second time again. Oh and last but not the least, do try their masala chai...its fantastic...!

author: mayshi1710
title: ““Awesome stay, an experience to relish & cherish forever””
text: Udaipur is a place where there are numbers of hotels to pick which is actually very difficult to do so. Me and my colleague travelled to Udaipur, after a tiring train journey we got a sigh of relief once we entered this place. Owners( Mr. SINGH), are really warm people as they welcomed us very nicely The hotel is located in the heart of the city. Stay was very peaceful, everything was great about our stay. Staff was really good and indeed very sober. This hotel is real value for money by all means. Rooms were neat and clean, good in size, Soothing ambiance, nice lights etc. gave us a relaxing start to our journey. Another best part is there is no big movement outside the hotel which makes it more peaceful. It was really a "Home away from Home". As i am a big Non Veg foodie so the best thing for me was the food. Because it gets cooked under the supervision of MR. MAHENDRA and its really yummy, mouth watering especially the Mutton dishes. , Finally I am glad to say, We enjoyed our trip here with lots of scenic views and fresh air. Special thanks to MR. MAHENDRA and MR. AJAY, the most heartily caring owners I’ve ever come across and to the entire team for making our stay a pleasant one :) Room Tip: If you are travelling as 2 individuals then 201 would be the best room. But if you are travelling as...Couple then take 205.

author: anital67
title: Great food
text: My husband took me here for date night. He did make a reservation which I highly recommend for a weekend night. The dining room was very classy looking. So we dressed up a little. We got there and it looked like Nascar just broke out in there. We both felt over dressed but it was date night so we just tried to relax and have a good time. The service was a tad slow because the dining room was completely full. I didn't see a drink list just the wine and beer lists so we ordered beers. Then I spotted a woman drinking a martini so they do have mixed drinks. We started with the shrimp cocktail and the coconut shrimp. If you like shrimp get both or at the very least the coconut shrimp. The dipping sauce was to die for. We ordered the prime rib dinner. Salad was very adequate. We ordered medium rare but they were rare for sure. Very tender and juicy. The food is worth the trip. I do recommend this restaurant. We will definitely be going back but during the week.

author: JH928S4
title: Better food than hotel
text: First, the positives: I loved the food and the prices are from the eighties! I had soup and scallops and a local draft beer. Delicious. Apple crisp for dessert. Homemade and yummy. A large dining room with not much personality or recent upgrades but friendly service without too long a wait for the meal. The room, I’m sorry to say, was tired though roomy, clean but with water stained threadbare carpeting and stained bathroom ceiling. Fixtures really dated. Small beds. And a heavy cigarette odor that flourished when I turned on the air conditioning before bed. Too tired to change rooms and not sure it would be worth it. Called the front desk with not much response. She said she’d tell housekeeping in the morning. Same reaction when I checked out the next morning with scratchy eyes and very stuffed up nose. Not much soundproofing either: I heard every conversation and tv noise from upstairs including footsteps on the floor above. I was really disappointed that T and C hasn’t maintained their motel rooms but instead have added all sorts of ‘amenities’ to make it a resort instead of just a terrific restaurant and reliable motel. Definitely needs work to bring the motel up to standards we all expect in this day of Hampton Inns and Residence Inns.

author: Travelhb228
title: It was ok i guess
text: The address listed for the hotel is not the address you should put into your GPS. Had to call for correct address. Person at check in was nice except she did not know how to get to our room. Sent my mom and I on a wild goose chase, had to go. Ack in and ask again where the room was and luckily someone else was there to let us know out room was just up the stairs in the lobby 🙄. Room was clean, beds uncomfortable and room was huge. Housekeeping did not come until 2 (at which point we were home from our morning hike), kind of annoying. And then at 3 a man BANGED loudly on the door asking if he could check the radiator. That goodness it was clean otherwise we would have left. As far as the restaurant goes.. DON'T. I see the reviews are decent for the restaurant but the food was eh at best. Bread at table was frozen, for too long.. not fresh at all. Dinner was bland, no taste. Pasta dish that had "homemade sauce" had NO taste at all. I had high hopes for this place based on other reviews but i was not impressed.

author: tryharder
title: Average motel accommodation and restaurant
text: This motel is nicely situated just west of the town of Gorham and has plenty of parking. Rooms are large but bathrooms are small. Some rooms have a musty smell that necessitate that you keep the A/C on to keep the humidity and odor at bay. WiFi was really spotty and at times unusable (probably when the place was full and everyone was active at the same time) - upgrades to the WiFi are in order. The buffet breakfast is acceptable, offering scrambled eggs, bacon, pan fried potatoes and alternating with sausages, corned beef hash, pancakes and waffles, plus fruit and cereals. For us, the coffee was horrible (as well as that available via room coffee makers). It's a 5-minute drive to downtown Gorham or about a 20-minute walk to some good restaurants. The first 1/4 mile is along the side of the highway and then you are on sidewalks the rest of the way. Our large group had no issues with this walk. Dinner at the motel is a mixed bag. I ordered the flat iron steak covered with mushrooms and Gorgonzola. The steak was perfectly cooked for me medium-rare but covered with canned mushrooms and a salty, unappetizing Gorgonzola. My wife had the NY sirloin and ordered it medium, however it was served blue rare and so she asked for it to be be redone - it took 15 minutes for her steak to return and it was medium-rare. Another person at our table ordered the prime rib and she was served more fat than meat with her dish. Side accompaniments were really good, including the pickled beets succotash, pan-fired potatoes and salads. Service at the motel and restaurant was really pleasant and helpful. I think that they have the potential to be better than they are as a motel and restaurant, but they need to address some issues. But then again, maybe their client expectations aren't that high.

author: mountainoutin
title: family run mid-range motel
text: This is an older independent motel, but in reasonably good condition. The owners are on site. Rooms are in several buildings, which were erected at different times, so it is possible there are differences in rooms between buildings. The room in my building was generous size, but the bathroom was quite small. Interestingly, the room had two doors, one to the outside, and one to an inside corridor. Neither, however, had security chains to prevent unwanted access to the room. The furniture in the room was well used, but in good condition. Lighting was good. In addition to the desk, there was a table with 2 chairs, and a refrigerator. Room climate control draws air from outside. There is no traffic noise, but the hotel is used by truckers, who parked their rigs near the room block. When they left early in the morning, --well you know what a truck diesel engine sounds like. The hotel has an indoor pool and restaurant. Breakfast is not included in the room rate. I found the breakfast buffet mediocre, though it did have a selection of typical hot items. Adequate, but certainly not memorable.

author: 348jackiec
title: Great Location with Scenic Vistas, but....
text: The Town & Country was once the go-to venue for weddings, conferences, family gatherings, etc. It still has all of the amenities one might look for in such a facility and, of course, its setting in the heart of the White Mountains with their breathtaking views is part of its charm. The hotel itself is dated (though I have heard some rooms have been renovated). Ours was basically clean and had what we needed. I should also add that this property allows pets and that was a big plus as we were traveling with our canine companion on this trip. On the downside, though, the T&C leaves a bit to be desired. The air conditioning wasn't functioning on a warm and muggy night (something we will report to management before checking out). That left the room uncomfortable and the noise level higher than it might otherwise have been. Bed wasn't very comfortable and led to a night of tossing and turning for both my husband and me. Towels were AWFUL, thin and scratchy -- air drying might have been preferable. I know that a rating of an establishment shouldn't rely on such a small detail, but we're both finicky about this particular detail. The bottom line -- this is a property offering reasonable value and all of the amenities that especially a family with children might want. If you are looking for a romantic get-away or quaint venue, this might not be the best place for you. However, I would recommend checking out the rooms in the main part of the hotel containing the restaurant and lounge (in which they generally have entertainment) before discounting the T&C entirely. I stayed in one of those rooms several years ago and they were definitely better appointed and nicer.

author: fivekampers
title: Reminded me of the movie Dirty Dancing!
text: Had just spent a less than optimal night at a place in Lancaster, NH and got the name of this place from another hotelier in Gorham. We loved it. No, it wasn't updated, but you felt like you were checking into a resort. Lobby has a big front desk, with welcoming staff who obviously like where they work. Nice restaurant with a full menu. Passed many happy guests telling us they are return visitors. We ate our dinner in the lounge. It was a good meal, not fabulous, but very pleasing. A single guitarist performed covers of all sorts of tunes from Van Morrison to Pink Floyd--nicely done. Our room was huge. It was not updated, but was clean and well provisioned. Nice pool and workout space. Excellent breakfast buffet for 7.95 per person. The hotel was less expensive than our hotel in Lancaster and has a much more convivial atmosphere. I would go back.

author: JenniferHR
title: Outdated, dirty and disappointing
text: This hotel looks decent from the outside, but the inside is very outdated and needs a very big cleaning overhaul. The carpets in the hallway have stains, moldings are chipped, and the grout in the bathroom is disgusting. The room floors hardly seemed vacuumed. The blanket on the bed had hairs all over…has it ever been washed? There are other things to comment on regarding cleanness, but any reader will get the picture. Unfortunately, the hotel seemed to overbook the Friday night we were there. Several hockey teams were booked, as well as snowmobilers. They also had a Chamber of Commerce event in the dining room. When we returned at 8pm from a hockey game in Berlin, there was absolutely no parking to be found. After 30 minutes of backing in/out of rows, I stopped in to ask the front desk where to park. They replied, "once the event is over, there will be plenty of parking". They did not know what time the event would be over, and to just keep looking around. Seriously?? At that hour of the night, after driving 3 hours to get to Berlin, the last thing I wanted to do was to try and find a parking space! The parking lot should be plowed better and they could spend a little money on salt to get rid of all the ice. I almost fell a few times and I imagine other people actually have fallen given how slippery the parking was. If you absolutely need a place to stay, this is a below average hotel. If you have time, keep looking around for something that is recently renovated, clean, and caters to the customer in every aspect.

author: jodil349
title: NHSA Easter Seals Ride-In 2015
text: We were a part of the Ride in and we got there on a Thursday and stayed til Sunday. The hospitality of everyone who worked there were fantastic. I want to thank Scott for being there whenever we needed anything. He was just all over the place, when you needed him he was there. Our service the first night was fantastic. Mrs.T was just so kind and great to all of us. Food was delicious! I enjoyed the pool with my daughter, we went in every day. House keeping was fabulous. I asked for a cot and they came right away with it. Asked for more blankets they brought them. Just fantastic! I would recommend T & C to anyone! Thanks again can't wait till next year!!! Jodi George

author: dianaonacki
title: Birthday getaway
text: We decided to stop someplace to sleep as it was dark. WE had been to this place before. It is fine!! We checked in, had a nice place with double beds. We went down to use the pool and hot tub. We really enjoyed having them!! Our bed was comfortable. No complaints at all. I had left my phone charger at a hotel we stayed at the night before. Decided to ask if by any chance, the front desk had any chargers we could borrow. Glad i asked. I guess there are LOTS of people who leave their chargers behind. Thank goodness i asked. The women at the desk were friendly. Bummer that breakfast isn't part of the deal, but the restaurant is a good place to eat. We would definitely stay again.

author: InnChaser
title: Not bad, but not great, either
text: We have stayed here a few times over the past few years and have had varying experiences, from good to disappointing. The lack of consistent quality is disappointing. On the one hand, people at the front desk really try to be accommodating and helpful; on the other hand, there appears to be a real lack of oversight of the housekeeping and maintenance staff. We stayed in the "long" building, as before, but the housekeeping staff are allowed to take their break on the "red porch" end of the building, where cigarette butts overflow the ash can, as do pieces of trash, such as drink cups. The whole area at that end of the building is quite messy and littered with trash. I don't put this on the housekeepers so much as the grounds people. However, because so many of the housekeeping staff are poor and uneducated about the dangers of smoking, they still smoke a lot and that smoke gets sucked into the air ventilation system and into the rooms. Our room, which was fine when we first entered it, smelled like smoke just a few hours later when we came back from a hike and the housekeepers were outside smoking not far from our room. Another annoyance, which could be helped with a new policy, was the revving of ATV engines for over an hour from 7 to 8 a.m. by other guests just a few doors away from us. So, new policies, such as no smoking on premises for staff, no revving of engines for guests, and better clean up of the grounds would make the place more pleasant. Another disappointment is that some of the gym equipment is barely functioning as it was meant to. It almost seems as though the equipment has been picked up second hand, and from our experience, it has been there for years. The Royalty Inn down the street has a much better fitness center and adequate space for it. Finally, we have heard front desk people say tell guests who want to eat at places other than the inn, of some of the mediocre restaurants in town, and not the better ones. Perhaps staff do not know that there are actually some good, classy restaurants, but we suspect they want the guests to be disappointed and to come back to their own restaurant, which is a good one, but has predictable and unexciting fare. The room was adequate, though the television had some streaks going through the picture. The housekeeper was very polite and accommodating. Overall, average, and with a little work, the owners, whom we have met, could really make this better than just a "ho-hum" place.

author: lorig109
title: HAS ALOT TO OFFER
text: I was simply amazed at what they had to offer -- Location Location Location 1.Staff was very friendly and helpful 2. Ask for a room with views of mountains and Golf Course - Just beautiful! 3. Indoor Pool Area - Great for rainy days - snowy days etc. Very Warm - Lots of towels - kids can bring in small floats. Also has a jacuzzi - Sauna and Steam Room - Lots Of Towels 4. Small gym but has just about everything you would want Lots Of Towels 5. Small game room for kids 6. Business Center 7. Nice Restaurant - They do offer a buffett on Sundays and possibly most Saturdays. The breakfast was very good - Also had bread pudding on another occassion very good as well. 8. Bar - Lounge Nice Size and they have entertainment on the weekends. 9. Room had 2 Queen beds - flat screen TV - Plug In for computer - Desk - small table with 2 chairs.- The room was larger than most hotels we have stayed at. 10 Hotel was abit dated but loved everything else : )

author: 533kristah
title: Poor stay somewhere else!
text: I stay in hotels all over the country. Easily in my worst 30 I have stayed in! Will not stay again. Room was not well vacuumed. Had other peoples hair in the tub. Only two but still shows poor cleaning. Blew the breaker in b room with hair dryer, light, and vent on. Weak breaker? An inconvenience when you are soaking wet. Not impressed. Refrigerator and coffee maker on the floor! No table. Breakfast was NOT included with the stay. However it was good and VERY reasonably priced. Under 5$. OJ was over priced @3$ for a small glass. There are two or three other hotels there try a different one.

author: LindaL663
title: Smokey smelling rooms
text: A group of 16 of us went to the T&C for the Easter Seals Ride-In. The rooms were roomy and fairly clean. They had a 2x2x2 foot refrig that sat on the floor which was not very convenient for us older folks to bend down to use. The room had 2 double beds to provide a sleeping place for 4 but had only 2 bath towels in the room. Beds were too hard for my husband, and pillows were quite flat. This room was promised to be a NON SMOKING room but it wreaked of cigarette smoke! I requested a different room and it, too, wreaked of cigarette smoke!! I went back to the front desk to complain and they said they would take care of it. We went snowmobiling for the day and upon our arrival back to our room, it still wreaked of smoke. I sprayed it with Fabreze but that didn't help either. Four of the other 5 rooms our friends had also had the same horrible smell. These 4 rooms were definitely not worth the money we paid as the rooms were not what what we had been promised. On top of that, we had to wash all our clothes when we got home because they, too, smelled like cigarette smoke. I won't stay at this hotel again for fear that this same thing will happen again. And I wouldn't recommend it to anyone who is sensitive to the smell of cigarette smoke.

author: lovetotravelandread
title: not my cup of tea
text: Let me start by saying we called the hotel to make our reservations. Requested to have rooms close to the pool and to be by our friends. We received adjoining rooms. BUT we got the last rooms at the end the farthest away from the pool. I am not talking a shot distance. We were also on the Second floor , no elevators. Not fun when carrying luggage... The indoor pool was freezing cold, and the Jacuzzi was something you would find in someone's basement, 4 person hot tub! Seriously it was awful. The room was good size, bed fairly comfortable. The décor of the room absolutely awful. Dark brown curtains , brown wallpaper simply drab and not a feel good feel at all. The rungs on the chairs were covered with dust. I have read the other reviews, I don't understand how they could rate this place a 5. WOW. The restaurant was excellent. However this is in a different building. You have to go outside to get to it. Also the front desk is in the same building as the restaurant.

author: ballymacoda
title: Trip to the North Country
text: We had not stayed at this Inn in quite some time, and were looking forward to dinner in the restaurant after a long day at Santa's Village with our grandchildren. The hotel is just ok, but, looks quite nice on the outside. We had a 2 bedroom suite, and were amazed at the lack of lighting in the room. Basically, there were no lamps at all...overhead light, 2 wall scones, one floor lamp in the adjacent room, and that was it. Very dark wallpaper and carpeting added to the darkness of the room. We shut the door between our room at night, as my husband snores, and our grandchildren panicked as they could not open the door (big fire hazard) in the am, as there was no door knob between the rooms, and it could only be opened from our side...pretty scary. We looked forward to dinner as we remembered the food being great. What a disappointment. On top of that, it was a weird set-up. You had your regular waitress, and a bar waitress. Two checks..weird. They brought out a loaf of bread, which we remembered being terrific, however, it was stale...my husband said don't say anything...our grandchildren would eat it...they were hungry...I said...could we please have another loaf, as it is kind of hard...another one came out...same thing, but by now, the food was starting to come out. It was mediocre at best. There was a wedding going on at the other end of the dining room with only a partition dividing us, so, you guessed it...we got to listen to Proud Mary, the chicken dance, etc during dinner...lovely... When they took a break, the bar started up...swell...great for conversation. The servers were polite and nice and accommodating as best they could be, but, this establishment needs to get into 2013.

author: oda5432000
title: Secret Jewel
text: Just by chance my wife and I found this lovely 'secret jewel'. We were looking for a place to spend a quite/relaxing night, that was clean, and had a secure location. This was the place, the front desk staff was fabuious, friendly, and offered assistance in all areas. We selected the "meal plan" which I thought was a great value. We had,what I felt was a premium package, and we did . The food and service was "Excellent". Now the best part of this stay: when my wife and I returned to our room, I felt sick. Before I knew it I was. Lucky for me the Office Manager: Catherine King was on duty. She stayed with my wife and I until the papa-medics arrived. Durning this time I felt better and was able to relaxe. We had a good nights sleep in a clean,neat room, that was well maintained. The next morning we departed for home. Upon arrival home(Fla) I had to have surgery, all is well now. I wish to say "Thank You" to the staff/front desk persons: Jackie, Jaylan, Krystal, and Catherine King. You Ladies were "Great" in all aspects of interactions and my wife and I truly were blessed to have you on duty the night of June 5th. If and when we get back to Gorham, N.H., we will be at The Town&Country Inn and Resort. Thank you, Take care.

author: Charlie03045
title: Good on the outside; Poor on the inside
text: I stayed here on Memorial Day Weekend. From the outside, the place looks really nice. Its a big facility with plentity of room for toys. Snowmobiles in the winter, and ATV's in the summer. However, the rooms are old, and in need of remodeling. Our shower was not working properly, and there were cobwebs hanging from the ceiling. In addition, I had to fix the sink. The stopper would not go up and down easily. Maintanence came and put on a new shower head, but that wasn't the problem. I knew that, and told them so. I've stayed here before, and it wasn't this bad. The place is tired, and needs some work. The indoor pool was cloudy; it didn't look clean. It was raining, and the roof was leaking into the pool. It could be a nice place, but they need to spend a little money on the place. We didn't use the restaurant on this trip.

author: 574AnnM574
title: Be careful what room you get
text: This facility presents quite well from curb appeal. The lobby, check in staff and general areas are quite nice. BUT--they have different levels of accomodations. Unfortunately, we arrived later at night and didn't know about the difference--nor were we told. There is an ancillary building to the west of the main complex, and it is old, with no elevator, and hard to access. After 'lugging our luggage' up the flight of stairs we discovered a very old dated room, old TV, no chairs other than the 'hard backed' chairs at the desk. the most disappointing aspect was the quality of the beds. The heat did not work, we called the front desk and they "reset it" and after about 15 minutes the room warmed up. The beds were the real problem, they were hard--we enjoy a harder bed, but this was beyond the limit. The bedding itself is very worn and old, some of it was torn and may have been in the place since the 1960's which must have been the vintage of the building. The pillows need replacing, basically two really really hard rocks, and the towels are worn out. I don't know if this facilities other buildings are nicer, but you don't want to be in the 'far west seperate building'. BTW, the room we had was no less expensive than was any other room, so we didn't get some sort of a deal. Breakfast was not included, but we did eat at their restaurant. It was just okay-- extra charge for 'real maple syrup' of $1.75 for a small ( 1 ounce +/- ) bottle. Rather disappointing policy on a somewhat pricey breakfast. I think in the future we would stay in North Conway. Best advice, unless you really want to stay in Gorham, better to try to stay at the Royal Motel--in their new section-- or better yet stay in North Conway, It is difficult to give much more of a positive recommendation for Town and Country in Gorham, NH. Sorry!

author: Johnny1262
title: Good value, and great staff.
text: We spent 3 nights in at this Inn, and were overall pleased with our stay. We found the Inn while trying to find a place, on the internet, to stay near Mt. Washington. We were pleasantly surprised with the Inn as we had driven past many other motels on our drive up that were in sad need of care. The grounds are beautifully maintained. The buildings themselves are old, but well maintained and updated. Great location for day trips to various natural wonders of the area. We had an incident with our room when we checked in, but the manager (Tyler) and another employee (forgive me for forgetting your name) came in and rectified the situation immediately, and gave us 2 free breakfasts to make up for the error. We were overall happy with the room size, except the bathroom was quite tight, close to cruise ship tight. The diningroom is affordable and the food off the regular menu is quite delicious. I had the ricotta cheese stuffed eggplant which was good in it's presentation and taste. If you eat breakfast there off the regular menu, spring for the extra 1.75 for authentic VT Maple syrup. It's worth it! With that said, the breakfast buffet left us feeling less than satisfied. The prepared too much food at one time, so when we ate, the food was dried out. The highlight of our stay there was the staff. They did everything they could to make sure our trip was enjoyable, responding to our every request with a can do attitude, and a smile. You can not go wrong by staying here when in Gorham.

author: JOJO1260
title: Stayed there with child the last 3 years
text: I am writing this review as i have read some of the others and feel that you deserve another Positive one. I have stayed at your Motor Inn/Resort the past 3 years. I have a 6 year old boy and we have been vacationing up in the White Mtns, for the past few years and we stayed at your place the last 3 of them!! One time we stayed at another motel/hotel one town up even more North, but found it very lackluster and not much to do in the Town and not many restaurants. However, every time my family which consists of me, my little boy and his Dad have stayed at your place, we really liked it. The pricing is reasonable and our views from our comfortable and clean room were excellent! We stay there to go to Santa's Village as well as other attractions in the summer. My little boy loved your pool and had a blast in there last summer with his Dad. (Mom relaxed in the room with a book) :-) As for the restaurant we only had breakfast there last summer but found the omelettes, pancakes and everything delicious and the Staff, were so friendly and nice. We had a young server who was just so nice and down to earth and even the hostess who sat us was a pleasure. We had dinner in previoius years there in the dinning room and found it very good as well and our waitress was like a Nana when speaking to our son. I would recommend this place to youg couples or families with children. Lots to do and see and near alot of the Great White Mountain Attractions. Only one little negative thing was the mattresses are a bit uncomfortable. Maybe they need new ones or mattress toppers on them to soften them up? I will be staying there again this Summer as my son loves it there and so do his Mom & Dad!! :-)

author: grinnellma
title: Clean and Basic
text: My husband and I are currently in our room. We're only here for 1 night. The toilet takes 2 flushes when just used in a basic way. The door knob to the bathroom was loose. (My husband had a screw driver with him so he tightened it.) The 2 full size beds are very uncomfortable. They are very squeaky and the springs can be felt. A mattress pad would help a little if there was one on. The decor is very dated. The room pictured on their website is not what we got. We both had a full size suitcase because we are staying in a different New England area each night for the week. It was difficult managing our things up the stairs to the 2nd floor room that we have. Luckily, my husband is strong and managed both. The 2nd floor rooms are not good for older people with limited ability so people should remember to ask for a 1st floor room. Overall, the room is clean and has the basics and nice for the price. Next Fall we will be staying at a different place. It's fine but on vacation we just want a little more at the end of the day. I don't feel comfortable giving a 4 star or 5 star review. I save those for places that go above and beyond the basics.

author: bb125_11
title: Will not stay here again.
text: Our room looked nothing like the pictures on the website. Our room was outdated and had a funny smell (mixture of smoke and must). We were in a non smoking, but apparently people are allowed to smoke right outside the room (on the deck) so the smell of smoke ends up in your room, or you need to walk through it to get to you room. The worst part are the beds. The MOST uncomfortable bed and pillows ever. Please update your beds and bedding...that would make the other things bearable. Also, weird stain on the boxspring...please clean these or buy a bedskirt. The restaurant staff was very nice. Warning: you will be paying for every cup of coffee you order...no complimentary refills here. Food was just OK. Also, an extreme inconvenience-no irons in the room. When we called the desk for one, they said, "We are all out right now". Great. Definitely not going back here. We wanted to change rooms, but motel was fully booked. We cut our stay short because we could not bear another night there. The place has potential, especially if they updated everything and got more comfortable beds and pillows.

author: motions
title: Beautiful Motel and the Dining Package was excellent.
text: We just returned from a 2 night stay and had a lovely experience. We came to the area to go Whitewater Rafting in Milan and this location was just 20 minutes away. First, the rooms are very large and clean. I was suprised as to the size of the rooms, (we fit a rollaway that was provided at no additonal fee), and still had plenty of walking room. The property is completely updated and it appeared to have all new rugs/wallpaper and decorations, also super clean through out! The pool was heated and warm and the jacuzzi was a nice size and we loved it. Also, always plenty of towels. Gym was large and had plenty of work out equipment. As for the dining, we were a party of 6 with 2 rooms and had the meal plan, that included breakfast and dinner, off of the full menu. Both nights I had the Baked Lobster and it was excellent. My family had delicous meals as well, and we were definately impressed. The Breakfast was Amazing, best breakfast in a long while. Large quantities and delicous. Also coffee was real good. Service was fine. Lastly, the front desk staff was exceptionally pleasant, from the making of the reservation to the lovely woman who checked us out. Overall, we do not have one negative thing to say! Great place to stay!!

author: BVG1971
title: Not impressed
text: street appeal-2of5 bed-2of5 bath-3of5 bfast-3of5 staff-2of5 Reserved a Queen non smoking room. Upon arrival the teenager who couldn't care less put us into a smoking double. We called down and he found another room. Hauled all our stuff out. Went to the front desk and as he was giving me my keys i said "thats a Queen no smoking right ?" he still had not looked at my reservation and stuffed us in another smoking room, Eventually, we have our keys and end up in the room with 1 "double" bed and a 1982 TV 19". called the manager. he hunted around and eventually found a queen. three times we had to move our luggage. very unhappy with this place. 2nd disappointing visit. will never go back. they don't have any true queen beds. they are all doubles or fulls. its another example of cheap hotels trying to sell you something they don't have. oh and don't fall for the nice room pictures on their website.

author: LoganandPaige1218
title: Great Place to stay run by Great People!
text: Stayed here for the first time this past Tuesday night with my husband and two children (9 and 6) for our trip to Santa's Village. The location was beautiful. Right near downtown Gorham, but not smack in the middle so you had beautiful views all around. The room was enormous! Probably the biggest room we've ever stayed in, which was shocking since it was the best price. $88.00 triple A rate. The staff were so friendly especially to my 6 year old daughter who LOVED the attention. They have an indoor heated pool 3/5/and 8 feet which is open until 11 pm. This is great after a long day at the park. There was also a hot tub, sauna, steam room and small arcade. The onsite resturaunt serves breakfast and dinner. We did not eat dinner there, although I wish we had. We did have breakfast there and it was delicious. Even the coffee was great, and I'm very picky about my coffee. I think it was about a 15 minute drive from Santa's Village and that was fine. There are places closer (across the street), but Gorham is the better place to be anyway. The staff was even nice when we were checking out. I tried to purchase a few postcards for the kids and they insisted the kids take them as a gift. We will be back :)

author: laner483
title: Great package stay
text: Our stay at the Town & Country Motor Inn was excellent. We brought our snowmobiles to the inn and signed up for the 2-night snowmobile package. The rooms were very clean. The trail was conveniently accessible to the hotel. The pool/hot-tub area was clean. The package included dinner and breakfast. The food was excellent. The package entitles you to the dinner offerings on their menu. That included prime rib and lobster. Breakfast was a full breakfast, not continental. When you consider the cost of eating out while away from home, it is an excellent value. We were very pleased with our stay. The hotel is dated. That's apparent. However, it was clean, the staff was very friendly and attentive, and the food was excellent. We will be going back.

author: fiona1006
title: Blissful honeymoon hotel
text: Our agent had recommended this hotel to us as part of our honeymoon trip, as a getaway from Cape Town. We had been really spoilt here at mosaic lagoon lodge, and it is a once in a lifetime experience for us! As a frequent traveler both for fun and work, I’ve stayed at many 5 star hotels all over the world. The level of service and friendliness here, has been one of the best that I’ve encountered so far. The lodge only has 5 rooms so you are on first name basis with everyone. As soon as we arrived, we were wowed by the amazing view of the lagoon. Our attendant Moses has been amazing, always cheerful and ensuring we are having a good time. Every time when we came back from an excursion, we were greeted by a cocktail and a big smile. All the staff here, from the host to the chef, were amazingly friendly. My husband lost his iPhone on one of the car rides, and a few of the staff went out to help him retrieve it (we found it in the end). We had Billy as our tour guide - he was amazing, really knew his stuff, and always attentive to our needs. My husband wanted to go fishing and he went out of the way to get us worms and fish rods for a fishing trip! We especially loved the walk on the beach - it’s so beautiful, so secluded; the sand is so white and soft. We were also especially impressed that the staff went out of the way to let guests have a special Christmas. We were here for Christmas Eve and checked out Christmas Day, and the lodge organized a special Christmas dinner (with personalized menu), left a Christmas present in our room, and also a boat cruise for all the guests on Christmas Day! It was very kind of them to go the extra mile to make us feel special on Christmas. This place may not be for everyone - you really feel like you are in the middle of nature (there will be some bugs and wifi is weak/not available at half the places). But for anyone who wants to disconnect, needs a city break, or just want a beautiful place to spend a few days, we highly recommend it!

author: MorePlay
title: Luxurious and rustic
text: We visited Mosaic as a family (two kids, 8 and 6). We all had a brilliant time and the staff couldn't have been more friendly and accommodating. I had been a bit apprehensive about taking our kids to such an upmarket place but I needn't have been. They really enjoyed themselves and my 6 year daughter asked if we could come back the following weekend. Saying that - if your kids are noisy or exuberant, it could be quite difficult as nearly all guests are adults and specifically couples - young and old. There's only one family room in the lodge. People eat in a cosy space and having noisy kids jumping around would be pretty awful and most guests would not like it one bit. Tough for the parents too - unless they are the inconsiderate type. There are excellent activities to do - quad biking, cayaking, walking, cycling, beach, visiting Stanford (with its excellent lunch options). Families stay in unit 2. It's a large room with a main bed and the kid's bed on a slightly raised platform. Very cosy. My wife had a massage - she's quite fussy about massages but she really enjoyed this one so they must have done something right. Looking forward to going again - once we have saved up enough. It's not cheap.

author: bvmay
title: Wonderful Lodge. Family LOVED it!
text: We stayed in the family room for 3 nights a couple weeks ago and we were VERY happy with our stay. The room, amenities, staff, food and activities were perfect. Its is about a 10 km drive from downtown stanford on a dirt road that feels like you are heading to nowhere, but when you arrive it is like a small oasis. Check-in took about 10 minutes and a quick tour of the lodge was all that we needed. The room was very elegant and they had thought of every detail imaginable. A stocked fridge with plenty of drinks and a bottle of local red wine were waiting. We took an afternoon trip to the beach where there was a large group of whales breaching about 1000 ft from the shore. A nice selection of snacks and drinks were served on the dunes. During our stay we also took an ATV ride which the kids really enjoyed. There were also several other activities we could have done during our stay, but we opted to go shark cage diving with the great white sharks and whale watching instead. All meals were included, all meals were delicious and nicely presented. Drinks were also included so there were really no hidden expenses (other than the massages that my wife and daughter signed up for at the on site spa). I can not say enough about how great the stay was. Plenty of things to do, great food and even better staff. I would highly recommend a stay here to anyone including families with older children, mine are 9 and 10 and it was perfect for them!!

author: tavener-Smith
title: Perfect Engagement
text: What a fantastic place! Hidden away at the end of a dirt road near to Stanford, is this beautiful lodge. On arrival we had a very friendly welcome by the staff, who kindly took our bag to our cottage for us and offered a lovely welcome drink. The lodge is surrounded by beautiful milkwood trees and a wooden boardwalk between the cottages and main lodge area. Our particular cottage had a stunning view directly to the mountains and lagoon. Spacious and very comfortable large bed, with all the needed amenities. The food at the lodge was fantastic, lunch had great portion sizes and variety and dinner offered a brilliant 3 course menu - we chose. the goats cheese tart, beef fillet and creme brulee, which were extremely good! To top that off the restaurant has incredible views across the magnificent mountains and lagoon. There is an extensive choice of drinks, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, the house wines and spirits included in the all inclusive price were of a very high quality. The service of the waiting and bar staff was extremely attentive and friendly, where nothing was too much trouble. The biggest surprise was the romantic turn-down on arrival back to our room after dinner. A hot bath with amazing smelling bath salts, a candlelit pathway and petals scattered around the room..and last but not least a bottle of sparkling wine on ice! We can honestly say, this was an extremely special stay and such a treat for us...the perfect place to ask my girlfriend to spend the rest of our lives together. The only negative is that next time we would stay longer so we could do some of the many guided activities offered such as 4x4 drive or quad biking! We will definitely be back very soon!

author: PeterGX2
title: SUBLIME
text: We've been readers of Tripadvisor reviews for many years and have used them to plan our many vacations around the world but never actually written a review ,until now. The Mosaic Lagoon Lodge is a very special place. From the moment we arrived when we received a very special welcome to the time we reluctantly had to leave , we had the most magical time . The rooms all connected by walkways to the main reception, lounge and dining areas . They are well appointed with stunning views of the lagoon and the mountains. They are authentically built in an African safari style with local materials and thatched roofs and are extremely comfortable . The accommodation is all inclusive of meals and drinks with a fully stocked minibar. There are number of activities included in the tariff which you can find details of on the Lodge website. We thoroughly enjoyed the quad biking although neither of us had any previous experience. The beautiful unspoilt beach was accessible by cycling or being driven in the Lodge 4x4. It was a wonderful venue for Sundowners (drinks and nibbles) before a sumptuous dinner. With cruising on the lagoon, walks to the Spookhouse, kayaking, visits to the caves etc etc. ., there is plenty to fill the day. The reason the Mosaic Lodge is so special lies in the virtues of ALL the staff and their very warm and caring nature . Nothing is too much trouble for them and they are always on hand to help in anyway they can. Thoroughly recommended and we'll definitely be back !

author: HelenSmeaton
title: Beautiful lagoon lodge near Stanford
text: Spent 3 nights at Mosaic staying in the 5 star all inclusive lagoon lodge at the end of a fabulous 50th birthday holiday to South Africa, our first visit to this amazing country. We were pampered beyond expectation with all the staff/hospitality being exceptional in their attention towards us. We had just completed an epic bike ride in the Swartberg mountains, so this was my treat staying in a place surrounded by nature and simple tranquillity where I could practice yoga and simply chill out. The activities were not high on my priority list, but we enjoyed the kayaking and the trip to Walker Bay. Sadly the wind was too strong for a lagoon cruise to watch the sunset. On looking up at the mountain opposite our lodge on the first day, we asked if we could climb it, thinking it would be private land and therefore impossible. But Marcelliano, the manager, promptly arranged it for us with the owners of the private nature reserve near Hermanus and we had a fabulous 5 hour hike on our last day - justifying all the amazing food and wine we had consumed on the previous two days! The staff gave us a bag of goodies to munch on the hike as we had an early start to beat the heat. You can eat lunch either at the Lodge or the Spookhuis which is an equally lovely setting 3km down the dirt road. The lodge accommodation is truly luxurious with gorgeous Rain products, candles in the bathroom and an outdoor shower, a huge comfy bed and a mini bar stocked with whatever we needed. The champagne on our last night was a lovely touch and all the food, whether breakfast, lunch or dinner was excellent. The only reason I have not given 5 stars is that our final afternoon was slightly spoiled by a young family staying at the Lodge. This suprised me as the lodges are really aimed at couples wanting peace and quiet and having two toddlers tearing around the place and screaming at the top of their voices in the plunge pool (when we really wanted to chill out there after our hike) was not what we expected. We could even hear them in our room when we retired after a late lunch to get some peace. Mosaic lagoon lodge is a beautiful haven away from the real world. I would suggest that it should be a toddler free zone as, had we stayed only one night, we would not have been able to enjoy the tranquiillity of the setting. Many thanks to all the staff for their incredible service.

author: aliaslili
title: Hospitality, location and good food meet luxury!
text: We decided to stay 3 nights at Mosaic Lagoon Lodge in Stanford to discover Hermanus. We came for the whale season. The place is secluded and amazing. You drive 10 km on bumpy road to arrive in paradisiac location, surrounded by stunning landscape and nature. Birds singing, flowers everywhere and views to die for. The small and romantic cottages are amazing. They have a big bathroom with a huge bath and an external shower. In the time we visited, the weather was a little bit cold and to be honest it was a challenge to open the warm water and jump quickly under the shower head to avoid the chilly wind ;-). The rangers are great and will propose you all kind of activities. We did the quad excursion (so fun) and the drive to the beach (amazing views on the whales in the sea). You will be pampered by the lovely and friendly staff, they are really in guest hospitality, nothing is fake, they like what they do and you can feel it. Be prepared to be fed like a turkey before Christmas, they just don’t stop, from morning to late evening, until you call for mercy. And the food is just not only food, the quality is AMAZING. The chef should be working in a Michelin’s restaurant: his ideas and the preparation are top (slow cooking, juice reduction, …). We told him but wanted to say it again on Tripadvisor, we had the best beef ever (we’re 42 years old). Won’t say here what they did for our anniversary but it was amazing. Thanks again. Hope to be back one day.

author: danv327
title: Great weekend!
text: My partner and I spent two nights at the Milkwood Cottage 1 in January 2014. Upon arrival we both knew that only good things awaited for us there. We had an amazing time in the reserve. The room was bigger than expected, with a clever layout and plenty of space to move around. The kitchen area had all the utensils and cutlery required, everything sparkling clean. The shower too was spacious and the window allowed for a nice flow of air. The only two things missing were air conditioner (not a fan) and a TV set. I appreciate the fact that people go to the Mosaic private sanctuary to enjoy the tranquility and the offering of the amazing nature but I feel one can combine those offerings of nature with watching TV specially since i am a tennis fanatic and it was the time of the Australian Open. I think there should be a TV in every room. Saturday morning we went on a quad biking ride with the highly professional Marcelino who took us for a spectacular drive around the reserve.
