The privacy of the villa is one of the main advantages. The complimentary afternoon tea is a nice touch. The free private shuttle taxi is very handy. Kayumanis has a small private beach. Only thing missing there is an outdoor shower. Overall we did enjoy our stay, but we are not sure we would come back again.

author: TanTekkTyann
title: Best of Bali!
text: Firstly I would like thank all the staff like Bagus, Jeanny, Eka, Yuda, Devi, etc. at Kayumanis Nusa Dua for their warm smiles, hospitality and help they gave my Wife and I during our stay. It is ultimately the people that makes an establishment stand out. Some may have the best and newest infrastructure but it's the people that makes it special. This is the Kayumanis Nusa Dua. This is a nice quiet and peaceful establishment with around 18 villas where you can rest and relax. Breakfast can be served at ANYTIME so you never have to rush to make breakfast hour. Sun rise breakfast by the beach was wonderful under the big umbrella. Staff are always there ready to help you with anything you need and they REMEMBER. For example, my Wife really likes the shampoo they provide but all they had in the gift shop was the travel size type so I asked if I could buy it in 1 litre bottles for use at home. Bagus simply smiled and said he will look into it even though it's not a usual request. Days passed by and I thought they forgot about it. But upon check out they asked if still I wanted it and lo and behold there it was. A one litre custom filled bottle of shampoo for us. This is what makes this place stand out! We are so happy with our stay and will probably be back in near future with our family! Thanks to everyone at Kayumanis once again.. ;)

author: AnnaL10408
title: The best!
text: It was our first time in Bali and it was hard enough to convince my husband to come visit (he later revealed to me that he would have proposed to me in Bali as his mind has been changed since!). We stayed back in September 2015 and still remains as one of our favourite stays to date. As soon as we stepped foot in Kayumanis, my husband was mind-blown and gobsmacked at our different Bali actually was compared to what he thought it was like! We only stayed for about 4 days in a one bedroom villa. From pick up at the airport (when we randomly came across our driver in the unlikely of places after looking for him for 30 minutes!!), to my husband eating all the cinnamon cookies (they topped off the cookies EVERY NIGHT for us!). Even the shampoo and body wash smelt amazing. The pool was huge, and the separated living space was great - we had our amazing breakfasts there every day except one morning we wanted to have it outdoors, and they moved all our furniture for us, including the heavy marble table! The afternoon tea was SO good. We arrived late to the accommodation and we decided to have something to eat for dinner. We couldn't believe how delicious the food was! Their hospitality was fantastic and even saw a squirrel one morning. We never saw anyone during our stay - and we went in and out of Kayumanis a lot. We borrowed their bikes to ride down to the beach. We had the sunrise breakfast at the beach which was just beautiful and memorable. Thank you Kayumanis for changing my husband's mind about Bali!

author: 744parisw
title: Unforgettable bittersweet memories there.....
text: We came here to Bali for Christmas as I'm in my second trimester so Bali was just an easy option for us. Last Bali trip we stayed at St Regis and definitely enjoyed the experience sooo much. This time we tried Kayumanis for the first time as its got great reviews online and ppl mentioned that it's exclusive and quiet, that's exactly what we were looking for. Honestly the villa is spacious but a little worn out, however we really enjoyed the pool, the separate living room area....the bed was really comfy, big and I liked the hardness of the mattress! The outdoor bathroom is sth I'd imagine "not for everyone", although after a few days, we started to learn to enjoy it. The first few nights, I was terrified by the gigantic ants roaming around on the toilet seats. It's definitely got a lot of "life" there, three huge snails constantly moving across the shower floor each night, mosquitos, moths, a lot going on..... I'm not a fan of insects, so it did take us a good 4-5 days to get used to this nature part! The staff were very well trained, most speak good English and very attentive! They all have genuine smiles and are just truly friendly people! Drivers who provide free shuttle are also communicative and polite! People were great! My husband is usually very hard to please, the first few nights he was complaining a lot, but by the end of our trip he said next time we could try Kayumanis at other locations, that, I can say...... Kayumanis did a great job! Our bittersweet encounter with our stray kitten Ubud, it was really an unforgettable experience in our life, if anyone of you see him (a small skinny pale yellow kitten), please let us know as we are still trying to find him....He came to our villa in the evening of Christmas day, and ever since it completely changed our lives...... Hotel staff was great help! We thank you for everything! Hope to see you soon!

author: robertdG8465KR
title: The jewel in the crown for your vacation
text: Recently spent a romantic weekend and birthday at Kayumanis Nusa Dua. From the airport pickup to leaving we had the most exceptional holiday experience. The airport pickup, courtesy of Kayumanis, started with the friendly driver offering us a cold towel and bottle of water. I recommend trying the cookies provided in the vehicle, they are great. The cookies also make a reappearance in the villa, the jar refilled every day. The welcome at reception and personal service from your own 'butler' makes for a very enjoyable stay. Nothing is too much for them. All staff are friendly and helpful. Breakfast, in your villa or at the restaurant is available when you are ready for it. This flexibility allows one to enjoy breakfast when it suits you, yes, anytime in the 24 hours of a day, where else can you get this. Here are too many superlatives too mention in a review but the beach is down a path, 660 steps from our villa, yes I counted them. If you do not wish to walk then collect a bike from reception and cycle down. The beach club and bar are on a private section of the beach and it is a great place to relax for a while. We stayed in villa Gamal which was perfect, from the tasteful furnishings to being able to open the bedroom sliding doors and walk straight into the pool. High tea can be served at the villa if you wish and means one does not need to go to the restaurant. Privacy is assured in the villa and allows one to truly relax. A special thanks to Eka who "organised" my birthday cake. It is those small things that make this place so enjoyable. If it were possible to provide a 6 rating then I would do so for Kayumanis Nusa Dua and its staff, thank you for a very pleasurable weekend. We will definitely be back, sooner rather than later.

author: michellekelley89
title: private relaxing tranquility
text: The hotel is absolutely lovely & private. Ideal place to just relax and enjoy the tranquility of the private pools in each villa. There are only 20 villas at this resort so they have the ability to cater to any of your personal needs. I had a warm stone massage and another 2 hour massage during my stay and they were both great. The only thing I had to get used to was showering and using the bathroom outside of the villa. The bathrooms are attached to the villa but they are outside. The only negative comment I have is the mosquitos. They are everywhere. This resort is surrounded by trees & water so the mosquitos are expected. Its worse when it rains. Bring plenty of bug spray. The resort also has spray in each villa to address the mosquitos. It helps that the beds are surrounded in netting to help avoid mosquito bites while sleeping. Overall this was a great resort. The food was actually pretty good as well. The free breakfast was great day as well. I'd definitely visit Kayumanis again.

author: wht52
title: luxurious quiet and private place to stay
text: Staying at Kayumanis from 20 to 29 July 2016 was a great new experience in spending our holidays. This place is perfect for couples who seek privacy and cosiness within a beautiful environment. The whole concept of Kayumanis is to make you feel very special. The private villas are spacious and you have everything you need, including daily refilled mini bar, plenty bottles of water, home made cookies, and a fresh fruit basket. Otherwise just dial "5" to get anything you wish to the villa, served to you with a smile. Breakfast á la carte in the restaurant or at your villa any time you like. The food is delicious. Anything what is not on the menu can be changed to your liking. You may also enjoy a small private beach just some minutes to walk towards the sea, where the big hotels are located. There you can enjoy the sun or shaded place with a Kayumanis beach bar. Food or drinks are delivered from the Kayumanis kitchen. Just a few words for the big hotels - there are like everywhere else, noisy with too many people on too little space. We loved returning from the beach walk back to our Kayumanis oasis, watching the squirrels dashing up and down the trees. The resort is 12 years old, but well maintained. Time has left some wear on some facilities. All in all we can recommend Kayumanis and would definitely return again. We are thankful for the lovely time!

author: Hollywood1973
title: It's good, but not the best....
text: Decided on a quick getaway at last minute and couldn't get a good rate at the Mulia Villa's but wanted to stay in Nusa Dua area. Have stayed in many fantastic resorts over the years, but our first stay at Kayumanis. We opted for this based purely on the feedback and reviews from the trusted Tripadvisor community. Email communication prior to the trip was good. The use of the hotel car around the local area and airport transfer is great and considering the property is only some 16 villa's we foundwe never had to wait. Even when we checked out the car was out but they had prepaid a taxi and it was waiting for us. Nice touch. The staff are fantastic, can't say enough about these great people. The food was ok, not great as other reviews state. We found the breakfast menu a little limited compared to places such as the Mulia (even though the price is similar). The afternoon tea was not up to speed of many other properties but it was ok. As we booked late, they did upgrade us to a two bedroom villa which has a nice size pool, a little dated in furnishings and an odd layout. The living room was in another cabana seperate from the main bedroom but did not have toilet facilities. So if you were watching tv, having a meal etc you had to walk out and over to the other cabana to use the toilet/bathroom. The thing that we really noticed was the very average wifi set-up and limited tv options which unfortunately during our stay had issues which affected the viewing of many stations. At over $600 AUD per night (when you add it all up), I think better properties exist for us, but different people like different things. Take a chance, but maybe split your stay up if you don't come to Bali much. Overall, a really good stay was had. Avoid two bedroom villas as they are close to the road and a little noisey if seeking solitude.

author: TiffanyCunliffe
title: 5 star experience
text: We traveled to Bali for our 10th wedding anniversary. We stayed at the Kayumanis Nusa Dua. We had a fabulous time. Service at the resort was outstanding. Even prior to arriving in Bali they communicated with us to make sure we had everything we needed upon arrival. Staff took care of our every need. Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. The villas were private and luxurious and exceeded our expectations. We would definitely recommend Kayumanis Nusa Dua to any couple looking for a relaxing getaway. We loved our experience there. When we arrived at the airport in Bali we were greeted by the Kayumanis driver, Beny; he was very friendly and helpful. Later in the week Beny was once again able to take us on a day tour from Nusa Dua to Ubud. We saw so many wonderful sites along our day tour and Beny took care of every detail. We made stops to see Balinese dancers, batik collection, Batuan temple, Kintamani restaurant with gorgeous views of Mt. Batur, Tegalalang rice terraces, and the Monkey Forest in Ubud. He was an efficient driver and he led the way so we didn't have to worry about a thing. He answered all of our questions and truly made the tour a wonderful and memorable experience. If you find yourself at Kayumanis definitely request Beny for a tour of Bali!

author: JackP1989
title: The Best Hotel I've Ever Stayed In
text: Kayumanis Nusa Dua truly is the best hotel I've ever stayed in across the world. It's concept is that of pure luxury in amazing surroundings. Before flying to Bali I had arranged a pick up from the airport, completely complementary. When we were picked up by Beny who was our driver and was fantastic from our arrival to our departure, he really set the precedent for the experience we were going to have st Kayumanis. He carried our bags to the car, got in and gave us cold towels and ice cold bottles of water. The welcome at the hotel was just as good, we were shown around everywhere and had all elements of our private villa explained thoroughly leaving us with hardly any questions. The room itself is fantastic, pools are much bigger than they look online and stay a lovely temperature to cool off from the sun. Outside bathroom was different but enjoyed the experience of it! The staff are what makes this hotel as special as it is, we were always told "welcome home" whenever we came back to the hotel, then asked us by name how we were, just impeccable service. Kayumanis has truly thought of everything a paying customer may need or desire. Along with the free airport pick up they also operate a complementary car service that will drop and pick you up anywhere within Nusa Dua and Jimbaran between until 10:30pm which will save you a lot of money in taxis. Food at the hotel is fantastic with breakfast and high tea included in the price. Both available to call reception and have delivered to your room. Breakfast range is brilliant and is unlimited so feel free to order as much as you'd like! The high tea was a great benefit in the afternoon with the ice coffee being sent to you. All in all this hotel may be small in comparison to every other hotel in the Nusa Dua resort but in my opinion it allows the staff to focus on the fewer amount of guests they have and deliver the incredible service that they do. Please continue working the way you do as we will definitely be back in the future. Bapak Jack and Bapak Dominic 😊

author: Traveller940834
title: A wonderful stay
text: We stayed at the Kayumanis in the last week of January and very much enjoyed it. The villa was in incredible shape. I also very much appreciated the privacy that it offered. The service was very personal, unlike the other gignatic resorts nearby. Breakfast was delicious. Try the banana pancake. It is actually more of a crepe. The afternoon tea was a delight. They changed it up a little bit everyday. The transportation was seamless. We went to Jimbaran Bay for seafood dinner twice. The staff was all wonderful. They did everything with care. We love the experience so much that we are planning another visit at their other locations (maybe Sanur or Ubud). Love G & H

author: YappiesX
title: Just perfect
text: This was our first trip to Bali and had no clue which area to stay but this private villa made up for what the location was lacking. It was private, quiet and so relaxing.... compared to all the big resorts surrounding us. The villa was the perfect size, huge comfortable bed to sleep in, huge pool for 2 ppl to laze about all day and the garden layout made you feel like you were in your own private sanctuary. The breakfast was nice as you could order as much as you like of what you like. High tea was a nice touch when we weren't out on an excursion. Hotel staff organise everything for you and always happy to oblige, fast and friendly. The nusa dua beach isn't great but it was nice to have it close by so you could go for a night stroll. Unfortunately the Italian restaurant and room service food was... I'm sorry to say terrible. Cold gluggy pasta, tough beef, frozen pizza bases. The restaurant itself was beautiful and staff was nice but the food wasn't made by an Italian chef and the quality of ingredients was poor. However there are heaps of other restaurants in Nusa Dua so we pretty much ate out after the first day. Spa was nice, resort prices but clean and relaxing.... very convenient when you just want to stay in your villa all day which is what we craved after day trips to semiyak and ubud. Highly recommended if you want a place to truly unwind and relax.

author: Han5844
title: Luxurious
text: Stayed at Kayumanis Nusa Dua from 12-16 January 2016, it was a lovely experience overall. The villa was very spacious with separate living room and bedroom. Check-in was done in the private villa itself, which was quite fast and convenient. The private swimming pool was very huge that i could swim a few laps everyday, the biggest private swimming pool among all villas i have ever stayed at before. The resort provided return airport transfer and free shuttle to Jimbaran/Nusa Dua area, with free mineral water and cookies in each vehicle. My friend arranged for a surprise birthday treat for me, hence upon arrival, the villa was beautifully decorated with flower petals in the pool and bath tub, the staffs who brought in a birthday cake also sang the birthday song along, which was nice. A 30-minute complimentary welcome massage was really great that 30 minutes felt like such a short time. However, prior to that we have already arranged for 2-hour spa package which includes foot bath, body scrub, body massage and wine bath. It was quite pricey but the they did really good job at the spa. The staffs were all very friendly and helpful, always greeted us with smiles on the face and would do everything possible to make our stay a memorable one. The service provided is exactly what you expected from a 5-star resort. However, the beach is quite a distance from the resort itself, and the private beach owned by the resort is almost the same size as our villa. One of the downside is that they dont have comfortable waiting lounge for guests who either arrive earlier than check-in time or check out late while waiting for their airport transfer, since the weather is very hot and you'll be drenched in sweat while waiting at the lobby area. Also, the resort could have improved the menu in the restaurants for in-house dining as there were very limited options of meals available. Otherwise, we have a good time at Kayumanis.

author: Enricorbe
title: 2 wonderful days in Kayumanis Nusa Dua
text: For the price and service, no doubt the best in Nusa Dua. Everywhere we go in Nusa Dua (Geger Beach, Jari Menari, Bali Collection and Bumbu Bali), we never took a cab coz they provided a private car for each and every guest (1 car per villa). They will just ask you what time you wanted to be picked up. The villa was perfect. Pool size was enough, depth was 1.5m. We were there Dec 18-20 2015 and surprisingly we don't get any mosquito issues. There is a turn down service every night where staff will light mosquito sticks and prepare your bed. Also, management says they are doing this smoke thing to repel mosquitoes every 5pm but we hardly noticed it all. Kudos to the management making it mosquito free while not disturbing any guest while doing it so. The breakfast was the best we ever had anywhere in southeast Asia. You could order a lot as well and have an option to have it served in your villa or in the restaurant anytime of the day. According to my wife, eggs Benedict was very similar to the one she had on Paris. The only problem was 3 days was not enough. We can't wait to try Kayumanis Ubud next time. and if ever we will come back in Nusa Dua, will definitely stay at Kayumanis again.

author: ThitiratHoyle
title: Unforgettable memory!!
text: It's the first time of me and my husband in Bali and we have to say it's beyond happiness for choosing Kayumanis Nusa Dua Private Villa. Since first step we reached airport was welcome by Erna, she's so happy and share her happiness to us and made the first impression to us already. The villa made us feel Woww!! Big pool and beautiful villa just for both of us, so private and truly relax. Eka, the butler always taking care of us. The villa is not right by the sea but we can walk and they is Kayumanis beach club right by the sea. We always get the bike from the resort to bike along the sea which continue with lots of 5stars resort on the Nusa Dua beach and we were welcome to dine and drink with them everywhere. There is free shuttle service to-from airport and to Nysa Dua area and We had a chance to go Jimbaran beach for dinner which is very nice place. We had breakfast by the pool everyday, what a life!! And afternoon high tea by the pool too. Last night was our wedding anniversary which we booked for Candle light dinner package. Our villa was decorated with many candles and tons of roses in the pool. Can't believe my eyes how beautiful it is! And thx Tana for taking care of our dinner. We have to give compliment to the chefs too, all meals we had were delicious especially Siap Meplecing.. We had to order again and again even changed a bit of candle light menu to be this one too. And I have Asian prawn porridge, I just ordered for breakfast everyday, so yummy. Thank you all Kayumanis team who made our trip so wonderful. 5days 4nights here seems too short and don't wanna leave here.

author: travelwithwine
title: Honeymoon Bliss
text: Just returned from an unforgettable honeymoon stay at Kayumanis in Nusa Dua. Our villa, named Waru and its surroundings exceeded our expectations. On arrival we were in awe of the serenity and welcoming smiles from the Kayumanis team - they are all so friendly and accommodating. The villa was clean, spacious and oh so quiet. We spent many days relaxing at our private pool or cycling down to the beach club. The breakfasts and afternoon tea certainly set you up for the day - we were not disappointed with the selection. Also the complimentary cookies....highly addictive!!! The spa at Kayumanis is also notable. Try the indulgent full body massage which included a peppermint foot scrub. Then relax after with a ginger tea and ginger cookies. We took a day tour with driver, Bayu to Ubud – this is highly recommended. He took us to Taro to see the elephants; we sampled coffee, drove through endless rice terraces, went to Monkey Forest, and did so much more…Bayu, Benni and all the other drivers will happily take you to restaurants, shopping areas etc around Nusa Dua, to as far as Jimbaran. Thanks to their recommendations we got to try the freshest seafood and delicious Indonesian food. My partner and I highly recommended the Kayumanis Villas and we can't wait to return. You will arrive as a guest and leave as a friend, feeling like the Kayumanis is your second home!

author: Spooky_1992
title: The best accommodation we have ever stayed at!
text: We are seasoned travellers and this place easily takes first place as the best accommodation we've ever stayed at. The private villas are amazing - you get 2 little huts (one living room and other a bedroom) and the private pool makes you want to stay here forever! The outdoor shower and bath was also amazing. I found the complex itself very private and secluded even though it was fully booked. Perfect if you want some privacy. Oh and they do not accept any children under 16 so perfect for the first or even second time honeymooners. Included in the price: - Breakfast (which you can choose to have at the restaurant or a sunrise breakfast set up for you at the beach at 6am - a must do!) - A 30min welcome massage for the couple - Daily afternoon high tea Unlike all the other big names along the Nusa Dua coast, Kayumanis isn't right on the beach but it has a private walkway which leads onto the same stretch of beach with their own private beach club. We liked this as it felt very exclusive and private. Besides, who needs the beach when you've got your very own private pool? And that private pool is not small either. Kayumanis also offers a free driver service which can take you to Nusa Dua and Jimbaran Bay. We went to Jimbaran Bay for a romantic beach side seafood dinner one night and for lunch, we just asked the driver to take us to a local warung just outside the Perimeter. Best to look these up yourselves with TripAdvisor, but they are very happy to take you there. What is the Perimeter that I'm talking about? Basically Nusa Dua is a gated community. It's not that easy to walk out as it's a bit of a distance. But just use the driver or borrow one of their free bikes. The complex was very modern, modern facilities, aircon in the villa. Impeccable service from the staff. I just can't write enough about this place but it's definitely a place I'll be coming back to and have also been raving on about to my friends.

author: TravellerNL010
title: Amazing experience
text: This place is just fantastic! If you are looking for a quiet place to stay with outstanding service in a beautiful area of Nusa Dua then this is the villa you have to stay at. We reserved a one bedroom villa. It has a separate bedroom and living room. A beautiful outdoor shower and a half open bathtub. Towels changed twice every day. The private swimming pool is just fine for two people (1,5 metres). You can have your breakfast any time of the day (a la carte). One morning we went out to eat babi guling (warung pak. Dobiel which is very good!) and had our breakfast served at 3 pm. The complimentary afternoon tea with sandwiches and some local cakes and cookies is a very nice touch. The complimentary private shuttle within Nusa Dua, Tanjung Benoa and Jimbaran is very handy. All the staff are very polite and friendly. They really do everything to make you feel very comfortable. We booked this villa to celebrate our wedding anniversary and they surprised us with a wedding cake. Such a nice gesture. This place is highly recommended. You really get what you pay for. Would love to stay here again!

author: loi_joel
title: Kayumanis, oh so manis (sweet)
text: We just returned from paradise! Kayumanis was just beyond "manis" (sweet in Bahasa Indonesia) in every aspect of that word. Our wonderful experience began right at the pickup from the airport where we had Erna who welcomed us by name, and handed us cold towels and water as soon as we got into the van. That pretty much set the tone of our entire stay. The staff members remembered every detail of our needs from me not being able to take spicy food to the kind of activities we enjoy. We were spoilt with in-villa food services, which were not just convenient but delicious. One of the the things we enjoyed most was that breakfast was served from 7.30am to 10.30pm - fantastic! Our package included a full-day car charter which we maximised to tour around to watch the Barong dance, Ubud Market, Kinta Mani and the rice terraces. Our driver, Mayo again surprised us with cold refreshing drinks and towels after a whole day out. We also enjoyed a 2-hour spa treatment which we could only summarise as top class. The butler made sure our every need was met from helping to plan our schedules, make reservations, suggestions, etc...they were ever ready for every request and made sure our villa was cleaned, prepared at any time of the day. The culmination of our stay came in the form of a private beach dinner aptly named "Extravagant Dinner" and it sure is extravagant. The private beach was closed for only us to enjoy with live music accompanying us throughout the dinner. We were treated to a 7-course dinner which our palates were spoilt, dish after dish, served by a personal waiter. Bliss! If you're looking for a honeymoon destination, look no further. If you're looking for a stay with complete privacy to spend with a special someone, book a spot now. I will definitely be back!

author: Sonieka_EarthAngel
title: Blissful............
text: Blissful.... Blissful... Blissful.... These are the words that ring in your mind when you enter Kayumanis Property. When me and my husband landed in Bali, we were super excited, but not sure what to expect of our stay bookings... I must say that Kayumanis definitely turned out to be extremely amazing, much much beyond our expectations... Apart from serene and peaceful surroundings of our villa, the service and great hospitality we received from the staff there really moved us... They really go out of the way to help you and make your stay memorable... Being an Architect and Designer myself, Im very particular in choosing a particular taste of the built environment and Kayumanis lived upto it...The villa in which we stayed had a private pool, with our bedroom opening into it... We had a superb bathtub with glass all around and a private outdoor bath, which was the best feature for mee... It was nicely planned, tastefully decorated and maintained too... Food and high tea, breakfast were tooo good. The desserts they serve are great. I would recommend having breakfast at their restaurant which is atop a nice waterbody. Would surely stay there again.

author: hoped670
title: Relaxing and luxurious
text: My husband and I stayed here a week before Christmas to relax after a big year in our demanding corporate jobs. I wanted to cry when we first checked in because the staff member who picked us up and showed us through the villa was so lovely and the villa was completely luxurious. Let's start with the great things: attentive staff, very well kept premises, complimentary use of the bicycles which are a lot of fun! The villa Shuttle will take you most places in Nusa Dua, there is cable TV in your bedroom and we had an international electrical socket which was helpful. We enjoyed a sunrise breakfast. It was great however due to the beach being a little further away from the complex, it is much better inside the villa. Great food for breakfast. One time serve of breakfast is complimentary, depending on your package and is served 24 hours. That means if you head out for a day trip and return at 6pm you are able to order you breakfast, complimentary, at dinner time! Which is great because they have savory items on the menu like Nasi Goring etc. A few observations and recommendations: Bring snorkel or goggles for the pool. The pool is chlorinated, not salt (for people with blonde hair) Ladies, the hair dryer is small and weak. There is no iron in the room (just FYI). Kayumanis provides complimentary citronella for the flies and mosquitoes however I would still pack a small roll on of Areogard. The restaurant food not great for dinner, in my opinion, there is better food at the Bumbu Bali restaurant up the street. There is not a lot around Nusa Dua, so there is really no need to leave the villa. Much better shopping in Seminyak and beaches at Finns Beach club for example.

author: S6802GNrobertb
title: The Best
text: We stayed at the resort from the 6th October until departing on the 14th October. We stayed in villa WARU. From the pickup at the airport to our return journey we felt like it was home. The staff really do make your stay special, but the little things add up. Free transport to and from the airport, around Nusa Dua and Jimbaron. Great breakfast, any time of the day, in your villa or at the restaurant. Afternoon tea. All we had to do was dial "5" on the phone and we could request anything. We were celebrating our 30th anniversary, we had the private dinner on the beach which was fantastic. Nadi and DWI were great and really made as laugh. We had a private tour up to the volcano, rice fields and Ubud. We stopped in to see the Kayumanis resort at UBUD. Although we did not see in a villa, the area was fantastic and the staff did treat us as a guest. Thanks for the drink and also to DEDY our guide and driver. The villa was very good and the staff that cleaned and prepared the room, from lighting the mozzie coils to getting the room ready, cleaning, everything was spot on. All in all it was one of the best stays anywhere in the world. Thanks to the great staff. Make sure you feed the squirrels. The love the place to and are super friendly. Robert and Christina

author: Gen_Lee_11
title: One word: Exceptional!!
text: The Kayumanis and it's staff exceeded our wildest expectations. From our airport driver, Bayu, to the welcome greeting from Eka, it was clear to us that this was going to be true 5 star service. After getting a tour of our honeymoon suite, we were excited to plan our days ahead and chose from the stellar list of activities they had to offer. We couldn't have asked for more, from the camel ride, our romantic two hour spa package (including wine bath!!!), sunset fishing expedition with Pram and in-suite private BBQ with Nadi, sunrise breakfast on the beach to our free welcome massage. The complementary bicycles were a nice touch and made it easy to get to the beach (which is a quick 2 minute bike ride down their path). We highly recommend you bike the boardwalk to get a nice tour of the resort area and beaches. The attention to detail was paramount and did not go unnoticed. The turndown service was like clock-work, not to mention the room cleaning which was done before we came back to our room everyday (like they had a 6th sense or something...). To give you an idea, our first stay there, we came back to a bath filled with rose petals! The food was exceptional, both in the restaurant and the in-room service. We were told to "dial 5" for anything at all and the responsiveness of the staff was the best I have seen. Always polite and smiling, they would deliver our morning coffee, breakfast and/or lunch - or anything we really asked for. We were pleasantly surprised by the security and comfort level with check-points as you enter the general resort area in Nusa Dua. The Kayumanis in Nusa Dua is an amazing quiet get away, perfect for couples. One off the best spa's I have been to, with incredible attention to detail. Incredibly friendly staff and impeccable service.

author: denizzozkan
title: Amazing!!
text: I stayed in Kayumanis Nusa Dua 6 days and it was amazing. All people worked there were so nice. There was a small problem in our reservation and they solved very professionally and didnt make us sad. Villa that we stayed was amazing and very comfortable. They always kept our villa cleaned. Private pool was big and cleaned too (I have a sensitive body and I cannot swim every pool but it was so cleaned. Nothing happened to me). They also have a private beach and you can go there by using bicycle (max 7-8 minutes if you walk). Overall Nusa Dua beach was not perfect but if you go to Bali, don’t expect amazing sea like Maldives. Bali is a place that you can see a different culture and habits and you can discovery other amazing places like temples or rice terraces. They only have villas, so they kept the trees and natural beautifulness of the place. Therefore, there were lots of squirrels living on the trees. If you give them a fruit or nuts, they start to like you and not be afraid of you. The only problem was mosquitos. This is Bali's main problem but they have a lotion and it really protects you. I strongly recommend Kayumanis if you plan to go Nusa Dua area. It is a small hotel as compared to others and it has only villas. I think it was the reason why everything is perfect and so lovely.

author: Lin_WuClark
title: Kayumanis is a Heavenly Paradise
text: I live an urban life and it isn't exactly something I relish. I escaped to Bali, my favorite place in South East Asia. I discovered Kayumanis Nusa Dua and I discovered Paradise. This is very unlike the crass and tacky Kuta. Kayumanis is tranquil, peaceful and serene. It's also a throwback to a different time and place, as if one is indeed on the Island keeping company with the Gods. One wakes up early in the morning to go see the spectacular sunrise at sea. One is only greeted by flora and fauna, frangipanis gently falling on you, the sea breeze and a songbird singing. Each villa has its own pool. So one can either go swim in the sea or just dip in the pool. None of this serenity is ever broken or interrrupted by the staff. One is provided with a butler and service is efficient, excellent and never intrusive. All needs are anticipated and met. A car is also immediately provided for nearby trips within Nusa Dua and Jimbaran. I highly recommend Kayumanis for those of us who really need to escape City life and to celebrate the Balinese way of life.

author: AmyHickson
title: Absolute private luxury
text: There are no words to describe this amazing place and pictures just do not do it justice. From the moment you arrive you are treated like royalty. Every staff member knows you by name and are all super polite. The breafast is amazing with a huge range. The afternoon tea is delicious with a range of small cakes and sandwiches and room service food is also top quality. The room....WOW!! It is your own private sanctuary. 10m long pool..yes 10m long! Outdoor shower and bath, seperate living area, outdoor lounge chairs and the little local guests (squirrels) who are the cutest things. The fridge is stocked daily with complimentary bintang, coke, sprite and water. You also recieve free fruit basket daily as well as nuts and cinnamon cookies which taste sooo good! People have mentioned on here the walk to the beach. C'mon people it is max 5 mins walk down a private lane way and really isn't anything to complain about. We had the sunrise breakfast on the beach on our last day which is no extra cost and it was amazing. The beach is clean and staff at the beach club very polite and attentive. They also offer free transport pick up and drop off within nusa dua between 7am and 10.30pm. f you want to stay in private luxury inside nusa dua this is the place and it should be number one. I will never stay anywhere else now that I have been here.

author: 448rajata
title: Amazing honeymoon destination!
text: I don't know where to start with this place! It was absolutely amazing from start to finish... From the humble welcoming, to the out of their way helpfulness, to the pristine and clean villas and the respectful and courteous service this place makes you feel like royalty! Everyone would always stop to humbly and graciously say hello and good morning everytime we ran into an employee. They would review all the food with you that they delivered to your villa to make sure nothing was missing. They had free bicycles that you could borrow for as long as you stayed there, but always first come first serve. The Butler knew everything surrounding your itinerary and would always check up on you. The villa sticks to the Balinese culture of simplicity & homeliness, you can see it and feel it all around the premises especially in your room. None of the frills that come with corporate hotels are present, it is a humbling place to stay. The pools in the villas were well kept also. My only turn off was the 15min walk to the beach, but that was quickly embraced when I watched my weight increase from all the delicious food I was consuming. I quickly started jogging that stretch to the beach where there are private lawn chairs set up with an employee on duty and a couple of security guards. The beach faces due-east where I watched the sunrise with the wife with a romantic sunrise breakfast set up, we had to call that in the day before to book our seats. The shuttle is amazing too, they always have a minivan available to take you wherever you require.... Saved money on taxis! There is a mall nearby called "Bali Collection" with amazing patio restaurants & great shopping selections from name brand stores. All in all we were extremely sad to leave Kayumanis, it felt like leaving home! We will go back in a heartbeat.!!

author: Erfp79
title: Small is beautiful.
text: This is one of the smaller resorts--only about 23 villas in all, and as a result was serene and peaceful. The villas, restaurant and public spaces are beautifully designed and harmonius with nature. Each villa is nestled in a small walled-in private compound with separate adorable thatched huts for bedroom and open-air bathroom (lovely!) and living room/dining room. Butler service is availabe 24 hours a day, and all staff are wonderfully attentive. As noted in other reviews, the delicious a la carte breakfasts can be served in the villas, in the restaurant, or even on the beach. The beach is a ten minute walk down a lovely path. The Kayumanis beach was not very large, but was MUCH nicer, more peaceful and more romantic than those of the huge resorts which surrounded it. The fact that children under 16 are not permitted made it al the more perfect for a romantic getaway. They hotel provided airport pickup and drop-off service for no additional cost, and both were smooth and efficient. They were able to provide a hotel car and driver who took us on a ten hour island exploration (we journeyed to Ubud, the moneky forest, a coffee plantation, the volcano and a beautiful 10th century water temple in which we immersed ourseves for prayer rituals) for a very reasonable fee. Nusa Dua is a bit tucked away in a gated community (this has pluses and minuses) but the hotel cars were available to take us to nearby areas for no additional charge, and taxis were readily available to take us into Seminyak and Kuta. We ate dinner at the hotel (in the Indonesian restaurant) on our first night. It was lovely--but there are so many wonderful restaurants in Bali that it behooves one to explore. The Nusa Dua was a wonderful experience. We will return...or perhaps try their sister hotel in Ubud. It is well deserving of its five stars, and provided excellent value when booked well in advance.

author: fly_wouldnt_i
title: In all the world is there a better stay to be had?
text: We arrived and were greeted in the most pleasant of manners by the head butler Bagan and his staff. We immediately took advantage of the free car service which took us to go jetskiing and picked us up afterward to take us to get SIM cards on the way back to the villas. The driver even gave us a bunch of tips of what to do and how to do it on the way. We ate breakfast in the Kayumanis restaurant which was extremely well presented (albeit somewhat average on the taste scale). Now the villas. OMG the villas. I have not seen with my own eyes or on television a more amazing, private, tranquil and hospitable environment than these villas. Stepping out of bed a few feet and walking into our private pool was something I couldn't have imagined to be better. Going to sleep to the sound of our villas waterfall was heavenly. The showers bath and bathroom were all very clean and well appointed with luxurious towels, robes and a set of products unique to the Kayumanis. We were given free mosquito repellant which was also a product uniquely made for the Kayumanis. EVERYONE from the gardeners to the wait staff knew us BY NAME. People who we'd never seen knew us and greeted us by name. Breakfast at the beach, high afternoon tea and in room dining were presented with such an elegant touch that I felt as if Robin Leach himself would walk through the door at any moment. There was even beer (and sodas) stocked in the fridge FREE...DAILY. The only thing I can say I hoped for was a shorter walk to the beach. Everything exceeded our wildest expectations and I do mean everything. Special shout out to Bagan and the team for a flawless execution of service and hospitatlity.

author: Lorelai2109
title: Amazing service and villa
text: I´m writing this review on our last day here in the Kayumanis Nusa Dua.The hotel is just amazing. We loved our villa and especially the breakfast concept (you can have breakfast in your villa every time of the day/night). We got a recommendation from one of the butler to get some suckling pig from a local warung in the morning when its freshly made. Therefore we switched breakfast to dinner which was absolutly no problem. The villa has a well equipped kitchenette, so you can have some take away from local warungs/depots and have dinner in your villa. They clean the villa twice a day, so it was clean all the time. Of course the pool won´t be immaculate the whole day.But I rather have such nice greeenery and trees around in my villa than a perfectly clean pool the whole day. And we´re talking about some leaves and flowers, nothing else; the water quality is checked every morning by the guy who cleans the pool. There could be one or two alterations to the practicallity of the villa (e.g. another hook in the bathroom which is not directly next to the shower, to hang your bathrobe or the possibility to change from the romantic light concept to one where my husband could shave properly). But these are really minor issues and nothing to really complain about. But the most impressive about this hotel is its staff and the service they provide. You can call the butler at any time and asked for anything he/she will not disappoint you. They know you by name from the minute you arrive at the airport, they remember your preferences and even if you had a chat with the butler in the evening, the guy next morning will know your plans for the day as well. So special thanks to Ayu, Eka, Erna, Bayu, Naomi and Lisa and also to all the nice drivers which helped a lot with choosing dishes from the local warungs. Terima Kasih Banyak for two very relaxing and blissful weeks in Bali!!!

author: affang
title: Perfect for our honeymoon!
text: We had a stay at Kayumanis Nusa Dua for 3 days and 2 nights in the first week of our honeymoon. We had an incredible experience started with their pick-up service at the airport. They provided us with bottles of coke and cinnamon cookies during the trip to the hotel. I cannot prevent my mouth to not munch it. The taste was very good. We stayed at Cemara Villa, which has two main rooms, the living and bed rooms. Both rooms are very spacious. They also have an outdoor jacuzzi at the backyard, next to an indoor bathroom and open air shower area. Our favorite is indeed the private pool. If you are a bit lucky, you could have interaction with squirrels and pigeons around the pool area. You can also feed them with balinese nuts which is provided by the hotel at the living room. All the rooms and outdoor areas are very very clean. The peaceful ambiance is second to none. The staff are also very quick to respond your needs. I would give 10 (out of 10) for their reliable service. For the spa, you do not want to miss the spa at Kayumanis. For the cons, we think the living room needs some improvements though. They should put some multimedia devices here. A tv and an ipod dock would be great. Overall, we would recommend Kayumanis Nusa Dua for your unforgettable honeymoon experience.

author: SKS12345
title: Paradise
text: We arrived at Kayumanis with awe-stricken faces. It is BEAUTIFUL! The staff so smiley and happy. They made us feel like family and royalty throughout our entire stay. They attended to every need. The rooms equipped with everything you could need, from mosquito repellant to a shopping bag for when you go out. The bathroom was outdoors and it felt like showering in the amazon. Stunning villas. The restaurant served amazing food. we chose indonesian food every day. It was authentic indonesian food and we were full to the brim. High tea was delicious every day. I would come back again in a blink of an eye. This truly is an amazing place to stay to relax, unwind and get to know Balinese hospitality. Special thanks to Bagus and all the reception and restaurant staff. We had a good laugh with you all. Nilesh and Surina

author: c-vrak
title: Personalized 5 Star luxury
text: I just returned from a 5 night stay at Kayumanis for my honeymoon. I work for a 5 Star resort in the U.S. and can tell you that Kayumanis is a unique and amazing property. There are many other luxury resorts in Nusa Dua that may have bigger and more modern facilities, but they do not have the Balinese character that Kayumanis has. From the design of our villa to the hospitality of the staff, my wife and I truly feel we experienced the Balinese culture. We opted for the Honeymoon Package, which offered amazing value. Two private dinners, a spa treatment and a private tour of the island. My wife and I were surprised at how small our bill was for what we received. I highly recommend it to any honeymooners. Plus our breakfasts were included and the chef is very talented infusing a local flair to his dishes. Kayumanis is a Chinese/Indonesian company, so they do not have a strong presence in the US yet, so I feel like it is still a hidden gem. But with more reviews like they continue to have on TA, the secret is out, so visit soon. Special thank you to our Butler Made, server Doni and driver Mayo, I feel like my wife and I have made friends for life and memories we will never forget. Thank you Kayumanis for an incredible experience that we both needed! Hope to see you again in the near future.

author: Jackliam10
title: Honeymoon Bliss
text: We just returned from a week at Kayumanis. We stayed in Akasia villa. It was wonderful. The villa was spacious and of a high standard. The pool was fantastic and jumping in first thing in the morning set the tone for a great day. The restaurants and day spa were great and the food perfect although we ate away from the resort often. Although the walk to the beach is ten minutes and quite boring the fact that you can use the resorts bikes make it fun and a give you an opportunity to explore. The beach club is perfect and so relaxing. Nothing is any trouble for the beautiful staff here. They are attentive but not imposing or intrusive. Little touches are what sets this place apart. I would highly recommend this place if you want to chill out completely and want to go on the occasional day trip. If I had a negative I would say they need to keep on top of the maintenance(the odd bit of paint peeling and decking warping). But really this is due to the seasonal environment. Thank you Kayumanis and particularly the staff! Jane and Chris

author: MSukrisman
title: Awesome Paradise
text: My daughter and I would like to spend our weekend at the quite place, a private villa & spa in Nusa Dua. When we entered our villa, we were so surprised to find out the specious villa with two areas, the bedroom and the family room. One of the amazing area is the garden and its pool where we can meet and greet with numbers of squirrels. They love people around and would accept food feeding. It was so fun! Second surprised, we received a welcome massage for 30 minutes, indeed so relaxing. What next? Free ride using the villa's bike? Why not! we visited the most stunning beach view at the back area. When we returned back to our villa, we were so pleased to enjoy our high tea and continue our lovely intimate conversation. Perfect Getaway! We would not been more happy with our stay here... our bonding even better after our visit. Thanks for a superb service, appreciate all the amazing experiences here.

author: J_J_Spalding
title: A Perfect Honeymoon Getaway!
text: The Kayumanis Private Villa & Spa in Nusa Dua far exceeded our hopes or expectations for our Honeymoon. It was absolutely beautiful - with tranquil walkways, manicured gardens, our stunning villa and private pool, 5 Star Restaurant and unmatched service. We could not have been more happy with our stay here. We stayed for 10 nights and we were sad to leave at the end! When we arrived at Denpasar Airport we were met by a private car to take us to our accommodation - with refresher towels, pillows, cookies and water - not to mentioned a lovely driver who told us what to expect for our stay! We had a one bedroom villa with the most beautiful pool - always clean, with a waterfall and generous in size. We loved the outdoor bathroom with a shower where you could watch the stars, and found our bath filled with lovely rose petals one night. Our accommodation included 24/7 butler service, free breakfast everyday with an amazing menu to choose from, free afternoon tea, drinks and snacks as well as room service every morning. The Villa was always clean, drinks and snacks refilled and towels replaced. We were in heaven! Kayumanis has its own private stretch of beach, with lounges, umbrellas and towels - not to mention the opportunity to order drinks at any time. It was just a short 5 minute walk which we actually really enjoyed; down a little stone walkway - and we were often transported back to the Villas on a beach buggy - if we were too lazy to walk! There were bikes to be used for free, to go and explore which was really fun and a private car to take you anywhere in the Nusa Dua and Jimbaran area. We truly loved our stay and were treated with the utmost respect and care from the beginning to the end. We would definitely come back again :) Jackson & Jordan

author: ZuZ85
title: Will definitely come back again
text: Kayumanis is AMAZING. Throughout your stay, you get the feeling that you own the place and it is actually your home. Everybody was super helpful and everyone knows you by name, and respectively call you Bapak and Ibu (Mr. and Mrs. in Balinese). Our butlers were simply the best. Pram, Ayu, Doni, and Arya, alongside the many other amazing butlers made sure we felt at home and catered to all our needs. They even served us a full dinner at 1 AM and it was raining! The whole "hotel" was exceptional, and I would definitely recommend Kayumanis to all my friends. We didn't want to checkout .... and we will come back for sure. Side note: One thing I really loved is how Kayumanis' management treats its employees. During our stay, the management was having a private pool party to all the employees at Kayumanis for a successful 2013. You could tell from the employees' smiles that they were having a blast and were very happy. A hotel with happy employees is a hotel with happy customers. Terima Kasih Kayumanis Nusa Dua for a honeymoon that we will never forget.

author: pailinlee
title: Excellent
text: We stayed in Kayumanis for a night on 27 January 2014 for our honeymoon as well as to celebrate my husband's birthday. I have emailed the staff prior to my arrival to see if they can arrange a small birthday cake (which I was more than willing to pay). Replies were prompt and they actually offered to provide a cake at no cost at all! On the day of check-in, they also prepared a heart-shaped cake for our honeymoon. While we were exploring our villa, all of the staff (yes, the butler, the driver, basically everyone!) came and sang my husband a birthday song and to offer their birthday wishes. It was a really nice and sweet gesture to mark this occasion! They even prepared rose petals in our bathtub! The villa was well-equipped with a small kitchenette, minibar (with free drinks). Breakfast menu was splendid with a good spread to choose from. We ordered egg benedicts, truffle eggs, porridge, fruit platter, banana crepes. All of the food items were of restaurant standard definitely and overall presentation was unremarkable! All of the staff are very very hospitable, including our driver and butler. While we were out for dinner, they actually make up our room and let down the veil of our bed. I am really impressed with their thoughtful service. The minus point will be that the indoor shower area looks worn-out and some of the walls are stained near the bath area. There were also quite a number of mosquitoes around. However, they actually have mosquito repellants for our usage. I have came across several articles about the staff in Bali were underpaid and service charge do not go to the staff at all. I hope Kayumanis is not one of them as the staff there are really one of the best I have ever met! Good job Kayumanis!

author: Rosco711
title: Just like home without any worries :)
text: Kayumanis Nusa Dua's staff is what makes this exclusive resort stand out way ahead of any other. From the moment, our butler, Dedy picked us up at the airport, we felt part of a family returning to our Bali home. The van was very comfortable with refreshing towel to cool our faces and a cold soft drink plus Balinese cookies. Pretty good first impression! When we arrive, we were warmly greeted by the receptionist, Eka who became our 'matron' for our whole stay :) We fell in love with the place even more when we were shown to our Waru villa (all the 20 villas are named after trees). There were 2 rooms connected via our own private pool and deck. The Balinese architecture and sounds of the waterfalls into our private pool were calming and just right to set the scene for our new 'home' in Bali. The resort organized a special new year's eve dinner and the food was superb. Fine dining indeed with the level of quality you would expect from 3 hatted restaurants. The chef even came out to speak to each table. This is how personal the service at Kayumanis is! :) Throughout our stay, the resort made our stay very comfortable which included feeding us well with unlimited ala carte brekky any time of the day plus afternoon tea. They even serve it to us in the villa so that we can be private. Privacy is what you will get at Kayumanis Nusa Dua so couples are strongly recommended to stay here. In fact, the staff also helped me arrange a surprise candle light and floral message for my wife as part of our wedding anniversary on top of a candle light dinner at our villa by our private pool filled with rose petals and floating candles. Just imagine how elaborate that is! :) All in all, Kayumanis Nusa Dua was an amazing home for us and we can't wait to go back to Bali and see our 'family' at Kayumanis Nusa Dua :)

author: PFaraguna
title: A piece of Heaven!
text: What an amazing experience to say the least! Villas are beautiful and very well maintained. Pool is bigger than expected and very clean. Really enjoyed our al la carte breakfast in comparison to buffet,great quality food and staff were happy to accommodate our special requests were they could. Comparing to other places we have stayed in the area, value for money was second to none.. We decided to stay 3 weeks here and can't tell you how relaxed and well looked after we were. Staff are very professional and friendly made our stay comfortable and they couldn't do enough for us, beautiful souls they are. Location is superb as my husband and I love to run every morning. The streets are clean and the beach areas are very well maintained every day. The Resturant Piasan is superb beautiful dinning in serene environment. Compliments to chef Deny lots of love in his food!! Kayumanis provide so many inclusions with our stay which we haven't experienced anywhere else! Very much appreciated. We would like to thank Karta and all the staff from Kayumanis Nusa Dua for making our stay unforgettable! We can't wait to stay with you once again!

author: deep9680
title: A pathetic stay in an over-priced villa
text: The villa was located in a nice area, an area full of private villas. However we thought it would have a better view, but there was no view anyways. The beach was a 7-minute walk from the villa, and was nothing special compared to other private beaches where I stayed. Most importantly, some of those hotels were about half as costly as Kayumanis, and were still better. I cannot remember one single thing that I really liked about the place, except that the hotel/resort beside Kayumanis had a nice restaurant. The room service was quite horrible, no one even asked us for our choice of breakfast, or for the complimentary 30-minute Spa. We had to remind the staff of all these things. The breakfast spread was quite bad, and I would have anyways preferred a buffet to choose from rather than ordering from Alacarte or set menus. Also my wife and I stayed in the twin room. It had a king size bed with 2 single mattresses- which defied any logic. It made our first night's sleep really bad. Apart from this, the pool was really dirty, though I agree that it was difficult to maintain due to the rain, but still there was no effort from the staff. Apart from this, the hotel staff recommended a place for dinner (Restaurant Ganga at Jimbaran Beach). The hotel's food was awful, and overly expensive, and the place had a very bad ambience. It was located on the Jimbaran beach, but that alone couldn't have been the reason for charging so highly. After this, we asked their recommendation the next day for a better place, and the place named had such bad reviews on the internet that we didn't dare to set foot there. Overall, I paid around 700USD per night and it was just a waste. I would recommend no one stays at this place ever, unless they have an abundance of money to waste.

author: RayShivaun
title: Amazing Holiday
text: For our 25th Wedding Anniversary celebration, my wife and I were looking for a quiet holiday in Bali, no children, good food and attentive service. We found this and much more at the Kayumanis Nusa Dua Private Villa and Spa. We both travel a lot through our work, however we have never come across such excellent customer service (I used to deliver training on this subject so I am aware of what is required). The villas are spacious, the one we stayed in had a nice size pool, villa for sleeping/ablutions and another villa for relaxing in. We often had meals delivered to our villa, although the restaurants are very nice. For our last night I had booked a "romantic dinner" by the pool. An amazing experience with every romantic cliche being met. I am lactose intolerant so the chef amended the meal to suit. The private beach is a 10 minute walk (although bicycles are provided free). Unlike the major chain hotels further along the coast, the Nusa Dua beach offered far more space between loungers so there was no feeling of being cramped by other guests. In fact such is the private nature of the resort that we rarely saw our fellow guests. During the holiday we hired a car and driver for the day to take us around some of the island. They tailored the itinerary to our needs and provided a packed breakfast for the journey. As it was our wedding anniversary the staff organised a cake to celebrate the occasion and really made us feel special. Not once did I think we were being overcharged, indeed it was excellent value for money. All in all a truly memorable holiday and I would like to thank the staff for making it so.

author: RuthandGail
title: Wonderful sanctuary and safe haven!
text: Looking for somewhere quiet to rest and recuperate after a traumatic and difficult year, we honestly could not have found a more perfect and idyllic sanctuary than Kayumanis Nusa Dua. The staff were all magnificent and ensured that our stay was peaceful and quiet, allowing us privacy whilst at the same time being readily available to ensure we had everything we could possibly have wished for. The Kayumanis Nusa Dua family pride themselves on making this a “home away from home” and they excelled at this - nothing was too much trouble. We were most touched and surprised by a visit by the staff singing Happy Birthday and presenting us with a delicious birthday cake on the special day. The villa was comfortable and clean and just fabulous with the added luxury of the private pool, all within an enclosed courtyard. The treatments at the Kayumanis Spa were a highlight and it was overall a very professional, luxurious and sublime experience. The breakfasts and meals we had there were superb and the high teas were a lovely extra touch to tide us over until dinner. The main highlight, however, was the cooking course. We were overwhelmed by the effort and care that went into making this such a memorable experience, starting with heading down to the market to purchase the fresh fish and ingredients for the dishes we were cooking. The staff set up a complete outdoor kitchen for us in the dining area which was totally unexpected. We had the personal services of executive sous-chef, Astawa, who was just wonderful, assisted by Yudi and then Puti who became our official photographers. We cooked (and then sat down to enjoy) a menu of our choice and learnt so much about Balinese cooking. We each took home the gift of a Kayumanis apron which we wear when trying to replicate the gado-gado salad and nasi-goreng dishes we learnt to cook. This is a personalised experience that we highly recommend to anyone interested in cooking. We also loved the fact that we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go - to the private beach, an awesome choice of beach front restaurants, the Bali Collection and to the local market outside the entrance to Nusa Dua. All in all, this was a fabulous and memorable 10 days which we hope to repeat in the very near future. A very big thank you to Karta and all the wonderful staff at Kayumanis Nusa Dua.....take good care, we will see you soon.

author: JeffP343
title: Kayumanis delivers.
text: Let me start this review by saying that somehow, we found an amazing deal on a villa at the Kayumanis Nusa Dua through the internet (about 60% off the rack rate). In light of that, it was a very very good value. Most of the Trip Advisor reviews about the property are accurate. The villas are very nice, private, relaxing, and spacious. The staff, and overall service are excellent. Take advantage of the complimentary car service which will take you anywhere in the Nusa Dua and Jimbarran area. Many reviewers complained about the long walk to the beach. We used the complimentary bicycles on property, and rode them to the beach. Problem solved. In addition, we used the bikes to ride along the beachfront Nusa Dua boardwalk, and throughout the Nusa Dua resort area, where there are fantastic wide safe sidewalks. We really only had a couple of complaints about our villa named "Sukun". In spite of the fact that the bedroom bungalow was very roomy, there was not one dresser of drawers to store clothes. The a moire had two tiny drawers suitable only for toiletries. We had to live out of our suitcases on the floor the entire time. I know it sounds silly, but we have never experienced this type of inconvenience anywhere in the world. We hope management can correct this obvious flaw in this particular villa and add a dresser. The villa pool was surrounded by a lush beautiful garden and trees. The only issue was that the pool quickly filed up with so much leaves and debris, that a single daily cleaning was woefully inadequate. Otherwise, the stay was, almost, perfect, and we would highly recommend this property!

author: Dhruma
title: Excellent Service
text: Celebrating an occasion THIS IS A MUST !! Excellent service. Never seen service like this. Staff are so well trained. It was a special occasion we celebrated my husbands' 50th Birthday. Every single staff knows what activities you are doing or if you need any thing special eg my husband had a sore throat when we got their & we asked for some warm water, honey & lemon to soothe his throat. Every single morning when we were served breakfast the staff made sure it was there, we didn't have to ask for it again. We ahd our own butler. One of the nights we had a romantic dinner on the beach. Only one couple per night could enjoy a night like this. It was AMAZING !! One of the staff took us to the beach from the resort in an open rickshaw. The beach was decorated with candles & had light live Balinese musicians & music playing the whole time. We had 7 course seafood dinner. There were 2 staff just catered for us. What a service. Every single course was divine. Next day every single staff knew we had dinner on the beach & they would ask us how the dinner was. The villas have private pools as well.

author: AmericanAbroadAMS
title: Private, perfect, COUPLES ONLY & Amazing Food!
text: Literally just home today from a 6 night stay at Kayumanis Nusa Dua and all I can say is wow! This was our first visit ever to Asia and further to Bali, Indonesia. After researching and researching, I selected Kayumanis because of the private pools and the Nusa Dua location was adults only. I have to say we felt taken care of from the very first moment. It was a great feeling to have someone waiting for us with a sign to start the trip off upon arrival at the airport. Then once at the resort, we were given the grand tour and explained all the features of our private villa. We had never had anything like this before and travel quite a bit. The Villa had 2 buildings, one was the sleeping room connected to an outside bathroom (which took some getting used to) and hangout living room villa....with 2 sunchairs and a good sized pool in between just for us. We enjoyed all they had to offer which is alot. We both thought the food was simply incredible, not a bad bite ever. There were many things that were just wow! We ate about 80% of all our meals at the resort. They were also totally helpful with suggestions and honest, happy service 24/7. They honestly wanted to make us happy and thats what they did. The beach club is not on the best part of the beach but all the space in the villa was all we needed. We layed out, swam, ordered in food and drinks, enjoyed high tea, breakfast whenever we wanted, couples massages...you name it. I can go on and on but I think I've said enough. Also their shuttle service is ultra helpful. If you are a couple, want a resort with privacy, the best service, amazing food and total relaxation ....look no further. PS we are a gay couple and were treated with 100% respect.

author: ErinC873
title: Simply beautiful.
text: My husband and I stayed at Kayumanis to celebrate his 30th birthday in March 2013 on the advice through other tripadvisor reviews - we were certainly not disappointed! The entire process of booking, arriving and departing was so easy and I was kept well informed throughout. From the moment we were picked up by our Kayumanis driver, we knew that we had picked a great place to stay with. The driver was very professional, and the car immaculately clean, air conditioned, and with comp water and snacks. On arrival, we were greeted by friendly, warm smiles and our butler showed us around the Kayumanis grounds and our villa. Walking into our villa we were thrilled - it was just beautiful. And so much space! Everything had been well thought out with the planning of the villa, and this resulted in a wonderful stay. The beach club is only a short walk, or even quicker bike ride on one of Kayumanis's bicycles, from your villa, and is lovely. We didn't swim at the beach, as we preferred to make the most of our pool instead. Along from the beach club are the beach frontages of some of the other top end resorts, where you can walk alongside the beach and explore the other resort restaurants and bars. Kayumanis is a very quiet place, perfect for couples, especially honeymooners. There are two beautiful restaurants on site as well, however no one really uses them and chooses to dine in their villas instead, or eat at one of the many beachfront restaurants close by. There are also many options for activities providers by Kayumanis, many special private dinner options, water activities and tours, and a cooking class with Kayumanis Chef Astawa - my husband and I loved this! We had so much fun learning how to cook traditional Balinese food, and Chef Astawa was very fun. The staff are only too willing to help, any request and they will be there to assist! All of the staff are very professional, friendly and always smiling. The drivers are very informative about the local area and very reliable, and also a lot of fun. The staff make Kayumanis a very special place to holiday, and we can't wait to come back to stay again. Terima kasih Kayumanis!

author: Crakup
title: Totally relaxing - fantastic experience never to be forgotten
text: Let me start by stating that my wife and I, although down to earth Aussies, are not easily impressed. Arriving at Ngurah Rai airport was an eye opener in itself. Our first impression was underwhelmed. We were then greeted by our very friendly driver and after a short 20 minute drive arrived at our stunning villa. The villa and pool were very clean as was the outdoor bathroom. Very extravagant for us but very welcome. The totally private villa and pool were a real treat wih all staff being extremely accommodating to all requests. The included breakfast is as large as you want and then high tea - nearly don't need any other meals - but we did anyway. The bedding is great and very comfiortable. Relaxing 30 minute massage each also included in room price. We have never stayed in accomodation so nice and we were totally spoiled. The outdoor bathroom is fantastic. There is nothing quite like showering or having a bath by candlelight whilst itis raining - sooo relaxing. I am writing this review whilst sitting next to our pool watching the varied wildlife going about their business and coming to realize that in a couple of short days we Willa be leaving this tranquility to return home - disappointed to leave but oh so relaxed. A bg thanks to Sam and his large team for making our break unforgettable.

author: 15PaulF
title: Honeymoon in Kayumanis Nusa Dua
text: In the beginning, it's not accustomed to live in villa for our first time. But easily, we accepted all the hot and friendly service. No matter what we eat, live, even the transportation, all the detail keep our mind at rest. We deeply feel that it does be the place relaxing fully. Before going to Bali, we not only scared about anything included eating or living, but worried about the SPA would feel pain or uncomfortable. Actually, I found that we think it too much! All the food that we eat in Bali is good especially in Kayumanis Nusa Dua. There, every meal makes us amazing. The gentle and meticulous SPA must be the best one all we try in Bali. As the ending of joruney, we leave Kayumanis, leave Bali. Unforgettable, it's the two days staying in Kayumanis. Thanks all the friends in Kayumanis Nusa Dua so much for your caring. Due to your considerateness, we feel much satisfied with our honeymoon. Your kindly smile will always keep on my mind. Expect the next time we meet.

author: EricB935
title: One of Bali's best
text: We are regular Bali visitors. We made a booking at short notice by phone to Kayumanis Nusa Dua and they organised our accommodation within 2 hours. We rang at 4.00pm and they were ready for us at 6.00pm. The location in Nusa Dua was fine, and wholly suitable for what we wanted. The staff members were all courteous and obliging and responded to our every need, and yet were unobtrusive. The facility was excellent. It was modern, attractive, appealing and full of water features. Our villa was well established, and in excellent condition. The villas are a short path walk to the spotlessly clean beach where Kayumanis has a beach “club” providing sun shades and massage services. Kayumanis Nusa Dua has three fine restaurants: Italian, Asian and mixed, and provide outstanding room service. “Breakfast” from an excellent menu was available on call at any time that suited us, unlike so many places where breakfast is available within limited periods to suit the hotel. Afternoon tea was provided either in the restaurant or in our villa, at no cost: ie: it was included in the tariff. The villa refrigerator was full and open use was included in the standard tariff: ie: there was no cost for the consumption of drinks from the bar. A diver and vehicle was provided for transport to and from all locations in the Nusa Dua area, and a little further afar. There was no cost for transport which was included in the tariff. The private pool which was a key element in our booking was excellent, with a perfect ambient temperature and spotlessly clear. The complex was peaceful and security was obvious and comforting. We grade Kayumanis Nusa Dua amongst the best three resorts of about 30 we have so far experienced in Bali. Any guests who do not find total enjoyment in their visit to Kayumanis Nusa Dua would have to be very strange in their demands and unlikely to be satisfied with any accommodation on the island.

author: 654stane
title: Fantastic
text: We have just returned home from eight nights at this magnificent property. It has lived up to and exceeded what we expected. The villa & pool were great as was the service of all the staff. Nothing was too much bother. The staff bent over backwards for any requests.Special thanks to our butlers Bagus & Sanjaya who kept us informed of what and where to go as regards to outings as well as around the villas. In fact thank you to all the staff from reception, waiters, chefs right through to the gardiners who were always helpful. The great thing was the privacy and being able to totally relax. It was nice to be able to come out to our pool and relax on the deck chairs and not worry about the hassles of worrying about getting a chair near the pool as in other resorts. Having a shuttle car to take us to the shopping complex as well as other restaurants was a bonus. The tours you could arrange through Kayumanis were great as they used their own staff who were interested in what you required. Indulge in the massage as we did. It was the most relaxing feeling you could wish for. We have travelled all over the world and this is by far the best holiday we have had and the best resort we have stayed at. A special thanks to Samuel the manager & Karta the general manager for their help. We are already planning for next year with an extended stay.

author: 386JenniferH
title: Paradise
text: A six night stayed could have turned into a wonderful lifestyle had we stayed any longer! This is one of the most magical places we have stayed in. Each villa is separate from each other and each one has a thatched roof and decent sized swimming pool and outdoor shower and bath areas.The grounds are green and lush with water flowing every where you look. The tropical smells of plumeria lingers in your nose and you inhale deeply. The villa we stayed in was spacious with two separate bedrooms and an open air upstairs living room, which was perfect for the balmy nights in Nusa Dua. We did not understand the butler system as well as we should because this rating then would have received a 5 ++++ rating. By the end of our stay we realized these people who served as a "butler" really were knowlegeable and present as a tour guide, shopper's guide, food guide, beach guide, sports activities guide at our fingertips by pressing 5 on the telephone keypad. We especially enjoyed Eka and Sanjaya as our butlers . Each day a platter of fresh tropical fruit provided and that was always a treat. When the tide was in the beach was quite lovely and charming and of course, the view stunning. Thie whole experience is for romantic, private retreat. Included in the stay was a free 30 minute arrival message!!! My family loved it and scheduled more messages during our stay. The masseuses were very attuned and were excellent and very sweet. In fact every one who worked at this villa was very kind. The two restaurants, Asian and Italian, were perfect and we usually had orders from the two menus whenever we ate at the restaurant or had room service. Indonesian food is excellent and spicy and we were driven to a very excellent Balinese restaurant.
