The hotel is next door to the Heritage Hotel We paid only a little extra for a 1br standard suite, which had lots of space.. and took a reviewers advice and asked for a room overlooking the pool rather than the busy road. Traffic noise was still evident but not a worry, but I think if you aren't used to Manila traffic the street-front room should be avoided. The room has a balcony but no furniture but you can drag a seat out of the living area. Airplanes can start flying over from NAIA just after 6am, depending on wind direction, but I am never bothered by aircraft noise, in fact I enjoy watching them fly over. As usual in Manila the AC is noisy but at least it masks out external noise :) Has a mini bar, beer and soft drinks about 79p, (less than US$2) which is still pretty cheap when compared to "western" hotels. I like to give the street vendors a little business so got a couple of bottles of lemonade from a little old lady for 15p each We used the restaurant twice....meals are just Ok, but it was pleasant to sit by the pool in the evening and have a drink. The pool was clean and well maintained and always attended. (we didnt have to pay....)The staff were pleasant and would always greet you no matter how many times you passed them during the day. The Mall of Asia is accessible by taxi, bus or jeepney...same with the Greenbelt/Glorietta Malls in Makati, just along the EDSA. Would be happy to stay here again on returning to Manila, as it is easy to get to the airport. If you are new to Manila be aware that the older hotels have lots of dark wood furnishings so they wont be bright and glitzy. If you want that, spend more money. If you, like us prefer to limit the amount you pay for accommodation, then this hotel will be pleasant enough to stay at. Oh, they will ask for a 2500p deposit but I just let them swipe my card and no charge resulted.

author: remcom967
title: Homely
text: During my holiday I stayed in this hotel three times in three different rooms. The first room 909 had a nice big flatscreen tv and new aircon. The second room 1009 had a small not flatscreen tv and old aircon. The aircon of the second room turned the room into a fridge and made the air very very dry, and it might have been a while ago it was last turned on because next day i was sick (very sore throat, slimy dripping nose). The third room was 415 and it had the same old tv and aircon. The rooms were all almost the same in layout. The apartment consists of two spacious rooms, of which only the bedroom will be properly cooled by the aircon. The kitchen has a minimum of utensils, but it's just sufficient to cook. A (combi)microwave and a pair of scissors or a sharp knife would be a welcome addition. The room looks nicer on the picture than in real life but on the other hand the room in real life is bigger than it looks on the picture. The fridge is filled with plenty of drinks, there is a wide selection of bathroom supplies (including toothbrush and toothpaste) more than enough clean towels and a map with sightseeiing suggestions. The hotel has a restaurant on the second floor at the side of the swimming pool. The prices of the food is quite high in comparison for what you can get in restaurants in the city. There is also a taxi standing ready in front of the hotel, but the ones that drive by are much cheaper and also just as easy to obtain. The hotel offers free luggage storage which is very convenient. There is also a laundry service, but again, much more expensive than the ones you'll find in the city. The check-in counter is opened 24 hours per day and there is a guard in front of the entrance which is a comforting thought. The rooms at the side of the road (1009 and 909) were very noisy (traffic) and the rooms with old aircon had uncomfortable air quality.

author: mandalay1971
title: Good hotel but couple things you need to know
text: Stayed here for 8 nights couple of weeks ago. We had a studio room which was a pretty nice size with a small table/chairs and a 1 queen size bed for $62 a night. The only problem with that is all studio rooms are on the 11th (top) floor and the elevator only goes to the 10th floor. So we had to take the stairs 1 floor up which got to be a nuisance after a while carrying grocery, shopping bags, luggages, babies stroller, etc. But can request a bus boy for help for small tip.The other things that I didn't like was you had to pay for WiFi, like $2.50(100PHP) an hour or they have cheaper rates if you buy more and have to use it by a certain time or you loose it. The laundry is charge by the piece, that's right, like $2 for one shirt! No way! They have a nice little pool, a salon, massage parlor, foreign money exchange, and a little restaurant that serve alcohol and OK food. I do like the fact that this hotel is 10 minutes taxi ride to Mall of Asia/Manila Bay and like 20 minutes to Greenbelt shopping center and the airport. There is a casino next door at the Heritage hotel and that is also where the closes ATM is. I also must say the staff was very friendly and polite. The guards out front were very nice and helpful too. They call a taxi or help us in anyway they can. Be sure to have small notes or coins whenever you visit Philippines for tips because some truly deserve it. Overall pretty good hotel.

author: JesseR469
title: Nice, big rooms...no free internet/breakfast :(
text: We stayed at Copacabana from May 16-20, 2012. The hotel is a nice quality apartel and our room was really big. It not only had one room with a bed and nice bathroom, but also a separate living room/kitchenette. Therefore, we had ample space and it would be perfect if we we planned to stay for a week or longer because we could cook and eat in if we chose to. LOCATION: The location is very close to the airport and EDSA street, so it can be a little bit loud from all the honking and sometimes hearing the planes nearby. It is located close to the SM Mall of Asia, which has many stores, movies and a lot of little restaurants and bars on the seaside. It's also across the street from "The Firehouse". Even though it's close to this place, I didn't notice a lot of girls of the night roaming in. (don't worry, I felt safe here). Within walking distance, are a few gas stations, 7/11, and a couple restaurants, but mostly you will have to take a taxi to most places you go. PROS: Big, nice and clean rooms. They appeared newly renovated. Location to airport and SM Mall of Asia. The hotel has a decent pool on the 2nd floor. CONS: They don't have free internet or a breakfast buffett. You have to buy an internet card for an hourly rate or for 24 hours in a row. 24 hours costs 500Pesos. Breakfast is around 200-300pesos. OVERALL: I would stay here again because the location is close to the airport, but I'm huge on free internet, so if I was to look for a similar hotel, then I would try to find one with that first.

author: JoshS139
title: Nice budget Hotel......
text: I have stayed at this hotel twice now in the past 6 months, for a total of about 7 days. This is a good hotel to get some nice sleep, also the pool is very nice as well. It is literally about 5-10mins from Terminal 1, and most taxi drivers when they found out they are going to take you here aren't to happy about it, I guess bc it's so close. But that's fine by me, bc it costs less than 100 pesos to go to and from the airport. Usually Terminal 3 is alittle more, maybe like 50 pesos more, but its ok. The driver's then try and ask me if I want to go to drinky bar for girls. Because obviously bc I am a American, and young. I come to do that. Yeah right The staff here are very good, and attentive. The last time I arrived, I was supposed to be arriving the next day, but I decided to surprise my wife. Well when I got at the hotel, I showed them where I paid for the room, and they told me what room she was in, and turns out she wasn't there. Like a typical woman she went shopping at the Mall of Asia (which is about 100peso taxi away). So I had the front desk call her, and had them tell her to come back for a "emergency phone call." So when she got back there I was waiting for her at the room, needless to say she was very happy and surprised, and the front desk got a kick out of helping me out. Maraming Salamat. Yes, there are better hotels in Manila. But this hotel is a good one close to pretty much anything. The security and front desk are all top notch. I will be staying here again in the future.

author: Robb2000af
title: Not worth the price!
text: I booked through Asia Travel for 2 nights, 3-4 Dec 2011. Check in was good and fast, clerk told me that I was facing EDSA, but being on the 10th floor it did not bother me. One bedroom apartment was spacious and clean. Since we showered on arrival I called and asked for two extra towels and they were delivered within 5 minutes and I was asked to sign for them, no problem. On the next day when the maid cleaned the room she left two additional towels and that was nice. Check-out was very fast (5 am), as I called down prior to leaving room asking them to check room. Now for the bad: There was no water pressure. I could more flow out of a water bottle. The next morning when we went down for breakfast I asked the front desk about the water pressure and she asked my room number. I told her the 10th floor and she replied, "Well sir you are on the 10th floor". The pillows are foam and very uncomfortable. There is NO security box/safe in the room. My room included two plate breakfast. Went to restaurant on 2nd floor and when we went to order breakfast I was told, "Sorry sir, since you booked on-line you can only order the American plate, not Filipino plate, but for an additional charge of 60P, you can order the Filipino plate. The window in the bedroom/bathroom would not close completely, so that made the noise worst. The doorman/security will offer you a hotel car for 270P, but if you say no, he will tell you good luck getting a taxi.

author: jetzlan2011
title: Inadequate Customer Service
text: My fiancee book me into this hotel together with my dad, but we encountered some problems with the booking schedule so we needed to move the dates twice because of personal matters. When we arrived at the hotel, the guy at the main door ask us what business matter we had before we entered inside.I talked to the lady in the front desk and told them my name and gave my letter for the approved re-scheduling of the booking. As to my knowledge my fiancee paid the whole stay through online. But what they told me is that my fiancee only paid 10% of the stay because he used a diff. site to for the reservation..( we stayed on this hotel the other month for 1 night also,though my fiancee paid the whole amount they will still need a 2000 security deposit cash/card and they wont allow you to stay if you dont have the 2000. I called my fiancee and told him about it,then he called them and fix the problem. I wasnt able to pay the 2000 in cash or card cause my money wasn't enough.They decided to remove the amenities like the mini bar and others.) and for the 2nd time i asked them to remove the extra amenities cause we wont be using so that they wont also make us pay the 2000 security deposit just like before,but unfortunately the front desk told me that they can't do it anymore since it was the 2nd time now.And i said okay..they told me to pay the security deposit 2000 and another additional 2,309.85 for the remaining balance which is i was confused because as ive remembered my fiancee already paid everything online and it also states in my itenerary. But to avoid arguments i paid the whole amount they told me. The roomboy took us to the room but again i was disappointed because the room they gave was small and only had 1 single bed. As i know on this booking my fiancee booked me 1 standard room with 2 single beds. So i called the front desk and told them i have my itenerary with me if you called checked it , it shows the preferrences of 2 single beds and the paid full amount of $53. I went downstairs to show them my itenerary and they immediately change our room (what was annoying is they never said sorry for what happened and the front desk said there information was based on what was updated by their manager.( I was thinking what was our registration and reservation online for if on their system it does not provide the correct details better to bring your itenerary than telling them your name because they wont be able to have all the informations regarding your booking unlike other hotels ive been with)So it was all a total mistake that they let me pay the remaining balance of 2,309.85 because my fiancee paid it all. The next day it was our check out time, we were in a hurry because it was almost 12:30 and we were catching a flight back to our province.I asked them to please hurry the check out process and checking of the room, but as if they heard nothing they were very lousy and unsatisfying. I was very disappointed because of their treatment, the other girl in the cashier desk even had a soured face when i ask them about the amount they have deducted in the security deposit. We had a charge of 140 from the mini bar which i thought was only 100 pesos because my dad didnt told me that he also took 1 bottle of mineral water. I asked dad about it and he said yes, i was talking to this girl who was just nice and calm but the other girl sitting soured her face and her reaction was very annoying.. Despite the unsatisfying customer service the second room we had was okay and it was much bigger than the first room we had.. But i wont recommend this hotel to other people i know since their customer service sucks !!

author: James083
title: Copacabana Apartment Hotel >>great staff
text: Copacabana Apartment Hotel 30 Minutes from the Airport this 3 Star hotel is also convenient to Manila center. After an initial problem with my booking I spend 8 nights in the hotel. So I consider I am reasonably familiar with the hotel. The staff were first class in all aspects especially the front desk that helped me with that needle to a plaster when I had anaccident. They were always extremely pleasant and would great me with a smile at all times. The door security was always on the ball and werevery attentive to needs of getting a taxi. However I preferred to get a non hotel taxi (always demand they use their meters as Taxi drivers are notorious and Manila is no exception. The domestic staff deserves a special mention and witnessed an exceptional cleaning of my room every day. No detail was missed. They were also helpful and courteous at all times. They wouldreport an item that would need repaired, in my case a light, I did not report it yet the staff attended to report it without myintervention. The restaurant is small but adequate and a reasonable selection of menu. It is open quite long hours for late arrivals. The pool is quite adequate and never crowded. Internet & Broad band Wi-Fi is available in reception with safe deposit. The hotel can be little noisy with local traffic but it is hard to get away from this is Manila anyway. The biggest Mall in Asia (as I understand) is actually within walking distance (20min) but suggesta taxi at 50 peso is best. This is the Mall of Asia and is fantastic for eating out, superb for shopping and also has latestentertainment. Good priced hotel for business in Manila or overnight stay for onward flights. Thursday, June 11, 2009

author: ZOOM3097
title: GREAT Hotel for a low budget "HONEYMOONERS"
text: For me,honeymoon is not only for the newlywed couple.It is also for people who are vacationing and would like to spend quality time with their family. My visit last October was not a planned visit. My daughter was hospitalized of pneumonia so I had to rushed home to Davao City. We are from New York City but my children lived in the Philippines to study and learn the Filipino culture. When my daughter recovered from her illness I decided to take my family to Manila. My daughter was always curious about Manila. Everytime we go to Davao City, we just passed by Manila. I had a very low budget since that was my third visit that year and also I had to pay for medical bills. But, I was determined to make that trip to Manila so I decided to contact my brother who was a tourist guide to find us a hotel base on my budget. We stayed at the Copacabana Hotel for four days and would like to stay for more but I was only given several days off from work. Our hotel room was not a 5 star hotel room but it was fresh and clean. There was plenty of water in the shower and we have fresh towels everyday.The employees were very respectful and worked hard to satisfy our every needs.Unfortunately, we were not able to use the pool since we were busy with sight seeing and Mall of Asia is just a ride away from the hotel. And also, a walking distance from the hotel are bargain stores that sells really low price ready to wear clothes.We treated our self to a nice massage and my children got a "hot" new hair style at the hotel's spa. We were very happy and satisfied with our stay at the hotel that I would go back there again on my next trip to Manila. And by the way it is summer now in the Philippines.Next week, mydaughter will be vacationing in Manila for one week and difenitely, she will be staying at the Copacabana Hotel with her friends.

author: Curiousjeorge
title: A good Trip Gone Sour
text: I thought I would share this story as it has gone from frustrating to down right funny. I recently stayed in the Copacabana Hotel in Pasay City Manila, Philippines. I have stayed there a few times before. It is relatively inexpensive and convenient so I did not mind that it did not have all of the normal accommodations I was used to when staying in hotels (but beware of the door guards that may ask for a “Gift or Tip” if they run into you when you are downtown). I have stayed in Singapore, South Korea, Japan, Guam, Alaska, Germany, Italy, Greece, etc.. So I am use to different accommodations. What I have experienced recently with them and still going trough is funny if not true. First of all let me be up front that I should have validated all of my charges upon departure so I share some blame in this. I will also give you the condensed version of a 2 ½ month ordeal. Upon checking out of the Hotel I was charged an additional 6000 Pesos which is about 150 US dollars. I did not notice the error until I started balancing my books when I was back in the US. I contacted The Hotel and they stated first that is was not an error, after pointing out to them the number of days I stayed and their rates they stated that the charges were not for the room but they would have to wait a month and a half to get a phone bill from LBC (the local phone company) to make sure it was not for phone calls, I knew then I was in trouble when they had to wait that long but I decided to wait this out. I called them again after 1 ½ months and they stated I had made calls that resulted in the extra charges, I told them I travel with an international phone l and that they might want to recheck what they were stating, they then stated that I had not made calls and they would correct the error. I waited another 2 to 3 weeks after not seeing the money applied to my account and contacted them again. They then stated that they could not reverse the money but would have to apply this to my account and wanted my banking info I told them what card it was charged to and reverse the charges. They stated they could not do that and wanted a checking account number and Bank, I told them “No” they would not get my banking info and to just wire me the money western union, they stated they need my entire address house number phone number etc.. to western union me the money I told them that is not true I have used western union many times and all you need is country and state (maybe even city of pick-up) I still haven’t got the money back 2 ½ months later. So beware if using the Copacabana Hotel in Pasay City, Philippines. Next time I am in the Philippines I will use something like Manila Hotel. Heritage Hotel or a more professional hotel.

author: Russ-McD
title: Functional, and better value for money than its sister hotel next door.
text: We initially tried checking in at the more prestigious "Copacabana Hotel" next door, but the US$150 rate was more than our budget. As we left the doorman suggested we walked next door and tried the Copocapana Apartment Hotel, which evidently is owned by the same Company. This was a far better solution as the walk-in rate was 2205 Pesos, (about UK£27) and the look of the hotel was identical as far as the reception areas went. It also had a pool, which was important to us. Check-in was courteous and we were allowed to park in the hotels secure carpark for free. The first room offered was very spacious, but had 2 single beds; we asked to change it for a double bed, and were moved to a smaller room. However it was clean and big enough for our needs, having a walk in shower, large dresser, fridge (mini-bar with extra space), and TV. The a/c worked but seemed to be operating at its limits and may have struggled on a very hot day. The pool was very clean, although the staff struggled to keep the tiled area around the pool free from the city's grime and if you walked barefoot, your soles became black in a few steps. The showers by the pool were also a little temperamental. The location is probably the best asset as you can actually walk to the "Mall of Asia" (about 15 mins) and there is always a Jeepney or taxi handy, if thats too far. Its also very convenient for the International airport, and always insist the taxi uses the meter - we were quoted 300 Pesos, but after insisting on the meter, the eventual fare was only 60 Pesos. You will also find other things to do in the area as there is a market to the West of the hotel, and the city of Manila starts in earnest if you walk North. This is also the direction to walk if you want to board their overhead rail system. It may not have been the most luxurious hotel around, but represented far better value for money that I suspect the adjacent Copacabana hotel would have. I would certainly recommend for anyone travelling on a budget.

author: OldTaffy
title: Change of booking but worked out well
text: We stayed three nights at this Premier Inn on a leisure visit which is located on a business park at Brockworth with easy access from the M5 Junction 11a. We had originally booked at Little Witcombe but Premier Inn rang us a couple of days prior to the visit to ask us to relocate because they had overbooked the disabled rooms with a wet room which we had advised them we need. This Inn was dearer but Premier Inn stood the additional cost. There is plenty of parking which is pay and display but residents at the Inn get it free. Access for the disabled is very good. Welcome on arrival was very good. The room was very clean with a 6’0” bed and a 26” flat screen television The wet room had a very good walk in shower with plenty of grab rails. There is free wi-fi but the signal kept dropping out or we could not connect. If you want fast broadband then a charge is made. The hotel has a Brewers Fayre pub (Whittle Inn) a short distance away serving breakfast, lunch and evening meals which we did not try. About two minutes walk away is a Greggs where a bacon roll and a hot drink will cost you £2 if you cannot put away the Premier Inn all you can eat breakfast at £9.50. There is also a Subway or a Tesco Extra close at hand. The average cost per night was £63 based on the ability to cancel up to 2pm on the day of arrival. We liked the hotel very much and found it quiet and convenient to get into Gloucester. We would stay here again.

author: Whodhavethoughtit
title: Noisy Traffic & so this hotel EXCLUDES the Good Night Sleep Guarantee!
text: Was Sir Lenny Henry @SirLennyHenry told by his agent that his advert for a Good Night Sleep Guaranteed doesn’t include all Premier Inns? .... READ ON...! My room faced the front and 13 yards from a major roundabout.. This Premier Inn advertises itself as being on a business park... not like any business park I have ever known... it’s an industrial estate. At 23:00 huge artic lorries starting rolling past every 35 minutes and this went on all night. I brought ear plus but they were no use as I could also feel the vibrations from the lorries accelerating passed the hotel, then slowing down at the roundabout before noisily accelerating as they crossed the roundabout. In the morning a helpful chap in the lift informed me that there are two major industrial distribution centres (a Wineries and a Tescos) by the hotel and hence the lorries rolling out all night. He said I should complain... ... when I came to check out in the morning, I casually mentioned the lack of sleep and was rudely interrupted with her saying “well it is a business park and so we do NOT offer the Good Night Sleep Guarantee here”. I hadn’t even complained but the receptionist was really objectionable. She said (without me even asking for a refund) that if I wanted to complain that I would have to write to Premier Inns (premierinn.com/guest-relations). I stay in hotels all over the UK and I have to say that the response and attitude I received in the morning after my stay put a lasting sour taste in my mouth. When I arrived on the Sunday evening the receptionist working until the 23.00 ‘handover’ was so nice. She made me feel very welcome after a very long drive. It's a shame as the room whilst a tad dated, was fine. Safe to say that in my professional legal profession I will not be letting this experience go without an undoubtedly long battle ahead....

author: susanlH9179IW
title: One night for shopping
text: Stayed good Friday one night to do some shopping. Nice friendly welcome by Wendy who booked our breakfast. Our second visit to a premier inn. Given room 4, a family room. Very clean, adequate size. One of the older property's. Good shower. Very comfortable bed and good pillows. Decent T V. Great value as booked months ago. Got exactly what they advertise and what we paid for. Little chat with William on leaving who clearly knows his brand of hotel and was singing their praises, very helpful. Car park is free, you get a ticket from reception. Wendy did tell us and you would know if you do your research. Plenty of useful shops on site as others have mentioned. Easy to find. Would stay again if needed to. A good experience. Small negative......when people moving around, on stairs or along upstairs corridor it was loud but stopped after 10.30 ish so wasn't a problem. Maybe just the room we were in ?

author: coatesyUK
title: Nice quiet Hotel and great for Fairford Air show
text: We booked this hotel as it was the closest we could get to Fairford. The receptionist was very nice and helpful. The room was nice and clean. It also had air con which was a bonus. As it is on an industrial estate, it was quiet. The Brewers Fayre next to the Hotel was nice. There is a Tesco's and Costa coffee close by. There were a couple of negatives but nothing major. There was no clock in the room so if you don't take your phone or an alarm clock, you won't know what time it is. Also this is not just for Premier Inn but all hotels. There are never enough plug sockets. There needs to be sockets by the bed. Most people have phones and tablets, but there are never enough sockets to charge them with. A tip for any air show travellers. You will need to leave before 7.30am if you want to get there for 9am. The traffic starts to get heavy when you get to the village of Poulton

author: ColinN467
title: Standard Premier Inn
text: Stayed Friday & Saturday. Pretty much knew what to expect, having stayed in other Premier Inn's before, and also due to having family members staying at this one before. Checked in no problems and very quick. Room was away from main road so noise levels were pretty normal. A gym overlooks the hotel on this side. The air-con was pretty useless, as the room was extremely warm during the day. We turned it on, and it only had 4 temp settings: 19/20/21/22. When it reached the required temp it turned off completely, so if it warmed up, had to turn the unit back on. Tea/coffee facilities were standard although no free biscuits anymore. Bathroom was fine, and extractor fan was not overly noisey. Main complaint is about the bed. I'm pretty sure the only thing harder than the mattress was a plank of wood. Very disturbed sleep as unable to get comfortable. We had a family room as originally there was supposed to be 3 of us. Luckily as the sofa had been made into a bed, my partner slept on that and was able to get a decent-ish night's sleep. Expect noise if the room is next to the stairs, which ours was. Mainly the banging of the corridor door, as opposed to people talking or stomping.

author: NikNokNoo
title: Disappointed!
text: We have stayed at quite a few Premier Inn's across the country and the stay at this one was quite disappointing. The adverts say extra comfy beds..... not at Gloucester business park! I have never slept on such a hard bed! It was awful! The bed also creaked with the slightest of movement. Squeaky floor too, from the room above. The reception staff, the younger guy was very pleasant always smiled & said hello, but the older guy on duty (mornings) never said a word. Head down looking at computer, even when I stood at desk, it took a while for him to acknowledge I was there! Quite rude. At other Premier Inns, always a smile & a greeting, no matter what time of day. Room was clean but bathroom a little tired. Taps were really hard to turn on & off. Air con is a positive, this is the only reason a score of 3/5 was given. Without Air con the rating would have been poor. If anyone stays here, we found a really nice pub called 'The Victoria' You can see this pub from the back of the hotel. Walk past the Gym, down a short alley & its right in front of you! Good home cooked food, half the price than Brewers Fayre. Very welcoming!

author: angier931
title: Hotter than a sauna!
text: Do not, I repeat do not stay at this hotel in the summer!! I was labouring under the misapprehension that there would be a level of consistency amongst Premier Inns and we had previously experienced this to be the case. Apparently not here though as not only was there no air-conditioning, the TV was the smallest ever, and the bed the most uncomfortable we have ever slept on. Guess we should have guessed we were in trouble when we walked along the corridor and so many of the rooms had open doors where people were obviously trying to get some air into their rooms. The room had the curtains closed to try and keep the sun out but was like walking into a wall of hear. There was a small noisy fan, which Mervyn the Team Leader kindly swopped for his quieter one. It was impossible to cool the room down. Apparently the staff receive many complaints but head office refuse to do anything about. This is a real shame as the staff were friendly, facilities locally were extensive. When five minutes walk, there is a Costa, a Greggs, a Subway, a Dominos, a 24 hour Tesco, and a pharmacy. In addition to the Brewers Fayre next door to the hotel. The hotel was easy to find from the M5 via sat nav, although once in the Business Park, the directions went a little off course. Make sure if you do stay here you get a voucher from the hotel reception for your car, as otherwise it is a pay and display car park. In short, Premier Inn need to get their act together with this hotel, install air conditioning, flat screen tv's, and more comfortable beds, to make it worth ever staying again. For only the second time ever, we invoked the good night guarantee! Feel sorry for the staff here, and anyone crazy enough to stay here in the summer months.

author: paulpebbles
title: clean and comfortable
text: ..We stayed in rooms 10 and 8 for two nights as part of a family trip on an advance saver deal. Check in was pleasant. Premier inn normally have colouring packs for the kids on arrival but this was not offered this time. Rooms were typical premier inn. Clean, comfortable and spacious. Tea and coffee provided. Good bathroom with shower also and toileries provided. Sadly only and old crt tv but with a good freeview selection and a free scart socket for your own kit. We had just previously stayed in a travelodge on a £10 rate that had a 27inch hdtv so premier inn take note.... Nice brewers fayre next door with a good range of food. We did have a few drinks but chose to dine at the crown carvery in cheltenham. It was a lovely pub and great value. There is a fantastic 24hour Tesco on site including a petrol station. We did have breakfast in the brewers fayre on our first morning and was good value but a little disappointing. Some hotels have a buffet style ,others cook to order, this was the latter and maybe the chef was having an off day as some things were over cooked. Nice location for exploring gloucester and neighbouring towns. A good hotel , we would stay again if we were in the area..?

author: shugspice
title: Quiet, comfortable hotel in a great location with friendly staff
text: Great 2 night stay over the August bank holiday at this Premier Inn. We chose this hotel so we could visit Gloucester, Cheltenham and the surrounding area and the location was perfect. It's on a business park just outside Gloucester. The whole area seems to have been developed quite recently and the hotel looks very new. Next door is a Brewers' Fayre pub and a large Tesco is about 5 minutes walk away. There's a bus stop right outside the pub (The Whittle Inn) - which takes you to the city centre in about 30 mins - great if you don't want to worry about driving right into the city and finding parking. The staff at the hotel are friendly and helpful and the rooms are great - really spacious and comfortable. We were on the ground floor in a room facing the road but we had no problems with traffic noise, it was quiet. We got a really good deal and paid £80 for 2 nights which we thought was great value for a bank holiday. It was great to be able to go to the pub next door for evening meals too. Again, this seems a very new pub and the staff are friendly. The food is very reasonably priced and good quality - the portion sizes are also very good. The drinks (especially the wine!) are also good quality and good value. They also serve breakfast in the mornings but we didn't stay for that. Overall, we'd definately recommend this hotel. It's a great price for the location and standard of accommodation. There's a sign outside the hotel which says there's a new shopping and restaurant centre being built nearby (not sure when this will open), so not sure if this might push the prices higher - but we found it to be great value.

author: jasarahor
title: does not even deserve 1*...
text: I received a birthday gift voucher to stay in this hotel, worst birthday present ever. I spoke to a lady over the phone to book and everything was confirmed. I called the day before to confirm our ETA, again everything was fine. Arrived at the hotel as promised at 5pm- apparently no booking was made. The lady on reception called the manager. The manager called us lairs, I literally had to take my phone out to show her my call log to prove to her I did actually call the hotel on the days I said I called.The manager was rude, abrupt and told us she was very sorry but they were fully booked and it was not her problem. I and my friend both work in the hotel industry, if you overbook your hotel it IS in fact your problem. The fact that it was a Groupon voucher that we were using was brought up more than once by the staff. This gave us the impression that if you book through Groupon you are not as important as other guests. Other guests that came to check in were horrified as they stood by and watched how we were treated. We refused to leave the hotel until they admitted fault and fixed this problem. In the end the manager called everyone on her arrivals list to reconfirm their bookings and a double booking was magically found. One mere apology was given along with our keys and we were on our way. The hotel lacks professionalism and structure. What happened to us was not acceptable and we will NOT be back again. Nor will anyone we have told. I would advise anyone to stay away from this hotel and if you do want to stay, do not book through Groupon.

author: francezt
title: Poor customer service
text: My husband and I booked 2 nights here as it was in an area we were travelling. We arrived late on Friday evening as we'd work commitments till late and we were travelling from Dublin down. We had a few drinks downstairs when we arrived (10:30/11 pm). I went to have a shower about 12 or so and there was no hot water ! I rang the front desk and was told the water would be hot again at 6am !! I was cross to say the least but hey-ho... On the Sunday morning at 9am I had a similar experience - LUKE WARM WATER !!! I showered and went to check-out. The receptionist was most unhelpful and her response was 'I'll pass it on to Liam' ... Who's 'Liam' ? I've no idea ... her response was neither professional nor courteous. It left a sour taste in my mouth. May I add... all other staff were lovely. We had breakfast there in the Sunday too, and it was nice. It doesn't take much to look after a guest but it's a lot harder work to win a guest back once they feel they've been cheated...

author: G8052WLsaraho
title: Very bad stay never again
text: Myself and my husband booked this hotel for 3 nights, we went for a deal of 3 nights with 2 dinners included and breakfast for 3 mornings. When we arrived the receptionist was lovely and very welcoming. We were then showed to our room. The room was really dirty the bed had a stain on it and the bed wasn't even made properly the duvet was just thrown in the bed, there was no towels in the bathroom and the cups for tea were filthy. Also there was a big window in our room and we were on the ground floor and the window was facing the car park, there were no nets on the windows so everyone from the car park could see straight into our room. I called reception so we could change have our room changed and we were told we couldn't until the next day so we agreed but the next day we were never contacted about changing room and we ended up being stuck in the same room for the 3 days. The tv in the room was a tiny computer monitor that you could barely see. The add stated that they had multiple channels which they don't the have the couple of Irish channels and that's it. The wi fi was constantly going of and I had to call them about it a few times. When we went for dinner and was informed that the 2 meals we had included in our price were only of the specials menu when no where on the site was this stated, there were about 5 meals on the specials board and these stayed the same for the whole time we were there. My husband ordered the pork stir fry on the second night and it tasted like it had been there for days it was discusting so we sent it back. Finally when the day came that we were leaving we also had a late check out of 1:00 including in our deal and at 12:30 we had a woman knocking on our door asking us if we were staying another night because otherwise she needed the room for the next guests so we were rushed out of the place it was ridiculous. The night before we were kept awake all night by a drunk man next door to us shouting all night and continuously setting of the smoke alarm and no one came down to sort it so we were exhausted when this women came and rushed us out of our room. I am extremely disappointed in our stay in this place. It was supposed to be our anniversary and it was a horrible stay. I certainly wouldn't stay here again. Very very disappointed.

author: Suzy72237
title: Disgraceful
text: Awful stay. My friends room had a leaking bathroom with what can only be described as looking like pee all over the floor. No one available to assist and they don't answer the night number. Reception was not manned. The bar man had to come up and mop the floor quite late. Also there was a 21st on and the noise outside passed 3am was horrendous, drunken arguments and urinating in the car park. whilst I appreciate you can't control people's behaviour they should have been asked to move on or keep quiet. This went on for well over an hour. On check out I wasn't asked if I enjoyed my stay at all. Nothing courteous whatsoever . Totally unacceptable and when I complained anyway it was met by a receptionist who looked passed me and said they "thought the group would be OK" and I got a far away looking "sorry" . All they wanted was my payment which didn't even warrant a thank you? avoid this place. Unless you like not sleeping and being dismissed by the staff for expressing your views. Never felt so unwelcome in a any hotel as this one.

author: Trek174122
title: Girls Night In
text: We booked a night at the Rhu Glenn to have a girls night in before a friend has her baby next month. When we booked it we thought it was much closer to Kilkenny than it actually is, in fact it is much closer to Waterford! When we arrived at 5:40pm one of the rooms was still being cleaned... We were given one room with a double & single bed & the second room had only one double bed - not the two twin rooms we had asked for at the time of booking. There was no attempt to rectify this blunder when we enquirer as we were told they were fully booked for the night. We settled in to our rooms & had planned to go into Waterford for some dinner - not Kilkenny as originally planned as it was too far of a distance. However as we were leaving we were asked by the person at reception if we were going into town, when we replied 'yes' we were asked if we would be late back. What business was this of theirs? We were staying in a hotel free to come & go as we pleased, no?! As our friend is in her last month of pregnancy we were hardly going into town on the tear but if we were why should this matter???? We arrived back from dinner at 10:02pm & the main doors to the hotel were locked! What was this all about?! The rooms were relatively clean but the non-slip mats for the bath were filthy, old & in desperate need of replacement! There was an opened & used shower gel in one of the bathrooms - how well were they cleaned? We would not return not return or recommend this hotel as we were fairly disappointed.

author: martinakeyes
title: Valentine nightmare
text: Arrived to hotel to be told we had no room after booking it through a website a few days previously. Put up in a bb driving back and forth. Told on our arrival back to hotel we would review a meal and drinks for the night. We thought this fair enough... but NO.. We were asked to pay for the meal and a glass of wine and a beer on our departure back to the bb. I refused but the staff were so annoyed. Was never so embarrassed. A terrible experience. The bb was freezing ended up wearing my jumper in bed. Shower door fell off and shower hose squirting out water destroying my hair. Never again. Would never be back again and would not recommend. The website we booked through complimented us very nicely with a night away. One sure thing it won't be used here!!! Luckily I had the emails from the hotel reception showing how they were not been honest with regards to the supposidly free meal and drinks!! Would be an eye opener. Family and friends would have been to this hotel quite a bit but won't return either after our horrendous weekend on Valentine's. One we won't forget. ..

author: DubTwosome
title: A most enjoyable stay
text: Spent a very comfortable overnight in the Rhu Glenn last weekend. There's plenty of free parking in the grounds of the hotel and free Wi-Fi throughout. Check-in and out were hassle-free. We got a lovely cosy room on the ground floor, which had everything supplied. There were extra pillows and a big thick blanket in case we needed them. The room, and indeed the hotel itself, were spotlessly clean. It was a bad night out, and rather than drive the 10 minutes or so to dine in Waterford city, we decided to eat in the hotel. This turned out to be a very good choice, with quite a varied menu, and excellent value at €16.95 per head for two courses (early bird). There is a three course option, but two was plenty for us. The restaurant wasn't open so we dined in the bar where there was a log fire burning, and we sank into the comfortable chairs while our meal was served to us. It was accompanied by a nice (and very reasonably priced) bottle of red wine, after which we relaxed in the bar for a while before returning to our room. The only downside of the room was the tiny television screen; it looked more like a VDU from a computer. However this didn't spoil our stay, which we thoroughly enjoyed. A large comfortable bed, a clean warm room and an undisturbed nights sleep and a good fresh-cooked breakfast before heading off the next morning - we couldn't ask for more. Contrary to other reviews we have read, we found the staff to be very helpful and friendly. This hotel is excellent value for money and not only would we recommend it, but we would definitely stay here again next time we are down in this neck of the woods.

author: sandraCarlow
title: stayed there but won't be back again
text: myself and my husband and my 2 children stayed at this hotel and were very disappointed! The hotel its self was lovely eg. the decor and location. the family size rooms were very large and quiet beautiful. we went for a meal in the lufanny resturant in the hotel and it was like something out of a comedy you would see on TV. when we arrived in the hotel we had to seat ourselves as we were standind waiting for ten minutes and no one to be seen. we picked a table and eventually someone came out to us, she gave us our menu which consisted of a sheet of A4 paper and not the proper leather menus. we ordered our starters and main course and wine which arrived down not opened and in no wine bucket, now i'm not fussy and laughed all this off , but i have to draw the line here, the waitress stood and moaned to us the whole way through our meal. so much for a nice meal out. when we finished our main course she shouted form across the resturant ..... DO YE WANT SOME DESSERT! i replied yes and asked to see the dessert menu to which she rattled off the desserts . out of desperation we each picked something which we did not eat ( food was lovely) and finished off our wine as quick as we could just to get out of there. on the way out she shouted DID YOU DRINK THAT WHOLE BTL OF WINE ALREADY? we sounded like alcos. we were never asked did we enjoy our stay when we booked out. i know i know we should of complained but didn't like to cause a fuss as we had to stay there. my husband was fuming as is was mean't to be a lovely weekend and that ruined one of our nights there. maybe we were just one of the unlucky ones.

author: starfrenzy
title: Dog Hotel. Not worth the money.
text: This was my first time at a La Quinta property and I won’t likely choose one again. This hotel is “dog-friendly” but the way it is executed, it seems like it’s Dog Hotel, with humans also allowed. They don’t designate which rooms dogs can stay in and which are dog-free. Our room had a terrible odor. Head of Housekeeping was unable to remove the odor. The hotel entrance also reeked of dog poop. We opted to shorten our reservation there and move to another hotel. Besides the dog smell issues, the decor is also dated. Breakfast chairs are stained. Double beds, not queens. They also don’t have a pool but they do let you go to a YMCA about 1.5 miles away. We tried that, and although the YMCA was a nice place, the desk staff there incorrectly told us it was open swim time, and after we and our five kids changed into our swimsuits, we went to the pool and found out it was actually lap-swim only. Honest mistake on their part but just be advised that you can’t go swim any time you want. The only thing we liked about this hotel was the rooms were not too small, and it was in a nice neighborhood, bordering on residential. We took our kids on a short walk through the neighborhood to a playground nearby.

author: superdave65
title: A great choice for a value hotel - don't hesitate
text: I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Great experience and a tremendous value when the Breakfast is figured in. Ability to reserve and cancel up until 6pm on day of check-in is an amazing benefit not offered by most chains. Staff was on the ball, friendly and willing to help. There was a terrible blizzard so the hotel was filled with last minute travelers but the staff showed no sign of being overwhelmed in light of this difficult situation. The room was spotless, and up to date. Comfortable bed with a choice of different pillow type and firmness. Climate was easy to control and worked well. Only negatives would be unsecured Suggestions would be Secure the WiFi. Currently there it is insecure and this leaves guests open to having data such as passwords harvested when not connecting to secure websites. More television choices - 30 channels plus HBO very underwhelming. Rooms should have drapes that will close (no blackout curtains). The sheer curtains that are provided allow people to see in at night...don't care for that at all. As far as dining goes, there is no restaurant, but there is a Marriott less than a block away with a full bar and restaurant should you choose not to drive. Other restaurants and shopping malls within 2 miles. Right on the freeway (I-394) going into downtown Mpls...about a 8 minute drive to downtown and right in between 2 other major freeways (I-494 and MN100) for easy travel. 20 minutes from the airport and MOA in light traffic.

author: lizzie0244
title: Not quite up to par
text: I stayed here in 2015, and this time I stayed with my sister who is 83. Because I asked for a refrigerator in the room for her medication - they thought I needed a disabled room - incorrect. The room we were in had a bar next to the toilet which someone had pulled out of the wall - they came and fixed that right away. I requested another room, and we got to move on Saturday and after having checked in on Wednesday evening. When changing rooms I moved all of our luggage, and accidentally forgot my shower gel, and face washing lotion in the disabled room. I asked immediately about that, and finally learned it had probably been thrown out. That day when we switched rooms I had gone down and gotten some breakfast for us both, and brought it back up to the room. I had a waffle with syrup which I dumped in the wastebasket by the desk. That was Saturday morning. When we returned to the room on Monday evening I was looking at my laptop, and had a problem with the mouse- when I dumped the old battery In that wastebasket I figured there was no problem with the battery, and when I retrieved it found there was still syrup in the bottom of the plastic liner. No one changed the liner from Saturday to Monday? So when we checked out I asked for the manager, and informed him of the "minor" things we had run into. He asked if there was anything he could do - I stated maybe the housekeeping just needed to be trained a little better, and left a tip for the maids. I also stated maybe you could take some off the bill. He stated that since we had already checked out, that he couldn't. I assumed that the other stay was indicative of how this stay would be, but found that was not the case. The staff was helpful, and the free breakfast was good, but the "minor" things impacted the stay. I guess if I go back again I will check out other options. This was also the time of the State Fair so it was a good bargain for the price, and clean and quiet, except for the thunderstorm that woke my sister in the middle of the night.

author: MelissaB233
title: Hotel was clean and comfortable but not for us
text: My daughter and I decided to stay at this hotel for our 7 hour trip from Canada while we attended a Lady Gaga concert. We chose this hotel because of the free parking free wifi and especially the free breakfast so we didn't have to waste time going somewhere else before our long trip back home. When we checked in the lady who checked uscin was so nice and helpful. I believe she told us breakfast was from 6-10am. The hotel room was clean, comfortable, it also had fridge, microwave coffee maker and hair dryer. There is no pool, if you want to swim I was told you can go to the YMCA for free a few blocks away but there is a gym.The only issue I had with this hotel is, we woke up at 9am because we didn't get to bed until at least two am because it took so long to get back from the concert with all the chaos from the traffic. We were tired so we thought that getting up at 9 and going for breakfast was reasonable. We called down to make sure that breakfast was still going on at 9:25. The lady told us breakfast was over at 9 but there was fruit still there that we could have. Of all the hotels I've stayed at most of them stay open until 10 but not this one during the week it closes at 9. We were pretty upset because this was just going to waste more time for us and fruit wasn't going to cut it before our long drive back. When I went to check out of the room a bunch of staff were sitting in the breakfast area EATING breakfast. This made me upset. One of them seen me, she then comes to the desk to check me out and just as she's about to help me the phone rings and she answers it without even saying anything to me. I thought this was rude. I left the hotel keys on the desk and just walked away. This experience left a bad taste in my mouth, next concert I go to in st.paul I will definitely not stay here. It seems more like a business oriented hotel.

author: Joyflnoise
title: Nice visit!
text: Upon arrival we walked into a nice large lobby. We were greeted by friendly staff. Within minutes we were checked in. The hallway to our room looked old and dated. I was relieved when opening the door to our king room. It was clean, spacious and decorated nicely. Our room did not come with a microwave or fridge. It did have a flatscreen tv, coffee maker (which wasn't working), iron, free wifi, free Bright side breakfast, and free pet policy. We had previously considered walking to a nearby restaurant for dinner, but the area where the hotel is located wasn't lit well and we decided to order a pizza. Our room was quiet and the bed was comfortable. We were pleasantly surprised at breakfast. They offered fresh oatmeal with almonds, raisins, and brown sugar. Also offered fresh apples and bananas. They had skim milk, fat-free cream cheese, regular cream cheese, three choices of yogurt (Chobani and Activia), make your own waffle, cheese omelettes, sausage, pancakes, juice, coffee, and an assortment of carbs. We were very pleased with our stay here and would highly recommend them.

author: Anonymomof2
title: Great Value! Best kept secret in twin cities
text: We have stayed at this LaQuinta twice now and it is probably the best place we have stayed in the area. It's not fancy but it's nice. It doesn't have every amenity but if you are not in need of or don't use the amenities anyway, it makes no difference. This hotel is in a really nice area and is close to Trader Joes, Whole Foods and Ridgedale Center and many restaurants and shops. It is a safe area and has a nice wooded area next to it. We stayed in a standard double room the first time we stayed and the room did feel a bit small. This time we opted for a king suite and were very pleasantly surprised by the spaciousness of the room. The room was basically two separate rooms. One had a pull out couch, tv, desk, bathroom, fridge and microwave and the other had the king bed, chair and tv. Both rooms had ample space. The room was extremely quiet and clean and nicely updated. The bed was quite comfortable and the room was overall a great value. Even with the higher price for the suite it was still affordable and well within our budget and we are definitely a family who travels on a budget. I did not have the breakfast but my husband did. There were plenty of options for him and he was very satisfied with it. Staff is friendly and attentive. This is a very well-run hotel.

author: kzs1
title: quiet, good breakfast, helpful staff
text: We stayed at the La Quinta, Minnetonka, for four days following eye surgery at a nearby clinic. We got a suite which had a king size bed, fridge and microwave, couch, and extra TV, and desk area. We were on the second floor, and the room was pretty quiet even though the corridor looked onto the check-in area below. Since we were recovering from surgery, we were glad it was quiet. When people moved in next door with two dogs that barked, we asked the manager to take care of the problem and he did. The free breakfast was probably the best that we've had at this kind of hotel. Good coffee, a nice selection of teas, fresh apples and bananas, several choices of yogurt, and a variety of hot items each day: one egg dish (scrambled or omelettes), a meat dish (sausage, bacon, or meat patty), and French toast one day, pancakes the next. The waffle maker was available every day as were breads, bagels, and other items. The area was kept very clean. It was nice that while the TV in the breakfast area was on, it wasn't blaring. Some people like to eat their breakfast in relative quiet. We do have a few suggestions for further improvement. The couch in our room was not comfortable at all and even though the room had apparently been refurbished pretty recently, this sofa looked older. The towel hook in the bathroom had come off and was on the bathroom vanity when we arrived. It needed to be reattached. We appreciated the fact that when we asked for maid service at certain times while we were at the clinic, the hotel was able to comply so we were not disturbed when we returned from the clinic and needed to rest. All in all, we give this hotel high marks.

author: jacobak4
title: Not that Great
text: This hotel was one of my company's "preferred" hotels in the area. All of the other standard business hotels were sold out. I would not recommend staying here. When you walk in you see a nice updated lobby with nice furnishings, but that's where it ends. The bedroom was ok at best. It smelled like someone had smoked in the room before me. The door coming into the room was very old and not very secure. The bathroom is where I had most of my issues. First, I found a bunch of hairs everywhere. The cleaning was definitely half heartedly done. The tiles in the shower were cracked, some of which had been replaced by different colored tile. The bathroom countertop was the only thing that looked newer. The noise you could here in the room was also a factor. You could hear everything. If I am going to criticize a place, then I am also going to point out its good features. It is in a convenient location, easy on and off access to the freeway. The staff was also helpful during check in and check out. My business plans did change, so I needed to checkout a few days early. They were very accommodating. Breakfast was ok, but nothing special.

author: flowerladytoo
title: Great stays in a very nice hotel!
text: We've stayed three times at this hotel, in Feb, April and May of 2014. We were in a two room suite two of the three times (my pictures are of the suite), and it was awesome each time. Brand new bed in both rooms, that was so comfortable, we wished we could sneak it out with us. The bedroom in the two room suite is to the back, away from the hall, and is very quiet. Each time we stayed we never heard a sound, even in the regular room. The rooms were always extremely clean, well equipped, Lots of towels. The internet worked great. Lots of channel choices A nice big TV in the separate bedroom of the suite, and another one, not quite as big in the living room area. The regular room had a large TV, also. A nice desk and chair, micro and fridge worked great in both the room and the suite. The breakfast here has scrambled eggs, sausage and was kept well stocked. Delicious breakfast. The only change I would make would be to add a second waffle maker...there was a long line each time we were there, to make waffles. They even had sugar free syrup, hard to find at many hotels. We enjoyed all three stays very much, and look forward to our upcoming stay again, in August. I want to add that the employees, at the desk, at the breakfast and even housekeeping, were very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend this La Quinta!

author: DebraMN59
title: Very welcoming
text: My husband and I stayed here for 1 night. All staff were very kind and welcoming. The room was quite large with a very comfortable king size bed and 5 pillows which were all to our liking. The air conditioning worked well and was quiet it was 88 degrees outside and it kept the room @ 68 degrees which we set it for. The room was spotless when we arrived. The furnishings were nice and inviting. Little extra touch the chocolate mints for 2 which is a small gesture but pays out in a big way with welcoming you. A card is left with the name of the person who got your room ready for you which adds to the personal touch. Everything worked well in the bathroom. They do the towels up fancy for shampoo and lotion. The free breakfast in AM was very good we chose the omelet, sausage, yogurt, bagels with cream cheese, English muffins with jam, OJ, and fresh fruit. All of our choices were cooked properly and warm, the sausage was especially good. There were other choices such as waffles, cold cereal, oatmeal, muffins, dole fruit cup, other juices, coffee. I liked that they had a mini fridge to keep yogurt, fruit cups, cream cheese and toast spreads cold. If you leave there hungry you must be a very picky eater. I want to thank the staff for running a " well oiled machine" what a great place to stay!

author: JimDavisHouston
title: Nice Business Stay
text: This was a very nice Business stay. Check-in was fast and friendly. The rooms are fairly large. The atmosphere in the room was excellent. Everything was fresh & clean. A flat screen with about 30 channels. Flat screens are becoming as common as phones in the rooms, but this one had an excellent picture, and no interrupted service during my stay. The Free Internet connection was fast and reliable. The work desk was large and well lit with plenty of electrical outlets and USB charger connections. Heat/AC was effective and quiet. Microwave and Fridge. The bed was slightly soft for my liking, but it was clean and comfortable. Another outlet and USB charging station was located on the nightstand. Large Bathroom, good water pressure, and plenty of hot water. Just be warned that they have very soft water, and things are somewhat slippery while showering. The tub is non-slip, but not 100% effective. The free breakfast average for Hampton standards, but had a decent variety. There’s not much around the area that I could see. A shopping center is close with a food store. Nice place for business travelers.

author: Latitude41
title: THE BEST hotel staff, hands down!
text: This is a very nice Hampton. The wooded lot with the trees outside your window makes you easily forget that you are in a hotel near a highway and conveniently located near many restaurants, shops, and a nice mall. We were completely satisfied with our stay. The hotel was very clean and easy to navigate and our room had everything we needed including a (large) mini-fridge and microwave. The reason that I am writing this review though is because of the staff. The staff is truly amazing. We arrived late and completely exhausted after a long drive to be greeted by the friendliest, most helpful staff that genuinely cares about their guests. We were quickly checked in and too tired to go out to eat, we were provided a stack of menus and several recommendations for food delivery. Our pizza (Pizza Luce) was there within 15 minutes and was fantastic, as recommended. After believing that this was all too good to be true, tragedy struck when a diamond stud earring was washed down the shower drain. Although seemingly hopeless, I headed back down to the front desk in an effort to calm a very distraught girl that had just lost her earring. Once again, the staff was truly concerned about our situation and left a note for maintenance to come up to our room the next morning. Our hero, Jason, arrived the next morning and went WELL out of his way to retrieve the lost earring!! Unbelievable. I can't say enough great things about this staff. The only negative is, for us, that they raised the bar and we're unlikely to get that quality of service anywhere else. THANK YOU!!!!!!!!!!!

author: gjb2424
title: Amazing from Start to Finish
text: What can I say, first of all when we arrived they greeted us with ice cold tea, and cold towels to cool us off... off to a great start! The grounds and facilities are exactly as advertised, although the pictures don’t do it justice. The views are spectacular, the pool is amazing, and overall being here is a full experience in and of itself. We debated on going on another pre-planned tour or just staying at the hotel, and we chose the hotel. The food was delicious. The breakfast every morning was on point, so much variety and friendly service. The staff is attentive, accommodating and pleasant (every single day). There is something for everyone to eat at Nook Dee. And if you don’t want to eat here, they provide a shuttle service free of charge down to Kata Beach, so you can find other food establishments, or hit the beach (which they provided beach/pool towels and beach bag for) They have a couple bars at the Hotel, one poolside and one on the roof. The drinks arent too strong and there was a 10% surcharge for some reason but thr view more than makes up for that. They also provide movie nights on the lawn, where they project several options for your viewing pleasure. We took advantage on our last night and it was a great way to cap off the experience. If all I have to complain about is the strength of a drink then I’d say this Hotel is superb. We would definitely stay here again and again and again! Gabe&Shauna

author: 460claras
title: Skip the Buffet
text: PRO: The room is very nice. I liked the interior design with the minimalistic charcoal walls combined with discreet Thai kitsch. The huge bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was attractively designed. A modern TV and a beautiful view. CONTRA: 1. The communal area around the pool is not particularly charming. The somewhat shabby building facade blocks the view and the spartan furniture and bar area was disappointing 2. The hotel is up high on a very steep hill. There is a shuttle which solves that problem. Unfortunately there is no service in the evening (however there is a single service at 10pm) 3. The Thai Buffet was a big let down. Overpriced with mediocre food that had obviously been prepared some hours before. This goes against typical Thai cooking style where everything is prepared/cooked freshly a-la-Minute. The Prawns had not even been cleaned (deveined). To make matters worse they slapped on service and VAT surcharge without any notice on the board where the banquet with a price of 890 Baht had been advertised. This was in actual fact a scam and a serious rip off. CONCLUSION: If you basically just desire a room without hotel amenities and food & beverage, you are fine here. Leave the rest, it isn’t much good.

author: PYYan
title: Lovely and relaxing small resort with nice location
text: We are glad to finish our Thailand visit here for 3 nights! It was located on a hill with an amazing view from the room, pool and the roof. We enjoy every moment of it. The staff are friendly and food of the hotel are great! We tried the room service first night and their outdoor buffet second night. Both were yummy food with fresh herb and ingredients. The hotel has buffet style breakfast every morning that serve western and asian food. I can't beliebe anyone would complain about this. Lots of fruits and veggie options as well. And they make good espresso type coffee per order. Even better than the coffee that we got from the outside cafe. However, the cocktails on the roof top was not good, save your money to get real cocktail outside. One tip from us is to rent a scooter from the scooter rental located right outside the hotel. Make sure to bring extra money for deposit (5000b) and rental fee. You don't need international driving license for scooter. Just use your common sense on driving and make sure to drive on the left side of the road. It really helped us to get around town without paying taxi fee or waiting on the shuttle. Overall, I recommend this to couples or adults. Not so much for kids. And if we go back to Phuket, we will stay there again!

author: sarahwisniewski
title: Delightful Surprise
text: Nook-Dee was our final few days in Thailand after spending time in Patong and Khuekkhak. The stay was nothing but dreamy. We arrived in the late afternoon to staff setting up a BBQ seafood buffet for the evening. As it's perched on the hill, the outdoor area and pool overlooks the hill down the beach - making it a perfect spot for sunset. Reception is strategically placed in this respect which allows you to relax immediately. With some cute, semi-kitsch decor around, the place has a pretty fun and relaxed vibe. The hotel seemingly attracts alot of thai locals, which definitely softens the OTT tourist vibe you can get at other hotels. In addition to the outdoor dining area and pool, there is an upstairs bar and open area with beanbags to relax with a beer or coconut and watch the sun go down - truly magical. Buffet breakfast are simple and modest, yet the best omelettes and highest quality spread we found throughout our ten days in the country. The rooms are nothing short of stunning. They are cosy, with quirky, cosy fabrics, all alongside clean lines in their room design, deep timbers and patterned tiles. Rooms face out to the same sunset you view from rooftop. It's cliff top, so a scooter hire (available at hotel) is recommended. Staff were friendly, helpful, and warmly shy. We had such a lovely stay. We wished we could stay longer, and honestly long to return.

author: bangay
title: No soul, forcing location and disturbing profit desire.
text: Hotel is at the hill, so has a beautiful view, but very hard to climb if you don’t use taxi. Hotel has shuttle 5 times a day, in every 2 hours and the last time is at 5 pm. So you have to use taxi or walk after this time. Hotel probably doesn’t offer shuttle after 5 pm just to keep guests at hotel’s restaurant. Hotel’s location offers a nice view, but so hard to reach to hotel if you miss thise very few shuttles. Rooms are spacious, nicely decorated and very clean. Pool is so nice, relaxing and has a beautiful view. We had lunch three times at restaurant and liked very much what we ate. So delicious, but a bit pricey. Staff at restaurant is amazing. Breakfast is very good. Tour prices at hotel is so expensive. They tell the companies they use are the best, but we compared hotel’s prices with city prices, hotel prices were so expensive. We checked the same company’s zipline prices at city. City prices were quite cheaper. So, we liked restaurant, pool and rooms, but location forced us too much. In every square meter of hotel, you feel their profit desire, but unfortunately you don’t feel any soul...

author: VickyMARitson
title: Very average.
text: We stayed here for 4 nights in a standard room. The hotel is spotlessly clean and the decor is lovely. There are reasonably priced soft drinks and beers in the room mini bar and 2 complimentary bottles of water a day. We did not enjoy the food at all in the hotel apart from breakfast, which was decent. We ate one evening meal in the hotel, the service was poor and the meat over cooked. We had lunch twice, the first time my lunch was lovely but my husband ordered a pork dish and when he started eating it he found it was over cooked fish. The second lunch we both ordered club sandwiches which were very dry with no sauce on them and the bread was sweet and coated in sugar. I get they were probably going for brioche but it was far too sweet and didn’t work. The cocktails were really good though. There are shuttles hourly down to the beach but these stop at 17:00. It was an easy walk downhill to town and about 250-300 baht in a tuktuk or taxi back up. The pool is great and got lots of sun so was nice and warm. I felt the hotel was just a bit soulless, the way a city centre Ibis or Novotel is, its not what I expected from a Boutique resort. And while we only paid £80 a night so we didn’t expect pure indulgence we didn’t feel there was any luxury element to it despite the hotel winning a luxury award in 2016. If it’s that kind of vibe you are after I would recommend the hotel but I found it unremarkable. Things we did nearby we could recommend: •Karon Viewpoint - But get a taxi for 250-300 baht! We walked from the hotel and it was a killer uphill! •Eightfold Restaurant - Tiny little place on the main strip in Kata, really cheap and really good food. •Sunrise Phi Phi Tour with Simba - Brilliant crew, good food and a lovely day. •Elephant Retirement Park Phuket - Promoting ethical elephant tourism, we had the most incredible day.

author: Holly_n_Ruth
title: AMAZING SERVICE, BEAUTIFUL VIEW, GREAT FOOD
text: My girlfriend and I stay in this resort for 5 nights. The sea view from our balcony is amazing! Very clean bathroom and nice bath robe. This resort is very thoughtful. They have a lot of power plugs in the room. The food in the restaurat is amazing! Very authentic thai food and I love how friendly the staffs are as well. Most importantly they remember our room and they are always very helpful. The pineapple fried rice is a must-try. Other than that, the breakfast buffet has a really great selection. The pool is very instagram worthy as well. You can enjoy a 2 for 1 cocktails during happy hour at the pool or on the rooftop to enjoy the sunset. The bartender surely did his job well! I love the Coco Loco and Piña Colada. This resort is on a very slopey hill. But they have free shuttle bus service every 2 hours to both Kata Noi and Kata Beach. So far this resort has not disppointed us for once. I'm pretty sure if we visit phuket again we will definitely go back to this resort!

author: AntBex6869
title: Superb hotel; relaxed, lifestyle, 5* service, views
text: Small ‘boutique’ hotel with 5* attention to detail. Great sized room (we had 835) with a spa bath (it was an upgrade we pre-booked) with beautiful quality sheets, view of Kata Noi beach and surrounding hills with total privacy. Air conditioning and ceiling fan together with two sets of French doors to two balconies, one with our spa bath. Good fittings to everything and very clean. Great shower room with double basins, rain shower and window to room and view! There was also a blind should that be necessary. The pool area was immaculate and felt friendly and relaxed. It was always quiet so plenty of loungers and often only me in the infinity pool. The pool bar provided some background music (low level, not intrusive) and high quality food with drinks. My favourite was the Skybar with cocktails and view of the Big Bhudda, Kata beach, Kata Noi and Karon in the distance, all surrounded by hills of Phuket. The jungle sounds were great and the sunsets fabulous. High quality food in the restaurant and very attentive yet fun staff. To me this Hotel was perfect balance of relaxed fun, privacy and high quality service. I would return, and highly recommend. In case it’s helpful, this hotel was chosen from other Tripadvisor’ feedback.

author: jayandchels
title: Two Gorgeous Weeks
text: We spent two gorgeous weeks at Nook Dee in March 2018. Some things we really enjoyed about the hotel: 1) the pool - it is one of the most incredible infinity pools we've ever seen. Not really made for children and people who had kids seemed a bit stressed at times because it could potentially be kind of dangerous. 2) breakfast - we enjoyed the buffet breakfast each morning. It has a wide selection of pretty good quality food. The whole buffet room had a bit of an off putting smell in my opinion but it was not that big of a deal because we enjoyed the food itself. 3) the gym - it is a decent facility. Located in the spa. 3 cardio machines, a few free weights and a universal machine make for a pretty good workout. Never busy. We stayed for two weeks and I saw no one else use the gym except us. 4) the hill - it is steep. We are active and in our young thirties and I still found the hill pretty unbearable. In the heat and if you're carrying anything... But I guess you have to burn off the banana pancakes somehow. All in all we enjoyed our stay. The room was nice (I liked the bed a lot), the staff was helpful (a few little language barriers but nothing major), the location is quiet and private. It is located within walking distance to anything you need, but there is also a shuttle if you would prefer. We would definitely return :)

author: Xanadustar
title: (Not too) far from the madding crowd
text: Nicely designed hotel above the beautiful beaches of Kata with great views. We stayed for four nights which was probably one too many as although the hotel was nice, we just didn’t like Kata very much and are thankfully now appreciating a less crowded and traffic congested stay on Koh Lanta. We had a deluxe panoramic sea view room which was beautifully decorated but on the cosy side. The view however was fantastic and being able to watch the sun set from the balcony was a treat. The infinity pool is a show stopper though during our stay there were lot of young Chinese families who liked to use it as a sort of wet crèche, resulting in a lot of splashing around from little children so not particularly peaceful. Sun beds were plentiful though. Plenty of choice at breakfast though not really high end (the hotel bills itself as 5 star). Very good coffee. Downsides are the hill which is as challenging as other reviewers have said, not helped by the fact that you have to walk on the busy main road with no pavement. It takes about 10minutes to walk down into town. We didn’t use the hotel shuttle bus as the departure times in the evening are not at all practical - 5.00pm or 9.00pm. They really should make more of an effort with this or just not bother at all. WiFi connection was fine by the pool but virtually non existent in our room. Staff were great at all times and we asked for and received a packed breakfast on the day we left as we had an early start. So good on the whole but not truly 5 star compared to other places we’ve stayed. But I am picky!

author: ALutz324
title: Nice Hotel, Small Rooms, Some Staff Not Helpful
text: All in all, a nice little hotel. The staff at the lobby/front desk were so unfriendly and rude, except for the manager who was sweet and kind. Mostly it's a young team and they act incredibly arrogant. The manager and staff from the pool and restaurant were very kind and helpful, but the front desk staff were terrible. The rooms are far too small. It is the smallest room we ever had in Thailand. There is no place to put your clothes or organize your things for a long term stay. The staff really caters to Chinese guests and it was evident. Also if you don't tip everyone at the hotel you wont get any service.
