It was clean and very spacious, although could do with updating it was still fine for what we needed. The bins were changed everyday and toilet roll was provided in the plenty, towels were changed twice which was fine. the swimming pool was freezing, even after a long day in the sun it was still freezing cold, however I did get in the pool twice and it was refreshing after sitting in the sun all day, kids didn't seem to mind as they were in and out all day long. Food was ok, lunch and dinner consist of a fish dish, a meat dish, rice and chips, breakfast was continental, if you are not fussed about what you eat it is perfect, food in the town is cheap enough if you want to eat out anyway. If taking children I could see why people would moan about the all inclusive as there was not much choice for the kids. evening entertainment was not every night but the club house still had music playing when there wasn't any. Perfect location for the hotel, if you came out of the hotel and went left you would find the shops and beach, if you came out of the hotel and turned right you would find the marina, all within a five ten min walk. Beaches are stunning and well worth a walk along. Drinks were a local beer, local white wine, local red wine and soft drinks. Spirits were only on the all inclusive after 8pm but to be honest after watching the way some of the brits behaved on just the beer and wine I was rather pleased. This hotel is perfect for a cheap getaway, like i say if you are not fussed about what you eat and just see it as a meal then the all inclusive is a perfect choice, if you are looking for 5* quality I wouldn't book all inclusive. Loved every minute of our holiday away.

author: MarieW654
title: Exceeded expectations
text: Just back from a 4 night stay and this hotel is far better than the reviews led me to believe. I think you have to base your opinions bearing in mind the price paid for all inclusive is less than a grotty b&b in Blackpool. The room was very dated but clean. The bed were comfortable yet firm. We had maid service every day although the towels were not changed. There was always hot water and the shower was powerful. Tv in room with a few English channels, you do not have to pay for the tv, just a deposit for the remote. The food was better than expected after reading the reviews. The soup was always lovely and there was a fish, meat and children’s choice lunch and dinner. Drinks were self service. Spirits are not included in the all inclusive until the evening. Plastic glasses day and evening. All staff were friendly and efficient. Large pool and spacious sun bathing terrace. Plenty of sun beds €1.50 each. Lovely resort with a fantastic beach. All inclusive bands are cut off at check out. I would return as thought it was great value for money.

author: SteveB2067
title: Let’s be honest.....
text: We paid £158 for 4 nights all inc. for a family of 4. You couldn’t get a room only Ibis in the UK for that, so manage your expectations. Good location, 5 mins from strip and beach. Arrived and asked for a low floor which was accommodated no problem, also arrived 4hr before check in time and room was sorted by house keeping and we were allowed in which was great. Room was big and spacious, clean and tidy. Big pool, friendly staff and room cleaned everyday. The food is limited, 2 choices, a fish and one other, sometimes ok, one day where it wasn’t good. They get through the bar service as quick as they can, it is only 2drinks per person, but that’s normal on all inc. in summary, if you want modern accommodation, restaurant food and have a couple of thousand pound, there are many nice 4/5star hotels around, good on ya, go for it. If you want somewhere to stay, canteen food and spend a few hundred quid then this is the place. We got the same sun, same beach, same sea and same access to the strip. But had money left to enjoy the resort. The only thing wrong with this hotel is the expectation it’s guests arrive with. You for a meal and expect ala carte.....

author: 578liae
title: Avoid at all costs
text: I have stayed in plenty of low budget hotels over the years and have always been pleasantly surprised, I'm certainly not a complainer and have the attitude "a holiday is what you male it". We had a fantastic time on this holiday too. But only because we spent very little time at the hotel. I took my 12 and 13 year old nephews with me, we had to eat out every day because the food was horrendous. There was very little choice and whatever they had was inedible. The meat was never cooked properly and as my nephew said "they even managed to mess up chips, how do you even do that". The pool area was grubby but not too bad. You couldn't do much there though, my nephew wanted to kick the ball around, but was told he couldn't, he was away from everyone and not causing any disturbance, as they have no actual area where he could play with a ball o thought they could have compromised, but no. The games room was God but obviously you had to pay for all the games, as you did for sunbeds and coffee between breakfast and the bar opening. Our room was 223 and it was shocking, there were broken tiles all up the walls which were really sharp and broken tiles on the floor area in the room and balcony, two of us cut our feet on these. The room was filthy and only cleaned 3 times when we were there, the pull out mattress was solid and really uncomfortable. Only one of us could manage a warm shower per day and that one had to be quick, the hot water ran out really quickly morning and night. Some staff were nice but the majority were really rude, especially the women in the back bar, they couldn't even muster a smile and barked at my nephew when he asked for red sauce. As I say I'm really not a fussy traveller but this hotel is the worst I have ever stayed in, it's not worth any money you pay, especially if you take children with you, if it was myself and my part er I would have been u happy but with children it's worse. Badly run hotel, I would never go back here again.

author: Theyareatschool
title: Hotel heaven or hell
text: We have just come back from a weeks holiday at the Clube Praia da Rocha as a family of 4 myself my husband and two children 15 & 8 On arrival (at 11am) we spoke to a helpful man on reception who said that we could not get in our room till 4pm and get our all inclusive bracelet till 12, so we went in to the bar and had a drink and waited. At 12 I went back to the reception where we were given our info pack and bracelets and our key! We were in block 1 on the 7th floor, we took one of the 4 lifts up to our room. The room was very basic a large living dining room with a kitchenette and a bedroom with 2 single beds and bathroom with a 4 piece bathroom suite, and a cupboard ( cleaning bits) The first thing I noticed was that it was very basic but as we had only paid £750 for the whole holiday all inclusive including our hotel, private taxi transfer & flights I wasn’t expecting a great deal so I wasn’t disappointed. The decor was in real need of a lick of paint but as a base it was sufficient for our needs. There was no remote for the tv this was obtained with a €10 deposit (given back when returned) , no kettle ( I was not aware that you could rent one) but there was a pan so that was good enough for making a cuppa. There was a safe but again you had to pay to use it for us it was €10 for the week but with a €20 deposit (returned when key was given back) The appt was big enough for us and was sufficient for our needs. We went to the pool and found out that to hire sun beds it was €1 each per day and a further €1 to hire parasols I did think that this was a bit of a cheek but it meant that you could leave your stuff if you went for lunch knowing it was ok. The bar served wine, beer or soft drinks for all inclusive free all day but at a limit of 2 per person each visit so it stopped people taking advantage which people would do otherwise. Spirits were served in the evening after 8pm (I think) Breakfast was vast, bacon, sausages, eggs, beans, tomatoes, mushrooms, ham, cheese, breads (several different ones) cereal, pastries, fruit, yogurts, jams fruit juice, coffee, teas etc Lunch always a hot option plus salad, puddings Snack bar burgers, hotdogs, chips, cheese & or ham rolls Evening meals were simple but included fish, meatballs, pork, chicken nuggets, kebabs, chicken, stew, salads, fresh veg, chips, rice, pasta the food was in my opinion simple but plentiful and sufficient and different every night. There was always cakes that were nice and fresh fruit too. The maid came in twice while we were there although all she seemed to do was make our beds properly. My only complaints were the beds were really uncomfortable and my 15 year old found the sofa bed unbearable so I swapped with him as I found the same with the bed. The staff were helpful, and friendly and although you had to pay for extras I did not see this as a major problem. We did notice that there was a lot of appts that had satellite dishes and air con so can only assume that they were privately owned within the hotel, there are 3 blocks in the hotel, block 1 was the main hotel, block 2 was next door and connected and block 3 which was across the flyover across the road. In the evening there was entertainment, we only went a couple of times as the bar they used was too small for everyone that went so unless you got there early there was nowhere to sit. There was a games room this had pool tables air hockey, soft tip darts, table football etc all were chargeable Internet was only available down stairs and was €10 for a week or €3 for a day. All in all we had a lovely holiday and would go back. The weather was lovely and the Portuguese are friendly people. For us it was just what we needed!

author: toppers2801
title: Should be named the Horror Hotel
text: Arrived last week to this hotel and managed to stay 12 hours before we paid and moved to another hotel. I'd read the reviews beforehand and thought it couldn't be that bad, you get what you pay for etc etc but seriously, it is that bad! On check in we found we were staying in block 3 which is across the road from the main hotel in what can only be described as a derelict building. Definitely not the kind of place I want to be returning to as 2 women getting back from a night out for example. It was unlit and felt very creepy. When getting to the room it absolutely stank, the toilet looked like it had never been cleaned, the beds were made out of pallets with sheets of metal and wood on them with the hardest mattress. One nights sleep in the bed has meant I've had an injured shoulder all week! We returned to reception to ask them to move rooms and they refused, said they were fully booked up. Very doubtful given its low season and within the school term. After a 30 minute "discussion" with the reception staff who were extremely rude, and threatening to camp out in the reception and tell everyone checking in just what to expect, we'd still not got anywhere apart from them sending a cleaner to the room to clean it. We went out for tea and while out we discussed either getting a flight home of paying to stay somewhere else. I booked another hotel to check into the next morning for a mere £200 for the week and at 7am the next day we left. Best decision ever!! The hotel Amirilis was absolutely fantastic!! Read the reviews, the majority say it's bad, it's 100 times worse than what can be perceived through a review!

author: AmandaJ2106
title: A holiday is what you make it!
text: Just arrived back from our all inclusive 7 day holiday. I had read the reviews and didn't know what to expect-we had a really enjoyable stay. Staff very friendly although I did notice some residents were really rude to certain members of staff who were trying their best. We stayed in block one in the fourth floor. We had new towels and beds made everyday. Nothing was too much trouble with the domestic staff. As the weather was beautiful a lot of people were using the pool area, so other reviews saying it was too busy what do they expect? Families shouldn't have to keep their children quite for other pool users without children, it didn't bother us as we didn't have children with us. The food on the whole was good. If you're in another country what do you expect other than their food? Bars were open from 10.30 to 23.00 and throughout the day the restuarant or snack bars opened so eating was not a problem. The room was dated but apart from that two beds in the main room with ample space to store clothes and your suitcases. In the lounge area was a settee which turned into two single beds. The balcony was ample size and there were cooking facalities if required. The town itself has a beautiful beach and historic buildings to look at and explore. I found that if you walked into town there where cheaper places to book trips if needed. We are certaintly booking again next year.

author: 772amij
title: Had a really good time
text: Was pleasantly surprised! after reading the reviews on here I was dubious about staying here with children but they absolutely loved it. Aslong as you take into account what you paid for the trip you can't really complain, some people are just fussy! Really good atmosphere. Plenty of choice off food. Good pool area with music, bar,slide. Rooms together like requested. Dated but large room. Good amenities. Good location. Drinks in the bars good. All staff pleasant. Cash machine outside. Taxis not far away. Only thing that annoyed us is people smoking but not the hotel faults. Would stay again!

author: 293vikic
title: Not bad
text: Just got back from 10 days all inclusive. Having read reviews we were dubious when we arrived. Rooms are basic could do with modernising, but to be fair they were ok. Daughter 11 loved the pool and the water slide. Water was nice once you were in and not too cold. Sun beds and parasols €1 each and as long as you leave your towel they are yours for the day. Staff were friendly especially the restaurant staff. Couldn't fault them they worked hard getting every one seated at meal times, making sure the queue went down quickly. Choice of 2 restaurants which served same menu. Food was ok not the best but there was always plenty of salads,rice etc. The fish dishes were lovely as was the yoghurts and cake at breakfast. We didn't go hungry but did eat out a few times for variety. The beer was great and at 5.4% you can't complain. Pool bar was great too and the snack bar. On the whole we had a great holiday and would go back and stay again.

author: TravelKing202
title: Just Don't Go
text: As a hugely experienced traveler who stays in hotels a few times a month this was the worst experience ever. Family booked cheap long weekend away (thank god it was just a weekend). Hotel did its usual trick when we arrived. Front of House clerk Eduardo telling us there had been an issue with the booking (even though it was clear as day on his screen) & the hotel was overbooked. Note - this didn't happen to any of the Spanish or Portuguese families checking in at the same time. It was 11pm and he moved us to 'another part of the hotel' - 600m away down the road by car. This 'other part' can only be described as an Old Asylum - no hot water, no lifts, no furniture and a fridge that sounds like a plane taking off. No sleep for us. Fast forward to the next morning - our room in the main hotel would be ready by 8am (nope wrong again it was ready by 12pm) so we went for breakfast. 50 mins of queueing later we didn't know why we bothered. The food is honestly disgusting please please don't bother going All Inclusive (plenty of amazing affordable restaurants and great supermarkets within a couple of minutes walk of hotel) Facilities wise the hotel is in dire need of a revamp. Pool is ok highlight of hotel for the kids & I didn't mind paying euros for beds and brolleys as it was well organised. Snack bar needs about 10 extra staff as queues reached an hour long. Bar in hotel is the same. All in all just heed everyone's advice and don't go. On The Beach should remove this hotel from portfolio to save further damaging its reputation. I'd never travelled with them before and won't do again.

author: supermansg1
title: Hell in a cell with prison food
text: I'm a good hearted family man and what I'm about to write is far from who I am so I will apologise in advance.... Those of the reviews that say on here "you get what you pay for" need to be hit with the boned fish and the gone off food they serve here. We paid a lot to come to this hotel with all inclusive (something we do with all holidays we go on) and it was not cheap at present we are still here trying to make the best of a bad situation but we have given up on going for any food here. Staff: The staff are rude, abusive and really don't look like they want to be here, I sat on the bed pulling up my shorts and a maid just walked into the room even with the do not disturb sign on the door. The entertainment staff here look like some of the staff have enlisted their wives to come in and "give it a go" they do not speak English to the children and apart from being completely overweight (not their fault) they are giving exercise/water aerobics lessons to the guests when really the need to throw (free) willy back in the sea. Food: Well what can I say apart from ......... I have no words to describe it but I'll give it a go..... Tasteless, colourless, greasy, watered down and tell me this how on earth can the fruit they serve not taste of anything. Food has gone off or turning and the cold milk is well hot!!!! The evening bar has one person on and you can only have certain alcoholic drinks between 8pm and 11pm which does not help me as we do not drink white/red wine and beer.... the beer again looks like I've produced a sample and warm. We have found the best thing to do from now on is read 10 reviews for a hotel and if 3 are bad then give that place a miss. All I can say is PLEASE GIVE THIS PLACE A MISS. We are here till the 7th September 2017 and we have just spent over a £1000 extra to book trips and meals away from this hotel. We in the uk could decrease the prison population by sending the inmates here. Am I bitter yes but that's the only alcohol I'm getting..... Gutted we booked here and went on the travel agents recommendation. 😞😞😞😡😡😡

author: clairebrizell
title: Do not stay here!!
text: Myself, partner and 2 children arrived home from here a few days ago. We spent the majority of our holiday queuing and waiting. 10+ minutes for the dining hall, 30 minutes for a sunbed, 10 minutes for the lift then another 10 minutes in the lift as it stopped on every floor. There are 4 lifts and we found that only 2 of them were ever working. The food is terrible. Considering the size of the hotel and the amount of people staying here there wasn't a great deal of choice and whatever there was looked like slop. Great if you like chips. Watered down orange, Coke, pineapple juice. "All inclusive" is poor. No ice creams for kids. Only beer, wine and soft drinks through the day, spirits after 8pm. Anything else you have to pay for. Most of the staff are very rude. Plus side was the pool area, very big pool with water slide and separate baby pool. 5 minute walk to the main strip and beach where there are lots of bars and restaurants with good value food and drinks. The beach is one of the nicest beaches I've seen. Lovely area and would go back but definitely would not stay in this hotel again.

author: 334beccag
title: Dissapointed in this hotel!
text: Just back from staying at this hotel with my partner for a week. I can only say I was so dissapointed. Got told we were staying in block 3, got to the room and i wanted to cry. The room we thought we booked in the hotel grounds which was actually 5 mins ACROSS from the actual hotel itself. The bathroom stunk of sewage, the shower curtain was smelly, damp/wetness in the corner off the kitchen wall next to the bathroom. The room was very basic. After leaving it a couple of days we complaint and asked to be moved for them to turn around and say no they were fully booked. I explained to them that I was really unhappy in the room were in and we thought we'd be on hotel grounds and not across the road from them, they didn't even care! The food also you don't have a lot to pick from. We went half-board only had breakfast once and tea once - this was because our first night for tea my partner had burgers and they were raw due to him being sick that night. We decided to try again for tea the day after we both had meatballs - again they were raw left two full plates of food and left. I understand there is a few comments on good reviews but I bet these are the people that had stayed in the block 1 & 2 that were on the hotel grounds and didn't feel the need to complain. For someone like me who has only been abroad a couple of times I've learned a far lesson on looking at review before I book a hotel, for one I WON'T be booking back here. Apart from my own experience with this hotel and the people who work here on the attitude my time in Algarve was lovely. I would also say please go next door and visit the squash bar. We went in there every single night for drinks and even treated ourselves to breakfast a couple of times, the owners can't be anymore nice.

author: 327martino
title: Put your minds at rest
text: We are here at the moment, 3 days into a 14 night stay. 2 families 4 adults and 4 kids aged between 11 and 3. Cannot believe some of the rubbish written on here. Having read every review since we booked in January, we were panicking that this holiday was going to be a disaster..heres the good bit..it isn't and it's absolutely fine. Rooms are basic but perfectly liveable and clean..is it the Hilton?? No..what it is is functional. Food..plenty to eat for all tastes, fresh salads, veg, meats etc..snack bar is great too. Kids don't go hungry..not heard any complaints. Everyone moaning about queues..never waited once at the pool bar for longer than 2 mins..theres a small wait at night but no longer than a wait at a town centre bar. Beers good, soft drinks cold. Staff are great, pool area is brill..yeah it's salty but doesn't bother the kids.great idea paying a euro for the sunbed..stops the towel brigade. Beach is beautiful..shopping area lovely. In summary..if you are your average hard working family looking for a cheap break in the beautiful Portuguese sunshine, you won't go wrong. If you like a moan and are a glass half empty type of person, spend a bit more an go elsewhere. We cannot complain at all. Here's to the rest of the holiday... Cheers!

author: xixaevictorv
title: Horrible! Do not book!!
text: I did not expect much after reading the reviews when booked this holiday in January. We don't care much about cleaning as we stay all day out of hotel. But this hotel is a joke, totally out of this world. We are at the 10th floor (last one in our building), the sun heat our roof all day long, and THERE IS NOT AC OR FAN in the room. Walls are hot, floors is hot, the air we breath in is hot. Seagulls start their choir at 5 am in our balcony. We have been here for 2 days already with no sleep. If you want an old and small fan you need to pay €1.50/day. With a €10 deposit. To get the tv control you need to pay, to seat in a sun bed you need to pay, even to use the safe you need to pay daily. We have been in different hotels all around the world, never complaint. But this hotel is a nightmare. We asked to move rooms but they said Nothing can be done as the hotel is Fully booked. Now my question: what to do in the next 13 Days? 13 more days no sleeping With tired kids because then cannot sleep as well.

author: nicola19822017
title: Read this first! dont book! and certainly don't book through ON THE BEACH!!
text: Think you'll be staying at the hotel in the photo? Well think again!!! If you have booked through on the beach!! So If you have lost your senses and choose to ignore the bad reviews then god help you. We unfortunately booked through on the beach and stayed all inclusive and when we arrived very late at night we were told we were in block 3 which is over a duel carriageway over a treacherous concrete bridge in a run down apartment block away from the main hotel. It is dimly lit and lacked security of any kind, the room smelt stale, and mouldy. We instantly raised our concerns (to which I burst into tears) and asked to be moved. There was nothing the receptionist could do until the manager arrived in the morning so between us we decided to book in a hotel at our own cost of £74! up the road which was suggested by the reception team and we would return in the morning to see if we could be moved to the actual hotel advertised..... We got moved into a room in the main block 1 by 15:30pm the following afternoon, the manager was very helpful and couldn't apologise enough,,,,so we then tried to enjoy our holiday.... The hotel itself is more like a 1 star its very run down, the main toilets and the pool toilets/shower block are absolutely disgusting, it is understaffed and even they are embarrassed to work there! The food is also disgusting, oh and expect to queue for a long time to actually get into the restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner, what joy! The pool snack bar kept us alive with burgers and chips. On the last day you have to check out at 10:30 regardless of what time you're leaving and they cut off your wrist bands so from that time onwards you have to pay for everything! We weren't getting picked up until 17:30!!!!!!!! The pool and water slide is great for kids that's the only good point, oh and yes you have to pay for sun beds and parasols but that takes the stress away from people hogging all the beds so you'll always get a bed no matter what. You may have noticed that I haven't mentioned what on the beach did for selling us a falsely advertised hotel room which we were displeased with.......they did nothing, the hotel did all the work and they never apologised once, because they don't care.

author: rebbeccaw2014
title: Won't go again
text: Just got back from a holiday there, won't go again. We went self-catering. There's nothing to cook with except 1 pan, a few plates, 4 plates, couple dirty glasses and cutlery. You have to rent an iron, toaster, kettle, fan and tv remote. And you have to pick them up and put a €10 deposit down. They cost €1 each a day to rent. The beds are hard, the pillows are lumpy and the glass doors to the 8th floor balcony where broke. They change/ clean room every 4 days and they give new towels every 4 days. The supermarket next door is a rip off. Very expensive, there is a spar near the high street. Where the beach is, that's much cheaper. The swimming pool is salty and cold. You have rent sun loungers and umbrellas for €1 each. We never ate at the hotel as we ate out, there's lots of restaurants near the beach and high street which are very good. The only good thing, was that the hotel was 5 mins from the beach. Spent all our time at the beach.

author: CLR15
title: Not as bad as I was expecting
text: I travelled in a party of 8 which included a pensioner and a 3 year old with additional needs. First impressions weren't great when we arrived at 11:30am to be told check in was at 4pm, however we were given our wristbands straight away so we checked out the snack bar. We arrived just before it closed so didn't experience much of a queue on this day. Back in reception we observed people arriving after us and being given room keys, so we queried this several times and were continually reminded of the check in time.Finally at around 3pm we were given keys to our 2 rooms, one on the 3rd floor and the other on the 12th floor, both block 1. There are 4 lifts which are really small and really slow, often stopping on every floor which was really annoying. I was in the room on the 12th floor, only to find the balcony door did not lock so my 3 year old kept trying to get out. My husband reported this to reception who said someone would attend that evening,which they did while we were out,however once unlocked again, the door would not lock. We reported this a further 2 times, however in the end took turns in guarding the door,thankfully we had a small balcony that didn't open up into the living room so only 1 door to guard. The room was basic, fairly clean and suitable for our needs, which was a base for the trip. Although all-inclusive we had a stove, microwave and fridge in the room which was good. The beds were changed once during our 1 week stay, however we were given fresh towels and toilet roll 3 times. The food was ok,we ate out quite alot because we tended to get up and go out after breakfast for most of the day. The snack bar was often busy but helped the 2 really fussy eaters in our group get something to eat. The pool area was nice, often very busy and lively, however this was not a problem for us. I have seen people complaining about the music around the pool, in my opinion it wasn't loud enough! I only visited the bar once so can't really comment on that, but as with most of the areas there was a queue. The staff at the hotel were generally very friendly, but you could see just how hard they had to work. The restaurant staff in block 1 were extremely appreciative when we stacked our plates and glasses to help them. Overall I had a good experience, if you are simply looking for a place to stay so you can go off and explore then this hotel would suit you.

author: I3715IEgarys
title: Mis sold by travel company
text: First of all this hotel should not be classed as all inclusive, this however is not the hotels fault but the holiday company that I booked through.when we first got there at about 1.00 pm we were told check in wasn't until 4 which we were not aware of so us to wait around for 3 hours which meant we got to look around the town of rocha and the beach which is absolutely stunning so not a problem. When we finally did check in we were told our lift to take us to our room would meet us outside the front of hotel !!! When I questioned why we would need a lift to our room we were told our room was in the block over the road from the main part of hotel!!! I had already seen the block over the road where we were put and all I can describe it at that time is a disused empty hotel and looks Like it needs bulldozing. yet the fact I then realised this is the building they expected me and my partner to stay in I wasn't happy. After trying to get a room in main block we were told by the manager of reception { can't recall his name but I must say he was extremely helpful throughout the week with certain issues) that of we came back next day he could try and get us moved. So off we went in the minibus to the other building and as we pulled in I thought it wouldn't look Out of place in A war torn country. It was horrific there is no security on the entrances to the blocks there are 2 disused swimming pools , broken glass and debris everywhere. All this was before we got into the room and my god the list is endless....... the bath tub was disgusting there was poo on a towel a dirty toilet roll just chucked in the bin. Blood on the coffee table and the floor hasn't been mopped. How they expect people to stay in these sort of rooms is beyond me.We took plenty of photos and went straight back over to main reception and showed the staff the photos and at which point myself and my partner were reaching breaking point. We had to wait another hour for them to turn and sort the problems out ,in the end they found us a room in block 2 which wasn't great but what you would expect from a cheaper hotel so we were satisfied then.The towels were only changed once in 5 days we were there and think he room was cleaned twice. The food is absolutely terrible in this place, I had a burger from the snack and bit into it and it wasn't cooked at all, the nighttime meals are a complete farce, have to que up for half hour even though there are plenty of empty tables in side, and by the time you get in I wished I hadn't bothered, it's like prison food , been to cheap AI Hotels before but never have I seen such a limited choice of foods available, we ended up eating out every night as we had too. You have to pay for hair dryers fans for your rooms , that's another thing the holiday company say the rooms have air con ! They don't . Paying for a sun bed I agree with as it stops anyone taking more than they need. Last 2 days there it was full of kids playing football anywhere they can find a bit of space , I like football but having to watch out you don't get one booted at your head every 5 minutes isn't he best.As out flight wasn't until evening time and we had to check out at 10 you have to give in all inclusive wristband which is the first place I have ever been that has happend. I asked for 2 coked at bar and wanted 4 euros which is a joke as you can get a big bottle of real Coke for 2 euro in the shop next door .Its a shame really as the hotel is in a great location only a 5 minute walk for the main strip and he beach which is beautiful. Only thing is the tediousness of being offered Weed or Cocaine on the strip even in the day, first couple of times I didn't mind but when I was having a drink outside a bar it's annoying.the staff were friendly at the hotel but it does lack a lot but also the holiday companies need to help them out a bit more by not mis selling this hotel

author: Curious717843
title: It's ok
text: Many reviews about how bad the hotel are unwarranted. The room are ok they are clean but very basic. The equipment in the rooms is a bit of a let down to be honest we are a family of four there were 2 plates, 3 cups 1 spoon, and four wine glasses other that a couple of pans and a microwave I wouldn't touch that's about it. The fridge leaves a lot to be desired and for the first night of my stay cooked the contents despite it been turned to the max. There is a maid service however other than empty the bins and leave toilet rolls not sure what they did. The reception staff were friendly and very helpful can not fault them. The bar staff made me feel like a criminal for wearing swimming style shorts pointing out to me that wet clothes weren't allowed. I hadn't been in the pool all day this is just what I was wearing. The bar service was appalling and after been charged a rediculous amount for money for flat cokes and warm beer decided not to make use of the bar again and instead used to many friendly bars in the resort. The pool area is very good and I do support the idea of paying for a sun bed it's only a nominal fee but does stop people hoarding sun beds. The staff around the pool do however need to be taught how to treat people. My wife was sat with my very young little girl in her arms fast asleep and a horrible arrogant pool attendant came up to her demanding to see her ticket for a 1 euro sun bed we had been sat there for 2 hours. My wife had to put my little girl down then empty out our bag to find the ticket. This is not acceptable there is only one way in the pool area so there needs to be a better system Put in place surely it's not difficult. These points may seem petty but to my family were important and it had tarnished my image of the hotel. Overall I would be happy to return mainly because I know what to expect and the hotel Is ok especially for where it is. However I really hope some of the points I make are looked at seriously because I little improvement I'm very basic areas could make this hotel a much nicer place. I would be happy to recommend the hotel to people however I would feel the need to warn them in depth of what to expect.

author: 368alexandran
title: Poor .
text: Would like to rate this a 2 star as I actually feel sorry for the staff- they are evidently under staffed, and you can tell they work extremely hard under pressure. Unfortunately, on a few occasions I felt as though I was pestering some staff members when attending the snack bar as their customer service was basic and some, not all, staff lacked manners. I was polite, always saying please and thank you etc. And felt as though my effort to be polite was wasted. Maids were polite and saw them frequently to clean the room. The hotel rooms in my opinion are dated but clean. Although you have to be fast if sharing a bathroom with family as the hot water in the shower is limited before it turns cold. Environment - strange smell when walking on complex of hotel (beside pool, from room to the restaurant etc. Our doors mainly) Myaelf and a few other people we met whilst there said we could smell sewage, every day. Not pleasant. Food in the hotel is extremely poor quality. We paid for all inclusive and we may as well of went self catering as we preferred making our own food every day or going out for meals which was obviously more expensive on top of paying for all inclusive. The breakfast was awful - everything tasted plastic. Milk for cereal was always warm, the eggs were powdered eggs, I lived on cheese and ham bread buns for breakfast on days I didn't go to the Irish bar for English breakfasts. Tinned fruit for choice which was basic. Lunch times there was no vegetarian option aside from what tasted like microwave veg and salad / pasta. Not a lot of variety. This is either due to under staffed or money problems but either way it was not satisfactory.

author: Jell670
title: Don't expect anything great
text: Just got back from an 11 day holiday at this hotel . Don't expect anything spectacular as you will be highly disappointed . I read the reviews before we went but thought I'd make up my own mind . We were a group of 11 with ages ranging from 5 to 77. What can I say about the food apart from its not very nice at all , nothing short of prison food to be honest ( prob better fed in there ! ) most of our spending money was used on buying food and eating out . There are kettles/fans/safe/remote for TV but a deposit has to be paid on everything plus daily charge for the fan/kettle. We watched the pool cleaner on a couple of occasions pretending to clean it , in reality he moves a net around to move debris and dirt to break it up . It's under staffed and as can only get 2 drinks per person at busy times be prepared to wait up to 20 minutes to be served . Staff are quite miserable but to be fair I would be too if I worked there ! Rooms are outdated but clean enough . On the plus ....... good location about 10 minute walk to beach . The place is absolutely stunning . The constant harassment up at the strip and on the back streets to buy drugs is very annoying and quite intimidating when have children with you . I would not return to this hotel for all the tea in china !!! I would return to the resort if the drug dealers were eliminated

author: tosht252
title: Don't pay over the odds for this place on All Inclusive
text: My hubby and I spent a week here and to be honest it was ok, it was clean the rooms are a bit dated but quite roomy you get a small kitchenette but no microwave or kettle you have to put a deposit down on them if you need them. We went All Inclusive and was a little disapointed with this as you had to pay for sun beds 1 euro a day and parasol was also 1 euro. The drinks during the day were very limited to soft drinks, lager and red and white wine if you wanted anything else you had to pay for it. The only place you could get a tea, coffee or hot chocolate was in the bar inside the hotel. The kiddies and adults for that matter had to also pay for ice creams while we were there they completely ran out of all ice creams and lollies and were still out of them when we left so I am not sure how long they were without a delivery. At 8pm your drinks were up graded until 11pm and then again you have to pay if you wanted anything to drink after 11pm. The drinks you could get at 8pm were general spirits vodka,gin,bacardi,whisky,brandy and baileys oh and port, i think that covers your drinks. Amelia who works behind the bar inside the hotel was great she was lovely and very hard working bless her. Now the food Hmmmm this was not good it was very samey and we ended up eating what they put on for the kids most days, ie chips with cheap chicken nuggets poor spaghetti and meatballs, spag bol not good, and pizza which we had once while we were there and you had to queue for this as they were only putting one out at a time. We found the food to be very greasey and the breakfast was terrible. Boiled eggs, watery beans, tiny sausages that were awful they were like a reddy colour inside it could have been choizio, mushrooms which I think were tinned, toast which you had to toast yourself which wasn't an issue, thats it for cooked so we went out for our breakfast. You also got a continental breakfast and 2 types of cereal we had cornflakes and some chocolate cereal.You could also get a hot drink at breakfast from a machine but it was only in use for breakfast.The staff were great Marco on reception was very helpful but if you need them to confirm your pick up back to the airport that will cost you another 1.50 euros. Paulo who is the supervisor in the restaurant was a diamond what a great guy we had no problems with any of the staff a big thumbs up there. Now the only other thing we had a bad experience with was the transfer, now although I don't think this has anything to do with the hotel I really would like to tell you to STAY AWAY FROM GREEN BUS TRANSFERS shocking, our hotel was 46 miles away from the airport and it took us 4 and a half hours to get there, the transfer was longer than the bloody flight. I would recommend you pay a bit extra and get a direct transfer I know thats what I will be doing when we go back. We would go back here because over all it was ok but we would go self catering the next time Its cheap and cheerful and the beaches are stunning.

author: Holder04
title: Not as good as I expected
text: I have just returned from a 1st timer at this hotel & as the saying goes "1st & last". The best thing about the hotel is location. It is within walking distance of the beach, restaurants, bars, shops & a small market. The staff were not very helpful. Only one male receptionists, a middle aged bald man (I didn't get his name) and, a red headed waitress in the restaurant seemed happy to assist. As for the food, breakfast was about the best meal you got. They was only 1 toaster for, could be up to 60 people at a time, the fruit juices were watered down after the 3rd day. We ended up eating out much more than we had anticipated We went as a party of 3. We stayed in Block 2. The apartnent only had 1 bedroom & a sofa bed in the front room/kitchenette /lounge area. The sofa bed was very very hard to get a fullnight's sleep on. Also there was the constant banging of doors & very loud conversations going on throughout the night. It doesn't appear to have any kind of night time security patrolling the large complex The boiler leaked which, dripped onto the enamel draining board in the front room where I was trying to sleep on the hard sofa bed............ Thank goodness for the company I was with. If not for them I would definitely need a holiday to get over my holiday. I recommend you spend a little more & go for 4 ⭐

author: missjuney
title: Clue Praia de Rocha...quanity is better than quality
text: Standards have gone downhill and still falling. 3 years ago I went to this hotel. Great staff. Room was basic but clean. Read reviews about the pillows but that was ok room was cleaned regularly. Last year there were major changes to the hotel taking place but quantity overrides quality now. As much as people from the north are getting a deal for all inclusive it costs more from where you choose to fly from. The hotel has a lot of hidden costs. Calling a cab, using a iron, booking your transfer, weighing your suitcase, sitting in the sun on lido. Our rooms were not tended to for 4 days after being there. We were placed in block 2 which use to be for self catering. The noise was unbearable all night from the entertainment bar then people shouting and banging their doors til 3am. Phones do not work. God forbid if there was an emergency...its like a cattle market. There are a few exceptional staff members who should be touted for another hotel as it will be a matter of time before they will be exploited...beautiful location but standards have gone down and still continue to do so ...good luck...you get what you pay for....not a bargain

author: aileenclarke267
title: Absolute disgrace this hotel with their all inclusive & extra charges
text: Their all inclusive is an total disgrace & l told them so on many occassions but they were.nt bothered. bar is 10am-12pm but from 10am-8pm the only drinks on alinclusive is lager&red/white wine. Spirit's can only be got 8-11pm. you pay for all your drinks after that. kids are charged for ice cream. loungers & parasol €1 each per day. one lady ask for lager &dash of lime & was charged €1 for lime even though she was all inclusive. charged €1.50 to print transfer times & €1.50 print boarding passes & 50c charge to phon taxis. at 10.30am check out your all inclusive band is cut of even though we pay €40 each for full day.we cud not get as much as a drink of water or mineral after breakfast.when l asked why we were charged for full day & couldn't get any drinks after that even though we weren't leaving hotel til 4.20pm l was told that's their policy & when l asked for refund for that day l was straight out refused. This carry on is an total disgrace & l told them in no uncertain terms that l was disgusted with them & that they'd charged for the sun if the could but what realy sickened me was the fact that the kids had to pay for ice cream. If the little boys went into snack bar to get few chips & had their tops of - they were told never to come back in like that again-seriously.answer them better to clean the pool bar toilets which were a complete disgrace all day long.they only let you get two drinks at any one time so if you wanted two drinks & two sandwhiches you cudnt get both at same time.you could only get ur two drinks & cue up again for your sandwhiches. Staff were pleasant enough it's the hotel policy's is a disgrace. worse hotel lve ever stayed & l definitely would not recommend this hotel to anyone even if you went self catering.you stil pay 10 for kettle for a wk,hairdryers & irons also & u still pay €1 each for sunloungers & parasols & 50c phoning taxis & 1.50 for print outs of boarding passes or transfer times.total meaness with this hotel & l wil never be caught dead in this hotel again. I just wanted to warn you all before u book this hotel. so good luck if you do-you'll be needing it

author: 265gemmak
title: Don't listen to the bad reviews!! Lovely hotel!
text: My partner room me here for my birthday and after reading all of the reviews he was panicking about it.. there is absolutely NOTHING wrong with this lovely hotel! People are complaining about petty things.. which to be honest, we didn't experience any of them at all. The staff were very pleasant and helpful, the apartments were very spacious, separate bedroom and a large kitchen area and lounge.. with everything you need. Yes ok our balcony doors didn't lock but that was it! The pool area is great, plenty of space sunbeds are perfectly fine, and the 1 euro a day is a great system they have running, you can come and go all day as you please without having to worry about getting a bed again! There are 3 different pools and a slide which all the kids seemed to have a ball on.. life guards are very attentive! The beer was 2euro for half a pint and 3 for a pint.. beer was lovely! And I'm not a beer drinker! The hotel is clean, not noisy and dirty.. there's a good atmosphere about it. It's in a brilliant location, 5 minute walk from everything and beautiful beach! My partner and I would 100% return here, we had a fab holiday and couldn't get over the amount of complaining people have been doing, we were so shocked when we got there! Please DO NOT listen to the reviews, some people obviously have too much time on their hands!

author: charlesaR8931BB
title: Wonderful April Family Holiday
text: First off, we were a bit apprehensive in staying here after reading the reviews. In the end we thought everyone's got an opinion. So we booked it. Yes, the rooms could do with updating, however we go on holidays abroad to be outside. So, to us, it didn't matter. The beds were comfy and the room was large. The hotel is run very well. The people who work their are friendly. The pool area is well organised. Yes you have to pay 1euro for a bed but this at least allows you to get a bed. We had no issues at all around the pool, always plenty of space. The bars are well organised, never too long to wait for a drink. We went all inclusive, so it's either beer, wine or soft drinks. Whiskey etc is extra. Meal times can be busy, but just be patient, you'll soon get a table and be able to eat. The snack bar is great, we always polished off a burger and fries at 330pm lol As long as you go here with an open mind, patience and the willingness to just enjoy yourself, you'll be fine. Location wise, perfect! Around a 5 minute walk to the fantastic beach and town. Enjoy!!

author: marriedirishfather
title: Dont go all inclusive and youll be fine
text: Have stayed here a few times over the past few years. Dont know why people go and then complain that its no good. What do you actually expect for so cheap. Never went all inclusive because i know exactly what to expect for the price. If you want nice food stay in a more expensive hotel. The rooms are fine. Quite dated but very spacious. Nice balcony to. The pool is fine. Plenty of beds to go around. Lots of restaurants and pubs close by and the beach is beautiful. Less than a ten minute walk. We just use the hotel to sleep, shower and have fun at the pool. If thats what u want stay here for little or nothing. If your looking for 5 star and only want to pay for 3 star like a lot of people seem to, then dont stay here.

author: bevo143
title: food was horrible but most staff was nice
text: so me my daughter and neighbour went to this hotel been aware of the bad reviews and good reviews. my neighbour has been going to this hotel for over 8 years and she loved it she said there was always an activity for a child and the food was decent but this year she said it is horrible and nothing like it used to be we was all disappointed with the food, some staff, the state of the room and the muck just around the hotel also the smell around the hotel. firstly I will be talking about the food, there was no option for food it was very random for example who would feed there child monkfish and bananas? it didn't taste nice at all.The best thing about it was the deserts but you cant live off deserts for 2 weeks. we paid for all inclusive and unfortunately we stayed out most diner and night for our food. lucky for us there was lots of restaurants 5 minutes away from our hotel but we spent more than intended. for snacks during the day (you only got the option twice to get a snack) you got served a dry ham and cheese sandwich and a very dry burger which I think could of been left there more than one night the snacks didn't change during the two week whilst we was there. Basically the food was disgusting and I probably wouldn't of fed my dog it so I definitely wouldn't of fed my child it. secondly I am going to talk about the staff. most of the staff were happy to be there and were very generous but there was certain staff that were very rude and moody towards the visitors. we got clean towels every other day which was good but we was there for 2 week and our bed wasn't changed once. you had to pay to use a kettle, iron, hair dryer. the pool was massive but very unclean but they washed it everyday but it needs a good wash. it ended up were we all couldn't wait to get back home during a week in. if you are even considering going to this hotel just stop now and look somewhere different. thanks bev x

author: careyanne1979
title: awful hotel,never book here unless you want to go on a diet !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: What can i say other than just the worse hotel i have ever stayed in for 7 days all inclusive. Food was awful,smelt vile,undercooked,n fatty meat. Well breakfast bacon swimming in grease n scramble egg,tomatoes were sliced an like mush,un-edible.toaster was broke. Best part was dessert,you could actually eat it. You have to pay 10 euro for remote control,31 euro safe,1.50 euro daily for kettle,10 euro for wi-fi but it only works in the lobby. You only get 80 litres of hot water at any 1 time then you have to wait 1.5 hours. Whole area smelt of eggs,cockroachs in the snack bar. Rooms were quite big but filthy,beds were made but with ur old sheets,you had to ask for towels n toilet roll.beds for kids were so creaky that we had to have a bed brought up .fridge broke and leaked everywhere.wire hanging from cupboards.lighting was lose. Video bar n pool bar shut,you can only get beer,wine,soft drinks,hot drinks all day,spirits are free between 8-11 there own brand,cocktails were charged for. Pool area had seen better days,n also smelt of eggs.There was a 1euro charge each for sunbeds but at least you didn't have to fight to get a bed. Games room was expensive for the kids. There was a entertainment schedule up but was never actioned,there was nothing for the kids to do,entertainment was on once when only the spanish guests arrived.Then you had all spanish music on. If you complained they said put it in the book they just didn't care. We tryed 1 lunch,1 breakfast,n 3 dinners n all was so bad. We ended up spending an extra 900 euros eating out. This concludes the hotel absolutely a joke.We would never book here again or recommend this hotel. The area is so beautiful one of the best beaches i have been to,the local restaurants n bars are of a great standard n quality.

author: Linsey2581
title: Avoid if you can!!!
text: On first arriving at this hotel (if you can call it that) it seems very nice and clean however if you are in placed in Block 2 as we were prepare for a major shock. Our rooms were 702 and 703 (7th floor) and in entering were very basic but we thought lets get on with it . On closer inspection we discovered that the it was in fact very dirty, the main light in the living area was held up by a piece of sellotape and was covered in dirt, the beds for the children consisted of a couch and a mattress that you pulled from underneath the couch. In the kitchen area all the pipes from the boiler were exposed and there was 2 massive holes in the wall (i assume it was a flue type system for the hob area we never used this as we were all inclusive) The floor or whole room had clearly not been cleaned prior to us arriving. The bedroom was 2 single beds pushed together (which is normally pretty standard abroad), the sheets which I assume were supposed to be white were a funny dirty off white colour there was dust galore in the wardrobes so most of our items stayed in the case, again the floor had never been cleaned. The balcony area was quite dangerous as the doors didn't open and close properly and the chairs and table were engrained with dirt! Tje bathroom was definitely the worst room ever! 2 days in and we couldn't use the shower as when you ran the water there was a horrible sewage smell and then later the bathroom floor was covered in cockroaches! I complained to reception who sent a maid who stood on them and then swept them up and proclaimed room was ok. I complained to reception who said they coulnt move us due to the hotel being full. I had to get in touch with my travel agent who called the hotel who then said that they could move us. We were moved to block 1 which was much cleaner but not by much. Onto the food, The food was disgusting . Breakfast was fine a selection of eggs. sausages bacon or croissants but dinner and teatime were horrendous , soup (which just changed its name) tasted the same every day , a fish dish or a mixed meats dish. The vegetarian option was pasta but it had ham in it so not sure what that was all about !! The snack bar was1/2 cooked burgers and chips and there was no ice cream included in all inclusive. All in all this was a disgusting horrible hotel with uncaring staff and its safe to say I shall not be back

author: johnfP5236DG
title: Brilliant holiday
text: Was worrying about going after reading all the reviews but for what we paid we did not have high expectations anyway. We got there late at night so the all inclusive for food was closed so we took a walk down to the strip which is only a couple of minutes away and went to Burger king. That was the only meal we ate out as we enjoyed the food there. There is plenty of choice for breakfast one day you have bacon the next day its sausages but there is scrambled eggs fried tomatoes beans ham cheese salami and toast, there is also croissants cake fruit cereals and yoghurts. Why people was complaining there was no choice i have no idea. The snacks were the same everyday but i always made sure i was back from the beach before they closed as i really enjoyed their cheese and ham salad rolls which was really fresh. We never really made it to lunch but we always had an evening meal there and it was only one night that i wasn't really fussed on the food so i just ate fish fingers chips and pasta as a main meal, but you can always find something to eat there. The other meals were all enjoyable. Our room was the biggest room we have ever had on an all inclusive holiday we had a bedroom with an huge built in wardrobe, the bathroom was huge and had a bath as well as a shower it also had a kitchen with a table and four chairs in and a living room with a tele. You did have to pay for a remote which was 10 euro's to watch it and i heard a load of people moaning about it but i thought it was fair to be honest seeing as the price we paid for the holiday. We did not buy a remote as i intended to stay out on the balcony if i was in the room at all. We also had a lovely balcony overlooking the pool with a table and chairs. I found the staff friendly and as for the people saying it was dirty that was down to customers being too lazy to pick their drinks and plates up and put them in the bins. There is a charge for the sun loungers of 1 euro a day which people were moaning about but it allowed you to get a sun lounger and keep it for the whole day. I spent all my day on their beach which was one of the nicest beaches i have ever been on and i have traveled to all different countries. I have to say i am giving this hotel five stars for a budget hotel and plan to go back there next October with the grandkids and family as i think the kids will have a ball in this hotel. Not once did we see a miserable kid there just miserable parents moaning about everything they could. My husband wants to go back to this hotel every year in October as it really has been a fantastic holiday we were gutted that we only booked one week instead of two.

author: heidihU227EX
title: Stay clear of this hotel!
text: Visited beginning of oct for 4 nights with a friend. Got a good deal and I guess we got what we paid for! The hotel is large and in a good location but the rooms are horrendous!! No exaggeration but is the worst room I've ever stayed in. Bad points- -Only 1 plug socket in kitchen which powered the fridge so we had the kettle and toaster plugged in around the dining and lounge area. -Sea view is a a slither between 2 high rise buildings -Bathroom is falling to pieces and disgusting. The bath matt was yuk! -You have to pay for- sun Loungers, umbrellas, Tv, Iron, Hairdryer, Kettle and Toaster PLUS €10 deposit per item! -Reception staff very miserable, didn't see them crack a smile once. Not very friendly. -Light wasn't working in kitchen, surely this should have been checked before checking in. They fixed it though. -Boiler was leaking which was above the draining board contaminating clean washed pots. -Bed was solid and could feel every spring -Pillows were that over used all the inside was bunched up, felt like I was sleeping on a load cotton balls shoved in a pillow case. -Don't expect the "friendly" reception staff to call and confirm your transport for you. They will charge you. -Overpriced trips, you can buy them cheaper on the strip. - you have to Pay for wifi even in the public areas. -spirits not avail till after 8pm for those all inclusive. - food terrible Good points - - good sized pool area -location -good public areas in general

author: KateA83
title: Could be great... but only potentiality!
text: Ok not going to go on and on but I will start with the good points: The pool area is lovely, big swimming areas and because you pay €1 for the sun loungers there is always plenty of room no matter what time of day you get down there. We had a nice big room, but was AI so didn't use the kitchenette. Bad points: (I'll carry on with the room) the bathroom was a throw back from the 70's and smelt of mold, the beds were also very old but were surprisingly comfortable. The cleaners made the beds the 2 out of 5 days (2 days we put the do not disturb sign out as there was no point them being in our room) they swept the floor in the room once and replaced toilet roll twice. We had no clean towels or bedding in the whole 7 days. Now for the restaurant 😬 breakfast was scrambled egg, grilled tomato, beans, alternating days was bacon or sausage, choice of 2 cereals or bread/rolls/ham/cheese. Lunch and dinner were pretty similar 1 fish main, 1 meat, chips, rice, pasta and salad. And if you were lucky enough a cockroach or 3... unfortunately we spotted one running around on our 2nd day so ruined any meal we had there. The only bad point I could see with the pool was how dangerous and slippy the edges got, we saw so many children fall daily I found myself constantly shouting at my 6 yr old to walk/don't run/ be careful etc. The entertainment was dire- bingo/quiz etc and not worth turning up to, and didn't even start until 9.30pm. The all inclusive drinks were fizzy/water/wine/beer/tea/coffee from 10am until 11pm, local spirits were available from 8pm-11pm. Payable at any other time, ice-creams, crisps, cocktails were also chargeable at any time. Only 4 small lifts, to service 13 floors, 1 out of order, and 1 wouldn't stop at our floor. Wifi was sold to us at €10 for 7 days- bargain right?? No! It only worked in the lobby, the pool wifi is charged at a separate rate, and no wifi available in rooms. I probably wouldn't return to this place, if I did it would have to be very very cheap and only as self catering and as a couple, no way would I subject my child to this place again.

author: superwizon
title: The restaurant makes up for the apartment
text: My first impression wasn't good as the telephone in my room had been ripped out of the wall and the man on the reception accused me of doing it when I'd only just arrived! The fridge was iced up and the door was open when we got there, and it didn't seem to work properly but not really an issue as we were all inclusive. I'm sure we would have been given a different room if I had complained. The apartment was a bit tired but was clean, not as some of the other reviews have said. Maid service every day apart from Sunday, clean bed linen and towels were provided, so I don't know what hotel these other people have stayed in that say the rooms don't get cleaned at all. The restaurant was immaculate, you get shown to a table on arrival and help yourself to the food. I honestly don't know why people complain about the food, there is a starter and a choice of mains for lunch and dinner, there is always plenty of salad and side dishes. There was also food aimed at children. Food was much better than expected. Good selection at breakfast, yes there was scrambled egg every day but there were also boiled eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, cold meats and cheeses and a varied selection of bread and rolls, cereal, fruit, yoghurts etc. What more do people want? Judging by the size of most of the people there they had probably been on too many all inclusive holidays, and if people weren't making up picnics to take away in their bags, there would probably be more selection. Just because it's all inclusive doesn't mean you have to eat absolutely everything that's out! You can't have spirits before 8 but that's not necessarily a bad thing! You have to pay a deposit for the tv remote and rent it for around €1.50 a day, which we did not do as who wants to watch telly all day when you are on holiday? Staff in the restaurant were really friendly and efficient. The nice man in the games room helped me print my boarding passes for Ryanair, which cost €1 for 15 minutes on the computer and 90c for each print, much cheaper than the £12 you have to pay for early check in! I would definitely return to this hotel, the restaurant definitely makes up for the dated rooms.

author: RevRFC
title: You get what you pay for.
text: This hotel is not as bad as some make out. It is a 3 star hotel and you get what you pay for. Two high rises buildings. One block gives you views of the bay. The block we slept in looked over the road. The noise didn't bother us. A very busy hotel. You have to pay 1 euro for a sunbed also for an umbrella. The edge of the pool was mouldy but the water did seem clean. The furniture in the rooms needs to be replaced. I thought my son's bed was going to fall through every time he turned. Not well decorated but the room was clean. The shower was not good. It leaked and the shower head is too low. I am 5'8" and had to duck, my son is 6'4". The food was good. My sons loved it. The restaurant was rather cramped and you had to queue to get in. Staff where polite and very helpful even when they had to deal with drunken Brits. And there were a few.

author: michellemV8305EF
title: Make the most of it..
text: The location was good as it's a short walk to the main tourist strip where there are bars, restaurants & shops etc. The staff that we encountered were pleasant enough and helpful. The hotel and rooms could do with a major refurbishment. But was adequate for somewhere to sleep each night. The cleanliness of our room could have been improved as it seemed to receive a "quick cats lick" every day. One of our major complaints would be the lack of variety / choice of food during meal times. The food it's self was edible but to be honest, we didn't really enjoy it. Also the choice of beverages for the 'All inclusive deal' needs improvement and is quite basic (beer, wine, softdrinks, juice and wine during the day). They seem to only serve spirits after 8pm. There was planned entertainment in the cocktail bar each night which is aimed for families, which is fine, but the awful layout of the bar and uncomfortable seating doesn't make it worth while. Also to have only 1 bar staff at night serving is not adequate (I felt so sorry for the guy). The pool & pool area was nice & large and great for families to spend the day by. It was clean and seemed safe. Although you do have to pay €1 for a sunbed and umbrella!?!?! Overall our holiday wasn't ruined by the place we just adapted to our surroundings.

author: Sarahp1975
title: Lovely relaxing holiday. Good for gluten free.
text: I stayed at CPR with my husband and 2 children in late July. My husband has to follow a strict gluten free diet and he was catered for brilliantly. The head chef met us on the first day and was very pleasant and helpful. We had well informed attention every time we used the restaurant. The food was of good quality with a fish and a meet dish at lunch and dinner. There was always fresh bread, soup, salad, fruit and desserts. We stayed on an all inclusive basis which was very good value. The children always had something they were happy to eat. The pool area was great and there was always room for sun loungers and umbrellas. The pool was clean and well designed. We relaxed by the pool while they played all day, bliss! In our experience it was not a noisy hotel and the staff were friendly and helpful. Our room was well appointed and clean. We had a great holiday. Thank you team!

author: wiganlatics2013
title: Don't bother
text: Large hotel, small restaurant but we called it a canteen as food was shocking. Table and chairs old fashioned and to close to each other. The food wasn't worth while queing for. You have to pay for a sunlouger and umbrella when the sun only comes out on the pool area by afternoon. The entertainment was dreadful if you call it entertainment. Room was larger than expected but maid service lacking as bed made and fresh towels left only. No brushing or mopping of floors during our stay. Toilet comes with a hygiene wrapper on it was than toilet was rotten and was never cleaned. The report its is also a let down. Not much entertainment on the strip, dirty resort and expensive. This is a place we would never recommend nor come back to. You can get a taxi from the hotel for about 8 euro to the shopping centre, primark, oasis etc and a large food court. Didnt expect to go Portugal and shop in primark didn't suit the area really. Didn't bring any duty free back as cheaper in England. Cigarettes between 48 and 50 euros for 200. As other reviews no spirits until 8pm till 11pm when all inclusive not what one expects.

author: cobrax
title: Nice basic hotel
text: Hotel is quiet basic but we had no issues. We were in block 2 on the 3rd floor with a nice pool view. Room location was great as we had the evening sun on the balcony. Loads of space in the room, only downside is you have to hire a kettle and toaster. Swimming pool is large with a slide and a smaller kids pool but is quite cold due to running water for slide and fountain. You do have to hire the loungers and sun umbrella for 1 euro each. There is a shop attached to the hotel for water, food etc and another one around here he corner. The beach is not far but is up a little hill. Best way to go is turn right out of the hotel past the hotel shop towards the water fountains and then go up the hill there. That will take you to the beach with access via a ramp instead of steps that are located everywhere else. Great beach with nice white sand and warm sea. Overall hotel is ok. Could do with a bit of updating but I found a lot of hotels in Portugal are dated. Busy hotel with nice pool. Could do with a few more activities for the kids.

author: Katie9555
title: Great Hotel
text: After reading previous reviews I was worried about staying in this hotel. Turns out I had nothing to worry about. Had a fantastic time here. From the moment we arrived in the hotel it was a great experience. The staff were so helpful and very friendly. There's a room where you can leave luggage in if you are to early for check in and you can also leave it there once you check out. We were in block 3 which was across the road from the main building. I booked self catering and we had everything we needed in the room. The room was spotless and was cleaned regularly during our stay. The only problem with the room was that the balcony door didn't lock properly. But other than that it was perfect. The pool area was fantastic. Very clean pool. Lots of activities during the day for both kids and adults. Can't comment on the food as we didn't have any meals in the hotel. The supermarket was great for fresh bread and rolls. About a 5 minute walk to the beach and strip with lots of bars and restaurants.

author: 859erink
title: Don't be fooled by the promise of WiFi..
text: We arrive late.. which alot of travlleres do and they are understandibly weary from from their long communte... but to be met with a 45 minute delay is beyond ridiculous. Albeit the driver was very courteous and respectful.. better planning should be in place.. we arrive tired and looking forward to relaxing.. to which we get the news we are to wait for yet another shuttle bus is to arrive.... to literally bring us across the road... with that, no WiFi.. extra costs for using the pool and sunbeds with nothing less than its policy and all inclusive is no exception... (some should then check their hotel info page as a room across a busy street does not count as WiFi, in fact you pay 10 euro for Wifi in the lobby only) the power shower is meerly a limescale soaked dribbling mess (but alas piping hot water is at the ready) the tv only provides the basic channels (for those linguistically challenged a nightmare) so if decisively you choose to stay in, you are with a basic apartment with a handy selection of kitchen untensils, a leaky air conditioning system on the balcony, poor bathroom cleanliess standards and a serious lack of bedlinen of which was available was tan stained then this is your ideal home away from home.. but I would strongly suggest do not bring young childen or the elderly.. if you do.. kick up a stibk and ask for accommodation near the lobby.. easier access for all...

author: I3116TTlauraf
title: It's what you make it.
text: After reading the reviews before we went to clube Praia da rocha I was not expecting great things so I was determined to go with an open mind and not moan about anything and enjoy it as much as we could. We stayed all inclusive from 4-11th sep. I'll get the bad points out of the way: Before each meal you had to wait for them to find you a table this was just a waste of time as often there were many tables free they just needed to be cleared the queuing often took a good 10 minutes. If they just had disposable tablecloths this would have been much more hygienic and would have saved so much time. The food was absolutely horrendous I was absolutely sick of eating chips with a tiny bread roll. As I'm vegetarian I really struggled anyway but then the amount of inconsiderate people who would used the spoon for meat then dig it into the vegetables afterwards was so annoying as this meant even less choice from the awful food. Breakfast was watermelon, dinner chips lunch chips. Also the layout in the dining room near the pool needs improving as there was always a big que for the hot drinks machine and the soft drinks machine was right next to it so it meant even more queuing there was plenty of space to put the soft drinks at the other end so there wasn't a huddle of people trying to get to each machine. The rooms were so hot it was absolutely unbearable as there is no aircon deffinately recommend paying for a fan from day one. The rooms were outdated but this was not a problem as they had everything we needed but I must say the rooms were not very clean we had our beds made three times out of 7 and our bins emptied but other than that nothing else was cleaned. The pool was brilliant for kids and there was a nice relaxed atmosphere around the pool. Yes you do pay 1 euro for a sunbed but we found this was better as there were always plenty of sunbeds and you got to choose where you wanted them no need to que up at daft o'clock like we have done in previous hotels. The location is absolutely brilliant. We often went out at night and found some lovely pubs with such friendly staff. Walk up to the main strip was 5 minutes at most although this was uphill for anyone who may struggle with walking and the paving was a little slippy I often almost fell over. We did end up going to the old town which was was €5.20 in a taxi and we really enjoyed it we had a meal at the masala house an Indian restaurant and it was the best Indian meal I have ever tasted. Sorry for the long review but I wanted to cover all bases so you don't go expecting too much. All in all we did have a fantastic holiday the weather was fantastic we would deffinately visit Praia da rocha again but not at this hotel I would say this should be 2* as we have stayed in many 3* hotels and they have been absolutely fine. If you have any questions please feel free to ask.

author: marcinkL7732FU
title: Fantastic Vacations
text: Our stay was an 8 day stay all-inclusive When we first entered the hotel all of the staff were very friendly. We had a room on the 1st floor and for 2 adults and 2 children there was enought space. The balcony was a nice place to relax by candle light on a warm night . The food was delightful and all of the kitchen staff were organised and everybody knew what to do . The dining room was very presentable.There was a wild selection of dishes every day . Every night in the video bar there was a entertainmant program at 21:30 from a reptile show /parrot show to bingo/karaoke . Every night at 21:00 there was a mini disco for the children . At 10:30 there was a zumba class every day. In the pool at 15:30 you could join in aqua fitness and at 16:30 you could play a game of water basket or water polo . There was also a games room perfect for the kids ! The pool was free , but if you wanted to rent a sunbed or sun umbrella for a whole day it was just 1 euro !! There is 2 pools one is a kids pool and the other one is a pool that is a mixed pool form the lowest water hight being 1,10 m to its depth being 2,60m . There is also a slide that's a really fun attraction . Over all this was great for the price and we hope to come back to Clube Praia Da Rocha soon. Thanks !

author: poppyh475
title: Never again!
text: Me and my partner stayed in this hotel for 7 nights, during August, on a self catering basis. We booked the holiday the month before and got it at quite a reasonable price, we therefore didn't have particularly high expectations. Last year we stayed in Club Amaralis in Praia Da Rocha, which is also a 3 star hotel and was perfectly fine, we thought that Club Praia Da Rocha would be similar. We are very fond of the Algarve and we were not looking to spend much time in the hotel at all, however the time that we did spend there was very disappointing. We arrived at the hotel around 2am, we were told by the receptionist that he could give us "a very good deal." He advised that he could give us a room in Block Three that had air conditioning, as the rooms in Block One and Two did not have air conditioning. We happily accepted the room in Block Three and were told that his colleague would show us to our room. We went outside to find a man waiting with a car, we asked where exactly were we going to then be told he didn't not speak English, as this point we had no idea where we were going. When we arrived at Block Three we found that all of the amenities in the block had shut down. We entered the block and I have to say it looked more like a derelict block of flats than a hotel, with windows covered up with wood and padlocks! Our room was on the street level and the balcony opened up on to a walkway looked as if it could be entered by anybody as it seemed there wasn't any security. We immediately walked back to the main hotel and asked to be in either Block One or Two, the receptionist allowed this. The room was very basic and all drains were blocked. The room was not cleaned, we received fresh towels once, but the bedding was not changed. We only had one request of the hotel, on the last day we asked if we could extend our check out time as we didn't fly until 10pm and would have liked to be able to use the room to quickly shower off, after a trip to the beach. We were told by reception staff that this was impossible, we were told this even though we were more than happy to pay a charge. Considering the absolute lack of cleaning and that there are six hours between check out and check in time, I cannot believe that 6 hours are spent cleaning the rooms during the switch over of guests.
