I cannot comment on the food as we did not eat at the hotel, but it is correct the use of a sunbed and umbrella is charged at one euro per item per day. Due to the nature of Block Three, the condition of the room and the unhelpful staff members I would recommend not to stay at this hotel.

author: Loopyloob
title: Disgusted!
text: Me & my family have just come back from Portugal. We stayed at the Clube Priai da Rocha hotel. Looks quite nice on the pictures. We walked into this hotel & it was was like walking back in time. Old shabby reception area, 4 lifts which cover 13 floors which is ridiculous as they take forever to come & can only fit 4 people in at one time. The rooms are VERY dated had a very funny smell when you first walked in which wasn't pleasant. Fridge didn't shut properly & was leaking water, hardly any utensils no microwave no toaster, you can hire a toaster but you need to pay a deposit the same also if want a fan & tv remote plus other things! bathroom was filthy. However the maid did come every day apart from Sunday.....she never actually cleaned the floor or changed the bedding is was just to drop clean towels off. If you want a relaxing day around the pool expect to pay for sun loungers & parasols. Good point though they do have life guards & are very good! The beach is a 5/10 minute walk away & is absolutely beautiful. Night life is great but do be prepared to be constantly offered drugs. Would I go back here again? NOT A CHANCE IN HELL!!

author: Sabblu
title: Basic
text: I'm not one to write reviews but for the sake of other family's I have felt the need!! As they say you get what you pay for and in this case correct!! Basic room got there the 1st night we had to put the baby in the bed with us due to not enough travel cots!! My other 2 children slept on draw beds that pulled out from the seating area!! The adult beds were very dated every time you turned over the would squeak!! Pillows had nothing in them!!we went all inclusive the 1st week was not worth it!! The bar was a joke!! No icecreams all inclusive just Coke or lemonade! The reception staff would talk to you as if you were 10 years old!! They must have that many complaints they make the reception unapproachable!! There was the odd nice one don't get me wrong!! Portugal was beautiful but unfortunately we were walking around wishing we had booked other hotels!! Whilst we was there a little boy went down the pool slide and knocked his 2 front teeth out!! All the staff were worried about was getting money for the beds!!!entertainment was rubbish no aircon anywhere! Never again I must say tho met some lovely people who had a good Ald Moan with me lol!! Enjoy but don't expect to much miss bell Liverpool

author: RossiGiants
title: Stop your moaning!!
text: This really is my first ever review but reading some of these i had to tip my toe in. For the money i paid this hotel was fine!! I went to a 5star in turkey 2 years ago that was out of this world. It cost me 3 grand and although i would love to go every year it is not realistic! This hotel for a week self catering cost £950:00!! A steal! The only negative for me was the balcony. They really need to update this as i believe the concrete step up is to dangerous as kids will climb on it and then be to high over the metal railings. If you have kids the pool is brilliant fun, a very good friendly vibe. A good mixture Europeans! They have daily activities for the kids. Music playing all day and the area around the pool is a sun trap. Staff friendly, Portuguese friendly, lovely resort. I would suggest S/C, go and see the resort. Beaches unreal! Squash bar next door cheap and good atmosphere. If you want 5star pay the doe!!

author: piotrr881
title: Great value!
text: After reading some really bad reviews I was even considering to cancel our booking and find somewhere else. I am glad I didn't. It is not as bad as some people write. You will not get everything for that price like some expect. Apartments are very spacious and clean. Kitchenette with 2 electric rings and fridge, few cups, glasses, plates and pans. Kettle, toasters has to be rented which I found a bit weird especially that we went self catering. Furniture, sofa bed and bathroom very dated even though it is a cheap hotel I would expect better sofabed and use of mattress protectors. Can't complain about the staff although our room was set for 2 even though we booked for 2 adults and 2 kids, when went to reception got missing towels and bedding. Towels replaced once during our 7 day stay which is about right, rubbish taken daily and toilet paper topped up daily. No problems with the lifts as some say, there is a bit of wait but definitely not 10 mins! Few mins max! I was concerned about lack of Air Conditioning but it was not a problem, we were at 11th floor and our room was never in direct sunlight so it was always nice and cool. Pool was good but very busy and there were times when the water slide was not controlled by the staff and some kids were pushing others etc, that should be improved. All in all we are happy with our stay. We expected a lot worse. If you want luxury you need to collect some more money and choose different place. Staff very friendly!

author: 622michellea
title: Friendly Basic Hotel
text: Spent one week at this hotel and was worried after reading a lot of reviews but had a lovely holiday. Check in was hassle free, we rented a safe as I didn't want to be worrying about passports and carrying too much money and found the cost very acceptable. Had to pay a deposit on the safe key, tv remote control and fan that we rented but got the money back when checking out. The room was large and clean but basic. Towels were changed every 3 days but when we asked ours were changed when needed. Found the euro charge for sunbeds really reasonable and sunbeds were always available. Pool was fantastic for the kids, really clean and felt very safe. All the staff were really friendly and helpful. Especially the kids club/entertainment team they are so nice and couldn't do enough for my son. Monicka really went out of her way, sitting down with my older boy talking about Pokemon Go! We stayed all inclusive and did find the food disappointing. We didn't go hungry but it was a struggle each meal to find something to eat. Found myself filling up on chips and rice which got repetitive. Dessert was always nice though with a selection of cakes and the melon was really tasty. Location of the hotel is really good only a few minutes walk to the beach and strip. Hotel can be a bit noisy but nothing out of the ordinary and is very family friendly. Overall the hotel was good value and we enjoyed our stay. Don't go expecting a four star experience and you won't be disappointed.

author: 8HelenB
title: Wow ......where shall I start !!
text: Let's start with some positives... The resort of Portimao is great with a beautiful beach and many shops and restaurants serving good food, two that are well worth a visit are Casalinhos on the beach and cafe del mar, both offered lovely food and excellent service. Now clube Praia da Rocha if only I could say the same!!! We arrived on the 15th of July for a 10 day stay. The pool area is bright and cheerful although the parasols and sun beds are not part of the all inclusive they cost €1 each but you don't feel you are keeping a bed and not using it as you have paid for it so we didn't mind the cost. We were put in block 2 on the 9th floor ...we entered our room and it smelt musty, the curtains had holes and stains all over them,the floors were dirty with hairs and dust,furniture was old and worn and quite honestly needed the tip!! The bathroom was absolutely disgusting with mildew all over the tiles and behind the shower curtain which also had a hole in it. The beds were clean and we had some very strange pillows that can only be described as having lumps of foam in them. The maid service was non existent and in 10 says we had one towel change which I went to reception and demanded plus one bed change, our room was never once in our stay either swept or mopped. Now for the restaurant and I use that word loosely....always fresh salad, coleslaw, fresh bread yogurts...the rest of the food available was awful and can only be described as 'slop' I would recommend if you opt for all inclusive that you take enough money to enable you to eat out on a regular basis as we had to do. During our stay both myself and my partner experienced an upset stomach and I was also sick. The rooms become very hot as no air con and the areas in the hotel where there should be air con rarely feel cool! Finally don't expect all inclusive to mean what it says at the bars as generally any drink which is worth drinking has to be paid for. Would I return to this hotel most definitely not. Please remember this experience is purely ours and others may have a different feel about this accommodation but I would say if you can spend a little more find somewhere better as this is a waste of money.

author: philipd856
title: Average is best description July 2016
text: We stayed her almost 15 years ago with 2 small kids in May and it was average then and much the same now. Never stayed all inclusive anywhere in Praia da rocha so cannot comment on food and went to beach daily this time so cannot comment on pool..The bedroom was on the first floor so we used stairs daily. We waited on lift once when we arrived and it is slow. We took the sofa mattresses from sitting room and placed on top of bed mattresses for comfort..When you get there they give you a coloured bracelet for security recognition and to let their staff know if you are all inclusive. All extras are payable and we only used safe. The complex is enormous with 2 blocks of accommodation. It used to be bigger with 5000 rooms but the across the road accommodation was closed down years ago. July and August are busiest times with local holidaymakers. There are better hotels and there are worse hotels in this location but when on holidays you should eat out daily, stay out late, have a few drinks and the bed or the heat or the noise will not bother you..the beach is 7 minutes away and is wonderful. 3 course meals up town and are 9 to 11 euro and although small, once the body acclimatises to the holiday it is plenty. At the main entrance exit go left and Jose in the mini market is a nice guy with good offers and everything you could need. Another Jose in the squash bar next door who is renowned for chilling his glasses before filling with beer. Jose will fill you in on local spots.. These guys work 16 hour days but still meet greet and remember your faces and orders after just a few visits. Good business men who work hard and earn every penny.. Their staff are happy and that is a good sign. Overall stay was average to good for families which is fine once your expectations are not high. Rooms were cleaned every 2 days so that is acceptable and price for stay was value for money. I would stay again and this is our fourth visit to Praia da rocha.

author: charmacgregor
title: You get what you pay for!
text: After reading several reviews via this site, we were dubious as to what to expect. However, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Rooms: Many of the pictures taken by other visitors are just people looking for reasons to fault the hotel, and although the rooms are outdated, they were clean, functional and extremely large. Pool: The pool is extremely large and deep. The hotel does ask for a €1 charge for sun beds and parasol, however we found it to be no problem at all as it guaranteed a bed and there was no fuss over having to put towels down. The guys around the pool sorting the sun beds were nothing but helpful. However, the entrance is a long way round from the block we were in as they tend not to open all entrances, but not really a problem. Food: The restaurants did not offer much choice, usually one meat option and one fish. Found it quite difficult as we had a fussy eater and vegetarian in the group, but we overall found Portugal does not offer much vegetarian food in any restaurant on the front either. We addressed our food requirements on one of the first days and the waiter 'Alexandre' couldn't do more to help, he asked the chef to make the effort to cook more vegetables and this became apparent as throughout the week we could eat more. He came and checked on us everyday to see how we were finding the food which was nice. Location: Fab location, 5 minute walk to the beach and main strip. 10 minute to marina. Staff: Staff extremely helpful and attentive to any needs, very good at helping sort out transfers and trips. We were overall happy with the service we received for the money we paid. Would go again but not all inclusive.

author: Stubsifer
title: OK, but I wouldn't recommend it
text: This was a very cheap all inclusive holiday and you know that you get what you pay for. The rooms are dated and tired. We had twin beds as it is an apartment hotel. The phone jack was hanging off the wall when we arrived, so we went down and reported it to the receptionist) after he finished shouting at his colleague) and although he said the engineer would be up to fix it the next morning he never came. Not really a problem as we didn't need the phone though. We moved onto the old sofa bed in the kitchen/lounge so we could watch telly of an evening so it was a bit like glamping (without the glamour) in the end. There was a working fridge in what remained of the 70's kitchen area. The all inclusive food was not good, we lasted 3 nights and then it had started to taste and smell the same so we ate out for the rest of the week. The all inclusive drinks were fine and we enjoyed drinking plenty of amaretto. The pool was nice but the surrounding area was a little sharp on the feet without shoes. The beach is a good ten min walk up a hill the down to the sand. We enjoy walking so that was not an issue for us. The main strip was very lively so we were pleased that the hotel was a short walk away as the location is quiet. Each night my partner was offered drugs as we walked along, so him looking the drugs type became a running joke. Overall we had a nice time as we were on holiday and it is what you make of it, but I wouldn't ever wish to return to this hotel nor recommend it to others to stay at.

author: tonyfZ8453OZ
title: You get what you pay for and a little more
text: We booked with Holiday Gems , Cheap mini break (4 nights mon/fri ).we booked a studio and on arrival was given a 1 bedroom apartment all be it on the top floor. we also arrive around midday and checkin was not till 4pm but the staff were so kind and helpful we go our room in 10 mins . yes we paid for safe key and remote control but we had read the reveiws and knew this would be the case . we got all our deposits back with no trouble at all . The Rooms Dated and a bit wore out .NO AIR CON. bed was very creaky,they need a refurb and by the sounds of it next door was being done up while we stayed there , (cant make a cake without breaking eggs i say ) The Pool Like the idea of paying a euro a bed , keeps everything under control. lots of beds . best to go in pool about 1pm when all the all inclusive residents queue up to eat more food . we were room only . Staff 10/10 was made so welcome , nothing too much trouble .A credit to the hotel group . Conclusion Dont expect 4 star . this is not a 4 or a 3 . but take it for what it is . your on holiday enjoy it . and there is a lot to enjoy in the surrounding areas , bit confused that you had to walk UP a hill to the beach . Would return .

author: gerard1991
title: Club pria da rocha better off in derelict building site
text: We booked my son into the hotel for a week away. I know it's not a great hotel but they put them in a block across a bridge with no pool. From there room it was a nearly a mile to the hotel pool. This block was used for the street promotional and drug dealers. I know this because I spoke to them to ask how much they paid. €2 a night!!! Uv complained and was told that it was their hotel so no deception. They don't have to specifie which building. This room or block was in none of their promotional literature. I've been told that I can't put a complaint because I didn't speak to the resort rep. I did and reception I did. But their word against mine Absolute pit. They couldn't stand on the balcony. One of the neighbours joked that he held onto the door when he went out for a smoke. They had a pool that was empty and hadn't been used for many years. I have pics I'll download later

author: 175zhanet
title: Room was poor
text: The hotel is very big. I got an apartment for 2 weeks. Try not to get the room at the front of the hotel as we did not get any sun, we asked to move but was told the hotel was fully booked. The cleanliness of the apartment is very poor! There was other people's hair all over the rooms, in the kitchen cupboards also. I was in a self catering apartment and the cooking facilities are very limited. Had to ask for two bowls to have some cereal, after two complaints it took 4 hours for someone to bring them up to our room. There was a block wall above the stoves which looked like an extractor fan should of been there, I got very frustrated with this unnecessary wall as I kept banging my head on it everything I cooked! There were building work going on in the room opposite which caused a load of dust in my apartment hallway. Also building work was going on above us, drilling at 10.30am which really annoyed me, as my partner and I were on holiday to relax and sleep in, not to be woken up by drilling and banging. It would have been nice to have been notified about the work so we could of prepared for it. We also had limited lights, out of 3 lights in the sitting room only one worked and that was really dull so it was hard to see when cooking. They provided cleaning equipment, a mop, a broom and a dust pan. After sweeping up the whole apartment, I found it hard to sweep all the dust with the big broom onto the small dust pan. Don't think I will be visiting this hotel again and sure won't recommend it!

author: tcols
title: FANTASTIC HOTEL!
text: I’ve just returned from a wonderful 2 week stay at Club Praia Da Rocha with my girlfriend and her family (6 of us in total). We had the perfect holiday and this hotel was the perfect place for us. For the amount you pay this place is unbelievable, it surpassed all our prior expectations, staying All Inclusive is essential! The food was brilliant, changed everyday, great selection of fruit, vegetables, meat, fish & deserts, coffee & tea making facilities and a nice selection of drinks on tap, turn up early & you won’t be disappointed. The cakes at lunch & dinner were especially delicious. The rooms were lovely, spotlessly clean & had everything that we needed. The beds were comfortable enough for a 2 week stay & we had a peaceful sleep every night. The shower was warm & powerful. The cleaners made the apartment for us everyday & provided clean towels & fresh bed linen as you’d expect. We had alot of fun around the pool area, the pool itself was cold (as you’d expect from an outdoor pool) but very clean, sun beds were €1 each, which was fine by us, saved the rush in the morning trying to save a place. You're allowed lilo’s, food and drink around the pool which was great as we did lounge around here quite alot and there is a Lunch bar next to the pool serving burgers, chips, rolls & drinks everyday. The staff were just amazing throughout our stay, not enough could be said about them, really lovely genuine people who always had time to stop for a chat and seemed to really enjoy their jobs & the environment they were working in. In particular Junior, Bruno, Micael, Paulo, Sam & Mario, its was a pleasure meeting you & thank you for making our stay so enjoyable! A holiday is what you make it, this hotel is so easy to lazily criticise which is why people have done & the bad reviews are completely unfair. This is a 3 star hotel, not a 5 star, if you want a 5 star hotel then book one, but if you want a fun holiday on a budget then this is the hotel for you. For the price its the best hotel I’ve ever stayed in! It really is a wonderful place and I’ll definitely be returning again. With this hotel you get what you pay for & much, MUCH more! Thank you CPR!

author: noreeng121
title: ***SUPER BUDGET HOLIDAY***
text: This was a real surprise. On arrival the staff we're fantastic very helpful. This went right from the cleaners, to the Management they we're all extremely helpful. Apartments we're very clean with fresh white towels, and the beds had fresh white sheets.. The pool area was kept lovely and clean. The sun beds and brollys looked new. It was only 1 €uro to have the beds and 1€uro for the brolly all day. A great idea as there was no one sunbed hogging and throwing their towels over them and not using them.. Next to the hotel was a little shop selling English papers and Basic English food. 5/ 10 min walk to the BEAUTIFUL BEACH & lined with restaurants, bars and gift shops. The weather was Glorious reaching 78f from 27th march til 3rd April.. All in all for the Money we paid All inclusive we were delighted. The food was great, good selection of breakfast, lunch and dinner. Oh and snacks from 3.30pm cheeseburgers fries Ham & cheese rolls. The wine and Beer was great too. This was excellent for a family on a budget, with plenty to do..And entertainment in the day and on yhe evening. All i can say is Thank you to the staff for making my holiday enjoyable. Im booking for next Easter.. 😁

author: Beverley0571
title: For the money paid - Budget holiday
text: Positives: friendly welcome by staff at all times. Apartment big, had been cleaned and new white towels in room. Large pool area, restaurant, bar and snack bar. The beach is about a 10 minute walk and is beautiful. Extra costs- sun beds and parasols are €1 each. No kettle in room you can hire one. The TVs remote is €10 deposit, the safe €20 ( and €1.50 a day) - you get deposit back when you leave. The hotel is basic, the outside facing the street has recently been repainted , the fronts of those facing the pool have been filled and painting was underway. As this was start of the season there was work ongoing throughout. Some of the apartments are privately owned. Inside the apartment had extensive storage, bathroom which needs updating, a bedroom with twin beds - could fit more in. A lounge with bed sofa (2 beds) , table, chairs and balcony. New boiler had been fitted in small kitchen. The balcony has table and 2 chairs - we didn't use this as table was covered in what the seagulls had left behind and there wasn't anything to clean it with. Food in the all inclusive option was ok but nothing special. We found lovely restaurant Cafe del Mar on the strip and Spot 3 was fab too on the beach. The apartments can be noisy at night, all noise echoes. They were working on a beauty room and the games room seemed to be well kitted out. All in all, did the job, was somewhere to sleep while exploring the area.

author: 248robv
title: Where do I start....
text: I'm going to right this review with the fact that this holiday was super cheap!! I will start with the positives First and for most one of the saving graces of this place is the staff!! They really are a credit to the hotel and nothing was ever to much especially Sam in the restaurant. Secondly the pool is amazing!! Bit cold but it was October but can honestly say it was clean and tidy and the kids loved it. Thirdly the location is amazing. So close to the beautiful beach!! And that's it, that's all this hotel has going for it, we were all inclusive which was a load of crap, food was repetitive and two days on the trot the milk was off. All inclusive drinks was the worst I've ever seen. The lager was awful and the wine was basically vinegar. No spirits until after 8 and then only till 11. Snack bar just did burger and chips or ham and cheese rolls which were very basic. No ice cream for the kids as stated when we booked. Rooms were very very uncomfortable, the sofa in the front room pulled out into two "beds" although beds isn't what I would call them. The mattresses were barely 3 inches thick and like laying on concrete and the pillars where like lumps of old concrete in a pillow case. It's such a shame I have to leave a bad review as with the staff they have and a little investment in the little things such as decent beds and pillows it would make all the difference. Thankfully now home and had a decent nights sleep!! Would I stay again? Absolutely not worst sleep ever!!

author: samanthab753
title: Stag n hen
text: Me and my family (2 boys aged 10 & 14) and my boyfriend have just returned from a week in this hotel. I wouldn't recommend to families but it would be ideal for stag n hen parties. The highlight at the start was the swimming pool which on 1st view it's lovely the best Bit being the slide and it's a great sun trap. The downside floors needs redoing as cracks and slabs sticking up especially going up the stairs to the slide where a friends child slashed his toe on sharp steps. Also beware of the seagulls which arrive about 3ish u cant stop that but signs could be put up asking guests not to feed them! The lifeguard is useless he just sits not paying attention my 14yr old had to jump in pool to push a little boy to shallow end coz he drifted out n where was the lifeguard? Sitting with his girlfriend ! It cost a euro a day for sunbed but i think thats good because ur guaranteed a bed n u can leave towel on it go out come bck n itd still there if u dont leave anything u will have to pay again.The games room was a godsend with the boys although it could be updated they had more unworkable things than workable and the pool tables had thick layer of dust on tables. Breakfast/lunch/dinner wasn't great we had pork options most nights grilled,roasted,stewed one night we had it n it wasn't cooked properly. We ate out more than in which took a huge chunk out of our spending money people always had a choice of chips,rice,salad or pasta though so if ur not a big eater ul be fine. The drinks aren't all that I swear the beer is watered down u don't get much choice with all inclusive n its the first holiday with the kids they didn't offer ice cream. They also have snack bar open at pool u have a choice beef burger cheese burger chips cheese roll or cheese n ham n if u left it too long it tasted like cardboard! The rooms look clean from 1st glance but ours had dried blood under bathroom sink n walls looked like they needed redoin. The beds are so uncomfy and the pillows feel like theyve been washed n not dried properly all lumpy my tip is to put a blanket over them (Much better) we had two singles and a sofa bed which isn't a proper sofa bed it's a sofa with a cot like thing my Son slept on sofa 1st 3 nights and got bitten to bits. Also some of my items were broken by the maids I did complain but nothing got done. Also some of the staff do seem lovely but we did have a run in with a small lady who works in cocktail bar who told my son she would take his band of him because he didn't realise the rules if I would of been told I would of dealt with the situation. If you do want more families to come it needs more options and a but more cleanliness I understand it's a big hotel so u need more staff. The other good thing Is the bar next door called squash bar the man who owns it Is called Jose n he'd really welcoming and cheap. I wouldn't recommend for families friends holiday only.

author: rebeccalM8249TK
title: Basic, but you get what you pay for. (don't take to heart all the bad reviews!!)
text: I have just returned from a 3 night stay in Club Praia Da Rocha, which I visited with 12 of my family and friends for a hen weekend. After reading some terrible reviews on here, I must admit I was a little worried about what to expect, but I really wish I hadn't read them as it was nothing like I was expecting at all! We had 3 rooms, 4 people in each room. Yes, the rooms are very basic, but were clean, which is all we wanted as a base to get our heads down. The rooms consisted of a main bedroom with 2 single beds and a living area with a sofa bed which pulled out into 2 beds (not the comfiest I must admit but again, did us fine). We were placed in an apartment on the 13th floor which overlooked the road and the back of the hotel, but we never once experienced any noise, and although the lifts were sometimes slow (due to the amount of people using them) all were in full working order, just abit of patience required! The staff in all areas of the hotel, were friendly and helpful, and the reception staff went out of their way to help you. Yes, they have a 1€ a day fee for the hire of a sunbed, but this actually worked so much better as there was no rushing and fighting over sunbeds, and you get to choose where you want your sunbed placing. The pool is a salt water pool, and at times was quite cold, but that isn't the hotels fault... That's predicted by the weather. It was still bearable to use, as well as there being a slide into the pool too. Bruno on the pool bar was more than helpful serving us drinks throughout the day, always with a friendly smile on his face. We were all inclusive so used this to our advantage and ate all of our meals within the hotel restaurant - yes the food is very basic (but what can be expected for a 3 STAR HOTEL!) however, there was always an option of a meat dish, a fish dish and pasta, and none of us had any problems with finding something to eat (and that was with a picky eater in our group). The snack bar was open every day between certain hours too, and this provided people with burgers or sandwiches, aswell as fries. As for all inclusive drinks, these are available all day (beer, wine and soft drinks) and yes they limit you to 2 at a time, but there's nothing to stop you going straight back and getting more! Spirits are available from 8pm for all inclusive but can be bought before then if people want them, however with the measures they serve i don't think I'd want any before then anyway or I'd never have made it until 8pm :-) The video bar opens from 8pm, which is where the entertainment is held (however i can't comment on that as we made our own entertainment) and then there's the cocktail bar which seemed very popular and where we spent majority of our time. The beach is approx a 5 minute walk away, and it is gorgeous with soft golden sand and beautiful blue seas, however for people with mobility problems it may be a struggle to get down to the beach as there's steps to climb. There is also a strip of bars which come to life on a night, some being open to the early hours, if that's your sort of thing. Overall, Club Praia Da Rocha, served it's purpose for all of us and we throughly enjoyed our stay here. Please remember you're not booking a 5 star resort, it's a 3 star, that it cheap and cheerful.

author: becki_g91
title: Great Holiday For The Price!
text: We stayed in Club Praia De Rocha for 4 nights and have to say, had a fabulous time! The main hotel lobby and communal bar areas were clean and well presented and the pool area was nice, tidy and clean and did not allow smoking, which although I am a smoker myself I found great, especially with all the families and young children around. The sunbeds were only 1 Euro a day as was an umbrella,and the staff put these in your desired spot and set them up for you, and there was access to three bars onsite. We did not eat at the hotel as we are fans of getting out and exploring, but the drinks we had from the pool bar were reasonably priced and the cocktails we had from the cocktail bar were lovely. The staff were so friendly and helpful. Happy to help and give directions and hand out maps, and to call and confirm our transfers for us, and arrange day trips and vehicle hire. We stayed in a one bedroom apartment, which was basic, but as we were just using it for a base to get out and explore was more than fine for what we needed. It was clean with the usual facilities and fresh clean towels and toiletries were provided. The rooms were cleaned four times a week and towels and bed changed twice a week. We had a double room which split in to two single beds, which was ideal for me and my friend, the bedroom had lots of storage space and double doors leading on to balcony with table and two chairs, which had a spectacular view over the marina as we were on the eighth floor. There were several lifts to get up and down the thirteen floors of the building. There was a large kitchen/living/dining area which was light and airy, and a large bathroom which was clean. Good lighting in the apartment. There was a gift shop and a small supermarket onsite, which was reasonably priced. The hotel was in a perfect location for exploring, a two-minute walk from the beach and shops and restaurants. We had a fantastic stay. I would definitely go back again!!

author: chriscS4149JV
title: Cheap and cheerful
text: We stayed at this hotel in early August and after reading the reviews, was a little weary about the hotel!! So my review !! HOTEL The hotel is dated and repairs are underway to update the place . The rooms are spacious but could do with bring up with current times !! No air con , (but don't know why I'm saying that when they don't state to have it) . Pillows are lumpy . The lifts went up and down like in other hotels!! FOOD In our 10 days at the hotel, we was gutted cos Gordon Ramsey wasn't cooking are food like most ppl expect for the mediocre price paid.. Choice is limited compared to most all inclusives but there is always something to eat... Maybe not ideal for your holiday, seen a lot of people saying the food was cold and inedible, but in all honesty , there talking crap!! The soft drinking are all proper brands !! POOL The pool is big and salt watered!! Little dated but kids loved !! They have a 1 euro policy on sun beds , which when ppl get over having to pay a whole euro out , works a absolute treat!! You don't get idiots saving beds then turning up at tea time !! OVERALL The hotel isn't the greatest but the price tells you that!! The location is excellent !! TRANSFER & FLIGHT Who cares it's nothing to do with the hotel !!! 👍🏿

author: kellyf616
title: Worth the money
text: having just returned from this hotel I can honestly say for the £639 I paid for 10 nights for a family of 4 during the school holidays was a bargain ! The flights from Manchester cost us more ! All in all though £1480 is still a great deal! But please don't go thinking that it is all inclusive as it is not - even though it is advertised on the websites it is not true - take a look at your documents it states full board plus drinks ( which are local or the cheaper brands we get back here ). The pool is brilliant and kept our children entertained almost all day. The entertainment on the night wasn't so good but great for our 4 year old and the Portuguese kids ie local kids action songs ! Only gripe there is that it starts to late and the bar has only one tender - and ques form rapidly - more about saving the hotel money on drinks I think ! Staff friendly. Rooms spacious but they are in desperate need of new furniture ! Pillows as everyone else has stated but we found putting a blanket from the wardrobe under neath helped ! Failing that get drunk and pass out lol ! Bathroom - right this is were I've held back on my rating ! Although it's very dated and has mould along the sealant around the bath and sink - which wasn't the issue it was the cleanliness ! - it needed a steam/ jet clean ! I used baby wipes to give it a quick go on the surfaces we were touching but I find it unacceptable that there was that much surface dirt ! So please take some wipes with you. Food edible and could always find something to eat although my husband and son couldn't so we ate out a few nights but the snack bar was lovely ! For the price I paid it was worth it ! Great location too

author: 188pauloc
title: Seedy Hotel
text: My visit was in August 2015 and the apartment is very decadent, looks like it was built for 20 years and never had a work, as well as the furniture. I was with my family (2 small children) and have not used the kitchen that the apartment has. The kitchen is poorly equipped, a small stove and refrigerator. It has some cutlery, but not enough for 4 people. I liked the pool, very good for children to play, even has a water slide and allows children to be with large buoys in it. Employees are kind. What is also nice is the ability to walk at ease at the hotel, especially when it comes from the beach you can walk comfortably bare-chested. A local problem is the lack of parking, although the hotel have the same park had never place for the car, even close to the Hotel is not easy to find parking. Nearby Praia da Rocha, a fantastic beach, very large, clean and quiet and hot water. Great for families with small children. The location of the hotel is central, has many bars, supermarkets, disco, etc. The food in the hotel is average, not very varied at the same meal, but was changing dishes every day. Has breakfast type English, if you like. The elevators are always busy so often resorted to the stairs, my suggestion is to choose a low floor. The apartments face the pool have a better view.

author: JulieM273
title: Clube Praia da Rocha III apartments (not the main hotel)
text: Booked this with My Holidays Praia da Rocha -AL via Booking.com. Aptmt was in blue & white towers which seem to have been sublet & overall not greatly maintained. Didn't have access to pool in main hotel over the bridge but this was not that clear when booked & doesn't appear to say it on site now either but also strange you can't book this accom via Booking.com now too!!? Apartment was basic but expected this from reviews. Beds were hard & mine very creaky every time moved do not great sleep. Pillows lumpy but ok. Linen was clean but some had ingrained marks on them. Didn't have enough towels & crockery for 4 people & took 5 days (of 7 day hol) to get more. No obvious check in or contact point other than a portacabin opposite tower G. Was only by chance I saw the 'rep' to get what needed. No instructions given for check out so handed keycard in to portacabin at 4:50am when left. Location ok & we did get a reasonable view as requested. Also had air con which was nice. No safe in room tho & no option to get one. Cars were parked all over place around complex so had to take care when entering/leaving accommodation. No noise issues. Shame about general state of place & pool on that side been left to decay. We didn't let it spoil it hols but won't go back.

author: johnnyt322
title: Bit of a disappointment
text: Stayed for a week in this hotel and it was a let down from the beginning. Room was on the sixth floor facing the road so it was noisy at night and hard to sleep. Beds in the bedroom were fine but the sofa beds were very uncomfortable and squeak with the slightest movement. We had to put the mattresses on the ground so the kids could get some sleep.The room was very basic. Kitchen utensils were minimal. No tea towels to dry the cutlery ( we asked for one but never received it). No sweeping brush and the cleaning staff never swept the floors only emptied the bin. Towels were not changed until I complained at reception on our second to last day. The lifts are antiquated and painfully slow, so most of the time we had to use the stairs, all six flights four or five times a day. Not much fun after two or three days. Not many English speaking people staying at this hotel, there seemed to be a lot of Portuguese here, and to me seemed very ignorant and impolite. The pool area is really big and great for kids. Didn't eat at the hotel so can't comment on the food. Would I go back next year?? I'd doubt it.

author: Rose5585
title: Save more money and book at the other decent hotels in the area.
text: On arrival booking was fast all they did was hand us the key and told the room number, 9th floor! There's four tiny lifts that are very slow, and always packed. Rooms are basic (what we expected) beds are terrible, no air con. Pool was the best part of the hotel, very cold but clean. Not many English in this hotel it's more Spanish and locals, which seem to come across very rude towards English ppl. Met a few English and Irish families who informed me of money being stolen from there bedrooms so if you do risk it please keep your valuables on you. The location of the hotel is good, a Steep walk up a hill to get to the main strip which is full of bars, Restaurants and souvenir shops. Then down the stairs to the beautiful soft sand beach. Make sure you Que. up for your sun bed at the hotel the reception don't tell you but the process is Que. and pay your 1 euro per bed and 1 euro for umbrella, and then one of the staff puts the bed in the spot you choose, also once the beds Are gone there are no more. Also this definitely is not wheelchair accessible!! I have a disabled child and did not see how on earth a disabled person could get around and Enjoy this hotel. I would come back but not to this rude hotel. Also transfer time is an hours from airport, don't use the market in the hotel go to your left and there's a lovely little shop on the corner so much cheaper than the hotels shop, and go to the water park it's a great day out. Pricey but enjoyable.

author: Wolfee
title: Not much around
text: Check in was easy. There was a little bit of confusion but all was handled and sorted out without delay. The air condition for the room I was given was not working well. And it was a really hot day. Had to request for a change of room. The request was handled smoothly and swiftly. Great work. I did not select with breakfast option so cannot tell anything about that. The coffee in the cafe was really good. So that was a great plus. Close to airport link. The walk can be shortened if you cut across the condo right next to the hotel. Maybe around 700m to the local market for cheap food. But it is closed on weekends. 7 11 just at the ground floor so no complaints about that. Had an easy comfortable stay.

author: samadshaikh
title: Halal food in Prathunam and Veg food too.
text: D varee Xpress.. name is big.. xpress means fast i think so.. bt d problem is room service is disaster.. hotel is ok. Near bus stop for Prathunam.. got easily..Tuk tuk.. or taxi.. 3 to 4 kilometer from the main market for shopping better avoid if u going to shop everyday.. Look for a better hotel in d market.. like Baiyoke 1 or khurana inn or many other u got Halal food there near this area.. Called Prathunam.. Al Sana restuarant.. very gud food indian ,pakistani and thai food and . For veg food there ia lot vegeterian restuarant, South indian restuarant Before u book hotel check the area specially..

author: nipu56
title: Poor Service
text: This is below average hotel. The ;location is though ok, but has very poor connectivity to all activities. There is nothing in walking distance. MRT is the only option. The room is adequate, but very basically furnished. No storage cupboard. The TV has very poor international content. Bathroom needs upgrading. The CP fitting was loose. The window has broken frame. They had no city map. The only saving grace was the the decent front staff. Worst experience was at breakfast time. The serving dishes were taken off at closing time , unmindful of sitting guests. Instead of turning away late arrivals at breakfast time, removing dishes for already dining guests was in very bad taste. I would not recommend this hotel, if some one cares for good service.

author: ladyfitch
title: Good for stop over
text: I no longer stay in town for 1-2 day Bangkok trips; I stay on the airport train line. The hotel choices are limited. Really, they are all fine. This is about a 6 minute walk to the train. Mostly all on a sky walk, about 150 across some lights then on the footpath. Mostly smooth. Early check in was allowed. Wifi is usable but slow. Staff are friendly. Cheap to mid range restaurant on site that seems popular with locals too. Rooms are clean and spacious. Air con is strong, free water. 7-11 down stairs. 33 aud a night, I can't really rank it any lower. I have no complaints but the slightly weak wifi and lack of amenities otherwise. Staff are friendly. No credit card or bond was asked for when checking in. Very quick.

author: rossiunleashed12
title: Good budget hotel
text: Checked-in on 8th Oct 2016. The hotel is located a little far from all the touristy places such as Patpong, Khao San lane, MBK etc. But MRT station is very close by, so travelling is just a bit easier coz of it. There is a direct connectivity to the airport from this hotel via Makkasan station. It also has a 7 eleven next to it. . Check-In was quick, we had booked a triple room - the room was clean and spacious with all the basic amenities. Obviously being in a city we were not expecting any great views from the window but at least there was open space, so that was good. The hotel in general was a bit worn down. The hotel corridors had a very unpleasant smell. Big let down was that the hotel does not have a pool. Breakfast buffet offered by the hotel is just bad, there were no veg options except bread and the non veg options provided were very limited. Eggs were served stone cold. Well, there is actually nothing good to write about this. Better go out and have a breakfast or have it in the café downstairs from the menu. Overall good for max 2 nights or for a short stopover.

author: Mulkvist
title: Convenient location but...
text: This hotel is perfect place, if you are traveling from or to Suvarnabhumi airport - only 20 min. by Rail Link and 5min. walk from Makkasan trainstation. Just follow signs to Phetchaburi MRT along the skywalk over the road, take only one escalator down to MRT station, go straight ahead to EXIT 3, one escalator up, then from first street corner to the right and walk about 150m and u are there. Very friendly staff at the front desk. My room was on fifth floor facing to the Rail Link station, so there was no traffic noise at all. Room seemed to quite clean. Breakfast was very basic, some fried rice and eggs, sausages, cucumber, tomatoes, toast, orange juice, tea and coffee. Enough for me anyway. Dear hotel manager: Please call to a locksmith to adjust your door locks at once!!! The doors and locks are extremely tight, and you have to pull or push the door very heavily to get it closed. If it stays open, the electric lock is beeping like alarm clock. Some older people does not hear this beeping, and it could go on and on all the night. And then there are some idiots, who are trying close the doors by slamming them so hard, that you can hear it all over the hotell. First night I slept quite well with earplugs, but second night I couldn´t use them because of early wake-up to airport. I didn´t slept nearly at all! I would recommend this hotel to others, but only after this very inconvenient issue is solved!

author: umairahjay
title: Simple
text: The hotel is easily accessible by the airport link. It's only 10 minutes walk from Petchaburi MRT. There is 7/11 beside the hotel. If you walk further up, you'll be able to find massage parlours and food stalls. There was only one lift available for guests which was slow. Sometimes we ended up going down the stairs. The room was simple, clean and it was equipped with basic amenities except for a wardrobe but hangers were provided. The toilet was small. Besides that, I had a really hard time connecting my phone to the wifi. There is a restaurant on the ground floor. Breakfast consisted of fried rice, eggs, sausages, etc. There is also a small garden near the lobby where you can chill and take nice pictures. I love the space although we ended up being bitten by mosquitoes. The staffs were friendly and helpful with directions. The only down side was that the staffs weren't efficient in replying to my enquiries. I had to wait for a few days for a reply. Overall, I had a pleasant stay.

author: Colten1983
title: Pictures are deceiving
text: Hi stayed at the hotel and entered the room which had a very bad stale smell to it and the conditioning did not work so i complained to the girl on the front desk. The lady on the front desk was very helpful and did her utmost to rectify the issue. She transferred me to a lager room which was Ok. The aircon was not great and still had a funny smell. When I came down for breakfast they sat me down in the restaurant and gave me a menu with prices. I thought this was odd as I paid for breakfast. When I queried this with them they pointed and said you have to go upstairs for the hotel breakfast. They need to put a sign to tell customers as this is very deceiving. For breakfast well this was the worst breakfast I have ever had. The eggs were stone cold. The sausage tasted like rubber and it was very dirty. The bread was moldy which I have attached images so you can see what you get. The rooms just look nothing like the booking.com images which obliviously have been Photoshoped which is a big disappointment. The price for hotel is very cheap, but however cheap the hotel is, it should be clean. The only really good thing I can say is the staff are very friendly they just need to improve the hotel.

author: JWNYsg
title: Decent location away from mob
text: Yes, kindly update Hotel name from FX Hotel Makkasan to Hotel Link Makkasan. From the airport, you can take the ARL directly to Makkasan station and it is about a 7 minutes walk to hotel. From MRT Petchaburi station, it is about a 5 minute walk (Exit 3) Quite residential area with two condominiums nearby. Not much eateries around. Thankfully there is a 7-Eleven downstairs directly. All meals are probably a train ride away with a single stop by MRT to either Rama 9 or Sukhumvit. Room is very basic for this 7th storey hotel. Basic air conditioned, hot water (no tub), safe in room and television with minimal channels. Bed is ok. Floor is not carpeted. Wifi is available for a small fee. Very no frills, just for sleeping. Location is ideal for being in a quiet area. Travelling is easy via train or even cab. Recommended for those who just want a cheap alternative away from Central Bangkok crowd.

author: ChrisPDK
title: Hotel has CHANGED NAME
text: Please beware that the -- FX HAS CHANGED IT'S NAME -- to "HL Makkasan". Neither they, nor the booking website I used, bothered to notify me of the name change. It may cause confusion when trying to find the hotel. Essentially, this hotel is cheap, basic, but good value for money. Public transport access: Phetchaburi MRT Station... exit hotel, turn left and walk 3 minutes down the street. You cannot miss it. Cross the road (traffic lights make this easy), and enter the station. If arriving, leave the train and follow the signs to "EXIT 1" (there are three exits from the station, all clearly numbered). Once you exit the station, walk to the big cross road and cross to the right. Walk down the street for about 3 minutes (and you'll find the hotel right next to a 7-11 grocery store and fastfood Asian restaurant). There is a sidewalk/pavement the entire way, and I had no problems with two suitcases. Airport Train: Direct to/from Suvarnabumi. The station name is "Makkasan", and is connected with the previously mentioned Phetchaburi MRT Station via a sky-walkway. You do not need to cross any busy roads... there is an escalator and gently sloping walkways to/from Phetchaburi MRT Station. It's very civilised. However... if you're travelling with a large group, I noticed that the airport train was quite full upon arriving (it has two stops before it arrives). Alone I had no problem squeezing in, and the train emptied quite quickly after the next few stops, but if travelling with a large party, this might be a consideration.

author: jazpy82
title: A Basic hotel
text: stayed here for 3 nights. From 28 Oct to 30 Oct. Stayed on the 4th floor. They do have free wifi in room but their wifi doesnt seems to be very stable and you get logged out very often. If u lose your ID and password which was provided to you upon check in, you will be subjected to only free 15 min usage per day at the lobby and after which you need to pay. The ID and password were provided on a very small piece of paper so the receptionist caution us not to lose it. Room is rather new and clean but the walls are not sound proof. I could communicate with my sisters who were staying next door without raising our voices. If we 'speak to' the socket point. HAHAA. It was kinda fun for us. The negative about this hotel is that many taxi drivers do not know their way to the hotel and we have to mention the school which is near by to give them an idea where the hotel were and there is nothing much around the vicinity to see. It can be quite dark and dangerous at night. Breakfast was served at the dim sum restaurant downstairs. No buffet though. only 4 breakfast sets to choose from. there is also a 7-11 just beside the dim sum restaurant. When we requested for late check out. they were only willing to give us a 30 min grace from 12nn to 1230pm

author: IzzShariff
title: Great location
text: It has a very good location. You can take a train from Suvarnabhumi Airport, and take a stop at Makkasan about 15 minutes journey. (Makkasan -Airport Rail Link). You don't need to take a taxi since its very convenient to take a train. From Makkasan station it takes about 5-10minutes walk to FX hotel. If you are carrying heavy luggage there is a free shuttle bus from Makkasan to Petchaburi station which take about 2minutes to reach. FX hotel its just a few minutes away from the MRT Petchaburi station. FX hotel located at a very peaceful and safe area. There is a cafe at the ground floor of the hotel. There is a tour package provided in the hotel if you are interested to go to outskirt eg: Floating Market and River Kwai. Don't worry about transportation in Bangkok, you may ask the staff at the train station and they will guide you to reach your destination. Just take a train from Petchaburi station, and you can go directly to Chatuchak market - Cha tu chak Park station.(The world largest weekend market). You may ask the staff from Petchaburi station on how to go to The Grand Palace. From Petchaburi station, you may change the line at Sukhumvit (Sukhumvit line). You can take a BTS (Bangkok Sky Train) to go to Siam Paragon, Jim Thompson House and other attractions. Everybody loves to be in Bangkok. You may love it too!

author: danprsd
title: Ok for a Rest Stop
text: We had our flight around 12 AM so we had 12 hours to spare after we checked out of the Hotel we were staying at ..So since FX Makkasan was giving a 55% discount so booked on there. I booked on the Furama website and it made me enter the card details but on arriving at the Hotel they swiped the card for the same saying that it had not been charged on the website. I am not sure if I was double charged.. will come to know only when my credit card statement comes. It is a 3-4 min walk to Phetchaburi MRT .. and 6-7 min walk to Makkasan Airport Link with City Check in incase you are flying Thai.. So this is an added advantage. Rooms are clean and Ok .. not too fancy but beds are comfortable so no complains. Bathrooms are clean .. sometimes some bad smells seem to be coming..but this is just off and on. There is a 7-11 on the ground floor .. the attached Ramen place is a little too expensive and not the most amazing in terms of choice.. But apart from being close to the Airport Link this is bang in the Middle of NOWHERE... no shopping.. no food .. no nothing .. so you might want to consider this.. But for the price paid it is totally worth it.. so if you dont mind being in the middle of nowhere and willing to stay out of your room for pretty much the whole day needing to Crash only at the end of day I guess this is a Good Place

author: Chillclouds
title: Basic hotel, nothing much to offer
text: If you are travelling to BKK alone or with friends backpacking then I think it's alright to stay here. The hotel looks trendy at the lobby. So far the service is alright, quite prompt during check in. But they lack in room service, when I called to ask them to refill my tea & coffee the staff was blur and keep asking me to contact the restaurant instead. When i called the restaurant, none of them know what i was talking or asking about. So i decided to drop it. I didnt go for the breakfast at all. The breakfast is serve at the next restaurant of the hotel. The location of the hotel is near the train station but it doesnt go to the shopping mall directly. You got to change train to get to the shopping mall. There are no shops or other restaurants around. If you walk down the streets you will find a 7-11 nearby. You can take a cab to go to the shopping malls it is around 90 Baht (with no heavy jam). But do take note most of the cab driver are not familiar of the hotel location, so take a map or the hotel name card with you. Personally i think most of the taxi driver PRETEND not to know the location as they want to charge you more. Overall i should say, its not bad for a decent hotel room. If you dont mind the room floor are not carpeted and the toilet does not have a window or any ventilation. Would recommend for family trip. Happy shopping in BKK!

author: Tun418
title: Not bad
text: It was difficult to find this place. I used one of the fellow reviewer direction and found this place. It took me a while and it was raining. The reason I booked this place because all the review said it was near the Air Link and BTS. There nothing around the area. There a 7-11 about 3 minutes walk. If you walk pass 7-11 there are a few street vendors. But they charged me like restaurant price. In that alley there seem to be a few bar or club. The girl receptionist was nice. There was some confusion when I was checking out and I asked the receptionist guy a question. I asked him What time does the AirLink open. It open at 6am so I asked him to call me taxi to the airport. When the taxi came, he asked if I want to go to the airlink...??? I said no to the airport. Overall, this place wasn't that bad. You get a free welcome refreshing drinks. Room was comfortable, and big. Free two bottle of water everyday. In room safe and refrigerator.

author: jas_yeo
title: Average hotel
text: The hotel is average in general. It's clean and spacious. The staff are nice & courtesy. Definitely add points. Also, there's free wifi at the only dim sum restaurant. So it's pointless to pay for their hotel wifi if you are only going to use it for a while. However, the location is not that fantastic. Airport Link: It's about 15min walk from the airport link, which I'll say it's really convenient. I took the express line and it took me 15min to reach instead of the 1hr drive through the congested traffic jam. MRT: It's about 5min walk to the MRT station - Phechaburi (exit C). Taking train is really much more convenient but you gotta change line to major places like MBK. Chaktuchuk is on the same line though. Taxi: here's the tough part. most taxi drives do not know where the hotel is even though we showed the hotel card. we had a hard time going back via taxi. but it's near the platinum fashion mall, which is a straight road down. Overall, i would say i won't be back due to the location. There are hotel with better location and amenities.

author: be1st1
title: Will not stay there again
text: Location: 1) Next to "highway" 6 lanes - can be very noisy all day/night 2) No nearby food stalls 3) No nearby shopping center 4) No nearby shops- there are buildings next to the hotel which seems to be deserted I think its due to the highway; 5) Only one chinese restaurant next to the hotel; so you dont have any choice unless you walk across the highway then to another main road 6) 7-11 convenient store is very far down the road 7) About 7 minutes walk to MRT 9) About 10 minutes walk to Airport link - you need to walk over the train railway track to get to the Airport link (quite primitive) 10) Dont feel safe walking back to the hotel from the mrt, since the buildings along this road are deserted; not many foot path lighting Room Interior: 1) Cheap hollow door 2) Cheap paint job 3) Floor is painted- glossy white paint 4) Toilet extremely narrow - bath room door almost touch the sink basin 5) Wall facing the toilet seat is too close, so you dont have much room 6) Bed is extremely hard 7) Sheets have yellow stains/ patches 8) Limited tv channels. News/ fashion channel (in English); the rest are Thai or foreign language 9) Door lock not well installed to the door. (again Cheap Installation) 10) Corridor to the room is not air conditioned nor the lift. So you will be sweating as you are in the lift or walking towards your room. Only the lobby is air conditioned. Reception: 1) Hotels.com said Free Wireless Internet. when i got to the hotel the staff told me is free for 15 mins in the lobby area only/ one time usage per room per day.(Ridiculous). Be careful when booking with hotels.com. I posted this feedback in hotels.com review weeks ago but they failed to post my review in their review site. 2) WIFI for room is over-priced compared to other hotels I stayed in which was in a premium location then this hotel. I dont see why they are over charging their WIFI since the hotel is basically located near a highway and next to several deserted buildings.. Overall: 1) The price they charged was OK, but I will not stay there again. There are other hotels which are next to the BTS with free WIFI at the same price. The reason I chose to stay in this hotel is I thought it was quite close and easy access to the airport link, however it didnt seems so, I had to cross the railway track and its more like a mission then convenience. Secondly this hotel is part of FURAMA chain hotels so I assumed the quality of the hotel should be quite good. however this is not the case!!! The hotel is refurbished in a very cheap way,/ ie: patch up paint job / fixings. 2) Will not stay there again- or any Furama chain hotels . 3) There are better hotels out there at a similar price with Free WIFI and next to BTS station; you can still catch the airport link using the BTS. 4) Cautious when booking with hotels.com , I was tricked by their misleading advertisement about the WIFI

author: waj50
title: Ideal for a short break
text: Had a 2 night break here and arrived early. Booking in was straight forward and very quick. Our room was 11 and had a four poster bed! One window looked over the beer garden and the other over the main street. The room was very light, clean and airy. One thing that might annoy people (but didn't bother me) the sign for the Pub was outside our window and the light didn't go off until 12.00pm. So if you hit the sack early the room is not completely dark. There is a shower attached to the taps in the bath for hair washing purposes but not a stand up shower. The bath was massive and took some filling!! Tea/coffee facilities are available, and the room has a hair dryer. The bed was really comfy. We had an evening meal both nights and the selection was also very good. The waitresses were very polite and good at their job. There was a good selection of drinks at the bar, including real ales. One thing that i didn't agree with was that dogs are allowed to sit by the tables in the restaurant. In my opinion if you have a dog with you then you should eat outside. Breakfast choice was also good with cereals, fresh fruit and the full English on the menu. The waitress dealing with it was also very good. All in all we would definitely stay again, always a good recommendation.

author: hannahb928
title: Lovely weekend stay
text: This is the pub that my fiance grew up going to, as a previous resident of the village. We booked our room for the weekend so that we could catch up with old friends. From the start, we had made a mistake with our online booking. It turns out we had only selected one person to stay, rather than a couple. The guy who checked us in was more than accommodating with our error and made us feel very welcome indeed. He even congratulated us on our recent engagement. The room itself, although a little compact (it had bunk beds in addition to the double bed which meant space was tight), was very clean and bright, as was the bathroom. In terms of any negatives, I think the tea tray could have been better stocked (although the biscuits were yum!) in terms of variety of tea, and fresh milk would have been much better. On the wall directly opposite the bed was a large mirror, which meant that when you're in bed/watching TV etc, you can see your own reflection. We found that a little uncomfortable, and actually took the mirror down for most of our stay. Lastly, as it was a very hot weekend in July, the room did get rather warm. It would be lovely to have had a fan, but then we may have been offered one if we had asked at reception. Something to ask for next time though! The breakfast was a buffet style, which is actually very good. I've been to many places where a buffet style breakfast results in a lack of quality but this definitely was not the case here. It was all delicious. Overall, a great stay and we're bound to be back again and again when we come to visit our friends in the village.

author: SteveB2636
title: Evening meal
text: Whilst quite a nice looking place, the meal itself was very disappointing. I ordered the steak and Guinness pie with a "rich red wine gravy'. Well it was clearly Gravy granules. The pie had too much pastry and was under cooked. The filling was sparse and dry. I was bizarrely asked if I wanted vegetables but it was part of the menu description; when they arrived there was less veg compared to my child's portion. I ate it, as I was hungry and it was edible albeit completely sub standard. At £12.50, I expected considerably better. When we complained about the third lot of cold mash potato, it was received with a flighty attitude and "No one else complains... " type response. I fed all my views on the meal back to the manager and there was no apology just a very defensive and unfriendly response. Then she walked off. When my brother complained a little later , who ordered the same, and asked what they were doing about it, she begrudgingly took off one meal. The rest of the food people had a mixed response. The onion rings were greasy and my wife's salmon was ok but over priced. As they knew I was a tourist, they clearly they couldn't care less if we returned or not. Awful. Ruined the last night of our holiday.

author: EmmaLcoles
title: Ok food, poor staff!!
text: Visited 16/04/17, Party of 11 travelling from Bristol so booked a table through email. Turnt up, no booking! Staff very unwelcoming and didn't want to seat us but managed to squeeze us in the very back table out the way even thought lots of tables were free the whole time. Rushed us to get drinks and food. Food arrived not HOT but slightly warm. For a 'posh thinking' restaurant and paying their high prices we would have expected at least warm food. We asked for sauces and a spoon which was a 'problem' everything we asked for came with a sigh from the girl serving us. Then they didn't take our plates for over half an hour after finishing. We asked twice to order deserts. Waited 20 minute to be ignored still. So we then decided against it and asked for our bill. Bill came, 2 different girls we asked for the card machine from. Then we ended up having to go to the bar to get someone else so we could pay and leave. As we were leaving the girls who served us were hiding pretending to clean a table that was laid and pointing at us. Disgusting service from the staff!!! Anyone who likes a bit of friendliness with their meal please do not go here! Treated us terrible when all of us were polite and easy going!

author: chrisdumbleton
title: Charming & Comfortable
text: We booked as a last minute trip and had no prior experience so we're a little wary particularly being part of a public house. We were so relieved to find that it was a professional, smart, modern, comfortable and above all a friendly place to stay. The food in the restaurant was excellent and the breakfast was freshly prepared. The staff were attentive and genuinely polite. The bedroom was clean and modern. The pub element is inviting and populated by a mix of local people and holiday makers. There is ample free parking. Pets are welcome to stay (and permitted in the bar). The restaurant area is naturally off limits to dogs. Otterton is a quintessential Devon village with interesting church and thatched cottages. A walk long the scenic river is a must (a longer walk along its path will take you to Budleigh Salterton on the coast). The village is a great place to explore from. Only downside was poor broadband but this may be more a feature of the area rather than the hotel (which offers connection for free). We would definitely return. thumbs up.

author: zacheyben
title: Lovely place
text: Easy to find on the main road through the traditional, widely thatched village. On arrival, made to feel welcome and able to check in early. The room was spacious and, being the old hayloft, still had the roof beams etc. Looked out onto the garden area. Small but adequate ensuite. Plenty of yea and coffee available plus a jar of home made shortbread. Plenty of storage for clothes etc. Breakfast was made to order with plenty of choices from pancakes to kippers to full English and others in between. Evening and lunchtime menu has a good choice and the servings are plentiful. The prices are about normal for good pub food. All the food was excellent. Dogs are welcome to stay and are welcome in the pub if well behaved - they even have their own menu! Made the place even more homely. The pub is also the village local and it is good to be able to mix in with the local life if you choose to. I honestly cannot think of any negatives to the Kings Arms.

author: Jade0077
title: Unbelievable!
text: We go to The Mill in Otterton on a regular basis, but we've never been to The Kings Arms Freehouse in Otterton. Perhaps we caught the bar staff at The Kings Arms on an off day & they were fed up with all the customers who'd been in during the day because of the Open Gardens in Otterton. We arrived not long after 5pm & The Kings Arms was pretty empty inside, apart from a few men propping up the end of the bar watching tennis on the pubs wide screen television. We got our drinks & some snacks & found a comfortable seat around the corner where there are a collection of faded leather sofas. The window was open behind where we sat & there were quite a few flies flying around & sitting on the other sofa. We were comfortably watching the tennis on the pub's television, when one of the men propping up the bar got up from his bar stool & turned the television off, during the presentation ceremony of the tennis, without looking at us, or asking us if we were still watching it. WE COULDN'T BELIEVE IT! WERE WE INVISIBLE? I got up & turned the TV back on, & not long afterwards one of the barmaids used the remote control from behind the bar & turned the tennis off, & a music station came on. Again, without looking at us, or asking us. WE MUST HAVE BEEN INVISIBLE! Is The Kings Arms running a "LOCALS ONLY" set up on Sunday afternoons, where other customers are invisible? We couldn't believe how RUDE & INCONSIDERATE those 2 individuals were & I thought there would be no way I would ever want to stay there. I wonder if the landlord is aware of how their customers are treated? There is NO WAY WE'LL EVER GO BACK to The Kings Arms in Otterton, let alone recommend it to anyone. We've never been treated so rudely anywhere else we've ever been, & from reading the other recent comments here on the two Trip Advisor pages for The Kings Arms in Otterton it appears to be a very disorganised business with staff who don't seem to care about their customers.

author: felicia333
title: A little witchcraft saved the day!
text: Back to the Kings Arms, for us a home from home. Small, but very comfortable and clean room, as usual. Small maintenance problems resolved immediately. Day two's early breakfast was better than day one which was a buffet and rather tired of waiting for us late-birds.The evening meals are always good but a slight oversight in our order saved the day for us on day two, and proved extremely amusing. After a good breakfast, and rather late and large lunch in Exmouth, we were rather too over-fed for the two courses we had ordered. The Fish Medley sharing platter was absolutely delicious, as are all the fish dishes here, but also quite substantial! Whilst we waited for out mains, I kept saying that I wish we could cancel the order as I really couldn't do justice to any more food; my idea of an evening meal is a prawn salad! After about half an hour, a lovely young waiter rushed up, red in the face, to apologise that our orders had been missed and chef was just getting them under way! No! No! We cried! Run back and tell him to stop, another course would spoil the evening! Everyone was so apologetic, but we were so pleased. My husband ended up asking me, "How did you manage that? You must be a witch!" Such lovely people, such good food, such a lovely village in a beautiful County. Hopefully we will be back next year! (That is if they accommodate witches!)

author: Yummytwinmum
title: Excellent service, excellent food, & best nights sleep EVER!!
text: I recently stayed at The Kings Arms in Otterton with my 3 (very young) children for a night last weekend, after watching The Exeter Chiefs play Worcester in Sandy Bay (shame about the result at the game though). The Kings Arms were accommodating us for a night after we had spent an amazing week at Ladram Bay Holiday Park, approx. 2 minutes up the road. I have to say we were extremely impressed, and content, with everything about this lovely, "boutique-like" (sorry can't find another word that fits!) village pub/inn. The Service we received was absolutely spot on, no need was ever too big, no dietary issues (my 6 year old is lactose intolerant and also has an allergy to dust....things we didnt have any problems with due to the clinically clean rooms) the food is beyond anything you ever expect in a local pub. Actually calling The Kings Arms, a "local" pub, doesn't befit the character or atmosphere of this buzzing, well run, family set-up. The Landlord and Lady seem to understand and appreciate what their guests need, and all their staff were accommodating in every aspect. My 3 youngsters loved our family room which comprised of a bunk bed, and large king size bed for myself and my 3 year old. I have to admit, this was one of the best nights sleep ive had in a loooong time. The village falls very quiet at last orders and the peace and serenity of this gorgeous village Otterton, has a wonderful gem of a pub for locals, as well as visitors, to attend whenever one needs a decent, hearty, well cooked meal. I have eaten in this establishment on numerous occasions over the years, but never stayed there until last weekend. Everything from the modern décor, to the Chefs menu and exceptionally tidy, modern, "Cotswold-like" feel of the bedrooms, made this stay a joy. Having travelled to hundrereds of places over the last 15 years, and stayed in some incredible boutique hotels, as well as the famous well-known high enders.....The Kings Arms, is definitely one of those secret little cheeky hideaways, you would never have known about. I had THE MOST INCREDIBLE dinner on that particular evening (stunning beef from a company called Greendale....I actually bought some, as well as bacon and sausages (!) from the local Farm Shop that supplies it, to bring home to London). Having read some reviews below, I'm quite surprised at anyone giving this charming, genuinely well run, village pub any score less than a 4 or 5 star. It serves all your needs, and the service is BEYOND what one expects. The Landlords have ensured their customers are well looked after, and this is evident in the entire places atmosphere downstair in the main bar and restaurant area. I found the level of work and service that goes into running somewhere like the Kings Arms to be on a par with the 5* places I've stayed in, in South East Asia. Definitely worth visiting, even just for a meal.

author: hsmel
title: Just not that good :-(
text: Have now eaten here twice when staying down at Bicton Arena during the showjumping weekends. Just a tad disappointed as far as value for money goes and quality of food. Excellent hosts but waiting staff had difficulties with English (same staff both times and not sure English had improved much!!) Had the thermidor dish myself the first time but found it overwhelmingly cheesy and coudnt even taste the fish . . . scallops are so delicate the sauce needs to be too but it may as well have been cauliflower cheese as the cheese was all I could taste sadly. The steaks that the others in the party had were good but expensive. The second time round I opted for a different dish - I thought I would try 'pie of the week' along with another member of our party. This was actually more disappointing than the thermidor . . pie crust, more pie crust and more pie crust with a morsel of chicken and tarragon sauce in the centre. Expensive too. The others had fish and chips - both of us wished we had gone with that choice too. The bill came to around £100 which for four of us, no starters just mains and drinks was expensive. We all discussed it on the way back to Bicton and decided it was 'just not that good'

author: IanA635
title: Relaxed and Comfortable
text: My wife and I with our two dogs had a very enjoyable stay here in January. Our room was clean and comfortable and spacious enough for our two dogs to sleep on their own beds on the floor. (well done to the cleaners who hoovered up every dog hair each morning, thank you) The bar has a very nice doubled sided log burner and comfy lounge furniture either side of it to relax in and read the papers, have a coffee, pint etc. The Kings Arms is well patronised by locals and visitors from further afield and as such there is always a nice atmosphere. We had 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners, all of which, for us both, were very nicely presented and extremely tasty. Our dogs, who were allowed to dine with us in a separate area had a very nice doggie dinner each evening at only £2 per bowl. (Liver, potatoes and gravy was their favourite) I should point out that there is ample space for dining and it is easy to accommodate you should you wish to be distanced from pets whilst eating. Our hosts and their staff were very friendly and we were made to feel very welcome, nothing was too much trouble. I take with a pinch of salt the reviews left by others who moan here instead of asking at the time for a solution to the problem they might be having. One morning, the radio was too loud at breakfast as we were sat directly under the speaker. I asked for the radio to be turned down which was done immediately and an apology was offered. Simple!! The Kings Arms is in a lovely village and the location offers lovely walks along the coast as well as up and down the River Otter. The "Common" is only a short drive away and is another great location if you need to have plenty of space to let your dog (s) run freely. Our two really enjoyed their stay and their all day walkies. We had a really relaxing stay, good company, good accommodation, lovely food, ale and wine.
