And apparently other guests may have felt the same, as there was almost standing room only in the breakfast area. The wait time for an omelette was 40 minutes, which was a bit ridiculous, but an indicator of how popular their breakfast is with guests. The room and bathroom are immaculate. This is an extended stay property, so there is a fridge/microwave/stove in the room as well. We took full advantage of our stay and utilized the gym (which is alright) and the pool. Great stay. I will be seeking other Hyatt Houses or Hyatt properties in the future while traveling.

author: Tessfromoregon
title: Ideal
text: Although this hotel is meant for longer stays, I was just an overnight guest. It was great! The staff was friendly and helpful. For example, there was no lotion in the room. When I went to purchase some at the front desk, they told me it rarely gets used I. The rooms, so they don't put it out. The young guy handed me some lotion and asked if that was ok. Uh. Yes. Free lotion. The bar is small but nice. I was pleasantly surprised. I was in the area for medical school interviews. My requirement were cheap, clean and safe. It was impeccable clean, the least expensive in the area on the site I visited and beautifully updated. Bonus, it was close to a mall so I could get my clothes pressed.

author: CBMommy
title: Exceeded expectations
text: We were in town for a high school reunion and booked because of the great reviews. We got a good rate thru hotels.com ($126 total, prepaid for a Saturday night). The room was very big - L shaped with a kitchen complete with stovetop, dishwasher, sink and fridge as well as pots, pans, plates, glasses, utensils and even sharp knives. We had no plans to use any of it, but I was impressed how well kept it was and the attention to detail. Adjacent to the kitchen is a table with chair and then a couch with coffee table. Plenty of room to walk - not cramped at all. Turn the corner to a king bed surrounded by windows which had drapes that, when drawn, totally blocked the light. Next to the bed area is a sink with mirror and next to that a bathroom with a very large shower. The decor in the bathroom was sparse, but it was the only reminder that this is a well-priced hotel, not a luxury resort. Breakfast is included and is a full buffet (hot and cold food) that you'd definitely be charged for at any other hotel. The lobby was modern and functional. Breakfast had plenty of seating. Bar closes at 10 but there's are several restaurants just steps away. Basically someone thought about what makes hotel stays truly convenient and did that when designing Hyatt house. No unnecessary frills, just the necessary ones.

author: coloradocarey
title: Good rooms but service is lacking
text: We came on a Saturday for a long shopping day and just to have a break. We arrived early, noon, room wasn't ready and were told to come back at 3. No surprise and not guaranteed so we just headed over to KOP to shop and grab some food and shopping. Left the wife shopping and returned with kids ( they were wanting to get into the pool) at 3. Apparently we weren't the only ones told to come back at three, line was nearly out the door. Okay after waiting my turn for 15 minutes, got up to check in, room not ready. Being the trooper with the kids I said fine, we'll just go over here and shoot some pool in the lounge area. While discussing this I noticed a printed piece of paper stating the hotels policy of no disturbance, extra guests will be evicted, no noise after 10, etc. with a line to sign accepting these rules. I've never seen a printed paper with acknowledgement of such rules at any Hyatt brand or honestly at most brands before, kind of felt like a throwback to a 70s cheap motel notice ( as seen on TV)! Now for me it was no issue, not the rowdy type, but it made me wonder what type of place we were staying that required additional verification of understanding the rules that you had to SIGN with your room number as part of checking in. So we go to shoot pool and wait for the room to get ready, finally after going back up to remind them they come over and the room is ready, probably around five. Again, I'm trying to chill with the kids, wife is still shopping, she is planning on calling for the shuttle to come get her so I can take the kids to the pool and swim. Right before heading down she calls me, she's called the hotel to ask for the shuttle and was told they have no one to drive it, best they can do is call her a cab. I wished had let them but she didn't so I go down and drive over to get her at KOP. Next morning, when we go to take showers, we realize, they had not left any bath towels, just little hand towels....they quickly brought them up when we called and said they had run behind on laundry the day before. Not impressed, room was nice though. Really disappointing shopping escape for a weekend.

author: WVU2014
title: Good Management
text: This hotel is close to the mall. We walked over. I believe they have a shuttle. Breakfast was good but the omelette line was veryyyyy slow on Sunday morning. We did run into some hiccups while we were there, but management was very helpful and involved in solving the issue.... The front desk people, not so much (one lady was kind of rude actually.) Once we spoke with management, I felt a lot better and they took action to fix the issue immediately and followed up with us while we were there. They even left a small basket with water and snacks in our room. Although, I haven't completely gotten an answer, they did their best. The negative (the rude front desk clerk) was when we asked to purchase a bottle of wine to take to our room since the bar was closed. We were simply told no, abruptly. No explainations. Later, management explained the liquor laws in PA and why they couldn't have sold it to us. Overall, rooms were above average. Staff, average. Management, wonderful! The pool and bar closed earlier than I would have liked. Once we were home from the mall, they were closed. We didn't get to use either. I would recommend this hotel for the convenience, the management, and a hot breakfast!

author: str8foward
title: Loved it!
text: We stayed for 2 nights during Labor day Weekend. This hotel was wonderful! Nice, modern, new, clean facilities. The kitchen comes equip with everything you would need. The shower was amazing. The beds are a little too soft, but that's a minor issue. Free hotel parking, and wifi. Breakfast was an added delight. They continuously keep everything stocked so you can eat to your hearts delight. Wish there was more seating for breakfast but again minor issue. Hotel is right by the mall, great places to eat, and a casino. It is maybe a 20 minute drive to Philadelphia, but worth it for the quality facilities. I honestly have nothing negative to say about this hotel. I would highly recommend it. I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely return!

author: lagflag
title: Would give it five stars if..
text: The room is good, the staff is very nice. The hot breakfast is great and omelet is delicious. The pool is good, and probably you will be alone with your family as it never gets crowded even in the weekend.. all is good except.... 1 thing happened that made me disgusted. while I was at the pool I noticed a red fresh fluid near the edge of the jacuzzi. At first I wasn't sure if it is really blood, but then I decided to look closer and around the area and to my surprise I found also a used bandage "see the photos"! I said, well, this may be something that just happened and the staff is not aware of. I went to the front desk lady and informed her. At the next noon, I checked, and found it is still there! nothing has been cleaned although it was over 24 hours since I notified the staff! No body reacted, no body cared!! and that is when I decided to go back to my room and grab my camera and take some shots. This could be really dangerous and contagious specially for kids and people with poor immunity! what are they were waiting for to get it cleaned? If it were cleaner or at least if the staff cared and cleaned that, I would give it 5 stars. I am still giving it 3 stars as other areas were very clean. But human blood on the floor with a used bandage, is something that can't be forgivable!

author: CatC192
title: Thank you for great service & a great experience!
text: I stayed here for one Saturday night, so I could attend a concert in Camden, NJ. It was a quick 25 minute drive to Camden, and definitely worth the stay. Check in was quick & easy, very friendly front desk staff. My room was on the first floor, very clean, quiet & spacious! I had a full kitchen, fridge, stove, sink, dishwasher & microwave. A little sitting area, comfy bed, and up-to-date bathroom! It was like a little studio. So worth the money! I reserved the room through my company's discount site, I paid about $100 for one night with tax. The motel 6 down the road would've cost the same with less amenities. They had a full breakfast spread which was included! I loved the custom made omelets, everything was delicious & vegetarian friendly! Also, the hotel is pet friendly, I didn't bring my dog, but would have. I would absolutely recommend to others & stay again in the future. Thank you for great service & a great experience!

author: k99js06
title: Not as great as I had hoped
text: Stayed here with my mom and 8 month old son for one night as part of a short getaway to the area to shop, get out of dodge, etc. Overall, this place was fine. Newish, clean, easy free wi-fi, free breakfast, and so on. A couple of things to point out, though: (1) The "Studio" rooms are in fact studios; there are not two separate rooms, despite the description of a "separate living space" and a photo on that page of what I now know to be one of the Suites. Traveling with a baby, we were hoping for a separate room so that we could stay up after baby went to sleep. We mentioned this to the front desk, and after some arm twisting, they did accommodate us in a handicap-accessible Suite (the only one not booked the night we were there). (2) I also asked for a crib when I made my online reservation, and there was no acknowledgment of that when we checked in or crib in our room. We ultimately ended up brining our own sleeper, so didn't bother to ask for the crib, but if you offer that as part of the reservations process, it's disappointing that they don't have it ready for you when you arrive or at least acknowledge the request. (3) Finally, this is NOT a pet-free hotel, despite the language on the website. There were two loudly barking dogs staying across the hall from us, and they barked quite obnoxiously for much of the evening. We called the front desk, but they weren't able to do much as the owners had stepped out. It's unclear why dogs were allowed. We saw the dogs with their owners the next morning, and these were not service animals (and they were loud and feisty then). I love dogs and have dogs, but if the website says pet-free, the hotel should be pet-free. Two large barking dogs are not ideal elevator buddies for an 8 month old. So overall, this place was fine, but I wasn't nearly as impressed as the other recent reviewers, so just wanted to point that out.

author: TravelM349
title: Saturday Night Stay
text: This was a one night stay for business. The room was large and comfortable. We stayed on the second floor overlooking the parking lot. Our room was not far from the elevators, which is always a good thing! The staff was extremely pleasant and helpful. We ate breakfast Sunday morning near the lobby. They serve eggs, sausage, potatoes, muffins, oatmeal and cereal. Coffee is also available and the to go containers are right there if you need them. Overall, this was a good stay. My only complaint was some long pieces of black hair found in the shower. I don't think the shower was cleaned well. I felt like it was a college dorm. Otherwise, an ok visit. The girl who works the breakfast area (didn't catch her name...sorry!) but it was on Sunday, 4/6, was incredibly sweet and cheerful. She is an asset to the Hyatt House!

author: sacredphi
title: Satisfying experience
text: The bed was comfortable, and I thought the room had a nice feel being inside. My partner didn't like the layout very much, but I thought it was okay. Our living area was right in front of the bed, and the TV could be rotated towards the sofa or bed. It was nice to have that versatility, even though the TV was not directly in front of the sofa. The kitchen was very nice to have. Nothing in the fridge, but the hotel has a good selection of drinks and snacks to purchase at the front desk at fair prices for a hotel. Doing laundry in the self-service laundry room was more affordable than doing laundry in my apartment building. There is no room service, but you can get food at the restaurant. I got dinner at the restaurant, which was okay. Staying there on a weekday, I didn't get breakfast, which ended at 9am. Our room was facing the highway. I could hear traffic from the room. Not very desirable, but it wasn't that bad. I wonder if double paned windows would have eliminated the noise. Nice shower.

author: Sonyatanise
title: Wonderful customer service......Sandra at the front desk is wonderful!!!
text: My Husband is from Philly & we stay at this hotel often. It's a wonderful lady by the name of Sandra at the front desk. Sandra is a pure delight! She greets you with a huge smile & will accommodate you with whatever you need & if it's a problem, she will make sure the problem is taken care of. She has a great memory. I have odd requests & she took care of them. The next time we stayed there, she made sure I had everything I needed. I think the Hyatt should promote Sandra & send her to different locations to train people. Her customer service skills are excellent!!! We come to Philly a couple times a year & I look forward to her greeting us at the front desk & I get a little disappointed when she's not working. I had a problem with the room & this young lady was not pleasant at all. The next day, Sandra was working & she made the situation right! We use to stay downtown Philly a lot, but came across this hotel & loved it! I recommend this hotel. Praying for a promotion for Sandra!

author: TamaraM378
title: It lives up to the positive reviewa
text: We chose this hotel for its proximity to Philly -not too far but far enough out of the hustle--and because of reviews on tripadvisor. We always try and get an indoor pool for the kids and a suite for some extra space. So we booked a 1 BR suite and we were impressed. King bed was super comfy , the pullout sofa was perfect for the kids and lots of closet space - a big + for me. Clean modern and equipped with a nearly full kitchen makes this a definite keeper. It is located right In the mall complex, next to Joe's crab shack -very good-and just of the turnpike. I want to come back and stay longer and shop! Very cool area. We had no issue with highway noise. And the free breakfast buffet is just so good. So much variety made it perfect for all of us. Nitpicking: had to call several times to get coffee for the in -room coffee maker. Had no toiletpaper in room when we checked in but they brought right away. All in all, this is a super hotel with free parking and great rates. Win.

author: cabolina
title: High Expectations-Not Quite Met
text: I will preface this review by saying that this Hyatt House was by no means bad...I would certainly stay here again, and my rating is probably closer to a "very good" that "average". However, I believe my opinion of this property was skewed by the overwhelmingly positive feedback seen in reviews on this and other websites, so I had extraordinarily high hopes for this hotel prior to my visit. As noted in other reviews, the decor of this hotel was bright, fresh and crisp. Loved the high ceilings and large windows in the rooms. Noise was not a problem for me but our room faced the mall and not the freeway. At first glance the room seemed clean. There was some wear and tear noted to the coffee table/ottoman, but not an entirely big deal. What bothered me the most were the multiple hairs I found on the floor of the shower stall. I can't help but lose confidence that the room is truly clean after seeing this. To make matters worse, it seemed the shower doors weren't sealed appropriately- when I got out of the shower the bathroom floor was practically flooded. The microwave and fridge were ultra-convenient, and all the amenities were provided to run the dishwasher and keep the "kitchen" clean. Breakfast in the morning was very good-the omelet station especially. They also offered Tazo tea, which is one of my favorites. The location of this hotel is ideal, and the staff was friendly and accommodating. While this was not the best experience I've had at a hotel, it was a good experience overall and I believe it is one of the better hotels in KOP (I've stayed at 3 other properties in the area).

author: davido882
title: Not Bad....for the price
text: We stayed three nights May 31 to June 3/13. Bought on Expedia less than a week before, paid $104/night...stayed out here because the cost of hotels & parking for a decent hotel in the the core of Philly is just stupid...Negative- if you want to go into the core you have to fight the Schuylkill Express Way, both ways. Hyatt House is across the street from the King of Prussia Mall, 5 major dept stores & everything around it. Literally walking distance. First scare- at the front desk as I checked in, the front desk clerk was having a phone discussion with a guest complaining how her bed sheets were dirty & not changed since a previous guest- not a great intro for either of us. Guess what was the first thing I checked when we went into our room? Our sheets were clean & fresh. Room was great, king-sized bed, kitchenette complete with apartment sized fridge, microwave, dishwasher & glass two burner hot-plate, big screen TV, coffee maker, plates , pots & cutlery. Bath did not have a tub ,but had a super-sized European style shower with variable spray. Second scare- our room #300, over looked the highway. If you keep your windows,closed truthfully you will not hear a sound. Even number rooms are on the highway, odd numbered rooms are facing the parking lot. Free-hot breakfast, eggs,bacon, french toast, custom omelettes, fruit, yogurt, cereal & the ubiquitous American sweet rolls as well as USA Today & the WSJ. Negatives - Housekeeping-they did not replace my coffee packages on day#2, did when requested to. Issues with dirty linen of other guest. All-in-all, great value my score an 8 out of 10 PS Don't waste your money next door at Joe's Crab Shack- see my review

author: BPK52
title: Beyond all expectations!
text: Recently I planned a shopping weekend with my sister from New Jersey. I am a local but sometimes it is just nice to get away and focus on the fun things in life….shopping….good food….shopping….shopping! This hotel is within walking distance of the King of Prussia Mall, a quick ten minute drive to the QVC Outlet and a twenty five minute drive to the Philadelphia Premier Outlets! As soon as you enter the lobby you are greeted by a super gracious host and a warm fire place! Yes, the fire was roaring on this rainy and cold April Friday in the Northeast! The lobby is gorgeous! It has a nice intimacy not often found in new construction. The building is merely fourteen months young! Everything has a sleek European feel to it. The rooms are amazing! Our room was a two queen suite with enough room to host an in-room reception! The kitchen area was nicely equipped with even stemware for our wine! The rooms were quiet and serene. The linens were soft with pillows aplenty! The next morning we enjoyed the complimentary breakfast….no freezer burned waffles here….an omelet station and hot potatoes, bacon and sausages, too! There was fresh fruit and a nice assortment of breads and pastries, juice and Starbucks coffee! I live just ten minutes away from this lovely oasis and you can be sure I will be treating all my out of town guests to a stay at this lovely, fresh and spotless new kid on the block!

author: kdkjs
title: Very nice hotel perfect for mini-trip
text: This hotel is really nice, and literally across the street from the King of Prussia Mall. The pictures don't do it justice. They should get a new photographer. It is tasteful, well-furnished and modern. Like your perfect little studio apartment. You drive up and expect a lot less, but when you enter it is like an urban hotel reveals itself. Fully stocked kitchen, coffee. The whole place is well-designed and works together. The bed is super comfortable. The staff is very nice, the pool and area is well-kept and very clean. I followed other's advice here, and asked for a higher room on the side away from the highway, and was not disappointed. King of Prussia was a mini trip for me and my daughter, and I highly suggest it. After a 2 hour drive and at least 5 hours of mall shopping the last thing you want to do is drive home. This place was perfect. It will not disappoint.

author: my3boys00
title: The place you must stay at when visiting Philly!
text: What an amazing find this hotel was for us. We were in Philly for a family event and so there was a block of rooms set up at another hotel. When we started comparing that hotel to others we came upon the Hyatt house. What a find! First of all, the hotel itself was newly renovated and looks like it was just built. Every detail of the hotel is clean and modern and interesting in terms of decor. The rooms are plenty big and very clean. The beds were soft but not too soft and the tub and sink looked brand new. The staff could not have been more welcoming from the moment we walked in and helpful throughout our stay. We liked this hotel for location, it's next to the mall and tons of restaurants but still so close to Philly. They have free wifi and free parking which made a huge difference in our decision making. They offer a free breakfast as well. Breakfast was pretty good but This was the only time I had a complaint. There is one person at the omelette station and at times I had to wait in line 30 minutes. However, the food was better than most free breakfasts and the staff there was also great. We will certainly stay here the next time we are in the Philadelphia area and you should too!

author: Eric78London
title: Hyatt house King of Prussia (formerly Hotel Sierra King of Prussia)
text: This is a fabulous new hotel on the perimeter road around the huge King of Prussia shopping mall. We only stayed one night, having arrived at Philadelphia airport at around 8.30pm (about a 45 minute drive), but if my husband could have stood anymore shopping, we would have easily stayed more as it was so comfortable. The rooms were great and very spacious – all mod cons and lovely bathroom. Big TV, comfortable beds, good storage space etc – it was all wonderful. The staff were also extremely friendly and helpful and the following morning took us across to the mall in the hotel shuttle bus. We didn’t have to wait for a timed bus, they just took us when we were ready to go and came and collected us from the mall as soon as we called later in the afternoon. We had booked a special “mall package” with the hotel and not only was the room slightly cheaper, but we also got a $25 voucher to spend in the mall which was great. When we arrived at the hotel late in the evening straight off our flight, we were keen to have a drink at the bar and have a bar snack. From memory, I think the bar closed at 10pm, but even though we raced down about 9.55pm, they were still happy to serve us - although we did have to produce ID to prove our age (let’s just say we are well passed 21!) and whilst it might have been flattering, it was actually a pain to go back up to the room to get our passports. However, having done that, we did get served drinks and had some very nice bar snacks that were hot and tasty. Breakfast the next morning was buffet style. Not huge, but a perfectly reasonable choice of cereals, great fresh fruit, yogurts, breads etc and a hot cooked breakfast option. We didn’t leave hungry! The King of Prussia mall is literally a couple of minutes away in the shuttle bus and probably a 5-6 minute walk, if you feel energetic. The mall is huge and had all the shops we wanted and more! After 5 hours we had just about had enough, but if you are a really serious shopper, then you could probably spend all weekend there and still not have time to go into every shop!!

author: Jcb264
title: Excellent service and highly recommend.
text: I had an event at the Expo center in Oaks not far from here. There was a large group of us so we got an excellent rate for the overnight stay. They upgraded my room to a suite since there was 3 of us. Room was huge. Very clean and quiet for being so close to mall. The front desk was so accommodating. They offer a shuttle to anywhere in a 3 miles radius which was wonderful. They shuttled us to Cheesecake Factory which was a 4 min drive but driving through the mall can be confusing so I was great to be shuttled there. We waited less than 10 min for the return shuttle so this was very convenient. This service alone was worth the stay. The provided us what we needed with speed and the beds were VERY comfortable. Loved the soft pillows. Don't be discouraged from staying here of the location in the mall. It is quiet, clean and convenient. Excellent stay.

author: OkomfoAdwoa
title: Excellent Stay!
text: This was my first stay at this Hyatt and I will no doubt stay again in the future. The entire hotel is immaculate and clean. My room was awesome! I had a full kitchen and plenty of room. The staff is friendly and the mall is a VERY short drive away...basically across the street. I caught the complimentary shuttle and found some amazing after-Christmas sales! I had a room that faced the highway, but I heard absolutely no highway noise. I did partake in the omelets from the omelet station both mornings, and I do agree with the reviews stating that the line gets a bit long...however; it is well worth the wait. The bed was a tad firm and I did wake up with a backache, but the bed would most likely be comfortable for most. The shower was awesome, but do be aware that the only rooms with bathtubs are the Master Suite (which I really wanted, but the rooms were completely booked) and the Double Queen (which doesn’t have the kitchen I wanted). There was a bit of an issue with the TV reception for local channels, but maintenance came and fixed it for me. There was still some interruption in the local channels, but it was tolerable. I came here for some R&R away from the hubby and kids, but next time I come, I will be bringing the family. There is no other hotel that I would even consider staying in when in King of Prussia. Next time I’m booking the Master Suite!

author: Niccolonia
title: Exactly what I want from a perfect hotel!
text: Changed my existing reservation at the Doubletree on short notice because I prefer newer hotels and got curious when reading all the enthusiastic reviews on Trip advisors current number 1. I wasn't disappointed at all and found a great weekend-rate on their website. When making the reservation I had mentioned that I would arrive early and also asked for a room on a higher floor. My wishes were met but when I entered the room I noticed that the windows were facing the highway. It wasn't that bad but nevertheless I called the front desk and asked if they could move me to the other side. My wish was granted in a heartbeat. The room itself was wonderful and equipped with everything you could ask for. I especially liked the full kitchenette with flatware and even wine glasses, the comfortable bed and the big walk in shower. Breakfast is free and of great quality, omelette station and Starbucks coffee included. They even serviced the tables and took away used flatware while asking for additional wishes. The location practically within the mall area is unbeatable and they offer a free shuttle if you want to keep your car in the parking lot. Parking is free and there were lots of spaces. It was my first stay at a Hyatt House but I enjoyed it as much that I immediately changed my existing reservation for D.C. and booked a Hyatt House there as well. Will always look for Hyatt Houses during my future travels now, that’s for sure!

author: WilliamD174
title: Rates for the same rooms change by the hour.
text: I stayed in this hotel in early December this year 2012. I booked my reservation on Sunday evening 2 days before my stay. I was told that I was being given the lowest rate the hotel had for a room $269.00 per nite. I arrived on Tuesday to attend a company seminar. Upon arrival I asked again if the hotel had a less expensive room available, and I was told no again. I attended meeting and I was told by a fellow attendee, that he and a co worker had booked a suite that afternoon at the hotel for $159.00 for the same nite as I did. Same room, same day and $110.00 difference in price. I asked the front desk about the difference in the price, I requested the hotel simply credit me the $110.00. First the clerk told me that it was impossible, when I told him the other guests name, he then told me it was a much smaller room. Both of these things were not true. He told me that the hotel could do nothing. When I arrived back home, I received one of these totally bogus surveys that everyone sends. I explained my experience and i was sent a computer generated response explaining how sorry the hotel was and offering me a $25.00 gift card. I responded to the hotel manager listed on the computer generated reply. I received a auto response that the manager was out of the office for a week. She sent me email but was out of office the same day when I responded.

author: Bittco
title: my hurricane hangout and a great hotel
text: I recently spent several nights at this hotel which happened to coincide with hurricane sandy. This hotel is exactly a year old (i found this out when a hotel employee came by to the change the door locks- something they apparently do once a year) and located next to the King of Prussia mall- pretty much irrefutably the best mall in the Philadelphia metro area. It isn't next to the mall in the way that you can walk to the mall but it is basically a two minute car ride away and off of mall blvd. The rooms were incredibly nice- they had a modern look but not overwhelmingly so. There were flat screen tv's with a lot of channels and hd broadcasts, a nice ipod radio, a wine bottle opener (thought no wine), a microwave, and mini fridge. The walls of the hotel were full of photographic canvases of Philadelphia and the walls of the lobby featured a mural of Geno's! The breakfast for the most part was standard fare but there was a hot food fresh preparation line as well (i didn't have time to the wait in the line but it seemed quite popular). The lobby had sort of a lounge/bar/restaurant next to it. Its hard to say which of the three it was since all the elements blended together. There was a pool table and fireplace though. The staff here was also friendly. From the front desk, to people at breakfast, to the sanitation workers, everyone was surprisingly polite and always conversive. Supposedly this hotel has a backup generator, which thankfully was never needed during the storm. Finally, Hyatt House in many ways has replaced the Hyatt Sommerfield Suites. Unlike the Sommerfield Suites, however, the Hyatt House does NOT serve a light dinner type meal. The breakfast is free but this hotel was more a conventional hotel then a suite or extended stay type place.

author: campsintents
title: My new place to stay in Philadelphia
text: I stayed at Hyatt House with my two children and we all had a very relaxing stay. The staff was extremely accommodating and friendly. From the custodial staff to the the administrative staff, I was really impressed with their professionalism. The kitchen came in very handy, allowing us to avoid eating out every night. To sit back with the kids on a couch, watch a little television, and eat a quiet meal was, in my mind, the perfect getaway. The room was extremely clean and refreshed, without fail, everyday. Even a dishwasher for the fully dish stocked cabinets, made my trip easier. The complimentary breakfast was delicious and the hotel store came in very handy for snacks and ice cream desserts. My only issues were the bed, which was way too firm for me. I actually woke up sore. Then a leak at the bottom of the door of my shower which created a river in the bathroom. This was a bit annoying since the river flows right by the toilet and stepping in puddles to get there is unavoidable. I've seen this complaint in other reviews and having seen where the leak is occurring, it should be an easy fix. Otherwise, thank you for a wonderful visit, Hyatt. Your hard work is greatly appreciated.

author: YvoncitaR
title: Absolutely a keeper!
text: My family and I decided to spend the weekend at King of Prussia and when he reserved this hotel we were not sure what to find, well it was a pleasant surprise. The hotel is clean, beautiful, full of amenities and the service is outstanding. The pool was great and the whirlpool even better (spacious and hot!). The workout room has a glass wall looking into the pool, so you can workout while keeping an eye on your children. The bedrooms are more like studio apartments, we had EVERYTHING needed in them... i mean everything from spoons to ipod stations! The beds, you can tell, are expensive ones, very comfortable. The decor is modern and sleek. They have a pool table in the lobby area next to the bar and we had lots of fun during the night, my husband and I had a drink while playing with our children. In the morning (breakfast was included in the price) we walked down to have breakfast which consisted of eggs, bacon, bagels, muffins, omelets (done for you as you wait), cereal (cold and hot), juices, coffee.. i mean.. you name it! The employees are so nice and greet you like family, I would recommend this place to everyone I know. Oh and King of Prussia Mall (which is the biggest mall) is right across the street.. dont forget to go to Joes crab shack...mmmm delicious!

author: Mershguy
title: 2nd stay, more nights, different style of room, just as good
text: This was our second stay in this very nice newly furnished hotel and it was even better the second time around. We got to enjoy the complimentary breakfast on 3 mornings and there was enough of a variety to keep us interested. For a "complimentary" breakfast, it was more than satisfactory. We also got to experience the pool & fitness center this time around, which were both very clean and new-looking facilities. We were bummed that the whirlpool was closed one of the days but our young kids had a lot of fun in the pool nonetheless. While I didn't use the fitness center quite so much, it seemed to have just about anything average exerciser would need. Again, all new-looking equipment in a well-maintained area. The one negative would be the room keys. They kept getting erased & I had to run down to the front desk twice to get them reset. This wouldn't have been as big a deal if we weren't in almost the corner room on the top floor. It got a little tedious. We were told by the front desk staff that this happens when you put your key near some electronic devices. As I was storing mine in the same pocket as my iPhone, this made sense. They should post signs or warn you about that when you check-in. Hotel also has a small convenience "corner" in the lobby, which served its purpose when we needed a late-night soda. Again, very clean, very modern-furnished and upper-scale feel to this hotel, which I would definitely stay at again when in the area. Sesame Place & Philly very easy to get to from KoP.

author: elcentro1
title: I LOVE this place!!!!!
text: I wouldn't mind staying in downtown Philadelphia, BUT, the hotels there by and large are way too expensive. However, with the second largest mall in the US being in suburban King of Prussia/Valley Forge, it's nice to stay right across the street from it. This Hyatt House is NICE, and again, literally, right across the street from the King of Prussia Mall. I loved having a kitchen in my hotel room. Instead of me going out to dinner, I went to the local Acme grocery store down the street, and bought me some food, took it back to my room, and cooked it that night. The bed was so comfortable, and the room was so clean. The staff was very friendly. Also, I loved the swimming pool. And I learned something new. Once inside the room, you have to put your hotel key card in a slot, in order to activiate the electricity in the room. It cuts down on wasteful electricity when you're not in the room. Very eco-friendly. The continental breakfast was delicious. Oh yes, I'd like to stay here more often when I visit the Philadelphia area. I won't even mind having to drive 20 miles down the Schuylkill Expressway to get into the city, because I'm staying here.

author: stephaniek615
title: Amazing stay!
text: I stayed in a 1-bedroom suite and really enjoyed it! The shower was huge, enough for two people easily, and the pressure was awesome, as well as the temperature! The only drawback is no tub...I like to take baths too. The kitchenette was nice, but would have liked an oven. Only has a stovetop and microwave to cook. The refrigerator was full-sized and the freezer was nice too. Also, there is a dishwasher, dishes, glasses (including wine glasses), silverware, pots/pans, and a coffeemaker. One of the biggest complaints was the noise level outside...I stayed on the 4th Floor towards the end of the hallway, as I requested a room apart from other guests to keep things as quiet as possible, but I could hear the highway noise in my room. I made sure to put the A/C on and the fan to help drown out the noise. Also, the room came with an alarm clock/noise machine that played a variety of nature sounds...I enjoyed this too at night. Breakfast was delicious, just perfect for me! Omelets were good, though if busy, you'd wait a while. There were cereals, fruits, breads, muffins, bagels, scrambled eggs, sausage, bacon, potatoes, and I'm sure more (that I just missed). The bed in my room was extremely comfortable. Another complaint was that the tv's had limited channels, and some of the local Philadelphia stations were not working...so I didn't get to watch my morning news that I enjoy. Not sure if this was weather related, or due to some problems with the satellite/digital coverage. So, I had to watch CNN for my news, versus the local Philly stations that I enjoy when I travel. Anyway, overall, stay was very pleasant and I'd definitely stay again!

author: watchyoursix
title: Pet-Friendly in King of Prussia
text: My wife and I had to be in King of Prussia for a weekend. Instead of pawning my poor dog off on my parents yet again, I decided to bring him with us for the trip. He's a chocolate lab / beagel mix. Everyone always mistakes him for a lab puppy, but he's three now and well behaved. Finding places that are dog friendly can be difficult and it quickly narrows your search. We had three options. The first location I cannot remember, but it looked beneath even my dogs standards (and no I'm not being snobbish). The second was a Residence Inn, but they wanted a huge non-fundable pet deposit. Then there was Hyatt House which offered dogs up to 50 lbs for a more reasonable deposit. All I'm going to say is that the rooms are updated for the traveler in mind. We were in outlet heaven. Every charger and home in a reasonable location. The kitchen was stocked with utencils and dishes that made our stay more pleasurable. Especially when we brought back leftovers from this wonderful Indian restaurant we went ate at. The bathrooms are clean and comfortable. The bed provided a good night's sleep. We've stayed at Hyatt Place hotels, but I've never heard of Hyatt House hotels. I'm looking forward to investigating more locations for another dog weekend getaway.

author: njkvr
title: Great Room, good amenities, great value
text: Stayed in a 2 queen bed studio with wife and two kids on a weekend shopping trip to the adjacent mall. Room was spacious enough that 4 of us could be in there without feeling on top of one another (separate coach / chair sitting area, a desk in kitchen space help spread you out). We usually end up spending extra for a suite when traveling as a family so this really helped on the value front to be able to use one room comfortably. Odd numbered rooms are on mall side of building - even rooms face back to highway. I didn't notice traffic noise in hotel, but if that concerns you, ask for an odd numbered room. Everything in room was new, clean and working. Lots of easily accessible outlets for charging your devices. TV is angled toward sitting area and not beds in our room type if that is an issue for you. Lobby / bistro area was VERY comfortable. Bar, pool table, free breakfast buffet that was a cut above the norm and convenience snack bar are all nice touches that make staying here more comfortable and convenient The fitness room has 4 treadmills, 3 elliptical, a bike (2?) one cable weight machine and one rack of free weights and medicine balls. All equipment was relatively new so you can get in a solid work out without leaving the hotel. Bally's just down the mall road (1/2 mile perhaps) if you need the full fitness center experience. If you're a little adventuresome and willing to cross a busy mall road and parking lot, you can walk back and forth to mall, to movie theater and several restaurant choices without getting back into you car, though there aren't really pedestrian features to help you. If your intent is to go into Philadelphia proper, there are better locations certainly, but our trip centered around the Mall itself and Valley Forge. For that -- darn near perfect.

author: bazom
title: Clean, refreshing, wonderful service, beautiful decor, average breakfast
text: My wife and I decided to go for a night getaway for some r&r, the first since our daughter was born. The hotel is very clean. The staff is excellent, kind and courteous. The attendant at the front desk asked us why we were there and when he found out, booked us into a King suite on the top floor. Embarrassingly, I did not get his name to praise him here. The room was great, hardwood floors, granite counter-tops, two 42" flat screens, etc. The only objection I had to the Hotel was the breakfast. Don't get me wrong, the breakfast was good and included in the price, but they market it as being the best breakfast and above what normally passes as a buffet breakfast. Additionally, an employee there commented that it was superb. But it was just average: omelet bar, breads to toast, cereal, sausage, some dry French toast, fruit, yogurt, coffee... no bacon. I could see trying to tell everyone how great it is when they will pay extra money for it, but it's included. Just say that and don't hype it to something it's not. Overall, it was a 5 out of 5 and I would stay there again and eat the breakfast. Oh and there were no pets allowed and no smoking so it smelled and felt clean and free of air-born nasties.

author: nickgZ7729FB
title: Hit and miss
text: Ok, bare with me. Location: Perfect Room: Actually not bad considering. Bit average, but was told by good old Roger that it's getting renovated, so there's that to look forward to. The staff: Absolute pleasure to deal with Pro's: The shower, OMG that is amazing and I want one in our house! haha! The bed was good. Couldn't hear anything from Bangla Rd (and considering how loud it is, that's impressive in itself!) Cons: this is where it gets interesting. We purchased a voucher. And yes, I was skeptical to start with, and even though it said we had to sit through a "90 Minute Presentation", and that my fiance said she had done a similar thing in Hawaii, I was still skeptical. We arrive, the staff are amazing. We enter the room, and find out the "90 minute presentation", is actually a 90 minute OPTIONAL brunch, and a 4 HOUR MANDATORY lunch with Roger. Who, to be quite honest, was a typical, american, salesman. Arrogant. Chauvinistic. And no regard for our input. I get he has a job, and that job is sales, but my god man. And then there's the "no availability at Twin Sands for the dates you have selected". After going there for the lunch, I can see why, it was never going to be an option. It's obviously used as a sales tool, because it is absolutely INCREDIBLE

author: miss_piaalba
title: Good location
text: Very good location for party animals. It's in Bangla Road! It wasn't very appealing from the outside. Hotel was small but the rooms were spacious. It was cozy and nice. Staff were helpful and friendly. Pool area was small. Internet was fast enough. I couldn't hear the outside music, it's probably soundproofed against the noise from the outside but not from the inside. We could hear conversations from the other rooms. It was too clear, I think we could join the conversations. Anyway, despite that, since we were tired, we didn't mind and still was able to sleep well. It'll be alright, I guess if your neighbors are quiet. Ours weren't. The toilet in our room kept on clogging but staff were quick enough to help all the time. So, it's alright.

author: 6dac
title: right in the heart of crazy town
text: I'm still not sure about the read and black and white decor...a bit gaudy I think, but our room was well appointed, if a little small. The bed was awesome: a firm king size. S comfortable. The bathroom was a converted balcony which was weird, but the jacuzzi was excellent. The water temperature in the shower was a little difficult to get right. Lots of channels on the TV but they were all fuzzy. Bad reception on all. Bangla Road goes all night and you can hear the party from the room, although with the sliding glass doors shut, it wan't annoying. Climax Bar on the roof is really good. Great service. Super friendly, who are happy to chat with you like friends and give you advise about this and that in Patong. The food is really nice. I mean the hot breakfast were seriously good. It's all open, the bar and restaurant (under cover, but open) and there's a pool there. We spent a bit of time relaxing there. From the security guard at the door to the reception staff to the service staff, everyone made us feel really welcome. We enjoyed our time there a lot and we sorry to leave.

author: MoemienahV
title: harrasment
text: We bought a wiki deal for absolute bangla resort. After meeting our first meeting the sales rep, we were repeatedly harassment by the management of absolute resorts time share. One of the conditions of wiki deals was "no group travelling" which ofcourse we adhered too. At the same time there were many other SA couples that booked there stay the same us. as well as more couples from across the world. Automatically they approached all the couples from SA and assumed we travelled in a group! After explaining to the sales reps for Absolute we do not know any of the couples and we have just from them ,that there were so many other SA couples, we wouldn't have known until the made it clear to us. We thought we would befriend them and perhaps do trips together as we may get a better rate from the tour companies??? which would a good thing RIGHT? well not to them they were super focused on "cathing us out" in breach of contract and tried having us pay full amount... in EUROS and ofcourse this is out of our "holiday Budget" as we paid for the wiki deal --- Were totally harassed felt as if we we being watche dby all the staff all the time, our hotel rang off the hook from some people in spain??? seriously??? they made the experience at bangle unpleasurable and would undoublty not recommend wiki deals, under false advertising. GUYS STEER clear of these scamsters!! esp ROB!!!! all about the MONEY MONEY....

author: amymI2088TJ
title: Awful place, not recommended at all!!
text: First we arrived and the service was lovely, that's pretty much where it ends. We got to our room and it looks like a porn movie set, reds and dark. The lights were difficult to find and even the concierge who came up struggled to find them! There were ants all over the dressing table. The loo is basically at the end of the bed, only separated by a sliding glass door. The shower water was either cold or boiling and had some sort of oily film about it. The lift wasn't working for our whole stay so it was a climb up and down to room, pool etc. To their credit, the pool area is ok. Small but does the trick. The cocktails are good but the restaurant food was nothing amazing. Do not get sucked into the big sell. We were told a bit of a chat about their product over breakfast. This guy extremely pushy. We told him it wouldn't suit us and FOUR HOURS later he finally gave up but packed a hiss like a baby and went to get the manager. The manager asked us again, by which time I was getting very hacked off and near telling them to shove the rest of the stay. They finally delivered us back to the hotel so we could get a late lunch. We did go in open minded but it is closed for all time now to Absolute. Another company may win our membership but certainly not this one. Aside from that the room is noisy, right beside a nightclub and you can't get a cab in or out past 6pm as the street is closed off and you have to push through crowds to get down the alley way where the hotel sits. The only thing this place had going for it is the service from staff.

author: EmmaA218
title: Loved it
text: We got a great deal for 7 nights for Absolute Twin Sands, however when we arrived we were told we were going to Absolute Bangla Suites as there was a problem with the water in Absolute Twin Sands. We were concerned, admittedly, as we had planned our trips from the other hotel. On arrival on a late Saturday evening, our taxi could not take us to the front of the hotel as this hotel is situated "in" Bangla road which is closed off at night to traffic. If you have done your research, Bangla road is party central and one of the loudest streets I have ever visited and quite a feast for the eyes. It was a very different experience than anticipated as we had been looking for a tranquil stay and this was somewhat not tranquil at all! We arrived at the hotel and had a very easy and smooth check in process. We had one of the penthouse suits on the 4th floor which was lovely. Lovely kitchen (which we didn't use), lounge area, massive bedroom with night club theme (as all of the hotel) and lovely big and clean bathroom. Not forgetting the lovely Jacuzzi on the balcony. We did not really have a nice view, but that was ok. The music at night was loud due to the proximity to Bangla road, with ear plugs in and the air con on you could barely hear it but light sleepers would struggle I think. However that bed, that bed was super comfy and I what to get one back home. The service at the front desk was excellent - nothing was too much trouble. The proximity of the hotel was close to all the action, shopping, restaurants, markets, nightlife and beach so was perfect. In the end, we were really happy for having stayed here instead of all 7 nights at the other hotel. Thank you Absolute Bangla Suites for making our Phuket stay an absolutely unforgettable experience, we will recommend to our friends and hopefully be back one day.

author: jdanielca
title: Where do I even begin.....AVOID THIS PLACE
text: Let me start off by saying that I did not book directly with this hotel and I stayed in one of the privately owned rooms ( yes I know they have a weird thing going on here) but as far as I understand it the rooms are all about the same. 1. I would not say I overpaid for my room, but I find it hard to understand how anyone would pay the going rate for the hotel rooms. Unless those rooms are leaps and bounds better, which I find hard to believe. 2. the decor is horrid, the red is horrid, the air conditioning has to be left on all the time if not the room does not cool down quick enough, the are critters in the wash room, small cockroaches and various ants and such. 3. The toilet/washroom is separated from the bedroom with a glass door and due to the ventilation and the noise that has to be kept closed all the time. If you leave it open the room doesn't stay cool and critters that crawl up from god knows where will enter the room. 4. This is my biggest problem with the place, the food... the food is HORRIBLE.... they should be ashamed to be serving this sort of food, the quantity is miserable and the quality is lower than what you can expect from any thai fast food joint. Over the 4 days and 3 nights I stayed there, I have tried the tom yum soup, cashew nut chicken, massaman curry etc the choice to use weird slopping bowls meant that i paid over 200 baht for a bowl of lukewarm soup which was not spicy even though I asked for it to be spicy, it contained 4 or 5 spoons of soup..... they decided using weird looking bowls would be more important than providing customers with proper portions. And very atypical of Thai food they fill the dishes with onions and random vegetables and each dish only has a few slices of meat. 5. The location, Bangla street is closed off at 6pm so there is no way to be picked up or dropped off after that time, so imagine coming down rubbish thai streets with potholes and full of people if you arrive or depart after 6pm.

author: RentiaV_13
title: Amazing location and Hotel
text: I would recommend anyone to stay at this hotel. Perfect location in the hub of the city. Close to all the shops. Very friendly staff. On our arrival the hotel collected us at the airport with a complementary shuttle and a breakfast the following morning. Rooms are very spacious and modern with a little kitchen which is very nice! Huge jacuzzi bath in the room and huge shower. The hotel assisted with room service on our arrival night due to landing so late. Portions were big and the food was delicious! There is a nice big pool on the roof that comes in quite handy during those hot nights if you don't feel like going out into town. It was my birthday while staying at the hotel, the staff arranged a birthday cake and surprised me with candles and sang for me. Made the day extra special. Staff can help arrange all trips or Tours you would be interested in doing! We did the sea canoe, island hopping, city tour, and the fanta Sea show. Really an excellent hotel to stay at, would definitely stay here again during our next visit!!

author: ChantalK9
title: Good enough
text: While this hotel is located in the heart of what's going on in Patong. Walking distance to the beach, the mall and everything in between. The hotel is more like a self-catering guest house than a hotel. The rooms are clean. Staff friendly. That said: We were lucky to have our room upgraded to a penthouse for the week, it's very spacious, except the cupboard doors in the bedroom don't open all the way because of the size of the bed. The room has a large fridge, microwave, stove and all you need to make your own food. We didn't do this as there are some really nice restaurants in the area. While here we did not see a single person eat at the restaurant. The cocktail happy hour at the bar is worth the spend, although it's only cocktail of the day and in small glasses. The lift was in working order while we were here. Even though we were told it wouldn't be. We were given a free breakfast the Sunday at a sister resort. Also breakfast on the day of the presentation. Not once during the presentation when we asked about cost were we told. We also asked for relevant quotes for our travel purposes yet were only given "last minute deals" quotes which don't assist in the decision making. Be careful, realistically who decides a week before the time to hop on a plane overseas. We were collected from the airport and taken to the hotel, yet because we did not sign up to the membership were told to organise our own transfers back or pay 900baht, far over priced. If you're looking to do tours, there is a very friendly lady near the corner of Bangala Road at the end of the alley who has very good prices for everything. Otherwise we had a good stay.

author: 300ismailr
title: On Bangla Road
text: Made use of. Wikideals for a 7 day stay at Bangle Suite Hotel and Spa. The hotel is situated just off the very busy Bangle Road and is close to the Patong beach and Jung Ceylon Mall. Noise from Bangla Road never a problem when the patio doors to the bathroom was closed. The hotel elevators were being replace and I was informed beforehand of this. Was promised free refreshments for this inconvenience. Never offer any free refreshments although staff claimed it was available when I booked out. Lots of notice from the installers of the elevators during the day. Fortunately was out most of the day. No elevators meant climbing steps to the 5th floor to access the pool. But was not too much of a problem. Making use of the Wikideals meant sitting through a presentation to sell you timeshare. Breakfast and lunch was provided. Did not sign up to this offer. Be aware of pressure sale tactics. Although the hotel is well placed the decor of the room was not to my taste. Too many dark colour sand decor. Hotel staff very friendly and tried to help were they can.

author: 97susie
title: Noisy, not what we expected
text: First off, the main reason we gave the Suites a "3" was that it wasn't right for us. Part of that was due to our lack of due diligence - we didn't realize just how noisy Bangla Road was, or how close this hotel is to the actual Bangla Road. On the other hand, the advertising is certainly not clear about that either. We showed up, the hotel is down a narrow alleyway directly off Bangla Road. Thehotel is sandwiched between a bunch of other buildings. Everything is dimly lit. Our windows opened up to concrete walls, about 4 feet away. Our room was modern and clean, but very musty smelling. Part of that was probably that you didn't want to open the windows - no view and Bangla Road is incredibly, incredibly, loud. The elevator was broken, the roof top restaurant didn't have many of the things listed, the pool was nice, but the fountain was broken and it was much more worn then the pictures. Staff was nice and very helpful. There are computers to use in the lobby, and free wifi. Laundry was ridiculous expensive. We had trouble sleeping because with the windows closed and the A/C going it was still hot and muggy. And you could still hear the music from Bangla Road. Opening them was NOT an option with the noise. We left 3 days into our 7 day stay. IF you wanted to party and party hard, this would be one of the nicer places on Bangla Road to stay. If you want quiet, relaxing, beaches, clean air, few people, etc. - this is not the place for you.

author: tcmot
title: bitter/sweet
text: Bangla suites is located right off of Bangla road. It is a great location(2 min from the beach) if you do not mind walking through bangla street which closes down to traffic at night and becomes a night spot.,. It is close to a great shopping area. The hotel was clean and the restaurant and pool on the 5th floor is so convenient. Be careful about using hotel phone. Local call are free excluding mobil. This bit us twice.It is very expensive.Also try to get a room with breakfast included. It is fairly expensive comparatively. . the front desk had trouble communicating with us . . A very important message was sent to me there( a hand delivered note) giving me the time and place for the next day's meeting. It was delivered as an urgent message. I never got it. checking out I saw it taped to the counter. I asked them about it and he just smiled. One of my 6$ calls was to try and find out what the note had said.

author: Vinsmith96
title: Better than expected
text: We stayed here for 7 nights as a complimentary guest of the Absolute World Group...This was our "free gift" we received for attending a half day presentation last year..... Our host was Michael,,, a very pleasant Kiwi equipped with jokes! Very helpful and respectful.... We had a lovely apartment on the third floor facing Bangla Road. We could see it from the jacuzzi! Noise was not a problem,,, just close the glass sliding door and next to no noise. It was good being so close to the nightlife and having a 7eleven so handy.... We loved the fresh lemon scent in the lobby,,, the staff had enough English for us and were most pleasant..... Our room had nice mood lighting, satellite/cable TV and the Wifi in our room was exceptional.... The king bed was divine!!! We dined at the Climax restaurant (rooftop) last year and it was really good! We dined there only the once this year and unfortunately it was far from good. In all fairness, we were informed that the regular chef was away,,, so I would be confident it would return to its former high standard upon chefs return.... Like I said at the start,,, this was a complimentary stay. At no time were we pressured, badgered or hassled to purchase this holiday plan. In fact, we chose not to buy (at the moment) and were still treated exceptionally well by all.... This holiday plan would be well worth consideration by anyone that's ready to enjoy "regular" travel in luxurious establishments around the world.... Thank you Michael and Absolute World Group for the invitation and the experience!

author: scottaus46
title: Room 213 is a gem.
text: I have just stayed for 16 nights in this fantastic suite. I have had great communication with Bob Harfield the owner of the room from the start of me making a booking. The room is at the back of the complex and double glazing has been put on the windows. Not a great view from the room but head up to the roof top pool and you will love it. look over patong Bay. Room has Wi-Fi but you need to stand at the door to get it. Great cooking facilities but you won't use them as its more fun eating out. 2 massive flat screen tv's to choose from and check those DVD's before taking them home to find they won't work or are in Thai. Location is perfect for me as I locate myself on Bangla most of the time. The amount of friends i took back to show the room off and all of them were just as impressed as myself. Decor of the room is bold but pleasant Red/Black dominant. Happy hour at the rooftop pool with local beers and a cocktail of the day for 50 baht between 17.00 and 19.00. Will stay again for sure. Even if you turn up and Bangla is closed for traffic (6.00pm) it is only a 1.5 minute walk. 2 things the room needs are 1- a fan for those who can't handle aircon and some reed diffusers or air freshner

author: baliblondeBrisbane
title: lovely hotel in central location
text: we stayed here for 5 nights on a time share deal. The room is spacious and has a small kitchenette (which we didn't use but was nice to have), there was a corner lounge, king size bed and ample storage for personal items. the bathroom is on the fully enclosed veranda including a corner spa and separate walk in shower. The towels are nice and fluffy and the linen was nice quality, the bed was very comfortable. No complaints about the room or cleanliness of the hotel. Because we had a "time share" special price we paid for our own breakfast each day at the roof top restaurant, the price was cheap but there were only 4 options, English, American, healthy or continental breakfast. It was ok for us cause we were only there for 5 nights but it would get boring if you stayed longer. Al the staff are very friendly and speak good English. We visited two of the other hotels and found them to be of a similar standard however one was due to be refurbished and the other was too far from town for us. the swimming pool is on the roof (very small) and they have about 8 pool lounges, there are no other seating options and no space to accommodate extra people. Its good for a cool off but you wouldn't sit around it all day chilling out, you would need to go down to the beach 5 mins away if you were considering this hotel for accommodation and wanting to spend lots of time tanning, swimming and reading. We heard other people on trip advisor complaining about noise from the nightclubs, it is blaring loud in Bangla Street but we didn't here anything in our room. We had a ground floor room right next to reception, it was lovely and quiet. There is a massive puddle at the front door due to a speed bump that has been constructed without including a drain, as it rained when we were there we were constantly walking through the puddle and getting wet dirty feet. Management need to cut the speed bump in a couple of places to let this water drain away, we mentioned it and were told it wasn't their problem however if the hotel guests have to enter through the puddle I believe it is the hotels problem - first impressions count! Although we chose not to purchase time share we would stay their again (if the price was competitive) and just plan to eat breakfast elsewhere occasionally and spend most days at the beach and only use the hotel pool for a quick cool off. PS: definitely not a fan of the black and red colour scheme or strip lighting under the bed, if they are marketing this hotel to my age and income group they should make over some rooms so they don't look like a night club.

author: lornal820
title: BLISSFUL THAILAND GETAWAY
text: Spent around 4 days in Phuket with my friends and we stayed at this hotel via my friend's Club Ultima membership. The rooms we were checked into were big and spacious. We were 5 in 1 room, and we didn't have trouble at all fitting! The couch, the TV, the rug, it was all wonderful and very conducive for those chill nights. The room was complete with a kitchenette, refrigerator, microwave, and dining area. The room had a king-sized bed that could fit 3 adults. The best part was the bathroom because the tub was just wonderful. The pool was also really good. We watched the sunset from there on our last day and it was beautiful. The location is also very good, you step right out onto the nightlife district, Bangla Road and then just walk a few meters to the beach. Downside is that if you arrive at night, you might have to drag your suitcases for a few meters down Bangla Road because cars can't pass through after 6 I think. Another downside is the noise level from the streets that you end up hearing from your rooms. However, the good outweighed all of it for me and my friends. Best part of everything was that it was all free because my friend just exchanged her nights or something with Club Ultima. Definitely would recommend this place to all travelers out there!

author: 36alisa
title: Apartment 213 - Absolute Bangla Suites ! an Absolute Pleasure!!!!
text: From the get go, Bob and his wife Kath were tremendous help, as first time travellers to Phuket I was unsure if booking a private rental was the way to go, as we read many horror stories about scams etc, but this really proved to be the exact opposite. Bob was very helpful and alleviated all concerns that we had booking a private rental, he gave us a great price as well. Bob kept us updated with everything, he emailed me a travel coupon and was very flexible with the method of payment. He followed up the week prior to us leaving with a list of tips, where to go shopping where to exchange money etc. he went above and beyond and I was very thankful and delighted he was so pleasant to deal with. Upon arrival, the room was just as we expected from the photos, but looked way bigger and better in real life, it was very spacious and modern and had a very Las Vegas feel to it. It was clean comfortable and everything was in working order. The room was serviced every day with fresh towles and bed sheets (muchely needed after a night of partying) the mini bar was restocked and rubbish removed. The staff were very pleasant and friendly by the end of the trip we had made friends with a lot of them. We used the room service a couple of times and ate in the Climax restaurant I would recommend their Tuna Tartar and their calamari rings, they also had a happy hour every night from 5pm-7pm serving really refreshing cocktails, we would sit by the pool and have a cocktail relax before a night out. The hotel location was perfect it was within walking distance of everything we needed, we only caught a tuk tuk once and a taxi once and that was to Kata Beach and to the airport, you can pretty much walk anywhere u need from the apartment, Shopping centre, beach, night club precinct, boxing stadium etc etc. As we were two females travelling alone this was very convenient staying here as it was literally 2 mins walk from the popular night club seduction and gossip and 10 seconds from tiger bar. When we left the hotel staff were kind enough to bring down all our luggage and had a lounge area that played a movie and had air conditioning where we chilled out for a few hours till we caught our taxi to their airport. The hotel has free wifi in all areas, including the pool area which was a bonus for us. All in all it was a great trip and if I was to visit Phuket again I would def stay in apartment 213 Absolute Bangla Suites.

author: 73MariaS
title: Awesome Stay
text: We stayed at Bangla Suits for three nights. Wow it was amazing. It really is a 5 star. The room was beautifully furnished and very modern. The bed and pillows were amazing. Slept so good that I didn’t hear any noise. Loved the Jacuzzi in our room. The kitchen had all modern appliances and was clean and neat. There were many TV channels to choose and free internet. The staff are all very friendly, helpful and courteous. Its location is in the heart of all the night life. Close to all the shops, restaurants and beach. The pool and restaurant are amazing and have an awesome view. This is the perfect place to stay at if you are going to Patong wish I had stayed longer. I would recommend this Hotel to anyone who is visiting Patong. Best stay ever.

author: Tini-treen
title: Absolute Bangla, absolutely in the middle of Bangla Road
text: We stayed seven nights here and thoroughly enjoyed the proximity to the beach by day and Bangla road by night. Our room was spacious and we made use of the kitchen as it has a full sized fridge were we were able to store snacks, drinks and fresh fruit. There's not a great deal of breakfast options around this area so to be able to prepare our own light breakfast each day was great. The rooms are very modern with flat screen TV and comfy lounge. The bed was comfortable too. The bathroom faced the street and housed a large walk in shower and massive spa bath. We did try out the spa but the only negative was that it took a while to fill. I realise some people reviewing this hotel have complained about the noise - yet we were facing Bangla Road and on the ground floor. The large sliding doors to the bathroom shuts out the noise - so use them at night time. We were happy to be on the ground floor when we checked it as the lift was out of action for a couple of days as was the rooftop pool. We didn't eat at the restaurant as we were spoilt for choice with all the nightlife, markets and restaurants close by. We did have a cocktail there and although pleasant, they weren't anything to write home about - but it's hard to find a good cocktail in Phuket. We found the staff very pleasant and helpful and they were kind enough to let us use the beach towels for our last day there even though we were checking out. Plus they stored our bags for our return to book into the next hotel (we would have stayed there longer but they were fully booked). We got some good local knowledge from one of their staff members, Stephan an ex-pat from the UK and he answered a lot of our quirky and curious questions. Overall I would highly recommend this really contemporary hotel to those of you who like us, aren't traveling with children and want to explore Phuket by day and by night. There are some very interesting bars of all shapes and sizes and they're great to pull up and bar stool and order a bucket. There's even a no name bar in the alley way to the hotel. At times they can get quite noisy but are friendly if not a little crazy (you have been warned).

author: 47JenniferS
title: Great hotel! No problem with noise!
text: Great hotel! We were in a room on the lobby floor and had no problem with noise as some others say they had, slept like a baby. We were in an odd number room so don't know about the whole "even numbers are less noisy". We got a complimentary taxi to and from the airport which was great, i think that might have been because we were a member. The staff are very helpful but would recommend not ordering a taxi from the hotel, they were unsure of how much it would be but they booked us one anyway, we ended up paying more than double the price than we would get on the streets which was crazy. The rooms spa is amazing! recommend buying some bath bubbles. Restaurant is a bit expensive so didn't eat there, but pool was quite nice. Only thing they need is more pool seats, got a bit annoying when there was a lot of people swimming and had nowhere to lie down in the sun. The location is fantastic! right in the middle of bangla road down an alley way, so its a little bit off from the street. The road closes to cars/motorbikes at 6pm every night and reopens at 5am. Its like a party on the street every night, its crazy but very fun. Room includes beach towels you can take to the pool or beach as well as umbrella's if it starts raining and has a small safe in the closet. Also has a speaker system where you can plug in your iPhone (didn't have iPhone 5 compatible plug so may need to bring adaptor if you want to use it). The bed for me wasn't very comfortable, especially the pillows, they were just to big and thick, and the cover on half of them was just very thick and heavy and not really ideal for sleeping on. Wasn't a fan of the blanket either, but thats the only minor thing i can think of that was a bit annoying. Apart from that wonderful! would recommend to everyone!

author: LibbyW332
title: Shame about the noise
text: We stayed for a week in room 102 & was greeted at the airport by their friendly staff awaiting our arrival in a mini van with fellow Absolute patrons. We had an hour trip to our accommodation with no dramas at all. Arrival was pleasant & quite fast with a refreshment drink & cool towel to freshen up. We soon were escorted to our room 102, which we were pleasantly surprised when we opened the door to see how clean & comfortable our room looked. We soon asked for a second entry card to leave in our front door electricity slot to keep the A/C going 24/7 due to the very warm weather. We had a small balcony with a spa which overlooked the opposite site of Bangla road thinking this was going to be a relatively quite room. The first night proved right, after a long day travelling with numerous drinks & a lovely meal from The Banana Phuket Restaurant we didn't really hear much at all. The second night proved all the previous comments were true. Some generator from nearby bar/night club started with an extra loud knocking noise & their A/C units also made the noise seem like there was a jet on our balcony. It was way too loud to sit out & enjoy the night. The noise starts around 8.30/9pm every night & YES, finishes around 5.30am. We did bring ear plugs which deafened the noise to a quieter thumping but you could still hear the boom, boom every night. We turned our A/C up so the noise from that drowned the noise a little. Other than that, the room was cleaned every day by their lovely staff. The reception staff were always very friendly & helpful & our last night we were lucky enough to have our driver pick us up at the hotel & drive through the busy Bangla road at 7.30pm. The shopping centre is a few minutes away if you can miss the backpackers flogging fellow hotel groups promoting holiday schemes, which after the 4 time on 1 day, my husband abruptly told them to bugger off. The climax restaurant is quite expensive compared to local restaurants. If you're into the excitement & thrill of walking down Bangla Road after 6pm, this is the perfect spot for you, close to the beach & walking distance to all the shopping hot spots. If you're after a quiet spot at night to relax, unfortunately you will be disappointed.

author: 23louise
title: Nice surprise
text: On tripadvisor, you see all a range of ratings for this hotel-- so I was a bit nervous about our stay here. We had used our timeshare in the states in exchange for our stay. But I shouldn't have worried. We had a great time. We had a late night arrival, which I notified them about and also had requested a "quiet" room via email and they notified me that they would try to honor that request. And they did. We were given room 214 (all the even number face the back--away from the noise of the nightclubs in front) and we never had problems with the noise. The room was clean and in fact looked like a night club itself, with it's red and black decor and blue lights-- kind of fun for us!! It's in a perfect location-- easy walk to shopping, beach and restaurants. Bangla Street does get crazy at night-- but it's an easy stroll back to hotel and the noise and craziness disappears. We ate only once for breakfast, which was good, but we were often out and about and early and just grabbed something from places around Jungceylon. We attended their free BBQ night--which was just ok-- and since we were owners at another timeshare we were not bothered by the sales reps. Internet worked good. Housekeeping was VERY good--room was always cleaned and ready when we returned. Only thing that was not great was that we had very little hot water in the shower-- it was at best lukewarm, and only for a few minutes, before it turned cold. We let the front desk know, but nothing seem to change after they said they would send a workman up. I guess it's a good way to keep the hot water use down, but it would have been nice to have it at least warm. And another kind of trivial thing, the shower arrangement is very strange-- with the water going everywhere if you use the hand held device--even running under the glass wall. It was really more of a nuisance than anything. But those were very minor concerns and overall our stay was great.

author: barbhart
title: GREAT PLACE
text: We had two weeks hear. Had read some of the reviews on tripadvisor. We had room 307. Yes is was noisey from the disco outside. BUT is was nothing that couldn't be over-come. We found that if we put the tv on low it took away from the noise in the bedroon. We were also told that they are approved for treble glazing which sould be happening soon. We ate a few meals in the rooftop restaurant and found them all to be very nice and very tasty. The staff were very friendly and very helpful. Jaeb the hotel concierge was very helpful. We also had no problem with our housemaid Low either. Would happily stay there again as it is very central to everything. The only down for the whole trip was our night out to Fantasea. we booked our tickets at a street ticket offices and asked for a certain area. When we got to the show after the driver finished getting lost we found that we had seats way in the back of the theatre. But that was not the hotels fault. It's a case of first come first served. So if you get there late through no fault of your own you get a seat were they put you. P.S. FANTASTIC HOTEL

author: 651toddm
title: won us over...=)
