text: Had a wonderful experience at Le Royal- starting with the check-in staff member who was sympathetic to my lack of sleep/jet lag upon arrival around 11AM. He proposed a Jr. Suite at a discount, which would be readied as quickly as possible. It was, and what a good room: marble topped sinks, spotless bathtub and shower with gleaming fixtures, large bed, desk table and a number of armchairs and chairs. The room faced the courtyard and was quiet. Excellent buffet-style breakfast, internet terminal available- and best of all, location. The hotel is quite close to the famous Raspail/Montparnasse intersection, cafes like the Dome, Coupole and Select described by Hemingway when he lived in the city, and near the rue de la Grande Chaumiere of artistic history, Gertrude Stein's apartment, and the ever wonderful Luxembourg gardens. One of the nicest areas in Paris, and as other reviewers have noted, very handy to metro lines 4 and 12, and 6 a bit further off. The clientel also makes a difference. No party animals, frat trips, or school groups. A quiet, fairly well off segment of the tourist and business markets, making no waves and appreciating their surroundings. Very clean, wonderful lounge downstairs, and literally a few feet down the blvd. Raspail, toward the blvd. Montp[arnasse, an excellent Italian restaurant as well as a more traditional cafe and another equally good small, boutique type restaurant. Memorable experiences in all three; the cafe perfect for just a hot chocolate/sandwich type meal. The old, inexpensive hotels in this area are now almost all gone. Le Royal is a perfect replacement starting around 200 Euros per night. Well worth it!

author: wsdwsd
title: Decent hotel but terrible hotel manager
text: Postives: Good location -- located in a safe area near 2 (Vavin (closest) and Raspail )metro stops, decent European breakfast, free internet (we brought our laptop but had to use it in the lobby as the wireless signal didn't reach our room on the 5th floor). Several good restaurants nearby (Creperie Plougastel at 47 Rue du Monparnasse, Chez Berbert --- good Morrocan restaurant nearby, Coupoule ?sp --very good French cuisine) Negatives: VERY rude and unaccomodating hotel manager. We came for a week to see the sights (1st trip to Paris). On day 5, Sunday AM, we went downstairs to eat breakfast and then returned to our room to get out coats, gloves, hats (it was 32 degrees F outside), my wofe's purse, and our camera. Our electronic door lock would not work. The hotel staff tried repeatedly but it still wouldn't work. They removed the lock cover & tried their master keys to no avail. I asked them to call a locksmith or the manager but they refused. Finally they called the manager who agreed to come in --- by that time we wife convinced them to let her try the master key and she was finally able to open the door and the manager didn't have to come in. I asked to speak to the manager but the desk clerk refused and said I would have to take it up with him the next day. After all this, we had spent 4 hrs in the lobby waiting to get into our room (it was too cold to go out without protection) and finally left the hotel by 1:30 PM. We were upgraded to a somewhat larger room for the last 2 nights of our stay. I asked the manager if he would refund a portion of 1 night's stay as we had wasted 1/2 a day stranded in the hotel lounge (rather than seeing Paris) because we could not get into our room but he was quite rude and flatly refused. Not only did he refuse any other compensation but he was very rude about it. Finally he said " I do not know what to think, I have no mind...." My wife was quite upset at his rudeness. The other hotel staff (especially Sammy the night attentent) was very good but the main hotel manager was unbelievably rude. Considering we lost an entire morning of our trip, we didn't feel a room upgrade for 2 nights was fair, but the manager made it clear he could care less. The rooms are fairly small and the mattresses uncomfortable.

author: WorldTraveler061
title: A nice hotel
text: This is a good 3 star property. The plusses: Well-located, friendly helpful staff who speak English, clean, modern. The lobby area and breakfast room are especially stylish with modern but comfortable furniture. There is free Wi-fi in the rooms if you bring your laptop. Otherwise there is a free computer near the lobby to connect with the internet. The breakfast was a standard cold buffet with croissants, bread, butter and jelly, meat and cheese, yoghurt, cold cereal, mixed fruit, applesauce, juice, coffee, tea, and hot chocolate. I only wish the yoghurt had been flavored rather than plain. Our room was quite comfortable, but laid out in an unusual manner. One entered the room into a hallway, with the bathroom off that hall before getting to the bedroom. Still, it was convenient. The hallway had a hall tree for hanging extra clothes and there was a nice closet with shelves, built into the room. The room was clean and serviced regularly. The negatives: The only English language channel on our TV was CNN, and for some reason that didn’t work after the first day. The heater in the bathroom, designed to heat the towels didn’t work. The shower head had an extra spray out the side rather than in a nice smooth spray. We didn’t complain about any of these issues, because they really didn’t affect our stay and seemed minor. Overall we were very satisfied with our stay.

author: donnalmorgan
title: WOW!!! I Love Paris, and I Loved this Hotel!!!
text: This was our first visit to Paris, we were a little nervous not knowing the city or language. I knew that safety, cleanliness and location for picking a hotel were my main concerns. WE LUCKED OUT with Le Royal Hotel!!! The room was CLEAN. The bathroom was CLEAN (cleaner than a lot of American Hotels I've stayed in!). The view was GREAT!! The double door windows that opened up to the beautiful Parisian Street were the absolute BEST thing about the whole room!!! The location was GREAT!!! This hotel is in on a main SAFE street in Paris in the southern end of Paris, one block away from Vavin Metro Station and the Taxi Station and 2 blocks away from the Train. On the corner is an ATM and right around the corner from the ATM is a FABULOUS french bakery we found, they don't speak any English but pointing to all the incredible treats worked very well! This hotel is walking distance from Luxemburg Gardens, Notre Dame Cathedral, the Louvre, and LOTS OF Restaurants and shopping!! We always saw lots of Police on bikes or horses and the streets were clean and well lit so I always felt safe. The continental breakfast at the Hotel was AWESOME!!! We took full advantage of it every morning before heading out for the day --- there was a full dining room type area for breakfast which included a selection of breads, jams, fresh meats and cheeses, eggs, yogurt, fruit salad, cereal, coffee, tea etc YUM!!! The lobby had a pc with free internet service and a coffee machine with free coffee 24/7. The staff was SUPER GREAT, someone was always there 24/7 to help with any questions, they could book just about anything you were interested in (boat river dinner cruise and moulin rouge are 2 musts!), give you specific directions to anywhere you wanted to go and always had tips for the best way to get around Paris depending on the destination and time of day, day of the week. I loved Paris so much I never wanted to leave!!! The food, the wine, the champagne, the sights, the shopping, the SHOES!!! :-) I've attached some pictures of the room we stayed in and the view from the room to this review, feel free to contact me if you are looking for more info!

author: susaninmesa
title: Nice staff, location and value.
text: Our 7 night stay was very pleasant. We booked our trip through Virgin Vacations and this hotel was one of the choices. We selected Le Royal based on $$$ value as compared to a central Paris hotel and research based on other reviews and mapping out metro stops and walking distances. The staff was always very pleasant and helpful with directions and a re-booking of a tour. At the end of long days of walking and sightseeing we were very happy to find our room freshly cleaned and vacuumed. Our room was a Jr. Suite (sleeping for three) that looked onto a school play yard at the rear of the building, no street noise! The bath area featured two lavatories and separate tub and shower with compartmentalized WC - very nice for the three of us! The hairdryer had a 110 outlet but be advised that it did not accept US plugs with the wide flange. The continental breakfast featured fresh baked goods, meats, fruits, coffee, tea and orange juice. There are many places to eat in the area, especially seafood (poissons). We also found a couple of Italian restaurants, a steak house, asian foods and street crepes (mmm-mmmm) within walking distance. There is a coin laundry around the block (Lav-club - but I understand this can be $$$ and time consuming). We caught a train to Versailles out of Gare Montparnasse, a 10 minute walk away. For shopping there is a Galleries Lafayette as well as great window shopping along Blvd Raspail. The nearby Vavin metro station (line 4) can get you to the Louvre area by changing routes at Chatelet (line 1). On our last night we went to the top of the tour Montparnasse for a view of the city lights and to watch the Tour Eiffel light show. Our second floor room was neatly maintained, warm for the cold nights and did not smell of smoke. The internet at the hotel is frustrating to use. At times it was okay for surfing, but sending messages was terrible.

author: bookwoman11
title: Pleased Overall - Just A Few Flaws
text: My best friend and I stayed 5 nights as part of a GoToday.com package. We knew what to expect, having read the reviews here at TA, and can now say from experience that they're mostly accurate. The location is wonderful; quiet, yet right around the corner from the heart of Montparnasse and directly between two Metro stops, each mere steps away. Also, the Le Tour hop on hop off bus has a stop virtually across the street. The staff was incredible. The much talked about front desk clerk on nights did ask a couple of times if we needed info about tours, but we politely said no thanks and he did not push it. They looked up directions for us, woke us up, made dinner recommendations, and had a cab waiting to take us to the airport, always with a smile on their face. We found the daily breakfast to be perfect for us. The women who served breakfast were not proficient in English, but were very kind and we managed to communicate via sign language when we needed something. Our room, #53, had french doors that opened out to a balcony overlooking the street, and surprisingly, we only had to wait about 15 minutes for it to be ready when we arrived from the airport at about 10:30 in the morning. The only complaint I really have with the hotel is the odor of smoke which permeated our room, despite it being a non-smoking hotel. We aired it out each evening when we returned from our ramblings by opening the french doors, but it is my guess that when a building is that old, all those decades of smoke are hard to get rid of. When we walked into the lobby each evening, that air-freshener scent that other reviewers have mentioned was present and it was sllightly unpleasant. We went straight up the tiny lift to our room though, so it wasn't much of an issue. Also, the first night, I asked for 2 additional pillows and it took 3 days to get them. No big deal for me, but it may be for some.

author: Croydonguys
title: A friendly, well located hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel on a short break to Paris. It is located less than 5 minutes walk from Vavin Metro. If arriving from CDG or Orly airports you can take the RER to Denfert-Rochereau station and either walk 10-15 minutes to the hotel or take the Metro to Vavin (CDG to Denfert is about a 40 minute journey). The hotel staff speak English and were very helpful. There is a lobby with internet access (if you pay!), a lift and breakfast room - but no restuarant or bar. Our room (no. 12) was on the first floor and had a double bed and a small en-suite toilette, basin & shower. The airconditioned bedroom itself was a little small and the main problem was a lack of drawers for clothing - we had to use the desk drawers! The decor was modern, the room clean & the bed comfortable. The continental buffet breakfast was sufficient to start the day. Near the hotel there are cafes and bistro. Using Metro line 4 from Vavin you can easily access the Latin Quarter, Ile de la Cite, Gare du Nord and even Sacre Coeur. The Jardin du Luxembourg, St Germain-des-Pres and the Latin Quarter are within walking distance if you do not mind stretching your legs! The Montparnasse Tower is just around the corner and gives fantastic views of Paris by day and night...without the horrendous queues you get at the Eiffel Tower. In short...good value and handy location - I would use this hotel again.

author: Melanie85
title: Fantastique!
text: I took my mum to Paris for her 60th birthday and decided upon Le Royal for 3 nights over a weekend. I was not disappointed. The decor of the hotel was modern and contemporary. It was exceptionally clean. We had a twin room looking out over the street with a separate bathroom and toilet. Plenty of storage space for two women's stuff! The big plus point was the sound proofing of the rooms. We had two Aussies blokes next door to us staying over for the rugby and aside from brief snatches of conversation in the hall outside the room heard not a peep from them - and I doubt they sat silent in their room! The large french window to the street also did not let in traffic noise when closed. One downside the AC in the room was not great. Breakfast was typical french style with croissants, pain au chocolate etc. Beware the P au C go quick and they don't always have more! The area was perfect for dining as a previous entry said. Chez Clement on the Blvd du Montparnasse did a good hearty formule (set meal). The market on the road behind the hotel (Rue Edgar Quinet) held on a saturday and a wednesday was a fab typical french food market - great for picnic food or just drooling! On the sunday we were there there was also an art market with great original work including small pottery gifts - well worth a look. All in all a fantastic hotel and area - we would certainly return.

author: JimVT
title: Everything that was Expected and More
text: Just returned from a wonderful six night stay. Our flight landed early (5:30am) and we took the RER directly to the Port Royal station. This stop is only a short (10 min.) walk to the hotel. We arrived at Le Royal before 7:30am and expected to just drop our bags and head out but were surprised when we were given the key to our room at that early hour by the friendly and helpful clerk. Our standard room was small compared to American hotels, but once we had settled in it wasn't bad at all. The double bed was comfortable, there was a desk, a minibar / refrig (prices reasonable) and a place to hang shirts and slacks with areas to stack other items (no dresser with drawers). The bathroom was decent size with a very good shower. We were on the top (6th) floor (back rooom, very quiet) and never had to wait for the elevator (only large enough for 2 people with luggage or 4 without) more than a few seconds which was amazing. The room had a flat screen TV with 2 english speaking stations (CNN, BBC Prime). The breakfast each morning (included in our deal) was good -- coffee, tea, OJ, milk, good bread, crossants, cereal, etc. There was someone there making sure everything was supplied. The neighborhood is great -- well worth the time for exploration! Within a couple of minutes walk there are countless restaurants, cafes, bars, grocery stores (cheap wine, beer for the room or picnic) etc. -- some cafes even open 24 hours. You don't have to wait until 8pm to eat dinner or worry about options on Sunday -- plenty of choices around the clock every day. Depending where you want to go on the Metro, there are 2 stops very close by and also various bus routes close also. The Luxembourg Gardens are a 5 - 10 minute walk and it's outstanding for walking, running, sitting, picnics, whatever. I would definitely stay in the neighborhood again and would not hesitate to stay at Le Royal.

author: Whim
title: Smelly public areas, rooms need new wallpapers!
text: Hotel Royal Montparnasse Luxembourg had a special promotion in August, so I decided to book, even if the 14th arrondissement is not my favourite at all. The young lady at the reception was friendly and efficient enough. The first thing I noticed, though, was a very strong unpleasant smell in the public areas, a mix of cigarettes and chemical air-freshener. I was happy to see that the lounge was non-smoking, but the reality was something else. The smell of cigarettes was horrible. We quickly found out the reason. It was the night staff, the middle aged man was often sitting in the lounge at night, smoking something that certainly wasn't the usual cigarettes... The same night receptionist was very pushy, trying to sell us all kinds of tourist sight-seeing trips every night. The last evening he asked if we were going to leave the next morning, and tried to force us to book a "private" taxi at a special price. I can imagine it was a "special price" for him. Really disgusting! Our superior room was spacious enough for two persons, but the wardrobe was very small. There was very little light in the bathroom. The wallpapers in the room need to be changed, the sooner the better. The cleaning ladies were friendly and did their work. If I ever decide to stay in 14th arrondissement again, I will not stay at Royal Montparnasse Luxembourg. There are a couple of very nice looking hotels almost opposite.

author: threetravellers
title: An oasis of calm in the middle of busy Paris
text: Just back from Paris. Spent Saturday and Sunday night in this charming hotel. We last stayed here in August 2004 and both stays have been enjoyable. Each time we have stayed in rm. 48 (4th floor facing the inner courtyard). The courtyard overlooks the playground of the college/high school next door. During term (weekdays only) bells ring on the hour (starting at 8am) this should not be a problem as in Paris you are mostly out and about but it is necessary to know.The courtyard is open and the back of the hotel is painted a goldish yellow and so a feeing of light rather than dark as a tall buildings inner courtyard may generate. We stayed in the same style triple room as the travellers above and it is lovely (an L shape which is huge) and there was room for us, our luggage and a small army if neccessary. Decor very tasteful. Our room was in yellow and crimson with heavy brocade curtains, reproduction antique writing table, bedside tables and chairs. There is also a glass topped table (picnics, possible). We paid September rates of 200E per night (breakfast not included). Breakfast 12E available but not recommended as the max paid at a nearby cafe for a breakfast of tea/coffee/hot chocolate + croissant + orange juice is 4.5 - 5 E. The management also runs Hotel Jardin le Brea on rue Brea nearby. Good restaurants nearby include Les deux cigales, rue Brea and Bistro Romain, bvd Montparnassse.

author: Mtl-travelers
title: Great Place, Great location and Clean
text: Been to Paris prior and always had difficulty finding a decent hotel. Aware the rating system cannot be compared to North American. So this time, I did my homework and finally decided to book at Le Royal. What a great choice! What a great surprise. We had a triple/family room for 3. The bathroom is exactly as shown in the pics. THe room is a good size. There were 3 single beds, one against the wall and 2 others are side by side. Had a mini fridge and desk, T.V. and we also had 3 luggages and still have enough room to walk around. The closet had a mini safe. Everything was clean! Great location, not on a crowded street and only 4 minutes walk to the metro station. 6-10 minute stroll to the Jardin Luxembourg. Staff were welcoming, always pleasant and helpfull. Continental breakfast included which provided a decent selection: Cereal, ham, croissants, pain au chocolat, yogurt, boiled egg, juices, coffee & tea. Paid 215$/night for 3..Great deal for what you get (In Paris anyway)! Will recommend this too my friends and will go back for my next trip!

author: RayCathode
title: Nice, charming hotel.
text: We stayed in the Royal in October 04. It looks much larger from the photos on the web, and from the virtual tour, as it was much smaller than I imagined when I walked in. The lobby is nicely appointed; lots of chrome and soft cushions etc. The staff were great, very helpful, especially the desk staff, perfect English and everything. Be careful you don't get roped into booking a tour; they were quite pushy with us and we ended up buying bus tickets we never used. The lift was the smallest lift I've ever seen, but the corridors were bright and airy. Not really corridors at all, more a series of landings and doors. Our room was wrong when we arrived; it wasn't their fault but the fault of our Parisian friend who booked us a double room instead of a double bed. We stayed the first night in this room and there was no problem moving to another. The first room looked over the Raspail, which is a very Parisian street; rooms at the back look over a school yard. The room was small, as are all Paris rooms, but clean, tidy, and comfortable. Bathroom was good except for the shower door which only went a third of the way across, leading us to unintentionally flood the bathroom! Again, not their fault! Location was great, lots of real Paris bars, restaurants, and cafes near by. Try the little Italian place downstairs. Take a left out of the hotel and the second left (I think) and you'll hit the cafes. There's also a great nearby bar called "Smoke", but bear in mind it is very smoky! Also very close to the Raspail subway station, a few stops up to the Eifel tower etc, and not many changes to get to the major shopping and sight seeing areas. All in all a good stay in a nice, average, clean hotel. It has a charm of its own.

author: teamHNH
title: Fell in love with Athens gate
text: This place is south of the hustle and bustle of town. They arranged everything for us as far as tropic air pick up, and a taxi was waiting for us at the airport. Also a golf cart was arranged for us at our condo. Upon arrival we had welcome drinks at the bar and Cindy and Rob were there to answer all of our questions. The condo was really nice and plenty big for four adults. The view we had was right on the ocean and we over looked the pool, bar and beach. The service was excellent at Athens the staff was very attentive and always willing to accommodate. They are full of recommendations of things to do and see as well. I would recommend getting a golf cart if you stay here as it’s about 20-30 min drive to go into town if you want to eat and or explore. There are some places within walking distance to Athens gate. The only two negatives were that the ac is set to 74 and you cannot make it cooler. It does get a little warm in the condo at night time. Also the wind was blowing about 15-30 mph for several days while we were there and the wind will howl through the condo 24/7. It kept us up at night a couple of nights. Other than that amazing place to stay and would be back for sure! Thanks Rob for all the yummy drinks!

author: margaretdQ1064IM
title: Early 2019 Trip
text: My parents stayed at Athens Gate in April of 2018. They loved it so much they decided to bring the rest of the family (me, my brother and sister) early 2019. It definitely lived up to the hype...we had SUCH a good time. The condo was beautiful, spacious, and equipped with everything we needed. I am very finicky when it comes to having enough space to feel comfortable in the bedrooms and bathrooms, and absolutely no complaints there. Everything worked perfectly and was very clean. Loved that there was a washer and dryer, too. The surrounding amenities (pool, bar area, beach) were just as perfect as the condo. Truly paradise. It never felt crowded, and always felt private and luxurious. You can take out paddle boards, snorkeling gear, fishing equipment, etc. There were ample beach chairs and umbrellas, and a full table on the beach with a grill if you felt like grilling out. Cindy and Rob were both incredibly informative and helpful in suggesting what to do and where to eat. Some of the drinks Rob made me were beyond anything I ever tried in the states (the strawberry madness). We also spent a day at sea with Captain Oliver snorkeling, fishing, and eating. That experience was amazing and well worth the price. We are a ski/snowboard family, so we usually take a trip to Colorado around this time of year. Traveling to Ambergris Caye and staying at Athens Gate instead was totally worth skipping the Colorado trip this year. I cannot say enough good things, and we will likely be back again in the future.

author: 773melodyt
title: Amazing relaxing resort with swim up pool bar!
text: We stayed in one of the privately owned 3 bedroom condos in this resort on our recent ladies trip. Everything was perfectly appointed, great amenities and very helpful staff. Cindy was very kind and helpful answering all our questions about the resort. She helped us to book our connecting flights from Belize, even helped us to rent a golf cart, and booked us a charter boat trip with Belize Master Tours (it was awesome and totes worth it btw!). The condo was very clean, kitchen stocked with coffee and basics, plenty of linens, even facial wipes, and all toiletries. Cindy was on site most days to answer questions and give us suggestions. Rob was a fantastic pool side bartender even letting us select whatever music we wanted to listen to and made us fantastic watermelon drinks. They have a private beach front area with loungers and even their own private dock. Very convenient if you decide to do a boat tour of some kind, they can pick you right up! Athens Gate is not quite in San Pedro town but I preferred staying just a few minutes away as it was really quiet and peaceful. It only took a few minutes on the golf cart to get into town to all the restaurants and shops. We were on the 4th floor and there was a wide, spiral staircase that was beautiful but it's a lot of stairs. We hired Carlos to drive us to and from the San Pedro airport and he helped with all our luggage so we didn't have to carry our bags up and down thankfully! Carlos is also great as he let us make a stop at the store when we were heading there from the airport. Highly recommend Athens gate for all considerations as they have various condos with different layouts and room counts.

author: jalynnashley
title: We will forever stay here!
text: This was our first time to Belize and I could not have picked a better place to stay. Our room was 5 feet from the main pool and our room was SO nice and clean. The staff at Athen's is incomparable anywhere else, I felt like the staff became friends of ours. They are very helpful with finding transportation, things to do, spa's to visit, where to get food whether that's groceries or eating out. One of the things we did not utilize is asking for groceries to be there when we arrived, next time we will use this for sure. We just did not know what we wanted at the time or what was even available on the island. I loved using the paddle board and the kayak, the beach front is maintained and the further you get away from shore the clearer the water gets! The water was SO clear, I have never seen anything like it before. The ONLY thing I would suggest is bring allergy medicine and the 100% deet small bottles if you go in May. A storm had came through a few days before we arrived and everywhere on the island had mosquitoes. Lucky for us, Athens gate had complimentary bug spray and sunscreen. One additional thing we loved is we had a golf cart for the entire stay and we were away from town about a 7 minute golf cart ride. It was great because it is peaceful and quiet at Athen's gate vs. when you are in town, I feel like the party goes on and on. We will be back in the next two years, we will not stay anywhere else it was THAT great.

author: ericjelinek
title: Great resort just far enough from town, but just close enough, too!
text: We did tons of research before our trip, and also had advice from friends that have been to Belize before. The four of us ended up choosing Athens Gate, and we were glad we did. The resort was awesome, and the rooms were great, but what really makes this place stand out is the people. Cindy is a rockstar, and can book any excursion you want to do ... and can give you the local low down and the what's what. Danny can make you the best drink ever, listen to you at the bar, and also tell you any local information you want to know. Luis, and the rest of the staff are just awesome. Cool people who really made our stay great. The views, the beach, the pier are all top notch as well. There is no food onsite, but that wasnt an issue at all. Lone Star right across the road has the best grub at great prices, or you can order from the resort next door... easy. One of our best trips ever, thanks to these people. Do we want to come back as soon as we can? You better Belize it!!

author: JonM3241
title: Great find in South San Pedro
text: What Athens Gate has earns it a 5 star review. Warm, friendly, attentive staff. All were very pleasant but three stood out: Cindy was very helpful booking activities and making dinner reservations, Danny making drinks and good recommendations for food, and Luis working the night shift and always having that coffee ready at 5:00 AM. The property itself is small (2 building, 6 units in each) but well maintained. We were 4th floor with great views. Our unit was nicely furnished with high ceilings and lots of lights and windows and a full kitchen. There is a poolside bar, lots of chairs to lounge in, and a few chairs out on the dock. Athens Gate loans bikes, kayaks, and paddleboards. There are things to be aware of as you plan your trip. As other guests have noted, there is no restaurant on site. We did not take advantage of having the refrigerator stocked (a returning guest suggested it). It is an easy walk to Pelican Reef (sister resort, decent food, slow service) and there are others in walking distance to choose from (Lone Star Cantina, Black Orchid, South Beach Cafe). Robin's delivers and their food is excellent. But you will want to rent a golf cart to get into town and have a wider selection of meals and shopping. Overall: great location, great staff, wonderful memories.

author: 271jeannier
title: Amazing stay at Athens Gate!
text: Just got back... We had a great trip! The condo was beautiful, large and super clean! It had everything you could possibly want... Flat screen tv in every room, washing machine and dryer, Stainless steel appliances: Frig, stove, microwave, coffee maker, and dishwasher. It even had a ninja blender! The staff was great too! Cindy helped us plan all excursions and was a great resource for everything else... places to eat and things to do. Daniel made some delicious drinks and even offered to cook the fish that they guys caught and did a great job! Everyone else was super helpful, polite, kind and extremely friendly. They even were able to accommodate my request for a large fan to help us sleep. I'm one of those crazy people who can't sleep without a fan... I really was happy with the location of the hotel too... We were 2.5 miles south of San Pedro in a quiet strip of beach. We still had several restaurant options easily accessible to us... Specifically, The Lone Star, Black Orchid, and Victoria house... In the morning my husband and son would hop on the golf cart and head to The Baker for delicious pastries.

author: R6527CUdonnar
title: 4 night stay at Athens Gate
text: We flew to San Pedro after a three night stay in San Ignacio. Athens Gate is 2.5 miles from town. We stayed in a beautiful two bedroom, two bath condo. It was incredibly spacious and completely furnished. I wished we could have stayed there longer than two nights.The staff was so accommodating, friendly, and treated you like family. Special mention to Cindy who took care of all excursions and plans and communicated with us so wonderfully before we arrived, to Danny, the bartender, who not only made us fabulous drinks, but, made excellent restaurant recommendations, phoned restaurants for us, and even shared his delicious Belizean stewed chicken lunch with us and showed us how to make it! And lastly, to Luis,night time security, who was so warm, friendly and always there with his flashlight when we needed him! We were on the top floor, which provided exquisite views and a lovely breeze on our spacious veranda, but we hiked a lot of stairs to get there. There are no elevators so ask for a lower suite if stairs are a problem. There is no restaurant on site but, two are located waling distance and very short golf cart ride away. Expect dirt roads for some of your journey and some paved roads. Everyone gets around on a golf cart. Cindy will send you information on renting them. Downtown San Pedro is relatively large and worth exploring. You could also get a taxi if you are interested in just going to certain restaurants downtown. Lunch and breakfast can be delivered or you can take a very short walk down the beach to their sister place, Pelican Reef. Lunch was delivered poolside for us one day and was delicious. Be sure to walk down the dock and relax in one of the chaise lounges. The view is spectacular and the breeze is better. Athens Gate left me wishing I could have stayed longer!

author: DadOnRed
title: Pleasant, Quiet Setting, beautiful room views, nice balcony!
text: Great staff, very helpful and earnest, but professional. Welcoming place. Nice view with a pier that got you away from the pool noise, if that’s your thing. This is a simple place with nicely maintained rooms. Beautiful setting with palm trees and nice places to relax. Definitely not overcrowded due to the size. 4 adults in a 3 bedroom / 2 bath. Two distractors: oven wouldn’t work and issues with leaky fridge. Appliances seemed new, not sure what the deal was. Staff made sure we had bottled water and ice. They sent staff up 3x to check oven, but had to make do with alternative dining plans. Be prepared for a bumpy ride into town but that’s par for the course on the south side. Diving companies picked up at the pier, manta rays hang out at the pier, beautiful sunrise/sunset. Pleasant staff. Couple of restaurants in walking distance and a simple market also nearby.

author: G1618DZseanb
title: Beautiful setting, amazing service
text: Stayed with my wife and daughter. First, while the hotel is somewhat remote (requiring travel over dirt roads), we felt this added to the quaintness, quiet, and sense of seclusion. The hotel is attractive and very clean. The rooms were humongous, much larger than we needed, with a separate room and bathroom for our daughter, and a large living room From our porch we had a wonderful view of the beach and water. There isn’t a restaurant, but the sister property very close by serves a delicious breakfast and lunch. The best part about this hotel is the staff! They were all extremely friendly and willing to go out of their way to help. Cindy is very knowledgeable and a problem-solver, organizing tours, scheduling your day, and making dinner reservations, all with a smile. Danny was a friendly and charming bartender, flexible with the type of individual tastes desired, never pushy with alcohol. Denice (“the menace”) was a true factotum, sweeping the grounds, cleaning the pool, taking your luggage, putting up hammocks, pulling down a coconut to eat, and even escorting my daughter around—he was so friendly and caring, asking about my daughter when she was sick! Even the night-time security guard, Louis, was attentive and available, shining a flashlight on the golf cart so I could lock it properly. Apparently he would clean it daily! At the end he wrote us a note on a large, beautiful shell that we could take home. This kind of service is outstanding! While you will find cheaper properties or those with more amenities, this is the place to stay!

author: arivera11082
title: Amazing!! 5 Star!!
text: Athens Gate in San Pedro, Ambergris Caye Belize (Central American) is amazing! We were a family of 7 staying here (5 adults and 2 children) and we Loved it! Right on the beach! Poool! Bar! Bar connects to the pool :) the service is Great! They take really good care of you there. Cindy and her team went above and beyond and were extremely helpful. You can book all your tours right there at the hotel. Rooms are clean and spacious. The rooms come with everything you need and more! Not to mention that they are beautifully decorated. I miss this place already. I would recommend renting a golf cart which the hotel can also help you with. This is nice to have while staying on and exploring the Island. Ps. You receive a free welcome drink when you arrive at Athens Gate! The Belize Punch is really good! The Hotel has Pool toys, giant jenga, actual tv channels, wifi, and other games. I highly recommended this place and would definitely stay here again.

author: DKP66
title: An Exceptional Little Slice of Paradise
text: We did a lot of research into the many options to stay for our honeymoon on Ambergris Caye and finally decided on Athens Gate. Wow - we couldn't be more pleased with our choice! First and foremost are the great people! It all started with Shannon who helped answer all our questions when making the reservation and coordinate our flight out to the island and reserving our initial excursions. Once we arrived the entire staff was incredible with a lot of personalized attention. We really hit it off with William, the pool bartender. You really do need to take him up on the beach BBQ. He made a killer conch ceviche along with lobster, fish, potatoes, corn and of course rice and beans - fantastic!! Since it was off season, we were sharing the resort with only one other couple most of the time and really had the feeling it was our own exclusive retreat. The rooms (actually they are pretty much full size condos/apartments) are large, clean and come with all the amenities you need including full kitchen and washer/dryer. We liked the fact that we were a bit south and more secluded away from town. However, town is only a short golf cart ride away whenever you want to head up (we took advantage of going to town to sample several recommended restaurants and shopping). There is a nice little grocery store nearby and we stocked up early on for breakfast and lunch items. William also brought us journey cakes a couple of times from a great local place on his way in to work. On site, you can enjoy the pool, relaxing on the loungers, or take out the complimentary kayak, paddle board, or snorkeling equipment. The dock is brand new and great for sitting out on the end to enjoy the sunrise coming up in the morning. For shore excursions, this is where you are picked up for the shuttle down to San Pedro and then the quick flight over to the mainland. When we had some cancellations due to weather (there was some worry that Tropical Storm Nate would strand returning flights from the mainland) the staff got us seamlessly rescheduled on the next available date. BTW - highly recommend the Lamanai excursion and cave tubing as well! Thank you E., William, Luis, Dennis, and the rest of the Athens Gate staff for an unforgettable experience and a fantastic honeymoon!

author: jbarber2017
title: Much nicer than your home....much nicer.
text: Our 2 bedroom condo at Athens Gate was amazingly plush. From the exquisite wood work to the cool to the touch tile work, GREAT accommodations. Fantastic ocean views for each room, and a nice pool with a wade up bar, both of which help to cool off. The service offered was always genuine and enthusiastic. William, E and Glen were great setting up trips for scuba diving or fishing add-hoc cart rental. Once we found the "second", or was it the third remote, we had access to Netflix and TV channels. Literally, the only downside that we experienced was the distance into town. We normally stay close to the "down town" when we go on vacations and walk everywhere. Colorado folks tend to walk a lot. The solution to the distance is to get a golf cart. You will need to rent a cart to go just about anywhere. There are two restaurants that are very close by, Black Orchid (100 yards) and Lone Star (across the "street"). There is also a small grocery story (200 yards) that has the essentials.... beer, bread, eggs, sausage and M&Ms even. All of the snorkeling, scuba and fishing trip providers will pick you up at the Athens Gate dock, so you will not need a cart to get into town for those types of activities.

author: drewfine
title: flip flops and golf carts makes for a relaxing week!
text: We visited Athens Gate the first week of June 2017 for a large extended family trip. We had 13 people including children ages 2,4,5,7,10,12 and adults and grandparents. We rented the first two floors of the 3 bedroom condos in the building closest to the beach. Both rooms were excellent and everything at the resort was very convenient to let the kids out and about. We liked the first floor unit better than the second due to the furnishings but both were very nice and spacious for our group. Everything from booking to pick up to payment was very easy. We were actually supposed to go last year but had to move due to the hurricane and Athens Gate was very accommodating. We had them set up diving and snorkeling which was excellent. I would trust their suggestions and recommendations. We loved renting golf carts and waking up every morning to go to the bakery in town (10 min ride or so) and stopping at the fruit stand. The grocery store on the south side of town is very good as well. The team at Athens Gate was helpful with restaurant recommendations too. We enjoyed Black Orchid (more expensive but right outside...excellent cocount rice!), Caliente in town (great for kids), Waruguma for local type fare and great rotisserie chicken, and Elvis Kitchen for a classic. E had an option to cook a big family style BBQ at the resort which was amazing. Ask him for the best tortillas too It was very windy while we were there so we went up to secret beach which is a long bumpy ride but worth the experience. The kids did some snorkeling off the pier, we took akyak rides, and loved the pool. There is some really cool beach art at a house about 3/4 mile south as well which was fun to walk to. All in all its a great week when you wear flip flops and drive a golf cart all over and stay in such a nice resort and complex.

author: alfonsovisaya
title: A Sterling Staff of Real People
text: Firstly, Glen greeted us. A Canadian by background, he ensured our immediate relaxation after a red-eye, after-midnight transfer, discomforting taxi ride, bouncy and over-crowded boat ride, a relieving taxi ride, and Glen's greeting; he made us all a drink. We traveled with five adults, my grown children and a friend. Then the next day, we settled in by buying groceries for our suite and planning a group excursion. We snorkeled Hol Chan and Shark Ray Alley with Carlos, the glass-bottom boat pilot. Between Eliazar and William, two of the concierges, the connection felt flawless. Carlos impressed us to our utmost expectations. Then William arranged a tour of ruins on the mainland very close to Guatemala with Dario and Baldemer. Those guys made sure of our comfort all the way through the day, including passage among our points of destination. After a 13 hour day, Dario and Baldemer had shown us Maya ruins, an inner tube float through a cave river system, and the Belize Zoo, as well as safe and early passage back to the ferry that brought us back to San Pedro. Between events, we tended to plan among ourselves for the next trip while dining and drinking in the local foods, both in the suite and in restaurants. Then Eliazar booked a spear fishing and snorkeling half-day trip right out in front of our resort that gained us fish as well as lobster. We dined in luxury that night, cooking our own gourmet preferences (all five of us cook) with the local fare. Today is our last day and reluctantly, we know we can book a taxi to the docks in San Pedro as well as the taxi to the airport through Eliazar and William. We loved this trip for its comfort, its conscience around our security, and its fastidious classiness. Definitely worth the expenditure.

author: Likestolive
title: UnBelizable
text: Very nice place to stay; washer & dryer was a bonus; owners very friendly as well has the staff. There is nothing the staff can't or won't do. Down right good people. Pool was kept clean and the poolside bar is a plus. There are rest rooms above the bar. The beach is small, but so are all the other beaches in the area. Beach was always clean. Our group of 5 stayed in #3, a 3 bedroom, 2 bath, full size kitchen with most everything you would need in a kitchen. Very minor problem was the smaller bathroom shower did not put out hardly a drop. Several other rooms also indicated the same issue. Master worked great. Athens Gate is on the South end of the island. It's a trip to town but not bad. Dive/snorkel guides will pick you up at your pier. No on site restaurant but several good ones well within walking distance.

author: 542jakes
title: Awesome place-great location & fantastic rooms
text: This is a fantastic place to stay. We will definitely come back. We stayed in a 3 bedroom overlooking the water. We had our two children (9 and 11). The rooms were amazing, the location is perfect, and the service was wonderful. We really enjoyed being a bit out of the craziness of downtown San Pedro but close enough that we could enjoy dinner in town every night. It has a nice beach area that is well maintained from sea grass (and a lot of other places don't keep up with sea grass). The pool was great -- basically on the beach overlooking the ocean and with a swim up bar. We really enjoyed jumping off the dock as they keep a little swimming area clear of sea grass. For those that like to swim in the ocean this is a must stay in Belize as some of the other places don't have that option given the proximity of the reef and sea grass buildup. The rooms are amazing. They are very modern, spacious, and well maintained. We had one overlooking the ocean with a huge balcony and lots of windows. The beds were very comfortable. We didn't cook a ton -- just breakfast and occasional lunch -- so we didn't maximize use of the appliances, etc but they had everything you would need if you want to cook regularly. The team supporting Athens Gate was fantastic. They helped us with every small thing, including recommendations, dinner reservations, snorkel reservations, renting a golf cart, airfare to/from the jungle, and tax to/from San Pedro airport. They are extremely friendly. Definitely stay at this place (we will come back for sure).

author: bagswife
title: Best Accommodations on the Island
text: This was around our 10th trip to Athens Gate. We have stayed at other places on the island (as well as other locations throughout the Caribbean) but always come back to AG. The condos are beautiful, well appointed and the service is unsurpassed anywhere on the island (or any other country we have been to). Everything you could possibly need is taken care of. Eliazar, Will, Dennis and Glenn are there to handle everything for you and make your vacation relaxing and stress free. As for the units we have stayed in multiple units 3 bedroom and 2 bedroom and all are decorated nicely and have all accommodations you would need. The units on the upper floors have the most spectacular view of the ocean. 4th floor has almost a 360 degree view of the island ocean and bay. Of all the units #8 (2 bedroom) is my personal favorite I love the outdoor furniture, great decor and amazing view. However keep in mind we have stayed in 7 of the 12 units. No matter where you stay you can't go wrong. What makes this place so special are the people. Eliazar has been at AG since the beginning and provides excellent service every time. We have sent many people to AG and no one ever leaves without planning to come back! This complex is quiet, safe and you will be treated like family. Counting the days till we return! See you there!

author: SeeitAll728
title: Luxury on the Beach
text: Athens Gate was very special thanks to an amazing staff, peaceful location, a well-appointed unit, and an amazing view! Glenn arranged the best activities for our family. Scuba diving and snorkeling nearby offered an up-close view of thousands of colorful fish. Our third-floor unit had a beautiful sunrise view from a large, private patio. The features and furnishings were perfect with a large, functional kitchen, a dining area that seated six, two large bathrooms, two bedrooms and a large living room where we played games late at night. The beds and furniture were comfortable. We were delighted to find a washer and dryer in the unit, a treat to wash swimsuits and other items while on vacation. There were a couple minor glitches - leaky dishwasher and washing machine. The repairman's attitude made me relax, "You're on vacation - leave the dishes for our staff to clean." We were able to take our golf cart to a local market and vegetable stand to get food for breakfasts and lunches, as well as some beer and wine for happy hour and late nights. There are a couple restaurants within walking distance, but we found better dinner options in San Pedro, which was about 20 minutes away by golf cart. Better yet, ask Glenn to arrange a boat trip that includes snorkeling, fishing for your own food, and a beachside cookout with the fish and lobster you catch! There's a nice pool with a swim-up bar where you'll find the friendliest bartender, who serves awesome tequila shots. Even the night security man was amazing. He helped us set up a kayak in predawn dark so we could kayak out on the water to watch an amazing sunrise. Finally, the location is perfect. We appreciated that Athens Gate is close enough to San Pedro so we could enjoy the restaurants, culture and activities. Yet it's far enough away to be a peaceful refuge. Belize is magical!

author: 383camik
title: Beautiful property and great customer service
text: My parents, my sister-inlaw, my husband, my baby and myself stayed at this property over Christmas through the New Year. My husband and I are avid travelers and have stayed at many 4 star hotels, but this place by far exceeded our expectations. This property/ Rooms were VERY clean, the bathrooms were very clean/ spacious, the kitchen was fully stocked will all the cooking essentials, there was plenty of seating in the common areas to accommodate the 6 people staying in the room, and the staff was beyond helpful and friendly. Glen at the front desk was an amazing host and very knowledgeable about tours/ excursions and places to go visit in town. He helped book us 3 different excursion: Cave Tubing, Snorkeling in the Blue Hole, and the YOLO Chill/ drinking cruise where we got to snorkel at Hol Chan. All 3 excursions exceeded our expectation and I highly recommend anyone visiting Belize at least check those three out. The security guards would come up to our room the morning of each excursion to give us our vouches and to escort us to the boat that was waiting to take us away for the day. There is a security guard on staff 24- hours a day which made us feel extra safe. I also want to mention that the hotel has very good communication with its guests. A couple weeks before our arrival, we got an email from the hotel offering to help us arrange transportation from the Belize City airport to San Pedro (the airport on Ambergist Caye) and a hotel transfer from San Pedro Airport to the hotel. The hotel is about 2.5 miles outside the main city of San Pedro which is in an excluded part of town. We had to rent a golf cart for our 8 day stay which came out to around $275. The only way to get around the island is by golf cart or walking, and its too far from town to walk. The two restaurants near the hotel (Lone Star and Black Orchid) didn't have good food, so it was essential to have a golf cart in order to get to the town every day for food/ grocery store/ restaurants/ bars/ night life. Personally since I was traveling with family, I enjoyed stayed outside of town because the town can get lively and noisy at night. I will for sure stay at this hotel again the next time I come to visit Belize!

author: MelMacAustinTexas
title: Paradise
text: We had a blast- went with 4 families with kids ranging from 6-15 and everyone of us had a great time. The rooms are spacious and very comfortable- with daily housekeeping- and a very well equipped kitchen. Athens Gate is also beautifully situated on a stunning little beach. The staff were kind and helpful and the Pina Coladas outstanding. They have bikes, scuba gear, paddle boards and kayaks readily available. I particularly liked that the hotel is small and a bit out of town. It was quiet and safe. We rented a golf cart to get to town (super fun) and did a tour on a catamaran- both arranged by the hotel- We hired a local chef ( also arranged by the hotel) Ms Coy- to make dinner 3 of the 5 nights. She was fabulous and it was so convenient. She does make a lot of food so we had lunch leftovers- her cevichi is a must! My only point of improvement for this hotel are the steps- when it rains they are extremely slippery. We could not let the kids walk on them alone. Also know there are a lot so if that's a problem for you be sure to request a lower room. Be sure to wander down the beach to see the sculptures made by Dewayne- they are fun. Also a nice little snorkeling area two docks down- also nice.

author: B9912WAkatieh
title: Don't look anywhere else! You found the best hotel in Belize!
text: I came here for a mother/daughter trip. I was so pleased with Athens Gate. They made it so easy. If we wanted to lounge around the pool and beach all day, they catered to us. If we wanted to go for an adventure, they booked it for us. The hotel is very safe. Luis is the security guard at night and is very friendly. I felt extremely safe there. I couldn't believe how much space we had in the hotel! We had a full kitchen with all the cooking utensils, pots and pans that you'd need to cook just about anything. We also had fresh caught fish for dinner one night. We drank the water from the filtered fridge and had absolutely zero issues with it. It's very clean. You can make Athens Gate whatever you want: a girls trip, a family trip, or a romantic getaway for a couple. I highly recommend this hotel.

author: ashtalks
title: Ideal for families, great people; rent a cart!
text: This is a great place to stay on Ambergris Caye. We would come back again happily. Here are some tips that may be useful to know: - the people here are awesome. If you want to do any activities while here, tell them when you book, and let them organise for you; there are many benefits. For example, if you book a trip to Hol Chan, the boat will meet you here at the hotel pier (saving you thirty minutes each way). - the rooms are very generous. We took a three bedroom, and it was more of a family apartment. Great to have a kitchen and laundry too. - if you have kids, this is a great place. Safe, lots of sand (many places don't actually have a beach on the Caye) and fun activities (kayaking, paddle boarding etc). - the rooms higher up are more private; conversely, if you have kids who want instant access to beach, pool etc, ground floor may appeal. - Rent a cart. It is too far to walk anywhere useful. And because there is no restaurant here (though Lone Star is just across the road) you will want to able to go into San Pedro each day to eat and get supplies. Driving is easy and fun! Again, let the staff here book a cart for you and it will be waiting here when you arrive. Thanks again, E, William, Glen and Luis S: you made our stay fantastic.

author: jfisher1501
title: 5star service and the ultimate hospitality experience
text: Well it started as our honeymoon trip, after researching many different locations on the island we opted for Athens gate a smaller boutique style property. It was the best choice we have ever made. From the moment we arrived we were greeted by William and given a complimentary drink and towels soaked in eucalyptus to cool you down on a hot caribbean day. William insisted that he take care of everything, he carried our heavy bags up four flights of stairs gave us an introductory tour of our new apartment for the next two weeks. They had a bottle of champagne chilling in the fridge, the master bed covered in flowers, it was so special and tasteful. After checking in and relaxing William was down tending bar he kept the drinks flowing and makes an incredible blended coconut mint mojito. Our vacation lasted for a total of 13 days, we opted to rent a golf cart as you will need one to explore the island. Elizar or "E" is the manager of the complex he is the man that will book you anything you need and coordinate anything you need from sailing excursions, diving, snorkeling, beach bbq, mainland excursions to the ruins and even can call a masseuse to your room for a balcony massage or beachfront. When I say these guys know everyone and everything about the island I mean it. Glen is also a really professional and knowledgeable member of the staff he is the really tall one from Canada and will teach you all the provinces if you want to know them, LOL your awesome Glen. The guys here are so humble and welcoming and just want you to relax and enjoy your time. We would sometimes see the guys out in town relaxing and enjoying the island on their days off and even when you see them then they treat you like family. There were a few times we would bump into them and have a drink and some really good conversations. Also I must mention Louise is the nighttime watch (security from 7pm-7am) its not that they need to keep the grounds safe, but if there is anything you need Louise will assist in any way he can. The sunsets early and sometimes if you find yourself lounging on the beach at night Louise will join you for genuine conversations or not, they are all good at non verbal communication and reading peoples body language and genuine interest to engage or relax. The over the top welcoming hospitality is not a show these guys are the real deal and for someone who works in hotels and hospitality I definitely learned a few things we could use in the states. Last words to William, E, Glen, Louise and Dennis when we come back we refuse to stay anywhere else, My wife had tears as we left because she felt as if we were leaving our family. Thank you everyone at Athens gate.

author: Cheepskates
title: Intimate, and fun place to stay.
text: We arrived a bit late expecting very little. We were greeted by three of the staff (E., William and Lewis). They were ready to bring our bags to our room and serve us a great rum punch. In the morning they were there again to show us everything we needed to see around Athens Gate. Our 2 bedroom unit was well equipped and fully updated. So comfortable. Hurricane Earl hit during our stay yet we never felt unsafe. We were told how to prepare and provided water. After the storm cleared all of the staff immediatly went to work to clean up the damage left in the wake. They were exhausted yet remained patient and friendly with all of the guests. E. even took time out to plan a snorkel trip for several of us. William made the best ceviche after we bought fresh lobster and red snapper from a local fisherman. They have a new employee Dennis who stole our hearts. Always smiling and always working. The pier was destroyed by the hurricane but I am hopeful that it will be rebuilt soon because we truly enjoyed fishing off the pier and watching the sunset on the hammock. Thanks Athens Gate for a super time!

author: BIGLIFE
title: HURRICANE EARL !!
text: HURRICANE EARL hit and hit hard !! But Athens Gate is fine and ready for business. Lori takes care of the reservations and can help you with different requests. E will take care of you when you arrive. If you want to go fishing, diving etc. He will get your golf cart or anything else you need. William is the one behind the bar, he makes some great drinks. The pool is really nice for a 12 unit resort. The beach area is really nice too. A golf cart will be a must for you. You are too far away to do without one, you will want to get groceries and go to dinner. The decks are the best part. I love a big deck over looking both the beach and the pool area. Our last visit to the island was our 7th or 8th or so and our second trip to Athens Gate. I've searched the island over for the best place with the best price to stay and in my opinion ATHENS GATE is the place for us and you will love it too.

author: StacyWtx
title: Fantastic Family Vacation in Belize
text: Just returned from 6 wonderful nights at Athens Gate!! Prior to arriving, I had personal assistance with getting questions answered, booking flights to the island, and renting a golf cart. Once we arrived, we could not believe how beautiful our suite was!!! It was exceptionally large, impeccably decorated, and oh the view of the Caribbean!!! (I earned mom bonus points with my boys when they saw how huge and nice the suite was!!) It was then that we met E and William. They were truly awesome ~ assisting with anything we needed, going above and beyond, booking excursions, and let's not forget the drinks at the pool bar made by William!!!! The personal service you will receive is unlike anything I've experienced at other hotels/resorts! The atmosphere at Athens Gate was perfect for our family. It's a small, boutique style resort - no huge crowds. We enjoyed the pool daily and when we ventured out for excursions, we were picked up right at the Athens Gate Pier. We used the kayaks provided by the resort several times too. The hammocks in the water added an awesome touch!! You will not be disappointed with your stay at Athens Gate! Needless to say, we were sad to leave. My 9 year old is still talking about his buddy William (hey William ~ Whiskey Man says Hello!!!). We had such a positive experience that we are looking at property on Ambergris Caye! Thank you Athens Gate for assisting with some great family memories!

author: anotherstampinmybook
title: BEAUTIFUL, RELAXING, PEACEFUL, A SLICE OF HEAVEN!
text: I couldn't recommend this place any more! Please remember when booking stays you truly get what you pay for! Our stay was amazing! It was so much more than we expected. The resort itself is VERY clean. It is spacious and extremely well taken care of. The cleaning staff came up everyday and made the beds and picked up. The bartenders, E and William were AMAZING!!! They both arranged for all of our excursions (which picked us up directly from the dock). Louis, the evening security guard was the nicest person we've ever met! I would be prepared to do your research on food. There is a small cafe within walking distance, The LoneStar and The Pelican Reef. You may want to rent a golf cart, which William or E can arrange. :) We will definitely go back! I would highly recommend that you take the TropicAir flight over instead of the boat taxi. We took the boat taxi over and it was in the evening and was very crowded and hot. We took TropicAir back and it was 14 minute ride to the airport vs. 90 mins of being squished like a sardine.

author: E6289COscotta
title: AWESOME! Trip of a lifetime!
text: We stayed January 16-23rd of 2016. Not sure where to start....but in the end we came home thinking this was the most epic trip ever. We traveled with our 4 kids ages 11, 7, 6 and 3 and also my parents. The accommodations were fabulous. The master bedroom was huge and there was plenty of room for the kids. Eliazar or "E" took good care of everything we needed including arranging our tour to Lamanai, a two tank scuba dive & family snorkel trips with Tuff E Nuff, a 1/2 day fishing trip for the boys and all of the taxi rides on the island and on the mainland. Soto the bartender was also awesome! He cooked up the fish that we caught off of the dock and also the Barracuda from our fishing excursion two nights in a row. Stuffed Barracuda was sooooo good! He took all of our fish and cooked them up 5 or 6 different ways so we could experience all the styles Belize has to offer. As for the kids they had fun playing on the beach and at the pool which we seemed to have all to our selves and they can't stop talking about the snorkeling. Even my 3 year old was able to do it. We loved having a full kitchen as eating out with 8 people wasn't the easiest. Golf cart is a must for this location. We did a grocery run at the beginning of the week and if we needed anything Marin's Mini mart is right around the corner. We did eat out a Waraguma's, Pepperoni's, The Reef Restaurant, Neri's tacos and the restaurant almost across from the resort. All were excellent The only drawbacks of the trip were I couldn't afford to fly a family of six to the caye and back so we had to take the boat to the mainland and taxi to the airport and a few bug bites for those who didn't have bug spray on. And of course "E" and Soto always had some of that available too. Can't wait to come back!

author: J852OKkellyl
title: Two night stay at Athens Gate
text: We had a great stay at Athens Gate. We took a water taxi from Belize City that took about 1.5 hours and then a cab from downtown San Pedro to the hotel (about $25 BZ). The hotel is located about 2.5 miles south of downtown where we docked from the water taxi. We were a bit confused when we arrived because we looked for a traditional "lobby check in" but instead the friendly property manager/bartender, E, took care of us as there was none! There were only two of us so our accommodations were large, but not complaining! There was a full living room, dining area, kitchen, washer/dryer, two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, PLUS! A beautiful balcony with furniture facing the ocean. Had we stayed more than two nights, we probably would have taken advantage of the kitchen and done a grocery run. Everything was clean and comfy. E was very helpful in (making us delicious rum punch) but also how to get certain places and with general knowledge of the island. We have already talked about getting some friends together in the future to vacation here. There are only two restaurants very close, otherwise you have to walk or cab a little bit to get to your destination. Try the Black Orchid! Only thing constructive for the property was the wifi was a little shaky, maid service showed up late in the afternoon (which we declined because we weren't expecting at all at that point) and ESPN was blurry on the TV....and to be honest that was only my boyfriend that minded about that one! :) Overall, great stay. If you're looking for a quiet, independent and relaxing getaway - this is your spot!

author: Willis6866
title: A great experience
text: Honestly, this place was one to remember. From the staff, to the room, to just the AWESOME service, this was definitely a place to stay when on Ambergris Caye. Eliazar, I can't say enough about this guy!! He was not only understanding, empathetic, and accommodating, he provided service that was top notch and with a personal touch!! It was my birthday this weekend, and he made sure to the best of his abilities it was one to remember (which I wanted because it's my 30th!) He got in contact with tour guides, accommodated me getting, and had my birthday drinks ready without another thought!! I can't say enough, but I don't want write a novel. Lori, the owner (I believe) who was in constant contact with me was a wealth of information and was stellar in answering my multiple questions and even arranging my flight from the mainland to the island…and she didn't even charge extra!! It was the same price as the TropicAir website. So observing this, you see that this establishment is truly looking to help and not beat you for your money. The grounds were cleaned and well maintained. I heard of how there is seaweed in places, which you did see on other beachfronts of resorts but not this one!! This shows they take pride in their maintenance and pride in their property. Overall, this experience was great. If and more so when I come back to Belize, I would really come back! It was an experience of a lifetime.

author: sidney7474
title: Perfection!!
text: From my first inquiry , to our check out, every aspect of service was perfect. Lori, in reservations was so I quick to respond to all of my questions. She booked our flight from belize city, arranged for our transportation to and from the San pedro airport and had a gold cart waiting for us at the resort. Upon arrival Jamee greeted us with towels and a complimentary drink. Our room was was spacious, had a large balcony overlooking the beach. The kitchen is gorgeous, with everything you could need. The resort is lovely and quiet. The location is an easy golf cart ride into town. You can walk to 3 restaurants from the resort. There is a nice dock with a lovely area to hang out at the end of the dock. The beach is full of Seagrass ( every beach on the island has this) , so it's not great for swimming. You can swim at the end of the dock and the water is clear and pretty. Jamee and E were around all of the time, they make you any drink you want and can arrange for any excursions that you would like to do. They both were exceptional. Let them advise you on great places to eat and things to do. We really loved our time at Athens Gate!

author: Cestlaviii
title: Loved our rooms!
text: We went with a group of friends and got two two bedroom suites... They were huge! And clean! We could have all just stayed in one! Loved the open areas, where we could all sit and talk and hang out. The dining table and kitchen were also very spacious. There was a washer and dryer, but no laundry detergent. However, the dryer came in handy when we wanted to dry our swimsuits quickly. The balcony was huge and had a table and chairs for us to hang out and enjoy the view. The staff was very friendly. Loved the pool. Only thing is that you can't really walk anywhere. In order to get into town, you'd have to take a cab (about $10 usd) or take a golf cart. It's about 10 minutes away. There are about 2 restaurants nearby though, if you wanted to get some food closeby. The wifi was pretty slow, but did work (somewhat) by the pool as well, so that was nice. Overall, loved it. Would stay again!

author: lanteik
title: Great Experience
text: My husband and I stayed here October 16 - 22. I can't say enough good things about this place or the staff. We will be staying here every time we visit Belize. Positives: - E and Jami were excellent from the minute we arrived until we departed. They booked all of our excursions and even a chef to make us dinner on our anniversary (which was excellent). - The view was breathtaking. Enjoyed walking and relaxing on the beach and walking down the pier. - The environment was quiet and relaxing. It is positioned away from downtown and is a smaller resort. - The room we stayed in was amazing. It was a 2 bedroom with an excellent view of the beach. The only negative was having to walk the stairs up to the 4th floor. By the end of the trip, we were tired of walking up and down the stairs. Next time we will request a lower floor. I also recommend renting a golf cart to get around. Thank you to everyone at Athens Gate for making our trip so great!!

author: eolinec
title: A Touch of Paradise
text: We have stayed in hotels and condos all over the world; however, our stay at Athens Gate was by far, the best of the best! My husband and I were celebrating his birthday and our anniversary. We stayed in a two bedroom on the top (4th) floor - it was magnificent - kind-of like sitting on top of the world overlooking the pool and the ocean. E, the property manager, was truly like a best friend - he was so helpful and thoughtful. Imagine my surprise when I opened the refrigerator and found a bottle of champagne and two glasses to help us celebrate - courtesy of E! E also serves as the bar tender and makes a magnificent Margarita. There are only 12 units and each one is beautifully furnished. In the kitchen and baths, you have granite countertops, upscale appliances, and very tasteful furnishings. The master bath has a Jacuzzi tub, as well as a huge walk-in shower. Everything you could possibly need, including washer/dryer with soap and an iron and ironing board! Others have commented on the distance from town. We rented a golf cart, right at the resort, and were never more than 10 minutes from downtown. In fact, the location is perfect and you feel like you’re actually part of a neighborhood, instead of a resort with a thousand other people. We dined at the neighborhood restaurants: Black Orchid (our favorite) and the Lone Stare and Island Time for casual meals. We also ventured out to the north end of the Caye and tried several other fun eating establishments. Thank you to Lori for working with me to make the arrangements and to E for taking care of our every request and need. We will be back!

author: PilotsWife27
title: A Little Piece of Heaven
text: WE LOVED ATHEN'S GATE because it really is a special place! They only have 12 rooms that are all either 2 or 3 bedrooms and are all oceanfront. We prefer smaller places because we find them more relaxing. People often say in reviews that they can't imagine staying anywhere else and that is the case with us and Athen's Gate. This was our first visit to Belize so we did go look at some of the other properties that we were considering booking and were VERY happy that we ended up at Athen's Gate. As everyone says, "E" the onsite manager is great. He booked a fishing trip for us and then he and Javier cooked our catch and it really was the best meal we had on the island. Ruth was also great. Lori's family owns the hotel and she and her husband run it. She booked our rooms and couldn't have been nicer or more helpful. The rooms are very large, well-appointed and have huge balconies. The property is 10-15 minutes outside of town by golf cart which was no big deal at all. We were very happy about this and would not have wanted to stay in town, again because we like more peaceful, relaxing places. The awesome dive shop we used, Belize Pro-Dive Center, picked us up at the Athen's Gate dock as did the fishing trip guy so it is very convenient. There are a few restaurants that are an easy walk from the hotel. Lone Star, Black Orchid and Island Time are average but the restaurant at Victoria House was really nice.

author: stacyh78
title: Amazing week with Great Friends!
text: Athens Gate was even better than expected! We had the three bedroom condo on the third floor, and traveled with two other couples. The stairs were a little brutal after a long day or night out on the town but the view was worth it! The only downfall of the room was that the 3rd bedroom was substancially smaller than the other two and had two twin beds, however they put them together for us and it worked great! E and Ruth were awesome, so helpful and great company when we hung around the pool or bar. Everything we needed or had questions about they answered and took care of! They got the 6 seater golf cart rented, had our travel arranged, and our excursions which was great! We did the Mayan Ruins and Cave Tubing excursion and that was awesome, long day but worth it! We also did the sunset catamaran cruise and that was INCREDIBLE especially for $60 per person. We definitely do that again next time! Food was great, we learned quickly that you can split most meals. Hidden Treasures was our highlight, live music and awesome food and drinks. Lonestar across the street was a bust, we are also from Texas so we may be harder to please but service was lacking as well. Palapa bar was great, a must go but pretty far from the hotel although a scenic drive in the golf cart. The seaweed was very bad when we were there but is not normally that way, we are excited to go back and see it without the seaweed! We will be back for sure and loved every minute of our trip to San Pedro!!!!

author: 2canadiangirls
title: Amazing Accomodation
text: The accommodation was simply amazing. The finishings were stellar. We stayed in a two bedroom condo. Overall, we LOVED it but we were disappointed by three things. None of these things are directly related to Management but we figured it's on a "good to know" basis for travelers. 1) The second bedroom. Although beautifully decorated, be advised that the second bedroom is considerably smaller than the master. It's fine if you were a couple with one child but this could definitely create an issue between two couples or even two single friends. The master was stunning, spacious with an amazing ensuite. The interior designer was well picked. We'd love to know where the furniture was bought as it was so lovely and sophisticated. 2) there is no restaurant onsite but there is a minimart and restaurants nearby. 3) Most of the island's coastline is suffering from a sea weed erosion issue as such, their beach is overtaken by sea weed. The pictures of the beach on the website do not represent the current situation. The beach sand is also hard-packed and fairly stoney. Other than that, we made use of the beach bicycles and the kayaks. Both were good fun. Ruth and E are cool and helpful. We would definitely return at a time when the beach returns to normal.

author: mykae
title: LOVED ATHENS GATE!
text: Loved the view from the condo! The pool was cleaned every morning! Very relaxing! Pamela (Housekeeper) always made sure it was clean and she was very polite! The staff is AMAZING! E was a big help! He recommended great places to eat. Ruth was extremely nice! Those two together always took good care of us. Drinks, Beer, Recommendations! Javier was a great groundskeeper and also a big help! He, E , and Ruth made sure our vacation was great! Very Helpful staff! Lori was very sweet as was Greg! Definitely will be back to that property! Definitely recommend getting a golf cart to go into town! Try the late night taco stand in the center, across from Jaguars! Be sure to walk down the beach to Pelican Reef (the other property) FOR THE GUACAMOLE !

author: rashannad
title: AMAZING!!!!!
text: The condo has the most amazing view! We stayed in the two bedroom condo on the second floor . The condo itself was very spacious and extremely clean. The housekeeper came by every day and cleaned the rooms. "E" was amazing! Anything we needed he got for us. I had a list of restaurants I wanted to try and E went over everyone of them with me telling me which one was worth trying and which weren't. Ruth!!! Ahhhhh we loved Ruth so much!!!! She seemed to always be there when you needed her. She greeted us with drinks and many conversations by the pool which is where we spent most of our time. Javier (I refer to him as the hardest working man on the island) was such a pleasure as well! He always made sure the grounds were in perfect condition! Lori and Greg were such a pleasure as well!
