As for the meals, I was totally satisfied with my HB plan, I also liked that dinner is served outside in a beautiful garden area. Despite what some reviews say, I never felt limited in choice too. As for the beaches, there is a big verity of choices in 2-5-10 min walk distance. I personally loved the municipal one just in front of the hotel, though the Lighthouse beach on the right just behind the Harbor and the Archeological park seems most picturesque to me. It is nearby the Kings Avenue Mall as well if one cares to combine beach rest and shopping. Importantly, Paphos proved to be ideal for individual travellers like me this time. The area is extremely rich with charming authentic villages, monasteries, picturesque places to visit either by car (the way we did the first time we stayed here) or even in a more authentic way - by local buses (thankfully the Harbor bus station is in a 7 min walk distance from Dionysos hotel and buses operate on the dot. Moreover, all schedules and routes are available online. I did enjoy my stay at the hotel immensely thanks to a very hospitable reception and its great location!

author: henrym324
title: A 3* star hotel worthy of a 4* rating.
text: Recently returned to the UK after a week at the Dionysos. What a find! I was recommended by a friend who had stayed there previously. I can only say I was more than satisfied. The location is incredible. Within just moments, you are on the sea front with all that it offers. The hotel has a very welcoming atmosphere in all areas. There are two separate garden areas for breakfast and dinner. Both breakfast and dinner are more than adequate. The rooms are very modern. Rooms at the front could be affected at night by some 'noise' from the bar opposite. Obviously the rooms at the back facing the pool would be quieter. The pool area itself is lovely and built on two levels giving everyone more space to relax. I found the staff (especially at Reception) very friendly, helpful and efficient. I would love to return to Paphos again and would have no hesitation of returning to the Dionysos. Thank you all for a lovely week.

author: scottsbabe
title: Great location but has its Plus and Minus
text: Just got back after staying for one week here and must say the location is excellent. We had a premium sea view room which i must say was to my expectations which included free safe, free air con, free fridge, also lovely white bathrobes & slippers and lovely white towels. Included was lovely bottle of Red House Wine plus a Plate of fresh fruit plus a bottle of water in the fridge & best of all a kettle with tea & coffee making. We stayed B & B due to we like to go out for evening meals and breakfast was choice of cooked and cold which suited us so always managed to eat something. Hotel inside reception very clean and relaxing music playing. The Hotel pool was far to small for the amount of rooms and there was a shortage of sun beds for the many guest staying. Now for the minus side or shall i say the health & safety side. Balcony rail not very stable plus no balcony light for evenings for safety Stair rails all wobbly not very secure Sun beds old and tired very uncomfortable to rest on. Breakfast room far to small for the amount of guest such a tight squeeze one could get burned or scalded with trying to avoid the rush for food. Did see cockroach in breakfast room - stairways & our room think they must fly in. Staff not really friendly no happy smiles plus no luggage man on arrival where i did see lots of older people struggling with there cases. No entertainment at all so no atmosphere in the hotel. So all in all the location and the room was probably the best we got from the hotel and the T V which did have a good all day film channel in English. Paphos is very expensive double the prices of the UK so beware and take plenty of cash it was costing the two of us £95 to £100 euro a day for lunch & evening meals out with just a few drinks . One other thing is the Maids they were brilliant at the room cleaning could not fault them plus the Guy on the pool bar who left the job mid week in our stay he was a most friendly guy compared to the rest off the staff.

author: 337AndrewS
title: LOVELY HOTEL
text: We cannot say enough good things about this small hotel. We stayed in a Deluxe Seaview Room, which had a great open view. The room was plain, but nice and very clean. Same fro the lovely bathroom with nice soft white towels everyday or when required. The corridors were nicely decorated too and always very clean as was the reception area and bar area. Nice pool with loungers and also a raised bathing terrace. We had breakfast outside most days in the garden. Also a separate café bar with nice outdoor area. In a great position in a nice typical area near the front. It was very quiet when we were there. Quite a soundproof hotel. We had half board. Loads to choose from at breakfast. The evening meals had a big choice too. Nothing exotic but good food and always plenty being taken out of kitchen by staff. The staff were really nice and helpful too, specially Katerina and Vincent. So thank to you all for a lovely time and we certainly will be back sometime.

author: Yoetz
title: Stay Away from Dionysos Central at all Cost
text: On one of the days we returned to the room and noticed that the housekeeper broke a pair of reading glasses which were left on the night stand. After finally we managed to speak with the hotel manager, he refused to take responsibility and compensate us. While speaking very aggressively he blamed us for everything he could think of, while implying that we were lying since the housekeeper had said that she didn’t do it (how surprising…). He then ACCUSED US FOR NOT STORING THE READING GLASSES IN THE SAFE when we left (!!!). He also added that even then he wouldn’t have taken responsibility. For him, we had to bear a 120 EUR cost for a damage that was clearly caused by the hotel staff, “and you can go to the police”. Earlier this week: - While sitting in the balcony the chair suddenly broke under me. I fell down, and my head missed hitting the floor hard in only few millimeters. - Ultra slow internet and weak WiFi. Practically you cannot connect in the hotel. - Breakfast was the inedible – watery and tasteless coffee and juice, scrambled eggs swimming in water (definitely made of powder and not fresh), tasteless pastry and bread, aged and fatigue fruit salad, “selection” of one vegetable. - Saggy and sinking mattresses that do not let you sleep at night, and you wake up in the morning with severe back pain. - You can hear (and be heard) through the walls and the old doors everything that goes on in the other rooms. - The ceiling fan was very noisy and useless when one wants to sleep or relax. - We returned to the room and found that the housekeeper left us no towels. They didn’t bring them, but we were asked to go down and fetch them. - We paid extra 32 EUR for 4 hours late check-out in just to be able to take a shower before the flight, but had to argue with the front desk who refused to provide us fresh towels. This was one of the worst hotels we've ever visited.

author: koggyboy
title: Good hotel in a great location.
text: Spent the last week here, hotel is maintained to a very high standard and is exceptionally clean. Very comfy seating area in foyer and a lovely garden that has lots of seating and you can eat and drink here. Some of the rooms look out onto the garden which is really pretty. We booked a sea view deluxe room which was very modern with a lovely modern bathroom and big walk in shower, dressing gowns, slippers etc, also good tea and coffee making facilities in the room with supplies replenished every day. Rooms are a tad on the small side but perfectly adequate for what you need. Beds are good and slept well all week. We stayed half board and the food is decent with lots of choice for breakfast and dinner. Has an average size pool with sunbeds round and a good sunbathing area higher up with lots of sunbeds and brollies. Staff are friendly and efficient. The one thing that would make us return was the excellent location, very central but just set back enough for it not to be noisy. Free safe, tv, fridge - you just have to sign a slip to say you'll pay 20 euros if you lose key/controller, also wi-fi but intermittent, however most bars have free wi-fi which was really fast. Start of season so was pretty quiet but got busier during the week. Lots of fab places to eat, Pinguino was a favourite, just on the corner near the hotel, great choice with quality food and drinks and fab service. Demokritos Tavern is authentic with yummy food and fab entertainment, turn right from the hotel and it's further up on the left. If you fancy a good kebab, try Donor Xpress across the road from Pinguino, cheap and super gorgeous, probably the nicest kebab we've had. If you like a good pub with live music, try Rose Pub, just a short walk from the beach front, you get a great welcome and fab service. So many places, so little time!

author: U7872VHjohnt
title: Pleasantly surprised
text: Arrived at 8pm and went straight in for dinner before checking in. First room overlooked a road which was not to our liking, however Nadia the very helpful and pleasant girl on reception arranged a change for us without any fuss. Second floor garden view was perfect. The room included a bottle of wine, water and fruit also fridge and safe [key type] and tv, bathrobes and slippers, air con [poor] fan and wifi [poor] and a free drink all included in the price. The bathroom was spacious and a furnished balcony and twin beds completed the room. We were half board and breakfast included the usual choices. Dinner consisted of 3 or 4 mains soup and sweets. Not a huge choice like some hotels but all very tasty and very much to our liking. Wine from 12 euros per bottle. The dining area is quite small and can get busy at times. The hotel has a nice lounge and bar area with a lot of steps and outside there is a small pool and sun terrace. Books are kept at reception,just ask. The hotel is situated 50yds from the seafront with its restaurants and bars. We found the staff very polite and friendly and quality of service, accommodation and food well above what we expected. A good choice for a holiday in Paphos.

author: 74duncans
title: Excellent Staff
text: Lovely hotel a short distance from the sea. Very friendly atmosphere. The staff cannot do enough for you. This hotel prides itself on its green credentials. Other reviews have complained about the obvious re-working of leftovers. TBH I welcome this, along with the reduction in waste. We arrived on a Fri afternoon. The led lighting was quite dim. We asked reception if their was anything they could do. Sat morning, an electrician replaced the lights. Cannot fault that service. Very clean facilities with daily maid service in the rooms. Nice sized pool, however quite bracing. It is not heated. I will quite happily spend another holiday in this hotel.

author: shaunc704
title: Noisy corridors!
text: The first night for the buffet I'd been for a bottle of water from the mini market! Well they made a huge deal about me turning up with my own drink!! I'd of understood if I'd of rocked up with a bottle of wine but come on I'd just been to the shop! I felt very intimidated that I didn't order drinks! I'm a lone traveler who didn't want alcohol! The food is excellent and has been every night. Great selection but not vegetarian friendly. Lucky I love meat but veggies your stuck with a salad and pasta, every other night it's got ham in it! The hotel is in a great location but not what I'd call disabled friendly. It's just scrapping 3* very clean nice interior. The beds are like sleeping on a slab so if you like a super hard bed your in heaven! Unfortunately I'm not one of those! You can hear all activities in the corridors so like me, if the snore like a pig and the guy singing in the shower next door, feel the love! And if you didn't know what was going on next door they put poster up to let you understand that they are newlyweds!! Ahh that explains everything I thought there was a bit of cage fighting going on in there. apparently the do not disturb sign is a cue for the cleaner to bang really loud at 11.40am on a Saturday!! Well I did order wine with my meal Friday night! No by all means come in just to make sure that I'm not up to anything that the newlyweds might be doing. Nice but I wish I'd of gone 4*

author: elaineandy2016
title: Excellent Hotel 😄
text: What a great holiday we had at this hotel. The hotel is in a fantastic location in the harbour area. A minute's walk to the sea / beach areas or a further walk in each direction will bring you to small bays which were excellent for snorkelling. It was also situated close to a great choice of friendly Tavernas and bars. The hotel staff were excellent. Very smart, friendly and helpful. The hotel was spotlessly clean. We had a sea view room on the top floor which was amazing. It also afforded us stunning sunset views from the balcony. The room was immaculate and modern with a fridge, safe, kettle with complimentary tea and coffee for no extra cost. Also free WiFi. The breakfast was good with a variety to suit everyone. On arrival in our room we found a complimentary bottle of local wine and fresh fruit, what a lovely welcoming gesture. There was some noise from nearby venues and road which we could have eliminated by shutting the patio door and windows and using the efficient air conditioning, however, just through personal choice, we preferred to have fresh air and use the ceiling fan and keep the door open etc. Our choice - we just ignored the outside noise. The hotel itself was quiet and had a lovely relaxed atmosphere. The pool area was clean and a small pool bar provided drinks and snacks. Would definitely return to this hotel.

author: daveyoungone1
title: Fairly dissapointed
text: When booking for this trip I was keen to find somewhere which was close to central Paphos and by the harbour. I read numerous reviews about this hotel which generally indicated positive remarks. I'm afraid I can't really say the same. Apart from the location which was great there's not a lot more positive things I can say about this hotel. I believe it may have been refurbished in recent years however in my opinion to a fairly low standard. Our room was small and basic. There were numerous cracks and holes around the plaster walls and the ceiling fan was filthy with dust. This was also coupled with a fridge door which was incredibly dirty. Beds were basic to say the least. The bathroom however was of a reasonably decent standard however it was tiny and having a shower was tricky, even my partner who is quite slender found it a bit of a task to manoeuvre around in. We did make a request at the front desk to upgrade rooms (which I was willing to pay for) but were told there was nothing available until the Wednesday however when we asked again then we were told there was nothing available and staff seemed disinterested in helping us out. We got on with our holiday as we normally do enjoying all that Paphos has to offer along with the incredible weather. Upon checking out we were informed that we could return to use the courtesy room to get changed and freshen up before our transfer to the airport later that afternoon. This was really a waste of time since the room was not air conditioned and to manoeuvre around in it to get changed etc would have rendered us dripping with sweat since the temperatures were mid 30's. We decided to return later and use the toilets to quickly change and freshen up since they were air conditioned. This was a little disappointing considering I had read a few good reviews prior to booking. Sorry Dionysos not good enough!

author: leonardh478
title: Excellent Hotel, all staff friendly, helpful, and pleasant, and a perfect location.
text: My Wife and I returned from a 14 night stay at the Dionysos Central Hotel on Wednesday 14th Sept. We also in May this year, spent a week at this Hotel. This Hotel is prefectly positioned for what ever your holiday needs are whether its, walking, tours,hiring a car for your own custumized tour or just lying in the sun and relaxing. The sea is just 100m across the road from the Hotel with a good safe swimming area, and life guards. A sandy area with sun beds if you prefer that to the sun terrace, and the swimming pool of the Hotel. The Hotel has recently been refurbished to a very modern, and high standard, but at the same time retaining the Cypriot style and character especially in the reception area. Part of the referbishment and improvements was the construction of another floor to the top of the building offering deluxe rooms with added sea views, to that of the rest of the hotel of which may have sea views. The food is excellent, the breakfast caters for all, with hot foods such as eggs (fried, boiled, scrambled, etc), sausages, bacon, crapes, and more. Cold foods as, cerals, meats, friuts, yogurts, breads, and more. A variety of coffees, tea, and fruit juices. There are two resturants within the Hotel the Amore offering an Italian style plus extras, and the La Place Royale which offers a varied menu that should suit most travellers. If you hire a car to visit the places coach tours don't take you the Dionysos has it's own car park. The cleanliness of the Hotel is excellent, and you can see yourself in the morning just how the cleaning staff take a pride in their work and the Hotel. The manager, and his staff are great, they are always ready to help you with what ever you require, and sort any problems that may arise within your stay, even down to booking a taxi if needed or the like. The Hotel refurbishments have taken place during the winter months over the last few years, and now they are completed I was informed by the manager after asking him that they are pleased to say the Hotel will be completeley open for buisness this winter so get booking, you will enjoy your stay at this excellent Hotel. My wife and I would like to thank the manager and his staff for another enjoyable stay at your excellent Hlotel. 121

author: emmakH7865ZY
title: Would never go all inclusive here again!
text: So to start our trip we were told adult only hotel wrong! It's not All inclusive wrong it's not all inclusive We paid a lot of money to go all inclusive and it's not all inclusive there's sets times and periods during the day as to what you can have: Breakfast was 7:30-10am you could not get a drink before this unless you went offsite to get one. Only drinks at breakfast were hot drinks or apple juice or watered down Orange juice (Breakfast was okay nothing special but most was edible) we had one coffee and one tea sachet in our room (no milk) so from 10-11 no drinks again were available until the pool bar opened. There were snacks served 11-12 in la royle cafe & bistro next door..A toastie was served (best food in here!) then lunch was to be served between 12:30-2:30 in the hotel, (buffet style) well so our form said they actually finish at 2. Then again snacks are served from 5-6 in la royle it's ice cream or pancakes, what ever they choose to put on on the day. Then dinner is served 7-9 in either amore or la royle.... Ate once in amore and never again food either over salted or bland, meat tuff not good at all, we ate in la royle food wasn't fantastic in here but better than any from the hotel! Most days we found ourselves going off site to eat lunch and our evening meal or popping to the shop for bits for our room. Even though we had paid to go all inclusive! There's no onsite entertainment at all.... Pool closes at 7pm but the pool bar closes at 10:30pm. Then from 10:30pm-7am you are unable to get a drink again. Bottle water, ice creams, crisps/snacks or certain drinks list of approx 12 drinks you could pick from the rest were not in all inclusive so you have to purchase them extra. You could have a free glass of tap water but not bottled! Only one drink person at a time which is completely understandable but when my husband was going to get a drink for himself and me they wouldn't allow it I had to go get my own! Food for lunch and evening meal is only a small selection off the menu and it's set for each day of the week they give u an option of 2-3 items in la royle or in amore it's a buffet style dinner. Hotel is clean and tidy most staff have a miserable face like they don't even want to help especially the breakfast staff and the man on the bar, pool is small our room was supposed to be a deluxe room but we ended up with a twin room but it did the job of somewhere for us to sleep. It's very close to the beach and harbour and it's lovely on an afternoon or evening to walk down to the bars and sea front! I wouldn't stay here again.

author: Lindadx
title: Friendly central hotel
text: We have just returned from our second wonderful holiday at the Dionysos. It is a superb 3 star hotel in the centre of Kato Paphos. It is quite a small hotel with an annex to the side of the main hotel. The hotel has been refurbished and this winter will see the final part of the refurbishment completed. The rooms are lovely and modern with walk in showers. The manager and all the staff are really friendly and cannot do enough to help you. The public areas like the rest of the hotel are modern, clean and have recently been updated. It still has a touch of the traditional with mosaics on the walls and floor of some of the areas. There are nice touches of greenery with plants in the reception area, staircase and the plants around the pool are lovely. There is a good selection of food at breakfast- not as much as in a 4 star but you are not paying for that. The Amore restaurant is outside under the trees but is set above the pavement so it has lovely views. The choice of food is good and you can always have salad, pasta or pizza if you don't like the main menu. The Place Royale is a cafe/bistro attached to the hotel and offers a different menu.This is accessed near the pool and is nice for coffee and at lunch time. We return to the hotel twice a year and absolutely love it. Due to the number of steps in and around the hotel it is not suitable for those who find climbing stairs difficult. This is stated clearly in the Jet 2 website but not in the Mercury one so it is worth noting.

author: hannai956
title: The dangerous bathroom: broken glass in the bathroom
text: The hotel has a good location: it is situated near the sea and supermarket. If you have the birthday, you`ll get a present. My husband got a wine and fruits. The wine is delicious. Staff is unfriendly, rude. The glass door in the bathroom was broken and there were a lot of pieces of glass on the floor! The most surprising was that girls on reception didn`t pay attention to it, no apologies. If you want to see TV with remote control, you should pay for it. Using of remote control is not included in payment for the room. I have seen it at first time. Dinner was on the street. There was dark and I didn`t see what you eat. The elevator is too tiny. When I was at the hotel, I felt that managers skimp on everything. It`s the worst hotel in which I have ever been. The hotel isn`t cozy. Have no intention of going back.

author: alexsergivan
title: Not corresponding to our expectations
text: We stayed here for 11 nights with small baby. It's the worst hotel from all where we have been ever. Let's start from pros: +Convinient location +We had a calm room +Delicious waffles on the breakfast That's it Cons: -Bathroom in very poor condition (fungus, broken shower). -Broken glass door at the bathroom (after every closing, we found small dangerous pieces of glass on the floor). -Very small elevator without conditioning. -Unappetizing dinner without variety. -Very dark at dinner. You can not see what's on your plate and what you take into your mouth. -You need to pay additionally for the TV remote control (absurd), fridge, safe, wifi. -The door to the hall with the poor soundproofing (the gaps under and above the door). -Not responsive, nor responsible and rude staff on the reception. Due to the fact that they didn't allow to make us a late check-out, in spite of small baby, we had to search another hotel for 10 hours to wait for our transfer. This is very irresponsible on their side. However, we found a cheap hotel near (36 euro per night), and it was better place than Dionysos and with nice staff. It would be better just staying here for 11 nights than in Dionysos. So, we do not recommend Dionysos Central hotel.

author: rabbiter
title: Disappointing experience
text: I have given one star for the location and one star for the nice breakfast. Everything else was disappointing, though. We were apparently given a "deluxe" room, but we did not quite figure out what was so deluxe about it! The room itself was ok but very small; there was only one chair in the room; there were no toiletries or other complimentary items (which you would expect in a "deluxe" room). The weirdest thing though, was the transparent glass bathroom door! Why bother with a door at all?! I could really not get my head around this. The bed itself was comfortable and we enjoyed our al fresco breakfast in the morning. The breakfast staff were very conscientious at clearing tables quickly and keeping breakfast items stocked. Very poor tea but then I never expect good tea outside of England! Wifi was free for only one device and we had to pay to use it on a second device. This is very odd; we had paid for two people to stay in the hotel, therefore we should have both had access to free wifi. We did not use the pool but it looked nice. The location is great but this does mean it can be noisy at night as there are lots of bars nearby. Another disappointment was that the hotel is not accessible. There were stairs/steps everywhere and no ramps, which made it awkward for us with our luggage. A wheelchair or pushchair would be impossible to navigate in this hotel. Overall we did not really enjoy our stay in this hotel. It was convenient for our purpose as it is very central to all the sights, but I don't think I would stay here again.

author: Rae87
title: Yeah it was ok....
text: Distinctly average is exactly how I would rate this hotel! We stayed in a deluxe room which I understand had recently been refurbished, The bathroom and bedroom looked great and were clean and reasonably comfortable. However we did run into some problems - firstly a towel rail in the bathroom was stuck to the wall with mastic rather than screws and this fell down and hit me on the head (yeah it was pretty funny but still). Our air conditioning broke, there was no remote for the tv, no fridge to put water in, our thick duvet was taken away and not replaced so we were only left with a sheet and on two out of the 5 nights our room wasn't turned down. Also when they come to fix the air conditioner they did so about 10am on the day of our departure and knocked and came into our room despite having "do not disturb" on the door. None of these things were a huge disaster but are the difference between an ok and a good hotel. Food at the hotel is ok, we went all inclusive which probably you don't need to as there are plenty of places to eat and drink around. They also make it kind of difficult to get your moneys worth on the drinks. We were in cyprus for a wedding which was taking place at another hotel so we didn't spend much time around the pool here (sneakily went to our friends hotel instead as we wanted to spend time with them) but the pool and loungers were ok. Pool bar wasn't open so getting a drink meant having to go inside. Food average - never made it up for breakfast. Lunch was nice and dinner was samey. I'm a vegetarian and as expected options were pretty limited. Also wifi at this hotel sucks - don't bother paying for it! Reception and waiting staff are helpful. Finally, if this sort of thing bothers you, the hotel has mainly russian guests. This hotel could be a fantastic hotel but needs a bit of work. Wasn't expensive though so can't complain.

author: davidbonser7
title: Dionysos Hotel Paphos
text: Stayed here for 10 days in April. Hotel is clean and friendly, the staff at the Bistro connected to the hotel are all very good. We were all inclusive in a room on the 3rd floor, the room was excellent newly furnished with a walk in shower, suggest that the shower should have a grab rail especially for someone who may not be as sure footed as we. The room had a good balcony which over looked the pool with a south facing vista over the sea the rooms was always clean the housekeeping excellent coffee and tea replenished daily.. Breakfast I would say was average sometimes bacon sometimes sausage the eggs could have been fresher. Cereals and fresh meats always available. The staff were always good. On our time there the pool bar was not open. this was a shame as we would have spent more time around the pool if it had been open. Lunch times was taken at the connecting bistro, always good service from the girls there. We were on fully inclusive and the lunch was served from the all inclusive menu. a good choice with coffee and some drinks included. However if you wanted a cappuccino you had to pay the full price I think that this should be included or at least a reduction. Just a small complaint though. Overall I think value for money and would recommend. The hotel is very well positioned just a short walk to the sea, although the beach is not that sandy mainly rocks, however a short bus ride to Coral Bay 1.50 euros gets you to a good beach. Plenty of good restaurants all around the resort, worth a try.

author: Jens0
title: Friendly, welcoming, small hotel in an excellent location
text: This was my second visit to the hotel, and I stayed in a standard room in the main part of the hotel. The room was spotlessly clean, though the furniture was a bit "tired looking". I understand that the hotel will be renovating the standard rooms in the near future. For the time being,for a supplement, guests are able to upgrade to a newly built room for a fee, if one is available. I think that the hotel offers excellent value for money. It is a 3 star hotel, in an unrivalled location, close to the harbour, shops and restaurants. Everything is within walking distance, including the main strip of shops and restaurants on Paphos seafront, leading down to the harbour, fort and mosaics. The staff are extremely polite, helpful and welcoming. Cleaning staff work tirelessly in the background to ensure that the hotel is kept spotlessly clean. I stayed on a half board basis, and found the food to be fine, though as a non meat eater I was limited to mainly salads, vegetables, pasta and pizza. However, most people enjoyed the variety of meat and fish dishes on offer. The pool area was nice and quiet during my stay, and I was always able to get a sunbed and umbrella. The pool area and gardens are very relaxing places. There are tables in the garden area that can be used when eating breakfast, though smoking is permitted here. Once again, I recommend this hotel to anyone wanting a clean, basic hotel room in a central location.

author: DaJo_1966
title: Makes for a good bag drop.
text: Stayed here on a recent trip to Paphos and booked the hotel by way of a package with British Airways. On arrival, and first impressions were very good. Bear in mind that I do think of any hotel as a bag drop, because unless you are going to be staying in your room all day, then that is essentially what it is, or at least to us. Anyway, back to the hotel. From the check in which was done without any fuss, we went to our room which was numbered in the 200's so on getting in the lift, you'd automatically think it was on the second floor, not to be as it's on the first, but again no hassle. We were informed by a lady who we shared the lift with, to be wary of it as it could be a little on the vicious side, what she meant by that we didn't know until it came to an abrupt halt. Anyway, we found our room. The room was of a decent size, clean but basic. The bed was comfortable. We soon went on to find that the only plugs available were tucked under the table right in the corner, so if there were any guests with needs they may struggle to get down in order to access the electricity points. The room had a small flat screen tv, however, no remote. It had a fridge, but it was locked and the wardrobe had a small safe and again locked. As the room had these features, I enquired as to how you were able to use them. I was informed that they incurred a daily charge and a deposit. We took advantage of the fridge in order to keep drinks cool, but didn't go for the safe or remote control of which I would expect to be included with the room. Having to pay for everything else, made me think as to whether we'd be metered on toilet flushes or for the amount of water used in the shower!! The bathroom however, was ok, our room had a large chunk of marble?, missing which was only noticeable if you happened to sit in the bath, and again was clean and there was piping hot water for the duration of the trip with good water pressure, Our hotel deal included half board, the food in the restaurant being good and the waiter in there for the majority of our time was a tall gentleman by the name of Demetris, who it would seem was kept on the go morning, noon and night! He was to say the least very attentive, keeping a watchful eye all the time. Verdict: Would I stay again, yes, but would try somewhere else before going back.

author: pennyh83
title: 3 star don't think so
text: First impressions: not bad, then you hit your accommodation: Shabby - old fashioned very basic. some would say "rustic" we would say "absymal". Tiny bathroom - shower head holder hanging off the wall, hairdryer holder hanging off the wall. These 2 items reported and were attended to. Shutters on balcony filthy - and great lumps out of them looked as if been chewed by a dog - no proper lock on balcony door just an "intruder" chain the type you would have on your front door. Not sure rooms were cleaned everyday. Left wet towels in bath still there when we returned late afternoon - another instance we usually take a drink of water to bed - any water left in glass was just left in room never emptied and glass not washed unless we did ourselves - only way you would know anyone had been in room was bed was made! We booked twin room - allocated double very uncomfortable didn't sleep well for 10 days. We booked half board. 6 nights out of 10 we ate out. One evening went down to dinner the lamb dish was gravy and bones, deserts boring - you had to be in the dining room dead on 7pm to get anything. Small pool-bar only open between 11am and 4pm and attendant often not immediately to hand. Pool area not very clean and the pool itself dirty -broken tiling on the steps leading into the pool and in the 10 days we were there we only saw it cleaned once. Sun terrace dirty, for 2 days rubbish left uncleared - small tables beside sunbeds dirty - the general cleanliness of place I reported to holiday representative and was told "well you are in middle of the town" - it's a hotel for goodness sake I wouldn't expect visitors to my home to have cause to complain about the cleanlness - have they no pride. Breakfast - 1st morning one of the tea machines was not working - another day no teaspoons, breakfast was from 7-9.30 we could hear them rattling around setting up at 6am so why were things missing - poor workmanship starts at the top - perhaps someone should take a "hotel managment course" - staff did not seem happy. - fruit on offer at breakfast was just small pieces of apple or orange and "tinned" fruit salad. Could go on but I think there is enough content to make people think twice before booking this particular hotel, we will be contacting the travel company direct to with similar review. Penny & John Hertfordshire

author: A_Brooks-11
title: First time stay in Cyprus, will definately be returning to this hotel.
text: Myself and my partner had never visited Cyprus before and had heard various different opinions both of the resorts and the accommodation. Thankfully we dropped on fantastically with both. The hotel I will admit did have some little infractions i.e could do with a lick of paint, a bulb out here, a few dinghy tiles there. Overall all this hotel was perfect, it's comfortable and overall very clean. The cleaners were in everyday changing the bins, making the beds and changing the pillow cases and towels everyday, changing the sheets every couple of days. My partner who is an obsessive hair dye-er had issues with it washing out and staining the bed, headboard, bath and towels, after returning from the days excursions we found no trace of the dye. The staff were more than helpful on more than several occasions ranging from a lost key too a mysteryious self locking bathroom door. They went out of their way on a daily basis to make you not only comfortable, but welcomed in everyway. The same staff at breakfast were those at the Amore Restaurant in the evening, they again couldn't help enough.The food was great and they always had a variety of both Greek and other cruisines to choose from with the Moussaka always going down a treat. The one and only occasion we visited the Royale Bistro and we were very dissappointed and didn't return again for the duration of our stay. The sole reason for this was because as nice as the staff were, we felt that we were ignored because we were part of the hotel as opposed to a regular paying customer. The location at first was a bit sketchy to start with, with the main bar strip just over the back of the hotel, once the door was closed the noise disappeared and allowed you to sleep soundly. Another advantage was it was so close to the harbour front (1 minute walk), a large variety of bars, restaurants, attractions. The bus station was about a 10 minute walk away, but they ran to numerous locations around the area. In conclusion this was a Great Hotel and added to a FANTASTIC holiday. Will definately return and highly recommend.

author: SUNCAT25
title: Excellent arrangement of hotel, good parity the price-quality
text: We had a rest a week from June, 12 till June, 19th. The hotel was pleasant, corresponds 3 *, lived in number Standart Inland View, a food was a breakfast and a supper. Public: 70 % adequate Russian + 30 % English pensioners. It`s in the center of a tourist zone of Pathos (Kato Paphos), near to quay, where many different cafes, restaurants, bars and shops. In number 2 one-and-a-half beds shifted together, bedside tables, a sofa, a dressing table with a mirror, an armchair and a journal table, a spacious balcony with two plastic chairs and a little table, the small refrigerator, on it the TV with 1 Russian channel without the panel, a payment for the safe is 1,70 euros +20 euro the deposit (at departure from the hotel hand over a key, return the deposit), a bathroom, a toilet bowl, a bowl and a mirror. Using the hair dryer, the conditioner and the ceiling fan free of charge. Cleaning daily, for a week bed 1 time have changed, towels some times (dirty we threw on a floor). That wasn't in number: a tea set, toilet accessories (only liquid soap), salutatory fruit and a wine bottle. Territory is small, well-groomed, very green, pool for adults + small for absolutely kids, a bar at pool. The children's playground isn't present, however, it hasn't prevented much to have a rest with children. A food a buffet for a breakfast and a supper, is quite various and is tasty, it was pleasant to us, we didn't take drinks at supper, ate too much of a water-melon and melon. We liked very much a city Pathos, its Archaeological park, Old port, beach Coral Bay, Park of birds. In Archaeological park have taken a walk independently, it`s in the pedestrian availability from hotel. In Park of birds the transfer free of charge is organized, it is necessary to register in a reception. Unfortunately, it was not possible to visit an Aquarium which is in the neighbourhood with the hotel, it has been closed on preventive maintenance (or reconstruction). The sandy beach is located near to hotel Alexander The Great in 10 minutes of walking from Dionysos Central. Near to hotel are a pier and some short flights of stairs in water, transparent water, a stony bottom. All beaches of Pathos have blue flags EC that guarantees cleanliness of water and ecology. In our arrival water in the sea was rather cool, about 20 degrees. Result: from the hotel and from the Pathos there were only pleasant impressions, recommend.

author: TRSM
title: Fantastic Location - Sufficient Hotel!
text: Myself and my partner have just returned from a week in the Dionysos hotel. We stayed in a twin room which sleeps up to 3 adults, however, if there were 3 of us it would of been a tight squeese! The room was basic and had a small fridge. Our room was overlooking a car park at the back and adjacent to bar street. Being 5 months pregnant this worried me due to the noise levels. There was no need to worry however, once the balconly door is closed you cannot hear anything from the bars outside. The one complaint i did have with the room though was the standard of cleaning, although the cleaners came in everday they just did the basics, as in dress the bed etc. The bath or sink was barley cleaned and the floor wasnt swept- this just added to the slightly tatty feel of the room. As many of the other reviewers stated, the rooms are in definate need of an upgrade. They do have good air conditioning though! The pool area was kept clean and there was always plenty of sunbeds. We stayed on a Bed and Breakfast basis. There is not much of a choice here but it was sufficient enough for us, if you stayed for two weeks i would imagine it would get quite boring. The location of the hotel was very good and Paphos itself, although touristy and expensive, is lovely. We rented a car for two days at a reasonable rate and got out of Papos for a while. Overall we had a great holiday, the Dionysos has no frills attached but it was great value for money and i would recommend the hotel as a good base.

author: sparkeyuk
title: Below Standard
text: My room at the Dionysis was in poor condition, badly in need of renovation and noisy. This “standard” room was definitely below standard. Avoid Hotel Dionysis Central Pafos, Cyprus. In Orwell’s book Nineteen Eighty Four, Room 101 is a room of torture. The corridor next to the public toilets and near the reception of Hotel Dionysis, could have been called Corridor 101. The room numbers start at 101 and while I can only vouch for one room, I could also hear complaints from the room next to me with an irate lady “with connections” demanding to be moved or upgraded. In my room there was a black mouldy goo on the bathroom ceiling. The refrigerator door was dirty and like much in this room looked like it was installed in 1984. My room was above the kitchen where one could see and hear the delivery of heavy metal barrels. Sea and mountain views it was not. The bedroom shutters were falling apart and were locked with a simple hook as the original mechanism no longer worked. The marmalade cat that prowls around outside could have broken in. The receptionist insisted there was nothing wrong with the bedroom door key. I had to report back and forth 3 times before she agreed to check the electronic key. Finally, after trying it herself, she accepted the key was faulty.

author: johnnylough
title: Great hotel in a beautiful city!
text: Just spent 3 nites at this hotel. Oct 21, 22, and 23 after and Avalon River Cruise. This part of the trip was arranged by our travel agent. Beautiful large corner room, could see modern in one direction, old in another and some construction. Comfortable bed, clean room, lots of plugs, high ceilings, nice wooden floors. Beautiful bathroom, great shower and a hair dryer that my diffuser fit on! Housecoats, slippers, toiletries provided. Beautiful windows facing the remarkable Kafka moving head. Close to restaurants, malls, hop on hop off bus stops, 15 min walk to old town. Beautiful area. Quiet at nite. Buffet breakfast was great. Excellent cappuccinos and “Canadiana” coffees. Hotel staff was excellent, very helpful and friendly. Would highly recommend this hotel!

author: 550mariettaa
title: Amazing
text: We got a room with a view to the fantastic Kafka statue, and we got a cute balcony. The room was spotless. Big Twin- Room with a huge bathroom. The room were right by the elevator, but i can sincerely say that we didn't hear a thing. Extremely quiet Hotel. Nice and various breakfast. Helpfull staff. Perfect location and a quiet location. If i should mention one thing, it must be that the room was a little cold, even though the temperature outside was 24 degrees. We did try to increase the temperature in the room, but it didn't make a difference. But we had a delightful stay and if we travel to Prague next year i will stay here, no doubt. And also for the Italian restaurant Love IT. Amazing food. Miss the Hotel already. Thanks for this time.

author: LSC06
title: Great location, helpful staff, nices rooms.
text: The Hotel Golden Crown is in a beautifully restored older building, and in a terrific location. Not a large hotel, but just a nice size, and has everything you need. The hotel is right next to an excellent little mall with food markets, and a reasonable cash exchange office. Underneath the mall are subway lines, and just outside the opposite mall door you can catch Tram 22, and other trams that head throughout the city. (Trams 22 & 23 will take you across the river and up to the Castle, etc.) The Golden Crown is also in easy walking distance to the old town center and many other areas of the city center, the river, etc. We had a lovely air-conditioned room with beautiful windows facing the remarkable Kafka moving head. Our room was a good size, with high ceilings, plenty of plugs, and a nice bathroom. The bathroom had a very good shower and an excellent hair dryer. Also numerous bathroom amenities were supplied. The wooden floors were appreciated, as they seem much cleaner than carpet. Breakfast was good and a nice variety of foods were offered. Coffee or drink selections are brought to you. The staff was very friendly and helpful. We enjoyed talking with the morning staff, and had interesting conversations with the young lady from Prague and the young man from Russia. Both spoke English very well. The young lady who worked in the evenings was also very pleasant and helpful. Room prices were reasonable.

author: Ankur123
title: Amazing hotel in the center of Prague
text: It was my first trip to Prague with my friend. I was looking for a hotel from where everything is closeby and this is the best choice. This hotel is right in front of Franz Kafka which is one of the main tourist attractions. There’s a mall in front of the hotel, which has everything like DM,Billa,Sephora,food court,McD’s and so many other outlets. Tram station and metro station(narodni trida) is just 20mtrs, you just have to walk through the mall. So if you are coming from the airport, just take bus to the nearest metro station and get on the yellow line and it will drop you to narodni trida station and from there hotel is just walking distance. There’s a vegetarian restaurant adjoining to the hotel. Old town, shopping street and main square is just 10mins walk from the hotel. Now about the hotel, there rooms are spacious with wooden floor and bathrooms are given with exquisite toiletries. The space is enough for two to move around in the room with your big bags. They also provide, kettle with tea/coffe stuff, slippers, bathrobes and safe. Breakfast is quite good with multiple selection of foods. There staff is friendly, hospitable and always ready to assist you in best possible way. They can guide you. I had my birthday during our stay so their staff surprised me with a cake and it was such a kind gesture, that I will never forget. Thank you Hotel Golden Crown Team for making our stay a memorable one.

author: anniek597
title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed for 2 nights last week. Hotel is in great location. Very easy to get around. We stayed In a standard double room. Very comfortable. Very quiet. There was a kettle in room with tea making facilities. Mini bar too. Bathroom had lovely little treats which was a lovely surprise. Only issue we had was our shower was blocked so the place was soaked out into the bedroom. We rang reception who said they would send someone but no one came. It was just very messy. Breakfast was very nice. Fruit, cereals, bread and hot food. And loads of it! Very tasty coffee and the staff will make you whatever you want. Very friendly and helpful staff at breakfast. Lovely hotel. Would definitely recommend.

author: stunt101
title: Good Friendly Hotel - Can be Great with some tweaks
text: Stayed at this hotel for 4 nights in December, greeted with a friendly smile, quick introduction of the hotel and the surrounding area. Check in was quick, room was on a high up floor in a superior double room with street view. The room was clean, and spacious, with lots of room for storage. The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was very nice, and again large. I found the room to be slightly warm, and even tho I turned down the heat, the room would heat up - I think this is because of the heated towel rack. Anyways opened the window and all was fine. Part of our package included buffet breakfast. Breakfast was pretty good with lots of different options, if you are doing keto or enjoy eggs, meat, cheese, this is the buffet for you. The only downside to the buffet, was some juices weren't replenished, once they were finished - and so if you asked for refill, you were told, sorry that's all we have. So that was like .. oh okay, if you say so. I have to say I enjoyed the hotel very much. It was quiet and in a good area, we were able to quickly get around and use it for a hub for all our day travels. Downsides to the hotel, when making reservations, I told them we were celebrating my wifes birthday - they confirmed, but made no mention at check in or during the stay. The wifi was a bit choppy, it cut in and out through out the 4 days and didn't improve. Kudos to the hotel for installing motion sensor lighting in the hallways .. but makes the hotel feel dark. This hotel has a lot of potential and can be good base for travels. Recommend this hotel!

author: Natalykov
title: Amazing !
text: The perfect hotel. One of the best i have been in..sevice is great. Always with a smile. Ant problem -glad to have. Perfect cleaning of the room. Bug room whicb is not typical in eueope. Great breakfast . lot o choice. They even make a capuchino in a special cofee bar in the breakfast area fo free. A free bottle of water in room. Spacious bathroom , huge shower. Close to everything. 5 minute walk from wazlaw square and 10 minute to the astronomic clock. Located in front of very interesting KAFKA statue. The entrance a little hard to find. It is just opposite of the kafka statue -a double wooden door leads to the lobby. If ever again in prague- will deffinetely choose this hotel !

author: deej54
title: Huge room, wonderful staff
text: The Golden Crown is an SLH (Small Luxury Hotel) and it was just that and more. Our room was on the 3rd floor with 3 large bay windows (that we could open and let the fresh air and sunlight in). We overlooked a beautiful rotating sculpture of Franz Kafka as well as the new Quadrio Shopping Mall. (An easy place to change currency). Our room was bigger than some suites we've stayed in, clean, well lit, with a most comfortable king size bed. Our bathroom had really nice products and a bathtub big enough for two. The separate shower was wonderful. Bathrobes, slippers, a safe, and cold mini bar. I never buy snacks from the room, nor do I use their coffee machine - but this time I did and the coffee was delicious. (who knew?) The very best part of the hotel was Olga at the front desk. Knowledgeable, caring and with such a great smile. She was so helpful with her directions and suggestions. (She wasn't working when we left so we didn't get to say goodbye). Breakfast was the norm - fresh fruit, cereals, sliced meats, and cheeses, croissants and more. Self-service and very easy to get to. But they had a wonderful coffee bar with two young ladies - who couldn't have been nicer. They even knew what we wanted daily, and on our last day brought us two cappuccino's "with love from Prague". We are looking forward to returning to the Golden Crown Hotel and highly recommend it to others.

author: 639frankj
title: Very nice Hotel close to city center
text: The Hotel seems to be quite new and was a great choice. Walking distance to the old city part and all important sight seeing spots. Metro and Tram stops very close by. Shopping center next door. The room was really nice. Only two very minor things: 1. The Toilet seat wasn't mounted properly, meaning it was twisted a bit to the left side. So not even. When sitting on it it just gave a weird feeling. Really minor, and I guess/hope only in our room ;) 2. The blinds were not big enough to shield the window completely. So there was always light coming in which might be a problem for people who can only sleep in complete darknes. Otherwise the room was really good! Service was also good and always very polite. I can only recommend this hotel and will consider if I travel Prague again...

author: 512kristinaf
title: Much bigger potential, but underutilized
text: After roughly 1 year I revisited the hotel. The good news is that it has maintained its level. The not so good news is that the level is far from great (taking into account its potential), it is rather average (especially the service level and the atmosphere). The building is beautiful, newly renovated, good location near to the National theater and Vencel square. The rooms are decorated in a minimalistic modern decor, which I personally like. The wifi works well. There is a wide selection of bathroom amenities. The breakfast is good, with sufficient selection (at least for me) and nice coffee. What is however missing totally in this hotel is any sign of hospitality. It's starting with the entrance and lobby. When entering you see a corridor instead of human interface. The reception is placed further on the right side. Even this could be ok if there were professional and pleasant front desk staff welcoming you. Instead of that (at least during my few check ins) there was a staff literally hardly capable of even basic conversation, definitely not trained to work in hospitality industry. Also the breakfast staff deserves improvement as they are passively waiting to serve coffee instead of proactive taking care of the guests. Around reception but not even in the room there is anything which would create a welcoming atmosphere (no nice scent, flowers, welcome message). During my last visit it was already pretty cold outside, but the heating was not yet calibrated so it was very cold during the night in the room, again not adding on the atmosphere. They fixed it next day though. All in all, nice hardware, weak human interface.

author: jenn31884
title: Great hotel, location
text: I can't rave about this hotel enough. I did a lot of research on where to stay without knowing much about Prague at all. I booked Golden Crown based on reviews, price,and a seemingly central location, though again I didn't really know where anything was. Boy, I made a great choice! First of all, the hotel itself is very nice, the rooms new and the bathrooms are awesome (waterfall showers, all tile, complimentary products). They give you a firm and a soft pillow for each person! There's a small fridge with reasonably priced snacks, slippers, robes, and plenty of closet space. There was a complimentary breakfast that blows any American continental breakfast out of the water, they will even make you a latte or cappuccino. A great perk! Next, the location was perfect for us as first time visitors. We found nothing to be too far. 5 min walk from U Medvídkû, one of the oldest restaurants (Bourdain visits here in his Prague episode), 10 min walk from Old Town Square and the Charles Bridge. Close to shopping on Nardoni. We could go in any direction and we weren't far. I would highly recommend Golden Crown, especially for its reasonable price!

author: scorryuk
title: LOVED IT! Could not find fault. Will return.
text: Just back from a weekend break- my 3rd visit to prague. Definitely my best hotel stay, the last being the Best Western Majestic. At time of booking the prices definitely varied from site to site but I snagged what I considered to be a very well priced 3 night stay. I had a query about twin beds which was answered by email very promptly. Check in was very efficient and problem free. The hotel had a very clean and modern décor. I was very impressed with the room. I stayed in room 504, an attic room with high ceilings and beams. Room was spotless, loved the shower. All bathroom extras including bathrobe and slippers were provided. Comfortable mattress and provision of both normal and memory foam pillows on bed- very thoughtful! Breakfast was a well stocked buffet which met all my needs. I`ve had better but still thought it to be well above the normal. All high end appliances and dining area spotless and well run. Overall I was very impressed with my stay and would definitely return.

author: LawrenceSoh
title: A memorable stay in Prague
text: We arrived at Hotel Golden Crown from Cesky Krumlov one late afternoon in April 2016. The staff was friendly, warm and ready to help with a quick check-in to our room on the fifth floor. There was a good Italian restaurant nearby where we took our dinner and the location of the hotel was just opposite the Quadrio shopping complex, Tesco and the iconic, 11m dynamic Franz Kafka sculpture. We also found out on the first night that the Narodni Trida station (metro and tram) was just a few steps away, and Mustek Metro station was a 5 mins walk from the hotel. Kvetiny Floretta, the local florist opened till late at night along the walkway near the hotel. We had a neat and spacious twin room, with hardwood floors and high ceiling. The wardrobe and well stocked minibar were away from the washroom area. The WIFI was of decent speed and there were adequate electrical points to charge our notebook and hand phones. The shower area was long and roomy & the washroom was clean, with large, a flat basin, long mirrors and adequate towels. We had a 6” space at the head & foot of each bed (outside the mattress) and I found this extremely convenient to place my books, maps, spectacles, hand bag etc. Well positioned reading lights and bedside charging sockets were most appreciated. Breakfast the next morning came with a generous continental spread of vegetables and fruits for salad, warm bread, butter and cheese, crispy croissants, eggs, bacon, sausage & pastries. There was a huge, flat screen TV with BBC news at the dining area. Our freshly brewed coffee came with latte art from an experienced barista during our stay, and this was memorable. We plan to return to this hotel again in future.

author: Doughnut00
title: Excellent.
text: Stayed for 5 days in Prague, and this hotel was just excellent. Central location. Very friendly and helpful staff. Rooms were spotless and very comfy. Very quiet as well. The breakfast, which was included, is possibly the best we have ever had at a hotel. From the hotel you can reach all of Prague via the metro and trams. There is also a Tesco across and through the mall. Lots of wee shops as well. Avoid the local pubs next to the hotel. More like all male drinking dens. Not nice. Go out and explore Prague. So much to see. Tea and a coffee substitute (a few Nescafé sachets would help) were supplied in the room as well, but with square cups, which was a bit odd. The TV had all the local channels. Maybe a couple of movie channels would help. Overall, really liked this hotel. Highly recommended.

author: KalamataC
title: Good location
text: Location is good within five minutes’ walk to metro and bus, within easy access to all tourist spots. Rooms are of decent size and modern. The first room I was assigned was nothing as expected, the closet door handle was broken and cannot be opened easily. The curtains could not be closed properly and one end fell off the railing so lights coming in from different directions. I asked the housekeeping to fix it and was replied could only be fixed on Monday (I checked in on Friday)!!! I requested them to tape the curtains to minimize the light coming in and was given the tape with no scissors and asked me to tape it myself. I could not even tear off the tape. I was totally annoyed and asked for change of room. A new room was ready for me after dinner, however, no assistance was offered to move my things over. I already told the receptionist I had unpacked all my stuff already. There was change of duty so I guessed the receptionist on duty at night was not aware but at least could offer if assistance was required. The new room was roomier but air conditioning was not working properly with the temperature could not go down below 24C. (My friend’s room could go down to 21C) The control was funny, you need to lower the fan before you could start the air-conditioning, once you increase the fan speed, the system turned off. I reported the problem after the first night but the problem was only fixed on the fifth night!!! Housekeeping did not check the details carefully and the facial tissue box was emptied on the third night and not replaced until the fifth night I took the box to the reception and asked for replacement. Apart from the minimal service provided and the uncomfortable room temperature for four nights out of five nights, the rooms, location and breakfast are reasonable with the price charged.

author: janidb
title: Great location, delicious breakfast
text: My husband and I stayed at this hotel in September, 2015. The staff was very nice and helpful. When we saw our room, it was clearly not what was shown on the Internet, so I asked for another room. They had Housekeeping show me two different rooms, one of which was what I had been expecting. We went out for lunch, and when we returned, the new room was ready. The room was fairly big by European standards, with comfortable beds and a bathroom with a large shower with a rain shower head and a separate spray head. I would have preferred bedside tables with a drawer and a shelf, but these were designed for a modern look, not for utility. The air-conditioning was supposed to be controllable by us, but only to a point. We never got it to go below 21 deg. C, no matter how low we set it. Breakfast was terrific, with an excellent variety and just the best croissants! One morning, they ran out of them for a short time, and when they were replenished, they were hot out of the oven. Delicious! The hotel is located across the street from a shopping mall and a great Italian restaurant, where we ate most of the time. We would recommend this hotel

author: Pradeep_Maheshwari
title: Lovely Hotel, Lovely staff....Loved it thoroughly
text: It was our first trip to Prague and we fell in love with the city and the hospitality of it's people. Hotel Golden Crown made our stay memorable in Prague. Located very close to the old town and Charles bridge, this hotel has everything to offer that you may need. The room was superb and had a great view of the big giant rotating metalic human face in front of the Quadrio mall. The hotel is very close (5 min walk) to Mustek Metro station and also the Narodni Trida station (metro and train) was just a few steps away. The hotel staff was excellent. We stayed in the hotel for 5 nights and found different person at the reception at different times. All of them were very friendly, always smiling and ready to help. We asked them many questions (about directions, attractions, public transport) and they never got annoyed. Breakfast was too good. Internet speed was superb. Bathroom was awesome. There is nothing that we did not like about this hotel. Great value for the price. Highly recommended. And yeah, there are two pure vegetarian dhabas (Dhaba Beas) right next to the hotel so perfect location for vegetarians like us!

author: lmhazardous
title: This hotel accomplishes everything it intends to do
text: Libertalia is a homey hotel right on the beach. The most notable feature is one that many reviewers also highlight - the friendliness of the staff. Upon our arrival, we were warmly welcomed and presented with a map of the island with recommendations of how to spend our time and where to visit. What we really appreciated was that the staff wanted us to experience the best of what the island had to offer -- there was no attempt to keep us only at the restaurant on the premises. Thanks to staff recommendations, we took a moto up to the Piscine Natural, enjoyed multiples meals at Idyle Beach (don't miss this!), and took a day trip at Ile aux Nattes. Libertalia is excellent value for your money, but isn't fancy. The bungalows are clean and nice -- but a bit dark (although all have a sea view). Like most hotels on the island, the bungalows are near the road so you will hear some car noise -- but it's mostly canceled out by the sound of the waves. The food isn't amazing, but it's perfectly clean and adequate -- and the staff will point you towards other restaurants in town or on Ile aux Nattes to try. Their recommendations were all excellent. From we gathered, the hotel owner is also very well known for his whale watching excursions, and a marine biologist gave us a briefing on the whales before we headed out. The trip we went on was excellent (although we did get a bad day of weather and were quite sick!). We'd definitely recommend that you go whale watching through them. In short, Libertalia punches above its weight in terms of staff friendliness and customer service. The atmosphere is great and definitely fits a beach vacation. Great value for money. Overall, a very positive experience for us.

author: 263sophieg
title: Lovely staff, great location!
text: We stayed here for 6 nights and it was absolutely great. The moment we arrived, we were greeted by a lovely young lady who welcomed us in a friendly and enthusiastic manner and offered us a drink, before she went through information and showed us our room. First impressions count for a lot so she did a great job on this. The food was very tasty and considering we were there for 6 nights the menu changed every day so we always had something different, even on days we chose to eat both our lunch and dinner there. The bungalows are only a few metres from the sea, and come with a safe for our valuables which was good. Note that the distance from the sea means the waves can be quite noisy, so if you're a light sleeper you might want to bring ear plugs. Cleaners come in everyday to make the beds, change our towels and sweep the floors from all the sand that would inevitably end up inside. The shower is powerful and there is hot water. Electricity is available all hours except for about 5am - 9am, and wifi is available in the restaurant/reception area (which by the way is beautiful, complete with a few tortoises). Staff were lovely, especially Mirah (who we think was the manager). She was there to speak to the guests regularly at mealtimes to check we were happy, and she was warm, personable and approachable. All our requests for help with things were met without hesitation. We will miss her! The boss of the hotel was also kind enough to notice us walking into town and stopped to give us a lift which was lovely. If you're keen on whale watching (June - September) Liberalia also offers this with Cetamada, the organisation to go with it seems. We were even able to attend a presentation from one of their volunteers, at Libertalia itself. Unfortunately we were unlucky on the trip we had, but there was great success the following day which we missed as we were diving instead (green turtles included!) All in all we would highly recommend Libertalia. It's a great mid-range option, and without the high price tags you still get superb service, great food and a beachside experience.

author: VacationSweetHeart
title: Simply Amazing
text: The moment I got here, I took a nap after a long journey through Western Madagascar. The bed was AWESOME! The room is very classy, but in a low key way. Everything was very quality. There's a great dock that walks you out to your own personal island. The food was grand. Live music during dinner. The view outstanding. The vantage point faces westward, so it is hard to beat. The staff speaks English. We rented a scooter, too. We stayed an extra night, since we loved it so much. Honestly, this place I will remember forever. It's pricier than the other places we stayed, but you can see why.... you get what you pay for!

author: WisdomExchangeTV
title: Great Value, fantastic location & relaxed atmosphere
text: One of the nicest places along the beach. It is the the first hotel south of town (towards airport). Easy 2km walk to town (relaxed 30 min walk). Hotel will arrange taxi pu for 20,000 MGA from airport - about 15 minutes. The road literally runs along the coast/beach which means it is also right behind virtually every hotel & bungalow along the coast. But beware: it is not the road that will keep you awake, it is surf - very calm water but it echos & is amplified night. Wear ear plugs if light sleeper. Libertalia are series of bungalows to serve needs of couples, friends, or families. All are relatively private, smaller units right on the beach. Very clean, plenty of hot water, and nicely sized with nets and fans. We stayed 9 nights. Restaurant offers good service for breakfast, lunch, dinner & snacks. Mains are 18,000 MGA with usually 3 offerings available. Very good value, tasty and well portioned and very good variety offered over our stay. We visited several other properties along the coast, and were very happy with our choice - would stay again. Only drawback is beach is not suitable for swimming, however they have built a long dock out to rock island where swimming & snorkeling is possible.

author: babswFl
title: Nice place
text: I've stayed with Hyatt before and have been impressed but never stayed here. The staff was awesome and very helpful and nice. Our room was a king bed suite with view of the pool. Not too many great views there. Room was really clean and fresh. Had extra amenities, like all kinds of charge ports, bigger TV and nice sectional couch with pull out. Breakfast was good, had good assortment for everything. Very clean hotel. They allow pets for extra 75. Which is great. Quiet rooms, there was a soccer kids tournament staying there and we didn't hear anything in our room. My only complaint was that the AC wasn't the best. It was cold everywhere in the hotel but not our room. We didn't complain since we weren't there too much. Also the blanket was kind of heavy for summer. But we will definitely stay again. It's Close to downtown, about 10 minutes and 5 minutes from Ringling and bridge to Armand circle. So nice stay

author: eminker
title: Very Nice Stay in Sarasota -- Highly Recommended
text: Visiting from NYC for a 90th Birthday celebration weekend. Check-in and Check-out was flawless as well as plenty of parking in their onsite parking lot. Staff was very friendly, courteous and helpful. One accommodation missing was the availability of coffee/tea in the main lobby which we have at Hilton and Marriott Properties. Its a little thing but we missed it. The Computer Area unfortunately is in the main lobby so no real privacy and printer was not working for the five days we were there. Also usual issues accessing work and personal email due to outdated computer software which we have seen in most hotels when we travel. Proximity to Sarasota Airport (5 minutes) and 1 hr from Tampa Airport. Hotel and room were very clean and maintained overall. Room size was a bit small with a divider between sleeping and main coach sitting area. Bed was a bit too soft for us so you may want to request a room with a firm mattress if you need it. Air conditioning was fabulous (not too loud) and you will need it in the Summer months. Basic No Frills Breakfast was fine and again staff very accommodating as much as they can be. All in all though, it was a good stay and we would recommend this hotel to those traveling in the Sarasota area. Its a good value and we will be back.

author: dms11
title: Good rooms and GREAT staff but fitness center desperately needs repair or new equipment
text: Let's start with the positives: The staff here are among the friendliest and most helpful people I have ever run across in a hotel. I almost felt sad having to leave them. The rooms are good in that they have a half-divider between the bed and living room areas that makes rooms feel like mini-suites. The free breakfast is pretty standard stuff (eggs/cereal, etc.) but not bad. However, a huge plus is their 24-hour food/beverage cafe selections that include beer/wine and flatbread/tacos, etc., all for sale of course. But that is a great convenience and the food is not bad. The one huge disappointment for me was the fitness center. There is only one essentially non-working elliptical. The actual level is stuck at about 20 (even when it reads "0") (i.e. very heavy resistance) and the video monitor does not work. Then there is only one recumbent bike which works, except for the footstraps that are so worn they cannot be adjusted or tightened. And while the video monitor sort of works (good luck figuring out where to press to activate buttons), there are only three working channels on the TV--ESPN U; Comedy Central and an infomercial channel. There are also two treadmills, which I do not use so I cannot speak to their deficiencies, if any. There is a Crunch fitness center you can use for free a few miles away but that is a good option only if you have a car to get there. The hotel shuttle does not run before 10 am. Bottom line---this is a nice hotel right next to airport with good rooms and great staff but the fitness center desperately needs an upgrade.

author: Q7762LPkimberlym
title: Comfy hotel with awesome free breakfast
text: This hotel has the famous comfy Hyatt bed. It has free shuttle service to take you anywhere within 3 miles. The breakfast selection is great. The hot tub and pool were nice. Mini-refrigerator in each room. Staff were very accommodating. I needed to find a nearby location that served milkshakes and they were kind enough to look it up for me... only a couple miles away. No restaurant on site but they do offer "food service" which is a selection of different snack type foods they cook to order and can bring to your room. They also have a coffee bar and snack case to purchase foods. They might also serve liquor.. I don't drink so I'm not sure. Pet friendly but did NOT have any odors... I only knew it was pet friendly when I saw dogs walking about. Located DIRECTLY across from entrance to Sarasota/Bradenton Airport. Greyhound Dog Race Track right down the road also. Everything was clean. Computers with internet access right in the lobby. Washer/dryers only $1.50 to use. Only negative is small towels in rooms and pool...we had our own large beach towels so it wasn't a problem for us.

author: Suziekim2015
title: Most horrible hotel experience!
text: To celebrate my daughter's birthday, my family made a short road trip to Sarasota. We had made reservations at the Hyatt Place Sarasota/Bradenton for 2 nights. My husband and I both have Hyatt Rewards Credit Cards which enable us to use points accumulated towards rooms at any Hyatt Hotels. We had booked 2 separate nights and when we checked in, the hotel personnel were aware of the fact we use our Hyatt Rewards Credit Cards and told us to check out in the morning and check back in at the same time. We had done as they told us. While we were out spending quality family time, we got an alert on our phones that there was a charge from our hotel for the room. A worker at the hotel had made another reservation for us for the same day and decided to bill us for the room. In the middle of having a good day, we went back to the hotel to inquire able the charge and why. The only personnel at the time was a worker named Jeffrey, who didn't look happy to see us when we entered. My husband talked to Jeffrey, but he refused to assist us and told us to call customer service. We went back up to our room and waited while my husband was on the phone with customer service. It was a long and lengthy process of getting this matter resolved. As we were getting ready to go out again, my son pointed out that this Jeffrey was the same guy who was rude to him the night before. My son had gone down to get a cheesecake for my daughter's birthday and unfortunately came across this rude man. Jeffrey did not give my son a receipt of the cheesecake, slapped the change down on the counter instead of handing the change back to him, and when my son had asked for some paper cups, Jeffrey refused to give him any. After all was said and done, Mr. Collin Sanei tried his best to make things right, but we didn't want anything from this hotel afterwards. No amount of free things they wanted to provide afterward will erase the bad image of our experience at the Hyatt Place Sarasota. Now we will definitely avoid Hyatt Hotels in case any of this happens again.

author: clm10124
title: Pretty Decent
text: Stayed only one night on business. Upon entering the hotel, I wasn't greet. I dont mind but I was slightly confused about front desk because its together with the snack bar. A guy at the front acknowledged me as soon as he finished with the couple that he was assisting. He was professional and nice. On my way to the room, there was people in the hallway working on the hotel's renovations. That concerned me since I can hear it in my room but they wrapped up before night fall. The room was clean and updated. The bed was comfortable. The shower was weird. It was glass but no door. Not sure if i was missing a shower door or if this was a new concept. The TV in the room had a very grainy look on any channel but again I was there one night. Great thing was that I was able to hook up my laptop via HDMI cable and watch Netflix perfectly. I steamed Netflix on the hotel's WiFi and it worked great as well. For dinner, I ordered a chicken Cesar salad from the hotel. Waited a while only to receive a salad that wasnt that great. Overall, I would definitely stay again.

author: 308Discodave
title: Fine for a few days
text: Just an overnight stay until we spend a month on Longboat Key. Hotel easy to find - immediately opposite exit from Sarasota airport. Staff pleasant - loads of parking space. Room was clean and beds and pillows comfortable. Rather dark with inadequate lighting. Why they put us at the very end of the corridor next to busy University drive I don't know. Noisy at night, although windows double glazed. A/C really noisy although effective. So a bad nights sleep - but some of that attributed to jet lag. Didn't ask to change room- it was for one night. Breakfast very acceptable - self service. Great fruit salad, eggs bacon, juices coffee etc. Pool area very pleasant, and cleaned regularly. Would I stay again? Probably not.
