I didn't like my room and as a HYATT gold passport member I should have been given something nicer, away fro busy road. The hotel appeared to be quiet during our stay.

author: MichiganderAbroad
title: Below standard Hyatt property
text: Unfortunately, my stay at this Hyatt Place did not even come close to the reviews I read before booking my 2 night stay. First off, if you're approaching the hotel from the wrong angle, their sign is almost impossible to discern- they share it with two other hotels on the same side street. Not great advertising. I was assigned an accessible room which I didn't need, but was fortunately able to change to a regular room. The desk agent told me that I must have booked the wrong room type (I checked my reservation afterwards- I hadn't booked an accessible room). The room I ended up with was spacious with a nice shower and good bathroom counter space. However, I could clearly hear the TV on in the next room so the soundproofing wasn't ideal. I was also staggered at how uncomfortable the bed was- one side sagged so much that it would have been like sleeping on a cliff's edge. Fortunately I was traveling alone and could sleep on the other side, but that side was firm to the point of hard, so that wasn't ideal either. The linens were scratchy and uncomfortable- your basic sleeping nightmare. The other thing I found inexplicable about this property was that my room was not made up on my second day. I had vacated it from about 11:30-2:30 but had to come back in the afternoon to make some work calls- it wasn't made up during those 3 hours which surprised me. I put the do not disturb sign on from about 2:30-3:30, and at 3:30 found a note slipped under the door that said because of the do not disturb sign I wouldn't have my room serviced and that the housekeeping staff had left for the day. This wouldn't have bothered me nearly as much if I hadn't left my room half an hour later to see two housekeeping carts in the hallway as I walked to the elevator! It just didn't make any sense to me and spoke to a lack of organization in the hotel. The breakfast was free which was a nice perk but overall I was really unimpressed by this property- I had expected way more based on these reviews and on future trips to Sarasota would happily spend more for a hotel with better service and more comfortable rooms.

author: BigMan50
title: Hidden Gem
text: We usually stay at Hyatt's regardless of where we are. Most times our visits revolve around sporting events. Football, hockey and baseball trips. This trip was purely for fun. The front desk staff were courteous and professional. Parking was free. The room was your typical Hyatt room, large, clean with a king bed (which was very comfortable by the way). The pool looked clean and well maintained though we never went directly to it. The workout room was the same. Clean and well maintained. No problem to get a workout done. Complimentary breakfast the next day was great! Everything you can think of for a typical breakfast was there. It wasn't until the next day that I realized just how close this location is to downtown and the ocean. Some people may worry about the airport and the noise... we did not hear any noise at all. We only stayed the one night but I would recommend this location to anyone.

author: wendybN7373QZ
title: UNPLEASANT STAFF INTERACTION
text: We came in for Parent's Weekend for New College. I called around 1:30-2pm Saturday when we arrived in town to see if we could possible drop our stuff off in room before heading out for activities. We were told a room was ready. We checked in and went to the room to find a do not disturb sign on the door. Hesitantly we went in. The room was empty but not cleaned - the tip was still on bathroom counter. We went down front (the in room phone was not charged) and told the staff. She assured us the room would be cleaned very quickly. We left our baggage in room and went on to activities. We came home after 5pm - room not clean. There was cleaning staff outside room and I asked about it and she told me to go to front desk. We were short on time and wanted to change for our dinner plans. I went to front desk and told the gentleman and he asked me what I wanted him to do. I said we wanted a clean room to be able to change clothes in for dinner. He got us into a new room. But he was very rude. We will book somewhere else in Sarasota the next time we come down for a visit.

author: /undefined
title: Quality for a decent price
text: We moved to the Hyatt Place after an uncomfortable night at an overpriced modern "boutique" hotel that did not include breakfast or parking. The Hyatt Place includes both in the room rate which was significantly lower. Our room was a King and had a sitting area with a large couch, table-desk and prep area, coffee-tea service, a separate bedroom area, vanity-sink separate from the toilet-shower room. Large walk-in shower. Small closet, no in-room safe. Ample outlets for electronics. Very quiet room. Has an A/C unit, not central air; settings can be changed. Reception was pleasant and helpful and the housekeeping staff was friendly. Cold drinks and snacks including fresh baked cookies are available for purchase as are menu items from the small bistro. There's a small bar. Our room was quiet even though it overlooked the pool. The airport across the road is not busy so there's not much noise from there. Breakfast was a surprise: it was generous with a good variety of standard American fare and healthy options including fresh fruit. We were impressed with our first Hyatt Place stay.

author: /undefined
title: Nice hotel, but room-cleaning needs improvement
text: My husband and I stayed at Hyatt Place Sarasota/Bradenton Airport for a total of four nights. On our second day, we had gone out to beaches, then returned to the room a little bit after 3pm to wash-up, etc., for the evening, and the room had not yet been cleaned. We alerted the front desk staff and this was resolved in a reasonably prompt fashion. The following day, however, our room was never cleaned. The representatives at the front desk (night staffers) provided all of the necessary towels and toiletries and were very attentive and responsive to our issue. They alerted management right away and assured us that we could speak with a manager the next morning (and we did). Overall, the remainder of the hotel experience was a good one. The breakfast area appeared to be neat and clean, and well-stocked. Although we did not take advantage of the Starbucks counter, we were happy to see it there as an option. Nice selection of newspapers (free for the taking) as well. The hotel lobby area greeted us with a very fresh fragrance; hallways were spotless; rooms, once cleaned, were spacious and tidy. Bathroom only offered a shower - it would have been more relaxing with a bath tub. I would like to recommend this hotel but am hesitant to do so unless the cleaning staff were improved upon. In the hot/humid Florida sun, with bug as well as lots of beach use, it's important to be able to return to a clean hotel room and a reasonable expectation to have this service completed by the afternoon hours. I've read numerous reviews for other similar-quality hotels and notice that frequency of room cleaning seems to be an issue, generally. I would have expected a bit higher attentiveness from a Hyatt property. The manager was apologetic and understanding, though - and compensated us fairly for our troubles - and we appreciated that. Again, staff was very friendly and inviting; it was nice to be served in that way promptly.

author: flaviator
title: Quality & Value rolled into one
text: What a fantastic hotel with quality management!! I stopped in early in the morning, way before check-in time to request a top floor, end room. The front desk assured me he would block a room for my request. I checked in after 8pm, and sure enough my room as requested was blocked for me. The room was great. HOWEVER, the breakfast the next morning was utterly FANTASTIC!!!! This was a buffet to match the best of a full service hotel. No, correction....it was better!!! Cottage cheese, two types of yogurt, assorted bowls of fresh fruit, various preparations of cooked eggs, pancakes, french toast, pastries, six different juices, etc. etc. You get the picture. Being a Hyatt Diamond member, I also received a $30 voucher for food from their 24/7 menu. So, during breakfast I ordered two salad plates w grilled chicken and assorted containers of hummus for my lunch with a friend that day. Though all the food was fresh and tasty, it was too much for us to finish. So my friend enjoyed the balance the next day. This was among the best hotel experiences I've had in SRQ, especially at this price level, in a very long time. I'll be back!!!

author: Shortcake15
title: Beautiful hotel but..
text: The hotel itself is gorgeous! The staff is very friendly and check-in was a breeze. We really enjoyed the small bar area and being able to order food 24/7. The morning breakfast is awesome! The rooms are spacious, well decorated and clean. Now for the not so good part... We stayed on June 4th for a family trip. We were excited to relax by the pool after a long day only to find that it was taken over by a sports team and the guardians and we had no place to sit, much less swim! Of course we didn't expect to be the only ones there but kids running, cannonballs, whipping balls (parents too and most of them showed no attention to controlling their kids when people other than their group showed up to swim!) across the pool does not make for a relaxing time. To top it off, my husband was hit in the back of the head with a ball that was whipped across the pool while swimming with our baby. It may not sound like a big deal but he has a cervical fusion and being hit like that could be life threatening..not ok!! The staff did step in and have them all move to one side of the pool ( again, the staff is wonderful!) but I think more monitoring of the pool may be needed. We went down for drinks at night and loved the service! Very sweet staff but again..kids taking over the area late at night. It was hard to relax anywhere but our room.

author: emailgreg
title: Quiet, comfortable, nice staff, close to the airport, great WiFi!
text: I stayed here for one month, the staff are very friendly... Especially Natalie and Rico. I have never been to a hotel where the WiFi was this excellent! I especially appreciate not having to login everyday, the strength of the WiFi was consistent through out the property. This was very important to me as I was there on business. Hyatt Places all being similar in setup, it was you would expect. One thing I didn't care for was the same breakfast everyday. For guests who stay there long term this gets very old fast. The same fruit (no berries) melons, citrus fruits was very plain. Some days the breakfast sandwiches were hard. Housekeeping was super friendly and when I had my "do not disturb" sign they would do exactly that which I appreciated. Most hotels, their housekeepers would yell loudly by your door, bang around in the room beside you and even call your room to see if you needed service. They didn't bother me at all and respected the sign which was nice as sometime I didn't go to work until 2:00 pm. Trip Advisor has many write ups about teams staying at this hotel. There were a lot of teams while I was here for month. However there was never any noise that went on that bothered me at night, all groups seemed very well managed on all levels. Thank you Hyatt Place, Sarasota/Bradenton. I will stay here again and will recommend it.

author: bayviewer_13
title: The good, the bad, the ugly
text: My husband and i stayed here on 11/2/15. We liked the room layout and found it clean, quiet and comfortable. We didn't like the short glass shower door that wets the floor when you shower but we experienced this crazy design recently in California so I guess some hotels think it works. Now, for the ugly. No one appeared to be servicing the breakfast area from 7:00 a.m. to 7:20 a.m. The two sandwich trays were empty and when they were finally filled, I discovered the sandwich was not good. I ate half and threw the rest away. Maybe they had been prepared and stored too long before being offered to guests. Also, the fruit seemed to be old, not cut recently. Perhaps this food operation needs supervisory overview. We left at 7:30 a.m. and no one had walked around to check food levels or cleanliness while we were there. The young woman who filled the sandwich trays did so and disappeared immediately after. We haven't had this experience in other Hyatt Hotels and we will stay at this one again, but won't expect a good breakfast unless something is done to make changes in this failing operation.

author: cfdragons
title: Nice Place, Really Small Bathrooms
text: Recently went to Sarasota and stayed here for a week. We picked this hotel because of location and price for the time period we would be there. Check-in was quick. One problem was I had reserved a King, pool view, and we were given a king, street/airport view, on the first floor, busy street at that. So back to the front desk to get the room we requested. This time we were on the third floor with the "pool view" (but only if you could see through the trees). And it was way far from the elevators. The room itself was fairly nice, dry bar, L-shaped couch with a divider from the sleeping area. We liked the fact that the sink was separate from the shower and toilet. The bathroom was very small and cramped. You had to go in, stand on the side of the toilet in order to even close the door. The shower was a stand-up with a rain shower head and what I would consider a 1/4 door which meant the floor tended to get a little wet no matter how you positioned the door. And there was no exhaust fan in the bathroom. The bed itself was very, very firm which didn't make for a comfortable nights sleep. I've always wondered why hotels don't go for Select Comfort beds, then everyone would sleep well. The free breakfast was OK, nothing to rave about. Sunday was scrambled eggs, bacon, pastries, bagels, juice, etc. The rest of the week was breakfast sandwiches which were not appealing at all. They offer 24/7 food and drinks which we did not try. All in all the hotel was OK and most of the people we met at the front desk were very nice and helpful, especially Jorie and Natalie.

author: dotters
title: Could have been great, but was very good!
text: We made a reservation thru Priceline for 2 rooms. They weren't close to each other. One was near a screaming baby - the other down the hall. It would have made more sense if the desk figured out that we were together and put the rooms next to each other. One room had an enormous living room, but the shower fixture was so low, it was ridiculous. The other room had a smaller living room and the shower was higher. (This is an important detail as my hubby is 6'5".) The towels were not thick at all, but plentiful. The room was quiet even though it was near the airport. One bed was very creaky - you couldn't move without making a lot of noise, The Pillows weren't the nicest - not soft at all, but there were a lot of them. Breakfast was so so. The scrambled eggs were terrible; pancakes and waffles good. The fruit salad seemed like it came from a can and the fruit wasn't tasty. However, there were fresh bananas and apples. Orange juice wasn't fresh squeezed. There were a lot of choices, and once you knew to avoid the eggs, you were good. The staff seemed friendly - some at the front desk were a bit clueless (maybe being trained?) Overall, I think I would give them another try, but would definitely not pay the stated rate and go to Priceline or another website. WiFi wasn't the fastest, but free. The pool looked nice, but the weather wasn't great so we didn't go...

author: 219marcyg
title: This IS where you want to stay.
text: I have stayed at this specific Hyatt Place for five years. As soon as you walk in you feel how important you are to the hotel. The check in is a breeze. The staff when you first arrive really do a first class job making sure all your needs are taken care of. You can ask if you have a special need and these people just make it happen. The location is perfect. You have all of downtown Sarasota and the beaches too so close by. They offer a shuttle as well. Then after a long day out you come back to your room and it is so clean. I love their beds and their special way they make it. The pillows are lush and refreshing. The out line of the room is great because you have a side which is where the bed is and another side where there is a sitting area with a sofa that opens up to a comfortable sleeping experience. And let me say that when it comes to cleanliness this is the hotel. You will see it the moment you walk in. Kitchen is open 24/7 too. I hope you give this gem a chance. I did and I have never stayed but with Hyatt at Sarasota/Bradenton in Sarasota, Fl.

author: I4364JYmarian
title: The best hotel in Sarasota
text: As I was moving to my new home, wonderful sales team Dana and Angie brought me to their hotel Hyatt Place in which I stayed for over a month. Hyatt Place Sarasota/Bradenton Airport hotel is centrally located to popular area attractions including the Siesta & Lido Key Beach, Ringling Museum of Art, and over 50 private and public golf courses. I've never had better experience than staying in this Hotel. Morning crew running delicious hot complementary breakfast was always smiling and assisted me with any problems I had. The biggest THANK YOU to Michelle, Diana, Taylor, Ricardo, Rayna and Maria. At night I had a chance to enjoy fabulous team of people. Thanks to Denise, Natalie, Dawn, Boaz, Jeneane, Lizeth, Haskell and Paul I had a chance to enjoy my happy hour daily watching the games on big tv at the bar :) What a fun thing to do... Not to forget General manager Ashleigh and her assistant Duauna whom I also had a chance to meet. Great people with amazing passion for customer service! Also big thanks to Gabby who made me laugh every morning! During your stay, any of these lovely people will happily assist you with orders from their new Gallery Menu, Fresh 24/7, featuring signature flatbreads, a Make It 2 option and delicious new sandwiches, greens, apps & more. Or you can enjoy specialty Starbucks coffee, premium beer, wine & cocktails over friendly conversation at the bar. Not to forget about free WI-FI throughout the hotel and outdoor swimming pool and hot tub. 24/7 fitness center is also available and they also have agreement with Crunch fitness which is just 3 miles down the road. All I needed is to show them my room key and I could work out for free any day. And of course I took advantage of this :) The last thing I can say is don't be a fool and go to any other hotel in Sarasota! Stay at the Hyatt Place!!! Enjoy the best!

author: quietlycool
title: Low Key but Top Notch
text: We visited Sarasota for a quick 3-night visit and ended up choosing Hyatt Place. It wasn't exactly where we wanted to stay considering Sarasota's beautiful beach properties but since this was a family visit and technically not a vacation we gave it a try. First, for being so close to the airport, literally across the street thru the traffic light at the exit of the airport, it was not noisy. Second, for not being a more upscale hotel it was soooo comfortable - in sleeping room and out! King bed area is just that, a place to sleep, but it also had a sitting area with a pull out couch bed, small refrigerator, good sink/make up area and all the normal amenities. Clean and comfy was the room, but the staff nailed it. Never have I been at a hotel, midscale, upscale, premium, etc., and had this kind of genuine, all around, customer service. Jeanene, Paul, and Haskell shined and really know what hospitality should look like to a guest. This was my (our) best hotel experience in years (and that includes the Puerto Rico Sheraton from last year)! The only things lacking were the hot items in the continental breakfast. I just did not care for those items, but the cold items and variety was fine. There's a little bar in the lobby that's open till 2a, and a few food items available 24 hours. If you have to stay close to the airport this is your hotel. Oh yeah, and if you need a ride somewhere, they have a shuttle that will take you within a few mile radius of the hotel, and pick you up..... for FREE! (By the way, down town Sarasota is within that radius, yaaaaaaaaaaaaaay!) If I'm not staying at the beach, I'm staying at Hyatt Place Sarasota! (PS... you can't add a bar tip to your debit/credit card, or to a room charge so be sure to bring a some cash and tip those wonderful folks.)

author: BarbaraC692
title: Comfortable, clean, value priced 2 night stay.
text: We stayed 2 nights over Labor Day weekend. I purchased the room on Priceline and got a King-bed, 1st floor room for $60 per night. It turned out to be a great deal. The Free breakfast each morning was very good and included scrambled eggs, pancakes or french toast, fresh fruit, muffins, bagels and cold cereals and plenty of fruit juices and Starbucks coffee. The staff was friendly and welcoming. We found the room was clean, but there was an odor when we arrived that was some kind of room freshener. It wasn't a bad smell and was very subtle, but I am so allergic to room fresheners and fragrances in general, that I would have preferred not to smell this at all. The location was good but you will definitely need a car to see the area. If you want to visit the Ringling Museum- it's within easy walking distance from the hotel. If you have some time for sight-seeing, be sure to go to St. Armand's Circle - about a 15 min. drive. There are some cute shops and nice little coffee shops and restaurants to choose from all around the Circle. The 2nd day we drove to Anna Maria Island- a beautiful drive through Longboat Key - we highly recommend this drive. Anna Maria Island is a lovely little town with many shops and restaurants to visit. We walked out to the end of the pier and if you're hungry, there's a casual restaurant with gorgeous water views to enjoy at the end of the pier. The beaches were uncrowded (except for Siesta Key) even though it was a holiday weekend. This hotel has a very nice fitness center, pool and spa and although we didn't use any of these, there were plenty of guests that seemed to be enjoying the pool area. We like the Hyatt Place hotels and would stay at this one again.

author: johnrays
title: WORST CHECK-IN
text: After having a fun filled vacation around Florida! Going to Pensacola Beach, Daytona Beach, Orlando, Miami Beach, and our final stop in Tampa! The hotel we booked was just outside of Tampa, FL called HYATT PLACE BRADENTON AIRPORT! We checked in and went to the room! The room we reserved was a 2 double bed with a sofa-bed! We got into the room and it was a king bed with a sofa-bed! We were a family of 6, 3 adults and 3 kids! How were we suppose to fit? We went to the front desk and asked if they could transfer us to another Hyatt around the area, but they said,"NO." We then asked,"If they could do anything to help us?" They said,"They couldn't do anything because they were fully booked! We made the reservation 2 weeks ago! They made excuses!After talking to the unhelpful manager, Paul and a lady in the front desk, we decided to leave and go to Springhill Suites Marriott next door! We called them 5 mins before we arrived! They had a 2 double bed and a sofa-bed! Perfect for us! It had better service than Hyatt! The front desk manager at Marriott, Thomas was so nice and accommodating!

author: Iloveflorida16701
title: REVIEW ON HYATT PLACE - SARASOTA BRADENTON AIRPORT
text: Very clean hotel with nice size rooms for 2 persons. Free complimentary breakfast was great every morning! Staff was wonderful! Easy drive to beautiful beaches in Bradenton and Sarasota. Computers in lobby, if you don't want to bring your lab top. Did not use pool or hot tub, but many people did. Nice location close to airport and beaches. Hotel rooms were clean and modern. I would highly recommend this hotel. Beds were extremely comfortable along with large sofa couch. Large area for couch and office desk. Large 42" HD TV which you could watch from bed or couch area. Rooms cleaned thoroughly on a daily basis. New washers and dryers located on 2nd & 3rd floors, which we used to do laundry. Nice hotel at a very reasonable price. Rob G. Bradford PA

author: shannonl918
title: Very Nice & Perfectly Located for Ringling
text: This hotel is almost right across the street from the Ringling museum so its perfect if that is what you're coming to see. I called in advance, booked my room and asked to be in a room with firm mattresses and in a quiet location and they were happy to comply. When we checked in, the person behind the desk offered to show us around and pointed out the breakfast room, coffee bar, small business center and the pool/hot tub area. He was very friendly. The hotel decorating is mildly modern... clean, right-angles, but with earth tones. The television is really large, swivels and has a spot for you to plug in an HDMI cable. There is free wifi in all rooms. I really liked my stay. The breakfast is great - very classy, lots of choices, including hot stuff and its included with the room price. everything seemed clean. great place. Oh, the pool and hot tub were very clean and both heated - not large, but nice with pretty trees around them. And the AC unit in the hotel room is the kind that is about knee height, wider than tall... It blows cold air out so efficiently that we had some difficulty regulating the temperature, but its a small detail. I think it was an issue only because we had two beds so one of them was right next to the AC and that person froze. Sarasota tap water is very chlorine flavored so bring bottled water to drink.

author: Anuta27
title: Great stay
text: This was our second time at this hotel. We stayed here 7 nights. Love the rooms and the location. Breakfast is to die for! I looked forward to it everyday. Rooms were cleaned everyday and looked spotless. Beds are great! one comment, there are a few front desk receptionists, who seemed to be less thrilled than to be working there. When we first arrived and were waiting to be checked in, one receptionist wouldn't even recognize we were there waiting, no greeting nothing. After about 5 minutes we got, we'll be right with you, while 2 other receptionist stood there doing nothing. The one who greeted us proceeded to give us unfriendly looks, and we got the same looks the entire stay we were there from this individual. The other receptionists were great and very professional! Always greeted us and asked how we were and made us feel welcome. However, that one receptionist at first we thought maybe she was having a bad day, but it did not seem that way. She just did not seem happy to be working there and like she had better thing to do. Hopefully the management will have a discussion with her about her attitude and behavior towards the guests. Otherwise, great location, comfy beds, will stay again!

author: amandarose74
title: Exelent Hotel
text: Easy Check in. We came to visit our Son at NCF and it was also close to all of Bay Shore, restaurants, shopping and Siesta Key was only 20 minutes. Room was spacious with a separate living space and we just had a standard with 2 queens. GREAT BEDS OMG!! Again I am a terrible sleeper and it was very nice, Summer down blankets, big fluffy pillows, triple sheets. It was extremely quiet. Nice that there were real glasses and coffee mugs. Breakfast was really nice, 2 different egg sandwiches, french toast, Loads of fresh fruit, oatmeal, granola, bagels....Good Real OJ and other milk and Juice. Starbucks coffee and Tazo teas. The bar lounge area served espresso, coffee and wine and cocktails. There was also food to order all the time, however not roomservice as you picked it up at the bar. Nice though. The pool was really pretty with towels right outside. Will definately stay there again. And Ricardo is super nice and very friendly as we chatted with him upon our arrival and he made our espresso and wine!!

author: 13ellezee
title: Good value at this hotel. No airplane noise. Recommended!
text: I stayed at both this Hyatt and the Hyatt Regency while in Sarasota and this hotel is definitely the better value. It doesn't have the expansive, fancy lobby, or nice onsite restaurant, but the small lobby is nice and comfortable. This hotel has more of a younger feel to it. Pros: Price is good for the area and for the quality that you receive. Friendly front desk staff, low key casual atmosphere, pretty pool area, very convenient to the airport, obviously, I did not hear any airport noise while inside the hotel. The air-conditioning unit worked well. My room was kept cool and there was no musty odor as is often the case in humid areas. My room, bed and pillows were very comfortable. Bathroom was small but clean. Simple contemporary decor. Cons: room service is available 24 hrs. but you have to go down and pick it up. It's not actually delivered to your room. I noticed a couple of minor maintenance issues: a little spot of peeling wallpaper, a loose moulding in the hallway, and one tile cracked in the bathroom. In spite of that, though, it generally felt well-maintained.

author: JulieP329
title: Not impressed!! Don't use the pool.
text: I made reservations here based on the reviews. I was not impressed. The location is convenient and rooms fairly clean, that is were the benefits end. I am presently staying at the hotel but shortening my length of stay. Parking lot not lit well, don't feel safe walking to car. The continental breakfast is fine if you are eating the cold items. The hot items are on trays but are not kept warm, especially with eggs, worry about seminal. The POOL, DON'T USE THE POOL. This is the main reason we are leaving. The pool needs cleaning, after swimming my skin started tingling, I didn't think much of it the first time, however the second day after swimming it got even worse. Even after showering, I can't stop scratching. As for Hot tub it is litterly green. I was wondering why we never saw anyone in the pooI. Also staff needs customer service training, always felt I was inconveniencing them when you ask for something. A sharp contrast to the welcoming lobby that Hyatt went out of there way to portray. I don't usually write reviews unless they are truly warranted.

author: VanessaD110
title: Good option for Bradenton, Sarasota stay- with a drawback
text: We decided to try Hyatt Place as we could not secure a well priced room at The Hyatt. One enters to a lovely foyer, friendly staff. The room is quite upscale, with a European feel. The colours are pleasing, the decor modern with a flat screen TV, granite bathroom countertops and a sleek shower enclosure. The breakfast as noted in some of the other reviews was very acceptable, better than most in the airport area. The drawback was the AC. It was terribly noisy and continuously turned on and off all night long. The room started off very cool and it was comfy to snuggle under the fresh linens. However, we were awakened shortly thereafter when it shut off and the room became very warm. We shucked off the covers and went back to sleep, only to be awakened by the noise when the AC kicked in and cooled down the room. Blankets back on we grumbled about being awake once again. This continued all night long. Blankets on, blankets off. My husband and I both had a terrible night's sleep. We have no idea if this was exclusive to our room, or the entire hotel needs a new AC system. This was reminiscent of a two star hotel experience and should not be a problem in a Hyatt hotel.

author: verypicky4u
title: Pleasant Dreams!
text: We stayed here looking for some rest and relaxation. We couldn't be closer to the airport, and that was great because I hate the rush of getting to the airport on time. I never heard the noise of the airplanes. All the staff was very friendly, helpful, and accommodating. The room was excellent! In my opinion the room accounts for 90 percent of a pleasant stay. It was very clean. We had a large room with plenty of space and comfortable beds. We were extremely appreciative, since there were four of us, my husband and sons,(male teenagers over 6 feet tall). Everything worked! The shower had great water pressure. The room was equipped with a mini refrigerator for drinks and left over pizza:) It had a spacious desk, with plenty of electronic charging outlets. It had a big clear HD flat screen TV. The breakfast was enjoyable with various selections. We had easy access to everything within a short drive... beaches, food, stores,etc.... The pool was clean and relaxing with fresh warm towels. Also, I felt it was a safe hotel. I would definitely stay here again.

author: teacher6th
title: Few flaws, great place
text: We stayed or a week and found the room comfortable and clean. For some reason our room was not cleaned one day, which was a disappointment. When we checked with desk to find out why, they claimed we had the Do Not Disturb sign up. This was absolutely not true. The breakfast was fine with three hot choices each day. This was a plus. One disappointment was the shriveled fruit and brown bananas each day. I ended up buying fruit and keeping it in our mini fridge. Overall though, it was nice not to have to purchase breakfast. The television was huge and my husband enjoyed it each night. The staff was always helpful but were constantly looking on their cell phones. I guess this is indicative of today's techy society though. The pool was very nice and towels were available near the pool. What bothered me the most was that there was a small outside area by the pool that you had to walk through to get to the pool. This is designated for smokers and there is always an ashtray available on the table. I despised having to walk through a cloud of smoke!! Afterwards you smell like an ashtray. This area should be away from where people must walk. Other than that it is a lovely place and I would stay here again.

author: geogjog
title: Super Service & Perfect Location!
text: My wife and I stayed at this well kept property at the very end of December 2013 through the first few days of January 2013. Upon our arrival, Greg Thomas provided us with a warm welcome and quick and efficient check-in! In the morning, the breakfast was truly superb! Chilled juices and milk were available each day. An excellent selection of teas and coffee was available too. Hot selections varied from day to day, but included French Toast, steel-cut oatmeal, warm muffins with a protein topping, pancakes, and waffles. There was a good variety of cold cereal. Several fruit selections were served daily. The morning staff, namely Cynthia, Betsy, and Maria did an excellent job of keeping everything full, all the while doing so with a smile on their faces. As an added extra, hot pastries were served. Our room was very clean. The bed was quite comfortable. The shower was quite adequate and soaps, shampoos, and conditioners were replenished daily. This hotel is centrally located and afforded us an opportunity to visit many of Sarasota's noteworthy attractions. I highly recommend this hotel to those who seek a clean & comfortable room along with a bountiful breakfast. Equally important, the staff is very accommodating...they always make you feel welcome! Lastly, the wireless internet service was very good.

author: anitaw596
title: Sweet Staff and Roomy Room
text: This was our second stay at this hotel. For the past two years, we have visited Sarasota for the O's spring training games. At first, we were hesitant about staying at a hotel which was located close (within walking distance) to an airport for fear of noise. However, we did not encounter a problem at all. Our spacious and comfortable room backed to trees so it was quiet and peaceful. No airport or vehicle noise was heard from our 3rd floor room. The room is larger than the standard hotel room. The rooms contain a spacious sitting area with a sofa so there is an additional space to sit so you don't have to rest/sit on your bed at all times. There is also a small refrig to hold your leftover dinner from the nearby great restaurants. I just wished there was a small microwave too. Another reason we came back to this hotel is because of the friendly front desk staff. Paul and "L" keep up the good work! You were attentive to your guest and we appreciated it. Also, the shuttle bus service to/from the airport and to the local area is an invaluable service. Although, we rented a car to get to Smith Stadium we saved money by using the shuttlebus to get downtown to sightsee and have dinner. As long as this hotel stays clean and the staff remain friendly we will come back next year. Go O's.

author: wolfpackgirl12
title: Very Good 3 Star Hotel That is Near the Airport
text: This is a very good three star hotel. The rooms are huge! I had plenty of space to set up my laptop and work. When I was through working, I relaxed on a super-sized sofa. I really enjoyed not having to read, watch TV in the bed. The bed itself was big and very comfortable. Even though the hotel is across the street from the airport, I didn't hear any airplanes, and I slept like a baby! The free Wi-fi in the room was also nice. One thing I didn't like about the room was the fact that the sink was located outside of the bathroom. I just find that to be very unsanitary. The staff was also clearly overworked while I was there. so the service was just ok. The food is overpriced and not that great, but the free breakfast was good. If you're in Sarasota for business, then I recommend this hotel. If you're not going for business, then stay away. I hated the location! Looking out the window was an eyesore. I wanted to see the beach (or something pretty), and it's nowhere near the beach. I was there on business, so it served it's purpose.

author: GaryM66
title: Didn't just live up to Hyatt quality, it exceeded Hyatt quality.
text: After a long drive from West Palm Beach and staying at a lesser quality hotel in West Palm Beach I checked into The Hyatt Place and felt like I was at a Ritz Carlton. We were greeted by a very pleasant woman named Betsy who just made us feel like we were the most important person in Florida. She greeted us with a friendly hello, warm welcome, gave us advice on nearby attractions, restaurants, Sarasota in general and The Hyatt Place. I knew I was in a fine hotel as soon as she greeted us. I got to the room and it was large, comfortable, well laid out with a very comfortable bed. There is a nice desk/work area and large couch in the sitting area. The TV was top of the line and bigger than most homes would ever have. Everything in the room was in place, neat and in perfect working order. We went out to see a concert which was the purpose of this visit. Upon coming back to the hotel we were again greeted by Betsy who was just as pleasant as she was upon check in. Asked us about the concert, pointed out that they had 24 hour food and a nice little bar if we wanted a cocktail. She took a few more minutes to chat with us and just made us feel like our business was appreciated. We got up to the room and watched TV in the very comfortable bed. The walls must be sound proofed or thick as we did not hear a peep once in our room and the hotel appeared to be full. Check out was equally as pleasant as check in. The continental breakfast offered a better variety of food than most full service restaurants. After a great breakfast we left with another desk clerk (Didn't get his name) thanking us for staying and a very friendly goodbye. If you want luxury accommodations, great service and a friendly staff check out The Hyatt Place Sarasota. They treat you like gold.

author: Grumbleweed
title: Convenient for airport, Ringling & University, but not much else.
text: The Hyatt is one of a number of hotels that have sprung up near the airport entrance. There is surprisingly little noise from the airport, but be aware the only nearby restaurant is at the Ringling Museum, fortunately it is a decent one. The usual popular restaurant chains, and shopping mall, are miles away. The Hyatt Place is a spacious modern hotel, clearly designed for the business user. The I.T. facilities are excellent throughout, our good size room had a 42” TV/Monitor with multiple jack/connection points for games and laptops. That is not to say vacationers will not be well catered for. Everywhere seemed clean and smart, and the cold buffet breakfast was satisfactory. Unfortunately the $$ supplement hot food was dire, so much so that although we had prepaid for it for our entire length of our stay we gave up on it after a couple of dishes. However, for us the major flaw was acoustics. It appears they were not considered in the hotel design. One wing is very close to a main road but has no sound proofing (maybe double glazing isn’t available in Florida!). There are numerous extractor units on the roof which appear to have been installed with totally inadequate (or no) insulated mountings, giving top floor rooms unacceptable noise intrusion 24/7. And I bet occupants of rooms near the lift (elevator) love the excessively loud “Bing Bong” that announces each arrival of the lift. Unless we could be assured of a room in a quiet corner we will not consider visiting again.

author: VancouverStephanie
title: A good airport stay
text: My husband and I needed an airport hotel because of an early flight the next morning. We drove round all the airport hotels, and picked the Hyatt Place because it looked just a bit nicer than the other hotels, which were all of the big box variety. Well, it was just a pleasure. Our room was quite spacious, though not huge... but it was so well detailed. There was a comfortable sitting area with a settee that you just wanted to cosy up on. The TV could swing from the lounge area to the bedroom. The bed was so comfortable I really didn't want to go home! Lots of fat pillows and white sheets. The bathroom was super clean. We just wanted a light meal, and went down to the snack bar in the foyer. Thebig foyer area was cleverly split up into cosy corners and seating places. The front desk curved round to become a snacks bar, and round a bit further it became a bar in the corner. The snacks bar served an excellent burger, very simple but well cooked, on hot focaccia bread. Glass of wine. Nice little tables. It was the details in this place that added up to a good experience. Having stayed here, we would always choose a Hyatt Place rather than other chain hotels. A touch more expensive, but not bad, and worth it for a good night's sleep and the energy to go on travelling. .

author: mangemutt
title: very disappointed in service and value
text: The booking agent really pushed what a value this room was after I objected to the price. She indicated there was a living area separate from the bedroom and a complimentary full breakfast. The living area is separated from the bedroom by a 4-5 foot wide partial screen. When you have small kids, and you've been told these areas are separate, this is not what you expect. Breakfast was way below average, and by no means a full breakfast. At best it was continental, and not a very good one. I've had better at Holday Inn Express. Tried to play DVDs using built in connections in room. They didn't work. Needed the DVDs, because there is only basic cable provided, and no children's programming. Called the front desk upon arrival for 2 more sets of towels, as we had 2 adults and 2 kids in the room and only 2 sets were provided. I was told there were some available at the front desk and I could come down to get them anytime. Somewhat flabbergasted, I said "There is no one available to bring them up?" The response was "no, and there won't be for at least 30 minutes!" I said "that will be fine, thank you" When they did bring the towels, I was given 2 bath towels. We never did get a bathmat, so we ended up using one towel for that to avoid slipping on the floor. What?! I realize I overpaid for this room because I called last minute. But, I have never been told to come get my own towels? Again, not even at much cheaper hotels.Basically, this room provided us with a place where we could shower (there is no bathtub) then drip dry; all go to sleep at the same time in the same room - my kids are 2 and 4, and then have a lousy breakfast before checking out.

author: iamjunebug1354
title: unexpected surprise
text: My husband, son and I visited Sarasota for a college tour. I picked the hotel from a travel website. We really weren't there for leisure, more for information on the college. I expected your run of the mill, 2 double beds, mini coffee pot, possibly minibar, generic hotel room. We were pleasantly surprised to find that our room was actually a mini suite, complete w/ small living room that included a SECTIONAL couch w/ ottoman, computer desk w state of the art connections, free wi-fi, coffee STATION, wide screen tv that rotated between the living room and bedroom, two QUEEN beds w/ wonderful mattresses, comfy bed linens, a marble separate sink w/ vanity and a pretty view. The room was decorated beautifully. The closet space was tucked behind the tv wall unit w/ a mirrored door. The tub/toilet space was a bit tiny, but really not impractical. The service at this hotel was topnotch. The foyer was welcoming and inviting. There was a free breakfast in a friendly, modern dining room w/ impressive options. Not just coffee, juice, stale bagel! The hotel just opened in December '08 and it was IMMACULATE. The only draw back was location. It is right across from the airport. We never heard airplane noise, but it isn't really near much and not within walking distance of anything. We had to drive to town, the college, and the museum, but it only took a few minutes. I would have to say that the Hyatt Place is a Sarasota jewel!

author: Sarahw123459
title: Wedding
text: We booked Sparth House for our wedding venue in August 2018. Well what I can say.... from start to finish Olivia made the whole process so easy. She is so thorough and puts you at ease at every stage. The venue is beautiful, the decor throughout the whole hotel is fresh and modern, the actual wedding function room is neutral and the perfect backdrop for any type of decor, the grounds are immaculate and the bedrooms (especially the bridal suite) are to a very high standard. The only room I can't really comment on is the civil ceremony room as we didn't get married at the venue (church wedding) but from what we saw it looked beautiful. The food and drink on offer for the wedding breakfast is varied and will suit a wide range of tastes, there is a good choice of drinks and the pricing is reasonable. They also catered for dietary requirements. All the guests commented on how lovely the food was and we particularly enjoyed having the 'date night' to choose what we would like to eat for the wedding breakfast. Breakfast in the morning was lovely and a great touch that we could all eat the same time. I'd highly recommend going for the full exclusivity as it gives you full use of the whole hotel meaning there are no strangers walking around during the day or night, which we loved! I honestly haven't got a negative word to say, all the staff were lovely and very attentive, if there were any 'hiccups' we were none the wiser. The whole day from start to finish was excellent and Sparth House definitely delivered. We would highly recommend to anyone, as would our guests who thoroughly enjoyed it and commented to us throughout the day on what a lovely venue it was. So once again, thank you to each and every member of staff who made our day magical in every way possible. We will be back! Sarah and Chris xx

author: IanS692
title: Externally great with some attentive staff
text: My arrival was late and the way to summon the night porter was by calling the hotel on its phone. He duely arrived and my allocated room was top floor, to which he escorted me without, sadly, the offer of help with my bags. The room was spacious and clean. The basics were there and appreciated; beverages and toiletries. The value for the room is very good and must be taken into account when reading my suggestions for improvement. What is a little odd for a venue of this potential distinction is the lack of thought for the customer. I offer these to the venue for their consideration to enhance their offering: No decaffinated coffee sachets, so no coffee to drink in the evening. No flannel. The bath towel would wrap around a small to average adult, however...... There is nowhere to hang the bath towel once in the bath or shower. The tv is about the size of a computer monitor and on the table and not facing the comfy seat. I didnt try the tv, wifi, hair drier or iron in the room. An issue that was a shame was that on arrival in my room it was a comfy temperature for someone fully clothed, but for a bedroom when the temperatures were in single figures outside, I didnt feel was adequate. The night porter said there was no portable heater. Someone next day organised a portable heater for me. The breakfast is simple but filling and a cooked breakfast is available. So. This is a beautiful house in lovely grounds made into a pretty reasonable hotel. It just needs the manager to sleep in each room for a couple of nights to sort out the minor irritations that would turn it into a classy act!

author: EmmaKearney823
title: What a treasure of a hotel! Perfect for your big day or just a break away from it all.
text: Elegant and luxurious but with a real honest and homely feel. I have not encountered such accommodating staff anywhere else in the UK. They really do go that extra mile for you! I booked the hotel in July 2016 as I was getting married nearby and needed somewhere for my family and wedding party to stay. From my very first phone call with Julie the hotel manager, I immediately felt at ease. I was invited to look round the hotel and the rooms and Julie even gave me the guided tour herself. She was such a great person to have involved and dealt with all the stressful stuff so I didn't have to. The rooms really are out of this world, all with a character of their own. The photographs of my bridesmaids and I getting ready are truly stunning because of the backdrop. The bridal suite was big enough to accommodate myself, my 4 bridesmaids, a hairdresser make up artist AND photographer without feeling cramped. I'm so glad I booked an extra night to get ready for my big day here. TOP TIP, the bathroom in the bridal suite is a fantastic place to have pictures, particularly the window seat. And if you want a room with a bit of history ask for the "titanic room" (Not it's real name I'm sure but they will know what you mean) Also I couldn't believe how reasonably priced the hotel was! Breakfast was included and full of delicious local produce. I don't think I've ever had better sausages at a hotel than here. We are already looking forward to going back for our anniversary. PS special thanks to the Olivia, Jessica and the housekeeping team - not to mention the night barman who didn't yawn once!

author: alisonn917
title: The Best Day, our Wedding.
text: Our wedding organiser, Oliva, helped us with everything. She was brilliant. The setting was amazing with beautiful gardens for our pictures. We booked the honeymoon suite, it was so luxurious, it was just out of this world. The quality of the food was outstanding and so was the service from all the staff. They couldn't do enough for us. We had full use of the hotel, which was great for all our guests and to use different settings for the photos made it even better. We used the DJ that Sparth House uses for other weddings, need I say it, he too was great. He played anything you asked for and his choice of music was brilliant. I was amazed how wonderful the ceremony room looked, it was truly beautiful. I really would recommend Sparth House for your wedding. From the day we went to have a look around to the day after the wedding I knew we had found the perfect place for our wedding. It really was the most amazing day and a lot of that was thanks to all the staff at Sparth House. Thankyou to every one involved. Alison & John Roberts.

author: LaurenK89
title: What a wedding venue!!!
text: I recently got married here in July. From booking it in October 2015 to walking down the isle - every single part with the hotel was easy and enjoyed. Olivia our planner was brilliant, really personable and no wish for the day was too big. The hotel for price was outstanding- we had viewed four different venues prior - well within budget and no hidden bills. The quality of the food at a wedding is usually hit or miss however there were multiple compliments on the food and service combined, it was absolutely wonderful! We had full exclusivity of the hotel and the hotel accommodated for all my guests whatever their needs. I have never come across such a warm, friendly and well run establishment as this one. I would highly recommend you pay a visit when booking a wedding, or even just for food/drink! All my guests were happy with the rooms and the services provided with staying, of which I imagine Sparth House will see the majority of my guests again for a sleepover :) I must also point out that the bar/waiting on staff were superb throughout the day before and day of! In particular a young red headed girl who was there to help me at any moment I needed it, everybody was smiling and friendly which in turn made my guests enjoy the day even more. We have been receiving continuous compliments about the wedding and some pretty big statements saying it's the best wedding they have been too! It is without a doubt that none of it would have been possible without Olivia and the Sparth House team. We still can't get over what a brilliant venue this was, we are so glad we chose it. Thankyou to everybody at Sparth House that made our day perfect - You are a brilliant team, keep it up!! Lauren & Mike Glossop

author: LiamFoulds
title: Best Wedding Ever!!!!
text: Having booked our wedding at Sparth House in May 2015, from start to finish we could not have asked for anything more. Having viewed unsuccessfully and uninspiringly other wedding venues in the area we were completely won over by our viewing at Sparth House. The grounds to the house offer the perfect setting for wedding photos, the ceremony room and reception room offered everything we could have wanted and Olivia, our wedding cooridinator was so welcoming and friendly and made us feel completely at ease. To be able to book out all the rooms to give us exclusivity in the hotel was an extra factor in helping make our decision so much easier and instantaneous. All the members of staff could not have been more helpful in the run up to the wedding with Olivia and her team doing all they could to meet any requests we had for the day whilst also giving us some helpful pointers on what other things would help make the day special. We were able to enjoy and lovely family, meal the night before the wedding with a fantatstic menu available to choose from. The wedding day itself could not have been better and we cannot thank every memeber of staff involved on the day for everythiing they did. The morning of the wedding nothing was too much trouble with the bridal party being served sandwiches and drinks at lunch time as they got ready, something that was asked for last minute on the day but was supplied despite the fact the kitchen was preparing to cater for 104 guests. The day flowed so smoothly and the organisation of the team cannot be faulted. The food served at the wedding breakfast was amazing, enjoyed by all our guests as was the eveing buffet that was served to all the guests by the staff. All the rooms were enjoyed by the guests and the bridal suite in particular is a superb room, so spacious and comfy. So much so we decided to stay ourselves an extra night as the room wasn't booked. Breakfast, which was included in the price for all the rooms was also great and served fresh to every guest. We had such an amazing wedding day as well as extremly enjoyable days either side of it and really are so grateful to everyone at Sparth House for helping make it such a special occassion and cannot wait to stay there next year for our 1st anniversary. Mr & Mrs Foulds

author: sattie24
title: Excellent venue to hold training
text: I have had the pleasure of delivering training at Sparth House on three occasions over the last few months. It is easily located from the M65, under two miles away with ample parking. As a trainer I am used to a variety of locations and to be honest don't have high expectations a lot of the time; if the delegates have enough seats and a projector is provided this is good! Sparth House however is excellent and I feel it is down to the team running it; Julie and Co. They make you feel at home and are like old friends. After one visit I felt I had known everyone for ages! The training room we hired was light and spacious, though a snug fit for 20, it worked well. Everything was set up and ready for me to plug and go upon arrival. Delegates don't often have high expectations on training days and are grateful for a cup of tea, here though it's above and beyond. Tea and coffee was constantly topped up prior to me breaking, homemade biscuits and scones were provided, and the lunch...wow! The delegates were able to break out into the bar area, some very quickly running to sit on the sofas next to the open fire. I can deliver in over 100 different locations a year and this by far is the best catering. All the food was fresh and delegates needs (even at short notice) were catered for. The array of pastas and sandwiches, hot nibbles and salads meant that we were all fuelled up and ready to go for the afternoon. I don't write reviews on TripAdvisor unless I have stayed in a hotel, this though had to be written. I look forward to delivering at Sparth House and I can't wait to be back. In summary, an excellent team throughout running a wonderful venue. I highly recommend them!

author: 169annef
title: Slightly dissapointing
text: Booked to stay 1 night whilst visiting friends in the area. The hotel is obviously being redecorated, and the areas which have been done are looking clean and inviting. Had arrived late afternoon and booked for dinner. Phone call a little later to say chef had phoned in sick but we could have free drinks and help with finding a restaurant. Looked on trip advisor and found a superb Italian a short drive away! The room was rather small, a cracked window (probably original stained glass). The bed was reasonably comfortable but only 1 bedside light was provided. The shower room door, once shut, was very difficult to get out of, not ideal if on your own!! The said shower room itself was very tight and in need of updating. Not sure the advertising gives the correct information. Looking at the photograph one assumes the hotel is in the countryside and not in the middle of a street of houses etc. on a busy road. The feel wasn't quite right but am sure it will improve over time, once the owners have sorted out what needs doing. Breakfast was adequate, a choice of cereal, yogurt, fresh fruit, scrambled egg on toast or full English. Picked out what we wanted from full English and it was cooked fairly well. More toast and butter was given when requested. The waiting staff were young and friendly with a polite attitude, well done.

author: Sujata65
title: Nice Enough Hotel
text: I have recently stayed at the Sparth House when visiting the area on business. The hotel was recommended to me by the supplier I was visiting - not my usual hotel - unfortunately it was fully booked. Before making the booking I had a look at the hotel's website and the rooms looked very nice so I went ahead and made the booking. The lady I spoke to was very helpful and friendly and I booked a number of loft rooms for myself and colleagues. On arrival we were told that 2 of the rooms we had booked were being refurbished so we were being upgraded, my mind went back to the pictures on the website and I have to say I was more than happy with this. When I got to my room I was somewhat surprised, it was a large room and very clean but quite dated - nothing like the pictures on the website. One of my colleagues refused his room based on the strong smell of paint and the fact that the bathroom door handle didn't work. At first the hotel said they no other rooms available, but eventually they organised an alternative room for him. There were five of us in our party and none of us had rooms of a standard depicted on the website - so I would be very interested to know if those rooms actually existed. All our rooms were quite dated and my bathroom although adequate didn't have a power shower which was a little disappointing. The hotel has a small bar and a nice garden off the bar area. Breakfast was excellent, and once we had ordered our food it did come very quickly. The staff were very efficient and friendly, however it was a little light on staff - we had drinks before we went out for dinner and it was the receptionist who was also manning the bar and also organising my colleagues replacement room at the same time and she did look like she was getting a little frazzled. The same again in the morning the receptionist was also the breakfast waitress - I'm sure she wasn't also the breakfast chef - but you never know!!! All in all an average hotel, all I would say is I don't think the photos on the website were representative of the majority of the rooms in the hotel.

author: 568bg
title: An Amazing Wedding Day
text: I held my wedding reception at Sparth House Hotel last weekend. Not only was the room ready and set up a day before, the staff were so very accommodating when I had to make some last minute changes. Nothing was too much trouble for the event organisers. They were genuinely happy to do whatever was needed. The recent updates to the hotel have made it even more beautiful then it was before. The wedding food was exceptional - the guests have all commented on the quality, especially of the mushroom soup!!! The bar staff were quick and efficient and the waiting staff were all extremely friendly and professional. I could not have asked for a better, more organised or happier wedding then I got at Sparth House - and I'm pretty demanding! The honeymoon suite is exquisite and decorated to a very high standard, as are the rooms that I was able to see. The breakfast was delicious and the staff were more then happy to deliver it to our room so that we could relax in the morning. I think my favourite part of all of the wedding planning and the day itself was how invested the staff were. They all knew my name every time I visited the venue. They knew all of my family and were always there to help with a smile. They were even getting emotional during the wedding speeches and I felt that they truly cared about my husband and myself. Special mention needs to go to Julie, Olivia and Emma who anticipated my every need, calmed my many fears and made the day run like clockwork! Thank you from the new Mr. and Mrs. for all you did!

author: 3Kath3
title: Christmas 2014 FIASCO
text: Where to start? Until Christmas 2014 I have never felt the need to write a bad review. Over the last 20yrs we have been to Sparth House for various events. Always had good experiences, and always had value for money. We were looking forward to spending christmas lunch there with the family. What an absolute fiasco it was.......OVER ONE THOUSAND POUNDS worth. My 83yr old mother saved throughout the year to take a party of 18 family members to eat christmas lunch at this place. A room resembling a basement funeral parlour. The staff were doing a lot of running around but not much actual waiting on tables. At no time were the whole party eating at once. Half the party had eaten the rest still waiting for look warm food. A five yr old boy sat throughout the fiasco waiting for the promised Santa. Only to be told , sorry little boy you'ved missed Santa he came earlier. Atrocious service, insensitive staff , mediocre food, no Santa and the owners nowhere in sight. I could go on and on and on. I have had better experiences in low budget B&B accommodation in Blackpool.

author: loobilooLancashire
title: 10/10 for New Years Eve
text: We have booked many family celebrations over the past 13 years at Sparth House, ranging from 21st Birthdays, Weddings, 80th Birthdays and Ruby Wedding Celebrations, after a mixed review from our last visit (March 14) we were apprehensive but thought we'd give the Winter Wonderland a go with 9 members of our family, ranging from 21 years to 88 years! On arrival there was a bag piper who was fantastic and a lovely surprise. The arrival area was very crammed but the staff soon started to take people through to the main room. Champagne and canapés on arrival were also excellent. Really didn't expect much in the Winter Wonderland department but WOW!!!! The decor was fantastic, the room has also had a makeover since our last visit and the new colour scheme just added to this!!! A lovely lady with curly hair (sorry I don't know here name) was so accommodating and took many photographs for us-thank you! In fact all of the staff were extremely friendly and always offered their service with a smile and were always very polite. The food arrived...a six course meal and didn't disappoint. The food was piping hot and of a very high standard. The only niggle here was the beef. It did arrive pink which wasn't a problem for most but some from our party will only eat beef well done so therefore didn't eat this. The DJ-Carl was also as always brilliant! I'm sure he is now part of the fixtures and fittings ;-) he played a massive range of music and certainly played something for everyone, the dance floor was always full. The icing on the cake was the bag piper again at midnight. Well done Sparth House for a fantastic New Years Eve. It was really nice to see such a massive mixed aged Party with something for everyone. We will be back :-)

author: 8765JD
title: Fawlty Towers
text: We had the "Bridal Suite". The room stank of paint. Husband got wet paint on his hand when opening the window to let out the fumes. Two lights not working in the bathroom. For the first half hour, we had manager up a ladder in the bathroom. No television. One was brought eventually without a remote control. No hairdryer. Very poor toiletries. One pillow each. Had to ask for toilet roll and more towels. The breakfast room was very sad with a poor offering of fruit, cereal and juice. The breakfast arrived after a puzzling exchange with the waitress, who seemed to have very little idea how to take an order. Full English breakfast on a hot plate but food was completely cold. A bizarre experience all round.

author: SimplyRed54
title: Relaxing Break
text: We stayed at this hotel for 2 nights B&B to enable us to visit family in nearby Great Harwood. This is a beautiful old building with tremendous character. We were very warmly welcomed and shown to our room - 22 - on the first floor. This was an enormous room at the front of the building overlooking the lawned front area which has massive mature trees. Very pleasant indeed. Three of us were sharing the room, so it had a double bed, a double sofa bed, and a single Put-U-Up bed, and still room to have a dance. There was a very clean en-suite at the back of the room with a shower over the bath. Although it was an electric shower, it was a bit temperamental temperature-wise. Breakfast is served in a lovely sunny room at the front of the house, and quite frankly it was the best full English that I`ve ever had. The sausages were gorgeous. There was a very good selection of both hot and cold items, and fantastic service. We ate both nights in-house in the breakfast room, although it`s also possible to eat in the bar. The menus was very good and reasonably priced, although we seemed to be the only people eating there. Pros: Very warm welcome and helpful advice Lovely large room and comfortable bed Cons: The carpet in room 22 needed cleaning. There were a few light bulbs which needed replacing, or which were the wrong size for the lamps. Fussy I know, but it`s the little things that can make a place look so much better.

author: holidayheaven82
title: A nice stay with friendly service
text: Very helpful and friendly staff who were always ready to accommodate our needs - including our dog Mabel. We stayed here for four nights as we were visiting family. We were moved after the first night from a lovely room to a bigger room - both were nice although preferred decor in the first room. The second room made us feel like we were in an episode of Sherlock Holmes - but thats not always a bad thing. The move of rooms was done with swift efficiency and our suitcases were there when we came back to the hotel on Saturday evening. The breakfast was lovely - full english, cereal/porridge and pastries. We were told breakfast was served at 7:00am on Saturday morning but it wasn't - it was 8:00am. We had to be somewhere at 8:00 but the member of staff on duty gave us the option of cereal but no cooked breakfast. We also took the family here for Sunday lunch on the Sunday. The hotel had a problem with the drains - we received a phone call to see if we wanted the lunch to go ahead - again very efficient. We decided we wanted to go ahead. The food was great and well prepared although there were a few disappointments with items being unavailable on the menu. No problems from the drains at all! All in all a "very good" stay despite slight issues with menu and breakfast on the first day. Also wifi is intermittent but I think that may have been our room position in the hotel. Thanks for being very accommodating!

author: TMCLondonUK
title: Good value, good food, good all round!
text: This is the second time that I have stayed here as a solo guest. I booked a room in the main part of the hotel and was pleased to discover that I had been put in to the very large room at the front of the hotel, (shown in the 'professional photos' part of this site). This was a bonus as I had two under 10 year old family members visiting on one day and they had plenty of space to play in. The bathroom again was very large, an unusual feature being a mirror almost the length of one wall by the bath! The dinings room(s) have been refurbished since my last stay and are very nice indeed. Decorated in a contemorary style but still cosy. I treated myself to a cooked breakfast each day and it was cracking. You will not need to have a lunch after having breakfast here. Well cooked food, and a lot of it. The breakfast staff were also very pleasant and helpful. On two evenings I had an evening meal, I choose to dine in the bar area purely as the restaurant was quiet. I was still offered a choice of a la carte or set menu and a small list of specials. On both nights the food again was very nice and the portions ample. The bar area itself is decorated in a faux library style giving it a more intimate feel, with a mixture of comfy sofas and more formal chairs and tables so that you can dine easily. All in all a nice little hotel, the staff are friendly and always have a genuine smile on thier faces, the prices are fair and the food tasty. It's no Savoy, there again its no faceless/characterless Premiere lodge etc etc either. What I can say is the next time I'm up North, I'll be booking in here for sure.

author: ErikG231
title: 3 nights summer stay.
text: Stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. Check in was quick. Room at the 6th floor, facing the back of the hotel. Good size room, renovated in 2014 according to information in the corridor. No air condition in the room. Outside temp. around 30 celsius. Temp. in room about the same, not easy to sleep. Room seemed to be clean at arrival. Not decent cleaning during our stay. Had breakfast 3 mornings, ok, but not as good as other hotels we have visited recently. Conclusion. Hotel fairly nice, but a bit worn down. A hotel like this should have aircondition in the rooms. Aircon. available at other hotels in Tønsberg?

author: AdvoKitty
title: Was booked in here by another hotel, but the room was ok and staff were pleasant
text: We were booked in here by the Mercure when they overbooked their rooms and moved us to this hotel. Upon arrival, there were no car parking spaces, but thankfully someone moved shortly after we arrived and we took that space. The receptionist booked a taxi for us as we were only dropping off our baggage at first. There was a function going on in the room below our room and lots of kids running around and leaving cake on the floor, so it wasn't a great first impression. The room was ok, fairly small as the photos will show. A bottle of white wine was left for us in an ice bucket, although we aren't sure if that was from this hotel or the Mercure as an apology. The decor was nice, but perhaps needed a bit more upkeep or hadn't been refurbished in quite a while. The main downside to the room was the noise. It was louder in our room when we arrived than the function room that was hosting the event. Thankfully we were heading back out to the wedding reception we were attending, however if we had arrived home fairly early it would have been completely unsuitable. Their website warns about this, but of course we weren't expecting to stay at this hotel so it wasn't expected. When we returned at around 1:15am, there were still people downstairs in the function room talking and it was particularly loud in our room. We waited a little while before asking reception if we could be moved, the member of staff we spoke to was very apologetic and friendly but unfortunately they were fully booked and she explained that a business man who had also booked to stay at the Mercure had found this to be an issue and had to find another hotel. She went into the function room as we returned to our room and presumably asked them to move to the bar area away from our room so thankfully it was quiet after then, but if you intend to stay in one of the standard rooms instead of the suites and want to get an early night, bear in mind this will be an issue. The bed was very firm, too firm for me, but the pillows were big and soft. The TV was very small. The room was very warm so we used the fan in the wardrobe during the night. The bathroom door did not close and the lock on the room door didn't look fully closed but the door didn't open so it must have been. Overall, the room was ok but we probably wouldn't stay again.

author: GentlemanTravel
title: Dirty, uninspiring and really dull
text: This hotel is famous for its cabarets, musical shows, concerts and so on. And that is it. The walls in the hotel are somewhat quaint, since they have fun paintings of famous Norwegian artists. Apart from that, the hotel is dirty. Stains all over. The carpets, furniture and other public rooms. The men's toilet is so nasty and smelly that it is a shame. The room I had was spacious and good enough. The TV in the room was too small for my taste, and it was placed on the wall so that it was difficult to maneuver it in a good position. The room seemed to be clean and ok. The breakfast was very good. Has to be said that the staff were kind, smiling and charming. Should you stay here? No. Go for one of the other options in town.

author: HenLondon
title: Bloody awful, would not reccommend to my worst enemy
text: We stayed here because it was the closest to the wedding we were going to, I went up to our room with our dog who was also booked in. The room barely had even a window, a small narrow velux window in the slanting ceiling, the bed had maybe a couple of feet of space on each side, the bathroom didnt have a window and the television had barely any reception. When my husband came up too there was not enough room to swing a cat. One of us had to sit on the bed while the other got ready as there was not enough room for us to both be standing. My parents were also booked into the hotel and despite paying the same amount as us their room was 10 times the size of ours (literally no exaggeration). We also ordered lunch there which they screwed up on the order. Once we finally finished the military manouvre of getting ready, we went to our wedding away from the hotel, as I am pregnant, we decided to leave our wedding relatively early so got back to our room at 11.30 for an early night. As we walked along the corridor, the music from the wedding reception downstairs got louder and louder, when we opened the door to our room the floor was literally vibrating as was anything loose on any surface in the room, the disco continued in ever increasing volumes (I could hear it getting louder and louder) until 12.30am when we could hear all the guests then talking and laughing. Due to the only method of ventilation being the velux window, it had to be open during the night, so as soon as the sun came up (about 5am) it was as bright as day in our room as there was no sort of curtain over the window. A horrific nights sleep for a knackered pregnant woman. Breakfast was a catalogue of disasters, there were far too many people in the dining room for the single member of staff to deal with, we had to wait ages for our toast once our breakfast had arrived. My husband had to deal with the staff upon check out, they said that when we had booked (3 months previously) they had said that is was above the disco so we had been warned. However had we also been warned that the entire room would be shaking for over an hour and our room would not have a window we simply would not have booked into the hotel at all. We were offered £15 off the price of the room which is disgraceful, why couldnt they have put someone from the actual wedding in the rooms above the disco?? Utter idiocy all round, I was ready to ring their necks in the morning.

author: 955marthab
title: Serious Smoke Problems
text: I reserved a handicapped accessible nonsmoking room with roll-in shower. When I arrived the room was filled with smoke. The woman at the front desk advised me to close the bathroom door to keep the smoke out of the bedroom. That, of course, would have precluded my access to the bathroom. Apparently, the smoke was coming from another room. That approach to ventilation is completely inappropriate!!! I reserved a nonsmoking room out of deference to my health; cigarette smoke is a health hazard. In order to make the only handicapped accessible nonsmoking room with roll-in shower available to me, the woman at the front desk placed a device in the room. That meant that I had to wait about an hour and a half to use the room. As the person responsible for facilitating a multi-day clergy retreat, I needed to have access to the room for prayer and sleep. Although the actual smoke was eliminated, there was clearly residue which still led to discomfort. I did not allow spraying of additional chemicals to mask the scent as I was not sure what reaction I might have to those chemicals. Venting smoking rooms to nonsmoking rooms is problematic, but it is extremely inappropriate, if not actually dangerous, to vent in such a manner to rooms designed for people with disabilities. I am requesting that this design flaw be corrected in this and other Ramada facilities. Dr. M. Banks Fairlawn, OH 44334

author: T2826DZrogerm
title: Still a great place.
