text: Very clean. Nice addition of a pub since my last stay six years ago. Much of the food available is homemade. Reasonably priced. Pleasant, helpful staff. Good firm bed. Easy on/off from I-77. Among the best values I've had in a hotel over six years . . . . last stay there was in 2009. (Oh . . . . could even hear the PA of a Strasburg Tigers game on Friday night at the field out back. The only potential downside is the railroad track 100 feet out back. I find train sounds romantic and relaxing, so I actually liked it.

author: /undefined
title: Would Not Stay Again
text: When I called the hotel to make my reservation, I wasn't aware that they still allowed smoking. My husband and I are terribly allergic to cigarette smoke. I called the front desk once I learned this and was told that there were not any smoking rooms near the room I was given. She assured me we would not notice the smell. Upon arrival there was a terrible skunk like smell in the lobby. Luckily this smell did not go into our room. Our room did smell of smoke. We had to keep our bathroom fan on and the door closed to keep the bulk of that out. We were traveling with a pet and were not able to get room elsewhere or we would have. My husband coughed all night. The next morning at check-out I explained the situation to the front desk and she then told me the smoking room causing our issue was just 3 doors away from ours. The woman on the reservation line LIED! Then I was charged $20 additional fee from the receipt I was given at check-out. We did not purchase anything from the hotel so I have no idea what that was for. I am completely disgusted. Will not go to this hotel again.

author: DTF2014
title: LIfe in the early 80's
text: The decor was terrible in the room!!! Outdated, old style furniture and fabric; wood was chipped in places. We had room 108, which was supposed to be a no smoking room. We opened the door and were overwhelmed with smell of stale cigarette smoke in the room. It was awful! The mattress was so hard it felt as if plywood had been placed under the sheets. The toilet was old, tiny, low and uncomfortable. There was what appeared to be mold on the ceiling near the shower. If we hadn't been tired and needed to get to the people we were meeting, we would have looked for another place. When you come from stays in a Holiday In Express and Courtyard at Marriott, this place is shockingly disappointing - and the price was just about the same at all three!! The one bright light was the desk staff. They were friendly, welcoming, and helpful. But we will not stay here again. We will drive on to Canton or Massillon where there are a variety of updated hotels. Please do something to clean up and brighten up the dismal rooms.

author: StunkOut2014
title: Smoker's delight
text: First time staying at this Ramada. And may be the last. We also had a problem with very strong cigarette smoke in our bathroom, which was reserved as a "non-smoking" room. Upon arrival in mid-afternoon, there was a slight smoke smell in the hallway but not in the room. We left and visited with family and came back late at night. That was when the hallway smelled just like a smoker's lounge. Noticed the next morning leaving our room, the cleaning staff was in the hallway cleaning some of the rooms. One of them had a spray bottle in hand and was walking down the hallway spraying some liquid onto the hallway carpet. Thought this looked kind of odd. But definitely knew why they were doing that the next day. Very strong smoke smell late afternoon into the evenings. The last night we stayed was the absolute worst yet. That was when we entered the hallway, the smoke choked us both out. We also noticed in our room the smoke smell was coming through the bathroom vent. This hotel SHOULD NOT list "smoke-free" rooms unless they can have separate ventilation systems for each floor and have smoker rooms on one floor and nonsmoking rooms on another. Saw a post by someone else that they complained about the smoke and got a "smoke machine" in their room which removed the smoke. This would have been nice to know beforehand so we could ask for one.

author: /undefined
title: Answer
text: We are usually very pleased with the cleanliness and staff at this Ramada. However, we had a problem with very strong cigarette smoke in our bathroom a non-smoking room. It continued intermittently up and including the first morning. I spoke a night staff the night before. She did nothing. The next AM I was sick. We do not smoke and I have allergies. I spoke to the manager the first morning of the stay. She asked if she could put a "smoke machine" in our room which removed the smoke. It appears that the smoke was coming through the duct work from another room which allowed smoking. This was a bad situation. We never want to stay in a room in which that could happen again. The health consequences for me could be quite serious. The room from where this cigarette smoke came from we observed that a chair had been removed from the smoker's room and that the seat of the chair had been damaged by what appeared to be a cigarette burn. This causes additional concerns for the safety of the occupants of the motel.

author: mzdi3
title: Helping the boy scouts
text: In Helping the Boy Scouts I stayed at the hotel. It was average, nothing special. the rooms were clean, the beds were ok, no too soft and it didn't smell either. The town is very small and you don't see a lot of people walking around. everyone said hello but not too many smiles. Breakfast was ok your ordinary danishes, bread, waffles, yogurt and a Hot item. The first day is was biscuits & gravy (not a fan of that) so I cereal about 8 different choices. 2nd day was french toast (a little better) the coffee was very week on both days. Their is a McDonalds right next door! and a subway down the street. no exciting places for dinner, we drove up to canton 1/2hr drive for the Outback. Overall for a room to sleep in it was OK. and yes I would do it again. its the best thing around and theres not much..... There is a pool, so people in it but I didn't go.

author: scronk0413
title: A very rocky start
text: It was the check-in from hell. It seems that the "corporate" reservation service, did not inform their "franchise" that I had changed my reservation and booked with them to get a lower rate than the hotel offered when I called them directly. It was a busy Fall weekend in Ohio Amish country and if we hadn't arrived when we did we wouldn't have had a room at all. I felt like I was in the middle of a family fight. The thing that bothered me the most was that, although I had a printed copy of my reservation confirmation, the deswek clerks argued with me saying they didn't have a room or a reservation for me. What ever happened to customer service? I did stand my ground since I had made the reservation 7 days ahead. As a travel agent I was especially bothered because I know who gets blamed when reservations go bad. That said they did finally offer me suite for the 2 nights I would be there. The property is fine, but for the money, I expected a more up to date hotel. Carpets and bedding need to be replaced and in general, it could be cleaner. Breakfast is ordinary. They seemed to only pay attention to the golfers there for an outing. Live and learn. We travel with our small dog and needed a pet friendly property and they are that.

author: ChristalH503
title: The worst customer service!
text: I'll just give you the basic outline of the stay... Got to our room and the thermostat was at 60. We were freezing and so was our 2 yr old and 7 month old. We let our son push the buttons to turn the heat on to take the chill off the room. Within a minute the whole rm was filled with smoke and our smoke alarm started going off. I called the front desk to tell her that our rm was filled with smoke and she basically told me that we shouldn't have turned the heat on during the summer season. We were apparently just burning off the dust according to her. The whole rm was filled with smoke and with 2 small children I didn't want to stay there. I asked for another rm and I was met with a large sigh and a " just open the window, are you sure that you need a new rm". I was insistent so we got a new room. The new room was on the 3rd floor. For the sake of shortening this let me just say this THE 3RD FLOOR IS THE SMKING FLOOR!!! If you Are sensitive to smoke or are allergic don't stay on this floor. I was a mess! My 7 month old was a mess. Front desk's response to our asking for a rm not on the smoking floor..."just put towels down around the door, I don't want to have to mark another rm as dirty." There is so much more to the story but you get the gist. WORST SERVICE EVER AND 3RD FLOOR IS A SMOKING FLOOR NO MATT WHAT THEY SAY. And the breakfast sucked!

author: SharpestJim
title: You Can Do Worse - But You Can Do BETTER
text: This is one of those places that is difficult to review because there are positives but there are also negatives. To their credit, the staff was very friendly. The room wasn't particularly bad; it was spacious and quiet. The negatives: The smell of cigarette smoke permeated the hallways. I had a non-smoking room (thank God) so my room, although not exactly fresh-smelling, at least it did not smell like cigarette smoke. But as soon as I stepped into the hallway, it was there. Why hotels that allow smoking do not segregate their smoking rooms is beyond me. I had a room on the second floor - some smoking and some non-smoking. All of the smoking rooms should be on one floor, in my opinion. The linens were not particularly fresh either. I really disliked the pillows; they were foam and entirely too thick. Perhaps I am being picky, but I did not like them. Another positive: The morning coffee was really quite good. And the hotel is right next door to a McDonald's. So a quick bite is a short crawl away. All-in-all, I give it an "average". Not all that bad, but certainly not all that great.

author: SimmyF2
title: Hotel break.
text: Trip first time to turkey.. looked foward to it... got their, hotel large ..small bar inside...pool was big... Great seating around pool, and large bar outside.. with bar food.. food was reasonable priced....Also gud game activities. ..room large. . Bed comfortable, loads of Cupboard space.. bathroom gud....view from room splendid. .. view of sea from distance. .Great breakfast selection, and large dining room.. even had lad doing omelettes...staff friendly and helpful. .would like go back...

author: rebeccapower2
title: never again
text: I travelled to this hotel in October with my mother, husband and two young children (under 3s). The only positive review I can give is the housekeeping service. Our room was cleaned to a high standard daily, fresh linen most days and towels every day. The girls were very accommodating to babies napping etc. The room was very basic but we got a family room which was ideal – two interconnecting rooms which suited when having two small children allowing plenty of space to run around. The hotel itself wasn’t the cleanest. There were cigarette butts in the ashtrays next to the lifts. The breakfast room was constantly covered in flies. It was very off putting. The food wasn’t too good either. We ate in “Somewhere else” down on ladies beach which was absolutely gorgeous. There are shops onsite which are very overpriced for essentials like cow’s milk for the youngest child’s bottle. The pool was freezing, the kids couldn’t swim in it(neither could the adults!!). The playground was covered in cat poo & wasn’t well maintained. The kids club was not very good, there were no activities, just a play room really. The “entertainment” was awful. There’s nothing else to say about it.

author: yvonneh376
title: Basic hotel but clean and not a bad location
text: My husband & I stayed there in Oct 2015, end of season. Hotel is basic and clean, not a 4 star hotel. Rooms were fine, we asked for a room on the 6th floor as had pre- read the reviews. View was absolutely lovely. Room was basic but clean and cleaned every day, new towels each day. No toiletries in the room, only one small bar of soap. Cleaning staff were very nice and friendly. Hotel reception were fine, anything we asked they answered. There was nightly entertainment but we only stayed there one night, the BBQ night which was very good, as much as you could eat for €15 and the food was good. Breakfast was just ok, got fed up of it, bread and cheese, fruit and yoghurt. Make sure you bring your own butter and teabags!! Pool area was lovely, cleaned every day. Wifi only in reception area.. Great location for Ladies Beach. Only a five minute walk, lots of lovely restaurants and the beach is lovely but unfortunately as smoking is permitted in Turkey, cigarette butts everywhere. The dolmuş comes every few minutes and stops outside the hotel, very handy to get into Kusadasi. A great service. All in all, not a bad hotel, clean but basic. Would recommend it.

title: Centrally located but has some negatives. Breakfast very poor.
text: Very good bus service to beach or into town. Breakfast is a bummer unless you pay for a full Irish in Restaurant. Chef makes omelette in dining room and you are expected to tip him (having already paid for Bed & Breakfast!!). Beware if you come down late to Dining Room. That angry supervisor will have a fit and telling you "Cleaning Time, Cleaning Time". Everything is cleared from tables on dot of 10am. No variety, same old things every morning. No sign of fried egg, sausage, rasher, pudding or fried tomatoes. We never again want to see melons. Are there any other fruits available in Turkey except apples/oranges & melons. Cereals like cardboard but you could have dried sultanas or currants with it!!!. If majority of guests are Irish why not make a better effort with breakfast. The sausages were like those for hot dogs. Image having to drink your morning juice from a plastic container. Are they fearful that we would all bring home a glass if it was made available.

author: Marwar123
title: First timers
text: To say that it was the most enjoyable and relaxing holiday we ever enjoyed would be an understatement. The staff were second to none. Very helpful, and so polite . We were on the third floor with a view of both pool and sea. Our sunway rep was very helpful and couldn't do enough for the guest on her watch. If you want 5 star hotel quality then maybe this is not the hotel for you. In saying that the rooms were spotlessly clean. They were cleaned every day and fresh towels every day also. Reception staff lovely. From maid to managers were extremely helpful and always smiling,. The waiters were exceptional. All in all we will defiantly be back. If I had one criticism it would be the plates. There was a few times we got chipped plates but it wasn't the end of the world. Defiantly the clothes shop and jewellery shop are as good as in the town and very reasonable. Thank you Sea Pearl for a great holiday.

author: Bridget-McG
title: I would never stay here again
text: I visited this hotel 4 years ago and I enjoyed it so when we were booking Turkey again I decided to book this hotel again. I just got back last night and I strongly feel I should advise anyone thinking of staying there. I made a big mistake re-booking this hotel and I hope this review will help others before they book it.. The hotel has gone down hill since I last visited. There is a kettle in the room but you only get tea and coffee on the first night of your stay. When I asked the cleaning lady for some more I was told to go to reception. I went to the bar as the reception was closed or staff was on a break but there was nobody there. At the bar I was told if I wanted tea bags you should go to the shop and buy them. I said the shop was closed so they SOLD ME 2 tea bags and charged me 4 liras (3 lira = €1). I asked to speak to a manager because I was not happy with the barman telling me to buy tea bags in the shop and he was very rude to me. But the manager was just as bad and told me to pay for the tea bags plus he then followed me to my room. He waited for me to go the the stairs and then thinking I couldn't see him he followed me but I could see him tro the window reflection. That was very scary, While the table waiters and cleaning staff were very nice I have to say the bar staff and manager were the worse people I have every had the misfortune of having to deal with. I even witnessed a barman have a row with one of the guests because the guest ordered a brandy and the bar man having used the measure funnel for the drink only gave him 3/3 of a measure. The drink was so expensive the guested asked for the full measure as he was paying full price €6 (very expensive for drinks in this hotel (It was 17 lira for bicardi and extra 5 lira for the 7up). The barman said to the guest "This is what you paid for do you want it or not". The guest said no thanks and when he returned back to his seat the barman kept string down at him which was very intimidating. So before you book this hotel be warned this is the worse hotel I stayed in in Turkey and I have visited Turkey 5 times now. There are so many hotels to chose from and the people are generally very nice in Turkey so I don't understand why the staff here are so bad. Any of the guests I spoke to including one who have been visiting this hotel for the past number of years have said they would never go back to it.

author: hbucket1
title: Drink at the bar in this hotel quite expensive
text: Got a good deal for a week here in November 2014. Hotel was spotless clean and the rooms were quite spacious. They were cleaned every day. Breakfast was ok but not much variety. The omelettes were lovely. Brought our own tea bags. We ate at the pool area at lunch time and they done a lovely full irish breakfast there. Only had dinner in the restaurant on the night we arrived and wasn't impressed. Bottle of wine with dinner was expensive and was horrible. The drink at the bar was also quite expensive. We ate at the saray restaurant most nights which was fantastic as usual. Also ate at I think it was called seans place with the friendly ossie. We met a fantastic crowd of people at the hotel. It's a pity the drink is not cheaper at the bar as I feel people would not have left at night if it was more reasonable. People we met ate at the carvery in the Hotel and they said it was very nice and good value. Had a Turkish bath and massage at the Hotel and it was fab.

author: mariemul
title: Gone way downhill
text: Spent a miserable Easter fortnight here. Damp freezing cold beds as we were the first occupants since the hotel closed for winter. We all got bronchitis and had to go to doctor. Husband and self spent all day at a hospital for treatment.Lots of people coughing and complaining about cold beds. Bar area was cold Corridoors were freezing with wind howling in the ill-fitting windows and fire escape doors.. Food is hopeless, no salad dressing same two soups all the time, and awful white margarine...no butter. It's insulting to present cheap lardy margarine to anyone, not to mind a paying guest. Same entertainment right down to the same comedy sketches the hotel's been presenting for years A miserably small tv on which to watch daily movies whilst the noise of guests goes on around you. In bad weather a movie in a quiet room would be great and the room needn't be too big. .Extortionate prices in the sweet shop which is grossly unfair on kids who have saved pocket money. The staff are very nice but are extremely overworked. All rubbish bins on display at side of hotel with lots of plastic and papers blowing over the fence onto the road. Very untidy and careless looking. Overall a very amateur hotel. Won't be going back.

author: YralcElbon
title: The Ultimate Horror Package Holiday
text: Practically everyone in this hotel was Irish.The resort of Kusadasi was practically all Irish. I go on holiday to experience different people and culture. I didn't enjoy the constant bad language. The hotel was reasonably clean, wifi only in reception, there was never enough beds by the pool. The staff were pleasant enough but there was the usual pushing for tips and to join in the 'fun' activities. They were also clearly massively overworked day and night. The entertainment was the awful entertainment you expect from a hotel package holiday which I find entertaining because it is so bad. The hotel shop stocked very expensive rubbish food and things like sun lotion etc. The rep all but refused to tell me where there was a large supermarket to be found in town, which turned out to be a place called Kippa(Tesco). Here I was able to get a handle on prices. There was very strict rules about buying your own food to bring back to your room. Sometimes it's nice to sit on your balcony with good ole bread and cheese and wine (had to sneak it in)The hotel food was basically not too bad for a package holiday but the behaviour of the clients rushing and grabbing at the buffet and piling high only to waste it was embarrassing. The free trips to a leather factory and gold manufacturers with no obligation to buy was only a thinly disguised push to sell. The whole place is a hard sell. A truly horrendous package holiday experience but I expected no less and still wonder why I did it when I know better.......

author: NeadyN
title: Great location and very affordable and clean
text: Loved everything about this place the location was the best part so close to the beach "ladies beach", restaurants and bars. The staff were all very nice and efficient. A bus came every 10 minutes I think it was to the main town just from outside the hotels main gates. Even tho the town it's self wasn't my favourite and wouldn't recommend to anyone unless on a big drinking Holliday. The food at the hotel was very reasonable and quite good quality. The rooms were tidied every day and were very clean and comfortable. The pool bar was great everything ud need. There was a shop and hair dressers also. Turkish currency can be bought at reception which was very handy as it's quite hard to get in the banks at home before leaving. The only point I'd make is the breakfast even tho is very fresh and there is plenty of its quite limited. There's eggs to beat the band and lovely fruit cheeses bread and omelettes. But maybe a hot breakfast eg a fry up would be great for the Irish and English guest. Even tho it can be purchased at the main pool Bar It isn't available on the breakfast menu in the breakfast room which is included on the package when booking the hotel. I would highly recommend this hotel and I'd love to come back. I stayed here July 2014. The weather was fab.

author: Beau118
title: Family week in Turkey
text: We just got back from Turkey last night after a 1 week stay in Sea Pearl. We had a pleasant week. The hotel was clean. The rooms are basic but adequate. The standard of food in the hotel has definitely improved since my last stay 3 years ago. The evening meals were good with a good choice on the menu and plenty of food. Much better quality and value than the restaurants on Ladies beach. Breakfast is just ok. Turkish buffet style which ends exactly at 10am. No late comers allowed. All the staff are friendly and make you feel welcome. My only problem is everyone wants a tip for the slightest service provided which gets a bit annoying after a while. The evening entertainment was poor enough and not really worth staying in for. The hotel is about 250 metres down a steep hill to Ladies beach and about 3 miles from the centre of Kusadasi. Kusadasi can be reached by the local bus service which frequently stops outside the hotel for about one euro per person alternatively about 6 euro by taxi. The hotel is suitable for families and has a kiddies pool, playground and daily kids club.

author: 83SarahF
title: Sea Pearl Experience
text: I am just back from a week in the Sea Pearl and cannot recommend it enough. Arrivals were dealt with extremely promptly, literally took all of 5 minutes. The luggage is taken to your room by the Hotel porters almost immediately after. Our room was well maintained, basic holiday bedroom, tv,air-con, mini fridge. The rooms were well kept and the cleaners were in frequently and clean towels were never an issue. Breakfast every morning was perfect and more than enough. The general pool area is well kept, ample sun loungers available for every guest unlike in some resorts. The poolside entertainers Fah and Ginger in particular were excellent and created a fun atmosphere around the pool every day. There is the option of starting every morning with yoga and then there are numerous activities running throughout the day to get involved in. The BBQ night is not to be missed and generated a really good crowd. Room Service is available 24/7 and wifi is available in many areas around the hotel. Only a short walk to ladies beach and unlike in some reports I found the hill leading up to the hotel not steep. Enjoyable walk. Again check out and baggage is dealt with without any hassle. I would go back in the morning. Highly enjoyable.

author: pennydinners
title: Great base for doing the tourist thing.
text: Sea Pearl staff work very hard, most are friendly and helpful. Chef and Co are good. Nice selection for breakfast. Room Service prompt and hot. Rooms need a bit of updating but are clean. Reception staff need to be more welcoming and helpful. A smile helps.Pool is fabulously clean and area kept really well. Animation Team work tirelessly and are so nice and love to see you having fun. Restaurant Staff very helpful. Barbecue Nights are great with excellent food. If you want to have a quiet holiday its superb, if you want to have a bit of fun its good too. Excellent location, 5minute walk to Ladies Beach and lots of shops and restaurants and people strolling and enjoying the atmosphere. Dolmus the local bus stops every 3 or 4 mins outside hotel and you can head to Centrum and visit the markets or take another Dolmus to any of the fine beaches Kusadasi has to offer. You can go to Ephesus or Izmir also, so worth a visit and a very reasonable way to travel. Many Restaurants in Centrum will collect you at your hotel and bring you back free of charge if you book a meal with them. So the Sea Pearl offers you a safe environment with a few extras.

author: Gurlonthemove
title: Great place!
text: I have been going to Kusadasi twice a year (May & September) for about 10 years now. I have stayed in the Palmin hotel once and the Tropicana Garden hotel 3 times and the Sea Pearl is by far the best! The reception staff are as accommodating as possible, the porters/bell boys despite their limited English are also very helpful. The bar staff & waiters are very friendly and they will chat to everybody when they get a chance despite working so hard. They always have a smile on their faces. I am not a breakfast person so I can't comment on the breakfast but my family enjoyed it, there was a good selection of foods. Cereal, breads, eggs, fruit, omelettes, tea, coffee, orange juice etc.. I really enjoyed the poolside food at lunch time, there was a great selection of foods to cater for everybody's tastes and it was very tasty. The poolside is lovely with a lovely pool boy who is very helpful despite his limited English. There was music playing in the background and the entertainment team did their best to entertain with pool games and different activities during the day. They are also lovely fellas. The rooms are basic but nice. The beds are hard but what do you expect in a foreign country. They are very clean as the cleaners clean them everyday. Ladies beach is a 2 minute walk from the hotel and Centrum is about 10 minutes on the dolmus which stops outside the hotel every 5 minutes. The price of the bus os €1 per person which is very reasonable. Overall it is a wonderful relaxing hotel and I would recommend it to anybody. I will defiantly without a doubt be back again!

author: El_Nig
title: Badly in need of some TLC
text: We stayed at the Sea Pearl for two weeks (just got back two days ago). The first thing that struck us was that the bedroom looked like a prison cell as we walked into it - bare, with hard beds and threadbare coarse bedding. Towels were threadbare and coarse, couldn't swing a newborn kitten in the shower. We were requested not to hang towels on the balcony but to use the clothes hanger on the balcony (fair enough if it wasn't broken - as were most others looking up from the pool onto the other balconies). TV was from the 1970's and was hanging 1-2 inches from the ceiling (i.e. impossible to view without hurting your neck) - channels were limited (but hey - we didn't go to watch TV!) The place looks like it was very nice once upon a time, but many areas now look to be abandoned (tennis court, kids play area with weeds growing up through the ground, "chinese garden" complete with boarded-up restaurant), fire extinguishers holding doors open - no money has been spent on maintenance her for a few years Food - terrible and overpriced - Breakfast was shocking - so much so that we regularly opted to head out to pay for our breakfast rather than eat the pre-paid muck that was being served. Pool bar food was massively overpriced (approx 50% higher than down the road in the Ladies Beach restaurants) and was terrible quality - "Executive Chef" could be seen walking around in his spotless whites from time to time . . . he should have been in the kitchen sorting out the food ! Pool was nice and big - sun beds all need to be replaced as they kept collapsing under us. Parasols were scarce (although the Pool Boy was fantastic and very helpful despite his limited English) Staff were great - special mentions to the Omlette Boy slaving over his frying pan for 3 hours every morning , Entertainment team (lovely guys and great fun but the nighttime routines were the same as everything else you've ever seen on your holidays), Kids club lady (Julia) in particular was great with the kids. It was a little frustrating that housekeeping cleaned our room last each day (4pm), so perhaps rotating the schedule might help ? All sports from home shown on massive projected screen which was great for the World Cup & the GAA. (this is an exclusively Irish Hotel) Would i stay here again ? - Absolutely not (although i did speak to a couple who have been going there every year for past 6 years). There is no comfort here, food is terrible, drinks overpriced { Corona - 15TL (€5.20) }, its run-down and in disrepair.

author: Baire1958
title: Don't Believe All you read
text: Having read a lot of the reviews for this hotel made me wonder if they were works of fiction or written by highly medicated people or people with lower standard than mine. Saying that this was an adequate hotel. but just adequate a lot off the points are true but exaggerated and the negatives are just glossed over. negatives 1 The beds cannot be described as comfortable in any shape or form. The are HARD and not in a therapeutic way but in a spartan way. Also i was introduced to a brand new form of upper sheet. easiest way to describe it would be as a large beach towel heavily starched. 2 The number of instructions and notices as what NOT to do can be similar to school notices posted all over the Hotel 3 Breakfast. For a hotel that caters almost entirely to Irish Customers they did not cater much to Irish taste especially the sausages which looked more like pet treat i buy for my Dog 4 WiFi. in the lobby and pool area only (Coincidentally where their bars are) In this day and age. this has to be a marketing ploy to get you to spend more money on over priced drinks and food etc. 5 Fridge in Room.. This is not a fridge but a cooler which is of no use to you at all. another ploy to ensure you buy there product thats my main gripes out of the way. the hotel is spotlessly clean and your room is cleaned very well every day. the staff are very professional and efficient but i would not say friendly. you might think so until you experience how friendly and keen to please are the staff in restaurants and shops in Kusadasi. as they have to earn your custom the trips with Sunway are over priced and are much cheaper outside and as for shops on sight. well they do fleece you tried to be as honest and fair as possible this has been my experience of this hotel others obviously have other opinions

author: SeanO651
title: Great Hotel
text: This was our third time staying here. Still top class and standards always the same. Very guest friendly no matter what age. Great views from the rooms. Staff are very attentive and never seem to forget a face. Very attentive to detail but not over powering. For family's with young kids it must be reassuring to know that they are in good and safe hands when at the kiddies club. Julia must have endless patience and you can see how much she enjoys looking after the kids. What a lovely person. The food here is also very good. Turkish type continental breakfast with plenty to eat. Beautiful freshly baked bread each morning. It is also great to know that if you feel like stopping in then you know you can have a good evening meal. Plus, entertainment provided by Gandhi and his team. Wednesday night is barbecue night. Well worth going to and great Turkish evening. The place is spotless and rooms kept to a high standard of cleanliness. Keep up the good work.

author: foodcritic20110
title: Only Average!
text: I e-mailed the hotel directly a month before we arrived looking for rooms on the higher floors and ended up been put into what i would consider the worst room in the hotel, (ground floor, over the shops and the only access point to the pool area, so noisy would be an understatement!) Anyhow after asking to be moved we were told the hotel was full! An hour after arriving roughly 5.30am another bus load arrived all to be given room keys, so much for being full! After trying some breakfast we got some sleep and decided to get on with things, FYI Turkish breakfast is continental but they will sell you breakfast for 13YTLira. Thats one of the things about Turkey you can have anything you want so long as you pay for it. They give you Frankfurters for their breakfast and near enough Irish sausages when you are paying for it!! After our first day in Kusadasi we arrived back to the hotel only to met by CRANKY late night bar man (Muraj) and seemed very put out by the fact that we disturbed him,as we wanted to have a drink at 1am, after his strop and consistent tutting we got our drink and i decided to see what he was doing on the computer on the upper lobby area near the child preparation room, he was playing candy crush and watching porn on different occasions. Note to Management you can verify this by checking your security cameras. The rooms were spotless the beds were very hard, the cleaning ladies were excellent nothing was a problem. The public areas in the hotel were also spotless, corridors did seem to gather trays and glasses from room service and there was this stench of sewage around the pool lobby area which seems to be a long term issue that has not been addressed, ok if you consider putting down wet napkins over the drain covers! Seriously! The situation with putting towels on the loungers at 9am and nobody using them till 3pm is unacceptable, beds should be checked hourly and towels removed accordingly to give others a chance! I also found that the closer we got to our week been over, i found the waiters far more friendly then at the start of the week! I had to stand up and wave and sometimes i was ignored (pretended not to see me) to get service and i always tipped when served by someone and when a waiter who served me once asked me to Tip him for looking after me for the week i laughed in his face. Otherwise i would consider the Sea Pearl to be a good base. I believe Seamus owns the Palmin group we have mutual acquaintances, its a pity he does not hire somebody of an Irish Hotel background to oversee day to day operations in his hotels and train staff accordingly. I know what i'm talking about as this is my background and i have even won awards. We travelled as a large family group 2 rooms at the Sea Pearl and 3 at the Carina Hotel.

author: 484elaineo
title: Would stay again
text: Just back from a week in kusadasi with my boyfriend and two friends. We arrived to the hotel in the middle of the night about 5am Turkish time. We were greeted by a bell boy who took our bags to our room for us while we checked in. We also to a free cocktail which was nice. The room was nice and very clean. The view from the balcony is lovely you can see the pool but you can also seethe sea in the backround. The room was cleaned 6 days a week and the maids were very efficient. The break fast was nice they made fresh omelettes in front of you and you can choose what you want in them. There was also scrambled eggs, sausages, boiled eggs, cereal bread cheeses hams and other typical continental breakfast olds available. We had no problems with the breakfast and loved the omelettes. The pool was nice and big about 1.5m deep I love swimming so this was beat and we spent most of our time in he pool. There was also plenty of sun loungers to go around and if you couldn't find one a pool boy would help you. Although we didn't participate there was n entertainments team around during the day, they played waterpolo, darts, soccer and gave swimming lessons, there was also a lady looking deter small children and playing with them in the kids pool while the parents relaxed. The food on the hotel was great and me and my friends availed of room service a lot while on holiday especially after a night on bar street. There was never a problem and the food tasted great no matter what the time. We slept great for the week also as our room had air conditioning and the bed was comfortable enough. Overall we enjoyed our stay at seapearlhotel, we hadn't problems and would stay there again

author: sarahrossiter
title: Best Family holiday EVER... Genuine review
text: Sea PEarl hotel: stayed here for one week in middle of july with 4 adults and 2 children (4 and 11). This is a genuine review from a person who has a love of for hotels and food. the hotel is 4 star and so it should. before i went sea pearl i read the reviewz on here and to be honest i didnt know what to expect i really thought i was goin to have an awful holiday, but in fact it was quite the opposite. The rooms are big, clean, the shower is always hot and water is powerful. ther is tea and coffee making facilitys however bring your own tea bags and u must buy your own milk, most rooms have a pool view but as we had a family room we did not but we did have a fab view of kusadasi harbour. FOOD: breakfast did not appeal to me as it included boiled eggs( eatable), scrambled eggs( discusting), fruit, only one type of cereal that tastes like carbord so i would suggest if you are bringing kids then bring coco pops etc for them, one good thing about breakfast is the fresh bread. We did however get an irish breakfast roomservice which costs 13 lira around 6 euro which was fab could not fault it. wr ate in outside restaurant on 3 occasiond and i must say the food is 5 star and reasonable try the stealk!!... we also attended the weekly BBq which was 35 lira pp , children half price and under 6 free which is great value as we had a 5 year old... The staff are extremly hard working and work 14 hour shift for very little pay: from all our 7 days we only had one rude staff member and he was in bar servin drinks other than him everyone else was top class, they are excellient with children. the lady who looks after the kids is great however her english is nt as good as rest of staff. the pool is brill and also a kids pool. the main pool is.quite deep but so clean. the hotel has a shop with sweets and ice creams, sun cream ( which is very expensive so would recommend bringing plenty of your own as it cost us 50 lira for bottle of garnier as their own brand burnt us. the shop is very expensive. their is also a welness centre whcih i got a deep tissue massage which i was.in severe pain for 2 days afterwards but my back is now painfree but it did cost 35 lira. over all 9 out 10. will be going back next year for 2 weeks. brill for familys.

author: emmad8
title: perfect location/great hoilday
text: just back from the sea pearl we went for two weeks this was my second time in the sea pearl and my 3rd to kusadasi. this time there was bout 70 of us for a my sister wedding where she got married in the sunset plaza. the sea pearl was a very good location for us all as we where near ladies beach if you don't mind the walk back up the hill. the hotel was very clean and staff where lovely. i only had breakfast 3 mornings out of the two weeks as it was mostly eggs and fruit. most day we went to ladies beach where the food was cheaper and must nicer i would recommend the sunset restaurant the staff where very welcoming we ate most days here for a good price. they also sent flower to the wedding which was lovely. they beds in the hotel are not the best but the view and the room size were perfect. if booking any tour i would not book in the hotel as they are cheaper from reps on the beach. the bbq night in the hotel is bout 35lira or just over15 euro it is good value for money and entertainment very good although if you are staying for two weeks i would recommend only going one of the nights as the entertainment is the same each week. if heading into two you can get the local bus which is 2.25lira where they are many restaurants and great shopping. a lot of the restaurants will offer you a lift to there restaurant and bring you home to. it is great if you have a large group or family saves on the cost and drops you right at he door of the hotel. there is a kids club and the lady there was lovely and very helpful my 6 year son and some of the other children got on great with her she was a very hard working woman. i will defo go back to the sea pearl as it is in a perfect location for all.

author: donIreland40
title: Nice, clean, basic hotel
text: I'd rate it as a Good hotel - Trip Advisor have automatically filled in my overall rating to Excellent which I don't agree with. More or less all the rooms are the same size and have pool and sea view. There was no single supplement. In the evenings, there is usually entertainment in the lobby and you can hear it if your room is on the lower floors. Ask to be transferred to a higher floors 5 or 6. Staff are nice. Food and drink is expensive compared to food and drink in town. Unfortunately, you have the tourist or white man's price to pay in turkey. But if you go two or three streets away from the tourist traps, you will get nice Turkish food at a fraction of the hotel prices. I guess it is a 4 star hotel because it has all the facilities i.e. Pool, shop, restaurant, beauty spa, bar. Buffet Breakfast is nice too: Plenty of fresh breads; Omelet cook; sausages and scramble and boiled eggs; fruits such as apples, oranges, dates and raisins; jams; chesses; olives; cereals; meats; tea & Coffee; and juice but it is very surgery juice from a machine. Overall a good hotel. 60% full of Irish "Sunway" tourists. A few Irish druggies were on the flight and in the hotel also - They were noisy and a pain in the hole but all the other guests were very nice people. I'd recommend the hotel, but parts of Kusadasi are overbuilt and underdeveloped.

author: NoelnGeraldine
title: wonderful holiday, lovely hotel....BUT!
text: Just returned from 2 weeks at the Sea Pearl. We travelled from Knock with Sunway Travel, flying with Onur Air. I have to say that i have never travelled with any airline with so little leg room.I spent the entire flight with my legs jammed up against the seat in front or out in the aisle, very uncomfortable flight! The transfer with Sunway was first class,hotel check in forms handed out on coach for completion and when we arrived at the hotel we weer presente with our room key and our bags taken straight to our room. The rooms were spacious and extremely clean, towels changed every day and bedding every 3 days. All rooms have a pool and sea view. I would however recommend higher floors. The reception staff, cleaners and pool staff were friendly and helpful. Some of the bar staff and waiters had a bit of an attitude problem, though in the main they were ok. The pool area was great,very clean, plenty of sunbeds with comfortable mattresses.The breakfast was not very memorable and after the first few days all we had was cereal and tea/coffee. There was however plenty of snacks etc available throughout the day at the pool.We only dined in the hotel the first night and this was pretty good, the menu was large and varied.The weekly BBQ on wed was from reports very enjoyable. The entertainment from the animation team was absolutely deplorable, again from reports as we only could tolerate it for one night. The singers were very good though. The daily animation programme by the pool appeared non existent apart from darts, darts and more darts! What part of NO did the irritating animation guy not understand when he asked every day if we would play and got the same answer NO !! The only negative about the Sea Pearl was that during the 2 weeks we were there about 20 or more people came down with a very severe vomiting/diarrohea bug and many were hospitalised. From what we heard from people effected, the Sunway rep was of little or no help and refused to accept that the hotel may be at fault in any way. The hotel location was great, about 10 mins walk to the beach and the dolmus service into town was excellent. All in all we had a wonderful time in Kusadasi and would recommend the Sea Pearl provided the source of this severe bug can be identified and steps taken to prevent a reccurence.

author: Juliao
title: Nice Hotel for Turkish 4 Star
text: My husband and I stayed in the Sea Pearl in September. The hotel was good , very clean and well maintained. We were on a bed and breakfast basis. Our room was a very comfortable even if the bed was like a board, with a nice balcony it was very clean and was serviced daily. The air condition in our room was excellent. Breakfast was ok and the omelettes were good. All the other facilities were excellent including the Turkish bath and the hair salon. Having read other reviews before we went I read about the friendly staff and the 'warm home from home' atmosphere, well I didn't experience this. I felt the staff were unfriendly with the exception of one waiter and the chef cooking the omelettes. We had dinner one night and the food was really good. In general I would stay there again but would not anticipate 'the warm friendly atmosphere'. Aside from the Sea Pearl Ladies beach is less than 5 minutes walk down the hill but it is very steep when you are coming up again. The Dolma which is the mini bus service operates from the beach back up constantly for 2euro. Restaurants in Ladies Beach to go to are Rosy's and Somewhere Else both excellent. Enjoy your holiday - I did !

author: Smallsmac
title: Pleasant stay
text: My husband and I are just back from staying at the Sea Pearl, and after reading some of the comments here before our departure I was quite worried, but I can now say our stay there was pleasant. We were very lucky with our allocated apartment, it was 510, which is on the top floor and the last one in the block. so only one apt. The sun shone on our balcony in the evening beautiful sea view. Noise was to a minimum. Beds were a little hard, but didn't prevent sleep. There was two house keepers one of which was very friendly and appeared mad to practice her English with guests. We didn't eat in the hotel save for breakfast which was included in the price. I learned to stay away from the juices not nice at all. The omelets were tasty, the bread fresh, the coffee with milk was good too. We were not expecting an Irish breakfast as it was stated in the brochure it was a "Turkish style continental breakfast" so no disappointment there. There is a lot of staff so I wont tar them with the same brush, they were all friendly with the exception of the barman that was working the night we arrived, we called for one drink after our dinner out, that is all we had there for the full week. He would barely look at you when I went to the counter after a minute or two standing in front of him he looked up and said "Yes please". He was not busy nor was he serving anyone, he could have at least acknowledged my presence. My husband likes a beer when at the pool but all they had in large beers was Efes which he couldn't take to at all, apparently the owner has a deal done with the company to only supply their product which he gets at a reduced price. The hotels location was perfect. Phew I didn't think I would be writing this much, but in conclusion I do hope to return. The restaurant we used in Ladies beach was "Some where else" worth a visit

author: omalley1950
title: Disappointed!
text: I recently stayed 2 weeks in the Sea Pearl and I was very disappointed! I would not consider this to be a 4 star hotel, it is more like a 3 star! Firstly the towels were hard and fraying, the curtains seemed too narrow for the room and light was coming through the sides. One of them had come off the track and hung lop sided. The worst thing was the beds, they were so hard it was like trying to sleep on wooden boards. During our 2 weeks stay we hardly slept at all.There was entertainment around the pool area every night until 12:45am and because all the rooms are facing the pool the noise level was very loud even with the patio doors closed. Another reason we could not sleep! On three occasions there was also loud music in the lounge until very late which echoed into our room! Certainly not suitable for children...The mattresses on the sun loungers were hard and tatty, and some of the umbrella's were broken! The hotel is in need of a total refurbishment. Despite all this the hotel was kept very clean, the bed linen was changed every second day as were the towels.....I was disappointed with the breakfast, for an Irish owned hotel with 95% guests from Ireland there was no bacon or Irish sausages, The French bread rolls were fresh but only white. Most people these days prefer brown. The long-life milk tasted horrible! The scrambled eggs and omelets were made with this milk, I asked if they would make me some without milk, I was told that they could not! I am allergic to dairy so there was very little that I could eat! There was only one choice of cereal. I spoke to several other people during my stay who were also disappointed sharing the same experience and they said that they would not consider booking the Sea Pearl again! It is such a pity because overall its a perfect location just a few minutes away from the lovely Lady's beach. On a positive note, the staff were fantastic, very friendly and helpful and couldnt do enough to please!

author: Dmfay1
title: Not Bad
text: Just back from a one week stay in the sea pearl. Was dreading the thought of it after reading the reviews here, but was pleasantly surprised. Arrived about 4pm, our bags were taken by a porter and check in was quick and efficient. Room was good enough, spotlessly clean and kept that way all week. Had an English movie channel which was nice. Pool area was clean, had a nice bar, although drinks are 2 lire cheaper outside the hotel. Breakfast wasn't bad, plenty fruit fresh bread cereal, and plenty of Turkish options. Why do people complain here about the lack of the "Irish breakfast?". You are in Turkey for God sake! Didn't have dinner here as we went to Ladies Beach each night and ate in a different one each night. Turkish food is excellent and the people are very friendly. Try the Sunset and Rosys. Also did the Ephesus trip (amazing) Book with Jean Claude on ladies beach as the hotel tours are about double the price. Also, stay away from Adaland (it's a complete rip off). Hadn't much dealings with the staff so can't complain, but there was one guy ( Irish, the owner) who walked around in an arrogant manner, treating his staff with contempt basically. The only problem I had personally is that the hotel is exclusively Irish, and the Irish are loud and a few dodgy looking drunken ones there(we all know the type), don't get me wrong, most of the people were lovely but I'd prefer to be away from the Irish while on holiday. So, all in all it wasn't a bad spot, not 4 star but the price should make that obvious when you are booking (very cheap) A

author: IPAIRLTravSec
title: Lovely Hotel & excellent value
text: My wife and I stayed at this hotel for 1 week in July. We were looking for a short relaxing break and our daughter was at this hotel earlier in the year and recommended it. It was also recommended by the staff at our travel agents. It was a long journey from Ireland by plane and bus but on arrival we got a warm greeting from the staff of the hotel with porters bringing our bags to our room while we concentrated on checking in and enjoyed our welcome drink. The staff throughout our stay were very accommodating, from reception to room maids. The bedroom was basic but spotless; the addition of a bedroom chair would be nice but it was not a huge inconvenience. The bathroom & toilet again clean but the shower cubicle could have done with updating, although water pressure was good and plenty of hot water was always available. The disappointment of this hotel has to be the dining room. There is a wide choice for breakfast but we stuck to the omelette, bread and fruit. The evening menu was huge and offered everything from Indian, Chinese, Mexican, Turkish etc. However having eaten there the first night we only ate there once again in the week. The food is passable but there is a wider choice at the nearby Ladies Beach restaurants or in Kusadasi, which are also cheaper. The bar area in the lobby hosts popular football matches or movie nights and service by waiters is very good but if you go to the bar expect a wait. There is also a lovely bar area at the pool where entertainment is laid on every evening. The pool is well maintained and sun beds were top class. There was always a staff member on hand to assist with beds and parasols. For those with children there appears to be a very well run animation programme and creche for younger kids. Overall I would recommend this hotel and it was excellent value.

author: LisaH230
title: i really enjoyed my stay and would definitely go back
text: We stayed here for 2 weeks and I honestly couldnt fault it, bar one or two things. On the positive side, we got a lovely reception which was very welcoming and our bags were brought up to the room for us. The room was nice, with a good view of the sea and pool. Breakfast was free and is ok. We didnt really eat breakfast much though but when we did it was mainly boiled eggs and bread. We had dinner once in the hotel and said never again. I'm glad it was dark by the time we were eating because mine looked awful. I couldnt eat it. However, the pool is gorgeous and always sun beds free - no queuing thankfully. And every evening there is entertainment, which is not very good. There is also a photographer floating around every day an she takes beautifully photos of you which you have the option to buy. i bought mine because they were stunning. The hotel is in a great location, 2 min walk from ladies beach and a bus stops every few mins to bring you into town. So for location and the pool alone I would stay here again. However, the one thing that I will say and which really annoyed and upset me was that we asked the staff at reception to post our postcards, there were 4 of them. And NONE of them were delivered at all, none of our family and friends received them so that did make us angry

author: deewicklow
title: clean basic accomodation
text: I stayed here at the end of April with my sister. Nice clean basic accomodation. I agree with other commentator about the beds they are hard, the springs stick out in places. Great views down to Ladies beach, which is only a 10 min walk away. Nice pool and surrounds, a few shops, hairdressers and spa. The turkish baths on site were good but expensive. The breakfast was typical Turkish fare, took a bit of getting used to but fine for the price. The evening meal was usually a buffet and overpriced at 15 euro each. Much better and more fun to walk to Ladies beach and choose from a wide variety of resturants and food at excellent value. We discovered the Plaza resturant on Ladies beach and ate there most nights. Food was great value and the menu was extensive, catering for vegeterians very well. The dolmus the local bus stopped outside the hotel and took a circular route taking in Ladies beach and the town of Kusadasi for 1.25 euro a trip. Much more convienent that the local taxis which we thought were expensive. The evening entertainment in the hotel was dire! but going out was much more fun so we didnt mind much.

author: olwynh
title: Amazing Service and Staff
text: I am just back from a week long stay in The Sea Pearl Hotel. We travelled with friends and I have to say we had a fantastic week. The staff were so helpful, friendly, and the overall hotel service is a well oiled machine. We forgot to put a sign on the door for the room to be cleaned....but they still cleaned the room and changed our towels every day. The rooms were big and maybe a little bit basic. But they were immaculate. I had no problems with the towels. The water pressure in the Shower was so strong! :-) We ate twice at night at the hotel and all four of us were happy with our meals. We didnt eat breakfast as we had a few late nights :-) but we were told before our trip that the breakfast was basic enough. I had a massage in the Spa and it was Brilliant. The Jewellary shop on site had great bargains and some of my friends got some Jewellary there that was cheaper than in town. Ladies Beach was less than 5 minutes away walking. Location wise that was great. Entertainment was good at the hotel at night......with belly dancing, comedy shows and karaoke ETC.... We loved the Pool area and the fact we could eat at the restaraunt at any stage.....it was getting very warm during our week and we were glad that the pool was a little bit cool :-) I will 100% return to this hotel, as will my friends.... This year if we can!!...... I will recommend it to friends and family. All four of us had a ball. Thanks Sea Pearl :-)

author: figures123
title: not a four star
text: just after coming back from this hotel and will not be returning to it or to Turkey. this hotel is a basic 3 star hotel. The beds are so hard that i took pain killers to relieve pain in my back . the breakfast was a disgrace. there was no bacon,no weetabix, no freshly squeezed orange juice,no Kelloggs cornflakes, no bananas. On display were platters of tomatoes, cucumbers, assorted cheeses, vienna loaves Natural yogurt was displayed in one big bowel and you used a ladle to put it in your bowel. there were no selection of yogurts. the only food been cooked in the breakfast hall was omlettes. A young 20 year old male made up your omlette consisting of mushrooms tomatoes grated cheese and processed ham. you chose what you wanted from that combination. Scrambled eggs was available also .(the bathroom) The towels were so worn that you think you were drying yourself with sandpaper as they were so hard. no shower gel or shower cap in the bathroom. .. Alcohol was a crazy price with Hennessy been €10 a unit Bacardi Smirnoff , whiskey were €6 unit. location of the hotel is 20 minutes from the city center by bus. it is too far to walk into the city or town. we used the bus or taxi to get to any destination. that was an added cost because of the location. we did not eat in the restaurant of the hotel so i cannot comment on that.

author: maggiemoo1978
title: Meh....its was ok
text: It was our first time in Turkey so I can not compare this hotel to another in Kusadasi. We stayed a week starting the 31st of March. It was the first week of the season and so not extremely busy. Staff & Service Overall pleasant staff Room service quick, as was any request made to reception Exchange rate - €1 to 2.2tl, Downtown - €1 to 2.38tl €10 to rent safe for a week Room We had twin rooms, standard, shower no bath TV with some English speaking channels but bad reception Balcony overlooking pool area and sea Cleaned 6 out of 7 days Food We booked to include breakfast only as we knew we wanted to go to other restaurants for dinners. I had breakfast one morning and skipped it for the rest of the week. Its a selection of cheeses, meats, pastries, eggs etc. Quality not great in items like orange juice, raw halloumi cheese (?) and dry pastries Food is available by the pool or table service between the bar and poo and inside, Sandwiches, Pizzas et, Burgers etc. Somethings reasonably priced like omlettes. Chicken baps without chicken on half of it that kind of thing. Ok but could be better Room service avail 24hr and similar menu by the pool / tables outside with a few additions like chicken dinners and desserts. We got profiteroles for 6.50tl, 4 of them and they were not good quality, mass produced frozen Buffets every night for €15 Drink Full bar in the lobby/ seating area and by the pool Also available from room service 24hr Soft drinks / water ...cans about 5tl Wine a bit more expensive than in other places, starting about about 50tl I think Cocktails available from about 13tl and up. Not great Pool Lots of free sun loungers when we were there but could see it filling up quick in peak season. They could do with changing them as they are hard to adjust and kind of annoying, the pool was unfortunately frigid. Spa / Salon We had a turkish bath in the hotel spa (intro to hotel offer in room for €18 instead of €25) the girls who worked there were lovely and it was very relaxing, Not as good as I expected resultswise (the hamam in Morocco last year could have set the bar too high though) but still very enjoyable, they provide lots of massage options as well. We also used the salon (hair and basic beauty) she was lovely and ok prices for simple things like €16 for a pedicure Getting Down Town Its not within walking distance of bar street or the shopping, so we took dolmus (small van/ bus) that costs 2.75tl each to get down there or a taxi will cost 15tl - both are each way

author: GalwayLinda
title: Best hotel Ever!
text: This hotel ticked all the right boxes for us! Turkey is a wonderful country with so much to see and do. The Sea Pearl is a good base and all of the tours on offer pick you up from the front gate of hotel. The staff here go above and beyond to ensure you enjoy your stay, they were so friendly and bubbly! From the moment we arrived we were made feel so welcome. The rooms are gorgeous, proper double bed, very spacious and we'd a lovely big balcony overlooking the pool and sea. Just a couple minutes walk to the beach. There's plenty of facilities provided with a salon, hairdressers, spa, souvenior shop etc. I'd definately recommend the Turkish bath, it's heaven! As a young couple, we thought we'd be out on the town every night but I found the clubs tacky and very full on and we actually ended up in the hotel most nights. The entertainment was brilliant every night, great craic and they make the best cocktails! The food was top class too, I even tried the shark for dinner. I can't describe the breakfast...unreal. Anything and everything you could want. There was a chef making omlettes to order and the fruits were so fresh and tasty. I cannot fault one thing about this hotel, it's 5* and nicest hotel I've ever stayed in. Best holiday ever and will definately be back some time.

author: pamela11_11
title: What do people expect
text: Just returned from Hols in Sea Pearl. Great hotel and very clean. I have read other reviews before travelling and since returning from Sea pearl I can't see what people have probs with. Ok.. beds are abit hard but its not your own bed your in with your duvet! Its a hotel your staying in so of course the prices are going to be more expensive than elsewhere in Kusadasi but you can make up for that haggling in town later for prices!!! This is the 3rd time we have travelled to Kusadasi and enjoyed it this time as much as ever. We kept ourselves to ourselves and enjoyed this hotel. it has a good location close to Ladies beach and easy access to Centre on Dolmus. Very clean and good selection of food available. Breakfast gets abit repetitive after about 3rd day but you get enough to do. We brought some snacks and drinks in with us and never had a problem...but didn't make it a show of it the way we saw others doing. We would return to this hotel again. Although we have also stayed in its sister hotel The Palmin and would say the staff at the Palmin are 100 times more efficient than staff at Sea Pearl.. At The Palmin staff cannot do enough at all times so missed that.... but don't worry if staying there too its a good hotel, clean and good food... its every bit as good as the Sea Pearl.

author: JennieGrangel
title: 'Jailhouse Rock' holiday from hell. NEVER AGAIN
text: Well where do we start?? this is the worst hotel we have ever stayed in. The noise is unbearable - entertainment is nightly till 1 am (sometimes later) and can be heard from rooms - louder than TV!! the quality of the entertainment is low and this makes it harder to listen. The beds are like rocks, the bed linen is very very poor quality - it hurts your skin and feels awful - they play rave music around the pool whenever they have activities so from 12.30 - 3pm you cant hear yourself think with the boom boom.- fine if your out for a night out but when your trying to relax by the pool its not nice, its not even good boom boom music. The food is of such low quality/ low amount (you can count the chips on the plate) that you would be better to eat out at all times, its half the price and twice the quality, breakfast which is free is the cheapest/lowest quality food available in Turkey and bought for that reason as the hotel are not interested in pleasing the guests, just taking your money. They double charge for items such as ice creams, crisps, WATER, juice etc and its strictly FORBIDDEN to bring food/water in from outdoors, we saw people being stopped bringing cans of coke, bottles of water that they were drinking from??? the words Contraband were used frequently with people sneaking around eating food from outside and laughing amongst themselves, but really when your on holidays you'd rather be able to relax, you would buy the food/drink there if you felt you weren't being ripped off - Cans of coke/orange/ 4tl=2euro, Pringles 7.5tl =3.75euro, Ice Cream 3tl= 1.50euro. Cocktails 15/17tl = 7/8 euro Factor 50 suncream is 48 tl, roughly 24euros - same over here is 9euro, all kids swim toys are dearer than at home - not what you expect in Turkey, which is so cheap, the children's playroom is full of broken toys & the Sea Urchins Kids club has 1staff and she cant speak english!! The rooms are 2*quality with stains on the ceilings of the bathrooms from leaks from upstairs, we had ANTS every day in our room. Cooler in room didn't work. Curtains don't fit the windows, if you have booked a holiday here change now & don't bother going to other hotels in the Palmin group as the same man owns the 3 of them and they are all the same. - Sunset Plaza/Palerma - saying all this we met some lovely Irish people on holidays all with the same complaints, the general staff around the pool and waiting on tables were friendly and felt sorry for the guests as they knew we were being ripped off at all times. The management of the hotel don't care if you have a complaint and even when they had the opportunity to move us to a quieter part of the hotel where we might have been able to sleep before 1.30am they didn't bother. If you have a complaint don't bother going to the Sunway rep CIARA - she doesn't care - she's on good terms with the hotel owners son and is more worried about keeping her job than pleasing the guests. she is awful, just shrugged her shoulders when we complained and snapped our heads off when we complained again!! if your already booked and ready to go, then be sure to bring plenty of cash with you :) delighted to be home, we may have grey skies in Ireland but we have high standards in our hotels and if you have a complaint it will be dealt with - we thought that with an Irish owner this hotel would be of the same quality as what we'r used to - ha -not a chance - once your there your stuck with it and they know this and take full advantage - Go self catering - its what we'l do next time - Loads of Irish people have apartments to rent & Kusadasi is an exciting place with really good bargins/ really nice places to eat for roughly 50tl for a family of 5 including drinks, you just have to look for them and stay away from the moor obvious places :)

author: irisheyesKillarney
title: Second Visit to Sea Pearl
text: Just back from our second trip to Kusadasi staying in Sea Pearl. Our family suite was located on 6th floor and we had no problem with noise or late night revellers. It is a very clean hotel and has very friendly staff from reception to bar and right down to their cleaners. It is not 4 star by Irish Standards but good overall. It has a lovely location with good views and very easy to get into Kusadasi itself by Dolmus and local taxis, which are always outside lobby. The entertainment could do with a bit of updating but pleasant to sit and listen to for a last drink before bed. We enjoyed the restaurants in Kusadasi and can recommend Saray, Castle, Victoria and Erzincan. We are being ripped off in Ireland with our restaurant prices. a T Bone Steak in Kusadasi ranged from €14 to €19 with all the trimmings and was top notch. While eating in the Victoria restaurant they invited us to a free boat trip on the Wed eve, they pick you up at your hotel you order your meal, go on the boat trip which took us 1 hr 20 minutes to watch the sunset and our meal was ready when we returned. A lovely experience. There was a very professional photographer on the boat and she took great individual and group photographs which we were not even compelled to buy but we ended up buying 6 of them as they were only €2.50 each for a large size and excellent momentos of our trip. Even if you dont eat in Victoria I would recommend the boat trip on its own as it only costs 5 Turkish Lira and was marvelous value. We also got our teeth checked out during our visit. On our last trip I found a marvelous dentist Fuat Akyildiz and his wife Dilek. They are perfectionists and their work is to an exceptionally high standard and so very very cheap compared to home. Prices for dental work varies over their so do your homework beforehand. One of our friends paid double what we did to a dentist over there. Overall a lovely trip and we will go back. Temperatures up to 38 deg last week so bring plenty sun cream.

author: neevo79
title: Never Ever Again
text: Well what can I say???? A relaxing holiday it was not. My husband and I were booked in for 2 weeks to this 'Hotel' with our 2 year old daughter. Not our first time to Kusadasi, but first stay in this 'Hotel'! We were situated on 2nd floor. Nice view of sea was only good thing. Breakfast was substantial, but most tables were never cleared away, no cutlery available, most crockery in use was cracked or broken. Staff pleasant enough once you do not have any problems to report. The Entertainment would be poolside every night until 1am in the morning, so if you plan on any early nights forget it. There may as well be no windows in the room it is so loud, no matter what floor you choose (speaking with other guests). Totally unaceptable when you have a baby. We got absolutely no satisfaction (at all) from either Sunway 'Rep' or Hotel staff when we informed them of the noise issue along with many other guests. We were basically informed that, that was the Entertainment in the Hotel like it or lump it. We are a couple in our early 30's who are well used to late nights and loud music, but we feel when staying in a hotel there has to be allowances for young children trying to sleep, and a reasonable cut off point for music. Our 2 year old was woken many nights due to the 'Entertainment' being so loud. We checked out early from this hotel it was so bad and booked in elsewhere for the remainder of our stay, and we were much happier as it was very annoying and upsetting to not get any help or satisfaction from either Hotel staff or SUNWAYs 'REP'.

author: GermanInIreland
title: Brilliant stay in a good location
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in the Seapearl Hotel last week. The staff was nice, friendly and well able to speak English or get someone promptly who can. Most people staying there are Irish and in their 50’s+ as such and with the few exceptions of some families with kids and the some 30’s couples. So it was a nice and peaceful for rest for us. The rooms were with a small TV, airconditioning, clean, tidy and functional. Cleaning happened daily and we got fresh towels every day, although they state that they only give towels every second day. The location is brilliant, 5 minutes walk from the Ladies Beach with bars and restaurants. It takes 40 minutes at a leisurely walk into the main town of Kusadasi or just take the bus for 2TL (€1). There is entertaining in the lobby every evening of different type like live music, Turkish dancing, game shows...etc. It certainly is fun to watch it for a while, when you got nothing better to do. The Turkish Night on Wednesday in the hotel is well worth the price for the food alone. The drinks in the hotel itself are more expensive than in the town, but still reasonable. They got a spa, but be aware that the prices for it, are Irish prices Internet is free in the lobby, but no facilities in the room itself. They got tea and coffee facilities, you can buy your extra teabags, coffee and milk in the small shop in the hotel for very little money. Only thing they didn’t have was sugar, which we got in a small shop outside the hotel. The Hotel has a policy about bringing food to the Hotel. This didn’t bother us, since it is not a self catering hotel anyhow and nobody said anything about the sugar.

author: SamPam
title: Friendly and helpful staff
text: My husband and I spent 2 weeks holiday at the Sea Pearl Hotel September 2010. On arrival the staff took all our luggage to our rooms. I asked for extra pillows and for cotton top sheets (as they don't seem to put cotton top sheets on) all was delivered immediately. All staff speak perfect english from the reception to the cleaners to the restaurant staff. We found the dinner menu very good and price was reasonable. The few down sides are : The entertainment around the pool after dinner was poor, we were there 2 weeks and it was the same thing repeated the following week and the girl in charge of the entertainment was the only one who could'nt speak english properly. The breakfast in the morning was the same thing day in day out, the same trays of food in the very same positions, obviously some of the left overs from the previous day. The barbecue is very good on every Wednesday night, brilliant selection of food and lots of it. The hotel was spotless towels changed every day It was definitely value for money. The Turkish people are friendly (the shops do hassle people) aside from that the bus drivers are so helpful if they see you they pull up and wait for you. Overall a really lovely holiday ,nice beach, value for money, nice weather very hot early September changes drastically the end of September. Kusadasai is near to Ephesus and to the House Of Mary. I would recommend Kusadasi. As regards the restaurants along the beach front , a lot of them are over rated , we were very disappointed in Rosies, It seems to get the business it is always full, but definitely not for me , vegetables are obviously tinned , everything about it was instant! It may be cheaper that,s why they are busier, we went there twice and decided that was enough , Mona Lisa restaurant was better.

author: devlio
title: An excellent choice!
text: We stayed in the Sea Pearl for 2 weeks this September. You're checked into your rooms on the coach transfer, which saves waiting around in the hotel lobby and when we arrived at the hotel we got a complimentary drink, which was nice. Our room was realitively small but spotless and we'd a great view of the pool and the sea. The cleaners came in everyday for two weeks and replaced the towels every day. The breakfast was great, loads of fresh fruit, bread, cereal and even a freshly made omlette if you like. The food in the hotel was really good in general- huge portions so no starters required if your not a big eater! The entertainment was great, the entertainment staff were really enthusiatic and friendly- we stayed in a few nights for the magic show, fire show and BBQ (a must- but don't enter the best couple competition!). The hotel is really close to Ladies Beach (but not that close to Kusadasi town), 5 minute walk, and Ladies beach has loads of good restaurants and Dream Boys bar is a great spot. We caught the dolmus to Kusadasi for the first week, which is so cheap and handy, but decided to walk to Kusadasi along the coast route and it only took about 30 minutes or so. It's a nice walk, with a good view (especially at sunset) so try it once. Saray restaurant in Kusadasi is the best one we went to, ask anyone for directions. No need for a starter here either, they give you warm turkish bread with dips. They give a complimentary dessert too- fruit and icecream. There's entertainment most nights- Wednesday's their Turkish night. One word of advice- shop around for your day trips. We booked 3 trips(waterpark, Ephesus and Pamukkale) with a operator at Ladies Beach and saved over 60 euro, compared to the price at the hotel. Overall the hotel was great, we'd definitely stay there again.

author: smokeytra
title: a hidden gem
text: went to kusadasi for 2 weeks in may with my partner and stayed in sea pearl hotel. fantastic hotel. we had a double room, includes tea and coffee making facilitys. bathroom spotless. all toilet seats sanitised on arrival. we had a beautiful view of the pool and nightly entertainment from our balcony. even at 5 floors up. the staff were fantastic, always on hand to help you. always professional. barbeque night fantastic, with great food and entertainment. located 5 min walk from ladies beach, and 10 to 15 min dolmus (local bus) trip to kusadasi centrum. ate in the kiwi, halikarnas with the famous seamus, and young brothers on ladies beach and the food was fantastic. (seamus's turkish night is well worth a look). pop into jean claude van damme at sundial travel agents and book a turkish bath with him. 10euro including transfers. bar street is fantasic, loved it, but you would easily spend a fortune on a night out there! fantastic, hotel, location, staff......... cannot fault it. we will be going back!!

author: BibaGa
title: Very nice clean hotel, but expensive for meals / drinks.
text: €15 visa to enter Turkey payable at airport. Efficient check-in procedure, all Irish guests, very clean hotel, friendly staff, great maid service, all rooms have a sea view, balcony, kettle, small fridge, individual air-conditioning unit, hairdryer and safe(€10 per week).
