English speaking channels on TV - BBC world News and True entertainment. Drinks and meals very expensive in hotel - eat out when possible. No 5 local bus stops outside €1 into town. Taxi €6. Ladies Beach 10mins stroll away - Turn (L) outside hotel, walk to T junction, go (L) & follow road around to the (R), sea on (L) - loads of restaurants - Halikarnas and Old House restaurant are good for during the day, very quiet at night. In town Casablanca, Mayflower and Murphys restaurants are all nice. Large market in town on Wed 7.30am - 5pm, No 5 bus goes to it - lots of real genuine fakes. Need to haggle, but good value in belts, tee-shirts, perfume etc. Sea Pearl operates a Charge Card. Euro accepted everywhere in resort. Trips to Samos Island in Greece €35 good. Ephesus trip interesting. Turkish Bath in Haman great fun €14 / full body oil massage €10. Our Ladys House on Sunday - Mass at 10.30am.

author: Ashy91
title: Wow!!
text: Myself and my boyfriend travelled here last June and we had THE BEST TIME EVER!! After a rather nervous flight(Onurair not going to win any awards anytime soon!! Very shaky flight!), we finally arrived at the hotel. It was very handy as we were given the paperwork(eg room number etc) on the bus, so we just had to walk in, pick up our key and head upstairs! We received a lovely cocktail on arrival and it was so nice to have our suitcases carried up for us! A few people complained that you had to tip everyone, but we found that a little tip the first day and you are well minded for the whole trip. We were on the 6th floor and had the most magnificent view ever. We would recommend the turkish bath, great for relaxing muscles and helps your skin tan better! The jeep safari was a whole different story- to make a long story short if we ever go back to Turkey we receive a free excursion! Boat trip was also well worth the money! Rooms were very clean, food in restaurant was lovely. I'm allergic to eggs and therefore didnt like the breakfast but we found a lovely little place just down the prom beside the excursion office. Denny sausages, galtee rashers, dairygold and lyons tea! heaven! 5stars!!!

author: loura89
title: NEVER AGAIN
text: three of us went to turkey for the first time this year we booked our holiday in Falcon Travel in Limerick flew with Sunways and stayed in the Sea Pearl, well for 3 days....... we are 3 young girls aged 20/21 and were really excited to go on holidays!!! our travel agent really pushed the sea pearl so we said grand book it. when we got to teh hotel we checked in got our key went to our room, within 10 mins being there we got complained, ovwe the next few days we were gettng complained about everything at any time of the day our night! a letter got left in our room because a pillow case had hair dye on it and if it didnt come out we would have to pay for it!!!! this was crazy what would they do if we had being putting on fake tan ??? another letter was put in saying we were to loud to be quite!!!! the last complaint was at 7 pm a member of staff knocked and said keep it down when the kids at the pool were louder than us... this was outrageous!!!!!! finally on the day we got thrown out we were in bed barley a hour and knocjs came to the door but we didnt answer then the door was opened and a man appeared it was SEAMUS GLYN the OWNER he told us go to reception so we did, he basically told us to 'pack our bags and get the [--] out we werent welcome' we asked for our money back and he told us we didnt pay him so wasnt his problem!!!! when we went to speak to the Sunways rep Sharon Byrne she told us the exact same to get the [--] out and to sleep on the beach she didnt care where we stayed..... while packing our bags seamus glyn and seven other employees were in and surrounding our room... seamus glyn was shouting at us calling us 'pieces of [--]' and called one girl a 't***p' which was totally uncalled for!!!! he also cut open one of the girls fingers open. seamus Glyn was unbelievably ignorant aggressive and rude. wen we got kicked out we sat in reception and we couldnt even get served water in the hotel in the heat that was there we were slowly dehydrating!!!! we were shockrd and appaulled at the way we were treated teh staff the food the owner were all horrid, I WOULD NEVER EVER RECOMMENDED THIS HOTEL TO ANY ONE OF ANY AGE TO THIS HOTEL IT WILL RUIN YOUR HOLIDAY. also the travel agent should not of recommended this hotel for us !!!!! on the bright side wen we found new accomandation we had the best time ever in turkey and we are returning next year!!!! DONT GO NEAR ANY OF SEAMUS GLYN 3 HOTELS IN TURKEY YOUR HOLIDAY WILL BE RUINED!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: zsazsacorcaigh
title: Stunning view from this beautiful hotel.
text: I booked two weeks in this hotel with a friend of mine and I really couldn't fault it except that it is fairly pricey for food and drinks. So we just had food the odd time by room service and basically bought our own drinks, water beer etc and kept it in the fridge. The breakfast buffet is huge and has a good choice. From omlettes, fruit, eggs, cheeses and breads, olives etc. The staff (apart from reception) are friendly especially the cleaners and we left them a box of chocolates each. They do wonderful sculptures with the towels! Rooms are cleaned and towels changed every day. The rooms are bright and airy and spacious. My friend got a massage in the spa but it was pricey at 70 euro whereby it would be half that price in a turkish place, so check elsewhere. The food is lovely there but as I said pricey. I would recommend Rosys restaurant on Ladies beach to eat and watch the sun set or if you fancy going to the centre, check out Erzincan kebap house. It's next to the mosque across from caravansarai and does the most DELICIOUS food I've tried in ages and it's ridiculously cheap. Tip , go to where the locals eat and you will not be disappointed. Overall, I enjoyed my stay here and it was really relaxing. The Turkish people are so gracious and friendly.

author: CrockerDublin
title: Dont go for last week of season
text: The Sea Perl Hotel lies about 3 Km from the tourist centre. The hotel itself is for all intents and purposes a well run hotel, clean and with friendly staff. However it is best described as Ballymun in the sun a term your Irish readers will understand. What I mean is that it would remind you a lot of what one sees when one looks at old documentaries of Butlins Holiday camps. As far as I could see most of the guests stayed in the hotel not venturing out to sample Turkish life except for organised trips. The entertainment was amateurish and aimed at children. The food, we had one dinner, lunch by the pool each day and breakfast each morning was poor to say the least while the service was friendly and efficient. The room was cleaned each day and we were very happy with the efforts put in by the staff to keep the hotel clean overall. In addition the reception staff were very efficient and friendly. Internet access was slow and in this day and age had to pay for it seems a little mean. Our holiday company was Sunway Ireland and I have to say that our rep was excellent always ready to help and the information she provided was spot on. Would we go again? Yes we would return to Turkey not sure if we would opt for this hotel again. I would not knock it if you like the Butlins type thing or going to a place and staying there I guess it is not easy to travel 3Km with kids at night. So yes if you have young kids or don’t like to get out and about it will be perfect for you.

author: TrojanDublin_Ireland
title: Sea Pearl by name but cerainly no gem!
text: Myself and my husband are just back from 2 weeks in this so called 4* hotel and my advice for you is to book one of the many other hotels in Kusadasi. If your style of holiday is to stay in "Ballymun in the Sun" then this hotel is the ideal place to stay. No disrespect to Ballymun or anybody who comes from there - Ballymun has many good qualities not found in this hotel. Location isn't too bad in relation to the beach but you wouldn't want to be either elderly or bad on your legs as the hotel is up a very steep climb from Ladies Beach. I saw several people struggling trying to get back up the road to the hotel. The local bus DID pick and drop to the hotel, but many, like myself, prefer to be in a position to walk to and from somewhere relatively close-by. Hotel itself had several other downsides. Whilst the hotel cleaners seemed to spend an inordinate amount of time cleaning around the pool, it appeared that they never cleaned the pool itself and there was a "scum" line around the pool. The so called "extensive sun terraces" were non-existent - there was a large area around the pool, but hardly extensive! The sun loungers were set-up in such a way that they were right on top of each other so you barely had room to move one if you needed to position it in a certain way, so basically you ended up nearly lying on top of the person beside you whether you liked it or not. The foam mattresses on the sun loungers themselves were so dirty that your beach towels never felt clean after laying them down. the Hotel also operated a policy whereby you could not buy food and drink outside the hotel and bring into your room!! The rule was that you were to purchase all food and drink in the shop in the hotel. If the cleaners found any food that had been bought outside the hotel, the guest was chastised and food removed. In relation to food, if room service was ordered, the trays/leftovers were left outside room doors and didn't seem to be removed by cleaners until later the following day. Sometimes, trays were moved down towards reception but left in corridors, despite the fact that cleaning staff may have been up and down during the intervening time. The bar prices were pretty exorbitant too bearing in mind the cost of living in Turkey. Much cheaper to drink in the many restaurants closeby in Ladies Beach and lots more athmosphere. Upshot is, if you like budget holidays and being surrounded exclusively by people from your own country then this is the place for you. However, it might be easier just to visit Butlins!

author: EeZeeTravelman
title: Good Clean Hotel
text: The hotel is clean and modern. We did the B&B and it was very good. The hotel is walking distance from ladies beach and waterfront. Lots of restaurants and bars. Staff at the hotel are very hospitable. Food and Drink at the hotel is expensive in comparison with the surrounding area - prepare to pay nearly double (hotel prices). There are many good places to eat and drink in Kusadasi and Ladies Beach. Book trips/excursions at Ladies beach - thru the hotel and rep is very expensive - the trip compaies at Ladies beach are for the same thing at nearly half the price. The hotel front desk people are very nice - the problem here is that they have no idea about Kusadasi and surrounding area. I asked them for a Turkish restaurant and was sent to an Irish bar!! There are no recmmendations for anything outside the 4 walls of the hotel. I asked them to book a table at a restaurant and was handed the receiver and then asked for 1 lira to pay for the call....I think this insular approach can only beblamed on the hotel management. Turkey is a really nie place and Kusadasi is very nice albeit a little over commercialized. See Ephesus when you're there. I will go back to Turkey.

author: sallyann82
title: Relaxing Resort
text: Our trip to the Sea Pearl hotel was extremely relaxing. I went with 4 other girls and we seemed to be the only group staying there at the time. Mainly couples and familys and everyone was Irish. The hotel provided entertainment every evening and although the food at the BBQ night was just ok the belly dancer was great. The food in the hotel was of a high standard otherwise, large portions and Heinz beans! We booked b&b but it was bascially a continental breakfast, an Irish breakfast was about €5. Room service was free and available 24 hrs. The food in the hotel was actually some of the best we had. The pool was fantastic and we could always find loungers. There were also pool staff to get you an umbrella, ice cream or drinks so you could literally just lie there all day. The room facilities were basic and the fridge was really only a coolbox as it only keep things that were already cold cool. The entertainment staff could be a bit annoying while we were relaxing trying to get us to join in games around the pool but maybe thats just because we were lazy and would probably be good for kids The products used in the spa were very poor, I had a facial with dove body cream! We did enjoy the turkish bath although I think if we were going again I would go outside the hotel. Kusadasi is fully of Irish bars and people. The restaurants down at ladies beach were much better quality then the central area and be wary of buying wine by the bottle in restaurants, we got stung for 2 bottles which cost us more than an entire meal plus wine elsewhere. The markets are great for buying genuine fake bags but not much else Wednesday market was very stuffy. Locals say than when they are offering half price that is their realy cost so be sure to haggle down some more. Really enjoyed this trip and the weather was fantastic. Would defo go back

author: Donegaltourist
title: The Sea Pearl
text: Stayed here for 2 weeks with my husband (we stayed in the sister hotel The Palmin at the same time last year). POSITIVES 1 Kettle and Fridge in the bedroom (which you're only supposed to use if you purchase products in the hotel) 2 Very clean hotel 3 Great sea views 4 Good entertainment in the evenings - music etc 5 Quiet location, close enough to Ladies Beach and far enough away from the hustle and bustle of Kusadasi. 6 Bbq night was good value for money - great selection NEGATIVES 1 Raw sewage stench in our bathroom for at least 4 days which kept coming and going over the course of our holiday 2 This hotel is not wheelchair friendly 3 We found most of the bar staff grumpy and unpleasant 4 Food in hotel was too expensive and the alcohol was an absolute rip off - 12 euros for a brandy 5 Sound proofing isn't good 6 You are not allowed to bring in food/drink purchased outside the hotel 7 Bingo is a rip off - 22 euros for a pile of junk! In saying all of the above we enjoyed our stay - The Sea Pearl and the Palmin are much of a muchness. I think that the staff are friendlier in The Palmin. Would I stay in either hotel again, yes because the holiday only cost 440 euros. Can't say that we received any hassle from staff regarding staying in the hotel to eat and drink. Best places to eat at nightime are Rosys on Ladies Beach and Sarays in Kusadasi (excellent staff and service). Casablanca also serves up a good meal (surroundings aren't great). Rosys is good for lunch and Sherwoods is also vfm for lunch and drinks. Word of advice, we went on the Jeep Safari with Emile who works on Ladies Beach. I've been on many excursions in my life but this was the worst ever!! A waste of money. Take your jumpers for the evening as it gets nippy and we had 3 days of storms and rain on our second week. The average temperature during the first week was 22 C.

author: doblush
title: Didnt live up to its reputation
text: We had heard alot about the Sea Pearl, namely that it was a fantastic holiday for familes, kids AND teeenagers. It was clean, the staff were poilite - but not overly attentive, which was frustrating at times if there was a problem, say, with a meal or something. The one person however, that did make this holiday enjoyable most of the time was Cezar - he was great. Sooooo friendly, so funny and great with kids and adults. His one liners during the activities, be it daytime or nightime were fun. His Mr & Mrs Sea Pearl nights are HIGHLY recommended (for those that like easy going, light entertainment - not to be taken seriously, its all tongue in cheek style fun). My 4 year old took a shine to him and they had lunch together (well, cezar let cian eat HIS lunch). The rooms were cleaned every day, towels seemed to be changed every day, if you needed them to and the maids left petals on the beds afterwards, which was a nice gesture. The maids did do a great job as there were two teenagers and two younger kids, plus two adults in our family suite. Didnt really see where the hotel was good for teenagers, other than the pool tables (3) around the side of the hotel and then two computers allowing internet access for a charge. The kids club was basically a room where they could draw or play. Nothing too exciting to keep the kids amused. Cezar did play pool games with the families and made exceptions for adjusting the games so the older kids (8-12s) could join in. Something that did upset other guests, was that the in-house shop owner actually tried to re-sell water inflatables that guests had left around the pool, current guests that were still staying there, they hadnt even left to return home!!!!! Was very disppointed upon arrival to be told that there were no irons to press clothes, for such a large hotel. You had to avail of their expensive laundry service (bit of a rip off for a family of 6!!!). On the whole, the hotel was ok, but we are thinking of trying the Palmin next year.

author: I5437DNchristinal
title: Exceeded expectation! Loved the entire stay!
text: When I booked Montechiari I was nervous that SOMETHING had to be wrong for the decent price we were paying. The pictures looked so nice. We arrived and I have got to say my expectations were well exceeded. The hotel is located in a great location with a great view of the volcano. We were lucky enough to get some clear views every afternoon. Just ~8-10 minute walk to the town center. There's a sidewalk, and the walk was decently lit. I was with my boyfriend so I felt pretty safe walking, maybe if I was alone I'd have been worried..but who wouldn't in a foreign country. Even if you want a taxi, it's like $2, if that. The rooms are private, thin walls but never had to deal with any disturbances. Everything about the room was AMAZINGLY clean. The A/C ran great, and the shower water got super HOT; be careful. We loved the folded towel animals with fresh flowers that we returned to everyday from the cleaning women. The room comes with a mini fridge and small table for 2 to eat. I literally couldn't complain about anything in our room. The breakfast was pretty good and really convenient before our excursions. The rice and beans was GOOD. The staff were also very welcoming and helpful. I would DEFINITELY recommend Montechiari Hotel and if I return will be looking to stay again.

author: Patriesh
title: No pool and only cold water
text: During our stay the pool was 'closed'. Meaning there was no water in it, so we weren't able to use it. However the rooms, or cabins are really spacious. It has everything you need. The light in the room during the day is perfect, at night when you turn on the light... not so perfect. It turns the room completely bright white! It makes you want to turn it of right away. Also during our 4 night stay it rained for 3 days. Which let to 3 nights of cold showers! The warm water is based on a sunboiler, without sun you have cold water. Other then that its fine. The rooms are cleaned daily, the breakfast is simple (eggs, fruit, rice, pancakes, plantains, coffee, tea, juice), the staff is nice and friendly. And the view is beautiful. The location is a 10 minute walk out of downtown, so turn on the flashlight in your phone when you walk in the dark.

author: Kattypomp
title: Private, Quiet, but a Perfect Location
text: We loved this hotel. We had an end room. The view would have been beautiful if it wasn't too cloudy. It's peaceful and quiet, but only a ten minute walk into town. You had privacy as well. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They called the companies for our day trips to confirm pick-up times and location for us. The breakfast was delicious. The wi-fi likely works in the first few rooms, but not in the middle to back rooms. We experienced that almost anywhere though. The price was perfect as well. You had plenty of space in the rooms. The gardens and grounds are so pretty. You can see pineapples growing from the ground. It's very unique. We would definitely stay here again.

author: marykind
title: Best Trip, wonderful little hotel
text: We loved Hotel Arenal Montechiari. My husband and I were only in La Fortuna for 2 nights. It was the perfect place to stay. The cabins were adorable. We had the back corner unit and had the most AMAZING view of the volcano. It was super clean, not fancy, but had plenty of space and everything you would need in a room including a mini-fridge which was unexpected and great! The only almost negative is the bed was not the most comfortable, but if you are in Costa Rica, there is no point in complaining, it's such a beautiful country and everything else about the Hotel made up for it. Also, wifi is free, but only available at the front desk area. We were fine with this because our vacation was an escape from email and work, and it was just a nice break from looking at my phone:) The garden surrounding the cabins is lush and beautiful and well taken care of. The service was incredible. Everyone who worked at the front desk were super helpful about getting us get to our destinations. We rented a car and driving through Costa Rica is an experience on it's own:) It was a great location because you could easily walk into town to all the restaurants. There is a square in the middle of town that is perfect for sitting and people watching. Breakfast was yummy! Pancakes were delicious and I still crave the beans and rice. Overall, amazing experience. We will be back and it cannot be soon enough!

author: Lily1Wildflower
title: Loved it!
text: I stayed three nights in this hotel and I absolutely loved every moment of it. This hotel is beautifully located just outside the city center of La Fortuna. It's a 5 minute walk through a calm residential area. The rooms are spread out in cabines surrounded by beautifull green. They are very roomy and comfortable. I stayed in a room with 4 other people spread out in 3 double beds, but it never really felt crowded. I got to see the biggest treat of this hotel: the spectacular view on Arenal volcano. I didn't realised in the beginning how fortunate how was to see it, but it showed how well located the hotel is. The view is not disrupted by men-made constructions. Other treat is the pool and the provided breakfast. I still miss it. The hotel lays in a pool of green which attracts a lot pretty birds. There are also some sloths around. Only downside: their WiFi. This was only possible near the reception, but that's at the front.

author: 187melissak
title: Rustic cabin with amazing views
text: Stayed here for 3 nights in September and really enjoyed the hotel it wasn't in the center of town but only a short 10-15 min walk to the center (front desk will call a cab if you want). The room/cabin: basic cabin with 2 reasonably comfortable beds, a nice feature was that the tv had satellite service so we were able to watch channels in English. Also, the bathroom has a large shower with hot water and the hotel provided liquid soap (smelled really nice too). Each cabin has a small patio area at the front door, which is nice to sit out and enjoy the birds and flowers. Note-there is NO wifi in the cabins. It's only available in at the reception area. Staff: I can't say enough good things about the staff here in particular the front desk team. They were extremely helpful in providing us advice on where to go and showed patience with our lack of superb Spanish skills. The owner is also very friendly and chatted with us throughout our stay. Breakfast: typical Tico breakfast that varied slightly each day. However, there was generally always eggs, beans and meat. The coffee was tasty too. It's set-up buffet style, but the cooks serve you when you walk up to the buffet. Property: loads of beautiful flowers and trees. The view of Arenal Volcano is surreal! One pool is currently open and it looks like they are in the process of building a larger one with a swim up bar.

author: Inez0972
title: Beautiful grounds & cabin
text: Stayed here 4 nights so I could avail of all the outdoor activities in the area. The grounds & pool are absolutely *lovely*. The gardening team (2!) do an amazing job of keeping all the flowers, plants & trees looking as natural as possible w/o it being quite the jungle. There are birdfeeders dotted about, so you see lots of hummingbirds whizzing about. There's also a lovely small swimming pool to cool off in at the end of the day. Not sure it's entirely suitable for lounging around for the entire day as the sun loungers are extremely uncomfortable but it is a nice spot to pass an hour or 2. With all the outdoors activities to do around Arenal & it's parks, you probably won't have the time anyway. The cabins are a 5 min walk into Arenal's town square where all the restaurants, bars & other facilities like car hire, laundry, supermarket etc. are located. We were allowed to check into our cabins early after informing the hotel in advance which was super convenient. The rooms are spotless & come equipped with everything you'd expect - from a fridge to air-con to a hairdryer. The rooms are cool & spacious - perfect for coping with the heat. The beds were especially comfortable. I found WiFi reception quite poor in my cabin but then, I was furthest away from the reception. The only fault was the breakfast which I found quite poor in terms of the same choice every day & on 2 mornings, when the food wasn't covered over, the flies on or around the food was off-putting. Really think the hotel could do far better on that point. A security guard does the rounds once it gets dark (6pm) until morning time, so no concern about leaving valuables in your room. There's also a safe in each cabin. Otherwise, I couldn't fault the hotel & would definitely return (but source breakfast elsewhere). When I was there, most people turned in around 10pm so I'd say it's ideal for families, couples or solo travellers looking for a bit of undisturbed R&R.

author: rmtyler
title: Loved this place
text: OK, it's not a perfect 5 star resort, but I had to give this an "excellent" rating because that's how our overall experience was. We had a car, but I probably wouldn't recommend this place if you are on foot - it seemed far from town to me, which was what we loved about it! The huts actually use a regular key which I thought was so cool. The owners were very nice, admittedly we speak at least adequate Spanish, and I'm sure that was helpful, but it is a Spanish speaking country, after all. They were very helpful on answering our questions about the area, and giving us ideas of places to eat or how long they thought it would get to certain places (our GPS was not all that helpful around here for some reason). The Wifi does only work by the main lobby, but I just went down and uploaded my daily instagram picture to show off to my friends and then went back and relaxed in the room watching my Spanish Disney channel with my teenagers. Lighting is pretty dim, but we had headlamps for reading. Shower was lacking water pressure, for sure, but it works and the water was hot. Beds are sort of like foam mats, but I actually slept really well. They do have a fridge (you need to plug it in when you get there) which I didn't expect, and even had a little hair dryer in the bathroom. The air conditioner also worked really well, and kept the room at a nice comfy sleeping temperature. The foliage is beautiful, definitely take your camera with you to breakfast as there were birds out every day - there was even a toucan, a really small toucan, but still... the fruit was good, they had pancakes, toast, and of course, the standard scrambled eggs and beans/rice. OJ was definitely TANG so I didn't have any of that, but the water was good, and the watermelon was so sweet. If I go back to La Fortuna I wouldn't stay anywhere else. We booked only a few weeks before our trip and I can't believe this place was still available. We loved it.

author: CharmaineD923
title: Great Value!!
text: This place is a great value!! If you have a car, don't need any frills and just want a beautiful, clean, comfortable, and convenient place to stay, this is it! It's off the main road of town but extremely close if you have a car. I'm sure you could walk to town in 10-15 minutes. The landscaping is gorgeous! The rooms are clean and comfortable with a nice bathroom. The cleaning staff fold your towels in a really cute way and leave flowers on your bed. I thought it was a nice touch. The view of the volcano is amazing on a clear day! We had an end bungalow and could see it right outside of our window. Breakfast is good and the same every day - fresh fruit (banana, pineapple, and watermelon), eggs, 'Tico' rice & beans, toast, and OJ, water & coffee. The staff is really nice but speak very little English - so brush up on your Spanish! They don't book any tours, but can call and speak to tour companies for you. For the price, this place is above and beyond! I would definitely stay here again.

author: joys59
title: We needn't have worried ...
text: I must admit that we didn’t like what we found when we arrived – two parties of teenagers from the US. However, we needn’t have worried, as their behaviour was excellent & they left the following morning … leaving the superb gardens, the pool & the incredible view of the volcano to us. I think the best views are from Chalets No. 14, 15 & 30 – at the top of the complex, furthest away from reception, etc – max. of 2 minutes walk. A few more adults arrived during our three night stay. The cabins are spotlessly clean, very comfortable, with air-con. – one couple complained that their A/C was noisy & so they changed rooms. We, too, changed rooms – not because there was a problem with our original one, but because we thought the view from the second would be better. It was. We enjoyed simply wondering around the gardens, spotting humming birds, fly-catchers & other assorted birds. All of the staff were very helpful & friendly, esp. the manager. Food was freshly prepared & we were given far more than we could eat. The hotel is about 10 minutes walk, along a flat road, from the centre of La Foruna, where all the services you need are available.

author: Jordan16
title: A peaceful haven
text: We stayed here for 3 nights during a 2 week tour of Costa Rica and fell in love with this place. The views of the Arenal Volcano are fantastic and you are just far enough out of the small town for peace and quiet. it is only a few minutes walk to all the bars and restaurants etc and we felt perfectly safe walking around the area. The lodges are very rustic / basic but are perfectly adequate for a few days stay. We are well travelled from 3 - 5 star accommodation all over the world and i am very fussy were i sleep but the rooms were clean and comfortable. We dont use tv's while we are away or room telephones etc as we dont feel the need. In any case you were seconds away from the reception area if you needed anything. The lighting is a little dim at night inside the cabins as there aren't any bedside lamps etc but we had head torches as we are avid readers so managed fine. The bathrooms are large and there is a fridge in the room. The breakfasts are served opposite the garden under a little open sided cabana with choice of fruit, toast, eggs, omelette etc not large but again sufficient. The highlight for us was the owner Daisy who was like a friend rather than an owner and while we were there took a personal interest in us and other guests showing us around her beautiful gardens and explaining about the different birds and iguanas etc. This may have been because we showed an avid interest in both the wildlife and her garden, but nothing seemed to much trouble for her. On one day our tour collection was late and she even went off on her own accord and rang the tour people up to chase them up without us asking her to. We are also aware that she helped other guests with similar problems and also seemed to us to go the extra mile. The place has a nice pool and there are some cabins still being built to one side but this does not detract from the established areas. Yes small improvements could be made but for us the pros certainly out way the cons and Daisy is clearly trying to establish a good and efficient holiday location from which to tour this beautiful country. Best bits - the garden and birdlife, seeing large and i mean large iguanas hanging from the trees , views of the volcano and the relaxed and quiet atmosphere. Would we go back again - yes without doubt. Many thanks Daisy for a wonderful stay!!!

author: AggieGirl2012
title: Fantastic stay in La Fortuna- best location and great price!
text: Arenal Montechiari is a GREAT little hotel so close to the center of La Fortuna. It's an easy 400 meter walk from the hotel to the town, so there's no need to pay for a long taxi ride like with many of the other hotels in the area. If you do choose to take taxis back and forth, they only cost $2 or 1000 colones, very cheap! The cabin that we stayed in was perfect; very basic, but very clean and meets all necessities, including very nice hot water. Bring an alarm clock though! The property was beautiful. Although very close to the center of La Fortuna, the way the property and cabins were arranged with the garden made it seem very secluded in a peaceful way. The garden is gorgeous, maintained with love every day by the gardeners, who are all so friendly. The breakfast every morning is very good, served at whatever time you need for the activities you have planned. The seating area for breakfast (and the garden) has a FANTASTIC view of Arenal Volcano. Be sure to sit at a table where you are facing the Volcano!! The staff is so helpful; the manager, Mayid, personally helped us continue planning the rest of our trip, which we had left somewhat open ended. He recommended a great tour for us, arranged it, and even helped set up through the tour service a transportation of ourselves and our luggage to the next hotel we had in Arenal region. Even once we left La Fortuna and travelled all the way to Monteverde and Jáco beach, he continued to make sure things worked out smoothly. Also, as we were walking into town one evening for dinner, two of the staff were about to leave for the evening and they offered us a ride into town! So friendly. Stay here if you have the chance! Best location, services, and experience.

author: maggies870
title: Great place to stay on a budget - a little out of town however
text: As with other Ibis budget hotels, this is great value for money. Separate shower, washing facilities and loo and a comfy beds. TV and free Wi-Fi. Air-conditioning in the room. The only issue with the room that I had (and according to the staff) is that there is a bunk bed above the main bed - a great place to store extra luggage but very easy to hit ones head on. I hit my head pretty hard - and, being on a medication regime that includes blood thinning medications, I felt the need to report the incident. This is when we were told that I was not the first or only person to have hit my head badly. So, Be Careful. We typically ask for the room not to be cleaned - by hanging the do not disturb sign on the door but each day the room was cleaned. The check in was a little slower than the other Ibis budget hotels that we have stayed in but extending our stay and check out were very easy. The hotel is located quite far out of the town centre so a car really is needed to make life easier. I'm pretty sure that there were buses into town but had no need to enquire about this. There was a lovely outside patio area for breakfast and for smokers. There was a small but sufficient area for computer usage and small groups next to the indoor part of the breakfast room. Great value for money

author: Ejo526
title: Small room, uncomfortable beds
text: Spent 2 nights at this location and was not impressed. The beds were like sleeping on park benches with sheets. The room for 6 people was so small. The beds were inaccessible for the people sleeping near the wall and the A/C unit because each bed was so tight to the walls. The pull-out sofa did not have sleeping pillows. When we asked the front desk for pillows, they stated that they didn't have any. No pillows whatsoever for the pull-out sofa bed, really?? The refrigerator definitely kept our items cold. Frozen, actually. Even after we adjusted the temperature, it still froze our stuff. The pool water was dark and had an odd odor to it. The front desk staff stated that it was safe to swim in. I wasn't so sure. I am posting pictures below. The breakfast was decent. The location was convenient for local attractions. It took about 10 minutes to get to Baylor and the Magnolia Market. Heb plus and Walmart are nearby. However, given the quality of our stay, I would not stay here again nor recommend to family or friends.

author: 121chuckd
title: Flat tire & Rain shelter
text: On Oct 6, returning from the Cotton Bowl, Dallas., UT v OU. On the north side of Waco, as we travelled south on I-35, we heard a sound that I quickly recognized as a tire issue. I made a quick safe right turn on the exit ramp which led to the Comfort Suites Waco North. Almost simultaneous with the ties damage, it began raining and lightning. I pulled into the Comfort Suites parking lot, simply looking for a safe place to change a flat tire. Seeing the portico where guests unloaded luggage, it seemed to be the ideal spot to change the tire. I went to desk and ask permission to use the covered entry. Ms Noelia, night manager came to the portico to assess the situation. Seeing the rain, she asked how long I would take. She was concerned for her current guests, new arrivals, yet wanted to help me ...another person with a need. She gave me permission to change my tire. Here is what impressed me. When I was done, I offered her a cash gift thank you. However, instantaneously, without hesitation, she smiled and said no thanks. You had a need. We helped you. That's what we do. That brief exchange spoke volumes. If ever u am in Waco overnight, I will stay here. I encourage anyone reading this to do the same!

author: trra
title: Nice and clean but outside Spotlight Ruined sleep
text: This is a bit difficult to find initially. Says it sits on the fwy, but you take one of Texas' famous turnaround roads onto a frontage of I 35. Once there the property is nice, newer and clean. The Suite rooms are nice, with a kitchenette type area in a sitting area with a couch. Open but divided by a partial wall is the bedroom area. The couch is big and comfy. Bathroom area sits in between the two areas basically. The rub was the GLARING SPOTLIGHT SHINING DIRECTLY INTO OUR 3RD FLOOR BEDROOM AREA WINDOW. Even with the curtains drawn the room was illuminated like it was daytime. Why it is not pointed DOWN to the parking area is beyond me. And the A/c was very noisy. They had a thermostat on the wall that was inoperable, it was a wall unit that blasted you in bed, but you barely felt in the sitting area. So a MIXED BAG. Nice newer rooms but with some glaring flaws. Breakfast was good with lots of choices.Close to the silos and DP museum ( took about 5 min and was easy drive.)

author: U8327NBpamelas
title: Very good - would recommend
text: The hotel is clean and modern. The room was like a mini apartment with a microwave, mini fridge and wet bar sink, desk, sofa, two queen beds, and large tv. The breakfast served hot standard fare, scrambled eggs, sausage, potatoes, bisquits and gravy along with the normal cold offerings. The con is: it’s along the I-35 Frontage road which is ONE WAY! So to be able to go to the nearby Cracker Barrel (which we did), you have to get back on I-35 up to the next exit then take the TURNAROUND exit which gets you back onto the frontage road and right to Cracker Barrel. No big deal if CB hadn’t been like only 3/10ths of a mile away. There is a large grocery store on the other side of I-35 which we got food at. Again, to get back to the hotel you have go to North on I-35 take the TURNAROUND exit to get back on the frontage road. We stayed here because it was close to the Magnolia Market Silos which is just a couple exits south on the same side as the hotel. The Silos is a must see! The cupcakes are awesome. There are food trucks there but the Magnolia Table restaurant is about 3 miles away. There’s a free hop on hop off Trolley that makes a 15 minute loop around Waco’s shopping district. I would recommend this hotel and would stay again if in Waco. Safe travels! Scarlett329

author: Beckyup
title: Good overall
text: Room was clean and in very good shape. Floor plan in our room was unusual yielding a very small bathroom sink and counter area. Hardly counter space for one person. But there was a very nice wet bar area with a sink which we used. Because we did not use AC/Heater we did have some quiet interstate noise. Recommend room on the back side. Bed was very comfortable. Not the hotel's fault, as all rooms are non smoking, but there were smokers in one of the non smoking rooms near the elevator. Smoke smell filled elevator area and hall way. It did not affect our room. Next morning there was a stale smoke smell in the hallway. I expect this is not uncommon in most motels and don't know if any of them deal with it. I mentioned it at the desk but there was no interest in follow-up. Breakfast was standard. Would stay here again.

author: razrbakgal
title: Magnolia Silo visit
text: We stopped overnight in Waco to visit the Silos and Magnolia Market on the Tuesday before Thanksgiving. I was very impressed with the cleanliness of the hotel! It looks brand new. Our room smelled like a breath of fresh air! But this is not the best part of the hotel, although you can tell cleanliness ranks right up there with me. The staff was nice beyond compare. They offered suggestions and answered every question without hesitation. We enjoyed the bar happy hour and and the friendly conversation. It was nice to have a drink and not leave the hotel. The breakfast bar was good for a complimentary bar. Waffles, biscuits , gravy , sausage, yogurt, fruits, cereals, and breads. All were fresh. There was an open hot chocolate area 24/7. Traveling through Waco again? You cannot miss with this hotel. Did I mention how clean and comfortable the rooms were?

author: ChiMom
title: Fabulous Hotel - Will stay again!
text: In a great location right off the freeway, this hotel was an unexpected gem! The lobby and bar area is spacious, modern and very clean. Parking availability was extensive and well-lit. The double queen suite was also spacious, everything was new, comfortable beds (nice linens too!) and couch and let me say again, very clean! The kids loved the pool area and spent several hours in the beautiful indoor pool. We all appreciated the little food store attached to the front desk for many treat, and even real food options for late night arrivals. The breakfast also offered a variety of options (eggs, biscuits, yogurt, muffins, juices, etc.) and they were all very fresh and yummy! We will definitely be staying here again and would highly recommend! All of the pluses would be meaningless without great staff. Obviously, housekeeping does a fabulous job as the facility was impeccable (and I am a bit of a clean freak). But the real treasure was Lucy A. at the front desk! I made a mistake in my online reservation, called her and she was able to quickly fix it. When we arrived she greeted us with a sincere smile, and was personable and very efficient. Every interaction with her was a level of exceptional service that is typically only found at the best resorts. If one needs to stay near Waco, this is the place to be!

author: mikesY6443VY
title: Great experience for our family
text: We spent two nights here in July 2016 and had a good experience. The room was just right for us, and the service from the front desk to the housekeeping staff was excellent. Everything seemed relatively new and very clean. The location was good as we were only a couple of miles north of downtown. We lost track of time and were afraid we would be late for our tour of the Baylor football stadium, but we literally pulled into the stadium parking lot less than five minutes after getting into our van in the hotel parking lot! Very close to everything! The pool and hot tub were clean and nice. Fitness center was just okay. The only thing that could've been a better was the breakfast. Nothing wrong really...just average. Crumbly, dry eggs, kind of greasy sausage, etc. A few apples oranges and bananas for fruit. Might have been nice to have some sliced melon or something like that for breakfast. Coffee and waffles were good though! My wife accidentally left an old pair of sneakers in our room and they even called us that evening after we arrived home offering to ship them to us. Great service! We'd stay there again.

author: visentea2014
title: 1 night stay during holidays.
text: Got the room at a pretty good rate. 2 queen beds and a Sofa bed for $79. Not bad. Check in was simple. Got my key and family went in. Room was pretty good sized. Had a fridge , coffeemaker , and charging station that included USB as well which is nice. Bed wasn't too bad. A little soft but still pretty good. It was fairly quiet but you can hear people pretty easily upstairs. So neighbors can be really quiet or loud. Breakfast in morning had biscuits, eggs, cereal etc. You had options for yogurt, toast and pastries. So not bad and is included so you can save some money :). For the money thus definitely was worth it. So when you need a room at a fair price definitely stop here.

author: Firemandavid
title: Clean, modern and completely average. A nice overnight and nothing more.
text: This Comfort Suites boasts a modern design in the lobby and the rooms as well as quality beds and furnishings. The room layout is perfect for two people with a pullout couch with chaise seating, comfortable bed, well lit sink area, big closet, desk, fridge and microwave as well as a large high def TV. The staff was friendly, efficient and helpful and responsive to all our requests during our stay like extra towels, toothbrush, etc. The only drawback to this hotel is the poor lobby and dining area design. On our visit the breakfast area was very crowded which is not the hotel's fault but the crowd was made worse by the food placement in a back corner. Long lines formed unnecessarily because only one or two people could access the food at a time. Management should look at configuring a bar or counter that can be accessed on at least two sides. One waffle maker with 3 minutes per waffle times 50 people just won't cut it. The kitchen staff consisted of one person and she could hardly keep up. Granted, this was a weekend but some planning ahead for high capacity days and an improved breakfast service system would make this hotel a good experience. One note about the pool area should be mentioned. Upon first glance it looks plain scary as in murky, creature from the Black Lagoon scary. The designers used a dark gray tile for the bottom and sides of the pool, used a single light inside the pool and didn't install any lighting above so that at night or on a cloudy day the pool looks very suspect. We took a long time of examining it, smelling it, looking down into it before deciding it was okay and taking the plunge but at least one family came in before we jumped in and commented that it looked too dirty to swim in. Once we did jump in, several more families joined us assuming I guess that if it was good enough for us it was good enough for them! A good, comfortable overnight accommodation with great rooms but with a lousy breakfast experience and dark, dreary pool area.

author: vhefner92
title: Loved this Hotel!
text: This hotel is a little complicated to get to if you are driving north from the San Antonio area. The building is on the opposite side of the highway and has one entrance that is located directly off of the south exit ramp. We had to pass by it a couple of times before we figured out how to get to the entrance. At first when I arrived, I was a little concerned about the amount of construction workers standing outside. I was afraid the hotel would be loud with a bunch of rowdy men. That was not the case at all. The front desk clerk, Vanessa, was very nice and helpful. The hotel looked bright, clean, and new. Our room had a little couch and coffee table, with 2 full/queen beds. The ceilings were tall and made the room look nice and specious. We made it through the night without being disturbed. They served hot breakfast in the morning with all kinds of options. I did not get the chance to check out the pool, but I overheard people talking about it having a very nice water fall. I was so impressed by the friendliness of the staff and cleanliness of the building! This was one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in.

author: E644NBlisad
title: THnak You!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: My hiusbad and I flew in to watch our son at the Baylor Spring Football game March 20th. It was so last minute we took whatever hotel we could find and not knowing Waco we chose wrong. Spent one night at a horrible hotel and told my husband we had to find something else. We went and had something to eat and drove by the Comfort Suites Waco North, told my husband to pull in so I could check to see if they had a room for the night. When I walked into the lobby Ashley was at the desk and on the phone. She put the call on hold and asked how she could help me. Told her I was in need of a room for the night. She asked if I could wait a minute for the person on the phone was wanting to cancel their reservation. Ashley comes back to me and tells me there was a room available. Short of going behind the desk to hug her I was so impressed by the way she handled this. Hotels were all sold out due to many things going on in Waco President's weekend. Comfort Suites Waco North is now my choice hotel in Waco when we come to the Baylor games! Ashley was amazing and her Customer service is #1! The next moring when we checked out, Sharon came to our rescue, with again amazing Customer Service. Hands dow this is where you want to be. Room was large, clean and bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was tasty too! Thanks again Ashley and Sharon!

author: piglet0576
title: Very Pleasant Stay!
text: We stayed in Waco last weekend for a quick Spring Break getaway. I booked the Comfort Suites Waco North based on its location & great reviews on Trip Advisor. This is a new hotel, located right off of I-35, across the highway from HEB grocery store. There was plenty of well lit parking, and a covered entry. Our checkin was quick & easy & the front desk staff was friendly & helpful. Our suite was located on the first floor across from the indoor swimming pool & fitness center. We were very pleasantly surprised with our suite. It was huge! There was a living area with a sectional pullout couch, coffee table & end table, a small kitchenette with a fridge, microwave, sink & cabinets, and a desk and chair. Transitioning from the living area to the bedroom is a dresser and flat screen tv. The bedroom had two queen beds with a nightstand in between, a walk in closet, vanity with sink & mirror, and a bathroom with tub/shower & toilet. We were a party of 6, and we had plenty of room. The suite and bathroom were very clean and stocked with towels & toiletries. Breakfast was included with our room, served daily till 10:00. The buffet included toast, pastries, muffins, make your own waffles, eggs, bacon, sausage, biscuits & gravy, cereal, oatmeal, yogurt & fruit. There was also plenty of juice, milk, coffee & tea. The kids enjoyed the indoor pool & hot tub area, but my only concern was it was a bit slippery. No need to bring towels, as they are provided. All in all, we were very pleased with this hotel, and would stay here again in a heartbeat!

author: MGondekova
title: Exceptional place
text: We have just returned from our trip to Bali. This was the last hotel we stayed in and we were pleasantly surprised. We stayed in villa no 812. The reception were super friendly and welcoming. When we were taken to our villa, the staff explained everything from how the shower works to how to use the lights. Very helpful. The villa is cleaned to a very high standard, and comes with a lot of freebies - mouthwash, bottled still water, shampoo, conditioner, bath salts, to mention a few. Every day we had 'the ninja cleaning rota' arrive and clean our room, I have never seen such a great team working together to ensure they leave the villa as soon as possible to let us enjoy it in peace. Breakfast was enjoyable, a choice of three sets - American, Continental and Indonesian. Again, very friendly and attentive staff. Tea served in the afternoon was very appreciated. Meal portions are generous and tasty. We really enjoyed our stay there and would definitely come back. Highly recommended! Thank you for having us.

author: deb_bl94
title: Beautiful villa, average food
text: The Kayana is a beautiful hotel in Seminyak. Our villa was truly superb. It was spacious, clean and with all amenities needed. The plunge pool and garden area is a dream. It is a perfect spot for a honeymoon. The staff are lovely, extremely attentive and perfectionists. Never have I ever been so well treated as a customer. Special mention to our amazing butler :) The spa is very nice. The girls there are very nice, skilled and respectful. My husband and I went there twice and were very happy with the quality of the treatments. The only downside to this hotel is the food unfortunately. Its quality is pretty average and this is probably the only thing keeping it from being a 5 star hotel and review. We were on a package deal for food & drinks and were not really impressed with the menu options which were a little boring and very simple. Even though it was included, we ended up going out for meals. However we did enjoy the option to have in-villa brekkie & dinner. We would recommend this hotel to stay only. Make sure you eat out, not worth packaging food here.

author: SammyC199
title: Beautiful Resort, Rooms, Private Pools, Food and Service
text: Where to begin!? We are staying in Room 823, Its a 1 bedroom pool villa and it is absolutely stunning. The facilities are fantastic, excellent WiFi, room service and turn down service and they provide absolutely everything you could need, right down to bug sprays, mosquito plugs, razors, toothbrushes and even mouth wash (fresh every day!) It's the small things at this place that really make the difference. The staff are amazing, they are all so friendly, helpful and always looking out for your happiness. It's quiet and peaceful here and fantastic location to get to the beach (3-5min walk) or to local restaurants, bars and all that Seminyak has to offer. Drivers will take you wherever you ask to go (loaclly) but in truth, it's so well located you can walk basically anywhere. If you are coming to Seminyak, you would be crazy not to trust me and give this place full consideration. You will not regret. I wish I could shout out everyone, but as the list would be too long, i'd like special thanks to go to Mahendra, Aditiya, Tri, Agung, Putu and Samu but really everyone else here deserves individual recognition, no exaggeration! The staff can never do too much for you! 24hr butler service is an awesome touch. What a place, we dont want to leave but sadly are going tomorrow morning. But when a door closes another one opens... in Ubud. We are very excited to continue our travels in Bali but will miss The Kayana dearly and will always have the fondest of memories here. When we return to Bali in the next few years, we know we don't need to give it a second thought and will book The Kayana without question. Check it out and thank me later guys :D x

author: alexbH6256EN
title: Has initial WOW factor, but not up to standard for the price.
text: We stayed in the pool villa here for 3 nights and although a nice stay we do feel previous reviews are very optimistic. Pros: pretty, friendly staff although staff appear to have no authority to do anything without managers permission who are not present at evenings or weekends. Breakfast very average for Bali, smoothie bowl is good but had to pay extra. Location brilliant. Cons: For £160 a night (not cheap even by European standards, bear in mind Indonesian) our main complaint is the cleanliness/upkeep of villa. Sofa and loungers had large stains/marks on. Pillows yellow inside. Stains on both bed sheets and duvet. Pillows are terribles too, very uncomfy. Very dusty around bed area. Whole place needs a revamp, damp marks on walls and ceiling and generally needs updating a bit. Wood floor around pool area very splintered with sticking out nails. Photos of marks on bed below but as rushing to check out we forgot to take photos of other issues. Also if you don’t get the airport transfer included 300K is what they charge for a one way transfer, which is totally ridiculous. After complaining about misleading marketing which implied as we were staying 3 nights we would get an airport transfer included the manager agreed to give us the free transfer. Also note if you’re a light sleeper you can hear the beach club Mrs Sippy late at night and also lots of very low helicopters going over. Overall it was very pretty and chilled out but unless the villas get revamped or the price drops significantly we wouldn’t stay here again.

author: Rhonda041
title: Easily pleased
text: We feel either these last few reviews were by folks that never travel far or a very easlily pleased. Chose this place as the reviews were very positive. Yes I can say the place is set in lovely gardens. The main pool is very nice, although I’m not one that likes a pool that’s overlooked by the restaurant patrons. The staff are lovely as most Balinese people. The Spa is very good, massages are excellent. We felt the one bedroom pool villa was okay. The furniture very uncomfortable, bed hard (but find that a lot in Bali) but no top sheet so you needed the doona which was very heavy and warm, this made us have to use the air conditioner on very cool to cope. Out door furniture okay but very tightly spaced and no so comfortable. The food looked good in the photos but not that great...we love Indonesian food but felt this was just average. Quantities more suited to Chinese travellers not Aussies. In summary, if you are a shopper its a great location. If you’ve got years on your back its a little dangerous with lots of steps without good handrails. I may sound a little snooty but i do feel some reviews here may give travellers unreal expectations. I love to drink a lot of water and felt 4 x 300mil in your room were lacking. The fruit basket offered in your room is crappy...2 x oranges 2 x mandarins and a snake fruit thing that was off. I would honestly rate this place as average good but definitely not Amazing. We’ve had some amazing stays in Bali, Lembongan and Ceningan so feel qualified to make this statement.

author: B5724TIcindym
title: A quiet accomodation, with one main pool at the restaurant
text: Firstly the service is nothing but polite and kind and friendly. I have to explain my review is from my own personal viewpoint. And I’d want to know these things. We were also asked everyday if there were any issues, but I think it’s hard and also pointless to discuss things that can’t be changed for the stay, but that may be because I found it uncomfortable to discuss. The furnishings need some updating. And the blinds are all manually put up and down and there are many, so it’s painful and they are also old and falling apart in spots. They do clean rooms every day which is great. Staff are so lovely. The set menu available on the escape deal gets so boring- and as only a couple of other guests were there dining at one time at the most, I think they could have just said anything on menu - but over a certain cost you pay the difference. Just an idea. The afternoon tea was also not really worthwhile I have to be honest. Nothing good about that sorry. We ordered banana fritters one day for dinner and got plantain starchy bananas ( completely inedible and worst I’ve ever eaten, so that could be reviewed ) they should only be for savoury dishes, some plantains can be used for sweet. The pool feels very open and very public which is why I’d say no one was ever seen it, more than just because the villas have pools. My husband loved the bed - I found it hard but slept, so it was fine. The birthday cake was a beautiful touch and room service is done with a smile. The spa is lovely and Martha is great at massage. The place is good if wanting to seclude yourself away, but we hung out at the W most days as a resort has a lot more to do and see. Great stay for honeymooners, or retired couple most likely. I truly hope I have not offended in any way, we appreciate the service.

author: 520rizkik
title: Beautiful Villa in Seminyak
text: I can say, this is my best stay. We stay in the pool villa. Me and my husband love it so much. The location of the is very easy to find, because it is a strategic location. In the centre of Seminyak area and surrounded by cafes and boutiques. First, the hospitality from the receptionist and all the staff, they are very helpful and friendly. The room villa is beautiful very homey, clean, calm and safe. The bed is so comfy. My daughter love the bathtub. And for sure we love the pool, very relaxing to enjoy the pool all day. We order the food at the Dauh restaurant. The food is great, we try the balinese dishes, the taste is authentic. We also did massage at the Ayur Spa. The best treatment i ever had. Very relaxing for a busy mama ;) They have big room for relax after treatment. While i had the massage my daughter had her nail art, she was really enjoy and happy with the result. Thank you to pak Ericht Allesandro and all the staff at The Kayana Villa for the great service while we stay. It is very recommended villa to stay in Bali and to enjoy the Seminyak area.

author: Jadeinbali
title: Beautiful Private Pool Villa within a resort in the heart of Seminyak, perfect location!
text: My husband & I recently stayed at The Kayana for 3 nights. When we arrived at the resort the staff were very friendly & welcoming and they presented us with a frangipani lei which they placed around our neck and also a welcome drink of passion fruit tea which was delicious. A butler then walked us to our villa with our luggage. The walkways at The Kayana are so beautiful, surrounded by so many luscious green trees. We stayed in a 1 bedroom villa with a plunge pool. The pool was the perfect size to take a dip in & also the perfect temperature. The room is a generous size with also a nice large bathroom that has two sinks. Plus a bathtub and separate area which contains the toilet & shower. When we arrived our bathtub was full of yellow & red frangipanis in the shape of a love heart which I thought was a nice touch. The way the breakfast service works at The Kayana, each day you fill out a form with selections of what you would like for breakfast the next day which can then be served to you either in your villa or at the resort restaurant. They also have a signature special at The Kayana called the “floating breakfast” where you can choose to have your breakfast served to you in your own pool. We chose to do this on our first morning & it was so cool, it felt very special! It was also my 30th Birthday on that first morning & when the staff brought our breakfast to our room they walked in with a birthday cake & sang Happy Birthday to me! It was very lovely & thoughtful. The hotel also has a gym which we used & luckily we happened to have the gym to ourselves haha! The long walkways of the resort are also very useful to jog/run up and down in the early morning before the guests are up and about. Another highlight of this resort is that they serve complimentary afternoon tea at the restaurant where you can have coffee, tea and snacks which we utilised every evening when we got back from our day trips! We had a great time at The Kayana, the staff were all very friendly and we enjoyed our stay very much!

author: fattumsb
title: Luxury hotel provides great service
text: This hotel is amazing. The service was phenomenal. All the staff become familiar with you and therefore are personal making you feel comfortable. They were always polite and always extended their services to their guests. By far this has been the best experience I have had in terms of customer service. The food good. I had plastic that was left in my pancake one morning. I didn't mention it to the them because it wasn't a big deal. I had no other issues with the food. It's always been good, and they always ask you if it's okay or how do you want it. They provide shuttle service around the area which we used however we called them from Mrs. Sippys and didn't get a response so we ended up walking back to our hotel, which was fine as it wasn't a far walk. On our last night we had to catch our flight in the wee morning so they offered us breakfast to go. I have never been asked that before and I thought that was s kind of them. They always asked if they can clean our rooms which was appreciated. The Kayana staff are amazing and I would return. I recommended to a friend who also stayed during my stay here and she and her family loved it.

author: KiranF123
title: A beautiful paradise amongst the bustle of Bali
text: We have just returned from our two week stay at The Kayana and I think staying here for the duration of our holiday was the best decision we ever made. We booked the Pool Villa and it was absolutely beautiful, The actual villa had amazing light during the day once the blinds were up. The only thing in the evening the lighting in the villa can be a bit dim if say you're getting ready to go out after sunset. The bathroom and dressing area was a good size also. The pool was the perfect service the outside living area was nicely laid out to with a sofa and a little dining table and 2 chairs. For people complaining about the size of the plunge pool the dimensions are on the website and plunge pool is usually that hence why we opted for the large pool and it was definitely worth paying a little extra for it. The staff were so kind and attentive from the moment we arrived, we received a refreshing welcome drink which were definitely needed after the long flight. Our villa was always cleaned as though it was the first time we entered. On one or two occasions there were late night parties at the nearby potato head beach club which to be honest did not actually affect us but the next morning there was a small apology card from the hotel for any disruption which may have been caused. The hotel offers a local shuttle within Seminyak which was pretty much available whenever we required it which was a big help. The restaurant was beautiful again staff were very attentive and breakfast was always fresh and served quite quickly. I liked the fact you ordered of a menu and not a buffet which is left open to the elements. Probably one of my favourite points of the hotel was the Spa. We were given two complimentary massages as we had come for our honeymoon and the moment you enter the spa it's like another world. I was a bit apprehensive having read reviews that it was a little pricey but I would definitely say it's much better value then a lot of the other spas in the area. Thank you to all at the Kayana who made our stay so very memorable and we hope to come back soon!

author: JazzyfromTazzy
title: Wonderful service and location with great tranquility
text: My partner and I stayed at the Kayana for 5 nights at the end of August 2017. Upon arrival we were greeted very well and everything was explained to us including the facilities and our villa. Stayed in a one bedroom pool villa, massive pool and yard area with outdoor dining and relaxation beds, huge bathroom, good bed, air con. (All the important stuff was spot on!) Groupon deal was such great value with inclusions such as breakfast each morning (which you can have delivered to your villa or eat in the restaurant). Well cooked and presented. Also got a choice or 3 course lunch or dinner each day with western and Indonesian options for each course. Butlers were always very attentive and nothing was too much trouble. The location of the Kayana is amazing... right in between Potato head and the W hotel... directly across the road from Spring Spa and Cafe Organic and lots of other great restaurants and shopping options within walking distance. What I loved the most about this place is that as soon as you walk off the busy street into the ground of Kayana it is immediately peaceful and as you make your way to your private villa there is lovely tropical foliage surrounding you and grounds are kept immaculate. Such a nice escape when you have spent the day out in the chaotic and at times smelly Seminyak. What a lovely private oasis with fantastic service and friendly staff with a top location. Quickest access to the beach is right next door through the W hotel or down The road at Potato Head. Will definitely stay here again in the future. - Jasmine from Sydney, Australia.

author: NickG3447
title: Nice Hotel
text: We stayed here on the second leg of our journey in Bali. It is situated on a busy road, but once you walk through reception and down to the Villas it is like you are in your own little world, far away from the busy hustle and bustle. It is also situated in a great location as there are many nice restaurants and bars within a 5-10 minute walk. There is no beach access at the Kayana which is frustrating, but if you go out the front of the hotel turn left, you will see the very long drive of the W hotel. There are shuttle buggies which take you down to the hotel which is situated on the beach and this is the easiest way to get to the beach. The grounds of the Kayana are immaculate and the gardeners are up early every morning sweeping the paths and cutting the trees. The Villas are really nice and clean and quite spacious, with a nice garden area. Although, the sunbathing area is not that big, and depending what Villa you get can be impeded by any trees blocking some sunlight, which can be quite frustrating. There is a main pool area which you can use but this is at the restaurant where other guests go for breakfast and lunch so would not be very relaxing to sunbathe there. The staff are also really friendly and take the time to ask you how your stay is and if anything further can be done to make it better. We only ate breakfast in the hotel and never dined here on an evening. Personally I did not feel the breakfast choice was overly great, but the food was nice. We also visited the spa while we were there, and he massage was excellent. The only downside is the spa is situated next to the main pool/restaurant. If you are unlucky enough to book your appointment and there are kids playing in the pool, as was the case for us when we received our treatments, this can ruin the relaxation element which is frustrating. Overall I would recommend the Kayana as it is in a good location, the Villas are good and the staff are friendly.

author: ChrA_13
title: Peaceful retreat in the middle of Seminyak, great staff, good value, recommended
text: Spent five nights there in May 2017. Great find and worked perfectly. Location is ideal, in the heart of Seminyak, close to the clubs, restaurants, shopping & the beach. Small intimate, peaceful, luxury resort with 24 villas (I think). It's an established, ie older property, which is very well maintained. Rooms were spacious and well equipped with perfectly adequate private pools and a sala. Two minor comments, there's no outdoor shower and the window blinds could do with replacing (if u like your nights 'black out' you may have a problem). Beautiful communal pool which we used quite a bit and had to ourselves most of the time, quiet, very peaceful with good sun. The restaurant and lounge area are adjacent to the pool. Breakfast was a la carte, not a buffet, 'adequate' as far as breakfasts go although the menu could do with a refresh. We chose to eat by the pool instead of in the villa, great setting, very peaceful & recommend it. We didn't eat in the resort in the afternoon/evening so cant comment. Likewise we didn't try the spa. The gym was a bit basic for us, old equipment and not much of it. Wifi throughout the property. Management was first class, good service from the front desk to the restaurant to the butler to the gardeners, all super friendly & helpful, as well as discreet but there whenever you needed something. Met the manager a couple of times as well - always a good sign. All the important pieces - the villas, the pool, the restaurant and the staff, worked perfectly. Overall, very impressed and would return, worth noting as well, they were full throughout our stay and we barely noticed it.

author: Travel504220
title: Beautiful villa, amazing spa
text: Just coming to the end of our 5 night stay at the kayana villas. What a beautiful traditional place to stay in Seminyak. Great location, close to all the best restaurants and potato head! The room caters for your every need, comfortable bed and quiet aircon. The plunge pool villa is perfect for couples and the sun lounges get sun all day! There's a club car that picks you up from your villa if it's too far to walk to reception although the walk is a tranquil experience. An added bonus is the complementary shuttle to anywhere close to Seminyak. Eliminating the need for taxis and if it's available, it can bring you home to. It was alway available for us which was amazing. All staff at The Kayana are friendly and welcoming. The spa at The Kayana is absolutely amazing, the perfect spa experience! We booked a 1 hour Balinese massage before heading to the airport, best idea ever and one of the best massages I've had in Bali! Overall a very pleasant stay and relaxing! Breakfast needs improvement. I would recommend The Kayana villas for anyone who wants the villa experience that's quiet and super close to everything!

author: 86carmelv
title: Holiday luxury
text: The beautiful Kayana was amazing! First time for my daughter to Bali so I wanted her to experience the best time. The pool villa was amazing! So spacious and big. The grounds of the Kayana was perfection. Inclusive was our breakfast everyone morning bought to villa. Breakfast was good. Also a buggy that would pick you up from your room or from reception area. Had a lovely spa treatment too that was heaven... We ordered room service a few nights and food was yum! Especially the famous Kayana burger my daughters fav! We also ate at the Duh Restaurant which was lovely too. The Staff were very friendly and made you feel so welcome if we needed anything they would do there best to accommodate you. We also had the shuttle bus that would drop you off and pick you up. The location was fantastic as well,right next door to W resort we had the buggy take us in for a look and enjoyed the beach and refreshments. Thank you Kayana for a lovely experience.

author: bananallama
title: Luxurious villas, exceptional service
text: We visited during the Christmas period, and loved our relaxing stay at the resort. It's exactly what we were after! The villas are spacious and well maintained. We had a 7m pool private villa at the back of the resort in a secluded corner. The fantastic customer service really made our stay one to remember. We'd read that light noise from the W Hotel could carry over to the adjacent villas so we requested something a little farther away, and this was arranged for us by the lovely staff. Throughout our stay the staff were always ready to help and went over and above to ensure we were comfortable. The staff at the Dauh restaurant always greeted us with smiles and served us in a highly professional manner. The ladies at the Ayur Spa did a great job in making sure our spa treatments were relaxing and luxurious. The Spa decor is a blend of modern and traditional design. Between your villa, the Spa and the restaurant, you could easily spend your whole day inside the resort - if your aim is to simply relax and unwind. The resort is conveniently located in a trendy part of Seminyak with a choice of modern bars and cafes or local warungs (eateries) along the street. While there is a beach close by, we didn't really find it appealing - there was a quite a bit of rubbish lying around. This didn't detract from our experience however, because we could always swim in our own villa or catch a 'taksi' to another beach. Ultimately, our stay at the Kayana was exceptional and we're glad we bought a Scoopon to try it out!

author: 886zedb
title: Back for more pleasure...
text: We arrived to The Kayana with an online booking with a web agent. To our shocking suprise the agent had gone bust and cancelled the booking with The Kayana without any notification to us. Staff at reception were sympathetic and understanding with what had happened and did an exceptional service to us. They managed to create a little bit of magic and got a new booking organized for us. The Kayana even matched the original price we had paid. I do believe that they went out of their way for a returning guest. The villa we got just happened to be the same one from 5 years ago. Like back then a fantastic villa. Plenty of space with your own plunge pool and the air-conditioning worked perfectly. Breakfast was included and was very good, the restaurant overlooked the pool. The location is perfect, just a short stroll to Potatohead Beach Club, and the choices for food unlimited. We did try the spa and had a very relaxing massage in a very well detailed room. The staff are very friendly and helpful. There is 24hr Butler service for the villa...nice to know you can get something at anytime. Definitely worth coming back to, even a third time. Keep up the great work.

author: CandaceH182
title: Pure private luxury
text: The whole experience at the Kayana is beautiful - but first and foremost I want to mention the staff. They were absolutely amazing - they went our of their way to make us feel comfortable and welcome. Every time we left the villa they offered to drive us anywhere we needed. The butlers were so kind and friendly. We felt really special being there. There was even someone out the front to help stop the traffic while we crossed the road. The room was amazing too- the attention to detail was incredible. There were flowers decorating our room, small bottles of mouth wash, lovely beauty products... everything you could need. The pool we had was lovely and cool. Very comfortable bed, and lovely robes. We also used the spa, and that was lovely and relaxing. A great service. We will come back for sure! Thanks Kayana!

author: SuzanneS212
title: Quiet, private oasis in busy Seminyak
text: What a beautiful place to stay. Not only are the staff so super friendly and accommodating, but the accommodation is of a very high standard and jam packed with Balinese style. We stayed in a very private villa with a pool which was kept immaculately clean at all times. Our massive bed was super comfy, complete with different types of pillows. The bathroom was extremely spacious with loads of bench space to lay out all my products. I loved the toiletry products provide as well.
