The rooms comes with a good size mini bar and it's not a problem to take the hotel supplied goods out to store your own, before returning the hotels items before leaving. The tea and coffee facilities were great - however they only provide the Bali "kopi" which takes a little getting used to - however this isn't a problem if you desperately crave a good western style coffee as they will provide this via room service, plus every afternoon with their afternoon tea service - plus the restaurant makes a very good cappuccino! Speaking of the restaurant, the food is excellent with the staff being very attentive. I enjoyed no less than three massages at the hotel's Day Spa - amazing!! Such beautiful and professional ladies in such a peaceful setting. Loved it! The hotel also provides car services around Seminyak for free which is super handy. I can't say enough about the staff - they were so beautifully friendly and extremely helpful with everything and anything we needed. Lastly the location was perfect for us being right next door to W Hotel, just up the road from Potato Head and around the corner from my new favourite restaurant Merah Puthi. If you don't want to spend a small fortune on a private villa with pool at the W Hotel, but want all the same facilities and the benefit of the location, then I highly recommend Kayana. We'll be back!

author: asmcneil
title: Absolutely divine!!
text: Our experience at the Kayana was absolutely perfect!! We were welcomed by warm staff and our villa was FANTASTIC! I really enjoyed how peaceful it felt once we were inside the property and couldn't believe we were still in busy Seminyak. I also really liked the buggy rides in such beautiful green scenery. The hotel just screams of luxury and perfection! The location is also perfect, you are situated right where you want to be in Seminyak. Our villa was massive, with a very big private pool, gorgeous bath and comfy bed. I liked how you could go in the pool from the bathroom too. I couldn't get enough of the meals served by the butlers in the villa and how quickly and efficiently they came in and set everything up and took everything away. And the phone calls!! They call you to make sure everything is ok and to ask if you would like anything!! What a wonderful touch! The service here was so smooth, loved it! The breakfast options were amazing and generous and the food was so delicious!! I also enjoyed the turn down service and afternoon cookies and tea. It's hard to leave the villa but the main pool is also worth a go. Truly beautiful and peaceful. Love, love, love the Kayana!! It's definitely worth treating yourself and staying there!

author: alma_apologist
title: Superb stay, great location, wonderful people
text: The Kayana is right next to W and in my own view, fares better in comparison. W (from what we saw when we dropped by for drinks) is glitzy and over the top in a definitely luxurious but somehow impersonal way. In comparison the Kayana is serene, elegant and will punch a much smaller hole in the pocket. - Overall the location is excellent, within walking distance to some of Seminyak's best restaurants, clubs, bars and spas. On top of that we were given free transport to anywhere on Seminyak beach so long as we gave them 1 hour's advance notice. - The grounds are beautiful, our private swimming pool was clean, all facilities worked well, including WiFi (inclusive). - Breakfast (inclusive) was delicious, not buffet style as there weren't so many people around (it was February, Bali's rainy season) but we could order anything we wanted off the menu on the house -- American, Indonesian, Continental and endless other options -- and have it served either by their poolside restaurant or in bed. - Value!! We had a wonderful candle-lit Balinese dinner for two beautifully laid out for us in our villa's gazebo one night, complete with two glasses of wine and a great spread of dishes. All for under RM550,000 *after* taxes. If I had known about this earlier I would have planned for more in-villa dinners, that one dinner was more enjoyable than other nights out at Mera Putih / Sarong etc. for twice the price. - Last but not least the people are amazing, even by Bali's high standards of hospitality. Friendly, accommodating, warm, happy and pleasant. If I had to dock any points, it would be for slight wear and tear in the rooms (e.g. some rusty coloured stains on the floor) but nothing that jumps out at you, the rooms and grounds are still beautiful and well maintained, and the imperfections were in places we never had a reason to poke around in. Thank you and well done Kayana!

author: avalongal
title: Simply the Best I have Experienced
text: Kayana Villas are the best villas i have had the pleasure of staying at. Location : Perfect next to The W if you want to see the sunsets. Across the road from two great Spas. My favourite AMO. Walking distance to Potato Head. Easy walk to Seminyak Square. Staff: The very best. Warm, caring, friendly people with the greatest attitude and if they can assist you anyway they will. From getting our pool floatie blown up, dropping us off and picking up at local restaurants, booking restaurants and allowing you peace through the day. Villa: The villa was perfect for us. The bathroom was well equipped. The bed was extremely comfortable. Everything was fantastic. Room Service : We did order in on a couple of occasions and the food was delicious. The grounds are beautiful with frangipani arbours. Again I need to mention the staff unbelievably nice if you did a have problem all you need is to talk to them and they would look into it. I did like how they had car a service for the local area which made life even easier. My only request was for a sunny villa and villa 829 was very nice. I would highly recommend this property.

author: 984merya
title: Perfect honeymoon at The Kayana Bali
text: We stayed at the Kayana in September 2014 two weeks for our honeymoon. Everything was as expected and more. The villa was superb, big, clean, modern. The staff was incredible with us. We were in one of the villa with the big private swimming pool and it was perfect for our honeymoon. Silence at night. Cleaning twice a day. Delicious snacks and cofee in the afternoon. Amazing breakfasts in the restaurant and perfectly prepared and in time when we ordered the breakfast in our villa. The butlers were kind and always attentive with our request. We had four pieces of clothes for the laundry each day at no extra cost and they were neatly delivered the next day into the room. Nice amenities (flower bath, fresh fruit...) on our arrival. We fell in love with the hotel and we're sure we couldn't have chosen anything better. Not a single negative thing to say. The Kayana is in an area with lots of shops and restaurants nearby, discos... The beach is next to the hotel and we could access anytime from the W hotel facilities. The Kayana made our honeymoon perfect!

author: Neyhaa
title: Blissful!
text: Kayana was our honeymoon stay and the stay was plenty memorable. To keep this review short: 1. The property - Beautiful and well kept. Very nice and spacious villas. Our villa had a small little plunge pool with outdoor seating where we used to have our meals. 2. Service - Great! We'd let them know that we are vegetarians at the time of the reservation. We quite liked that had made a note of it and we got a lot of vegetarian options to choose from everyday. We really appreciated that we were served breakfast at 5:30 AM when we had to check out. 3. The food - Nice. Fairly decent choice for vegetarians, the pizza and noodles were our favorite! 4. People - Very warm and welcoming. Starting from the reception to the one who served us our meals, they were all very nice people and always smiling. 5. Spa - Don't give it a miss!

author: TalesofaPoachedEgg
text: The kayana welcomed us wonderfully after a very long storm interrupted transfer from Ubud. Some 2hrs later than expected, we arrived to an awaiting hotel, awaiting but not bursting to see us. We checked in quickly, although this did initially seem quite rushed and without any real detail or service but once Bagus got us in the buddy and smiled this and the arduous drive was wiped away. Our villa was stunning, it was late at night, the lighting, pool and room looked fantastic and we felt we were in for a fantastic second leg of our bali journey. (Note the mosquito nets aren't the best) Overall the location of the kyana was good, central enough and the free driver service quite good to use once you also get your bearings and can be more direct. One thing we noticed is that unlike other places we have stayed, the desire to offer that extra help isn't quite there so you need to be more direct in your needs and it lacks a little of the cultural feel and Polish that is what we came to expect from Ubud and loved initially about bali (and missed the whole time in Seminyak) Clearly the weather and building conditions here are a little brutal and the venue overall is starting to show wear and tear where it probably shouldn't, joinery mainly, bathrooms and windows are struggling a little but overall the property sits around 7/10 Service levels are probably also around 7/10 at most. I'd rate it more like a 6/10 to be honest but the ground staff and room staff are lovely so this made my final view on this aspect a bit higher than it may have been. The day spa is good, we only used it for a complimentary service that we had as part of our room hire but it was relaxing and nice. One thing we noticed is that its priced in USD, which will be confusing considering everywhere else is in IDR and the onsite spa is also very expensive for what else is on offer in Seminyak. We loved body works in Seminyak and went a few times but there is also a new spa across the road by a New Zealand team called Spring that's meant to be fantastic too. Day spa love you will find all over the place, outside the kayana walls. Food wise we didn't eat here apart from one breakfast and some quick spring rolls one afternoon. The breakfast was ok at best, nothing special or traditional and after that one experience we opted to skip it for the rest of our trip, so many other choices and with more lunch and dinners to choose from, felt breakfast was overdoing it. In saying that, plenty of options for breakfast in Seminyak. The spring rolls just to clarify were very good but at 180k, for two portions it was expensive. The price of convenience. Room 8/10 (once you close the doors to your villa, you could just spend all day here by the pool, it was quite an oasis style feel when locked away) Service 7/10 Location 7/10 Would we stay again, probably not, but then again we probably wouldn't stay in Seminyak anyway if we returned to bali. Overall a sound property, quiet, convenient, well located but nothing mind blowing for the price, 7/10

author: dmI6661XI
title: Unique experience
text: Visited Kayana for 6 nights in January 2015. We got the 1 bedroom pool villa for the 4 of us (2 adults and 2 children). Free Airport pick-up with welcome drink in the car. Check in was flawless and we were offered an extra single bed free of charge which we accepted. Daily breakfast was excellent and they can even deliver food to your villa but we mostly ate in the restaurant. Plenty of choices from Indonesian food, Korean, Japanese and continental, also fresh juice, coffee and tea. Breakfast were cooked fresh rather than the buffet style which was nice. As for the room, it was large with good size bathroom and decent pool size (about 9m x 3m). Get the pool villa rather than the plunge pool. As we were travelling with two kids (age 3 and 6), it was important to be able to re-heat kids food at night when they got hungry. We called the 24-hr butler service and they reheated food for us in the kitchen. All staffs were very welcoming and smiled every time. The Airport shuttle service was very handy if you wanted to get around Seminyak area. Recommend the restaurant across the road: Biku for high tea! Thanks Kayana for the wonderful experience.

author: Kimisani
title: Crappy kayana - 2 years later.. What a let down
text: I first visited the kayana 2 years ago. At the time the hotel was new and staff freshly trained. I was really impressed at the time. Two years later and just about everything has gone down hill. Food is very average we skipped breakfast for the rest of the time we stayed there after trying it on the first day...not up to scratch at all. Service is extremely average. I travel to bali 4 times a year for work (over the past 5 years) and stay at around 2-3 hotels every-time I stay there. This is by far the least friendliest front desk staff I have ever come across on my travels to bali . The front of house staff don't even acknowledge you when you enter or leave the hotel occasionally grunting when you acknowledge them first they seemed more interested in fiddling with their laptops than the clientele. They also never confirmed my booking even when I emailed them 2 weeks prior to arrival - no response. The rooms are literally falling apart. This is not an exaggeration!!. There are cracks in the glass villa walls everywhere, Doors that do not close properly, dying brown grass and plants in garden (like a muddy swamp),several tiles coming loose in the bathroom, mould and rust in the shower, murky green pool (see photos) , flooding bathroom when it rains (hazard in the middle of the night on tiles), tv with distorted imagery and some windows sealed up with temporary masking tape instead of properly professionally sealed with a sealer. This would be expectable in a 2 star resort in Kuta if that. But The Kayana is considered to be a 4/5 star hotel charging around $300 and up per night in the cheapest room in a very competitive area for upscale villa hotels. We had a drink around the large pool one day...we practically had to walk to the front reception to flag someone down for a bar menu!? Which felt awkward in our bathers. even though there were several staff constantly walking by and we were the only ones at the pool bar they would just ignore us and continue whatever they were pretending to do. Do yourself a favour Kayana and close the hotel to re-train staff and for a massive update and renovation!!, to avoid more bad reviews like this and disappointed returning guests. It's a real shame as the location is still good and there is some potential there for the hotel to once again be great.

author: muneebs2015
title: Beautiful villas, amazing customer service
text: I stayed here for 4 days over xmas. Beautiful villas, in a good location. What makes this place outstanding however is the service, and their attention to detail. Every request is met with a smile, regardless of the time of day/night! Nice touches included the complimentary cake and chocolates on xmas eve and xmas day. The only reason I gave the Kayana 4 stars was due to the quality of the breakfast. The service was great, with the option of having the breakfast in the restaurant or delivered in the villa. However, I wasn't impressed by the breakfast itself. There is no buffet as in many other hotels, but there is a huge a la carte menu with a lot of variety. As an example, the eggs were never cooked correctly in the 4 days I was there, and were mainly overcooked, and rubbery. We tried various different breakfasts over our 4 days, but none of them were that great. As part of our deal, we were treated to a complimentary massage, which was one of the best we had in Bali, the spa is beautiful, perhaps only lacking a steam room/sauna. There is also a shuttle service which is completely free to local destinations, and only needs to be booked 1 hour in advance. This is a great service. Further away destinations can also be arranged by the hotel, at cost, but competitive to taxis etc. I have to say that apart from the breakfast, everything else is brilliant in the Kayana, especially the fantastic staff. Would definitely stay there again if back in Bali.

author: 893Sandra
title: Little oasis
text: This small establishment epitomises everything about Bali. It's quiet, clean, tastefully decorated. Beautiful walkways are well lit at night. The gardens are beautiful and well maintained. Even the birds like it here. You can hear them chirping throughout the day. Conveniently located between The W Hotel and Potato Head, this is a little lush green oasis. Each bungalow is set apart from each other with a little garden complete with a gazebo where you can opt to have your meals or simply relax. This setup offers a lot of privacy for those who want a peaceful and quiet vacation. You would never bump into anyone. All rooms have pools or plunge pools. Rooms are large with well appointed spacious bathrooms. Comfortable beds with an excellent turn down service in the evenings. Service is what you would expect from this kind of hotel with a 24-hour butler service and free shuttles into the main shopping area of Seminyak. Staff are efficient, polite and happy to help. You can opt to have your meals served at your gazebo or eat around the pool restaurant. The Breakfast menu is extensive and well presented. We chose to have breakfast at our villa and it was served and set up punctually everyday at the appointed time. This hotel has lived up to its reputation and I'm so happy to have spent 8 days in this surprisingly lovely hotel.

author: 741vivp
title: Deluxe Villa's in the heart of Seminyak... Will stay again
text: My partner and I stayed at these villa's on our last stop before flying back home. We were so impressed with how 5 star the rooms were. The villa was luxurious with a very spacious bathroom area and a very comfortable bed (we like it a bit firmer so it suited us well). The small pool and outdoor area was also gorgeous. The food was divine and well worth the little bit extra price compared to most restaurants in Seminyak, my favourite was the white egg and veggie omelette at breakfast... yum! All staff were exceptionally friendly and helped us out for everything we needed. The location is great as it is close to shops, restaurants and they offer free shuttle around Seminyak. The mini bar items were free (except the wine) which was a bonus and the path through the middle of all the villas was so special and romantic. It is surprisingly pretty quiet as the block is narrow. Even for our standard villa that was second from the front we couldn't fault. They offered us late checkout to help with our late flight and even gave us all the information we needed about fees at the airport and what we needed to do. Definitely a 5 star in my opinion. We will stay here again for sure when we revisit Seminyak. Thank you to all for a perfect end to our holiday :-)

author: Leacey
title: Sanctuary, Service & Serene
text: My husband and I just returned from 6 magical nights at The Kayana. I’m no stranger to Bail and have done a fair bit of research over the years for accommodation that is the perfect balance of location, price and facilities. We like this area of Bali (Petitenget) as it is just enough out of the way to be peaceful and right in between the best eating and entertainment in Bali. The W next door, Potatohead four doors down Merah Putih, Sarong, Sardine, Metis, La Lucciola all within walking distance or a short scooter ride. We organised a pick up from airport, which was comfortable and prompt, and although we arrived before 2 pm our villa was ready. We were given a very detailed and appreciated tour of the facilities and lucky us, a cool and refreshing welcome drink. Gorgeous villa, well appointed with a flat screen tv and other mod cons like a Bose speaker dock. The villas are almost 7 years old but you wouldn’t know, they are very well maintained. Also the property is most suited to couples with only one of the villas being 2 bedroom – so this property is certainly more tranquil as a result. A couple of things to mention here which really made this place a value plus was, free bottled water, free afternoon tea with lovely Balinese sweets and nightly turn down service. So lovely. We had our daily inclusive breakfast at the restaurant - were we able to dine in the villa if we so wanted. Another benefit of Kayana is the fact that they had a larger communal pool for a bit of change of scenery, but honestly as our villa, gazebo and large pool were so comfortable we didn’t need to move! We had a massage at the spa and it was a great experience – the staff are very professional and the products used were also of a high quality. Yes you pay a little more but again the quality and experience is worth it, including the shower and lovely ginger tea and cookies at the conclusion. Finally, the staff. The reason I love Bali so much is for the people, and the staff at Kayana were no exception. Warm, kind, thoughtful and efficient. Particular mention must go to Prasana and Agung at the restaurant who were always genuinely engaged in what we had planned for the day and was lovely to learn a little about their families. All I can say is I can’t wait to go back!

author: Kikis78
title: Romantic Villas
text: Booked Kayana after shortlist ing a few other villas within Seminyak. Good location with a few good eateries nearby. Plunge pool villa is luxurious and spacious for us, family of 2 adults and a child. Best to have a la carte breakfast buffet within the villa, at your requested time. Staff are attentive esp the butler. Good pressure at the rain shower. We had a room near to the back and got an odd number unit away from the W driveway. We were celebrating our wedding anniversary but there was nothing special provided, not even a flower on the bed. Not a child friendly place as there are no bikes for kids and you can only ride outside along the ridiculously busy roads. Quite a distance to the beach. Pros Butler service is commendable. Fast & efficient. Always with a smile Breakfast in villa w good variety Good sized heatable plunge pool Romantic & extremely private Good for honeymoon Reasonable shuttle service within the area (subject to availability) Con - The so-called afternoon tea was pathetic (4 small cupcakes) - Foodservice lady on the phone was very rude. I requested for 3pm afternoon tea as we are leaving by 3.30pm. She replied rudely on the phone - only for 1 person, only 1 set. My villa has 2 adults. I was puzzled & a bit upset - late check out need to be confirmed everyday at the reception. Although I have specified it way before arrival All in all, a reasonable place for honeymooners. Not for family.

author: ariow2013
title: The perfect choice
text: Me and wife decided to stay at The Kayana for our honeymoon in Bali. Honestly it was last minute decision because we're already so busy with our wedding preparation and we have so little time to arrange our honeymoon..But it turns out that it was a perfect choice. We stayed at the pool villa. The villa has a private pool with a decent size for both of us and a gazebo which is used for dining. The bedroom was spacious, so is the bathroom with the his and hers side. Overall the ambience for the pool area and the bedroom is romantic and comfortable. For the breakfast? We really enjoyed our breakfast. We asked our buttler to prepare our breakfast in villa. The choice were many and the taste were delicious. Our favorites were eggs benedict, sausage and bacon. Room service was great , we order from pasta , pizza and indonesian food. Nasi campur kayana is highly recommended. We also took the balinese massage at the spa , the combination of the ambience ( lighting , music, scent) and the technique of the massage are so soothing and relaxing. The service was excellent as well. We took the first flight to Bali, the driver from the kayana has standby to picked us up (we notified our arrival just 3 hours before ). We arrived there around 9.30 am and we thought that we would have to wait till 2 pm like any other hotels for checking in, but surprisingly they allowed us to checked in at that moment and late check out at 3 pm was easily granted. Sum it up .. It was the perfect last minute choice. Definitely will come back !

author: klm2482
title: An oasis in Seminyak - Beautiful!
text: As soon as we arrived at the Kayanna we were welcomed with warm smiles and hospitality. The entrance is inviting and although you are right on the main street once you enter the complex the noise coming from the busy street goes away. The villas are beautiful, well-kept and very private. We never heard any exterior noises... just pure bliss! The pool is inviting and very well-maintained, they even offer to heat it, but we thought the temperature was just right! The service was fantastic- Always attentive and friendly and a true desire to cater to your every needs. The in-house spa is a MUST... treat yourself to a Balinese massage. We went all out and tried the four hand massage--- WOW! Well worth the price (only $70USD) for 3 hours. The hotel offers a free shuttle service which was very handy-- make sure you book in advance! The location is perfect - right by the beach and close to amazing restaurants and boutique stores. Overall we give The Kayana a well deserved 5 stars. Great value for your hard earned money :)

author: Sufifi
title: Excellent, Unsurpassed Beauty of a Villa
text: If you're looking to stay at a villa that will seamlessly combine both the tranquil Balinese Villa experience and modern, trendy rooms - look no further. The Kayana, is quite the gem in Seminyak. Service is warm and impeccable. Rooms were clean, cosy and tastefully designed - love how they managed to infuse a modern, sexy vibe to it while maintaining the Balinese touch making it very romantic for couples. Bed is comfy - not too hard, not too soft. Perfect! As for the location, you just can't beat it! It is literally next door to the W and Potato Head. Stone's throw away from lots of good bars and restaurants too. Inevitably, weeekend nights will mean more noise as it's close parties. Breakfast comes with a lovely spread, food is good although the staff at the restaurant don't speak fluent English. You can have breakfast by the main hotel pool or they will serve it up to your room and you may have it at your cabana. I found the latter slightly less appealing as you'd have to combat your breakfast with a somewhat small grist of fruit flies and mosquitoes. Overall, I'd recommend this place if you fancy staying somewhere nice in Seminyak. Brilliant villa!

author: PlanetEarthTraveller
title: Perfect (private) place in Seminyak but no nice beach
text: The Kayana is really a nice place with very comfortable villas (with private dipping pool) in good condition and extremely friendly and professional staff. Any of our requests was handled with top priority and to our full satisfaction. The villas are very well designed with enough space and a large bathroom. It will soon be necessary to renew electrical appliances (TV and iPod loudspeaker were cracking so that we did not use them) and the air condition in one villa (we stayed there twice in two villas) was making noise beyond normal functioning. The small garden and walls around the villa makes the Kayana a very nice 'private' place - with only one issue: the construction work around the Kayana creates a lot of noise without interruption. The entire Kayana structure is beautifully designed (Garden, walls, lightning) and maintained. We also liked the restaurant and the food (delicious) and again the flexibility and professionalism of the staff. What's also great is that very next (left side after exiting the lobby) is a great Deli with a very delicious food and a mini mart (7-11 style) on the other side. Opposite the Kayana is a good place for massages and plenty of restaurants around (the W ; Ku De Ta ; Luciola). If you are looking for a beach, then the Seminyak is not the right place. It used to be a nice beach here (10-20 years ago) but now the beach is extremely dirty (plastic and other waste as far as you can see) and there is so much construction that there is simply no quiet place. We love to walk on beaches but as you really have to watch every step on the Seminyak beach to avoid stepping on some waste its simply no fun. The Kayana has parking for 4 cars (we had a car) and there was never a problem to park there. Driving can be a bit stressful but I would still recommend a car (good experience with balicarfinder.com) to get around and travel to other more quiet places if you are in Bali. One final point: stay away from the villas next to the W entrance road (on the right side from entrance) as there is considerable traffic to/from W that adds to the construction noise level.

author: sharonlovestravel29
title: Outstanding!!
text: I have nothing but great things to say about this place. Firstly our flight was delayed but our airport transfer provided by the hotel was still waiting patiently for us. We were given water, nuts and a cold towel in the car. Our villa was 823 and it was just amazing - every detail was thought of and as other people have said it really was blissfully quiet and it is definitely worth the extra money for a big pool - it's just so lovely. I wish my house was like this. It's so much beter then the photos even! We got a great deal through the hotel (definitely book through the hotel) that included the free breakfast as well as 4 pieces of laundry per day and a free massage at the day spa each which we used and both were of the highest quality. Where the hotel really shone was when we got sick... very sick... They provided us with extra water, towels, ice and organised a doctor for us to come to the room. My husband had fainted and severely sprained his ankle so the hotel went out and got a compression bandage for us and just charged it to our room. The staff went out of their way to look after us and we are forever grateful for what they did. THEN because we were so sick without really needing to ask they gave us a late checkout complimentary until our airport transfer. When you go to Bali the risk of Bali Belly is high and knowing that a hotel can help you when you are just so ill is something I never thought about but when it happens to you you realise how important it is! I must mention that the Day spa is also fantastic and the ladies there make you feel very comfortable. Do yourself a favour and spend a few more dollars to stay here- you will not regret it.

author: JoshEvo
title: Great Place for our First Bali Trip
text: Off a referral from a friend on tripadvisor we decided to book The Kayana. A great decision as we found the service impeccable from start to finish. Airport transfer was without a hitch and very comfortable. Our package included a dinner at the restaurant which we promptly used on the first evening - top class for an in-house offering. we also received a massage pack and day tour - time constraints mean we didn't utilise the day tour, but the day spa massage pack was of a high standard and we enjoyed. Breakfasts were provided and amazing (hint - you can order was much as you want!!). Grounds were very well maintained, a very beautiful facility. Other services the Kayana offered were excellent, timing of breakfast, placing orders, asking for hotspots to visit as well as booking free of charge the Kayana driver to drop us off was all easy to do and seamless with a friendly smile at reception. The villas themselves do have some dating on them, but still very well maintained and more than comfortable - the point I am making is that it is not a brand new facility. This is an important point as it shows Kayana wants to continue it's high level of service, not a short term flash in the pan offering. The only issue we had is my wife getting a sore neck which we can only put down to a different pillow to her norm - but that isn't the fault of the Kayana. We were very happy with what we were provided by the Kayana - however being our first time in Bali we don't know what we don't know. Having said that, I have no reason to want to change after our stay here (end of October 2013). We look forward to visiting and staying at the Kayana again in the future. Location wise you are right in the middle between "W" and "Potato Head" - a great spot.

author: vividplanner
title: Clean and beautiful villa with great service!!
text: It was all good from airport pick up to check in. We were pleasantly surprised by a petals filled bath tub knowing that it was our honeymoon trip. Butler service was prompt and discreet and the staff were always ready to serve with a smile. Our butler would always knock and ask for permission before entering our villa. The garden and pool of our villa is well maintained. It would be even better if the pool is heated. The turn down service every evening was also very nice. It was not as noisy as we thought staying near the reception. However, noise from some construction work near the villa was a bit disturbing during the day. The villas towards the end might offer more privacy. Another plus point is the breakfast! The breakfast spread was good and delicious! If only the breakfast reservation form has better format to indicate portions and the butler could inform us on the laundry timing. Other than that, we were satisfied with the villa and service received. The Kayana even provides driver service around Seminyak area which is a plus point. The Kayana is located in a good location near the bech and lots of restaurants. Do go to Warung Bonitas for delicious and reasonably priced local food which is just around the left side of Kayana. If you want to be in the center of action and enjoy some privacy at the end of the day then Kayana is the place for you.

author: jessbeekink
title: Perfect Location and Wonderful Service
text: We had a wonderful time at Kayana in August 2013. The location is prefect, right between the W Hotel and Potato Head - everything you need is within walking distance. If not, there is a complimentary shuttle that drops you where you need to go. The Villa was generous and very clean. There were no issues at all. However if you are after brand spanking new rooms, then this may not be the place - the villas are starting to show very small signs of aging (but not enough in anyway for me not to recommend you to stay there!). The grounds, however, are IMMACULATE! So lovely to wander through the frangipani lined walkways, especially in the evening. The staff were wonderful, and couldn't have been more accommodating. I chose to have a spa treatment at the hotel - whilst you pay more than Bodyworks down the road, in my opinion, it was worth every sent. The atmosphere and service was top notch - definitely what I was after in a spa treatment. We had breakfast served in our room daily - whilst the food wasn't amazing, it was included with our room price and was served with wonderful service, so we couldn't complain. Generally, our experience is that breakfast is not always the best in Asian countries, in any event. If you are deciding between the room with a smaller or larger pool, I would suggest perhaps stick with the smaller pool, as ourselves (and our friends too) found this more than enough. Would definitely recommend a stay at Kayana - I am hoping to take my sisters/parents back to stay in the not too distant future!

author: AllanF794
title: Fantastic Service
text: My wife and I stayed at the Kayana for 4 days, mid April. This was our first villa experience as well as first trip to Bali. The staff exceeded our expectations to use a well worn phrase! From our first exchange to the final good bye, the service, professionalism, friendly sincerity, and excellent assistance will have us returning for sure. We had the Villa for two and a package deal with breakfast delivered to our patio area each morning to perfection. The spa is very well done and worth the extra cash for the conveniance and ambience. You can of course get all those services more cheaply within walking or a short cab ride's distance. It's really nice that this hotel will shuttle you on request and pick you up! All complimentary within reason. On occassion there was a sporadic noise from nearby motor bikes but generally we truly were able to relax and take a time out. The Kayana just celebrated 6 years of operation and while the Villas are nice, very clean and apportioned they are starting to show expected wear and tear. They will need to do some refurb to stay competitive in that regard. However as i mentioned the service and staff is incredible. My wife and I have a strong background in service management and the Kayana staff performs naturally every time what we had to constantly reinforce with U.S. staff to engage with guests both at the basic levels of interaction and courtesy. Even the Kayana groundskeepers greet you EVERY time by taking a moment, smiling and having a word with you. It's a class act all the way and I heartily recommend the Kayana for your Bali trip.

author: tonyandnaomi
title: Just Magic!!
text: This place is right in the heart of Seminyak right next to the W resort all the resturants and bars just minutes away. The staff and this place are fantastic from the drivers to front reception all amazing and speak really good english in my eyes anyway. From the booking right down to when we left the service was excellent. We had read some reviews and heard that certain villas were a bit noisy so when booking requested certain room and got it within a few emails back and forth all arranged. Also when we got picked up at airport we had drinks and food supplied in car with wet towels really lovely. Then when we arrived which was early about 10am we got checked into our room straight away so buy 11.30am I was in my villa by the pool service top notch. Even when we got home they sent us a system to review them which I did and that was great. First I would like to thank all staff at the Kayana your warm smiles and service are fantastic. But I would like to give a special mention to Agung who did most of the service in our villa your attention to detail is exceptional your just a really nice guy. The girls on front reception you ROCK just will do anything they can for you. The ladies in the SPA you ROCK just great must have a massage pricing for villas not bad at all quite happy. Drivers who picked us and took us everywhere full of information and just really nice. The villas in this place are just amazing couldn't fault a thing. I did mention with my review little things they could improve on because what happens is everything is done so seamless when you are there that when one little thing goes wrong it sticks out but we are talking like maybe not getting your glasses replaced one day just silly things. Because everything is just done so well but all you have to do is call the butler and then they'll bring it so no issues really at all. The food is really good as well cocktails ok but could do better but not bad. But we mainly mixed are own drinks anyway so alls good. We love you Kayana and will be back.

author: Sing_Healthcare
title: Excellent Service, very good property
text: My family stayed 4 nights at The Kayana and I must say we were all impressed by the level of service and sincerity of the staff. Everyone was very warm to us and one of their drivers even gave us a lift to Kuta Beach when he overheard us hailing a taxi. He then later advised that it would be very expensive for us to pay for a taxi ride to Kuta. Great service! The villa butler, together with the front office, was always on hand to handle your requests promptly and Ayur Spa was wonderful. Relaxing and the spa therapist was very professional. The Kayana is also very near to Seminyak Square with a couple of good restaurants and chill out place such as Potato Head, W Retreat & Spa, Kunis (Japanese) and Ultimo (Italian). However, our only feedback was that the villa could have been better maintained and serviced. The mattresses for the deck chairs were stained and the pantry were pretty run down. Although we were not sure if the pantry were meant for guests or as a preparation area of the butler. Even then, the pantry was not a pretty sight. However, if you do not intend to use the pantry area (like us), it is still quite alright. For couples, I think The Kayana is a great property to relax and enjoy each others' company. For families with children, like us with a 6-year old child, the room layout presents a challenge for some couple time or watching DVDs without disturbing his sleep. But overall, a great place to stay and chill out. And did I mention, excellent service!

author: hdc5
title: Just perfect
text: We had a perfect short stay of 3 nights here and loved every minute of our stay here. The villa was lovely and was always attended to perfection and done very discreetly. The restaurant food was lovely starting from the breakfasts to lunches. The menu was endless and there was no scrimping on the offerings on the breakfast included. The spa was slightly cheaper than australia prices (high for bali) but was amazing. The second day we used a cheaper spa elsewhere and well yes, we learnt we get what we pay for. we returned back to the Kayana and they were willing to discount when asked. Reception were so helpful and all the staff from the drivers to the garden staff were so friendly and helpful. The w retreat, (which we thought was a bonus to the kayana) was next door but a good 5-10min walk way down the road. The road is well built too and the drains covered unlike most areas so there was no smell etc..we caught the free golf buggy ride that was transporting guests. Here, we experienced the happy hour and enjoyed some great cocktails in the funky bar. We experienced no unwanted loud noise at all from the the W and we were back in the room normally by 10pm. The only road noise we experienced was the 1 or 2 scooters riding by but that was at breakfast. Did not spoil the beautiful ambience of the kayana at all. Loved the location, had a good hairdressers across the road and a 2 minute walk to the famous sarong restaurant that had amazing food/dining experience at reasonable prices. Loved the kayana and would book here again...just perfect!

author: oneinvestment
title: Far from 5 star, noisy, not clean and limited privacy
text: We booked this hotel following reading several reviews and staying twice at the Samaya in Ubud which is a sister hotel. Whilst my positive reviews tend to be short, we were very disappointed with our stay for a number of reasons. Some of the reasons may have been fine in isolation but when combined, they made our stay terrible. Firstly, whilst we were told after being transported to our villa that we had a quiet villa, from 10pm, it sounded like we were on a highway. Motorbikes were revving, beeping and people were talking loudly. The right hand side villas are next to the W Hotel and must be right next to the staff parking area. at 11pm we rang the hotel to find out what was going on. Eventually they agreed to move us to another villa so we got to bed at 11.45. This villa was quiet and we asked why we were checked into a noisy villa when this one was available only to be told that the manager we were talking to didn't make the allocations. A little disappointing when we have referred a number of friends to the sister hotel. The following morning, construction work started at another villa so there were loud hammering noises. We spoke to the manager and informed him it was not acceptable. Whilst he was apologetic, we told him that we would like to check out rather than spend the 2nd of our two night reservation at the Kayana. Eventually the hotel agreed to let us check out the following morning. Other issues included: - toilet was dirty when we checked in; - 2nd villa's bathroom smelled; - water was leaking through the wall of the room creating a puddle in the room - staff promplty came and fixed this when we advised them; - staff would come into the villa unannounced via the private door. Any other villa we have stayed at, staff would ring the door bell so we would not have to worry about what we were doing or how we were dressed; - our breakfast poached eggs tasted like they had been boiled only in vinegar and most of the vinegar had been poured on to our plates; - a number of stains on the couch. Overall definitely not what I expect from a 5 star villa and very disappointing. The Kayana has a lot to learn from the Samaya (we have only stayed at the Samaya in Ubud and can not speak positively enough of it. Unfortunately we were not able to book into the Samaya in Seminyak).

author: pioneer58
title: What a wonderful place to stay in Bali
text: We arrived at Bali airport to be greeted by a friendly gentleman who drove us to the resort. Straight away we sensed something special was about to happen. At the checkin the staff showed genuine warmth and professionalism and we were already feeling very relaxed. We were driven the short distance down the beautiful avenue of frangipani trees and we entered through the big welcoming doors into our villa grounds. Wow! This was indeed the tropical paradise we had hoped for. The Villa was set up beautifully and sparkling clean. A welcome drink was poured by our butler as he explained about the Villa. That afternoon we enjoyed our afternoon tea in the balinese gazebo that overlooked our own private pool that was perfect for a relaxing dip in the warm days. We had breakfast every morning which was laid out on the table in the gazebo and it was always fresh and fabulous. We had dinner from the restaurant one night which was again brought to our villa and laid out professionally in the same way. We had a package which included a Balinese massage which we enjoyed the second night. It was so fabulous I had another two and my wife had another 3 over the next 5 days and the ladies were extremely professional and skilled. I have never felt so relaxed. I worked for an airline for 18 years and stayed in many 5 star hotels but the Kayana has something more special than I have ever experienced before. The staff have a can do approach to everything, they are always friendly , warm and smiling and their professionalism is second to none...they truly want you to enjoy your stay. They take great care to be available when you need them but also respect your privacy. Little things like making up your room in the morning and turning it down at night are done very discretely without you even knowing. Thank you Kayana for the best holiday ever and we will definitely return for more,

author: wonderfelle
title: Worth the price in Seminyak
text: My husband and I stayed at the Kayana for 2 nights at the beginning of our honeymoon in Bali. The hotel arranged for transport from the airport (very comfortable providing water and snacks!) as well as the expedited visa service - pay the extra $35 USD for this if you can, it's definitely worth it to skip the lines at immigration/customs. The property itself is well maintained with individual villas and impeccable landscaping. The staff was always very nice and accommodating, but not overly friendly. There is a true boutique style as opposed to the W Hotel next door - it definitely doesn't have that large resort feel. We stayed in a deluxe villa (812) that had a small plunge pool which was perfect for us as we didn't plan to spend too much time in the villa while we were in Seminyak. Opt for a pool villa if you really want to enjoy swimming. The villa was always clean - one morning after breakfast we walked in on no less than 5 staff members cleaning it. Since it was our honeymoon, they arranged for flowers on our bed and in the tub our first night. We ate breakfast in the restaurant both mornings, it was nice that it was included and you could order whatever you like. We also had a complimentary Balinese couples massage in the spa - the spa therapists really made it a relaxing experience. The Villa is close to restaurants and shopping, but not on the main stretch where it can be loud. You might hear noises coming from cars/motorcycles driving on the access road to the W next door, but this didn't bother us at all. Free shuttle service is a great plus - we used it to be dropped off at Seminyak Square for shopping one day and at Ku De Ta for dinner. You can arrange for the shuttle to pick you up at a specific time or just take a cab back - its generally less than $5 USD.

author: 24minilu
title: What a fantastic hotel!
text: We stayed here for 9 nights for the first part of our hoeymoon which we booked through Audley Travel. The check in was speedy although we arrived at one after a 24 hour journey and had to wait an hour before we could check into our room..would be a nice touch if people coming from far could check in a little earlier. As we were on hoeymoon we got a free meal in or room (which was decorated with candles and fresh flowers...so romantic for our first night) and 2 free massges for both of us - one 15 minute and one full body for an hour. Such a fantastic touch and very kind. The room was so lovely. Not overlooked at all and the bathroom was lovely and spacious. The only criticism is that you dont get a full day of sunshine the way that the outdoor area is built. Pool is lovely though and cleaned daily. The staff were fantastic and unlike other areas where the continuous friendliness can get a bit much and fake- here it was just genuine and helpful. We had breakfast in our outdoor area everyday with no extra charge. We tried it at the restaurant thinking it may have been a buffet but it wasnt so much better to stay in your rooms. The cleanliness was second to none and the free car shuttle service was fantastic. The hotel is so romantic and perfect for our honeymoon. The actual roads around Seminyak are dirty and busy so it was great to come back to our little haven! Places to try are definitely Sarong, Potato Head, Chandi amongst the usual Ku De Ta and Living Room. The spa across the road was lovely cant remember the name. All in all a fabulous memorable stay.

author: CatherineBai
title: Beautiful Peaceful Resort
text: This is my first trip to Bali together with my boyfriend. We chose Kayana because of the many positive reviews. Kayana literally blew us away with their beautiful spacious rooms and attentive services by the staff. I am usually very particular when it comes to hotel/resort room. The appearance and layout of the room is important and have to give an instant wow-factor before we would choose to book with them. We were not disappointed! The 1 bedroom pool villa that we booked is exactly true to the photos that are shown in their website. Everything within our villa is near perfection. The water fountain near the pool with outside lounge area, huge 4 poster bed with fluffy soft pillows (complete with bed drapes, truly inviting!), free minibar (for soft drinks), wonderful breakfast selection, served in the privacy within your villa, complimentary tea and cakes served every 3pm. Room service is efficient n fast with plenty of mineral water and towel provided. At night the whole villa is basked in soft warm light, air con adjusted to a cool setting (we usually switch off the air con when out), bed drapes drawn…. The villa at night gives off a romantic atmosphere…. A boutique resort with only 30 villas, fully booked. However, we hardly see any guest around. It feels like we had the whole resort to ourselves! The staff is friendly and extremely helpful. We wanted a city tour and they were really patient, taking out the time mapping out places of interest. However, Con: Food in the hotel menu is not really appetizing. (But not the daily breakfast) It will be worth your money if you choose to eat out at restaurants outside the villa. Already looking forward to the next vacation back to Kayana!

author: aditraveller101
title: AWESOME!!!!!..read wht i say...
text: as u enter the place is very charming wit a very warm welcome and a welcome drink at u step into ur villa. mine was a villa wit private large pool. i have never had a pool villa stay before and i cud not imagine it being more fun. the hotel is very clean and the service is second to none. the free shuttle service to entire seminyak area is a real help. checking in and cheking out was super smooth. we took only breakfast at the hotel and was a large variety of really delicious food. i loved the stay and as i was on my honeymoon there it was a real treat. it was my first trip to bali and it was made worth while by kayana. a must stay place in bali. dnt kno wht more can one ask for in a villa. its good value for money too. the place and the villa looks exactly as the fotos do on the site. thats the best part. and even though its all water its all clean all the time and that is very impressive. awesomeness to the core lingers there. do stay in kayana if u goin to bali for the first time and love a dip in the pool every day. both me and my wife were fully satisfied by our stay there and wil plan to do again the next time we touch bali.

author: mrbrownMilano
title: Truly relaxing spot, great staff
text: My partner and I took a two-month sabbatical around Australia and Southeast Asia, finishing up with a 10-day stay at the Kayana, which was really perfect. 24 private villas, each with a pool (we had a plunge pool instead of the larger one, which was fine with us), done in Balinese style. Rooms were large, clean, and well-kept and the staff were fantastic--honestly friendly and helpful. I wish that whoever trained them would train the whole world! Most of the other reviews are justifiably positive and I don't have too much to add. A few things to consider: --The place is really quiet. We hardly ever saw other guests. So a perfect spot for honeymooners or if you want to get away from it all, less perfect if you want a hopping bar scene. --There's no beach access. If you get tired of hanging around yr private pool, there's a larger hotel pool, or you can go to a nearby beach club such as Potato Head (why they chose that name is beyond me) or KuDeTa. Potato Head is an honestly short walk (5-minutes door-to- door); KuDeTa requires a (not even) 5-minute car ride. The hotel is happy to provide a free transfer; cabs are also plentiful and cost less than US$1. --The W is set to open just next door and unfortunately the access road can be noisy, affecting around half the villas. We had a villa next to the access road and changed to one further away, which was fine. Except for the last, none of the above were problems for us. We've traveled pretty extensively around the world and stayed in places ranging from Four Seasons resorts to camping in the Australian outback and found the Kayana to be one of the more pleasant places we've been.

author: atthewedge
title: Honeymooners Heaven in Every Way
text: We stayed at the Kayana for our honeymoon for 7 nights in mid march. We arrived at night time and straight away were impressed with the resort and the service. The resort grounds are immaculate and maintained all day every day. The villa we were in was the deluxe single bedroom villa which had the larger plunge pool. We also poked our head into the other villas with the smaller pool and they are to the same standard just with a smaller plunge pool should this be more suitable to your budget. The room itself opened onto your own pool with an outdoor daybed gazebo and dining area that you could eat all your meals at with butler service. The king size bed was heaven and quickly became known as the cloud. Attention to detail by staff was exceptional, full room, pool cleaning and makeover morning and afternoon. The food, especially breakfast was great and we often ate so much at the all inclusive breakfast that we didn't eat again until dinner. Meals that we did pay for were also reasonably priced for resort standards and delicious. The resort is in a great location, with walking access to restaurants and great bars. There is a mini mart right next door and if you want to go out further there is a free shuttle bus which was ready instantly every time even though they asked us to let them know in advance. The shuttle service takes you into Seminyak shopping district (5 minutes away) as well as Legian. They stated during our stay that they like to treat guests as family and we certainly came away feeling as though we were and that they were. They all loved to please any requests no matter what they are. We had some great places to look forward to after staying here but we were left not wanting to go anywhere. We cant thank the Kayana enough for making our honeymoon perfect. We have travelled to some pretty special places throughout asia and this is one place we would go back to.

author: Johhannnes
title: Excellent Villas, Great Staff, Food, Service - Highly Recommended
text: Im wiritng this review after staying at another place in Bali and i regreted not returning here. While i dont intend to go back to Seminyak after staying in other parts of Bali, i would consider comming back just to stay here as you needent leave your villa the place and service is that good. Location: Firstly most people probably notice that this hotel is located on the top fringe of Seminyak away from what appears to be the centre. However it is actually located closer to the places you will more than likely want to go - La Luciola, Ku De Ta are both walking distance. But the location is a mute point as they provide complimentry transfers to anywhere in seminyak at any time and a taxi ride is 10,000 IDR at most $1USD so not an issue. We walked to La Lucciola most nights either for a meal or for a drink at their bar / waiting room located beachfront as well. Villas: Huge, large garden with swimming pool and bale (thatched undercover outdoor dinning / lounge area. We ate every meal outside and it was a really nice place to relax, it had sun lounges, grass area and the outdoor lounge area. The villas had high roofs, heaps of natural light and were all open plan so it was a real plaesant place to relax. Food: We every breakfast and a few lunch or dinners here and they were all great. They would make you anything you wanted for breakfast and you could order as much as you wanted. They also provided afternoon tea everyday of fresh juice and some food either savoury or dessert which was a nice touch. Small things that made a difference - fresh proper coffee was provided complimentry everyday, water was replenished daily and they had about 10 bottles scattered around the room. They provided complimentry massages 1hr for each person, afternoon tea daily, transfer service into town. Overall the villa had such appeal that we would spend most days relaxing in it + it was so large that you didnt feel cramped. The location was walking distance to La Luciolla and a few other nightsponts if that was your thing or you could use the complimentry transfer service. The food was always nice and they wouldnt stop feeding us whether it was large breakfasts or afternoon teas. I beleive they are a sister hotel to the Samaya and they certainly know how to run a hotel - best service i have received at almost any hotel worldwide.

author: Renai21
title: Amazing Holiday Experience - No Complaints!
text: We spent alot of time looking at reviews for villas, and found this to receive great feedback! We were not disapointed - upon checking in late at night we were greeted by a beautiful complex entry with soft lightining and friendly staff to welcome us. A golf cart took us down to our lovely 1 bedroom pool villa with a welcome drink & full explanation of the room. It was beautiful! Travelling with a 6 month old baby, we were worried a number of things could go wrong! We had nothing to be worried about! The Kayana staff had set up a cot with a mosquito net and pillows to ensure our baby didnt roll during the evening. This was positioned right next to our bed which was perfect! Throughout our stay the staff were so eager to please, and generally down to earth! Breakfast daily in our room, as we sat by the outside pool and soaked up the morning sun. We hired pram/play toys and floatie ring for the pool for our baby through Bali Baby & this was all brought to our room the following morning. Great location! walking distance to Ku De Ta and The Samaya for beautiful lunches. The villas are very clean and modern, with the spa amazing for relaxing massage and treatments. Across the road from Bali Cafe and next door to a quickie mart for any essentials! We loved it and would recommend to anyone travelling to Bali - any age!

author: Dunkersamd
title: Great for Honeymoon
text: We stayed at the Kayana for 10 days from the end of September as part of our honeymoon. We arrived late at night from K.L and were driven down to our villa (even though it was an easy enough walk). It was so peaceful and we loved our villa. Obviously there are walls around the garden and pool area of your villa, otherwise it wouldn't be a private villa but we certainly didn't find it claustrophobic. I have noticed people moaning on here about The Kayana looking 'tired', the place is only 4 years old and I think some people are pedantic to the enth degree, it didn't seem tired to us. You know that there is no seaview when you book this place so we had no expectations of that. The villa is mainly floor to ceiling windows and it's a balinese villa, so there are no curtains (as someone else on here has complained about), there are floor to ceiling wooden blinds which block the light well enough to ensure you sleep long enough but that you don't waste the entire day in bed (because its so dark that you can't tell what time of day it is). We loved the layout of the bath, shower room and sinks and the bed was really comfortable. We had one of the villas with a pool and we rarely bothered to leave the villa during the day. The butler service will bring food to you whenever you want including free afternoon tea and snacks if you so wish. The complex is really 24 or so individual villas with a restuarant/bar, small communal infinity style pool and a Spa. The restaurant overlooks the pool. The setting for both is really peaceful - we never saw anyone using the pool or beds because I think noone really needs to, when they can stay in the comfort of their own villa and use their own. The food and spa treatments were good and the staff were always polite, happy and couldn't do enough for you - they were always concerned about your privacy and doing as much as possible to avoid invading it. We are not the type of people to do resort based things and prefer to go out in the evenings so the lack of facilities that some people have complained of was fairly irrelevant to us...Petitinget is fairly small with a couple of good bars either side of the Kayana (Bar Code & Harrys something) and the odd shop but the staff at the Kayana will drive you into Seminyak whenever you want and collect you as well (we never bothered with the collection as it was quicker to get a cab for about £1). We accidentally walked back to the Kayana one night (we thought we were walking deeper into Seminyak!) and it only took 15 minutes with the odd shop and restaurant dotted along the way - although in the dark its a bit of a rough unmade route to walk. There are lots of restaurants and boutiquey shops in the street that runs along from Seminyak Square (5 minutes by car from The Kayana) but it was difficult to find many bars - there was a couple along this strip but we found the majority along a side street running off Seminyak Street - we never worked out the name of this street but there were a lot of gay bars along here so we just told the cab drivers that and they knew where to go - again cheap in a cab to get back from. Access to the beach is aboout a 10 minute walk down the road but you have to enter via a religious/sacred bit of beach - basically you can't sit or bathe in the sea in this bit and we couldn't be bothered to walk all the way left or right to the sun loungers as they looked too far away to walk to in the heat The only other thing to mention is that the mini bar in the Kayana only had wine and soft drinks - we drink spirits and we soon discovered that none of the mini marts anywhere seemed to sell any. The staff at the Kayana suggested the only place to get them would be delicatessan/supermarket in Seminyak Square or another large supermarket in Seminyak Street - we couldn't find that one initially and so we had to pay £35 for a 1litre bottle of smirnoff - yes its extortionate to buy bottles of spirits if you want to have a drink in your villa so would recommend you buy some in duty free!

author: AyatoKamina
title: Great Place altogether
text: After staying in Four Seasons Jimbaran for honeymoon, my wife and I checked out and moved to Kayana. We bought the package at a wedding fair so we think the price is quite reasonable for what we get. But of course, you get what you paid. There's no sea view from your villa or any exciting landscape to take pictures. But what they lack in panoramic view, they made up in good service, great staffs, very nice rooms, and great food. Basically the furnishing in Kayana is all simple. The private pool villa has water heater! Now that's really interesting. We also enjoyed having breakfast at the private lounge just outside the villa. Seminyak has a lot of fancy boutiques surprisingly owned by foreigners (Australians, Japanese, Americans, etc) so walking from the hotel to the streets to see the shops was interesting. There's also a very fancy restaurant/cafe called Kudeta just nearby. It was raining when we wanted to go back and I called the front office, they immediately arranged a pick-up at Kudeta, free of charge in 15 minutes. I just love that! Then there's the complimentary spa treatment which we get when we purchased the package, very nice indeed! Overall my wife and I had a good stay in Kayana.

author: Pearl18
title: Wonderful Stay-Good Location
text: We stayed for 4 nights in the Kayana Villas, Bali in August 2010. Earlier was a bit apprehensive about what we were going in for but after reaching there was quite delighted. The villas are very peacful and very very private. The villas are spacious, with enough space to walk around. Breakfast was very very good with a lot of variety. There is a side entry for the butler service and they always inform before coming in. The location is just perfect. About 5 mins by cab to the nearest beach. Its also very near Oberoi street, which gets quite lively in the evenings and has a number of eating joints as well as shops. For those interested in spas, there is Body Works just nearby(5 mins), where you can get a very good massage and spa at reasonable prices as compared to the prices in Kayana. The staff at the villas is very courteous and hospitable. On request, they decorated our room and bath tub with flowers for my husband;s birthday and even arranged for a cake which was delicious. All in all, its a good place to stay if one wants a combination of privacy as well as as access to party places like KuDeTa (must go), eating joints and shopping. If one is looking just for party then living in Kuta is better since most of the party clubs are there, even though travelling from Seminyak to Kuta takes about 15-20 mins depending on the traffic, and it does get crowded in late evenings. But i would go in gor staying in Seminyak and Kayana Villas.

author: ZiggyIreland
title: Great stay
text: Stayed in the Kayana for a week on honeymoon. They upgraded us to a 2 bed villa with a pool. It was a fabulous villa with a really large pool and decking area. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Rooms were really modern and airy. Breakfast was served in the restaurant or on your patio. We usually went for the patio option and it was fantastic to be able to sit out and wait for your breakfast to be served to you by the pool. Resort seemed very quiet and relaxed even though it was full. It seemed to be very private. Used the spa a few times, which was great, although the prices in the spa across the street were about a quarter of the price! Location is very close to seminyak, however walking along the road to seminyak or the beach can be a bit of a daunting experience. Taxi's were really cheap though and the hotel did offer a free shuttle service. We ate mainly in Seminyak, Ku de Ta was great, even if it was a bit expensive compared to the other restaurants. We also loved Chandi and Cafe Bali. Would love to stay again and would recommend to anyone.

author: surpisinglycomplex
title: great villa and excellent sleep quality
text: i live in Bali and my friend come from jakarta and visit me here. we decided to stay in the kayana villa since the location is very great. near so many great place for hang out and eat in seminyak area. when i come to the kayana, the nice lady in the desk already know my name, which is very weird but in a good way, and she give me a bouquet of white lily, and politely say its from my friend. i know that he will never go out to find that lily by himself, so the hotel help him to find that. whoever who may concern to choose the florist, nice taste by the way. the villa was simply great. very comfortable bed. i had the best sleep ever here. the pool is ok, we can call the reception to ask for the hot water in the pool and wait for 30 min until its warm. service was great. i forget to bring the charger for my mobile and the staff was very helpful and friendly. although they cant find any charger for my mobile its ok, the matter of fact is they care enough to came to my villa and bring the different types of charger which is nothing fit. lol. anyhow, love this place. will definitely come back in a near future.

author: meringo
title: Rejected reservation due to system error
text: I made a booking to stay in Kayana for 3 nite stay from 12-15 Jun 2010, I have made the reservation on 11 May 2010. So it's a good 1 month before my arrival. However, on 28 May 2010 they sent me an email saying that due to some problem with their system, they couldn't see some older bookings. So by the time they fixed the system and inputted my reservation it created an overbooked situation. These were what they suggested to me : 1. To change my date from 12-15 Jun to 14 - 18 Jun --> which was impossible because I have bought the ticket and we have informed our office to take leave on such date. It was a very selfish suggestion to be proposed from their end I feel, because I think they should recommend an alternative place to stay for us first rather than requesting a change of date. I replied to them and said that I can't change the date and they replied back just apologizing without even trying to recommend another hotel for us. 2. They said that from 14 - 18 Jun only their deluxe room (our rsvn was pool room) is available and to compensate us they will give us complimentary spa OR dinner. --> I feel they have caused such a hassle in our reservation and the only thing that they could propose to make customer feel better was spa OR dinner, they were so calculating despite mistake was made on their side. 3. And to make it even worst on 31 May they emailed me again and told me that they have found solution to their problem and able to reconfirm my booking. --> This was really upsetting because on 28 May when they rejected my reservation I immediately looked for another hotel, so when they came back to me 3 days later it was too late for a solution. I really hope the management will be more careful next time and update their system accordingly, it was such a disappointing event for us. We were looking forward to stay there, but with the service level that they offered us we don't know whether we want to go back or not.......

author: Elenriel
title: Affordable luxury in a tranquil, peaceful and totally private setting
text: This was our first stay at Kayana, having tried most of the other major hotels in the area, such as The Oberoi and The Legian. We were in a search for something new, someplace more personal and private. And with no screaming children! We were a bit nervous upon check in, as the lobby is off a very busy street, however our fears were quickly dashed, and were welcomed by warm smiles and a cold fresh towel. Our butler Agus swept us off to our room in a golf buggy stopping to familiarise us with the spa, library, lounge and dining areas. With equal passion he showed us every aspect of our room, which was quite endearing as we are very seasoned travellers and really did not need such a thorough introduction, but we had not the heart to stop him. He was very polite and ended telling us that our well being and our total privacy was thier mission. In fact all the staff were exceptionally professional and very warm and friendly. The grounds of the property are beautifully landscaped with palms and fragapani's. The pool Villa we had was modern and stylish, sympathetic to traditional Balinese architecture. Four poster bed netted at night, very firm matteress, luxury down duvet and pillows, ensuring long peacful sleeps. Large modern and spotlessly clean bathroom with stone shower and bath surrounds. The dipping pool was perfect and very private, with the relaxing sound of a waterfall feature. Plenty of room for a day bed, table and two lounges. The restaurant was also outstanding, great variety, exceptional quality and not over the top pricing, which you can't escape now at any of the larger hotels. The main pool area was never busy, and the pool long and deep enough to get some excercise. The location is not perfect, which is reflected in the price. However they offer a free shuttle into Seminyak and Legian, 5 minutes tops. Only a five minute walk to the beach, coming out right by the The Legian and close to Ku De Ta. The Kayana was affordable luxury in a tranquil, peaceful and totally private setting.

author: AdelaideLovetotravel
title: an oasis of calm
text: My husband & I have returned from Bali today after celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary at the Kayana at Seminyak. The occasion warranted a bit of indulgence & luxury, as well as some romance & privacy. The Pool Villa was perfect- large, airy,& private with a large private pool. We had room 825 which was quiet & sunny. The staff are very attentive without being intrusive & always very helpful & friendly. The area of Seminyak is now trendy with lots of good restaurants & boutiques sprouting up at each corner. It is relatively expensive compared to other parts of Bali but the quality is better & more on par with shops at home. There is a grogeous pedicure place opposite the hotel call Arno & the standard of hygiene & treatments there are very good. The hotel has a beautiful but pricely spa- I think it may be attended more frequently if the prices where a bit lower & not in US dollars! I enjoyed the afternoon tea with is complimentary- usually a coffee or a freshly squeezed OJ with a small tempting bite to eat . After returning from a hot outing this was a welcome treat. The Hotels free car service is also very welcome- they will take you anywhere as far as legian for shopping expeditions or dining & pick you up. Taxis are also a very cheap option - usually only costing about $3-5 for a reasonable trip. OVERALL we where both very happy with the Kayana & would not hesitate to recommend it to those looking for a relaxed quiet romantic stay. Children are not catered for & those for looking for the hustle & bustle of street markets may find it a bit quiet in this area. It was perfect for the type of holiday we wanted. Thank you Kayana !

author: Javed817
title: Cant wait to go back again..fantastic...you will love it!
text: Stayed there with my wife for our honeymoon in November 2009...just been lazy putting up the review! The Kayana is an excellent place to stay. We stayed in a plunge pool villa which was amazing. The villas are large and everything has been thought of. The bed is so big and very comfortable with a 42" plasma tv placed perfectly. The bathroom is so nice and the shower is brilliant. There is an outside dining area which romantic and great to just chill out in near the plunge pools . The staff are also brilliant and are so helpful. We never felt like they were helping us just for a tip. They were genuine and I am planning to go back as soon as possible! You also get a butler on call and they were always happy to help even at odd hours. Also location for Bali holidaymakers is good. Everything is pretty accessible and the Kayana is in a quiet but nice area. Beaches are a nice walking distance of 10 - 20 minutes. The only minor thing I would point out is that the Spa services they provide is very expensive! There are cheaper places close by but if you can afford it then the Spa is good as well.

author: dazza66
title: Fantastic Service
text: Stayed at Kayana for 2 nights in early October 2009. From the moment you arrive at this resort the thing you notice the most is the exceptional service. From the front desk staff to the turn down service everyone is genuinely interested in making your stay enjoyable and memorable. We chose a pool villa for 2 adults and 1 child. The villa is about 75 sq m and is separated into a living area with flat screen TV and DVD player and a large bed complete with mosquito net. The bathroom area includes a double vanity, shower and toilet and separate bath. There is a split system air-conditioning unit in the villa. The pool, complete with sun deck and water feature, is at your doorstep along with a small covered dining area. Our villa was located about 150m from the check in area – a nice walk amongst the beautifully maintained gardens and villas or there is a buggy always available to transport you. You can choose to eat your breakfast and complimentary afternoon tea at the Dauh restaurant or in your villa. A good range of food and drink is available and was always beautifully presented. Not always piping hot, maybe due to the distance between the kitchen and the villa, but no complaints. The staff is exceptional. From being treated like royalty upon check in to arranging reservations or transporting you to/from local restaurants, shops and spas. And everyone seems to know your name! The villas are located on Jalan Petitgenet in northern Seminyak just up the road from Hu’u bar and Nutmeg restaurant, the Living Room (over-rated), Body Works spa (very reasonable prices), the Samaya, La Lucciola and The Legian hotel. Ku De Ta (well worth a visit) and eat street are just a 5 minute drive away. We stayed at the sister resort, the Samaya, last year and as far as I’m concerned the Kayana wins hands down for value and service.

author: kathylee1
title: Better than other places that were twice the cost
text: We booked out stay at the Kayana through Booking.com, which i use regularly now and is always very reliable. After a week in Sanur and a few nights staying in Ubud, my boyfriend and i arrived at Kayana. It is perfectly located a short walk from some of the trendiest restaurants (The Living Room and Hu'u, and very close to Ku De Ta), and has a immediately calm atmosphere. The rooms are all individual buildings with high walls, making the each room incredibly private. We were really blown away, the private plunge pool can be heated and our garden had a beautiful Frangapani tree. Also in the garden was an outdoor seating area where meals can be served for you (far nicer than in the restuarant). The rooms are very spacious, with everything you would expect. Excellent quality bed linens with mosquito nets. I love the ipod music dock - great touch. Wonderful modern design, DVD players, free drinks in the mini-bar.. Just makes life so much easier.
