Great Juliet type balcony, sound proofing is good because our balcony faced the front of the hotel which is kind of busy at times, but we hear nothing with window closed. Some minor inconvenience: - Bathroom is a little old, but it’s clean. The problem is the frost glass door, both side of the door has a huge gap, if you look straight into it then you can see the inside of the bathroom. However, I did try to lay on the bed (facing the bathroom door) at different angles, if you don’t look straight into the gaps, you can’t really SEE the inside. - The shower has a swinging glass door that goes about half of the length of the tub, water leaks very easily and makes my shower very uncomfortable as I tried not to move around too much, and the bottom of the tub is squishy soft type of material. - WIFI is super slow and weak in the room, it keeps dropping, and even when it’s connected, it’s like 1.5mb/s! Some mornings I even have to sit outside in the hallway to get better WIFI (better is still only around 5mb/s) Overall, it’s still an okay stay, nothing major, but with the wifi being snail speed and the bathroom not that nice.. I can't give it a 4 star.

author: Tuney1774
title: Great location but absolutely no sleep
text: Absolutely fab location. Friendly staff. Clean rooms. Good WiFi. Now for the rub. We had room 015. Hot as hell in February and air con not yet switched on. So either you don’t sleep because it is too hot or you open the windows. Wrong. Our room was directly 1 floor above the road near a busy church. Church bells a go go. Also 1 floor above a lively local bar where the locals hangout noisily on the street until the early hours. Oh and throw in car noise and rubbish trucks at 4am resulted in the worst 3 nights sleep in a row I have ever had. Should have asked to be moved but we are English - we just put up with things and moan afterwards. Wouldn’t ever stay here again for that reason alone. Everything else was marvellous. If you go avoid rooms 015 and 016 in particular.

author: MakHongKong
title: Great staff makes a great hotel
text: We stayed at this property for three nights from 14 Feb. Inside the old town, the location of the hotel cannot be better, as one can walk from there to most major monuments plus the convenience of a number of bars and dining options in the area. The hotel is modern and its staff is unbelievable helpful. What we like most about the staff is their responsiveness and the way they render their service always with a smile. Mind you, a number of rooms (only the very superior rooms are upstairs) are located on the ground floor but still they enjoy much privacy. The breakfast is very good with both cold and hot items. In fact, there are two dining rooms for breakfast, one on the ground floor and the other a level down. Guests can enjoy all day complimentary coffee and tea, available in the lower level dining room. If you need a taxi, the reception can help call one for you. With the Seville airport only some 9 km from the city centre, it is most convenient to take a taxi to the hotel. On arrival late at night, we paid 25 euros for the trip, including two bags, while the ride from the hotel to the train station (around 1.6 km), we paid 8 euros (rounded up/this was close to a fare suggested by the hotel). Possibly, we got ripped off a bit on arrival but the fare was still "reasonable". In addition to all the monuments, being in Seville, it is almost a must to see a flamenco show. We spent some time checking out online the options and finally went to the Tablao Alvarez Quintero. We made our decision based on a few factors: it offers two different show times (19:00 & 20:30) while most others start pretty late, it is so close to our hotel and it is a pure dance performance (not dinner show). The show was one of the best we have ever seen. When arriving at the venue, we were a bit worried because there were a few small children. But the show was so good that even the little ones were all mesmerised!

author: Karen396
title: Very good Service. Average hotel
text: We stayed at this property on Feb 2-3,2017. Location is very central to everything . within walking distance. all the sightseeing as well as the shopping , markets, bakeries,restaurants all within walking distance. special mention to the front desk employees who are very helpful with directions, suggestions etc. The hotel itself......is petite as the name itself. rooms are rather small.we particularly did not like the layout of the room with the bunk beds . everything is in just one room with no privacy . the washrooms are right in the room , just with a glass door that does not close, so you can imagine the intimidating factor , while going to the bathroom and someone sleeping right outside !!!! there was just a small desk and a chair. the desk was so small , it could hardly hold the coffee machine. the mini fridge comes with pay , even water , however they have juice, tea, coffee and water after 1.0p.m to 12.0 midnight free in restaurant. which is nice.( be careful with timing as their timing is not same as north american) We did not eat breakfast at the hotel as it was too expensive. so cannot comment . There are lots of options nearby. even Mcdonalds , Burger King , Dunkin donoghts and Starbucks and lots of good pastry shops. overall good value for money minus the " PETITE" size of the rooms. it is no-frills hotel which is good for short stay.

author: LUchicago
title: Lovely
text: Our reservation indicated check in time was 12:00 so when we arrived at 12:45 we were disappointed that our room wouldn't be ready for an hour. We were offered an option of an upgrade to a superior room for 20 Euro a night more and immediate availability. It sounded like a hustle so we declined. When we returned, we were asked to sign papers which we assumed were for future credit card charges. When we later read the form, we were quite upset to discover that we had given the hotel permission to share our personal information! When we later retracted the signature, we expressed our dismay and concern about this misleading practice. Our room number 016 was up two short flights of marble stairs. It was a small, modern room with a comfy queen bed, a window looking out at St Nicolas church but adjacent to the public garbage and recycling bins. The bathroom was small, but modern with a large shower. Immaculate. The safe required a credit card swipe which did not work. The staff needed to adjust the batteries. This system proved to be inefficient, as the safe at another Petit Palace in Madrid required major repair. The breakfast included fresh fruit, eggs, sausages, cold meat, breads, yogurt, cheeses, cold cereal, pastries, juices, coffee and tea. The breakfast room was a lovely open courtyard. Coffee was available most of the day in the reading room. This is a pleasant hotel, well located, walking distance to Casa de Pilatos, Alcazar, Parque de Maria Luisa, Plaza de Espana, the cathedral and cafes. It is a 10 Euro taxi fare from the train station.

author: baltimorebeachbum222
title: Great for a short stay and large family.
text: We spent one night in Seville. We typically rent apartments for our family of 5, but that's impossible to do for 1 night. I was amazed to find a hotel that could accommodate a family of 5 in 1 room. The rooms are simple, but very clean. 2 sets of bunk beds, a full bed and a sofa. Plenty of room to stretch out. There was a musty smell when we arrived, but an hour of open windows freshened it up. While I would not want to stay here for more than a few nights, it was perfect for our needs. They brought gifts of pick up sticks and biscuits for the kids. There were plenty of nice toiletries for the entire family. The location is central to everything although we seemed to get lost finding our way back every time. I felt like we were back in Venice. The front desk staff varied from very helpful and friendly to those who were not as helpful. I would stay here again if in need of a large room for a family. We did not have the breakfast, but it looked like there was a nice outdoor area to eat. For the price and quality, we couldn't beat it.

author: EWTG1
title: Brilliant Location, great staff
text: Lets get one thing out of the way, the Petit Palace styles itself as a high tech hotel. It isn't. You can't link your smart phone to the room TV, there isn't an ipod dock, but you do have free wifi. Thats the bad, such as it is. Now to the good. The hotel is brilliantly located in Santa Cruz within easy walking distance of all the main sites (and some great tapas bars: the Alfalfa is literally 3 minutes away). The breakfast is plentiful with a good hot or cold choice and some decent coffee (self serve). If you are a tea drinker that's catered for as well with a number of blends, but be sure to ask for a tea pot. The lobby is comfortable with a selection of designer chairs and there is a small quadrangle open to the sky where smokers can do their thing, but the smoke does "waft" into the rooms that over look the area if your window is open. The rooms are well presented albeit a little small with great en suites, walled in opaque glass (with glass doors and erm how shall I say... no soundproofing! But with evening meals in Spain being late, 21:30 is early to the Spanish, you don't spend a lot of time in the room! The beds are large with comfy mattresses but I had to ask for extra pillows (which were provided almost instantly). Both rooms on our trip had an issue with the credit card operated safes, but these were rectified quickly. We booked the "romance" package with the inclusive bubbly and chocolates which was nice although our friends got more chocolates than we did :-(! The rooms have air con but this is only operated in the summer months although we had temps of 27 degrees during our stay in early March. Most staff spoke reasonable to good english and the receptionists were very pleasant and helpful. The paper map provided by the hotel was far better than the ones we bought in the UK. Reception also booked us a taxi back to the airport and were spot on with the timings from order to arrival and journey time. Being in the midst of the old town its not the quietest of hotels and the church bells can be intrusive but as a place to stay in Seville for a short break it's almost impossible to fault.

author: ThelmaM870
title: Some staff needs some trainning
text: Good and bad things about this hotel. Liked the location, you can walk to many attractions, it is charming and the building is also very nice and clean. Room was small but modern, quite noise was it was facing the breakfast area. The bad thing was about breakfast, it was nice and simple but no cutlery was available so when I asked the attendant for a knife she said she did not have it. I found it strange so thought maybe was a language barrier so I tried in Spanish ( I am half Spanish and half Brazilian so i am sure she could understand). So I did point to her what I was looking for to be 100% clear and she again said, sorry, it is finished. So I asked her how I was supposed to use butter and cut things during my meal and she mentioned she would wash on. Surprisingly 3 minutes later she approached my table with that knife...DIRTY!!! She had the courage to just wipe it with a napkin instead of washing it. How can someone , in any sense, offers an used dirty knife to another, as a service or as a human being? Honestly??? I lost my appetite and left my table and went to show the reception manager that. She apologized and said she was not used to work on breakfast. This is not an excuse...not even in my house I would be able to do that no matter to who! Just about sense and respect! Anyway...I hope she improves so others can have a better experience than I did and this was a big turn off!

author: sentout2016
title: Boutique hotel in Santa Cruz area of glorious Sevilla
text: Not the easiest hotel to find on foot, first visit best done by taxi unless self drive with sat nav. Once there, however, the hotel was everything we hoped for and expected. Reception staff were helpful, efficient and welcoming. No hidden surprises. Hotel interestingly furnished, lounge area relaxing and cool. Bedroom and bathroom were good size and well equipped. Comfortable king size bed which allowed good night sleep especially as there were no outside noises/disturbances. Towels in bathroom were all new and good be changed each day, if desired. Constant hot water. Cleaner very friendly and thorough. Excellent buffet breakfast 8.00 to 10.00, later on weekends. Good choice including cereals, fruits, meats, cheeses, cooked selection, choice of juices, non stop tea and coffee, cakes, cheesecake and so on. Free drinks in lounge available through the day. Free wifi was available all day and free bikes could be booked for parts of the day. The location of the hotel in the middle of the old town with its numerous historical sites,bars, cafés and restaurants added to an enjoyable experience.

author: IrishDonamici
title: Nice, city centre hotel
text: Our second trip to Sevile and rather than stay in one of the larger hotels further out of town we chose this hotel near the centre. The location is superb, a short stroll from the Cathedral, Alcazar and main shopping areas. The hotel is clean and the staff helpful. We parked in the hotel carpark, a bit of a nightmare to drive to, and a challenge to park in, if you have a larger car it is a nerve wracking procedure. But it is convenient and cost €20 for the day we were there. A nice touch was the free juice on arrival. The rooms: we had a family room, double bed and bunk. The room was clean, modern and nicely decorated with a spacious bathroom. The beds were VERY firm, and the pillows were too flat, not a great combination. The top bunk had a guard rail but it was set so low as to be useless. We did not feel it was safe to leave a kid up there so moved the mattress onto the floor for the night. Otherwise the room was spacious and clean, with the added bonus of a laptop, free wifi and mini bar. Would we return? It is a nice hotel with great staff, in a lovely location, but a good nights sleep is important after a long day sightseeing. If the mattresses and pillows were more comfortable then 100%, as it is not so sure I would return.

author: TrishaMcD4
title: Great hotel, great location and free services such as iPad hire. Loved it!
text: I really liked this hotel for many reasons: Its a few minutes walk from Cathedral and Alcazar. Santa Cruz is one of the oldest districts in Seville and i have stayed in Seville four times now and it is the best area in which to sample proper Spanish living. The hotel has a free laptop in your room for your use. WiFi was excellent, good strong signal for my smartfone use. The rooms are modern cool and comfortable. Air conditioning quiet. They had an area for guests to help themselves to freshly ground coffee, mineral water, orange juice. On the day we arrived there were pastries. Free bike here, free walking tour and free ipad hire. Honestly whats not to like?! Stayed for one night and am confused with the comments on the beds below. Our bed was large and very comfortabe. We asked could we check out late and did so with no supplement. The staff were extremely helpful on all counts. In the words of Arnie: "I will be back"!

author: PamDeJager
title: Small managerial issues
text: Reception and front desk staff very helpful and friendly! They can communicate in English which was welcoming. Comfortable room with free laptop and internet - this was wonderful! Well situated and close to all the historical sites as well as many restaurants (breakfast expensive in hotel). Lovely inviting entrance and reception area! The free bike was indeed a wonderful surprise and a lovely way to explore the town! A hotel with lots of potential to be outstanding. The managerial issues are however to be sorted out first. The promised times for free refreshments - water, coffee and juice - was not always met. The manager must check up on this aspect. The area was not clean and the floor sticky - the dustbin was overflowing! The smoking area must be checked upon regularly as the ashtrays were not cleaned regularly. The bikes must be inspected before handed over to the guests to ensure that they are fine! The non-smoking room did not smell like one - we were offered two alternatives - but they smelled the same! The front desk staff had to see to requests of guests at dining area where refreshments were supposed to be!

author: JellybabyLondon
title: Definitely not 4 star - find somewhere else
text: We stayed at the Petit Palace for 6 nights and I dont think we're high maintanence guests but I was really disappointed with this hotel. The hotel is over priced and definitely not 4 star. The loaction is perfect but apart from that, the hotel has few redeeming features. 1. The basement rooms are damp and smelly and the wallpaper is peeling off the walls, we asked to move to a different room. 2. The room we had was a good size but the beds are like camp beds and the linen and pillows are poor quality which means that you wont get a good nights sleep at this hotel. 3. Other reviews have said the staff were rude, we encountered one really rude member of staff and one really helpful member of staff who apologised profusely for everything. 4. The hotel is part of the "high tech" hotels range however we had problems with the wireless internet and the tv did not have any international channels so after a hard day's sight seeing and eating you're left to watch a bit of surreal spanish tv before heading out for the night. The hotel has no proper lobby or bar so you cant even relax in there at the end of the day. 5. The hydromassage shower that the hotel harps on about is about as powerful as a slight drizzle which does nothing to sotthe your aching muscles after a poor nights sleep. Ultimately if this hotel was 3 star and a lot cheaper it would be ok but its not a 4 star hotel and definitely not worth the money they charge. We found a lot better 2/3 star hotels in the same area which appeared a lot better value for money.

author: JulieBirdie
title: Boutique hotel – You must be joking!
text: I would rate this hotel as a poor 3* certainly not a Boutique 4*. Here are the good points: 1. Location not too bad 2. Presentable exterior 3. Free use of hotel bike 4. Dell laptop in bedrooms Here are the bad points: * Beds & Bedrooms – the worst nights sleep we have ever had! You’d get a better night sleep on a park bench; having complained every morning about how hard the beds were, they never did anything to rectify this! * Bed Linen – There was a huge yellow stain on my pillow case and holes in the sheets – and the sheets looked generally dirty. I did request more pillows, well pillows that weren’t like slab stones but we never received them – although the receptionist tried to argue this point with me saying the housekeeper had given us extra pillows – she was so rude about it! I will post the pictures of this boutique hotels bed linen. 3. Toiletries – appalling – take your own – you would fine better at a budget hotel – absolutely the worst ever encountered! The room we had was nowhere near the standard of those advertised on the web. 3. Breakfast – is very expensive if you haven’t included this in your room rate. Hot buffet was cold every day – uninteresting and by day 4 we just didn’t fancy any of it!. This again was the worst breakfast we have ever encountered. The main issue we had with this hotel is that it did not live up to our expectations based on what we saw on the hotel's web site. This hotel was such a disappointment there was nothing to do there, – no hotel bar to sit at for a night cap, no cosy area to mooch about and relax and certainly no luxury room to end your day in – this hotel ruined our stay in Seville as we walk round like aching zombies through lack of sleep. Do not waste you money on this hotel – move on and look at another hotel.

author: ParadiseChick
title: Luxurious & Perfect Location
text: Any of the hotels in this area (Santa Cruz) are well located as a base for tourism and leisure but this hotel is the best as its not on a windy tight little cobbled street but on a wide plaza with a supermarket opposite too - feels more roomy and airy. We booked though an online site but unfortunately they could not find our reservation - took about 10 mins for them to sort us out with a room and it was on the ground floor. The whole hotel is lovely - very beautifully decorated and the rooms and very luxurious - comfy bed, excellent and clean bathroom with double shower, hairdryer, enough towels and toiletries. There's a TV and laptop in the room with internet access. You can also do things like upload photos on the computer (even store them on their temporarily if you are transferring to another device). The room has a safe and fridge/mini bar. There's several storage areas too and really nice lighting. The air conditioning was very cold at night (can be adjusted) so we used the spare blanket. There is a full length mirror in the room (some places don't have one of these vital things!). The room is not overly large - just big enough to walk around the bed plus a desk/dressing table and the en suite is an enclosed glass area on one side which takes up a lot of the room. But it does not feel too small for 2. The room was very clean and the bathroom was too - it all looked extremely luxury (definitely 4* standard). We didn't eat at the hotel - 15euros each for breakfast (they said they had a promotion for 8euro each breakfast too) but it was around 2-3euros just around the corner. Breakfast in the hotel was in the quad area which our ground floor room looked onto. Location was very close to plenty of eateries, the Arab bath is just around the corner, plus a traditional flamenco place and the Cathedral is within 10 mins. Train station is 30-40 mins walk The staff spoke English but we didn't need them very much. It's a quiet hotel - we did not experience any noisiness or anything unpleasant at all in our stay!

author: Ian_Whitaker
title: Spacious. Modern. Central. All that was missing was a lock on the bathroom door
text: Ok. I'll admit I read this on trip advisor - the rooms don't have locks on the bathroom door, and I thought they were kidding. But no. They didn't. Which actually after a while is a bit weird. The door doesn't shut properly. So your most private moments on your own don't feel that private. The laptop was handy. It was central. Clean. Big bed. Spacious room. It has a fab bit of roman history in the basement, and is all subtle lighting upstairs. It is a good hotel. I'd stay there again. Just I'd want a lock on the bathroom door.

author: cheeseburger23
title: Good value for money
text: We stayed at the Petit Palace Santa Cruz for five nights in July 2008. The good: -Fantastic location. Wonderfully central to all of the sights, good restaurants, and in a quirky Santa Cruz neighborhood with winding medieval streets. -Good standard of cleanliness in the rooms. -Amazing air conditioning. It was 108F/42C while we were there and the room stayed cool. -Free wi-fi, a few English channels on the tv. -Helpful staff. -Very inexpensive as European hotels go. The not-so-good: -THE BED. Yikes. Hard as a rock. Both my husband and I had sore backs from staying in this hotel. -Staying in a hotel that does not serve food was trickier for us than we guessed. Seville restaurants have odd hours because of siesta and later dinner times, and there were no small cafes or supermarkets near the hotel, so we were often stressed to get food. -Shower was a bit on the grungy side. You can tell it was nice and high-tech once, but the nozzles really needed some cleaning. And don't bother trying to get cold water in the Andalusian summer. :) Overall, if it weren't for the bed, I would recommend this establishment to anyone, but having sore backs really hampered my enjoyment of Seville. But if you have a back of steel, this hotel offers great value for money.

author: orangeSaisInWales
title: YES AND NO
text: Excellent location on a quiet square. Room (212) very small with only window opening onto breakfast courtyard. However, this became something of a blessing with the weather being very warm indeed -gave us instant shade.Very good air-conditioning. Bathroom a pain, however. Glass screen dividing shower/bath from rest of bathroom meant that you had to get into the bath to turn on the water which is silly. Cold water pressure less than hot so baths took a very long time. Breakfast good but why vile coffee from a machine? And why, In SEVILLE, where there is not exactly a shortage of oranges, no fresh-squeezed juice? Also why say breakfast was ten euros when it actually came out at 14 with tax? Much better to pop down San Jose and have a croissant or two, or churros, for much less money in much nicer surroundings. Oh yes......bed like a brick....Why?? Seville is a wonderful city. Hotel could be really good with a bit of attention to detail. Our ceiling, for example, had not been painted properly and the paper was beginning to peel. But the room was clean and tidied every day although the sheets were not always changed. Would I stay there again? Jury's out - definitely not in that room but if they offered us something bigger and better, perhaps.

author: acavenezia
title: Would Not stay again.
text: Stayed here Dec 2007, first of all i must say the weather is perfect during december! I'll keep it simple and short. All other hotels were booked. Originally wanted Don`a Maria ( if you can , stay here)right by cathedral). This hotel is trying to be VERY modern... and what i mean is.... The colors are gray, chrome, white and black. Very gloomy. There is lots of plastic being used. The rooms have no view.again very gloomy. If you come to southern spain... you want something tradional and pretty. This hotel reminded me of being in a space ship. Dont know how else to explain it. Location was ok...but there are better ones. I would not recommend this hotel.

author: lousally
title: Cool and Snazzy!
text: We recently spent 3 nights at the Petit Palace Santa Cruz in Seville. This was not actually my first choice (Dona Maria being fully booked) as I had thought it a little bit too expensive and not very authentic. However, having now stayed there I can report that it is a very nice hotel nonetheless. It is a "boutique" hotel, so decked out all modern and contemporary - lots of grey, white, black and straight lines. Whacky chairs in reception. Nice room - big beds, flat screen TV, amazing shower - jets of water coming at you from all directions!. Not much in way of wardrobe space but not a huge problem. Breakfast was the usual buffet, help yourself style, but eaten in a lovely courtyard in the centre of the hotel - very pleasant. We really liked the snazziness of our room, it was pretty cool. If you want something old fashioned and authentic I would say this is not for you, but if you like the contemporary look you will be in design heaven. The staff at front desk were very helpful (especially when my room card twice failed to work). The location is also extremely good, a few streets away from the Cathedral, right in the old town. One big tip for this town - before you do anything else - go to Sierpes (main shopping street) - there's a book shop - near the front there are maps - one of them is a detailed street map of the old town - buy it immediately! I defy anyone not to get lost in this town. The narrow streets are incredibly confusing. On conclusion, I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Seville.

author: Gelena15
title: Great location, service could be better
text: I took my parents for a treat in April and one of the reasons why I chose it was because of the location and because it offered triple rooms. I was glad to find that the location couldn't be better. It is near everywhere and it is perfect in that respect. However, I think it is overpriced for a number of reasons. Although we booked in February, when we arrived on a Sunday evening we were given a room on the ground floor, close to the reception desk. This room was extremely noisy- you could hear all the conversations from the reception, the steps from the people getting into and out of the hotel and the noise coming from the shower in the upper floor! Make sure they don't give you a room on the ground floor. The receptionists were unfriendly and I almost had to beg them to change the room for one on the first floor. Considering that I was paying a considerable amount of money per night, I felt treated as if I was in a 1 star hotel. The service you can get is far from a 4 star hotel. As regards cleanliness, I agree with other people that the bathroom is not totally clean. I found used shampoo bottles in it and some hair in the bathtub. Overall, make sure you book in another hotel in the same area, which is fantastic. The hotel is overpriced because rooms have a jacuzzi and free internet connection... Next time I will certainly go somewhere else!

author: Jetstream1958
title: Location, Location, Location
text: Before I review the hotel, I have to mention, that our stay in Andalusia coincided with some of the worst weather this part of the world has experienced over the past 10 years. We had snow, freezing cold, rain, hail, thunderstorms, strong winds and in between a few minutes of sunshine. The Santa Cruz is a prefect place from where to explore the city of Seville. Only a few steps from the Cathedral and almost every other attraction. The hotel tries to be High-Tech, but I think they tried too hard, which creates – in our opinion – a rather cold atmosphere (but then maybe it was just the weather?). The small lobby reminded us of a museum of modern art. The rooms are small, but well equipped and everything worked fine. However, what use is a nice flat screen LCD-TV with only a handful of Spanish channels plus a German, French and English News-channel of which most of them had a bad reception (a problem I encounter in almost all hotels worldwide). One big minus for this hotel is the lack of cleanliness. The so called 'sanitized' Toilet was covered in some indefinable, tried stuff and the same substance could be found on the bathroom floor and the room carpet – disgusting! The breakfast room is very small and in some kind of cellar. Breakfast was ok, nothing special, just acceptable. Staff in the hotel (if they could be found) where as polite as you might expect in Spanish Tourist Spots. They do their job, nothing more, nothing less. If I recommend this Hotel, I do it for the location. That's the reason I would stay there again, its probably the best value for money and location to be found in Seville. Hasta luego

author: Phicus
title: Comfortable, Modern, Safe, Freindly, Reasonably priced and, loved it
text: We booked on a third part website for 120 Euros per room per night, its good to shop around as there were quite a few different prices out there. The hotel is located through some pretty tight streets and, it pays to be taken there by cab the first time if you've never visited Sevilla before just to get your bearings. the front of the hotel is on a small non descript square. The interior is all white marble, modern furniture in reds and, greys. We arrived in the evening to a freindly checkin, the room was on the ground floor which backed onto the lane we opened the window to find that we were actually mid street level read...The street was at shoulder height, we were actually below street level. Went back to reception and, was given keys to another room on the 1st floor front of the buliding, no# 12 I think from memory. The room was great, everything you need. minibar, safe, Separately controlled aircon, cable TV etc, they did not have and, Iron and, ironing board in the room though and, when I asked for one they could only provide an Iron, it was delivered in 10 seconds though and, with a smile so i can forgive them, but the realk winner was the Shower, its one of the oversized shower heads that just dumps water on you. It was shower over bath but there are other rooms with just the shower. The walls of the bathroom are frosted glass however so discreet visits to the toilet at any time are not possible. We didn't dine in the hotel but they apparently provided a continental breakfast in a small but clean breakfast room with a plasma TV or a small internal courtyard. The reception desk is also concierge and, they are very helpful and, freindly, they may seem rude but you just have to ask and they are happy to help and, tell you about their beautiful city. They also have Free highspeed internet on a laptop in the Foyer which is not the most private but its free. they apparently have rooms with Free internet on a computer but Im not sure how that works but its a nice touch none the less. Its very central and, there are some great Tapas bars around the corner and, Two super markets very close by as well. Just remember about siesta time!!!!

author: gsjrs
title: a little luxury in the old town
text: Great location, when you can find it! Sevilla is the city to get lost in so be prepared and don't stress when you get lost in the narrow windy streets of the Barrio Santa Cruz, it's part of the experience of Sevilla! You won't be the only one walking around with a map! The hotel was a little more expensive than we would have preferred, however, we were staying over New Year's Eve so it was expected. And on New Year's Eve we received a complimentary small bottle of Cava to celebrate! The rooms were quite spacious compared to other hotels we stayed in through Spain. Lots of room for two people! The bathrooms are big and bright, the shower is like a waterfall and the tub was long enough for a tall person (a luxury after some of the standup showers in other hotels). The beds were very comfy, but I prefer a hard bed, my problem is with feather pillows, which i can't stand. There is accessible free internet in the lobby 24hrs, provided another guest isn't using the computers. When we need directions to Lisbon, they front desk staff we very helpful, even allowing us behind the counter to print off a map from the computer. There isn't a lot of interaction with the staff, but when you need something they are there with a smile. Breakfast was a little pricey, instead I'd suggest taking a right outside the hotel down the street to the best little bakery and pick up a cheap croissant and coffee. And because the hotel is located in old town Sevilla, don't bring your car. Instead take a taxi because they know where the hotel is and it's a lot more convenient and hassle free!

author: LKP-VA
title: Driving? Don't even think about staying here!
text: Using a rental car, it took us from 8:30 p.m. until midnight to finally settle the issues of 1) where is the hotel? and 2) where do we put the car? If you only have one night to spend in Seville (as we did), don't spend it here - you'll waste it on these issues! Part of the parking problem was that they have about three spaces out front (at a busy, tiny local intersection) and then they send you to a parking garage that is many blocks away that is full when you arrive (they don't reserve any spots for guests of the hotel), then they act surprised that you found it was full, and then they tell you to try another garage that is plainly too far away to walk back from, so you go in search of what you hope is legal street parking (and you worry all night that maybe where you finally parked was not legal and your car will be gone by the time you walk back to it in the morning). Finally back at the hotel by midnight, you reach for the TV remote (at this "high-tech" hotel), and find there isn't one. You go to the front desk, and they don't have a spare. Tough luck. The room itself is otherwise adequate, but not nearly as nice as the pictures of the lobby imply. The prior comments about cheap plastic we found to be true. The hotel itself is situated at a rather busy little intersection, and our room was noisier than it should have been (enough to make sleeping difficult, even with the use of a noisemaker). Lastly, the beds were way too hard, and in December they had no blankets to speak of (we froze in the wee hours, using a throw and the one blanket in the closet). Honestly, this was one of the most stressful travel experiences we've had, hotel-wise. I really can't recommend staying here, especially if you don't already know how to get there and you have a car to store. Lisa from Williamsburg, VA

author: curlyfrogypsy
title: Ehhh, but Doable!
text: The resort itself is only a 1/2 hour drive from the airport. The lobby is the only area of free WiFi and is beautiful with a bar area. The resort itself appears well maintained. But digging below the surface is where flaws are found. Our room was sufficient for our stay; 2 full size beds in one area with another area having a sofa and luggage rack. Our other 4 friends shared a “suite” and that was quite cramped for 4 people; three full sized beds, 2 small baths. The rooms smelled of dampness and even upon coming home the clothing I didn’t wear I had to launder because it smells like wet basement. The air conditioning didn’t cool the rooms well but luckily there were ceiling fans. Our bathroom was a good size but truly needed a good bleaching; there was moldy grout and it was a bit dingy. We often had to ask for hand towels and wash cloths. The water to shower with was luke warm at best. My friends had cold water the last day. The beds only had sheets; no coverlets. The rooms were made each day but the one day the maid helped herself to my T-shirt and shorts I had been sleeping in and I had to call the front desk to get them back. The pools, bar areas, dining areas, etc are beautifully kept. The beach for the resort is kept very clean and the only complaint I could make is that there is no waitstaff patrolling the beach, serving drinks; kind of a bummer.

author: Jah210768
title: Wonderful Gardens and Beach
text: Stayed here in March 2019. Complex is large with wonderful gardens and beaches. Rooms are in need of some modernisation but how long do you stay in the room! Cleaners do a great job. Our air conditioning was non existent but I can't use it anyway and there is no air conditioning in main buildings as they are all open (without sides). Lovely to see pheasants, ducks, lizards, birds walking around and mixing in. If you are looking to relax in the complex for your duration then this is great, however not sure there would be enough to do if you stayed for two weeks. We stayed for one. DR is not a place I would have felt safe walking outside the complex and there is little around the hotel anyway. They charge 3dollars a night for the use of the safe. Beach towels are free, however there is a problem with people putting towels on their sunbeams early or in some cases the night before! We got up 7.30 one morning thinking we would get some shade on the Beach but all the beds under the umbrellas were already taken so we had the last two beds under a tree. There were beds around the pool available. Staff were lovely and friendly. Fridge in the room with coke, sprite and water refilled daily.Towels changed every couple of days. I would definitely rate as a three star mainly because of the gardens and beach.

author: laviajeracanadiense
title: Such a fun trip in Punta Cana!!!
text: This was our first time in the Dominican Republic and the Tropical Princess Beach Resort did not disappoint! The beach was beautiful, clean and there was a snack bar near by for whenever you got hungry. The water was clear but you can expect some seaweed here and there. We found our room not clean on our first night which was unfortunate. And many times throughout the week we had to call reception about the water or for clean towels. Wifi at the reception wasn't the best due to many people using it at once. The nature and wildlife at the resort was beautiful. The rooms were so colourful and there were birds like flamingos and peacocks I have never seen in person before. The entertainment crew and night shows were truly a hit! If you are planning to go to this resort, you will love the entertainment. The entertainment host is hilarious and constantly making jokes.The crew is very friendly and always want you to participate in games. Juli, an amazing entertainer truly made our trip memorable. He was very funny, kind, friendly and made everyone around him happy. Big shout out to him and the other entertainment crew for making our trip so fun! I love Punta Cana and Tropical Princess Resort. Can't wait to go back there!

author: kimbsmith
title: Solo Traveler save
text: Had an Airbnb next door that was frightening. Walked over and booked a room for a week. Did have some issues with checking in. They kept my passport supposedly because cc machine didn’t work. Hard to get a price for the week and they had someone else’s name on room. In the end it all worked out. Felt safe here-bartender Grey was awesome! She knew my drink all week and was very friendly. Singles can’t make reservations at the restaurants but made several friends who invited me along. Beach was awesome! Beautiful water and mostly clean. Cleaning staff left patio door unlocked so make sure you check! No hot water in shower. Brush up on your Spanish! Overall staff very friendly. Room clean. Food was ok at buffet-better at Italian (great!) and Mexican restaurant. Would probably stay here again.

author: Melissa3008
title: PLEASE STAY WELL AWAY FROM THIS HOTEL.
text: Dirty hole, worst holiday i have ever had. The local staff dont like the British. Rooms are not clean and we had sand in the corner of our room on arrival and still there 2weeks later. My dress was put in the laundry by mistake. British get ignored at the bars. Constantley waiting for food. We was in a block that was like ibiza music banging from others rooms. Bed sheets not even made daily well the top one was but the bottom not touch at all. Pools dirty. Entertainment in your face on the beach, too loud. .security move your sun beds to make areas for entertainment games. Couldn't wait to get home. I got fed up of waiting for a tray of tomatoes to be placed in the food hall. Local staff need to smile and look like they enjoy their jobs. Stay away hotel needs updating im suprised Tui even use such a bad hotel.

author: shannonlee1997
title: The tropical princess, Dominican Republic
text: My stay here was lovely, but the resort has a lot of improvements to make. I’ve been to every Caribbean island, and Dominican Republic is my least favourite. The beach is packed with people selling stuff, and they do pester you all day. The water isn’t clear as this resort is on the Atlantic side of the ocean, not the Caribbean side. The resort it’s self is very tired. It’s a huge resort and the resort has a regular cart service which allows you to travel from one part of the resort to the other. (For example, from reception to the restaurant). This resort is more of a nature reserve resort. The one positive I have is the wildlife here. Everywhere you look there’s an exotic bird or a lizard or just something that manages to take your breath away. It has beautiful grounds, and Is very green and bright. The staff here do not speak very good English at all so is very hard to communicate. The food in this resort isn’t the best. There’s a lot of options but personally I didn’t rate the food at all. There are 4 big pools in this resort, they were all dirty and filled with leaves/hairs. Which wasn’t very nice. The room I stayed in was very tired, and I had trouble locking the door a lot of the time. Overall, I wouldn’t come back to this resort. Unless it had a total revamp. I doubt I’ll come back to Dominican Republic as a whole.

author: eveya2015
title: Wondeful waves and beach, beautiful sunrises
text: Pretty nice hotel but a bit dated. The staff are absolutely lovely in the mian restaurant. The pools (3) are gorgeous, but we stayed away from the one with the swim up bar, a bit too noisy and drunk for our tastes.Our room had no air con when we arrived. The maintenance said it took a little time to come on and it was working. It was not and an hour later I demanded to move rooms. Luckily we had a working rooms on the other side of the building overlooking the nicest pool. It was a bit dirty, the bathroom door got stuck a few times. I guess the hotel would have been really lovely a good few years ago, but really needs an overhaul. There were lots of drunk people shouting in corridors late at night. Try to speak Spanish when you are there and learn some words for some of the food choices. A lot of people were pointing and grunting which was so rude. Even my kids (8 and 10) ordered and spoke Spanish basics so grown ups should be able to. I would have gone to the Bavaro or one of the other hotels instead as this one although the ground are lovely (turtles, flamingoes etc) and the pools great and the beach fab! the rooms were not up to par. We chose this one as it had seperate bedroom in the family suit, and could accomodate a family of 6 (three double beds). Mini disco was terrible, the same dated CD (superman Black Lace!?!?!!!!!) every night with a less than enthusiastic member of staff doing the actions. Would have been so much better having three members of staff dancing a bit on the stage and alternative tunes, it can't be that hard to find more songs. The kids club was lovely however with a great Halloween party. All in all we had a wonderful relaxing holiday mostly reading on the beach and body surfing the wonderful waves with the kids. Kids will need to be good swimmers and not mind seaweed.

author: DayTrip780495
title: Beautiful resort
text: We came back from this resort on Monday 15th October. My self and my husband were bowled over with the service we have received on our 11 night stay. The lobby was lovely and the receptionist staff really welcoming. We spent most of our time at the sunken pool and also the beach. We enjoyed a very friendly service from Joel and the other barman there. The mangroves were a delight we enjoyed feeding the iguanas and ducks. We didn't make it to the evening entertainment it was at 9.45pm. The higuero restaurant was lovely and we never grew tired of eating there and we even managed breakfast and dinner most days. We also had a couples dinner. As invited by the hotel, I had a bit of sunstroke so wasn't well however my husband enjoyed a 4 course dinner. Mexican wasn't great the food was a bit bland but it was nicely decorated and my husband had his first margarita! Our room 1305 was very well situated and we had a lovely maid who stocked our fridge with water and soft drinks daily. We would say that the traders being let onto the resort was very annoying particularly as we had to tell each of them no. Despite explaining we were leaving and had no room in our cases. Overall the hotel was lovely a bit tired in places but the staff were lovely and that made it for us !

author: 4AnaM_13
title: Nice resort
text: This is a nice resort with very friendly employees and a great atmosphere. The lobby is big and open with a bar and live music. Guest services are informative and nice in helping with any information you need for tours or shopping. Nexus Tour had an employee in the lobby who gave us information on tours and we took the one to Saona. You must take this all day tour. You are taken from hotel to beach area and leave on a boat for day trip. Half way there, you stop at a nice beach area where there are lots of boats and water is up to your waist or lower. Guides then treat you to free drinks (alcohol, yum) in the water. Pictures are being taken by guides throughout entire trip. When back on bus, you will be given a beautiful picture of you which is put on a local rum bottle which you can purchase for $20. Guides took great pictures. After a little while, you get back on boat and continue to small island where chefs and excellent food is waiting for you. All types of BBQ-chicken, meats, salads, rice, beans, drinks. Then you hang out at beach awhile with more entertainment. On way back, you return in a Catamaran where you are treated to live music and dancing and drinks. Great day trip. Resort has several pools and main pool has daily activities like shows and games. Resort is located on the beach and real nice. Very happy atmosphere and we will certainly return.

author: randybJ6185XI
title: Never again.
text: Booked by agent. Supposed to be 4 star lol!!! Bed was hard as a rock. Asked at least 5 times to change it or put something over it. They sent 1 blanket. Room was always a mess even after supposed maid service. Patio door didn't work until last night there after calling 3 times and stopping by front desk. Had issues with people trying to sell membership services. They tried running our cc 3 times when they were only authorized for 1 transaction. Chase called us as soon as they tried the 2 and 3rd time. When trying to meet with manager about issues. He was always in a meeting or to busy to help!!! S We had set a 10am appointment to meet and when we showed up he was busy. When returned in 20 like instructed he was busy and when calling back he was busy. Seems kinda fishy. Especially with meeting set up with him. Doors were broken and didn't work. Also no hot water the morning of our departure so so shower before flights. The other staff were great people. The business side of this resort needs to be fixed!!!

author: 228bethw
title: Not so Tropical Princess
text: My husband and two kids, 7 and 10 stayed here in June. Would NOT recommend! To start the room they put us in smelled musty had holes in the bedspread and the air conditioner didn’t work and the mini fridge was leaking! After several phone calls requesting a new room someone came to “check” the air conditioner. They told us seems to be working fine and left! I called the front desk several more times and was told I would have to come to the front desk the next day! Finally my husband had to walk to the front desk, which is a ways away and demand a new room. So at 10 at night we had to pack everything and carry our sleeping kids to the new room. Thankfully the air worked in this room but on the next day our hot water went out. We had to take cold showers for three days and nobody gave us an explanation or when it would be fixed. The food was mediocre and the customer service at the coffee shop was a joke! I would stand there staring at the employee and they would just keep working and ignore me. To no fault of their own I’m sure the beach was covered in feet deep sea weed that smelled bad! The hotel refused to credit back one of our nights when our flight was delayed and we by no fault of our own could make it in on time. NEVER would I stay here again even if I was given it for free! Would rate zero stars if it would let me.

author: nsss306
title: Tropical Princess Holiday
text: Me and my friends booked a week break at the Tropical princess resort in July, none of us had been to the Dominican so we didn't know what to expect- we wasn't disappointed! This hotel is situated on lovely big grounds, with wildlife roaming around freely. You can jump on and off the hotel bus which takes you around the complex, which is really handy! The rooms are very basic, but that's all you will need as you aren't really in them, having the mini fridge filled up each day was very nice We didn't bother trying out the different restaurants on the complex because the buffet offered such a range of food each day- we really enjoyed the pancakes in the morning and the pizza/ pasta stations! There is always something which will takes your fancy. You will never go hungry! The waiters were really good too and a good laugh. We were always greeted quickly and shown to a table, making sure our glasses were always full The beach/pool were also really lovely. We stayed on the main pool which had the swim up pool bar. The staff were so friendly and always a laugh, this is also where they hold the entertainment everyday- which is really good fun Not forgetting the amazing animation team, who kept me and my friends entertained the whole week with games, competitions and great dance moves! Shout to Jerry, Zuly and Luis The only negative was the seaweed, which really wasn't an issue. I think people can be slightly dramatic when it comes to this. They worked all day to remove it from the beach and within a few days it was completely clear. The beach it self is lovely! Thank you to all the staff at the hotel who are incredibly hard working and for making our holiday unforgettable. Would highly recommend !

author: X1121WVseanh
title: Thank you to all staff - for a Smashing Holiday:-)
text: It would be easy to list everything wrong with this resort, but It would overshadow the brilliant holiday we had and the efforts of hardworking lovely staff we met. 1- The Hotel was one of the first built in this area - This means the palm trees and plantlife are amazing to see, and all the wildlife walk round the grounds and it amazing to watch both day and night. It also means the hotel and pool areas are in need of some refurbishment, but also note holidaymakers are not paying for 5 star service and treatment. I would recommend the hotel chain focuses some investment in the rooms before too many people stop coming back. We were lucky and were given the room we were paid for after arriving to a very basic standard room. 2 - Our issues over the 2 weeks we stayed were sorted immediately, or as soon as was possible, leaving us to enjoy this superb resort. If you have issues, go see reception and ask for the service manager Ramos if all else fails. 2 - If you care to look the staff in the eye and give them a smile and a Hola- They are superb, warm and helpful. A speacial mention and big shout out to Amaurys, Genesis and Odeybi in the main dinnerhall, and Carlos at the pool bar for the service and the smiles - Thank you guys, we had a great time (and not forgetting all the other staff who looked after us.) The food is great, although it is the same at most resorts everywhere, it can get 'samey' after a week or so. ( We stayed 14nights). 3 - There is plenty of entertainment both day and night for both adults and children if you wish to get involved. 4 - If you are looking for 5 star accommadation and service look elsewhere, but if you are looking for a warm, value for money stay, this is the resort to pick. 5 - Seaweed on beach (Sargassum) - This has affected all the islands in Caribbean to some degree, and is actually a man made problem (look it up on google), and will not be going away. It didnt stop us swimming in sea and all hotels are working tirelessly to keep it down and off the beach, but day by day it keeps hitting the beach, and is kept to a minimum by some very hardworking locals. Hope this review helps anybody travelling to the Princess:-) Thanks - Sean and Julie

author: ckrdeans
title: Nice Resort with a great staff
text: Traveled in August with a two other families - 12 in total with adults and teenagers. While the resort made a mix-up in room reservations initially, they were quick to fix by the second day, which also included an upgrade of rooms and buildings. The wait staff is exceptional in the HIGÜERO buffet restaurant. Very friendly and quick to respond. There is a great variety food in the Higuero that includes an excellent omelette station for breakfast and pasta station for dinner. The Higuero is themed each night so there is a changing selection each night for variety, while they maintain a standard offering if you want the same dining option each night. We also ate at the EL RODIZZIO Brazilian style restaurant- again great food and a different dining option as well as the EL PILÓN Dominican restaurant, which is well decorated and great food. The LE CREPERIE CAFÉ is also a great treat spot for a nice coffee or sweet snack. While the resort shows its age in the rooms (we were spread over 6 rooms and each one had its own little defect - missing chair, or cabinet that doesn't quite close, or air conditioning doesn't quiet work), the resort makes up for these shortcomings with a well stock fridge, friendly staff and a very clean resort. The groundskeeping is immaculate. While it is no fault of the resort, you need to be aware that the amount of sea weed in the ocean is significant, to the point where it is a deterrent to going into the ocean and the bugs can be a challenge in the dusk with many of us getting bites through the legs and ankles when sitting for dinner. The only item that was a deterrent for me was the continual up-selling by staff on site when entering the Higuero for items like time sharing. It was easy enough to say no, but it was never-ending. Like most resorts, the early bird gets the pool lounge chairs, with many of them gone by 6:30 am, especially if you want some shade; however you could typically get 2-3 chairs around meal times as the early-birds leave for meals. I would certainly go back again. We traveled with Sunwing, and our on-site adviser was also excellent to work with. One of the other niceties that we weren't expecting is the wildlife on the resort. The variety of birds and the turtles were an attraction.

author: 835kayleighh
title: An honest review
text: This is my first ever review and I felt compelled to write it. There are many bad reviews of late. I just arrived home after 2 weeks here with my 2 daughter's, partner and my parents. This hotel is in a stunning location and is a beautiful setting. I feel that when it was first opened it was probably beautiful. It is now a little tired and run down. The pool areas and rooms were a little shabby and the pool grubby at times. The maintenance team were faultless and after 2 days of complaints about ac/fan, our whole fan system was replaced! We were then much more comfortable in our rooms. The bathrooms desperately need renovating, both in the rooms and the restaurants as they were mouldy due to the humid atmosphere. Our room also had a smell of damp which only shifted when the ac was on for a while. The highlight of our teip was the fabulous kids club amd mini disco. My daughter's have never been brave enough to go at any other resort but here they were asking us to go every day! And the disco was superb every evening. Kiwy, Carmen and Coco work very hard amd bring a real personal nature that is lacking in other areas due to the sheer size of the resort. I hope they get the recognition they deserve because I'm sure my girls will be talking about it for months to come! We had a great holiday despite a few teething issues (no tour therefore no idea about where to eat other than a map being one and being unaware of the supplement at some restaurants so coming away with a $66 dollar bill another!) The kids club team made our fortnight! Thank you to them ♡ This place is ok for a budget kind of trip but expect nothing more than basic.

author: LV_Travels25
title: Decent
text: This resort was fine for the price. The grounds are beautiful, 3 big pools, lots of activities (mini golf, ping pong, entertainment staff keeps you busy at the pool with activities twice a day). Room was outdated but big and clean (for the most part) they seemed to do heavy cleaning every other day. Otherwise just light cleaning and towel change- wish they would clean thoroughly every day. On our last day there was a leak in our ceiling. We called the lobby and they quickly sent someone to fix it. Beach was nice, they had seaweed but saw crews doing their best to clean it up-that’s across Caribbean all over not the hotels control/fault. We enjoyed the beach most days. Buffet was OK I generally found food I liked but usually 1-2 things, not all. We had a great waiter Rudy at the main buffet. Restaurants are a mess to book, we got here found out only 2 are included and you have to make a huge line at 8:30am to book (thought it was “all-inclusive 🤔-rip off) by the time you get to the desk everything is booked. We made one reservation at the Dominican Restaurant it was good. The Creperie which is a snack shop open 1:30-6 with crepes and coffee was great but the staff behind the counter was a little rude. Overall staff seemed overworked and stressed not as friendly as other places we’ve been. Night shows sucked a little, seats fill up quickly so if you don’t get there no where to sit. One night there was a live singer in the lobby she was great. This place is fine if you are on a budget I guess, otherwise recommend the Melia/Paradisus resorts chain much better.

author: Elliottbu
title: Not bad but could be a lot better
text: I’m so undecided about this place, feel it could be lots better with a few small things. Stayed here end of June for two weeks in room 1160. Hotel - lovely place, grounds are amazing with all the animals like iguanas, terrapins and birds including a lonely pink flamingo. Room - room was in a great place for us, bottom floor between the buffet and pool and bars. Unfortunately we had a few issues, one was the leaking toilet roof that we reported, someone came out but was hard to understand what he was saying with the language barrier, he finally showed me it was the air con condensation, it continued for a couple of days dripping once or twice a every 10 seconds so we left it, it then stopped for a couple of days but came back much worse dripping constantly up to the end of our stay meaning if we wanted to use the toilet we had to sit with a towel on our shoulders so we didn’t get soaked. Issue two was every time you used the shower the floor would be like a bath, it obviously wasn’t sealed correctly. Issue 3 was the only two nights I slept under the covers in the bed I was bitten by was I presume was bed bugs. Issue 4 was this place is noisy, the walls and doors seem to be paper thin. Oh and our phone didn’t work in our room until the last day, the engineer couldn’t explain why. Food/drinks - only ate at the buffet as wasn’t possible for us to get a table at the other restaurants even trying most days. Food was good lots of selection for everyone never went hungry. Snack bar near the 24 hour bar was good too. Drink selection was pretty good too, Wally in the 24 hour bar was the best in my opinion. Had a good few nights chatting to him there after 11. Unfortunately don’t think I would stay here again, Bavaro Princess seems much better place after spending the day there drinking and eating then to be told we were not aloud back at Tropical Princess reception when we wanted a Taxi to take us, I’m sure we were told that we had free range of all the Princesses but obviously not. But thanks to all the staff that looked after us during our stay, we still made the most of it and made it a good holiday.

author: shegibson
title: 1st but not last time 😁
text: We went for 2 weeks and enjoyed every moment. Beautiful weather, grounds,staff where great so helpful nothing was too much trouble. We will definitely be back. Big shout out to Jerry in the entertainment team love his dancing and very entertaining. Hi to Johan tui rep your brill. And last but not least winnie nothing was too much trouble she is an absolute star we love you all. Yes there was seaweed on the BEACH but it certainly didn't put us off we loved the sea it was so warm.the waves were great also we had a great laugh. The rooms YES they could do with updating but you only sleep in there. We had such a great time and this was our very first visit to the caribbean we would definitely go back. The food was great and plenty of choice. Only been home 4 days and we want to come back. This is an honest account from an honest person. We really miss all the people who work there they are all so very friendly and nothing is too much trouble. Do please be aware of the mosquitos we were both bitten to death but that is not the fault of the hotel we took veet but it's no good. Make sure you take plenty of repellent with you. I have never been bit but I stopped counting at 74 😑

author: 474jeans
title: Treated poorly after accident
text: We came here 25th jan to 8th feb 2018 At first glance, everything seemed ok..we were on 2nd floor..hubby disabled but he coped with the stairs..our room overlooked the staff alleyway..so no pool or sea view.. Room needs updating..bathroom needs a GOOD clean..shower door absolutely disgraceful..not enough bath and hand towels for two people..kept asking maid but to be honest..dont think she cared..must be the worst maid we have every had on holiday.. Staff in the restaurants were fabulous..they truely were lovely people.. Wifi is a bit hit and miss and you have to go to reception area to get it... The mangrove is lovely..all sorts of different birds..and other animals..loved feeding them on a morning stroll..they wait for you to feed them.. The beach is great..bit windy and waves a bit choppy..bar on the beach is good 24/7 Coffee and crepes by the beach is very nice!! Well my big disappointment came on day 7, right in the middle of our 2 week stay.. I feel on the VERY UNKEPT PATHWAY.. Cost us £180 for treatment.. They were not interested at all..not even TUI rep... On returning home I was still in pain..my arm was now BLACK all over..xrayed at home to find I had broken my shoulder/humurous in 3 places..still in pain at time of writing this review.. TUi have been notified, with lots of photos if pathways and my badly bruised arm..we have put in a claim as it ruined our holiday..we were booked for Saona Island, something we had been told 'not to miss'. We deserved better treatment from hotel and tui rep.. Our claim is still ongoing and we have been back since 8th February.. I would love to return to Punta Cana but not at this hotel.. This holiday took alot of saving for as we are 67 and 71..may not get another chance.. So disappointed..

author: Sirena1123
title: Spring Break 2018
text: I was a little skeptical about the property after reading the reviews but I took a chance because they had the best price for the privacy I needed for my family. I had my two children next to me with a separated door which was a really good feeling. I do feel like the rooms could use a little updating and that the room with the single bed could use a bigger bed and also the lock should be on the side where the parents or single person is sleeping. Plus the shower in the separate room is so small. But it was bearable and cleaned daily. We were in 3217 and it was right in the center of two different pools which was really enjoyable because I had an active 7 year old who loved to get in the pool every day. I felt like a towel center should have been located at each pool. Let's talk buffet!!! I had the pleasure of meeting Dana when I first arrived and she gave us her schedule and what side she serviced. She was amazing from the beginning to the end!! She would be the reason I come back!!! She is friendly and she was very attentive to our needs. My husband is Dominican and he felt right at home helping me and our daughters to communicate. My 7 year old was able to participate in the Lion King Performance at the theater and it was nothing short of amazing!!! Josias, Julie, and Damien at the Check-in Check-out were very attentive and available for anything needed. Overall, the experience that my family and I had was amazing. A few minor changes to the rooms and it would've been perfect. I would recommend this place.

author: verydisappointed2015
title: Great family vacation
text: This was our first time to the DR. Overall, the resort was absolutely spectacular. The pools were great and food was excellent. Everything was close so we didn't have far to walk. The walk (or ride) from the rooms to the reception was a peaceful scenic walk with tons of wildlife. The resort was extremely clean. Staff was up at the crack of dawn sweeping the pathways, cleaning the pools and raking the beach. An absolutely fantastic job by the staff. The restaurant was extremely clean and the food was very nicely displayed. I didn't eat anything I didn't like. The beach was soft and the water was warm. One of our beds broke and within 30 minutes of reporting it to maintenance, it was fixed. Absolutely fantastic. The only negatives I can come up with are: 1. There could be more chairs on the beach 2. The rooms could/should be updated (especially the A/C and fridges) 3. It would be nice to have benches throughout the resort Highly recommend this resort to all my friends and family.

author: lesran2018
title: THIS IS NOT A 4 STAR HOTEL DONT BE FOOLED!!
text: I have never had to make a complaint about any vacation I have ever taken but this hotel should not be rated a 4 star at most it is a 2.5 and thats being generous! Sunwing you should be ashamed! I spent a-lot of money to stay here with my family in a family suite..... Horrible! Even after complaining about the filth in our suite they finally after hours of waiting took us to see 4 more rooms ALL the same! Stay away from this hotel. I took my family somewhere else and had to spend another 5000$. Still waiting on sunwing for some kind of compensation but they haven't even responded to my complaint! The rooms are old dirty rusty and moldy, the tiles are filthy and cracked every where. The beds are like pizza boxes, blankets are dirty, only one small TV in family suite rooms. Nothing like the pictures at ALL!! The buffet is full of flies but the staff is very kind in the restaurant. My room and balcony was even accompanied with what I thought was bird poop all over the place.. but no not birds it was BATS!! thats right bats 13 to be exact such a treat! I have pictures and videos of this hotel and if I could post them I could. This place is a health hazard to yourself and your children ..Stay somewhere else!

author: shikka1
title: nice hotel overall
text: The hotel grounds are very nice , the services overall are good. The room we were in was quite basic needing uppgrades. The beds are very old , mattresses have stains and are hard. The washroom needs some upgrade too, fan doesn't work, cracked wall in shower, mirror stained, no drawers. Water off and on cold warm depends on day. Air conditionning works well but noisy fan. Pools are nice and clean. Ocean beach was clean , but very strong waves at the time we were there. One thing that was irritating was that everyone reserves their beach and pool chairs all day by leaving towels on them. They have signs saying it's not allowed but nobody reinforces this, so useless! The lobby was quite big and full of life especially with special shows and activities late in the evening. The waiters and bartenders are quite efficient and friendly especially on that we met quite often, Leticia ( Castillo). She went out of her way too make us feel appreciated , always happy and seeming to totally enjoy her job, thank you! The buffete in the evening were also greatly appreciated with lots of food and variety, different themes each night. The waiters and Waitresses were great especially our usual waiter Yommy ( Valdez Diaz) . Very friendly , efficient, always around to help. also Marino and Randy, very nice firendly waiters, thank you. Overall we enjoyed our stay but maybe we'd prefer a better room next time, renovated.

author: alexeykop
title: Excellent Vacation
text: We travelled as a family of 4 with a 10 year old and a senior. We really enjoyed our time at Tropical Princess. I read a lot off negative reviews that are not objective or justified in my opinion, so I will offer my perspective. BEACH Endless and beautiful, there were always enough sunbeds for everyone,staff did a good job cleaning the seaweed from the beach daily. FOOD The buffet offered a wide variety of fish,meats,salads,ripe fruits and veggies and they changed the theme and the dishes daily -french,italian etc.. we loved the buffet and were looking forward to dinner. We also went to Brazilian and Dominican restaurants which were pretty good but the buffet was the highlight for us. ANIMATION The animation team is by far the best I have ever seen in any resort in Caribbean. Piter,Jerry,Jonatan,Juli and Suli all did an incredible job. They kept tourists entertained on the beach through various activities such as salsa lessons,beach volleyball and fun games. In the evening they danced in the lobby and really created the mood for everyone! Piter's Michael Jackson performance was great! ROOMS AND SERVICE Celestino at the front was helpful at the check-in and attentive to our needs. The rooms are a bit dated and the hotel needs a renovation. In our room the shower was working well,no leaks. Maids clean up daily,no problems with that either. Overall,this is a hotel for you if you want to be entertained,eat well and don't mind rooms that are a bit old. Great value for the money!!! I would definitely recommend this hotel.

author: 108lenkaj
title: Lovely place with some bad experience.
text: We went there for 1 week family holiday. Hotel is so lovely from outside but our family room (3031)was very used. One bathroom toilet didn’t flush every time and was quite smelly. Other bigger one was dripping from ceiling around light in shower from leaking bathroom up floor. We called the service they came for 2 minutes at that’s all. Main restaurant full of amazing tasty food but not the best service. We were waiting for long time to set up tables with cutlery and wait for drinks most of the time. Some days we ate half of the food before we had drinks and had to search for cutlery. We went to Brazilian restaurant for dinner one night. Lovely food but bad system. You have to book advance but they booked full restaurant for same time. Long waiting line to get to buffet to get sides and drinks too. Cafe with cakes, pancakes and coffees great. Beach very nice but not very nice sea weed. Nice 3 big pools to choose from. My kids loved mini golf, kids playground, animals ( turtles, peacocks, ducks, lizards and birds). Mini disco not the best. Wifi only in the lobby. I think my biggest problem were mosquitoes. After first night I had to buy repellent as my body was full of bites.

author: sandralynn2608
title: Very Satisfied!
text: We spent the last week at the Tropical Princess and were very satisfied with everything. This was not our first time in the DR and after staying in different resorts, we were pleasantly surprised with this one. Our room was comfortable and clean, and Lillian, the cleaning lady made sure we had everything we needed (especially water!!!). We were so impressed with the food at the buffet that we didn't need to try out the à la carte restaurants! That is quite rare for us. We did, however, try the Dominican restaurant and it was quite good. Speaking of food and the buffet, we need to say a big thank you to Oobeby for his courtesy, his good service and especially his smile. We went to his section every morning and every lunch time, just for him. The beach was amazing. There were lots of chairs, lots of room for everyone and lots of palapas. We were surprised of the security guards on the beach but really enjoyed and appreciated Pablo who was so friendly. For the last comment, we would like to say a big thank you to Juliana at the lobby bar for her great personality, her smile and the great service. She made our evenings very enjoyable. We were fascinated by the walkway from the lobby to the rooms with all the birds, turtles, ducks, peacocks and mangroves. All in all, we thoroughly enjoyed our week at this resort. Sandra and Marcel from Gatineau, Quebec (Canada).

author: dornburg
title: choose another resort
text: This was our first visit to the Dominican Republic. Would definitely go back to the island but would surely pick a different resort. We flew Sunwing out of Winnipeg. A travel agent out of Steinbach, MB highly recommended the Tropical Resort. She should rethink her job or at least go visit the resorts. The whole resort needs serious updating. The menus are held together by duct tape, and we were told by a couple who have been coming there for years that the menus haven't changed selections one bit in years. The first room our friends were put in was so dirty I don't think it had been occupied for months--dirt and dust everywhere, black mod on the curtains in/out, huge visible stains on the bedding. closet doors off tracks, etc. They got moved to a new room immed. Our room was cleaner and we spent one nite. The next day both of us couples were moved to ocean front rooms on the "better" resort side, the Caribe. These rooms were much better but still just average. For what we paid for 2 wks we think the top of the Princess chain, the Bavaro, is where we s/h/b. We were told we had vip pkgs but apparently not--it took 4 days to get that upgrade at an addt'l cost. The food is average at best and pretty sure what's not used in the "premium" restaurants ends up in the buffet the next day or two. We found a couple really nice bartenders and trolly drivers but most bartenders were plain rude and looked inconvenienced to be making drinks. Definitely think the Princess line of resorts has lost our business.

author: christinebY8960SW
title: Amazing vacation
text: This was a vacation with Sunwing. This is the first and most likely the last time we travel with Sunwing. We had flight delays going and coming back, which we understand can't always be helped. On our flight to Punta Cana they ran out of food for a good part of the plane, which included us. There were many adults and children without food for dinner. The resort is wonderful. The staff are amazing. A special shoot out to Zuli and Jerry from the entertainment team and Carlos from the buffet. The food was really good. We did the Bazillian and Dominican a la cartes and they were both amazing. The buffet has a theme night every night so you don't get bored. The beach and pools are fantastic. Our room was ok, the air conditioner worked and the beds were comfortable. The cleaning staff were great. We were in room 3332 and the roof leaked every time it rained, which was almost every evening. We had to lift the doors to the bathroom and bedroom in order to open them as they got caught on the tile floor. My husband also cleaned the shower head as it wasn't working properly. We did not report these problems as we did not want to change rooms. More regular maintenance would solve these problems. Overall we had an amazing vacation and would return to this resort for the staff, beach and food.

author: mariatF8598SA
title: Winter vacations
text: This was not first trip to Punta Cana in Dominican Republic. Tropical Princess was beautiful. Our rooms were right across from the pool beside the ocean. The food selection was outstanding, many varieties and plentiful. Fresh fruit, appetizers, meals, deserts... Also several restaurants on the grounds that were included in all inclusive, Mexican, Asian, Italian- food was delicious and so was service. 24 hour bar and food service everyday right across from our rooms. The trip to the hotel was very fast and well organized. We were greeted and processed quickly by Pedro. Front desk supervisor Lirian very nice and friendly. She was very helpful to us, she explained everything we needed to know. There is not very long pathway that goes from the lobby to the hotel( 5 min to walk). Many exotic ducks, peacocks, funny chickens swimming in the pond, birds, even couple of turtles sticking out their heads for food... Main buffet was in the middle of place, which saved time alot. Food was good and there were different teams every day (dominican, oriental, french, mexican... ). There are many bars serving drinks and food.
