Pools were clean and the beach was fabulous with white sand. Spent most of the time on the beach. All staff members were polite and always tried to help with anything.

author: 79joycem
title: Sister from Chicago - Birthday Celebration
text: This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic. Club Caribe was absolutely fantastic. Our rooms were right across from the pool behind the ocean, great view. The food selection was outstanding, many varieties and plentiful. Fresh fruit, appetizers, meals, deserts and much more, 3 times a day. Also several restaurants on the grounds that were included in all inclusive, Mexican, Asian, Italian and food was delicious and so was service. 24 hour bar and food service everyday right around the corner from our rooms. I must say the Club staff was fabulous. They work extremely hard to please their customers beginning with check-in. I must point out Jukson who was our main person that set up outside activities and he so was full of information and very accommodating. Christian the bellboy was so polite, cheerful and gave us outstanding service and made us want to stay. Angelo was our breakfast server almost everyday and he was one of the nicest, efficient servers I've ever had. We never had a dirty plate in front of us and coffee cup always filled. I must commend the entertainers, the shows were fantastic especially the Michael Jackson performance. Peter was outstanding!!!!!!! He could be Michaels twin. I hope the Caribe appreciates what wonderful hard working staff and performers they have. This was a trip my sisters and I will remember for a lifetime and should we decide to take another trip back to the Dominican Republic we will definitely chose Caribe Club Princess. I would also like to stress that just because the stay is all inclusive, please remember to TIP you server, maid, bartender, etc. They work long hard hours and I know will appreciate it.

author: susierotolo
title: Intro to the Dominican Republic for us.
text: Our "family" vacation to celebrate my husband's 70th birthday, got off to a rocky start due to Zika concerns. We arrived at the lobby for our room keys and there was a bit of a mix-up. Found that annoying, but in all honesty, it was only because they were trying to put our group in the same building for our convenience. Anyway, the rooms are dated, but ours were fully functional- two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a nice patio on each. The food was good. Enjoyed both a la cartes allowed on our plan. Did not try the creperie except for coffee and pastries. Nice option though. Even off season as it was, we had to go out early to stake a shady spot at the pool. Never able to get one on the beach until late afternoon. Seemed to be very few English speaking guests at the resort and they were not willing to grasp the concept of lining up at the buffet or for service at the front desk. Not the fault of the hotel, but uncomfortable none the less. Will not return to the Dominican for this reason. If you want to cater to the North American market, your desk staff should speak better English. Wifi was not great and only available in the lobby. Best at noon when less users were online.

author: beadley
title: Health hazard
text: My friends and I feel let down by you after all the problems that we had to put up with while on our what should have been a holiday of a lifetime. After arriving at the hotel we was taken to our 2 rooms. My room was number 3121. To my horror the room looked like it had just been vacated, the beds were not made and the room had not been cleaned. I called the bell boy to show him the room and after 30 mins I was moved into room 3112 that was unfit for habitation. Blood on the pillow, Rust on the towel rails, Dirty shower heads, Dirt on the shower screen, Broken ceiling hatch, Live wires hanging from the bathroom ceiling, Dirty and dangerous light switches, Exposed live wires next to the bed, broken back panel in the wardrobe, Dirty doors, Blood on the curtains, Dirty air conditioner vents, Light fitting falling out of the bathroom ceiling, Mould, dirt and blood on their foot stool. I did not expect to find porn on the tv considering this is family resort. This was on in all the rooms! I'm completely discussed that any child could access this by picking up the remote control and flicking though the channels!! Eventually I got moved yet again due to the staff painting the room opposite mine. The fumes were coming in my room via the dirty air vents. My third room 2107 seemed ok ish apart from the smell of urine entering it after the second day of being in it. On the third day the ceiling fan stopped working and the toilet would not stop flushing. I reported the new problems and nothing was done to fix it. Avoid this hotel at all costs!

author: Wendy_Robertson
title: Really Good Experience
text: Traveled with my boyfriend, his 11 yr old son and boyfriends mother Oct 9th through Oct 16th, 2017. We stayed in a Family Suite and found it had ample space for all 4 of us and was pretty comfortable. We had a/c issues in the first suite but they quickly fixed the problem by moving us to another suite. We only did one a la cart - Brazilian..really good. The buffet was a different theme each night and we didn't feel it necessary to try another a la cart because the buffet was really good. The beach was really fabulous, very clean and we weren't overly "harassed" by vendors (unlike my experience in Puerto Plata) Resort had lots of activities during the day and the lobby bar was a favorite for cocktails after dinner...then off to the 24hr beach bar for late evening drinks. Disco was fun on one evening. Cant really comment on evening shows as we didn't take any in as there was other stuff we did instead. Its a fair size resort with the lobby at the top of property. You can walk from rooms/pool and beach area to the lobby in about 10 minutes or take their "train" car around the resort. The have streams and vegetation between the two areas stocked with birds and lots of turtles to see during the walk....really nice!! All was really great, had lots of fun and the staff were super nice and friendly. Side note - There are a LOT of Russian and Dutch travelers that we met but a few were really rude and aggressive. On our last day i had one Russian man kick a lounger so hard it slammed into my shin (and left a significant bruise). When I yelled at him he said something in Russian and motioned at my boyfriend as if to fight him...WTH!! Some people just shouldn't travel if they cant be nice and have manners. We all paid for a nice vacation and jerks like that aren't welcome ANYWHERE!! All in all - we would go back. I found we got our monies worth and were not disappointing.

author: bobsnail
title: Sexual harrassment from staff. an abundence of touts and poor everything else
text: Its not hard to find fault with this hotel. Tropical princess is a typical Caribbean budget hotel and this is exactly what I expected. I can forgive dated décor, poor to average quality food and poor service because the beach is amazing and the pool is good quality. What makes me angry is that the hotel actually encourages touts and sales people, so you cant even escape into the hotel grounds to relax. On the beach hotel sponsored touts try to sell you cigars, watersports, couple photos, photos with monkeys/iguanas and parrots, art work, clothing, hats, sunglasses etc. They do accept a firm 'no' however as the portion of the beach they patrol is only about 100 metres in length they approach you several times a day each. dealing with this all day and every day is REALLY exhausting. Theres a dive shop at on the left side boundary of the hotel, there is another one at the right side boundary, and several touts in the middle! This is also an issue inside the hotel, they station stalls selling coco bongo, water sports etc etc right where you collect the towels, there is no way of avoiding the sales people. At the entrance to each accommodation block there is another desk selling tours so you cant even retire to your room unmolested. As a special treat, every few days they have stalls outside the restaurants so they hassle you as you go in and out for food, firmly grabbing your hand and leading you to the stalls and giving you 'free gifts' but getting angry if you don't buy anything. Even the 'concierge' will stop at nothing to sell you timeshare. In the end I pretended to be Russian (they cant speak Russian) smiled sweetly and kept walking. Even worse my fiancé experienced sexual harassment from direct members of staff in the hotel. She went for a massage at the Spa and a Gardner in his 50s stopped her, started rubbing her arm and saying he would massage her for free. I saw another man walking behind her pretending to touch her bum and goose her much to the amusement of his friends and one evening in the bar, we were sat at a table for 2 enjoying a beer and a cigar. One of the animation team was stood behind her leaning back holding his genitals, trying to simulate oral sex with her, I had to get up and chase him away On checking out I approached a crowd of reception staff, all looked at me blankly. One girl did assist and I left her a tip, as I was walking around one of the reception staff mumbled 'eff off mate'. I was sure I heard him wrong so i stopped to clarify but he darted behind the scenes leaving some very embarrassed colleagues.

author: brianalove
title: A trip i will always cherish
text: Everything about this resort is amazing... The moment we stepped foot on their property we received a welcome drink. Check in process was extremely easy and they take action immediately and make you feel at home. Staff was BEYOND amazing. They offer i believe 7 different restaurants, all in which i tried and our favorite had to of been the Dominican one. Depending on your package you have to make reservations at certain restaurants that may not be included but the prices aren't expensive at all. One of my favorite servers was Sr. Pedro Morales at the Pilon restaurant. He went above and beyond my expectations and made an everlasting impression with us. He always made sure we were taken care of when he saw us (thank you for making our trip memorable). Debora and Juls from entertainment team were so nice and remembered us everyday and would go out of there way to make sure we were enjoying our day and getting involved. There is no need to step foot off the resort to go shopping. Their gift shops have everything and probably the most affordable. There is a casino nearby and a club on the resort and in the casino. There was plenty to do, see, and eat. I cant wait to come back!!! We were there for 9 days and did two excursions while we were there and they were AMAZING! the two were the juanillo vip (hoyo azul, private beach, and lobster dinner) and dr fish ocean spa (fish pedi, detoxification, Pilates, massage, exfoliation, chicken lunch). We also did parasailing off the beach of the resort which was very in expensive.

author: Ellisa02
title: Love this Place
text: My husband and I went to Punta Cana Princess with another couple and had a BLAST. This is my 2nd time staying at one of the Princess resorts. My first visit was Tropical Princess and this time we was upgraded from Caribe Princess to Punta Cana Princess. The room was beautiful. The service was great. Alexander at guest services was friendly and very helpful. Yasmin works the bar area and we absolutely loved her!!! Staying in Punta Cana Princess we had access to Caribe Priness as well as Tropical Princess which was a plus. We visited Tropical Princess and got to see some workers who remembered us. De La Paz works the Beach Bar Area and he makes sure everything is to your satisfactory. Then the entertainment by the main pool at Tropical Princess/Caribe Princess was great as always. We was greeted byYuli/El Dolar which is our absolute favorite Animation guy. He's so full of life . He interacts with everyone and makes sure your really enjoying yourself. The activities the Animation crew do are definitely entertaining and fun. At night the shows in the Theater are awesome full of talent. We also stopped at the Arieto club which is on the premises for some great music and dancing. Can't wait to book the next trip back. Thank you to All Princess hotels for the hospitality and memorable vacation .

author: momnasia
title: Great vacation!
text: We stayed at the Tropical Princess with two other adult couples for a week and we had a great time! The rooms are not fancy but we didn't expect them to be. They were clean and well kept and that's all I needed. One of the couples had to be moved because the air wasn't working in the first room but the front desk took care of it quickly. The staff is super friendly and accommodating. I don't think tipping is expected, but they really appreciate any tips given and will take good care of you. The beach is amazing. The grounds of the hotel are kept impeccably clean. The food was great as far as all six of us were concerned. We really enjoyed the restaurants on site and the buffet. Some of the restaurants are not included in the all inclusive price but were still reasonably priced. The drinks were good and they were definitely not stingy with the liquor. The only thing I didn't like was the constant badgering from the concierge people (they hang out around the buffet every morning waiting to catch you walking into breakfast) to hear their promos and the excursion people wanting us to do the water sports and excursions. We had to consistently tell them no every day. (We were just there for relaxing and didn't want to do any of the extra stuff) There are also several vendors that walk up and down the beach selling stuff which got annoying. Overall we had a really nice time and would visit again.

author: dnoe14
title: Dangerous, do not stay here
text: I recently took my family to this resort, after having taken them to Playa and Cozumel before. On the first night, my wife, son, and myself were in the heavily advertised disco on the property around 12:30. Shortly after my wife and I left, my son stepped outside of the disco to talk to some girls (still on the property inside the main gates) and had a knife pulled on him. He was taken off the resort and taken to an ATM machine and three males held the knife to his throat and demanded his card and pin number. Once they took money from his account, they left him and he had to find his way back onto the resort in the middle of the night. We called the bank first thing next morning and there were three transactions totaling $600 USD. I immediately spoke to the desk in the night and demanded to speak to police and security. I was completely blown off. The worker called a security guard over and spoke to him briefly and told me there is nothing that can be done. I spoke to my vacation express rep on property the next morning. I finally got to sit down with the guest relations manager. He told me stories of people leaving the resort with prostitutes and then making up stories. There were knife marks on his neck and 3 transactions from an ATM in the middle of the city. DO NOT stay here! If this transpired off the resort, I would understand. This happened ON PROPERTY and then they could not have cared less and immediately called us liars. My vacations express rep also said she would be in contact with the company back home and they would contact me to check on the situation. Nothing has happened. Be very careful if you choose to stay here, and understand you are not 100% safe ON the resort and if something happens, they will not care.

author: 461philg
title: A let down - could be so much better
text: A had a week at the Tropical Princess and came away with mixed thoughts on the resort. Location is excellent, super beach, mangroves on the walk from reception to the resort area. The rooms are basic and very tired. Could really do with a freshen up and modernisation. A/C working well, thankfully. Hot water, most of the time. 2 of the legs on the bed were broken and it take 2 days and 3 attempts to get it fixed. Staff were generally friendly and welcoming, but with that 'no hurry Caribbean' way of doing thinks at their own pace. Buffet food was ok, with lots of options to choice from. Dominican and Rodizio restaurants were both excellent and I booked them both twice. There are other restaurant options but with extra charges, c$30 per person. The resort is keep clean and tidy, despite the best efforts of some guests. Check out is midday and I needed a late check-out, which cost me $45 for 3 hours, over priced, considered that on most days the room was not cleaned until after 4pm. With a refresh of rooms and facilities this could be a really nice refresh. It certainly is not 4 star by European or US standards. Will not return.

author: MJT1977
title: Nightmare Vacation PLEASE READ
text: Let me begin by saying were are modest and average people. This resort is at best a ONE star, no possible way its a four star. Please read these, they are in no particular order: Rude and lazy employees NO HOT WATER!!! Water leaking from AC vent Mold on AC vent Our first room the AC was broken Transport from airport was a black Suburban, not marked with "NEXUS"! Transport driver drove dangerously and nearly wreck many times. BOTH of our rooms smelled horrible We had two rooms due to AC broken in first room No employees willing to listen to our concerns ALL food was horrible. On different days (not due to different types of food) Only two towels in room. When we called for more towels they wouldn't speak to us!!! Didn't feel safe in the resort or even in our rooms FILTHY linens and bedding. Extremely hard beds Room phone didn't work TV remote didn't work TV worked sporadically False advertising, pictures of resort and area were not realistic at all Dangerous wiring and electrical switches in room, exposed wires. Area around resort was so dangerous I didn't feel safe taking my family out. In closing I feel certain that the resort management will respond to this by saying " We will take this review and make changes", please understand that they could care less. We went to several employees, respectfully with concerns. NO ONE cared, it seemed as though they don't care for Americans. GO TO ANOTHER RESORT AND HAVE A SAFE VACATION!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: paccione2017
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text: We visited this resort from 19 to 26 of June 2017. This was my 4th visit to Punta cana but not the best I've stayed at. the people are very friendly. We had a family room because my husband and I went with my daughter and 2 children. the night we arrived We had settled in the best we could because there were no dressers to put our clothes. Just a closet space with some tablets on the side. After we finished putting our stuff away it started to rain and water came in from the balcony door into the room and it was horrible. We called the front desk and they gave us another room with the same accomidations. the second night we were there while I was taking a shower water started to leak from the ceiling. We called the front desk again however was not fixed and when we came back from the pool to shower the ceiling was practically falling down. Long story short the bathroom need some renovations and the rooms too. the beach is beautiful and the pools are nice. theater was nice too. But the food was always the same. My granddaughters hardly ate anything. Not a great selection of meals. Went to take a piece of meat one night and it was donkey meat! Will not be going back to this resort

author: 488debbies
title: Great Value All Inclusive - Would highly Recommend !
text: We have just arrived back from two weeks (14/6-28/6/17) in this resort, after having a fantastic holiday! We were apprehensive after readings previous reviews but do not worry as the resort exceeded all our expectations. We had a suite in the Lirio Bulidling overlooking one of the three excellent pools, near the buffet and a minute walk from a fabulous beach. The beach has plenty of sunbeds with shade and we never had a problem getting these or towels. The buffet was excellent with a wide varied selection of hot and cold food. Recommend fish, fruit and omelettes! There is also 5 other restaurants included which were all good. Our favourite being the Brazilian called Rodizio. All staff gave excellent service with a smile whether part of the Animation team, cleaning, waiting staff or general staff around the resort. We would like to give a special mention to Christian Alberto Mejia in the buffet who gave fabulous service always with a wonderful smile and a wave. Also Francesca in the buffet who again was excellent. As in previous reviews our bathroom was slightly tired looking but the sleeping areas were very spacious and the beds and pillows were very comfortable. We did not find the beach sellers or time share people a problem as we found a pleasant no thank you was sufficient. They didn't pester us during our stay when they knew we were not interested. Take $1.00 dollar notes to tip the fabulous service given as the staff work really hard to give everybody a excellent holiday. The gardens are stunning and well kept with a range of tropical plants, birds, lizards, turtles and peacocks! Would definitely definitely recommend!

author: Petra19880529
title: DREAM, I wanna go back
text: We loved our stay here! The food was really delicious and it was a huge amount to choose out of. The room was a tipical smell. when we entered first time, we thought it is smelly, we wanna change it, but we realised, it is because the tropical weather. Dont be afraid of it :) Two negative thing: - we wanted wifi router: we went to the reception first, we didnt get, wait for it, come back tomorrow at 12 am. OK, we did. The next day we were there at 11:50 am, come back at 4:00 pm, ok, we went back and again come back later. so come ooon! Tell me the truth! So my husband went there and he was a little bit angry..tadaaaam, we had a wifi router. So i didnt understand the attitude. - the second is: I had a really bad and strong sunburn: I mean: I could not go, could not walk, I could not stand...for a long time...so what to do now in DOM. REP. without any medicine for this strong sunburn? We went to the doctor, who could not help us. Nothing. He even had not a calcium injection, or calcium tablet, nothing!! He said: Go to the Pharmacy. Really? So I think the should improve the quality of medical care.

author: 324ingridb
title: Great service but miscommunication at Front Desk
text: Honestly, it's very reasonably priced. I appreciated the all-inclusive amenities. I don't drink, but those who do (Like the bridesmaids I went with) will definitely enjoy the free-unlimited alcohol. The facility was beautiful and the pools were great. The beach is awesome also. We pretty much had a great experience up to the last day upon check out. We were asked to turn in the beach towels or be charged $20 PER card. They said that they inform everyone about this detail upon check in when given a tour, but they didn't... we never even got a tour. As soon as we checked in, we were approached by a lady who started to sell us excursions. We honestly were not bothered because we wanted to do excursions anyways, but we were not aware that we were supposed to have stayed for a tour or briefing or whatever it is they do to inform you of all policies (such as the towel card). We explained this to the manager and he was adamant that we were indeed informed about this. Not to mention, the reason why two of the girls didn't turn theirs in was because they had literally just given it to the beach boy to get a towel, and they never requested it back from him because we were UNAWARE of that policy. I didn't have mine because I had turned in the room key and towel key the night before because it was deactivated by putting it close to my phone. That's the other thing... if your phone is remotely close to your room key, it will deactivate. We had to get new keys like three times. Overall, it was truly an awesome trip. I am very disappointed that our check out took so much magic out of the entire experience.

author: natashahueck
title: Amazing Property, Beautiful Beach!
text: This is my 2nd time at Tropical Princess. If you're looking for an affordable vacation with everything included this is one of the better resorts to go to. First off the size of the property is perfect. You can never get bored because there is always something to do and somewhere to go (if the sun is shining) There is 3 large pools and each pool has a different vibe to it so you can switch it up. The pool bar was my favourite, I especially enjoyed the great service from Braudilio & Juan!!! The drinks were fast and they were both very entertaining :) The first time I went was in 2011 with my family and a friend, this time I went in march 2017 with my boyfriend. I am 24 and he is 26. I have read many of the mixed reviews about this place, but my best advice is to try it out for yourself. There is a lot of complaints about the room but we had a great room... didnt have to switch at all. The only issue was with the bathroom leaking water out of the shower but still not a big deal. We stayed at 3105 and the rooms were updated and cleaned everyday. If you're looking for a 5 star hotel you're most likely going to have to pay the price for one. Overall this was a fantastic resort. Everyone has a different perspective and different personalities (good for families with children, young couples/friends and even very fun people in the older age group). Ps... if you're going to Dominican Republic in general, brush up on your French and Spanish as you can have more meaningful interactions with the more you know :) (ill keep that in mind for myself next time lol)

author: gracelizfitz1
title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE do not go here
text: Last April, a few of my friends and I decided to go to Punta Cana to celebrate her birthday. Where do I begin? The service was horrible. The workers were incredibly rude, even when I was incredibly kind and polite. From the moment we came in to the moment we left, we didn't receive ANY kind service except for one kind bartender who we tipped generously. We were a fairly quiet group, so I do not see how we could have received any complaints on their end. The all-inclusive food and drink was not only subpar - it was disgusting. Multiple friends (including myself) received severe food poisoning resulting in hospitalization once we arrived home. (Note: We did not drink any of the water either). The alcohol was low low low grade and you could tell. Additionally, one of the girls in my room left her wallet out and came home to all of the cash stolen from it. Granted, we probably should have put our things in the safe, but your employees should also not be stealing. When we brought the issue to their attention, they insisted we were lying. If you're going to go on an all-inclusive vacation, go literally anywhere else. Overall, if you're going to function as a resort, then you need to: A. Be nice to your paying customers B. Not put your paying customers in the hospital from your product C. Not steal from your paying customers

author: krnesmith
title: Tropical Princess is not worth the trouble!
text: Upon a arrival, I was told that my stay was for the 26th not the 16th, but my email clearly stated the 16th. The attendant acted like it was my fault for the mix up. We were told to enjoy the buffet while they "found" us a place to stay. After two hours of waiting, we finally were lead to our room. The room was obviously not meant for occupants, because it did not have hot water, towels or blankets on the beds. I had to call daily for towel service and hot water. The beds themselves were hard as rocks. I had to "rob" the maid cart just to get towels. The hot water finally started working, but you had to be quick because it only lasted for a few seconds. As if that's not enough, when I was checking out at 5:30 am for my 8:30am flight, the attendant said his internet was not working, so we had to pay in cash to check out. He said he was sorry he could not take our credit card. I was told that I could take a cab to the casino to use the ATM if I needed more cash! The attendant would not let us leave until he had been paid in full by cash. I will not be back to the Tropical Princess, and I would strongly discourage anyone from doing so. Furthermore the food was at best OK. not terrible, but certainly not good. I will say the the animation crew on the beaches were excellent!

author: dmaggio2
title: Ken And Diane- Tropical Princess Beach Resort & Spa in Punta Cana DR
text: We had a great time. We were at this resort Jan 30th - Feb 7th. We arrived late and we weren't real happy with our room and the front desk told us they would change our room the next day. and Elias? from the front desk was wonderful he upgraded our room with a bigger and better room the other 2 couples we were with were jealous of our new room. Thank you Elias? you were great. next we can't say enough about our housekeeper she was Aracelis, and she did a fabulous job everyday. she was so honest friendly and always had a big smile and hugs for me every time she saw me, I hope see remembers me I was always asking for coke-a-cola for my fridge. The last person we want to tell you about is Andris in the buffet he was always making us laugh and having a good time, he always was meeting all our needs he was wonderful. Their was many more great people we just couldn't get all their names. The beach was beautiful both on the white soft sand in and out of the water. The food, rooms and pools were good. The resort is a little dated but improvements were always happing just a couple things need to be better is the WIFi only available in the lobby was not convent to call home.and maybe more engagement to the activities more announcements on the beach so you know where things are happening for you to be able to join. The resort was smaller but you were always able to walk to everything or take a tram that was always running though out the resort. We, all said would go back to this resort again.thanks for the great vacation and all the fun Diane and Ken Hamilton Ontario Canada

author: fatmiri2017
title: Good experience
text: We stayed at Tropical Princess for one week (January 27 - February 3) . Let me start by saying the location of this resort is beautiful. Amazing beach, lots of trees and birds. If I would go another time to this resort, I would bring my camera with me. I took lots of pictures using my cellphone though. The food wasn't the best, but acceptable. Room, buffet, swimming pool and the beach are close together. Lobby is a few minutes walk, but we enjoyed it and almost never used the trolley. Rooms were in desperate need for repairs though. There was a bad smell in the room that would come and go. A/C was very loud, we had to turn it off at night. Couldn't sleep otherwise. The tap spraying water everywhere, had to open it just a little bit. Most of the staff was friendly. The entertainment crew was the best especially Rosa and Jerry. Lots of activities and shows. Overall, we had a good experience.

author: cccca2016
title: Bearable if you have nowhere else to go.
text: They seem to have employed a full-time English writing person to respond to TripAdvisor reviews who will go into useless details and basically say your feedback is subjective. This embodies the overall culture I experienced at this place for a week. They invest heavily in the showy marketing stuff but have absolutely no idea how to get the real things right. Examples: - Pretty landscaping but 80% food is terrible. - Various food places on premises, but terrible organization of timings & choices. - Fancy named drinks like Irish Coffee & Mocha in Cafe, but nobody knows how to make them. - Pretentious 'involved' online customer service, but you will wait 40 mins to get a room upon arrival. - Promise variety of activities on premises (mini golf, archery, pool, etc), but terrible equipment and timing of activities that renders them unusable. - Plenty of wait staff & attendees on premises, but they are profusely ill-mannered and untrained in basic routine tasks. - Call themselves "all inclusive" but applies only to local made stuff like dominican beer and locally made drinks. I could go on, but you get the picture. In the entire week we were here, we faced one disappointment after another compared to what we expected. If you don't have high expectations, you may be able to enjoy the stay. The beaches are nice looking (but expect to scramble for seats during busy times). If you have booked rooms already and want to enjoy the stay, i'd say lower your expectations to 20% of what you had in mind, only then you might have a good time.

author: D253YWdavidt
title: All around OK but had its cons
text: Stayed here with family mid December on a one week vacation. The first issue we encountered was after checking into our room, which had no hot running water, a non functional safe and a non working television set. We complained about this to the reception which ended up giving us a new room three days later. The new room never had hot water. The beach vendors are VERY pushy and will often return to you only after 20 minutes of declining them to try and further pursue you to purchase their goods. The vendors that popped up near the main restaurant were no better, some attempting such a hard sell that they would grab you if you tried to decline them. "my friend, best prices only today for you" was just some their favorite lines. I'm not too sure what the sort of deal the locals have to this resort, but you will more than definitely see them lounging around in large groups at the front dining area and the 24/7 snack bar late at night sometimes getting rather rowdy. The food was a hit or miss, with moderate selection but found myself battling through the chewiness of the meats that they had to offer. The rooms were definitely dated, and could use an upgrade at the least. For one, our ceiling fan spun like an uncontrollable tornado which looked like it would fall to the ground at any given second. On a positive note, the staff were all warm, welcoming, and helpful all around the resort. The beach is absolutely beautiful, clean and is one of the more positive points which this place has to offer. All in all we enjoyed our stay, despite the cons which we encountered. I hope who ever visits this resort doesn't experience the same issues, and enjoys their stay!

author: Angiebegone
title: Nice budget resort
text: We stayed at this resort October 28 - November 3, 2016. Check in was fine. Our room wasn't ready but we just went over to the lobby bar had a drink and by the time we finished our room was available. We had a very nice room. Bottom floor of building 35 near the coffee shop. For a quick review here is my experience. The night time entertainment was absolutely phenomenal. Food was average. The swim up bar was okay. Entertainment at pool, again was great. I read reviews about cold water and everything you read was correct. Not once did I have warm water. Did we complain, no. We just did quick showers. Would I stay here again most likely not but then again who knows what life brings. Regardless of the entertainment, lobby, pools, room, or water temperature your vacation is what you make it.

author: PirateTreasureFLA
title: Not so royal treatment
text: We were so excited to be returning to DR after a 1 year hiatus. Unfortunately, the Tropical Princess resort turned out to be a huge disappointment. The customer service at check in was sub-par. Room #1 (family suite) smelled of mold, was dirty, had a bed (and no 2nd TV) where the sitting/living room would normally be) and the furniture looked like something out of a Budgetel in the states (beat up, scratches, dings). Room #2 (same building, different floor) was similarly run down and the A/C didn't work. We gave them several opportunities to correct the problem but they couldn't get their act together. We stayed the night, eating at the buffet (with few offerings and low quality food). Day 1 of vacation lost. In the AM I spoke to the guest services manager and all he would offer was another dumpy room in the same building or an "upgrade" to a smaller room that had been "renovated". The catch? We couldn't look at until 4.5 hours later. The hotel manager was not available to help. I told the guest services manager we were leaving, he told me to take up my refund with Bookit.com and would not give me a receipt showing we checked out early, getting rude before telling me he wouldn't talk to me anymore. To top it off, no bellman available to carry our bags 1/4 mile from the room to reception and the taxi to the new hotel was a rip off (charging us $20 to go 3 miles). I would never return to the Tropical Princess. Bad customer service coupled with run down rooms are not what we look for on vacation.

author: Jason_Gida
title: Holiday
text: Have just recently returned from a two week holiday and must say no complaints barr one. That being as was on an all inclusive deal was still charged for use of the safe in the room at $3 dollars per day, to which i had to do. Something i have never had to do before. A total of $42 dollars for two weeks. We stayed in room 5105 villa Bromelia and had no issues at all with noise, cleanliness. I seriously think that people that complain about decor the tv etc must be on a different planet. You're supposed to be on holiday not stuck in a room, the being somewhere decent that you can sleep and safely. I say safely as the whole place is monitored by staff who also are around during the day and on the beach to keep an eye on things. The food in the main dining hall is great and the service impeccable. Ignacio and Solani were terrific and made us feel very welcome a credit to the staff there. The Brazilian restaurant the food was even better and the Dominican restaurant likewise, however we chose to eat more in the main hall mainly because of more choice. The bar staff in the lobby are great too after ordering your first drink keeping you with fresh cold drinks without having to finish the previous drink. The grounds of the whole place are superb with countless attention by the staff to the animals and their surroundings. Then there is the beach, again what can one say almost perfect. Almost to the point of the only thing missing was the butler? LoL Then to finish your day at the beach to go to the creperie for ice cold coffee, sweet or savoury crepe or a nice doughnut, cake or biscuit. Lastly i was apprehensive a bit before going to the tropical princess after reading some of the reviews on here. I must say though that the negative reviews must have been about somewhere else, i did not encounter anything negative at all regarding service. The only issue being like I said at the beginning was the safe.

author: 645nefertitir
title: Very unprofessional
text: My first experience to DR was horrible due to this hotel right here. But i decided to come to DR to give it another shot. First let me start by saying i had a reservation for 1 person, which i had changed for 2. It was for $116 per night. When i got there, they swore they didn't have it. I showed them my printed confirmation and also Emailed Ramon the manager my confirmation for 2 people. He still charged me a extra $120. I explained to him i also work at a hotel in hospitality and if a guest had a credit card confirmation for that rate, you were supposed to honor it. Very smugged he said no im not going too! It took them 2hours to give us a room. Then he had someone from inside the hotel to pretend they were calling from hotels.com when actually they were from the inside. What threw it off she kept saying"Hold on Lady!" Really? Thats how you talk to people. I was so furious but too far away from home. I feel the way me and my boss who is a GM for a hotel here in the U.S should be fully compensated for my stay.

author: 50brena
title: The Beach
text: 2nd time at Tropical. We where there for 2 weeks. There is the Tropical Princess section and the Caribe Club Princess side. Hotel rooms where clean, no problem. The food was good, many varieties. If you are that picky you should stay home. The beach has many chairs and umbrellas. You can walk along the beach forever each way. Close to a so called mall on the beach. Be warned, they will hound you to buy stuff. I get my bags of coffee at one of the stores there. You can keep walking along the beach past the mall and you will start hitting the big resorts. The beach is very busy at this part of the beach. You wont be disappointed. Enjoy

author: swalshx4
title: Beautiful beach
text: Thank goodness the beach was so amazing because this resort was not. We did get a really good deal so I don't think my expectations should have been too high. I was disappointed that the rooms were a lot smaller than they appeared on the website and the walls were very "thin", also not super clean. We barely slept the first night because there was so much noise outside our room. After some persistence, they moved us to another room which was in a much quieter location. We went with 3 other families and one of them had a very musty smelling room with a water leak under the sink and another had a room with no A/C. We have a family of 6 and it was very difficult to get 6 towels in our room to shower and no washcloths, ever. The showers were cold and the pool towels were always "out". When we got our hands on some pool towels, we held onto them until we were sure we could trade them in for new ones. Our kids really enjoyed the beach volleyball although there was only 1 ball for 2 volleyball courts. The food was pretty much the same every day and the non buffet restaurants cost extra. We did meet an amazing waiter who kind of saved the dining experience for us (but food not great). The weekends were very busy and noisy. We were told by some staff that the hotel was open to locals on the weekends and there was a definite impact. There was a line to get in to dinner and the pools were crowded and noisy. You weren't getting pool towels on the weekend. Our kids participated in some pool competitions (which were far and few between) and were told to report to the theater that night for their reward...there was no reward, just a sub par dance themed show. The activity staff (towels and volleyball) were not friendly at all. I could go on and on but all in all, we enjoyed this vacation because we love the beach, were with a group of friends and we did a couple excursions that were extra. The hotel staff was not friendly and I wouldn't go back BUT the beach is beautiful.

author: Tclearwater
title: 3 generation family vacation
text: We stayed for a week to celebrate my husband's and son's birthday's. We have been to the DR numerous times and always enjoy the culture. The Tropical Princess is spread out along the mangroves down to the beach, I very much enjoyed the space to roam and get away from the hustle. My mother had a hard time with the size due to her age so she stuck with using the trolley which runs 24 hours a day. The beach is large with tons of chairs and little seaweed. Great for early morning walks. The drink selection was sufficient. The bartenders were friendly. The buffet could use a little work it had a limited selection and was very repetitive. The seafood wasn't very good and the produce variety was poor, two things that we expected to be better since we were in the Caribbean. We ate at the Dominican and Mexican restaurants which were very good. Emmanuel at the front desk was very helpful, we needed a room change because my mom couldn't climb the 3 flights of stairs to get to the room. TIP: if traveling with elderly or small children request a first floor room because there aren't any elevators. We had the family suite which has 2 bedrooms with 3 beds and 2 bathrooms. The room was okay, the beds okay, closets small, one tv, water pressure was fine but the shower heads could be cleaned out. They decorated the room for my husband's and son's birthdays. The pools were spacious with shaded parts and plenty of chairs. We had a wonderful family vacation.

author: ormondah2015
title: Only fun.....was the excursions
text: I must say I booked this hotel through Bookit,their service was absolutely great from the day we arrived to the day we left. Upon arrival,the front desk clerks were very friendly. We had to pay for usage of the security deposit box in the room that just didn't seem to work good,the battery to the remote didn't work,the sliding door on ou room didn't lock at all,there was never any hot water the 3 nights me & my 3 girls s here. Our bldg was:Lirio. The room needs some updating: the lamp was tore up,there's a wooden shelf that has cob webs all under,the tiles in the ceiling. The door look like it had mold on it or could just use some paint. Had so many open holes,we stuck paper or tissue in it. We would leave the room & come back to the tile slightly being moved again. OMG...... were we possibly being watched. It really makes me wonder. Because of allergies,we are allergic to different things,cats & cigarettes are some of those things. Which made it a little hard to enjoy the vacation,we tried to avoid them as much as possible. But we was not expecting that at all. The lights went out during the day for about 20mins 1 day. Other than that, we spent most of our time on the beach & out in the ocean,eating at the all inclusive restaurant.

author: TracyAM
title: Beautiful beach and multiple clean pools. Will try a different hotel next time.
text: This was our second visit to the Tropical Princess. Our room was 3308. Our family does not mind stairs, however if your's does, the 3rd floor may not be for you. The room(s) are small, as are the beds (full size) but we literally only slept in them. My daughters full size bed had a twin fitted sheet. She did not appreciate having to actually touch the mattress. I don't blame her. The maids did a good job cleaning the rooms, however we were left one towel for both my husband and myself to share, and were never given washcloths for our faces. I called guest services for towels and although I was told they would bring up a towel, they only called back 2 hours later asking if I still needed it. The same thing happened when I asked for an iron. Now the food.....I love omelet's when I'm on vacation, however I was never able to eat the whole thing because they were undercooked EVERY day. It was also difficult to get coffee and tea at breakfast. They almost always brought it to us at the end of our meal. There was also a time my husband actually got his own (self serve was NOT an option). If it were, we would have had no problem helping ourselves. The pasta station at dinner was good for me as there were not many vegetarian options. The grounds crew are very hard workers. They keep the outdoor areas looking beautiful. Also, the entertainment people work so hard. They put in VERY long days and work multiple

author: MsNayTravels
title: Would Stay Again!
text: This was our first stop in Punta Cana. The resort is clean and the staff is friendly. When we arrived check-in was smooth. We were in building 4 right and right outside our room was a nice little hut to get drinks. Perfect I would say lol! At one point during our stay we went and sat on the beach around 3 am it was so beautiful and peaceful. There was a guard on duty so we felt safe. In addition we got hungry and at this point it was about 5 am. We some how ended up at the buffet area asking whoever we could find where the 24 hr snack bar was. We got more than what we asked for. Not only were we pointed in the direction of the snack bar. One of the chefs on duty setting up for breakfast made us a plate! It was soooo nice of him! The food was amazing overall and we had a GREAT TIME! We would definitely return!

author: splott112
title: No AC
text: We returned from a week at the resort on April 3. The beach was great (although large waves and no shells if you are hoping to find some), there were three nice pools, and the grounds were very well-maintained. The staff seemed generally very friendly. We asked for an additional bed in the room (a cot) and it was delivered quickly. The safe was modern and worked well, and the mini fridge was clean and always stocked with water, Sprite and Coke. Our room was another story. What a disappointment. The décor was really dated and sparse. No table, no reading chair, ancient TV. A creepy fluorescent ceiling light.The bathroom was really sad and looked dirty even when it was clean. The biggest problem for me was no air conditioning - at all. The day we arrived I mentioned the problem to the front desk and they said they would fix it. Someone came to the room but I'm not sure what he did as it was still like an oven in there. All day, all night, it was over 30 degrees Celsius. We couldn't sleep in the heat, even when leaving the sliding door open, as the loud music and partying kept us up for hours. We were miserable. I would not recommend the Tropical Princess due to the lack of AC. I feel completely ripped off. Even a basic Caribbean all-inclusive would have working AC, but this middle-of-the-road resort doesn't. Stay away.

author: excitedtotravel
title: Decent Trip
text: We went into the trip with reasonable expectations so we were not disappointed. We typically travel every year, sometime to high end and sometimes to mid range. Beach was lovely, waves were rough but the kids loved them and had fun hanging in their tubes. If you are looking for shade though you will have a tough time finding a palapa unless you are up at the crack of dawn. My husband was up around 630am each day to secure us chairs at the pool or the beach and not always successful at the beach. Pools were nice, always being cleaned and maintained. Same with the grounds always clean. We spent most of our time at pool #3 right outside of our room. Rooms-we stayed in a family room, was always clean. We had an issue with our AC and after numerous calls and a couple trips to the front desk we found out that we would have to switch rooms as the whole AC unit needed to be removed and fixed. We opted to stay as the alternate rooms being offered were right across from the main entrance to the buffet and very noisy. Food-was not to bad for all inclusive, was always the right temp. Did get a little repetitive by day 5 or so but I always find that with All inclusive resorts. All in all we had a good trip, no major complaints with the exception of the AC in our room but we did not let in ruin our trip. Wifi in the lobby at night was not great, we went up during the day and it was fine for what we needed. Night shows were enjoyable, the kids enjoyed them. Most of the employees were helpful and friendly. We loved the size, so easy to walk quickly to where we wanted. Go with reasonable expectations and you will enjoy!

author: LesGavelles
title: Map of hotel
text: Here is a map of the Tropical and Caribe princess hotel. Basically the same hotel, but I think you get more a la carte restaurant with Caribe. Building 30, 34-37 are at the Princess, the other side is Caribe. If you are a family get 2 rooms (1 king and 1 with 2 double beds). This is alot bigger than the family rooms. We have friends that did that and they got connecting rooms in one of the 34-37 buildings, it was really big. It's more quiet there too and I don't think they have water issues. The large 30 building is were all the family rooms are, hot water takes about 5 minutes to get to the shower... It's alot noisier because of all the rooms/people etc. This is a 4 star, not more, but a nice 4 star. Beach is beautiful so are the grounds. Clean, good service, food ok. Brazilian restaurant is really good. Beds are hard, and decor outdated but your in the room to change/sleep/take a shower so it's ok. We were expecting a little worse than what we got because of all the reviews. Good quality/price.

author: andreao296
title: In paradise
text: The staff (receptionist, bellboys, barman, waitress...) was very friendly since the time we arrived till the end. We are still absolutely satisfied with everything - with the nature, beach, sea, accommodation, food.... The accommodation was nice, the cleaning lady cleaned the room and changed the towels every day. The bathroom needed small reconstruction but it was ok. We stayed in a lovely house with lovely view nearby the sea. There are three swimming pools at the hotel (the main swimming with water bar). But there was a bar by the next two swimming pools, too. There is no night swimming (and no topless). The food was really various and delicious. The are some different bufets during the week (mexican, oriental, dominican - with some show, ...). There is a lot of restaurants at the hotel and we had two restaurant a la carte (Brazilian Rodizzio by the sea and Dominican restaurant). The sea was hot and brilliant but there was some seaweeds some days, but the guys cleaned it. Be careful about the sun, it is really strong, and cocktails =D We did some trips, I really recommend you to visit the island Saona.....it is the virgin paradise....and the country adventure, where you can buy nature cacao, coffee, chocolate, mama juana, tobacco.....for good prices. Recommendtaions: take something against mosquitos, learn a few spanish word (hola, gracias..), go to the dicso, take a strong some cream for the first few days, take a hat,go to some trips, take some money apart as a tip (tip for almoust everybody - about one dollar for bellboys, for the favorite waiter, for cleaning lady every second day,..), a negotiate bout the prices, don't buy for the prices the shopkeepers tell you (it could be about 50 % cheaper), ..... We absolutely go there again =)

author: miko425
title: Beautiful resort but boring
text: This is a beautiful resort. If you are looking for a resort with a lot to do, don't go here. There is no entertainment during the day unless you're on the beach but this resort is so big that they have a shuttle going around 24 hours a day. We were there for 2 weeks and found it way too long due to boredom. We were ready to come home after 1 week. The pools are amazing. The bars close way too early. The lobby bar opens too late. I wanted to go in the lobby in the morning, have my coffee and browse but the Wifi, which was free in the lobby but that's if you are lucky enough to get it. It doesn't work more than half the time. They need entertainment in the lobby at night, it's big enough for it. The need to have a grill by the pool bar at the Lyrio building. The room was amazing, no complaints. The mini fridge stocked daily. If you want extra, just ask and you will get it. I'll go back to DR but probably another resort.

author: LaineyJane
title: Pretty average - wouldn't return
text: This is an ok value for the price but at some point I am willing to pay more to get more. We travelled as a family and with some friends the first week of February. This was our first time in Punta Cana (we've been to Puerto Plata once) and I wanted to experience the amazing beaches of this area. The beach at this resort was nice, but didn't blow me away - very crowded, lots of vendors. PROS: - Three nice pools - Well kept grounds, with turtles!! (Kids loved this) - fun tram to ride - the housekeeping; no issues and my child's stuffed animals were always displayed creatively on the bed - the "lobby ritual" where after dinner lots of guests gather for the free wifi and enjoy the bar, dancing if the music's good, play games - the tennis CONS -not a single instance of outstanding service, everyone is blase - beds are TERRIBLE. I should learn by now that since my dh is 6'4 that I should always make sure beds will be queen size - but these were hard, awful doubles - I got very sick the last couple of days, and a few others in the group were under the weather at some point as well. It was the food/water/cleanliness of the buffet SOMETHING resort-related. I saw issues of mishandling food/food items at the buffet. Beware. - the family suite layout was bad. The adult side had a small bathroom, no TV, and the kid side had the lockable door. Huh? - lots of smokers - the food. It's just so mediocre I have to put it as a con

author: ranakutum
title: Nice hotel, not so nice staff
text: I stayed at this hotel from January 3 to 10. The hotel is nice and spacious, and has a tropical feel, especially with all the greenery and animals on the hotel premises, such as peacocks, turtles and various types of birds. Though this is nice, you will obviously have bad smells associated with this. The beach and pool areas were quite beautiful. Our room was ok, but didn't feel like a 4 star room. It wasn't very clean and was rather dim. The washroom toilet was used and clogged and didn't flush when we got there so we could not use it and had to wait till the next day for it to get fixed. In terms of food, there were many options but the food was just bland which is understandable as they have to cater to different preferences. The majority of the staff at the restaurant would not service us unless they were tipped. Also, staff from throughout the hotel would be in the buffet lines with the guests and would many times serve themselves before the guests. I'm not against the staff eating the food but perhaps being more discreet about it would be better. Speaking of staff, there was a particular receptionist who would force us to write reviews here, on trip advisor, and would particularly tell us to mention her name and say she was the best staff member at the hotel despite not ever having interacted with her. She approached me 3 different times and on the first time actually took my phone from my hand and opened up trip advisor for me. Finally, I would like to discuss the entertainment at the hotel. They do have sports throughout the day but the night show is terrible. The actors/dancers seem to be making fun and laughing, and are never in sync. It feels like I'm watching a school play. They say they will have different shows every night but turns out to be very similar every night. Overall the hotel is nice, but cleanliness and staff are an issue. I did talk about issues for improvement with the hotel and service but it was a pretty good stay.

author: neick
title: Amazing!!
text: Have only been back a week and already miss Punta Cana and the Tropical Princess Beach Resort. We had an amazing time. The place is huge and incredibly beautiful. I was leary after reading some of the reviews but don't let the bad ones scare you off. We stayed for a week and the only problem we had was getting a hot chocolate instead of a milk shake. My Spanish is very limited and we were able to get along just fine. Most employees know some English and are very willing to help you. The food was more than anyone could ever want. I would definitely recommend the Brazilian restaurant. Bring a huge appetite and only go if you like meat. The beef and pork were so good. The buffet had tons of choices, some ordinary and some I was able to try because goat stew just wasn't something I could get myself to try. Our room was a little musty smelling but you are in a high humidity environment. We had a ground floor room and the sliding door was locked with a screw but we had not issues with anything missing. There have been many reviews regarding the beds as hard but we didn't have any issues with our bed, the pillows are a little lumpy but nothing bad. Also the WIFI is very slow. We were on vacation and didn't care, but if you need to stay connected you might have issues. I would recommend this resort to all my friends.

author: 927nancyn
title: Terrible Hotel/Great internet service w/Gobecon
text: We were at the Tropical Princess Beach Resort & Spa the week of December 11th, 2015. The hotel staff were amazing and the grounds are well maintained however the food was terrible, no evening entertainment after 10:30 and the variety of drinks were alright. While there one of our friends had their i-pad stolen out of their room-resort did nothing to compensate her-in fact they gave her grief about having the police on the resort! The room doors had gaps and only a chain lock, no deadbolt. Patio doors don't lock either. So if you stay at this resort, please make sure you don't stay on the first floor and that your safe works! As for internet service we booked with Gobecon prior to leaving and I would highly recommend this company. They are a professional, reliable, reasonable priced company. Their staff are amazing to deal with. When you arrive at the airport, there will be someone waiting with a sign for you just prior to getting on your bus for transfer to your hotel. They ensure that prior to leaving you know how to use the device and that your phones/ipads/electronics connect to the device. At the hotel and anywhere else I had high speed internet and we were able to connect 6 devices. It always worked and we had no problems!! At the end of our trip their rep met me at the airport and I got my deposit back with problems or hassles. Loved it! I would recommend their services to anyone! I will definitely be contacting them on my next trip-however the Tropical Princess will not be hearing from me anytime soon.

author: ushirani
title: nice resort for family
text: this was our 10th trip to DR, but 1st to this resort , nice experience . we were 6 , 2 adult kids and 2 grand kids , 5 and 11 years old. while we had a good time, a few suggestions (based on other resorts): 1. the hours of operation posted outside the main buffet room was very helpful in some resorts. Maybe this resort might consider doing it. 2. while the staff works very hard , always polite and helpful, they could use some tips on making tea ( I understand most people drink coffee , but other guests have told me this as well) the boiling water for tea was not there most of the time . 3. they had labelled foods , but sometimes failed to write the meat addition to a vegetarian looking dish. some of us are vegetarians , I do know we are a minority , so it is understandable . the animation team works hard on the shows . there were lots of chairs , both in shade and sun . room was nice , bathroom a bit outdated but ok. the maid service was ok , but not consistent , one day our daughter and her 2 kids had no towels , the used ones taken away , so we had to give her ours, her safe did not work either , the code they gave was not working and phone calls to front desk were not helpful , these are not major issues , but could be improved . perhaps more water for rooms will be useful ,no hardship though , as all the bars have that the grounds were very nice , is there a solution to walking without watching for the ever present tram cars , maybe some time when they can not come and go if u want a light lunch , eat at the creperie , their coffee and milkshakes were good , also has a selection of pastries , vey busy 3-5 , the crepes are light and if like me, u are a vegetarian , try the mushroom one , café latte is good there as it is freshly prepared

author: lazeyboy
title: Beautiful Beach
text: We Vacationed at Tropical Princess Dec. 6-12. The weather was great. The beach was fantastic. Lots of lounge chairs available every morning. The rooms are outdated and could use renovation. "It was like staying in a Motel 6" We did not have hot water for the first 4 days if our stay. The cold shower was miserable. Rooms where cleaned and stocked daily. Food was OK. The food in the specialty restaurants where good. My wife did get stomach issues during our stay. Overall if you can book it cheap go for it. If you would like total luxury I would go somewhere else. You pay for what you get.

author: CK169
title: It was Ok
text: This hotel is only ok. The customer service is the worst part. We told them for 3 days that our AC was not working, before they finally moved us to another room. And that was done with attitude. The grounds are very nice. The bar tenders and servers were all great. I got a pedicure, and it was not all that good though. The guys that worked doing the scuba, and other activities were fantastic. The food was ok. The omelet bar was really good, and so was the Italian bar. The free beer was awesome! Do not plan to go shopping outside of the resort without an escort, and I would not suggest renting a car as the people there drive CRAZY!! Even my husband thought the driving was nuts, and he drives crazy! Over all, we enjoyed our trip. IF you are looking for 5 stars though, this is not it.

author: Dusmay
title: Outstanding Service!
text: We just spent a week at the Tropical Princess and enjoyed ourselves immensely! We had a little issue with water leak after a torrential rain one day, which led to us having to vacate our room. This was handled with professionalism and dealt with promptly by Guest Services Alvaro. We were moved to a different location of the hotel and even upgraded to a family room. We were 4 and originally had 2 rooms, however the family room was able to accommodate us-was a lovely newer room-recommend family room. Additionally, we felt our needs were met and exceeded with the assistance of Alvaro-please recognize his fine skill in Customer service. He is an asset to your organization. Also would like to mention with very high regard the following: Reina-please keep smiling and continuing to be such a pleasure and accommodating guests with whatever they need-thank you for the lovely flower petals of art you left for us:) And to the staff at the restaurants and bars-too many to name but also with high regard: Felipe, David, Cristian-you made us all feel special. Remembering our drink order and the cute paper animations for the sodas! You made my mothers trip unforgettable as well my stepson first trip to DR memorable!! And to Kiara-thank you for spending time to assist on our last evening as well, so good to meet you! And finally, but not lastly-the incredible team of dancers, animation team, MC and choreographer-you really "sold it"!! Giving it your all every single night. Well done. Keep smiling, and love what you are doing. Recommend and will come back when in DR!! Thank you. Best regards, The family from Canada:)

author: alisonbD335JD
title: Tropical nightmare
text: From the first night to the last this resort was unprofessional, unsafe & dirty. No crib available for my 14 month old baby when we checked in, we were kept waiting for almost 2 hours before the front desk finally said no crib available.Then we find black mold on the wall, floor the shower of both bathrooms. We had to carry the stroller up and down two flights of stairs each time we wanted to go anywhere because there are no elevators. Day 3 the ceiling in the bathroom starts dripping water all over the place, making it even more disgusting and unsafe and slippery. This prompted a move to a ground floor room where we had to listen to all guests and staff smash and crash and yell all day and night making nap time impossible. Surprisingly there were so many workers banging and crashing all over the place it was very challenging to keep the baby napping. So many maintenance trucks all over the property and workers but the hotel is in terrible shape, doors won't close, toilets won't flush. Then there was the night when a maid was able to just walk right in to our room even though the dead bolt was double turned. Apparently all staff can enter any room at any time, and then they lie about it when you confront management. Cleaning staff are also not concerned about excessive noise at any hour of the day and night and will yell at the guest when confronted. My impression is that this resort lacks proper management which is creating a very unhealthy unsafe environment for the vacationers. Multiple other negative situations including food quality & selection. Positive note - the weather was awesome. The beach was perfect. Seaweed washed up was not a problem. Some of the service staff in the restaurants were excellent and very friendly. They actually went out of their way to make you happy.

author: kristinrap
title: DONT GO HERE
text: I'm going to try and make this short. No one knows their head from their butt. You ask for vodka with orange juice, and you receive Rye and coke? You call the front desk inquiring if they have daylight savings and they simply just explain how the clock works. They advertise wifi in the lobby and for purchase. Wifi in lobby only works if your the only one in there. And we didn't receive our wifi until the fourth day because they only have 6 throughout the resort.. So dumb. There's cockroaches everywhere, your fridge was never restocked, they don't change your sheets, they only gave us 2 towels no face towels, if it rains your room leaks, you get harassed at the beach to buy stuff, their disco is outside of the resort filled with locals. There's nothing to do after 1130. And the one that really ticked us off... From Friday until Sunday the hotel is LOADED with locals. Rude, pushy, perverted locals. You are pushed out of the way while waiting for food, their kids act even worse then the wild turkeys and they take over the whole pool area regardless if you were there or not. I could go on for paragraphs. With that said I will NOT be returning or suggesting this place to anyone. I consider it a 3 star...... A Cuban 3 star

author: lucyloum2015
title: Tropical paradise...extremely good value.
text: Will keep this short and sweet. Service was excellent Room even tho superior was basic but clean. It was super close to the restaurants and touching distance to the beach...which had no sea weed and was beyond beautiful. Very tropical theme throughout resort with lots of wildlife. You will get people trying to sell you things especially excursions but in fairness they should sell themselves as there all pretty fun or amazing. Two words coco bongo is a must they really know how to have fun and entertain. Staff were all super friendly. They will try to cater for whatever you need you just have to ask. More food than you can eat with enough restaurants and different themed buffet nights each and every night. Wifi free in lobby and sometimes could pick up free in our room. Spanish is the preferred language but none the less more than manageable to speak English. Overall A hidden gem and extremely good value for money. Plenty to cater to everyone young or not. It was a pleasurable and memorable stay. Thank you to all that make it what it is.

author: foxii05
title: Relaxing, perfect for couples!
text: Very hot, nearly unbearable, Mosquitos are crazy, no form of repellant or relief worked for me. Staff lovely and happy to help with everything, worth brushing up on your Spanish as most struggle with English. Food was a struggle as I am a fussy eater so be sure to book into the restaurants if you are like me. Our package only included Dominican and Brazilian restaurant, Dominican not so great, Brazilian was my savour. A bit like the 'Bem Brazil' restaurant chain in the UK. Lots of different meat! Tip the maids to get extra drinks in your room fridge, the men in green clothes will get you a coconut drink if you ask but tip them too as they have to climb and get them from the tree! Security patrol the resort grounds 24 hours so very safe, nothing to be scared of. The resort is very big but there are regular mini bus/wagons to take you around if you don't want to walk (reception is quite far from some rooms) wifi is only in reception and is poor, that's if you are even able to connect as everyone is trying to get on. Early morning or middle of the night is your best chance. Rooms are like all standard resorts, spacious, air con, English TV channels, good working shower! (Well ours was) we didn't have a great balcony view but it's luck of the draw so not complaining. Easy to make friends over your stay, most guests are so friendly and the 24 hour bar by the beach has seen us making new friends every night! For me, pool over beach as although sea water was not cold, waves were quite choppy, have to go quite far out for calmer water. Very seaweedy on the sand but we heard it is not usually like that. Can't really comment on entertainment as we didn't attend any shows/ activities in the hotel. Overall a great time had, 10 days was long enough for us, I would recommend this resort to others but bear in mind all of the above so you know what to expect.

author: yvettes208
title: Great place Great people
text: We really enjoyed our time here. Everyone was so pleasant and so helpful. I loved the pools perfect for my 3 year old and my 11 year old. My kids loved feeding the turtles at night and the ducks in the morning. The activities at the pool were fun and enjoyed playing volleyball. The guys doing the activities are so much fun. The last night we were there (Sunday) they had a DJ party at the beach and they were showing us how to dance Bachata fun! fun! fun!!! I want to say a special THANK YOU to Jose De La Paz (El Pescador & Buffet), Gustavo Robles (El Pescador & Buffet), Angelina (Buffet), Andris (Buffet) and Miguel (manager El Pescador & Buffet) for their PHENOMENAL service. Having people like this work here makes you feel at home. I do have to say the room wasn't what we expected. Our beds were all queen and not 1 King and 2 Queen like it said for the Family room and the bathroom shower tile seem old and the AC is pretty loud but that did not stop us from having a great time since we were hardly in the room. I recommend you take insect repellent we got a lot of mosquito bites. Overall we had a "Great Time" and will definitely be back.

author: Loker18
title: DOMINICAN TAKE OVER!!!!!
text: I went there with my family in mid-July. It was rated 4 stars but I had heard that a 4 star in Punta Cana is not like a 4 star in Cuba....WRONG!!!!! When it comes to this resort, don't expect too much. t's like a 3 star! The rooms are outdated, dirty and hot. We changed rooms 4 times!!! The floor was sticky, the shower smelled like dirty bleach water, the AC would not cool more than 26 degrees, the shower head was so dirty that I had to use antibacterial wipes to clean it. The wipes came out black!!! Also, the food is "blah" and even if you want to eat, there are no plates and a lot of the food trays are empty and stay empty for a long time. Also, good luck on weekends when the locals take over the whole resort! They cut in front of you in line at the buffet and at the bar, they eat in the pool and then you see food floating in it, and they are so loud!!! We would be trying to get some sleep and would be woken up every few minutes by screaming people passing next to our room! When we asked for more pillows, since we were five and the five pillows we had were paper thin, and they wouldn't give us more than 2 extra pillows until we made a big fuss! And you better speak Spanish or good luck! I got sick for a few days from the food and so did my son. We would NEVER return to this resort. Go somewhere else! Anywhere else!

author: W275IZjennym
title: STAY AWAY! This is NOT a 3 1/2 star resort
text: First, be warned that the management of this hotel does not care about your needs. (Read his 'canned' responses to other reviewers) We had no food, towels, A/C was broken in the rooms, no toilet paper, no drinks in the refrigerator...I could go on. They offer specials to the locals, so the hotel is PACKED with people. However, they just can't keep up with the volume. They ran out of food in the cafe and every time they refilled it, people would swarm in and grab it. The lines to get food was horrendous! My 2 kids (ages 3 and 8) were crying because they were so hungry. You can't get towels for the pool after 6 p.m. (but they should have told us before my kids got in the pool!) So we had to use our room towels...but we only had 2 for a family of FOUR. We were with 2 other families and spent 6 hours in the lobby trying to switch hotels because we heard it only gets worse on the weekends. They won't let you call your travel agent without charging you for it. While there, EVERYONE we spoke to was NOT happy. Some had visited before and said it used to be great, but this time it was horrible. So if repeat customers even complained (and mgt. did nothing to help), there's a problem. STAY AWAY!

author: sag_man1978
title: Great Family Vacation!
text: Having stayed with a positive experience in 2009, we decided that Tropical Princess would be the destination for a family trip as a gift for my father’s 65’th birthday. Upon arrival there was a feeling of comfort and ease that I could only describe as being “home”, this feeling would continue throughout our trip. I knew we had made the right choice. The grounds are immaculately kept just as I remembered, and there was an army of cleaners each morning cleaning and maintaining them. The majority of our group were placed in the Lirio building (3500 block), while my parents were place in one of the “villa” buildings Jazmin. Rooms were terrific if slightly dated, with some chipped tiles and worn silicone around the sink/shower. However these were minor issues and did not at all detract from the stay. Food is typical resort buffet fare, with a variety of food options and stations with fresh made dishes. Also there each day had a different theme, Mexican, Asian, Italian, etc with food to go along with that theme. There was even a Canadian night on Jan 15, although it seems that their image of Canadians is that we are a bunch of cowboys who listen to Shania Twain :P LOL. We chose the Brazilean a la carte option, and our group enjoyed being served with all kinds of meats on large skewers/swords. Every staff member was terrific, too many names to mention. From the restaurant service team, to the guest services (setting up a la carte meals), to the animation team, to cleaning staff, to the bartenders. Each and every one made us feel comfortable and always greeted us with a smile on their face. There were however a few hitches. Pick up locations for excursions were not communicated very well and resulted in two members of our party missing out on their excursion (Their payment was refunded however, so thumbs up for that) and we were left wondering where to wait or who to look for, for our pick up. Overall I was satisfied with our stay, I would return and would recommend this resort to others.

author: 168ChrisL
title: Great for a Family with Young Kids!
text: First, this place has fantastic pools that are perfect for kids. Each pool area has lots of sun and shade all day so it's easy to roll with the heat and stay cool. The buffet has a wide variety of food to choose from and was quite good overall. The beach is all white sand and very soft. A downside to the beach was the Atlantic Ocean, it is not at all like the Caribbean Sea. It can be very rough and there is always a steady wind coming to shore. While we were staying (March-April) there appeared to be a lot of sea-weed washing up, but wasn't a big deal. Another small issue was that there was never towels available, beach or room. We noticed that only leaving a tip would ensure you had enough towels for everyone, otherwise we were always shorted. We also found that in order to get a decent spot at the beach or the pool areas, we had to have someone put our swimming gear out at 6:00am or you would not get a spot until 2 or 3pm when the heat of the day has some people heading to their rooms for siesta.
