The bartenders, for the most part, are fantastic. Although we found the language barrier a bit difficult at times the bartenders were always eager to help out in any way they could. This is also not an "ALL" inclusive resort half of the drink menu is pay items. 4 of the 6 a la carte restaurants require you to pay it didn't cause us any problems but was a little deceiving when booking the trip (I blame the travel agent really). El Pilon (Dominican Food Restaurant) was fantastic, even for small kids and the Brazilian Restaurant was amazing. The room itself was a family room with 3 beds and a separate room with two showers. The TV seemed totally pointless unless you like to crowd around an old CRT. The beds were very hard and small. The room was always clean, again, as long as we tipped well. I would recommend this place for families but would probably pass it by if it were a couples retreat.

author: G4371NFchristinew
title: Great Trip Overall!! Tropical Princess!!!!
text: Upon arrival at the Hotel we were greeted at the front desk by Elbis (Elvis), very helpful, friendly, smiling. He helped us with our check-in which went smooth and quick. We then took the train buggy to the main buffet as the children were very hungry. Got a chance to check out the resort at the same time. The buffet had a nice variety of food for lunch and for supper there was a different theme each night which was nice. (Something for everyone). The only bad thing I will say about the buffet is that the servers don't smile and in the morning we had to keep asking different servers for coffee. Edward (nice friend guy, smiles) came to our rescue and asked someone to grab us some. Edward can also be found at Le Creperie (yummmm). We went to three of the Restaurants (Dominican, Italian and Brasilan) The Brasilian was my favorite. There are three pools on the resort, the main pool with the sunken bar (best bartenders and smiling and happy) is the pool where the most action takes place. This is the social pool. The middle pool is the quiet pool, and then there was the pool on the far side which was where you would see lots of family and happy people just enjoying their holidays. Overall we enjoyed this resort very much. OMG a group of teens were at this resort and they were loud, noisy, impolite, drunk, vomited in the main lobby at night, vomit in the sinks in the ladies washroom very disrespectful for everyone. Bad Points: If you are in the 3000 block bring earplugs (our room was right at the entrance top of the stairs and I don't think I slept all week). The sellers can be very pushy and aggresive (the ones that come to the resort), never any clean beach towels, two nights of animation (Michael Jackson show) a must see. Not enough night time animation especially if you go with children and it starts very late 9:45 pm with children that is late. Good Points: Food was good, liked the different themes, like the daytime animation, if you are going to do an excertion very well organized (we traveled with Sunwing - excellent), the lobby is clean and the staff friendly. Overall we were a two families (2 adults 2 children each) and we enjoyed our time at this resort and would definitely go back.

author: Dannyana
title: Do not go there
text: My husband and I were there for one week. Had to pay extra money to get a better room. We saw cockroaches in our room. The fan and the light above the bed did not work. The fan above the toilet drips on your had when you using the toilet. I am talking about the " better room". Privios room had old ripped curtains and bedskirt. It smelled so bad, musty smell, that I could not stay in the room more than two minutes. People do play the game of understanding you only when it is convenient to them. I felt that constantly somebody is trying to sell you something. Some lady that works in the lobby was trying to sell me a flower hair clip for five dollars. Food was really bad. For frying they use most disgusting oil. Crepperia was good and a good service. Nice grounds. We would never recommend the place to anybody.

author: 100vinals
title: Students rule the resort and management does nothing!
text: We encountered S-Trip students at this resort. There were around 200 teenagers (16-18)drinking their faces off, and ruling the resort. You couldn't get away from them. Both their staff and the resort staff did nothing to control them. The fact that we were paying customers was of no consequence. When we called management about the noise nothing was done. It seems their policy is do nothing and maybe the problem will go away. We had to change our room three times before we got the room we booked. The air-conditioning didn't work and was never fixed. The manager said he would book us extra reservations at the a la carts but when we showed up at them there was no reservation. When we asked to go to the beach market, they told us there was no beach market. Friends told us about it, so we know there is one. If there is no money to be made with bookings they play the I don't understand what your saying game. Also be warned that you will get hounded by people selling stuff everywhere. There are timeshare sellers at the doors to the buffet, and excursion sellers on the beach.

author: Fran12345678999
title: Underwhelemed
text: This resort is truly a joke. The best part is the beach and the pool if your even lucky enough to find some chairs. Every single day we were stuck with broken chairs it was ridiculous. The food was terrible and most days all we ate was bread and butter or rice. The meat was chewy and the fish was not edible and no selection. The best night was mexican but otherwise there was nothing we enjoyed and we are not picky people!! Even the fries were horrible it amazed me. One night one of us got sick from the undercooked burger and had to stay in from food poisioning. The food was almost the same every night except for a few changes which barely related to the "themed" buffet. Hardly any vegetables and fruit which was extremley dissappointing. The omlette station and creperie were the best part except for the slow service. The staff is great for the most part but very limited English! There was no elevators and we had to carry our luggage ourselves. The shuttle was helpful but was fustrating to wait for. The whole place was extremley run down some of the showers had no door on them and our hair dryer worked spiradically. It was very fustrating to use the wifi so slow and basically a waste of time to even try it. They had the option to buy a personal wifi box but once again slow and waste of money. Many people on our trip got robbed of money and more. Spend your money else where in the dominican. For the cost of this hotel it is defintely not worth it!!

author: 255kellyd
title: Mixed Feelings!
text: Stayed at this resort for 2 weeks, Feb 25-Mar 11. The Good: Easy check in. Beautiful resort, loved the layout! Awesome beach, which is what we came for.You could walk for miles. Friendly staff although somewhat of a language barrier. Rooms in the Jazmin building could use a bit of an update but were kept very clean. The Not So Good: We did have some issues with the hot water but it was warm enough to have a quick shower. Pressure not like home but what do you expect. Old safes..uses keys, for such a big hotel chain they could afford electronic safes.(Friends we were travelling with were missing $500 from their safe) The food was not the best and never hot, with exception of the omelettes and the pasta station, but we could usually find something to eat. Three of our party were sick for a couple of days each. The hard liquor was terrible no matter how you mixed it, the beer was OK. We also found that it was hard to find a place to have drinks in the evening. There was a little bar outside our building that we sat at after a day on the beach, but after we went for dinner usually around 7-7:30, the bar closed at 9pm. So if you wanted to go for a drink you either had to go all the way to the lobby or back to the beach. Not a big deal but it is nice to have somewhere closer. Would we return? Probably not, there are lots of other places to see.

author: 215wills
title: a place to start.
text: We had 1 day and 1 night at the Tropical Princess and from there went out on the Turks and Caicos Aggressor. The accommodation were adequate. Nothing over the top. Our Air conditioning didn't work and we had heard one other couple having the same issue and the experience they went through to try to fix it and decided to ignore it. The food.. was good, not great but a lot of it. The drinks were bad or not what I would drink. Lot's of loud entertainment going on until 2 AM. The Pool was nice. Good accommodation around the pool with a nice view. The property is right on the ocean so beach access is spot on. The Staff was BAR NON the BEST!!! Great people serving you. Always wanting to make you happy or do something for you. (Please tip them generously the area is quite depressed and needs your help!)

author: cfigirl
title: Nightmare
text: The only nice thing about this resort is the beach and the pools. It took us two hours to get a room. The front desk was disorganized and clueless. When we got a room, it had three full beds instead of one king, but they had no other rooms (supposedly) to give us. The room was dirty! Sand all over the floor, pink mold everywhere, a spider the size of my fist lived in the bathroom, and the showers wouldn't drain! The food was awful. Terrible presentation, the same thing over and over, greasy, no choices, food left out uncovered and inedible. The second night, we ate at a specialty restaurant. Service was bad, and food horrible. That night I got food poisoning and threw up from 11:00 until 6:30 am! The service was terrible as well. We never complained, but it was like we didn't exist. Such a horrible feeling. They never had enough towels, didn't even have ironing boards and housekeeping came into our without our permission to get the iron...scary! I highly recommend staying somewhere she, people were all over the lobby complaining, and nothing was ever done to fix anything! What a nightmare!

author: michaelrE1988SB
title: Christmas Holiday Experience 2014
text: We met several family members flying in from Venezuela and we from the US for a Christmas family reunion at the Tropical Princess Resort. In total, there were about 18 of us. This was our first trip to an all inclusive style resort. An we had a wonderful time as a family. My impressions of the Resort are a bit mixed however. The staff was exceptional. Very friendly and helpful. They made us feel very welcome and we enjoyed talking and doing activities with them. They were energetic, and genuinely wanted us to have a wonderful experience. Some of the best hospitality that I have ever experienced when travelling. The dining facilities were very nice, especially the main buffet. The staff did a wonderful job of accommodating our large party - especially the Christmas Eve Dinner. The reason I mentioned earlier that my impressions are mixed in that the accommodations (rooms) at the resort are not up to a level that I find acceptable. The beds were horrible and I did not get a decent night sleep the entire week I was there. The air conditioning system was problematic and had to run full blast all the time just to keep the room comfortable. I believe they have better rooms at the resort, but I am not sure how to "guaranty" that we would be get a better room. It is for this reason that we will look to stay at a different resort for our next family get together.

author: Assafamrani
title: Christmas nightmare!
text: Assuming you're not looking for a Motel6 like getaway for the holidays, stay away from this one!! Went there on a family trip for the holidays. Made reservation for their family suite. Got a two x-small rooms with TV from the 60's. No Wifi. Rooms were dirty, mold all over the shower rooms, smells. Outside noise from drunk people late at night and noisy cleaning ladies at 7am. This was a daily routine. The next day asked to switch rooms and got it after a long battle. New room was cleaner but could not find one with no ms or rust on the mirror and all steel handles. Then a severe water leakage from the room above us began preventing us from using our shower. After complaining about it and being lied about problem being fixed, we learned that the guest above us does not allow service people to enter their room and fix problem. Hotel manager says he has no other rooms available so we end up using kids shower, with close to zero water flow, for the next four days. And this is just a short summary.... By the way, if you don't speak Spanish, forget about communication. Maybe 10% of the stuff speaks English. The service people in the restaurants were nice though and the beach is beautiful though non usable due to enormous amounts of seaweed

author: 815otmarm
title: Wonderful stay Thank you
text: Mr. Fedirico Espinal Gm, We would like to thank you for the wonderful stay and great service. It was truly a great experience. We as frequent travelers stayed from Sept.29 for a full week. The reception staff is very friendly The grounds, pools and beach where great. The kids loved the train rides and the kids club the staff there was very helpful. Our special thanks to the waiters staff in the resataurant especially Solani Vicente, Joel Santos Paulino Hertego Amado and Cristian Elemano they got out of there way and deserve to be mentioned by name and recognized. They really make us feel at home and welcome You truly have a wonderful staff. The buffet restaurant was excellent also the Brazilian and the Dominican restaurant. Not to forget the HSPK who kept our room clean during our stay and maintenance who where there instantly when we called to check our TV. The shows where very good, we saw 6 of the 7 nights. especially Roy. The massages and pedicure where great and relaxing. We choose your hotel because it was recommenced by friends. We truly will recommend this hotel to others and will definitely be back. Thanks again for the great stay and hospitality Fam. Molina

author: 742MichaelK742
title: dissapointing
text: This was our third vacation in Punta Cana and the worst! We were there 08/30-09/06 and changed three rooms in first two days just to find out one with working AC !!! First assigned was 3304- when we entered we were surprised- room is about 7x9 with small window and two queen bads. I went to lobby to ask for room with balcony and was given 3355- same floor just normal size and with balcony. At that time was about 6 pm we went for dinner and later when we got back we found that AC is not working!!! It was 88 degrees in the room but we were very tired so we turned on all the fans and fal asleep.. Not much of a sleep but first thing in the morning was back to lobby. Cust. service gave us third room, this time 1206, different building.Here everything worked! Over all whole place need at least to be painted, also some minor repairs are needed specialy in bathrooms. One thing I don't like is that there is no coffee maker in the room, also there is no iron so it is best if you take wrinkle free stuff.fridges are stuffed dailly but only with 4 botles of water and one soda, also you have one small soap and two body washes per day per person, so I am recomending to bring your own stuff. Wi-fi is working stricly in the lobby, every call you make is at least $1/per min. for local calls and up. Safe is $4 per day, I was aware of that but in my opinion that service should be free of charge. Food is not bad- we didn't go to specialty restorans El Higuejo is very good- plenty of variety every day different so most likely you can find something for everybody. Stuff is friendly but specialy housekeeping doesn't understand English so that is little problem when you want to explain something. Beach is nice and very close.

author: 606madeleinea
title: it was a nice staying
text: Nice pools. A lot of bars. Great food. Nursery for children. Close to the airport (30 minutes) The shows at night were very nice and funny! The animation team is excellent!!!!!! Special mention to spaghetti!! You can always find chairs at the beach. Mexican restaurant and brazilian restaurant were delicious and the service was very good. I definitely recommand the catamaran excursion that last 4 hours for 59$/person. My father (50 years), my sister (5 years), my brother (23 years) and stepmom (43 years) enjoyed that day. Negative points: Our air conditioning broken every day. Every day we had to call to the lobby to fix the problem. In the night (around 8pm), wi-fi didn't worked in the lobby (only place to have access to internet) because they were to many people trying to use it. Last thing, to many algae at the beach. The service at the buffet was very nice! Special mention to Junior, a waiter. I want to thank him for his service and his kindness.

author: carolmG7333FU
title: Better than I had expected
text: Just returned from a 6 day stay at the Tropical princess. Prior to my arrival, I read through many reviews which made me a little nervous about visiting this place. But because we had booked, there really was not much choice in requesting changes. Upon arrival I was impressed at the lobby, our attendant at check in was very courteous and helpful. We arrived very early, so our room was not yet prepared, therefore, we took the little shuttle provided and ate at the buffet. The Buffet was very decent and had several choices which catered to most diets. The desserts were pretty good too, lot's to choose from! Once we ate, we were able to go to our room. Beds were clean and comfortable. We also had two bathrooms, One had a really loud extractor, and the toilet seemed to be leaking so it was a bit annoying when you needed to do a night trip to the potty. Aside from that, it was also decently clean (there was some soap scum on the shower door-wall). When you travel to places like these, you are barely in the room anyway, so these little things were not a major disappointment. Our housekeeper was also really nice, she stocked us with plenty of water and soda for the kids, and even gave us some extra towels. Beaches were well maintained, as well as the pool. And perhaps the best thing I admired is that we were not bombarded by salesmen to purchase packages for excursions. overall, this place turned out to be much better than I had anticipated, and will be going back to this resort.

author: Alya222
title: Nice outdoors, poor rooms
text: The hotel is located 25 min from the airport, it is right on the beach. I liked the fact that it was not too big and not too small at the same time. The reception staff could not be less efficient, taking forever to check in people and not being really helpful. However the animation staff and the service staff were much better. Sometimes a smile was missing but they were helping you fully and that is what matters. The outdoors were really great with beautiful gardens, nice pools and large beach that were taking care of. The beach has clear water and wind that makes it perfect. What I really did not like are the rooms. Mine was really outdated and furniture were damaged and poorly fixed. I would not say it was not clean but looking that bad does make you feel comfy. Few examples are the missing chain on the doors while the chain holder were there, no "do not disturb" sign, the tape on the switch, the really bad bathroom, dark with only 2 large towels and not even smaller ones, no bathroom rug, no toilet paper holders, old AC, old TV. They could have added some nice touches with decors and new shower curtains or newer bed cover to compensate the older side of the room but seems they did not care to invest. For a Princess hotel I was disappointed compared to the ones I have been in Mexico. Food was ok (depends on the theme of the buffet in fact) and excursion a bit pricy. Photographies are negociable.

author: HelenY2346
title: Not quite a 4 star experience
text: Our first day was also a bit of a nightmare. Having arrived at the hotel before lunch, we had to wait nearly 4 hours to check in after 3pm, not convenient at all considering how hot it was, and travelling with two teens. We booked a family suite because of the two teenage boys, so that they would have their own space and more room as we are all very tall. The room we were given was not as described, and had only a small double bed in one room with a very outdated bathroom, whilst the 'boys room' had two double beds, a large bathroom, fridge, TV, telephone etc. ... the 'master' then I guess. To add insult to injury it was extremely noisy that night, as apparently all the locals come to party at the resort for the weekend Fri-Sun! Upon request, we were moved to the upgraded suit in the Caribe Princess section, which was a lot better. Credit to the staff for making this happen. Being a 4 star, I would have expected a little more, for example, we only got water in the fridge (not cold), no pop or beer. In fact there was nowhere on the resort to buy a few cans of beer for the room... just rum lol Wi-Fi was only available in the lobby, which is a fair distance from the accommodations, not great for the teens, but at least it was there. The pools were good & beach great. The nightly entertainment did not start until 9.45 each night, by which time we were all too tired to stay up and wait, the one show we saw 'Lion King' was quite entertaining. Be aware of this if you have young children. Overall, I would not go back to this resort, as it was a little disorganized and not up to the usual 4 star experience I have had in other places such as Mexico.

author: OctavioG395
title: Excellent Customer Service and Property
text: This has to be one of the best stays i've had in the recent years. you can tell the service was good when i learned the names of almost everyone at this place! even the bell boy Anthony was really helpful. The property was very well kept, had a minor water issue in my room when i first checked in but i was moved to an upgraded room by LUIS at the front desk (he was VERY friendly and helpful). the resort is very live but it is not over crowded, there are three pools, one with a bar which gets a little more packed, but we never had an issue enjoying the place! the food was really good! if you plan on trying any of the restaurants make sure you make your reservations early because they are really popular. I recommend the Rodizzio style restaurant, TERESA will take care of you really well. The buffet was also really good, they had a different night every day (Italian, Asian, Dominican night to name a few) in there be sure to look for ROBERTO or ANGELICA both were very friendly and world class in their service. The drinks... oooh the drinks!!! the front lobby bar is THE spot to enjoy the best drinks on the resort (no offence to CLAXTON on the beach bar) but MARCO, ANEURY AND WINSTON were THE best bartenders!! their drinks were really well made and their service was spectacular. The breakfast was also all really good =, make sure to be there early, try the egg station with GERMAN very friendly and skilled guy! i love this place and i would definitely go back without a doubt!

author: 59maribelr
title: Nice Hotel & Great Experience!
text: My husband and I stayed at Tropical Princess from 6/19-6/22. It was our first time in DR. We had a room in the Lirio building with view towards the mini golf and spa building. The room was nice and clean. The bed was a bit hard for my liking, but not bad. The bath tub does over flow, but I am assuming this is because it is a walk in bath. If you are not picky with this kind of stuff then there is really no fuss as the room serves its purpose. We paid for the safe box and although the resort is safe, its a good idea to store valuables specially if you are out in excursions all day. The all inclusive buffet was good, not a lot of variety, but there are other restaurants in the resort you can reserve in advance if you would like to switch it up. We recommend "Redozzio" Brazilian. I didn't mind the buffet since I had a short stay, but can see how it can get old if you stay for a longer time. No complaints about the drinks, all were so delicious specially their Pina Coladas & "Mama Juana." The staff was friendly and cheerful so be kind and tip their service. The actual beach and pools were nice and there was always chairs available! Walk around the resort to get to know it, its doesn't take long to get places, specially if you stay at the Lirio since main things like the lobby, all three pools and beach are not too far! Overall great hotel and would definitely come back or recommend people to book.

author: OmarR157
title: Terrible experience
text: Me and my wife are going to have our first daugther soon so we decided to have one last couple experience in some time. There was a price cut for this weekend so we jumped right on it...terrible mistake... The first thing I noticed was the terrible service at the desk, it was as if we were not paying real money! They treated us with such commonness that we didn't feel like we were welcomed... Our room was not the ''superior'' one they advertised. The bathtub didn't hold the water, the hot water took FOREVER to kick in, the bathroom was dirty, the soap and shampoo smelled terrible (bring your own), the TV reminded me of the 90's...and last but not least, there was a door that connected to the next room where there were loud people staying at. The drinks are all watered down and felt uninspired. If you wanna have a beer just order 5 of the thing they call beer. The pool had mold, the towell place is far away and the food is nothing especial. But what really let me down was the reservation for a romantic dinner with my wife. The women went to lunch at the same time (around 2pm) and we had until 3pm to make the reservation. I left her a note with my room number, pax, restaurant, time and name in case she came back before we finished lunch. When we come back, there is a line and she is making reservations. When it gets to our turn, I tell her I left her a note...she tells us all reservations are full while disposing of our note. I asked her if there was another restaurant available and she said no with the most punchable face you could make. Oh, on our way out they destroyed our bracelets. I guess to prevent us from re-entering the hotel; that was the first time they did that to me on a beach resort and I felt insulted. I will NEVER return to that place and will make it my MISSION to prevent friends and family from going. Good riddance Tropical Princess Beach Resort & Spa.

author: SonjaOcala
title: Beautiful Property, Tropical and Beachfront
text: Upon arrival we were greeted with fresh fruit drinks in the lobby. The check in staff was friendly and the property is lovely. We were on the 3rd floor which was great because there were no mosquitos! The hotel is beachfront and looks like a tropical paradise. The hotel is older but is beautifully maintained. It's a bit of a walk to the lobby from the beach but there is a little tram that runs back and forth There is a fridge in the room with water and soda. There are stores on the property with necessities. The internet is sporadic and only available in the lobby so if you don't have an international cell phone plan you might want to purchase a prepaid phone that works in the country. We were in the Lirio building and the location was great, away from the main pool, but next to a more quiet one. There is plenty to do at the hotel, but we did a surf excursion at Macao Surf Adventures also called Macao Surf Camp at a beach about 15 minutes from the hotel. That surf excursion was the highlight of our trip! Definitely worth trying. You might have to find that trip on the internet because I did not book it through the hotel. If management reads this you might want to add Macao Surf Camp to your excursion list, it was so much fun and we are all in our 50's and 60's so it's not just for kids! The staff from the maids to the waiters were fantastic. A smile and a gracias with a little extra tip helps. There were people pitching sales but a firm no gracias and keep walking worked, unless you are interested in purchasing future vacations then it would be worth checking out. There was a huge variety of food, so we always found something really good to eat and the presentation was nice.Enjoy.

author: Edi423
title: Could be better
text: I had a short stay at this resort the first week of May 2014. First off it is hard as hell to find, took me forever to find it tucked away in the corner where it was. Once I finally found it I was greeted by a very nice front desk attendant. The reception/lobby is HUGE, and so are the grounds of the resort. So big they have a trolley to take you around. The place is beautiful. Now for the bad stuff... During my 2 night/3day stay my room was never attended to. At the buffet hall I literally had to flag wait staff down to get something to drink. I was mostly ignored, I think it was because they saw that I was a solo traveller. This place is a great place for families and large tour groups. If you want quiet, this isn't the place for you. Also, I don't recommend for solo female travelers, I had to deal with a lot if catcalls and overt sexual advances from male staff (excluding front desk guys). I understand it was because they mistook me for a fellow dominican but that is not acceptable behavior towards a guest even if she is a fellow dominican. So they lost a lot of points with me for that alone. The stay there was otherwise ok. The beaches are nice which is for this island. The room was a decent size and included a balcony. I recommend but not for solo female traveler.

author: michelled422
title: More like a 3 Star.
text: I know this hotel is listed as a 4 star but it is more like a 3 star. Reason being is the food is just ok. You will find that there are the same foods every day, not a variety. Also, my bathroom was not great either. There were ants on the counter which were bearable but having no hot water in our shower was not. You don't normally spend much time in your room on vacation, but it would be nice to take a shower in at the minumum luke warm water, not freezing cold. The grounds are beautiful. A big resort which makes it nice. There are different bars and restaurants although only 2 restaurants were included (must make appointment). Those two were brazilian restaurant (the best food on the resort) and a dominican restaurant (just ok). Tropical Princess and Caribe are on the same grounds, same resort; not sure why they are listed as separate when booking my vacation. I stayed in room 5221 (one of the stand alone buildings) and it was nice. A big room with king size bed overlooking the pool but minus the bathroom disaster. My family stayed in the bigger buliding 3228. A good room if you're traveling with kids. The bathrooms were upgraded nicely, two separate rooms, 3 double beds, but again no hot water. Hope my review helps. One last thing, don't expect the greatest service either.

author: 412BobT
title: nice resort, but wouldn't go back
text: I found the reviews I read a few weeks ago quite accurate and handy. The concencus seemed to be that overall, the resort was decent........... It was. So I don't mind writing a review if it helps people out. As I read before going, the resort was a little dated, but the beach, which is beautiful and to food and service were more than compensatory. So the concencus of reviews was spot on. Just the way it is there. On the negative side I was surprised to find the place over running with Russians! They kept to themselves for the most part but weren't that friendly; some were kind of ignorant, but might be a cultural thing. I thought I was at some resort on the Black sea or something. The Russian chatter was overwhelming, they seem angry even when talking to each other. The other negative was the resorts attempt to push time shares on guests. They have their own sales agents stratigically located at the main dining hall. They know everyone shows up there sooner or later. So the somewhat dated facility, poor air conditioning etc. combined with the time share push would prompt us to look elsewhere for our next vacation.

author: Thunderbird71
title: Great time in Punta Cana :)
text: Had a great time in Punta Cana, last 2 weeks of November, 2013. It was about 30c everyday. Sun set around 4:30 though at that time of the year. It would have been a perfect vacation except for those darn annoying time share people. Being HARRASSED on vacation constantly several times a day is not fun. You guys should really do something about that. Otherwise, the hotel was great, great value, unfortunately we didn't get to try the a la cartes, the Russian girl taking the reservations kept saying full, full, before I could even mention which a la carte I was inquiring about. The resort was about 75% Russian, not the friendliest bunch. There are 3 pools, 2 of them quiet, the food was great, the fruit is always so fresh & delicious. By far the best bartender JORGE, give that man a raise. He loves what he does & it shows. The drinks were delicious ! Service on the beach in our chairs by the one & only ANGEL, give that man a raise too. They love what they do & took great care of us. We would go back for sure. We did call for room service one night, placed our pizza order after missing the buffet for a night at the Princess Casino a short ride away, but it never came. After calling the lobby, they said you have to call a different number ... which we did, & ordered again, figuring one of them has to show up ! And one did, only one lol

author: sunsetlover2010
title: Happy New Year!
text: My 17 year old daughter and I went on Dec31,2013 to Jan7,2014. We had a terrific time..The beach is Gorgeous as well as the grounds and buildings.The atmosphere was very festive. I have seen a lot of complaints and a lot of good reviews..I am giving the tropical Princess an 8 out of 10. People stop being so picky. Yes the furniture is worn in spots..How many people come through those rooms a year?? The staff was always helpful,and polite,even when they didn't understand.The food was very good..Yes they had a lot of the same menu daily..It's a buffet 7 days a week, 3times a day..How many variations can they do but they sure do try.The Brazilian Restaurant was the only one we went to and it was Delicious. The crepierie was loved by my daughter and the little lunch buffet by the beach bar was very good. the drinks were always good and sometimes a to strong. I loved there Champagne. Room Cleanliness and problems..Ok my daughters shower was a problem, as the shower above leaked into her shower. we complained once and nothing was done but honestly I'm not sure they understood me and I forgot all about it. The only complaint I really had was a towel shortage or rather facecloths but by the end of the week we had plenty of facecloths and towels. No resort is perfect. This resort is Gorgeous! The Beach was absolutely Beautiful! The food was Delicious! The gounds and buildings were Beautiful! The had wonderful shows and activities and the Staff was very Friendly. We will definitely go back.

author: leafscrazy
title: Save your money
text: Quick review. Save your money and go somewhere else if you are looking for solid 4 star hotel this ain't it - I would give it 3.5 at most. Rooms in this hotel are 3 star rooms - falling apart , leaking bathrooms not painted walls - standard things are not where they should be in 4 star hotel. Problem every night with getting plates at buffet to eat - had to wait by kitchen door and fight others to get a basic plate to eat your dinner. Food was basic but eatable. Drinks are very weak and they use cheapest Dominican brands - didn't even see brugal rum which should be standard. They claim to have selected international drink selection - good luck finding even one. Only place to get internet connection is in lobby - try going there in evening - whole resort is there trying to log in and it's impossible cause of to many people on it ; also impossible to find a seat in lobby cause of that. No atmosphere at all - just about two hundred people sitting on cellphones trying to connect to one page for half hour. Pools are dirty with green algae on edges everywhere ; I've been to 4 star hotels in punta cana before and this ain't one of them. Only nice thing there was the creperie for crapes and beach. Otherwise save your money and go to another place. This is shared by many travellers on tripadvisor. Ask me any questions and check out my review of dreams punta cana which is heaven comparing to this place...if this is 4 star than dreams is 7. Thanks!

author: LakinTIA
title: OK if this is what you like - but not my cup of tea.
text: It is odd that the reviews vary between those who found it brilliant and those who found it terrible. To be fair, the holiday was good value for money and quite relaxing. The food in the main buffet restaurant was very good with fresh stuff being cooked all the time: there was also quite a good choice available.The staff were brilliant - friendly and efficient. The beer available as part of the all inclusive was terrible. It was weak, tasteless and served in 20 cl disposable plastic. It was similar to the American 'Lite' beers, but even weaker. The white wine was almost undrinkable (at home I would only have cooked with it.) Unfortunately, as the resort was 'all inclusive' it was not possible to buy better stuff - it just wasn't available. There was also a hard sell to join their 'Lifestyle Holiday Club' - they want you to pay 4-5000 Dollars up front for the promise of holidays in the future. This is really an unsecured loan - and judging by the comments we heard by the pool the deal failed to live up to the selling - the small print apparently contained unexpected charges when the holidays were redeemed. People who did pay up became 'VIPs' when they turn up. They enjoy special privileges and exclusive access to some resort areas. The flip side is that if you are not a VIP, you are denied this access to the best beaches and the better restaurants. It was very 'in your face', and if we hadn't booked our holiday at a hefty discount I would have been irritated by it. As other reviewers have mentioned the rooms are very dated and tired! The failure of the balcony doors seemed widespread - ours didn't close properly and this seemed to be endemic.The shower rooms need refurbishment, and the company are going to have to spend considerable sums getting it back to standard. Having said all that, if you can get it at a good price and can live with the shortcomings it is alright.

author: dianasandro
title: Nice resort
text: The landscape is beautiful. People working there were very friendly and nice. Resort is very well kept and very clean. They speak little English, some of them speak good and we did not have comminication problems. As in few previous reviews some people wrote that resort staff did not like english speaking tourists is absolutely wrong. They treat everybody with respect. During our stay I did not notice that locals were rude or were disturbing the guests on weekend. I noted that many tourists were from Russia (almost 50%). There was an incident in buffet some of them were very drunk and they started singing very loud and people were very disturbed. Food was good. For meat lovers Brazilian restaurant was excellent. Negative side of this resort are buildings and rooms. They need to be upgraded. Rooms are big and nice but first day there was smell. We were on the last floor and after heavy rain we had a leak. Very nice pools. They always have towels on the beach if you go there before 11. Shows were ok. Overall this resort worth the price we paid $3,100 for family of 4 but the next time I would prefer to pay little more and go to 4-5 star hotel.

author: nikita719
title: Nice, we loved it!
text: It was our 6 th voyage south (Cuba, Mexico) but our 1st in Dominican Rep. Family of 3.(2 adults and a 17 year-old).We had booked for a standard room but when we checked in we asked for an apartment. Elias at the reception desk was very helpful, he assigned us a very good apartment in Lirio building. We enjoyed the location because we were close to the beach, pools;far from the lobby though, but as we used to go there just in the evening ...it was ok. We went to almost every show, we missed just 1, we appreciated the dancers,choreographs, they were good, we particularly liked Gregory. We loved the site, luxurious vegetation,the fauna in the mangroves.We went to 2 restaurants Dominican and Brazilian. I liked the rustic decoration from the Dominican but the Brazilian was just like a passing place, not really a restaurant.However the food was good, waiters smiling, nice, helpful.Food at the buffet was OK, too, I should add that we are not picky, we ate omelettes, cheese,fruits in the morning.And I shouldn;t forget the tasty croissants.We appreciated the thematic evenings there.There was a large variety of food but as we were a large variety of tourists I found that thoughtful and considerate.I don"t understand why some people criticize food so much, we ate in the buffet and we always found something on our taste.My husband loved their red wine, I drank some champagne and cocktails. People trying to sell us trips, souvenirs were a bit annoying but a No was enough. We loved the La Creperie bar, great pancakes and ice cream. The beach was wonderful,white sand, nice view. As we used to go to the beach rather late it was a bit difficult to find free palapas to stay in the shade. Some people used to leave their towels on the chairs and not come back for hours. Trips: We had the Ranch Macao buggy trip though I am not the adventure type of person;but I thought I might enjoy the instructive part of it. They were supposed to show as the process of making coffee and chocolate beans but we had no guiding information. They were more pushing us towards the souvenir shack. So they were more interested in selling us things than in giving us info about their products. I even wonder if it was a real farm there, behind all that.The buggy part was fun but that was all.The rest, Macao beach, the cave were on the run. Hotel, site, a real 4 star indeed. Negative:small things in the apartment water-drops from the air conditioning just above the toilet seat in our daughter,s bathroom, the humming of the AC., no access to international drinks (just if you paid additional money) On the whole, we enjoyed the experience and we would recommend it.We would definitely come back anytime

author: Cubasi1280
title: girl trip in paradise
text: Gorgeous resort with beautiful trees and grounds. A shuttle service that is at your door or anywhere else on the resort within 5-8 mins. Areito discotheque is great on a saturday and has open bar from 11 to 12. The beach is beyond gorgeous and pools are well kept as well. A few cups floating around in the pool where the sunken bar is, however the staff does there best to clean this up. The resort is more lively from Friday to Sunday as locals come spend the weekend with their family's. I personally think that this is great and makes it more interesting. I travelled with my best friend and my room was great, never any issues. Hot water takes a bit of time but if you let it run for 2 mins it will come up. The buffet was mediocre but you will definitely always find something to eat. Great omelettes in the morning. Try the dominican A la carte ( El pilon ) it is great!!! :) I would def come back to this resort. I may try their sister resort called Punta Cana Princess instead as it is 18+. *** Just an FYI Towels are available early in the morning***

author: skhalfan
title: This Resort is a Total Nightmare!
text: We arrived on August 12th. We are informed it s a 4.5 start resort. It is not! The rooms are disgusting! The locals do arrive on Friday and really mess the resort up! The blankets in the room are old and dingy. My wife and would never go back to Tropical Princess. The only bright spot is the service at the buffet. When the locals arrived the service deteriorated. The food was okay. The dishes were not that clean. Overall we had a very poor experience. If it was not for the people we met and the friends we made, this trip would have been a total loss. The pool are is full of cups and plates with unfinished food, which then resulted in ants everywhere. We also so a dead cockroach in the hall of our room. We were totally turned off. Most of the people we met at the resort felt the same way. On the way back the plane was delayed for 4 hours. Do your selves a favor...GO SOME WHERE ELSE!

author: 471amandag
title: Quite the experience!!!
text: We arrived Tuesday, July 30th in the afternoon. When we checked in, the front desk employees were friendly, but did not tell us absolutely anything helpful! I felt very rushed, and felt as though we would aggravate them if we kept badgering them with typical tourist questions. We were given a packet with two room keys, and two towel cards. We were put onto a trolly and taken too our villa. Our luggage was delivered a short time after. Our room was older, but still tolerable. Beds were EXTREMELY uncomfortable, and the pillows, and blankets were way old, and sucked! TV was from the 1900's and missing almost all of the buttons.. Air conditioning was very strong, which was good. We lost power one of the nights, and called the front desk 3 times before the lady told me to simply slide in a key card in our room, which fixed the problem! Bathrooms were all disgusting, ESPECIALLY, in our rooms. On our last day, we called the bell hop at about 9:30am, and requested our luggage be picked up and taken to the front by 10:45 am (we were leaving at 11:50am) We waited for the bell hop until about 11:15am, called twice, and they never came! SO we ended up caring our own luggage and rolling them to the lobby ourselves. We were not informed of the restaurants / reservations or anything. Minus the beach, we would not stay at this resort again!!!

author: WhoFart
title: Needs TLC
text: Got back April 1. This is my second time at this resort. I would not recommend staying here. We started leaving a tip for the maid everyday but after the first few days when she never cleaned the bathroom mirror (thinking this was an indication of what cleaning was being done) we stopped leaving a tip. She never cleaned the bathroom mirror for the entire week we were there. The curtains were also falling down and were never fixed. Our phone cord had a loose connection, the air conditioning did not work one day and the lights another day. They never fixed the phone cord but did fix the air conditioning and lights. There should be more variety at the buffett. Service at the buttett, bar service and the staff in general was great. The lady at the shop wanted me to buy a pack of gum because she did not have $1 change to give me. The mini golf is in desperate need of repair. The Entertainment Schedule Board by the pool and theatre was always wrong. The children were very disappointed when The Lion King was not the show on the night that the Board by the pool had indicated! The Front Desk Staff said to check the Board in the Main Lobby. So we did one day - that morning the board said Beach Party but that night it was Ideal Couple. You could not make plans to go see a specific show. The beach was great. Walk up the beach 10 minutes to the left to find lots of vendors.

author: 791SamanthaM
title: everything was terrible except for front desk staff
text: The hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous. THE POSITIVES: 1: the Chinese restaurant and Mama Mia are fabulous. Big portions and plenty to choose from 2: beautiful beach and 3 good pools. 3:beach party was so fun THE NEGATIVES: 1:food was not so great. Most times it was cold or hard as a rock. The food was always the same it and never changed. One night my mom went to get meat and there was still FUR on it !!!!!! 2: There were thousands of ants in our room. 3: our phone was broken. It would ring busy. when we would pick it up to call people there would be no dial tone. when we called customer service it took them 3 days to actually come fix it. A lady came and she just jiggled the wires and said it was fixed. it would only work every now and then. took a day later for them to replace the whole thing. 4: shows were usually in spanish or french. IF YOU SPEAK ONLY ENGLISH THIS IS NOT THE PLACE FOR YOU!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! IT IS MOSTLY FRENCH AND SPANISH. MAIDS AND WAITERS WILL NOT UNDERSTAND YOU. The following staff were absolutely amazing: 1:FRANSISCO 2:JEFFERY 3:AWILDA 4:ANEWDY 5:ELIAS 6:ARABELLYS 7:PAPITOE

author: billi156
title: worst vacation ever
text: This resort is by far the bottom of the charts. When we arrived, all looked great. Then we got to our room. There were bugs everywhere, and no water pressure. Try talking to a maintenance person there is impossible. Nobody other then front desk speaks English. Then our phone gives out. Front desk wouldn't help at all. Took 24 hrs to get it fixed and all was wrong was phone itself. All they had to do was change it. Then comes the food. If you want to loose weight, It's the right place to go. It was terrible.We had beef one day. It was on the grill with all the hair still on it. Enough to make you sick. The pictures you see on their website is nothing like what it's really like. There is no WiFi there unless you rent a mobile internet stick from them. All in all, I would recommend anyone going to Punta Cana to stay away from this place.

author: AndreaB219
title: Perfect Vacation
text: We stayed at Tropical Princess for one week in February 2013 with 2 adults and a 1yr old. Pros: The staff was super-friendly besides the language barrier. The food was plenty, average quality, but different theme every night, and if you did not like the theme food, there were always pizza, pasta, cold cuts and burgers to fall back onto. We did not try the reservations-only restaurants since that was too much hassle with the baby. The desserts were out of this world great and gorgeous! The beds were comfortable. The room was quiet once the doors were closed. Everything was very clean, except the cigarette butts at the beach that another visitor mentioned. There were receptacles for cigarettes but the rude smokers just dumped them wherever - not much the staff could do about it but pick them up every night. Three pools to chose from, one with swim-up bar, and one that had plenty of shade trees which kept us from burning up. Cons: Animation and event announcements were all in Spanish and French only. Not many trips to chose from that allowed young children. Outside the all-inclusive, the area was crazy expensive, even further away from the tourist areas: sun block $18, baby wipes (12 count) $8, a "cheap" lunch for the 3 of us ran $50! Not enough water pressure available for the rain shower head, but the hand shower worked great and always had ample warm water for all of us. A bit far away from shops and outside attractions. Vacation rental sales people picking up unsuspecting tourists for a time-share talk inside the resort. Spa staff did not speak much English or German either, so it was hard to communicate how I liked my massage. We loved the place and the people there, so we will definitely go back once the children are older and can do more. All the negatives were minor from our point of view and did not bother us much, but I listed them for completeness sake since they may be a big deal to other travelers.

author: voyageur724
title: le voyageur
text: Just came bak from a week vacation in the tropical princess in punta cana.. This hotel is share with caribe princess.. we were two couples. the hotel is great and not too big everything is accesible. they gave us a double room with 3 double beds, 2 complete bathroom which was great.. the service in the room is poor , missing big towels all the time they give 2 per room and sometimes they run out , we have to call the maintenance service, we forgot a umpty bottlle on the floor, the maid did not pick it up. even we gave good tips nothing changed.. The food is not bad but repetitive (buffet),, the morning coffee is awfull and you have to be patient to get serve but the servers try their best,it was just too crawded they were overloaded with french from France.but you could go in the bar near the beach they will sewrve you a good capuccino.. Dont go to el Pilon Restaurant its just erk.. The rodizio is good if you like meat in brochettes.. the creperia (pancakes) is great and you will love it as for teresa she is always smiling .. The bars are fine , the drinks are not always what you expect but this is not a 5 stars hotel,, You will enjoy walking on the beach, km of sand and sun..The pool is cold sometimes spêcially in the morning but it get warmer around 4.00 pm.. The animacion group is very active near the pool.. they make a good job,, in general if you want to spend a good week.. i recommend this hotel .. Tropical and caribe princess.. Lobby is big and you could have a drink in the bar with a nice breeze. just seat on the numerous sofa and chairs, the service is good.. Shows are like other hotels just average..

author: gpaudel
title: Nice beach, nice swimming pool, bad food NOT a 4-star resort
text: Just came back for a week long stay with 3 kids (4,8,10). We had a family suite (32xx) that had 2 rooms and 3 beds, which was fine for 5 of us. The location was close to all of the 3 swimming pools and the beach. The beach was probably the best part. Pools were nice also. The workers were very friendly and did their best to make us happy and welcome. This place is definitely geared towards people from France. One night at the buffet, the staff was asking if we were from France at the entrance and we had to go to a different entrance because that area was reserved for French. We try to book an excursion at our building and the booking staff tells us that he only books for French. We did not like that. The buildings and the other facilities look "old" and run-down. The food at the buffet was lame. They tried to have different theme everyday but the food seem to be the same. The Brazilian restaurant was good. The drinks were nothing especial. Kids like the ice-cream place that opens 1:30-6pm. This was our second time in Punta Cana and we will probably not go back to this place.

author: MarieLine888
title: 3rd time there, still loving it!
text: This was our 3rd time at this hotel and my whole family love it there. We keep going back to the resort as the people working at the resort are very friendly and are always eager to please you. Rooms: The rooms need some renovations but then it is not a major issue as it is only used at night time only. We had 3 different problems with our room during our 3 weeks stay but Aneudy and Francisco from guest services were amazing and very effective at getting the problems fixed right away. Once the handyman was there in 5 mins and the other times, the problems were fixed when we were not even in the room but enjoying ourselves on the beach. But the problems were fixed the same day. Beach: Beautiful white sand beach. There are many waves but my children loved them. Food: We had no problem finding something to eat with the variety of food offered at the buffet. It was always nice to go eat at the buffet where our servers, Ambrorix, Miguel, Wilson and Wanel would always welcome us with a big smile and making sure that we have something to drink. The resort offers food 24 hrs a day. For lunch we would always eat at the snack bars where they offer you hamburgers, baked chicken, fried chicken, pizza, salad, french fries or the creperie where you could have crepes with cheese and chicken and their amazing cheesesauce. Animation: DJ Wander and DJ Junior are very friendly and they made our stay enjoyable. The music they played always get everyone dancing. Luigi and Ludo, from animation were very good at entertaining us by making us laugh all the time. Bars: Josue, Gorge, Francisco and Obama are very nice and friendly bartenders. They always welcome you with a big smile and they always remembered our usual drinks. They are also very fast at serving. We will definitely go back next year.

author: KELIZABETHCHIP
title: Great family vacation
text: Travelled with 2 teenagers for 1 week in April. We had 2 rooms - directly across the hall from each other. The rooms were basic but kept very clean . The high ceilings were a nice feature. We stayed in Villa Jazmin, which we found to be a great location - near the beach. Our rooms were on the second floor at the back of the building, very quiet. We saw only one bug - on the last night! Plenty of hot water. The resort has beautiful, well kept grounds. The lobby was also very nice. Check in and out were very efficient. Our rooms were ready when we arrived - around 3pm and we didn't have to wait long for our luggage. The kids really enjoyed the buffet which is where we ate every morning and most evenings. I would rate the food as average and as with most buffets,after eating there for a week , the food began to look and taste the same. We did try the Brazillian and Dominican restaurants and liked them both. We took 2 day excursions - Seavis tours to Saona Island and the Country adventure tour (which was recommended by our Sunwing rep) We really enjoyed them both. We had 2 very windy days - unable to swim in the ocean - spent those days around the pool. Tried the parasailing and banana boat ride - lots of fun. Never had a problem getting a chair at the beach or at the pool and didn't get up early to 'save' them. Weren't impressed with the nightly shows.

author: rc0te
title: honest review
text: Punta Cana (Bavaro beach) is a very nice place. The beach was just ok because the sea was very agitated during the week (April 14 to April 21) ...so we've had a lot of algae between our toes or on top of the water. This hotel doesn't control the freakin thiefs who wants to sell you crap, arts, gadgets or adventures. "Hola mi amigo come and see my special"....Haaa shut up! The food was OMG worst than Cuba... I'd go back into a 4 star hotel in Cuba anytime. Buffet was offering the same annoying food...the pasta bar was ok...that's about it. You have to run after the waiter to get coffee. I'm honest if I say that it's the worst buffet I experienced so far. Room was clean and everything was working great (AC + refrigerator)...we were getting our pop + water every day. Don't buy you rhum or cigars on the hotel site...they are crooks...if you go divide their price by 5 and start your negociation.... instead buy your stuff "Chez Nicole" a Canadian lady that has been there for over 18 years... items have price tags and quality is there. Don't try to get money from the hotel...they don't offer withdraw on credit card...you have to go to the ATM (5 min walk)...where you get pesos (37-38 pesos for 1$). I won't go back there.....

author: AngelikaB687
title: Fun in the sun
text: Aloha! The Tropical Princess offered great service and buffets were excellent. We loved the assortment of foods and refreshments offered in different venues. Our waiter named Rafael Antanop Estrella treated us well. The rooms were well kept and the scenery beautiful and beaches fantastic! Beware of the sand fleas/sand flies on the beach though. Two weeks later I'm still itching, off antibotics and bites healing. The little noseeums are most active after rain and early in the morning. It is important to tip staff in USA dollars, since the average worker only earns $10-$15 per day. Bartering is a way of life if you want to purchase items. I was not used to not seeing prices on items sold. Venders gladly shake your hand and pull you into their shops. Loved the tours. Zip lining was not my cup to tea. I can knock off my bucketlist though. Items to bring from home include sunscreen, bug spray,and Kleenax . Drink plenty of bottled water. It was a warm 32 degrees each day. We really enjoyed out stay.

author: jessr807
title: Overall A Good All Inclusive Resort
text: I just returned from the Tropical Princess me and my boyfriend went from Nov 23-30th 2011. This was my first trip to the Dominican and to an all inclusive resort. I overall found this to be a good place for the money you pay (we got an amazing deal on sunwing). The Food was good but after 8 day it gets a little repetitive. When we first arrived we were given purple bracelets that said caribe club princess beach resort & spa. The Caribe club is located at the same place but the rooms are on the opposite side but everyone from there and the Tropical Princess still eat and swim and drink in the same place. We found that night and the next day we had amazing service everyone was helpful and always made sure we had a drink in our hands. Then we went to the front to book a dinner when they told us that we had on the wrong bracelets and changed them back to the Tropical Princess which actually only included 2 dinner places (Brazilian & Dominican) And if we wanted the others we would have to pay 11$ USD for since we were not staying in the Caribe Club. After that we found we didn't get as much service the waiters hardly asked is what we wanted to drink at dinner and would take forever to bring them to use, and we found that every drink tasted the same! There is only one swim up bar located at the third pool by the Caribe club rooms which was always packed. I loved that while we were there 2 different nights they had vendors come into the resort so we didn't need to go off the resort to buy anything. They have a photographer on site from photoshopcaribe (you can check them out online) there is no sitting fee so it's free, the photo shoot only took about an hour and a half which was really fun and then you can purchase pictures after. You have to remember that you can talk down the price for almost everything we even did for an excursion. At one vendor he asked $250 for a painting we liked we ended up getting the painting, 2 bottles of rum, 2 bottles of mama juana and 2 bags of coffee for $175.... It was a good first all inclusive vacation but I would be willing to try a new place just to see what's out there before going back again.

author: sofitastic
title: really nice all inclusive for the really good price!
text: we just spend one week vacation at the Tropical Princess and we loved it. we usually do not go to all inclusive resorts and were kind of worried to be bothered by the crowd. but NO! the hotel shares it ground with the Caribe Princess and dispose of 3 nice pools, spread between the several buildings. each pool has a different ambiance, and some pool 3 was really quiet while pool 1 was the activity and party pool. all rooms are near a pool and near the beach. no hiden bungalow far back in the green garden were you have to walk 10 min to get to the beach. the hotel is so well disposed that except to go to the reception, show theater or disco, you a near every restaurants, pools and beach. I liked the esthetic and the colorful buildings. the food was good and I do recommend to try the specialty restaurants. the creperie was a nice snack for on the beach in the afternoon! the hotel and the rooms are really clean and everybody is really nice. the rooms at the Tropical Princess are quite old, and could be in need of renovations, but for the little time we spent in the room it didn't bother us. if you pay attention to room esthetic you might want to reserve at the Caribe Princess. for almost the same price you will have a renovated room and access to 3 extra restaurants. just the buildings are bit bigger than the one at Tropical Princess. all the rest is exactly the same! we also never had to fight for a chair, at the pool nor at the beach. plenty available! I will return if I can, and I would definitely recommand the hotel

author: GemGem391
title: TROPICAL PARADISE
text: I have just returned from the Tropical Princess Resort in Punta Cana and I loved every minute of it! We stayed from 9-16th October (3 ladies ages 21-22) and it was surprisingly quiet around some of the pools during the day but this was nice as there were always beds available no matter what time we got up. At first you think that the resort is so big you are never going to know your way around but there is a little bus route which runs from 6am until people stop coming out of the nightclub and the latest we got it was just after 2am and once you've been round a few times you get to grips with where you are. The Tropical and Caribe Club Princess are basically one resort, there are 2 receptions but the entertainment and facilities are shared. I found the food in the buffet restaurants to be fine nothing amazing but nice edible food and you'll always find something to eat. There are 2 a la carte restaurants you can book at on the standard all inclusive package El Pilon the Domican restaurant which was lovely and the Brazillian restaurant which is basically every type of meat carved to you from big skewers! We stayed around the main pool most days as this is where the fantastic animation team and pool bar was and its just a couple footsteps from the beach. The daily activities were normally a bike ride, stretching, dance lesson, darts, beach volleyball, water polo and the odd other things and there is a pool party twice a week with presentations from the amazing dancers who also featured in the shows every night at 9.45pm. The beach bars serve mainly pizza, chicken, burgers and chips for lunch but you can go into the main buffet restaurants for a proper meal. The majority of staff were really friendly and helpful and we have kept in touch with a couple, we went to Areito the club every night as there wasn't much else to do after the show at 10.30pm and the drinks are also free in there until midnight. There are other reps in the lobby trying to take you to clubs outside the hotel but we were a bit scared to leave and it would mean paying for entry and drinks. We only left the resort 1 day for our Reef Explorer Excursion which we booked with Thomson in advance. The trip was excellent and we got to swim with sting rays and there were 7 sharks! (vege ones) you won't see amazing fish but it is worth it to say you've swam with sharks and held a Ray (no stinger). All in all our holiday was fantastic especially our room and I'd definately go back!

author: Soulful403
title: It was good for the money spent
text: Hurricane Irene destroyed 3 days, but the resort kept us informed. We were able to enjoy the time in the lobby. My sons (ages 16 & 10) loved the teen club with Carlos D and spent a large majority of their time there. All the staff was extremely friendly and took care to remember us (with or without a daily tip). Tipping helps, but some will tell you "it's my job, but thank you". I wanted fried plaintains and garlic which wasn't on any of the menus for the day. The cook at the bar/restaurant near the beach happily obliged me and made me a plate full. That was really nice. They staff knew my family pretty well by the end of the trip as we are friendly people anyway. My only complaint is activities - they need more for the kids to do in the teen center. They have 2 pool tables, 2 foosball, 1 darts, 1 archery, and 2 table tennis. Their wasn't much for the adults to do except drink once the pool closed at 7pm. We were disappointed the pool closed so early. The beach was beautiful and clean. Our rooms were clean and not musty as I read in many reviews. We were upgraded to a family room. The family room only had one TV and it was in the kids' room so on nights we wanted to stay up late and watch TV, we could not. We all got a little ill from the buffet food every single day. Due to the storms, the specialty restaurants were closed and when they reopened, the reservations were all booked. There was something for everyone to eat everyday - even my vegetarian son.

author: amandalovestravel_11
title: What a great family holiday, we loved it
text: We are a family travelling with children aged 13, 12 and 9. The overall service was excellent with a great choice of food, from traditional local fayre, to Mexican, Italian, an "oriental" night, with many varied dishes to choose from. The daily maid service was excellent, the mini bar was stocked daily, free of charge, with soft drinks and bottled water and really friendly staff. Although, there is everything you could possibly want on the resort, it was really good to explore the local area. We went to Manati Park where there are horses, dolphins, sea lions, you can even swim with the dolphins, although we didn´t do this. Another great day was Saona Island, although this is quite a long day - 7 am start and returns to the hotel at 7 pm, it was excellent for the whole family. The journey over to the island on the Catamaran, included lots of dancing, regular Cuba Libre top-ups, soft drinks for the kids and a lively, friendly atmosphere. It was truly, the highlight of the holiday and I would recommend it, this trip can be arranged with your local tour rep or there is a guy on the beach organises trips and he did us a really good deal. The Animation team were excellent during the day, where they entertained the kids at the beach, at the kids club and also at the Teens Club for kids over the age of 12. There is stuff for adults too, beach games, water aerobics, dancing competitions and loads of chances to win bottles of the local rum, t-shirts, great competitive spirit. There is always plenty going on to suit all ages and the evening entertainment is varied from Gothic Night to traditional DR dancing and a mini-disco for the kids from 8.30 pm most nights. Our 9 year old daughter was in her element and loved getting up on stage. We also went horse-riding at Macao beach, which was superb for riding and our sons went surfing there too. The beaches were amazing, not too crowded and all the pools were clean, with a plentiful supply of beach towels. Lots of watersports and free kayaking every day. The only negative comment was that there was no free internet, although this was available in the hotel reception area for an hourly fee. We cycled to the local village and used the internet there which was much cheaper, only 2 dollars for half an hour. A thoroughly enjoyable holiday and particularly good for kids, they are kept entertained all day and we can´t wait to go back. We booked through Thomson First Choice and got really good value for money for a family all-inclusive holiday.

author: Beacheshome
title: No Sunsets!
text: Resort - nice. Beaches - fantastic Overall a good trip, but I'd never have booked at any of the hotels in this area if I'd know that the sun sets can't be seen from anywhere within the resort. Rooms - beds, bedding and pillows were disgusting. Take your own pillows at a bare minimum. Rooms otherwise fine. Food - fair. I'm really into fine dining and certainly didn't expect gourmet at this price. Good variety though, just nothing to get excited about. The food was consistently just 'ok'. Restaurant & bar staff - excellent! Vendors are a problem at first. Get used to smiling and saying thank you as you walk away. They won't chase you or anything. One big piece of advice - beware the people who offer to take you to neighboring hotels to see other resorts. It's an aggressive time share scam and they are down right rude and nasty if you don't buy into it.

author: Ayrheads1
title: Great Vacation!
text: We stayed at the Tropical Princess from Mar 2 to 9th. Had a wonderful vacation. The resort is very nice, not too big and very clean. Rooms need a little update but you are only in them to sleep. The grounds are beautifully kept and the flowers are magnificent. Food was excellent and there was always plenty. The breakfast buffet has to be the best! All the "Santa Domingo" coffee you could want! The Buffet had the best food, large variety and a different dinner theme each nite. The staff are very friendly, always a smile and Hola! The pools are great--ours was just across from our villa. The pool bar and Alcendes, our bartender had to be the best yet. Loved the Dominican Flags! THE BEACH! What can I say--absolutely beautiful. We spent most of our time there. In the water, in the sun or under one of the many sun shades. The sand is white and soft, wonderful to walk on! It was a great trip and I would recommend the Tropical Princess to anyone.

author: Fourtyouncetofreedom
title: Great Resort
text: AMAZING Resort, and AMAZING Vacation. I've been to a few All inclusives and this one is going to take the top. Punta cana is the best place to be if your lookin to have an amazing time on the beach and in pools. The constant breeze was beautiful - Kept you cooled down in the boiling sun. The night bar was unbelievable. Make sure you tip Joe WELL. He will take care of you like no other bar tender. Best vacation ive been on! Food was excellent. Beach was extremly clean. The dominicans in the red shirts - Seapro or whatever the company is, They were great. VERY helpful and a total riot to play Volleyball and stuff with. I went diving 4 times with them and did a ocean cruise with them. Very trustworthy and will show you the amazing beach life!! TOTALLY recommend this place if your going with a few friends.

author: meandmykids2010
title: AMAZING !! Would go back again --
text: Just got back Feb 23rd 2011 This is resort has 2 names Tropical Princess and Caribe Princess the only difference is the package/room you get.(not very different from what I saw & heard) Excellent food new theme every night at the buffet. We did not even go to any of the restaurants. Great ice cream & snack bar had that a few times for lunch by the pool. Great pools!! 2 pools that have lots going on and the 3rd is more quite and great for the little kids. My kids has a blast (9&5) make new friends everyday. Even came home with some address. They are excited to have pen pals. Great security on the grounds !! They are EVERYWHERE !! Really made you feel safe. I didn't worry at all when my 9 year old went to the kids clubs with his new friends. LOTS OF FRENCH !! Even the 2nd night show we went to (kids one starts at 830) was all in French ... didn`t go to another show after that. I would say the only bad thing I can say about this resort was that the ocean was way to strong for little kids.......maybe good for teens but the undertow was really strong. GREAT 1st Vacation with my younger 2 kids !!

author: Triptic1980
title: Great place for this first time all-inc. traveller!
text: Stayed at the Tropical Princess for a week, and had a great time. The rooms need a little upkeep, as it appears that the budget goes to the common areas and exterior appearance. It is combined with the Caribe Club Princess, so it is fairly large in size. The staff were extremely friendly and courteous. We usually sat at the same table at the buffet, and our server, Yanira Garcia was awesome! She remembered our drinks every time, so after the first night, we never had to order drinks, and she would reserve our table for us everyday as well. The buffet had a different theme every night, so it was never redundant. We didn't get to use our a la cartes, as we had to go to different buildings to reserve, and by the time we got around to doing it, there were no spaces left at the restaurants that we were allowed. The Animation team put on a great show every night, again with a different theme. The beach, though busy, was clean and beautiful. Because the resort is so large, there is a trolley that takes you around the resort, and runs almost all of the time. The three pools are nice to look at, but only one has a deep end, and it was almost always used by one of the resort activities. Not far from a market area, which was a neat experience, though you are constantly harassed to buy. Don't buy too much at the hotel, as everything is much more expensive than off the resort. All things considered this was an excellent trip, and I would not hesitate to return.

author: Banada
title: Highly recommended - unless you expect Macy's at a Target price
text: My fiance and I arrived late at night at the resort and were well received. The room had a couple of issues, one the patio door wouldn't open properly and the other was very little hot water pressure. We made a call in the morning and by the end of the day it was rectified. We thought the food was terrific with a wide variety to choose from each day. We found that just by leaving a small tip made a world of difference with the staff having said that there was a day when we forgot to bring some cash and they were just as pleasant. The grounds are absolutely beautiful. It is about a 10 min walk from the main lobby to the hotel area which is very nice at any time of day. There is a trolley that passes by at about every 6 mins or so. The pools are very well maintained as well are the loungers. They put a show on every evening which is located near the lobby. The shows are wonderful and very entertaining. Our package included 2 x a la cartes. There are also other restaurants on the resort that you can dine at for a small fee. They have Mexican, Brazilian, Chinese, Dominican, and a seafood restaurant. They have a Creperie which serve amazing crepes. We were extremely pleased and will definitely be back.

author: parksie57
title: you get what you pay for
text: We arrived at the hotel at noon but were unable to check into our rooms until 3pm so we waisted part of our day in the restaurant and bar waiting for rooms to be ready so we could change and head to the beach. The grounds were well kept, the beach was great but the rooms were in very poor repair. Our air conditioner sounded like there was a helicopter landing in the room, the counter was stained and there were little sand fleas all over the washroom. No dressers to put your clothes in so you had to hang some up and live from your suitcase. There were no stands to put the suitcase on so it had to sit on the table in the room. Our friends had similar rooms, and in one, the toilet paper holder was on the floor (it did get repaired) No beer in the fridge as advertised. Went to play mini golf, only 5 putters with no grips. Asked how long we would be, said an hour and the answer was no, there are other guests in the hotel. They have no issue making you wait, beach towels..come back in 30 minutes, change money at the counter..come back in 10 minutes. On day we did not get towels in our room so we had to call to get them, one day our friends room was not made up until after 3pm. These were all small annoyances that we did not expect. Food at the buffet was average at best but we did do a dinner in the brazilian which was good and a dinner in el pilon which was good.The restaurant staff in all of the restaurants was a different ball game altogether. They were efficient, friendly and eager to please. They remebered who had coffee and who had tea (there were 7 of us) and had some fun trying to teach us some spanish . Overall, language was as bit of a barrier as some of the staff spoke little ot no english. Overall this was a cheap vacation for our family and friends, in spite of the areas that the hotel was lacking , we had a great time. If I were to return to Dominican, I would choose a different hotel as we talked to several other vacationers on our excursions and none that we talked to seem to have the same complaints.

author: Annedubureau
title: Fantastic vacation!!!
