text: Although the room was just okay, it was amazingly clean and the housekeepers went out of their way for us. Flowers on the bed, extra towels (no washcloths though) every day, extra water bottles (okay, we tipped each day but I find it normal to do so). The hotel site is absolutely amazing and super clean and the staff is the friendliest we've met so far. À la carte restaurants aren't worth it, except for the Brazilian, but the buffet was great and varied each night. Oysters, caviar, sea food, steaks, pasta, they have everything for every one. The beach is beautiful and there were always chairs available. Only thing negative is the guy purposely writing the wrong date on the coupon to have the table decorated + cake for for my husband's b-day (it was on New Years eve) instead of telling it wasn't possible. He changed the date at the last minute, thinking I hadn't seen... Oh and the Sunwing rep Johan is a hypocrite. He was talking badly about the people waiting to see him with a colleague thinking no one understood... but I do. It was rude. But aside from the the actual hotel staff is amazing. We loved it! But next time we'll choose a "child free" hotel. I love kids, but I hate the ones that are brats with parents not saying a word about their misbehavior. We had a "screamer" (or rather high pitched screecher at random intervals) with her parents right by not telling her t stop. A lot of people were annoyed, we just left and went to the beach.

author: sentra911
title: Disappointing
text: Just arrived 8/24/10. I was very diappointed on how this hotel is considered a four star hotel. The day of arrival we had a leak in our bathroom sink that took 3 DAYS to repair, (after I contacted a supervisor). When we arrived(group of 8) we were never informed that the restaurants on the premises, we had to pay (2out of 7) were free. Most of the meals were extremely salty. Waiters were friendly. If you wanted a drink after 8PM you either had to go to the Main Lobby or go to the all night bar, which was quite a walk from where we were staying. To get to the main lobby you had to hop on a tram that rarely stopped at the section we were staying. Reservation desk was not very informative, VERY RUSHED. One of our friends got sick, $425.00 later she still flew back sick. Some staff were very accomadating Others didn't even crack a smile Lobby bar staff not friendly at all. We had the nicest bartender at pool 1 his name was Christian, if it wouldn,t be for him we swould not have known anythng. We made the best of it for 10 days. NO NIGHT LIFE I could go on and on, but won,t......BOOK SOMEWHERE ELSE..WILL NEVER GO BACK THERE I have traveled to D.R. 4 times, this is the worst time ever..

author: jancol2000
title: Would go back
text: This was our first time in the Dominican Republic and to this hotel. After reading reports on Trip Advisor I was a bit put off. I have to say we did'nt pay the earth for this holiday so on the whole Im impressed with what we paid for. The Check-in was smooth and quick and luggage was immediately delivered to our rooms (Ground floor, Pool view). I have to agree with other reports that the rooms are in need of updating, but ours was big (2 beds & a bathroom in one and a King Size bed and bathroom in the other and there were only 2 of us in the room, friends rooms were the same) We did have a problem with mozzie's but it was not down to the lack of cleaning as the maids cleaned every day to a high standard. This IS a TROPICAL resort you have to expect bugs!!! Reported to reception and the rooms were sprayed straight away. The whole resort is continually being swept, tidied and cleaned but some people are just downright dirty or lazy and know that if they leave rubbish the staff will clear it!!!! The food in the Hotel was very good, always hot, loads of choice and a different theme on a night time. there was ice-cream and crepes at one pool bar and an all night snack buffet at the beach bar, as well as numerous restaurants, so anyone NOT finding anything to their tastes must be VERY hard to please. The animation team are vast!! loads of them, great fun, always on the go, friendly and game for a laugh, the night time gang putting on shows and dancing with guests until late at night. These people never stop and are a credit, as are the staff, to the hotel. As most people have commented, the beach is amazing, soft white sand and a sea that is the most gorgeous blues and greens, fringed with palm trees. The only real "gripe" I have with the hotel is that they allow groups of teenagers to book on a weekend, they arrive on a Friday until a Monday morning, but in that time we found most of them to be VERY loud , pushy and in many cases totally disrespectful of the fact that there were other guests in the hotel TRYING to enjoy THEIR holiday. After talking to holidaymakers from other hotels, this seems to be a common problem with most hotels along the beach accepting these kind of bookings. This holiday was a totally new experience to this part of the world. I found the local people, kind, funny and very friendly towards us, many I hope to keep in touch with. I will have no problem in returning to this hotel.

author: TravelerTrust
title: Beautiful Resort, Dirty Outdated Rooms
text: The resort in general was beautiful, as it was maintained and clean. The lobby was large, open, and very nice & modern. We expected the rest of the resort like that. We took a tram from the lobby to our room buildings were bright and colorful. You might wait a while for a tram, so your better off walking Food was average, at breakfast you have waffle, pancakes, yogurts, fruits, and pastries, as well as two omelet stations where they cook it in front of you. For lunch, you have burgers, hot dogs, and other hot foods. At dinner each night it is a different meal from a culture such as Asian, Dominican, American. Food was good. Rooms were terrible, bring bug spray as they are everywhere. We switched out of room the 2nd day. They placed us in a ran down room. We expected two tvs, as there was a tv stand in the other room but it happened to be empty with a tv cable. We were switched to a cleaner yet still old room with two bathrooms. They should update the rooms as they were very old and outdated. Pools were refreshing, and very nice. The beach was the highlight of the trip with white sand and warm water. The onsite bars on the beach were great. The resort was in a great location, maintained though rooms did not compare to the outstanding exterior. Please, if you expect more pay more.

author: yvonnegg0
title: Would not recommend
text: I went on the vacation with my 3 children and parents. I was not expecting the ritz, but I would have liked a decent hotel. The rooms were run down and required constant calls to the service desk for repairs. The maid service was lacking.Floors etc. still dirty after they mopped? Our rooms never were cleaned until 5pm at night. I guess that constituted the nightly turn down service. The food was mediocre. Do not eat anything from the creperie unless it is ice cream. All six in our party were ill from the 4th day on of our stay. Tipping meant nothing to the maids or at the buffet. If you go, ask for all your drinks at once in the beginning because you will never see a waiter again to get another drink! You also never knew where the nightly entertainment was. Was it at the beach, at the auditorium?, etc as it was never really avertised. It smelled musty and like a sewer at times. My clothes still stink, even after 4 washes!

author: David_Sheen2010
title: STAY AWAY
text: After reading some mixed reviews about the place we decided to visit this hotel, and i wish we never bothered... right at the very start of the holiday The Cleaners / The Maintainance man or the security used their key to enter our room and steal some of our belongings phones etc... the hotel security is a complete waste of time they spent 4 days supposdly questioning the people involved then to then tell us that they find nothing.. we had to go to the police ourselves to report the crime.. (note that the police dont speak a word of english so try and get someone to come with you who speaks spanish, oh and make sure u report it straight away, as the hotel will tell you that you need to let them do an investigation, dont take their advice as by the time they have finished they tell you that they have found nothing the police will not do anything as it has been left for 3 or 4 days...) IF YOU GO HERE AND YOU HAVE ANYTHING VALUABLE THAT DOES NOT FIT IN THE SAFE MAKE SURE YOU LOCK IT INTO YOUR SUITCASE OR IT WILL BE STOLEN... we spoke to 3 "english" Familys who also had items stolen from room, video cameras, baby's Toys, phones... the rooms: Were infested with something (fleas or bedbugs or something)... had to be fumigated a couple of time while we were there. also there was a funny smell in the rooms, not all of them but half of the ones we stayed in, it was like foisty damp smell not sure how to describe it... The shower door in the apartment fell onto me dad and shattered into a million bits and left cuts that required stitches lucky the babies were not in the shower instead, and the doctor is not cheap, it cost 95 dollars just to see him, never mind the prices for treatment.... there was no good nightlife around.. there was a show on a night that was basicly some form dancing, they had a kareoke nite once and a limbo night once... the nightclub was rubbish hardly anyone went into it... then we have the people trying to sell you stuff... around the pool expect to be bothered by someone about every 20 mins, to go on a trip somewhere, or to buy something like cigars or some other crap, and the people selling this stuff are constantly trying to rip you off, you can get stuff for about a quarter of what they are actually selling it for... the shops on the site are a complete ripoff, dont use them... if you walk up the beach there are shops that will give gifts & cigars etc at a fraction of the price... oh and watch out for the people who want you to visit another hotel, they basicly try and sell you a time share and u end up being there for about 2 hours... I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone, the beach was very nice it was clean sea was blue but you should stay at a different resort you will enjoy it more for sure...

author: saige57
title: Excellent
text: We just spent an amazing week at the Tropical Princess. Excellent weather, excellent service. People were super nice and we had friends with hotel staff. Our room was clean. We had a mini fridge in our room that was stocked daily with soft drinks and water. Our bathroom had little soaps, shampoos, body washes, even a comb, hairdryer and clean towels everyday. We were on the ground floor and didn't have any problems. We ate at the buffett and even for picky eaters, you wld have no problem getting something to eat. When at the buffett we rec'd excellent service. Dania and Andrey really looked after us. As for the english, Hey people we don't speak Spanish but we all managed to commuicate and have fun. I wld recomment to anyone. A large resort but they provide transportation. Also the little stores that are there sell t-shirts for about the same price as the flea market P. S. at the flea market you will be hasselled. beware

author: 260travisy
title: Great place to Vacation
text: Had a wonderful time at this resort . Read some of the reviews before I went and was a little weary onto this place. But all the negtive reviews was all false these people must live in palaces. When we arrived we where treated with respect and felt very welcome. The food was great lots to eat and something for everyone to enjoy. Lots and Lots of rum. Pools and beach area was very clean. Lots of entertainment The rooms where clean, tidy and well keep up. The service was the best I ever had. The Lobby Bar was the best place to visit the bartender Jose Obama was the best bartender I have seen in a very long time he treated you with respect and welcome you into the Tropical Princess with open arms he was a pleasure to go see everday to have a drink and ask questions and have a chat with. The staff at the resort was great also. Glennis the girl that work behind the bar some days with Jose Obama and also at the Buffet was very friendly and helpful always there to serve you. I will recommend this resort to all my friends and there familys. I tip my hat to all the staff and the owners of this Resort. Thanks for the great Vacation. We will be back again next year

author: Sirius57
title: A Nice Stay
text: We stayed in Tropical Princess from 12/25 until 1/3. I wanted to write a quick note to balance off some of the very negative reviews: I read them after we book the hotel and was so upset that almost cancelled the reservation. I am glad I did not, our family really enjoyed our stay. The beach was beautiful, the grounds were very clean and well kept and we found the staff incredibly helpful and friendly. It is true that service might take awhile but we never had a problem or lack of response. We did lock all the valuables in the safe but always left our bag near the pool or at the beach and never had any problems. Spoke to quite a few other guests at the resort, no one complained about theft, though many people mentioned that were upset by the simplicity / size of the rooms. The room was very clean and the maid did excellent job cleaning it every day. However, the accommodations are very basic and some of the furniture pieces are old. The TVs, if you care about them, are incredibly old ;-) The food was good, not gourmet, but none of us, including a 15-months old, got sick and we always found something to eat. It is true that you need an advanced reservation to go to a restaurant on the grounds, I think you are guaranteed two, but we had no problem booking more. The service at the restaurants is excellent but I found the food to be not much better than that in a buffet. Still worth trying the restaurants for a change. Overall, we had a great time but I would give this hotel three stars, not four. If you seek luxury accommodations, try Punta Cana Princess or Bavaro Princess. If you only stay in the room to sleep at night and spend all your time on the beach / at the pool, you would enjoy the grounds and the beach.

author: traveler777_10
title: 14 days in Paradise
text: We just came back from Tropical Princess, Punta Cana. We stayed there from 12/17 to 12/30. This was our 5th visit to the Caribbean. Just to summarize: Check-in - fast although they could not find our reservation at first Hotel: very clean, the AC did not work but we called their emergency line and it was fixed immediately, hot water - all the time, the cleaning lady decorated our bed with flowers every day, the room was spotless, the fridge - restocked every day with beverages and water. Food and restaurant service: wonderful, various and delicious food, fresh fruit and vegetables,nice drinks, there are thematic nights and we always found something nice to eat, the waiters were very kind, they come the minute they see you, smiling and hard working people, nobody expected tips although we tipped once we were satisfied with the service, the eating establishments at the beach are very good too. Beach: gorgeous Entertainment: very professional / if you do not expect Broadway musical/ and amusing Pools: clean, quite and peaceful Grounds: kept in perfect order, there is a 10 minute ecological walk/path that connects the lobby/reception with the hotel. It was so beautiful to walk along this path - we went to the reception at least twice per day just to have a drink at the lobby bar and to feel the contact with nature. There are almost no guests from the USA there. Most of the guests are from Canada, France and Italy. We knew in advance from other reviews about thefts in the resort and we did not have a PC with us. We kept all valuables in the safe. We walked along the beach for miles, we talked to people from other resorts and we also checked the resorts in the area. We think that Tropical Princess is one of the best, definitely a 4 star resort. We are planning to go back there in the future. We are both teachers and we really enjoyed our stay there.

author: GSR94
title: Misleading and Disappointed
text: This was my first all inclusive resort vacation. I was tremendously disappointed. I read as much reviews as I could. The Tropical Princess received a majority of positive reviews, that was why I chose to book our trip there. Positives: -Great Location -Friendly Staff -Spotless Negatives -Lost Luggage (American Airlines) -Lost reservation made with Orbitz (Landed at 11 pm, with lost luggage and the front desk attendant could not find our reservation, demanded a $100 cash deposit to stay for the night until the manager gets there the next day) -over price gift shop (that's a given) spent $130 for t-shirt, trunks, dress and 2 flip flops. Had to buy clothes due to our luggage that did not get us until 22 hours later. -was not given a proper introduction to the resort and all the amenities. found different services and attractions of the resort on a daily basis. was not aware of the off site tours, the gym, flea market etc... -HARASSMENT by time share salesperson. We were stalked by the time share person, followed us everywhere!! -The staff that was in charge of the rental bikes was utterly incompetent as well as a liar. On 3 different occasions we tried renting a bike and on 3 different occasions we were lied to, from changing the time of operation, mysterious lost key for the bike lock. They don't even have an air pump for the tires!! 9 out 10 bikes had broken seats, chains, tires and pedals -Dining the buffet was great. Everyday was a different theme, however the resort also had 6 other restaurants. only 2 were included in the all inclusive package. No one ever explained this to us until we tried booking a dinner. VERY MISLEADING and DISAPPOINTED. You can take a chance with the Tropical Princess resort, there are plenty of positive reviews, however I will never visit and give my business to this location.

author: Jim1210
title: Beach was great
text: This was my second time to Dominican Repubic, we stayed in a RIU previously the Bambu, so knew what the beach was like, Stunning!!! the hotel its self needed some work as there was gapps between the door and the frame, the hallway needed plastering in places, but other then that was great. The wildlife was amazing and the Peacock that struts about was great, other then the squacking on a regular basis... We mainly eat in the main restaraunt and food was ok, the bloke in the corner serving the meats usually had a good selection. Muigelle was very friendly and could not do enough to help you, everything was his "pleasure"... My partners sister burned her back quite bad, and had to pay £200 to see the nurse and get medical treatment, so beware even if the sun is behind clouds it burns out there. We spent a lot of time on the beach as it is one of the best we have seen, and the trip to Senoa is a good one as it takes you on speedboat to a secluded island to drink Rum and BBQ.... Be careful of the little crabs nipping your toes tho... The vendors the hotel let in are rude and told my partner she was "Stingey" when she said there prices were high - £135 for a painting the locals did?? becareful tho as they give you cigars and other testers first to get you to look at there stall then it makes it harder to say no. Paul was the rudest so if you see him be ready for abuse. Other then that the hotel and grounds are good, the food was ok and there was always alot to choose from. The cocktails are not that great in the beachbars but the main lobby bar was alot better. Most of the staff was firendly and helpful, but the on site shops are expensive for crisps and other stuff, cigars etc.. The trip to Senoa was worth doing and previouly we did the trip on the Monster Truck, which again was well worth the experience as it takes you into real Dominican. The wildlife on the grounds hear was great to see and the fish and turtles in the mangroves were awsome. We had a good time and I would recommend it. It is worth the money, we could pay alot more and get a lot better hotel but for what you pay for this one it is fine

author: Loveabeachandsun
title: Beautiful beach hotel okay but ...
text: First they need to fix the palapas at the beach because they are old and too low or too close to the ground. Second when we arrive we were informed that we were second class citizens right away as their first class hotel is the Caribean and not the Tropical. Not a good feeling when you paid over $2,500 for one week for two. Third all the brochures talk about them providing irons, yet, I was informed that as a second class citizen, we did not get irons, but they could look into it and maybe get me one. I did not hold my breath on that one and indeed 7 days went by and no sign of an iron. Fourth, the TV in our room had not remote and again 7 days went by and no remorte was provided to us by the so call guest services. Yes, guest services !!!! Fifth, again as second class citizens we were not allowed to vist the Mama mia or the mexican restauruant, Therefore, if you are goin gto the Tropical Princess, you are only enttiled to the Dominican and the Brazilian. Neither of them is that good. Sixth, staff are very nice and most of them are very courteous without all kind of tips requests etc. Overall, I would not say the trip was bad, the room was impecably clean, no bugs, great buffets all the time, semi okay bicycles to ride for an hour, etc. Yet, I did get the travellers diarrhea so no need to go into explanations as to the fact that there is a bit of food contamination since I did not drink any water. Seeing the doctor is a bit too expensive, $120.00 per visit... ONE THING for sure, I disliked a lot was going shopping to the shops, plazas or whatever they call it. The people are way too keen and aggressive towards the touritst and I did not appreciate being accossed so much. Very uncomfortable, to the point that we bought the bare minimum and only at one shop that was the only one where they did not accosed us so much. Sorry folks, but while the hotel was an overall 8 out of 10, the staff were 10 out of 10, the whole trip was okay but I would not recommend going shopping to the plazas. Punta Cana is NOT a city, so all you find is shopping malls, plazas made to cater the tourists etc. There is no downtown or anything similar..

author: Gemini1972ON
title: A good time!
text: We just got back from the Dominican and had a great time. I was a bit worried due to the negative reviews but my family and I had a great time. We found the staff to be extremely friendly (be sure to tip as you get even better service and the tips are appreciated). The food was good and the buffet is changed nightly with different themes, I was always able to find something to eat. I would stay away from the burgers as they never seemed to be cooked (very pink throughout). The animation staff really try to make it a good time for people. One night there was a beach party, and one day they had a barbeque on the beach where the food was really good. The beach is beautiful and we were always able to find chairs in the shade. The pools were good and chairs were always available. Take a lot of sunscreen! I have to agree with everyone who says the rooms could do with some updating, but I did not mind. The only thing I did not like were the ants, and when we were there pest control came to spray the rooms (i am guessing they got a lot of complaints). The first day I noticed some ants in the bathrooms but once I had put out the ant traps taken with me we really did not have a problem. My only regret was not taking more ant traps to leave all over the rooms. There is no iron in the rooms so I bought a cheap one to take with me. Be sure to lock up valuabes in the safety box. Put mosquito repellent on at nights to prevent being bitten. Do not listen to the negatives. Go with a positive attitude and you will be sure to have a great time.

author: Mont_Family
title: who are writing these reviews?
text: We arrived..... no problem with check in My son and his friends room was fine but our room had a really bad smell We went to reception and paid extra to up grade to an ocean view. Well worth the extra cash. We could watch the lightening storms from the balcony. The food was fine but there was no where other than your bedroom that had air/c. Only the Al cart restaurants are air conditioned and in July you need it. My main complaint was the towels are dirty. I think they just dry them off and bring them out next day. The blankets on the beds have see better days. Princess should get the towels and bedding renewed. It really brings down the quality of the hotel. The drinks are not mixed properly.Only some of the bar staff know how to pour a simple gin and tonic for example. No name brand alcohol was included in the all inclusive. If you want it you had to pay extra. I'm surprised no one got sick. Butter melts and sits out until next morning, water pouring in the roof getting all the food wet. Birds flying around the dinning room landing on tables pecking at the food. My son and his friend had a good time but what do you expect @ 18yrs old as much as you can eat and drink for a week. and hanging around the swim up bar but if you more than this do not bother with this hotel. The thing that this hotel had nothing to do with was the beach and it was beautiful.

author: esso34
title: Great location- this is where the sun as been hiding!!!
text: Just got back this morning having spent a week at the Tropical Princess. Having had the best experience ever on my first trip to the carribean (Jamaica on my honeymoon a couple of years ago) I was really looking forward to my visit to another of these great islands. Well although it didn't quite live up to that, it was still a great place and well worth a visit. The view from our room was amazing.....overlooking the sea and the main pool (not sure we could have choosen a better room ourselves!!!), it was also within minute walk to the main swim up bar pool, beach, snack bar and main buffet. The beach by the way like everybody else has put is truely amazing. The food in the main buffet had lots of variety and had different theme nights. (Tip......Go down early for the evening meal 6.45-7.30pm otherwise you'll find yourself queuing). The entertainment in the evening was excellent the nights I could keep my eyes open!!! (starts at 9.45pm near main reception but the combination of early mornings/hot sun/drink all day/ and my old age catching up on me....I was ready for my bed at this time!!!!). There was also lots of day time activity if you want to do this....waterpolo, beach volleyball etc. The other great think as well as the location, is the widlife......it would normally be about a five minute walk to reception through a lovely winding path, trees etc.....ours took us about and hour and 5mins as my lovely wife took it upon herself to adopt every animal on site for the week!!! (ducks, moor hens, geeses, peacocks, king fishers, herons, fish - along with all their youngsters!!!) I think they wondered where all the bread in the buffet was going!!!! I think because it a fairly big complex you sometimes need to be a bit pushy at the bars as certain nationality's think they have the right to be served first all the time and haven't heard of queuing or using words such as please and thankyou!!! Couple of other tips.......take dollars and dominican pesos (dollars for the trips, parasailing etc....pesos for the shops, otherwise they convert at their rates i.e 34 pesos to the dollar instead of the 39 you would normally get hence a nice healthy profit for the shops). Oh and just say 'no thankyou' and keep walking to the market traders.....personally i don't think they were to bad anyway. I shall also plug our Thomson rep Louise, she was really helpful and sorted out any queries we had, supplied us with a bit of extra suncream rather than pay an extortionate amount in the shops, and told us how to go about sorting our most important souvenir for our trip home 'MamaJuana' bottle!!! Already looking for the next island to visit!!! :-)

author: vl84
title: Don't waste your time and money.
text: Tropical Princess Resort was a nightmare I can only attempt to forget and that will fade only with time. If you are American you will likely experience food poisoning due to substandard sanitation and poor water quality that I believe the staff washes the food with. The staff does not wear gloves and I never viewed any member of the staff washing their hands. My husband and I stayed for 7 days and hated it. Half of the trip we both had explosive diarrhea and painful stomach aches and no, it was not from alcohol, we are not into heavy drinking. The staff was mostly rude, unhelpful and only speaks Spanish. We had to hide our wallets and passports due to constant warnings that staff would steal and the hotel admitted it was not their problem. If you want to use the safe that is attached to the wall they will charge you $24.00 for a few days with the key to safe. The entertainment is minimal and only a good show hit or miss that last 30 minutes. The alcohol is local alcohol only and nothing fancy. The service is rather poor from the majority of the staff. Dominican Republic beaches are not nearly as nice as the Bahamas. The Dominican people are constantly trying to rip you off especially if your American. There is no internet available unless you pay $6.00 every half hour at an internet center that is run by a separate company. This company will likely rip you off and not give you the internet time and service you paid for. This internet cafe on the resort also sells excursions. My husband and I paid $180.00 for a zip line excursion and no one showed up. I had to fight to get the money back by demanding information and the money from several mmbers of the most of which did not speak English and then finally the hotel manager stepped up and got us the $180.00 back In short, I am still very angry I wasted my vacation time and money and time at this resort. I live in Washington and it was a long plane ride for a lot of grief.

author: mihito23
title: Vacation 2009 at the Tropical Princess
text: We just returned from the Tropical Princess and were pleasently surprised. The rooms, although having outdated furniture,were actually two rooms, one with two single beds and a1/2 bath an the other a king bed and a full bath which is great if you are in a rush. The food was good not great but everyone found something they liked. The drinks were very good but noone knew how to make a good mohito and the beer is always good. The hotel itself needs some upkeep( i.e) walkways cracked, plaster peeling but nothing that you should get worried about. There are two bars on the beach. The first is also the snack shack where you can grab lunch if you don't feel like heading to the main dining hall. The food here is mainly tacos, hotdogs,pizza etc. but they do have a sandwich menu you can order from. Ham and cheese,cubans,chicken and fries and the best hamburger I've had in a while, but order it with no huevo (fried egg) That my friends was quite a surprise. The first time we ordered it we all just looked at the buger we ordered and there was a fried egg on it. Wow!!!!!!!!! The other bar we went to after 5 pm as it is less crowded. The biggets problem we had was the constant bararge.of people trying to get you to steup an appointment for a timeshare meeting, also the vendors at night with their tables selling goods you don't want or need, but we just told them no or just totally ignored them altogether. All in all we had a very good time and would defenitly would go back there.

author: keepfittildesley
title: this resort is probably the best in the area.
text: Beautifully landscaped with a tropical feel, ultra clean rooms with safes (extra cost). check the aircon works on arrival otherwise the mosqiutos will interupt your fun. They dont like cool temperatures and will stay away as long as the room is cool. The food, in my opinion was great. Over 40 choices of hot food and plenty of fruit. The bars serve alchohol and cocktails round the clock-almost. Its almost all local brew and as good as you can get. No production boosting chemicals that leave you worse for wear after a few drinks. This resort prides itself in cleanliness and polite staff -bar those who approach you on the first day to push timeshare on you. Nonetheless they are very polite and will leave you alone if youre not interested. There are activities for all. Even young kids. Although myself and my partner are quite fussy, we loved this resort and had a great time. Tip. opt for a villa. dont get talked into paying extra/booking for the oriental cuisine. its no point. the food the the main inclusive restaurant is much better. cmmathme@aol.com

author: montreallobsters
title: a glorious week!
text: Thanks to trip advisor we hit the jackpot. We are a family with 3 young children and this resort really caters to famillies. We had a family suite with 2 double and 3 single beds and 2 bathrooms, WOW. The room was a little outdated but clean. I would suggest they change the matresses! There was a safe in the room. Very secure, no problem.The kids pool,Excellent. The beach was amazing and there were always chairs available. At the buffet, there is something for everyone. Food and drinks are alway available. The staff is always friendly and smiling especially when you give them a few dollars. We felt very safe on the resort security everywhere. The only real negative point to our stay was on the evenings they had vendors come and sell on the resort. Don't buy anything from them , you will pay double the price then what it costs at the stores on the resort, or the stores at the airport when you leave. They are just as bad as the vultures at the flea market on the beach. I don't know why the resort allows them in and swindle people the way they do, all in the name of friendship. We would definetly go back.

author: brigus
title: Clean Faciltiy, good service, lovely beach but disappointing food
text: Strengths • Beautiful setting, long beautiful beach with clean white sand • Grounds immaculately maintained • Weather was perfect – 2 nights with heavy rain and brief shower morning of April 12 other wise sunny and comfortable every day • Three large Pools - two large quiet pools and 1 larger (livelier/noisier) pool with swim up bar • Cleanliness of entire facility, rooms cleaned once daily (most days), public bathrooms and all public areas including beach cleaned continually by many workers • Rooms were good clean and bright except we had a family suite with hose type shower in one room would not rest in holster, kids beds had no bed spread and blankets looked very worn out. • Service always pleasant friendly • Spa seemed beautiful did not use except for hair style for daughter • Beautiful lobby but too far from rest of site (~8 min walk) with infrequest shuttle service • Felt very safe and secure on site • Plenty of bars, good hours, • Truly all inclusive - not like a cruise - no nickel and diming for extras Weaknesses • Food was generally unappealing – most meals feature the same type of food with subtle variations – food was cooked in sauces generally greasy, salty or too rich – by far biggest demerit for this resort • No clearly posted schedule in English of events time and locations. There was info posted but it was not always complete or available in English. • Large pool was “cloudy” could not see bottom of 4 foot pool – Question functioning of water treatment system • Selection of included a-la carte restaurants at for Tropical Princess guest limited to 2 (Brazilian Restaurant (tried) and a Dominican Republic Restaurant – did not try) . Other a-al carte restaurant are available at $11pp tried Chinese which was good (best meal of the week) • Daytime Kids Program – seem to be only available in French when we were there – did not avail • Most staff do not speak English al all – some speak a little English - a few key staff speak English well • Limited bike selection, cannot ride biked on site, bike usage hours 9-5 only (heat of day) • Beach equipment limited – kids could not get mask, fins general not available • Mini bar/bottled water resupply was haphazard -had to obtain directly form maid cart frequently • Some mosquitoes in room at time annoying – likely case by a problem with Patio door seal with left a small gap. Not a huge issue. No other issue with bugs. • No face clothes provided - bring your own • Drink selection was limited – nomfrozen fruit drinks except those with coconut milk. Only soft drinks available were Sprite and Coke. Wines were unappealing. Beer was light and good. Other • Nasty stomach ailments were experienced by 2 family members and 2 others to lesser extent - not sure of cause but my wife effectively lost the week due to illness – on site medical care was very good • Animation program – did not participate but seem lower key then other resorts – evening shows started at 9:45PM too late for our family • Most guests at this property were Spanish or French speaking. • North American Blackberries work in area as cell phone but data/e-mail not available • Bring US$ (small denominations useful). Everything is priced in US$. Bring many US$1 bank notes for tips • Had to get up early before 7 am to "reserve" choice lounge chairs on beach with towels - system is not ideal as chairs can sit idle for extended periods but people generally respect this is the system. Seems to be less of a problem at pool side Overall we had a nice holiday. I would give this resort a mediocre score but would not return. Next time I would go 5 star only.

author: Wrinklies62
title: Excellent value, thoroughly enjoyed ourselves
text: We too were aprehensive before going having read some negative reviews, but were very pleasantly surprised. We had a family room which was very clean and comfortable although perhaps a little "tired" looking. Mosquitoes were not a problem as we used repellant and plug-ins and never got bitten once. Plenty of hot water and fridge stocked daily. Used safety deposit box ($48 for two weeks) and had no problems with security. Service was excellent, we left frequent tips for maid and waiters and they couldn't do enough for us. They are such friendly and delightful people. Hotel grounds very attractive with lots of wild life and superbly maintained. Could have done with some seating in the grounds to appreciate them more fully. Entertainment variable but some of the shows were excellent. Good selection of food, we didn't feel the need to use the a la carte restaurants at all as the buffet restaurant had themed nights. Beach fantastic, white sand stretching for miles and turquoise sea. Loads of sun loungers, never a problem getting one either on beach or poolside. No guest has to walk more than 3 minutes to get to beach. Surrounding area seems safe, we cycled into Bavaro and though we were hassled to buy things there was no problem with security, but the hotel bikes are decrepit and need replacing urgently! We had a fantastic holiday and would certainly return.

author: beachbumMaritimers
title: Great time at Tropical Princess
text: Just came back from Punta Cana. Stayed at Tropical Princess. 3 couples. Nothing negative about this resort. Great food, great service, beautiful beach and very nice pools. Always chairs available at beach and pools. We always managed to get shade at both places. Lots of food choices at the buffet with a different theme every evening. The two included a-la-carte restaurants (Brezilian and Dominican) are a must. Service was excellent and always friendly. Always going out of their way to help you. Grounds are beautiful. I do not know why people are complaining about this resort. Been to a 5 star resort in Mexico last year and must admit I preferred Tropical Princess. There's something in Dominican Republic that makes you want to come back!

author: Cat112
title: Traveller Beware!!!
text: This resort is a little dated but, still a very nice place, the beaches are great! I would however stay away from this resort as they have many problems at this time. They have a very bad security problem & repairs take forever. During our stay there we were two of multiple guests that had thier room broken into. We had all of our money taken along with identification cards and credit cards. The doors to our room were broken and remained broken still when we checked out at end of the week.This resort is very poorly managed and this reflex on the resort itself. Too bad, it is a nice location. If looking at vacationing to this property, please stay away at this time. We would never want anyone else to have their vacation ruined like ours. In the time of our stay there were more than 12 other people that were missing money, cameras, cell phones, laptops ect. There were even reports of safes being broken into. If you are already booked to stay at this resort keep all of your personal effects with you at all times. Hopefully this problem is taken are of promptly because it is a really nice place. Could have had a very good time. There are many other resorts in that area to choose from. We have travelled to Dominican Republic 8 times before in bigger & smaller resorts and have never had any problems like this. Take care.

author: Jessica27274
title: Vacation: Amazing, Quality: Superb
text: Thanks to our profession as teacher we had to take our trip south during the March Break. A time of high prices and occasionally students. So, we were very happy to find the lovely Tropical Princess. After a plane flight with a lovely staff (the flight attandents allowed our 6 year-old daughter hand out pretzels on the plane and announced her name over the PA, this made her feel so special) we arrived in the Tropical Princess grand lobby. On our way in our eldest daughter, 10, was happy to see the sports centres at the front of the hotel. The check in was very fast. Our room was in a great spot, beside the less busy pool which was great for our children. It was never overly crowded. The food was great. It was so relaxing to sit in the beautiful, open air buffet with a very willing and happy staff. After dinner every night we would take a walk down the semi-longed path through the jungle part of the resort to the lobby and shopping area were they would display these cute pictures taken every day of people with animals (adorable trained monkey, parrot etc.) our kids loved looking at the pictures. The room was very clean and had nice high ceilings. The pools great and not too cold. The beach was outstanding with soft white sand. One morning we got up early enough to see the sun rise over the ocean, it was beautiful so I highly recommend getting up at 6:15 to do so. Our experience at Tropical Princess was difinately a positive one! We will be return this March (09).

author: nihari
title: Loud modern disco terror
text: Close your eyes and think about the white beach, wind, palm sea, waves and dream away. Then BOEM BOEM BOEM "welcom to the club" says a dark voice very loud in the big speaker boxes. This is the start tune of a 4 times per day session to activate the people for aquagym and other activities of the animation team. You can hear it all over the resort and beach. Away is your dream, your concentration in your book, or you maybe even were snoozing away on your holiday. No way, the animation team is there for the 1 to 3 persons who like it. This is terrible. If you stay there longer, you can dream it. Most people we spoke did not like it at all, but let it happen. We tried to speak about it with the 18 year old animation team leaders, but this was without result. A manager was able to arrange one normal morning without the BOEM BOEM BOEM of the modern disco terror. Only the volume was fast pushed to there usuall level later that day. The only ascape was to find a place 150 meters from the animation mosk and bars. One day with a lot of wind we tried to stay near the pool. Impossible to do something other than listen to disco music and other different music, at the same time!!!, from the animation, the pool bar and beach bar. We left the resort that day to find some rest because our room was near the pool. Even in the room you could not relax or read a book. Looking for a disco, go to the tropical princess. Want a Carribean relax holiday, find an other resort.

author: MELHELE22
title: Aug26-Sept 2 Honeymooners and Loved it!
text: Honeymooners! WOOHOO...We liked Tropical Princess a lot!! Ignore all the comments of the bad things. Things do happen but make the best of your trip. I won't lie we did have problems. Our toilet clogged on us the first day and so did our tub but they fixed it right away and were great about it. they called to see if someone was there and then later on they would call to check to see if it was still working okay. That was good of them. The rooms were nice...maids were awesome..and the beaches are so nice..the food is good. Lots to choose from, different themes every night. Josie the bartender at the pool was awesome. Made your time a blast. I would definatly recommend this hotel to ppl. We had a blast and met some pretty fun ppl too... So go expecting to have a great time, and if you run into problems..so what..don't let it put a damper on your vacation..enjoy, soak up the sun and if you do go here...we are jealious! Have a blast..oh and don't forget to pack the sunscreen or Aloe Vera!!! :o)

author: walkar
title: Fabulous!
text: We stayed at the Tropical Princess from 22 July to 5th Aug 2008. Family of 4 (2 teenage sons aged 16 and 14). We had the most fantastic time despite being worried about some of the reviews before we went. The hotel room was spacious and clean, maid service every day - clean towels etc. The food in the main Buffet Restaurant was extensive and I defy anyone to not find something they like amongst the array of varied food. The grounds of the hotel are immaculate and are tended all day every day - green and lush. The setting (on the beach) is like a picture postcard with white sands, palm trees and blue warm sea. Yes, the entertainment is in different languages but then there are different nationalities visiting. What a lot of people don't realise is that after the main show (near the lobby) all the dancers etc. descend on the Lobby Bar where there is dancing etc until midnight. We only found this out after a few days - I thought the only reason you went to the Lobby was if you needed something from reception. DO NOT be put off by bad reviews - they worried me sick before we went. You will have a fabulous time. Room problems could be had anywhere in the world and anyone who did have this problem were just unlucky. On the whole, everyone we spoke to had a fantastic time with no complaints - sickness included. We all would love to go back next year especially my 2 sons who made some great friendships. Enjoy!!!

author: sweetie_piex
title: Amazing!
text: Wow, what an amazing holiday. Holiday of a life time. The staff were soo friendly ! Alawys smiling and chatting. The entertainment crew were very nice and their shows at night were fantastic. Couldn't have asked for better. Made friends with some of the staff as it was a pleasure to talk them. They really made me laugh. The food wasnt that great for me but i cant fault it. There is a lot of variety. The beach was very very clean but hard to get a lounger. Have to be up very early to get 1. The pools were absolutely magnificent. As clean as anything and the swim up bar was handy. The people and staff are really great. The rooms get clean bedding, towels and they get tidied,cleaned and fridge restocked every day. I have never experienced such a great holiday! It was truly fantastic. See ya next year Edwin, Victor, Jonothan, Geraldo and Miguel ! I would highly recommend it !!

author: liberty_emotion
title: Beautiful!!
text: My family and I stayed at the Caribe club Princess in Punta Cana the week of Sept 15 - 22. Overall the place was great. Beach and pool very clean but good luck trying to get a lounge chair around the pool. Need to get them early. Rooms were nice. Clean and a decent size. Food was good. Buffet was a little repetive but always busy. Had a bad experience at the a la carte mama mia. Had a reservation for 7:30pm. Sat down, waited 15 minutes before we asked if we could get drinks, waited another 20 minutes before we asked if someone was going to take our order considering other people who came in after us were having there orders taken, Then the waiters decided to discuss amongs themselves who was going to take it so we ended up getting up and going to the buffet instead. Activites at the pool and beach were very entertaining. Have to give props to Jonathan, Miguel and Geraldo for being great. Also go to the bar la matica located on the beach attached to the snack bar where Izzie (Izidor) is, he is the best bartender at the whole resort. There is also so much wildlife there, it's great. you have peacocks and roosters running around, birds of all types and fish and turtles. Would go back!!

author: suggie
title: Friendly place with some bad design and great beach !
text: This place is slow on check in, but the guys are so kind i didnt mind at all, i was there with my 13year old daugther. Better book a superior room, nicer areas, because the rest lacks on the design, not warm. The personnel is very courtois and do their best, the big flaw of this resort is the housekeeping, it was a problem for everyone in the regular rooms. Food was ok, found something good at each meal and the drinks too. Great service from bartenders and servers in the restaurants, dont miss the mexican restaurant, its fun tequila at your table ! The animators are very kind and try their best, but nightlife is inexistant on the resort, youll need to go out and they plan fun stuff to do for about 25$ per person. Somes discos are worth seing. Beach is the best part, take a catamaran tou its worth it, great staff there also. For any medical need there is a drug store with a nice pharmacist that will help you. Room are descent, if you go there in summer, pick a room on the second floor, its cooler. First floor rooms were smelly apperently from people who change room. We were on third and i was fine. The main pool, where the bar is, wasnt always clear and some people got ears infection during my trip. But we had a nice and relaxing week, we met wonderful people, from usa, france, haiti !!! Beach is perfect you can take long walks...

author: greencoconuts
title: Loved the pizza
text: I would recommend the tropical princess to anyone, but I wouldn't recommend the VIP package unless they have to money to chuck away and like spending loads of time looking at the customer services rep in the lobby.I spent hours there !! My spanish skills sure did improve listening to them for hours on end speaking on the phone whilst I sat waiting for attention. VIP is an acronym for Very Important Person. I felt like the opposite, so did my partner when we were ignored in the a la carte resteraunt - la cava. We upped and left soon after the waitress was too busy sorting out other peoples woes instead of taking our order. Enough moaning, the place was beautiful, a real tropical haven we didn't leave the resort all week. The food was plentiful and they cooked real omelettes for you in the morning. The beach was blissful and the sea sublime. It felt cold when you jumped in but it soon warmed up with the waves. Played water polo in the Caribe pool. Scored a couple of goals but let in a few when I was keeper. Pool bar was ace ! Swim up for a coke and rum how good is that ? Seen a wedding there too. Fancy horses and all. Definantly go back.

author: sandy57
title: Great B-day celebration
text: My sister and I just returned from a 4 day 3 night stay at the resort and I must say that we enjoyed every minute of our stay. I was celebrating my 50 th b-day and was looking for a place to relax and sit back. The resort caters to all types of people: adults, children, adolescents, etc. Check-in and check-out was so simple with no complications whatsoever. There are activities for all age groups. The rooms were impecably clean and neat. Our key did not open the door initially but when reported was solved quickly. On night the AC unit was not cooling properly. When reported the problem was solved in less than one half hour. Food was excellent but my sister had a slight upset stomach, but this was do to her over eating. The biggest assest the resort has are its people. Coming from an Island in the Carribbean (Puerto Rico) where we are used to happy and free spirited people, the dominicans are truly friendly and respectful. I honestly believe they enjoy what they are doing and most of all, are very aware of proper customer service. We tipped them generously but I was saddened by the fact they were not tipped as they should have been by other tourists. Most of them work double shifts and after conversations with some of the employees, we found our that they work 11 days in a row for a very, very low salary. Nevertheless, I would return in a blink of an eye. Great B-day celebration.

author: PaulAllenfamily
title: Great place to relax
text: Stayed there 7th to 14th May and was very impressed by the facilities on offer. We were offered the VIP upgrade but did not take it, and at the end of the day it was not needed. Food was plentiful and very edible, with service that many top class restaurants would struggle to match. Always a cheery and friendly welcome. Rooms were clean and well looked after. We did have a couple of minor problems which were sorted out - lights failed a couple of times and toilet flush handle broke. But guest services (Ingrid) were always on the ball and sorted things out. When I rang to report one problem I found that themaid had already reported it and maintenance was on its way. Beach is superb very clean and always had room availabele, likewise the pool areas had ample seating etc. Most days we were up and about at 6.30 walking the beach and grounds. Hotel staff would be working already keeping gardens tidy, cleaning pools etc. Fresh coconuts were about from own trees and the gardeners would open them right then and there for you. Reception area is a room to see, it is open sided with marble floors etc. Very nice and very efficient. No tips were expected but appreciated when given Would I go there again - yes without question.

author: CalgaryKell
title: real nice resort
text: This is a lovely resort with very well maintained grounds. They are spotless. It almost feels like you are in a national park setting. In the front section of the grounds is a mango tree perserve. The staff is real friendly, much better than cuba. The food is fine. The one night the 12 of us went to one of the a la carte restarants the food was sub par so we decided to stick with the buffett which had a different theme every night. THe resort has three pools which we really liked. They go from extremely noisy to very quite. The beach here is teuly magnificant. LOng ,wide and pretty clean. THe sand is white and fine and the water very warm. The rooms, well not that great but ok. Try to get in the newest section for a better room. Did I say we where there April 12 - 19, 2007.

author: NotSoMini
title: Tropical Princess is Great!
text: We were very happy with our week at the Tropical Princess! We travelled from East Coast Canada via Sunwing, and were impressed with this charter airline and its services. We were offered champagne, a meal with wine, and complimentary drinks (non-alcoholic) and snacks on the outward flight, with the same, sans champagne, on the return to Canada. We had prepaid for seats with extra legroom, and were happy we had done so....loads of room! Tropical Princess, and its sister resort Caribe Club Princess, function as one large resort, with guests having access to all facilities, although having to pay a little extra, sometimes, if you had not paid for VIP service. Our room was spotless, and had two double beds - very, very comfortable. Housekeeping service was great. We used only one of the three large, free form pools at this resort, and found it clean and cool - but not too cool! The beach is beautiful, and we spent a lot of time floating around in the azure ocean - we were very surprised at the large number of people who don't seem to stick even one toe in the water, at any time! The resort is lovely, with well landscaped grounds, prowling peacocks and other birds, a few small shops to buy things at greatly inflated prices (by my reckoning, suntan lotion would set you back about $25 or $30 US, so take lots from home!), pretty buildings, friendly staff. We could always find something good to eat (although we were not brave enough to sample some of the more exotic offerings) and I am still dreaming about the flan available at this resort. La Creperie was great for an afternoon snack of ice cream (try the coconut!) or a sweet or savory crepe offering. We were also happy with the drinks we were served, whether at a restaurant, the lobby, the beach or a pool bar. Coco Loco and Pie Pie (I am not sure whether I am spelling that correctly) were my personal favorites - yes, way too sweet, but really good! Even though there are a few glitches in this, as in any, resort, the one thing we'd like to note is that this resort does not seem to have enough beach and pool chairs for the number of guests - either that, or many people are "reserving" chairs at both the beach AND pool. It seemed the whole resort was up and at it early in the morning (prior to 7:00 a.m.) 'reserving' chairs. The lack of chairs and 'late arrival' of those who thought they had reserved chairs by virtue of placing their towels or other belongings on them - which were subsequently removed by other people - served as a source of entertainment for us as we sat on the beach, sunning ourselves and people watching. Loud arguments ensued in a variety of languages...... All in all, however, we would return to this resort in an instant!

author: SarahMorales
title: Best Beach!!
text: We stayed at the Tropical princess the week of mar 17th-24th,2007. The grounds were beautiful and well kept. It is a bit of a walk from the lobby to the pools/beach but there are trolleys constantly running to transport. The rooms were average, we upgraded to a suite which gave us more room but nothing exceptional. The maids were over compensating with the help of a few extra U.S $. Entertainment was fantastic, friendly curteous staff. Two in particular from this resort are Jose, whom is with activities, and Daniel the pool bartender. We will miss them dearly and would return just for them in particular. As three single friends, there was always something to do, and lots of good times to be had. I recommend the parasailing and the catamaran ride if you are looking for something extra. The beach was OUTSTANDING!!!! This is the most beautiful and clean beach I have seen yet, and I have been many places! Just a 15 min walk up the shore is a market where depending on how much energy you have, you can get anything for a great price. Beware of the banana leaf cigars. Remember quality cigars should not be kept in plastic and should be refridgerated! I would definately recomment this resort.

author: Voyager15037
title: Tropical princess- resort 3.5*
text: We have just returned from a week at the TROPICAL PRINCESS. The RESORT hotel is magnificent with beautiful trees, beach and flowers. There is still the season of wind so we can only use Catamaran and Kayak for 2 days out of 7 days. Avoid months Jan,Feb car a lot of wind. The resort is very clean. The room is small even that we had a small suite with partial ocean view (2adults and 2 children ). Room is very standard *3*). We took VIP option (15$/person adult/day) which is really great so we can go to all restos a la carte and many options such as massage, motorised banana float...). The food is just normal even a la carte restos (chinese,italian,mexican,sea food,domnican,french ). We loved the room service 24H, the snack is good when you order from the room. The evening shows are great(Lion King,...). If you do care about having a luxurous room and excellent food then may be choose for a 5* resort car this resort has a very standard room, food is normal. Three of us were sick by eating food. Be careful for the bagages when check out. There are no system for labels or numbers assigned to each person so bagages can be mixed up anywhere. People are very nice in this resort. Service is good. It was sunny everyday 28C.

author: Getaway7715
title: beautiful resort but the food is lacking
text: We went with our three children (7,10&13). It was great for the kids. Lots to do. We had taken some junk food as recommended on this site. The food really was not very good. Two of us were sick and are still not feeling great at home. If we were to go again, we'd take a small suit case of healthy snacks. Probably wouldn't go here again because of the food. The beach was awesome. We did have one cockroach in our room. Saw him on the first day and a few times after. They're very fast - we never did get him. The resort was very clean, not overly big (which we liked. We left at 1 am on the last day and had to check out at noon. We were promised a courtesy room to shower but never did get one. They had assigned the same room to more than one couple. We saw two couples arguing over another room for which they had done the same thing - assigned one room twice. Not the end of the world but they really didn't even seem to care. No "Sorry for the inconvenience". Just "there are no rooms - we're very full".

author: Trail30186
title: Lovely Resort
text: We returned from the Tropical / Caribe Princess on Feb 1. We travelled with our mostly adult kids and friends and family members. We had a wonderful time here. The weather was awesome some windy days though so we sat at the pool instead of the beach. The guys in our party of 10 took turns putting the towels out in the am so we could get our spot at the beach/pool. The entertainment was absolutley entertaining and the 1st night we were very confused as they hardly spoke any english- a few days in and we were understanding more. These young people work very long hours and are very outgoing and friendly. Watch your teenage daughters the boys like to take them for walks on the beach at night!!! The grounds of this resort are really beautiful and well cared for - the spa is very nice a little $$ though. The rooms and halls very clean and the maids were great we left gifts and tip everyday. No problems at all. The food was our only problem - some of us were sick but not terribly -- I am a very fussy eater and had a bit of trouble with some things but I always found something that I liked and did not go hungry. The a la carte restaurants were quite good. The coffee was not great but it grew on me (milk is not good.) Bring some tim's and canned milk with you there is a coffee maker in the room. Bring snacks from home too the Lay's chips are imported and cost $6 us a bag. If you have fussy eaters in your group bring some snacks from home you will be craving them by the end of the week. I went on this site before we left and was quite prepared for our trip - thanks to all of the advice from here we had a great time. many thanks to all

author: TRIMS
title: Lots of hype and hot air
text: We got back form the Tropical Princess on the 18 of Dec. and I am sorry to say that we read all the reviews on this resort before we went with it and find it hard to believe that so many people fine this such a great place. Yes the beach is nice and the ocean is warm but the beach has about 60 other resorts on it, so you can't say this is a great thing about staying at the Tropical Princess when 59 other resorts offer the same thing. The rooms were plain but ok, the mini-fridge would leak water on to the floor making a small pool and the potential for a slip and fall. Every Once in a while the hot water would stop working and you would have to wait about an hour or so before you could take a shower and then the water temp. was just above cool at best. The A/C vent would give off a musty smell when just starting up, which was because the past guest in the room was a smoker which accounts for about 70% of the people at this resort, mostly Europeans. The staff was not as friendly as everyone had said most of them would just ignore you if you could not speak the language, mostly the bar staff. The food in the buffey was terrible, with most of it looking like it was re-used from the last meal, this is were I thing most people are getting sick from, us included. The front lobby is about a good 10 min. walk to the rooms which is divided by a big smelly swamp were most of the mosquitos come from and the shuttle cars are never around when you need a lift or they are going the wrong way. The pools look nice but don't be fooled, they don't clean them as offend as they should which leaves bites of plant matter and floating bugs on the top of the water, after swimming in the pool about 3 times I started to get bad earaches which went away when I stop putting my head under water while swimming, stick with swimming in the ocean. Check in is at 3 pm & check out is 12 noon, remember this if booking a trip here because we had a 6:30 pm pick up in the lobby,this would leave us with no room for 6 1/2 hours. But you can extend your room for about 10.00US per hour. We went that route because we had our 7 year old with us and it cost us about $80.00 Canadian for about 5 hours more, what a burn. Lots of the kids at this resort were looking ill, probably from the food and it was hard to stand by and see this and the parents did'nt look very happy as well. All in all I would have to give this resort a 4 out of 10 and we would not return to this resort again.

author: chewp
title: Very Relaxing
text: My husband and I were joined by our children, 14, 17, 22. It was a lovely vacation and the best beach that I have ever been to!! The buffet was incredible, they had 15 or 16 different stations. We arrived at 11 pm and there was lots of food and drinks for us so you don't need to worry about not having a supper on the plane. The buffet was open 24hours!! There was nightly entertainment in two different locations, one by the buffet and the other at the main entry. There were five different restaurants and three pools. We did however have to get up around 6 am to reserve beach chairs under palapas. However, if you didn't get up there were chairs to be found in the sun. We had beautiful suites with two bathrooms that were cleaned everyday. The staff was very friendly and if you tiped they were that much better. Bring hats to give away, you will make great friends and get incredible service from staff if you acknowledge them. In all it was very relaxing and we won't forget this holiday. Oh and don't forget your sunscreen and mosquito repellent for the black flies at night, that you don't see till the next day. Have fun and enjoy the beach

author: 401TanyaM
title: Very nice but I hope you don't want a chair at the beach
text: We have travelled many times before to the Carribean and knew what to expect. The food was very good. You must remember it is not Canadian food. There was something at the buffet for guests from all over the world so of course there are many things we passed right on by. For example one night there was a delicious hip of beef with all the trimmings. We went to the Dominican a la carte restaurant but were not overly impressed. The service was fine throughout the resort but what is our personal pet peeve when travelling is a resort that does not have enough lounge chairs at the beach. You had to be up before 6 a.m. to get a chair. People would go down and put their towel on the chair and not come to the beach til after lunch. I was surprised to see this at a 4+ star resort. We saw chairs vacant for 4-5 hours straight. Extremely rude guests. We have been away many times and always meet people from all over. This resort however had mostly French guests and we are strictly English speaking. We did meet an American couple the second to last day there and they observed the same. The attitude of the guests is something you can not hold against the hotel however they promote French guests by employing French students brought from a university in France to deal exclusively with the French guests. I have nothing against French people just only wanted to make a point that the language barrier made it difficult to meet people. The resort itself was very clean and the entertainment deserves top marks.

author: DayTrip31412
title: Amazing.. read this if your going there
text: Im 17 and my family of 4 arrived there on march 17. When you get off the plane it was like you were getting hit with a brick wall of heat, therefore go on the plane wearing very VERY light clothing. The airport is pretty amazing all outside but quite busy ( we arrived at night). Getting your luggage and getting on the bus that takes you to your hotel is a little bit hecktic but RELAX, when u get there its so worth it. The roads are very skinny and the drivers sure drive fast but its fun and they do get you there haha. Once again when u arrive at the hotel and checking in its pretty crazy because everyone is frantic to get to their rooms. The rooms are pretty nice but i suggest taking bug spray with dit. I got alot of bits but they were only minor. Make sure you have very extreme sunscreen, i was wearing 50spf but i still managed to burn, bubble and peel. My family adn i went on the Swimming with the sharks/sting rays excurtion. very well worth it. I was pretty timid to go into the pen but it was fine. There is snorkling included in that package. it was about 80 bucks / person. expensive but once again worth it. Parasailing was so awesome too, highly suggested. it is reccomended to take some snacks on the plane with you they didnt feed much, but the chips down there are about 6 bucks for a big bag, kinda ridiuculous.the beaches are absoulty almazing as well. If you have any questiopns e-mail me at ---

author: 157GrahamR
title: A Very Good and Welcome break
text: This hotel is oozing friendliness and is very welcomming. First impressions count and the reception staff are marvelous. Our rooms were no tready on our arrival so luggage deposited in luggage room and we went to the bar for a drink followed by lunch in the dinning room. Two waitresses impressed Natailie and Rachel. Always smiling always "hola" throughout the whole visit. A credit to the restaurant team. The food is very good. Always a good choice and salads amazing. If you cannot find find anything suitable to eat then you must be the fussisest of eaters. Within minutes of sitting down you are approached to see if you would like drinks with the meal. Breakfast is a marvelous choice of things to eat. Stuff you would not contemplate at home. Cleanliness of the hotel is immaculate. Never a thing out of place. The cleaning staff go about their business with a ferocious pace and thoroughness.Always smiling always "Hola" There is entertainment on in the evening and we loved the flamenco dancers. All in all a fantastic hotel and staff that are so friendly you want to pack them in your suitcase and bring them home

author: Scrubba-dub
title: Noisy hotel
text: Hotel in a good location it has to be said. Check in ( Manuel ) very easy. Room clean. Couple of moans. The hotel is noisy from a point of view that we could hear the next room talking and listening to the TV. People above us ( we stayed in room 1004 08/02/18 thru 11.02.18 ) moving furniture at 11.30hrs at night. No carpets so noisy. Room sparse. Asked for milk on day 2 as we'd used ours ( in room cups of tea ) and was told " milk only for day 1, you need to go to the supermarket and buy your own ). Four star hotel - attitude off day time reception people not the best!. Quite surly actually. Buffet breakfast OK, staff again surly. Bar staff OK, got told off for using the heated swimming pool by the one - and they want Euro 15.00per towel deposit plus Euro 1.00 a time ( not a day so change towels and pay again ) to rent. Far better hotels in the same area with better, more friendly staff. Wouldn't recommend this one to any fellow TA's I afraid.

author: alelors1
title: 2 weeks November 2017
text: This hotel is in the centre of Benidorm. It has easy access to both beaches, buses are just down the road, shops, shops everywhere.public transport very cheap. Hotel has high proportion of Spanish visitors, but we are in Spain and should enjoy the Spanish. Culture. Hotel staff and management, so pleasant and willing to help all the time. The food is a gastronomic delight. But you have to try everything. Everything is in English and Spanish. Every night their was entertainment. Mainly for the Spanish clients. But you have to respect and join in to the Spainsh culture. If you want to do English things then they are just down the road. We visited late in the year, so can only give an opinion on this time of year. It also coincided with the Benidorm fiesta brilliant. My wifes birthday was during our visit and the management gave us bubbly for two in our room. will return again. Yes yes yes

author: lesliea686
title: Fantastic location
text: At arrival the hotel is very smart and clean. Checking in quick and easy with good directions to our rooms. There was 5 adults traveling in our party and we had booked 2 rooms. Both rooms whet the same size and they had just put an extra bed in one. This made the room very compact put still very useable. The room itself was very clean with a great view of the sea and sun in the morning. (Floor 10 facing pool) nice balcony. Bathroom was very nice always had hot water and shower was excellent. T.v. Had some English channels if you wanted to watch it. Restaurant was mainly catered for Spanish people and there was a lot there, not a bad thing ,if it’s good enough for them it must be good. It was... the food was varied and good quality with plenty of choice at all meals. Breakfast,lunch and dinner was excellent. The evening entertainment was again Spanish orientated but a. Nice place to sit and have a drink. Personally I thought it was very hot in there in the evening and went outside to cool off. The drinks where a bit expensive at the bar and the only one draft beer, but the G&T was large and very nice.i would definitely recommend this hote mostly for location, 100 yards to the old town and 200 yards to the breach.

author: MidsTravellers
title: second stay
text: We stayed for a second time for a week commencing 29th October. We had a very pleasant stay. Mainly Spanish...we were the only couple travelling with Jet2 from Manchester staying there for the week... but the Spanish government heavily subsidise holidays from October for their pensioners and disabled...so it's only to be expected in most of the hotels in the area (on the edge of the Old Town). It wasn't an issue for us at all. We had the opportunity to practise our Spanish...very badly! :-)... the food was varied. We found plenty to ruin our Slimming World diet anyway! The drinks in the hotel were very reasonable. The staff were friendly and efficient and the room was clean and comfortable with the usual kettle, hairdryer and fridge..toiletries... complementary tea and coffee initially but we took our own mugs and Nescafe and PG Tips. All in all a very nice stay. Very conveniently located between Old town and New ...and can recommend the tapas bars in the Old Town...a totally different experience from the hustle and bustle of Levante..although we enjoyed a few shows there too. Benidorm is a lovely place to visit and if you cant find something to please you...then you're impossible to please....and this hotel ticks boxes for location and accommodation and price. you get what you pay for :-) :-)

author: Macklin
title: Very Comfortable
text: Our first trip to Benidorm and we were very pleased with this hotel. Excellent location. Spotless rooms, serviced daily. Food was very good, with always something for every taste, even though mainly caters for Spanish guests.(Just avoid the sausages and the orange juice at breakfast). Very efficient waiting staff. We were talking to a lady who had been going there for 20 years who said the food has actually gone down considerably this year, but of course we had nothing to compare it with and thought it ok. Entertainment every night but mostly enjoyed by the Spanish guests. Outdoor pool was enclosed in it's own "conservatory" which did not make it very inviting to sit round.We only used it once and it was well looked after and warm. Guests were asked to wear swimhats purchased from reception which may have put people off. Information in room mentioned a "courtesy room" for guests such as us with a late pick up for return. This actually turned out to be a shower in the gym changing room but was adequate for us to freshen up before our pick up at 7.30 pm. It may have been possible to keep our room until 6pm for a charge of 30 euros, assuming it was free. Luggage was kept safe for us also. Staff entered into Halloween by dressing up and hotel was decorated with various Halloween props. Overall, a very clean and well run hotel. Bed/pilows very comfortable. Could literally hear every word from next door guests as walls very thin but it was not a problem because the other guests were considerate. Maybe a different story otherwise. Would recommend this hotel because of comfort, cleanliness and location.

author: karl1968
title: Ideal location, clean and great food. BUT...
text: Just spent 5 nights here and overall very pleased with the hotel. Checking in was quick and very friendly. The room was up to date and clean. The room service was excellent. Beds were very comfortable, bathroom was clean and modern. The food available can only be described as excellent. Something for everyone, probably the highlight of the holiday. Staff are friendly and sometimes helpful. Would recommend to anyone who likes comfort and a relaxing atmosphere. Only downside, we experienced was the late check out option. We asked on Tues for a late check out on Friday to be told it would be fine and to confirm/pay on Thursday. On Thursday the reception advised I could not pay or confirm, as the hotel was still trying to sell our room !! If my wife and I wanted a sleep due to late flights on Friday I was told to use the chairs in reception!!! the hotel did sell my room and no late check out was available. Thanks!! They do offer a shower room to freshen up but that's no good for a siesta nap. I suggest the hotel changes its policy to say subject to availability. We've already booked flights for next spring and have decided to book accommodation elsewhere. Shame really as one small detail for the hotel was a bigger deal to its customer.

author: paulineterryc
title: Great Stay
text: We had a two week holiday, August/September 2017 and enjoyed our stay at the Benidorm Plaza. We arrived late at night 'mid monsoon' but were met with a warm welcome by the friendly staff. We found all the staff, from reception, bar, restaurant, cleaners and the night security to be very courteous and helpful. Our room was pleasant, clean and the balcony had a sea view.
