The location of the hotel is just perfect, 5 minutes stroll from the beach and similar to the old town. We found the food to be very good and quite varied. Having read some of the reviews from other English tourists we can't quite understand how they came to their conclusions, why go to Spain if you don't want anything Spanish! Try staying at home!! The food catered for all tastes and even had the obligatory chicken nuggets and chips for those who really didn't want to try anything else. There was gluten free and diabetic options. The only negative thing we could say is that there wasn't access to 24 hour drinking water. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would like to thank Juan Miguel for his Spanish lessons and tourist information, and Pedro. Also Erika for her help and concern. We definitely will be back. Pauline & Terry Cowgill

author: Dinky999
title: Disappointing
text: We've stayed at the Plaza before but were very disappointed this time. When we opened the door of the room we were given we could smell strong cigarette smoke before we stepped into the room - the room absolutely stank of cigarettes. Not good for non-smokers. This should have been picked up by house keeping staff and the room should not have been offered to any one in this state. We went straight down to reception and luckily the lady was able to offer another room because we could not have spent one night in the first room. From the quick glimpse of the room, it also looked rather dated and was not a "nice" room, not like the "red" and "green" rooms. Even if the room had not smelt, we probably would have asked for another. Not a good start if you are tired and hot due to a delayed flight. Regarding the food, this time we found it very bland and often cold. If you were a bit late going down for breakfast some things, such as the sausages, had run out. We occasionally found this at dinner as well (in particular our first evening due to our later arrival). We love the location of the Plaza and the entertainment (or lack of it) has never bothered us as we prefer to go out and, as before, the staff were friendly and our second room was always cleaned and fresh linen and towels provided. Just such a shame that the start of our holiday. Not our first visit to the Plaza but probably our last. This was our most expensive trip here but the poorest value.

author: F7984FXbrianh
title: Lovely place to stay
text: Spent a week here at the end of March and could not have been happier. Room was exceptionally clean, and well maintained. Beds were comfortable. I liked that they'd listened to feedback and our room had tea and coffee making facilities in it, however, it would have been nice if these were refilled once you'd used them. Bathroom was equipped with shower, sink, wc and bidet. All immaculately clean. There was a notice about how to request new towels, and although we'd hung them up to use again, fresh towels were changed daily. Our bed was changed at least 3 times during our stay. Food was plentiful and suited all tastes when we went to the restaurant for breakfast and dinner. Waiting staff very friendly. Receptionists were extremely helpful, would offer advice for days out, and help you find your way around town. Hotel is situated very central, come out, turn left, over the bridge and you're in the old town and city centre. Couldn't be more central if you'd tried. 5 mins from beach, perfect location. I can't wait to visit again, and wouldn't hesitate booking in to this hotel again. Highly recommended.

author: 368JerryG
title: Fantastic as always!
text: We have just returned from another fantastic stay at the Hotel Benidorm Plaza. We arrived at lunchtime and check in was a doddle, together with a warm return welcome from the reception staff. Our room was on the fourth floor facing the main road which with the refurb of the hotel opposite and the festival preparations going on it was a little noisy this time. No great problem though and obviously nothing to do with the hotel. The food was excellent yet again and the restaurant team were friendly and helpful as usual. Great choice of hot and cold food including fish, pasta and a choice of hot dishes in the open kitchen counter. The steak and pork loin were delicious and I avoided eating chips all week! Breakfast offered a wide choice of hot and cold options including a full english breakfast from the buffet. Drinks are reasonably priced and the spirit measures are generous to say the least...oh my poor head! Entertainment every night and some good fun to be had watching the oldies strutting their stuff on the dance floor. Great fun. Plenty of tables and chairs outside as well as the covered pool which was lovely and warm. This area is kept very clean and tidy as well. The hotel is in the perfect location for a quick walk to the beach as well as the shops and bars of old town. Another perfect week and we can't wait to return again next year. Thank you for a lovely holiday. :)

author: V_S978
title: Disappointed
text: For a 4* hotel was expecting more. For money paid we would expect more. On check in a member of staff seemed to be quite bothered to do some work. Asked for double bed, got 2 singles. Even if you put them together they somehow slide apart. No possibility to at least lock them together somehow. Was staying in many hotels around Benidorm. Basic room service offer,rooms out dated. If nothing else they could at least repaint that greenish and yellow colour in rooms. Wi-fi is ok.While we stayed there it was unfortunately quite a few days with bad weather so we decided to stay in and watch a TV. Don't bother, it keeps buffer. And I have to say that a waiter( unfortunately forgot his name)who was looking after us through the whole week deserves a big thank you. After the second night he knew what kind off a drink we will have. Would really expect more from a 4*hotel. We won't be back.

author: 350cliffs
title: Delightful accomodation in a quiet but central location.
text: Very helpful and polite staff from Front of Desk, Dining Room, Entertainment to Chamber Maids. The bedrooms are spacious and clean and the bathroom has a good sized bath with overhead shower and plenty of hot water all times of the day. Good quality towels, shower gels, soaps etc. Individual Air conditioning Units that had quiet operation. A television with news and entertainment channels in English as well as channels in other European languages. A fridge big enough to hold 4 x 1.5 litre bottles of water and a safe that can be set to your own 4 digit code (cost 19 Euros with a 5 Euros refund at the end of hire term) Plenty of drawer and hanging space. The only niggle was that the beds were a bit on the firm side for our liking. View from the balcony was good with a table and 2 chairs to sit out and relax/chat. Our room was on the 11th Floor and was very quiet. There are 2 lifts in operation on our side of the hotel, which was adequate, only had to wait during the breakfast peak time. Food was plentiful with loads of choice for all palates, although some dishes were quite bland. I would rate the food as 'Good' and the service as 'Excellent'. There was entertainment on every evening and from what we saw, was aimed at and enjoyed by retired people. The hotel has a large covered swimming pool and lots of sunbeds, tables and parasols. with other high rise hotels in the area that provide shade at different times of the day, if full, all day sun is required, than it's a 5 to 10 minute walk to the beach. There is a pool bar, but some drink prices being over the top (A round of Brandy & Dry/Bacardi & Coke/Southern Comfort & Coke costing over 17 Euros) Location of the hotel is just a short walk from the old town and equally as short to the beach front. I can recommend staying at this hotel and deserves it's 4 Star rating.

author: /undefined
title: Great Hotel
text: Hotel in a great location, with everything in walking distance. On arrival room was not ready as we arrived at 11.30, no issue they took our bags and we went for a walk and drink or two. Booked in at 14.00 and straight in to the room. Bedroom was spacious, clean and plenty of storage, Great air com, and fridge. Bathroom had a walk in shower with 2 heads, very good space and very clean. Balcony was good space and clean. Swimming pool area was great, a high percentage of Spanish people so no beds being saved which was great. Bar staff could not do enough for you, put your hand up and they come and serve you with a smile and laugh. dining area was clean and bright, not sure why some people have moaned on reviews about food as there was plenty, hot and tasty. We eat too much, and we never waited at the self service/s. Location great for old town, and new town within 15 minute walk, 30 minute to the end of new town. Quite where the hotel was, but within minutes in the night and day life. Trying to think of an negative, but both my friend and i could not really find one. We did get locked out on the balcony first day, as no external handle, however shouted down and maintenance come and let us back in, it was so funny so no hardship and we never shut the door again whilst on the balcony. Overall excellent place to stay.

author: Tonybich
title: Great weeks holiday
text: First time at this hotel and thoroughly enjoyed an eight night stay. The weather was wonderful for this time of year. First impressions of the hotel didn't reflect how good the hotel was...the outside just needs a bit of a face lift to make it more appealing. Some nights the signage wasn't lit up. However once inside we found what a lovely hotel it was. The staff were excellent ...everyone was very helpful, polite and friendly including Reception ,dining room ,bar staff and house maids. We were particularly impressed with the friendliness of Dining room staff. The food was good...we enjoyed good English breakfasts which were always hot and fresh but there was also lots of other choices. Lunch was also very enjoyable but could have done with a little more variety to accompany the salads...hot meals were very good. Evening meals also were good with a good choice of food...although the desserts could do with a bit more variety but what was there was enjoyable. The accommodation inc rooms was very good...rooms were very clean. We could have done with the air con turning on in the room because the weather was so good for May but wasn't due until first of June....should be more flexible Pool area apart from small Solarium which we used each day didn't get the sun all day and the pool itself was covered while we were there....so this would be difficult for families...but ok for us as a couple. The location of the hotel made it for us as well... only 5 mins to the beach and Old Town. Overall very enjoyable ...will definitely go again.

author: Alsbaby4
title: Great short stay!
text: We arrived around 12 noon. We had asked for a lower floor as we are both not good with heights. We had been given the 7th ( which i suppose in Beni that is low lol) We asked could we change as it was too high and this was not a problem and we were given a room on the 3rd floor. Booking in was very fast and the man on reception was very polite. Off we goes to out room and it was pool side. Nice to have been given this request. The pool is covered, something i don't really understand as a lot of Benidorm hotels seem to have this, it was nice enough when you were in to cool down. We got a great deal with jet 2 holidays as to upgrade from B&B to half board was only 86p more each for the full 4 nights ( bargain!!) We really enjoyed the full english and was suprised to see black pudding on the menu ( i know we are heathens going to Spain and eating full english lol) We ate the evening meal once but we would rather eat out as we never really stayed in the hotel apart from sleeping there. The food was ok and something for everyone. And at 86p who cares if we didn't eat at dinner time. This hotel is nearer the old town i would say, and if you go out the hotel and turn left then first left down a little alley way you will find your way the beach no problem. Come out the hotel and turn right and then first right you will find plenty of bars and shops and a little walk down you are in the strip. Great hotel great staff. Would i stay again yes i would but the pool is not the best cos of it being covered. Review very late as went last yr but everything remembered well

author: lcg98
title: Brilliant Winter Sun stay
text: Stayed for 4 weeks in Jan/Feb and was delighted with this hotel, sourced through Trip Advisor reviews and David Urqhart Travel (Excellent travel company). Just close to the old town and mainly Spanish clientele suited us as far away from the worst excesses of the British part, although that was accessible by a 20 minute walk if you want that. Stayed half board as were out all day and found the food excellent, lovely varied salads, a variety of meat and fish dishes and plenty of fresh fruit. Breakfasts extensive, both continental and cooked- even pancakes for a few days round Shrove Tuesday! Lovely Gala night on Fridays with fantastic seafood, hotel decorated for Valentines week gave it a festive feel. Was able to change room with no problem as found the high floor too scary, fortunate as we were able to walk up the stairs to third floor as lifts are slow and can be busy. Had a lovely corner room so windows on two sides and a view of the sea, although these rooms have a connecting door (locked) with the next room so there could be some noise, but was not bothered unduly. Entertainment in three languages if you want that, but bird (feathered!) shows twice a week not to the British taste. Excellent wifi throughout the hotel. Chose this hotel for the swimming pool, as a keen swimmer, ideal for serious swimmers as covered and heated in the winter and a good size. A special mention must be made of the staff who were always charming, helpful and friendly, we really enjoyed talking to them. Parking is 10 E a night so we parked about 15 minutes walk away in a free zone(only in winter) but this wasn't a problem. We stayed to play golf - recommend Don Cayo Altea, Villatania, courses and Sierra Cortina and Las Rejas pitch and Putt. Also used car to visit Denia, Gaudalest, Moraira, Xalon, amongst other places - drive inland to the mountains if you can, behind Benidorm are the most spectacular mountains- you will not be disappointed. In Benidorm go to Mal Pas beach, small and sheltered from the wind out of season- good bars in the old town and plenty of tapas. February is carnival and we enjoyed taking part in the Burning of the Sardine festival! A great stay - thank you Benidorm Plaza, very much recommended for a Winter sun stay.

author: AnnetteH261
title: Staff & service were good but hotel was very basic for what we paid
text: This hotel is in the old town area of Benidorm We went for a family Christmas with my husband, elderly parents & teenage daughter but was not really what we were expecting to be honest. Staff were lovely, whether it be restaurant or reception or cleaning. The rooms were quite dated & we were on 15th floor even though we we booked about 8months ago. Only 2 lifts to the higher floors & at busy times it was a bit of a nightmare to get down the stairs There was a pool outside covered over for the cooler months we tried it it was freezing so we didn't last long ! The food was very average not what we were expecting, my husband named it school dinners very bland but edible! Not much 'live' cooking Christmas (Gala) diner was a bit disappointing to say the least. However there wee canapés on the terrace which was nice with waiter service & free drinks . We were expecting the usual Turkey etc but no it was pumpkin soup to start, seabass with spinach, then small piece of lamb & a small jacket potato, then a layered sponge cake with orange topping & ice cream . The wine was free & free flowing as were any drinks for kids etc & a glass of cava. The staff worked hard to build a nice atmosphere & it was a nice atmosphere in particular our waiter Sebastian was a star. Entertainment guy tried hard but it was a very old audience & mainly Spanish very few English which we don't mind it was more the age thing! There were hardly any children of any age It was line dancing , waltzing etc to organ music some bingo, parrot show & the only thing that was really suitable for us a couple of quizzes. The overall cleanliness was excellent cleaners in every day with regular towels & bedding , hairdryer was a bit weird & took ages to dry hair. If you are looking for a fun filled family holiday it's not for you however things may be different in the summer. It's definitely more suited to the older generation in December.

author: peterdE3219KQ
title: A Christmas Holiday with family
text: Our room on the 4th floor was well appointed but small. The cleaning and making up of it were very good. Overall the general decor and cleanliness of the hotel were very good. Reception staff were very helpful. There was reasonable and varied entertainment every night. It is an all year round hotel so there is heating when required. The bathroom towel airer was on all the time. The room radiators never came on as it was always warm anyway. We had a modern wetroom style shower which was far better than being over a bath. The swimming pool is designed to be used all year round. In winter it is covered and heated. Christmas dinner was very well organised and the staff worked hard to make it a good experience. The food was average and not very seasonal from a British point of view. There was a suitable good wine served with each course. Breakfast food and drink were OK but nothing out of the ordinary. . Evening meals were quite disappointing. The choice was poor and rarely to our taste.The sweets and savouries were stranglely displayed together on the same gondola. On the last night we and our family chose to go out to a restaurant as we were fed up with the lack of choice and sometimes the quality.

author: elainek437
title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel 14th-28th September. The hotel is right on the edge of the new and old town. Room fantastic we stayed on the 16th floor and we asked for a pool,view which we got - thank you. The room was lovely 18 euros gave you access to the fridge/mini bar which included all the contents. Juice, beer and water plus a tray for making ice for the 2 weeks we stayed. We tended to sunbath on the 8th floor as this always had sun as the pool area can be shaded and doesn't have sun all day. We were mostly on our own it was a nice quiet spot. The rooms were spotless and the maid serviced our room every day. The hotel was mostly Spanish, and why not!! This reflected on the food and we were full board. We don't like fish but there was always salad and pasta if you didn't like the mains on offer. Sweets were fantastic as was the fruit. I have to say the restaurant staff were particularly amazing and a big thank you to Elizabeth on the main door and to Tariq the waiter. They were incredibly pleasant. We had 2 gala nights where it was fish, fish and more fish beautifully presented but as I said that is not for us. All in all lovely hotel, fantastic staff especially in the restaurant and our stay was really good. 😉

author: caronh519
title: not too bad....
text: Just returned back from this hotel. I read reviews before going and was determined to mk my own opinion. Room - cleaned and spotless everyday. Our air con was on all day, even at night so not sure why others said theirs was switched off, couldnt fault all maids, excellent job. Restaurant - food was ok, something for everyone. Clean and waiters doing an excellent job also. Pool area- this completely let this hotel down. Covered pool???? The kids pool was the size of an bath and by no means could you call this a pool. Main pool was tiny for the size of hotel. Sunbeds were in shade but if you go up the stairs there are a few more beds but no umbrellas so no shade. Opp side of pool more beds upstairs but literally beds and nothing else. Our hotel was mainly full of spanish people, i have nothing against them but came to realise their manners are not what i am used to, no please or thankyou if you leave doors open etc....this also goes towards a female bar tender, rude towards me after asking for the correct drink, with that we had all drinks in plastic cups, unlike the spanish who had theirs in glass ones, doesnt taste quite same when you are having a warm beer. Other than the ignorant bar tender, think her name was glatz, evrryone was fine and happy to help. All this said i wouldnt stay here again as too many things let them down.

author: n0bby107
title: A good base.
text: Stayed here April 9th to 12th for a 50th Birthday celebration. Reception bright and airy , staff very helpful. Room on the small side but not cramped,Walk in shower (no bath), hair dyer ( not very good), soap ,shower gel provided also nice clean towels.Everything clean and decorated in a modern style.Beds very comfortable ( this may be due to amount of alcohol consumed).Also TV . air con, fridge and safe ( charge for the last two). Lifts very slow, we were on the 6th floor used stairs at busy times. If your on a high floor you may have a long wait at meal times. Restaurant large and bright. Food poor , all very bland. Beans and scrambled eggs at breakfast stone cold some mornings. Staff helpful and attentive. Hotel has mainly Spanish guests so the food is aimed more at there tastes ( although there is HP sauce at breakfast). The pool area is small but very sheltered and is a good sun trap, the pool itself is covered and pleasantly warm.If you travel in the summer months you may struggle to get a sun bed. The bar staff are very friendly,Pint of Amstel 3 euro (1 euro in resort). Entertainment on most nights consisting of live acts and quizzes ( didn,t stay in so cant comment). The Hotel is ideally situated close to to the Old Town, Levante beach and the strip with its myriad of bars, clubs, cafe,s and restaurants. Benidorm itself is a massive place, the bars are full all day and night and they cater for all ages and tastes ( dont think I,d come back with the kids though). Its a great place for a party and seems better now than it was in the 80,s. To summarize the hotel is clean with friendly staff but is only worth three stars. But if your in Benidorm for a party its a great base.

author: rodknight_home
title: Great Hotel - Bizzare Colour Schemes
text: Booked a week at the Benidorm Plaza with Jet2.com holidays for £610 at short notice. Generally a great value for money holiday. The only problem was flying from Leeds & Bradford Airport, the most disorganised dysfunctional airport you will ever pass through. On arrival don't be put off by the colour schemes both outside and internally. The design team were obviously overdosed on acid at the time. Generally the hotel was great. Only 3 colours in our bedroom but the room was spotless with a wet room style bathroom. All towels were changed daily. We couldn't fault it. Perhaps 80% of guests were Spanish as it was fiesta time. There was an abundance of food for both English and Spanish guests. The foods not going to win any gold stars but it was well cooked and plentiful. Waiters were great and friendly with a good wine list as well. The only downside was the sunbathing area which was shaded all morning by adjacent hotels. It was small and cramped. The covered pool was too warm. I've been in cooler saunas than this. In conclusion.... Give the place a try, you'll enjoy it.

author: Catlover_1958
title: Been here many times
text: Been to the Benidorm Plaza 16 times in as many years and the staff in the restaurant and bar are wonderful - so friendly and always remember you. The hotel changed hands last year - I think it had always been family owned until then. We always had a bottle of champagne and a card waiting for us in our room to acknowledge our custom but not on our last two visits. I'm not bothered about the champagne but it would be nice if the hotel still recognised us as regular customers - a card would be nice I agree with the comments about the decor of the hotel - some serious money needs to be spent on it. When we first visited in 1997 the tall block of rooms had just been built and were lovely. A couple of years ago the rooms in the smaller block were completely refurbished with walk in showers etc., but the rooms in the taller block were just 'tarted' up and are still a bit tatty in places. The food this year wasn't as good as last year - lamb cutlets used to be served more often and sole was a regular item on the menu. I was puzzled by the 'panga' fish that seems to have replaced this and googled it - to my horror I found out it is farmed in vietnam - come on Benidorm Plaza, do you really have to serve cheap stuff like this at the price you charge? Also what happened to the ice cream that you could scoop yourself? Those little cartons weren't very nice - again I feel you are using a cheaper option. The entertainment has always been poor - the hotel caters for mostly a Spanish clientele (which we like) so is bound to appeal to them. We go out a visit the tapas bars for a drink and just go back for the last drink. So, all in all bit disappointed with the way things are going. I can see Thomsons not doing this hotel in the near future. The question is - will the owners of the Benidorm Plaza care?

author: lydiaong7
title: Great location near to beach and old town
text: We stayed here and were surprised by the good array of food, fish, meat, prawns, serrano ham! and salads. We opted for full board as we were not that mobile. After a week, we didn't want to see anymore food! We were glad with the selection of fruit and we had freshly griddled meat cooked before us. The paella evening was the best with the chefs demonstrating and giving out recipes. Overall this hotel is clean and commendable. We were impressed with the quality of the bathroom and bedroom decor was modern as the foyer and reception was a bit dated for a 4 star rating! Waiters work like a machinery, very army like clearing plates, cutlery and taking drink orders. Did catch a chill though as the air cond wasn't able to swing. The best bit of this hotel is the location: what it says on the tin, 300m to the beach and 75m to the old town which helped save a bob on bus-ing around. We took 2 trips on Thomson, the blanket trip and the jeep safari. The bus stop is just a short walk from the hotel. We took the No. 10 bus to Althea about 25 mins journey which cost only E1.50 per person, with quaint shops, a hilltop church which was very ornate, and a lovely view to the Mediterranean sea. This was a good contrast to Benidorm centre, is a bit tacky with lots of shops with an array of shoe shops mainly made from China. I prefer the Spanish made shoes as they are better quality. The sea is brilliant at this time of the year, warm and clean and not surprisingly, awarded consecutively the blue flag. The beaches are fantastic and clean as well.

author: Paul247
title: Presently suprised
text: The Plaza is wonderfully situated for the old town & the promenade. The hotel is clean & comfortable, the hotel having recently had the bathrooms updated. The showers were very good.The rooms can be a little noisy but when not full the staff seem to spread people around the hotel so noise is kept to a minimum.The beds are a bit IKEA but the bedrooms are nicely updated & clean. The food is of a reasonable standard. The bar was nice although the entertainment was for an older audience. The drinks were reasonable & of a good quality. The swimming pool was warm. The staff were friendly & efficient. For the price this was good value. Tips:- Safe. To operate you need a key. You pay 19euros & receive 5 euros back on giving the key back. The safes are modern & huge. The air con in the winter isn't needed so use the plug point to recharge your phone by the bed side. The rooms aren't blessed with many sockets. The hairdryer cuts out after about 3 mins but does again come on after a while. Pros of hotel - Its updated, friendly staff, good position, nice & warm in winter & very good value. Showers very good. Cons of the hotel - Sound proofing isn't great Cons of the hotel - Rooms can be noisy.

author: Reviewingu2
title: Give it a try
text: We stayed in the Benidorm Plaza as the Victoria next door was fully booked. Don't be put off by the dated look of the exterior. It is actually very nice. The restaurant is located on the basement level and the bar is next to it. There is a large terrace area doenstairs and their is an outside bar for durring the day. The food was excellent except whn they did a mexican night. No comlaint but i don't eat mexican. The gala dinner on Friday night was good. The entertainment is ok with a different act each night. The location is the good. Five minutes from the old town. The rooms are dated in a way bit again nothing to complain about. The beds and storage space is good with access to a fridge. There is also free wifi in the hotel. There are nspapers for sale from reception in the morning. Overall not a bad stay and restaurwnt staff friendly. We would stay the aain and we are fussy. Enjoy

author: champagneboys
title: Very pleasant stay
text: First thing we noticed was how trendy the hotel looked from the outside. The result of a refit in 2011. Reception staff efficient and friendly. We were given room 212, over looking the pool. The room was clean, bathroom had all facilities you would need, no bath, but that did not bother us. There was a safe in the wardrobe, which you had to purchase a key from reception to use. Our room was not large, but the beds were comfortable, lots of hangers in both wardrobes. It was cleaned daily and towels changes as often as you liked. Restaurant was clean, staff friendly and the food was good. Yes, a lot of spanish stay at the hotel, but we have always found that that is a good thing, as they will not accept second best. The swimming pool is covered and yes the sun does not hit the pool area very much, due to the high buildings surrounding it, but you know this before you book, so cannot see why people make all the fuss on Tripadvisor about it. Look before you book is our motto. The hotel provided nightly entertainment and although we did not stay for it, it seemed to be of a good standard. Hotel is in a good location for the beach and if you turn left out of the hotel and keep walking in a straight line you will come to the main street which runs through the old town. We had read terrible things about Benidorm in the past and it was refreshing to see that much of what had been written was not a reality. Yes, you get groups of people, but you get that anywhere. In general we found the resort to be welcoming, clean and would return.

author: davidh781
title: Superb hotel
text: Stayed for 3 days in September, 2011. Booked via Thomson as that was cheaper than booking with the hotel itself. We had deluxe rooms at the front of the hotel and it was very quiet - no noise. The older rooms at the rear of the hotel overlook the pool and entertainment area and could be noisy up to midnight when the music stops. The rooms and public areas are very clean and well maintained. The food was very very good with choice of English or Spanish food. There was always something suitable and the quality was very good. The staff were very helpful. The only downside was that we travelled from our home in Spain and the car parking in the area is very limited. We got a car parking space in the hotel itself but that was 15 euros a day but still cheaper than the nearby car parks. The evening entertainment was nothing to write home about and the price of drinks was a little on the high side. That said you are only 5 minutes walk to the old town with its many bars etc. The location of this hotel is what sold it to us being very close to the old town and Levante beach. Overall a very pleasurable visit. So much so we are going back again this month.

author: brianj714
title: very poor hotel
text: We had paid to have a private bath and when we went to our room it was only a shower. Went to reception and the man gave me a vacant stare. I waited a few momwents to see what he was going to do. He immediatley started a long telephone conversation whilst I stood there. When he came off the telephone he then proceeded to talk to a local man. During this time the young lady on reception was dealing with other guests whilst I was stil there. I was completely ignored. The man on reception then told me there was no rooms with a bath available.He said I could try and come back the next day. Needless to say I didnt return!!!! This hoitel is mainly for the Spanish with the food and entertainment geared to their tastes.The bar staff and restaurant staff our excellent. One thing to be careful about is taking drinks into or out of the dining room. If you still have wine in your glass after completeing your meal you are not allowed to take it outside. If you want to take a drink into the dining room you are not allowed. We were treated like common criminals when my wife proceed to takje her half glas of wine out after luch. The receptionist in the dining room banged on the window to tell us to bring it back. Overall this was not the type of hotel we will return to. This was our third time at this hotel .

author: lkbharris
title: The good and the bad
text: The positives of this hotel: Staff very nice. Very accommodating to keep our frozen food in their freezer. Have one 2 room suite on first floor. Pet friendly. Medium size fridge and microwave in the room. The negatives of this hotel: Found out that the 2 room suite was closed due to plumbing issues while we were on our way there. There is only one 2 room suite. Was given a room with wet carpet, which had been cleaned that day. Found this out after we had moved to a second room, and it was wet too. The entire 3rd floor had been done with no other rooms available on another floor. Right next to the airport so LOTS of airplane take offs and landings. Noisy! Other pet friendly hotels where we have stayed, you couldn’t tell they were pet friendly. This one you could. Scratch marks on bottom of bathroom doors where dogs had tried to get out. In desperate need of a sign asking pet owners to pick up their dogs waste as there was poop everywhere on grass surrounding the hotel. Providing bags would be nice too. Definitely do not recommend this place unless you have to stay right by the Mobile airport and have a pet.

author: 312krish
title: Great breakfast.
text: We arrived late and the parking lot was full. We eventually found a spot. We checked in with Jarred. It was clear he was busy but he was very easy going. The person in line before us told us it sold out and hoped we had reservations. Fortunately we did. We were checked in quickly and got pool towels. Pool was nice but there were some smokers out there so we didn’t stay long. Some guys were smoking pot in the parking lot. Our room was beautiful and clean. We like the two queen and couch but when we asked for an extra blanket they were out. It smells like dog a bit but I guess that is what you get when you stay at a pet friendly hotel. It wasn’t bad. Breakfast was incredible. Eggs, bacon, grits, potatoes, oatmeal, biscuits and gravy and lots of coffee and juice choices. Yum. Great way to start the day. Breakfast staff was attentive and everyone was so nice.

author: 611valb
title: Not Impressed
text: My children and I came into town to visit a very ill relative. We arrived on a Monday afternoon and had 2 rooms. The girl at the counter tried to be sweet but didn't seem like she understood what she was doing. When I asked if the rooms were adjoining she looked at me like I had 2 heads! The rooms were clean. But, the next morning my sons in the other room found out their shower did not work and the heat was not working throughout the night. I went to the front counter and was told it'd be checked on. In the meantime the boys had to shower in OUR room which put 4 people showering and getting ready in one room. When I went to check out I was given about 20.00 off one room and $5.00 off another. Their excuse... "the rooms haven't been used in awhile. Thanks for letting us know". Really?????? That's the best you can do? I will never stay there again. Ever. And, they do NOT have vending machines!!!! You have to buy drinks from the front counter and they're $2.00! Ridiculous.

author: pattipippen
title: Never disappointed with this hotel
text: My husband and I make a yearly trip to Mobile to see family, and this is our hotel of choice. The staff is incredibly friendly. The rooms are clean. The housekeeping staff do a great job. The beds are firm but comfortable. It's quiet. Pets are welcome. They have a free, hot breakfast. What more could you want? I have to point out two very friendly and helpful front desk people, however. Dawn and Kourtney. Very nice, great customer service and very helpful. They definitely go out of their way to make you feel welcome. I do have a couple of suggestions.....a do it yourself waffle maker at the breakfast station. That would be awesome!!!!! Also, Community coffee with chicory. Just a thought :).

author: 132leea
title: Huge Room / Whirlpool Needs Replacing / 75% ADA Friendly
text: Stayed here for 3 nights while attending a Wedding. Great: Large, clean room and friendly staff. Not so great: I recommend replacing the Whirlpool in Room 103. The Whirlpool is obviously older, including two different styles of handles for Hot / Cold Water. The jet nozzles were discolored by age. The Whirlpool Jets were weak when the tub was filled with water.... On a Scale of 1-10, with 10 being Best, I would rate them a 3; I could barely feel them operating. Special Note: I do Volunteer Work with Wounded Veterans. Room 103 was 75% ADA Friendly. Currently, if a person in a wheelchair wanted to use the Tub / Shower in the Bathroom, the door swings out next to the Hallway door, making it difficult for someone in a Wheelchair to *easily* navigate into the Bathroom. I tested the shower with the fold down seat in place. Currently, the best someone on the bench would be able to do is wash their legs and feet. The water stream does not hit the bench. Also, the fold down seat is too far away for someone to reach the water control and it's impossible to reach or adjust the shower head. Please go the additional 25% to make the room 100% ADA Friendly by: 1) Reversing the swing direction of Bathroom door to better accommodate Wheelchair Access 2) Add an adjustable shower head in Bathroom Tub 3) Reposition the fold down bench in Bathroom Tub closer to the water control

author: guest922015
title: Great Staff
text: First off, my husband and I decided to stay here for our honeymoon in order to avoid congested roads, restaurants, and child-infested hotels and condominiums closer to the beaches (The hotel is about an hour from Dauphin Island and two hours from Gulf Shores). It's a quick hop onto the highway to get to Downtown Mobile for all of the museums and great food. The staff at the hotel was absolutely excellent- from the cleaning ladies, the front desk staff, and the management. We stayed a full week, so we saw the staff on a daily basis, for an extended period of time. The room was clean and the hotel overall was in great condition. Any needs were met promptly by the staff.The breakfast was good- we had to wait a few times for them to restock a few breakfast items but we were eating last minute and they were quick to replenish. The coffee in the lobby was hot and ready all day- even through the late night hours. The two minor problems we encountered were: 1) The front staff's knowledge of local amenities and attractions was lacking (we asked about local coffee shops and mini golf- we were told there were none, but we found these places anyway after driving around and doing a Google search). 2) The dogs were everywhere! I have a dog, and I love animals, but there were so many dogs in the lobby, in the hallways... At one point a dog supposedly hopped onto the second-floor elevator by itself, and made it into the lobby where it preceded to run loose. The lady behind the desk managed to corral it quickly and take it outside while the owners took their sweet time retrieving their pet. Overall, despite the two problems, the stay was excellent! The staff alone makes it worth the stay. We will be back.

author: lindalC2887NE
title: Not so great
text: We were on vacation from 9/7 to 9/27 and stayed at various La Quinta Inns around the country. We were very disappointed with this stay. It was the most expensive of them all (I tried to book directly but had to go on line to get the best price which still was not great). Upon our arrival, we were given bottom floor as requested. Upon entering the room, we noticed a strong cigarette odor masked by spray. I informed the clerk immediately so we were not blamed (as they made a point of having me initial the non smoking policy). We were traveling with two dogs and a lot of stuff, so decided to make the best of it. Later on we realized that this room had been smoked in a lot (even though they are claiming 100% smoke free). It was especially bad in the bathroom. By this time, we were unpacked and not wanting to move. Later on, found out there was no working "struck by lightening a while back) and were not able to provide another one. Had to live with this too. At three am awoken with sound of very loud voices (dog was awoken too) and no one told them to quiet down. Since I had no phone in the room, could not even call the front desk to complain. Very disappointed--great La Quinta in Fort Meyers Florida, better price and top notch. Breakfast, not great either. Ended up at McDonalds.

author: Aupaka
title: Good Value, Internet Issues
text: I have stayed here a few times and it is a good quality hotel at a great price. I am used to staying at higher priced/higher quality hotels but I was very comfortable with this hotel. The staff is usually helpful and the rooms are in good condition. Each room has a small refrigerator and a microwave. The air conditioning worked well. They have a happy hour some nights between 5pm and 7pm. There is not much within a block or two but there is a Walmart within a mile or so as well as some restaurants and fast food chains. (5 Guys, Hooters, Firehouse Subs, Ruby Tuesday, etc). Easy access to the highway. The one issue I have experienced every time is that the internet is very slow in the afternoon/evenings. My last trip there, I measured the speed just so I knew what the reality was vs my perception. At a good time you will get 1.5 to 2 Mbps which is very usable. In the afternoon and evenings, I was getting between 200 Kbps and 20 Kbps. You should be able to get email but if you want to Skype or get on a web conference at night, you probably will be out of luck. Movies are out of the question. They have a laundry room but there is only one washer and one dryer. The workout room has a weight machine, a treadmill and an elliptical machine. All in all it is still a good value. I will be back in Mobile a number of times over the next 3 months. I will probably look for something similar in value with better internet but if I can't find that, I would consider staying here again.

author: disneyrunners
title: So-so stay
text: We were on our way back home to Texas from Disney World. So we were looking forward to this stop. This hotel was hard to find. The directions were great, but when we got to the turn, the road we were to turn onto look rather dubious, with a really run down motel on it, plus either there was no sign or we just were so tired we didn't see it. Had to go to another hotel to ask for directions. Check in was smooth, room looked out onto the parking where we could see our car. Beds were okay, pillows were lumpy, knotty, linens were not the best. Air conditioner worked really well. But what bothered me was that I had forgotten to bring in flip-flops to wear in room. After my shower, I looked at the bottom of my feet after walking across the room, and they were dirty. The carpet does need to be shampooed, badly. Ladies at the breakfast weren't that friendly, but it was early. The breakfast was usual, the breakfast meat was not good. Eggs, biscuits, fruit, cereal, milk. I think there was waffles, but we didn't have any. Sorry, but I would not stop at this hotel. There really aren't any restaurants that are close by. There may have been some, but by this time we didn't want to drive very far. Ended up going to Taco Bell.

author: JCDunnigan
title: Elevator out
text: Had the elevator been working, I think we would have had a better stay, but as it was out due to a lightning strike, it wasn't great. When we arrived the hotel was quiet. The lobby receptionist informed us that the elevator was out, so we would be in a room at the end of the hall on the first floor (118). There is an outer door by the room which was great for unloading/loading our luggage. However, we didn't think there were additional guests upstairs as the room is also across from the stairwell. Come 6am we were woke up by the stairwell door slamming, the outer door slamming, and a barking dog that needed to go out. There was more door slamming and at 7:30 another dog that wouldn't stop barking. At that point we gave up trying to sleep in. Breakfast had a nice selection, but beware of the waffle maker. It sticks badly and there was no cooking spray or oil, only oil-free conditioner. Last i knew, that wasn't the same thing. The biscuits were burnt and the sausage patty had a chemical taste. After breakfast, the hotel was quiet again, but we were already up by that point. The room was nice, but the road noise from the interstate was rather loud compared to other hotels I've stayed out. I don't think we'll be back.

author: makwa55
title: Not good value for the money
text: Stopped here because a few days earlier we stayed at a different La Quinta and were extremely pleased. What a difference! This La Quinta cost considerably more than the previous one and nowhere near as nice with fewer amenities to boot! the front desk was efficient but unfriendly and indifferent. I was disappointed to hear they did not have movies to rent in the rooms, but I can understand this as many hotels do not. But not even HBO or similar movie channel? Com'on, even the economy priced (which this certainly is not) hotels can muster up a couple HBO channels. If you're like me and do not sleep well during the wee hours of the night you won't have anything to watch except boring infomercials (or listen to barking dogs). The exercise room did not look nearly as nice as the previous La Quinta - and I didn't see a guest laundry room although I did not inquire about it - they may have one. I understand allowing pets at the hotel and can forgive a few dogs barking in the rooms, and there were plenty all night long - but why not keep them grouped together (or at least on the same floor)? To wear socks in our room and have them completely covered with dog hair after a couple minutes is just plain gross! Very busy carpeting in halls but can still see that it needs cleaning - lots of stains. The best thing about the stay at this motel was their breakfast and watching Wanda care for it. Her work ethic and sunny attitude made a great start to the day. She did a wonderful job of keeping all breakfast items stocked and fresh - she is to be commended! Best biscuits and grits I've had at a hotel breakfast-

author: MsBark
title: Enjoyable stay
text: We stayed here for a 3 day weekend trip. It was easy to find and close to many things. The front desk was friendly and we were given a room on the second floor. We got to the room and it reeked of smoke. We went back to the front desk told them of the problem and was given another room on the same floor. This one was fine. For a family of 4 we had plenty of room and the beds were very comfortable. My only minor complaint with the room would be the bathroom. There were only 3 towels, 2 small bars of soap and a small bottle of shampoo. I have noticed the trend on the bathroom items lately so have a tendency to carry my own lotion, shampoo and conditioner. On the first night we got more towels from the front desk. By the next day the cleaning people took all towels regardless if they were hanging up to be reused, clean folded on the counter or lying on the floor. We were again left with 3 towels which meant another trip to the front desk. The kids loved the breakfast. There were waffles, cereal, muffins, bagels, donuts, and oatmeal every morning along with a different hot breakfast buffet everyday. One day was make your own burrito with sausage, eggs, flour tortillas. Another day was biscuits, eggs, gravy and bacon. The breakfast lady was super nice and always made sure there was plenty of food out for everyone. The seating area is small so by Saturday some people were having to take their food back to their rooms as there were no more places to sit. Overall, we would stay here again if we are back in the area.

author: TishaD_13
title: Stinky!
text: We chose this hotel for a quick overnight trip. I checked tripadvisor and it seemed to have good reviews. The hotel is nice looking from the exterior, and the lobby was warm and nicely decorated. When we checked in, we were given a room on the 3rd floor, room 300. When the elevator opened on the 3rd floor you could really smell the cigarette smell. I guess the 3rd floor was a smoking floor at some point in the past?! Upon entering the room, we were overwhelmed with an obnoxious and disgusting odor. It was stinky cigarette smoke mixed with chemicals smell. It reminded me of a bar room on Bourbon Street. Our eyes and noses were stinging almost instantly. We have small children so I knew this would not work. I immediately called the front desk and the nice girl who answered moved us to another room on the same floor, room 325, and gave us an upgrade to a "suite." This room smelled less terrible, but the carpet had a slippery/oily film on it. We were slipping and sliding with our shoes on. It was late and we were tired, so we chose to stay. We opened the sofa bed only to find a bare mattress and broken springs which made one corner touch the ground. It looked like it came out of a frat house. I tried to use the phone on the nightstand to call for linens for the sofa bed but the phone was not connected to the wall, and was completely missing its cord. Once we got the linens one of the two fitted sheets had a large unidentifiable black stain on it?! In addition, the bath tub was dirty (had hair in it), the shower curtain was torn, and the pillow cases were put on inside out. Very upsetting night!

author: reploglemk
title: Good stay - one minor flaw
text: This was our second stay at a La Quinta. We needed a place to stay with out animals and the first night of our move from Maryland to Texas via NC was a very pleasant surprise. The Tillman's Corner location is a bit tricky to find - you can see it from the highway but we "lost" it once we exited, and the locals didn't seem to know where it was. However once we found it, it was very easy and close to many things. We were a bit frazzled from the hunt after a long day with the animals but the desk clerk was so pleasant and accommodating that we relaxed. She informed us that the hotel has been 100% non-smoking since the end of summer and she even switched our room for us without being asked when my husband explained his sensitivity to smoke. The only negative of our stay was someone used the toilet at some point and didn't flush or clean the seat. That upset my husband a bit but otherwise the rest of the stay was good. The bed was comfortable; there was ample space for the beagle bed and breakfast was very good. The walls can be a bit thin at times but there were no obnoxious guests so it was no worse than most of hotels we have visited. (I hope the girls basketball team won their game) Breakfast was very good. Sarah the attendant, was very pleasant and helpful; my husband enjoyed chatting with her as well eating as the food. On our stay there were grits, waffles, pastries, cereal, eggs, sausage gravy, biscuits and yogurt. My husband was thrilled. Checkout was smooth. Again a good experience for our second stay at a La Quinta. We will return if in the area and definitely use La Quinta again with or without our pets. Being pet friendly is wonderful and having guests with well mannered pets is also great.

author: /undefined
title: Will not stay again
text: I ordered a queen suite which as described is to include a sofa sleeper. I was traveling with a group of friends attending a conference and we needed the extra bed space so, we thought a sofa sleeper would be great and would meet our needs. Well, we got up to our room and discovered that it is ONLY a sofa NOT a sleeper. Tried to sleep on sofa, but 1. it was too short and 2. VERY uncomfortable as the cushions sunk all the way down practically to the floor. I ENDED UP SLEEPING ON THE FLOOR...NOT OKAY!! There were five ladies in the room...what were we to do...three on a bed? I don't think so. Then, we had left our room for about an hour and returned to find in the bathroom that the hand soaps had been opened, the shower had been used as the tub was wet and there was pee on the toilet cover. Seriously!! We had not used ANY of those things. We called down to the front desk and were simply told "we don't know how that is possible". We aren't sure how this happened BUT it did. Also, all of the ladies in our group said that there was a distinct odor to the halls and the elevator and it was not pleasant by any stretch. The worker at the desk when I checked in was very friendly and when I checked out the lady was very friendly. I did not mention the sleeper situation seeing as how when we called the first time nothing was really accomplished so, I figured why bother. I will not stay at this hotel again. Sorry LaQuinta....but this was very disappointing. If you advertise a room to have a sleeper sofa then that is exactly what you should have.

author: buuger
title: Very Pleased and will recommend to friends/family
text: First off, we love LaQuinta Inns. We try to stay at them whenever we travel, and this trip wehave driven from Columbia SC to Mobile Al. a 3 day trip, and this is our 3rd LQ! This property is fairly new and still smells of the construction. It is a very roomy property, and is VERY PET FRIENDLY! We travel with a shepherd puppy, and he loved it here. The rooms are very nice with all upgraded admenities. I've had no issues with fleas or anyother bugs for that matter. They have a small grocery center at the front desk where they have different snacks and drinks. This place is awesome and I will return when in the area. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Housekeeping has done their jobs well also. Thanks to the manager and the staff that made our stay a pleasant one. This makes traveling a good experience and not a chore! Thank you...:)

author: Gayle880
title: OK stay
text: We stayed here on our way to and from North Carolina. When I made reservations three weeks prior, I called and asked for 2 rooms with 2 double beds. I called again the week before we left to make sure that we had the 2 rooms, each with 2 double beds. I was told that we were confirmed. When we got there, we had 2 suites with one king bed in each one and a very uncomfortable fold out couch. We were told that they were fully booked so they would not be able to help us with the double room problem. The person at the front desk was very nice but we were annoyed that we had been assured of the double rooms only to get rooms with one bed. We were also charged a suite rate rather than the lower double room rate. I asked them to please make sure that we had 2 double rooms the following week when we returned. The next week we came back and did have the double rooms but one of the rooms had a big wet spot on one of the beds. It looked like water had been spilled. We called and they came in to change the sheets. They were going to leave the damp comforter on and we had to request that they please change that as well. I also found a Little Ceasar's Ranch Dressing (unopened, thank goodness) on the floor by one of the beds. The staff is very nice and helpful, but the stay was just average.

author: pecten56
title: Friendly Staff, Clean & Comfortable
text: Located just a few minutes outside Mobile, Alabama, this hotel is a great place to stay if youi are going to be visiting Bellingrath Gardens! When I arrived the friendly desk clerk had my reservation and I was checked-in quickly. My room on the third floor was spotlessly clean and comfortable. The bed was neatly made and comfortable, the bathroom was clean with marble countertops and a nice shower massage. The room had a desk, and chair, a sitting area with chair, lamp and coffee table, a mini frig, microwave and a coffee maker. I was meeting friends here and we found the staff to be very friendly and helpful. Anything you asked they tried to accomodate you. The internet service was great and easy to log-on to. I have only a few complaints about this place. The desk chair in my room was very uncomfortable. I didn't sit in in more than once or twice. I found it more comfortable to bring my laptop to the other chair and sit in front of the coffee table. Also, most hotels have a few complimentary toiletries in the bathroom. This one only had shampoo. The free continental breakfast was not great, but adequate. There was a decent amount of selection, some fruit and yogurt was avaiable in addition to the eggs and sausage and biscuits. The staff working there was kind and very helpful and the dining room was comfortable. All in all I had a great experience at this hotel and would recommend it to others who are coming to Bellingrath Gardens as a great bargain for you money and a good location next to a number of eating establishments and Interstate 10.

author: bluuuskies
title: Excellent Service!
text: We stayed here two different times in April 2011. Both times was a great experience. We traveled with 3 kids and a dog. We were greeted upon arrival. Everyone was very friendly. When we went to have breakfast in the morning, Sara, took great care of us and made my kids extra special hot chocolate. She also makes really good biscuits and gravy!! We enjoyed our first stay there so much we stayed there again on our way home. Our second stay was just as pleasant. The only problem we had was the water pressure was very low for a few moments. Not a big deal. Again, Sara remembered us from a few weeks before and had more hot chocolate for my boys! Thanks Sara!! It can be hard traveling with kids. You made our trip extra special.

author: slc55
title: Very nice hotel, but...
text: The hotel is lovely. It still has a very new feeling. Everything was clean. Sparkling, actually. The room was huge. The beds were comfortable. The breakfast was terrific and everyone who worked there was very helpful. The only thing I want other travelers to know is that this hotel apparently allows smoking in some rooms and even though we were in a non-smoking room, we could occasionally smell cigarette smoke in the room. If you have any type of breathing problems, I would recommend that you NOT stay here. The only other negative we found at the hotel, which we have found with other new hotels, is that we could hear the people upstairs walking around their room. I don't remember ever experiencing this with older hotels, but this is the second "new" hotel where we have heard the upstairs neighbors. All that being said, the cost of the room was very reasonable and we all slept and ate well, so we will probably return if in the area. One last thing... After we arrived we did not want to go out to eat, so we asked at the desk about places that delivered. I can't remember the name of the place, but it was recommended by the person at the desk. He said the meals were home cooked. After being on the road for days, it was nice to eat something healthy - we had salads - and have it delivered. Definitely ask at the desk for information if you find yourself there and wanting dinner delivered.

author: dkorwood
title: Mardi Gras magic
text: We stayed here because of the great TripAdvisor reviews. You were right, this LaQuinta was excellent. No price hike for Mardi Gras and no extra fee for my 100 lb dog. We could not have been more pleased. The staff are friendly. Beds and pillows were comfortable. Flat screen TV with Drect TV service. Breakfast was plentiful and there was a variety of hot foods and cold foods. We really like the early check-in time (1pm) and appreciated that we were allowed to check-in at noon so we could get our pet settled before a 2pm parade. We signed a waiver to pay for any damages if our pet made any and agreed they would call us on our cell if he started to disturb others while we were gone. Neither happened, as he was quite pleased with his stay. He met some new friends in the lobby and while out for his walk. I think they put the pet people on the first floor and this is great! We heard an occassional bark or whine but we didn't feel disturbed at all. There is a guest coin laundry on the first floor. Easy on/off I-10. Plenty of places the eat close by. Close to Bellingrath Gardens.

author: Houston_TX_Dad
title: Nice, new, clean hotel, convenient location
text: We stayed here on our way back to Houston from Disney. The hotel, as other reviewers have stated is brand new, and as you would expect, the rooms and public areas are very nice. We had two adults and three kids in a double room with fold-out couch. It was perfect for what we needed, a clean comfortable room on a stop-over from a long drive. The room was clean and spacious, and the beds were very comfortable. The complimentary breakfast was good, and the buffet was well stocked with eggs, sausage and bacon, a variety of cereals and pastries, toast, bagels, and make-your-own waffles. The staff were friendly and helpful with directions. We planned to catch a Mobile Bay Bears minor league ball game, and the front desk clerk was quick to provide a map and directions to Hank Aaron Stadium. The hotel is convenient to I-10 if you are just passing through, but a little far from town if you plan to do anything else while you're there. We visited the USS Alabama while there and had to backtrack almost 15 miles on I-10. Unfortunately, there were a couple of black marks to mar an otherwise excellent experience. One of the towels in the bathroom was stained, and appeared as though it might have been left from the previous guest. It was replaced quickly with an apology. Also, as other reviewers have stated, we found food left in the mini refrigerator from a previous guest. I hate to jump to conclusions from one visit, but based on our experience and other reviews this is something they need to address with the housekeeping staff. Aside from these two slip ups, our stay was great. We'd stay there on our next trip though Mobile.

author: kferrell1
title: clean and nice for just passing thru
text: Hotel is NEW, clean and nice. Convienent to I-10W. Got great rate from LQ website and discount using sams card. The pool is small, but comfortable for just cooling off after a long day. The hotel NEEDS to get a rug for the enterance from pool side into hotel. It was drizzling and I walked into hotel. Slipped on floor and busted my knee. Went to tell desk clerk but she was on the phone and wouldn't get off. That was the only negative thing to say about this hotel. Room was clean and I thought it was very comparable to the Hampton Inns that I usually stay inn. Had nice bedding and new furniture. Bathroom had curved shower rod, and marble countertops. Only provided bar of soap and shampoo. No lotion or shower caps that Hamptons would usually provide. Breakfast bar was make your own waffles, dry cereal, fruit, toast, yogurt and pasteries.

author: donjackw1
title: Professional, gracious personnel, very nice room
text: I wrote a previous review and put in the star rating wrong. This is truly a 4-5 star motel with the personnel being 5* plus. The location is close to I 10 thus convenient, yet it is very quiet in the rooms. A new La Quinta nearby (20 miles east) got some poor ratings due to sound issues between rooms and water pipes, etc. We never heard a sound in many days there on two different occasions and this motel charged approx. $30 less per night than the other new one which was closer to our destination. There are now some good casual restaurants nearby and the area is truly a motel area. The grounds are kept totally clean so no doggy problems. The rooms (two stays) were perfectly clean and no sign that pets had ever been there. We have two dogs but still hate the idea of pet residue for lack of a better word. The outgassing of the new carpet with NO windows that open can be solved completely by leaving the bathroom fan on. I am very allergic and this worked out well. Breakfast is nicely done. This motel is now finished and very, very comfortable and an excellent value. Happy travels

author: deeperblue82
title: Excellent little hideaway!
text: Stayed here for four nights as a base for tour of the sights and sites. Up a road from the main square in modern Pompei. External gate to get through and then check in. Spotlessly clean room (we had rooms on top floor). Two beds, one big double (my daughters) and I slept on the Sofa Bed in the living room. Air con worked well (required as temp was high 30s during the time I stayed). Room is cleaned every day. Wifi took a while to get going but was fast when it did and enabled us to stream Youtube etc. Breakfast was good...continental with as much tea and coffee as you liked. Lovely views across lemon and orange groves to mountains. Owners were very helpful and organised a taxi to Naples airport at 8am the day of our departure. Breakfast is served from 8am so they prepared breakfast at 7:45am just to accommodate us! Taxi was €70 but worth every cent to avoid the train in the morning... Very good and will recommend to all those wanting to stay in Pompei. Tips: Use the Amphitheatre entrance to get in to Pompeii, a shorter doable walk from BNB and less queues. The tourist office near this entrance also offer minibus trips to Herculenium and audio guides etc (you must have ID to leave as security). Pizza Pasta on the square is very good and reasonable as long as you don't buy lots of beers. There is a small supermarket very close to the BNB for anything you might need. The BNB is quite a walk from the main Pompeii entrance (by railway station) so if you arrive there from Naples, get a cab if you can (people will be dropped off by cabs). We walked with hand luggage and were roasted alive!

author: ChasInLucca
title: Unhappy ending....
text: Generally, we were pleased with Certe Notti. They did not bother to tell us which of the two train stations in Pompeii were the closest to their B & B. Naturally, we got off at the wrong one and had an expensive taxi ride. What truly disappointed us was after we left. About the time our train left Pompeii and we changed trains in Napoli for Rome, we realized out son had left the battery charger for his camera in the hotel room. I immediately called Certe Notti and the very nice lady informed us that they had found the charger and would be happy to mail it to our home address in Lucca, Italy. I told her I would be happy to reimburse her the cost of postage. The charger was critical to us as my son's camera is an older model and you can no longer buy the batteries or the charger; we left one of each at Certe Notti. We were thrilled at her eagerness to please us and to mail the package to us. I confirm with an email containing our address and confirming that I would reimburse the postage. I never received a response to that email or to any of the other three I sent. We patiently waited three weeks for the battery charger before purchasing my son a new camera. The worst part is that he missed three weeks of picture taking. Yes, it is our fault that we left the charger at the hotel. But, had the manager said she could not find it or was unwilling to mail it to us, we would have purchased a new camera immediately and not miss three weeks of photo taking! Very disappointed. Charles

author: dinj
title: Loved this place and the hosts were very nice
text: This was a great experience. The room is really a spacious suite - large bedroom, living room (with a telescope, which I would have loved to get to use, but didn't have time to ask), and large bathroom (with a window, unlike most hotels). Well-furnished, clean. The location was also very good - walking distance to the ruins. The street leading up is nothing to rave about, but it did not put a damper on our stay. We were able to park and the hosts helped us maneuver into the parking - a bit tricky turning in there from the street through the gate. The hosts were helpful and very nice. When they emailed me to ask our arrival time, I told them and mentioned that I eat lots of fruits and veggies for breakfast, and sardines, hoping there would be something like that, as we don't eat cheeses or meats. The hostess brought me a can of sardines both mornings for breakfast - special for me. I don't know if she thought I was weird, but she was as pleasant as could be about it and I appreciated the accommodation. I do have a few suggestions for improvement: real juice for breakfast, rather than a sugared juice drink, some hooks for towels on the back of the bathroom door (there was just one hook for a bath towel right near the tub), and a shower that can be hung. The water pressure was low. And it is a shame that the host, when welcoming us with all sorts of useful info, did not tell us that there is a switch we have to switch on for the A/C to work. It was too late for me to call him to get help with that, so only on the second night could we use the A/C. But all of these are minor points. The place was a delight to stay in. The spaciousness and lovely decor were a pleasure.

author: null
title: Thanks Antonio and Ione!
text: Antonio and Ione were more than helpful to help make my five days in Pompeii stress-free and enjoyable as possible. I went there alone, as I was interested in seeing the ruins. While I did end up seeing the ruins on a very cold day, I was followed by a man around the ruins and ended up in tears. Please, if you are going to Pompeii in the off-season, please be aware there are not many tourists around and it's not a real "tourist city" like Rome or Florence. Boy was I glad to be reunited with my boyfriend in Venice shortly after! Anyway, please do not miss out on this BNB...go with somebody, or drag them there! (I couldn't get my boyfriend there :( ). It's one of the most charming bed and breakfast's I've ever stayed in, and my apartment was huge (yes, my room was apartment sized and has a living room!). The television had cable, the rooms were clean, the bed was cosy...and Antonio even put a generator on for me when I was relaxing one afternoon and the council decided to turn off the power for maintenance...I couldn't believe his hospitality! He even gave me a USB modem because the internet was down...I was so very impressed!! I also loved Romeo, the dog, he is so very friendly and I never heard him bark! Also, Antonio escorted me to the train station one early morning when I was leaving for Naples, I can't thank him enough for that. I felt much safer in Naples due to the fact there are people around, and spent two of my five days there. There are regular trains there running every half hour. It's also worth checking out: the media does it no justice, it's a really interesting city. Grazie Mille, Antonio and Ione for a pleasant stay! I felt very safe when I was within the walls of Certe Notti! :D

author: 2manydogs
title: Safe, clean, helpful
text: You get off the Cirumvesuvia train and walk down this horrible noisy street and think this is the worst mistake of your life, but then you walk into the nice courtyard and check in. The rooms are all fresh, clean looking IKEA and the bathroom was the most generously and conveniently furnished I have ever experienced. There is a nice balcony and peaceful view. There is tv in the room and limited wifi. My room was right next to the breakfast room so I went out in my nightgown to send photos pretty often, but I wouldn't count on wifi otherwise. There is a supermarket next door and I stocked up on salami, cheese, biscuits, and bruscetta to take on my hike into the scavi. There are fountains within the site to refill your wate bottle. If you plan to redeem an ArteCard pass, you will need to go around to the main entrance. Breakfast is delightful and includes both fiber, carbs, and protein. There is a delicious pastry created every morning and left for you to enjoy later in the day. The hosts are extremely kind and generous of spirit. Great big Romeo was a salve to my spirit while I was missing my own dogs. This was a great location to explore Pompei, Ercolano, and Oplantis. I had planned to visit another site (Boscerali), but was warned off but the host here and feel grateful that I was able to avoid discomfort. I walked down to the city square in the evenings and enjoyed the company very much. Even with my very limited language skills people were friendly and eager to talk.

author: thomashN6293DX
title: Lovely B&B.
text: Stayed here one night of our two week trip through Italy. What a lovely little place. It felt more like we were staying with a family than a hotel. I have to say, after spending several nights around Italy in B&B's, Inns, Seminaries...I wish the States had more of these kinds of establishments. Anyway...back to the review. We had 2 rooms, one for my husband and I, one for my mother in law and daughter. They had a nice mini suite, with 2 rooms, we had a large room with a queen sized bed. All was clean, modern and comfortable. The breakfast area opened up from the second floor and felt like part of the rooms, the breakfast was typical Italian, and very nice. There is a very small gated parking area, which we used, no charge. The rooms are on the second floor (well up one flight of stairs), and their was no elevator that I could see. So be forewarned if this is a problem. Very friendly dog just hangs around, very nice. I doubt we would go back to Pompeii, since we have now seen it...but if we did would stay here again. This was our best price of hotels for our entire trip.

author: thumper460
title: No Place was BETTER in 10 days of travel in Italy!
text: Go to Naples!! Gotta see Naples.. This is what we have been told. BUT!! DONT GET A ROOM IN Naples!! Make a reservation for " Certe Notti" in Pompeii !! When you arrive you are meet at the door by a big ole friendly Golden Retriever!! The rooms are the best. Comfortable to the highest degree... towels are SOFT!! ( those traveling know what MOST towels are like!!) AC/ WiFi.. awesome breakfast.. and the best part are the owners. The will take care of all your needs, from where to eat the best local Italian foods, the train ride into Naples and where to find the museums. Short cuts that just the locals know... way above ANY placed we have stayed on this Holiday ( Venice/Rome/Pompeii ) I suggest to see Naples.. however do it from Pompeii and the " Certe Notti" !! A nice 30 min train ride into and OUT of all the hustle and bussel.. to the highly Italian Town of Pompeii. Thanks..

author: h0llygreen
title: A lovely place to stay for visiting Campania
text: I was worried that I would not find Certe Notti as good as all the reviews I had read, but I should have trusted them. It was worthy of all the praise it has had. I spent 3 nights there with my 11 year old son on an educational visit to Pompeii and Herculaneum. I had requested separate beds if possible in a comment box on the website booking form and was not disappointed. We had a sitting room with a folding bed and a double room with balcony, all very comfortable, spacious and beautifully clean . We travelled by bus and train from Naples airport to Pompei Sanctuary via the Circumvesuviana line, which was an easy 10 minute walk from Certe Notti. Antonio and Ione (owners) were very upset that we had not rung and asked for a lift from the station. I intended to arrange a lift back early on our departure day but failed to organise it with them the night before. I should not have been so reserved about disturbing them as again, when I emailed from home to make sure they had found the keys we left, they were most upset that I had not arranged an early breakfast and a lift . So my advice is to make sure you ask as they are very willing to do anything to help. On arrival they will give you a cup of tea and go over the places of interest in the area and how best to visit them We should have arranged to spend longer as there was so much more to see. The train line is very easy to get access to the whole area, although it is important to use the Pompeii Sanctuary station for travelling with your luggage as the other station (Pompeii Scavi) is quite a lot further to walk but does seem to have faster trains (one we caught home from Herculaneum did not stop at so many stations). The supermarket next door is ideal to buy food to eat in your room if you are too tired to go out and to get food to take a packed lunch with you. Everyone in Pompei was so friendly and helpful. All in all don't look any further for accomodation, I can not imagine why you would stay anywhere else in the area!

author: Stormykiwis
title: The only place to consider!
text: If you are planning on staying in Pompei, there is only one place you need to consider - Certe Notti! Nowhere else in Pompei will you find such a warm & welcoming atmosphere. Certe Notti is situated close to the town & train station ( easy access to Naples/Sorrento/Ercolano) and within easy walking distance of the ruins. Right next door is a superette with everything you need to prepare a delicious picnic for a day out. The rooms at Certe Notti are spacious, modern and airy, and thanks to the lovely Angela they are spotlessly clean! With balconies at the front and back of the rooms there was always somewhere pleasant to sit and enjoy the sun. ( and watch our daughter play with Romeo! ) The wifi connection worked well and we had a well stocked mini bar. The breakfast provided was always delicious and varied, often with homemade goodies baked by Ione herself. Their cappuccino is definately the best in town! When Toni & Ione heard that out daughter is on a gluten free diet they immediately offered to provide a special breakfast for her. Antonio, Ione, Angela ( & Romeo) made our stay extra special, they made us feel like family and were always more than happy to help with anything we needed, Antonio always took the time to make sure we knew how to get around and provided us with detailed maps and schedules and gave us ideas of things to see & do and good places to eat. They are the warmest people you could wish to meet and we now consider them as friends. We could not possibly write a review of Certe Notti and not mention Romeo - what a sweet and beautiful dog. It was always lovely to come "home" each day and see him waiting on the stairs. He kept our 8 yr old daughter entertained for hours! We highly recommend Certe Notti to anyone, you really will not find a more pleasant & welcoming place to stay anywhere in Pompei. Antonio, Ione Angela & Romeo - we miss you!

author: Nunkey
