I will list here the pros and cons regarding the resort: Pros: - Amazing location you have breathtaking views, private beach which is probably the nicest in the entire island, and activities. - The private beach is beautiful, very warm water 28C during April, clean and turquoise. - One plus that we thought of was the activities, they have kayaks, snorkeling gear, paddle boards, frisbees, soccer balls, volleyball net all on the beach ready for you to just grab and go with assistance at every step (paddle board will he walked over to water for you and the staff help you out with everything) - the villa was beautiful - private pool, rooms are big and comfortable and obviously clean. - food at hotel was great they have Thai cuisine, Peruvian, Mediterranean and they were all excellent. - we did not try the breakfast buffet as it was quite expensive and both my wife and I couldn’t eat that much we ended up just ordering breakfast to the room every morning at a reasonable price. - pool is big and very nice, drinks by pool are great, views are amazing I can go on and on but you guys get the point. Cons: - this resort is basically on a hill in a lush environment and mostly natural environment. That being said if you are scared of bugs or lizards then this resort is prob not for you (probably Koh Samui in general because they are everywhere and prob located at every hotel). - we had a tiny lizard in our room when we came back to the room. Not a big deal you just call the concierge and they take care of it. But still I can see some people turned off by this (city people). - one thing I would recommend to the hotel is have tighter closure on the doors. There are tiny holes and crevasses where insects and other things can come in to the room. I would highly recommend staying here if you can afford it. You definitely get what you pay at this resort and I highly recommend it. You basically do not need to leave the resort.

author: hawrig
title: Fairytale Honeymoon Destination!!!
text: We had a great start to the Four Seasons Koh Samui experience by being picked up via their Mercedes S-Class limousine service from the airport. The drive takes around 30 minutes and you experience some scenic views of the island. Upon arrival to the resort, we were greeted by the resort manager, Jeff, and a photo was taken at the highest point of the resort as a way of welcome. After finishing the check in procedure, we were transferred down to our wonderful via a buggy. I can highly recommend the Deluxe 1 bedroom pool villas, where we were surprised with a complimentary bottle of Thai Champagne delivered to our door. The staff were very friendly and happy to help which made our stay even more comfortable. A Four Seasons mobile app allows you to communicate with the staff without having to leave your location within the resort. The resort has nice dining experiences, Steak Night in particular was one of the best nights accompanied by some fine tasting wine. CoCorum is recommended especially for a morning/daytime relaxation by the private beach, where you can enjoy refreshments and beverages from the nearby bar. Tip for those planning to stay at Four Seasons Koh Samui, be sure to eat the banana chips and amazing fresh cocktails made by the bar staff. The spa and salon were very professional too. They helped us pamper up before a private photoshoot with the resorts recommended photographer Max. Complimentary tea upon arrival and a very enjoyable Thai massage hidden within the many trees of the resort, allowing you maximum privacy. The staff organise daily events to accommodate for all age groups. I would highly recommend this resort to everyone visiting the beautiful island of Koh Samui. Stay 29th December till 6th January.

author: Love-to-travelOttawa
title: Absolutely incredible!
text: My husband and I recently spent 5 nights at the resort and were blown away by the experience. From the moment we arrived until the moment we left, we had nothing but positive experiences here. The property is stunning. There are incredible views everywhere you look. This is the first property that I have been to that I have felt the need to take pictures and video of the accommodations, restaurants and lobbies! The food was excellent. I have a number of allergies (fish, seafood and gluten) so traveling to Asia always makes me nervous. From day one all of the restaurant staff knew my allergies. At our first meal on the property the chef came out to speak with me and told me how they could make my food. There were plenty of gluten-free options. I especially loved the variety of GF foods offered at the breakfast buffet. The options changed daily and they were all fantastic. The staff is over the top helpful. They always had a smile on their faces and went out of their way to help. I miss them all! We loved spending time at our villa pool and at the beach. You can’t help but feel peaceful and rested at this property. We can’t wait to go back!

author: Journey607006
title: Honeymoon in December
text: This resort is absolutely incredible. The staff is very kind and will help you with anything you need. My wife and and I had never stayed at a Four Seasons resort before so we may be overly impressed compared to some return customers. But, the standard for service is absolutely unmatched! Positives/Examples of Service: -The airline lost my luggage and the team at the resort handled all communication and worked to get our bags (which had been lost in China) back as soon as possible -My wife was sick for a day or two from traveling and every team member we met would ask how she was feeling and if they could get her anything to make her more comfortable -We felt that almost everyone at the resort took the time to learn our names and to remember little details about us a couple. They even offered complimentary farewell drinks on our last day and multiple team members went out of their way to say goodbye to us on the last day of our stay. -The management team would regularly stop to chat with us and were genuinely interested in who we were and how our stay was going -Facilities are very clean and well kept. We read multiple reviews that mentioned mosquitoes as a negative, but this is a lush tropical island so you have to expect some insects. We were surprised by how little we actually noticed the insects and this was largely due to the efforts of the resort team (providing personal and resort wide insect repellents). Constructive Criticism -The only observation we made was that the food at the restaurants was much better in person, than when ordered to the room. This is likely due to the fact that the resort is so spread out and it takes time to get the food to your villa. I realize room service is never going to be as good as eating in the actual restaurant but we noticed a difference enough that we stopped ordering to the room. Tips/Advice -The weather in December was actually very good for the most part. However, if you are using the i-phone weather apps they are completely inaccurate. Wind guru was the recommended site from some FS team members and we found this to be decently accurate. -If you are traveling in a month that is not known for consistently great weather, email excursion groups prior to your trip. If the weather is windy or stormy it can prevent some of the boat based excursions or significantly reduce the days of availability. This can cause you to miss out on booking events -Book through a preferred travel agency to get upgrade perks

author: KailashR
title: Start the year with a Four Season’s Brunch’
text: No other brunch anywhere can match this!!! This should be on the ‘ bucket list’. We did not have the privilege of staying in this magnificent property! What an amazing set up. Beautiful! Excellent set up and great spread! The Oysters, lobster, Sashimi make a great starter with fresh side salad. I had a slice of beef ( medium rare) to die for! The lamb chops and Rissoto ( magic!). I had a white chocolate mousse petals ..... All with a Pino Grio!! A double espresso to close it all. The live music great and one guest joined in to play a great rock piece and electronics guitar. The GM offered that we stay for a sunset drink! No better day for a Jan 1!!! With wife and two young adults......Happy New Year 2018.

author: Nikhil2610
title: One of the best property of Four Seasons!!!
text: It was my Birthday celebration weekend and we choose Four Seasons Koh Samui as our destination. I had a memorable Birthday and this was only possible because of the outstanding hospitality of the team. We are regular guests at Four Seasons and this was the best property that we have ever stayed. The rooms are spacious and beautifully designed to provide complete privacy to its guests. The view from the room was mesmerising. The breakfast was lavish and scrumptious keeping with farm to table concept. The pastry chef should be appreciated for his excellent creations! The service team was extremely friendly, attentive and helpful. At Four Seasons Koh Samui, we had our best breakfast till date. We also enjoyed the food at the various restaurants around the property. We were really impressed with the team, who always had a welcoming smile along with personal touch. The "Secret Garden Spa" provides its guest a slice of tranquility from the hustle and bustle of everyday routine. The treatments are well designed with extensive use of natural products. Thank you for making this a memorable stay for us! We hope to visit here again.

author: Nourr_h
title: Dreamy!
text: We spent the first 3 days of our honeymoon there. It's a place very hard to leave. - Super clean resort and rooms. - The beauty of the resort is beyond amazing. Wherever you look, you see nature, beautiful coconut trees and a pure blue beach. - The villas are big enough with a beautiful bathroom area. The bed is very comfortable. The outdoor area is also big enough. If you stay at the beach pool villa, the pool will be bigger than the normal pool villa. - Very friendly staff and professionnal service. They are always smiling and they spread positiveness. This resort has an application specially made for room services. You can send them a simple chat and you'll get your service within 5 mins. Buggies are always available and they usually arrive fast. - Different restaurants and lounges are available in the resort. The food is great. The breakfast/dinner area has an amazing panoramic view. - The spa was great and the staff was very nice. - The prices are quite high (spa, restaurants, lounges, everything you order will be expensive). Our overall experience was perfect and would recommend this resort for anyone looking for a beautiful and relaxing place.

author: PCCUK
title: Absolute Paradise - Perfect Wedding and Honeymoon Location!
text: This hotel is on a whole new level and was the perfect place for us to get married and stay for our honeymoon earlier this year. We decided that we wanted to get married in Thailand and after visiting the resort in 2016 we knew we'd found the perfect location. The best way to describe this hotel is a "5 Star Plus Luxury Resort within a Manicured Jungle!" The resort itself is absolutely stunning, within a thick palm tree forest with lush vegetation leading down to a beautiful private beach. Each room is an individual villa and feels very private and secluded. The rooms are very well appointed, the bed is ridiculously comfy and with a private pool and terrace - there's no need to leave your villa! The staff are unbelievable and offer a service that so far has been completely unrivalled. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming and made us feel at home. Each member of staff seems to know your name, even if they haven't met you before! Ram the Resort Manager took special care of us and our parents and was so warm and kind it felt like chatting to an old friend. The food is sensational! There is an abundance of choice at breakfast and the restaurants and themed food evenings mean that you never have to leave the resort for a change of food. For anyone looking to get married in Thailand, then this is the place! Our wedding coordinator Worawan was incredible and made planning a wedding from the UK an absolute breeze. She thought of everything and made sure that we were completely relaxed and ready for our big day. Our wedding itself was incredible and from our guests' point of view, the food and the service were second to none. This was reflected throughout our stay and made our experience so memorable. During our wedding, we even had our own appointed member of staff looking after us - Mas - who was so on the ball and made sure we had everything we needed. He even straightened out the train of my dress at the top of the aisle! Overall, we had the most amazing experience and will certainly be returning next year!

author: WFerg2016
title: Lovely resort, limited beach access
text: I have to admit I was disappointed. Four Seasons is a smart resort and the service is second to none. The rooms are large and they have literally thought of everything you might need toiletry wise and stock it daily (toothpaste, mosquito repellant, after sun and so on). They also offer a service whereby you select the type of topper and pillows you'd like in your room (memory foam, feather and so forth) which is very cool. The food is also very good and you barely have to walk a meter before you're whisked away in a gold buggy to another area of the hotel. However, when you go away on a vastly expensive tropical holiday, when you boil it all down, there are only a few things you absolutely want. A beautiful beach and pool, a comfortable room and good food. On the surface, Four Seasons has all of these things and more. It's not until you actually get down to the beach and want to cool off in the sea that you realise you can't. The entire beach is covered in coral and sea urchins. To cool off, you need to take a kayak and paddle out to the dive platform 80 odd meters away. We did do that a couple of times, but really, it's just not ideal. It's too far, too hot and once you've cooled off, you then get hot all over again paddling back to shore. Consequently, we thought we'd hang out at the pool. A beautiful exceptionally long infinity pool and bar. It's nice (if you can switch off from the incessant beat of the vocal-less music they insist on playing) but not so nice on the 4 days where they had construction going on. We complained and the manager was lovely and really did pull out all the stops to make sure we could have a pleasant day elsewhere. We were all very appreciative and don't get me wrong this is a beautiful beautiful place. But will I return? No.

author: charlotteg898
title: Beautiful resort, wonderful staff, shame about the mosquitoes
text: My first view of the resort at check-in brought a tear to my eye, it was so beautiful. We stayed for 15 nights in a family villa over the Easter break. The resort is stunning, the staff exceptional and the room, facilities, food etc., were all top notch. I have known for 30 years that I have an allergy to mosquito bites so I always travel well prepared & take lots of precautions. I have been all over the world & sadly, this was my worst experience to date. Despite all measures, by day 2, I had upwards of 30 large, very ugly, welts. The hotel staff couldn't do enough. they installed a screen to the room entrance (although this should probably be standard in all rooms), fogged the room & the garden and provided lots of extra spray etc. I had to stop eating outside but room service indoors was quite a challenge as the villas are totally set up for outdoor living/dining. A trip to the mini-bar (also outside) involved strategic planning. Had I been the only one affected, I don't think I would post in such strong terms. However, my poor husband was also really badly affected & at the mid-way point had more than 200 bites all over his body (I wish I was exaggerating). At this point, we asked to move villa, in he hope that a different location within the resort might help. However, there was no availability as the resort was fully booked. We were offered a move 3 days before the end of our trip but decided against it as, by then, we had just resigned ourselves to staying completely indoors. Mosquitoes are a big issue at this resort and the hotel staff do everything they can to alleviate the problem. I asked my travel agent about mosquitoes before we booked and he reassured me that they were under control. I am posting here to let others know that no, the mosquitoes are NOT under control at this resort. I hate writing a negative review as the team in the hotel is wonderful & everyone works really hard to provide excellent service. We appreciated the many kindnesses we received but sadly, will not return.

author: 655liams
title: Beyond Wonderful
text: My family and I recently had the most unforgettable 7 nights stay at the Four Seasons. Everything was perfect from arrival to departure. We were spoilt beyond belief. The staff were all so friendly and helpful. When we first arrived Miss Ying Qi met us with a cold welcoming drink and a warm smile. I have 7 year old twins. They could not get enough of the kids club. The staff there were incredible. Unfortunately I did not get all their names, however my children constantly mentioned Miss Belle, Pookie, Nan and Kan. The hotel's General Manager, Jeff Rednour, constantly mingled with guests to ensure all were being looked after. It's that personal touch which made this trip so special. I highly recommend the hotel's boat trip to the nearby marine park. It was well worth the cost. The gym was excellent was a good selection of free weights and machines with the most unbelievable view. I even tried the Muay Thai. My family and I can't wait to return.

author: sueaV5481NE
title: This hotel may be what heaven is like!
text: My husband and I wrapped up a trip to Thailand with 3 nights at this hotel. This hotel is a bit remote - it took about 45 minutes from the airport to get to it. There are no restaurants or stores nearby, so you are pretty dependent on using their restaurants and activities. However, the real question is : why would you want to leave?? The hotel is made up of individual villas, situated on a hill. The placement of the villas is such that you have total privacy. You can not see anyone from your room. As for the room - stunning! Each room is very large, with a huge bathroom and dressing area. The real treat tho is the private plunge pool attached to your villa. You can cool off in the lovely pool, have a drink on your terrace and stare at the beautiful view of the ocean. There are several restaurants on property serving a variety of food. At the main restaurant, a beautiful buffet breakfast is served each day until 11am, so there's no need to rush to get up each morning. We ate at CoCo Rum one night and it was quite good, as well as the Koh Thai restaurant. The service is exactly what you'd expect from the Four Seasons, friendly but unobtrusive, always remembering your name. We did not take advantage of any of the spa services, but we did utilize the free water activities on the beach. This is truly what hotel perfection is about.

author: 20oscar16
title: Fantastic hotel
text: I've stayed in 3 resorts in Koh Samui over recent years (Banyan Tree, Six Senses and FS) and this was by far the best. It's also more expensive than the others, but I think worth the extra money (if you're looking at these locations you're already spending an absurd amount as it is). Pros: The villas are beautiful - FS always does a good job of incorporating the local culture into their design, and the layout, amenities and pool at the villa are all first rate. Banyan Tree also has amazing villas, but they could be anywhere - there's little sense of being in Thailand vs., say, Bali. The common areas are completely over the top. The gym is up on a peak with a truly amazing view, the restaurant and lounge also make the best of the topography. It's a really amazing piece of property, and FS uses it well. The beach is protected and private, and is far better than the beaches at comparable hotels. It's very good for families with small children. The Banyan Tree beach can be very rough depending on the time of year, and the Six Senses beach (while very beautiful) is not as private. Food was excellent, as it tends to be at FS resorts. Service also was excellent. The staff is well-trained and balances being helpful with letting guests relax very well. Cons: Not many to speak of. It's a quiet place - the kind of resort where you're more likely to stay in your villa or go to the beach than to meet people or spend a lot of timne at the bar. If you're looking for a more social scene the Six Senses is better - they have a few interesting places to grab a drink, and the bar there is more upbeat. Overall, an amazing hotel and piece of property. I had no real complaints, which is expected given the high prices. But I would definitely return.

author: Seapig18
title: Not the best FS resort
text: We stayed for 5 days around early Feb. A lot of Mainland China guests due to Chinese New Year holiday but this is something you cannot avoid. As others commented, villa (we stayed in family villa) we stayed is well maintained and very spacious. Buggy service is efficient and staff are all friendly. Food quality is ok and price is expected for a 5 stars four season hotel. I tried Thai massage which is very professional with excellent service. Here are some areas which I found that the resort can do better, in particular the kids club: Staff at the Kids Club are not proactive at all. During our visit not many kids were found in the TreeHouse. At least 2-3 staff were there and some of them just sat there and do nothing (or talk among themselves). When I went there with my son, no warm welcome was received and the staff even not choose to talk to us at all. Second, in view of the humid and hot weather of the island, there is no fan or air-conditioning in the Treehouse, my son got sweating and mosquito bites after spent an hour there. Third, we love the very comprehensive programmes offered by the kids club, especially the Thai Boxing for kids. However, the staff will not strictly follow the programme if there is not enough kids to participate, and they do not offer any alternative programmes if outdoor activities at Beach House are not available due to rainy days. Housekeeping service is efficient and our villa is very clean. However, one day morning after we woke up, we found a big cockroach in our villa. We called housekeeping and they immediately came to clean up our villa. I believe that pest control can be do better to avoid such unpleasant suprise.

author: malvarezds
title: Postcard views
text: We originally booked our stay on the island at the Intercontinental. But the photos on their website were so deceiving. We arrived and were extremely disappointed after having just been at the Four Seasons in Chiang Mai. So we decided to throw away the money we had paid at the Interncontinental, and immediately book the next few nights at the Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui. Best decision ever. The property is gorgeous. We were greeted in their lobby with a welcome drink and taken to our gorgeous villa with a view of the entire property. The Room was spacious and beautifully decorated with its own pool and deck area. The attention to detail is superb: golf cart transportation to the differente areas of the hotel, complimentary coconut baths set up in your spacious bathroom (advance notice of 2 hours needed), concierge visit you at different times to see if you would like to participate in any of the events the hotel has organized for its guests. We booked a class of Muay Thai in their own sports/gym area. The boxing ring overlooks the ocean, and has a professional Muay Thai Fighter as the instructor. Fantastic! Don't leave the resort, there's not much to see in town... the tour they offer of the Thai Islands by boat is an incredible experience and they pick you up from the resort's beach. They were renovating the pool at that time, but it should be done by now. We are looking forward to visitng again for our 5 year anniversary!

author: cdjvj
title: Exceptional views, exceptional management
text: The Four Seasons Koh Samui, was one of nine hotels that we visited during a month long trip to Asia around the holidays/New Year 2016. We loved it so much that we are returning for Christmas 2017 season. Upon arrival, we were greeted by Jeff Rednour, the resort's GM and then shown to our very lovely room #306 by a kind woman named Beau. As others have mentioned, the views, from the moment that you arrive and walk through the doors for check in, are breathtaking. The rooms are beautifully appointed and spacious, with large decks and plunge pools. The food on property was amazing - from the delicious breakfast each morning, to the special Bounty of Thailand meal that takes place at KOH on Thursday nights, to lunches and dinners at Pla Pla, to the over the top amazing buffet that was served on New Years Eve on the beach (including Maine lobsters that were flown in for the occasion). The facilities are also quite lovely - I had a great massage at the spa (thank you Pla!), there is a muay thai ring (where I believe yoga also takes place) and there is a great recreational area down near the beach called the Beach House that has a pool table, air hockey and table tennis. The water is clear and great to swim in and the beach is gorgeous although I REALLY, REALLY hope that an adult only section can be added or sectioned off in the near future. I found that other guests did not seem to think there was anything wrong with their children sitting at the foot of my lounge chair flipping sand around. This is obviously not the hotel's fault, but, could easily be avoided if an adult section was carved out - just a thought :). This is the one, very minor opportunity that I feel would make this resort near perfect in my eyes. As many others have mentioned, the staff at this resort is exceptional. Mohammed, the outlets manager, was so friendly and helpful as were Jeff and Rem who clearly work so hard to make every guest feel at home. It is very special, and I have never seen another GM that is as visible, present and approachable as Jeff. We so look forward to returning and seeing all of these wonderful people once again.

author: lumierette
title: Paradise
text: Husband and I were in Ko Samui for our friend's Stag & Hen's party. We decided to stay at the Four Seasons at the end of our 10 day stay on the island. We have stayed at some amazing hotels and resorts but nothing, NOTHING compares to our stay at the Four Seasons. It was absolute heaven. We stayed in Villa 300 which is conveniently located in the middle of the resort, you could walk down to the beach or up to the restaurant for breakfast (though I wouldn't walk up from the beach, too far). The villa is SO beautiful and the pool is lovely. The service is amazing, we came back from dinner to find all the charger cords for our electronics tidied and rolled up! The beach is just gorgeous, the water clean and warm. I did some stand-up paddle boarding which was very fun. The main pool is lovely and the service at the bar was fabulous. The food was amazing (especially those breakfasts), though I didn't enjoy the food at the Thai restaurant quite so much. On the Monday night we did the Thai Wine Tasting experience which I highly recommend, it is hosted by the hotel Sommelier who was wonderful and the wines were surprisingly good! We met a lovely couple (Hi Steve and Catherine!) at the tasting and had lots of fun with them at the bar. The only negatives would be that its a little awkward being on a steep hillside and having to order buggies to get around but you get used to it pretty quickly. The food and drinks are expensive but that is the expectation for a five star resort. Our stay was just amazing and I didn't want to leave. In fact, I'm already trying to plan a return visit. Highly recommend.

author: HongKongTrojan
title: Perfect trip back to paradise
text: This was the third time we stayed in this resort. What I miss was their service, Thai food and wagyu beef burger, these things always bring me back here. Compared to five years ago, this resort did a lot of enhancement on their facilities. The new pool renovation and pool side restaurant and kids club .... Back then this resort was quiet and every staffs can recognise their guest name. But this return trip I found there were a lot of kids and family guest staying here. Food quality was still good and the wagyu beef burger and Thai food still the best in Thailand. But down side was the breakfast not as good as before especially the pastry ,may be too many guests now. I decided not to go breakfast after first two days. We tried their paella night, so pity that wasn't good tough. The waitress was so attentive to waive our charge. The only one thing that I like to recommend is they should offer pillow menu and blanket choice. I could not have a good sleeping quality because their pillows were too soft without any support. The down blanket were way too hot for room temperature 20c. I requested to change a thinner one. The blanket was too uncomfortable. The housekeeping did a perfect job, I felt like having an angel to tidy my room everyday after breakfast and dinner. It was perfect.

author: X8230SGfrancos
title: This Place Will Be Tough to Beat
text: What's there not to like about this beautiful resort? The villa was amazing space: perfectly maintained, large and comfortable. The bathroom area was as large, if not larger than the bedroom. Large sliding doors leading from the bathroom and bedroom onto a covered deck and private infinity pool make you want to never leave those areas. The design of the resort is quite clever: each of the villas is built into the hillside, affording spectacular views of both the resort's lush vegetation and the water. The main infinity pool was even more impressive and was located right on the beach. Plenty of comfortable furniture was every where to be found: the beach, the main pool and common areas outside the restaurants. Our breakfast was enjoyed every morning at Koh with high elevation views of the water and the resort. The charming general manager took time every morning to speak to us at breakfast. The food was outstanding and the service was even better. Our daughter enjoyed the kids club almost every day of the week. Plenty of fun projects for the children and flexibility in joining the activities throughout the day. An electric car could be summoned at a moments notice to take you anywhere in the resort you needed (the beach, the pool, breakfast). We chose in villa dining almost every night. The serving staff was quite impressive: they set a full table outdoors (on the deck) or indoors at our request each evening for our dinner. The number one thing I could say about this place is the staff is beyond exceptional and works very hard. Do not miss an opportunity to visit this wonderful place.

author: Angelina709
title: Fantastic Resort
text: This is an amazing resort in the middle of a rainforest. The villas, restaurants and the environment were all great. The staff were incredible good. From the first moment we checked in, they started to greet us with our names. Very nice team and we loved their very friendly, very personal and very polite attitude. Breakfasts were so delicious. The Thai restaurant has a limited menu but was very classy. They have good wines and it is somehow exceptional in Thailand. The villa was so chic and also was so comfortable. The private pool was quite large. The pool, the pool-bar and the beach facilities were all very good. But a few negative things, if I may mention since nothing is perfect: 1) The hotel is in the middle of jungle, it has a fantastic environment but inevitably there are some mosquitos around. Be prepared. 2) The beach and the beach facilities are amazing but the sea itself is not that good. There are a lot of small rocks and it is so shallow. So do not expect a Mediterranean type of sea to swim.

author: Klyphic
title: Minor Affair
text: There are few other tropical island resort on earth that could contest tete-a-tete with the Four Seasons Koh Samui and come out without feeling slightly inadequate. From your drive (via taxi or hotel limousine) up to the rustic teak doors, and your first gasp of air (likely from the 'welcome view' behind those doors)... you are transported to a different world. Because the hotel is a true 'retreat', it's perfect for guests (like me) who don't really need to leave. Soak in the view, ride the buggy around meticulously designed gardens (originated by Bill Bensley), explore the classes, maybe try the spa... and enjoy a white private beach before sunset. If you do need to move around, the hotel will book taxis or provide the hotel's car when available (for a fee). Remember that there's somewhat of a Taxi Mafia in Samui, expect prices to be vastly different from Bangkok. Food: This is a Four Seasons, you can have exactly what you feel like. Take a sample from the menu, and then ask the staff or chef if there's something they may recommend. I felt like grilled cuttlefish with nothing but seafood sauce and got exactly that, off-menu. For that instance, it was divine. For something extra: On certain occasions, the hotel's private yacht (The Minor Affair) is available for rent. You can have a private meal or book the boat for a sea-faring tour. Personal chef, butler and crew are included, of course.

author: JennyOS_mcr
title: Perfect Honeymoon Location
text: We had high expectations on FS Koh Samui and we were not disappointed. From start to finish the resort and the staff who work there were excellent and made the second leg of our honeymoon incredible. The villa we were in (1 bed villa) was beautiful and the pool and sun loungers got sun all day (I had read that some were constantly in the shade but this wasn't the case with ours). The vila was clean and the bed was huge and so comfy. Although we had people next to us we would never have known as it was so private. There were loads of bits in the villa such as the usual shampoo/conditioner/shower gel etc (which you would expect from a 5* resort) but there was also aftersun, bluetooth speakers for the whole villa, fresh fruit every day and a well stocked (but VERY expensive) mini bar. We did the Muay Thai boxing class which was great, in fact the hotel organised for an extra class to be put on just for us as we arrived the day before and by this point it was booked up, which was so good of them and not expected once they had told us the class was fully booked. We also did a cooking class which was brilliant and we came away looking forward to trying the recipes in our own home. Breakfast had tonnes of choice and chefs there ready to make off-menu items or different kinds of eggs. We ate our evening meals in the hotel a couple of times and the food was good. The location of the resort is amazing and we didn't see anything else to rival it on the many excursions we took throughout the week, the scenery is stunning and we never tired of sitting outside and admiring the view. However the one downside on the location is that nothing outside of the resort is within walking distance and we had to take cabs everywhere, which is fine as the hotel organise this - they are not cheap (we found taxis in Bangkok much cheaper) and when we used regular taxis on the way back to the hotel as soon as you say you're staying at Four Seasons the price does seem to be more expensive than it should be. However this is a small thing and a small price to pay for such an amazing place to stay. We tended to stay in the resort throughout the day and then went out on a few nights to the nearby Fisherman's Village which has an amazing fire show on the beach (a must see), Chaweng (quite dirty and cheap - a huge contrast to the beautiful FS resort) and to restaurants that were recommended to us. All the staff were all brilliant and happy to do what they can to make your holiday even better. They were all friendly and chatty all seemed really happy to be there which is a credit to FS as it has so many staff! If you want tranquility and beautiful views, plus 5* star service then this resort is for you - it was the perfect location for our honeymoon and we are so happy we picked it!

author: 723salmann
title: Fantastic property.... Food could be better
text: We visited the hotel in December 2015 for the Christmas Vacations. We were 4 adults and 2 young children and had booked a 2 bed Villa. As we were travelling with a Nanny as well, the hotel was fantastic in offering us a three bed residence villa upon arrival. I have to say that the landscaping and the quality of the accommodation is second to none. The residence villas have a small kitchen (very handy when you have young kids who have certain dietary requirements) and a 24 hr onsite butler to hand as well. We had a great time at the resort but there were a couple of things that I feel would make the whole experience even better. 1. The stand out food option was the Thai restaurant at the top of the resort. The Italian restaurant was OK but could be better. They could improve on he variety of Options on offer. 2. Unfortunately, our daughter is allergic to nuts and we needed the service of a doctor. We were quite surprised to learn that for a resort of this size, they did it have an on site medical practitioner (GP or nurse) and also the staff at the front office were a little lost on the next way to help us. Although it was a mild allergic reaction and managed with medication we have brought with us, it could have been more tricky if we had needed some urgent attention. 3. I understand that the hotel is super high end and expected super high prices for the service which I had no issues paying, I just feel that there are some costs which should really be part of the room cost. EG pool heater. Overall all fantastic experience and would come back and recommend to others. They do really look after you.

author: CarolineM205
title: Really wanted to love it, but ...
text: We were not wowed by this property. We had a one bedroom pool villa on the jungle side of the property which was disturbed by the extremely loud buzzing of cicadas, we learned the hard way. Additionally the villa shared a wall with a neighbor which led to us hearing them and I'm sure them hearing us. We were moved when we brought up the buzzing noise to management, just wanted to share since I did not know about the swarming bugs prior to booking. Breakfast, while having truly amazing views, was sub-par. Especially egregious was the flies swarming the fruit and pastries that are left in open air. Service in the other restaurants was not the best either.. one evening my husband and I ordered a shared appetizer and two entrees. My entree and the appetizer were brought out at the same time, his entree didn't come for another 20 minutes. The food was good but the overall experience was just so disjointed. We frequently had to wait on buggies, even after calling ahead. We were told this was due to the resort being at capacity. Since the resort is built on a hill, it is difficult to walk to many places and we felt like we wasted a lot of time waiting. While these are seemingly minor issues and we overall enjoyed our stay, the value was not there. It was simply not up to par with what I've come to expect from a Four Seasons property. To end on a positive note, despite being at capacity, we never had a problem getting a front row beach chair or any kayak, paddle board, etc. The pool and cocorum bar are magnificent, it is truly a beautiful place to enjoy a cocktail. I had one spa service and it was excellent. One of the water sports staff members waded out into the water to take a photo of me and my husband on one of the over water hammocks, which was truly appreciated.

author: ninagreen123
title: Breathtaking views and the best hotel service you'll ever experience
text: The staff couldn't be more attentive and friendly. Even before we arrived at the hotel, one of the hotel's assitant directors Songpol was extremely helpful in providing me with plenty of info on hotel activities and attended to my concern of having a room near mosquitos by ensuring he put us in a better room. And we definitely did! I've never checking in to a hotel as much as this one, as it's lobby is located on the highest point of the hotel so you'll be amazed by the views. One of the main reasons why this hotel is so special is the service. The staff are so friendly, always greeting you as you pass and making sure to build a relationship with you on a personal level. Small things like the staff greeting you by name and the hotel manager coming round to guests individually for social chats go a long way! The concierge were helpful in organising day trips we wanted to go to, tickets and taxis etc. Buggies always came to collect us immediately when we called for one. I feel it necessary to pay attention to how kind and friendly each buggy driver was too! They cleaners paid extra attention to detail - everything from providing extra accessories such as macbook laptop cleaning accessories to putting a four seasons leather bookmark in the page you were last on in your book were just such special touches! There's no doubt that they go the extra mile to ensure you have a fabulous stay at their hotel. Even after we left the hotel, we were pleasantly surprised to have a little goody bag of small pastries, yoghurt and granola and bottles of water in our cab to the airport. And just when we thought the wonderful service was all over we were greeted by a lovely member of staff at Koh Samui airport to help us with our luggage and sort out our check in and see us all the way off to the departure gate! Not forgetting to mention the views from the lobby, the villa, the beach and the restaurant were absolutely breath taking, you really won't find anything like it! My only critique is that for such a luxurious hotel as the Four Seasons I would've expected a much higher standard of breakfast quality. There was little choice so I don't believe it was good value for money. And even though room service will never be of any sort of standard as restaurant dining, I believe the same went for some of the dishes for their room service. Seeing as the hotel is so secluded and is far from local restaurants, we wanted better quality and value for money for its food

author: zorro69
title: Incomparable.
text: If you are seriously thinking or Four Seasons Samui for a holiday, then you are already aware that it is a resort with the highest of qualities throughout.....so is there any need for me to add to the glowing praises heaped on the resort by other reviewers......well perhaps you can decide that for yourself after reading this, is it a valid review, or merely an addition to the annals of largely unread data on the internet. A personal greeting on arrival from the Guest Manager, the highest quality villa with pool, a breakfast buffet that literally overshadows previous bests in Baros Maldives, various St Regis, Shangri-La Resorts, Peninsula(s) and Fairmonts.....and while enjoying the excellent buffet you are treated not only to highest quality surroundings and food (with a choice from the a la carte menu included), but perhaps the best styles of European, Asian, wholefoods that are just so well thought out as to compliment each other in a culinary sense, and that's just breakfast. .......sorry I forgot, while eating the breakfast if you can riase your eyes, the swallows, butterflies and sea eagles provide a stunning foreground interest, while the background interest is provided by the islands close by and the Gulf of Thailand. Exquisite. Perhaps a quick seat in a luxurious daybed while you wait for your buggy....no problem, any help in planning your days activities is already given in villa, but the superb Concierge Staff will supply any further ideas and help. Other reviewers can give a broader picture of the superb details to be found in the Resort. If you can drag yourself from your villa, the beach awaits, with drinks and snacks, a new Central/South American themed Bar with snacks has recently been opened on the beach beside the swimming pool, the idea being that in addition to providing another place for casual dining, many tastes of that region compliment tastes already found in Thai cooking. Other reviewers have already written about the eating options, no need for me to duplicate that, but it is a standard you would expect from a Four Seasons Resort. A very useful feature to us was that the Hotel will organise one of their cars to take you to the nearby port of Nathon, or Bo Phut, and charge the car to your room, this negates Thai freelance taxis ripping you off, and is just another example of the high standards of thought put behind enhancing the Guest experience. The Villas.......palatial.......enough said. But......where the Four Seasons Samui is literally at a totally different level from other high end Villa Resorts, and we have sampled the Banyan Tree, Vana Belle and others as previously mentioned is in the team work and superb qualities in the Staff, it would be unfair for me to pick out and name any single Staff member.....for there was not one Staff member who was a true credit to the Resort and to themselves and the Four Seasons name. Endlessly helpful, always sincere in their wish to help, although never intrusive, and I mean from buggy drivers to Villa staff, to waiting Staff to Management, purely simply a credit to all the hard work, training and ongoing training that makes the Resort offer such a unique experience. Thank you all. Now....did everything go without a hitch from arriving until leaving, no that is not the case, we had to ask for a little matter to be attended to, and this was timeously and effectively remedied with great thought and consideration, so it's not even worth a mention, but again it shows the hard work which goes on behind the scenes in Staff training and resolution. Which brings me back to the title of my article for Four Seasons Resort......"Incomparable", perhaps I was a bit reticent with the title it should be "Simply Incomparable"

author: KLEGASTO
title: Great Weekend Break with the Team
text: It was too short a visit! This place was a short perfect getaway with work colleagues - which also meant more "me" time (a time out from the huddle and bustle of being a mom). I loved my villa (I can't call it a room since it is huge)! It had great amenities, a dipping pool just outside my bathroom which had a great bathtub. The bed always tempted me to waste away the time in the room rather than enjoy the outdoors. But I am a tropical beach girl and that meant I needed to run barefoot on the beach to feel the sand between my toes. I want to dive right into the water and look up at the bright and clear blue sky (I was coming from a hazy Singapore and Koh Samui was certainly a refreshing sight to see). I hung out on the beach 80% of the time alternating between swimming, kayaking, stand up paddle boarding, eating, drinking coconut juice and sleeping - like I said, some great "me" time for a change. The beach isn't like Boracay, but certainly way better than any beach in Singapore. Facilities were great, staff were ever present and helpful but unobtrusive. Always smiling and always ready to help. I saw they had babysitters which opened up the possibility of a return trip with the family (which would leave me with some free time for myself). The young kids looked like they really enjoyed the beach activities. On the food - I can't remember how much Tom Yum I've eaten, or their Ceviche! Oh my gosh, the Ceviche! Ordered that again and again too. Try the magnum-like ice cream with special flavour combinations like Chili and chocolate or something with lavender and mango (I can't remember the combinations anymore). If you're looking for serenity in Koh Samui, Four Seasons is the place to be.

author: CucumberMartini
title: Paradise on earth
text: We stayed for the 4th time in this most beautiful resort and once again it was an amazing experience and we felt so pampered from the very first moment when we checked in up until we boarded the car to go back to the airport. The consistency of high quality service level we experienced since 2012 is impressive. What we really appreciate is the stunning location, the layout of the resort and the privacy of the villas. The entire hotel (villas, restaurants and public areas) is very well-maintained (considering the humidity this is a tremendous challenge) and no obvious signs of deterioration are visible. The resort ongoingly invests in the guests’ facilities and this time we were able to discover the new pool. The impressive 50m (!) length is nicely nestled in the environment and nature and especially at night, with the lighting, it looks cozy. The entire staff is very friendly, courteous and professional and their dedication to deliver top quality service 24/7 is impressive. And every time we return, it’s nice to recognize so many familiar faces - this loyalty to the firm reflects the employees’ satisfaction at work which can be felt. The beach area is extensive and it also offers a quiet beach where one can relax and read in a laid-back atmosphere. The beach attendants are very attentive and pass by regularly to check on the guests and refill the water glasses. There are constantly gardeners cleaning the beach by removing seaweed, leaves and pebbles. The food and beverage offering is diverse and can satisfy all different appetites (Thai, Mediterranean, Latin-American, BBQ). The breakfast buffet is incredible and the diversity of delicious dishes, the home-made specialties and the freshness tops everything we have experienced anywhere. All in all, for us it’s the nicest holiday one can expect - it always feels like home away from home!!! We really hope to be back soon.

author: KMIED
title: Little gem
text: I liked : - the scenery and the beautiful views from anywhere you are on the resort. - the comfort of the 1 bedroom villa, its big size, stylish decoration, huge bathtub and bathroom and its beautiful pool terrasse and the amenities, gifts and treats prepared for my kids. - the coco bar and plapla restaurant right on the beach with their great vibes, cozy seatings, elegant decoration, good food and cocktails. - the delicious tomahawk beef at the beach house on saturday night cooked on the charcaol grill. - the nicely presented breakfast with a good selection of fresh fruit juices, buffet items and a la carte dishes. - the huge and super comfy round lounge chairs on the spa side of the beach. - the kids club activities on the beach in the morning. - the beach house with many games such as ping-pong table, snooker and others. - the qualitative nautical equipments. I regretted : - despite checking-in on the FS app, the process at the lobby was not any smoother nor quicker. - we have not been informed the steak night at the beach house required advanced booking. - the kids club is closed for lunch break and the room they use on the afternoon is extremely tiny and not exciting for bigger kids. - the beach house advertise a nintendo wii with a long list of games and big screen but it was out of service. - the spa beach which gets the best lounge chairs and the best natural shade on the beach is not allowing kids. - the wine already expensive in Thailand is priced 2 times more than in a nice restaurant in Bangkok. - I wanted to do the check-out on the FS app but could not as they made a mistake on our bill. - it's not the resort nor management fault but you get disturb by loudy bugs ringing like alarms around the property some time of the day and you can only swim close to the shore as the sea gets quicly full of seaweed. Anyway our family spent a qualitative time and we would be happy to stay at this property again.

author: herve_in_paris
title: 6 days in Haven
text: We've stayed 6 days in this luxurious hotel in the middle of nowhere. It was a Paradise! From your arrival to your departure, everything was made to have an outstanding experience. We had a villa with pool with no vis-a-vis and a stunning view. The vila was extremely luxurious, every day we discovered new simple attentions as a cleaning kit for iPad, a strap for cables, bookmarks and sweet gifts every nights. All the staff was always kind, helpful and smiling. A special thanks to Jimmy at the Thai restaurant who always cared about us, and doing everything to help us to have the best experience at the Four Seasons. The Breakfast was unbelievable. Obviously, everything was homemade, delicious and refines. You have to experiment the Thai restaurant with his incredible view. The food was really good and tasty. The Mediterranean restaurant was also good. The vegetarian wrap was the best one We ever eaten. Unfortunately the French fries were not homemade! In conclusion, if you are looking for a palace, this hotel is made for you. We hope we will be back soon!

author: luxurytraveler
title: An incredible Experience
text: Just returned from a 4 night stay at the Four Seasons Koh Samui and I have nothing but praise for this property and its staff. My stay was fraught with complications caused by two unfortunate events: Bangkok Airways losing my bag and the Winter blizzard which led to the cancellation of our return flight to New York on Jan 23rd. Prior to our arrival I had already been in contact with one of the Managers, Songpol Duvoisin, about some special requests I had regarding room location and possible upgrades. While I was not upgraded due to space limitations, Songpol assigned us what I would consider to be one of the best “basic” villas on the property, Room 202. Throughout our stay, he was in constant contact with Bangkok Airways and served as my advocate and intermediary in dealing with staff at the Samui lost baggage office. Everyday he would seek me out to provide updates on his efforts. On my second day at the resort I mentioned that a foam roller that I use in the gym was in my lost bag. Two hours later, he approached me on the beach with a brand new foam roller that he had just purchased for my personal use. When our flight was cancelled and we contemplated the possibility of staying 1-2 extra nights, he went out of his way to help make special arrangements for us to extend our stay. When we decided to stay in Bangkok for 2 extra nights instead, he called over to his former colleagues at the Anantara (formerly the Four Seasons Bangkok) to ensure that we received VIP treatment and a room upgrade. He’s just an incredible guy! I enlisted the help of “P” from the concierge desk to help change my Bangkok Airways flight to Bangkok and book airport transportation in Bangkok. P was a pleasure to work with and offered us only smiles and efficiency as she assisted us with last minute arrangements that kept shifting. A real class act! Even though this property is the most expensive on the island, I can assure you that this is money well spent. In al my travels I would rank this property at the very top of the list, dare I say the best resort property I have had the opportunity to experience. Under the management of Jeff Rednour, with his down-to-earth and warm demeanor, this is a resort that shines brightly. Thank you all for an incredible vacation. Andrew and Doug

author: AndrewandSeamus
title: Absolute perfection!
text: This was our second time in two years staying at the Four Seasons on Koh Samui - and it has only got better! Nothing can prepare you for the level of service provided by the team at this resort - from check in (over looking the sea, cocktail in hand with shoulder massage) to check out (complimentary coconut milk caramels gifted on departure). Everything little detail that could make your stay better has been anticipated. Reading glasses are available in the library. Got an iPad? They'll clean your screen at turn down and leave you with a cleaning kit. Dog eared book left by the pool? Expect to find a book mark in it next time you see it. Since we were here last the resort has upgraded it's beach bar and pool. It's now called Coco Rum and boasts a 50 metre infinity pool. Terrific place for lunch in the sun or evening drinks. Every lounger and cabana has a service button, which means that you never have to wait for service. Addition of a sumptious private cinema provided a fun and memorable evening - great seats with personal usher and treats provided! Overall - accomodations are to die for - food is excellent - service levels are out of this world. The only drawback is that at the end of your stay you need to go back to reality. N.B. we booked next year's return trip before we left!

author: Ade888
title: Fantastic honeymoon destination
text: We stayed for 7 nights last October as the last part of our honeymoon. Staying in a Deluxe one bedroom villa we had a stunning villa with private pool and spectacular views. The decor in the villa is beautiful and cleaned daily as well as little treats left by maids such as cakes, iPad cleaning kit etc. Minibar is fully stocked and outside the room by the pool, a little expensive. You can have room service delivered which is very nice, but again quite expensive. We ate in all the restaurants for breakfast - which was great with a good selection, lunch and dinner. We also had lunch on the beach which was great as you only need to press a button and they deliver it to you. The beach is quite small, but wasn't too busy when we went so was quiet. I wish the kids section was further away though as the noise they made was annoying. They were building the new beach pool and bar at the time, so there was a lot of unexpected noise from this (this has now finished though so no need to worry!). When we expressed our disappointment to the general manager he kindly arranged us complimentary 3-hour spa package treatments which was a very nice gesture. I can't praise enough each and everyone of the staff - they are all so wonderful. The buggy system from the room is also very good and quick. They have theme nights like beach BBQ, beach burgers, etc - sadly on our last night it was the Beach BBQ which was stunning and amazing food and entertainment on offer - but a tropical storm quickly came in and we had to rush inside- the staff did such an excellent job of looking after us and clearing the beach quickly - bravo! There is a free shuttle bus into Bophut in the evening and you can also get a taxi for about 600THB I think. All in all, a very nice hotel and very luxurious.

author: spas_for_me
title: Breathtaking property but disappointing food
text: We were 2 couples with our kids and stayed for 5 nights at the resort. We paid about 175,000 baht per night for a 2 bedroom villa. Though we were upgraded to the 3 bedroom villa as they didn't have enough of the 2 bed ones. Very beautifully done up and so cosy. Right from the unobstructed views, private setting and beautiful landscape, there is nothing lacking as far as the property is concerned. I think enough has been said earlier about the brilliant property.We had a private butler, Bond, who was very nice and helpful too. But one of the most disappointing things was the food. They have just 3 main restaurants. My husband being a vegetarian, the steak place was out, so we just had to juggle between the other 2 which also had very limited choice. The breakfast was very disappointing and the same every day. When we enquired, they said they change the menu every week, which pretty much beats the purpose right! On our last day, the chef did try to make something special for my husband, but was quite disappointing to say the least. Also I don't know why they didn't share the full menu, I had to keep asking the lady at the restaurant if she had any other menus!! Also, they would charge ridiculously for the smallest of things like heating the pool or such similar or maybe more frivolous services. When you are paying so much per night, you expect a few simple things on the house. Anyway, we spoke to the manager and he was sweet enough to waiver those off. They need to act like a 5star hotel to begin with. Overall a great place if you are not a picky eater :)

author: LondonBurl
title: Fabulous Resort
text: Stayed here in a family suite in July. Rooms are fantastic - high ceilings, massive bathrooms and large deck. The private pool was really good - large enough (just) to win in. The children's room was a little dark and basic but they didn't seem to mind - its good even with older children but bear in mind that there is only one bathroom. The beach was private with a decent pool deck. The sea is a bit disappointing for swimming but there were some good water activities - kayaks etc. There's also a kind of club house with pool, air hockey etc. The restaurant on the beach is decent too, although a tash expensive. The resort is built on the side of a hill and to get around you mostly need to take a golf cart. These usually came very quickly but, occasionally, we had to wait for 5 minutes or so. Up near the top of the resort is the Thai restaurant, which was really first class. Well priced for this type of resort with great views. The food was good too (the menu changes every few days) and so was the service. This is also where they serve breakfast; this was really good - wonderful buffet supplemented by hot dishes from a menu. One of the best hotel breakfasts I've had. The only negatives were, first, the air-con in the bedroom struggled with the summer heat and, second, too many mosquitos. Not sure what can be done about that but if coming here in the summer, stock up on a decent repellant.

author: RebeccaS420
title: Amazing start to our honeymoon!!
text: We had the most wonderful beginning to our honeymoon at the FS Koh Samui! Our honeymoon began on June 23rd and after traveling 20 hours, we were welcomed with cold towels and a luxurious drive to the resort, and then the beauty of the resort literally took our breath away once we arrived! They gave us a quick massage as we took in the views before giving us a tour. We were brought to room 910 which had a private pool and was the most gorgeous room at the entire hotel. It was very private and we were right on top of the beach. We stayed at the FS Tented Elephant Camp in Chiang Rai so there was a package offering two complimentary nights at either Koh Samui or Chiang Mai, we chose Koh Samui because it looked stunning. We couldn't believe the service we were given considering our stay was complimentary, we weren't expecting it to be as amazing as it was. The breakfast was out of this world amazing. My husband took a Muy Thai boxing lesson and had a blast. The spa is very nice and large, we enjoyed Thai massages. Each room has their own private pool so we didn't feel the need to go to the main pool for the hotel but we did venture down to the beach every day. We LOVED going on the paddle boards to the dock out in the water where you can tie up your paddle board/kayak and jump into the water. The staff went above and beyond throughout our entire trip and helped us plan our night out in the town. My husband wanted to go to a Muy Thai boxing match in town so we had dinner at The Happy Elephant. I would definitely skip eating dinner in town, the town doesn't have much to offer other than vendors selling the same things and our dinner was not good. The restaurant at the hotel is by far the best option, so I'd recommend to stay there for as many meals as possible! I really can't say enough positive things about our experience, it was so luxurious and the staff was beyond accommodating and welcoming!

author: FoodNTravelFanatic
title: Beautiful resort, high-end living
text: We had a beautiful time here - the resort is amazing and the staff are all very welcoming and friendly. Everyone says hello, goodbye and thank you ALL the time. The resort is spread out on a hillside overlooking the Gulfs. The buggy service was very impressive (you need it!), having 24hr operation and there was usually never more than 5mins to wait. All the different staff areas communicated well with each other so that names and villa numbers were known to give a personalised experience. Staying at the Four Seasons Koh Samui was the highlight of our trip, however there is just a small amount of feedback I would like to give: 1. The gym could do with some more equipment/space (this may be difficult due to space but if the opportunity is there, it would be a great improvement). For a 5-star resort, the fitness centre equipment (specifically the weight training equipment) was a little basic. 2. Considering the resort is massive, two restaurants are not really sufficient. We were only there for 4 nights, and were struggling to find suitable options for the duration of our stay. There needs to be more range, or an extra restaurant for more options. 3. The food in the resort was good for the most part. The meals however, were mediocre in size compared to the extravagant price for each meal/item - patrons are already paying a premium price for their accommodation. We have dined at many, many restaurants with better quality/portions, at much better prices so this was our biggest disappointment as we are extremely big foodies =( Overall - the staff were wonderful, the resort itself and the villas were beautiful. The amenities were extremely good, and the natural insect repellent provided as part of the amenities kit was a god-send. The main thing that let it down for us was the cost of the meals within the resort compared to better options elsewhere, considering you are paying premium prices already for the resort itself. Would absolutely love to return to the resort, but if we do, we would be definitely hiring a car to dine out of the resort if the prices within it don't become more realistic - the cost of hiring the car for a few days to do this would still be cheaper than dining at the resort for every meal, plus gives you flexibility to go sightseeing without paying for taxi's or transfers.

author: Vtaneja
title: One of the best we've stayed in !
text: This was our first Four Seasons experience and it did not let us down! The property is beautiful with great views. The arrival lobby has an exceptionally breathtaking view. We visited the resort, with our 7 yr old daughter, for our 10th anniversary. When we reached after an overnight flight, breakfast was already laid down for us in our room. The staff was courteous and polite. The resort is built on a steep hill and it is advisable to call for a buggy. The buggy was almost always at the villa within 5 minutes after we called for it. We spent most of our day on the beach and the small snacks and drinks served by the hotel staff time and again (complimentary) were a very sweet gesture. The villas are great with all essentials provided for. The pools are big enough. There is a problem if mosquitoes and insects but it's a tropical climate and these things are expected. Also, the villas are quite private. Although the property is serene and secluded, the play area activities on the beach and play room kept our daughter busy and happy. There are just too many memorable experiences to be shared in one review. All in all, it was a great stay. We hope to explore more and more Four Seasons properties in future.

author: Travelator72
title: Best welcome drink, pizza and bathroom!
text: We ran away from Chaweng for some peace and quiet at the 4 Seasons. Our check in was great the GM was on hand to welcome us. I must say the welcome drink is awesome in its presentation and taste (sorry I'm a foodie!). We also had our photo taken and sent to my e mail. They gave us an upgrade and checked us into a room with a bigger sized pool! The staff are very friendly, always addressed us by name and helpful. The bathroom is wonderful.. With a huge bath that could fit two persons (I'm small so I had to lie across, widthwise lol). Fantastic natural light streamed in and applying make up was a pleasure. I have to say though that the bed is very high and tended to sink in.. Perhaps it is old and seen it's time. Food wise, it was ok we had lunch, supper and breakfast. The 4 cheese pizza we ordered via room service was scrumptious .. It really is one of the best thin sliced pizzas I've eaten! The beach was ok we didn't swim as it was low tide. Upon checking out they sent us to the airport in the hotel Mercedes Benz.. It was a nice touch. Overall it was a lovely stay!

author: MrGlobeTrotter1965
title: Fantastic hotel, incredible experience.
text: Yes, this hotel is very expensive; however it is worth every single cent. My wife and I stayed at the hotel for 3 nights for our Honey Moon (I will continue posting reviews from the other hotels we stayed through SouthEast Asia). I will start with the pick up at the Airport (I STRONGLY recommend arranging the hotel to pick you up with their own vehicle). A Mercedes Benz and its driver will be waiting for you at the doorstep of the airport (any other vehicle is at the parking lot). The vehicle smells delicious and has WIFI; ideal to catch up with family, friend and business. Upon arrival to the hotel you cannot imagine what is in door for you. In sum, from the moment you enter the hotel gate, you enter a magical place. The rooms (the higher/away from the beach) the better as the view will be spectacular/gorgeous/etc. The rooms are decorated with very tasteful details providing a very intimate, clean, private environment. To conclude my very brief summary, the food! They have two incredible restaurants (very expensive though). You must try both as they provide two different experiences. While you are at the top restaurant, make sure you have breakfast at the private area with view to the mountains. My favorite dish was the Mango Sticky Rice. Nowhere in Thailand did it taste so delicious. PS. Should you go to the SPA, treat yourself with the coconut chips and the tea they provide for free :-)

author: danielleknyc
title: Amazing property!!
text: We booked our stay with Amex Platinum Fine Hotels & Resorts and stayed 4 days for our honeymoon. The stay was amazing! We got upgraded to a fantastic beach villa - 905 - which was positioned well for afternoon sun. We had privacy on our own deck and swimming pool. The furnishings of the room were beautiful and there were his and hers areas to get ready in with separate closets, sinks, etc. Breakfast was great and selections rotated daily. Dinner was good as well and the staff was attentive. The staff was prompt in picking us up in a buggy when we called for one, though inconsistent if we made a reservation for pick-up in advance (typically had to call after the pick-up time to say no one showed up). Since you need to go nearly everywhere in a buggy, they always know who is going from where to where. They cleverly use their walkie talkies to communicate this so when you arrive somewhere, the employees greet you by name, which adds a personal touch. They had yoga included the one day, which we took advantage of and then scheduled a private class for another day. The tennis facility was nice as well. Overall it was an amazing stay for our honeymoon! If I added a few points of feedback, one recommendation would be to not allow children in the 'quiet area'. There is a sign specifically stating it is a quiet zone, however, they were not enforcing this. Another small gripe I had was the price of a fresh coconut - almost $9! They call it coconut island and they export millions of coconuts a month. I understand it's a luxury property and prices are high, but this one really got me!

author: ALHongKong
title: Beautiful luxury resort, but some flaws
text: It was our 2nd stay at this beautiful resort, and again, is was truly relaxing and a wonderful vacation. The view is just superb, the resort is under constant maintenance, so there was no difference to our first stay, The Spa (we had in Villa treatments) had always availability despite 100% booking rate, the treatments were divine. Thus I have to say there are some changes since our first visit (Christmas 2014) which I did not like: They changed the breakfast location away from the beach to their main restaurant near the lobby. For me, starting the day with a breakfast almost at the beach was one of the real big assets of this resort. The buggy service was a hit or miss. The buggy was either there as soon as we hung up the phone, or we had to wait for 10 /15 min. They only managend once (despite us telling them every day) to send housekeeping while we were at Breakfast. All other days they came quite late in the afternoon while we were in the Villa. The bed is on the very soft side, and despite my believe all Four Seasons use the same mattress (which I love) the Koh Samui Resort does not. The Pool was too cold. It is just not enjoyable when the water is too cold. The staff was a little bit too pushy for tips. We are generous tippers, but at some point you just don't have cash on hand, and they made us feel uncomfortable when not tipping each single time somebody came to our Villa - which we hardly left because they changed the smoking policy, so even at the beach bbq outside with heavy smoke from the grill there was not a single smoking table, neither in the 2 restaurants. I fully understand smoking is forbidden inside, and outside I agreed to a designated smoking area, but to offer no choice but a few tables inside in the bar area and your own villa area seems too much. Therefor we either had room service or went outside for dinner, where we needed a car which was ridiculously overpriced for the distance we drove. We asked for a normal taxi every time, but every time they ignored us and we ended up with the fixed fare hotel cars, as if to punish us for eating outside the resort (which we normally never do if they allow us to smoke somewhere...) To summarise, it is a really high class luxury hotel, just with some flaws which we hope have vanished at our next trip.

author: RishT
title: Super Property and Service
text: The views of the property are breathtaking. The service great and the food superb. The breakfast has a large spread, including all kinds of fruits, breads, cereals and also eggs. There is also a Thai selection at breakfast. There are two other restaurants one which serves Thai and another which serves modern italian cuisine. The great things about the hotel is that it is very kid friendly and they have activities every day for the kids as well as the adults. When we were there there was a great barbeque on the beach in the evening, movie under the stars and other kids activities every single day in the morning. The entire hotel is on a small hillock and walking around is impractical but during our entire stay of three nights we never did have to wait for the buggy for more than 7 minutes, which is just great. The beach is small but very clean with white sand and crystal clear water. The reef is also very close by and you can snorkel and enjoy the marine life. The beach also has great service, great beach beds, hammocks and many activities like kayaks, snorkeling gear, surf boards with paddles and a ping pong table etc. There is also a small sail boat on which the hotel takes you for a ride. We were traveling with our 7 year old son and the hotel went the extra mile to make sure he really had a great time. The spa is also great and treatments are done by well trained therapists. The hotel is a 40 minute car ride to Chwaeng beach. We would definitely come back again to the Four Seasons Koh Samui and this time for a longer break

author: fleetoffoot
title: Going The Extra Mile!
text: Other reviewers have commented on the beautiful villas, restaurants, beach etc. Some comments are fair, our villa had no direct sun, the beach is compact, the sea green rather than blue. However, we went to the beach for the sun and lay on wonderful circular beds being waited on hand and foot. Delicious complimentary snacks appeared every hour or so, little touches like this make a real difference. Complimentary yoga classes were excellent, but daily sessions would have been appreciated. For me the thing that sets any establishment apart are the staff and customer care. All the staff are friendly, smiley and keen to be of assistance. I stupidly left both my battery and charger for my camera at home. This was the start of a much needed three week break, starting at the Four Seasons and then travelling on to Vietnam, ostensibly to take photos. You can imagine my despair! Luckily the gorgeous Tuck, from concierge tracked down a charger and battery in Bangkok, having scoured the island to no avail. New terrorism laws meant flying the items in through cargo was impossible. The ever resourceful Tuck, went through the duty roster to see if any member of staff was flying in from Bangkok. Luckily someone was and two days later the charger and battery arrived. Holiday catastrophe averted! That is the sign of a great hotel and great staff. Worth every penny!

author: EnglishMango
title: FS standard but with flaws
text: I went to FS Koh Samui with my partner over the new years period 2014-2015. The hotel is modern and stylish and the staff are friendly. I would only point out a few observations: 1) I was surprised by how small my room was - compared to another 5 star hotel I stayed in Thailand I was disappointed by how closed the room felt. 2) the Thai food is not the best I have had - it is too spicy (I usually like spice!)/ too small a portion and the menu is rather limited. 3) The room service menu is more expensive than the restaurant menu although the portions etc are smaller - perhaps it's not a big deal but I would prefer consistency on pricing and quality 4) The breakfast NEVER changes - although some items are quite nice on the breakfast menu 5) the checkout is really annoying - you have to go from your room to concierge, to the arrival sala... I would just prefer the FS Malaysia style of checking out from your room - after all that is why they take your card details and debit 100,000 bahts! 6) Lots and lots of lots families, which include children. 7) the hotel is a sugar dynamite - don't be surprised to see old men with women old enough to be their grand... daughters. 8) Sloooow wifi and you can only connect 4 devices New Years Eve Party: For those considering going to FS KS during the new years period, I would just add that it is OK. I couldn't find a lot of info online before I went. Firstly there was a dress code - all white but some people decided to opt for black and blue (? bizarrely). The food was... OK. I say that in a generally positive way but it was nothing special. The beach was decorated nicely etc I celebrated new years at another FS hotel last year and my partner and I both received gifts, there was champagne flowing all night and all the food was special - ending with an amazing new years cake. The new years at FS KS did not have any of those features... so whilst it wasn't terrible, it was not amazing either. The fireworks were great and if you want a beach celebration in Thailand then this is a good place to go.

author: Flanners10
title: Dream wedding in the most gorgeous resort
text: We got married in the Four Seasons this November and the entire experience was just magical. The team did an amazing job in organizing everything and making sure we never worried about even a single detail. The Four Seasons is a great wedding location.
