Did a little beachcombing then went back to grab my swim suit.....had a light snack at the Moonshine Bar and Grill where I met Miss Suzy Q who had a smile that would make anyone feel like family. Then headed off to Emma's Natural Pool and take a dip in the ocean. That evening had the best home made burger and snuck and extra piece of L's bread (to die for). Falling asleep with just the screen shut and hearing the waves was what this soul needed. The following day ..... was picked up in the morning by James Docky Smith and escorted to the Bonefide Ghost at the marina. For the next 8 hours I was the most important person on the tide...or so I felt.... had some much needed casting instructions (cause God knows I have the worst back cast), Landed my first two bone fish from the boat then on the way to the flats saw sharks, sea turtles, sting rays....was magical. If you ever decide to bone fish....the flats are where it is at! After stealthily scouting several schools ( which I spooked with my spaghetti casting) Docky found a perfect loner who was eager to take my fly.....what a thrill - my cheeks still hurt from smiling! Thank you so much Jill for organizing with my emails back and forth. To James for making a dream come true and for all the staff at Stella Maris Resort including the pilot Joel for leaving a lasting memory that I will cherish and encourage others to experience- I am truly grateful. I just wish I could press "pause" to make it last longer.

author: Rejseman
title: Family relaxation in a beautiful, remote location
text: We visited late season August 2016 as a family of five and stayed nine days. We will go back but not for flash luxury but the overall relaxation and setting. The Bahamian charm and Germanic management touch suited us perfectly. Staff: It’s interesting to read other reviews about whether staff were friendly or not. Actually, I’d liken the approach to a Swiss hotel where guests have their privacy but if guests take the initiative to ask a question, the communication was great. We learned about the Bahamas and Long Island and had some good laughs. Food: Food is pricy but bearing in mind the location and that everything is boated in, we were pleasantly surprised. Activities: We live in a crowded busy city so the goal was do nothing. We succeeded and loved hanging around the pool, and the big hit for our children was the natural pool, Erna’s Pool. However, we did the mango grove trip in sea kayaks and saw a variety of fish sea turtles. Emerging in a private lagoon was breathtaking. Robert, presumably associated with the resort took one of our PADI licensed adult children for a day’s diving which she loved (other than seeing a Bull shark). Another day, we went with Robert to fish and more than fed the family with snapper and a few grunt. We released all grouper and other fish that we would not eat – the exception being a barracuda that headed for someone else’s freezer. Transport: In considering Stella Maris, it is a small aircraft flight. We used Southern Air from Nassau which flies south to Dead Mans Caye first then to the northern part of Long Island to Stella Maris. We flew with Joel from the resort back to Nassau. The views are breathtaking to keep the camera ready.

title: It's the people
text: We recently returned to Stella Maris, our favorite family destination. We've had several prior family visits and a couple visits for just my wife and me. One daughter is set to be married in the fall and the other planning for next summer. We had one last chance for a family of four vacation. We've been fortunate to travel the world dating back to when the kids were young. The unanimous vote for the last hurrah was Stella Maris. We spent a week at Rainbow House and loved it. Our compliments to the owners. We did the same activities we'd enjoyed in the past: diving, snorkeling, Cape Santa Maria Beach, Dean's Blue Hole, and Clarencetown, with the addition of bone fishing with Docky and his brother, Big Dog (highly recommended). We usually finished our off-resort activities by 3 or 4 pm, then hung out in the beautiful vanishing pool at Rainbow House enjoying adult beverages before heading to the dinning room at 8pm for a fine dinner. After we returned home, we reflected, and decided Stella Maris and Long Island are unique not only for the setting, but for the people. We felt welcome and part of the island family. It reminds us of our former favorite resort, Kona Village in Hawaii. Special kudos to Joel, our excellent pilot and sometimes waiter; Yvonne, who somehow managed to make all our activities work in our timeframe; Sue, the top Bahamian baker and bartender at the Moonshine bar (one of our daughters is a pastry chef), Robert, the skilled and patient dive master musician (who may not do another shark dive with me); Queen, the sweet, creative bartender; Rico, our driver (and sailboat rescuer a couple years ago), and Jill (who fetched us when our rental car got a flat). There are others, but I forget the names. The people are real, without mega-resort phony friendliness. We can't wait to return with the new son's in law. Maybe a shark dive?

author: jamesaugustnieman
title: Weekend In Paradise At The Rainbow House, Stella Maris Resort Club
text: It's hard to put into words how truly magical this home is. For 5 straight days, we were greeted each morning by the sun rising over the vast ocean in front of us, an image so picturesque and perfect that I will remember it forever. The saltwater infinity pool oversees the ocean so you can enjoy the view while listening to the soothing sound of waves slowly tumbling onto the reef in front of you. I've been on many destination vacations before, but this one offered something that none of the others could match. The remote, yet warm and friendly nature of the island allows you to truly rid yourself of all the stresses of the outside world. It's a home built for pure relaxation. I've never felt more "at peace" before in my life, and it's a feeling I wish I could relive everyday! There's something about the setting and scenery of the home that transports you to a state of serenity you probably haven't experienced before. It's just lovely. If you are the type who wants to be a bit more active, the resort (which is just a short walk away) offers boat tours and fishing excursions of all kinds. We spent two days on the ocean, and I have never seen water so clear and crystal blue. I took plenty of pictures (which i've added here), but even the pictures don't do it justice. We went fishing with Docky, who was about as professional, polite, and knowledgable as any guide i've ever encountered. If you happen to make your way down to the Rainbow house, I strongly encourage spending a day out on the water with him, you won't regret it! The staff of the hotel was amazing. Everyone we met on the island was extremely generous and friendly. Everything about my stay was stellar. I can't wait to go back!

author: MonetaMan
title: An Oasis Away From Everday Stress
text: We flew our plane to Long Island for 4 nights at Stella Maris. The place was very nice, staff was very accommodating, and service excellent. Food was much better than expected - I tried the fish (who wouldn't??) and it was fresh. It wasn't until I left that I realized this place is pretty close to farm-to-table. They do have beef, and a friend order the steak, he claimed it was excellent. Breakfast buffet is outstanding and offers a variety of fresh fruit, cereals, yogurt, etc.... and a good bargain. You can also order off the menu if you want an omelet, eggs, etc.... They have bikes to get around - but they are very basic one-speed - and we ended up walking up many of the hills. If you plan to explore the island a car would be required. They have a variety of pools, but our favorite was the salt water grotto. There the ocean washes in one side and flows through the other. Great for adults, or supervised children, as the current can get powerful - but we had fun and "rode the waves" for a few hours. You can stand up in most of the pool. The only down side, which others have mentioned, are the bugs. I brought spray and it took care of the problem. Rooms are neat and well appointed. WiFi is only at bar/restaurant. Overall an excellent value for the area.

author: 109HelenS
title: Another Fantastic Bahamas Fly-in Adventure
text: This was probably the 3rd or 4th time we have visited this resort as part of the Bahamas Ministry of Tourism Fly-ins. The resort just keeps getting better. The accommodations were breathtaking (see photos); the food was fantastic, and the service unparalleled! We arrived around noon on February 12 and received a warm and friendly greeting (including our Jack Russell) at Customs and Immigration at the Stella Maris airport. A total of 4 planes (9 people plus 1 four-legged visitor) were on this trip including our new members that came all the way from the mountains of North Carolina! After a short taxi ride to the resort, the resort’s wonderful assistant manager, Yvonne, showed us to our accommodations. We had a party of four, plus our grand-dog (aka Sunny the Salty Sea-dog) and were upgraded to the Dolphin House, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 2-bath home with a full kitchen situated on the Atlantic side of the island. The hotel is absolutely fastidious when it comes to cleanliness and attention to detail. This was one of the most beautiful locations at the resort with a private pool and an observation point overlooking the Atlantic. What a great way to start our Valentine’s Day weekend vacation! Next, lunch at the Moonshine bar, featuring amazing drinks and delicious lunch and snacks, got us in the Island mood. This resort is like a day camp for adults (kids, too!) as everyday you may sign up for a wide variety of activities, some included free. Snorkeling, boat rides, beach trips, and fishing are all available at the resort. We snorkeled at a nearby reef, walked the unspoiled beaches, explored a cave, and were given a personal guided tour of the Adderly Plantation Ruins by our knowledgeable and gracious host, Peter. The tour culminated in a rum punch party! For a beach day, we ordered a packed lunch that was fresh and tasty. Dinner each night featured a culinary feast of freshly made local and continental dishes. A great “Rake and Scrape” local band played one night before and after dinner for our listening and dancing pleasure. If you are looking for an amazing and exotic out island adventure, Stella Maris Resort on Long Island is the place to chill out, relax, and discover tranquility!

author: yelsew28
title: Nice Vacation, Except for Mouse Droppings
text: This was our families third trip to the Bahamas Out Islands. We have visited Elbow Cay, Andros, Eleuthera, and most recently, Stella Maris. We came here based on recommendations from other travelers we met on our previous Bahamas vacations, so we were very excited to see what all the talk was about. Let me first begin by saying, that Stella Maris may be the right vacation spot for other travelers coming to Long Island. The resort is quaint, the staff is friendly, and there are interesting historic sites to see. But I must admit, the cottage we stayed in called Caroline Favorite, also known as the Steed House, put a damper on the trip. The place was nicely furnished, had a gorgeous ocean view, and was clean for the most part. However, when we pulled back the pillows as we put my son to bed, we noticed dozens of brownish stains (about the size of tiny polka dots) inside his pillowcase. It was disgusting, so we changed the pillowcase. Later, when my husband and I went to bed, we found mouse droppings under our pillow, inside dresser drawers, and also on top of the sofa cushions in the living room. The next morning I went to the front office and told Deatrica about what I saw, but she was only mildly apologetic, and one cleaning lady even insisted they were not mouse droppings, but lizard droppings. Despite that, they did send someone back in to clean up the mess, but it wasn't enough. The next morning when we got ready to prepare breakfast, I opened a kitchen drawer to get forks out and there were more mouse dropping all inside. I was so disgusted I didn't even want to eat. Ordinarily, I would have requested another room but they were booked up during the time we were there. After all the great things I had heard about the place, I guess I was expecting better customer service, such as a more heartfelt apology or at least offering a discount on what were already pricey accomodations. For that reason alone, on our next trip to Stella Maris we will be staying at the Cape Santa Maria resort, which is more upscale at almost the same cost.

author: likeyvacay
title: Family trip with teenagers, will go back
text: We recently returned from our first trip to Stella Maris resort. We stayed in the Rainbow House. The whole property at the resort is very well maintained, landscaped, clean, and quiet. The staff was also very friendly and helpful. We will definately go again. We had a hard time deciding whether to stay on the rocky Atlantic side at Stella Maris or on the calm Carribean side at Cape Santa Maria resort. We visited Cape Santa Maria resort one day for lunch/beach, and although it is very beautiful there, there is nothing to do other than stare at blue water. We made the right decision staying at Stella Maris resort, as there was always a breeze, crashing of waves, and large property. We rented a car and visited Deans Blue hole and also found a beautiful secret beach down a long isolated road near Clarence town. We had our two teenage kids with us and they loved the resort as well. Only recommendation is that the gift shop could have some snack/drinks for purchase so that guests could keep these in their rooms. Beautiful resort, highly recommended, will return. Food was awesome as was the pizza delivered to the room. Spring for Rainbow House if you have large group, huge home with private gazebo and infinity pool. The resort recommended an excursion to Sandy Cay....this is a MUST and is the most beautiful place in the world.

author: travelthroughmyeyes
title: Beautiful Property
text: From the moment you step on to Stella Maris property your mind and body start to decompress. The check in is very simple and you are escorted to your accommodations and given a quick over look of the property. We stayed at the Gecko House and it was a very lovely cottage that can not be any closer to the beach but has just enough elevation to have a constant breeze to enable you to sit out on the lovely back porch to enjoy your beautiful beach and ocean views. The Wifi in the room was great had no problem with it at all and it was very fast! Though the rooms were very clean and well appointed they need to pay a little more attention to the bedding , making sure they smell crisp and clean , we did have to ask the housekeeping to change our bedding when we go there they were stale. Once they changed them it was fine. The food at the resort was excellent, take into consideration that there is really no other place close by besides the Cape Santa Maria Hotel to dine which we tried and Stella Maris food blew it away! The pools side service was the best experience we had , the bartender Sue was amazing and fixed us a spectacular lunch and yummy cocktails. She was also a joy to talk to. She made our trip! The only real negative that I have to say is that we did rent a car in advance and when we arrived they gave our car up because the regatta was in town . They did keep trying to get us a car but It did not happen which kind of put a damper on our trip since we wanted to get out and explore. But because of this we met the most amazing person on the Island that we really enjoyed spending the day with him his name is Divitt!!! If you want to see all the best in Long Island spend a day with him it is well worth it! He is all about service!!! We enjoyed Stella Maris and will definetly be back.

author: ajudgeinmiami
title: Great stuff to see at the resort
text: Great little place next to the airport. I flew private and the FBO / customs is simple. The resort is 70s / 80s. You can tell from the star rating. The AC in K1 sounded like a car from the 70s and didn't work. It's quite unique - no locks on the doors. There are quite a few things about this facility that are great! There is a tidal pool, cave party and nice beaches. As compared to Santa Maria, it depends on what floats your boat. It's on the East side, so the waters have strong waves. The other side has tranquil waters that are shallow. Stella Maris has better natural sightseeing. Overall, Long Island is one of my favorites in the Bahamas. When I return, I'll likely stay at Stella Maris over the other resorts. If they could get better Wi-Fi, that would make the experience much better. They have issues with Apple devices connecting. Note to owners - invest a few 1,000 on a hospitality-class Wi-Fi system. Kids loved it, but their attention span is limited. They need distractions and Wi-Fi seems to do well for them. Bring food if you can, you have limited options and the dinner was a little pricey.

author: 72wolfpack
title: Simply the BEST!
text: My wife and I spent eight days in a 1 BR villa with a pool. We are seasoned world travelers, and our experience was as good as it gets in terms of the helpfulness of the staff, the raw beauty of the location, the food prepared and served, and the activities available. One of the managers picked us up in Nassau in a small aircraft for the 50 minute flight. Upon arrival, we were collected and delivered to our villa within 5 minutes. For lunch we ate at the Moonshine Bar and were graciously served by Sue. It became a daily ritual. We ate our other meals - breakfast and dinner - in the dining room and chose the meal plan. Every night was superb! Daily we were taken on beach, snorkeling, or kayaking excursions on our schedule. Most of the time we would have a stunningly gorgeous setting to ourselves until we were picked up at the agreed upon time. The managers and proprietors often personally attended to our needs and chauffeured us around. Their recommendations were always just perfect. The villa had air conditioning. Even though our stay was August 7 -15, we never used the air conditioning. The breeze kept us very comfortable. At night the stars were awesome. We even caught the August 12-13 meteor shower. If you are looking for lots of action and glitz and casinos, do not go to Stella Maris. If you are looking for beauty, laid back island life, great food and drink, comfort, and memories galore, you cannot beat Stella Maris.

author: love2flyred
title: Beautiful Rustic Charm
text: We stayed at Stella Maris Resort several times, each time in a different bungalow. This trip we went with 1 other couple and stayed in Rainbow House - it was great! The house had 3 completely separate guest suites, making it totally private for all of us. The rooms were spacious and airy, the great room was exactly that! Though in need of updating (all the houses are privately owned) it was very comfortable, and could indeed be a 5-star property with a little TLC. It was very clean and well-maintained though, and we LOVED the ginormous infinity pool overlooking the ocean - the views are spectacular! We came in our own Piaggio and the staff couldn't be more pilot friendly, since Joel is one himself. (Check out his Piper Chieftan and the Aero Commander!) Karen, Jill, Peter, Joel all took very good care of us and the chef even cooked the fish we caught when we went deep sea fishing! Every night we looked forward to a delicious dinner and were never disappointed. Favs: Bahamian conch chowder, crab, mahi, and peas & rice. A few steps away is the private beach, the beach bar (casual lunch and great tropical drinks there too), the resort fresh water swimming pool, and the fitness center. And be sure to take the nature trail and a dip in the natural ocean pool carved out from the rocks. Awesome! Don't expect the Ritz - you're in the out-islands after all. But a stay at Stella Maris is a joyful experience you won't want to miss!

author: Rhodesian
title: Stella Maris-German efficiency with a Bahamian soul and the kindness and thoughtfulnessof a family business.
text: We have recently celebrated my in-laws 70th birthdays on Long Island Bahamas. We spent the last two days at Stella Maris. The total experience from reservation to checkout was not only flawless, but filled with comforting examples of kindness almost unique to the hotel business. And we are not yet returning guests! Stella Maris is the brainchild of a german industrialist who wanted to build and sell villas. The resort is marvellously beautifully located on the atlantic side with huge waves, cosy beaches, a large rock pool, lovely walkways, a poolside bar and saltwater pool with a view an our villa was-surprise-also located with a wonderful seaview and walls that could be opened totally to enjoy the breeze fully. The two families that run the hotel do all the different things themselves, from greeting guests to serving dinner! They still have time to commission personalized rock art for my in-laws birthday and a huge cake for dinner!!! And every little thing in the grounds is also there for a purpose. It is really extraordinarily well planned. Free shuttles to beaches and sights. Free bicycles. WONDERFUL staff for whom nothing is too much trouble. And affordable rates on top of that. Who could possibly have anything against that?

author: jungledriver
title: Great place
text: Although we didn't stay here, we took their resort dive course (Peter is great and extremely knowledgeable about diving and ocean conservation) and then went for one dive at Flamingo Tounge Reef later that day (Rober,the dive master is awesome). It was our first dive but they really took care of me as I was bit nervous. The reefs are beautiful and the water is crystal clear. The bar food was so so but the dinner menu looked very sophisticated and delicious. The resort really seems to cater to their guests. We even met one couple who has been going to Stella Maris for 27 years! On site, they have two swimming pools as well as a natural sea water pool carved into the rock plus their own airstrip which is very convenient. There's also the tide pools (very cool) and the Love Beaches. The resort is very spread out as far as the natural attractions and other private homes in relation to the Inn and club house. There are many roads with nothing on them. I highly advise renting a car, even just to explore the north end. We traveled up to the north area 3 times from our centrally located cottage in Pettys because there are more attractions to see (Columbus monument with the BEST snorkeling IMO in the bay just below, tide pools at SM, beach at Cape Santa Maria). Key advice: do your homework when traveling to an Out Island. Example: one previous post from "grrrrah" blames the resort for her no see um bites. Yes, they are all over the island and no one can do anything about it. Its best to be prepared (we used baby oil as they can't bite through the oil) which worked great.

author: AlabamaAnita
title: First Class Customer Service
text: If you are looking for 4 Star accommodations, you won't find it at Stella Maris Resort Club, but you WILL find 4 Star customer service! The hotel, cottages and villas neatly situated alongside a gorgeous view of the Atlantic offer the wandering traveler several options for clean, cozy accommodations. With the option of a meal plan and all-inclusive packages, there is no shortage of things to see and do OR not. If relaxation is in the picture, you will find it here. If you enjoy water sports such as bonefishing, diving, snorkeling, kayaking, etc., you will find it here. For the history buff, there are opportunities to take walks or ride bicycles to nearby ruins full of history. For the nature lover, there are bird sanctuaries, blue holes and foot trails marked all along the island. The Staff at Stella Maris will make your visit a pleasant one. This was our first visit to Long Island and although a big fan of the Outer Islands, I felt at home on this tropical oasis the first day. Highly recommended for those of you who need downtime and relaxation. We opted for the meal plan and WERE NOT disappointed at all. The food was plentiful, tasty and attractively presented. A very romantic Valentine's Day meal delighted us both. Please give Stella Maris a try . You won't be disappointed. Kudos to Karen, Jill, Joel and all the staff for making our stay a very happy memory.

author: Dackeldonnie
title: My wife and I love the place! Friendly people, family athoshere, great beaches
text: We are now back in cold Germany since 2 weeks after having left Stella Maris Resort on Long Island, Bahamas. We would like to come back into the sun immediately. The atmosphere on the whole island was very friendly indeed, nice people everywhere. People greet each other passing. The resort's family-staff was always very helpful to make us a wonderful holiday and just feel good. There are no keys for the apartments and houses. Good feeling! We tried to do nothing but relax and enjoy - sometimes some nice snorkeling. Meeting them at the resort bar in the evening other guests reported about great diving from the boat or ashore - or excellent bone fishing. Besidest: the best rum punch in the region! Actually my wife and I have been at Stella Maris Resort 20 (twenty) years ago and loved it that time very much. This January we decided to return and see if it was as charming as 20 years ago. It was as wonderful as before. People should check the many white beaches and the turquoises water to swim and snorkel right away or enjoy the Rumpunch party once the week or the boat tour etc. etc. Price and service are totally acceptable and include many details which you have to pay for in other hotels - it is much less then the high prices in the rest Bahamas. Thank you George, Peter and the whole (family-) staff! We will come back soon! Christa and Michael from Hamburg, Germany

author: Tinchen
title: Perfect holiday!!!
text: We spent 3 weeks at this lovely resort and would go back anytime! This is the perfect place for people looking for a relaxing holiday within a superb surrounding. The Stella Maris staff go out of their way to assist you with anything you might need and offer an extreme variety of leisure possibilities (a lot of them free of charge!). For example they offer daily scuba diving, boat excursions, fishing, kayaking, bycicles are available, driving us to the different beaches on the island etc – both Carribean and Atlantic sides have the most fantastic beaches I have ever seen!!! Not to miss are the great cocktails which Sean the Barman creates – once a week the hotel has a rum punch party with live Bahamian music. The bar at Stella Maris is in a “Hemmingway style” and we spent a lot of evenings enjoying the great atmosphere after dinner. The bar is a social meeting point of the hotel with different game offers such as billiard, backgammon etc. If you really need to check your mails while visiting you even have wireless lan internet connections here! We didn’t find this at another place while travelling the Bahamas: the Restaurant at Stella Maris offers a great menu with daily changing specials! Even though we spent average 3 weeks at the resort the daily special did not repeat once! Also the staff is very friendly and go out of their way to introduce local specials to you! Stella Maris offers different accommodation possibilities and comparing with other Bahamian islands you get a great value for money and can even choose between self-catering apartments and hotel rooms. I personally would recommend the restaurant as the next good supermarket is a while away and supermarkets are quite expensive on the islands. They have really nicely refurnished rooms with a fantastic view to the Atlantic side. The hotel is not situated directly at the beach but on a little hill with view to both sides of the island. You really notice that Stella Maris is a privately owned resort and the owners put guest service at the top of their priority! I can recommend this for families, sporting guests, couples or people who just want to get away and relax for a while. Even though we spent a long time at the hotel we definitely were not bored once and easily could have stayed longer -we def. will return!!!

author: BillVA
title: Great Escape, especially for Pilots
text: My wife and I enjoyed another wonderful trip to Stella Maris. The resort has a wide range of accomodations, so you can pick what level you would like, from regular rooms, to suites, to houses with private pools. Nothing fancy, and no TVs or phones. This is an out island place. If you are looking for wild night life, go somewhere else. The island is somewhat difficult to get to, but the airport is less than 1/2 mile from the resort. For pilots, it is an easy flight from Florida, and the airport has recently been upgraded. For non-pilots, the resort has their own charter flights at very reasonable rates from Nassau. There is a pilot discount for those that fly in themselves. Food prices are reasonable, and we usually choose to eat at the resort restaurant, as the prices are pretty much the same everywhere, but the service and attention at the resort is hard to beat. They also have a great variety of specials, as well as a regular menu. Food is expensive in the Bahamas, but we find we get by for about $50-60/each per day. There is a great range of activities, and you just need to tell the gracious hosts what you are interested in, and they will make it happen. We absolutely love the hosts and managers, Peter, Joerge, Joel and the entire staff. This has to be one of the friendliest places we have ever vacationed. If you are looking to escape from it all, and enjoy a stay with new found friends relaxing and enjoying "Island Time", this is one fo the finest places we know.

author: Cruiser38454
title: Lovely!
text: We stayed at Stella Maris in August, 2005 and the resort is beautifully located overlooking the Atlantic side of the ocean. It is very clean and pretty, and the staff very friendly. The owners made it a point to stop at each table at every meal and exchange a few kind words, and also to let us know what activities would be offered the following day. They have a nice selection of complimentary activities: taking you to the Beach at Cape Santa Maria (which is the most breathtaking beach I have ever seen) to a boat ride to the reef to snorkel, rum punch parties with conch fritters, bikes to use, and other land activities. You can also take paid fishing or scuba diving trips. We had a 1 bedroom cottage, which was very clean, air conditioned and comfortable, with a pool right outside our back door (shared with 3 or 4 other cottages). There was also a pool outside the main clubhouse and another overlooking the ocean. Or you could walk down to the beach. The only "surprise" was that while the food was excellent, in many cases prices were not provided. For breakfast, you had a list of what was offered and you checked off what you wanted and it was brought to you. The list had no prices on it and you were not given a receipt to sign. What a surprise upon checkout to find that the omelette was $12, plus a 10% gratuity and an additional tax is added to every meal. They offered delicious dinners, however again, don't be surprised to find that your meal cost nearly $40 apiece, including gratuity and tax. And you don't know it until you get your final bill. Some might say that this is fair exchange because of the complimentary activities they offer. Also to be considered might be the cost of getting supplies to Long Island. Either way, I think the meal costs should be clearly disclosed to guests. There is nowhere else within walking distance of Stella Maris to dine, so another idea might be to ask your taxi driver when coming from the airport, and either make some arrangements with him or rent a car to explore other places to eat if you need to be economical. Aside from that, I would highly recommend Stella Maris - their service is impeccable and the resort itself very comfortable.

author: FarAway25471
title: loved our stella maris vacation
text: eight of us went for a family Thanksgiving vacation, from grandman down to the 21 month old baby. we had been there in 1969 and 1972 and bought property there. stella maris is still lovely and unspoiled. the same hosts that were there for us before, peter and jorge were so gracious and helpful. grandma had here own motel room, and each couple with their children had a seperate cottage with one bedroom and sleep couches in the living roiom. there was a small refridgerator, air conditioner ( we didn't need it as there was a delightful breeze from the ocean) ceiling fans, but no TV, phones (cell phones don't work there) or computer access in the rooms (there is an internet cafe a short ride away.) Peter arranged for us to have bus or van service to the various beaches but we had to use taxi service to and from the airport which was just a short ride away. The food in the dining room was excellent. They went all out for Thanksgiving. Some of our party went scuba diving snorkling, kyaking and enjoyed the sunfish sail boat all of which was gratis. some of us just enjoyed the beautiful beaches, especiamlly Cape Santa Maria. They accomodated us with the bus to and from the beaches. Do bring bug spray as some of our party were bitten. The water does not taste good so we had to use bottled water but they sell all that there so it wasn't a problem. Most of the people were there for the scuba diving but there was a lovley mix of people from everywhere from Canada, Germany Switzerland, Alaska to Florida. We had a wonderful time and really loved it. We were entertained by a terrific Bahamian guitar player.

author: HappyJack12
title: Outstanding!
text: Just back last week from a wonderful 15 nights at the Ant Apart(our third time there). Can't really say anything that hasn't already been said, but I will. Tanel & Ceylin(not forgetting the new addition,Tan Ege) who run the hotel are a beautiful couple who will do anything to contribute to your stay there. The staff, Ozgur, Samet, Ben and Mehmet are brilliant guys who will look after you and keep you entertained. All have a great sense of humour (special mention for Ozgur) and will look after all guests as best they can. The rooms have all been upgraded, are spacious, spotless(thanks to the hard work of the maids) have a sitting room, cooking facilities(not that they're needed as the food from the apartments and surrounding restaurants is top class and cheap) two balconies and a large bedroom. Where the Ant Apart is situated is ideal, just back from the main road so no traffic noise. Ideal for a 5 minute walk to Hisaronu, or to catch the dolmus to Olu Deniz(15 mins) or Fethiye, my favourite place(15 mins) for less than £1. There are also plenty of bars and restaurants on your doorstep. Also plenty of shops for the essentials fr your apartment. The grounds of the hotel are also excellently looked after by the gardener and sometimes Tanel's dad. Fruit trees and beautiful flowers and plants are all around. Never short of a lemon for your G&T :-) But it really is the staff and Tanel & Ceylin who makes this place so special. Can't wait to return next year and catch up again with what feels like old friends and a home from home. Oh before I forget, there is one bad thing about the Ant Apart that I really must mention. When you have to leave, there may be tears(not me of course)

author: PauloS31
title: Fantastico !!
text: Stayed here for two weeks from 22nd Aug - 4 Sept for our second visit in 2 years, and wasn't disappointed. Our cases were taken up to our rooms by JJ (struggled a bit with the wife's case full of shoes ;-) ), and within 10 mins was unpacked and downstairs in the bar to start our hols. The rooms are basic, but for the cost it had everything we need for a holiday. Tan/Ceylin and the staff there work so hard to make your stay a pleasant and relaxing one, and are like a little family extension. a mention for Sal behind the bar who works so hard and makes some cracking cocktails (long island iced tea). Good selection of drinks, including Efes, Tuborg, John Smiths, Strongbow, Corona, Peroni, Becks. Food is spot on (snacks, never ate an evening meal) and great value, and they also prepare sandwiches for the airport for 9 - 10 lira (beware £5 for a cup of Lavazzo coffee at the airport). You read stories on forums about overcharging on your tabs, but this never happened here and your previous days tab was always at reception for you to settle. First place I have stayed at mind where towels were left on sunbeds overnight, even though there was plenty of beds to go around. Rooms cleaned daily and towels changed every 2/3 or if you left them on the floor for the maids. Booked a couple of excursions with Ant (horse riding £13 and quads £28 for 2 on 1 quad), so very competitive prices and less hassle. Only downside was the bloody cockerels who cocked their doodles at any time during the night (not to be confused with Tan and Ceylin's hens that run about the grounds), but got used to it eventually. All in all we had a great time at Ant apartments and have to say a big thank you to all the staff, those you see and those you don't and would not hesitate recommending it. Might even have a sneaky week in May next year (good discount Tan). And the girls are looking forward to returning next year......

author: Debs68lawrence
title: Great accomodation, location and staff are very friendly.
text: What a fantastic place to stay. The staff are so friendly and make you feel so welcome. The apartments are well equipped and are cleaned daily with clean towels. The food and drink is not over priced. The location is great and is not in a noisy area. I could not believe as to how many people return year after year. It is really a fantastic place to stay. Yes i shall be booking for next year. If you like a lively atmosphere then its a 8 minute walk into Hisarnou where there are many fantastic restaurants, shops and a few nightclubs. Taxis are cheap which helps getting into Olu Deniz or you could take a cheao short hop on a dolmus. This area is a truly beautiful region. The beaches are unspoilt. Also there is a no hassle ruling by the retailers and restaurant owners. One of my favourite holidays. I cant wait to return.

author: 595debbies595
title: Wonderful place which felt like home
text: This has got to be a hidden gem! We had a brilliant time here and would highly recommend. Whether you want a relaxing holiday or an adventure, this is the place to stay as nothing is too much trouble for Tan and all his staff. Great location as it is only 10-15 minute walk for the busy nightlife of Hisaranou. There are free transfers to the beaches on the Blue Lagoon. The appartments are spotless, food was lovely and plentiful. Iman and JJ always made sure our 7 year old (Molly) had her pancake for breakfast. Our 15 year old (Rebecca) loved the Paragliding and even persuaded her dad to do it. Not sure he was so keen after enjoying an evening in the bar with Samet and Volkan - who are quite happy to serve you in the bar till your ready to go to bed! When we left as some silly time in the morning Tan and his staff were there to wave us off and even had a blanket to give to Molly to keep her warm on the coach to the airport. We met some lovely people who I have to say are repeat guests and we can certainly see why. We look forward to returning next season, hopefully with afew of our friends from the Isle of Man. Well done guys! Keep up the great work. Love Debbie, Aron, Rebecca and Molly xxxx

author: ilovethesun64
title: FANTASTIC! Book without hesitation!
text: Book this now! Had a fantastic time here. Tan & all the staff are fantastic kind people & treat you like their family. Rooms are spacious & have everything you need. Pool is lovely with plenty of sunbeds. Bar is great as are the staff.. They are open until you are ready to go to bed! Great location as all bars & restaurants in ovacik are close by & it's a 15 minute walk to the busy night life of Hisaranou.Dolmus buses stop right outside the apartments if you don't fancy walking.Free transfers to the beaches on the blue lagoon. Boat trips are a must. Paragliding looks good too! Food nice in Ant & also in all restaurants especially the miraj & Angels. We met some fantastic people here & it was very emotional waving people off home.. staff always there to greet & wave off too! Couldn't fault Ant Apartments so book it as soon as you can! Well done Tan, Ceylin, Iman, JJ, Samet (Sammy) Volkan (GARY!) & all the hard working cleaners! Look forward to seeing you again! Love Nicki (Negulla!)Dave (Davuut!) & Lorna (Leyla!) Xxx

author: sunnyroda
title: F-ANT-ASTIC ANT APARTMENTS
text: Stayed here from 21st June to 3rd July, these are the best apartments I have stayed in. My partner and I have been travelling to Turkey since 2009, twice a year. We think Turkey is amazing and especially the people. Firstly can I say a massive thank you to Tan,and Ceylin, they run these apartments with upmost professionalism and they offer their help in many ways, any problems are quickly rectified, we had none but they are always on hand to help their clients, they were happy and very helpful at all time. Can I just praise their wonderful staff, our holiday would not be the same without them ,please Tan and Ceylin don't let any of them leave, special mention to Jay Jay, he was a very happy, kind considerate staff member and we became very good friends with him, also to Sammi, Iman and Volcan, they all work long hours and they always have a smile and a laugh with you. So thank you all for such a pleasurable happy relaxing holiday. Now the apartments we had were a one bedroomed apartment, they had a double bed, 2 balconies, kitchen area and living area, it was lovely, amazing views, the cleanest apartments we have ever stayed in, the cleaners here were fabulous and I should know, I normally have to clean myself, but these were just outstanding. The grounds were beautiful, amazing mountain views, the pool was large and plenty of sunloungers, also there are lots of new loungers and seating areas, many apartments have been updated. The area Ovacik is beautiful, mountains everywhere, we went to the Mirage, amazing service in there, Adam especially was a very kind and generous worker. Hisaronu is good for bars, restaurants and shopping, Olu Deniz is up and coming, we went there every night. We went to the Sultan restaurant, amazing atmosphere and the food was second to none, fabulous. Also we went to the Tequila Bar/Restaurant, food was lovely, staff here were brilliant, and the Cocktails amazing. Can we just say that the beach at Olu Deniz is spectacular and we miss it so much. We missed the Turkish night at the Ant apartments but the lay out was really done out beautifully and 100 people went to it, there was a fire show there too, and our friends at the Ant really enjoyed the evening, we could not go because we had arranged an evening out with friends, so we missed a good evening, and especially the food. The weather as usual was gorgeous, very hot about 38 degrees, I did get bit by mosquitos but just buy the Turkish repellant and this will help. These are the best apartments, don't miss out on wonderful staff, scenery and relaxing atmosphere. We hope to see you all very soon, Lorese and Wayne.

author: ayazh_13
title: Amazing!!!!!
text: For the the last three years we have been going to Turkey. We love the country. In the past we have stayed in 4* and 5* Hotels but this year we just wanted a budget holiday. We booked Ant apartments on half board basis after reading the reviews on Trip advisor, but my wife was still a bit aprehensive. We got there on 24th May 2013 at 5 am. Tan the owner quickly booked us in as he could see that my 7 year old son and 3 year old son were cranky and tiered. We got a ground floor apartment and it was spacious, kept extremely clean and although basic very comfortable. We were there for 11 nights and I could not fault one thing. The restaurant staff Ozqur and Serkon were polite and treated us like royalty. My sons are fussy eaters and if there was food they didnt like the staff were very acommodating. The food was delicious courtesy of Suheyla the cook. Swimming Pool was clean and there were plenty of sun lougers. It was also my three year old son's birthday and the hotel staff and the owners Tan and Ceylin made him feel really special by baking him a cake. The service was 5 star. I also loved the fact there was no hard sell or any kind of pressure to buy excersions or water from the hotel. The hotel location is really good as you are only a dolmus ride away from Olu Deniz beach and Fethya. Hisoronu is a 10 minute walk and has plenty of shops and restraunts. I must also thank Volken and Samet who are extremely helpful staff members. All in all I would sincerely like to thank the owners for making this holiday so enjoyable for me and my family, I would definately recommend Ant Apart Hotel. Look forward to seeing you all next year Ayaz Hassan and Family.

author: RubyMonkey2
title: Amazing Holiday! 10/10!!
text: Me and my boyfriend have just returned from 10 days at the Ant and we have to say it's probably the most enjoyable and relaxing holiday either of us had ever had. The Ant is a lovely place to stay,set off from the main road with gorgeous gardens and seating areas and a lovely,clean pool and bar area. The managers and all staff are really friendly and welcoming and there's a great atmosphere around the pool and bar - not in your face at all. They keep the music quite low so no problem if you just want to sit and chill at the pool. The room itself was really spacious with two balconies. Kitchen is well equipped for making light meals/snacks if you want to. Rooms are cleaned every day and fresh towels and bedding provided every three days. The Ant is in a great location for accessing Fetiye,Hisaronu and Olu Deniz. All are a short Dolmus ride away,you can easily catch the Dolmus anywhere on the road outside the apartments and it costs about £1-£1.50 depending where you go. Hisaronu is easily walkable too in about 15mins if you feel like a stroll! Good selection of restaurants in the local vicinity of the Ant too-we particularly enjoyed the Rockpool and the King's Arms. The Ant itself also does a good breakfast,lunch and evening meal menu. Only downside was not the Ant itself but the adjacent Greenpeace Hotel. Our room was right outside its pool/bar area and it could be very noisy. However I did shout at them to shut up one morning at 730am and the obliged! I hope the managers of the Ant read these reviews and perhaps sort something out with this other hotel as it's the only thing that can let it down and not their fault. We met some really nice people staying at the Ant and all had been at least once before so it just shows how good this place is. Highly recommended - we'll be coming back next year!

author: Semenim
title: lovely holiday & wonderful host
text: every year- i think for 7 years- we visit Ant, i enjoy both summer and spring time there. We generally stay for two weeks during summer time. the location of the hotel is so nice that you do not faint 'cause of the hot weather. if you want to go to city center, there are lots of minibuses from the front of the hotel. the new owners are very friendly and very thoughtful. the staff is energetic. it was a nice place for years but this year i see that everything is considered by the new owners to make you feel like you're home. the concept bar and renewed rooms are wonderful. i like the new atmosphere in here. if you have a child, he can enjoy the summer with pool,playground etc. or if you like to make some foosball or table tennis tournaments..i mean Ant is the place to have fun if you want, or a place to rest peacefully. if you want to try sky diving, boat trip etc. ask for reception, they arrange and the tour guides will pick you from the hotel. the food is cheaper and much more tasty than the places ypu can eat in Ovacık center. the most important thing for me is the hygiene. (actually i take my bed sheet & pillow with me to every where i visit) but this time believe me or not i did not use mine. look forward for my new vacation there..

author: Baba_Oriley1916
title: Great Hotel, great staff and great guests.
text: Just returned from a fantastic 14 days at the Ant Apart. Run by a lovely couple Tanel and Ceylin, the hotel is perfectly located just back from the main rd. through Ovacik. Walking distance from the bars in Hisaronu, and ten mins. by dolmus to Fethiye and Olu Deniz we found it ideally situated to explore the surrounding area. The rooms were very spacious and comfortable, with a bedroom and sitting room balcony, plenty of room for your clothes, good cooking facilities and kept spotlessly clean by the very hardworking maids. The food was also very good, with a broad menu to suit all tastes, my favourites were the salads, especially the Ant salad(not what it sounds like!) The pool area was very good with a good sized pool and no problem getting a sunlounger, we spent more time than we normally would on holiday by the pool. The bar area was fantastic and we would have a drink every night either on our way back from our night or we'd spend the night there, something else we wouldn't normally do. It was the staff however who made this a very special holiday for us. Tanel and Ceylin were perfect hosts who would do anything to make your stay as comfortable as possible. The waiters Cezgan(sp?) and Alp were polite and friendly, and the barmen Unal and Samet were top class, always having a laugh and chatting with the guests. Samet more so as his English was very good. Our fellow guests were also really good company, and we met some people who will remain friends. We will definitely be returning to the Ant Apart next year, and would highly recommend it for couples, groups or families of all age groups. You better book well in advance though as many guests had booked to return in Sept when we were there.

author: LondonSalem
title: Been There! Seen It! Done it! And Shall Again
text: Wow ! We have visited the ANT over a few years now and the visits will continue. Bar and restaurant are the focal points of this hotel with a bit of music, bonhommie and great food. The managers are young and trendy with terrific staff. Nothing is too much trouble for them and they just want to see everyone enjoy their holiday time. Spent two weeks with them from 20th May when the weather was just right. Great families and couples hotel and during our time there we met some really fun people. Close enough to the local nightlife to be convenient but far enough away to get to sleep if you want to. The only down side is that it is not close to the beach, about five minutes, but is cooler than the beach which is an advantage. Great pool, which I prefer, and service with a smile at all times. I do not go on holiday to spend time in my room but it ticked all the boxes - large, comfortable, bed, balcony, toilet, shower and kitchen which pretty much means you can sleep, wash, change and cook (I used the restaurant because I don't like washing up). Looking forward to returning and bringing friends. Try it, you will not regret it. P.S. I am an oldie.

author: FionaE187
title: Definitely won't be returning!
text: Most important if you intend to be going to bed before midnight - very, very loud music and entertainment coming from the hotel at the back. A huge problem with us having a baby with us. Apartments were cleaned daily, well swept maybe, definitely not mopped - the floor was filthy when i wiped it! Towels every three days. Cooking facilities very, very basic - just two rings and a kettle. Decor extremely dated - in need of a good refurb! No view at all from our ground floor, garden room. Just a bunch of greenery right at the balcony so no sun! Our baby's swimming seat got binned after she used it once so dont leave your stuff around the pool!! Apparently they were having a clear out after the storm - but didnt bin all their own filthy lilos! Nowhere to hang wet clothing - or your towels which makes it difficult to use them for 3 days. I had to hang our stuff on the balcony which was covered in rust. Kettle blew a fuse and when we told the manager our electric had gone off he said we must have done something wrong! Pool and bar area lovely but lots of ants. We paid to get our laundry done and ironed - came back wet and creased. Baby cots appear to be on a first come first serve basis - we were lucky to get one but another family were told they only had 3 and their baby should just sleep on the cushions off the sofabed - baby then fell off and had a big bruise on its head!! You definitely get what you pay for here so dont expect much.

author: CHRISTOPHER47
title: avoid this place its horrible.would not recommend it .
text: Booked the "Ant Apartments" because it had good reviews, big mistake, its like an overgrown jungle . We were given rooom T103 which had black mould growth all on the kitchen wall and in the kitchen cupboards, also along every bedroom wall, the headboard in our room was trimmed with black mould growth, the whole room stunk of damp & Mould (see the pics)! You could not hang a towl or sit on the balcony as they were so overgrown with plants. The trailing plants outside had completely covered the bedroom window and the balcony. The room got no light from outside so you had to have the light on all the time, and the ants were everywhere even in the kids beds! On complaining to the management about the damp and mould growth, he said and I quote. "He will get the cleaner to come in this afternoon and paint it white". which was not acceptable. It took them 2days to give us another room. Which wasnt much better than the 1st. On the 3rd day they placed a blackboard at the side of the pool which said."PLEASE DO NOT WEAR T-SHIRTS IN POOL" the manager/mangeress would call the kids by their names from the terrace, and tell them to take their T-shirts off. Drunken 15/16 olds at the bar, they dont care who they serve drinks to as long as there spending money. If you brought a drink/icelolly they never had any change, they would say i bring your change over, they never did, if you wanted a sunbed you would have to get up at the crack of dawn there wasnt enough to go round. We booked for 2wks and checked out after 7days dont book this place you will be disapointed. (see pics)

author: Eddieno8
title: Hugely friendly place. Would go back.
text: Have just returned from a week at Ant Apartments. As a couple we both hugely enjoyed our stay. It was our first time in Turkey and from what we understood from others, this is the best area to be in. Ovacik is a fairly quiet place, but still has restaurants and bars, with Ant being situated close to them, as well as a choice of shops that are quite well stocked. The town of Hisaronu, which is larger and livelier, is a ten minute walk away, and the beach at OluDeniz is a few Km's further along. These can both reached by the extremely handy Dolmus bus service, which runs about every 3-5 minutes. There aren't any stops as such, just hold out your hand and jump on. It only costs a few lira, depending where you're going, but it's a minimal cost. Plus it negates the need for a taxi. The beach at OluDeniz is lovely, however get there early as it was stupidly busy at the lagoon end. If you want to dodge the crowds, and the admission charge to the beach, bear right on the road towards the lagoon. Follow the road for about 800 metres and you'll find yourself at the bottom end of the lagoon at Sugar Beach. This has free entry although you'll pay 5 lira for a sunbed each (about £2). The beach bar is really chilled out, and you'll not go insane with the crowds! There are the usual choice of Indian, Italian and Chinese restaurants everywhere, but we stuck to Turkish cuisine for the week and weren't disappointed. Especially at Fetsival restaurant in Hisaronu, and Sunset on the sea front at OluDeniz. The last bit of advice I would give is to have a £10 note handy for your entry visa when you land, it'll save a lot of hassle. Hope this has helped :)

author: arundelclaire
title: Great apartments - well worth a visit
text: Just returned from last minute trip to Antas Apartments following mammouth trip advisor reviews on this place! These are great little apartments as per reviews. A few tips that may be handy. Location and Surrounding Vilages: Ovacik is much larger than I expected - a strip about 12 mins walk long - from the apartments you can reach them by walking down or along about 8 mins. Ovacik is most def 'brits abroad' style food and entertainment but fun if you like that kind of thing. For a more classy experience grab a taxi to Fethiye - about 35 lira and 15 mins to the lovely marina (check out Ece Saray and Yacht Boutique hotel or just the main marina). We didnt get into Hisaronu but this is only about 12 mins walk downhill from Antas. Get a taxi back up - only 5 lira (about £2). If you want more variety then head to Olu Deniz beach still lots of 'brits abroad' food but also seafood and stylish bars - a good mix. Harry's open this season absolutely superb and not pricey. So basically from the apartments you can get a good range of nights out and styles depending on your taste. Apartments wise, the pool was gorgeous and the staff fab, although the owners stayed low key compared to expectations from reviews. Please remember you will hear the prayers at 5am every morning and the apartments dogs are lovely but asleep all say and bark most of the night! They are extremely clean. I would def recommend a stay here for the overall variety of the place.

author: MrAndMrsFrenchie
title: Book this place, you won't regret it!
text: My girlfriend and I stayed here for two weeks in June and found it the perfect place to relax on a much needed holiday. The grounds are immaculate and gardens well kept. The pool area is very clean, and not overcrowded. We never failed to get sunbeds. The apartment itself was simple yet very clean and large. Large double room, separate bathroom, hallway with wardrobe, lounge, kitchenette and two balconies, all cleaned daily, with clean towels etc. Kitchen was well equipped for those wanting to save money and eat in, there's two hobs, an electric oven and a grill so you can pretty much make anything. The hotel is set in Ovacik just off the main road, so it's handy for getting to pretty much anywhere in the area yet quiet enough to relax during the day or retreat to at night time (whether you’ve been exploring the surrounding scenery, chilling at the beach, enjoying a quiet meal or partying hard!). Hisaronu is a 10 minute stroll away and fairly lively. Ovacik is a lot quieter but still plenty of restaurants and quieter bars for those who prefer that. Personally we wanted a mixture of both so the location was perfect for us. Oludeniz beach is a short (and cheap) 10 minute Dolmus ride away (small minibus which you can flag down / get dropped off anywhere along the way). The thing we enjoyed most about the place though was most definitely the service and welcome provided by all at the hotel. The place is family run and I always find it a good sign when the people who run the hotel eat with the guests. Ertugrul and his wife Tulin (they run the hotel) are extremely charming people whilst Yasin and Ismet (bar staff / waiters) worked very hard and were always on had to serve with a smile. We spent many a late night laughing with the four of them drinking beers, raki and cocktails. We made a lot of friends in this place, both guests and staff, and I would not hesitate for a second to go back!

author: /undefined
title: Card charged miscellaneous fees
text: Late check in and we asked for a late check out. Night auditor allowed us to have a late check out the next morning and we got up around 12pm to get ready to get out of the room. I showered then my wife showered. We received a call telling us to get out but my wife was in the shower. I asked her to hurry that the front desk was demanding we be out ASAP. Another house keeper came to the door and said we needed to leave. I explained we are packing and leaving while my wife was trying to hurry to get out of the shower. Not 5 minutes later two ladies came to the door demanding that we leave and that the cops will be called and the were going to be charged another night for the room. I told them we are leaving and we were packed just waiting for my wife to get done. It as 12:15 by now but the threat of having the police called upset me like I was some sort of criminal. My wife came out of the bathroom just as she put her clothes on and we both welcomed the lady to call the police as we weren’t doing anything but getting ready to leave. The two ladies walked away and said they were going to charge my credit card another night. We grabbed out clothes and proceeded to leave the room at 12:25 and I stopped at the front desk and asked why did she charge my card $80 and she stated that it was her right to charge my card anything she needed to. By the time we left the other house keeper came to the front desk and informed the front desk lady that there was no damage to the room. We knew there was no damage as all we did was needing a place to sleep on our trip to Minneapolis. When we got out to the car we called the police as we were threatened with them being called on us so we needed to make sure we were not in trouble with the law before we left. I gave the officer the hotel also made a report of what happened with the management. So I paid for another night in a room I wasn’t at and we have stayed at this motel before and had no problems. We will never stay here again and will never refer people to this place.

author: pamo654
title: Slept fine, upkeep leaves a lot to be desired
text: We slept fine, which is all we needed to do. But, the walls were poorly painted -- one section about six inches high and about two feet long was white, on an otherwise dark brown wall. The curtains were worn, with visible holes. The hair dryer mount was about to fall off the wall - only a few threads of the screw were holding it up. The little coffee maker didn't work, no matter which outlet we tried using. The lovely lobby area shown in the photos doesn't seem to actually exist. I mean, maybe it does, somewhere, but I sure didn't see it. What I did see was paneling on the wall behind the front desk that looked to be about 50 years old, as well as messy back room stuff that no one wants to see -- that's what doors are for. Our room was on the second floor, right next to the entry-way, so when I looked out the window, I could see that the roof of the entrance wasn't shingled. The layout of the building is cramped and awkward, but that's a whole different issue. The problems above are simple, basic maintenance and courtesy issues that should be no-brainers for motel management. But apparently, that's not the case. So, let me spell it out: do a proper and complete paint job on your walls. Shingle your roofs. Close your custodian/ janitor closet doors. Mount your little appliances securely - especially the ones that are right next to the sink. Replace broken stuff.

author: /undefined
title: going downhill
text: We stayed here in July, and it was not a wonderful place, but it was adequate. Not so now. The toilet was so loose that it clanked every time an adult sat down or arose. The grandchildren (ages 2, 6 & 9) were frightened of it because of its lack of stability. There were signs posted that they were looking for a desk clerk, a night auditor, and housekeeping. In July there was a competent, hard-working desk clerk who was berated by the on-site manager in my hearing. She is not there now, and I cannot blame her. The manager and his wife seemed to be all or nearly all of the current staff. The room seemed to have been recently repainted, but by someone who had no idea of what they were doing, with wall paint on the edges of the ceiling. The outlet covers had not been removed for painting. The mattresses need to be replaced. The carpet was filthy. Super 8's used to be acceptable, tho not fancy. Not so now. We will find another place to stay in Sioux Falls in the future.

author: JohnfaeHuntly
title: Clean spacious rooms but dark corridors and unhelpful staff
text: We struggled to find a vacancy at a hotel in Sioux Falls for a Saturday night at the end of June and this was one of the few we could secure at a week's notice. The photos of the exterior of the hotel on the web looked inviting enough but actually the hotel is situated in a fairly run-down industrial area and has quite a down-beat appearance. When booking online I asked for an upstairs room if possible but we were given one down a flight of stairs from reception. The room was at the end of a long dark corridor - very depressing. It turned out that despite the flight of stairs the room was on the ground floor - something to do with the lie of the sloping site - and the room itself was very clean and a good size though it was dark during daylight hours even with all the lights turned on. There was a clean medium sized well-lit bathroom. WiFi reception in the room was virtually non-existent. I had to go to reception to get a signal on my phone and on my tablet and then the signal kept dropping out for no reason. The staff were completely indifferent to the wifi problem and tried to imply that it was my fault! Generally I found staff off-hand and while not actually rude they had little idea of customer service. This hotel is generally dark and depressing. Most of the other guests the night we were there were young men - big and boisterous though always polite - making for a slightly intimidating atmosphere, though I'm quite sure that the young men in question were not deliberately being intimidating. Continental breakfast is served on tables in the small reception area. We did not try it, preferring to eat at a local restaurant where the food and service were good and wifi reliable! If you need a one night stop-over in Sioux Falls this is a good enough hotel: full marks for cleanliness if nothing else. It also has the benefit of being very close to the interstate system and to other local amenities. However it is anything but welcoming and I would not recommend it for a longer stay.

author: lisamQ5874VB
title: Need to be at the airport very early?
text: We arrived in Sioux Falls with no advance reservation on Labor Day weekend. There was a Lifelight Christian Concert the same weekend and all the area hotels were booked. We did find accommodations at this Super 8 that we were grateful to have. There was a microwave and a nice new refrigerator in the room. The t.v. was also new. The owners are very determined to improve the property and are making significant investments to improve it. Some rooms are better than others and you can be moved if necessary. My impression is that it was once a smoking motel and may have had a dampness problem but they are turning that around. If you suffer from severe allergies and arrive during a downpour you may experience some dampness. Try to get an upper level room if that is the case; if you have children with asthma or allergies. We did have a dog with us, as well as a cat, which were accepted without a major charge or a hassle. I can not say this for all places that we stayed on our summer vacation this year. The breakfast available was waffles, fruit, cereal, yogurt, bear claws and bread for toast and bagels. There was not an egg, breakfast meat selection but everything was fresh and clean. This was a good stay for the value. I needed to get my husband to the airport by 4:30 a.m. and I was there and back so quick that I was able to easily get back to sleep. Keep in mind that the motel is in a state of being improved or renovated and your stay should be fine.

author: dviant
title: You CAN judge a book by the cover
text: well here we go again ..... When you cant tell a up and running motel from one the has failed Maybe that's a hint to stay some where else ..... Curb appeal .......Zero Over grown weeds, and bushes Garbage in the parking lot ..... So we spend the better part of 40 days a year on the road ..... I feel I have earned my stripes ...... you know how some cars are called 30 footers ... at 30 ft they are great Well we checked in ,We had the lower level (basement) the carpet seemed Damp the Sheets had stains on them ,,, and pubic hair in the bed ... I do understand that it may have fallen off of Housekeeping..... stay with me ..... Stained towels not 1 or 2 but all of them , we get this uneasy vibe ,,,,, but stayed anyways The shower ceiling had a hole big enough to but your fist in , it looked like it was fixed with Marshmallow fluff ,,,, Its nice to see that people from a 3rd world country have brought their carpentry skills to the USA! The Wi-Fi was slow when it worked Some rooms have refrigerator and some don't same with Microwaves we stayed there 2 days ... NO not consectulivilty .... it was a little better the second time ,,,, And on top of that I was hashed about walking down the hall with a cocktail in my hand ....... I am 50 years old ..... Quiet going to the vending machine ...... No-No-No,, you may not have that out of your room ....... So seriously take your money go to the Days inn ....just avoid this debacle Peace ,,,,,,,,,, Yee ya!! Big D

author: 104geraldr
title: OMG NASTY FILTHY OVER PRICED FOR YOU GET
text: This location should be removed from being a Super 8!!! Nastiest Super 8 I have ever been in... Rooms are filthy... smell like smoke, urine, moldy even.... Checked in... got into room... water in the bathroom floor... tub over half full of water that looked like it's been there a few weeks... Mini refrigerator was full of mold.. gagged when I opened the door.... Went to front desk and checked out.... Had to argue to get refund.... pointed at the Cities Health Certificate and told them I was going to call them immediately.... refund was quickly made... Folks.... run don't walk.... drive right on by, don't look back..... Just pathetic for being a Super 8...

author: /undefined
title: Screwed up trip
text: I made an online reservation for the Super8 on East 10th in Sioux Falls, SD with note to hold for late arrival since I was traveling from Colorado. I didn't have to worry as they had no record of the reservation at all and none of the other Super8 motels had it either. It took me over an hour but at 1:45am I finally found a room at one of your compeditors. I should have just stayed there but made the mistake of calling in to your 800# to let them know what happened and that 1) there better be no charge for a reservation you guys screwed up and 2) I still needed a room for the last 2 nights I'd be in Sioux Falls. They reserved a King-suite room in the I-90 Super8. I went to check in and they put me in a double queen room. They were going to do nothing until I called the 800# and complained at which point I was moved into a king "suite". Turned out the only difference between a regular king and a king "suite" was the regular king had a fridge and the suite the fridge was traded out for a broken down recliner. Some upgrade guys. On top of that I was given the access password for the Wifi which didn't work. I talked with the gal at the front counter and she indicated they had several wifi domains. I tried them all and none worked. When queried she finally admitted they had been having problems with their wifi domains for a while now. While I'm glad my phone is capable of acting as a hotspot my carrier doesn't have a strong presence out at that location so was reduced from 4g to 2g after engaging their tech support. I wish I could give this rating a -5 as 1 is too good for the experience we had. I was glad about not having a room at the West Russell location as our previous visit there was not the best either. Yes, I visit Sioux Falls regularly to visit family. I will never stay in a Super8 in Sioux Falls again. I have stayed in many Super8 motels over the years and have enjoyed the brand and will continue to in other locations but never in Sioux Falls again.

author: richardz87
title: Room Had No Door Lock - Spooky Stay
text: Wife made and paid for reservation for family room - 2 adults and two children. Shortly before arrival, we called hotel and was advised our reservation was dishonored. Hotel stated that Wyndham reservations and local property do not communicate. After re-contacting Wyndham reservations, they assured us that reservation was corrected. Upon arrival, we had 2 rooms instead of one room, we had 2 rooms. One room did not have a working lock. Staff not helpful, claimed that he would correct lock and then disappeared. Needless to state, we were very uneasy. Blocked door with furniture. Grandson wss spooked. Didn't sleep much. Property is shabby and not clean. At the onset of problems, Wyndham reservations supervisor insured us that they would call next day and further discuss situation. No follow-up call from management. No integrity. No reliability. No good!

author: 405PAULH
title: Nightmare on Cliff Ave
text: By far the worst motel we have ever stayed in. Check-in took a good half hour because desk clerk couldn't figure out how to enter the pet charge so a "co-worker" had to come and help. The room we had reserved was a non-smoking room. They had to physically run around to find a non-smoking room which had been cleaned. We had to get our card keys reset twice because they wouldn't work. Around 8 pm the water in the motel went off and when I went to inquire at the front desk, I was told it would be back on in a half hour. It never came back on so we couldn't bathe, shave or clean up. The noise was terrible. People yelling and running in the halls. Garbage bags in the hallway. The back door was not locked even though a sign said it was locked. Breakfast was very sparse. No waffle batter available, the juice machine was out of order, there was a plastic gallon jug of milk sitting on the counter, etc. When we checked out we asked for our money back and were told we would have to wait for the day manager. We waited and were reimbursed our total expenses. We will never stay in this motel again.

author: /undefined
title: Not so good.
text: This motel needs some serious updating. Window air conditioning and a television manufactured in the early 90's. We paid extra for a king "suite". From what we could tell, the difference between a "regular" room and a "suite" is the recliner they threw into the mix. Very small room - overcrowded with furniture. Asked for extra pillows - first they told us that they didn't have any extra pillows. Then they said they found some and gave us king size pillows with standard size pillowcases. They said they hadn't gotten a chance to order replacements for the pillows and cases that had "walked off" with other guests. Asked for extra towels. They said they didn't have extra towels. Hair from previous guest still in bath tub. Worn (press board?) toilet seat. Desk clerk was a peach! She was the best part of our stay! VERY courteous, friendly lady!

author: ChrisJ358
title: Great price, clean room
text: I stayed here two nights and was very satisfied with the accomodations. The room was clean, and unlike other super 8s, it was not worn out and shabby in its appearance. The desk staff were professional and helpful.Two minor problems with the stay that have nothing to do with the hotel itself. 1. If you're looking for a decent meal, you have to drive quite a way. There is a Perkins nearby... If you like such places. Otherwise, you're left eating gas station cupcakes for dinner. Another note of caution, Sioux Falls is an absolutely dead town on Sunday night. I went downtown for dinner... Only one restaurant out of about ten was open, and it was full of giddy, loud college students. You have to go an extra mile out to the mall area to find anything else when it comes to food. 2. The air force base is nearby, and I could hear some of the military jets quite clearly as late as 10pm. If you are an "early to rise" type, and a light sleeper, you may want to look to the south end of town for a room. Otherwise, a great place.

author: NorthlandTravler
title: Free Goodies
text: If you are looking for a nice place to stay and don't care about a pool - which there is a pool you can use 3 miles down the road - this is a nice place. My 15 year old son was impressed. How many 15 year olds like anything? The room was clean and smelled good. You are given a goodie bag which contains personal hygiene items, a sample bottle of hot sauce (which my son carries with him) and candy. We stayed two nights and received a fresh bag each day. The continental breakfast was not the cheap stuff - they had biscuits with gravy and real waffles. You need to bring your pets. The pets are even given a goodie bag which I was really impressed. They have a decent size walking area for your pet - that is grass covered that is not filled with garbage, rocks or broken glass. There are also picnic tables under trees if you decide to sit outside. There is also a casino next door. There are gas stations and restraurants right in the area. The area is quite as is the motel. This motel was well worth the money.

author: superirons
title: 4* should be 5.
text: One of the best hotels we have stayed in. Our enormous jnr suite at a steal of a price was perfect for us. Large bedroom, separate large sitting room. Enormous bathroom with loo,bidet,twin sinks,drencher shower , and huge circular bath plus a drying tube. The first we’ve encountered. We mostly ate out but once we tried the restaurant we dined there again. 20€ for a choice of three course menu, inc taxes,water,bread and coffee. First class fare. Grilled prawns as an amuse bounce. My husband had a Thai crab savaurin along with a tempura spider crab on a hot stone garnished with dressed leaves, as his starter. Followed by a large rare piece of beef Iand layered bacon and potato, plus creamed potatoes. I opted for spaghetti vegetables poached in olive oil on a creamy cod sauce, sounds odd but was delicious. Followed by chicken cannelloni. Both finished with a beautifully cooked hot chocolate fondant topped with praline ice cream. Along with the recommended local wine our bil came to 59€. We travel a bit and this is the best value for quality we have ever had. We had planned to eat out on our last night but will definitely be eating in the hotel.

author: PauloBaptista
title: Best location to visit the city center
text: This is my favorite place to stay in Pamplona, given its location and standard. The hotel is at the edge of the nice old town, so it takes you 5 to 10 minutes to reach Plaza del Castillo, the very center. Around the hotel, you find nice gardens (Jardines de la Taconera), where you can relax or go for jogging, as I normally do at the end of a working day. Notes for business travelers: the hotel can be easily reached by car, despite the fact it lies in the city’s heart. The hotel staff will bring your car in and own of the garage. Take this in consideration: plan your departure trip! If you are in a hurry to leave in the morning, ask for your car ahead of time, as the procedure sometimes takes longer than you would expect.
