It’s quite difficult to walk around, but the hotel staff will drive you around in golf buggies at a moments notice. The hotel has its own private beach which is a little way through the jungle - not really walkable. It also has two very nice infinity pools. The larger one of the two is where you can sip cocktails at happy hour and listen to music. It’s also where you can enjoy breakfast (which is delicious) whilst watching and listening to the howler monkeys when they are around. The smaller of the pools is where you will see the white faced monkeys in the afternoon running around the pool. The staff make this hotel so special. Every single person (and it is everyone) is helpful, polite and will go out of their way to make your stay as good as it can be. There are restaurants close to the hotel which are just about walkable. Try Emilos, El Avion for the fun factor, Samui Thai. If you want to go to the Marina and eat try Gabrielle’s. If you eat at the marina there is a free shuttle bus which the marina restaurants put on for their diners. The hotel can arrange the restaurant and shuttle bus. Otherwise to travel around it’s normally $10 whether it’s a local trip or to the marina. Staying at the Makanda is a fantastic experience.

author: alysonm589
title: Jungle escape with ocean views
text: If you are looking for the best of Costa Rica (jungle and beach), you should stay at Makanda by the Sea. First, our room was spectacular. We stayed in the deluxe suite ocean club which had a comfy canopy bed, balcony and living area, and huge, clean bathroom. We were located in the jungle but we had amazing ocean views from our room. Plus,every day we saw monkeys from our balcony and even had a few of them come on our balcony which was awesome. It was a true Costa Rican experience. The property is gorgeous. The pool and the views from the pool cannot even be described. Just beautiful. Most importantly, the staff was extremely friendly and attentive. Any time we needed something, they were always quick to help. Special shout out to Louis for being the best bartender. Finally, the Makanda is close to town so you can easily walk or catch a cab to check out local restaurants. We had the best vacation and a lot of it had to do with the Makanda. Thank you for an amazing experience and stay.

author: kc328106
title: Stunning Hotel-a few tips and suggestions for improvement
text: Beautiful resort! The views are incredible and you will see a lot of wild life around the hotel. The rooms are beautiful, modern and have large balconies. Friendly staff. Feel very safe at the property. Close to many bars and restaurants but keep in mind it is an uphill walk and there are no sidewalks. Traveler Tips- The resort has two pools, however, both are shaded for most of the day. The resort has a small private beach, but do yourself a favor and walk to the public beach. It is large and beautiful! It is a 10 minute "hike" (mostly downhill) so plan to wear good shoes and taxi back. The food at the resort is delicious but food and drinks are more expensive on the property than in the town. When going offsite: La luna=beatiful sunset views, Emelios face= cute, good view, great desserts, La Avion= beautiful sunset view (crowded), Cafe Milagro= good food Hotel suggestions for improvement- The balcony door has bug proof features, which is great, however, the front door to the room does not have this feature which seems a bit counter intuitive. Included breakfast is a nice feature, however, the offerings could be improved. Would love to see a traditional Costa Rican breakfast on the menu as well as some simple healthy options (perhaps oatmeal, yogurt, American breakfast of eggs/potatoes/and meat) An ipad is used to process all transactions which can be awkward. Signing for the included breakfast should not be necessary.

author: JLev860
title: DREAM COME TRUE!
text: Everything that I’m writing in this review is 100% how I feel.. no fabrication, no bull-ish! Hotel Makanda was easily the best hotel/resort that I have ever stayed in my entire life! The staff treated us as if we were family. From the moment we entered Makanda they made us feel like it was our second home. They tended to every need of ours with love and compassion. The views and scenery of the hotel were breathtaking to say the least! Never in my life have I experienced more beautiful scenic views. Looking out into the horizon you are able to sit and think about life, about the ups and downs, about everything you’ve been through, it gives you clarity, and that peace of mind. You could easily lose track of time just taking in the beauty of the views. I’m not going to lie, I was a little nervous about staying in the middle of the jungle but the way they had everything set up made me feel safe and protected. Just imagine this, a hotel placed in the middle of the jungle, Monkeys swinging in the distance, sloths hanging in the trees, exotic birds chirping, and the calming sound of small waterfalls hitting the water that simply puts your mind at ease.. the rooms were immaculate! Nice appliances, technology was up to date. 8 of us stayed here and not a single one of us ever had a complaint about the room. The food was very satisfying , many options... even if something wasn’t on the menu they tried their best effort to make whatever we desired. You get the sense that they are super appreciative to have you staying at their resort. I could go on forever but I’ll simply leave you with this statement, I can’t wait to be back!

author: audioearl
title: "An outstanding resort!"
text: Makanda by the Sea, popped up on my search, when I was looking for a place to stay for a short vacation, and it did not disappoint! Since I work at a major resort in Las Vegas, and have stayed in many hotels, motels, and huts on a beach, I know a few things about hospitality. Once I got there (long story), Leo Carvajal, whom I had been texting on, and off, met me when I arrived. After a short golf cart ride, I was given a detailed tour of the studio, that was located very close to the infinity pool bar! This was an upgrade, and felt just right. After a day or so, I asked for recommendations on places to go , restaurants, downtown, shopping, and the National Park. All the staff, no matter whom I asked, was very helpful, with tons of knowledge. The resort itself, is VERY steep in certain areas, and you need good shoes, if you do not take the golf carts. Rain, and leaves, make it a bit of a challenge navigating the walkways, especially at night. Breakfast was served in the pavilion where diner is, vice the main pool, which was drained, and under maintenance during my stay. I would serve in there all the time! All of the meals at the pool, my studio, or the restaurant were incredibly good. The staff, housekeeping, bartenders, groundskeepers, security, and front office, were above, and beyond. Location to small bars, and a supermarket, are a 15 minute, up hill walk, as are the local beaches. Overall, Makanda by the Sea is, in my opinion, one of the top three, (and I have stayed at quite a few) resorts. Plus, all the staff, referring to you by your first name, is always heart warming! Thank you.

author: 91KU
title: Beautiful, Unique and Very Friendly!
text: My husband and I chose Makanda by the Sea through Trip Advisor and had an amazing stay! From the moment we drove onto the property we were wowed! You feel like you are deep in the rainforest, but when you arrive at your room, you see the beautiful view of the ocean! The rooms are very well appointed and modern. We enjoyed both pools, the saltwater pool was right outside our room and very convenient. The staff was amazing! They accommodated our every need, but honestly, we didn't have many, everything was already in place upon our arrival! Darwin and Jacqueline greeted us at registration and were able to let us into our room early which was great. Robert and Chris chatted and educated us and "called" the whiteface monkeys in for our entertainment at the sushi/bar at the saltwater pool and felt like friends when we left. Christian (is awesome!!) and Brian are expert golf cart drivers, on the varying elevations we were grateful they were always near by. We also used the spa and each got massages, we were the last appointment for the day, so we felt like we didn't quite get the level of service we would have if we had an earlier appointment. The actual massages were good, but we were not offered a private location to change or the typical robes most spas offer. That would be the only negative to our stay. We, sadly, ended up leaving a day early due to traveling back to San Jose, and Amanda called in a gentleman (I don't remember his name) and he offered us a "comp" on our additional services, it was too late to get a full refund for our last night, but we were pleased with his offer. Don't hesitate to book at Makanda!

author: grantsX2913ZK
title: A Honeymoon We’ll Never Forget
text: My wife and I had the pleasure of staying at the Makanda for 5 nights during our honeymoon. We stayed in a luxury villa (Villa 9) which has its own pool. The pool is shared with the upstairs villa and is absolutely beautiful. The room was very modern, clean, and comfortable with luxurious upgrades throughout. We felt very private and were surrounded by jungle making the stay feel very intimate. The hotel is absolutely stunning. The main restraraunt/bar pool and hot tub was large with multiple seating areas and had a beautiful view to watch sunsets from. The saltwater pool with swim up sushi bar had an even more breathtaking view of the ocean where we even were able to see whales. The facilities were amazing and made it hard to leave on the days that the hotel assisted planning fun excursions. The staff not only genuinely cared about you enjoying your stay at the hotel, but in Costa Rica as a whole. You could tell they really were excited to share their love for the country with the guests. Amanda was an amazing hostess that seemed to read our minds, being there before we could even ask. She made incredible drinks too! Amanda also went out of her way to help us capture pictures throughout our stay and chatted with us while we enjoyed the pools and hot tubs. Alex was another staff member that went out of his way to provide a great experience for us. He welcomed us daily with a big smile and funny story. He had great recommendations and took care of everything we needed. Luis also made us feel very welcome with good conversation and was helpful anytime we needed something. We cannot wait to visit Makanda again and hope to see the same faces when we do as we consider them friends now after having made us feel so welcome. We would absolutely recommend Makanda to friends as the best hotel in Manuel Antonio.

author: 563borisc
title: Great for couples and honeymooners
text: Stayed for 2 nights on Jacuzzi suite 7. The hotel is very well kept. Our room, the swimming pools and restaurant have awesome sunset, ocean and jungle views. Perhaps the best feature of the whole place. Our room was amazing. We have never enjoyed jacuzzis, they are usually poorly set up or are just not inviting. This one is awesome. Highly recommend it. Only con is the lighting, it is a bit cheesy. Pools are top notch. Food is very good, although it is not outstanding. Imp info: not a place for kids or the elderly. If you need assistance walking, think about it, ask questions. There are steep ramps and a lot of stairs. If you are going in your honeymoon or a special romantic occasion, go for one of the elite rooms. Totally worth it. 👍🏻 Expect a bit of wildlife, monkeys, birds and mosquitoes.

author: rachelwJ4490GJ
title: Weird hotel
text: Well, I’ll start by saying that it is probably the nicest hotel near Manuel Antonio. And that the rooms were spacious, clean and expensively furnished. In general, it is easy to tell that much thought and expense has gone in to the design of this hotel. I will also say that that the restaurant staff were very helpful and the food was delicious. Having said that - I found this hotel very strange. Very post-modern in terms of decor. The hotel rooms have no garbage bins. The bathrooms are beautiful but completely impractical. No shower door means water gets everywhere- I slipped and fell in the middle of the night. Speaking of which, the strange elevated pathways between rooms, restaurant and pool area are steep and slippery. Anyone with any kind of difficulty walking cannot possibly navigate this property. The guy at the front desk is a jerk - very offensive, sexist, homophobic. He was so afraid of being taken advantage of that he threatened us about things like stealing towels, sneaking off without paying, etc. I’m sure these things happen, but it set up a pretty uncomfortable feeling, just arriving for our stay. Certainly not what one would expect, checking in to a high end hotel.

author: christinedW8830TD
title: Honeymoon Vacation at Makanda
text: Our stay at Makanda was absolutely amazing!! After a hectic wedding just a couple of days before we were greeted at the resort by friendly and warm staff that helped bring all of our luggage and belongings up to our room. When we got to the room we were speechless, it was even more beautiful than the pictures we had seen on the website!! Everything inside was beautiful, the furniture, decor etc. We loved that we could have breakfast in our room if we wanted to which came in handy some mornings! The resort itself was absolutely breathtaking, it is literally right in the middle of the rain forest which was amazing as we saw white faced monkeys, sloths, indigenous insects and more! We didn't even have to go off the property see animals which we loved. The grounds were beautiful, every staff member was friendly, accommodating and welcoming. My husband and I felt that we were the only ones at the resort. The swim up sushi bar was our favorite, it was the best sushi we have ever had!! The pools were beautiful and the food at the restaurants was amazing. There really is not anything negative to say about this resort, we will definitely be coming back! We did ziplining, horseback riding, toured Manuel Antonio National Park and also went on the catamaran which was a lot of fun, we recommend all of those activities! Playa Manuel Antonio and Playa Espadilla del Sur were also beautiful and a must visit when coming to Quepos, Costa Rica. My husband had left his phone in one of the cab's, we for sure thought the phone was gone and this would dampen our vacation. We went right to the front desk and they were on it immediately, calling different cab drivers and my husband got his phone back somehow! We were so grateful at the effort the staff went to to try and resolve this problem. Anything we needed the staff was more than happy to help us, including calling a taxi, driving us in the golf cart to the private beach or just simply answering questions that we had about Costa Rica and the area in general. Makanda made our honeymoon and we are so happy that we chose to stay there. We will absolutely be coming back to beautiful Costa Rica, especially Makanda!

author: catelyn0829
title: Beautiful tree-house paradise!
text: The hotel and staff were so warm and welcoming. My husband and I arrived on a rainy evening and were warmly greeted at check in. We were very impressed by the modern styling of the room and the resort grounds were well kept. The resort was designed to fit into the side of the hill resulting in a tree-house like feeling. The rooms are very clean and the beds/pillows were very comfortable. Every staff member that we met was friendlier than the next. Both pools were great and had beautiful views of the ocean. They aren't kidding when they say the trip to the beach is steep! Though they offer rides in the golf cart, we welcomed the challenge and decided to walk it. The beach is a beautiful, peaceful volcanic sand/rock beach, though it didn't seem well suited for swimming. We ended up going to the National Park and Playa Biesanz to swim in the ocean. When we booked our trip, we were skeptical that the three nights were worth the expense, but it SO WAS! I would highly recommend this hotel. My only suggestion for future travelers, who are foodies like me, is to venture offsite for meals, especially dinner. While the food was fine, it wasn't impressive especially for the cost and it didn't seem to offer many local dishes. Though I have to say the different juice offering each morning at breakfast was lovely.

author: pjbb2014
title: Marvelous Makanda!
text: My husband and I stayed in one of the Villas at Makanda by the Sea for a romantic getaway and this property did not disappoint! All of the staff is wonderful and treats all the guests as family going out of their way to help in any way possible. The rooms themselves are incredible! Very spacious, furnished with modern yet warm decor and are spotless. The views...at least from our room were spectacular and private. There is nothing better than waking up to the sounds and sights of nature to start the day off right. From Howler monkeys to Toucans....you will see it all. The property itself is not large but has 2 gorgeous pools, each with fantastic views. We preferred the salt water, ocean club pool but neither is a bad choice to relax, have some food/drinks and meet new friends. We did not have the resort drop us off at the beach they use but we did go to Playa Biesanz down the road which was a beautiful cove and perfect for sunning and swimming. There are locals who offer chairs/umbrellas, kayaks, paddle boards, drinks and food which were all good. The lower the tide, the more beach there is. The beaches of Manuel Antonio are also a short drive away but can get crowded (closed on Mondays). Since we were there to mainly relax we did not do any of the action excursions that are available...but there are so many things available near this resort you can stay busy for days. We did hire a guide who took us on a private walk through Manuel Antonio showing us SO many animals through a scope and taking pictures so your pics look straight out of National Geographic....hire the guide, well worth it or you'll miss so much. They leave you at the beach so you can enjoy the beaches on your own. I highly recommend this resort and doubt I would stay anywhere else in this area of Costa Rica! Thank you to the wonderful staff again for making our stay so special! PS....there are plenty of good restaurants near the resort for lunch or dinner....the resort breakfast is perfect to start the day!

author: greggowee
title: Amazing accommodations, but keep an eye on your things, they are not safe...
text: I came here with my girlfriend at the time back when she met up with me in Costa Rica while I was traveling for the month. The accommodations are very modern and upscale. I am pretty technologically savvy, however I found the lighting controls a little confusing and/or didn't work. The bathroom is very chic. We had a private pool which was amazing, except it was a little cold. The reason I am rating one star is because my ex left her phone on the table outside near the private pool. The room sat on a cliff so the only way someone could have got to that area would be to climb up from the side or a ladder. Well, we left the room to go to the pool/bar area and when we got back her phone was missing. We retraced our steps and couldn't find it anywhere. We told the front desk and they ask their employees and they said the never saw it. The front desk guy then told us that the pool cleaner uses a ladder to climb up the side of the building to clean the pool. We assume that he took it but we could not be certain. When we checked out, my ex met with the owner, so I am not sure what was said, but when she came back my ex told me she was getting some money back or something. But originally the owner was giving her a hard time about giving her anything back. The hotel is very luxurious and even has its own private beach. But you have to track down a jungle first to get to it, meaning you need to track back up it when you want to go back to the room. Additionally, we wanted to get a couples massage while we were here, however the hotel could not find 2 masseuses. The hotel could only find one, so I had to wait for my ex to get her massage before I could get mine. This wasted an hour of the day, and I'm sure the masseuse was tired by the time she got to me. This place has a lot of potential, however lack in seriously important areas...

author: brucec678
title: A stunning boutique that earns its WiFi Password... "Personal Paradise"
text: We just returned from four superb nights at MBTS and I'm experiencing the pain of withdrawal. The hotel is stunning and the service was outstanding. After starting our CR trip with a lovely three-night visit to the Arenal volcano and hot springs area at a high-quality, pleasant, family-friendly resort, we were delighted to upgrade our experience to this luxurious boutique (adults only) hotel. Arriving after a long ride, we were met at the impressive, secured entrance by a friendly, welcoming staffer who took our bags and ran us by cart to Reception. We were immediately struck by the dramatic property - like many hotels in the area, it is built into the cliff and positioned to offer numerous breathtaking views of the Pacific. We were also immediately struck by the beauty and thoughtfulness of the contemporary design reflected in every aspect of the architecture, finishes and fixtures. From Reception to the pools, to the restaurant, to our room in the Ocean Club (highly recommended) we felt like we stumbled into the hidden lair of a James Bond villain (without any ominous overtones). The "17 favorite photos" does a wonderful job of capturing the feel. The staff was uniformly warm, friendly and accommodating. The included breakfast was amazing and other food and drink options excellent (the sushi and ceviche at the salt-water pool, in particular, extraordinary). We had one very good dinner on the property and the remaining in the nearby business district (as mentioned by others, Emilio's was our absolute favorite for friendly food and great coffee/desserts with breathtaking views - although the Manuel Antonio Falafel Bar was also fantastic for "cheap eats"). I could go on and on. My partner raved about her spa treatments and we saw more wildlife at breakfast and happy hour than on any nature tour. My only caution is that this boutique (27 rooms but feels like less) is for a sense of solitude - if you are looking for a teeming, high-energy, heavily populated summer-camp feel, you might want a larger resort. If you want rest, relaxation, privacy and a feeling of pampered exclusivity, Makanda by the Sea is for you.

author: A2288DTkellyg
title: Perfect honeymoon
text: My husband and I researched for days on where to go in Costa Rica for our honeymoon. Eventually, during an in-depth Google Maps search, we came upon Hotel Makanda and thought it would be the perfect place to stay during our week in Manuel Antonio in March 2018. From start to finish, our visit was top-notch, with the staff still feeling approachable. We LOVED the staff and feel that they are our lifelong friends. We arrived before check-in, and Luis greeted us at the main pool / restaurant where we were given a lovely bottle of bubbly rose and then ordered some delicious ceviche served in a hollowed out coconut. Once we arrived to our room with the wonderful Jorge, it felt exactly like the photos, but better. The view was incredible, and we were so excited to be able to spend seven nights here. We tried the restaurant on the first night. Sadly, I wasn't super impressed with my pork belly, as it was a bit on the dry side, but the tuna tar tar was out of this world -- we ordered it two more times after the first night. Each night, we took part in the happy hour at the pool, which is a great 2-for-1 deal. We would spend some of our mornings by the salt water pool, which has a glorious view of the ocean, lined with jungle foliage. The sushi bar there is fantastic. We loved chatting there with Chris (who also served us breakfast most of the mornings we were there). His English was very good, and he helped my husband, who is on a mission to learn Spanish, learn more Spanish words throughout the week. He was very patient with us, and we feel like we got to know him well. The breakfasts were wonderful! We woke up pretty early every morning and really enjoyed our short walk down to the pool where we got to look forward to a plate full of fresh fruit, a new juice concoction created with love by TJ, and a large and delicious breakfast. I feel like I could go on about specific details, but I'll just leave it at this: we 100% recommend this hotel and would go back any time. Our memories from our honeymoon are nothing but positive, and it's due in large part to our time at Makanda.

author: MrSleath
title: Makanda Ruined Our Honeymoon - Beware
text: To set the scene. We were married last week and after a week travelling through Costa Rica for our Honeymoon, we reserved a two night stay at Makanda as a final treat at the end of the trip before returning to London. First, the positives. The resort itself is beautiful and immaculately designed. The location is great, the wine offering well balanced, and the private beach a dramatically peaceful juxtaposition of volcanic soil and beautiful colours from the jungle. Some of the staff are absolutely wonderful and really will do all they can to improve your stay. My apologies for not being able to recite their names, but the restaurant manager and the sushi chef were shining examples of customer service. The reason for this review however, is that Makanda ruined our honeymoon. I shall do my utmost to keep emotion out of this and instead focus on the events as they transpired and leave the readers to draw their own conclusions. We booked a suite (you can see photos on here for what is promised), but in short, a design suite, complete with terrace and stunning design features. What we got was (in no particular order) What we Didn’t get No Terrace – though we did get a collection of workman's tools left outside – see pictures A non functioning shower – After repeated requests the manager came to take a look, and conceded he'd never been in this room before and couldn’t work out the shower use either. No Wifi in the room – out of embarrassment the manager kindly let us use their reception office network. Nowhere to hang our clothes No turndown/ maid service (no toiletries, towels et al) What we did get A free 'wet room' shower – assuming you can use one arm to hold a button down, and don’t mind it alternating at free will between two shower heads and soaking the entire room, then leaking into the bedroom – you got this included A soaked bedroom – see above Fit and finish – You could slice your hand on any of the bare rough wood surfaces used to 'decorate' (see photos) Free tools – they kindly left us a saw and some scaffolding outside our room. I assume this in case you wanted to finish the room during your stay. The most galling part of the entire experience was being charged $600 per night (later discounted after repeated protests) for a room which was an unfinished disaster that was clearly purposed for temporarily housing staff. At the pity of two other couples, they felt so bad on seeing our cell (sorry, 'room') that they offered to switch rooms with us to try and save our last night of honeymoon. The hotel offered us a couple's massage as remediation for this, which we declined. A massage doesn’t really fix this sort of pain. In defence of the hotel, The manager then reduced our room rate (though still charged) and offered to pickup our consumables during the stay for two days. It's tough to find a positive in this experience, so I'll conclude by sharing some of the pictures and let you make up your own mind.

author: nikki3030
title: Not the Costa Rica Nice that I am used to.
text: We arrived at the resort late and were not impressed with the check in process. Our private driver was not allowed in so we had to walk to the office while our bags were left at the main gate. We were not given a tour or a map of the property. After check in we were immediately taken to our room. . It took almost an hour to get our luggage and we sat in this room with no idea where anything was. Eventually my husband walked up a crazy hill (The incline is no joke) to bring the luggage down himself. The front desk offered a golf cart to help with the hill yet half of the time we called they did not answer the phone. There is also no staff or golf carts available from 11-7. The food at the restaurant was very good although I wish there would have been snack options as this resort does not have a gift shop. The pools were very nice and warm. One of the pools closes as 6pm which was a bummer. The main thing missing from this hotel is hospitality. I have been to Costa Rica several times and this was abundant at the other hotel and not this one. Also this resort does not have handrails and the lighting is poor. Both my mother and I fell during our stay. Be cautious if you have any limitations. The golf cart was not always available and when we called several times the phone was not answered.

author: ABA878
title: It’s all about the gloss
text: This hotel nestles very near Manuel Antonio national park. It has rooms built into the hillside over looking the sea. All rooms I am told have an ocean view. On arrival, we had to wait by the security barrier as our taxi appeared not to be allowed to pass. We had to wait for a golf buggy to transport us to reception. We were greeted by a friendly guy called Michael. Michael seemed to be trying to help other customers on the phone and in person whilst giving us pertinent information on the hotel, N.b. No useful information in the room. We arrived after check in time, however the room wasn’t ready as Michael explained, because of staff sickness. We were tired and rather fractious when we were eventually informed our room was ready. We were taken to our room by a young guy who really didn’t seem very interested. The room was clean, complete with ocean view, a view of the lower half of the pool and DIY equipment. All the pretentious gadgets going are here including the fingertip recognition safe which doesn’t recognise your fingertip! It took three attempts to get bathrobes, oh and a boring old key to lock the super dooper safe! This hotel has the look of wow. But it is people that matter. Front of desk are the first point of contact for guests. Michael did his best and he recommended a great restaurant. Raphael on the terrace.

author: 955daleh
title: Designer's dream
text: I've been visiting the Manuel Antonio area for 25 years. This is my first year to stay at this hotel, although we were able to visit the pools and restaurant several times last year during our New Year's holiday. We booked an Ocean Club Suite, which was a new room, and my parents had a Villa with a private pool. The beds are soooo comfy and the huge rooms are nice cooled to your desired temp. The design of every aspect of this hotel from the smallest details, is absolutely unbelievable (and extremely Instagramable!). The pool has relaxing chill music playing and every view we had at both rooms and both pools were stunning. There is plenty of shade for those of us who are a bit pale, and great spots in the sun for those of us who enjoy a good tan. We saw 3 species of monkeys, a sloth, countless birds, and reptiles. The service is second to none, Luis and Emerson are THE best bartenders and will keep your glasses full while you're hanging out at the pool. I highly recommend the watermelon juice! Everything is made fresh. The restaurant, Arbol, is also new this year. You cannot believe the design and decor, it WILL be featured in a design magazine this year, I predict! My husband and I had a couples massage at the spa, and those ladies were incredible and strong! If you are looking for a traditional hotel, this is not for you. If you appreciate details, design, and modern, high tech amenities, you need to stay here. We appreciate that it is adult only to ensure a relaxing experience.

author: MiltonsHilton
title: Incredible hotel with a few growing pains
text: I just got back from a two night stay at the Makenda By The Sea hotel. First off, the honeymoon suite is to die for. Architecture work is better than I've seen even in America. Her is the good and the bad. Good: The hotel is fully renovated. Most all rooms are near New and have great design. The woodwork is beyond comprehension and the design is phenomenal. The staff is amazing. Very happy too. The restaurant and most suites overlook the bay and have million dollar views. Parking is also good within the hotel. It's very close to the marina and all the other hotels but you feel like you are the only hotel on the mountain due to dense forest. There are a ton of monkeys and a few exotic birds and sloths on the property. Bad: The dinner was not that great. The appetizer was very good but the main meal was just not that great. The view and decor more than made up for it though. Make sure you stay on the top suite of any room. The lower ones don't have much privacy and we found the curtains had to be closed to keep the shared pool guests from seeing into our room. Not very well thought out. Final thoughts: I'd go back in a heart beat if we stayed in the honeymoon villa.

author: V3612TV_
title: Sweet dreams come true
text: A beautiful hotel in the jungle - well, is not it a miracle! Stunning species, diversity of flora and fauna. Sometimes when you walk alone all the sounds of civilization simply disappear and you find yourself alone with nature and the sky. You can feel yourself a participant of the expedition right here on the territory of Makanda. But your expedition will be very comfortable, because you will sleep on white sheets and in a soft bed, you will have fabulous dishes right in the restaurant on the tree. Exotic animals will become your friends. Just need to stand still and look carefully. Makanda staff are all local residents of Costa Rica Tiko. After communicating with them you begin to smile, the problems recede because they will someday lose their significance, Pura Vida. I heard that this hotel is many years old, but now it is being repaired, so there are sometimes some noises. But they are part of life. You understand that here people live and also work. This is normal. Ah, yes, here's amazing sushi and a small bar right in the pool! Girls, interiors and design of rooms, swimming pools and of course the jungle and the beach - this is our place for selfie and photo shoots. The team of Makanda, Thank you for making our vacation comfortable and secluded! PS And thanks for the reliable guards

author: NJain27
title: Beautiful hotel and very secluded room midst nature
text: We stayed here for a night when we visited Manuel Antonio Park. We got a studio. It was completely secluded with a lot of privacy. The room was incredibly comfortable and beautifully decorated. The bed was so comfortable. We spent the evening at the pool before having dinner at pool side. The infinitely pool has an amazing view and plenty spots to chill in and around the pool. The restaurant was next to the pool and food was great. We also visited the spa to get a massage under the starry night. The spa was still under construction when we visited. Management people were really helpful and nice. We saw quite a few animals and birds there as well. They do their part in preserving nature and reducing their impact and don't disturb the animals as much as possible. Their private beach is very rocky but it's beautiful, serene and secluded. It's a perfect romantic getaway.

author: 513alicia
title: BEST HOTEL EXPERIENCE
text: My husband and I chose to stay at Makanda by the Sea for our 5th year anniversary. The day we checked in it was raining and we arrived earlier than expected. From the moment we went into the gate everyone we were treated like family. As we were checking in they heard that it was our fifth year anniversary and decided to treat us on our stay. We went to the pool to receive our welcome drinks when not soon after the property manager met us at our table to let us know that we had been upgraded to one of the best rooms in the entire hotel. The rooms are incredible, it was by far one of the nicest hotels we have stayed in before. My husband and I were able to relax and enjoy great food and loved seeing all the wild life- monkeys and birds- up close. The details that they put into the hotel is incredible. Our room was beautifully decorated and secluded. We had beautifully hand carved doors that lead us to our hotel room. We felt like we were in our own house on a mountain side. The pool and lounge areas are beautiful and the staff is so nice! We ate amazing, fresh food and enjoyed talking with all the staff who worked there. If we return to Manuel Antonio we will definitely stay here again and will always recommend this to our family and friends who might ever visit. Thanks Makanda for making our stay so wonderful!!

author: hector1164
title: Marvelous resort with great service
text: We just returned home after spending 3 nights in Villa 5. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. The resort is beautiful, luxurious and very relaxing. It's adults only, which we appreciated. Our villa was secluded and private, surrounded by lush vegetation, with a mostly private terrace. Monkeys, sloths, birds, iguanas, lizards, butterflies can be found on the property. Beautifully designed buildings, stunning views of the ocean and rainforest, The staff was suberb: Jorge (helped with luggage upon arrival and when leaving), Alvaro, Robert, TeeJay, and another Jorge (breakfast, cocktails, sushi and towels by the pool). The staff kept checking on us to see if we needed anything without being obtrusive. We felt pampered. And I don't want to forget Luis, the guard at the security entrance, who was friendly and social. We did not check out the beach nor try the Arbol restaurant for dinner, as we had decided to try some of the restaurants in town. We asked for a late checkout and luckily, they were able to accommodate us. One small issue that we raised turned out to not be an issue at all, but someone came to our villa within 5 minutes of our call. Great service. A small word of caution: the tiles around the main pool can be slippery when they are wet, so be careful when walking around or getting out of the pool. The stairs behind the restrooms by the main pool could be better illuminated at night. We hope to return to Manuel Antonio again, and we'll definitely stay here again. thank you, Makanda staff!

author: HIborn
title: Trip of a lifetime
text: This review is very late in being submitted. We had the immense pleasure of staying at Makanda the end of August. From the minute we set foot on the property, we were amazed. They did an incredible job of incorporating this lovely, boutique hotel into the jungle. Everyone we encountered from the front desk to the cleaning ladies were so friendly and helpful. Our room and view were beyond words. Honestly, the minute the gentleman that showed us what we needed to see in our room left, I bawled. I was so overwhelmed with the beauty of what i was seeing. It felt like a dream. We spent quite a bit of time in the infinity pool by our room, so we had a lot of interaction with the guys that worked at the lower pool. Roberth, Jorge, Jose, Alberto ( I know I'm leaving people out, I'm sorry) were so much fun to spend the day with. We went on a couple tours in the morning and then would come back and spend the rest of the day in the pool. Drinking and eating sushi and ceviche! They recommended places to see and eat beyond the typical tourist spots. My guy and I were so grateful for the wonderful hospitality we received here. We definitely will return here in the future!

author: 849rebekahr
title: Smells bad and sexually harassed by staff
text: I arrived at Makanda, and was taken to a villa that smelled like something had died in the pipes. The stench was horrible, until I got to change rooms to the one beside it that smelled so much better. I will say, the architecture is incredible, but thats it. As for the food, The fish tasted like rubberl. Also, because of the construction and slopes, I saw a few guests fall down while walking to their rooms. Yes they have golf carts, but I was scared for my life the first two nights and couldn't sleep because the golf cart driver literally harassed me and said I had a nice butt, and would wait for me after his shift ended at 9pm so he could take me to town. I literally could not sleep because I was all by myself and the hotel gets super dark at night with no lights so you will have to use your cell phone flashlights as you walk down and up the steep slopes. For the price, the hotel is not worth it. And the food is overpriced. I had to pay $23 for nuts which I didn't even eat and that was charged to my bill. Oh well... never again will I visit. I will definitely do a review on instagram. I also hope the owner will stop harassing me and my fiancé anymore and threaten me about my green card status because of the review. Be a little more professional. If it keeps up, I will be reporting You and your friend to the authorities for Harassment.

author: drhedlund
title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
text: Cannot say enough good things about our experience at this resort/hotel. From the minute we drove up we were impressed. Every single member of the staff was attentive and helpful. Alberto who greeted us and checked us was fantastic! Coco helped us into our room which was breathtaking! Luis and Joshua were our favorite bartenders/waiters and served us VERY well going the extra mile to bring us whatever we needed. Joshua even asked the chef to prepare us our favorite Costa Rican staple "Gallo Pinto" (beans and rice) even tho it want on their menu. The food was incredible. We didn't have one bad meal. From breakfast at the large infinity pool to sushi at the smaller infinity pool for lunch to dinner at the restaurant Arboles , the presentation and flavor of the food was well done. Our room was #S1 Ocean Club with an incredible view of both the ocean and the tropics. Bed was extremely comfortable and the sheets were clean and soft. The room itself was very clean and the decor and layout was fantastic. I will say it is NOT at all handicap friendly. The hotel is literally on the side of the cliff and the walk to and from our room to the two pools and restaurant areas was literally a hike. We got our daily workout in just traversing the grounds! So if you are not in good physical shape or have the use of both legs, this hotel may not be for you. Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend this resort. Worth every penny. Close to Manuel Antonio Nat'l Park and inviting/relaxing enough that we spend the majority of our 3 days never leaving it.

author: Vera_Gavrilchuk
title: Trip into happiness
text: My husband and I have been saving for a couple years in order to have the Best delayed honeymoon possible and of course the Best option was Costa Rica. You know is not cheap to travel from Far East. We spent a LOT of hours trying to put together a nice itinerary so it was not only the money but the effort too. We tried to keep it a little bit standard for the first nights just to put the cherry on the cake for the last 4 nights. There could not be more exquisite, juicy, pumpy cherry than Makanda by the Sea… OH-MY-DEAR-LORD…!!! They helped us arranging a Private Ground Transfer from Arenal to Manuel Antonio so their service started even before getting there. Leo @ Reservations made sure driver was on time to pick us up. Comfortable SUV we did not even feel it was 4 hours. From SUV to Golfcart (if golfcart not there they would probably carry us, hehe). Delicious welcome cocktails (usually just fruit juice but ask to baptize with Cacique). Pacific Suite was set already and Alberto tried to make check in process as short as possible so we could jump into the Jacuzzi as soon as possible. Minibar is filled with many good items/brands and they also offer room service. The thing is that you don´t even need to get out of the room, but you gotta do it, I mean they have 2 AWESOME pool areas, one with a sushi bar, God I am gonna miss the Octopus roll. They just opened a new Restaurant and the design is SO COOL, not to mention the food which is just unreal. You all probably know or heard about the Pura Vida costarican slogan, beautiful thing is that indeed everything is Pure Life. We started saving again, since already planned to come back to Makanda as much as possible; it was really hard to leave… I was able to leave only by knowing that I´ll come back. 100% Recommended.

author: 563jenah
title: Romantic Paradise
text: Makanda by the Sea is in a spectacular setting and creates the ambiance of total paradise. Perfect for a romantic get away. My fiance and I stayed for one week. Our room was modern, well air conditioned, and had a fantastic comfortable king bed. The floor to ceiling windows on the balcony with the view of the ocean, are unparalleled. We saw more wildlife poolside at Makanda than we did on our excursion to the National Park. The private beach is stunningly rugged. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. We asked to see some of the other private homes and rooms for potential future vacations and they showed us many of the rooms that were vacant. The infinity pools are amazing. The food was great! The new restaurant was being constructed while we were there, and I'm sure it will be fantastic. INCREDIBLE and HIGHLY RECOMMEND, can't say enough about it. Trip of a lifetime. We will be back!

author: Hookylite
title: Honeymoon @ Makanda
text: My husband and I were celebrating our honeymoon and they made us feel so special. Our room had an amazing ocean view and we received a complementary bottle of champagne. An employee even brought it to their private beach, for us! The entire staff was extremely friendly and accommodating for anything we needed. The complementary breakfast was delicious and the bartenders and drinks were just as amazing! The property is newly remodeled in a modern yet relaxed take. We stayed in an Ocean Club Suite and it was beautiful!! Our bathroom was white marble from head to floor, it was gorgeous!!! The guys at the reception desk we're very helpful and made sure we were very well taken care of. As they say we are now a part of the "Makanda family" and they sure make you feel like it!! We will definitely be staying with Makanda again. We couldn't have been any happier and we can't wait to return!!! We can on and on about the small details from the decor to the servic that make this place great. Bottom line this place is a must do if you're looking for an exquisite romantic/personal get away! Pura Vida!!

author: D4089IVchrisw
title: A perfect way to end a perfect trip
text: So happy that we decided to book this hotel to finish off our Costa Rican dream holiday. My girlfriend and i booked this hotel as a last minute treat after we had such an amazing start to the beginning of the holiday. I proposed and she said yes! This looked like the paradise that we wanted to end on and we were not let down. After a really warm welcome from all the staff we encountered (espically from Darwin), we were invited to relax with a welcome cocktail and a dip in the infinity pool, with breathtaking views. The atmosphere is warm and very welcoming. Even to the point that the staff pointed out the resident sloth to us. After we had enjoyed our dip and drink we were greeted by Darwin again who showed us to our room before the scheduled check in time. We appreciated that as we were really early to the hotel. Upon entering our room we were absolutely delighted to discover that Darwin had upgraded our room as a congratulations on our engagement. Really unexpected and couldn't thank him enough for something so special. The room was huge and luxurious. We had direct views out onto the ocean, a jacuzzi in our balcony and all the jungle we could hope for. Unable to fault anything. The staff, the facilities, the rooms and the views are everything we could have hoped for the end of our magical trip to Costa Rica. We will be coming back in the future and highly recommend this hotel for anyone who wants to escape the hussle and bussle of the streets of Manuel antonio into their own paradise. Personal paradise!

author: kimdahlgren
title: Beautiful Hotel, Outstanding Service, a MUST While in Manuel Antonio
text: My boyfriend and I just returned from a trip around Costa Rica - we ended the vacation with 4 nights at the Makanda in Manuel Antonio. It did not disappoint! We received the recommendation from a friend who said it was one of the best hotels he'd ever been to. Upon arriving, our concierge Darwin couldn't have been nicer or more helpful. He gave us a personal tour of the grounds and let us decide which hotel room was right for us. Every room is beautiful and modern, with an amazing view of the ocean and the jungle. The pools are incredible, and completely cater to every guest there. I could have lounged on the daybed for hours. Makanda is also walking distance to a private beach, with multiple other beaches close by. It's absolutely stunning. Darwin even took us out one night in Quepos and Manuel Antonio. We had a blast and he went above and beyond to make sure of that. The rest of the staff brought us what we needed, ensured our room was cleaned everyday, and pointed out the sloths and monkeys in the trees to me everyday - they jump around while you're eating breakfast! If you're looking for a nice hotel to stay in during your time in Manuel Antonio, definitely check out Makanda by the Sea. Tell Darwin I referred you!

author: ella258
title: Beautiful hotel with amazing staff!
text: Beautiful boutique hotel with a trail through the jungle to a private beach. The resort is filled with exotic wildlife and makes you feel like you are in the middle of the rainforest. Impressive level of detail went into building the modern and spacious rooms. The amenities are fabulous and I thought about sleeping in the infinity pool because it is so great. It is impossible to articulate how nice this hotel is so I will give up. Although the resort was one of the most beautiful places we have stayed, we were most impressed with the staff. Jorge (golf cart driver) was always happy to help us with anything we needed. He went above and beyond and often anticipated our needs. After the restaurant was closed, he recommended a great place in Quepos that we never would have found without him. He even came to find us to show us monkey’s and sloths! Gabriel (bartender) and Roberto (sushi chef) served us at the swim up bar in the salt water pool several times during our stay. As we had already sampled most of the cocktail menu and were thirty for something lighter, Gabriel offered up new drinks for us to try. One day we were a bit hungry but had already tried all the rolls so Roberto made a beautiful sashimi creation. It was great that they were passionate about their jobs and excited to create new potential menu items (we recommend adding the kiwi cocktail and the tuna sashimi ). All staff we encountered were genuinely interested in working together to make our stay wonderful and seemed to love working at Makanda. Alberto and Leo (reception) were very friendly during check in/out and Jorge (breakfast server/bartender) was always a pleasure in the mornings. Hopefully this is a reflection of great management that is able to keep their staff so we can come back and visit our new friends! I have only one small suggestion- put another garbage/recycling can in the main area so we don’t have to use the bathroom one. Muchas gracias! A & S from Canada

author: goncat883
title: Hotel is like a Porsche with a Kia engine
text: First things first, Makanda really does have wonderful architecture, the hotel is stunning and has magnificent views over the jungle and the ocean. The two pools are amazing and also ideal spot to observe wildlife (we saw monkeys, sloths, and a toucan). The rooms are very spacious, decorated with a lot of taste, and super modern, huge balconies too! However, that is about all for the positives. Unfortunately, and in sharp contrast to the magnificent location and ambiance, some of the staff & experiences are not up to standard. For starters, we were greeted by a receptionist who we found to be arrogant (whether intentionally or not) as we felt he looked down on us for going to Puerto Viejo in Lemon province (surfer town), which was not up to his taste apparently. The waiters at the breakfast are rather rash and cold, they do not even answer our 'good mornings'; they also seem to get irritated if asked a request which isn't in their standard routine (Though Jorge & Leo were extremely helpful and very nice). The arrogance probably stems from the fact that they are supposedly working in MA best hotel, as can be seen from the management replies on the below trip advisor comments... The breakfast is good but you can only chose a maximum of 3 toppings for your omelet, which is a bit odd. We also ordered lunch at the secondary pool which had a ceviche/sushi themed menu. Although the sushi was made well, the tuna was of very poor quality and more expensive than Zuma or Nobu! The showers do not have curtains or a door so after showering the whole bathroom is wet which isn't convenient. No slippers are provided although bathrobes are. There is a lot of room for improvement for Makanda to be a true top hotel of which they aspire to.. they do not even provide any complimentary bottled water in the rooms, coffee is also paid for. It's not just about looks.. All in all, we enjoyed our stay but Makanda because of how nice the hotel actually is but it compares quite poorly with similarly priced hotel we've been to around the globe. I would give a 3.5 for service and 5 for decoration.

author: xoxmi
title: Luxury rainforest but not 5 star, glad electric curtains are blinking
text: We rented the most luxurious private Villa with private pool (at the highest price possible 1000$+/ngt), guess since it was Easter holiday. Upon arrival with private bus, we were angrily greeted by the gentleman at the gate, that the shuttle cannot enter, and luggage was therefore taken out of car. Then we were angrily informed that the bellman/ cart was busy and we could carry our luggage ourselves, which we denied.... Arrival at lobby was a bit sloppy, but acceptable, not 5 star greeting. Too much novelty info without making feel welcome, no drink nor towel.... we asked for changing to the more lovely surroundings by the bar to finish, and in the end we politely reminded the novice if we could get the promised welcome drink as offered for a genius booker when booking through booking.com. The breakfast waiter very moody again, so different than your friendly countrymen/ women, why so much attitude? If you like to be a 5 star please have an introduction how to achieve this with a smile and the appropriate service, it's so much missing. ( Jorge at the bar was very nice!) Of course the Villa was not cleaned by noon without calling, although to call reception is 99% failing, due to ???? Perhaps reception does not want to be disturbed? Next day Villa was cleaned by noon, only this time they 'forgot' the terrace and pool which was covered fully in leaves and debris. Of course the reception was not reachable by phone again......so a trip there, only 3-5 employees doing various other things instead taking care of hotel guests. Constructions next to pool and the tiny 'bistro' called restaurant ( very simple...) going on and on the lot everywhere, comes on top, not warned for, the workers were smiling though! Spa never found, golfcart driver was too busy again , possibly they only have one(1) cart, being 5 star, oh forgot.... The decor in the Villa is interestingly done, the technics not working all, like soundsystem and receptacles almost exploded .....electric curtains ( blink at night), overtechnisized digital system for lighting and call the non existent cleaning personal etc.:) Glad to have found pots in the kitchen because we wanted so much to do a special home cooked dinner on vacation.....joke...:) Sorry owners, hotel business needs attention to service and functionality also, not only the design, which is impressive, if the lights would be working coming into the steep steps to our Villa f.i. Only once you in Villa the walkway is lit, meaning dark when you need light. We politely were given a flashlight then. Thanks for a memorable impression !

author: mikeaU6677ZF
title: Amazing location
text: This modern, contemporary, boutique hotel is in the jungle. We stayed on Ocean Club S4 for the first week in April, 2017. There was some construction going on, but it was clear upgrades were continuing. A shout out to Coco, our driver, guide, and helper in language practice. Our room was literally in the jungle. A gorgeous living space opened onto a forest with an ocean view. Our first day we had a sloth going across a vine less that 30 meters from our balcony. Rooms are private and quiet. Everything was great. Pros: *View *Service *Food (every morning a new tall glass of fruit juice, fruit plate, and complementary breakfast off a menu). *Wild life (sloths, capachino monkeys, howler monkeys, tucans, etc.) *semi-Private beach *Room decor and atmosphere *Not a lot of people. On most days we felt like we had the pool and grounds to ourselves. Cons: *No outside phone lines in rooms (they said they were working on it) *The mounted soap tray in the double sink was on the far side of the left sink, making it inconvenient for the right sink user to access soap. *No dresser or drawers for clothing. We literally lived out of our suitcases and what we could hang in the closet. *The biometric room safe did not always function (low batteries?). *The steep path up from the lower rooms is slippery when wet. My wife fell after a short rainfall, breaking her sandals and getting skinned up (they have a cart, but it also struggled on the surface after a rain).

author: raymundor614
title: Great Place. Bad service.
text: Manuel Antonio and surrounding area are fabulous; this review is about the hotel only. The only good thing about Makanda is it has a wonderful architecture, only that. Everything else is horrible. To begin with: horrible service. One of the “Bellboys” named “Jorge” told my wife she looked “really pretty and so was her dress” while giving her "a dirty look". That happened as soon as I stepped inside the front desk while she waited outside with our things. She felt very uncomfortable but asked me not to complain. We both got sick having breakfast: we ordered Benedict eggs with salmon (they either didn’t wash their hands or the salmon was bad: that was the only time we had the same thing so it was definitely that). The rooms are nice but lack very basic things: they give you robes but don’t have slippers, no smart TV so forget about using your Netflix/HBO or Hulu accounts. No regular coffee machine, only espresso. So-so internet. No drawers or luggage rack (it seems the minimalistic appearance is more important than a pragmatic atmosphere). No trash cans for god’s sake! There is no way to walk around the hotel, the transportation is a golf cart that the bellboys drive (and they only have one cart, which is always busy). I honestly would never go back, there are a bunch of options to stay in paradise and many of them are way cheaper than 300 USD for the night. Cheers and safe travels.

author: JillH97
title: WOW!! Stunning place to stay with excellent service and so many animals
text: My sister and daughter (Senior in highschool) stayed here for 4 nights in March. We rented the top of a villa- 2 bedroom. I have stayed in hotels all over the world and this is by far the most beautiful, swanky hotel that does not have attitude or crowds. The pool is to die for. You can just hang out there all day. It's very close to the public beach and the the park entrance of Manuel Antonio. However, I have to stay we saw more wildlife (monkeys, sloths, toucans, etc...) just on the property grounds than our hike in the national park. Leo is an excellent host/manager and gave us lots of lessons in Cost Rican life and culture. He made us laugh every day. When our over the top technically saavy room had issues (we couldn't turn the bedroom lights off) he called in an electrician in the evening hours, hung out until the problem was solved, comped us for dinner and a bottle of champagne and made what could have been a frustrating moment fun and part of the "Tico time" culture. Jorge is the guy that will do EVERYTHING for you and drives the golf cart. The walk to the private beach is pretty intense and he was always there to pick us up and bring us back up the hills. He also came to show us anytime an animal was within sighting distance. We won't forget his hospitality and humbleness when we tried to tip him for his help. The bartenders and waiters are super nice, the grounds keepers and cleaning staff. All have a "hola" for you and they know exactly what room you are in. We left with big hugs, a beautiful sunset, monkey coming down the pool and a few Colones left in our pocket as the costs in Costa Rica are not ridiculous. Also the music by the pool is amazing. Can't recommend this enough. You will not be disappointed.

author: andreabU4672CH
title: Incredible from beginning to end!
text: From the moment we entered the gate of Hotel Makanda By The Sea I had a feeling that we were in for something special. We were greeted by the fabulous Darwin who made us feel welcome and at home after a long day of travel. Darwin had answers for all of our questions about unique places to eat, activities, places to watch the Superbowl etc. After check in we were escorted to the most beautiful room that we have ever stayed in and we travel a lot. Spectacular ocean view, second pool, jungle with monkeys right outside of our door. The design at this hotel is breathtaking. The attention to detail really made every where you go an adventure. The pool, with yet another spectacular view of the ocean through the jungle is amazing. We arrived right on time for happy hour and were greeted by Jorge who was such a pleasure. Throughout our stay, everyone at the pool/restaurant were extremely friendly and attentive. The food is outstanding, some of the best we had while in Costa Rica. There is a private beach that is a short go cart ride away. One one day in particular I had twisted my ankle and needed a ride past the time that the carts were running. The awesome young man who drives the cart made a special trip just to pick us up. He even asked about my ankle two days later! Prior to our arrival I had arranged to have a bottle of wine and a note in the room to surprise my husband for his 50th birthday and Leo had it waiting when we arrived back at the room after a day of surfing. We love this hotel and cannot wait to go back again!

author: smg81
title: A true design hotel
text: This is a really beautiful place surrounded by the rain forest. The pool area is amazing, perfect to relax. Most of the rooms are either newly built or renovated. Unfortunately many basics like a hairdryer, do not disturb sign, laundry bag and some bath room essentials are missing. There are no drawers, so you have to hang up your underwear, bath suits, etc in the tiny cupboard with everything else. There is no rack for the suitcases, no turn down, massages only in the room, no SPA, etc. Some of the design is a bit of a stretch and in the end not necessarily practical. The safety box can be opened with your fingerprint. Cool idea until you realize that your wife can't open it while you enjoy time at the pool. The stones in the shower are an ideal place for hair and bacteria. The reading light was not working, we asked three times to fix it, but nothing happened. The hairdryer we got was from the last century and dirty, this is where design obviously stops in this place. These shortcomings can be fixed easily and hopefully will be in the future, because the hotel is a real beauty. On top of the design one can enjoy the rain forest and spot many animals. Monkeys and sloths, numerous birds. Simply great to enjoy wildlife so close. The food is good, also the drinks and the staff is friendly and funny with the exception of one of the bar men, who never had a smile, nor a friendly word. Construction was still going on, so if you are sensitive to construction noise you should check with management on the status before you book. Despite the above mentioned shortcomings we had a great time here and can truly recommend it. To management: please take care of the above points then your place has the potential to become the best hotel in Manuel Antonio.

author: CJVTF
title: Not So By The Sea
text: Saving Grace of Makanda are its Spacious, comfortable villa/rooms with push button curtain and light controls. The pool lounge room we stayed in was quite nice and our pool was just the right size, overlooking the beach. There were lots of flora and guests can get visits from some of the animals around if one likes that sort of thing and we do... Its restaurant had a good menu, breakfast is hearty and the views were spectacular everywhere. All of the reception personnel were helpful and pleasant to deal with. This would have been a 5 if not for the following: FYR: Its $700 - $1000/ day or more - Makanda By The Sea is the name of the hotel but maybe not so by the Sea. Its a 5 minute golf cart ride to where one needs to start walking down the beach but it did;t have any stable stairs of sorts to get down there so the trek I can be long, quite slippery and dangerous since the stepping stones were not stable so the elderly or even the young should not go there for they can get seriously injured. When you get to the beach, there was a stack of dirty and wet lounge chairs far from the beach. One would need to drag a heavy one which is not a good experience right there. No umbrellas either so this part was quite bummer - Transfer, tour and taxis were not allowed inside for drop off and pick up and we needed to get down at the security gate which was a hassle especially after a long flight, a whole day of touring and who likes walking to and from the gate after a late night out... - the hotel was sort of possessive of their pool/beach towels. Guests need to call and request for it ahead and you need to pick it up from the office (?), otherwise you won't have one for the entire day. These should really be made available at the rooms each day at least or at the pool or beach areas at least. - Room service is only till 9 pm and there's not a convenient store inside for essentials, mineral water/drinks/snacks so guests would need to bring or buy outside which is OK but not late at night and its quite far to walk. - There was a big flat screen in the room but all channels were in Spanish, only 2-3 news channels in English were available and hotel staff could not change any of the settings and no Netflix either so it was good we were out most of the day during our stay.

author: stinacav
title: Beautiful hotel with some minor issues
text: My fiancé and I stayed here during New Years and I must say it was a beautiful hotel. People were also friendly and always tried to accommodate us. However, there were a few issues we experienced that I wouldn't expect from a 5 star resort. 1. Hotel was under A LOT of construction. Our room was located in a place that was only have finished. We walked by a ton of construction to and from our room everyday and the stairs weren't even finished. There were even electrical cords hanging out in our shower upon arrival. 2. There is no hair dryer so don't expect one if you're a woman. I called up front and they said they didn't have any. 3. They say you can order breakfast the night before and it will be delivered the next morning- we did New Year's Eve and apparently they forgot and no breakfast came. 4. Upon check-out, we had about $200 of bar tabs on our bill that wasn't ours. Luckily we checked. 5. First night in the hotel after a long travel day, the hot water didn't work and we had to take a cold shower. There isn't 24 hour service so you have to wait until the next morning to talk to someone. Beautiful hotel and our experience was good- however, I would call I average for a 5 star hotel and paying over $550 per night.

author: plunkettm2017
title: Okay, But Not Worth The Money
text: This place was the only part of our Costa Rican trip I wouldn't do again. The pool area and reception are beautiful. That's the best part of the hotel. But they hotel just didn't get anything else quite right. The room was not as nice as pictured. Basically, they photograph the updated portions of the room for their website. But the kitchen portion and bathroom were outdated. Our villa was also located under the pool deck area. The staff thought it would be great to start setting up the pool area at about 6:30 every morning. The scraping of chairs and dropping of who knows what above our heads so early in the morning was loud and annoying. The first night, we lost all water in the entire unit while I was showering. They said they would send someone to fix it right away, but after 45 minutes, I just went to dinner without being able to wash conditioner out of my hair. They apologized but that was it, not even an offer of a free drink. The second morning we found cockroaches on our towels in the bathroom. This is in the jungle, so you have to expect some bugs, but cockroaches on my towel was disgusting. When we asked for a late check after our last night, they were really rude to us about it. I understand strict checkout policies, but they could have handled it better. Overall, the staff acted like it was our privilege to stay there instead of their privilege to have us as guests. I would not stay here again. You can find much better options.

author: Grumps65
title: Fabulous Hotel in a Fabulous Country
text: Having read some excellent reviews on Tripadvisor, I booked 2 suites via Booking.com. We were not left disappointed as the service, room, bar/restaurant area and location were excellent. The suites were very well presented, large, well equipped and clean. Two of the staff were particularly helpful and went that extra length to make our holiday a successful one. Gabrielle was a great guy, who served us well in the restaurant/bar/pool area. The Reception Manager was also very understanding, especially when we challenged him over a grievance we had regarding building works. Construction works are currently underway on the hotel site to add more suites to the complex. We were not informed about this during the booking and had to endure some construction disturbance from 6am onwards. Having made our complaint, the hotel management agreed to reimburse us at check-out, to value of 300USD (approx. £210). We felt this was fair compensation and left the hotel satisfied. Recommendations: visit the Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio with a guide and you are pretty much guaranteed to see Sloths and monkeys. In fact, we were offered our money back, if we did not see a sloth (we saw the 2 and 3-toed varieties). Also go on the Mangrove Boat Trip. Fantastic wildlife to see here in beautiful surroundings. We booked via our National Park guide 'Mop' as he proved to be an excellent guide and knew all the right people to organise the trip with. Would I stay at the Makanda again? Most definitely yes, especially in one of the new suites.

author: amyv405
title: Paradise!
text: We LOVED this place! When we arrived I saw construction workers leaving the property for the day. We went inside reception and were greeted with frozen drinks upon check in. I voiced my concern about possible construction noise and we were immediately upgraded to villa #7 away from the noise without any problem. From what I understand Makanda is expanding, hence the construction. The property is beautiful and better than anything I had ever imagined. The views from our villa were breathtaking, the staff kind and friendly and the food/drinks were delicious. We woke to howler monkeys in the morning and were greeted by wildlife at every turn. We felt as though we had the entire place to ourselves. The pool is gorgeous and we watched sunsets from our balcony and pool area. Ive read other reviews about this resort and some were complaining about the stairs and private beach. Neither were a problem for us. Its Manuel Antonio, located on a side of a mountain! What did they expect?! We walked to the public beach which was not crowded at all and continued on to the national park. We took a cab back to Makanda which cost about 6 dollars. I fell in love with this place and definitely recommend it to others and cant wait to return. It truly is paradise!

author: 992jenellj
title: Amazing Honeymoon
text: There is nothing more to say but amazing. My husband is an architect was impressed by the design and details of the layout of The hotel. The free breakfast was delicious, very tasty. The food at the bar at the poolside was also great. The bartender was very informative about things to do in the coast and made some noteworthy drinks. The infinity pool is also really nice as well as the jacuzzi. We stayed in a new room which had a indoor shower and a outdoor shower. There was also a private pool in our room. The view of the ocean is phenomenal. We woke up every mooning to see the sunrise and we also got to see the most beautiful sunsets from our room. Did I mention the wall was all glass. It was pretty romantic and exceptional. We can not wait to visit it again. This hotel is highly recommended by far one of the nicest hotel we stayed at in Costa Rica. We have stayed at 7 hotels in Costa Rica so far.

author: Jen1375
title: Beautiful Place!!!
text: During our visit here my husband and I stayed at beautiful Makanda By the Sea. The place is absolutely pristine and bountiful in so much greenery. Its surrounded by palm trees, beautiful orchids and wild flowers. We also got to see plenty of birds and monkeys throughout the hotel!!! We stayed in villa 9, which was just spectacular and luxurious at the same time we got to enjoy nature and our pool and view was amazing. First negative is that the hotel advertises the villas pool as private, but indeed the only one that has a private pool is villa 6. The other villas like 8 and 9 share pools. So be ready to not have a private pool. The staff was friendly and very welcoming and courteos. The front desk "Erdwin and Leo where phenomenal at telling us and making suggestions of tours and places to visit during our stay. They handled pretty much everything as far as tours etc. The hotel comes included with daily breakfast, which I must say is the only reason as to why I gave this hotel a four star. Reason is, you as a guest have to ensure you call the front desk to order your morning breakfast, which is only delivered to your room daily. The breakfast menu is the same daily and us delivererd to your room, since it is the way they serve breakfast. Once it's delivered it is left in your room without any type of warming covers. You get fresh juice daily, however, you won't know what type of juice it is. In addition, the fresh juice it's delivered in a cheap looking plastic bottle. The reason why I mentioned this is because for the hotel price and quality I belive they should step it up and offer their guest who are already paying $500 +, a better breakfast menu, or a better more enjoyable one atleast.

author: Townie-TRIP
title: OO7 stayed here!
text: Makanda is this sort of high end looking place that could have been the set for a Bond movie. A very, very plush looking pool with a restaurant and bar at poolside. It's at it's best at night with all the dramatic angles highlighted with lush lighting. The best discovery for me was Guanoabana. A fruit made into a frozen drink. I had it without alcohol but I imagine that could be just as great. The most notable thing was the lack of other people because this is a fairly large property with few rooms (which are actually small structures spread out through out the compound) We had a small studio but it was all we needed. We had a great view of the Pacific and probably all the other rooms did as well. My only complain was the large furniture in the small space. The large coffee table with a glass top and many edges proved a bit hazardous. More simple would be better. You don't need a lot with that view. The trip to the ocean was a trip. Not a hop skip and jump. They are working on a road to help with this issue. They told us it would be ready by March 2016 but I'm not so sure. We did not eat there so I can't say anything about the food. The staff is small but efficient and friendly. This is a great place to feel luxurious and mysterious, like a Bond movie character.

author: SherriH826
title: Paradise in Manual Antonio
text: Small secluded boutique hotel short drive to Manual Antonio. Absolutely beautiful, comfortable, and clean. Staff is friendly and helpful. Large infinity pool covered in small glass tiles in geometric designs. Tiles and stone throughout the grounds all have different patterns very artistic. We had a studio and our friends had a villa. The beds, pillows and blankets were extremely comfortable . The bed in the studio face a glass wall overlooking the lush vegetation and ocean. We had a sitting area and a terrace. The villa was surrounded by windows with wonderful views, high ceilings, and a kitchen. Villa number 1 has no terrace. Breakfast is served in the rooms. There is a restaurant pool side with good casual food. The cons: each room is assigned a time for breakfast so if you want an early time and another room has it you are out of luck. They don't have a shuttle so you have to take taxis to town or the beach. But we loved our time there.

author: T6046YN_
title: Private paradise
text: We spent our romantic vacation in this wonderful hotel. I am glad that we chose it - the hotel only opened after a global rebuilding and upgrade. Noticeable that the owners of the hotel are the designers or so... Everything is done very stylish and with a good taste. Our room was just gorgeous - amazing ocean views, Jacuzzi on the terrace, wide comfortable bed .... We were surrounded by stunning nature and during our stay saw a huge number of animals on site (more than in the national park). A special words to say about the beach: absolutely wild and crazy beautiful. The path to the beach goes through a real jungle, and after... you are left alone.... on the wild beach... with nature - no pesky salesmen and touts, prying eyes. The nature here is meditative. Do not forget to bring water and sunscreen on the beach. Also want to mention nice staff - very pleasant people, like specially selected for this Hotel. I'm just delighted with our stay at the hotel, highly recommended Villa No 4!

author: Yarrabung
title: Beautiful place
text: We stayed at Makanda in December 2015 at the end of our tour of Costa Rica. We were greeted at Reception by the friendly owner who talked us through how everything worked (breakfast to be taken in the room, timings of pool, restaurant, room service etc). He then told us we had been upgraded and showed us to our room, #4, which was lovely.
