AFTER DINNER THEY ARE LACKING 100 PESOS FOR EXCHANGE AND THE WAITER SAID WILL BE GIVEN IN THE MORNING BUT NEVER GIVEN, well 1 Hu dred pesos is very small amount for me but the Word " is most important. About the Massage I wish the massage room place in the shore with mosquito net, instead of having a massage room with small space. The lady who did the massage to me was not good. Strokes are so bad and nothing special, I even give her a hint but seems like she doesn't care or do not understand. I am very sad to hear when she ask me if I am from USA and when I answered her that I wasn't from USA the attitude was changed. I am a traveler and likes 5 star hotel but this kind of attitude I don't like, why? USA citizens give big TIPS? Swedish and shiatsu combination but I did not get the right service. ... In the breakfast, there is a waiter asking our alacart breakfast order but mouth smells like cigarette so smelly, hygiene is the most important pls! The quite and nice view is 10 points, service is not every good service.

author: RdV88
title: Peaceful Paradise
text: Service superb, food good, rooms spacious & comfortable, tastefully done blend of local look with modern western amenities. I love how the cottages are set back from the beach (all do have beach views) and are hidden beneath the coconut trees. Gardens are tropical, lush and not overly manicured. For breakfast a few notes, if you order pancakes, crepes or hasbrowns, do specify how many pieces you want. Breakfast comes with the room (I think) and it’s good (with a variety of choices) and portions are generous. Frenchfries were soggy the first time we ordered but there after were cooked perfectly. Maybe specify you want double cooked or crispy. The aioli that comes with it is delicious!!! So is their pesto. Wonderfully managed place. As mentioned service superb all around, from driver, check-in/out, restaurant, room cleaning to the boat staff. They are all very welcoming, genuinely happy and work hard to make sure all guests are happy too. Lovely yoga space too. We were fortunate to catch 2 classes with Amanda. She is good and has such a wonderful energy. Pretty beach, super clean water and sand. Wifi on and off which is not surprising considering this is quite remote and there are no other resorts around. They are working on improving the stability ... not sure if that’s a good thing as it’s nice to disconnect from handheld devices and reconnect to nature and people present.

author: craigbR8958TM
title: Over-rated big time....
text: I really don't know how this resort is rated so highly, and to be rated the number one resort for El Nido on TripAdvisor isn't very flattering for their competitors. The bungalow was nice, but nothing beyond that. The bed very hard, and the tv the size of a computer screen and no bottled water, internet coverage or fridge (the second and third I knew of in advance). Like one of the other reviewers we had trouble with our washing. We left it out to be washed the day before we left and was told when it hadn't been returned that night that it was still drying. We ended up getting it back the morning we left, still damp. I suspect they had forgotten it until we asked for it and tried to do it early the next day. The beach was ok, but very tidal so depending on the time of the day you went for a swim, you perhaps had to walk out a few hundred metres to be waste deep to have a swim. The water clarity was so so, but compared to resorts I have stayed at in Fiji, Hawaii or Thailand both the beach and the water were second rate. The pool was completely uninviting and looked like a backyard pool from the 60's with permanently cloudy water. The food in the restaurant was very nice and staff were quite friendly, but the whole restaurant experience was completely off putting because management allow guests to smoke in the restaurant area. So you could be sitting down for dinner and have people puffing away at the very next table as you eat your dinner....as we did. Disgusting. For a resort that seems to beat the green mantra drum constantly, maybe they should focus on their guest's personal dining environment, rather than the global environment. I could go on but overall...... a disappointing experience.

author: sharlaf2018
title: Relaxation
text: From the moment you arrive you feel stress ebb away from your body. The pick up from the airport was efficient and easy. The drivers, wait staff, tour guides and massage therapists are so friendly. The food was reasonably priced and delicious. Accommodations were delightful. We had a clean room and comfortable bed. The front of the cabin is a lovely place to listen to birds and the ocean. Sounds odd, but I loved the outdoor shower area attached to the cabin. ❤️ Sunshine, birds and flowers present while getting ready for the day. The beach is expansive and quiet. The sunrises were glorious. We made last minute arrangements for tours through the hotel. Both the west and east side tours are wonderful. We chose a private A/C tour. I would highly recommend it! We got a massage after our first day of snorkeling. Such a treat! This is a place to stay if you desire a restful holiday and beautiful spot to return to after a day of island hopping.

author: danlee7
title: A little bit of paradise
text: Our stay at Qi Palawan was very good. Staff - Friendly and attentive. No issues here. Food - Their restaurant is the only option in the area. We tried both the Filipino and Western options on the menu and both were good with reasonable prices. Accommodation - Outdoor shower was nice but very difficult to regulate the temperature. It was either too hot or cold. Home made soaps with mint were nice and a little interesting when on your “bits”. The room itself was nice but basic. Little birds must have found their way in through a small hole so we heard them flapping around and tweeting in the two mornings we were there. Bed was comfortable and had a mosquito net around it so we didn’t get bitten. Location - It’s on the western side of the island which is less populated and has a nice private beach. Read lots of reviews that talked about mosquitoes but we didn’t have any issues with them, even though my wife is usually a mosquito magnet. Amenities - Lots of activities are offered by Qi, from kite surfing to scuba diving to stand up paddle boarding. No shortage here. We had a massage which was nice, and tried paddle boarding. Overall, a good stay and I’d recommend it to others.

author: samarie111
title: Qi Palawan....what a find!
text: We....a family of four (children aged 11&15) stayed here for 3 nights. It was a late booking and we weren't sure what to expect. We were met at the airport for our transfer (About 45 minutes) and pleasantly surprised when we arrived, what a gem, the area is stunning, well presented and many luscious plants. We had a family cottage. It was very nice, very spacious, with comfortable facilities including a hot shower....a first for me in the Philippines since leaving the U.K. Included also were towels, beach towels, shampoo & soap. The included breakfast was delicious & substantial. We also had lunch and dinner a few times, all very tasty and generous portion sizes. The staff were all very friendly and accommodating. If you want to do the main Island tours you need to travel 45 minutes to the town, which means cost soon mount up. We just did tour A which was amazing. Another bonus to the resort is the kayaks & paddle boards are free to use on the private beach, which our children thoroughly enjoyed. Be aware of the many bugs. I am white and seem to attract the bugs and although the resort provide a natural citronella repellent, it is very greasy and didn't seem to work very well. Three of us were badly bitten on our last night and think it was some kind of mite on the sofa in the restaurant, as my son didn't get bitten and he wasn't sat with us. Other than that everything was perfect.

author: debA6184OB
title: Paradise
text: My family and I spent 4 days and 3 nights at Qi. It was an absolutely relaxing time for us. We were greeted with a nice surprise with an upgrade in our room due to availability. Qi is a small, intimate beach front property and felt like a very personal experience. We met the owner, Bettina, and we really felt like she was hosting us in her home. She was very personable and ensured that our stay was what we were looking for. Her and her staff were very attentive and polite. We spent our mornings doing yoga in a beautiful upstairs open air room. Breakfast was delicious and we took advantage of the tasty Filipino breakfast fare- beef steak, tapa, eggs and garlic fried rice! Yum!! We spent our two days doing a island hopping tour and a cave exploration. Both excursions were awesome and there were ZERO crowds. It really felt like we were in a private location with exclusivity to the attractions! Dinners were always delicious. The only downside were the mosquitos and bugs but Qi provided a natural, citronella based oil free of charge to help as a repellant. A great experience- different from your typical commerical, tourist location- a MUST!!

author: johndS9897KJ
title: Treasure
text: I really enjoyed our stay in Qi Palawan because I personally love peaceful and quiet places. The sound of birds, trees, insects and etc. make it more relaxing. The staff are very friendly and hospitable. They assisted us outstandingly from the time we arrived until we left. The food they served are all good. I love their free breakfast. The villas are well designed and are very comfortable. Equipped with aircondition and a flat screen tv where we can watch movie of our choice. I like their outside shower where we can enjoy the rain (too bad there was no rain during our stay). Our villa is situated towards the beach where we can enjoy the vista just from our glass door. As an architect, I can say that it would have been better if the villas are naturally ventilated (with windows and insect screen) or at least a choice not to use aircon since the place is not really hot and the air is clean. There are many insects inside the resort but the good thing is they gave us insect repellant for us to enjoy our stay outside our villas. The place where Qi Palawan is already beautiful. The surroundings are excellent for people who doesn't like pollution and stress. It is also an advantage for Qi Palawan for having a good view of sunrise. I consider Qi Palawan a Philippine pride. I can stay there for good. There's nothing like Qi Palawan.

author: chowee
title: Our family found a best mate in Gordie!
text: Our Fil-Aussie family booked at the last minute 2 days prior to our trip and found Qi to be very unique compared to the bare bones backpacker and the mid-range accomodations in El Nido. We were glad that we chose it because it offers a very relaxing atmosphere right out the front of our family cottage. We were out all days (rain or shine) in the beach rowing the banca to the mangroves, riding the paddleboards, playing on the pool table, and horsing around with the resident amphibious golden retriever - Gordie! Gordie was a welcome additional family member for this short vacation - as he was almost always with and around us the whole day from Day 1 in our cottage, in the beach, on banca rides, on our cottage terrace, by the pool and resto... until Day 4 when we were about to board the van and he still wanted to jump on board! The food was good ala carte, as was the hearty 'create your own breakfast' plate. We would have wished for more assortment on fruits though. The lunch/dinner menu particularly the seafood could have been better if they had bigger serving sizes, and as we were on a budget - we had apportioned 3-4 entrees good enough for a Pinoy family of 5. Accomodations were great - we liked the plush pillows and soft beds, the big open space that is the shower/changing area, the special soaps and the offered natural insect repellent concoction neem/citronella/coconut oil . The secluded beach (probably stretching 2km long) is very gently sloping to the seagrass beds, no house reef here though (I would have thought that they had). So it is best and safe for those families with small kids - as mum and dad can just soak in their books whilst relaxing in the plentiful hammocks by the beach and garden. The 730am daily yoga class is a welcome treat to, even for beginners like us - not too painful for the joints, he he;-) This resort is not for everyone - particularly for those on a tight budget, or wishing for fun and excitement - as there is enough options in town for those. Qi is for those who wish to be calm, pampered (lest I forget, the staff were very attentive and polite) and relaxed during their stay. Overall - Very good! The kids are wishing to have a go again on a future holiday here;-)

author: caseyreaduae
title: QI Palawan
text: We were met at the airport as prearranged and taken to QI Palawan resort where we were met by Francis, we had an arrival drink and was escorted to our room. The rooms are very nice and clean with a lovely outdoor shower area which the children really enjoyed. The beach was nice and the water was warm, the children and I swam in the sea most days as well as the pool. We caught the end of the winds so it gave an opportunity for my wife and I to learn kite surfing, a special thank you to Donald for his time and patience teaching us both how to kite surf. We even used the local wooden boats to paddle in the sea with the children. All of the staff from Francis and Rose at the front of house, to Donald the surf instructor all of the waiters and waitresses are so helpful and friendly it really is a lovely place to relax and enjoy the scenery We made a couple of trips to duli Beach this was nice, as you could hire surf boards and body boards, just be mindful of the sand flies there. Beautiful beach to surf and swim, we used the bar at the far left of the beach, again very friendly staff. The island hopping tour offered by QI palawan was an amazing trip, we snorkeled over reefs and saw some amazing fish, the sea life really is vibrant and alive. We also did a boat trip from El Nido so that we could see the lime stone cliffs this was also a very good trip organised by QI palawan for us. The internet is very good in the restaurant, i could not get it in the room but it was not really an issue for us. The Owner Bertina is super friendly and always available to give you travel advice. She has two lovely dogs Gordy and Gandolf that our children adored (they both cried when we left as they did not want to leave the dogs!!). Our flights with air swift were changed at the last minute which meant we couldn't make our connecting flight home, Bertina very kindly rearranged our flights for us and managed to get air swift to book us a hotel in Manilla The food at this resort is amazing, the breakfast has a great choice with wonderful fresh fruit juices, the lunch and dinner menu never disappointed and the service always with a smile. The children enjoyed a variety of dishes from the burger to the spaghetti to the chicken curry. I must also add that my children mentioned that their favorite soup was chicken noodle and despite not being on the menu the chef made it for them. Everyone there was so accommodating. Thank you Bertina for sharing your lovely home with us. casey

author: alanb8365
title: Qi Palawan is literally like a dream❤️
text: Wow! Is there such thing as a 6 star resort? Because Qi Palawan is simply the Best! The place is so quaint, peaceful, secluded, beautiful setting and I could not stop smiling when I first arrived. The service was warm, friendly, attentive and top notch! Love the staff! The food there just tasted like home cooking and absolutely delicious! The huts or cottages were clean cozy and very romantic, love the private outdoor shower/bathroom area... describing it would do any justice just trust me. They offer many fun things to do like scuba diving, snorkeling, on full day boat ride where you go island hopping and check out different coral reefs. These very affordable trips cost extra as they provide a nice barbecue lunch and several staff members and instructors that provide guidance and safety...Had a blast! Also they offer kite surfing lessons and cave exploring, be sure to bring hiking shoes if you plan to scale some challenging rock climbing. Tina one of the owners was very warm ,friendly and engaging with the guests. They even grow some of their own produce used in the dishes they prepare. The Burger was so good and be sure to try the curry and chicken adobo entrees. Sorry to get carried away here but this place is a no brainer! It's simply awesome! and I will definitely go back and tell others of this hidden gem. 4 thumbs up👍👍👍👍 Alan B

author: arborantics
title: The key to isolated relaxation
text: I spent 4 days at Qi Palawan and loved the experience. A last minute decision due to cancelled plans I came here to get away from the noise and activity of ELNido. The first thing you notice is the peaceful isolation and attention to your comfort. The manager and all staff are just so friendly, kind and ever willing to help and make your stay memorable. The private beach is beautiful although when the wind drops the sand flies will attack. Staff will provide natural body oils to help you out. The bungalow are simple yet elegant and spacious. Fan, aircon and private outside shower is really nice. You can get free movies to watch on your tv but other reception. Wifi in dining area was good. The complex is off the grid using only solar panels for their power - respect! No sewerage connection but sanitary needs are well considered. The food is quite simply amazing and the best I have eaten on Palawan. I took the opportunity to ride their trail bike exploring the north east and west coast. Although the bike was not the best condition as expected for a resort, this was clearly a highlight for me to discover isolated beaches far north and villages not otherwise encountered. On my last full day weather allowed an island hopping, snorkel trip. I did enjoy the release to other islands and appreciated my well catered day. If you are lucky enough to be sitting in the dining area and see the owners black lab or golden retriever visit panting and wagging their tails they just want you to turn the tap on for a drink. This simple highlight brought a smile to my face each day. Thankyou Qi Palawan I love your space and staff.

author: DC1984NT
title: Great Food, Great Hosts, Great Snorkeling & Great Accomodation
text: We stayed here for 3nights and loved every minute of it. The hosts were great and really helpful and friendly. The Huts are well decorated and the outdoor showers are impressive. What's not to like when showering under the stars?! We arrived pretty tired after long flights and transfers and were greeted at the airport by one of the owners. The initial drive to the resort was discerning for my partner but I enjoyed the views as we spent the 50mins driving to the resort. The images DON'T do it justice! Let's just say my partner forgot about the little bumpy drive when she saw the resort. "you have done well, surprisingly well". She's pretty fussy. But she loved every minute of our stay and we even make the spanish potatoes and Aoili we were served not long after we arrived with our meal. They arranged a private boat tour, lunch on a private island, snorkeling trip and I even got to jump in with the local fisherman and try to spear a lobster with their homemade spear gun. You don't always get these experiences. Would love to go back some day. Couldn't have asked for more. They even helped us arrange another hotel to stay at in El Nido town. Awesome place! Thanks again Qi Palawan!

author: Y5938EAsimond
title: Unpretentious Luxury for active people
text: We spent 4 nights here at the end of our honeymoon. We came for kite-surfing but were too early in the season. We were pleasantly surprised by the number of other activities they had. We enjoyed yoga each morning (free) and had plenty of other options to choose from each day (many of them complimentary). I highly recommend doing the hotel's diving or island hopping. The coral reefs were much better than what we saw on the El Nido side. The hotel itself is wonderful. Unpretentious but luxurious in a very romantic setting. The quality of the rooms, food and service for the price is the best value we found in the Philippines. The staff is excellent . . . not just friendly but also competent. The beach is great for kiting but not a perfect white sand beach found at the super expensive island resorts. That said, we did have it to ourselves.

author: Yoga_Chica73
title: Awesome place to chill and disconnect!
text: Be sure to know that Qi Palawan is off the beaten path. Get your island hopping in from El Nido town and then get picked up to spend time here in a quiet natural space. If you are looking for a full moon party style atmosphere this isnt the place for you. Yeah – internet can be spotty but you don’t come here for that. Qi Palawan is to chill and disconnect. Really enjoyed the food, the yoga and the massage to soothe my sunburn! Bettina and Ismael are fantastic hosts – knowledgeable and helpful in every way and great at organizing fun stuff for you to do! Felt like we were visiting with old friends ;-) Snorkel trips were terrific, kite boarding a challenge but glad I had a go. Loved the SUP. Beach was perfect for my morning meditations and long walks. The rooms are super clean (I’m in love with outdoor showers!), comfortable and safe. Anything that was needed was taken care of straight away. Found the staff to be well-trained, attentive and honest - which isnt always easy to find. Much better service here than other places nearby we had to deal with for the same price. It’s worth the effort to get here and is why its so special, would I make the effort again, most definitely (great place for a yoga retreat!!) and would love to stay a lot longer!

author: Thingstosell
title: Not for me as some other traveler said.
text: Nice rooms, nice king-size beds. Off tge beaten path. Food is ok for a day or so, but then the menu gets real boring. Beer prices are not bad. Food menu is limited... and they had no milk for coffee. Place is full of mosquitoes. Pool is more of a wading pool. Depending on your room/cabin, the internet is almost inaccessible. Massages are not bad, but as a male, I do not like massages from a male. They do have a scuba dive shop on premises but I did not dive due to rains. There is no TV here, u borrow some USB drives with movies on it. The TV in my room was a 20 LCD, hardly worth watching. No hot water for bathing... it was chilly due to rains. Would i stay here again, no!

author: REveline
title: Excellent!
text: We wished we stayed there longer! We made the right decision to stay in Qi, an hour away from the airport and all the hustle and bustle of the city. The resort was very calm, the staff very nice, and set a very high standard for the rest of our trips in the Philippines - other places did not give us half the great service we received in Qi to be honest. Our room was very clean and cleaned twice - which is a surprise considering it's a small resort. The whole resort is powered by a generator but we barely felt power shut down. The shower was really nice, with hot water too! The food was good, but expensive - as expected. All the ingredients are so fresh you can taste it! There are no other options in the area though. We also got a free El Nido airport transfer. We did the picnic lunch on our second day because no other group booked the island hopping. We had a private boat to a private island, went snorkeling and had a great lunch. The beaches were really flat, allows you to just sit around in the water. Very calm too. I would stay here again for sure!

author: travelshah
title: Cute little hotel - incredible service!
text: We stayed here on honeymoon for two nights and we really enjoyed it. The resort is about 45 mins to an hour on dusty roads from El Nido Lio airport. However when you arrive it's very peaceful. The hotel is designed quite simply but this worked well for us. It's a lot quieter than other resorts we visited in the area and therefore you get more of a personal service. The rooms are quite big and spacious each with an individual balcony outside overlooking the beach and an outdoor shower too (in an enclosed area). The hotel offers free yoga (which was great), free kayaks etc. I wouldn't recommend swimming there; however we enjoyed the kayaking. There is an onsite spa which offered great value massages. We also tried out kiteboarding which was good fun. In general, food, drink and laundry in the resort are well priced compared to other hotels we have been to. The owner is available most of the time for a friendly chat or to help with anything. The staff are all local and although their English is limited they are all extremely helpful. They do provide the extra touches eg chopping up some fresh aloe for us after our kiteboarding lesson in the sun. We were also very grateful for arranging a private dinner for us close to the beach at no extra cost, thanks Ishmael. Food was of pretty good quality and tasty. We had a lovely stay.

author: 319sued
title: Beautiful resort with a personal touch
text: We loved this resort. There are 7 bungalows which are well spaced and simply, but elegantly appointed. They are set in beautiful gardens, overlooking the sea. It's on the quieter eastern side of the island and it takes around 50 minutes to reach here from El Nido on a road which is about 80% complete so some bumpy parts! From the moment we arrived we could tell that we were going to enjoy this place. The owner, Bettina, makes you feel very at home and makes a point of coming to chat each day about your plans for the day and then follows up later by asking for feedback. Her staff are equally friendly and attentive. We did the Eastern Islands trip offered by the resort and it was amazing. There were just 4 of us on the boat and we were taken to 3 different islands. The scenery was stunning, lunch was delicious and the snorkelling at the last stop was great. Such a contrast to the boat trips from El Nido which we enjoyed but found to be very busy with lots of boats. We also used their mountain bikes one day and paddled round the bay in one of their wooden kayaks on another. The only are area which we felt could be improved a little was the food. Most of what we ate was good but the bread at breakfast was toasted rounds of French stick which were really hard and difficult to bite. Also, we would have appreciated at least one choice of local fresh juice each day. Overall, we had a fantastic stay and loved this place.

author: simony589
title: Relaxing beach holiday
text: We recently spent three days chilling at Qi and it was paradise. The photos don't do it justice. It's an isolated resort and that is the beauty. It's about 45min drive from El Nido airport and the guys were there to pick us up. Pleasant drive, and it should be better once the road is finished. The resort is stunning. Beautiful gardens with lots of comfy sun loungers located in the sun and shade. The pool is fab and you'll often find yourself alone on the beach - which is amazing. The water is warm and clear. There are sandflies, but they supply lotion which prevents bites. I didn't have any problems with it. The food is great, nice variety and always delicious. The staff are very warm and welcoming. Rooms are a good size and the outdoor shower is a nice touch. There is also a deck out the front - a perfect spot for sundowners. Finally, the day trips are really good. We went island hoping and the guys took great care of us. BBQ on an isolated white beach, amazing snorkelling and a day spent chilling on the boat. A great stay. Thanks to Benitta and her team for a wonderful relaxing stay.

author: 497stephanj
title: Amongst the best in Palawan
text: Of course one can find much more luxurious resorts in and around Palawan, but if you are looking for a small (only 7 bungalows), Eco-friendly place (many veggies come for their own garden) with extremely friendly staff and a gorgeous virgin palm fringed beach then you will love QI. Bettina, the very much hands on owner, is lovely. We arrived on a windy and cloudy evening having endured a tough 6 hour ferry journey from Coron in a very choppy sea and she welcomed us with nice hot ginger tea. Our wet cloth (so much for a waterproof luggage) were taken away and dried and the hot shower felt wonderful. The huts are very comfortable with large beds, aircon, TV (we never watched it, but you can borrow films from the restaurant), lovely outdoor showers with nice shampoo, shower gel, conditioner and body lotion. Infused palm oil is provided and it will protect you against insects. We discovered that sand flees are a problem everywhere in Palawan, but QI is the only resort which we noticed fumigated the beach more than once daily and we were never bitten. This is a kitesurfing paradise and swimming in the sea is not as easy as in other places, but we managed to go for long swims every day. Betina turned out to be an excellent yoga teacher and we enjoyed the daily free 7.30 am classes overlooking the sea and the jungle very much. The restaurant/lounge area which also has a pool table is lovely. An Ideal,place to have a few drink, listen to the some great music and relax. The menu is very varied. We enjoyed most the specials, particularly the tuna tartar. Particular thanks to Rose and Bettina who went out of their way spending hours trying to help us plan and book our remaining two week on Palawan - improvising with no bookings so close after Chinese New Year is not a good idea. Lastly, we loved our massages every day. In response to some other comments, this is not a budget option, but we discovered that in the Philippines you get what you pay for and at this resort what you get is with the money you pay for. We can highly recommend QI.

author: RhodoraD
title: Relaxing...
text: I booked to stay at Qi Palawan no knowing where it was (how far away from Il Nido) or what to expect. I read the little reviews on offer but it was not enough. But it was exactly what we (family of 4, two teenagers in tow) was looking for after an action pack four days in Il Nido island hopping. We stayed in a 2 story bungalow; kids on the ground floor with 3 single beds and parents on the top floor. Needless to say there were plenty of room for all of us. There's 2 toilets (upstairs and down stairs) and one beautiful shower (outside). The owners have thought of everything; there's cold drinking water in every room (delivered morning and noon), even a special oil for the guests to repel mosquitoes and general bugs. There's a team that cleaned our bungalow while we had breakfast, and I mean CLEAN! The surrounds are always a buzz with activity with locals (employed from neighboring villages) weeding and doing general gardening...quietly. They are meticulous as the garden looks immaculate (they even rake the seaweeds washed up on the beach and cart them away!). There is a restaurant on the resort, manned and supervised by the owner (who is an accomplished international chef), so you know they would only serve you quality good food. If you don't like the menu selection, no problem, they would easily cook the food you like as long as you can tell them the recipe and ingredients permitting. There are no other restaurants close by (Il Nido is an hour away by private van) so checking out other restaurants are not conceivable. However, the restaurant offers daily specials you can try; from local recipes. There are plenty of activities available but we did not try it except the yoga and massage. I loved the massage as you can specify if you like it to be gentle or hard. The massage therapists were obviously trained well (you have to be careful as not everyone offering massage are good and would not accidentally hit the wrong nerve and end up inuring). After our island hopping in Il Nido, we really just wanted to relax by the pool. You can also just watch movies but the selection is sparse (so if you have a dvd or two you would care to donate, it would be very appreciated). We loved our stay here and given a chance, we would eagerly go back tomorrow!

author: vmc20142014
title: Great Place!!!!
text: We spent 7 great days at Qi Palawan. We highly recommend this resort. The owners, Betina and Ismael, are great. They operate the resort and were there making sure that our experience was perfect. The friendliness of the Philippine staff was another highlight. So helpful. So nice. Reading prior trip advisor reviews helped us pick this place and I have to say they are spot on. The location is fantastic, isolated from other resorts while providing all we needed from food to comfort, to activities and the right amount of adventure. Qi Palawan offers a unique experience in El Nido area, as you are able to go island hopping to truly deserted islands, and be there by ourselves, without other boats and tourists. We did 2 island hopping trips with them. Went to beautiful little islands and never ran into anyone else in all places we went. We also went to El Nido to try island hoping there, and while the landscape there is impressive, we were with at least 4 or 5 other boats on every beach we stopped. Also, we were rushed out of islands in El Nido, which never happened with Qi Palawan. At Qi Palawan we were able to define the pace. If we liked a spot more we could stay as long as we wanted. The crew managing the boats were excellent. We enjoyed a few other activities including scuba, snorkeling, paddle boards, and walks on the beach. The food was another highlight. I can't say enough of how much we enjoyed every meal.

author: ImranW969
title: Could have been better
text: I was tempted between a 3 & 4 rating... but multiple factors kept it at a 3. Let's start with the good. 1 - Good staff at the reception. Quick check in. 2 - Food is good. Breakfast spread is nice. Opportunities 1 - No Hand Towels. 2- Additional towel for placement that was provided had a unpleasant smell. 3 - Linen on bed was stained. 4 - Room service delayed the food and I was informed that it has been sent. Called back to be informed again that it's being sent 5 - Staff asking for a tip post delaying my food which was partially cold. Overall Verdict. A Nice place to stay if the above is taken care of. Have been to better properties of Keys so expected a little more.

author: vijayckartheek
title: A Wonderful Stay
text: I came to Vizag on a Eight day trip anticipating to stay at Keys Hotel for the first three days. The Hotel Ambiance, Location, Service and Staff were so nice, that I extended my entire stay at the same Hotel. Location: The property location was in the heart of the city and I was allotted a Room in the 12th Floor that I get a chance of birds eye view of the beautiful Vizag city. Ambiance: The rooms are clean and very well maintained and my stay was hassle free. The breakfast was included in my price and was also nice, typically South Indian. There is a decent Gym which you can use. Staff: The Staff were really nice, polite and very customer friendly. A special mention and appreciation one of the Staff member Mrs. Padma who comes basically to clean the room. She always bear a smile on her face, soft spoken and wishes the guests very warmly. Respect to her. A special thanks to service manager Mr. Yogesh. Also a special mention and thanks to the receptionist Mr. Sukesh, who provided me a room in the 12th floor and also assisted me with some special requirements, like simplifying the process rebooking my stay after three days, etc. Overall a very nice experience and would not mind to revisit the hotel at my next available opportunity to visit Vizag. If you are looking for hotels in Vizag, I would strongly recommend to stay in the hotel.

author: NagaB104
title: Awesome stay and amazing people
text: One of the best hotels in Visakhapatnam. Peaceful area, near to R.K. beach and other city attractions. Hotel staff is one of the biggest assets to hotel right from front desk staff to Main Chef. Front desk staff are very polite, room service is quiet impressive with complimentary snacks in the evening. Main Chef is another asset for Keys Select Hotel, Visakhapatnam, Chef Naga is amazing human being, down to earth and very warm hearted person. Actually you can find Chef in dining area, he will be roaming here and there to interact with hotel guest. Apart from his warm gestures towards guest, buffet menu by chef is extraordinary. Though dinner buffet items are limited but they are delicious and yummy. Breakfast buffet is awesome with plenty of options, french toast is awesome. Overall a good hotel to stay in a calm and peaceful area with very good staff and Chef. I would recommend you to consider this hotel if you planning to visit Visakhapatnam. Thanks front desk people for a free upgrade, love the city view from 11th floor. Thanks to Chef Naga for sudden surprise, you're an amazing person, pleasure to meet you. Thanks Keys Select Hotel, for making my vacation awesome. Only area of improvement for hotel is to include more items in dinner buffet (you can count on Chef Naga).

author: 447prabhakard
title: Good location but bad feel inside
text: Great location Quick checkin. responsible staff No one to carry your bags.. no concierge There are only two lifts and waits are long Restaurant looks good.. but awful air conditioning Food is just ok.. not much on the a la carte Breakfast buffet was soso. Continental was veg sandwich. Live counter was not there Coffee served from big tea cans. Some dishes like vadai and chutney were good With all this, the staff were helpful Rooms are not painted properly. Good size but toilets poor. The water does not drain well. There is no doormat.. the shower had just too little force. One day the room was cleaned but the towels were not changed.. ohh. the quality of the towels are pathetic. Better take your own.... The two stars are for the staff.. nothing for the hotel

author: twojatcapt
title: great hospitality
text: i checked in at keys hotel vizag on 05th november 2016 and checked out on 9th november 2016 i was welcomed by two smiling efficient courteous young girls namely bhargavi and zoya who took less than a minute to complete the check in process and was escorted to my room no 702 by bhargavi. room was nice linen fresh and new. aircondition working effectively silently,so was the refrigerator. room as such was not big just ok in size.all the required toileteries were provided in the bath room. i informed the hotel about my allergey to a particular condiment which was conveyed to all the staff members of f&b dept. i was very well looked after by chefs rama rao and sikander who provided me whatever dishes i asked for whether was in menu or not. buffet breakfast spread was nice and sumptuous.chef babu was there to provide you any item which otherwise was not available in the buffet. ms sravanthi was there to look after your plates with her smiling face. room service was fast and prompt duly taken care by nagesh and srikant. housekeeping was taken care of by ms leena mr naidu and a boy from shillong. vamsi and dhananjay two young men from front office impressed me with their smiling ever helpful attitude with prompt and fast service. any thing told to vamsi and dhananjay was prompltly taken care of. during my 4 days of stay in the hotel i never had to remind vamsi bhargavi zoya and dhananjay for any work . every thing was done promptly with smile at the very first instance. during my stay of 4 days i never once felt that i am staying in this hotel for the first time and i am interacting with these hotel staff for the first time. all of them had gone an extra mile to make my stay a very comfortable and memorable. i really appreciate their sense of duty attitude of serving the guests with smile which will bring me back again to keys hotel vizag whenever i visit visakhapatnam again.

author: Themotherhen07
title: Family meal with friends.
text: Our friends recommended this place to us... So we rang and made a reservation for 8 people over looking the sea. We were greeted my a friendly Cornish man, who led us to the table which was perfect and the view was even better. There was 4 adults and 4 children, the children ordered childs pizza. These were £5, and well worth it. They filled an adult size plate too, Infact we had to ask for a box to take the remaining pizza home with us. The waiter was more than happy for us to do that. The adults had fish and chips which also of a high standard, large beer battered fish and chunky chips. The house burger with cheese and bacon, which was another large portion and made to s high standard, and the merrymore (hunter style chicken) this again was. Very generous portion and was too big to finish. All the food was a high standard especially for pub food. We were so impressed that we went back 3 days later but just the 4 of us. Again we was greeted warmly and managed to get a table with a sea view again... This time the boys chose pizza again. And us adults chose the squire which was grilled chicken in a creamy mushroom and bacon sauce served with vegetables, this was a delicious generous portion. We also ordered the special which was hake, another generous portion there was how ever a small error regarding this meal. The waitress was extremely helpful and sorted the matter out quickly and professionally. She even gave us a desert on the house. We shall be returning to the merrymore inn on our next trip down to Cornwall.

author: Biggsy510
title: Average if that
text: The breakfast served here is fantastic, all freshly cooked and well presented. The food in the restaurant is also very good, nice selection of ales. The rooms are basic. There was no room to put any toiletries in the bathroom and nowhere to put your shower gel etc in the shower. The shower was quite frankly poor, terrible pressure, it took ages to wash the shampoo out of my hair. The taps were very noisy and the sink was cracked. The plug was tarnished and needs changing. The bed was small but comfortable. There was a teeny tiny television stuck on the wall near the window which was hardly worth having, we used it for the radio. On first glance the room was clean but I dropped my earring and had to move the bedside unit and found somebody's used cotton wool behind it. Also bird poo on the window, whilst I appreciate it is near the sea it should've been checked before we were shown to it. The stool for the dressing table was revolting, stained and horrible. The bins were not emptied each day. The view from the bar and rooms is stunning, it is in a lovely position. I just wish the room had been better. I feel this side of it lets the Merrymoor down.

author: grahamb812
title: Great location for good walks
text: The stay we just had was a gift from our daughter. You know how it is, a hotel you haven't stayed in before and hadn't researched yoursleves is always a bit of a worry. In this ase, we needen't have concerned ourselves at all. If you want sea views then get room 6. A big picture window straight out onto the bay. Look at the waves crashing on the sides of the bay, watch the surfers ride, and the dogs chase whatever they want to on the sands. The area around is hilly, so you will get a good workout if that it your thing. The room itself is good and clean. The tea tray is well stocked. The batchroom is as big as my bedroom at home :) So you know the first part of B&B is good, what about the other, the breakfast? Well on the first morning, both mine and my wifes breakfast were not quite correct. She was missing an item and I had 1 extra (not the same item, else I could have just of passed it over). But the other two days were on the button, and she remembered my wifes request for decaf coffee from the first day. You could hear she remebered each guests previous requests and what they said they were going to do the previous day. This is my mind is an indication of a good host. They show that you are not just someone passing thorugh that they do not need to think about, but someone they wish to converse with. SO in summary, not the pretiest of hotels, but in a great location with good rooms and food, with a host who does the right things, Nothing wrong with that in my book.

author: 500owenc
title: Good for a drink on a sunny day - avoid food at all costs
text: I think the main thing the Merrymoor inn relies on is the fact that it is the only pub in walking distance of the beach in Mawgan Porth as if it had any competition it would have to up it's game or close down. If sunny then it's a great place for a break from the beach and a drink with a good selection of ales and ciders (or cyders I suppose with it being in Cornwall). However, we made the unfortunate mistake of eating there one night. Upon ordering there was very little I wanted to begin with but i opted for the bbq chicken and chorizo pizza (best of a bad bunch). My partner enquired about the curry (medium hot lamb curry which seems an odd choice for a Cornish pub and one we did not trust), so she then asked about the beef and ale pie. The barmaid explained that it was a home made pie topped with puff pastry. this being ideal for my girlfriend the barmaid then said "oh, you can't have it - we've sold out". This being about half 5 on a Sunday afternoon when there was a carvery on seemed odd and shortsighted of the pub, but more so raised the question of why explain about the pie if there was none left - it is unlikely to have been asked out of mere curiosity. So, she plumped for the vegetarian lasagne (my girlfriend being an ardent meat eater this shows lack of other options). When this arrived it was a bit cold, but also, and I quote "quite possibly the most tasteless thing i have ever eaten". Having tried a forkful out of curiosity I can confirm her sentiment. I, as previously stated, had the bbq chicken and chorizo pizza. When it arrived it looked like a pepperoni pizza with large lumps of fried onion on. Unfortunately this was not onion but actually my pieces of "bbq chicken". I have had meatier and more realistic bits of chicken in a pot noodle. Many meals and disappointments were repeated across our table of six, with only addition being my girlfriend's father who had the steak which came 10 minutes after everyone else's food and was quite clearly either a frozen beef steak or a fatty piece of horse meat - grim either way. Resounding disappointment across the table and whilst we returned for drinks it was unanimous that we would never try food here again.

author: WhiteFamily_Hants
title: Happy family!! :0)
text: I don't know what is wrong with some people..... Lynn, Dudley, Nick and the staff of the Merrymoor could not have been any more friendly if they'd tried. We stayed there with our two young children for 5 nights during the October half term and I can honestly say that If it wasn't for their hospitality, we wouldn't have had the enjoyable holiday that we did. The Breakfast was excellent, you are quite literally spoilt for choice. Lynn and Sarah were very happy to accommodate and spoil our children with what ever they asked for (nice touch). We were also offered ideas for days out and informed of any offers available in the local papers. They really couldn't have been any more helpful. The rooms were lovely. They were clean, warm and had recently been decorated. Well worth the room rate! Comparing it to other places that I have stayed in the past, I would have expected to pay more. The Bar meals are fantastic. Home cooked meals at very reasonable prices and lots of choice. A lady commented about having to communicate to the bar staff over peoples heads... The Merrymoor is a popular bar/restaurant with locals and holiday makers, so it does tend to be busy during holidays. I don't know what she expected, as you would expect the same in any successful bar/restaurant in any town. The experience that we had at the Merrymoor has left us wanting to go back and stay again. I would be more than happy to recommend them to any one that is looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay in Cornwall. See you soon Merrymoor!!

author: Tiger-Squirrel
title: The Merrymoor: Fabulous!! 'I cannot believe some reviews'
text: FLABBERGASTED... I cannot believe certain reviews?! I'm not normally a 'review' kind of person. HOWEVER, following much publicity about Trip Advisor, I thought I'd take a peak. I am ASTOUNDED after reading certain comments regarding 'The Merrymoor Inn, Mawgan Porth, nr, Newquay, Cornwall. A place I have visited time & again. Hence, I feel compelled to write my views... Personally, I find the Building, Accommodation, Decor’ of Rooms AND Bar: The Ambience, Friendly Welcoming Staff, Food with a (Carvery to die for), Service, AND Value for money: Well, you've waited long enough, here you have it... ABSOLUTELY FIRST CLASS! Psssssst'... Not to mention, I had the pleasure of being in the company of Prince William when he dropped by, after surfing with friends in 2010. They very much enjoyed their visit, lunch & a bit of local chat! He stayed at the Watergate Hotel, but chose to eat at The Merrymoor Inn... Maybe, Prince William & Co' found it welcoming & friendly,,, eh! PS; ONLY PROBLEM is getting away from the place... Due to so many nice people wanting to natter, locals & vsitors alike. Joke of course! Moreover, how nice it is to feel welcome, comfortable & relaxed when you have your dog with you! Proprietors and Staff, keep up the good work!

author: jandgEssex
title: A little shabby but.....
text: We stayed at the Merrymoor for three nights in September. We were greeted by Lynn who is a chatty friendly lady and makes you feel welcome. The room overlooking the bay was fine and the view spectacular - the bathroom very clean, although if the towels were extremely thin. We ate at the inn all three nights, and every night we could not fault the food. It was always hot and tasty. As has been stated by other visitors the "bar" is very "clicky" for the locals. (I use the term 'bar' loosely as it is really a cafe type area) and whilst trying to order Nick did indeed have trouble looking at you or smiling at all. As a new arrival I asked if we could sit where we liked or if we had been allocated a table, he simply walked passed me with a sour face and without making eye contact and said "let Michelle know your here" - Michele being who??? Where do we find her?? I found him generally quite rude. The bar staff on other nights were friendlier. The "town" is very small and pretty but there is little competition for The Merrymoor Inn. It may have had a facelift in 2007 - but it is desperately old fashioned. Artex is not appealing anymore, and it generally gave the interior a shabby look. Having said all that it was perfectly adequate for its rates, but we would not stay again.

author: Marsgsd
title: Nice view of beach, but pub/restaurant is terrible.
text: The first thing we noticed was that although the Inn has windows overlooking the beach (and should be stunning), all the tables are curiously positioned side-on to the windows, rather than facing it. This meant we constantly had to crook our necks to see the sea-view, and therefore couldn't help but notice how shabby and bleak the pub decor was. Yellowing artex is not a great look, and when it is combined with dark brown gloss paint over anaglypta, it made the pub look like the owner stopped bothering in about 1973. However, realising that you should never judge a book by it's cover, we decided to order a drink and some food, but in order to do that we had to get past the little gaggle of tattooed, shaven haired, regulars who sit at the bar, and clearly take exception to visitors. The bar-person took our order, while simultaneously avoiding eye contact, and carried on their conversation with locals (not us). We ordered Scampi and chips, and crab fish cakes with salad and chilli dipping sauce. The bar-person said, what table are you sitting at, stuck out hand for payment, and we retreated to our table amidst glances that we took to mean we would be tolerated, but not welcome. Obviously their deep-fat fryer was very efficient, and our food arrived within a few minutes, but it was very poor indeed. While we're not food snobs, we like our chips from peeled potatoes, and hoped that crab cakes in cornwall would be home made, taste of crab, have identifiable pieces of claw-meat in them, and be shaped like cakes. What we got was catering type frozen scampi and chips, and the crab-cakes were two thin biscuits of deep fried brown fish paste. I asked for salad dressing, and was told they do not have french dressing or mayonnaise (only salad cream, olive oil or balsamic vinegar), so I had to try and concoct my own dressing. We both left half our meals, and while we were contemplating whether to risk a pudding, the waitress arrived, and said finished ?... but before we could answer, she had picked up our plates and whisked them away. She didn't enquire if we wanted a pudding, but continued whisking away full plates of uneaten food from adjacent tables. As we left (without a thank you, or good night), we noticed a friendly sign in the car park, saying that parking at the Inn is for customers only, any other car would be clamped and towed. No problem because we are not going back.

author: Lion2006
title: Best Place to stay in Kundasang to see Mt. KK
text: Kinabalu Pine Resort is the best place to stay in Kundasang to see Mt. KK. The rooms are large and clean, well maintained. No air con but the weather is cool enough and nice breeze throughout the day & night. Thin wall separating next door. Surrounding areas are well kept. Lots of trees and plants. Ample parking. Amazing view of Mt. KK and many spot for photos. Very courteous staff at reception and restaurant. Wide selection of food and clean for this grade of accommodation. Simple but nice steamboat for dinner, or ala-carte menu. Convenient shop open until 9pm-10pm at night. Close to Kundasang town, only 10 mins walk. Overall, very good value and highly recommended. Eric

author: C0Y_18
title: Memorable stay
text: We stayed in room S1 & S2 which shared a huge veranda that have magnificent view of Mt. Kinabalu. The view of sunrise from our veranda was amazing too! When we are not out from resort, we spent most of our time at our veranda. The room is basic but clean and comfortable. Towel, slipper, soap and shampoo are provided, but not toothbrush and toothpaste. Hot shower and hot water from basin tap are available without waiting time. Driveway to our room is steep as Block S located at top of resort. There is one parking space in front our rooms, so it is very convenient to unload /load luggage. The resort is well maintained with nice landscape surrounding with flowers and trees. There is a rabbit house in the resort where my kid enjoyed feeding the rabbits. The choices for breakfast are limited as it is a la carte, but the foods are good and with free flow of coffee, tea and orange juice. We enjoyed our dinner at the restaurant outdoor seating area by having steamboat and tomyam in the breezy cool weather. Resort is located not far from Kundasang town and along the main road. Such, it is very easy to access and very convenient to visit nearby attractions with car.

author: myssyolo
title: Very comfortable, clean and gorgeous view
text: This resort is not super luxurious but it is conveniently located about 10min drive from kinabalu city and offers gorgeous view of kota kinabalu. It is also rather central and easy to travel to various points of interest. The resort is very cosy and welcoming. Our stay was very comfortable and well taken care of. The room (cottage style) is clean with basic amenities. I love the balcony with beautiful view! Rooms in block R is great or those higher up but down side is the uphill walk. Not so good for old folks with mobility issues. Else the view is definitely worth the work out. The only peeve i had was the hair dryer that had a timer which is really faulty. In room R1, the dryer works for only a few seconds and it will overheat and shut down for 3 minutes before i can use for few seconds again! The good thing is, after a bit of negotiation, they have me another dryer that actually works. Hot water is good with good pressure. Bed was comfy and though there's no A.C., you won't need it. We got the half-board rate which included breakfast and dinner. Really great value for money. You get to choose from a selection of local food or simple American breakfast. For dinner it is a set menu with different dishes each day of the week, but if you have a something you don't eat and if you ask nicely, they may accommodate and change that dish for you. Would definitely recommend this place!

author: 230shahrimans
title: Great Stay n Great View
text: 1. Reservations was easy and all communication was with Wassap. 2. Cozy and very confortable rooms. Had space for extra 2 extra beds for my boys in the room. 3. Clean toilets with hot water and good pressure. 4. Inclusive of breakfast and dinner. Very tasty. Recommend to try their steamboat and get a table outside. 5. Friendly staffs. 6. MAGNIFICENT view of Mt Kinabalu! 6. Only downside was the visitors from Putrajaya was rude and litter the place with ciggy butts.

author: 613isaacl
title: Getaway
text: Stay in this hotel for 2 nights. After reading all the reviews from past trip advisor. Reception was prompt but we couldn't early..only after 2pm.Given a good view of Mount Kinabaru from our hotel room located P4. Room was Spartan only entertainment was the TV channels HBO and Chinese channels. The Queen size bed is clean but the blankets are Dam, toilet is basically standard and clean and there is rats outside the balcony in the middle of the night. No air-con, just fan. Cool enough to chill. But afternoon was rather hot between 1000- 1700hrs. Unless you are up the mountain where it is cooler. But in the night rather cold. Especially when it is raining. Car park is plenty and the pine resort restaurant is recommended to dine in. Trust me, no where else is suitable as we try all the recommended restaurant nearby. There are setback in this resort.. is the roosters nearby village seem to calling all day long even in the middle of the night while you are sleeping. Dogs barking are occasionally. And raindrop spattering on the zinc roof can be heard loudly.. Was like you are staying back in kampong good old days.

author: ChristopherLimTW
title: 2-night getaway in Kundasang
text: KPR was a nice hotel with a good view of Mount Kinabalu. We landed in Kota Kinabalu airport, hired cars and drove there ourselves. Roads are in reasonably good condition but do take it slowly as there are numerous large vehicles which also use the roads up into the mountains. Location in Kundasang is also convenient with easy access to Poring Hot Springs, the Kinabalu park, cow farm and the vegetable markets provided you are driving. Rooms in KPR were spacious with either King sized beds or 2 super single beds. Basic amenities were provided in the room. Bathrooms were clean with separated shower area. The best feature of the room was the large balcony provided which has 5 chairs and a decent sized table, and has a view of Mount Kinabalu. Our neighbours for 1-day, organised a big family steamboat session on the balcony and appeared comfortable. All rooms come with their own car parks right below/ outside the rooms so parking is easy. Food at the restaurant was reasonable. Breakfast comes with the rooms and has to be ordered the night before. We had dinner in the hotel, the night of our arrival and it was reasonably good. Other facilities include a small playground, a barbeque pit, a rabbit hutch with a handful of rabbits and a mini fish pond which was good for keeping the kids entertained for a while. All hotel workers were all polite and helpful. Will definitely be coming back on our next trip to Kundasang.

author: tinkikuttih
title: Nice View from the Hotel
text: Located not far from the Kundasang Main Square which has restaurant around the area. Has a nice view of Mount Kinabalu. But unfortunately during our stay it was raining with thick clouds. But still managed to get part of the view. Room and toilet are clean. But please do bring your own toiletries. The only downside are the rooms. Most of the rooms are side by side. So if you talk alittle louder or having kids who runs around the room all the time, you can practically feel it in your room. So there goes your peace and quietness. If you drive, you can park your car below your unit if it comes with the parking garage. If it's a van, you can park at their parking lots available. Breakfast was simple. So don't expect a fanciful buffet spread.Place an order and have your breakfast. And that's it. Wifi connection was ok. Not that strong. Try to get room located at P or S. Do book early to avoid disappointment as it tends to be full. Staff are polite and great.

author: Julie1899Julie
title: Very pretty enterance, well kept but basic
text: As we drove up to this place we were Impressed, the outside and grounds are beautiful, the flowers are amazing, they smell devine. The lodges look very pretty, all painted white, wooden, with parking underneigh. We arrived fairly late as the drive from KK took a long time (very small car) The reception was small, like a small office, we were here quite a while whilst they sorted check in. I wouldn't say the check in was the friendliest but they got the job done. They directed us to our room, which was in chalet D, we got there and the key card didn't work, nothing would register, so we returned to reception, asked them to sort it, they reset it, we tried again, this still didn't work, so we had to sit outside whilst they called maintenance. The took the scanner off and just gave us a regular key. The room was no frills, very basic and dated. The no air conditioning worried us but to be honest the temperature is much cooler here than in KK. We Headed out for dinner which was included, the restaurant is like a canteen with table service, serving one set menu. The food was cheap and cheerful, it filled a hole but nothing more. The service was prompt, they were efficient and helpful. We had to leave earlier than breakfast the next day so asked if it was ok to come to breakfast a little earlier, they were very accommodating. Unfortunatly neither of us slept a wink here, as soon as we had turned the lights out a cockerel started calling - ALL NIGHT. Even ear plugs couldn't stop the noise. We left early in the morning feeling very grumpy and tired, not a great way to climb Kinabalu Leave enough time to check out as they make you stay at reception whilst they check the room.

author: visitoradvise
title: Wooden Resort at Top Hill Viewing the Kinabalu Mountant
text: Check-in on 27 April 2016 late evening, I experienced a smooth check-in process despite the rainy day, I have a difficulty at the beginning to find the parking as it is limited for the resident only. Receptionist is very soft spoken and friendly and welcoming with beautiful smile. Hotel having a complete basic facilities (ion, ion board and cattle) with a special docking for the viewing nice mount Kinabalu scenery. The ambiance is very peaceful and cools weather, my daughter and son enjoy the moment we step in to the spacious room. Hotel room have a build in water heater which required 20 minutes to heat up and one simple wall fan next to the flat screen TV. In the booking slip, it mention that our room equip with the queen bed but it actually we get King Bed size which suitable for the small family vacation (2 adult and 2 kids). Yellow lighting in the room giving a direct impact to feel sleepy and cool. I try to adjust the level of room temperature by the room curtain and sliding windows shades. When it's raining, the room temperature is really cool up to 20-24 Degree Celsius. Lucky the blanket provided by the hotel. At night, we can gather at the balcony and enjoy the cool and beautiful scenery facing the mount Kinabalu. In the early morning, we can hear the chicken and bird singing all the way. It is just a perfect feeling to have a vacation and enjoy the mother nature with family. Disadvantages, I book a bit late and resulting that I get the unit below to the unit at block R which during the night I stay the occupant for the above unit is quite active and make us difficult to sleep peacefully. We can clearly hear the voice, step and coughing from the top room because the ambiance is so silence. Overall, I personally recommended to the visitor to book more than 1 day staying at this hotel to really enjoy with the natural ambiance and cool weather. Make sure you are booking the room that facing the mount Kinabalu and at the top unit for peaceful night sleep. It is highly recommended for a family vacation.

author: 1984LAD2016
title: "Basic" is too kind!
text: We stayed at the lodge as part of a honeymoon tour organised through Kuoni. Whilst we expected to stay in some basic lodgings throughout the tour, there is a vast difference between basic and somewhere that is tired, run down and generally poor. Yes, the views from the veranda were great but I could have got the same view from the road outside the place. In terms of location, it wasn't too far from Kinabalu Parks HQ however it was still at least a 15 minute drive and I am convinced that better accommodation could be found within a similar radius. The bedrooms were clean however they were stuffy, the bedding uncomfortable and the shower little more than a trickle. Every time we, or seemingly anyone else in the resort, flushed the toilet we had to listen to the water tank right outside our window (lovely view) rumble on for an inordinate amount of time. Alongside this noise was the noise from anyone and everyone outside the room, the shaking of the lodge anytime the neighbour moved and all the noise from the neighbours due to paper thin walls. Trying to sleep when your neighbour decides to watch the Chinese cooking channel all night and you can hear every word is less than easy. A call to reception on the out of hours number provided offering no assistance as they simply didn't answer. The promise of wi-fi was a joke. Yes there is a secured network and yes you get the password however whilst it can be unlocked it cannot be accessed so a little defunct really. Breakfast was a strange affair with chips and chicken nuggets one morning and what appeared to be spaghetti bolognese the next. There was very little choice and when food ran low the lady manning the serving platters appeared extremely reluctant to replenish them despite there being hours of service left. For dinner choice was again limited and what came alongside the rice was generally just bone. On what appeared to be a fist sized serving of chicken one evening I struggled to find a couple of mouthfuls of meat! Cheap cuts were clearly the order of the day. All in all this was the worst accommodation I have ever stayed in and we will not be returning.

author: Moon_hmz
title: Great view and location
text: This hotel is located very near to the Kundasang town, which is convenient. It's on a hill with lots of pine trees. It's beautiful, however, it's not recommended for wheelchair users. We booked a deluxe room, which was quite spacious and comfortable. The balcony has a SPECTACULAR view of Mt. Kinabalu. The balcony is shared with the adjacent room. For deluxe rooms, parking is right below your chalet, so that's very convenient. Rooms are very clean, and the hot shower is good as it does get rather cold at night/early morning. They also provide slippers/flip-flops. The free breakfast is nothing to shout about, but it's decent. Usually they have porridge, toast, butter & jam, fried rice or fried noodles, some local fruits, sausage, beans, eggs, fried yam/sweet potato/banana fritters. The restaurant also serves lunch and dinner. The food is quite good though of course it's quite pricey compared to going to the town. We ordered room service dinner, and there is a 15% additional delivery charge. The staff are helpful and friendly, and helped look for my son's missing toy.

author: 678derekt
title: Wake up to the view of Mount Kinabalu
text: On recent trip back to Sabah I was travelling with my parent's (in August). We stayed at the Pine Resort twice. The first week was all clouded in. But the second week the weather was better and we did another drive from Kota Kinabalu and got to see the Mountain (the road is very good). Both times we stayed in twin share. They brought in a comfortable fold away bed for me. The rooms are small but comfortable with a limited satellite TV (Astro) there were programs in Malay, Chinese & English (including a movie and sport channel). The free wi-fi was also handy if a little slow. The rooms and facilities are clean. But the onsite water can have a brown colour (the heated water seems fine) advisable to bring your own drinking water. There is no in room fridge. Room price includes breakfast, lunch and a small bottle of water. A bond is also required. The bar was being renovated at the time. They don't allow alcohol in the resteraunt which had very nice meals. You must try the steamboat (for two) if you havent tried one before. It was very good value and leaves you full! Defiantely worth a stay and the best time is in the morning to capture the view of the Mount Kinabalu.

author: Aviya207
title: Pleasant Stay
text: We stayed here in year 2013 we requested for a room facing the Kinabalu Mountain which was worth it . It was the rainy season and boy was it cold . The rooms were very comfortable we can request for extra bedding for children at a minimum fee. There is also a balcony where we can sit and enjoy the view. There is a cafe where we can eat but quite expensive as well. Breakfast was provided but was very simple nothing to tasty. There is ample of parking space. The kinabalu park is nearby and easy to visit. Watch a beautiful sunrise around 5.30 am . The only annoying things about this place are the receptionist they almost double charged us for the stay. Our credit cards were swiped and signed upon check in. But as we were checking out and handing over the keys they requested for the customer copy slip. Upon requesting why she was unable to give a reply and stated if we are unable to produce our copy. We need to pay again. Luckily i had the copy safely with me. Overall i love the place and will visit again

author: Vinnyau
title: Breathtaking and awesome view
text: I reckon this was probably the best place to stay in Kundasang. Rooms are decent. We got extra beds for the kids (charges apply). The view of the sunrise was amazing (note that sun rise is about 5:30 am local time) and you can get an awesome view of the Mt. Kinabalu. There is a look-out point with benches for this purpose. Clicking cameras at that hour is norm apparently, clouds will soon build up after 6:30 a.m. So wake up and start shooting pictures. Good parking spaces provided. No air-con, only wall fan. Guess the cool weather was comfortable enough without freezing you. Love the balcony where you can sit and chill. Breakfast was included, not fantastic but good enough for a quick fill for the stomach. The hotel is located very near to Kinabalu National Park. If you are into BBQ chicken wings, there are 2 stalls near the roundabout which are worth mentioning. A short drive away from the hotel, but it's worth it. Ask the locals for directions. Overall, a great place, great atmosphere and clean mountain air!

author: KarenL777
title: Amazing mountain view
text: Stayed overnight here on a 2 day sightseeing tour to Kinabalu National Park and Poring Hot Springs, etc. Rooms & resort were basic but very clean. Nice new looking bathroom with everything you need. Dinner in the restaurant was very nice, with a Malaysian style rice breakfast in the morning. If you expect 'western style' breakfasts & meals you will be disappointed. Accept that you're in a different country and be open-minded and you'll find the food is simple, fresh & tasty. There is a bar there (which was closed the night we visited) if you feel the need for an alcoholic drink. We found most places in Malaysia did not serve alcohol. This was no big deal, and I found the lemon iced tea to be more refreshing in the heat anyway. Also a little shop with souvenirs, basic supplies, drinks, snacks & ice creams. The best part was the amazing view of Mt Kinabalu from our decking! Sitting there, sipping a coffee, just taking in the immense presence of the mountain which towers over everything, was an awe-inspiring experience. We just sat and watched the mountain as the sun set. It was truly a highlight of our trip. Very glad we stayed overnight here.

author: Popstraveller
title: Average stay in an odd hotel!
text: My partner and I chose the Kinabalu pine resorts for a 2 night stay in May mainly because the accommodation provided by Sutera Sanctuary Lodges inside the park was either extortionately priced or not available. First impressions of the resort is that it looks like an alpine village in the middle of the jungle. We both liked this fact and it does have fantastic views of Mount Kinabalu in the morning (when the peak isn't covered in cloud). We stayed in a superior room. The room was large, had wooden floorboards and on first impressions, was clean and tidy. However, on further inspection the cleaners hadn't paid enough attention and I felt the standard of cleanliness was lacking. The balcony/terrace was huge and wonderful to sit out on. We opted for the package which included breakfast and dinner due to the limited options for food in Kundasang. The food was a set menu, including Chinese tea, and was edible, but of varying quality. Usually involved a soup and a meat dish and some rice. Breakfast consisted of tea/coffee, watermelon, noodles, eggs and chicken sausages. In hindsight, we would not opt for this package again and would find other places to eat (KFC in Kundasang village!) or near the entrance to the park itself as there was a good café outside the gates. The hotel organised transfers for us to Mount Kinabalu National Park and Poring hot springs. The transfers were expensive but our only option as we had limited time. I would advise travellers to find alternative transportation option. All in all, Kinabalu pine resorts is an odd and quirky place with pine trees, flanked by rainforest! Accommodation was basic, and not as clean as I would have liked. But, it's probably one of the better options around the national park.

author: Gordito100
title: Comfortable place to stay near Kinabalu National Park.
text: All in all, quite adequate and comfortable. Pros: Staff very friendly and helpful. Good bathrooms with adequate water heaters (wall switch). Rooms kept clean. Bedding decent and clean, mattresses a bit hard but tolerable. Cot mattresses pretty hard. Nice big porches. Wifi in the rooms (but low bandwidth). Fan in the room (AC not needed, cool at night there). Laundry service very good with one day turnaround. Cons: VERY noisy near the reception and restaurant, do not stay in the blocks in that area. Many flies attracted by the smells make it impossible to enjoy the porch- again, stay up the hill away from the restaurant. The poor office staff have to deal with flies all day long. The restaurant is mediocre but adequate. Plain, unexciting food- I did not look forward to meals but they did the job.

author: JuinZai
title: A comfortable stay ....
text: We stayed at KPR for 2 nites on the 19/5 & 20/5. We took 1 superior deluxe and 3 superior standard for 9 of us. The superior standard room is rather small ,just right for 2 persons, & can't accomodate at all any extra bed/mattress or cot. So if you are a party of 3 or have a kid, you must get the superior deluxe room. Bathrooms seemed to be newly renovated as commented by one of the tripadvisor contributor, but the shower was not strong enough due to low water pressure. I took quite sometime to wash my long hair.. Sound insulation is indeed very bad as all rooms are with timber floorings, a normal step will make a disturbing sound, so try to avoid staying in the lower level of a 2 stories chalet, you will definitely be disturbed by the tenants above you though they are not meant to do so. Breakfast buffet selection was limited but the chicken porridge we had in the first morning was so good. The next morning they took out the buffet due to low occupancy rate (non-peak season & weekday) & we were served ala carte style with the porridge refillable. We took the room package with dinner included -- the dishes and portion were better than expected. Overall our stay is very comfortable due to the cooling weather and the quiet surroundings -- we enjoyed sitting in our balcony, drinking wine/coffee and chit-chatting among ourselves. The whole KPR have a good view of the Kinabalu Peak & depending on the location to get the best view but for sure you need to go out from room, i dont see any reason why one needs to view the Peak from inside the room. My mother-in-law likes the hotel a lot -- one early evening, she just sat in her balcony by herself for almost 2 hours, looking at the Mt Kinabalu while drinking some chinese tea , she said she just want to indulge herself in the fresh & cooling air which is not possible to find in Kuala Lumpur or even Cameron Highlands. However i still think this hotel is a bit overpriced as the room setting is really very basic , more like a hostel than a hotel. Perhaps resources are scarced & expensive to bring any food/materials uphill which make everything costly.

author: sher1208
title: Good and pleasant stay
text: Best view ever! Our room was directly facing Mt. Kinabalu. Waking up to it every morning was just breathtaking. The rooms might look a little old but it's clean nonetheless. Bathrooms looked like they were newly renovated. There was a little walk in closet to keep your luggage and that's also where the dressing table was. The room came with a stand fan and no air-conditioning. Both were not needed as the weather was cooling up there. Only complaint was the food. On our first night, instead of having rice and 3 or 4 dishes, we opted for a steamboat dinner. It costs RM10 per person to upgrade. It was more like a vegetarian steamboat. The 'fishballs' and 'fish paste' were made out of flour. Breakfast was mediocre as well. Sausages with super red tomato sauce (looked like colouring was added), nasi kunyit (colouring again as there was no kunyit fragrance), sambal, toast, and some bland noodles. On our last day, we were awaken by other guests who came onto our verandah at 5 am. We didn't mind people coming but they should keep their voices down. Stayed there for 3D2N and had a lovely time.

author: Mahesh21
title: Beautiful and relaxing place...
text: I loved the place the instant I set foot there. Clean, fresh air, a little chilly as it was about to rain. The reception area is very small but the staff are friendly. What I liked most is the resort was not as crowded as I expected it to be so it was nice wandering around the area all to myself. I would recommend to take a cab (though it is pricey for solo travellers) but for comfort and view of the surrounding villages and landscapes, I did not regret it at all. I was fortunate to also arrive at the resort on a friday where there is a 'Tamu' in the kundasang town just about 10-15 minutes walk from the resort.
