The staff there are really caring and good and spend all day playing with and entertaining any children who want to join in. The kids can simply leave though if they wish so don't mistake this for a fully supervised service which will allow you to leave the hotel. Entertainment around the pool was fun with table tennis competitions, water polo, stretching and volleyball and they also put on archery competitions for the kids a couple of times a week. All in all a really good stay but the hotel does need some proper money spending on it to bring it close to the 5 stars they are claiming. Would I go there again? yes, but perhaps for a slightly shorter stay.

author: PippaHip
title: 5 day break- more than enough !
text: Visited early September with my husband and daughter. Received a very warm and professional greeting in reception and given all the information needed for a stress free holiday. The suite was amazing, clean and very spacious. The main pool- mixed bag here.. In the mornings cables draped across the water in order to presumably power the cleaning tool moving around the bottom of the pool.. Not removed until after 11am some days and a number of children seen swimming around oblivious to this hazard.. Some had the cable across their neck, some held on to it and swung on it! No signs around the pool to be aware of the danger. The pool was very busy, to be expected but we were able to find sun beds ok. Lifeguard/ towel hut/ 1st Aider spoke no English so difficult to converse/ explain concerns. Restaurant staff at the buffet very friendly. Food of a mid standard, plenty of choice but def not 5 star quality, more 3 star. Worst part of the holiday was meal times, very stressful with babies and toddlers screaming, tantrums galore - even towards the end of the sitting. The noise levels were deafening. Couldn't take advantage of the adult only pool or restaurant as my daughter is 11, but she sat and suffered those meal sittings as much as we did. Not the hotels fault but maybe a young kids dining time for families with babies and toddlers could be encouraged as I certainly wouldn't visit again to listen to ear piercing screams and not be able to hear our own conversations. Have had 4 children of my own but had much more respect for fellow diners than was practised by fellow holiday makers here. This is definitely a family, kid busy hotel so don't expect any quiet times

author: UKGizmo
title: Disappointed!!!
text: We usually find reviews are pretty close to the description of an establishment but in the case of the Gran Hotel Elba Estepona we were just not happy. We found the hotel very dark and gloomy, and the corridors are very eery and claustrophobic in places, Our room was on the ground floor, the outside terrace had a very small table and 2 chairs which were not at all comfortable. When we arrived the garden was soaked and muddy in places, there was no one in the pool or outside. The hotel seemed quite baron! We ordered room service which took about 20 minutes messing around being cut off from the phone operator which became quite annoying, an hour later the pizzas we had ordered had still not arrived! We called to chase and found the staff had sent them to the incorrect room, but then sent the pizzas to us stone cold!!! We called again and they were taken away and by 10.30 we received 2 more pizzas that were absolutely awful! They had no flavour and were presented with clear tubs over the top! Now we like pizza and are not fussy when we are hungry we are happy to eat frozen pizzas whatever but these were dreadful! We slept with a light on as it wouldn't turn off all night and we had had enough of calling reception to report the room service issue! In the morning we went to breakfast, there were children sat on the floor all over the restaurant, it was chaos! Not what was expected of a hotel we thought was 4/5 star! We have a young child ourselves and understand they get bored during meal times but the chaos in the breakfast hall plus the awful waft of sewage floating through was enough for us to pack our bags and check out! The hotel location is not close to main Estepona. A real disappointment and not anywhere close to our expectations.

author: KatiaD401
title: Unimpressive in every way!
text: This hotel is dated, not very clean, the food is less than marginal, the location is not very good and the staff is definitely not the most attentive or friendly. We checked into our room and there was still used soap and towels from the previous guests. You can't relax by the pool without being harassed by a tone of flies (non-stop). Guests leave their garbage around the pool and the staff doesn't pick it up and often it ends up inside the pool. The Internet only works at the lobby. The food for us was one and done. We had a meal at the hotel restaurant and after that we drove to Old Town Marbella everyday (well worth the 1/2 hour drive). Marbella is cleaner, hip and way nicer than Estepona. We tried to leave this hotel a few days earlier and relocate to a more suitable place and location; however, the hotel will not let you out once they "get you". We booked through hotels.com and asked the reception if they would refund three out of seven nights if we left earlier. They told us to contact hotels.com since we had booked through them. We called hotels.com and after 1/2 hour on the phone with the agent, we were told the hotel refused to refund any portion of our booking. Beware if you book this hotel be prepared to stay and endure it. Not for us but apparently many enjoy it as the reviews worked well in misleading us to visit it. My family will never return to the Hotel Elba.

author: tbodette
title: Good Hotel for All Inclusives
text: Stayed 3 nights, family of 5 (3 kids 13, 15, 18) in 2 rooms. Rooms were large and nicely appointed. We had a terrace with a view of the Mediterranean. In general, it is a nice hotel on a private section of beach. It does appear that the resort is next to a clothing optional resort. There are lounge chairs and umbrellas on the beach. (Not the cleanest beach, cigarette butts in sand around chairs) We spent most of our time at the pool. The pool was very nice!! There were lots of chairs available in both the sun and shade. The restaurant was ok. The hotel offers a buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The buffets were expensive: 30 euro (lunch), 40 euro (dinner) per person for dinner, not including drinks. We went to town one night for dinner and had an excellent dinner on the beach at half the price….and much fresher than a buffet. I felt that the web site did not adequately explain the meal options and offerings. We ate lunch off the limited a la carte menu one day. It was mediocre. The biggest issue we had was that the hotel is a 10 minute cab ride outside of Estepona. You cannot walk to town. If you don’t want to go anywhere, spend the whole day at the pool and buy the meal plan, then this is a good family place. We were more interested in exploring the town and culture of southern spain and we disappointed by the proximity of the resort to town.

author: cocoa118
title: Fabulous stay
text: This is an excellent hotel with great facilities. The staff on Reception were excellent, especially Gloria who helped us to book some trips. Just a note if you go with Jet 2 they do provide a rep, however the rep does not organise any trips which is a little annoying as we had expected this on a holiday of this price and 'indulgence'. For birdwatchers there are some great birds to be seen close by, along the road in between aldi and burger king towards the hills. My husband spotted Griffin vulchers, bee eaters, booted eagles and hoopoe for example. The hotel has great facilities, pools, restaurants and gardens were lovely. Great variety with the food, especially the hot plate where food meat and fish were cooked to order. A lot of fish! The weather was very hot for some days and the lack of air conditioning in the hotel made some areas too hot to sit in. Air conditioning in the rooms was great and the added fan meant you always felt comfortable in your room. Fabulous views from the balcony over the garden and straight onto the beach. Rooms spacious and kept very clean. Spa facilities were really good, 50 euros for a couple - well worth it, lots of different rooms to go into as well as a pebble walk, Jacuzzi and bubbly pool.... The hotel readily looks after bags and cases when you have to vacate your room at 12.00 before flying home, tainted slightly by the bar tender who wouldn't let us sit and have the drink we had left over, asking us to drink it in our room - which we had had to vacate whilst waiting to be picked up to fly home, when it was about 38 degrees, no air conditioning and the hotel won't let you pay for a drink with money everything has to be put onto the room, but of course we had already checked out!!! We were allowed to drink it on the next table, not in the bar, away from the slight breeze by the window where we were originally sitting. Really think a bit of sense needed as this is our lasting impression after an otherwise perfect 10 days.

author: bongodorset
title: Morning at the Spa
text: Have just returned from this Spa within the Hotel. We are not staying here but 6 of us went at 11 am (prebooked from London) for a 2-hour session in the circuit Spa which is located down a flight of steps from the car park outside Hotel. After checking in we had to sign some forms, take a robe, swim hat, flip flops and key (for lockers). After changing we went into the Spa and proceeded to the first door of the circuit. You either hang yr robe on a hook or lay on a bed then enter the first room. There is a steam room, sauna, 8 different types of showers (my favourite), ice room and two relaxing quiet rooms. Then you shower and enter the jacuzzi then an ice pool then a large pool with beds and water jets. Gorgeous. So relaxing. This took approximately 1 hr. Then as the pools are salt water we had another shower, robed up and took a drink (either hot or cold, herbal teas or water) and laid down on a heated stone bed. After 15 minutes my son and I went outside and laid on a different type of bed for about 15 minutes then we went back to changing room to shower again and get dressed. The rest of the family followed. In the changing room there are toilets and showers, hairdryer and benches. The hairdryer was broken but was quickly replaced. A really relaxing and amazing experience. As we were a party of 6 we paid an amazing price compared to where we went last year. It was worth every euro.

author: 225richarda
title: Very Welcoming & Friendly Staff
text: We stayed from 10th until 16th July, parents with 1 x 8 year old. Our flight didn't arrive into Gibraltar until 20:30 so we didn't arrive at Reception until around 21:30. Staff very welcoming and helpful and ensured that we got food from the buffet before finishing the check-in process. A very good range of food from the buffet. We had al la carte as part of the All Inclusive deal the once and again this was good food. The hotel is well maintained and there are obvious signs of staff going about their business such as spraying plants etc which meant that we did not see a single wasp or other large flying insect during our stay. My partner Couldn't avoid mosquetos unfortunately but no real fault of the Hotel. Taxi to the nearby port is about euro 6 out and around euro 7/8 on the way back and the port is well worth a visit. We found everything that we needed at the Hotel and it was exactly all we needed. The only negative comment was that we were issued with a single piece of card indicating our AI status. This needed to be shown for ordering all drinks from the bars and at buffet/restaurant service which is a bit frustrating if there are at least 2 x adults in the party. More frustrating was the need to have all drinks/foods written on receipts and having to sign for them even though these were included in the AI deal. Wasted staff time and ours. This did not spoil the holiday and I would say that the AI drinks were of excellent standard (Beefeater Gin used in G&Ts). I can't remember us going 'off-piste' from the AI deal once. Would definitely return to this hotel.

author: robr834
title: Not a Five Star Hotel
text: Overall a very disappointing experience at this hotel, It certainly wasn't Five Star. Thought the location was not the best and indeed needed to use taxis if you wanted to go into Estepona itself. This was needed as the entertainment was on the whole pretty poor. Seeming to cater for young children every night up till 11ish. No adult space or time was allowed. There was however, a nice adult only section with comfortable sun beds and loungers to relax on. Also an indoor pool available. The service from bars was not the most efficient. Possibly because not enough staff were employed at busy times. The food, was also not five star, being served on a buffet basis, and was often cold. Though you could have eaten a la carte for an extra €13 per person. We preferred to go out. Though have to say our room was very spacious and had a nice bath plus separate power shower to relax in after a day in the sun. But overall disappointed and would certainly not visit again. Have read reviews on hotels before and thought that some people can't ever be pleased. But visit this hotel at your peril.

author: 47crisf
title: Food and bevarges and the little things matter.
text: We arrived to nice welcome, where offers a drink got a good explanation of the resort and its workings. We got a wonderful room and a nice welcome surprise waiting in the room for us. Room was massive and faultless, other than the airco that seemed to be not cooling to well. Again the pools and property where very good. Downside was the breakfast it was chaotic although far from max capacity. Staff where rushed and had little time for there guests on both mornings. Worse was the bar only the lobby bar was open and both drinks we ordered, cocktails very very bad. As was the bad temperd staff. If it was busy I would have some understanding. But it wasn't busy. We stayed in Fuerteventura in an Elba which was far more busy yet the staff where wonderfull. On check out we where nickels and dimes on the minibar it was included in our room rate but was forgotten on the final bill. I don't blame the checkout staff this must be policy of Elba because booking systems are automated there must be a reason why it seems to be forgotten on the final bill. On top of that I had to proof it by showing the booking confirmation email on my phone. Don't get me wrong property and rooms are great, the human touch isn't there and it shines through.

author: sandra_7356
title: Family vacation
text: We had a warm welcome from reception when we arrived at the hotel. We had a rental car and we could park anywhere outside the hotel, and it was free of charge. We stayed for 12 days at the hotel and we really liked it (the kids as well). June is perfect to stay here, not crowded with people and really nice weather. We got a nice room with a big bathroom, with both shower and bathtub. It was clean and we have no complaints about the room. Our room was located almost at the end of a hall and that was highly appreciated, it was not so much noice at night because of that, the doors are not so well isolated (you can hear people walk and talk outside). Poolarea was good and we also really enjoyed the heated pool under the roof on floor 0 and the comfotable beds outside with the stunning view. We also tried the Spa one day with the kids (9 and 6 years of age). We all enjoyed it! Kids are allowed in the Spa between 10-12. We visited Marbiella, Porto Banus and Gibraltar during our stay and that we can recommend. Of course we also visited Estepona old town several times, it was only 5-10min drive from the hotel. If you are staying at this hotel we recommend you to rent a car. The only thing we did not like was the food! Breakfast was good, really good. But the snack restaurant and dinner restaurants was not good at all. Expensive and not tasty. (The buffé we cannot say anything about because we did not try it). Also found it strange that the staff in the dinner restaurants did not speak and understand english so good, not in the way that I thought they should when working at a hotel.

author: livelifeHampshire
title: Lovely hotel
text: We have stayed at the hotel this week and have been really pleased with the hotel and our stay in Spain. We had read some of the recent reviews and were beginning to have doubts however the ambiance as soon as we walked in through the reception was warm and welcoming. Reception staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Our room exceeded our expectations. It was large and comfortable. The seats in the room are really comfortable and a nice place to chill out after too much sun bathing! We were surprised not to be provided with drinking water. The first night we arrived late and chose to eat in the buffet. This was a mistake, not something that we repeated. The food is average and the ambiance of the restaurant is very poor. At €40/person I wished we'd eaten at Burger King across the road. We have since eaten in Duquesa port and La Cocina across the road both of which we recommend. Breakfast is very good with a vast choice of food to chose from from continental to the cooking station for eggs. Something for everyone. We generally go farther afield on holiday and this is the first European brake we have had for a long time but it will not be our last.

author: RonaC625
title: A few days of luxury
text: After spending a few days in Gibraltar for a wedding we decided to stay 3 nights in Spain to finish our trip. We were 4 adults 2 children we were all very glad we chose this hotel. Pure luxury!! We were greeted at check in with a glass of Cava and all the information we needed about the hotel. We had a family room and a double room. They were both huge!! Large bathroom with jacuzzi bath and shower with jets. Our balcony looked out into one of the many pools, garden and sea!! We were all inclusive which had lots to offer. Most things were included. Food was excellent and cocktails even better!! All staff members were fantastic. Always ready to help if needed!! A special mention to Peta. She greeted us on arrival and chatted to us about our hometown, Edinburgh. Every time she saw us she was extremely friendly!! The only downside to our stay was it wasn't long enough!!!

author: McClive
title: An enigma: True 5 star accommodation but poor otherwise
text: The hotel may have 5 stars proudly emblazoned above the lobby entrance but our experience was far from top notch. On the plus side, our room was well up to 5 star standard. It was huge, modern, clean and exceptionally well equipped with a Jacuzzi bath, power shower, safe, dual basins, giant beds, comfy seating area, mini-bar and a lovely sea view from the balcony. The trouble was everything else. At some time in the past a fortune must have been spent to build and equip this hotel but now the corridors (with some very slippy floor tiles) felt poorly lit almost as though they were economising on electricity. Some of our party tried the Spa which was far from relaxing with a rather unhelpful receptionist who later was heard arguing on the phone, no doubt believing that there weren't fluent Spanish speakers listening. The experience inside in the Spa itself was apparently not much better. In hindsight we should have had dinner in the more popular buffet restaurant that was included in our half board package but we opted instead for the extra cost a-la-carte restaurant that was completely deserted when we arrived, apart from some rather stale looking bread rolls that had been put out to dry on a few lucky tables. The restaurant ambience was more budget diner than 5-star hotel restaurant. We were eventually shown to a rather dishevelled looking table on the patio outside and were immediately hit with an obnoxious smell from the drains. On the plus side, dried out rolls were not present on our allotted table, but we nevertheless felt very uncomfortable indeed. We made our polite excuses as best we could and left to find an alternative restaurant in Estepona. Overall we got the impression that this was a once splendid hotel that has hit more challenging times. On the plus side, the accommodation was really nice for the price, the outdoor pool area was great and it’s right next to the beech so if that’s what you are really looking for you might consider it to be a very good choice. However, if you are seeking the full 5 star package, it might be best to look elsewhere.

author: President66
title: Space,glorious space.
text: So much room to move. The car park was full when we arrived, but no sign of the drivers, because they were in the conference room, which is where they should be. This meant no one by the pool, at least for the first couple of days, but then it was very windy. (Feb 26) even two days later ,no one ther even in the lovely sunshine. One wonders where the kids who had been running round the dining room, had disappeared to..but maybe they had read my thoughts and gone deep sea fishing. Oh and there were some German golfers..moral, don't sit near a table set for 12. The staff were great, particularly Alvar and Drew on reception, who let us keep the room till a late flight. As for the room, well everything worked, the taps, the bed lights, the bathroom lights, the big terrace, the modern large screen TV, comfortable bed and chairs..great. So what's to criticise ? The dining room had lots to chose from, the grill chef excellent, but his mate who had the task of providing chips failed miserably. Chips should be brown and crisp, not white and greasy. I suggested a little longer in the fryer, and this man glared, but the grill chef winked. Next day the chippey had gone and the spuds where brown and crisp. But the dining room did need someone to take a grip, the salads needed that extra something,though to be fair the seafood ones looked interesting. And wow, the breads were terrific.

author: roamingmatt
title: Family resort with great staff
text: For a 5 star, this hotel feels a bit dated and more cheerful than luxurious. But rates are also low for a 5 star and I feel the hotel delivered good value for money. The design of the building feels a bit outdated; the rooms are quite dark, with little sun reaching the covered balconies, and the decor includes a lot of dark wood and dark browns. The swimming pool area is pretty nice, but completely overrun by kids - fun if you also travel with kids. There is also an active kids club with nice kids' activities like face painting etc. There is also a separate kids' pool and, beyond that, a calmer grassy area with more space, less people, and ocean views for adults who want to get away from all the kids. The beach is pebbly and nothing to write home about - but it is possible to lounge and to swim, of course. The spa area we didn't see. The outdoor restaurants were nice, since you could dine al fresco with ocean views. The a la carte food was good. Breakfast on the ground floor was another thing; the buffet was exceptionally well-stocked with a huge variety of food, but the restaurant was noisy and kind of dark (for a beach hotel). The breakfast restaurant they should modernize, and make it airier. The most memorable experience was the service at the well-staffed reception, because the staff was really nice and went out of their way to be helpful. The staff definitely lifted this "low end 5 star resort" to a nice experience. We would stay here again if were in the area, because it's good value for money.

author: Khurmatulla
title: Angels and Dragons detected in sky
text: Please check photo and if you don't see any dragon and angel flying then you've never beed a dreamer. Now let's shift to review: 1. coast line covered with sand but you will be needed for swimming sleepers otherwice you can hurt your feet 2. hotel for 50+ people means no any of children facilities (only one small children swimpool with no water varning system) 3. kitchen is good but same all the time 4. IT IS NOT SPA HOTEL! Dear menagers please go to Thailand (for training) and study what is spa-hotel 5. very important: right next beach is nude beach and some times naked old gents and ladies are passed to our beach shocking our shildren. Yes we are on side of democracy but not so urgle meaning of that 6. hotel is not on walking distance from city. Be ready to spend at list 30-40 minutes to walk only one way 7. hotel is bit expensive and guess our first and last experience. No, we don't say that this hotel is bad... it is just not hotel what we needed for... 8. wifi signal is poor The rooms are really good and quality of cleaning services and other servicaes are really good.

author: lizzie439
title: Grand Gran elba
text: booked this hotel last minute & was very glad we did. The hotel itself is huge but doesn't actually feel it - we prefer smaller more intimate hotels but had an amazing stay here. the hotel itself is beautifully laid out with gardens, pools, spa, choice of bars and is located directly on the beach. We had a large suite which was tastefully appointed and enjoyed sitting on the terrace listening to the lapping of the waves. most importantly it was so clean. Location is ok - yes it is a taxi ride into town and there is nowhere to walk to (bit of a bug bear but never mind). However taxis are relatively cheap and quick. The old town of estepona is charming with cobbled streets lined with bars and cafes. the staff deserve a special mention as they were all exceptionally friendly, cheerful and attentive. Plus, oddly enough, there is a bar lady who is the double of kate middleton..... we had to do a double take! just a note for people who don't like children........we usually book adults only hotels, i knew the Elba is family friendly but thought the end of september/early october it would be fairly child free. it wasn't. And note to parents - not everyone is as adoring as you when your children are screaming and running around the restaurant and you just gaze lovingly at them without trying to control them! Gripe over - this is no reflection on the hotel and i would recommend (and return) to the Elba hotel again.

author: EdwardN396
title: Luxury with smiles
text: From start to finish we were made so welcome at this outstanding hotel. The facilities were superb throughout and nothing was too much trouble for the staff. We had gourmet and buffet food, poolside drinks and snack food in the bar, all excellent. The breakfast buffet catered for everything and everyone and we particularly enjoyed a glass of Cava or bucks fizz with our breakfast. The room was really well appointed with a sea view and a magnificent bathroom. Beds comfortable with linen and towels exchanged whenever we asked. Five star in hotels is awarded according to the facilities. In our book (my wife worked in hotels for some years) 5 stars is earned with good service and attention to detail. Being Spain there are a few quirks to British minds. Even when they forgot to clean the cups in the room a member of staff was there within minutes to put it right and that is what counts for 5 star. Estepona is a large straggling resort and the hotel lies 10 minutes from the centre by taxi. These are plentiful and quick so the Elba gave us the ideal location. As to facilities, we did not try the Spa but others commented favourably. We loved the atmosphere with a tinkling piano or guitar music in the background totally unobtrusive. Entertainment was simple but fun with a singer or pianist. Menus were great; we enjoyed the A La Carte so much we ate there several times. As a veal lover with a fish lover we could not do better. Drinks menu was comprehensive and relatively inexpensive. We chilled we rested we swam, we ate, we slept we had a really good time. No more to say.

author: smithy162
title: mixed reviews
text: We stayed here as a couple for 10 nights and returned last week. The hotel itself is nice and most of the staff are happy and willing to help. The only staff that we feel let the hotel down were the dining room staff as we felt that All Inclusive holiday makers were left waiting while staff attended to people who were paying by the meal which was very disappointing and blatantly obvious. There also was not enough staff in the dinning room. The entertainment was awful. We were there for 10 nights and saw 4 singers, if you could call them that. For what is advertised as a 5* hotel the entertainment should be better and not just a so called singer with a backing tape. I would expect that in a 3* hotel but not a 5*. Other than that, the entertainment consisted of a television in the lobby bar (which was the only one open). If you want a holiday away from everything, this is the place for you as there is nothing in the local area to do, no bars or restaurants etc. The pool area is nice and the young girl working in the beach bar deserves a mention as she was always happy and smiley and helpful. It would have been nice to have some back ground music playing around the pool as it was total silence. There was the first day we arrived but then that was it. If you book the day trip to Gibraltar you need to prepare for chaos coming home from there. The pickup point is dangerous. Way too many people in one place with big coaches turning and pulling up everywhere. Make sure you take plenty of water as there is no shelter at the pick up point and you can be waiting up to an hour in blazing sun and among coach fumes. It sounds like the holiday was horrendous but it wasn't. The hotel itself is very nice but I would say 4* instead of 5*. A week here would be plenty and I think children would soon get bored..

author: Denilytham
title: Wonderful Holiday!
text: I recently booked a week away with my daughter who chose this Hotel. From the moment we arrived at Reception we felt extremely welcome. We enjoyed s glass of the usual chilled Cava to greet up whilst Paco checked us in seamlessly and explained all the facilities, directions and handed me an itinerary. Once in our room, I was delighted to see it was spacious, clean and subtly decorated. I ordered an Iron and board, which arrived promptly. Considering I wanted a complete rest after a busy summer season, i was delighted to be shown to a ground floor, corner room (no one passing us) which opened on to a tranquil garden area, a few metres from the sea. The bathroom was enormous and had everything we required. Some days we relaxed around the swimming pool, which was a little more lively but always pleasant and one cooler, cloudy day I relaxed in the indoor swimming pool and solarium, enjoying the superb view of the sea, warmth and peace. Whilst there is nothing 'stuffy' or ostentatious about this hotel, and perhaps it is a little tired decor wise in one or two places, I consider it has been awarded its 5* rating due to the Staff, the service and the food, which I could not fault. We went half board, enjoying Breakfast & Dinner, which my daughter and I were delighted with. Under the caring, knowledgable and extremely talented reign of Chef Victor, the team produced a delicious, colourful, beautifully presented array of amazing dishes, every day. The fresh 'chef cook' station was a particular favourite, where we enjoyed our choice of fish (there were many choices every day) or meats cooked to our liking. A fresh array of different salads, vegetables and fruit concoctions met us every day and was a true feast for the eyes! There truly was a fantastic selection of delicious hot and cold choices to cater for every taste and nationality, however, the superb seafood is where the team really excelled! I cannot wait to return to this hotel to simply relax again and would recommend to anyone wanting an easy, by the beach, quiet location with superb food and service. When wanting a little more action or nightlife, the Estapona Port was just a short €7 - €10 taxi ride away (always easily available) and Marbella, a little further. Take me back to the Gran Hotel Elba Estapona asap please!

author: CarleyJones
title: Honeymoon Bliss
text: We have just left this hotel after our honeymoon stay. The hotel is lovely. Rooms cleaned daily. The hotel works round you. Don't want to be disturb until 7pm, they will wait until you would like your room cleaned. Managers and hotel staff by the dozen. Always someone wanting to help. I was unwell due to a jellyfish sting and they always offered to help. 9 times out of 10 they were polite but odd moody one. Hotel food was good and plenty of choice. Location is perfect for a relaxing break but if you wanted to go into the real world you are looking at 10 euros to get to Estepona. It can add up over 10 days. The hotel is on a beach. This is quiet and nice. If it's your sort of thing there is a nudist beach a short walk down the shore. Blocked by rocks from the normal beach. This is a great family hotel and if you can't take children not the place for you. It might be a little different out of the summer holidays. Overall lovely hotel a bit out of the way, But if you want to just relax then perfect.

author: lynnsc2014
title: Nothing really grand about this dated hotel
text: I spent 2 nights at this hotel in August and it was a big disappointment. Definitely not 5 stars. Nobody outside to help with the car and luggage. The rooms and furnishings were very dated. The bed was the most uncomfortable thing I ever slept on. Hard like a rock and felt only springs in my back all night. All the chairs in the resort were wobbly. In every restaurant we ate in and every chair we sat on were unstable. The food was just barely average. Another disturbing thing, especially sleeping alone in a room as a woman was that there was no way to lock the door from the inside. There was music and entertainment every night, which involved a bunch of 5 year olds jumping around on stage. Which I suppose could be fun if you have kids. Not so fun if you're trying to sleep upstairs. The only positives were the views to the sea and the location to some extent, although you had to take a taxi into town, which was 10 Euros each way. A shuttle bus would have been a nice bonus.

author: P8280TPrichardh
title: Relaxing stay / muy relajante
text: How could you not love this hotel, the staff and management team that run it. My family and I stayed 8 nights all-inclusive in July. After a speedy and efficient check in and a cold glass of Cava, we were taken to our double deluxe sea view rooms - beautiful. For breakfast, we mostly ate in the upstairs adult-only restaurant. For lunch and dinner we mostly ate in the Arena Beach restaurant (the main restaurant). The quality of food and service in both were excellent. We also had dinner in the Asian infusion and Paris - Roma restaurants, which had comfortable outside eating areas with fantastic views over the beach and sea. Again, the food and service provided here were of a very high standard. Like many other guests in the hotel, we did experience an issue with the air conditioning in our rooms. I spoke to the reception staff about it and they assured me they were doing everything possible to resolve the situation. By the end of the holiday they had installed another air con unit and this improved the situation. We spent a very relaxing morning in the spa circuit, which I would highly recommend. My wife and two sons also had a massage in the spa, which they said was very nice. The outside evening entertainment area is great for having a drink or two whilst watching the entertainment. They had a range of shows, including: magic, Spanish dances and a few different singers. It was lovely to see Mario the singer again, his rendition of 'Lady in Red' is better than the original! :) The young lady serving the best smoothies ever, down by the pool during the day, has to get a mention too. You must try one - the strawberry and coconut is delicious! We would also like to thank Drew and Gemma from reception for all their help and advice whilst we were on holiday. All-in-all my family and I had a great time at the Gran Elba hotel and we would not hesitate to return.

author: Mexytraveler
title: Nice and relaxing
text: Spent half of my honeymoon at the Gran Elba back in May. Having been to many all inclusive resorts in Mexico, where they really know what service is like, I had high expectations. To start the reservations agent was great to deal with over email and even put in for an upgrade due to our honeymoon. That touch was very nice and the suite was great! Large room, beautiful view of the ocean and nice amenities. The service overall was good, not great, there were a few times where they felt overwhelmed during meal periods, but otherwise everyone as friendly and accommodating. The front desk was great and had great suggestions for all my questions. When my now wife and I travel we are always excited about the food offerings. We had some really great dishes and some just ok ones too. After 5 days it did seem quite repetitive, but it was ok. For all inclusive we definitely got our money's worth with wine and cocktails, the bartenders were very generous and nice. Not much going on during the off peak season, but was ok as we were just there to relax. We went into Estepona one day and was an easy 10 min taxi ride. The beach was not very nice however if you just want something to lay by the beach it would work for you. All in all my next trip to Spain will be spent in Andalucia but not on the beach!

author: NIholidayreviews
title: 5 Star All inclusive food isn't the same as fine dining
text: I have seen some people complain about the food. As my title says 5 Star All Inclusive food isn't the same as fine dining. If you accept this you will find the food very much eatable and enjoyable. I finished every meal and actually put on 5lbs in weight ! Food Breakfast There was everything a British person would require for Breakfast, and also a good selection of fresh fruit and continental breakfasts had just about everything you could think of. Cooking station with a chef making omelettes, pancakes etc. Lunch Show cooking by chef with various fish, chicken fillets and beef. A fantastic range set out in the buffet. There would be 4 hot meats ready for self service. Just about every vegetable and salad item you could imagine. Dinner Pretty much the same as lunch, everything you could ever think of having. Deserts Very much what you expect in europe. Nothing special but I still took one at lunch and dinner! Drinks This is what makes this place a lot more different. Drinks like Bells Whiskey, Baileys and many other recognised top brands are included within the All Inclusive. Mini Bar If you are all inclusive you get the minibar topped up each day with 2 beer, bottles of coke, pure juice, sparkling & still water. All within the price. Wifi With all inclusive wifi is included within the price. Staff The majority where very good and pleasant. Facilities 100% & very clean

author: julie6797
title: Holiday June 2015
text: My husband and I just spent a 10 night all inclusive holiday in this hotel and it was superb. The hotel was spotlessly clean in every area and the staff were outstanding. I can't name them all but every one of them could not do enough for you. From the lovely initial welcome from the receptionist Chara to the wonderful bright and bubbly Pepa; they were all superb. The food both in the buffet restaurant and the a la carte was of an excellent quality and the chefs would cook you fresh meat/fish/eggs while you waited at the grill. I would say there was definitely something for everyone! The pools were kept spotlessly clean and the housekeeping staff were amazing; coming in during the evening to turn down the beds and leave mints on the pillows and to refresh the towels if necessary. The hotel is on the beach front with lovely views from the rooms and with easy access. The hotel has a small but well stocked gift shop and a hairdressers on site also. The hotel also offers a money changing service which we found very useful. The hotel is a taxi ride away from Estepona town centre at approximately 8 euros each way and the taxi rank is right outside the hotel. The hotel is definitely a "chill out/relaxing" place and there was a singer on Fri and Sat evening for entertainment but with Estepona only a short taxi ride away it is easily accessible for those requiring something a little more lively. The spa in the hotel was fantastic! I had a massage which was so relaxing and the pools and sauna etc were something I would definitely want to experience again. We are looking at booking to go again next year. I cannot speak highly enough of this lovely place with it's wonderful staff x

author: l0uise512
title: Wonderful anniversary break
text: We could argue the criteria for what qualifies as. " 5 star " hotel but the fact remains that this is a delightful hotel and one I would return to and recommend . The hotel lobby is impressive and on arrival we were greeted by genuinely friendly and helpful staff. A welcome glass of chilled cave went down very well ! Our room was very large & clean with a wonderful sea view .1or 2 very minor issues with the room were dealt with very swiftly by the housekeeping staff. The pools are clean & plenty of sun beds . There is an indoor pool on the upper terrace , this is a quieter place to lounge around in the sun away from the main pool . The food in the main restaurant is varied and plentiful and is replenished regularly contrary to some of the reviews I read. There is in addition to the buffet a " hot station " where you food is cooked to order . Steaks , chicken , fish etc all very good. Seating is either inside or out and staff friendly & welcoming. All staff speak good English , but I speak fairly good Spanish and found that talking to them in their own language was met with a very favourable response . In addition to the buffet restaurant there are 3 speciality restaurants. However I feel that these are overpriced and the high prices reflect the fact that they were empty ! Maybe if they made them more reasonably priced they would encourage people to eat there as the setting for all 3 of them is beautiful. This hotel is a little isolated and is not in walking distance of any bars or restaurants , but taxis are readily available outside the hotel and a taxi to the port in Estepona is only 5-10 mins and costs approx €6. All in all this is a very good hotel and I would recommend it .

author: Sandrapenstaart
title: Perfectly timed extra late check out!
text: Initially I was very underwhelmed upon arrival as there was no porter at the door when I drove up, to assist with my suitcases. I got them out of my car and carried them in myself after parking the car. People at reception where quite oblivious to this. I did get assistance carrying them upstairs when I was shown to my room. The people at reception did not speak English that well at all, so when I needed something I went downstrairs to make sure they understood because a few things went wrong when explaining over the phone. Trashbin in the room ánd the bathroom were not emptied after the room had been cleaned?! In the southern Spanish climate I rather not have a full bin in my room, so I ended up putting the trashbin on the balcony after reception did not pass on my message to housekeeping to come and empty it. I also had an issue with the bathrobes which were children sizes and made of this cheap thin fabric but they did not understand what I tried to explain so it took more than a day for that to get fixed. The requested advice to book excursions was poor and not well informed. I really kept having probelms getting my message across and instead I figured out myself how to get tickets for Alhambra because according to the receptionist it is always sold out well in advance and all tours were fully booked. I got tickets online for next day without any problem however and drove there myself which was quite a cost saving. Restaurant buffet quality really was not acceptable. Personnel did not pay any attention to the guests apart from some they seemed to know, and they started cleaning up around the guests 15 minutes before the actual closing time. Really quite bad and the price of the buffet (around € 40!) is way too high for the quality of the offering. They do not offer turn down service in the evenings? In this particular hotel I actually really needed it for the first time because nobody informed me where to get towels for the pool, so I used the ones from the room instead the first day and if they did make evening rounds, maybe they could have emptied the bins on day 2! Also the in room coffee I had used was not replenished and I am still wondering why there was only decaf coffee available. On my last day I got a very nice surprise when I requested a late check out and I could actually stay until quite late in the afternoon, which was perfect and very much appreciated. Other than that I do not feel the services and quality of this hotel lives up to expectations of a 5* star even remotely. Location at the beach and close to the highway was OK however.

author: OxfordshireDizzy
title: Very nice hotel, spacious rooms and excellent value for money...
text: We booked this hotel on-line at the last minute specifically to attend a nearby wedding. It was extremely affordable for a four night stay. On arrival the staff on reception were very welcoming, with a glass of fizz. We were given keys to room 506 on the second floor which had the most amazing sea view (which we hadn't paid extra for) The room was very spacious with a table and two armchairs, a king size bed and a balcony which also had two chairs on it. The decor was smart and the room clean. The bathroom was enormous, with his and hers sinks, large bath, large walk in shower, toilet and bidet. My criticism of the bathroom is that there was no privacy as the door to the toilet was smoked glass and didn't lock and the bathroom was open plan with no door! With regard to the hotel facilities, the pool area was super with direct access to the beach and plenty of sun beds. The restaurant was disappointing. There didn't appear to be enough staff and the food wasn't great. There was lots of breakfast choices but the hot food was greasy and unappetising. My overall view is that is it is slightly tired for a 5 star hotel (outdoor furniture needs replacing, walls need re-painting) however would make a fabulous 4 star. I wouldn't hesitate in staying here again or recommending it to others. There was a fabulous crèche for kids and reception staff very helpful. I also had the misfortune to require a Doctor. this was arranged very swiftly and satisfactorily.

author: suntothemax
title: A nice hotel - but not 5 star and need more staff/better service
text: We had a lovely stay at this hotel - but there were good and bad points, and I will give a measured balance of both. Great things: The room was large and spacious - really very relaxing and cleaned beautifully each day. The pool area was lovely - lots of space and right on the beach. The indoor pool was wonderful - heated water - and out of direct sunlight undercover. Lovely. The a la carte restaurant served a delicious steak the night we ate there. Not so great things: The spa area is expensive and tired. We had one use included in our package but if I'd have paid 100 euros for two people I would be very disapointed. Some items need repair. We had a massage - which was nice - but were then walked (nay. marched) out of the spa area immediately afterwards as spa use is not included with a massage. Service - there are some excellent friendly staff, but there are not enough, and some are far from attentive. This is a shame - as this is really what makes a hotel. As I said, we had a good stay here. The food in the buffet restaurant is ok - not 5*, but tasty enough. It's a little way out of Estapona - you can walk along the beach by day (it's on rocks/sand - so not ok at night) but it's quite a way - several miles. In the evening the hotel is very quiet - but this did suit us. If you get a good offer it's a great relaxing place, but it needs to work on a few factors to justify that 5th star.

author: JurateN
title: A let down
text: A beautiful hotel. Lovely facilities. A great location. That is it. Service throughout hotel is awful, including the spa. All staff seemed to be rushed off their feet and very stressed, plates are cleared without asking if you have finished so make sure you do not go back to the Buffett at breakfast as your plate will be gone. At 10.30 you are told "it's finished". Lunch menu has not changed for 10 days. Dinner served in the same manner normally with items being crossed off the menu as they ran out of them. All inclusive does not include water... Stayed in presidential suite that was not cleaned properly once - a glass of champagne I had on Tuesday was still there on Saturday. The website states that in presidential suite you have coffee machine and other small additional items. None of that exists and the mattress on the sun bed is ripped. Not a 5 star hotel. H10 two minutes down the road serve great breakfast and their staff behave like they actually want to be there. Waste of a lot of money.

author: andrewj89
title: Relaxing, Peaceful and Great location
text: Having stayed at this hotel two years ago, we were looking forward to returning and were not disappointed. We booked 7 nights All Inclusive, as this is the best way to sample the delights of the hotel and spa. I find it hard to understand why people who stay here write silly reviews regarding, the location, entertainment, firmness of the mattress, not being shown to your table at breakfast and the likes. Do you not review the hotel before you book? Remember you book out of season! It seems lots people like to whinge about something and they really need to wake up and be realistic. The hotel caters for the guests and makes every effort to ensure you have a relaxing stay. The rooms are very spacious; we stayed in a Junior Suite and the views of the sea were fabulous. Listening to the waves each morning was so refreshing. As we arrived on 21 April 2015, breakfast and Dinner were taken in the Roma restaurant and this changed two days later when the Arena Beach restaurant was reopened. This was a nice change to have buffet style meals in a lovely setting, where you sit. From then on the hotel seemed to get busy with guests, but the staff still made sure that your needs were catered for. The Spa and Gym were complimentary as we were All Inclusive and this makes the stay worth every penny, as you can relax in here at the end of a sun drenched day. Even when we had been out all day, we could book the spa at very short notice and this was never a problem for the staff. Overall, a very relaxing stay, with attentive service, without being intrusive and having been very happy, we will be returning again and again, as you get what you pay for. Best advice is to actually research your hotel before booking and then you won’t be disappointed, then be unrealistic about what you think you should get from your stay. A word of thanks to Pedro at the Lobby Bar who was very polite, professional and unflappable under pressure when there were lots of guests ordering drinks. Also must mention Elena who was very attentive and worked hard when meal times were busy.

author: traveller_spain
title: Good and comfortable hotel to relax
text: We spent 3 days just after new year to relax ourselves in a hotel with indoor pool, beach and spa. Rooms are quite elegant and comfortable. Most of standard rooms have sea view and unless hotel is full you will most probably get one. Our room had a big balcony, although some of them have an small one. Bathroom is quite big with separate shower and bathtub. It has no windows, so probably hotel should try to improve ventilation in this area. Hotel has a beach, which is beautiful (specially walking on your right), but has too many stones. As all rooms face to the sea, they are all very quiet (we did not have problems with noise, etc.). The hotel is a bit isolated, so you will need a car to go anywhere (Marbella 30 minutes away). Indoor pool is a very nice place for swimming and relaxing outdoor during winter during most of the day until late night. There are other outdoor pools also for children for summer time. All pools are free for guests. We tried spa once, that is quite complete, with different pools, sauna, steam bath, showers, ... that use salt water. Unfortunately is not free for guests (20 euros per person or 30 from Friday/weekends, which is not cheap). Breakfast is quite good, with different sorts of cold and warm food, fresh fruit and a chef to cook omelettes. We tried restaurant twice, food was tasty but not special considering the price, although environment and service were good. They should extend their wine options when ordering by glass, at least with red wine. Overall, a good place to spend some days to relax yourself and enjoy a good service.

author: LondonDuke
title: SO DIFFERENT NOW- VERY GOOD
text: The last time I visited this hotel about 2/3 years ago I have to say it was a bit of a disaster! However I decided to give it another chance given it is so convenient for my visits to this area of Spain. What a difference a couple of years can make. They must have new management or something as the hotel is a transformation on the chaos and poor staffing of my last visit. There remain issues as a 5 star which it still is not but overall so much better. The food and buffet in particular is excellent. Breakfast far too good for us watching our waist lines. The staff are charming and helpful but still thin on the ground... Had to wait 2 hours for room to be ready and the concierge to welcome you at the door and carry luggage etc still doesn't exist. The pool area is great and all very enjoyable but only 1 person on duty. Forget the cocktails carried to you on your sun lounger! The beach was dirty covered in rubbish. If i was managing this hotel i would have a crew every day raking and tidying the beach it is not huge and it would present so much better. The rooms are very spacious, the bed very comfortable and rooms well presented etc.Free Wi-Fi which I regard as essential these days. You still need a mortgage before you go using the wonderful Spa! Areas to improve are still those above plus the sound proofing in the rooms is terrible I said this before. Every foot print passing your door sounds like the cavalry are coming and if someone next door or above moves furniture it is terrible. I know marble everywhere is the rage but its freezing on your feet and lousy for sound insulation. A few rugs would make the whole experience much nicer.

author: DRDICKMAZEL
title: excellent stay
text: I am delighted to report on a stay at this hotel. Overall, it was without complaint and we had a really enjoyable holiday. It is about 45 minutes by road from Malaga airport and another 45 minutes on to Gibraltar. It is a large and well run hotel. The rooms are spacious, with elegant and comfortable furniture. The bathrooms are large with a twin sink area and wardrobes, then a bath, a shower cubicle and a toilet and bidet. The overall effect is very luxurious. The hotel had a quiet atmosphere, with a variety of quiet seating area, but a nice bar with live entertainment. Our room had a large terrace with table and chairs, directly overlooking the beach and sea. The hotel is very clean and the staffs are all very polite and helpful. There are several restaurants, a wonderful spa complex, a large indoor pool with a great se view and a big outdoor pool. There is a separate kid’s pool area. We were on the sukkot programme which was very well organised by Mr Laurant Cohen. I have two negative comments. The outdoor pool was rather too cold to use in October. The indoor pool is warm. The hotel is right on the beach, which is good, but the promenade is short, so that to walk into town, one has to walk about an hour along the pebble and sand beach. The road outside the hotel is a motorway, so there is no footpath directly leading into Estepona. The hotel could do with a shuttle bus to and from Estepona.

author: 388lauriee
title: Pefect family holiday.
text: My family and I ( children aged 7 & 5 ) stayed for 7 nights all inclusive, which was absolutely worth every penny. I could not fault anything, from the warm welcome we received on arrival to the hugs we got when we left. We had a beautiful room over looking the sea. The rooms were always immaculately cleaned and presented to the highest standard. The choice of food was fantastic, especially the choices of fresh seafood. My daughter is a fussy eater but there was always something for her to enjoy. The dining staff were fabulous, always engaging, making us feel welcome and making a fuss over my children. We enjoyed lazy days by the pool and strolls down to the beach, the kids often dipped in and out of the kids club, which was well run, with various activities and where they made friends, who they then spent time playing with in the cocktail garden at night and myself and my partner enjoyed the entertainment which ranged from a fantastic magic show to flamenco dancers. We took a taxi into Marbella one day, which took around 20 minutes, it cost around 30e each way so not overly expensive and spent a day there for a change of scenery. I made use of the Spa which was excellent value, so relaxing, the aromatherapy massage was worth the money alone. Myself and my family never experianced anything other than first class service. Friendly, efficient, so relaxing, any queries we had were delt with quickly, no request was every a problem. My daughter cried when it was time to check out and I definitely left with a heavy heart having had such an amazing time. You know a holiday has been perfect when your toughest choice of the day is what to wear for your evening meal!!!! I had read in a previous post about the nudist beach, you would have to go out your way to look for it so please don't let that put you off if you are worried your children could see something!!!!! I would absolutely and have recommended the Elba to friends and family. Keep up the good work. I would return here in a heartbeat.

author: scansiascot
title: Great holiday with the girls
text: We stayed here for a long weekend in early September 2014. The reception area is stunning and we were met with a cold glass of prosecco on arrival - a lovely touch. Our room was spacious and clean with very comfortable beds. The bathroom was amazing - double basin, big bath and shower and toilet area - definately 5 star. The food was excellent, with loads of choice from lobster and prawns, to steak and fish cooked fresh to your liking. Omlettes were made fresh every day as you waited, and the salad bar was brilliant - loads of choice. The wine was good, and as we were all inclusive, we had lovely cocktails every night. The gin and tonics were served in fabulous fish bowl type glasses, which we all loved.The only down side was the pool bar. This seemed to be grossly understaffed and there was often a good 10-15 minute wait to get served. On the Sunday, they seemed to have run out of beer and the cocktail mixer was broken too so Pina-Coladas on that day! However, the hotel was excellent overall, and I would recommend this for a bit of luxury. Not much to do for kids, so think best for couples or groups of adults. The hotel seems to be a bit out on a limb, but as we were only there for 4 days, we spent most of the time by the pool. The entertainment was OK - the usual hotel fair - nothing to get excited about. Our sea view was a tiny bit disappointing as we were facing the tower. It would have been much better if we could have had an uninteruppted view of the sea. The beach was a bit narrow and very stony, but we didn't actually visit it. The pool area was very clean with no need to bag beds every morning. The towels were replaced every day. Loved this hotel and would definately go back.

author: kent8686
title: Fantastic hotel, perfect place to relax
text: Having now visited this hotel on three separate occasions, I find myself as impressed with it as I was on the first occasion. I have visited twice in early July, and have recently returned from a late August visit. I was concerned that having previously visited outside of school holiday times, that the hotel would be too busy and it would be impossible to relax. This turned out to be a totally unnecessary concern, and although slightly busier than in July, the place never felt overcrowded. The staff at this hotel are one of its best assets - always very polite, welcoming and attentive, from the housekeeping staff to the management. I must also give a special mention to Alex, the daytime entertainer in the pool area who was hilarious, and successfully managed to entertain both kids and adults of all nationalities with a variety of activities, despite the language barriers. The staff also make the place feel like a true Spanish hotel, rather than a generic place aimed at international tourists - definitely a compliment. The sheer number of Spanish guests it attracts versus other hotels of its kind is proof of this. Rooms are excellent, very spacious, meticulously cleaned daily and with excellent facilities. My only comment would be the extra long pillows which extend the full width of a double size bed - they look good but a pair of conventionally shaped pillows for each bed would be much more comfortable. The all-inclusive is also excellent, a great selection of branded drinks are included and you never really find yourself wanting something that is not included. Food is where this hotel really stands out above any other all-inclusive I have ever visited - the selection and the quality of the food is superb. There is a great variety of food to suit any taste, and the choice of fresh meat and fish is vast. There is also never any issue getting seated when you want to, even in August peak season. As other reviews have mentioned, it is an out of town 'resort' hotel therefore there is not much activity outside of the complex without a taxi journey, however that is not what this hotel is about. Overall this is a fantastic hotel, and I would recommend it to anyone. It is fastidiously maintained, with great facilities, great staff and a very relaxing environment, so if that's what you are looking for, I'm sure you won't be disappointed.

author: Frumpsta
title: Wonderful hotel with wonderful staff
text: Spent a long weekend here with my wife and enjoyed every minute of the stay. We booked all inclusive which was a real bonus. I don't quite understand other reviewers when they slate the staff. We could not have found any of them more welcoming, friendly and helpful. The staff are one of the best things about the hotel, I guess if you go in with a rude and arrogant attitude you may get some of this back. We arrived in the middle of the night and were welcomed by the night porter. We were shown to our room where they had left us a cold selection of meats and cheeses FOC in case we were hungry, absolutely amazing. The breakfast buffet is huge although can get busy around the egg station where they cook to order. Huge selection of everything. I think if we stayed for longer then we would have made use of the a la carte restaurants, as lunch and dinner at the buffet are quite similar. The selection is huge and they cook to order steak, lamb chops, pork chops, chicken, tuna steaks, squid and other fish. Huge selection of seafood such as crab, lobster and prawns are available and enormous array of salads. There were a lot of family's there but not once were any of the children unruly or annoying all very we'll behaved. One nice touch is that if you don't have kids you can go to the adults only breakfast room. Some people have left bad reviews because it is out of the way, this is the reason we booked it. If people don't do there homework on a hotel before they go then that's their lookout. The drinks selection on the all inclusive is great especially if you like Spanish Cava (which is also available at breakfast....!!!) One thing is that even at this 5 star hotel people go down at 8 to reserve their sun beds with towels (mainly british people) but it's not really a problem as we went down on the first day at 12:00 and there were lots of locations to choose from. Towels are available for all guests. Even on this weekend the hotel had 97% occupancy but it never really felt very crowded. I can only recommend this hotel to everyone, it has to be one of the most relaxing places to go.

author: adamrS8439WE
title: Very relaxing stay
text: We are about to leave hotel elba after a five day stay. It was just myself and my fiancee and we were on our own. We did read alot of reviews prior to booking this so here it goes. ..... Hotel staff were excellent in terms of their level of service and we were greeted with wine on arrival. The condition of the hotel is very good and the beach is right out side. The room size is great. Its cleaned everyday. We stayed b and b and breakfast could not be faulted. There are adult pool areas which was great as we didn't have the kids with us. The spa is great. The missus loved it and so did I. We didn't eat at the hotel but we did go to both marinas and there are plenty of places to eat. Average spend was 40 euros including a bottle of wine. However you must go to el trejar tapas bar in the centre of estapona. We spent 21 euros including drink and dessert. Food was locally cooked. Also buy your water from aldi across the highway. Believe me it was 3 euros for a bottle of water. Overall we really enjoyed our stay.

author: kerrieh998
title: Beautiful Hotel and Problems sorted efficiently
text: We stayed here last week for 5 nights. Hotel is beautiful and good value for the money we spent on it. Lady checking in was extremley pleasant and very helpful. Rooms were very spacious and bathroom was huge. The room had stunning views out over the sea and we had a terrace with a lovely garden area outside it which our daughter loved playing in. The room had air conditioning which wasn't fantastic but adequate enough The pool area and gardens again were lovely and although quite a few children there it still felt very relaxing. There was some enertainment going on around the pool but not all the time which was fine with us. My daughter loved the kids club and made lots of friends and liked the ladies running it. I wasn't entierly comfortable with the supervision of the children as even though i wrote on a form my daughter wasn't to leave the kids club alone she was still allowed to go out to the toilets on her own. I just made sure any activities they did down on the beach i accompanied her too. Breakfast was excellent with a wide choice of food available and you could sit inside or outside to have your breakfast we loved being outside. We ate in the snack bar once and despite initally thinking the menu was expensive it was good value for money when the food arrived. Unfortunately we had a disappointing experience in the Paris-Roma restaurant with a number of errors on drinks order, wine being poured into a glass with water already in it and my dinner coming up with one of the ingredients missing. When i asked where the ingredient was i was told they had run out. Thinknig this wasnt acceptable to be told this once the dinner arrived my husband complained to reception. THis is where the hotel earns extra marks for me by turning a negative into a positive. We were offered a free dinner and an apology from the Manager of the hotel and again on check out the manager came to apologise for the mistake in the restaurant. Yes it would have been good to get it right to start with but i think the hotel dealt with the problem very well. THe only evening entertainment we went to was the mini disco which daughter loved and the FLamenco night which was excellent and a lovely atmosphere on the outside area. Estepona was a couple of minutes in a taxi around 6 to 7 euro taxi fare and Duquesa was just under 10 minutes away and was 16 Euros, personally we prefer Duquesa to Estepona but but worth a visit We hope to visit again some time soon

author: Genedeco
title: TO BE FOREWARNED IS TO BE FOREARMED
text: What you really need to know about this hotel, that is not on their website Location: On the beach, middle of nowhere. The hotel does not offer any shuttle to the city or to the airport, just taxis or hired car. Next to it, and you cannot miss it, there is a Naturist Area with completely naked people walking on the beach facing to the hotel. Not very nice for those who are not adhering to this principle, especially when they were past their sell by date! The hotel should not tolerate that. Welcome: Arriving at the front desk, the welcome “drink” was a horrible smell of paint; and when you mention it, the manager replied, “it is also not nice for us”! In the main lobby, there is a little shop but just with cheap souvenirs and post cards. No newspapers available in this 5-star hotel! Category: A 5-star hotel runs like a 3-star hotel. It would be of interest to know who has allocated 5 stars to this hotel. General maintenance is inadequate. Dining rooms just with tables and chairs, not even a little flower on the tables (just like a cantina in holiday camp), of course on the buffet there are a lot of plastic flowers behind the dishes! Room: In room 531 for instance, the TV plug was on the ground rather than being fixed to the wall, shower was copiously calcified, on the balcony there were a lot of paint stains and the little glass wall was cracked. Soundproofing between rooms was very poor; you could hear your neighbor snoring at night. Light saving energy: yes, but the light was so poor that you could not read in your bed Staff: the staff was very nice but with no style. Dinner time was a rather rush exercise!

author: VHOOLES
title: Lacking attention to detail
text: Very nice property on the beach, impressive lobby a little bit dated with wonderful sea views. Well looked after public spaces, pleasant gardens and pool areas. Nice facilities at the beach. Rooms reminiscent of a bygone era, spacious, comfortable if a little bit dated. The staff seem very accommodating and friendly. When we arrived to our room we notice the mosquito plug in which surprised us as we had been in the area at another hotel and hadn't had a problem, we did notice a few blood stains on the wall paper. That night we were attacked by Mosquitos, we asked the housekeeper for a mosquito spray, which was promptly supplied, that night we sprayed it thoroughly but were still bitten many times, so we bought spray repellent. They do have a serious mosquito problem. As I write this we are on our next hotel in the area, no Mosquitos here. Upon arrival at our next hotel we noticed that we had left a few items of clean clothing in one of the draws in the room, we called and asked if they were there and if we could collect them, we spoke to 4 different members of staff before being told we would be called back. After more than an hour we took it upon ourselves to drive to the hotel . When we arrived and explain the situation the gentleman we spoke to was in reception, he explained that he was still waiting for housekeeping to get back to him, there was no apology for the lack of communication. We waited for 15 minutes before they produced the clothing items in a bin liner ! Shocking service for a 5* hotel. We then had to walk into our present hotel with a bin liner. Did not feel like a valued customer, very different to passed experiences from 5* hotels. Not really worth the money.

author: Traveloholicman
title: Quiet and relaxing but not definivite five star hotel
text: Stayed four nights in Feb 2014 in a de luxe room with partial sea view. Checked in in normal time and asked for some extra pillows, when we went back to the room by evening the door room stood wide open, some problems with the locks, and I was asked to slam the door to get it locked, not a five star hotel. Nothing had been stolen and probably no one except the staff had entered the room- But this was the staff who didn´t secure that the door was locked, happened three times in total and probably they either fixed the lock, I checked that the door was locked several times while going out. It is a large hotel, not so personal and our stay was during low season, I can imagine that the breakfast room must be crowded during high season but this was absolutely not a problem during our stay. Prices in the hotel are expensive, stayed at smaller more luxury hotels and have to pay 4,80 Euros for a cappuccino in the bar is overpriced and a cup of tea for 3,80 Euros. ( more like prices in Puerto Banus) (But of course no competitors around). If you stay here you will need a car or strong legs to walk in to Estepona. Nice surroundings and friendly staff. Buffet breakfast was large but nothing special in quality, large variety of items but average quality if comparing to other five star hotels I stayed at both in Costa del Sol and other places. the freshly squeezed orange juice was really bitter and sometimes it didn´t taste anything, I had at least fifteen different orange. juices during a week in Spain and all of them tasted better than the breakfast juice. They just installed an automatic coffee machine for self service, probably in addition to the coffee served by staff. A coffee machine with dry milk for cappuccino, a Nestle machine, terrible coffee. New hotel manager this week, coming from Mallorca, hopefully he will get up some standard. It is not acceptable to have a room where the lock is not working properly, I tried to change room but the staff ensured that the problem was solved the day after. Spotless cleaning and heated pool inside. Didn´t try the spa, it was good weather so the sunbeds outside was more attending than staying inside. Large hotel, endless corridors, probably good for large groups, not so personal and that is of course a matter of personal taste. to hard beds (personal taste), functional wifi, large rooms, but why only two stone hard chair on the balcony? So a short summary will be that the hotel is not price worthy in my opinion, paid 135 Euros/night for B&B.

author: LuisaC387
title: Luisa Cerutti
text: Came here a while ago now for a few days days to relax, we had a wonderful holiday at the Gran Hotel Elba. We had a double room which was HUGE with plenty of storage space, beautifully clean and tidy. Even had a inset repellent plug-in. The blush bathroom was gorgeous with separate bath and separate shower, it also had his & hers sinks. Breakfast had a good choice of fruit juices, fresh fruit, cereals, pastries, yoghurts, cold meats, cheeses and a chef ready to cook your eggs just how you'd like them. The buffet at lunch times was perfect, with a variety of salads, soup, meat, fish. pasta, pizza and rice followed by a selection of delicious deserts. Yummy! The pool area was lovely and clean with lots of sun loungers and towels The gardens were beautifully maintained. Private beach has dark sand and shingle, in the distance you can see the rock of Gibraltar. The staff were helpful and friendly. The smell in the lobby was divine and really enjoyed the warm tea at reception. Would recommend hire car. Estepona is a few minutes drive away and 20 minutes drive to Puerto Banus which is worth it to see the posh yachts and luxuriance cars. A relaxing enjoyable stay, definitely would return here. Fabulous hotel. Loved it!!

author: Jandal-Mu-tai-li
title: Great Family Hotel
text: We spent a week all inclusive here in late July which was excellent value. We had to keep checking with reception that we really really didn't have a bill to pay as we could not believe how cheap it was. The room we had was excellent. Ground floor, right by the pool, our own little garden space and loungers and incredibly spacious. There was a spacious hallway, dressing room with 2 sinks, large bathroom with separate bath, lounge area with 2 beds for children plus a sofa and patio and a larger spacious room for us - best size of family accommodation we have come across. Food was nice although not amazing but perfectly lovely considering it was all included. All inclusive drinks were of a high standard and you never had to wait to be served. The children loved being able to order their own drinks and as many as they liked. We've never done all inclusive before but it was really nice being able to relax and not worry about how many 4euro cokes have been ordered by my son per day! Pool was lovely. Evening entertainment every night if you wanted it. My only downside would be that we felt a bit restricted as there is only one bar, one restaurant for all inclusive and one entertainment space so after a week we began to crave a bit of variety. We had a lovely time though and I would go back. We also liked the fact that spa allowed children for a couple of hours a day which my two really enjoyed and took advantage of. Good hotel.

author: aliceSurrey
title: Will not return
text: My husband and I stayed from 6 September until 20th September and were extremely disappointed since the hotel was billed as 5 star and quite clearly is about 3.5! Reception staff are extremely efficient and helpful but sadly the waiting staff are arrogant and rude. They need to be sent to 'charm school'. Food is monotonous, of poor quality and hot food in chafing dishes is cold! Coffee at breakfast is putrid and is not helped by the hotel only using long life milk. We had a suite with nice balcony but unfortunately the cushions for the sun beds were dirty, thin and particularly well worn. Luxury? Definitely not. A glass in the bathroom was wrapped in cellophane and when I took off the wrapping, found the last guest's toothpaste still at the bottom of the glass! At dinner one night, one of the restaurant managers asked us if we would prefer a table outside or inside the restaurant and before we had an opportunity to reply, he walked away and started giggling and laughing with two waitresses! This was exceptionally rude and I located him later and informed him of this. We received no apology, merely putting his hand on his heart as if he were sorry! Friends came to visit us one afternoon and we decided to have buffet lunch. At 30 euros a head this is an absolute rip off. A glass of red wine is 8euro 50, water 5 euros so we quickly decided to get basics from the local supermarket which is 8 euros there and 8 euros back! Having paid over 4000 pounds for our two week stay (half board) I feel utterly disgruntled and thoroughly ripped off. It is no wonder the hotel has lost its status as one of the luxury hotels of the world. It deserved to!

author: Babesb79
title: Lovely Family hotel but...
text: We stayed here for two weeks in August. The room was great however we had problems with housekeeping not calling in the evenings or leaving fresh towels. our room was right next to the childrens pool fantastic. however beware the kids pool turned our childrens bathers yellow and we were not al alone in this. The big pool was fantastic and on the last day of our holiday there were inflatables the kids had the best time. name these weren't there more frequently.The hotel is in a remote location and a car is needed. We hired one from the airport. Lovely breakfast and front of house staff very friendly! the wi-fi is rubbish does not work in the room which is a pain you have to stand in the corridor.
