I would rather pay and have access whenever I want. the bathrooms in the room are very spacious. This is a destination for a relaxing holiday. my children looked at the kids club twice but on both occasions none of the staff spoke to us or tried to interact. So I can't report any more than that. We enjoyed but probably won't be back. Our kids just wanted a toasted sandwich by the pool for lunch you had to have with chips and at over 8 euros when they only wanted a snack seemed expensive. Surely they could just sell a sandwich on its own. Bar service very slow.

author: Liamnye
title: A delightful hotel that is constantly reinventing itself to appeal to a wider audience.
text: My family and I discovered this hotel in 2006. Boasting five stars it delivered fantastic accommodation at a price in line with promised levels of service and luxury. This was delivered in every way, with courtesy extended from every member of staff. How has this changed in the six subsequent annual visits? It hasn't. A sure sign of good employer is the staff retention levels over this period. Whilst Spain obviously has it's own employment difficulties today that cannot be considered in the way that this hotel has kept and promoted all of those members of staff as well as bring in new, equally capable, employees. A warm welcome upon every arrival reminds us that we are there to be looked after. Today the hotel has evolved to cater far more for families, with a kids club that keeps the youngsters out of their parents hair for a while each day. This should not be confused with a loud environment of screaming kids and constant interruption by hollering parents. The clientele tend to be a likeminded bunch and the bars and evening entertainment are both civilised and contained. The pools are exquisite and the gate onto the beach makes for a wonderful opportunity to stretch your legs and have a wonder in the surf. The initial beach area is somewhat blighted by significant boulders which can cause concerns with swimming, but a couple of hundred yards either way and this problem disappears. The positive side to this is that the beach immediately upon the hotel is not a local tourist attraction and is therefore more tranquil. If you have a car then you are easily placed for trips in the vicinity as there is not a plethora of bars and restaurants within easy walking distance. However, Estepona is only a five minute taxi ride away, which are on instant availability from the hotel lobby. If you like to spend quality time with your family, over leisurely meals with a huge choice of cuisine from either the buffet or restaurants then Hotel Elba is waiting for you. If you are looking to be constantly entertained with a trail of reps to boot, then you should be looking elsewhere. I don't believe I've even touched the surface with this review but conclude by saying, a returning guest must be a satisfied one.

author: 343angelas
title: EXCELLENT HOLIDAY IN ESTEPONA
text: We returned this morning from a week's stay in the Gran Hotel Elba, Estepona. First of all to start with the negatives. Don't panic if you've already booked a holiday here, the negatives are few and not terrible. To start with the hotel does have a private beach, but it's not sandy more fine shingle and the coast is rocky but the sea is clear and nice to swim in. This wasn't a problem for us as we're more pool people anyway, but could be a disapointment if you're searching for long sandy beaches. The next issue is, it's very expensive to eat and drink in the hotel, so if you haven't booked on an all inclusive or full board basis it may be worth considering this and try to upgrade when you check in. Also there are no tea or coffee making facilities in the room, which when you consider it's about 8 euros for two coffees this would make quite a difference to the daily holiday budget. Despite what is said on the travel agent website, not all rooms are sea view and the first room we checked into definitely wasn't but the hotel did move us on the second day The last and biggest drawback is the actual location of the hotel, though the address is Estepona the hotel is not within walking distance of Estepona itself, its about a 7 minute ride in a taxi, costing between 7 and 9 euros each way, depending on the time of day you're going in. Even if a long walk is not daunting for you it's simply not possible as a large part of the route is along a dual carriage way with no pavement. Again this was an issue for us as we had planned to eat out most evenings as we were only bed and breakfast, so had to add approx fifteen euros to the bill each time we went out. On the plus side: The rooms and en-suites are of an excellent size and very comfortable, the view of the bay from the sea-view rooms is really lovely. The pool areas are busy but sun beds are always available, though if like us you use the adult only terrace this was always quiet and peaceful, once again with stunning views across the bay. Food is good but not excellent, the buffet lunches and dinners being much better value than the a la carte dining. Bar snacks are also available and of a reasonable standard. Though as mentioned before eating and drinking is pricey The staff were very friendy and always willing to help with any questions. We had late night flights on our last day, originally we had hoped to be able to use our room till later in the day but as it had be re-allocated we had to vacate by 12, but we were able to use a secure area for our luggage (accessible whenever we wanted) and use the hotel facilities for as long as we needed including use of the showers etc in the Spa. If you do go into Estepona, go on a Saturday evening the place really comes to life and there are some really lovely little beach shacks barbecuing fresh sardines which are absolutely delicious Overall we really enjoyed our holiday, it was our first holiday without our daughters for twenty years, and we felt apart from the mix up with the room to begin with that we had got exactly what we expected. We probably wouldn't go back to Estepona again for no other reason than we try and go somewhere different on each holiday, but I would recommend the hotel.

author: JohnR1234
title: SHOULD BE BETTER
text: This is officially a 5 star hotel but they are many things about it that mean it isnt. I really dont understand how the star system works when you can have 2 different hotels in the same counttry with the same start ratings but different standards. Anyway why isnt it 5 star in my opinion? The hotel is a little dated. Reception looks fine but the bar area is old fashioned and not as inviting as it should be. The sofas there are comfortable but ideally need replacing. The bedrooms are OK but the airco didnt work as well as it should do. We had 2 adjoining rooms and the celing fan came on in both rooms when trying to put it on is just one room. There were knocks on the furniture. The bathroom shower leaked for the first couple of days and was then fixed. That exposed the fact that the bathroom then wasnt cleaned properly as the water mark was there for 2 days before we complained. The bedroom wasnt cleaned properly - there was a piece of fluff near the mat next to my bed that was there for 10 days (so no mopping or vacuuming). The hotel is supposed to have wifi throughout the hotel but it definitely doesnt and i wasnt the only one to have this problem On a positive side the pool area is nice, clean and very well kept. There are plenty of sun umbrellas and sunbeds. If you want one by the pool you have to be early but to be honest the grass area is better and more spacious My conclusion is that the hotel needs to undergo refurbishment and then it could be a super hotel. it is good value for money but In the meantime a lot could be done to improve it

author: CliveAndrews
title: Good and not so good
text: We were here for a short break at short notice. Booked through hotels4U and got a very good rate. However the 'sea view' was fine if you leaned over the balcony and twisted your head fully to the right. Having said that the room was one of the best I have ever stayed in. Spacious, well equipped apart from what can only be called 'optimistic' settings on the air conditioning. The staff were polite but reception, when contacted by phone, were slow to react to issues. Breakfast buffet after 9.00am was a bun fight although the choice was extensive. Avoid snacks in the bar on the reception level, We ordered a ham and cheese baguette which came with fries and a small salad. The fries were cold so we sent them back. When they returned hot it was clear the whole plate, fries, baguette and salad had ALL been put in a microwave. First bite of the tomato was almost lethal. We really appreciated the adults only covered pool which saved us from all the noise around the main pool. Car park was very busy but we managed to squeeze in every day. Would probably go again but would eat outside the hotel. The restaurants around Estepona marina were excellent.

author: 918tonyc
title: EXCELLENT STAY - WELL RUN HOTEL
text: Dates of stay: 23/06/13-05/07/13 On arrival at the Gran Elba you enjoy a sense of calm in the well appointed lobby area. Check in was swift, efficient and informative. We were allocated room 237 which overlooked the gardens and sea. The room was spacious, clean and very comfortable. The design of the rooms placed the main wardrobes in the same area as the dual wash basins which then led to the bathroom/shower/toilet. Having the wardrobes away from the main bedroom made it easier to keep the bedroom tidy and free of clothes. The only slight niggle of the room was the unavailability of a kettles and coffee/tea making facilities. Fortunately we had read this same comment on a previous review and took our own kettle. The restaurant was very well organised with excellent choices of food both for breakfast and for evening meal. It is true that when staying in a hotel for longer than a week the menu may become repetitive and this was the case during our stay, however I must stress that the quality of food presentation and the ongoing maintenance of buffett dishes were excellent. Also the two male Restaurant Managers were very welcoming and took great pride in the smooth running of their areas. The pool and garden areas were well maintained and very clean. The beach area although shingly is very clean and enjoyable. For those using a hire car there is plently of parking space at the hotel and for those wishing to food shop there is an Aldi and other large supermarket just opposite the hotel. To summerise, this hotel is run extremely efficiently which very helpful staff. We would certainly recommend you to stay here. Tony Clarke - Newcastle, Staffordshire, England

author: MJAND
title: Oasis of Peace & Calm!
text: We are just back from spending a wonderful week at this hotel. It was quite by chance that we opted to stay here - and we will definitely be going back. The service was superb, and the staff very attentive in all departments - right from the moment we arrived at reception! We had booked a Junior Suite and were given a fabulous room with the most amazing balcony on the top floor with an perfect view of the private beach, and in the distance, Gibralter & the mountains of North Africa!. As my husband is disabled, it meant we could sunbathe in the privacy of our own room without him having to negotiate sunbeds round the pool. It was wonderful to wake up every day and listen to the sea lapping on the shore. The main restaurant is buffet-style, where the food was always well presented, and there was a grill section where you could get fresh fish and meat cooked if you wanted. Brilliant! We ate in the Andalusian restaurant twice - the first meal was excellent, but the second time, the meal was not as enjoyable. However, service was first-class. The hotel was very quiet - although fairly busy at the weekend - and the whole atmosphere was relaxing. Lovely lobby, nice pool area (with separate children's pool area), pleasant outside eating areas - all beautifully maintained and clean. The private beach is a huge bonus, and the walkway between the hotel and the beach was well paved so easy for my husband to walk along. Do not be put off by the dual carriageway that runs behind the hotel - try and book a room with a sea view - worth the extra pennies! The hotel manages to offer all sorts of different packages successfully, whilst still running a four star hotel. The hotel is not situated in Estapona town - so you will need to get a taxi if you want to go to the Sunday market or shop in town! It is great though, as it is in a residential area, so nice and quiet, and extremely relaxing. Came home feeling very chilled and relaxed - brilliant hotel choice!

author: jfl9876
title: Lovely stay - would go back
text: We have just returned from a very good 5 night stay at the Hotel Elba, we had a lovely large double room with sea view. The hotel is very attractive and the staff were very efficient and friendly, all the reception staff we spoke to all spoke good English and the bar staff also spoke it reasonably well, although we do try out our limited Spanish on them too. The hotel wasn't full which made it very tranquil and relaxing and it is on a lovely beach. Don't be put off by the dual carriageway outside when you arrive, as you are not aware of this at all once in the hotel or by the pool/beach. We spent a lovely couple of hours in the spa and didn't mind paying extra for this. We were on a bed and breakfast basis and the breakfast is the normal buffet breakfast with eggs cooked to order if required. One night we had been out walking round town all day, so decided to eat in the hotel at the buffet, which was the only thing I would say was disappointing, the salads were quite good, but there was virtually no choice of main courses apart from pasta, pizza, something in a hot plate which wasn't labelled and we didn't know what it was, the chef was also cooking fish steaks to order, but we thought at 39 euros a head plus drinks, this was a bit excessive considering the quality, therefore we were glad we weren't half board, also the atmosphere of the old town at night was much nicer. The hotel receptionist told us when we arrived that we could eat in any of the other restaurants, but needed to book in advance and we did see people eating in them during our stay, so they were open then. Outside the hotel: the hotel is a bit out of town, surrounded by mostly apartments, there is a supermarket over the road bridge, then to the left, an easy 10 minute walk, there is also a brand new Aldi which looks like it will be opening imminently, virtually opposite the hotel. There are also 2 restaurants both within an 5-10 minute walk to the right of the hotel, one over the road The Menorah and one on the same side - El Dorado. We ate at El Dorado one night, we had the mixed seafood which was excellent, also the staff were very nice, but we thought it was a bit pricey - 19 euros for 2 tiramisus ! and it also didn't have the atmosphere of the old town, where we ate every other night, the old town is also much cheaper, even taking into account the taxi fair - 7.70 euros weekdays, 9.50 after a certain time in the evening and 9.20 weekend daytime, which if there are 2 + people seemed reasonable to us. We also walked along the beach on the Sunday morning to the market at the marina, this is a really pleasant walk, with a mixture of promenade at the start , then beach and stony path. It took us less than an hour at a VERY leisurely pace, stopping to admire the view and take photos, you also pass 2 beach bars on the way once you get past the Estepona Palace hotel. After we had been to the market we carried on towards the town, (which is about another 20 minute walk to the old town), but stopped off after 10 minutes at a beach bar called Tropical for the second time during out stay to have lunch, which is really good, my husband had fresh sardines which the chef barbecued on the beach and you can just sit there for ages with a drink watching the world go by one the beach. Some previous reviewers have said they never left the hotel, which is lovely for a relaxing break, but I really think you miss something special by not going to the old town, walking through it's narrow streets of mostly white houses, all covered in geraniums, then coming across little squares to have coffee or meals. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely go back.

author: RufflesR
title: A decent review for you all :) Hope you find it useful.
text: Ok so I promised you a review when we got back home, but we thought we would do it while we are still here; Firstly since we had never been to Spain before we were a little cautious as to what to expect from the ,Elba, - so here goes folks and hope you find it useful - The hotel is well laid out, has very good services, and offers excellent cleanliness with warm and welcoming staff. The Spa is quite amazing and offers good quality regimes. The room we have been given 519 is large, spacious, clean, and the bathroom is of exceptional quality. I had expected like most hotels the water to slowly disappear out the bathtub, but no, the plug fits snugly and the water stays in there. The only problem with the bathroom is that there are no face cloths within the towel selection and the bathrobes were way too small for either myself or husband (and we are not large). The breakfast buffet far surpasses expectations, there is everything anyone could possibly want for a morning feast. All the staff are friendly and helpful and again everything is spotless with good quality food - rather reminiscent of a top class Swiss hotel. The quality of the food served within the restaurants is excellent, with some good choices to cover all tastes, it is well prepared and presented using good quality supplies. All the pools are very clean and well cared for, the gardens too are a pleasure to see. It wouldn't be much of a review if all I did was extol the virtues of the hotel so just to hopefully give you a few pointers - whilst the sun loungers look very classy they are very very uncomfortable and caused quite a lot of back pain. They need cushions at least twice as thick to make them anywhere near comfortable. Also having a minibar in your room is a very good advantage but you do need to put some glasses in there so we can actually drink the items in the minibar? A few staff mentions as some of them are exceptional in both their service and helpfulness - Gemma in reception, David in the restaurant and Andreas on bar service. The hotel does deserve it's 5 star rating and will I am sure have a good repeat visitor count. We will certainly be returning at some point. Whilst the drinks are a little over priced the food in the restaurants is quite good value.

author: UGGMerseyside
title: fantastic stay. miss it already !
text: stayed last week. stayed at some beautiful hotels all around the world and this place is 5 star. rooms restaurants cleanliness staff all fab. cannot fault this place. miss the place already. indoor pool overlooking the sea. kids absolutely loved it. free pass to spa was great touch and had great time. would return without doubt. any negative reviews astound me ! these people cannot do enough for you. food was gorgeous. Paris and al anadaluca restaurants served best food ever. ignore negatives. you can't go wrong in this place. enjoy x

author: need_an_idea
title: Excellent stay
text: Me & my partner stayed here 9th-16th June 2012. we stayed in room 509. we stayed half board Read a few reviews before i booked on trip advisor and wasnt 100% certain what we'd get, thankfully we were not disappointed. Location - a little bit on its own, but a 30 minutes walk round the beach will bring you to the marina which is a nice walk, we ate at the marina a few days and had tapas which was gorgeous. the beach isnt golden sands, its more stones but its literally a few paces from the hotel, you can walk round to near the marina for a better beach with proper sand. Rooms - well appointed, air con, mini bar, TV with English channels, comfy beds with a view to die for. if you like the sound of the waves you will not be disappointed. Grounds & pool - grounds are well kept and are better than most hotels i've stayed in, reception staff are very helpful. pool is great, nice & cool and no screaming kids! plenty of beds to go around and certainly was no rushing in the mornings to get a bed etc Food - the breakfast was superb, plenty of choice with fresh made eggs or omlettes or serial & breads/toast. The choice is very very good Evening meal again was plenty of choice buffet style, sometimes buffet's do get a bit repetative but that buffet's for you, it will be the same no matter what hotel you stay in. my only negative is the lunch is a bit pricey for what you get in my opinion. Top tips: 1) if you are getting a taxi from the airport, get the hotel to arrange it for you, it works out cheaper! 2) walk around to the marina for lunch 3) dont take beach towls, the hotel provide them 4) get your sun creams & location from the supermarkets across the road (over bridge) much cheaper. All in all, great relaxing holiday and one i'd recommend. Thanks to the Gran Hotel Elba for an enjoyable stay

author: garnik
title: Costa 5 Star
text: We vist some retired friends every year in Estepona, have been in most of the 5 star properties around the area and this one is no different. How they get 5 star GL is amazing. The hotel itself is okay, typical spanish construction, paper thin walls, so your peace in the room depends on the rooms either side of you. The junior suite was okay, very spacious and large bathroom. Decor rather on the dark side. They simply don't have the staff to be classed as 5*, there is no service around the pool at all, it's a case of go up and get it yourself, and please bring it back ! Drinks served in the cheapest plastic tumblers. At breakfast they are hopelessly understaffed, they simply clean the tables once you have left, if you finnish with a plate it simply stays on the table till you have gone. Scrambled eggs were out of a tetra pack ! In the evening the main restaurant only has buffet, once again saving on staff. Can't see how you can classify a hotel as 5* with only a buffet service. The staff seemed friendly enough, but they didnt have a moment to comunicate with guests since thy were so busy. All in all after years of visiting the Costa it's about what you can expect for the price, Kempinski is a little better but also average. I guess unless you move up to paying 700/800 Euros per day you cant expect any real service, it's average European beach resort standard. Beware if you are looking for a beach holiday there is no sandy beach in front of the hotel

author: BigmalLondon
title: Are we talking about the same place?
text: This is a hotel that I know really well having stayed there at least a dozen times in the last 3 years. Accordingly, I find some of the recent reviews surprising. First, you need to understand the location. The property is out of town on a thin strip of land between a main road and a small stoney beach. This is not a fairy story location. You will need a car, or to be happy to use taxis. That said, the architecture is magnificent, including great indoor and outdoor pools. All the rooms I have ever had are large, well appointed, quiet and face the sea. The public rooms are of a high standard. Contrary to some reviewers, I have always had good service, and sometimes very good. Food and drink is indeed expensive, as you might expect in a 5 star property. I have never had serious quality problems, and there are lots of cheaper options locally if you want them. I can understand the location may be disappointing if you have not checked it out first, perhaps on Google Maps. Any property will pick up the odd negative review, and perpahs the Elba had a bad patch. However, in my view, this hotel is fairly rated as 5 star. I can generally find a room at the Elba on the net for a litlte over GB£100 per room per night, which includes an excellent breakfast. You can find cheaper, but I regard that as good value. The "nudist colony next door" referred to by another reviewer is indeed there. However, it is a gated and walled collection of buildings and appartments, entirely innocuous as far as I can see, and much like hundreds of others on the Costa. Other than by walking along the beach into a clearly signed naturist area, I suggest that you would not know what it is unless you make it your busienss to find out.

author: 478fayev
title: Doesnt deserve 5* status
text: We have just returned from a 6 night break at the Elba Estepona and frankly were a little disappointed. Upon arrival all seemed to be in order, the room we booked (junior suite) to accomodate 4 of us (2 adults, 1 teenager + 1 infant) was roomy, with a seperate lounge area with a rollaway bed for our 13yr old and a cot as requested for our baby. however, the bathroom which could be accessed from both the master bedroom and hallway (via the dressing room) was more than a little impractical. for starters, there was no 'door' on the entrance from the hall and the glass door that separated the dressing room from the bathroom meant that if you were in the buff in the bathroom when room service/maid etc came into your hallway, by virtue of the mirrors in the dressing room, you were extremely exposed. in addition the glass door we felt was a major safety issue for our 17month old who walked into it more than a few times (even after we hung a towel on the handle to highlight the fact that it was a door), hence not recommended if you have young toddlers who tend to run everywhere. Buffet lunch at EUR50 is a rip off, and no one mentioned a free glass of wine with it when we tried it out. generally we found the food to be dull, uninteresting and overpriced. their club sandwiches were the sorriest i have ever experienced and came accompanied with stale crisps! service was also extremely poor, and no pool service for drinks or food was a let down, although there were a couple of outstanding waitresses and front desk staff who were helpful, most were rude and surly. the bottle of milk we ordered for our baby each morning and night was 'warmed' to thermo-nuclear temperature even after numerous requested to just 'warm' it. No buffet restaurant at night meant that you have to book one of the 3 restaurants in advance and given the location of the hotel there is nowhere else nearby (walking distance) to get something to eat. no early supper for children either which means having to take extremely hungry/tired toddler to dinner at 7.30pm, oh and the kids menu is the same whichever restaurant you dine in. we have stayed at far nicer hotels that have better service, better food, better staff and at a better price. the plus about this hotel is the rooms are large enough to accomodate a family and the actual price for the room wasnt too bad (pity they sting you on everything else!). we wont be going back.

author: angl0dutch
title: A 5*+ Hotel With A 2* Mentality!
text: I booked this hotel for my elderly parents for a 2-week stay in October 2006. I also arranged return airport transfers from Malaga airport to this hotel. My parents' last day at this hotel was a complete nightmare which ended with my mother and father (who are in their 70's) being led to believe by hotel staff that the car waiting outside the lobby for them was their transfer to the airport. It turned out that the person waiting was a criminal who confined them to the car at the airport until they paid him EUR 90.00. My mother has a heart condition and the hotel couldn't care less about us and our complaint! The hotel staff at reception have denied any knowledge of my parents asking them to call the transfer company on the day of departure to reconfirm the pickup time. The reception deny calling this transfer company and deny confirming anything to my parents. The staff member on duty at the lobby entrance also denies checking with the driver that he was there to pick them up, this at my father's request before my parents got in the vehicle. Complaints to the General Manager of this hotel have gone unanswered. Same complaint which was also sent to the head office of this hotel has also gone unanswered. Is this a five star plus hotel?! What other Superior class hotel does not answer complaints or has fairly senior staff who conspire to lie in order to protect themselves? What kind of hotel is not interested in guests who have paid out EUR 3,000 - and that's just for the room? Appalling. I am so angry at how my poor parents were treated and it is totally the fault of this hotel, which is made even worse by the attitude of the management team there. Avoid - and stay elsewhere! There are similar 5* hotels along the coast which are much more professional. Unique Qualities: The hotel's amenties were of a high standard, a pity that the hotel's customer relations department is non-existent!

author: norwichenough
title: Something missing
text: Around the swimming pool I asked everyone I met what they thought about this hotel and they all said "there's something missing". All said they would not return, and we agree. First the good things. The hotel is lovely, and good value for money. We paid 200 euros inc. breakfast and were upgraded to a lovely suite, with great bathroom and comfy bed. We had a problem with the Tv and it was changed within minutes. The hotel and the pools are very clean, housekeeping are great. There is a good hairdyer in the room. the location of the hotel is good in that it is right by the sea.We had a nice welcome from the general manager. The main problem I think is lack of staff, and lack of English spoken by them. When you can get hold of someone and explain what you need they are great, but there are simply not enough staff around, especially in the restaurant and around the pool. Also, both pools are FREEZING! We had a persistent problem with mozzies in our room, they are impervious to the repellent plug-ins the hotel happily doles out. No tea/ coffee making facilities in the room. nasty drain smell around the pool at times. Room service menu very limited and kid's menu nearly all nuggets and chips. Had a good meal in the fish restaurant in the port called Taberna marinera

author: Antoinetta
title: Superb Breakfast, well appointed room.
text: We (me, my husband and baby) stayed in this hotel for four nights in November. We were surprised how far it was from Malaga, and from Estepona itself. You would only leave this hotel in a Taxi, as the location is not particularly appealing, just stretches of appartment blocks. On arrival however, we were welcomed warmly and presented with a complimentary drink on the terrace where we could enjoy our new surroundings. It is, I am relieved to say, a confident 5 Star establishment, rather than a 3 star with false pretensions, and has the service and decor you would expect. It was very empty. They could probably price themselves more competitively to get more custom in quiet months like November. The Spa looked well equipped and luxurious, but that isn't our thing, so we didn't avail of it. Our Junior Suite was spacious and comfortable, with a sea view balcony and a fantastic bathroom. The champagne and well presented fruit selection was a nice touch. The outdoor pool looked nice, although it was too cold to swim in, similarly, he children's pool looked lovely too, but was too freezing to put our small child into. Although the restaurants were expensive (comparatively... you can eat the same in Spain for a fraction of the price), the food was of consistently high quality. We ate in the hotel a lot because we were able to avail of an evening babysitting service arranged by the hotel. It was worth every penny for the peace of mind, the lady who sat for our baby was lovely. Our only niggles were firstly that the outside pool wasn't heated, secondly that their attractive main bar was closed for the winter season, and the lobby bar had absolutely zero charisma, and thirdly, the beach was filthy, really quite disgusting, and finally, that the location was pretty drab. But overall, we had a very pleasant stay here. We found the service attentive and unobtrusive, and the breakfast buffet was superb.

author: 2babride
title: Fabulous Hotel
text: Stayed here for 5 nights on our honeymoon. Welcome drinks, champagne and fruit bowl on arrival. Firstly, the rooms really are stunning - very spacious, massive bed (with pillow and sheet menu).. comfortable armchairs and the bathrooms are beautiful... with great power shower. Large terrace leading to the garden with seaview (this was a standard room). Overall we found the service good esp clean/turndown service. Room service arrived within 20 mins and staff sometimes cleared away our breakfast before we'd finished it... The breakfast buffet has wonderful choice and outside seating area. The pool area is lovely but the rooftop pool won hands down in October as it is heated and has fantastic ocean views to Estepona one way and Gibraltar the other. Spa is fantastic - recommend the massages.. Didnt eat in the restaurants.. we drove to Puerto Estepona in the evenings and ate and drank a selection of harbourside eateries and bars.. recommend the Italian one, stunning food, but not the first one next to carpark, tuna covered in lard anyone?? Downs are: You need a car... also, during our stay there was a large corporate conference taking place... it was entertaining to begin with ..watching and listening to a whole afternoon of executive "games" taking place around the gardens.. but we did get "castenet fatigue" after a few hours! On the whole though, a fabulous hotel!

author: lja123
title: Fantastic Hotel!
text: We stayed for the first week in October. Dont understand where some of the reviews are coming from. Hotel not very busy, which might explain why our service was so good. Could perhaps understand if the hotel was very busy. Bedrooms very good, and bathroom luxurious. Turndown service was excellent, even changed the towels in the evenings as well as in the mornings. Wee chocolate in the evening was a lovely touch. We ate twice in the hotel, the first being excellent, (Paris/Roma) the second being good (Fusion) if a bit pricey. The service in the Paris/Roma restaurant was excellent, with our wine, and water, being poured for us. The beach was not very good, but I understand that the beach is not owned by the hotel, and therefore not cleaned by them. The pool area is spotless, with towels and cushions provided for the sunbeds. Reception staff were excellent, and dealt with any queries we had quickly and with a smile! Even to the point of giving us some ideas of where to visit while our husbands golfed! The only thing I had reservations about was the location of the hotel. You definately need a car. Although taxis are very cheap, and there is a taxi rank situated at the hotel, you definately need a car to go further afield. All in all, a great holiday, fantastic hotel, but remember to hire a car!

author: StevenHeverlee
title: Second stay at Gran Elba
text: In august of 2005 I stayed for the second time at the Gran Elba. I booked this time my room through expedia and paid a reasonable price for a standard room with half board. When I arrived at the hotel i was offered a welcome drink at the bar. The room was very nice and very well equiped with nice sea view. I got the impression that the hotel was far from fully booked. Everyting was perfect and well kept. Brekfast was great. the only mino is the waiting in the hotel restaurants. The restaurants were understaffed and probably the kitchen as wel. Food served was really great and prices of wines were reasonable. This is a great hotel and well located (a car is very much recommended) but...you really need patience in the restaurant, staff however is very friendly. The outdoor and indoor pools are very nice. The nearby beach does not belong to the hotel, but you can have a sunbed on the beach. As this is not property of the hotel the (public) beach is not cleaned by the hotel. You can walk by the beach to Estepona center or into the other direction were you pass a naturist zone.

author: StevenHeverlee
title: Magnificent
text: Luxurious Hotel at the costa del Sol. The hotel is located next to Estepona in the direction of Cadiz. As for many hotels at the Costa De Sol a car is recommended. We had a very spacious luxurious room with vast and well equiped bathroom. Welcoming and service was very ok. Staff was very attentive. The outdoor and indoor pool is very nice. The thalasso is incredible perfect. everything is well kept. Breakfast was excellent. For evening diner you can choose between Spanig, Italian and Asian restaurant. I visited both the Italian and the Asian one and was pleasantly surprised, howver the restaurants were a bit understaffed at the time. Hotel management pays a lot of attention to details ! The private beach is excellent when it gets a bit overheated at the poolside. I enjoyed long walks at the nearby beaches. In the evening We took our rental car to visit the nearby Ronda, Puerto Banus..... we had sevral times diner at the Estepona Port : I can recommend Rossati, a nice italian at the port.

author: Jobywan
title: Lovely hotel
text: The hotel is a standard 3 star all inclusive, lovely layout with beautiful gardens & 2 main pools with a smaller pool in the suites area opposite the main “village” area. It has a main dining area for breakfast, lunch & evening meal with a smaller snack area near the main busy pool bar. Mostly Swedish guests when we went but all very nice & lovely atmosphere. Rooms - the first room we were given was 223, although clean it was very dark & had a musty damp smell due to the fact it didn’t get any sun & had a big tree outside blocking the light. I went to reception & requested a change & 2 hours later was given a bright airy room, same layout & size as the previous room just no musty smell. No complaints the staff were very accommodating & apologised for us not liking the first room. Rooms have 2 ac units one in each room, fridge, cooking hob, sink, kettle, 2 TVs & lovely bathroom with rainfall shower. Daily clean & towel change except Sunday. Food - typical all inclusive food, lots of choice, pasta, grilled fish, stews, veg, chips, salads, meat dishes, pizza, etc some Greek food & nice breads. Wasn’t exceptional but good hot & fresh with lots of choice at breakfast. Drinks - local beer & wine/cocktails, you have to pay extra for brands €7.50 for aperol spritz but not more than the local bars. Staff - all staff are very good & work hard. Entertainment staff work very hard to include everyone but not in your face, good fun & great for the kids. Lisa was lovely. Location - off the main road up a hill, not great for those with mobility problems, lots of ramps inside the “village” but still very steep & hilly. About 10 minutes to walk to the beach, 5 minutes to get to the main road. Kato Dorasto is a nice quiet area, with a few bars & restaurants. We took the bus into Chania which was lovely & the next town kalamaki which was busier. We had a very enjoyable stay at this hotel, just what we needed a quiet week away. Nice for a 7 day break, friendly staff, spotlessly clean, nice food & good pool.

author: 303staceyp
title: All the good reviews have said it all
text: All the good reviews here have already said it all and we couldn't agree more. We have just come back from a two week holiday here and picked this hotel because of the fantastic reviews already left. We weren't disappointed. We were a little concerned how we'd get on in our first week as we are a childless couple and it was still the British school holidays but we didn't feel the children or entertainment took away from our relaxing holiday at all. We were lucky enough to get a room upgrade and stayed in the suites in the separate block across the road. I think this probably made our holiday. It was definitely the quieter part of the hotel, the pool there is very relaxing and the rooms are beautiful. The rest of the hotel is just as beautiful set in lovely gardens that we enjoyed walking through the grounds every day. Every member of staff we encountered were friendly and professional and we always felt welcome wherever we were. We did a couple of excursions - one to Gramvousa and Balos Lagoon and one to the Samaria Gorge where we completed the 16km hike. I couldn't recommend them enough and we were pleased we booked through Tui. They were well organised trips and the hotel were helpful enough to organise packed lunches for us. The beaches nearby are nice and walkable. There are 4 beaches in easy reach, some bigger than others so pick your favourite. Easy bus routes to town too - the old town is fab. The food at the hotel was also great - I'm usually quite a fussy eater and hate trying new foods but I indulged everyday in fresh fish dishes, traditional Greek dishes and all sorts. There was something new every day and a wide variety at every meal. There's really nothing about our holiday we were disappointed with. I thought I'd be bored and ready to come home after two weeks but I really didn't want to leave.

author: sofiahc2018
title: Has my heart!
text: Stayed for a week at the Althea village. Absolutely stunning hotel, the garden views with gorgeous flowers really make it look lovely. Reception staff were polite and showed us to our room. Nikos in the restaurant always said hello and asked how me and my mum were. I'm half greek so we had good chats and he always made such an effort to come over and check how our food was. Food was amazing. Chef's cooked fresh food everyday, always hot and lots of choice. The bar staff were beyond amazing!! Katerina, Alex and Stelios made our whole holiday!!!!! Cannot express enough how amazing they were, always made us laugh, filled our drinks before they were even empty. Made such an effort with us to tell us about the island, where to go and what to do. Katerina always had a smile on her face and was extremely sweet! Alex & Stelios were such lovely guys and often had me and my mum laughing away at the bar, we didn't even leave the hotel of an evening as we were so content there. The rooms were so clean and tidy, spacious and the maids were amazing. always said hello or goodbye and made an effort to chat to us. All staff were amazing however Stelios, Alex & Katerina were our favourites. we will miss them dearly but thanks to them we will be returning next year!! Cant wait to return to this beautiful island and excellent hotel. All love, Sofiah & Julie xx

author: angiea638
title: Angie A
text: What a fantastic week's holiday. The hotel was clean, well run, relaxing and friendly. The restaurant manager and his staff work hard, welcoming you with a smile every meal time. There was a wide variety of food each day and the puddings were to die for! All the staff around the hotel were helpful and ready with a friendly greeting. The shop on site is well stocked and reasonably priced and run by a very nice lady. We booked a twin with extra bed for 3 of us, I was a bit worried it would be a squeeze, but we were given a mini 2 room apartment, which meant our daughter could have her own space. Our room was very clean and a good sized bathroom and shower. We arrived late at night, but on check in led through to the restaurant, where sandwiches and soup awaited us. A nice touch and much appreciated. The pools and pool area was cleaned every day. Even though the hotel was full we had no problem getting sunbeds and no need for anyone to do the sunbed sprint at stupid o'clock in the morning! My only gripe was the ladies toilet door by the bar pool, didn't shut properly (I think it just needs shaving a bit). WiFi could be sporadic at times, but we were on holiday and didn't want to spend loads of time on our phones anyway. The Suneo team were fantastic, organised lots of activities which my husband and daughter loved. They made sure they got to know the guests and involved all who wanted to join in without anyone feeling pressured. On our last day we had Cretes first day of rain all summer, but Charley, Mikhaela, Liesa and Pawel organised fun activities in doors, which we all enjoyed. We would definitely recommend the hotel and thank everybody for a fabulous time.

author: MinniePoole
title: Great Crete holiday
text: Another fab family holiday thanks to the staff at Althea Village. Niko is a great host and always available with a smile and a kind word. We were upgraded to a suite to fit our family together which was fantastic. Gogo on reception was also amazing and helpful. The food was delicious and plentiful and cooked to perfection. I read about the food being good and wasn’t disappointed. In fact only ate out once as it was so good 😊 I can’t fault the cleanliness of the resort and the facilities available. No fight for loungers around the pool no matter what time of day - what a change from the usual bun fight! Overall a great place to visit and easy to access Chania by bus and the beach is a 10 minute walk from the hotel. Stelio and his team on the bar were fantastic and the cocktails were nice, especially the ones they made up if you paid a little extra. The crepe place on the corner is also worth a visit. As for the Suneo team - Charlie, Mikela, Pawel and Liesa- they were really good fun and seemed upbeat and enthusiastic all the time which must be hard to maintain in 34degree heat... all week. What a great team and deserved winners of Suneo best team 2018. I would recommend this hotel for those of you who want a chilled, but fun packed If you wish, holiday with the family.

author: thomjs90
title: Just what we needed....
text: Just returned back from a fantastic week at this hotel and we couldn’t find a single fault. The staff were brilliant from the late afternoon greet to the very end. The receptionists were very helpful with anything that we needed or directions to the Old Chania town, beach (10mins walk) and other trips. The trip to the old town was amazing and couldn’t recommend it enough with an easy 15min bus ride to the town at €1.20 filled with unique and authentic Greek restaurants bars and shops up and down the port. The bar staff were fantastic Stellios and Katarina were fabulous and kept us topped up at the bar along with all the other bar staff throughout the day and evening. The drinks selection was brilliant compared to previous hotels with excellent choice of cocktails in the all inclusive. Again the staff in the restaurant were great at helping us through our meals and was great to see them all smiling even though they seemed to be there all day everyday. Food was great always a good variety in all meals, and the reasturant was a beautiful setting under olive trees and out onto a small balcony. The room was brilliant. We were in the out building to the main hotel, spacious room, double bed, very clean and cleaned every day by the staff, excellent bathroom walk in shower air con and spacious balcony. The air con wasn’t as cool as previous places during the day however throughout the night it did get better. The pool was great mostly had this to ourselves and very quiet with the sun catching it all day. This has been a great trip and we will definitely be returning. Great for couple families and small groups. 🥂☀️

author: joseiphine
title: althea village crete
text: Just returned from althea village hotel daratso Crete . Had a fantastic holiday , No complaints at all. Very clean well managed complex, food plentiful and appealingly set out. Great choice as well even above and beyond what you would expect. Staff helpful nothing too much trouble. Wouldn't hesitate to go again. Sun bed towels available for 10 euros deposit and exchange once weekly. Book swap in the reception area a bit limited as most in foreign language but I managed to find a few in English. Three pools so always a sun bed available, we would go across the road to the althea suites and more often than not the pool was practically empty. Entertainment every night, karaoke Tuesday, music quiz and bingo etc. Talked with some people who had stayed nearby and our experience far exceeded theirs. My only criticism is not about the hotel but we got a taxi to platanias 28 euro going and 15 euro return which was daylight robbery so check prices before accepting taxi ride. Chania harbour lovely day and night so try both approx. 8/10 euros taxi form the althea. Lidl close by for any provisions you may need. Would recommend to anyone without hesitation if you want a low key, friendly, clean accommodation with a great food selection. All inclusive finishes at 11pm but we got a couple of drinks in and usually went in about midnight which suited us fine. Drinks are available after 11pm to purchase but its not a late late kind of complex.

author: 910philw
title: Fantastic all round hotel
text: Just come back from 2 weeks at this beautiful property. The service my family and I received was excellent especially when travelling with my 18 month old son. Everyone from the reception staff, waiting/bar staff, housekeeping staff and entertainers were really friendly and nothing was too much for them. We had a good choice of food, on occasion we struggled to find something but this was mainly down to us being fussy as we are not massive fish or pork eaters. The food quality was always very high. Rooms are to a very high standard. We stayed in a junior suite which was on the other side of the road from the main complex however it was not an issue. If you have a family the extra space the suites offer is very helpful. Pools were always highly maintained being cleaned daily and there was plenty of sun loungers available. With a number of new ones arriving whilst we were staying there that were stacked waiting to be used if needed. We even managed to get sun loungers in the middle of the day after going out for the morning. Hotel is in a good location on the edge of a small town with a selection of bars and restaurants close by if you fancy a change. The sandy beach was only 10-15 minutes walk away and was a easy to find. We hired a car so we could explore a bit further and Lake Kournas is definitely worth a visit. The team that really made our holiday was the SuneoClub Hosts, Charley, Mikaela and Liesa. They were so friendly and provided no pressure to join in activities however you knew you were more than welcome to join in with anything. They offered a wide range of activities throughout the day and the evening always with a smile on their faces. They were so good considering they had only been a team since the end of April. They have made me want to go back to this hotel more than anything! Overall this hotel has something for everyone and is highly recommended.

author: 713sheilav
title: A Little Bit of Cretan Paradise
text: Althea Village is a top notch holiday in every respect. We arrived late, along with 2 other hungry,weary travellers, the reception staff immediately took us to the restaurant to ensure we had supper before taking us to our rooms. Although it was almost closing time for the restaurant, there was still a wide choice of food, both hot and cold dishes - just what we needed after a very, very long day. Our apartment was fabulous, spacious and spotlessly clean overlooking one of the pools as well as a smashing view of the sea - which proved to be an easy 10 minute walk from Althea Village. The staff were warm, welcoming and so helpful, nothing was too much trouble for anyone. The apartment was cleaned regularly with fresh towels brought in 3 times during our 7 night stay. My sister and I wanted a peaceful rest in the sun and that is exactly what we got - we quickly realised that we overlooked the quieter pool where other holidaymakers were also looking for peace and sunshine. There is a bigger pool on the site which caters for everyone looking for daytime activities in the pool - holiday entertainers were on hand with music, fun and games in the larger pool for those who wanted it. Everyone clearly enjoyed themselves in that pool and, although it was noisy, we couldn't hear any of this on the other side where the quiet pool is situated. Superb and thoughtful design allowing everyone to find the holiday they are looking for in one place. All the meals were delicious, plenty of choice and I was delighted to find a wide range of dishes for vegetarians - we veggies are usually offered a chunk of bread and some goat's cheese, but the salads and vegetables on offer were superb and I was spoilt for choice. The staff across the whole village are utterly delightful, kind, chatty, helpful - even though they are coming to the end of a long season and must be exhausted, they kept going with a ready smile, nothing is too much trouble for them. A lovely bunch of people in a superb resort. The bar staff are amazing, make sure you try their hand made cocktails, they are lovingly created - a real work of art. A word of caution - their shots are delicious, but lethal!! Highly recommend this resort, whatever kind of holiday you are looking for, Althea will surely match your dreams.

author: aleksandrar982
title: Excellent holiday
text: The hotel is great, very modern, rooms look like they've been recently renovated. I've never met such an energetic animation team, with their charisma they could make anyone join the aqua fit. Unfortunately, I don't remember the girls name, but on Thursday evening's you can enjoy outstanding live music. Beautiful songs by a girl with amazing voice and accompanied by a great piano player. I wish there were more attractions like that. Everyone in the hotel is nice, at some point you just feel like you're surrounded with your friends. Even during breakfast the staff would smile to you and exchange a few sentences. When it comes to the food - it was fresh and tasty. Tzatziki and Gyros were my favourite. Great desserts too. The only thing I could point out to the management are waffles and pancakes for breakfast. There was only one member of staff making them, thus usually you had to wait in a queue to get them, which discouraged many people. Maybe you could have one more person doing them, to avoid the queues? The hotel is situated quite far from the sea, it's in the walking distance, but walking in that heat isn't something nice. However, the hotel has two great swimming pools, so if you're lazy like me - that's not a problem at all. What I highly recommend to everyone is to take a bus to Chania - the hotel is really close to the bus stop and the city, the tickets are cheap. All in all, I'd like to thank to all the people that make this hotel such a great place. I highly recommend it as this a perfect place to get some rest and forget about your problems and work ;)

author: Huddster
title: Wonderful
text: We arrived late as delayed so got to the hotel just when dinner was finishing around 21.30. Reception showed us to the restaurant before they checked us in so we could eat. Nikos showed us where everything was he was brilliant as were all the staff in the hotel nothing was ever to much trouble. The room was lovely and modern and was cleaned every day except Sundays. The entertainment crew were fantastic so friendly and funny loved them all. The location was perfect for us as we like to walk so the short walk to beach was ideal. The beach was lovely and the sea warm. We found the smaller coves a bit sandier as there were some pebbles on main stretch. The monastery in kolumbria was beautiful and €3.60 for 2 each way but worth the trip. Chania town was like a mini London very very busy but the old town was so pretty, we sat in the harbour for and hour it was lovely. the bus is €1.20 each way but we walked (I know mental). If you go to Crete you must do the Samaria gorge trip it is 16k walk and amazing! (Not for people who struggle with hip or knee) With iOS tours it is €35 for coach and an extra €15 for entrance to gorge and boat back to coach. The little village you end up in is very quaint. All in all I cannot fault anything about Althea Village or Crete had the best time!

author: bethv176
title: Wonderful hotel and a fantastic holiday
text: We went to Althea village mid october for two weeks with our 18 month old. The weather was great considering the time of year - i think we had one day in two weeks that it was too cold to go to the beach. The hotel was great. The staff were incredibly friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Their staff (particularly Stelios) were great and made great cocktails...not your usual all inclusive watered down drinks....these were good! The restaurant staff were lovely - really friendly and helpful, and like most greeks we have met, loved our little boy. The food i would say was good, not great, but could have varied it a bit more. We ate a lot of the same for two weeks - one night we had a lovely grilled fish and i looked forward to eating it again, except it never was on offer again. Rooms were big, and exceptionally clean and tidy. The hotel felt spacious and spread out with several pools, and lovely greenery everywhere so it felt like a greek village (as the name suggests). The entertainment staff were great - three girls who were cheerful, happy and helpful 24 hours a day it seemed. They kept us well entertained if we wanted, but were not in our faces to be involved which we liked. there is a nice kiddie play area and playroom which was good for our little one. Also a kiddie disco every couple of nights which the entertainment staff were great at. Would definitely return to this hotel and recommend highly for a great holiday.

author: loud326
title: Amazing hotel and wonderful holiday
text: We booked this holiday about 5 weeks before we travelled on 21.10.16 and had no idea that the day we departed was the last day of the season, 28.10.16!!! When we arrived we were given a free upgrade to the suites which are over the road with their own pool...WOW. They are a very good size for a family of 3 with a large balcony and nice furniture to relax on whilst our daughter slept. The hotel is finished to a very high standard and has been refurbished with a contemporary decor. The food was amazing. So much choice for breakfast, lunch and tea. We stayed for a week and the variety was brilliant. Even towards the end of our stay, with only 21 guests left in the hotel, the standards never slipped. Nikkos and his team are brilliant. I loved the fact that your adult all-inclusive band has a magnet in so you are able to help yourself to larger and wine!!! The choice of 3 different pools made our holiday feel. The pools were spotless with plenty of comfy sunbeds. Amber and Ebba were two energetic ladies who always made time to stop and chat to guests as well as putting 110% into all activities. My daughter loved them. Can't recommend this hotel enough, perfect for couples and families. You must get the local bus into Chania Old Town for a wonder.

author: CurlyChrissie
title: Lovely, relaxing holiday in October
text: I rarely do this kind of holiday - fly to a place, lie by the pool, fly home again, but I thoroughly enjoyed this holiday of pure relaxation staying at the Althea Village. The accommodation, pools & grounds were well maintained. We went all-inclusive and the food and facilities were very good. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, particularly the lovely Artemis and Niko in the restaurant. The animation team were always enthusiastic, always energetic, always friendly and always buzzing with activities to get you going. We absolutely loved the Greek Music entertainment on Monday night - they were excellent and it was a lovely way to complete our week in Crete (thank you). The hotel complex is a little outside the main resort and away from the beaches, up a step incline, but we never needed to go to the beach as the pools were very good and there were always sufficient beds in good positions. There was no need to creep out in the middle of the night to reserve the beds, we had our pick at 9:30. When we visited we noticed the majority of guests were Scandinavian, with few English guests. Despite this English is always spoken and is a Lingua Franca around the hotel In short; Althea Village is a lovely, relaxing hotel with very friendly staff and great food. If you're looking for party central or a swish, swanky hotel on the beach, this place is not for you. Sue, our Tui rep was very knowledgeable and extremely helpful. Thankfully there were no calamities requiring her assistance. We went to Chania town - which is well worth a visit. It is a lovely place. We also went to Knossos. It was a very informative day but I wouldn't do this trip in the height of summer as it was very hot in October. When we ventured down to the 3 beach coves, even in October they were very busy and cramped, which I was surprised at. There are facilities but we rather stayed at the hotel, near our rooms with refreshments literally on tap.

author: 805scottj
title: Perfect Getaway!
text: My partner and I stayed at the Althea for a week in early September and stayed in a standard double room. The room itself was a little small albeit comfortable. The balcony wasn't very big, however the bathroom was great with a good power shower. The hotel has a small community vibe which is great as you don't feel like just another guest. The hotel grounds are lovely and kept very well. The buildings are in great condition and very clean. We stayed on an all inclusive basis and a real highlight was that drinks were available as self service from around each of the three pools. Both soft drinks and alcohol were available like this and cocktails etc were still being served at the main bar. The restaurant was very clean and well staffed meaning it was a pleasant place to eat. As we stayed for one week the variety in the food was enough ranging from Sushi and Greek cuisine to freshly made pizza and pasta. The daytime entertainment was very good. The animation team made up of Ben, Ebba, Patrycja and Amber were very friendly and were not too pushy in getting guests involved in activities. Overall, couldn't rate the team high enough. There are three beaches very close to the hotel (about ten minutes walk away). If you're looking for a relaxing week away in the sun, this is definitely the place.

author: GalaziokaiLefko
title: I will return
text: Fantastic hotel in a fantastic location, located within walking distance of the beautiful Agioi Apostoloi beach. Spotlessly clean, the gardens and rooms are kept in immaculate condition. Three swimming pools to choose from with sun loungers in abundance. Close proximity to the beautiful town of Chania via the 21 or 15 bus routes that pick up 5 minutes from the hotel. However, what really makes this place is the wonderful staff who work at Althea; they are all so lovely and when you go back to Althea (I was a returning guest), it almost feels as if you are going to stay with family as there is a warm and welcoming feel to the place, a homely feel one might say. All the cleaning staff deserve credit for keeping the hotel in top condition working tirelessly and nonstop. Evi, Gogo, and Argiro on reception are all extremely pleasant and welcoming as they are always smiling, always willing to help, always willing to go that extra mile to cater for your needs and deal with any issues that you may have, they are an excellent first point of contact in the hotel as well as an excellent source of local information. Nikos the restaurant manager is an absolute asset to the hotel who works tirelessly every day; he's always on hand to greet guests, to seat them, to make them feel welcome, and generally oversee the running of the restaurant, a very pleasant man who does a fantastic job. Stelios and Dimitri at the bar are two top characters! Their personalities create a fantastic environment at the bar and they make brilliant drinks too!! Eirini in the restaurant is so friendly and polite to guests; like all the restaurant staff, she works tirelessly in ensuring the smooth running of the restaurant. Finally there is also the unforgettable Artemis! Another tireless worker with her vibrant and bubbly personality which lights up the restaurant! She is another asset to the hotel!! The hotel is excellent all round but I feel it is the staff who deserve a special mention; the Althea management should be given credit for employing excellent staff and I would recommend giving them pay rises because they are so good!!! They have a fantastic set of staff. All in all I would definitely recommend this hotel to anybody seeking a quiet and relaxing holiday. I am already making plans to return in the summer of 2017. Fantastic hotel.

author: Q8901EEpaule
title: Lovely Hotel And Staff
text: Stayed at the Althea Village Resort from 06/09/16 for one week and we have nothing but praise for the hotel and staff. After a bit of a "hiccup" at the start special praise goes to Gogo (10/10 ;)) the Reception Manager who went out of her way to correct this and more than made it up to us for the initial inconvenience. All the staff though were all very polite and within reason nothing seemed too much trouble for them. The hotel is set in lovely grounds that have well looked after olive trees (some very old) as well as other plants, trees, and shrubs. The grounds are also kept very clean with staff cleaning them from early in the morning. The hotel also has 3 swimming pools as well as children's areas in two of them. Our hotel room (suite) was very modern,clean and looked virtually brand new. It had good A/C, TV, hair dryer, and a fridge, as well as everything else you would expect. The food served in the Restaurant was very good (as also stated in other revues the owners eat there daily which is a good advertisement) with a good enough choice in our opinion to please everyone and if you order a packed lunch it comes in a cooler bag that you hand back on your return. Even though we didn't get involved with the day time entertainment all the entertainment staff were again very polite and still asked us if we wanted to join in without being too pushy. The hotel is located about 10-15mins walk to the beach (shorter if you go via the Sirius Village Hotel opposite and is sign posted) that is nice with crystal clear sea. A lot of the sun loungers are for the residence of the beachfront hotels but if you go to the far side (West) you can hire 2 beds and a umbrella for 5 Euros a day from The Blue Sea Restaurant. We really enjoyed our stay and somewhere where we would like to return. Paul + Jo. :)

author: Vimto82
title: Very nice Hotel
text: We stayed at the althea during May 2016, this was our first visit and we were impressed by the hotel. we were given a room at the Althea Suites which was very nice indeed but located on the opposite side of the road from the main complex. The rooms and all the areas of the hotel were very clean. and staff were always cleaning and maintaining the grounds throughout the day. We enjoyed the quite area of the hotel on the Suites side. Food was reasonable and plentiful, staff were Polite and welcoming and could not do enough for you. The manager was always present and made an effort to speak to as many guests as he could throughout the day. The Entertainment team Suneo Club worked very hard and were a friendly bunch, they were always working from early morning untill late evening and even when it rained they made the best of the situation and organised games in the bar area. A few minor niggles to note: *-the hotel does not provide Pool Towels *-Safe in the room has to be hired at an extra cost *-Air conditioner did not work in our room (however we preferred this) *-A lot of drinks (bottle water, orange juice, Freddo coffees) were not included in the all inclusive. One more note which was both a positive and a negative is that the hotel owners were Living at the hotel during our stay, Positive because they could ensure that everything was run to a good standard, negative: the Family took priority over paying hotel guests i did not mind this until I was asked to give up the table I was sat at the bar so that the 6 family members could sit there. The part that annoyed me more was they asked the bar staff to ask me!!!! when you consider the limited room at the bar I find it very inconsiderate that the family reseved a quarter of all seating for themselves every day. The hotel is in a nice area of the town just out of the town centre in a nice quite area but 5 minutes walk from the local bus stop (1.20 euro to the centre). Overall we really enjoyed our two week stay here and would definately return if we have the opportunity. All we would suggest is for a Second bar to be considered for the Suites part of the Hotel so that you don't have to walk across the road to the main hotel in order to enjoy some comapny and a drink.

author: mandym285
title: I'd come back....
text: Lovely hotel. ..rooms are very clean and the whole site is impressively clean. Staff are welcoming and friendly. ..especially the bar staff. Animation team are great fun and full of energy... Althea Village is about 10 min walk to the beach but the pools are just as lovely. The only downfall is if you are a fussy eater... menu is limited... lots of meat on the bone which I don't like .. and my friend doesn't eat pork.. everything has ham bits or bacon bits in. Our air conditioning in our room has been broken since Friday. .. and we are still waiting for it to be fixed..so difficult to sleep at night. However I would still come back... even though we've lived on chips and salad.... 😃Chania harbour is well worth a visit costs 10 Euros in a taxi ..

author: garethp898
title: Superb AI seven days.
text: Superb AI seven days for a couple. Accommodation 10/10 We had one of the newer rooms. Cleaned everyday and did a excellent job of it. Staff 10/10 All very friendly and helpful. Food 8/10 Quality was good with a hint of repetition in the seven days. Drinks 8/10 Soft and alcohol: generally all good, a good selection of spirits and drinkable wines and beers for AI. Pool 9/10 Clean with decent deep ends. The largest pool away from bar was generally noise free. Overall 10/10 Nothing to complain about. Lovely atmosphere. The beach is approx 30 mins walk. 10% Other. 10% Brits. 15% German. 15% Belgium. 50% Scandinavian / Dutch / Polish.

author: spaghetti86
title: First visit to Crete experience
text: My mum and I booked this hotel via Thomson due to the location (of family near by), free parking and free wifi. I would not normally pay £550+ per person for somewhere this far from the beach, with not much in way of views and with limited food options. I don't think they should call themselves a "Village" hotel when there is only one place to eat for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The snacks are very greasy rolls served in a room to the side of the main bar where children are let loose to pick and handle whatever they want. Not high on hygiene standards in my opinion. Ice cream is only served 12.30 - 2.30 which as someone else said, is during lunch, so not really the time you would want it. And a very limited time at that. It was quite apparent that they are new to being all inclusive as they have a lot of things still to work on. We had a junior suite which was over the road from the main hotel, this was nice, we were on the second floor so no noisy footsteps above us. Very fast wifi as the box is in your room behind the tv. Lovely walk in shower and fair amount of wardrobe space. Being that we were not a couple I got lumped with the sofa bed for the 7 nights and my mum had the queen size. It would be good if they had a few rooms, with two queen beds in them (they are capable to support another bed size wise), so that when people aren't in couples, they can both have a comfy bed. Food wise, I really struggled to find anything that wasnt dripping in oil (yes I know this is the land of olive oil, but sometimes it would be nice to let people leave it and add it themselves!) and the menu's with the half English translation made it quite hard most of the time to work out what was in each dish. I stuck to chip butties the majority of the time! There was not a lot of English folk here at all which was strange to say the least, everywhere else i have been there is always a fair amount of Brits, but not here. Maybe that is why no one (staff and customers) really bothered to try and say hello or speak to eachother as they had no idea what nationality you where??! With the exception of the little shop in the middle of the complex, the ladies working in there were always friendly and welcoming. Overall my Mum and I would not stay here again, it just didn't tick enough boxes for the price paid.

author: E11hoop
title: A thoroughly enjoyable holiday
text: My Wife, toddler and l have all just returned from a hugely memorable 10-day trip to the Althea Village Hotel. Memorable for all the right reasons. I would like to give credit to the staff as they work tirelessly around the clock to ensure that our stay at the hotel was a happy one. Nikos the owner never stops morning, noon and night. As it was our anniversary, he arranged for a bottle of chilled champagne and fruit waiting for us in our room. He also arranged for a beautifully hand crafted cake presented to us at our table. Additionally, the restaurant staff as well as the staff at reception especially Ioanna were wonderful. So often the food becomes quite predictable at hotels but this hotel is an exception. The food definitely varied. The animation team led by the delightful Leonie were absolutely brilliant in keeping all of us entertained. Rob the rep also always had a smile on his face and we booked a couple of excursions with him which were both fabulous. The hotel room itself had very efficient air con, a TV, a walk in shower, a balcony and a chargeable safe. Also they have free wi-fi. The complex has 3 pools in total plus 2 baby pools. The hotel was a melting pot of different nationalities mainly Scandinavians, Dutch, French and English. I usually keep myself to myself but I made good friends especially with a couple from Norway. Overall, I would absolutely have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to others and actually on this rare occasion, I fully intend on returning next year. Now it's time to detox!

author: SuzanneQJ
title: Fabulous all-inclusive hotel
text: We had a fabulous relaxing time at Althea. The service was excellent. The restaurant and bar staff were extremely efficient, so too was the daily (not Sunday) maid service. The food was tasty and there is a very good variety of different foods available. Hats off to the chefs!! The room was attractive, clean and modern with efficient air conditioning. The entertainment from the Suneo team was just right for us. We took part in aqua aerobics and darts and enjoyed the evening entertainment. (We are still laughing over the sketch 'dinner for one' now we are home!) The location of the hotel is ok. There is not lots on your doorstep but it is an easy bus/taxi ride into Chania. We went with Thomson and they are also super. Our rep Rob was so easy to talk to and he had a wealth of information. We booked two trips which were quite long days but very enjoyable. Our tour guide to Knossos Palace was a wonder, she was so very knowledgeable. We had an extremely memorable holiday and staying at Althea as an all-inclusive guest gave us the freedom to enjoy and relax.

author: MsRiley
title: Loved it.
text: Just back from a week at Althea Village - we were 4 "mature" women friends, sharing a two bed duplex apartment. We had a great holiday and would highly recommend, but accept that it might not be for everyone depending on what's important to you. We loved the comfortable beds, efficient modern showers,free air con (although we didn't use it) decent fridge, hot plate ( no kettle) for making tea in the morning, lovely roof terrace/balcony. The apartment was cleaned everyday to a very high standard, and towels changed every two days. All of the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful. We were B and B only and the breakfast options were great, hot and cold buffet, plenty of choice. The hotel complex was beautifully landscaped and maintained, two spotless pools, gardens full of flowers couldn't fault it. If you are looking for organised activities, kids clubs, evening entertainment it's not the right place for you, however I'd happily take my grandkids here for a relaxed family holiday. Our fellow guests were mostly from Scandinavian countries and EasternEurope (Poland, Russia) which was fine but attitudes to smoking are not what we are used to in the UK so lots of lighting up around the pools and in the outside dining area, something to be aware of, though easy enough choose space away from the smokers. The location of the hotel was perfect for us, 10-15 minutes walk to the Iguana Beach, maybe more like 15-20 mins on the way back, but it was a nice walk, down a narrow path opposite the back of the complex, passing gardens full of flowers, fruit and veg, chickens rabbits and goats.iIf you want to be right on the beach, Althea Village is not the place for you. Lots of eating and drinking places on the beaches. Iguana Beach is lovely - spotless WCs ( a work of art, you have to see them) free kids toys, books and magazines, table tennis etc, and snorkelling equipment for hire, also loungers,umbrellas and a small cafe selling drinks and icecream. 10-15 minutes walk to Lidl and a Greek Supermarket whose name I can't remember, but Mamas mini market close to the back of the hotel sells beach stuff, beer and wine and basics. If you turn right out of the front entrance, it's a 10 minute walk uphill to the old village, walk through the village for great views over the surrounding countryside and there is a pretty little traditional church at the top of the hill. The village taverna, Nikos, is fabulous, freshly cooked Cretan food, very good prices, very friendly traditional vibe. Five minutes from the hotel, Dimitris restaurant is also highly recommended. Mamas sells bus tickets, 1.10 Euro to Chania town, taxi fare 8 Euro, well worth a visit.

author: Frogletsmum
title: Mostly good
text: This hotel is family run in a suburb of Chania, so it's not totally in a resort. The beach is about 10-15 mins walk away and is a pleasant sandy beach in a bay. There are another two beaches close by, equally nice. The rooms are quite basic, could do with updating but very clean. Shower is modern and works well. I went half board which gave me choices at lunchtime. There are loads of tavernas and bakers nearby for food. Being in a suburb there are big supermarkets (Lidl and a Greek chain) within 10 mins as well as the usual mini markets.The food generally was ok but aimed firmly at the Scandinavian and north east Europeans who make up the bulk of the guests. They didn't seem to mix well with other nationalities. There was a good choice of food, but it was never more than Luke warm and full of carbs.if you want hot food you need to get there early! The staff were friendly and helpful. There was an incident at the hotel shortly after I arrived which clearly showed the staff have no first aid training, and the safety equipment around the pool is minimal. There are two pools which were kept spotless as we're all public areas. Unfortunately the hotel is sandwiched between two busy roads, so there is constant noise ( not the hotels fault) . Overall this was a pleasant place to stay and would go there again.

author: ziggy66_11
title: Fantastic time..
