I get that staff are limited to what they can say, but they can quietly say to these kids "We do not allow running" and for obvious reasons as tables were full of travellers who would also like to enjoy their breakfast. I found a distaste towards the hotel clerk who did the checkout, she dropped the ball entirely and totally missed the point I was trying to make. Listening a little closer might have been in her best interests as I am the one paying the hotel bill. My suggestion to her was that they have a hotel person operate the waffle makers and even so much as offering waffles on the buffet with other hot items. This would be a far sight better than having ten year olds go wild and really creating messes that make it unpleasant for others. Even with a reduced rate, the hotel was still pricey and I think they try to set this off by offering the free breakfast which was just like a cattle call, get them watered, fed and shipped out..........

author: 137neils
title: Family weekend getaway in summer
text: We loved this hotel and have found a new gem for Okanagan family getaways. We definitely would come back again. The hotel was well run and has high attention to every detail. We enjoyed our 1 bedroom queen bed suite with sofa bed and kitchenette in the courtyard on ground floor. We could just walk right across the courtyard grass to the pool or breakfast area. The room was comfortable, modern, clean and everything worked in it and nothing was old or terribly used. Our bed was very comfy but we would have liked a king size bed. The sofa bed was the best my kids have ever slept on. The living area was a good size and we liked the fact the A/C was awesome kept both the living room and bedroom cool in the hot weather. Housekeeping was excellent and did almost a full clean every day, not half rate like some other hotels. They also vacuumed and mopped the floor and washed some dishes. A lot of motels/hotels only clean the sink area, change towels, and make the bed. Our family really enjoyed the pool and liked the fact the side glass opened up so you could lie in the sun and watch the kids in the pool. The hot breakfast in the morning was good also. We also received prompt and helpful caring service from housekeeping/maintenance staff when we got locked out of our room by going out the sliding back door and leaving the deadbolt on the front door in the morning. I am a very discerning customer but could find no issues/concerns with this hotel. I really like the Best Western brand as I always seem to leave satisfied and feel I received good value for money. Our kitchenette did not have a dishwasher or stove and this is the only issue I had. I noticed a larger suite had a stove, not sure about a dishwasher though. Again, very well run with high attention to detail and excellent customer service.

author: CaseyyM
title: More than what I expected
text: I read a review once and saw pictures of Best Western hotel. I didn't like what I saw and read so I usually stay cleared of BW. But that changed this year. Not all of them are as bad as I thought. This is my 2nd time I stayed with them and it's perfect. Everything is clean. The washroom is lovely, from the tiles, the heated towel rack to the soaps. The pillows and blankets are perfect! It's just right and soft to the skin. I had to check what brand it is. The best part is their complimentary breakfast. Prior to this one we came from BW from Canmore and loved that there's good breakfast included. On our way back to Vancouver we thought about staying in Kelowna. First thing I looked was BW! It will always be our first choice now. Keep it up!

author: BegumRegan
title: There is a lot to like about this hotel
text: I wanted to like this hotel, and it isn't hard to find nice tings to say about it. It has a central location and is easy to access. The adjacent restaurant and pub were excellent. The bed was comfortable and the room spacious. However it had three serious flaws. Because we spent very little time at the hotel I didn't pursue another room, but I would have if I had spent more time there. First, the room had a distinctly unpleasant odor. It gave me a headache and made my sinuses run. I notified the management, so I hope they do something about it in the future. Second, don't go for room 131. Open the curtains and you see a blank wall. You can go outside and walk around it to be in the garden, but while in the room? Concrete. It's about the most unattractive view I've ever seen from a hotel room. Finally the fan on the HVAC was very loud so we had to turn it off at night. It came on again each morning about 6:15 so I had to get up, turn on the light and figure out how to shut it off again. The next night we stayed in a hotel where the HVAC was barely audible, so I know it is possible to have a quiet room.

author: 11rickya
title: One night in Kelowna was good
text: We arrived at the Best Western in Kelowna on May 30. The hotel entrance was a little bit of a search. Checkin was good and the room was also more than comfortable. Room was big and was on the 7th floor. To be exact room 722 and was overlooking the road and a store area. The only thing that we mist in the room was a safe. In the neighborhood you had some restaurants like the cactus, montana's etc. and also wallmart. It's a view minutes drive to the wineries. We visited the mission hill winery on our way to the best western and that was well worth. The hotel has a small gym, that has some treadmilles and some other equipment. We could do with it. The breakfast was okay. They had off course coffee, thee, bagels, brown bread and waffels, egg etc. Overal experience of this hotel was good.

author: victoriabadge
title: So Relaxing!
text: My boyfriend and I had taken a trip out to Abbotsford for a cousins wedding this past fall and on our way back decided to swing by Kelowna for a few days and spend some quality, relaxing time together. We were new to the Kelowna area and were unsure of where to stay but after some digging online, decided that the Best Western Plus was a good fit for us price-wise, location-wise, and for the type of room we were looking for. I have to say that we were definitely not disappointed! The room was absolutely stunning! We had a king bed, small kitchenette and balcony (granted the balcony overlooked a parking lot but it wasn't an issue for us). Because we were staying for several days, the kitchenette was extremely beneficial for us and we got great use out of it. It even included some dishes, utensils, glassware, etc! The bathroom was beautiful and the vanity was perfect for me to do my makeup and hair every morning. We used the hot tub every night we were there and enjoyed every second of it. Most nights we ended up having one of the two hot tubs completely to ourselves which was extremely nice. The hot, complimentary breakfast was to die for! We skipped the first morning we were there because we were not aware of how big of a spread there was. However the next morning we were very hungry and decided to try it and we did not hesitate to go back every remaining morning on our stay. The hotel was very quiet, clean, and extremely comfortable and relaxing. Would definitely stay here again if we should find ourselves back in Kelowna!!

author: TM11_Travels
title: Outstanding!
text: We stayed in the tower with an amazing view that overlooked the beautiful courtyard, the city and it even had a view of the lake! All the staff were friendly, from reception at check-in, to the housekeeping and breakfast staff... we were always greeted with friendly smiles and hellos. The breakfast... I thought we could expect a continental, but we were really surprised to see a breakfast buffet with waffles, eggs, omelettes, sausages, and more! We had a few business meetings while we were there, and were happy to have plenty of areas to have a seated meeting in the atrium and outside in the courtyard. The pub and restaurant next door was nice to have great food, service... all within steps from our room. There was no highway noise from our room, it was quiet and the bed was very comfortable. They go the distance with many 'little' touches that make staying here special. Just one of them is seeing huge murals of outdoor locations in the elevators that made me want to explore! Another was having "non-resin" patio chairs/table... it felt upscale and was a nice experience to sit on the patio. They care about your experience at this hotel, and it shows. We'll be staying here again and again!

author: 514Lorraine
title: Excellent Anniversary Night
text: We decided to get a suite at the Best Western for our Anniversary. We booked ahead and my husband told them it was our anniversary. Upon our arrival the front counter staff were pleasant and one even sang a song to wish us Happy Anniversary. They told us we had a little something in our fridge in our room as well. They were chocolate covered strawberries(6) and Rocher chocolates and a card from the staff. WOW. We went to the Italian Table for antipasto at 2pm in the afternoon and Wednesday Wine day which wine is on for a great rate all day. Service was very good with Kyle and told us all about the wine. Then for supper we had the awesome Caesar Salad with fried anchovies. It was absolutely delicious. Our main course was their spaghetti and meatball which had incredible taste to it. Everything was perfect! Our wine bottle was discounted once again. The outside hottubs(2) at the Best Western are incredible looking out to the sky and the room and bed was comfy. The free buffet breakfast in the morning has everything! Newspapers are free.

author: WhiteRockFamily
title: Recommended!
text: Great rates on their own website, clean and we'll accommodated. Friendly staff. Terrible pillows, if you are particular or have neck issues definitely bring your own, even for a short stay. Suite has one bedroom, one bathroom, full fridge, 2 burners plus pots and such, and a pull out couch. 2 TV's if you are interested but no in room movies. Get one facing the courtyard. Pool was nice, kids enjoyed. Free breaky is decent/standard but enough to fill the belly. Location is away from the lake so it's quiet. Safeway, Subway, TacoTime right across the street! We ordered a couple of "bellinis " from room service and were delivered two prosecos with peach flavoring - NOT what was described on the in room menu at all. Disappointed. Glad we didn't order anything else since descriptions were false. We would stay here again, definitely. Good family style hotel.

author: GaryW342
title: Championship Golf Package is a winner
text: If you want a no hassle route to a few days of golfing in the Okanagan, look no further. As in previous years, our group of 8 chose a 3 day Championship package - The Bear, Predator Ridge, and Gallagher's Canyon. We really like the hotel as a base. Great touch to be given a sleeve of golf balls when checking in. With morning tee times, having a hot buffet breakfast readily available at 6:30am is a great way to start the day. The DIY waffle maker is a treat. When we return in the afternoon, the pool and hot tub are great amenities. Also having Golf Town nearby is convenient, maybe too convenient....! Within walking distance are a lot of restaurants designed for hungry golfing groups (Cactus Club, Milestones, Montana's, Boston Pizza, Keg, even a White Spot if you're so inclined). On our last day we picked an early 7:30 tee time to give us more time to leisurely drive back to Vancouver. While the hot food doesn't come out til 6:30, everything else was available. One less thing to worry about. We checked out and settled our bills the night before with no problems or issues. One precaution: By the main door is a Do Not Disturb/Housekeeping required panel. I clicked Do Not Disturb on the first night but inadvertently didn't change it before leaving the next morning. Consequently the room was not made up. However, a quick call to the front desk remedied the situation and fresh towels were delivered. Thanks! The big lawn in the middle cries out for action. The next time we will bring bocce balls.

author: jessicap802
title: our 4th visit to this hotel
text: There is a reason we keep coming back here. This hotel has never let us down. Check in was busy and we had to wait for our room to be cleaned, but we were early so that was fine. Even though the line up was long, the girls at the front desk were kind and let us all know that we would be looked after asap. As usual, we stayed on the second floor facing the highway. We seem to have the same lady (candis) clean our room every visit. And she remembers us, which is nice considiering how many people must stay there. She asks us what we want and what time etc. She had a man working with her (mark) and he was so kind as well. Breakfast was great. Their sausages and eggs were yummy. Breakfast staff wasnt as kind as we would have hoped. But they were very very busy. Overall stay was fantastic as usual. We love this hotel and will never stay anywhere else. The rooms are immaculate and i can not say enough good things about that front desk staff. Well done, BW Kelowna

author: Jadzo
title: Good location, good hygiene and good room service.
text: I went there with my wife and son on the Canada Day long week-end for our first time in Kelowna - driving from Vancouver. I didn't' pay for our stay since i got it through "Airmiles" because there are partners.. so I advise Airmiles members to check this one out. The check in was easy and fast. The rooms are clean and properly air-conditioned/ventilated. The location is very good: you have several restaurants around in the surrounding blocks and their's a supermarket (Safeway) across the highway. 10 minutes ride by car and you'll be in downtown Kelowna on the waterfront. The Orchard Mall is a few blocks away too. Our personal experience with the breakfast, which is complimentary, wasn't too positive. We weren't impressed honestly by the quality of the food. I know this is not a 5 starts chain hotel, but i think they could serve better breakfast. Moreover, the tables are relatively few relative to the number of the room. During our 3 days stay we had to wait for minutes trying to locate a table to sit with our toddler. The fact that the swimming pool is indoors is good because it was cloudy and windy for 2 days during our stay, and very sunny for the 2 more days. So swimming indoors with a toddler was good and easy. My only comment on the pool is that the water should be changed more often. I'm not sure if it has something to do with the fact that they are environmentally-friend, but i think that the swimming experience would be more enjoyable if the water was clearer!

author: Walshcooks
title: Clean and Cool
text: This Best Western is kept very clean. I was given a King suite, which meant I received a King bed in a separate bedroom. Included in this room was two night stands, a bureau, one chair, a luggage rack, TV. It's not a huge room, but enough to move around. It also had it's own air conditioning unit in the bedroom, which was welcome in the 30C heat. The bathroom was clean and pretty typical of most hotels, although I do find the counter to be getting higher (or perhaps I'm shrinking?). The living area consisted of a couch, two chairs (one with ottoman), a small kitchenette (sink, microwave, small fridge, coffee maker and tea kettle), a bureau with TV on top, and a small patio. This room too had its own air conditioning unit. The room was quite dark, but lamps were abundant. Wifi was free and with excellent service. The patio is really very tiny, just enough room for two chairs and a cocktail table. There is a central courtyard area which has a nice large patch of grass where some guests sprawled out on towels. There is a separate fenced off area with covered swimming pool surrounded by deck chairs. The common area is spacious and serves a complimentary breakfast buffet for guests of the hotel. Ample free parking surrounds the building. This building is right on Highway 97 (Harvey Avenue) in Kelowna. Although only a short drive to the lake and all its lake activities, there is not much surrounding the hotel other than an Esso station, Home Depot, Golf Town, and other regular box stores. There is an attached Italian restaurant and a bar that seemed to have a number of people coming and going. This is one of the nicest Best Westerns I've stayed at and would highly recommend it if staying in the Kelowna area.

author: jessicap802
title: Fantastic
text: Breakfast was busy when we were there, but seating was abundant. This hotel is very well run. From the front desk to the housekeeping lady. My husband and i stayed on the second floor, room 218. On the second day of our stay, we had left our room for a couple hours. The lady cleaned our room to excellent standards. We returned and realized our own towel from home was gone. The lady (Candis) was so appologetic, saying maybe when she cleaned the room, it went down to the laundry. She was gone for 15 minutes looking for that towel and didnt come back until she had located it. It had been laundered for us, and nice and warm. Wonderful service, Candis, thank you so much. Cant say enough about those beds. Soft, warm, bedding so classy. breakfast above and beyond. This place is well above the rest weve ever stayed at., Thank you guys so much, will definately be back

author: I3734VYjenniferc
title: Quick Business Trip to the Interior
text: Speedy check-in service. The layout of the hotel was easy. Getting to the hotel was a bit tricky as you cannot directly enter it off highway 97 if you are heading east. So keep that in mind when booking this hotel! Room was very spacious and clean. I did notice a leak in my closet in the ceiling. It was quite severe. I called front desk and they immediately sent someone to take a look at it. Apparently something in the air conditioner was leaking, but after he came to take a look, he fixed it and it stopped leaking. The maintenance guy was very nice, and he even suggested a few places for me and my boyfriend to eat at while we were there. Great staff! The complimentary breakfast is one of the best all round breakfasts I've had in a while. Hot foods were hot and cold foods were cold. Coffee wasn't the best but it was drinkable. Check out was smooth, no issues and the morning staff were friendly.

author: CTParks
title: Breakfast Great: Not enough to trump disappointments
text: Went to Kelowna for hockey and chose this hotel for breakfast and the pool and hot tubs. The room was quite nice. The bedding comfortable and the amenities supplied for the bathroom were excellent. The refrigerator was the smallest I've ever had in a hotel room. The breakfast was one of the best that I've experienced. Multiple hot items, breads, cereals, fruit and more. The breakfast alone made the stay for me and makes the property very hard for me to give an overall rating. As stated above, I chose this location for the indoor pool and hot tub. First, I didn't realize the hot tubs were outdoor. This in and of itself was not a problem but a disappointment. The further issue with the hot tubs (and they have two) is that the jets had power equal to 1 on a 10 scale. Also the water levels seemed very low to me. They were warm... that I'll give them. So if the breakfast equals out the hot tubs and the room comfort equals out the tiny fridge - why only average? Well the final tipping of the scale is from our room we had to walk outside the hotel to get to the breakfast area. Thankfully it wasn't raining or snowing. If you don't care about hot tubs or refrigerators, then this is a wonderful hotel... I just can't give it greater than an average rating.

author: BrianArabsky
title: More Than You Pay For
text: After multiple visits to Kelowna for several sporting events (ball tournament this time) we were totally impressed by the BW. We attended with a group of about 40 and were treated with great service. Rooms: Above average size and spotlessly clean and modern. The facade looks like an older hotel (which it is), but the interior is upscale and nicely finished. Beds are super comfortable with lots of nice pillows. HD TV's as well as a small fridge were a nice touch. Breakfast: Great large open area to enjoy an above par breakfast. Slightly different every day, but your standard stuff like eggs (scrambled and hard boiled), bacon, bagels, toast, cereal and a small assortment of fruit. Lots of coffee and juices. Service: Above and beyond the call. Great "can do" attitude and very helpful. We used the Atrium breakfast area for team get togethers throughout the weekend which was very helpful. Staff should be highly praised. Overall: Maybe not top shelf like the Grand Okanagan or The Cove, but is probably 1/2 the price and not far off in terms of rooms. Way better than many of the other name brand hotels (especially the Sandman which is dark and dreary with claustrophobic rooms). This is ideal for teams in a great location close to tons of restaurants. I always have my eye on my pocketbook, and this BW offers exceptional value for the money. We will definitely visit again on our next trip to Kelowna for hockey this fall. A+++

author: PAMMYMAT
title: Wow! Will Always Stay Here!
text: This place was fantastic! I find the Best Western chains are great. Our room was a suite and it was amazing. Large entryway, separate sink in bedroom and large area with pull-out couch in a fairly decent sized room. There was a small counter, cupboards with a few dishes, microwave and small fridge. There is nothing worse than staying in a room (a suite especially) with no fridge. The room was brand new inside and very clean. We looked out on to the parking lot which was not a big deal. A room facing the courtyard would be nicer. We were in the north building Room 260. The restaurant just across the lobby was great. Yummy dinner. The swimming pool was a nice size and was located indoors, but with walls that opened up. The breakfast was great and the room was very large and comfortable. The best room we had on our trip to B.C. We were sad it was only for one night!

author: hiplainsdrifters
title: I was pleasantly surprised
text: I booked this place sight unseen. It was my first stay in Kelowna so I had no idea what to expect but I do like the Best Western chain. I am not a fan of the big cement looking tower hotels in cities (they are usually the old dumps) so as soon as I arrived I was concerned. Not that it looked horrible or anything but I asked the reception how old the place was. They were not sure but they assured me it was renovated regularly. I went ahead and checked in and went up to my room in the tower on the 7th floor. Not only was my room up to date, it was really nice, up to date and spotless. You can tell they are not cheap when they renovate. I could not find one single flaw and I am quite picky. If you stay in a room for a few days and look around a bit you can find flaws, not in this case. The view was very nice and it was super quiet in my room. The reception was very nice and professional (although I came in one night at about 1130 pm and the receptionist guy was on the phone having a super loud and argument sounding conversation that seemed work/shift related). Buffet breakfast was good but I wish they had just regular scrambled or fried eggs. Not everybody wants meat and cheese mixed into their eggs. I will definitely stay here again

author: Chellei58
title: The best place to stay in Kelowna!
text: We have stayed at this Best Western for years now, starting back before 2000. I have to say that the rooms are big, very clean and so comfortable. The bedding is to die for and the rooms and view are so quiet. They have wonderful rooms in the tower, with decks and have a beautiful view and a jacuzzi that looks out over the city. Floor to ceiling , wall to wall windows so while relaxing in the jaccuiz you can have the curtains open and gaze out at the city lights, and in the morning look out over the city and see Lake Okanagan in the distance. The staff is so fanatistic and I don't think I have had staff that is so caring and nice any where else as the folks who work here. I can't say enough about them. I would like to add that we have also stayed in the regular rooms and they too are large and have little kitchenettes, with a fridge and coffee machines. All the rooms have ironing boards, laundry services. They have a wonderful buffet like breakfast that is included with each night stay. I can't say enough about this Best Western. I am so greatful for finding this hotel many years ago. And when I was there for medical issues and surguries we had the the disable room which was so nice. And the staff went out of my way to make me feel as comfortable as possible. Last year I lost both my mother and father and they gave us the tower room with the jacuzzi at a bearevement rate, they had put flowers in our room, gave 2 bottles of wine and room service all one their own and everyone at the desk came forth giving me hugs and asked every day if there was anything else that they could do to make me feel better. Sincere and so conciderate, they actually make you feel like you are walking into a a family members home. Try it, I know you will love it!! It is just 1st class all the way!

author: 119JohnD119
title: Would stay here again...
text: Service at check in was very good. The rooms are nice and comfortable. Great for business trips. There's no running out of AC outlets. Some hotels lack the business amenities. Not this hotel. Room was very comfortable and up to date. Would definitely stay here again. The restaurant is not a place I can recommend. When we walked in, there were 4 staff members standing and talking. Not really doing much but having a powwow. The breakfast buffet is pretty sad. I should have taken pictures for this review. Not worth it. I would order off of the menu..

author: DavenGVAR
title: Fabulous Stay, Loved the Eco-Friendliness
text: Hotel: Staff was very friendly and considerate. Breakfast staff were always willing to please and awake at 7:00 a.m. Front desk staff had a good sense of humor. Check-in and check-out were quick and there were no surprises on the bill. The hotel advertises itself as eco-friendly, which was a plus with me (solar panels, recycling, energy efficient lighting, etc.). The newspaper available was The Globe and Mail, which I personally enjoyed reading every morning. Location: My GPS did not know how to find the hotel based on its Hwy 97 North address (GPSes can be fickle with how these sorts of addresses are entered), but Hwy 97, AKA Harvey Avenue, is the main artery of Kelowna - it's huge and there are lots of commercial buildings on it, so it's kind of hard to miss. The hotel is several stories tall, which helps it stand out. It is located near many restaurants and is a 20 minute drive or so to Downtown Kelowna. Room: My bed was very comfortable. I used the slippers and bathrobe all the time. Everything was clean; no mold or mildew. The TV was nice and there were no issues with the minifridge. I think internet was free, and while it was slow sometimes, it worked for the most part. I never heard noise from the other rooms. My one complaint was the shower flow was weak, but hey, the low-flow showerhead was part of their green initiatives so it's for a good reason. Breakfast: There was no variety in day-to-day (the offerings were always the same), but there were several foods offered: Various types of toasts and pastries, cookies (yes, for breakfast), scrambled eggs, pork bacon, pork sausage, home fries, omelet station, cereals, juice, milk, coffee, tea. Hot tub: More like cold tub :-( Only real complaint about my stay. I was very satisfied with my stay and would return.

author: Rainmanfor3
title: Terrific Time!
text: I brought my 3 daughters with me for one June evening. Check in was quick and friendly. The room was clean and beds were comfortable. We stayed in the Tower and was very pleased. I frequently stay at the Best Western, mostly in New Brunswick locations. I wasn't disappointed. I find in the last three to five years, Best Western hotels have upgraded and the hotels are affordable and modern. We used the pool, which was large and clean. I believe they use a salt water system which is a nice change from chlorine. We were the only ones in the pool so the kids loved it. We had a great sleep and took advantage of the free breakfast. Their breakfast was served in an actual restaurant with top notch food. Most Best Westerns have a small room with basic continental breakfast (cereal, toast, muffins). This one had pretty much everything you could ask for. Was a great treat! I would recommend staying here. Close to the mall and other shopping areas. Not too far from the airport. Highly recommended.

author: alanaarnold
title: We will definitely be back!!!
text: The reason we chose this hotel in large part was because of the reviews we read. I hope this review will help others make their decision as we had a wonderful stay here. We still have one nightl eft, but I felt it was very important to let the entire staff know what a great stay we had. Starting off at the front desk, Gardeen is an amazing lady. She is extremely friendly, accommodating, helpful, and definitely goes above and beyond for the guests! David, who I noticed is a trainee by his name tag, has also been all of the same! The housekeeping staff get the rooms done relatively early, which we liked because when we came back to the room to escape the sun, everything was clean and fresh! The breakfast buffet that is included was a typical breakfast, but the kids loved it and ate well every morning. The pool area has lots of seating for both morning, afternoon and early evening sun. The only issue here is the pool is relatively small without and slides or diving boards, but again, the kids made their own fun, and went back everyday for at least 4 hours! And finally, the rooms. We stayed in a deluxe queen which has 2 queen beds, a good sized balcony, bathroom with seperate sink outside of it, and a seperate counter with sink and drawers. One more to mention is the 2 bbq's in the courtyard area. On 2 evenings we bought groceries at the grocery store across the street and bbq'ed supper and ate at the tables outside. Once again, thanks to all the staff here at the Best Western Plus for providing such a positive experience for our family. We will be sure to stay here next year when we are back. A great trip for our first time in Kelowna!!! Thanks again, from room 211!!!

author: Denlight
title: Had a great stay.
text: I decided to travel to Kelowna on a last minute trip and needed a room for the Thursday and Friday night of the July 1 long weekend. I was having a lot of trouble finding accommodations and hotels seemed really expensive, even for the most modest places. I liked the look of this hotel and read the reviews, and I was lucky enough to get a room. It turned out to be the decision that made my mini-vacation. The room was facing into the courtyard, just near the pool and hot tubs. The room came with complementary breakfast. It wasn't just a pastry and juice either, a hot buffet, along with an omelet station made a great start to the day. Another seemingly small thing that made a big difference was the availability of coffee and tea in the lobby all day. The tea selection was really nice, too. The room was very comfortable with a big flat screen tv. I also had a chance to go to the spa that is at the hotel, with a friend of mine and really enjoyed it. The prices were reasonable there also. Service was great with both front desk and room service staff being pleasant and attentive. To be honest, although I was in Kelowna to attend a family function, I wished that I had more time to spend at the hotel! There was free parking also, and easy access to downtown. I was going to rent a car for the couple of days that I was in Kelowna, but ended up just taking a cab a couple of times to get around. Cheaper and more relaxing for me. I will definitely stay here again.

author: aleanef
title: Will not return
text: Me and my friends had a very unfortunate experiance at this hotel. There was a fire alarm issue in which kids pulled the alarm and uniformed staff took far too long to respond to the issue. At one point they even asked us (guests) what to do about the situation. Nobody was evacuated and there was a general attitude of cunfusion from all staff. Of the two hot tubs available - 1 was out of order and the other was tepid at best. The steam room was also out of order and the pool was occupied by swim lessions for 3 hours during which we (paying customers) were unable to use the pool. Upon bringing this to the attention of a manager the next day we were told we should have just used it anyways despite all the parents watching there kids take their swimming lession and pretty much occupying the whole area. The front dest staff was incompetant in general. Two people who stood out, the one who was confused during the fire alarm and Matt. As for the confused boy, he was forgivable because despite everything, he was sweet and helpful. Matt however, was a nightmere. Despite many attempts to engage in polite conversation and ask questions, he was rude and unhelpful. I could write pages on him alone. Now I will wrap up this review with the aknowledgement that we did speak to a manager the next day about our concerns but he was far from helpful. Though he listened, he made excuses about all the situations. We know there was a reason for these problems, we just think they should have been handled better. We were never truely apologized to, and were offered a paltry upgrade for our next stay which will not happen. The breakfast was acceptable but it took us 10 minutes of waiting for the hostess before we finally seated ourselves. In the end we ended up staying in Kelowna for one more night and stayed at the Holiday Inn Express which was cheaper, and FAR superior. Seriously the Best Western Plus may be number 1 on the site but if you compare ratios, the Holiday Inn has practically no bad reviews.

author: gypsywater
title: Excellent value for your money and exceptionally "Green"
text: I stayed 3 nights here at the begining of May on business. The service upon checkin and when ordering room service was fantastic. I paid a very reasonable price to stay here and breakfast was included. I ordered the spinach salad twice for lunch and it came fast, was fresh, tasted great and they didn't charge an additional "delivery" or "service" fee! I appreciated that and felt great tipping the nice gentleman who delivered it. The hotel is updated to an average level, nice and clean, with comfortable beds and a thermostat you can control yourself. I have to mention that the internet was free! Not a common added feature I can say, as I travel alot for work and was surprised to not have to pay (or beg to have it included lol). My room looked onto the back(?) of the building - facing a courtyard and was super quiet, no noise complaints from me. I used the gym once, which was spacious and I was the only one in there so I had obviously no wait for machines etc. The room was a comfortable temperature because the hotel doesn't waste money and resources blasting AC when it's not needed. The thing that impressed me most was this hotels fantastic initiative to be as Green as possible. They recycle everything, offer organic and all natural ammenities in the room (loved the soap, vegetable based and wonderful to use!) and even had fair-trade tea in the room. My only suggestion here would be to extend that to the coffee was well, it would have been great to see organic & fair trade coffee in room. And the most impressive...vinegar in the gym instead of chemicals to wipe down machines after use! Well done BW Kelowna! If you're coming to Kelowna to stay for business I'd recommend this over anything else, as the location is pretty central. And if you're staying for pleasure save your money on hotel & stay here...and then use your savings to explore the area, take a wine tour and dine at the Mission Hill Terrace restaurant, you won't be disappointed!

author: TravelBunny81
title: Value for money. Nice, clean & spacious room. Friendly staff.
text: My boyfriend and I stayed 2 nights - queen bed standard room. Reception was very friendly & knowledgeable. All staff I encountered were pleasant. Buffet Breakfast was good with lots of options - cereals and hot breakfast available. Room was very nice, clean & spacious. The bed was incredibly comfortable, lot's of good TV stations. There was a desk and plenty of room to place bags and walk around the room. Bathroom was very clean and modern with nice towels. Came with 2 bath robes to wear during your stay. Shower head worked well. There was a balcony off our room which had a good view and allowed a nice breeze in. Very good privacy. The lobby and breakfast room has high ceilings and is very spacious and attractive. I'm not sure how good the location was as we only stayed 2 days and just caught a taxi, which the hotel would order for us to get to the sports stadium where we watched Ice Hockey - it was only about 10 mins drive. Overall it was great value for money. And very good for a 3 star hotel!

author: holiday4four
title: Fantastic
text: Hotel was fantastic as was the service. We were on the eighth (top) floor in the tower. The rooms are modern, roomy, comfortable, quiet and very clean. The bathroom is spacious with marble countertops and slate floor. There is a flat screen TV and mini fridge (with no freezer). Beds (two queen) were very comfortable as were the pillows, there was a down quilt on the beds. The central AC worked well and was quiet. There is a spacious balcony with patio furniture. The lobby is inviting with a fireplace. There is a pool, indoor in winter that they open up for the summer months and hot tubs. There is a nice sitting area looking into the glassed in pool area. The best part about the hotel is the 'hot' continental breakfast that is included in the room fee. Omelettes made to order, pancakes, waffles, eggs, bacon, sausages, scrambled eggs, cereal, toast, yogurt, fresh fruit, baked goods, etc. For a family of 4, what a saver!! The hotel is centrally located for shopping and restaurants. We can't wait to come back!!

author: Tynes1der
title: Nice hotel, poorly equipped room, rotten location if not in a car
text: We stayed here for 2 nights on a Titan Hitours trip of Vancouver and the Rockies. The hotel is located in a strip mall well away from the lake side main town and surrounded by parking lots and only just off an ever busy dual carriageway. Whenever you go out you have to traverse at least one parking lot, and perhaps the dual carriageway (which can only be done at distantly space lights at junctions). The hotel is therefore located primarily with car drivers in mind. There is a 30m bus service to the proper town by the lake. The hotel also has a small indoor swimming pool on the ground floor overlooked by the breakfast area. We were checked in quickly to a room on the 4th floor overlooking car lots as far as the eye could see - no matter, we were not there for the view. Although the door closer for the room was very strong, we quickly noticed that the door would not self latch and it took a couple of minutes to fight the door closer to latch the door properly. (The next day we came back and fond the door unlatched after room servicing). There was 2 queen beds but only ONE bedside table and reading lamp. There was limited hanging space and only 3 drawers to pu clothes in. There was a nice balcony with a good view of parked cars if the weather is good. Noise insulation was very good so we had an undisturbed sleep, although the air conditioner was too noisy to leave on overnight. Breakfast was included and was a good quality continental selection with the weird addition of bacon and eggs which you had to microwave yourself if the queue was not too long to bother.. There was also a waffle maker. We did not try the on-site restaurant or bar because of dubious reports from previous tour visitors. Instead we walked down the side of the noisy main road and ate at a "Dennys" about 15 minutes away. If this hotel had been in a pedestrian area near the lake rather than in the middle of strip mall car lots it may have been OK, but I would NOT recommend it to anyone without a car.

author: Alberta-Travel-Grl
title: Good location, clean and quiet hotel.
text: Hotel is in a good location, minutes from the airport. Rooms are quiet and well insulated from both the traffic noise below (though I'm on the 6th floor so that helps) and from hallway noise (I'm next to the elevator - haven't heard it once). Rooms is well appointed though not terribly spacious but definitely sufficient (two queen beds in this room). Great green initiatives here with solar heated hot water, recycling and other environmental initiatives visible throughout the hotel. Free wifi. Large flat screen T.V. Artificial plant in the room is a nice touch. Balcony is accessible and has patio furniture. View of the foothills is pretty. Continental breakfast is stellar with lots of variety and dining room is clean and spacious. Housekeeping is efficient and considerate - I came back from a conference this afternoon to find fresh flowers in the room - very nice! I didn't use the pool but it looks clean and well maintained. 2 outdoor hot tubs are in the courtyard surrounded by greenery. Landscaping is tidy. Perhaps the only negative (and it's very minor) is that the AM front desk staff could be more generous with the "Good Mornings".

author: TransplantedNLer_Meg
title: Service above and beyond!
text: My boyfriend and I stayed here on the last night of a 9 day vacation from Calgary, AB to Victoria, BC and back. At the end of the trip and the end of a long day of driving, this hotel had absolute comfort and quality and the most accommodating, friendly, helpful front desk staff of any hotel I've ever visited, and there have been many. When booking our hotel online we had requested a quieter room since we would be tired after driving, and also for a comfortable bed due to my chronic back injury which was also exacerbated by driving. When we arrived, the incredibly awesome attendant at the front desk said that he had received our request and was sad to inform us that the hotel was hosting a large group of school age children and their parents who were in town for a sports event, so that they would do our best to get a quiet room. He then escorted us upstairs where he wanted to give us the choice between two rooms, to see which location suited us best for our need for peace and quiet. We felt that this was totally unnecessary but very much appreciated!! He also made sure to inform us of the scheduled outings and events for the sports group in hopes of giving us an idea when the hotel would be quietest, what time the continental breakfast area would be quietest, etc. The rooms appeared brand new, beautifully outfitted and modern, with two queen beds. My boyfriend and I even each enjoyed stretching out in a bed after our long week of varying hotel bed quality and the drive!! The bathroom was clean, modern, well-kept and well-stocked with toiletries. I really can't say enough about how impressed we were! We also had a balcony with a great view of the Mission Hill winery. The only aspect of this hotel which was perfect for us but might not be suitable for everyone is that it is located just off the highway in the Westbank area of Kelowna, so it is about a 10 minute drive from downtown Kelowna. We personally thought the location was perfect for visiting our relatives who live in the Westbank, but if you are new to Kelowna and interested in the downtown and the waterfront scene, you may choose something closer to there. However, let it be known that the Best Western had extremely good value for the cost, and if you have a car or rental, it should not be a problem to get downtown!!

author: Edmonton_mamma
title: Great Service, Great Value
text: My husband and I stayed at the Best Western Kelowna for 3 nights while we toured the Wine Valley to celebrate our anniversary. The staff were very friendly and helpful. I had emailed the hotel before we arrived to ask if it would be possible to have an upper room in the tower so that we could sit on the balcony and enjoy the view with a bottle of wine. The manager Al Lang responded immediately to say that he had arranged that for us. Freinds of ours had made contact with Mr. Lang and with his help they were able to have a bottle of champagne and card there waiting for us. I believe they had also upgraded us, as we had booked a standard room, but when we checked in we had a lovely suite, with king size bed, lovely sitting area, and fireplace. We were on the top floor and could see Lake Okanagan from our balcony. The bed was very comfortable, the bedding very nice and the room was very quiet. The bathroom had a lovely deep soaker tub and separate shower. A continental breakfast was included in the room rate. The hotel is in the middle of the wine country, so we were able to tour about easily. We spent a day with Fred from Wine Valley Tours and he took us to the west bank and had picked out 6 small wineries for us to visit. He had also arranged lunch at Little Straw Wineries. It was great service with pick up and drop off at the hotel door.

author: NFTravller1
title: Ear Plugs Provided By The Hotel Because It Is SO LOUD!
text: Before booking this hotel, I read some of the reviews on TripAdvisor and saw that some people had some issues with noise, but overall the hotels reviews were positive. When I arrived at the hotel, the room was very spacious and clean, modern, and I did notice one thing I have never seen before in a hotel room - EAR PLUGS on the nightstand! I thought it to be odd, but then after settling in the room for a few minutes, I realized why they were there - the room I was in (near the back, second floor) was located near the security door to this area, the vending machines, ice maker, etc. The noise was unbearable! Everytime the security door opened, it had a big BANG that sounded like someone was trying to kick down the door. Even the one wall the bed was against would shake! I called the front desk, and they said they would send someone from Maintenance to check it out. I left at 4am, and it was still not "fixed". I maanged to get some sleep using my iPod to drown out the noise, but it still was a horrible evening. Upon check-out, I mentioned the nosie again - nothing was said other then they will send Maintenance to look at it...I asked why they supplied ear plugs (I've stayed at many hotels attached to airports, on major highways, etc. and have never seen this) and they said a lot of their customers requet them...yeah, because without them I'm sure most would get no sleep at all! With all the modern ammenities this hotel has, I don't get why they can't get this noisy door fixed. They even have a push-button "Do Not Disturb" sign on each room, but can't control noise. They have a wired system to the doors so when they are opened, the A/C is turned off, yet they can't control the noise. On another note, the hotel also notes they have flatscreen TVs, however, they ard not HD - just stretched out SD channels on them. I always find this annoying at every hotel that has HD TVs - invest in getting HD channels! Some posiitives - the hotel has both wireless and wired high-speed internet, is probably one of the closest hotels to the airport, and is walking distance to many restaurants - however, the noise and lack of any attention or care (other then supplying ear plugs!) to my complaint by the hotel staff will ensure I never stay here again on my business trips to the Okanagan. Ear plugs...still can't believe that was the solution!

author: seteaum
title: One Petropolis' best. Unfortunately.
text: Not as "sophisticated" and "design" as on their website description... still keep on falling for the marketing, damnit!! The keyword here should be "standard". Standard hotel. Standard staff. Standard rooms. Standard breakfast buffet. Nothing fancy. End of story. If you need to stay there, get the front rooms with the nicer view. Restaurant is a bit of a let down, don't eat there (we had to because it was pouring outside). It seemed they were surprised to have guests, and it tasted like that. Still, probably one of Petropolis' best hotels. Unfortunately. Petropolis is best done on a day trip from Rio.

author: Gerry_in_St_Pete
title: A grand experience in a fine establishment
text: We spent a night at the Grande Hotel, while viewing the sights in Petropolis. For the average tourist, the sights consist of the Imperial Museum, some remodeled homes of former nobility, a wax museum and not much else... Petropolis is a very nice little town up in the mountains northeast of Rio de Janeiro for those who don't know it. Here the Portuguese Imperial family spent it's summers while in exile in Brazil, avoiding both the wrath of Napoleon and the sultry Rio summers. According to staff, the hotel was closed for many years, until it was renovated, starting in 2005 and re-opened in 2011. The hotel is relatively small (5 floors), about 60 rooms and suites, but very well renovated with modern rooms and modern bathrooms. We stayed in a Luxo room, which is the basic room, but in the front of the hotel with a view of the city's central plaza right outside our windows. There is a little less expensive room called Superior, which is essentially the same room on the back side of the hotel, with a less inspiring view from the windows. There were a couple of minor annoyances, which would not be found in most of the rooms, like the mis-aligned toilet seat and the partially shredded blackout curtain (see attached photos). Things that are easily fixed if management inspected the rooms, and did not expect the cleaning help to report these types of problems. But they seemed to miss these things. The hotel has it's own restaurant, where it serves it's breakfast buffet, and lunch and dinner, as well. The menu is upscale but limited. The food is well prepared and reasonably priced (this is a hotel restaurant, of course). There are other restaurants in the vicinity of the hotel, for those that want to get out and about.

author: Carla_Thiago
title: Perfect location and very modern now
text: This hotel dates from 1930 but it has been totally refurbished. It is very modern inside and kept the old fancy facade. It is very close to the main touristic place of Petropolis- Museum Imperial. It has a valet service at the door. The rooms have a good size and are very cosy, with a comfy bed and a marble bathroom. Free wi-fi is available. The restaurant is beautiful and the breakfast has many option to choose from, including delicious home made cakes: the banana strudel is particularly tasty. I just did not like the service at check-in, there was a misunderstanding between the price they charge and the price booking.com offer. They made us pay both nights of stay immediately at arrival, which I do not think is common and told us to sort it out with booking.com afterwards. They only realized we were actually correct in the price we booked the room after we had paid their price. So they had to cancel the first payment and then do it again. Boring! So check in was time-consuming and I was upset. Never before did I have a problem such as this. Oh well, I guess it happens once. I might stay here again....

author: PhilipBHerold
title: Newly remodeled, perfect location, spotty service
text: This hotel was remodeled and has all the Eugh amenities for an international traveler, save two. It's immediately in front of the museum. The bell staff was friendly if perfunctory. The check in was quick, but largely a result of no one but myself checking in. The room, specifically quoted (in Portuguese to my wife, a native speaker) as having a king, had what can be described as a petite queen. The room had flat screen TV with international channels. The bathroom was spartan, but clean and functional. The two negatives were these; no wall outlets in room to accept North American two-pronged plugs and a desk clerk who was clearly trying to be a dolt. All other hostels which can reasonably be expected to host international visitors have outlets sufficient to charge and iPhone or support a laptop. In anticipation of World Cup, at least, this is short sighted. Lastly, a desk clerk sat listening, no more than two feet from me, as I asked for help getting an outside line from my room. After several minutes listening to my best efforts in Portugues with his sweet colleague, he mumbled, not bothering to look at me, "dial zero". It didn't take him 5 minutes to know I spoke English. They speak English here, but you'll need to ask, don't expect them to offer. Why? No idea. In the end I'd stay here again, because for US$125/night it's a good deal. But management please remember, you're only 'new' one day, and service wins or loses every time.

author: Elle_01234
title: Take the renovated rooms
text: I opted for the renovated rooms and got a spatious room with a new bathroom. Everything worked perfectly with 2 exceptions: the A/C would not turn off even when I closed it, so it was very cold inside the room, and there was no coffee maker (and there should be). A minus was that the fridge was locked and we had to ask them to unlock it (but this happend to us in Hanzhou as well, so perhaps it is a Chinese standard policy?). My friends who took the regular rooms where also very pleased with the accommodation (their rooms where more spatious than mine and they did have a coffee maker but their bathrooms where a bit tired). The breakfast and dinner was very good and clean with lots of variety in both western and eastern food. The gym small but clean and I was on my own every evening. There was also an indoor pool but I didn't use it. The hotel has a spa and offers massages (which I didn't use). They have a bar at the top floor (I think at the 28th floor of the new wing) which rotates. It is very beautiful but rather expensive and the spin stops at 10-10:30pm. Still it is worth the visit. They offer free wifi everywhere, including the rooms, and it is very fast and reliable. The location of the hotel is excellent. Malls and markets of all kinds (cheap, expensive, mini markets, clothes, electronics etc) are at a walking distance from the hotel. Also some major attractions are at walking distance. As it happens in China, don't expect people to speak English, even if it is the hotel reception. However, they will make an effort to service you as best they can! All in all a great experience!

author: BethnBrett
title: Not too impressed
text: I stayed with 2 children and 2 adults in a room. The hotel is in a great location with great staff and service. However, the "average" room is 750rmb a night which is $150 Canadian dollars. I think this to be a pricey hotel without breaking the bank. Naturally I would expect a decent room but this is not the case. The rooms have mold, carpets are dirty, and the wood frames on doors and walls are coming off. My kids being young enough to sleep on floor in sleeping bag... that was not happening!!! I complained. Was shown a second room of even lesser quality all The while the halls and most rooms stink of cigarette smoke though it was banned in all hotels in Beijing last year! After complaining again and then telling me if I wAnt a "clean room" I have to pay extra to go to executive floors!!!!! UNACCEPTABLE in my eyes. I argued and wouldn't budge on that as we were already paying enough. Finally a manager came over and I was offered a free upgrade but he told me that next time I MUST book with the upgraded room to have a clean one. I very much appreciated the upgrade but I don't think I'll be staying here again.

author: Turkeyites
title: Dated!
text: Stayed at this hotel early May 2016 at start of tour of China - hotel somewhat dated. Lounge area rather small, and lack of a decent bar area. We we're allocated a room on the 16th floor which afforded very decent views of the city, as did the revolving restaurant at the very top of the hotel. Nice restaurant, excellent food, but very very expensive. £101 for two, two courses + drinks. But when we were charged £25 in the bar/tea lounge for two teas (one green, one black) it puts it into perspective. One tip - stay well clear of the Chinese restaurant - not good at all! Room was adequate, shower/bathroom serviceable. Tea and coffee in room kept to minimum and not readily available. Tv programming is also very poor. If you want drink cross the road to the shopping mall and go to the supermarket on the ground floor - you can purchase what you want there at a fifth of the hotel prices. I will also reiterate, as do many other guests, whilst a non smoking establishment, this is not adhered too and the constant smell of smoke within the hotel is nauseating! Staff were helpful when they could be and understood your requirements. Pool was good, but beware, you have to wear swimming hat to enter the pool, and yes, you had to purchase it from the hotel! All in all adequate hotel, dated, poor food choices (reasonable breakfast but such a bun fight as all self service, and finding a table - well! They do have a lot to learn here, and they really need to up their game! Wifi is, to say the least, crap!

author: HeiDi_Travelling
title: If it wasn't the location..
text: ..I would have only given 2 stars. The hotel wasn't "bad" but quite rundown and I could smell the cigarette smoke coming into the room via the ventilation unit that seemed to be automatically turned on between 6 AM and 11 PM. Though little bit fusty, the room was otherwise clean and bed comfortable. I did hear from others rating their rooms "excellent" so either they had different taste or there are renovated rooms in the other levels or other side of the hotel building. I was given a room in the 7th floor with a bad view to the courtyard and back of the next door Exhibition Center. Not that I had time to stay in the room looking outside anyway.. Free WiFi is available but not very reliable. Worked better with laptop being connected via cable than wireless. There were plenty options for breakfast though I think the Asian dish section (including rice and noodle dishes and hot meals) was much better than the options for food that I would have for breakfast. There were still the omelet station and fruits so didn't have to leave hungry, just little bit unsatisfied perhaps. I stayed as part of a tour so the hotel wasn't my choice in the first place. If I travelled again (on my own), I could consider staying again but would first carefully check out the prices and compare to other hotels in the same part of Beijing. What was excellent was the location. About 15 minutes walk to the Wangfujing Shopping Street, and the Tiananmen Square is another 5 minutes West from there. 15 minutes walk to East from the hotel and you can find the Silk market (shopping centre selling replicas of all sort). There's subway stations close to the hotel too, and a big supermarket opposite side of the road in the Henderson building. I did not visit the gym or pool nor the revolving restaurant after I heard how ridiculously expensive it was.

author: PramilaManoharan
title: tiring but not totally disappointing
text: I happened to stay in this hotel in the month of October 2015. I was there for a conference. My booking was secured by the organizers - but I was to pay. The organizers confirmed that they booked my room. But when I checked the hotel - there started my ordeal - none of them could speak English - it was two hour international calling but no results, I was asked to call tomorrow same thing repeated. I checked with the organizers and they in turn spoke to the hotel again the hotel confirmed with the organizers. hence I landed after the gruesome journey in Air China. When I approached the front desk I was in for a shock they could not trace my name - after making me wait for another one hour they traced my name after the organizer intervened. Then they started with payment problem - I was willing to pay in full - but they have some system of advance which they return back to you after your check out as a caution deposit. It was night marish to make the front desk explain and understand the procedures and pay in advance all the money. It is a good property with good rooms spacious enough for a single business traveler not for family. Huge property - you will get lost. But in good location close to Forbidden city and malls.hence I was not totally disappointed. If you are a vegetarian please carry your own food. I suffered.

author: sjamtsho
title: Great location
text: I spent five nights as this hotel as part of a package deal for a conference. The room was very spacious everything was perfect except for the Internet. The WiFi connection was very weak, and the only way I could check my mails was at about 6 am - 7 am. This is probably because there are less users around this time. They did have a RJ 45 cable to plug into your laptop but unfortunately like most laptops today, mine did not have the port to plug it in. Breakfast was included in the room charge, and it was very good. There was ample choice to cater to most tastes. The best thing about this hotel is its location. It's very close to two subway stations (within 5 mins walking distance); and a few minutes away from Beijing Central railway station. There is an airport shuttle that stops around the corner. If your flight is during odd hours like mine, it takes only 30 mins by taxi to the airport. Most big sites to visit such as the Tiananmen square and Forbidden Palace are only a few stations away by subway; as are a number of shopping places. By the way, subways can be very crowded especially during peak hours and weekends. There is also a lot of eating places in the basement of a shopping centre opposite to the hotel across Jianguomen st, which is connected by an underpass. This one is closed by 10 pm though but there's a McDonalds close by which is open 24 hrs. There are also convenience stores near the railway station (only a few minutes walk) that are open 24 hrs. There is a ATM that changes currency in the lobby that charges 30 RMB per transaction; and the maximum that you can change in one transaction is USD 400.

author: debbief419
title: Not so international "International" hotel and conference venue: sub-standard service and amenities
text: I have just returned from 8 nights at the Beijing International Hotel, where I was co-organising an international conference of about 500 persons from nearly 30 countries in conjunction with a local non-government organisation in Beijing. As a co-organiser of the conference, I was liaising with the hotel on the room bookings for approx. 150 international guests (some of whom were Ministers and high level government officials from countries such as the Maldives, Papua New Guinea, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Mongolia and more), but despite repeated communications, the management persistently got all my check-in and check-out dates wrong, causing me much embarrassment in not being able to produce hotel room confirmation letters in an efficient and timely manner. To make things worse, upon check-in, they would ask all my guests to pay a hefty deposit (when they were supposed to be sponsored by my organisation). The payment methods were also inflexible, where my organisation was unable to pay for the rooms in USD cash (we did not have a corporate credit card). This saw that everyday, a member of our organisation had to go down to the reception to pay the room bills (to max out her credit card limit daily), and that the hotel would lock our guests out of their rooms daily if we did not pay by a certain hour each day. This is appalling as we booked a total of 360 nights with them for the period of the conference. Even after the guests checked out, I had to stand at the reception with a member of the hotel staff to specify how their invoicing and billing was unacceptable to the strict finance and audit standards that I would meet once I was back in office in Singapore. This process took a mere 1.5 hours and caused me so much frustration. Also, it is worth noting that the hotel is actually looking very tired, and that meals and drinks at the hotel were EXTREMELY pricey - and the food isn't even anything to crow about at all. This is feedback not just from myself, but from the many conference participants who had to be accommodated at this venue (our local co-organisers chose this hotel, to my great despair and exasperation). I would not wish to re-visit the hotel, even if this were for a holiday in Beijing in the future. You're indeed much better off at an international chain hotel where you can trust that you can receive a truly "international" standard in hotel service. As a note, I organise many international meetings and conferences in my line of work, and travel an awful lot for personal purposes as well. This hotel was really exasperating, the communication was a serious issue and they were pricey and inflexible about payment methods and horrendous with billing and room confirmations. The wifi connection is also spotty, so you may want to consider if this is important to you. The business centre printing is costly as well (12 RMB for 1 piece of b/w printing). It's definitely the worst hotel that I have had to deal with professionally in my years of being in my current job. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE IF POSSIBLE!

author: 483shelleyg
title: Information to manage your expectations
text: Upon arrival to the hotel, you get a sense of old style grandeur that may lull you into a false sense of what this hotel truly is... unloved, in need of major renovation and someone to bring the customer service onto the 21st century!! This hotel relies solely on its central location and that's pretty much it. When we arrived, we were taken to our rooms, where they were spacious but very dated. On first appearance, the room seemed very clean, until bedtime when my nostrils were filled with with the smell of strong tobacco from the pillows. The room was so hot, so we put the airconditionin on, which did not work. When we called down to ask someone to come and fix it, we were informed that the air con was turned off for the autumn/winter and only heat will come out of the system...bearing in mind that the days have been in excess of 25/26 degrees and nights 15/16 degree; our nights were more than uncomfortable. When you open the widow, little breeze comes into the room but the loud sounds of the major road that the hotel is on invades and fills the room and we were on the 12th floor! Walking into the bathroom, you feel like you have stepped into someone's home bathroom that they forgot to update or clean!!! The bath/shower (if you can call it that) was cracked, dirty and the tiles were worn and in need of replacement. The shower head was so old that the water ran out of it like a tap, so you had to use your hands as a cup to catch the water. The hotel is supposed to be secure by design but every night someone would place cards underneath the door advertising prostitution services! So as not to be completely down on the hotel, I will say that the hotels buffet breakfast is more than comprehensive, dare I say fantastic! The location is perfect for all of the things you may want or need to get to, however I would not pay top money for this place. At all. The food is very expensive if you buy from the hotel but it is close to many shops and a supermarket is across the road.

author: BigDaveWirral
title: Don't Stay Here if You Want a Drink!
text: We stayed here as part of a tour from the UK with twelve participants. The foyer flatters to deceive as it is spacious and presentable. Our twin room was clean and roomy if a bit dated but the bathroom was extremely shabby with loose fixtures and fittings and shoddily repaired areas. On several occasions we came back into to room to a smell of cigarette smoke. The breakfast buffet was ok if you are Chinese but it was hard to get a cup of tea or coffee and the European options were limited and cold. However, the major drawback with this hotel is the laughable approach to drink service. They have a wonderful revolving bar on the top floor but the staff are completely useless. None of them speak a word of English and you have to point to an iPad menu to try to get them to understand what you want. On the first night there were six of us and it took half an hour to get a drink. We stupidly put this down as a blip so all twelve of us went the following night. Action replay. Staff with no English and no clue. Half an hour to deliver each round of drinks with total chaos at the end when it came to pay the bill. For an international hotel which supposed to be five star (laughable) at the very least you put in some staff that you have taught a few words of English, even it is only words like vodka, gin etc. As if that wasn't enough we went to the other bar on our final night and had exactly the same communication problem although the drinks did come a bit quicker (only 20 minutes). To cap it all they charge a 15% service charge when the service was non existent. When we challenged this on the basis that we had not received anything that could be vaguely described as service we were told that non-payment was not an option! Overall try somewhere else!

author: 195stephend
title: ...But a little uncoordinated
text: We stayed here for four nights and the service was faultless. The staff were polite and helpful and mostly did their best the satisfy all our requests. There are three (maybe four) restaurants and one rather unatmospheric (sic) bar area. The main restaurant (where the breakfast buffet happens) called the Sky Cafe has a fixed price buffet in the evening which has a huge choice the satisfy almost any international taste but, of course, mainly Chinese. This is quite expensive we thought at about ¥280 per head. Wine was available and the local wine was ¥198 which we thought equated with a UK restaurant price for an equivalent. It was quite drinkable. There is a revolving resaurant on the roof which we did not sample but it seemed as though it would be expensive and geared for business clients. On the same level as the bar (2 I think) there is a Chinese Restaurant. This proved to be the best value we found and the food was good. However, when we asked for wine we were offered very expensive imported red only. When we refused and suggested the wine we had had from the Sky Cafe there was a blank look and the weine list from the bar was produced. This, too, was expensive and seemed to be only imported wine. Nothing we said could persuade them that there was local wine availble! It might have been a language difficulty on reflection. If mome of these suit, there is a shopping mall right across the street (by underpass) which contains many small restaurants but mainly fast food. There are few Engish speakers in these and only some have picture menus so it could be pot luck what you get. The room was very good and the whole place was very clean. A very good hotel on the whole.

author: BlueCollarFoodCritic
title: Great Hotel and Location
text: This hotel exceeded our expectations. The hotel is centrally located and only a 25 minute walk to the famous Silk Market shopping center. The rooftop restaurant is a must with a 360° view of Beijing. The food is very good. Go just before sunset and watch Beijing transform as night falls. A truly wonderful experience. The restaurant can be very expensive depending on what you order. The foie gras is delicious and reasonably priced. Watch out, drinks are expensive, with a can of coke costing $10, ouch! The rooms are very nice. Our room on the 16th floor had a Playboy type separate shower/tub bathing area that can be viewed from the bedroom. It had a rain shower and a hand held shower. It is the first time ever I saw a hotel give bath salts for the tub! A very nice touch. There is a horizontal blind for privacy. The rooms are large, bed very comfortable, and the carpet clean. Great toiletries too. The hotel is right next to Citibank which is convenient. Only disappointment was the concierge had not maps of the city! This was unexpected.

author: womanofkent
title: Clean, convenient location
text: We stayed here beginning of April as the first hotel on our private tour of China. Check in took a little while but that was down to our bank querying our credit card being used in China (despite telling them in advance). The room was not too tight with 3 beds in. There was some noise from the road even on the 10th floor and even at 5am! Although the hotel knew we needed 3 beds we found as in most of our hotels that the 3rd bed is not added until you arrive, so when we got to our room housekeeping came to add it. Our room was double checked by a supervisor, not sure if this was normal, but you could tell she was very particular about the standard and it was very clean. The hotel provided toiletries and water for brushing your teeth. A wide range of breakfast available, both Chinese and European. My family decided it was the best out of all our hotels. We had a problem with our safe in the room it was temperamental and wouldn't open sometimes even with the correct code, we called reception who sent someone from housekeeping, when she couldn't get it working she called someone from management who could also speak better English. It was decided that it was faulty and that they would change it, unfortunately maintenance had gone home but it was changed the next day whilst we were out as we had left it empty. Great Service. We felt very safe in this location, many police around. Mostly we were door to door, but we did venture out on our own. The roads in places were hard to cross however there are underpasses that are clean, fully lit and in some places had security. One evening we walking to the night food market, not far at all. Between the hotel and the station there is a pharmacy and an underground shopping centre. Also my husband found a supermarket very easily close by. Just one caution, the deposit taken by this hotel was our highest in China at 1500Yuan they were happy to take a credit card, however, they initially told my husband on check out that they would fax the company later, he did not accept this and insisted they refunded the card whilst he was there which they did.

author: TraceyW680
title: Good quality hotel
text: Stayed for 7 on business. Stayed on the 17th floor and the rooms were great. Big bathrooms with bath, separate shower - quite large. Great lovely big towels which I like. Hairdryer in room. Had to ask for an iron and ironing board as they are not standard in the room. Iron fine but ironing board was not really padded so left marks on my clothes - not the end of the world really. Good, free wifi but limited English speaking channels - CNN on what seems to be a loop - same stories repeated over and over and HBO with films on - OK but not great. Room cleaned daily, 2 bottles of complimentary water replenished daily and tea and coffee in the room with powdered milk. Breakfast I found was good. Omelettes made to order, toast, jams, pastries, bacon, pancakes and several local dishes all in a large area. Staff were fine in my experience. English language is patchy by some people but a lot better than my mandarin and nothing that we couldn't muddle through with. If the person I was speaking to could not understand me then they called someone over who could speak and understand English better. I did book the airport transfer both ways as it was my first visit and it was excellent so will do so again if I ever revisit. Tiananmen Square 2kms away - easy walk. Turn right out of the hotel and keep going - you will also come to the shopping area on the way!

author: Juanybear
title: Very good
text: I travelled alone to Beijing from England for 2 weeks to celebrate my 20th birthday. I stayed in Beijing International and had a great experience. The beds were extremely comfortable (infact, the best I have ever experienced) and the rooms were sound proof so I couldn't hear the traffic at all which was good because I had a room overlooking the main road. The hotels location is very close to the centre and the main shopping area was within walking distance. In fact, one evening I walked back from Tiananmen Square and was surprised how close it was. However, I recommend getting a taxi to places. As the hotel can be quite a walk away from other things. What helps is that almost every taxi driver knows where the hotel is. So they have no difficulties in taking you there. The staff are friendly, especially the men who work at the front of the hotel outside and in the car parks. Even though I don't speak a word of chinese, and some of the staff didn't know too much english - they were still extremely helpful and friendly. The rooms were extremely clean and I loved the bathroom. There was a bath with a handheld shower in it. But also a separate shower in the bathroom that was a rainfall shower. Prices of food were quite expensive in the hotel though. Luckily there was a mcdonalds and a kfc over the road. I would return here in future.

author: MartyF_12
title: Clean, Spacious, Reasonable Price
text: We spent four nights at the Beijing International Hotel and found our room to be clean, spacious and comfortable. The hotel is reasonably priced and a good value. The breakfast buffet was excellent, with a wide variety of western and Asian choices. We did not use the dinner buffet as we thought the price was quite high. Instead, we ate dinner in the "Tea Room", to the left of the buffet area. This proved to be very quiet, with good service. The menu includes good sandwiches and light dinner entrees, though they are somewhat expensive. The food quality was excellent, so can't complain too much about the cost. A wine list is available in the Tea Room, but the wine we wanted was offered only by the bottle. HOWEVER, having earlier had a glass of our preferred wine in the bar, we pointed out that the same wine offered by the bottle in the Tea Room was being sold by the glass in the bar upstairs. Our waitperson proved to be very accommodating and brought us glasses of the wine from the bar at the same price as the bar price...... Don't be afraid to ask for this; you may have to explain that this can be done, and they will do it. The location of the hotel is fairly convenient for visiting Tianamen Square and the Forbidden City -- both a short taxi ride away. Otherwise, the hotel seems isolated in terms of other things around it. Bottom line, a good place to stay. We would use this hotel again if we were to return to Beijing.

author: MandyandSophie
title: Beijing Bound!
text: Booked this hotel through ebookers and got a good discount. We arrived in Beijing around 10am and even though we were told we couldn't check in until 2pm they found us a room and told us we could wait for it to be cleaned which we did. We had been up since 4.30 that morning so were really grateful. The hotel is in a decent location being on the main road so convenient for buses and taxis and was only a 20 min walk from the forbidden city. On entering the hotel it did have a 1960s feel to it. We we're put on the 12th floor which had good views. One morning because of an early start we decided to have breakfast room service. Don't do it.
