The home is owned and managed by Murphy's Resort, which is right down the road. All of the staff members at Murphy's were VERY friendly and accommodating. While staying at this home, you are even welcome to use the amenities offered at the resort! Every morning, we enjoyed coffee on the large deck while looking out at the lake and mountains through the gorgeous pines. We also spent several evenings out on the deck enjoying happy hour and/or dinner. There is a large outdoor table that seats 8 as well as 2 smaller tables that each seat 2. Even the inside has great views of the mountains and lake! The home is newly remodeled, so everything is new and very clean! The beds are comfortable, there's plenty of closet space, and they even provide movies and games! The kitchen was fully stocked with plenty of dishes and cooking equipment. The location couldn't be better! You are right on Lake Estes where you can fish, walk the trail, or play golf. It was VERY peaceful and quiet with no road noise. You are also close to the adorable and historic downtown Estes Park as well as Rocky Mountain National Park! Downtown has lots of shopping/dining/entertainment and visiting RMNP is a MUST! Trust me, you won't be disappointed with this property! We would definitely rent here again.

author: SueRobG
title: Perfect Place to Stay!
text: My husband and I spent five nights here on our recent vacation to Estes Park, and we could not be more pleased with our stay! We had a king room and were visited by elk pretty much every morning. The room was extremely clean and the bed was comfy. In fact, the entire grounds were always very clean. The staff was phenomenal! Everyone was always smiling and helpful and ready to answer any questions you may have. There was always someone taking care of the breakfast room and Rebecca and Bruce were our faves! Bruce is extremely knowledgeable about the area and is history and offers tours. I highly recommend his tours. Rebecca was also great and was very entertaining to talk to as she provided a lot of insight into vacationing in Colorado. The breakfast choices were perfect for us. They offered muffins, danishes, yogurt, hardboiled eggs, oatmeal, different breads and bagels, coffee/tea/hot chocolate, and many topping to choose from. I chose this place to stay as it offers many amenities, and we were not stuck sitting in our room at the end of the day. We played horseshoes, 'rented' movies, and borrowed some board games on rainy nights. Their DVD selection is extensive and excellent. We felt very welcome and at home here. I highly recommend staying here! We have stayed in many hotel/motel and B&B establishments, but never felt more at home than we did here.

author: patricknkim
title: Wonderful place to stay!
text: We had the pleasure of staying at Murphys Resort for 8 nights as we awaited the arrival of our grandchild in Estes Park. Cannot wait for our return visits and look forward to staying at Murphys Resort as we felt so at home there. Everyone, from the resort manager to housekeeping, was incredibly friendly and helpful. We stayed in the King Size Suite which was immaculate. Very clean and king size bed was so comfortable. We had a fireplace, couch and very comfortable recliner. In addition to that we had a full size refrigerator, stove, microwave and dinette set. The kitchen was fully equipped for doing meals in the room. The resort also offers a continental breakfast for a great way to start the day. Housekeeping did a great job with our room each day. We did use the laundry facility that is available and laundry area in just as clean as any other area in resort. We look forward to coming back in warmer weather when we will take advantage of pool, outdoor grilling and campfire areas. So many things to do right at Murphy's Resort! We were very pleased with location as it is just a couple of blocks away from Lake Estes in which the 4 mile walk around the lake was our daily exercise. The views are amazing and vary every day due to weather, but never disappointing. Many days we enjoyed watching the elk right on the property. Appreciated the free wifi.

author: TOM_SArvada
title: Great spot for a weekend stay; Clean, Welcoming and Convenient
text: We were in town for the weekend for wedding (lots of weddings in Estes Park). We weren't looking for a spa or specialty property; we wanted an affordable, convenient and clean place to stay. We liked Murphy's Resort. It has the look of a 50's motel (park outside the door which is great for loading and unloading), but the inside is pretty modern. It is winter, so the pool, etc. were closed, but we weren't at the resort a lot anyway. Looking around it would be a fun place to stay in the summer; firepits, grilling area, lots of outdoor games (beanbag, ladderball, etc.) with a nice view of the lake (the marina is right next door). The room was very clean and fit our needs well. My wife is a professional meeting planner and works with high-end properties a lot and she was impressed with the cleanliness of the hotel and the great work done by the maids. I liked that we had a separate bedroom room from the kids; each with their own TVs for late-night watching (I could sleep while they watched in another room). The beds are great! We haven't slept that well on hotel beds in years. The breakfast is nice (no hot items like eggs or bacon, but it gets you started). Watch out for the elk at night, they like to parade through the parking lot and hang out in the center area grazing before they wander down to the lake. It can be a thrill to watch.

author: mtntreker
title: Clean, well managed and affordable
text: At the last minute, I decided to take my daughter up to Estes for the weekend. I was surprised to find a hotel at $95 a night, even in March. A bit skeptical, I decided to reserve the room (double queen standard) and give the place a shot. We were pleasantly surprised to find the room clean, the grounds well kept and the management very accommodating. Don't get me wrong, there's nothing fancy about the room. No jetted tub or fireplace. The TV is very small and the picture isn't very good when watching cable. However, the office offers over 1000 DVD's free of charge and a good selection of board games. There are 2 fire pits with another area under construction. We bought some smore ingredients at the local Safeway and got some marshmallow sticks from the office. We were having such a good time that we offered one to the manager on duty. The complex backs to Lake Estes so you can walk to a fishing spot. In the morning and evenings there's a very tame herd of elk that roam the grounds eating every blade of grass in sight. The pool is outdoor so it was closed and the indoor hot tub was adults only. The pool and pool area looked nice for a summer day. Would I choose Murphy's for a romantic getaway? No. However, if you're looking for an affordable, clean and well managed place to spend the weekend with the family I would definitely recommend staying at Murphy's.

author: RJMAK
title: This Place Has It All!
text: We loved it. We came to Estes with 3 couples; 2 had been at the resort before but it was my husband and I's first time. We were all pretty hungry when we checked in and the front desk staff was awesome. With 6 people, picking a restaurant was frustrating. The staff kept giving us recommendations until we found a place that sounded good to all of us. I'm sure we were quite annoying but they were so nice. It was just a great way to start our stay. We had a lake view room and as the sun set, the elk came in to bed down right under our window! It was so cool to watch them close by. The resort itself was lovely. The rooms were large and well equipped. AND THAT BED! Maybe I'm exaggerating as this was my first full night sleep in 2+ years (young children at home), but I slept so well. I want to go back there just to sleep. The resort also has a hot tub, outdoor pool, 2 large play areas and lots of activities to entertain you. There are grills available to cook your own food and refrigerators and microwaves in the rooms. My husband and I are looking forward to bringing our family back up for a vacation. It really felt like we were staying at a stand alone resort but the town was less than a 5 minute drive away. tl:dr Check it out for yourself. Great staff, great rooms, great view, great available activities and close to town.

author: robertmA5084YS
title: Followed Trip Advisor Reviews
text: Just stop by while looking for a hotel in Estes Park. I remembered that this hotel had good reviews, therefore I followed those suggestions. I am sure glad I stopped and checked this hotel. The hotel is set up in a square and you can drive around an park in front of your room. Its kind of reminds me of what an old motel looked like. Anyway, it is an older hotel but has been totally renovated by the present owners. (two years of hard work). The rooms are large, have tile floors and all are decorated for a movie star. Our room was Marilyn Monroe. The rooms have all of the amenities, coffee, frig, microwave and table and two chairs on your front door patio. In the center of the property, there is a kids play yard, a BBQ pavilion, a large pool and hot tub. Breakfast is served each morning in the main building. They provided hot and cold variety of foods. Everyone at this place seemed to be very friendly and helpful. Its a great place to stay. Located about two miles from town center.

author: Iowaite
title: Great retreat!
text: Murphy's resort really knows how to help you "get away from it all!" :) We rented a two-bedroom family suite. It was very clean, quiet and peaceful and all on one level. The beds were new and there was both a spa tub in one of the bedrooms as well as a separate whirlpool tub and shower. The vanity area was shared. We loved that this was not a corporate chain and the facility had all the charm of days gone by, shuffleboard, horse shoes, picnic tables, grills, a playground, pool and a super nice hot tub. In the office they had movies you could borrow as there were DVD players in the rooms. The breakfast was very good, better than the average continental breakfast. The staff were extremely warm, helpful, kind and considerate. Check-in was a breeze! Loved the on staff manager dog, a cute standard poodle! :) They also have "sip and paint" where you can go several nights a week and for a fee paint portraits. The work is displayed in the rustic, woody pine breakfast room! Also enjoyed the smores and music around the fire! A very cozy, welcoming, warm, fuzzy, relaxing place to stay and the views are beautiful too! A+++

author: E2097GKchristineg
title: a most pleasant stay, indeed
text: I can't begin to say enough nice things about our stay. Our room was immaculately clean. Everything was in excellent working order -- in fact, we were told that our room had been recently renovated and we should let them know if there was anything not right. We did find a problem with the rear window when we opened it, and they were very happy to hear about it so it could be fixed right away. Our room was quite spacious, including a king bed, large sofa sleeper, table and chairs, refrigerator and microwave. There was also a ceiling fan. Our room was so comfortable, that we actually sat in the room with the front door and back window open, allowing for a wonderful breeze through the room. No bugs either (unlike back home in the Midwest)! There were all kinds of things to do too -- swimming, hot tub, tether ball, volley ball, horseshoes, cornhole.... and numerous other games that you could check out from the office. There were gas grills too -- utensils available at the office as well. We cooked out the first night and enjoyed it very much. We bought food at the Safeway store just down the road. Every room has a DVD player in it, and there are about 300 movies (and popcorn too) in the office. Breakfast was simple and tasty -- pastry, toast, muffins, cereal, yogurt, hard boiled eggs, juice -- and a perfect way to start the day. Everyone on the staff is so friendly and accommodating -- we felt like we were staying with friends. My only disappointment is that I was not able to participate in the Sip and Paint class, as not enough people had signed up (and this is most certainly not a fault of the hotel). I only wish that we would have had more days to stay at Murphy's Resort -- we really loved it! The price was certainly right too -- much less expensive than most hotels in Estes Park.

author: kerepesi34
title: Family-friendly; great place for a group!
text: We stayed at Murphy's Resort for 6 nights as part of a small family reunion in July 2015 and could not have been happier with our time there! Set up like a motel, with the rooms encircling the pool and common areas, the place has a charming KOA/campground sort of feel, complete with fire pits, bbqs, a delightful heated pool, shuffleboard and a bunch of other family-friendly activities. For us, the fire pits absolutely made our stay -- we made s'mores, sipped wine and reminisced around the fire while the sun set behind the nearby mountains. Yeah, pretty darn idyllic. Everything is included, from the firewood to some pretty decent bikes you can use to ride around Lake Estes or into town. There are a ton of movies and board games you can check out. The continental breakfast (also included!) is basic and repetitious (toast, yogurt, hard boiled eggs, juice, coffee (too weak!), cereal, bananas, etc.) but was adequate for our group. The staff was outstanding, patiently and quickly addressing every one of our requests and needs, never missing a beat. The rooms were nothing fancy, but sparkling clean and well appointed. Wifi is free, but very spotty. Murphy's is located about 5 minutes by car from downtown Estes and a 5-minute walk from Lake Estes and the little marina, where you can rent canoes, kayaks, paddle boats, etc. I was told when I reserved that a free shuttle bus into town would stop "directly in front of the hotel." That wasn't exactly true, as one needs to walk uphill a bit to a nearby restaurant to catch the shuttle. It didn't much matter as we found the Estes Shuttle to be a pain to use and not reliable at all -- much better to drive into town, despite the difficulty parking and advancing through the clogged main street. I researched the heck out of Estes Park for the ideal place to hold a family reunion and everyone agreed that Murphy's was the perfect choice. A big thanks to Murphy's and the stellar staff for helping us create a fun and memorable week!

author: lorim630
title: Great place to stay!
text: The employees as well as the owners (and their dogs) are very friendly and inviting here. They are a dog friendly resort, which I love. Our dog even had an enjoyable stay here. We did have some noisy dog neighbors, who did not want to seem to stop barking while their owners were away from the room. The staff was very helpful and remedied the situation quickly for us. We had no other problems while we stayed here. I feel like we had the room with the best view (351) as we could see Lake Estes, and the mountains from our main room. We also had a female Elk 5 feet from our window. There is a walking path around Lake Estes just a short walking distance from the resort. The resort rooms are decorated nicely, large, and felt very comfortable and homey. I loved all of the outdoor games and activities that are available as well as the giant rocking horse out front. Breakfasts were fine with hard boiled eggs, cereals, coffee, toast/muffins, yogurt available. Nice to have the onsite breakfasts before heading out to see the sights for the day. I highly recommend this place if you are in Estes Park, CO. Thanks for a great stay!

author: Sholson78
title: Great family vacation at this affordable resort
text: My family and I went to Murphy's in late June (2015) for a 4 night stay and ended up staying a 5th night because it was awesome. Tons of stuff for my four boys (ages 9, 6, 5, and 3) to do on the resort grounds like shuffleboard, ball toss, swimming, and their two playgrounds. The way the resort is set up and shaped is perfect because the central courtyard has a shelter with tons of grills set up next to a playground and the pool; it's perfect for families to meet each other and make new acquaintances--which we did. The location is nice because it's right on a bike/walking trail that takes you in to downtown It's very safe and quiet. We had the two bedroom suite with the kitchenette and it was great. Very clean and recently updated. Our family stayed there for 4 nights until something unforeseeable occurred (malfunction with a leaky pipe) which resulted in us having to move rooms. The management was very kind and went above and beyond; the resort was full when we were there and as a result the only room that was open was their gorgeous Summit House that is connected to the motel portion on the back of the lobby. If you're a bigger family like ours, we suggest you look in to this home unit because it has 3 BR's and a huge living room along with 3 bathrooms (2 fulls) and a gigantic kitchen. The home also has a 2nd story deck that overlooks the mountains. It's more expensive, but very worth it. The management put us up in there for no additional cost because our 2BR unit had a leaky pipe (which was fixed promptly, but they still offered us the free upgrade). The only gripe that we had during our stay was one of the front desk employees was rude to us over the phone because there was some confusion about our family staying an extra night. however, we are chalking that one up to the fact that she was very young. This was a very minor glitch that was well overshadowed by a fantastic stay. I would suggest this place to anyone looking for a family-focused resort in Estes Park.

author: Be-Well-415
title: Clean and Comfortable
text: We were very impressed with our recent stay at Murphy's Resort. I can't say enough about the cleanliness and all-around TLC . I understand from talking to staff that the resort is under new management for the past year or so and that management is putting heart and soul into the renovations. That's an understatement! During our 3 day visit, we saw workers constantly sweeping, pulling weeds and generally busy working around the grounds. The rooms themselves are old-fashioned motel style where you drive right up and park outside your entrance. Our room featured a king bed which was incredibly comfortable. We also had a couch and table and chair - very spacious. I liked the fact the floors were bare wood except for a small area carpet under the bed. The room was meticulous and the bathroom literally sparkled. The only complaint I would have were the towels. They are very thin and very small! Would hope eventually they would upgrade to a higher quality. Murphy's offers a free breakfast - the usual bagels, toast, granola, hard-cooked eggs, etc. Another nice thing is the free DVD rental library - hundreds of titles you can borrow and watch in your room. There is also a nice pool, fire pit, grills and playground for guests to enjoy. Really recommend!

author: johnB7100IG
title: The get-away that was needed
text: We had folks staying with us here in Denver and they picked Murphy's Resort. I decided to follow them up and get a place for myself and my boss and his wife. We both have been under alot of pressure with work, and I figured if I'm playing hooky, maybe I can get him to come as well. The planned work. All you have to do is say two words, Estes Park! My favorite place in the world. Murphy's Resort is a very comfortable and very clean resort. They have a great big (and deep) outdoor pool, an amazing hot tub (huge), outdoor fire pits to relax by (they even supply the wood), a killer breakfast every morning, a lage bbq area with many gas grills ready to go, and a great staff to make you feel at home. My place was amazing with a large kitchen area, private back patio and my own gas grill. Of course that meant I was doing the cooking. As long as there is coldness, I'll cook all day! Holla! We all had a great time. And the steaks came out perfect. BIg shout out to Loretta and her staff!

author: ZoboFlobby
title: Can't say enough good things about this place!
text: I'm in my early 40's and I can remember staying here at least 5 times in my life so I am going to roll back the clock a bit with my review. The title "resort" is well fitting. As a kid in Estes spending 4-5 days cooped up in a Motel while all the parents sat around and talked seemed to be the most boring part... It was the worst. These places had nothing for things to do for the kids but swim while you begged and whined and cried to go do the slide or go carts. I dreamed of a VCR or something ANYTHING to do. Now it's 2015. WOW! Murphys went above and beyond to make the little things available kids want and get their heads out of the iPads! Want to go for a bike ride? No problem grab a bike! Raining? Grab a board game or DVD from the stash! You can see some small projects ongoing to make the place even better. Overall Murphys is exactly what you want a family run place to be... Things the chains will never be. We had a great time, clean room and epic friendly service. 10/10. Like other reviews the wifi is lacking but who cares go outside cell service in Estes is awful too put the phone down and explore :)

author: Gadget665
title: Thanks, Mr. Murphy! Another Great Acquisition!
text: As part of our Murphy's River Lodge deal through Living Social, we were signed up for the Sip and Paint at Murphy's Resort. I was told this property was recently acquired by the owners of Murphy's River Lodge and is currently going through renovations. We only went for the Sip and Paint, but were told this location is geared towards summer vacationers (e.g. outdoor pool, large property, volleyball area, away from downtown), though works great during the winter time. The River Lodge is the opposite (e.g. indoor pool, small property, edge of downtown). The lobby area where they have breakfast is where the class took place. Initially, I was skeptical, but after seeing the reviews, I committed. My wife and I had too much fun! A good part of the enjoyment was due to the two instructors we had, though they were more like "guides" than instructors. They gave tips and suggestions, but you had the option to freelance if you wanted. A blank canvas and plenty of paint to express yourself. Even a glass of wine or other beverage to prepare yourself, if needed. They plan to continue doing this since the response has been really good. I personally hope so. No better combination than Murphy's and Estes Park for this. We hope to stay at this property in the summer. What I have seen of it so far makes me look forward to coming back!

author: 656diannag
title: The Perfect Honeymoon Local
text: We stayed at Murphy's Resort for our Honeymoon in May of 2013. We were greeted by friendly staff in the office who had a lot of knowledge of the area. They were able to tell us some nice places to visit in the area and recommended hiking trails. We met the owner on our second day and once he found out it was our honeymoon, he personally brought up a complimentary bottle of wine. The free breakfast every morning was a huge plus, especially when a lot of our trip consisted of hiking, white water rafting and other forms of exercise. It was essential to have a large, healthy and FREE breakfast! Other amenities include a pool & hot tub on site. We stayed in one of the rooms on the river. It was so relaxing hearing the river go by at night and spending time on the balcony just drinking wine. It was the perfect way to end the days. I would highly recommend the balcony room on the river's side. The location was also great for us. It's walking distance from shopping and a couple restaurants. It was the perfect location for us as we were looking for a private, romantic and adventurous Honeymoon. If we visit Estes Park again, we will definitely be staying here!

author: Q4271XWdavidr
title: Fun place, great location
text: We visited Murphy's Resort on the last weekend of summer. They are conveniently placed near some really fun things. There's mini-golf, go-carts, horseback riding, and a few good restaurants. They're a 5 minute drive to downtown. The rooms themselves were nice. The heater worked, the beds were comfortable. The decor was the typical rustic Colorado mountain decor. The TV worked, and they had a great selection of movies you can borrow. They invite a local guitar player to entertain guests at the firepit. He was very good with a great repertoire. Elk came down into the grounds. It was really cool. Our kids loved the playground. They have a number of games for adults, like beanbag toss and disc golf. My only complaint: The wifi was very spotty, but that's typical for Estes Park.

author: Marleebus
title: Murphy's Resort is awesome!
text: We stayed at Murphy's Resort Sep. 19 and 20. This too-short trip assured us, as Coloradans, that we will be back, it will be soon and it will be as often as possible. The resort is at the tip of Lake Estes, covers several green acres and is somewhat of a throwback to a different time. And I mean a throwback in the VERY best sense of the term! It has the feel and comfort of the era of family resorts of decades ago, with lovely, fresh new updates. The decor is current, the rooms are very spacious, clean, well appointed and just downright comfortable. To include very comfy beds with heaps of really nice pillows. You can walk over to the office and choose from over 1000 movie and game DVD's, get any assistance deciding where to eat, which hike to do today, rent a bike, etc. Each room has a table and chairs outside the door, and it's a treat to just open your door and sit and absorb the mountain air. The continental breakfast has something for everyone and is VERY convenient. The Lake is beautiful, and for those unable or not interested in the endless wonderful hikes and trails in Rocky Mountain Natioral Park and all around you... take a leisurely stroll around the lake. The staff is quite obviously very carefully hired. The mamagers are a married couple, and their staff is as professional and knowledgable as a concierge staff in a 4 or 5 star hotel. Seriously. So just stay there and see.

author: MF195
title: Reasonable, clean, good location
text: Convenient location for visiting Rocky Mountain National Park. Customer service was very friendly and helpful. Nice call a week prior to our arrival to confirm our reservation. Room was large, clean and the bed was comfortable. Room also had a desk & chair in addition to a high table and 2 chairs plus stuffed chair, microwave and frig. One of the very few places that have a safe in the room for your valuables (medico lock key available at the office for you to sign out). WiFi access was free and very good. Full bathroom plus a sink vanity area. The bathroom has soap and shampoo dispensers instead of bar soap and bottle shampoo. The guest laundry only has 1 washer ($2) and 1 dryer ($1). Breakfast was adequate. This was originally an Econo lodge that was renovated. It is still a little rough around the edges. The windows are single glaze and the outlets are inconvenient for charging electronics. Need a dead bolt on the door instead of just a chain lock.

author: wbrault
title: Great stay
text: We eloped to Estes Park and Rocky Mountain National Park. The staff at Murphy's were very friendly and offered to provide suggestions and directions to places in the area. The room was fine and big enough for the two of us. It was also very clean and quiet. You get to park right outside your door. We only spent our time there sleeping and showering. A few times we came back we saw people utilizing the horse shoes and other actives on the property. The rooms are remodeled and the one we had was fine. The water was hot, the pressure was good. We didn't try the breakfast but I did peep inside the room and the room looked nice. There isn't really anything bad that could be said about the place for our trip, but I am sure some people will dig for something. Everyone has different tastes, and likes but this was perfect for us. If I had to pick one negative thing I would go with the wireless internet. It was up and down. Even that doesn't make this close to a bad trip, but like I said if I had to pick one bad thing that would be it.

author: 983guyt
title: Great all round with a few free extras
text: Large room. Fridge w freezer. Microwave. Wifi works in rooms. Flat screen tv. Exercise room. Pool. Jacuzzi. Free ice. Free kids and adult outdoor games. Free dvds. Free souvenir picture on wooden horse in proper plastic frame to take as memento. Outdoor bbq and communal seating area. Pool was warm and lovely views. Toddler pool. Overall great.

author: JGo52
title: A-Plus Service!
text: It would be hard to find a friendlier and more caring staff. The beds were comfortable as advertised and the room was spacious and well appointed. During our six night stay the room the cleaning staff did an excellent job on a daily basis. All items were in good working order—microwave, fridge, hair dryer. This resort is very family friendly with many outdoor amenities. I particularly enjoyed the breakfast room with its pine decor and vaulted ceiling. The first morning I asked if they had any green tea. Unfortunately, they did not. But that was taken care of for the rest of the week. It's often the little things that make a lasting impression. On a very personal note my wife had an accident in Rocky Mountain National Park while hiking on our last full day. She was airlifted to a trauma centre near Denver. By the time I hiked down the mountain and returned to Murphy's resort it was 11:15pm and I had to disturb the managers after another long and busy day. Loretta and Bruce jumped into action retrieving phone numbers, addresses and printing off driving directions to the hospital. Their genuine concern for the both of us was greatly appreciated. You can rest assured that Loretta and Bruce will do all they can to make your stay an enjoyable one. Thanks to the entire staff at Murphy's,we hope to see you soon. Jim G.

author: michaelhJ4178YF
title: Excellent family experience!
text: We recently had a 7-night stay here with my wife and 3 kids (6, 4, and 1). This was one of our favorite places we ever stayed at. The resort is on the east end of town, only a few minutes from Rocky Mountain Nat'l Park and right next to the marina. We could go hiking all morning, then come back and the kids would play tetherball, or play in the playset, or enjoy any of the enormous range of activities they have. My 6-year old loved playing beanbag toss with me. They also have shuffleboard, horseshoes, ladder ball, and lots of other stuff available. One of our favorite things was going the the farmers market (open every Thursday morning) and then bringing our food back and grilling it that night on one of their numerous grills. The hot spa and pool were godsends after hiking all day - the facilities were always clean and never too crowded. I think we swam pretty much every night they liked it so much - and the spa is indoors so even when it was raining we could enjoy it! All the staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and the free breakfast each morning was a great way to start the day! Friendly tip: they put snacks for the kids in the drawer under the coffee that they can grab after eating. Also, there's a Safeway right down the road for anything you need. The room was great as well. We stayed in a 2-bedroom suite with a tv and dvd player in each room. Brought some dvds for the kids and that helped keep the kids quiet and in their own room at night, which helped us enjoy out vacation all the more. The jacuzzi tub was also a wonderful way to relax. All in all, one of the most pleasant places we've stayed at with our family. Great views of the rockies, good rooms, and a plethora of activities. I can't speak to how nice it would be for a couple, but for families I haven't seen anything like it!

author: 783SteveS
title: A great stay with great prople
text: We really didn't know what to expect. The reviews were good, but ....... we haven't had many good experiences with privately owned hotels. Murphy's is very clean and a nice place to stay. Our room (105) had two queen beds that were great for sleeping. Murphy's does have one quirk, the shower head. It was only 5 foot high. We all came to like the height because we felt it was part of the resort's charm. The pool and the hot tub were clean and functional. The hot tub depth went to 5 feet. It was great after a long day of hiking. We also liked the horseshoe and ladder ball games. The managers, Loretta and Bruce were excellent. They were attentive to our needs. Bruce even had wood delivered to the fire ring for a night time fire. A side note, they have grills that guests can use and the maintenance staff cleans the grills daily. Because of the facilities and the staff, we plan on returning very soon.

author: 899marilync
title: Very clean, but.....
text: This is a old resort that has been renovated and is located just a few miles from downtown. It is very clean and has laminate wood and ceramic tile flooring. I love not having carpet! The mattress and pillows are very comfortable. The bedding is all white so you know it's clean. Wifi is free and has a great signal. They provided plenty of towels and toiletries, and have a refrigerator and microwave. There is a playground, grill and picnic area, and hot tub. The pool is old but large and very clean. Staff is very nice and a continental breakfast is provided. Our main complaint is the bathroom. It is very small with just enough room for a toilet and small fiberglass shower. It is smaller than any cruise ship bathroom I have ever been in. Also, the TV is too small for the room. When I mentioned the bathroom on checkout, I was told that since we requested one queen bed, we got the economy room and that is the only one with that bathroom setup. They should warn everyone about that because we would definitely have paid the extra money to have a real bathroom. We think the resort is overpriced; however this is only the second mountain resort we have ever stayed in. I'm not sure what the norm is.

author: lindsaya855
title: They saved our weekend
text: We brought our kids up for a camping trip, our 1 year old was just not having it. After the 2nd night of little to no sleep we hit our limit. My husband came to Murphy's exhausted and at our wits end. He explained our situation and they were able to get us into a room right away. I am very picky when it come to hotel rooms and even so exhausted I walked in and was so excited. We were able to get a two room suite (perfect with kids). It was spotless, the beds are comfy and have nice linens. Once we all got a nice long nap we really enjoyed the hot tub and pool area, jetted tub in our room and the kids playground. Our room has a nice fridge and microwave which has been very handy, plus windows that open to get some mountain air in! We just played a nice round of horse shoes! In the common area there are plenty of BBQ grills, a fire pit, lots of yard games and the property is very very nicely maintained. It is walking distance to the lake, and a quick drive to down town. The customer service is amazing! We booked our 4th of July trip our first night here. We could not be happier and more thankful for Murphy's and their amazing staff!

author: Ricktig
title: Quiet stay at dated hotel
text: My wife and I stayed two nights at Murphy's Resort for her birthday weekend. We were enthusiastically checked in by Casey and given a room towards the end of the second building. The lobby had an odd smell to it but was clean. Ample parking was available in front of the room which has an outside door. The room was clean and well decorated. We visited the sauna which is just across the parking lot. The sauna water temperature was warm but none of the jets really produced any water pressure. The bed was comfortable and the room was very quiet. We ate breakfast at the in-hotel continental breakfast. The food was fresh and the selection was reasonable - yogurt, cereal, hard boiled eggs, danish, juice, coffee. Overall, the stay was comfortable and pleasant. I knocked down the rating to three stars for three reasons. First, I paid $300 for the two nights. The hotel is rather plain and a bit dated. It is still off-season and the hotel was nearly empty. I would have expected to pay $200 for this stay. Second, the sauna was a disappointment with its lack of working jets. Third, the hotel overall is still a bit dated. It has been renovated but could use some additional updates to windows, doors, and the sauna area. Overall, we had a nice stay and at a lower price I'd stay here again.

author: 55penelope
title: Relaxing New Year's Stay
text: We bought a 2 night stay package as part of a Living Social deal, and we upgraded to a room with a fireplace. We have had a lot of bad luck with similar online deals, so we did not have high expectations, but we were pleasantly surprised. The rooms are not fancy, but they are very clean and very comfortable. We were surprised at the big suite we had and the nice extras. The bed was much more comfortable than most hotel beds. We had a living room, small kitchen (full size refrigerator, microwave & stove top)/dining room, 2 TV's, a private patio with a grill, 2 person Jacuzzi tub, shower and comfortable bedroom. The fireplace was double sided, in the living room and the bedroom. There were utensils and supplies in the kitchen, and would have been convenient to eat in our room. The continental breakfast was nice and they had DVD's and games you could use for free. The outside facilities were also plentiful with a pool, hot tub, grills, tables, etc. We did have trouble with our fireplace and they got it working on New Years Eve. The owner, Bruce, offered us a new room or to show us how to fix it when it acted up. They were very apologetic about not being able to get a repair person there on a holiday, and wanted to make sure we were happy. I would definitely stay here again. I think it would be a nice place to stay for several days in the summer time when you can take advantage of the outdoors and you want to be able to fix some of your own meals.

author: D8579MEjohnf
title: Great service, caring people.
text: I booked a room for three nights at Murphy's Resort. After the first night I developed altitude sickness. The staff made me an appointment with an oxygen bar to see if the oxygen therapy would take care of the altitude sickness. It only worked for a short time. As the hours passed I wasn't getting any better and I knew I would have to go to a lower elevation to correct the problem. I was somewhat concerned because I was traveling alone and if I became much worse then driving down the mountain could become a problem. The next closest town at a lower elevation was 15 of 20 miles away. The manager was concerned about my condition and not only offered to book me a room in the other town but volunteered to drive me down the mountain! I was able to make it on my own. I stayed at a lower elevation for two days. Then I called Murphy's to see if my other two days were still available. This would have been the Friday and Saturday nights of the Scottish Irish Highlands Festival which is a big event in Estes Park. They let me have my room for those two days at the same rate as I was paying earlier in the week. They could have easily rented the rooms for a higher rate to someone else but didn't. The motel was recently renovated with new beds, furniture, bathrooms, etc. Complete interior makeover. This is the kind of service and concern that is difficult to come by in any business and especially the hotel business. The staff at Murphy's WILL go beyond what is expected to take care of their guests. The next time I am in Estes Park I will definitely stay at Murphy's Resort. I highly recommend them.

author: Mark_and_Jackie_R
title: Great location, great deal!
text: This is a great place to stay! Even with plenty of people around it was nice and quiet. It was perfect for family because we could relax and the kids could have fun with minimal effort. We played at the playground on site, walked over to the lake which is beautiful and close, swam in the pool and enjoyed the hot tub. We loved that there are so many grills to use and the grounds are beautiful and there are so many improvements and nicely designed elements being added. Our kids loved getting to choose movies to borrow as well. Breakfast was wonderful with lots of variety which is important to us. They were constantly checking it so nothing ran low or out. It's in a nice open and bright room which is kept extremely clean. The managers were super helpful with recommending places for us to eat in town based on the type of food and price range we offered. They were generally friendly and interested. We talked to the owners who are great people and described some of their ideas and future plans. We look forward to returning and seeing them develop! Our room had an amazing view; it looked right over the lake and the mountains are an amazing backdrop. The brand new mattress and the bedding was super comfortable. We got an amazing nights sleep. It was the perfect way for us to spend the last night of our vacation! We talked to several other people who had also really enjoyed their stay. Great choice!

author: joytredway
title: My favorite brag
text: We were just there a couple weeks ago (coming from Colorado Springs) and were so pleased with the place, we're giving serious consideration to making a second go next weekend. The value can't be beat. Ok, sure, so maybe a piece of furniture or two in the room clearly stands out as dated, but who cares. The place is CLEAN, which is most important to me. Even the dated bathroom fixtures- I have no idea how they got it all so clean, but it's impressive. The rooms are also bigger than most new rooms. You can almost see their priority list of upgrades, and I have to say they got it exactly right. I'd totally take a new mattress over a new end table piece or dresser or random chair. Frankly, I kinda hope they leave the place EXACTLY as is. Too many more upgrades and I'm afraid they'd up the price. I like it just how it is. Breakfast is awesome, too. More than enough. I didn't see any complaints in the few reviews i browsed, but if there are any, I guarantee its wrong. Oh, and there was an elk in the grass area in our first morning. Such a COOL place, clean, great value, love it!!!!!!!

author: Travel78746
title: A view of Lakes Estes at this motel
text: This was a nice motel with a view of Lake Estes through our particular window. The room was quite large and clean. Free WiFi and breakfast. Nice folks. They have a pool and hot tub that I didn't get to use (bad headache from elevation that night). They even have grills that guests can use out by the pool. Perfect weather. Don't forget to visit Estes Park Brewing Company. Each room has a table and chairs so you can sit outside in the evening. They are renovating their rooms at the moment. All rooms have new beds and they are working their way around. Fridge and microwave. They have connecting rooms for families. A few things are a bit strange, but it just comes from remodeling an old property. I think the hair dryers are antiques, but they worked fine.

author: 709markd
title: WOW!!!!!! What a change.
text: I looked at a lot of places and had to give this place a second chance. My wife and I stayed here I believe last year or maybe two years ago. After our stay my wife was ready to kill me. The place was old, run down and pretty much sucked. I pretty much begged her to stay here again.....then she reminded me of the filled in kiddie pond. I almost gave into her wishes until I remembered hearing that the awesome couple who turned Murphy's River Lodge around we're now at Murphy's Resort this was a no brainier. OH MY GOSH what a change. Loretta and Bruce you two are miracle makers. We loved the place and have already started planning a large family trip for next summer. I've never meet two people/couple that have it all going. They made your stay so special words can't even explain. Bruce at breakfast in the morning was something I found myself looking forward to every night as I went to bed. Loretta was a blast. Every opportunity she had to make our stay better she took full advantage of it and impressed the heck out of us. Her knowledge of Estes for where to eat, what to do, where the best coffee is and much more. Bruce and Loretta Thank You for the wonderful time and the great changes you two have done. I can't wait to see the place on our next trip out.

author: YaniQuij
title: PEOPLE ORIENTED HOTEL
text: My trip to Privato Hotel was short yet fulfilling. I get to meet a few employees who turned out to be such an eye opener. I can see that they are having a hard time balancing everything with their job and others but I can see how they strive to be a step ahead. How they want to accommodate everyone. I have witnessed a Front Desk Agent try her best to deescalate a guest who has been very bitchy about some stuff. I wasn't able to hear the entire story but it was clear to me that Contessa(just glanced on her nameplate) is a team player. She stood on her own eventhough her guest was already cursing her. I don't know how she did that but she speaks well and sounded positive trying to assist the guest. I know she's great because I was a frontliner too. If that happened to me I'd just leave and cry. lol. Kidding aside, everyone was just plain professional. Everyone especially those in the service industry doesn't deserve to be treated down. They may smile always but you'll never know how painful your words can hurt them. Housekeeping were also great. RJ, Abdul, etc. They always smile and greet you everytime. Thank you Privato. You are proving that people in the service industry are to be respected. Will definitely be back.

author: korinas462
title: Clean, friendly, and affordable
text: This was my first hotel after about 30 hours of travel. I came in very late at night and the hotel greeted me kindly. She mentioned some of the amenities/breakfast. A gentleman helped me to my room. There was a small issue with the lock, but it didn’t bother me because they were so friendly and quick to fix. The room was clean and comfortable. I really loved the view from the 19th floor!!! I also visited the rooftop pool just to view and it was beautiful. The lady up there showed me a better place to get a picture and view. I also visited the dining room for breakfast (only 350P). It was small and few options but convenient before I had to head back to the airport. Before I was leaving I called a taxi and the gentleman offered to carry my bag. The taxi was in traffic and he stood outside and even got an umbrella to hold so I would get wet when it started sprinkling rain. I was just impressed with the hospitality. I booked another night with them my last night in the Philippines. I am glad to know I will have a good night of rest in a clean hotel. :)

author: MycsA1
title: We made the right choice by choosing Privato as our wedding venue!
text: I can sum this up to three things: 1. Customer Service - The staff, regardless from which department they are from, offers excellent quality of customer service. I should know because I work for customer service. 2. Exceeded our expectations - We chose Privato Hotel for our wedding just because of the location and we didn't know we were getting more out of it. During the preparations, (few months from the wedding day) Privato has been very accommodating to the point that they really showed us our options. Special shout out to Miguel and Naria. An example would be: we requested a simple background for our special day and they have provided more than what we expected. The venue (Firenze) captured what we wanted for that special day, and they really provided more than what we hoped for. Which also leads me to my third point which is the facilities. 3. The venue, The rooms, The bridal suite, everything, all of these are what we wanted and needed. The food is amazing, the breakfast was awesome! We really can't thank Privato enough with the service they provided to cater to our special day. Thank you! Our wedding will be even more memorable because of you. Sincerely, #MySy

author: juliedM179SQ
title: Cheap hotel. Cheap on everything!
text: Staff are friendly and courteous. The room is not comfortable. We cant sleep. You can hear loud sound of vehicles passing the street. Hotel is not sound proof. Swimming Pool, think before you dip. Only 1 shampoo, conditioner and soap given to 2 person. Very low quality, it will make your hair very dry. Toothpaste wont even clean your teeth. VERY OLD, DARK TOWELS!!! Disgusting. Its use is for the floor not for your customers. There are better hotels around and throwing a little more bucks will give you the comfort of checking in a hotel. Very disappointed. Not recommended for people who came from another country especially Balikbayans. I got itched with the bed .. don't know why..

author: jamyu2016
title: Disastisfying and disappointing
text: Front desk was very accomodating. But everything else. Horrible! I asked housekeeping for water around 9pm at Feb 21 and it never came. They asked if I have an MV or Miscellaneous Voucher with me. I don't honestly know what the hell that is. The next day I asked for it again and again they asked if I had an MV with me, I told them again I didn't. Yet they gave me their water. I was half asleep and didn't get mad at them anymore. Cleanliness was also a problem. The bathroom sink has molds forming ontop of it's splash guard. It was disgusting. Ontop of that the whole hotel was poorly constructed in such a way that the noise that other guests create just bounces off. Amplifying it and making it louder and louder as if they're having a speech. I higly advise that they should carpet their walls or flooring so that there's SOME sound-proofing to the hotel. My whole stay was uncomfortable. Woke up thirsty for water and none had attended to my need. Needless to say, I AM NEVER COMING BACK!!

author: JessicaTheWanderer
title: CHRISTMAS STAYCATION
text: My family and I decided to have a staycation for Christmas Eve (Dec 24-25). We decided to try Privato Hotel since it was affordable. We got a deluxe room with twin size beds for P 4312 (good for 4 adults) using aisatravel.com, breakfast is not included. We paid 250 each separately. We got to the hotel a little bit late, we arrived i think at 3pm. When we got there they told us that our room is not yet ready, tho knowing that it should be prepared by 2pm because it was the standard check in time. They were also suggesting if we like to have the smoking room instead? This was the biggest turn off for me. No one smokes in my family so we waited for atleast 30 mins for them to find the regular room which we booked online. The room was spacious enough. Beds were nice and there is a provided hot and cold shower. What i just noticed was there is a "canal" like smell coming from the drainage in the cr. The elevators are also a big turn off for me because it is so slow that people are already piling up whenever at the lobby, the waiting area for the elevator is not spacious enough to accomodate everyone. Pool is just 4 ft deep and i think it was a turn off for me too :( But, Breakfast buffet area was a plus points for me, interiors were very modern yet classy. As for the food, it was a good meal for 250pesos. They served pancakes, rice, pansit, different fresh fruits and even desserts :) So i suggest getting one. But what i liked about the hotel is that their courteous staff. They were very eager to help us when we booked grab, they are the ones who waited for it outside. :)

author: eroma_25
title: Almost Perfect
text: Great location, clean hotel, peaceful ambience, and the hotel staff is by far the best I've encountered! I don't stay much in hotels in Manila. Compared to those I've been in other countries, these people are the friendliest and most courteous ever.Every personnel you see in all parts of the hotel will greet you with a smile. We even had a cool conversation with some. Shout out to Gab and the other two girls at the Verona Bar! -I had an issue with my reservation and they upgraded our room for free. (Premium: with mini fridge, stove and dining table) They even allowed us to borrow a pan without additional charge. -In room massage was good, but the other therapist was a little bit too nosy. -The bathroom in our room stinks, I think there's a problem with the drainage or something. -We got fined Php3000.00 for smoking in the room, which is more expensive than our room package! But blah, we're guilty anyway. Will I go back? HELL YEAH. The great staff is enough reason to overlook the minimal flaws. I'll just make sure I request for a smoking room next time. :)

author: rittyp
title: Affordable staycation but might not book again
text: I booked the Executive Twin Room at Booking.com for P2,134.06 for an overnight stay from April 15-16, 2017. We were able to check in early at around 1 pm and was given a room at the 22nd floor facing BGC. The room size was adequate with two twin sized beds. The thin, overused towels were frayed at the edges and dirty white in color. A small 20 ml shampoo bottle , two toothbrush sets and a soap was at the sink. Bathroom was clean however you can see that the building contractor did a lousy job with the bathroom and room finishing, with the bathroom grout and tiles not properly laid and the wall haphazardly and carelessly painted. There was no pad and pencil available at the desk (essential for taking notes while using the phone). Beds are comfy but the pillows are not fluffy. Wi-Fi connection is almost nonexistent since there was no connection from 8 pm in the evening until the next day. I raised this concern with the front desk officer the next day but all she can do was apologize for the wifi problem and just offered an extended two hour stay in our room (which I really do not need). The pool at the 23rd floor was small yet safe for kids to swim. However the pool water was not as clear as the day before and stings our eyes (chlorine overload, I guess). They are also not strict regarding imposing proper swimming attire, with most of the guests wearing tank tops, tshirts, shorts, and underwear. I cannot comment on their food since we decided to just eat at the fastfood joints nearby. The staff were courteous and accomodating, and so far this is the only positive thing I can say about this hotel. Overall I cannot really complain about the physical aspect of this hotel since I paid a fairly cheap amount for my overnight stay. I am just sad to realize that this hotel has potential if only it was maintained well and the interiors properly done by its building contractor.

author: grouchygurlette
title: Great Family Staycation
text: We stayed here together with my 2 kids since 1. I need to rest since I came from laser eye surgery 2. A great way to spend quality time with my kids. Since I have been working in a hotel, I know what to look for. Check-in was easy, reception was very nice. The lady with short hair (sorry cannot see your names in your nameplate) is very nice. Our room is okay, my kids love the view, unfortunately they can't open the windows since my eyes are very sensitive to light. We had a slight problem with the TV remote but no need to call for assistance. We love how the place is near other establishments like drugstore and other resto plus you can go to Shangri-la Mall and Megamall via public transpo. We went to their roofdeck in the evening and we love the view of the city. They have this wall which is IG worthy. My kids love their gym and pool is covered. Too bad we were not able to try the pool due to my condition. That night they had an internet maintenance but they sent notices and had a back up at the lobby in case you need to browse the web. Overall we love our stay. Great job Privato.

author: 990marionc
title: blantant disappointment
text: I decided to book a stay in the hotel so I could relax away from home and be able to work. However, in consideration of the amount I paid for, I was really disappointed. The rooms were okay, they were clean and nicely placed (we got a room at the 15th floor) but the following were really substandard. 1. My mate checked in before I did, so he was already in the room. I came up with a significant baggage but no one from the staff even asked if I needed help with my bags. They did however greet me good afternoon (WOW) 2. NO WIFI IN THE ROOM. THIS WAS THE WORST. I had to go down to the lobby to work. Despite repeated prompting, no adjustments were made. 3. Breakfast selection is BLEH. You should see it yourself. I don't recommend staying here and I wont stay here again. Salamat!

author: 380miguelp
title: Very Pleased
text: Stayed over for half the weekend from Friday through Saturday, Privato is a very good choice for a place to stay within the area, the immediate surrounds of Capitol Commons and the numerous bars and restaurants in the Kapitolyo area should be enough to make for an interesting stay. The hotel itself is very charming, I liked the lobby but they could work a little bit more on the coffee shop in it. My room (2208) was upgraded to the 22nd floor, it was clean, had enough space and two queen sized beds, the usual flat screen TV, mini refrigerator, closet and a study table. Its not that big but the space was enough, perhaps a sitting area for 2 could still be fitted in it by removing one of the queen sized beds but thats just me. Although I was pretty satisfied with my room there are still some things left for improvement, like some of the visible cracks and wears on the wall could be attended to as well as better lighting in the shower area of the bathroom, though it had a florescent light it still seemed pretty dark in the shower area. The building itself and the amenities are fine. My partner and I also made use roof deck bar, the prices were actually reasonable, we saw a gym and a pool there but we weren't able to take advantage of it during our stay. About the service, my experience was great! Although my reservation was booked through Agoda the night before, I contacted the Hotel Reservations personnel to ask if I could move my reservation to earlier instead of my original time, which luckily since there were available rooms my request was accommodated. From my office, I also asked if they could stock my ref with a few beers since I noticed it was empty when I checked in which they did so. I felt that the staff whom I engaged with, gave their best efforts to make my stay a pleasant one. The only points I'd say that needs improvement would be: 1. Well there are only two elevator shafts and 23 floors, and the elevators aren't that big, so waiting for one can sometimes take time. 2. They should add more food choices in the menu, seriously, please do! 3. I think the towels (in my room at least) should be retired. All in all, it was a good stay, I'd recommend Privato to anyone looking for a budget friendly boutique hotel in the area, I'd definitely come back even just for the roof deck bar. Keep up the good job Privato staff, thank you.

author: johnny624
title: Hotel run by Students thanks to Enderun
text: Let me begin with the rooms. I was made to check in into 2 rooms before ending up in the 3rd and where I eventually stayed in for 2 nights. 1st room I was assigned to smelled like a sewer: it stank and smelled like a canal. The 2nd one, the toilet bowl had not been cleaned and there was urine on the seat. The rooms a basic and are nothing great. High ceiling is the only thing going for this hotel. The bathroom was disgusting with strands of hair in the corners of the toilet and the smell was not clean at all. I used slippers even when in the shower: that's how dirty it was. The hotel is relatively new and based on the photos of the brochure and on the website, it looked like a wonderfully designed and decorated hotel. I was wrong and the photos are misrepresenting what the rooms are like. The doors are thin so every noise made in the hallway can be heard in the room. TV is very small and the most bothersome thing about the room is the oddly placed cabinet for the clothes. It was obviously not fitted for the space and made the room feel even smaller. The hotel is managed by the Enderun School which explains why the hotel fails in every aspect from service down to the facilities and amenities: all run by kids who don't know a thing about what and how 4-5 star hotels are run. The hotel felt like a high end motel at the most.

author: Explorer806499
title: Elegant Budget Hotel
text: This is our third time to book in Privato. The first two were mid 2015 and I must say that it stays the same -good old staycation! Pros: - Staff are all courteous. Everybody greets you, everybody is friendly and they are all attentive and helpful in case you need anything. - The rooms are fresh and always clean. Bathroom is spotless as always. - Location is superb. Easy to find and easy to get a ride. Centrally located in the city and you can easily find recreation spots around. Cons: - The bathroom had no rug and the tiles are extremely slippery when wet. My toddler fell twice because of this :( - They now have a corkage fee for food and drinks. Back in 2015, there weren't any limits on this. We understand that their restaurant is available but there are very LIMITED FOOD OPTIONS that's why we never ate here. :( if you're okay to go out to grab and eat some food, then this shouldn't bother you. The overall rating of this hotel is really superb in my honest opinion. But sometimes, it's really a disappointment. Especially when you want to have some midnight snack.

author: mayigarchi
title: On point!
text: At your first entrance - you are greeted with warm staff and treated very fairly. Amenities - they have this amazing pool, that I love. Although the shower room was just outside, that's the only problem I had. Since we wanted to proceed to the restaurant, I needed to wash up, so I just washed up in the outside shower, as their comfort room do not have shower. Restaurant - bit pricey for small amounts. The liquor we ordered was not very good. Parking - was weird. Once you get here, you'll know why. Environment - it's beside Chowking, so we had our dinner here. There was also a KFC - 3min walking distance, and was near Capitol Commons. :) Rooms - finally, something I love. Beds were fluffy, I think it's normal for them to have 2 beds in a deluxe room, and surprisingly, it was huge. Comfort room was very minimalist and on point as well. Good airconditioning. Comfortable sleep it is. Coffee was also included and helped us survive the next day since it's a workday. Elevators - kinda small Still a must- try. I availed this through a dealgrocer coupon, but it was very worth it.

author: josemarie737
title: Nice place to stay
text: Everyone was so nice specially the staff during the day. Everyone will greet you and welcome you. I just wish they know your name when they greet you. Some hotels do that (just a tip). Not sure if staff are new or intern but when you talk to them it feels like rehearsed.,specially when they are giving you instructions when you check in. Also pool and sky deck closes very early. Only 10pm and it's already closed. Hope they can extend it until 12. Sadly, they do charge you 200 php for corkage when food exceeded for 2 person. Room,refrigerator is very small. Over all. the experience was amazing. Very relaxing, quiet and location is very strategic. You can walk to alot,of restos, specially gastro park. Very comfy bed. Definitely will,stay there again.

author: gumbo08
title: Reminds me of budget hotels in Hong Kong
text: The lobby had a chic style. The receptionists are really attentive, accommodating and polite. The rooms were secured with key card locks, that you use in the elevator as well. The room reminds me of budget hotels in Hong Kong. We stayed in the Executive King room. It was simple, bathroom is not very exquisite. Only basic toiletries are present. Water pressure is good, but the towels are like those in Victoria Court, it's getting dark and needs to be replaced with new and fluffy ones. The space is ok, you can move freely inside. What I like about this hotel is that they are not very strict with rules. You can also ask for additional toiletries if necessary. They have a pool, but water is only 4 feet deep. It's great that they also have a gym, and the machines are in good condition. The view from the deck (on the side of Verona) is relaxing and beautiful, although you can also work your photography skills on the view from the pool's side. The location is strategic, very near the food hubs in which Pasig is getting famous for. You can just walk to Estancia, Capitol Commons and the new GastroPark, and some other cozy restaurants as well. Still, had a good experience here, not bad because it's affordable and decent.

author: LexieG575
title: Just good hotel
text: I saw Privato Hotel being advertised at Facebook. It was really nice in the advertisement that 's why we got curious and have it check. As soon as we were there, the lobby was really nice and smells good upon entry. Their front desk clerk was friendly and accommodating. I also saw her on how she responded to an irate guest. She was able to handled it well. She remained calm and her voice still remained friendly. I just pity her for having such an arrogant guest. Keep up the good work! I was not able to get her name to give her due recognition. Anyway, their check in was a breeze. The room that we had was a bit small. It's just good for couples. The pool was not deep for the safety of everyone. Their buffet bfast was only at 350/pax.

author: Chiquichichay
title: Staycation on a budget
text: We booked at Privato hotel last Nov 14. I made an error with the date of booking and Ms. Marah was nice to change it with no additional cost. Our staycation was good. The room with twin bed is enough for me and my boyfriend, though we are eyeing a room with one bed (they offer king size bed). The room is clean and equipped with basic needs such as hair dryer, coffee maker set, bottled water, mini ref, tv and vault. The wifi connection is also good and stable. Only problem is the aircon which doesn't work properly. The wholetime that we were there the coldest temperature that we had is 23°which is still pretty hot and humid, after a while it went back to 26°. It hadn't reached the set temperature of 18° Bathroom is small, but clean with complete toiletries. Flush in our room seems to have a problem, you need to press it real hard for it to work. We availed the buffet breakfast, as we don't want to hassle ourselves to go out and eat. The choices are limited but fulfilling. The food for room service is offers also limited option. Considering that the hotel doesn't allow outside food inside the hotel, I think they should work out their menus. Staff are nice and courteous. They have the warm smiles ready to greet the hotel guests. They also answers queries politely. All in all, we had fun staying in Privato and getting the R&R that we need :)

author: mks_reyes
title: Privato Hotel - A wonderful place for our family
text: We were booked for a twin bedroom deluxe room dated September 2, 3 and 4 of 2015. It was me and my kids first time to see my husband / their papa after 3 long years of working abroad. It was my first choice since we only live in Kapitolyo Pasig. MS.ANGELIQUE was very accommodating and patiently helped me with the booking process. I was about to book online since the offer via web offers a good discount rather than booking directly thru their site. But when I called the hotel directly Ms. Angelique was kind enough to give me the same discounted rate from the net. I immediately grabbed it. What made our stay so special was during the booking I requested Ms.Angelique if they can do a special request, That is to place us on a higher floor for the kids to have a good view outside and to prepare a small and simple Welcome Home banner situated in our room to surprise my husband. They said they will try but cannot promise. Unexpectedly as we entered the room, it was decorated so nicely. The Welcome Home message surprised my husband and of course made me and my kids so happy. I cannot Thank you enough for the effort they did. I will definitely go back to this hotel due to the memorable experience. just one side note, I know our room is not that expensive, but I suggest if they could make the room a little more spacious. But again, we had an excellent experience!!!

author: Benchmark33
title: Good place to stay in the middle of the city...
text: The place is nice. Not so grand. Had an overnight stacation with the whole fam. The room got a little kitchenet with pan. (We were not able to cook our own food coz we are not thay prepared). The view of our room is the Estancia Mall Pasig (capitol Commons). We had dinner there and in my opinion, their food is expensive and the serving is too small - not a good value for the money. Much better to eat out - we had to go out at night to buy at Shakey's since we are not fully satisfied with the serving of their food. They had a great city view of BGC (on their dining hall). The kids pool is clean (too much chlorine)...sorry no adult pool available. Hallway is not ok especially when you are waiting for the "slow" elevator because it is too hot...no aircon or any fan in the hallway. Probably to save electricity. I suggest to have a faster elevator or better yet provide an electric fan in the elevator/hall way area. Their room is very comfy. Bed and pillows are soft and clean. Comfort room is clean too. But don't expect the looks of the room is grand as a 5 star hotel. Overall, just an average place for us. But still a great place to stay in the middle of the city.

author: rjdexplorer
title: Great Beds and Nice City View
text: The ostrich wire art made by Ann Pamintuan amazed me upon my entry on the lobby of the hotel. The lobby has limited number of lounge chairs so during check-in/out time, guests also dominate the dining area of their Cookie Bar. Checking-in was a breeze one after providing the necessary details. The executive twin room we got is facing south, giving us a view of the city skylines of BGC, Makati, and part of Ortigas. The entire window converts into a great frame of city lights considering the skyscrapers during the evening. Room is a bit crowded but the comforts it provides is literally on the bed. We called it a night around 12midnight and we found ourselves turning off our alarms, woke up at 8AM. The room has a small working desk, coffee and tea making facility, fridge, safety box, hot and cold shower, and toiletries. The pool on the roof-deck is only 3-ft deep so we were a bit sad when we found about it. Next to the pool is a fitness center. Room rates sometimes don’t include the complimentary breakfast being offered at Piazza Privato. If you want to chill and enjoy the city view during the evening, Verona Bar, on the roof-deck is a great place to hang out. Try the different pastries being offered in Cookie Bar especially the cookie cup, you’ll not be disappointed. One thing I wish they could improve on is the servicing of the elevators (maybe they can add more?). They only have 2 lifts that service the 22-floor hotel, so waiting time is a bit longer. Another thing is the shower area having no doors (or even curtains) that separates it from the toilet so expect a wet floor when someone has used it. But good thing is, the toilet has a bidet.

author: scheksi
title: Room for Improvement
text: Privato has a nice clean room, with the very basic amenities, although there's not much space to move around. In-room compliments are just water tea/coffee, plus basic toiletries. We also didn't have a problem with the Wi-Fi. Customer service is very helpful and accommodating. No hassle reserving and checking in/out. We didn't try the pool, as it was quite small, and there was already a group of people taking a dip. Breakfast buffet has good yummy choices, considering the price. We didn't have the chance to try the dessert resto at the lobby. Food room service and roofdeck resto offer quite pricey meals, so we didn't try them, too. We instead opted to walk to a resto in Kapitolyo for yummy yet reasonably priced lunch and dinner. There are many restaurants in Kapitolyo and Capitol Commons that are walking distance which gives you a lot of options if you're willing to go out. There's also a Ministop nearby. You can bring your own food. There are no smoking rooms in Privato. You either have to go up the roofdeck, which is not open 24hrs, or the front lobby. It was quite a trip if your room is at the 20-something floor. Overall, our Privato one-night stay was not bad at all. Less luxury and convenience, but it has the basic comforts for a good night stay.

author: 259MartinE259
title: Far from ideal
text: Stayed 6 nights in a 1-bedroom suite that was overpriced and under equipped. For example, 1 dinner plate, 1 glass, 4 teaspoons and no other cutlery. The kitchenette has hotplates but nothing to use on them - no frying pan, no utensils. Perhaps it's a ploy to get you to dine at their equally overpriced restaurant. Daily bottled water wasn't always replenished and neither was the soap nor shampoo. For the near USD$100/night price I expect A LOT more than what I got. I once asked for water while waiting in the foyer and was told if have to pay for it! On the up side, the king bed was very comfortable, as was the sofa (suites only). Staff were nice and helpful, though I was told they would get back to me about a lower price for the room but that never happened. 3 restaurants nearby, Shakey's (very good), ChowKing, (average), and KFC (meh). Got the airport shuttle car to the airport after my stay and it was very comfortable. Cost, 1200 Pesos. Overall very disappointed with the price verses features. No bangs for my many, many bucks here. Wouldn't stay again unless it was a lot cheaper.

author: E9289RRcarlosa
title: IT'S NOT WHAT YOU EXPECTED. ITS MORE THAN WHAT YOU HAVE.
text: i write about affordable hotels around asia from SG, HK and MNL and i was surprised. - we always think a hotel in the heart of a cramped city will somehow have small rooms. - we think service will be so so. like a travellers lodge. - we think it will lack the feel of luxury i booked 3 rooms here for my birthday celeb because my theme is black and white and this hotel's theme is more like the same.. so going forward i booked 1 suite, 2 executive queens. they gave me a very spacious and stylish suite with a majestic view of the city. it's very accessible and has easy access to the nearest malls and restos (Megamall, Robinsons Galleria, Capitol commons ). Hotel Staff was very polite(even bowed =) ) and they are very quick in accomodating our needs, even the bell boy offered to wait for our ordered food and said that he would personally bring our food up. the room and service made me and my guests feel like we are staying in a 3-4 star hotel. like traders(hotel jen) the only concern that i have here is the limited parking space. but that's just it. you wouldnt expect much but if you'll stay in this hotel you'll know what i'm saying. GO AHEAD. click on that booking button=) if you're not sure about an event or a hotel to book for an event in MNL you can email me at cme.arana@gmail.com, i'll give you free sample themes + corresponding hotels/areas that you can book or rent.

author: luisdegu
title: Surprise, surprise!
text: I had just moved out from my old place and had a few days in between before I could move into the new one. I could've chosen to bother some friends and ask if I can stay the weekend at theirs but being the good friend I think I am, I decided to just search for a nice quaint affordable hotel room at the heart of Metro Manila. That search ended when a friend mentioned Privato. It was the perfect fit! I needed a place where I could have easy access to most of Metro Manila and Privato was smack in the middle of it. Located in Pasig which is what I believe to be, along with Mandaluyong, the center of Metro Manila. Just 15-20 mins away from the busy streets of Makati and Fort Bonifacio, Taguig and just the same going the opposite direction up north to Quezon City and San Juan. I did not have to really stress about going about my weekend plans with friends because of the great location. It was a pleasant surprise that the up and coming Capitol Commons is only a 2 minute walk away and is beginning to take shape and is becoming one of the more "happening" places on weeknights. I was lucky enough to get a room because it was supposedly fully booked. I would've been homeless for the weekend if I didn't get one. lol The price was perfect for my budget and I was pleasantly surprised to find out that my beds were upgraded too! I had initially booked a king sized bed and later on was shocked to find out that the upgrade was to a room with two beds... TWO QUEEN SIZED BEDS. SO MUCH SPACE! Although the rooms and the place overall might need a little work it's easy to see that the place is on the right track to making it as one of the better value-for-money hotels in the area - Its location along with the friendly & well-trained staff should make sure of that. If there're ever any staycation plans for me in the future, Privato would definitely be on top of my list. It isn't even far fetched to think that the place would be much improved by then.

author: 738macyt
title: YUPPY STAYCATION PERFECTION
text: I keep talking about my yuppy status in my reviews - but there's no denying that this is my current lifestyle, and we make do with our current resources at times when a break is well-deserved. Unfortunately, the latest long weekend was spent within the city. I didn't get a chance to save up enough to go out of town. I really needed a break from my condo in Makati to spend quality time with ahem, let's just say, a special friend; and honestly our options were limited. Almost lost hope and then my friend recommended Privato. It was well within our budget, location was perfect (between Marikina and Makati), and such a classy atmosphere. They were fully booked too - so we were lucky to get a spot. Service was great - always a must for me. But I was willing to let it go since this is only a 3-star hotel. But they definitely outdid themselves - there wasn't even a long wait for our room when we got there. So I think that is worth mentioning. I just have to give a special mention regarding the rooftop pool. I wish my condo had this. I have a thing for rooftop pools. Too bad though that it wasn't too deep! But it's ok because I'm short anyway. Nothing more to say about the stay. It was an overall excellent one (hence the high marks). Looking forward to rebooking - when the funds allow HAHA.

author: Chinese_B0y
title: Tasteful and Refreshing
text: We organized an event in Privato Hotel for a group of about 150 people for 3 nights and this is what we've got to say about the place. First of all, the hotel has great aesthetics. This was one of the reasons we chose it over four similar options. Very new, very boutique -- a fresh vibe from the moment you enter the lobby. Second, the staff is great. From the bellboys to the front desk attendants, sales executives, all the way to the general manager.
