Please do not microwave the hardboiled eggs. Someone there tried twice to heat up a hardboiled egg in the microwave. What a mess!!! The hotel offers free high speed internet. You can get the plug at the front desk for $20. When you return the plug, you receive a credit for $20. This worked out great since my daughter forgot her plug. There was an indoor pool but we never made it there. There is a Cracker Barrel restuarant right down the street and a Ruby Tuesday restaurant right next door.

author: GroovieGurlie
title: Convenient Location. Well- Priced. Nice suites.
text: The title pretty much sums it up. Nice convenient location - lots of restaurants/ cafes, supermarkets within close walking distance. The subway station is less than 10 min walk. You can walk to the Floralis Genérica in 30 min, and from there, a 15 min walk to La Recoleta Cemetery. Breakfast at the cafe next door is included (choice of 3 set menus). Unfortunately, we had to check out before the cafe opens at 7am, and there was no boxed breakfast provided. The suite itself is very large and spacious. Clean. Well kept. Only microwave, water kettle and a mini fridge is in the room. Plenty of storage space though. Bed is warm and comfortable. Two TVs in the suite: one facing each bed. Excellent shower: no issues with water temperature or pressure; the glass partition could've been longer, but we made do otherwise. The rooms aren't very soundproof though - you can clearly hear noise out in the hall, and footsteps above you. Excellent wifi speed and connectivity. Great customer service. Small language barrier, but helpful in making recommendations. Toiletries included: bulk shampoo and conditioner, bar soap.

author: SandraS731
title: Excellent hotel with superb staff and wonderful neighborhood!
text: I was planning my first trip to BA and researching hotels like mad. I wanted to stay in the best neighborhood and was also looking for a hotel room with a little bit more space so that we didn't feel crowded in the room. I came across Bulnes and after researching the different suites I felt this was the best choice. When we arrived at the hotel the staff were very courteous and accommodating. Whenever we had a question they were always available. The rooms were super spacious with a beautiful balcony that overlooked Calle Juemes. The room was very clean. Maid service was wonderful whenever we needed it. Cafe del Botanico right next door offered a free continental breakfast each morning-how we miss our cafe con leche and our medialunas! My only complaint was the amount of noise that can be heard in the room from the hallway-it can get quite noisy and the noise travels into the room but other than that the stay was excellent. The neighborhood is wonderful. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Buenos Aires and especially enjoyed our stay at Bulnes. I highly recommend this hotel. Muchisimas gracias por todo! :)

author: EZGtraveler
title: Loved this hotel; Wished our stay was longer!
text: I got a low price of $154 for a huge 3-bed room, with loveseat, dining table and spacious kitchenette area, so was not expecting such a nice hotel. I was pleasantly surprised at how upscale the room was. We were sorry to leave after only one night; barely had time to use the room beyond sleeping and showering. The neighborhood was not touristy. It had lots of businesses and stores of all kinds, clearly is a bustling area where regular people live. I like that vibe. The subway was one block away. You could walk downtown if you don’t mind a long walk — a little over a mile to the Fine Art Museum (Bellas Artes) and Recoleta Cemetery, etc. Our only complaint related to the breakfast. The hotel has an arrangement with the café next door to supply breakfast to guests, included in the room charge. The breakfast options included scrambled eggs made to order. Two of us were served perfectly fine eggs but then they seemed to forget about our third friend, who ordered a little later than we did. When we finally got the server’s attention, he brought her the most hideous plate of eggs, full of charred black pan scrapings. (Not like ours at all.) He slapped it down with an attitude and proceeded to ignore us once again. We would have sent them back but had to rush and catch our ferry. I blame the café for this, though, not the hotel. Would definitely book this hotel again.

author: LorenzoelJefe
title: The Eco is not only sweet but good, good, good
text: Palermo is a local neighbourhood close to shopping and lots of restaurants but not in the centre of tourist activity in Buenos Aires. If you want it quiet at night with relaxing walks (other than rush hour) after a super duper meal at Uco ... then this is your stop. (For example, Uco was 30 minutes through neat streets ... otherwise take a cab, they are cheap.) Or if you wish to Capp things off at El Ateneo the #2 most beautiful bookstore in this world ... it's a longest walk (30 minutes again the other direction) but you get to window shop Santa Fe. The parks about the same distant, same for the MALBA which is NOT worth a visit. We walked to Recoleta twice. Got us in shape for Las Torres de Paine. - Large room with empty fridge to fill for any microwave action. - Fresh air with balcony. Hilton and Hyatt (among the big guys) do not have operable windows anywhere. - Super accommodating staff but this is not a concierge spot. - Have your breakfast brought up to your room ... super quick and efficient. We love a smaller European style hotel ... and you can get away from the invasion of Germans. How can you tell they are Germans??? They always step in front of your photo ...

author: bizzigirl
title: Great hotel, practical and well organised.
text: We had a room for 3, very spacious with twin beds and a separate area with a huge double bed. Small kitchen area with basic utensils on request. Fridge, kettle and microwave, great for chilling drinks or a cup of tea! Room immaculately clean and good quality sheets changed very regularly on our almost two week stay. Perfectly located for all the sights, very walkable to most places, taxis plentiful and underground 'subte' station 2 minutes away. Journeys anywhere in the city with a pre loaded subte card about 25p a time. Good security on the door of the hotel making it feel very safe for us women travellers, and welcoming helpful reception who were always there to reserve a restaurant or arrange a remis (taxi's that you don't hail if you need a longer ride like to the airport, or in our case to visit friends in the suburbs). Restaurant cafe on ground floor serving breakfast or you could have it in your room. Breakfast a bit monotonous after our quite long stay, would have preferred some French bread rather than cold toast, but freshly squeezed orange juice was delicious and croissants and toasted sandwiches, with fruit salad or yogurt a good offering. Especially when included in the price. Restaurant also served food and drinks all day and is open to the public with local trade creating a good atmosphere. Sound proofing occasionally a minor issue. We were near the lift so sometimes got passing noise, and it is in the heart of a busy thoroughfare so you would expect some noise. Overall we were delighted with our stay. Comfortable, convenient, efficient, friendly and good value. Would defiantly stay there again when back in BA!

author: janetd90
title: Convenient Location, Clean
text: The hotel features large rooms that include a small table with two chairs, a small refrigerator, microwave, and sink. Dishes are available upon request. Our king-sized bed was comfortable with plenty of pillows and an extra blanket. Our room included a small balcony, but we didn't use it because of the street noise. The street noise was not a problem at night. Breakfast is included and has three options. Each option includes a hot beverage and fresh-squeezed orange juice. The rest of the food varies by option, but includes bread, or the ubiquitous ham and cheese sandwich, and fruit or yogurt. Menu items are available at an extra charge. The hotel is located in an area called Palermo Soho. There are grocery stores, drug stores, salons, restaurants, laundry services, a shopping mall, and a subway station all within easy walking distance. There's a casa de cambio for changing money not far from the hotel, but it's a bit difficult to find without good directions. The rate they offer is about 1.5% higher than the rate offered by the hotel, so it's worth searching it out. There is a botanical garden, a zoo, and several parks within walking distance. We had a comfortable 3-day stay and found it easy to get around the city by subway, taxi, and on foot once we had a map.

author: GeorgefromToronto
title: Great hotel and spacioud rooms
text: The location is superb, only one block from one of the best intersection of Buenos Aires (Avenida Santa Fe & Coronel Diaz). This is one of those "boutique" hotels built recently. Only three studios per floor (with a huge balcony). The price is not bad (about U$S 110 p/night INCLUDING Wi-Fi and breakfast which you can take it in the bar below or in the room). I was there just for a week so it was OK. But, if you are going to stay longer than that and you have the idea of cooking to save money in restaurants... Forget it. You have a small fridge, a Microwave and a sink. That's it. Just some TIPS: If you have the idea of buying something in Buenos Aires... be ready to pay crazy prices. ANYTHING I saw there (a shirt, pants, glasses, computer, etc). is MORE THAN DOUBLE than in Canada !!!. Even a small coffee costs between 30 to 40 pesos (about 3 or 4 US dollars at "official" value. RESTAURANTS: Get a lot of "pesos argentinos" before eating because SEVERAL restaurants (in order to avoid taxes) do NOT accept credit cards anymore. So...Change your US dollars in some places called "cueva" where you get more money for your dollars (the dollar in the black market, which is called dollar "blue" is about $13 p/dollar). Banks can NOT change dollars and the "official" value of a dollar is just $9 pesos. Anyway, I had a great time during that week.

author: keanech
title: Contemporary Hotel, Lacking Personality
text: I recently completed a one night stay at the Bulnes Eco Suites, a modern hotel in the Palermo neighborhood with large rooms for guests. Overall, the hotel provides a look akin to hotel brands including Aloft or Hyatt Place. However, with cooly decorated rooms and slightly impersonal service, the Bulnes Eco Suites also gives off the feel of these larger chain hotels. ROOM I stayed in Room 102, an expansive executive (standard) suite with a comfortable king bed and kitchenette. The room was smartly furnished and well kept, although lacking in a sense of comfort in furnishing. Unfortunately, the room was on a low floor. Therefore, street noise was prevalent throughout the day and evening. Noise isolation from the hallway and other rooms is good, though. The bathroom was surprising disappointment with low water pressure for a low floor room. LOCATION The hotel is conveniently located one block away from the Subte (Bulnes - Line D) and the Alto Palermo shopping center. However, the prime restaurants and bars that Palermo is known for are are ~20 minute walk from the hotel. At the time of my stay, a regular taxi from Aeroparque airport (AEP) costs approximately 100 Argentine Pesos and a radio taxi to Ezeiza Airport (EZE) is a fixed price of 430 Argentine Pesos. SERVICE Front desk service is competent, although nothing remarkable. For a small hotel with only 41 rooms, the service was rather cool and impersonal. DINING A breakfast set is offered in Cafe del Botanico (the ground floor restaurant) from 7 - 9:30 am for hotel guests. Otherwise, guests may have breakfast delivered to the room. On offer is your standard argentine breakfast consisting of fruits, pastries, and coffee/juice. WiFi Throughout the room, the wifi signal was strong with no dropped signals. Moreover, the wifi was fast enough to load complex websites or uploading photos to online storage sites.

author: luchyswanwick_10
title: Great choice
text: We only stayed for one night, on our return from Paraguay, while waiting for a connecting BA flight. A highly recommended hotel, great value for money, in a very safe neighbourhood of Buenos Aires. The rooms are large, with modern bathrooms, very comfortable bed and plenty of storage. We enjoyed having a drink in the clean, large balcony but found having to kneel down to get to the safe a bit of a pain. Breakfast is available in the coffee shop downstairs (a great 'confiteria' where they sell delicious cakes and pastries) or one can have it delivered to the room (at no extra cost). There are three distinct options, as explained in the room folders, offering their version of a 'continental breakfast'. Argentinians like their pastries with their morning coffee. A very spacious area with a sink, a good size fridge and a microwave make it ideal for Take Aways or early morning cups of tea. Cutlery needs to be requested from reception and is expected to be washed by the guests, not the cleaning maids. There are many cafes, restaurants, hair dressers, etc, close by and the friendly staff are happy to give directions and point them out. There is even a good folklore place just one and a half block down Bulnes Street. As usual in Argentina, the short show does not start until nearly midnight, but it is worth the wait. Again, great value for money, especially the 'parrillada completa'. As others have pointed out, the hot water in the shower is very hot- and the shower tray is rather shallow, so you will need to take special care there. Nothing that can't be solved with a little care. Walk around the neighbourhood and visit the church near by, next to a little play park. Ask reception to book you a taxi to the airport; the fee is clear from the start (350 pesos to Ezeiza) and it includes all the talls. We will certainly return when we come back to Buenos Aires.

author: theodoreW
title: gem in alto palermo
text: I just spent 10 days at this hotel with my wife and 3 kids. We stayed in a grand suite. Room was in pristine condition. Spacious and extremely clean. Very practical for both work and family. Superb location in a safe neighbourhood. Hotel staff while young were excelllent and always extremely helpful. One day we came home late and the maid service seemed to have forgotten our room. We called and within minutes they were up to fix everything. The staff goes out of there way to be gracious and were very tolerant of my 3 young boys whom could be a handful at times. Subway just down the street and within walking distance to zoo area. Plenty of choices for restaurants in the area. While i have never liked hotel restaurants, this one is excellent and very reasonably priced. Quite popular amongst the locals as well. Breakfast consist of ham and cheese, croissant, juice and coffee. My only criticism would be the wifi access in which we did not have reception in parts of our room and the speed seemed slow and the mini fridge, the freezer is not cold enough to keep ice cream (there is a FREDDO down the street and the kids wanted to keep some in the room). In summary this hotel is a great hidden gem in an amazing local neighborhood close to attractions and the subway. Great price for what you get. We have a family function there next year and we will be staying here again.

author: JessiLeon
title: Amazing, Friendly, Cozy and Clean!
text: I loved this place! It is small & quaint. I didn't want the mega hotels at all. This felt like home. It is right on the perfect location, so you walk across the street & and anywhere you want to go is close by. You can walk to shops & restaurants. I had a great room perfect size and so modern. Hotel is cozy & welcoming. The employees are fabulous, friendly & warm. The room was clean & neat. Bed was PERFECT for me. Bathroom clean with all the necessities. Cable TV. You can sit around the deck and enjoy a calm place. Gated entry for after hours was nice, too. I will be back again next year & stay longer. What a great place! love to discover Eco Suites, felt like a home for me! Thank you!

author: shalabhar0ra
title: Fantastic hotel with great food and superlative service
text: We stayed at Planet Hollywood this March on a holiday trip along with friends. This is a perfect hotel if you are looking for a relaxing and "away from the humdrum" type of break. The hotel has a large pool with Jacuzzi, beautifully landscaped gardens which lead you to a nice clean beach. Lots of indoor games too.. The food here is simply delicious and lip smacking. The buffet breakfast has multiple options and a perfect start to the day. We tried practically every cuisine in the menu and were never disappointed. Chef Sundar spoiled us silly and each one of have gained a few kilos thanks to his gastronomical indulgence..😊😋 The beach facing restaurant is a must do. The staff is warm and alert. They always had a smile and willing to go the extra mile... On the last day, my son filled up the feedback form after breakfast and mentioned that the trip would have been perfect if he could have played cricket and that was it ...Dinesh from the front office got in touch with us and asked me to get Kabir(my son) to the lawns. Lo behold! They had a cricket pitch laid out and played cricket with him!! Awesome A shout out to some of the service team who made sure we had a great stay..Eldrin, Caroline, Rajat, Wati, Lana to name a few. Kudos to Anand Chatterjee, General Manager for running such a fine hotel.

author: JoeS874
title: Review from someone who has never been to India and probably pretty naive.
text: As a family of 4 (2 & 4 Year old children), we were invited to a wedding in Goa. We've not been to India before so wasn't sure what to expect... Taxi's are pretty scary, we didn't see a childs car seat in the whole 2 weeks, they like to use their horn and an intact seat belt is a luxury. My furst suggestion if you have kids is get the hotel to send a car for you at the airport. Traveling to the hotel we were getting a bit worried as it didn't look like the sort of area we were going to find a nice hotel, however after the dirt track you pull into Planet Hollywood. We brethed a sign of relief as we entered the nice reception and were greated by the ver friendly and helpful Suba (sorry if I've got that wrong), she was very helpful throuhout our stay and very easy to talk to. Please bear in mind that if you book a room with young children they're expected to share the bed with you (it is a big bed) but Suba kindly arranged a spare bed and a cot to be delivered to the room. Breakfasts and dinners were made extremely pleasant thanks to "Wati", "Santosh" & "Lana", all three remembered our usual drinks, interacted with the kids and made breakfast and dinner with young children a lot easier. The hotel is perfectly situated for a beautiful beach, the pools are perfect and the gym is as good as any hotel gym you will find.The gardens are kept imaculate and manicured by multiple people daily. On the downside there were 2 weddings and a conference in the 2 weeks we stayed, both weddings were 3 days each and this meant loud music and lots of decorations being prepared all around us, 2 days we left the pool for the beach as it was just too much. However I brought this up with Suba who kindly compensated us for the distubance. The only other thing to add would be that we have a very blonde 2 year old boy... We were not prepared for the attention he would get, the first instance was 10 young men surrounding him on the beach picking him up, taking photos and videoing him. My wife was really panicked as I had ran back to the room to grab something, the rest of the holiday this probably happened another 15 times. To sum it up, we were naive to what India would be like, if you do your research and understand these things then this is a very lovely hotel with some very pleasant staff members.

author: reddevils2787
title: Leisure in hollywood style!!!!!
text: We wanted the best 5 star property in south goa & we came across Planet Hollywood in tripadvisor. After reading the reviews of other travelers I and my wife decided to go ahead with the booking. 1) The property was beautiful, peaceful and a perfect place for leisure. 2) The staff was really kind, co-operative and helpful inspite of us troubling them a lot for our 2.8 yr old son. Thanks to Lana, the Chef and all the others from the In-Room Dining services. 3) Nice spacious rooms with a Hollywood star theme. Our room theme was Jackie Chan 4) The beach was just a 2 min walk from the hotel which was amazingly neat and clean. 5) Huge pool area, with common depth throughout. My son was the most excited to get in the pool 6) Indoor child play area Overall an, amazing stay, we were thoroughly satisfied with the overall services. Special thanks to the team for giving me “SURPRISE CAKE” on my birthday  made it even more special. Our main concern for this trip was the "food" for our 2.8 yrs old son. But we were assured by Ms. Lana from the restaurant that they will take care of everything. And guess what?? They ensured that the baby food was not compromised at all. This ensured 4 happy days and 3 happy nights of stay for us :) :) :) I have already recommended this property to all my friends who are looking out for a peaceful & complete leisure holiday………

author: Pwalker19
title: In a beautiful part of Goa, although disappointing
text: We stayed for 8 nights in a premium poolside room. The check in was quick and the room was lovely and large we all the amenities you would expect. Large bathroom and lovely bedding, balcony was well furnished. TV and air conditioning did not work, we informed the hotel but no action was ever taken. The pool area was very nice and the gardens and grounds of the hotel were immaculate, we enjoyed the area and walking to the beach, the sunbeds overlooking the beach at sunset was a must. We order 4 small bottles of perrier which cost 2000 rupees!! The drink costs were expensive, it is cheaper to go to the Baltons beach shack for drinks and food, it is literally outside the hotel on the beach. The restaurant was small but very nice, especially the buffet nights, good value for money and excellent food, the breakfast was good but when it is busy it is chaotic! To say the least. Our biggest disappointment with the hotel was that we had 2 big weddings taking place during our stay and the weddings take over the hotel. The weddings looked amazing but be prepared that the hotel is primarily a wedding venue not a relaxing beach hotel, if you are looking for tranquillity and peace then definitely not here. They build the wedding structure a day or 2 before the wedding, then the wedding lasts over 2 to 3 days and then the structures have to be dismantled. In between the grounds are maintained, lawnmower goes on all day and so constant noise. The hotel also books for the weddings pool parties, so the day before the party the pool is cleared of beds and loungers and filled up for the wedding. The childrens pools are out of use and hotel guests can use a small selection of sunbeds the other side of the pool inbetween the spa and gym, however this is the main thoroughfare of the wedding guests. The noise of the music and dj is just completely mind blowing and so loud, the bass bounces of the buildings all day and up to 2230 when they have to turn off (thank goodness!) During the weddings all the staff are working for the weddings and the hotel guests are left waiting, to be honest we felt like we were an inconvenience to them. The wedding guests have a good time which is lovely but us and the other families at the hotel were sidelined for this. To be fair I did speak with Kevin and he offered a meal and returned the cost of 2 nights back to me. They at least did acknowledged the inconvenience to us.

author: AdityaS997
title: Good Property, However Process Lapses
text: We visited the property in Jan 2019. The Positives and Negatives are as under: Pros: 1) Beach - Excellent Private beach which is very clean and good shacks and water sports facilities around. 2) Swimming Pool - A very large, clean swimming pool with 2 small Kids pool. One of the better Swimming Pools I have visited. 3) Room and Foot Massager in the room. Foot Massager at the end of a long day really helps to relax. Cons: 1) Check In Process: I had to wait 30-45 minutes for the check in process. I had made the confirmed booking through Yatra, and Hotel Reception staff said they dont have the information for the booing even when I was showing the confirmation mail. After waiting for 30-45 minutes, they finally located that there was an IT issue because of which they didn't receive the booking details. 2) Room Lock Key Arrangement: 3 times during a stay of 3 days I was unable to open my room with the access card. I had to run to the reception multiple times where they said that access card would not be working because I placed it along with a mobile phone. However, even they were not able to open the room even with their master access card. They had to get a programming machine multiple times to the room to ensure that the keys started working. 3) In Room Dining: Some Petty issues, nothing very significant. I ordered a Pasta and Noodles, which was good, however somehow they sent only 1 plate. As soon as the food was delivered to me, they started calling from the restaurant to confirm if they can come to pick Dirty cutlery. 4) Invoicing: Though I didnot raise a concern there, I paid 21k on Yatra for the booking, the hotel gave me an Invoice of 29 k. Though I had booked it on Yatra, the Invoice I received said that I booked it through TravelGuru. So, the resort has a great location and Infrastructure, there are many process lapses which somehow reduce the extravagance feeling one has on visiting such a resort.

author: Maloshni
title: Relaxing getaway
text: Lovely hotel, the most beautiful park like gardens. Well maintained gardens. Picture perfect. Lovely pool area. Hotel leads directly on the clean beach with white sand and blue sea. Excellent location if you prefer the more private beaches. Hotel could do with some improvement in terms of lighting in the rooms which is very dark and gloomy in the evenings. Ordered room service when we arrived - absolutely pathetic food. It was so late in the evening and we had no choice but to eat and pay a fortune for disgusting sandwiches. Bins in the bathroom was old and dirty. This is a family hotel, so very busy over December. Restaurant staff try to provide a good service but food was very boring. Stayed for 4 night and standard breakfast everyday. 1 person frying eggs for way too many guests. Food need great improvement.

author: skewedeye
title: Go for the beach
text: Planet Hollywood is located on a lovely stretch of beach in South Goa. The property is quite large and has a decent range of amenities, but the top reason to choose it is the beach. The other positives are a very friendly and helpful staff. They were immediately responsive to any issue and all of it was done with a smile despite the pressure of the holiday season. The breakfast spread was also terrific. Fresh and a variety of dishes to choose from. On the downside, the location is one that taxi unions have a stranglehold on and it costs an arm and a leg to get around unless you walk (it cost us ₹1000 for a 4km roundtrip to a nearby restaurant). Since the hotel is set back around 700m from the main road, it is difficult to do this at night and you are at the mercy of the unscrupulous taxi operators (nice people, but price gougers) The other negative was that it feels like the levels of cleanliness in the rooms aren't what they should be for a resort at this price. The first room we checked into had a dirty toilet. It was unbelievable that something so basic for housekeeping to take care of could be neglected. It made us wonder about the rest of the room. The front desk staff was good enough to change our room right away. Even in the other rooms, the sinks were not perfectly clean. In another instance, we had a snack and tea near the poolside in the evening and the dirty dishes were still there the next morning. The management should be mindful of incidents like this. Overall though, I would go back for the beach, the food and the attentiveness of the staff.

author: RobKent333
title: Great hotel and super team
text: We have just returned after a week at PH Goa. This place has a really good vibe. The team have got the balance of laid back atmosphere and efficiency just right. All the staff were attentive, friendly and great to deal with. Rooms and common areas are beautifully designed and very well maintained compared to many places we have stayed in India. Pool is cool and the hotel is located on one of the cleanest and safest stretches of beach in Goa. Breakfasts are very good in terms of quality and choice. If you are planning on eating out at restaurants rather than at the hotel, you should anticipate a 25 minute walk to the nearest "permanent" restaurant. Pentagon is the closest and is set back off the beach down a lane. Taxis are available outside the hotel but charge around 3 times the normal price of local taxis for some reason (around £10 or $12 for two miles). Several beach shacks are much closer but not so good for evening meals. We had a few glitches on check in (re room availability) but this was at the busiest time of the year with the hotel at 100% occupancy. The staff immediately found a solution and we were fully looked after for the rest of our stay. In summary, we travel a lot as a family and our stay PH Goa was one of the best holidays in years based on quality of resort, service and atmosphere. Well done to the management team.

author: fromindiatoworld
title: Convenient location, nice property
text: We planned for meetup with friends and stayed for 2 nights at Planet Hollywood. Alright here is what we felt. Location: About half an hour from the airport makes it great to make the best use of time. Right on Utorda beach an easy access. Utorda beach in itself if an amazing place. So that's a plus. Rooms: Very very thoughtfully done, in fact not many resorts of similar scale have this level of thought out details, the rooms are all themed with Hollywood movies. The rooms are ample spacious and the really great piece is the bathrooms. Very spacious, well fitted and amazing. Hotel grounds & pool: really great, very nice landscaping and well maintained, a very large pool with amenities to keep the kids busy, separate pool for kids. The hotel ground have ample backdrops for a great photo shoot. Food: We didn't find the food very great but it was sort of ok. Not bad either. Breakfast spread was limited but nice. Ample seating and caring staff. Service: Well the reception is top notch with prompt response, but the rest of the guest service is sort of broken, if you are the patient kind you will be eventually be attended but don't expect a quick response. Guess there is a lot of scope of improvement. Overall: I would like to go back again.

author: aainamdar
title: Memorable stay on our wedding anniversary
text: The resort is half an hour drive from the airport and situated adjacent to Uttorda beach. They have a huge property with a swimming pool, beautifully manicured gardens, children play area etc. situated between the rooms and the beach. The beach, although strictly not private, is far away from the public access and only surrounded by a few shacks and other beach resorts in he area. That way, it is a perfect balance between being safe but also not crowded. The resort provides all the amenities expected of a high end luxury property such as comfortable rooms with large beds, cordial staff, huge balcony sit outs, beach towels etc. There are a few "extra" items like a foot/leg massager in the room. Our room was attended by Baston, who kept it clean and welcoming for us when we got back. The lobby area is very well maintained with plush seating, some games and a big screen showing live sports events. The travel desk can summon a taxi which can be availed for local sightseeing etc. There are two restaurants, but only one was functional when we stayed there. The other seemed to be booked for a big function. The restaurant was overwhelmed in the mornings for breakfast with staff trying to accommodate various demands of visitors. It's much quieter for lunch/dinner. We had a lovely time talking to one of the staff, Eldrin. Overall, the staff are friendly. The food quality is good, nothing extraordinary. There is no pool side bar, and overall the price point seems to be a notch high than the offerings. Having said that, we would definitely visit again.

author: sumeetr
title: Super Resort in the South of Goa..
text: When we booked the PH for the Diwali holiday weekend we never anticipated we would come away impressed on all key factors that one looks for in a Resort style property. Having tried quite a few of the resorts in South Goa, like Park Hyatt ( now ITC), Kenilworth, the Lalit we didn’t mind the quite of the south compared to the buzz of the North of Goa. Did our booking online and got a steep rate, once there I realised they have an all inclusive package as well - but doesn’t appear online on different sites. Check in was great and we were well assisted by Mr Dinesh the front office manager and he gave us a few room options in different wings and was very patient with us and I must add extremely helpful all through our stay. In fact every one we interacted with was very helpful during the stay. Coming back to the check in ( which was smooth) and rooms we got a 1 st floor room, which was perfect and had a nice and comfortable seating as well and kept very clean, it’s even more pleasant on the 1st floor instead of the lower one. Rooms are modern and well appointed with a large bathroom. The breakfast each morning was great and all meals that followed exceeded our expectations, we also tried their Fame restaurant which was more of a Japanese cuisine restaurant blended with a coffee shop menu as well, the food here needs attention as the sushi lacked flavour and presentation was poor, but their Italian cuisine was fine. Overall swimming pool was huge and nice and warm. Direct access to the beach made it even more comfortable, super clean as well. The water sports are a must try on the beach. The hotel property may not be huge compared to the taj village or taj exotica or park Hyatt etc but decent enough in size with good landscaping. They had organised a few fire works display as well as permitted all guests to light up as well, all the staff in the coffee shop ( Lana and her associate, I forget her name now) were extremely helpful. Housekeeping was great and prompt at all times. Only one grouse I can remember was that rooms need better lighting and the music that plays through the day needs toning down that’s all, we bought this to the attention of the GM ( another helpful person ) Mr Chatterjee, but I think it’s to do with the PH policy for their properties. Already looking forward to our next trip here..

author: Johnconnolly1
title: Goa in the Monsson - Amazing Property.
text: We were fortuante enough to be part of a group organized by Serene Journeys and got to spend 3D/2N at Planet Hollywood Goa. It was a beyond heavenly. The property is fantastic, the lush landscaped groups with the botanical details is a lovely touch, specially for someone like me keenly interested in gardening. The Passion Fruit trellis is truely gorgeous. The property sits right adjacent to the beach and has its own private enterance. Walking on the beach during Monsoon, with the thunderous waves crashing and the intermitent rain is something magical - I did not want ot come off the beach. As we were a group I wanted a little solitude to read and my fabulous room (111) provided me with that, a beautiful balcony with great chaise lounge for me to read and a picturesque marsh with crickets, frogs and birds all chirping away as my view. I could not decided to stay put or go down for a cooking class with everyone else later that afternoon. The rooms are fun each designed in a Hollywood theme. The beds are very comfortable, although I am not a fan of Satin sheets, I happened to mention this when I entered the room and immediately the house person asked if I would like him to change them to cotton - bam done! Now thats service. Being a group of LGBTQ travelers is not always easy in India, but here at Planet Hollywood there was no issue and we were made feel like we want to, just like any other guest. There where no raised eyebrows at requests for double beds and all the staff from check in, house keeping, the restaurant, and grounds were all fantastic and always willing to help. Several of the restaurant staff event remembered our rooms when we ordered food. My only critisim of the place is the food which I think could be bumped up a notch. But then agian we were there is off season and there was major fish issues in Goa itself unrelated to the property. If your planning a trip to Goa and want the less touristy South. This is a great option. I highly reccomend Monsoon time, Goa is a whole different feeling with its lush green backdrop, incredible skies and of course that magical ocean. Stay at Planet Hollywood and be a step away from it all.

author: SanobarK2
title: Feel relaxed and enjoy
text: Planet Hollywood is located on the utorda beach. The way to the hotel is a confusing and has a narrow road. But if you part ur vehical on the beach you can walk the shore and enter the hotel from the beach side. The hotel is well maintained and well equipped. The staff is great. You can enjoy with a large group of family and friends. I went on a official picnic. You have unlimited food. Do taste the sushi and fish .... Its amazing 🤤 There is pool for kids and adults. The depth is 5feets only... So no fear of drowning. To enter the pool you must wear a swim suit. I did zorbing which is free till 4pm. Changing rooms are good and service is also great. I recommend all my family n friends to do visit this place and have fun indoors.

author: Jpuneet
title: Great Property, Let Down by Hospitality Efforts
text: Well I am very frequent traveler to Goa and have stayed in all kinds of Hotels, From the cheapest of lodges near calangute and Baga to the most expensive of Hotels such as Leela and Taj Aguada. But this time around to celebrate the 1st Birthday of my son I chose Planet Hollywood as it was suiting my budget of a group holiday and also my travel agent gave very good reviews of the property. We were a group of 30 to check in inclusive of kids. To be honest I had serious apprehensions regarding the property, but all my apprehensions vanished when i entered the property and went for a tour. Its a very well maintained and lush property with all basic amenities one would expect from a 5* property. Special shout-out to Viveka Naik, Kevin at the front desk, Swarnim in the Restaurant and Suraj the head chef who were very friendly and helpful with there respective services. But as I said I the property is let down by the Hospitality efforts. Certain members of the staff were not friendly, during the birthday celebrations we were allowed private use of one of the restaurant at the hotel but no efforts were made by the staff to help us in decorating the venue, Once the cake was cut the staff did not have the presence of mind to serve the cake on there own and we had to ask them specially to place the cake at the dessert counter and as a result the cake went waste, When we asked for the cake to be packed it was sent in pieces to my room without any packing as if i wanted to consume the entire cake at that very moment. The major let-down was the checking in and out process. Kevin at the front-desk upgraded my room to a suite but I was made to wait the entire day for the room and I was allotted the room at around 6, as I mentioned I was visiting to celebrate the 1st birthday of my son, So the host of the party was without a room till 6 and the party was supposed to start by 8, as a result my whole schedule got upset. My kid slept before cutting the cake and I had to wake him up for the cake ceremony and later he got very uncomfortable by the entire hotch potch schedule and developed a fever. My whole purpose of visiting the hotel was ruined. And then on the day of my check out I received a call at 10:30 in the morning that our standard check out time is 11am. I pleaded my case that I was allotted the room at 6 in the evening and with a 1 year old baby I am being informed to vacate the room at half hours notice, and after a lot of haggling i was allowed to keep my room for an additional half hour. The whole purpose of my visit was defeated and I now need a vacation to get over the exhaustion from this vacation. The property is excellent and the 4* rating I am giving is entirely based on that and the good work of the staff members I mentioned but overall the hospitality is a big big big let down(and this in off season).

author: itarjun13
title: Yet Another Family Trip - Goa
text: We went on a family trip stayed in Planet Hollywood for 4 nights. We are very thankful for the great service provided. The staff is absolutely superb, they were quick, flexible, friendly with never ending service. Resort is located on the beach, kind of private beach with less crowd. My kid got enough time and place on beach to do whatever he can. Food was awesome, and I couldn't stop myself every other time. Pancakes were awesome and my kid liked them a lot, that he got few packed on our check out. Vegetarians will have more varieties to try. Specially the mutton biryani served to us on a special request by chef Sunder was really tasting like Hyderabadi. We had enough time in the huge pool, Life Guard Veeresh made our stay more comfortable, providing us the invaluable service. Thank you Veeresh. Rooms ambience needs improvement, bed was small, quickly getting moist, bathroom can have a bath tub as they are big enough. Children Activities are missing although my kid enjoyed in pool and beach most of the time Cost of Spa, Drinks and Food should have been reasonable. Overall it's a great and another memorable trip for the family and we were in no mood to comeback. Special thanks to Veeresh, Lana, Snehal, Chef Nitin Thank you Planet Hollywood

author: Chinmay7
title: Careful - don’t spoil your Goa Holiday
text: This is my first day at Planet Hollywood and I’ve had some of the worst service experience of my life. At check-in we were made to wait for an hour and there was no room to be found. We were not informed nor asked what we were waiting for. On enquiringly again, we were told to go have lunch as the rooms were not ready! We said ok, and proceeded to the saddest lunh ever. Ordered for a pizza and vindaloo. Waited for 45 mins. Asked about the food. Waited again. Asked again. After 20 mins a guy comes to say what we had ordered was not available. At this point we hadn’t been able to check in, nor eat anything post and hour of reaching the property at check in time. Another guy comes and says I won’t charge you for the food which hadn’t been delivered! So if you are honking of visiting Planet Hollywood, think again. There are more entertaining ways to waste your time and money. Hope you have a better holiday than we did!

author: bhattacharjeeavik
title: Overall extremely pleasant stay. Highly recommendable for family with kids
text: Pros 1. Beautiful property with Hollywood theme 2. Direct access to beautiful and super clean Utorda beach 3. Nice big Swimming Pool 4. Beautiful garden and lawn 5. Exceptionally clean rooms with beautiful Hollywood themed interior 6. Beautiful bathroom 7. Staff always courteous 8. Food is tasty 9. In room dining is excellent Cons 1. Slow service during breakfast. Replenishment done after waiting for some time 2. Always too many people in the breakfast area 3. Too many people just walking around swimming pool and ogling at the swimmers (especially ladies) affecting privacy. These people seemed to be day visitors (not staying at the hotel). Why hotel allow such people in the pool area? This is unacceptable.

author: AmritaRout
title: A super thoughtful resort
text: I write this review as I get a foot massage after a tiring day on the leg and foot massager in my room at the resort. One among many of the super thoughtful features of Planet Hollywood. Every room comes with a for massager. We booked a garden superior room and since we were traveling with an infant for upgraded to a pool facing room. I couldn't be more grateful since our little bubba enjoyed sitting on the pool bed in the balcony and watching everyone splash around. He also loved his kiddie pool time. The resort beach is lovely and the walk through the beautifully manicured gardens is delightful. Now coming to the room is beautifully decorated with celebrity snapshots (planet Hollywood you know!). Every room has mood lighting and a beautiful washroom, a home theatre with Bluetooth speakers to play music. Now coming to the best part, the customer service and attention to detail is commendable. Every staff is well trained, courteous and helpful. Our infant was well taken care of. The food was yum and room service was prompt. We just had one occasion in which the room service guys didn't turn up after a request for more than an hour and had to be reminded but this was an isolated incident in an otherwise awesome stay. I d be recommending planet Hollywood to all my friends. Kudos to the team!

author: TaPri
title: Great property.. great hospitality..
text: A little bit of a late review.. we visited at the start of March.. we had split our stay in the north and then in the south.. we happened to choose Planet Hollywood for our stay in the south and we loved it.. Check-in was a breeze.. the room was lovely.. the massager in the room was very thoughtful.. my wife loved it.. the Bluetooth speakers let us enjoy our choice of music.. the balcony was a great spot to sip on beer late at night.. great breakfast too.. comfortable beds.. spacious washrooms.. Wonderful staff.. special mention to Nuishka and Rohit at the front desk.. very accommodating.. loved the service.. We'll definitely return.. Planet Hollywood is now our preferred choice of stay in Goa.. Cheers!

author: 448himanshub
title: A mixed bag
text: I stayed at Planet Hollywood for 3 Nights and 4 Days during my family all boys trip. I will be very honest here in saying that my first day at the resort was a nightmare BUT the staff were quick to react and make it a better stay for the balance 3 days. When I checked in the rooms allotted to me were really sad and disappointing and were not what was promised to me at the time of reservation, I complained the same to front office manager and he promised me to shift to the first floor from next day. He kept his promised and I appreciate his efforts. My personal suggestion here will be if you are opting for garden facing rooms then please opt for first floor, ground floor is bang opposite to the restaurant with ZERO privacy, even the balcony at the ground floor is not usable as it is right on the footpath. I was a little amazed the way these rooms were designed. Their pool view rooms are the best to opt for. Now coming to food, I opted for a all meal package and that was a big mistake to start with. The food served on first night was highly disappointing as the spread was not upto the mark for a five star resort, the food was almost cold and even the staff was very casual. I was not very happy with the overall service and quality and even thought of leaving the resort after first night. I shared my feedback with the front office desk and I am really happy to share that they worked upon all loopholes to the perfection. The next morning breakfast and lunch was just fabulous. A special mention to their head Chef Mr Yogendra Uniyal for his personal efforts and correcting the things to perfection. All in all they worked it from zero to top quality and worked upon the feedback very genuinely and I really appreciate their efforts. Now coming to the overall recreation and activities in the resort, there was no live music or any other activity in all 3 nights to engage guests. If you are not in a group this resort can become a little boring. The best part is that they are located right at Utroda beach that is very very clean. Other than that I did not find anything very exciting. Also there are some local shacks at the beach but they are far more expensive than what you usually see on Goa beaches. At the end I was not much impressed but do appreciate the efforts taken by the staff.

author: abhie2014
title: Below average
text: We visited this hotel in December as a large group. Infact we had a lovely first time at this property in 2015 and hence we convinced our friends to choose this place as a reunion spot. What a mistake! They had a larger group around the dates and they converted twin beds into king-sized bed. To achieve this they hid switch panels (between twin beds) with pillows - mighty uncomfortable and a safety hazard to sleep with switches under your head. We had 6 rooms and 4 of them had this issue. This in spite of the fact that we had booked in advance. Infact when we went and complained their first reaction was - we do not have any rooms to change! But when we insisted they miraculously had rooms in 5 mins. Only we shifted our friends found it cumbersome and did not. In addition, we had asked for rooms to be given together but were given separately (they had told us it was subject to availability). We do understand that sometimes u cannot get rooms together but when we asked at the reception we were told we should have made the request in advance and they would have accommodated Why lie? While the food and other services were decent the experiences at the start of the trip really ruined our mood. When you visit a hotel for the 2nd time, in this day and age and that too a location like Goa that has multiple choices you would expect them to go the extra mile. Clearly, PH is not interested in repeat customers, they have enough am sure.

author: 64anikas
title: We went there for New Years Eve Party,INR 7000 per couple.Poor Arrangement.
text: At INR 7000 per couple ,one expects a decent experience. It was our first visit to Planet Hollywood and we were quite excited as DJ Suketu was going to play there. We reached around 9 pm . It is a huge property with lovely decor and ambience. However there was no sign of DJ Suketu ,just random music was being played. Firstly we were surprised to see they were serving Mc Cain frozen starters. Vegetarians had option of paneer tikka. That too people had to wait in long queues as there were only 2-3 woks they had for the frying purpose and 1 tandoor for the tikka.Clearly not enough to cater to such a huge crowd. Drinks counter was ok.Limited choice there also. So we spent additional INR 1000 per head for the drinks of our choice. The food was good,they had a nice spread at the buffet counter and it was served till the event ended. DJ Suketu started playing around 11 pm till about 1 pm. That was the time we enjoyed and the crowd was engaged to the maximum,before and after him it was poor music. We had to wait for our car for about 45 minutes as there were about 40 valets but they were still unable to trace our car and it was big time confusion around . One expects a better deal and arrangements at such a property,more so for special occasion like New Years where one plans much in advance. Clearly they can do better when there is such large scale event.

author: VenkySV
title: Lovely holiday at a nice resort
text: I and my family (my wife and 2 grown up girls) visited Planet Hollywood Beach resort at Goa. The resort is very nicely laid out with neat and clean rooms where you are always facing some of Hollywood's biggest stars (well at least their pictures!). The resort is classy without the formal airs of a typical 5 star resort. While the service is topnotch, it seems to come from the heart and not from a process manual. Right from the check-in staff, to the house keeping team, the restaurant staff, all appear to want to help you have a good time. In particular the restaurant team led by the executive chef Mr. Sundar and the head chef Mr Keerthi were great with their personal attention during all meals. Keerthi went out of his way to ensure we enjoyed all our meals and ensured that we got a lot of specially prepared dishes that made each meal a great experience. The other staff including all the service staff in the restaurant were also super friendly and always smiling and ever ready to serve. Great attitude. The resort has a fantastic pool and the beach is a 5 minute walk through beautifully landscaped lawns. The layout of the resort ensures that no one part appears crowded even though the occupancy levels may be high. Some minor quibbles - it could do well with another active restaurant to add to variety. While there appears to be another speciality restaurant in the property, we never did see any activity there with the result that the 24 hour dining restaurant appeared extra busy all the time. The service staff are very eager and helpful but can benefit from more training. There is absolutely no question of their intent and they show a great attitude but some more training will raise the bar even higher. Overall a great stay in a lovely resort and we will not hesitate to recommend the place to anyone. We ourselves look forward to visiting again soon.

author: SritiG2
title: Truly a remarkable destination!
text: Those who have been to Goa multiple times but are looking for a different experience should try this property. Away from the city’s hustle-bustle, bang on the beach, Planet Hollywood’s lush green lawns with palm trees open into a calm sea. A clean and tranquil beach with several shacks offering drinks and sea food is an ideal place for sunbathing, water sports, strolling and for simply enjoying the sunset. Both the hotel and the beach have enough activities to keep you engaged. The swimming pool area with private huts, were ideal to pass the day reading. The spa is well equipped with professionals on the job. Do specify your preferences of oils and the type of massage you are looking for. In fact one can devote an entire day exploring the hotel, the ambience and services it offers and the sea beach around it rather travelling far to other beaches in the city. Rooms are spacious with balconies having beds to relax. Martin’s corner and Zeebop are at walkable distance. We stayed for four nights and the breakfast served on every single day was sumptuous and very well laid. The dinner buffet would always have continental, North Indian and Goan Food to meet everyone’s expectations. The hotel organized a sun downer for the residents that will satisfy the party animal in you. What makes this hotel especially unique and attractive is the Hollywood theme based interiors! Walls lined with veteran Hollywood actors’ photos and memorable dialogues from classics are unique to this hotel. The hotel’s lounge with a huge screen to play movies as per your request serves as a private theatre. Overall it was a great experience. The staff was extremely courteous and the housekeeping and room service was prompt!

author: NewDelhiSaurabh
title: Very nice, but could be better so easily.
text: We went in a group of 12 adults and 7 children. The hotel is in south goa. It is away from the Goan party circuit, but we weren't planning on any of that, so the quiet surroundings were great for us. The only time I missed not being in North Goa were the shacks on the beach - the food was just ok while the shacks on Baga / Calangute take it up a few notches further. It's a short drive - 25 minutes - from the airport and the roads are great. The hotel is nice - clean, modern and with all amenities. The service was warm and responsive. Having said that, the staff needs a little more training. We had a few instances of the housekeeping/dining/reception asking us to call dining/housekeeping/etc which felt a bit inflexible. Usually the staff educates the guest about whom to reach out to and offers to reach out themselves. The food was standard and and met my expectations. The pool can do with more kiddy friendly support - arm floats, tubes etc. My kids missed these things but then got busy just dipping themselves in the kiddy pool. There is a shop where you can buy such things but as travelers, it would be so much better if such things are shared. There was a small paddle boat for kids but it was paid - I have stayed in many such hotels before and the only paid add-ons allowed anywhere near the pool are the drinks, so I was surprised.

author: Bhavin-joshi
title: A nice resort but needs better upkeep and maintenance
text: The property is nice. Restaurants are good. But the place needs to live up to its name and expectations! Activities in the resort are good. But there are two dampeners. 1) We were in the swimming pool and a crab hurt our friend in his leg. The crab was dead. Not sure if a dead crab was washed into the pool or it managed to crawl from the beach all the way to the pool and died due to some reason. The Manager promptly came to check on us and informed us that the crab may have come in from the beach side! There was no concept of service recovery. We did not make a fuss out of it but incident was unwelcome. 2) The room next to ours was a suite. It was occupied by stags (mid aged) who used this room as their pad (they had booked several rooms in the resort) to drink, smoke, play cards and eat gutka / mawa. They were extremely noisy. We could not be alternatively accommodated due to the resort being fully occupied. Along with a couple of sleepless nights, the occupants spat gutka / mava out of the balcony and in the corridor. They made the place shabby and stinky. While there is no way of finding out (by the Management and by us) that the occupants would be so troublesome, there was no effort to reaccommodate us,

author: Tour538214
title: They discriminate
text: Its like an amercian motel dropped into a beautifully landscaped property.. Rooms are modern stacked with moat modern gadgets one can ask for. The place felt very dry or derived of soul, the warmth and hospitality was missing. You can get what you want but feels too robotic.. Location is great right on lovely utorda beach. I woulndt recommend this place especially given the choice of properties you have at this price point, some of my observations below on why it did not work for me - breakfast was boring, more so because we hopped from a 3 day stay at next door property into this. Fans dont work if they are switched on the dosa hot plate gets turned off... Then why have the sitting in open - i wasnt allowed to drop my family to the hotel Entrance because i was on a rented scooty, all the manager had to say was sorry.. Gaurd at the door informed that this is the policy whereas it wasnt upon checking with GM. Clearly a case of discrimination based on vehicle you drive in. - pool for kids is aloof and uninspiring, black tiles.. Never seen those - play room is a tiny room with broken toys and mosquitos, when we entered a gaurd wss biting apple with this shoes on trampaulin. We probably disturbed his siesta. Check the image of filthy chair in kids play room - another play option is fussball.. Which is broken, Playstation with huge options of two games - onboarding was a disaster, we had called in to confirm early check in, only after being given a room no did we arrive, only to be informed of perpetually long 5 minutes which lasted 1.5 hours. Staff at reception were bickering that why did you allow check in when we dont have staff for room service. That too in front of me. What works for this property is - location, on utorda beach - landscaping - gadgets in the room, if you like to be surrounded by them on a vacation

author: AmitPrashar
title: Serene.
text: Small property in South Goa with plenty of Hollywood pics to remind u of the central theme of the property. Rooms are decent. No issues at all. No bath tubs though. Breakfast spread is good. South Indian, Paratha, Poori Bhaji, poha, eggs etc. Swimming Pool is big enough with a separate 2ft depth area for kids. Best part is the adjoining beach. 4-5 shacks and very little crowd. So if you want a beach that is quiet and peaceful, this is the place to go to. If you want action, then avoid. Water itself is smooth, not rough at all. The eateries in the beach provide more than just acceptable fare including vegetarian. Beautiful sunset. What else do you need.

author: Flightcrew777
title: Great place to unwind and build pleasant memories
text: Planet Hollywood is the milestone in quality service and experience. On arrival we were greeted by the GM Mr Anand Chatterjee who is a warm and welcoming person. He has done a great job in putting together highly motivated and courteous team of professionals. The check in was seamless and quick. Thanks to simranjit singh. Since I was travelling with family, all my requests were tended to promptly. The property is spread over acres of lush green land with amazing landscaping. Pool is quiet large with water not too deep so parents can breath easy while enjoying the sun by the side. There are plenty of activities (outdoors and indoors) planned by the hotel throughout the day to keep one occupied. Utorda is a quiet place with pristine waters and pleanty of water activities right outside the property. Life guard is present throughout the day. Restaurant buffet spread is lavish to cater for different taste. Staff is attentive and courteous. Biplab & Canisio are the managers ensuring guests are looked after well. Special thanks to Lana & Fairly for making our dining experience pleasant. These ladies have been my kid’s favourite. My special thanks to Ranvijay & Prashanth for looking out for our comfort and well being. They have been very attentive and caring throughout our stay. In short the property is excellent and the courteous staff is their winning point. I wholeheartedly recommend the hotel for a memorable stay.

author: Excursion737111
title: Simply fantastic!
text: A place that I have visited 5 times in 1.5 years deserves a review or else karma is going to bite me ( and I cannot afford that) This place is like a second home now, specially cause all the staff here have now won my heart and treat me like family. The resort : It is "planet hollywood" need I say more? They maintain everything that comes with the brand name....once you walk in, you will never want to leave. The location : absolutely perfect for anyone who wants a picturesque, calm, royal and relaxing getaway. The beach is a few steps away, the pool is inviting, the greenery puts you in a trance. The staff : the most courteous, professional and sweet people. I just can't say enough here....you have to experience the way they all make sure you feel royal....it can't be explained in words. Each person working here is pretty much watching you closely....so you have anything you need even before you ask for it.... That's par excellence for me Planet Dailies : This is one of their restaurants. Breakfast is served here. So they have what seems like around 100 dishes spread out for your breakfast...and then they tell you "Pls let us know if you feel like eating anything specific...we will make it for you".....even my mom won't say this 😁 A special mention to some people here who went the extra mile for us Planet Dailies : chef Ashwin, Fairly, Mayuri, Jovrito, Sam, Elderin...and two managers whose name I can't remember 🙈 ( on my last visit, I had told the manager I love the cream filled donuts, and on this visit (4 months later) he had them made specially for me as a surprise...I was thrilled) Pool : Carlos House keeping : entire team is so hardworking...a big applause for them There was a certain misunderstanding or goof up on my fourth visit here... Making mistakes is only human, but how one rectifies them speaks volumes. Everything was handled well by the management and I was a happy girl. I have pretty much celebrated every ocassion for the year here...I love these guys... Take a bow, Planet Hollywood....you guys are class apart

author: krishki197
title: 2nd visit, Simply wow !
text: This is my second visit with my family booked garden villa and got an upgrade to pool view. Check-in was smooth, welcome drink with face napkins was provided. The lobby is huge with Hollywood theme decor, the lemon grass aromatic oil is very refreshing. A Lamborghini is parked right opposite the front desk and what a beauty. Took an american plan meal for additional 3k per room that include 2 adult and kids which was well worth , you get buffet lunch and dinner. Their buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner is very elaborate and treat to eyes and taste buds. Really likes their cheese omelet and mutton biryani wow.. For kids there is a toddler pools and a jacuzzi which is illuminated with lights in the evening, and for adults there an very beautiful and huge pool again illuminated with led lights and it's a treat to watch and swim in the evening. Drinks are served by the pools. And Zorb and a small kids peddal boat is available for rent. Plenty of fresh towels at disposal. 2 minutes walk from the pool you get access to private beach and a guard is always stationed there, a shower is provided at entrance of the beach which is well thought off. Kids play area is cute and we'll equipped with quality play equipment and garden area is well worth the mention. Rooms are very spacious and the king bed is huge can easily accommodate 2 adults and 2 kids. Equipped with leg massage unit, mini bar, locker, etc.. Over all a very memorable and plesent stay.. Keep up the good work PH.

author: nikks1975
title: Family vacation
text: Very enjoyable and relaxing holiday with family. Property very well maintained with nice and friendly staff. It has a large pool 3 feet deep which is ideal for people like me and my kids who don't know swimming, but get excited seeing a swimming pool where they can enjoy. It has a jacuzzi pool as well which is quite an attraction. Food wise the taste was very good. Good spread of breakfast included in the package. In room dining is costly but tastes very good esp the north Indian foods. Continental menus are just OK taste wise. Resort is at the beach which is very clean and very good. Beach shack zeebop is walking distance from the resort along the beach but food wise it is just about OK..costly and not that great taste wise. Better to try resort food if you want to spend time in resort else try some other place recommended by various sites like Zomato to try food outside the resort. Taxi services are costly. Double than normal black taxis that one gets at the airport. With no Ola or uber in Goa, taxi services are a costly affair in south Goa. All in all very enjoyable stay and Will definitely try to visit the resort again whenever I plan for a south Goa trip.

author: 139deeptis
title: Best south goa resort...
text: Superb experience... Extraordinary services given by the staff... Specially Mr . Dinesh... He gave us early check in and also gave us support due to our flight delay coz of heavy rains in Mumbai... Check out time is at 11 am... He allowed us to stay till 9.30 pm... Thank u so much Mr.Dinesh... Chef Mr. Yogendar, Mayuri, fairly, oswald etc at the restaurant gave us very good service.. they r friendly and ready to serve as per our taste.. as we r jain we didn't find any problem there... House keeping staff too are prompt.. ready to help in best way possible.. overall very nice experience... Would surely like to visit again...

author: Atifnk
title: Goa holiday
text: We were two big families total 13 with kids. We had a great time. Food is just too good. On request Chef Sunder made special food for us. Beef, pomfret, prawns. I recommend to have the Sunday brunch in fame restaurant. The sushis are to die for. The fish is fresh and I would rate the sushis, one of the best in the country. Anand the general manager to ran vijay the front office manager all took extremely good care of us. Even the housekeeping is very good. Rooms are regularly cleaned up. Linen etc very clean. They have lots to do for the kids as well. Lots of activities. The pool should be one of the biggest in goa. Totally Recommend this place. Don't miss it.

author: 875rahulm
title: This is the place to be
text: LatePost: During my last Goa visit. 4 nights in North Goa were sorted, but last night in South Goa was supposed to be different. I was in dilemma while opting for a hotel because- 1. Was travelling with my in laws. Father visited thrice a year for work but stayed in best of the Goa hotels 2. Mom never visited Goa, so it was supposed to be special, specially the last day 3. It was rain time and most of the stay was supposed to be in hotel premises as the beaches were closed. ....All including my Madam agreed, I took the best decision considering above factors (😊). Visit PH for: Goa's biggest & beautifully done hotel swimming pool, most beautifully done architecture interior/ landscapes/ asthetic light schemes, Gauri SRK Khan's designed bar lounge, adjacent beach with white sand and fresh tender coconut they give you if you ask, personalized condiments placed in room, electronic full massager, high quality amenities and all traits of 5 star+ property. GM- Mr. Anand Chatarjee, Ex. Chef. Sundar and Manager F&B Mr. Saurabh Bhatnagar took special care. Apart from the huge breakfast spread to feast upon, dinner was so well taken care of with fresh most fish I had in Goa that vacation was specially suggested by Chef Sundar. I finished in 3 spoons 😂. Closed with bebinca desert. Super food. Prompt housekeeping & IRD services, made entire stay so comfortable. We shall come back and do recommend it to all.

author: Mitzyeah
title: Good resort, could be better
text: This is a nice resort but not flawless.Rooms are on the smaller side, style takes precedence over function and comfort. Decorated with kitschy Hollywood sketches and shiny bathroom tiles (also used in the hotel's pool & jacuzzi) this place has invested a lot in bling. However, there are significant shortcomings: 1. The reception folks are largely clueless - from being assigned a dingy room after 1.5-hour's wait (which we later got changed) - to swiping the wrong amount on my credit card, this was a poor experience. Nobody bothered to inform us about the facilities on the property - all we got was a printed sheet with day and time of "activities" like housie and karaoke. I mean, seriously? 2. There is no helpdesk, everything has to be routed through reception 3. Food is expensive, though quality is good as you would expect in a 5 star. 4. The rooms are smallish, and the balconies are largely useless due to the uncomfortable furniture Also, note that taxis are twice as expensive as the rest of Goa, thanks to the local union, so local sightseeing would cost a lot more than it would if you were in a hotel up north. What's good about the property - 1. The pool and jacuzzi are great 2. The chefs, and the restaurant and housekeeping staff are helpful and very polite 3. The open spaces are clean and very nicely landscaped, plenty of spaces for sports activities 4. Direct access to the beach, and its a great beach Yes there is a foot massager in the room, which is a nice touch, but largely irrelevant, imho. I didn't use the wi-fi, as I use my own phone data connection, so no comments on that. I agree with traveller t's review that the place is a bit overrated in terms of review ratings. Its good but its not great, not yet.

author: Priyakul2000
title: Nice hotel
text: We went for a family holiday and stayed for two nights. The concept us modern and fifferent which we really liked. Check in was smooth. All rooms were next to each other which was really appreciated as we had booked quite late. Pros- 1) the rooms are really different with each room had a hollywood movie as a theme for backdrop. They r clean and well kept. 2) staff is nice and courteous everywhere. 3) food is really good. Breakfast buffet is awesome. But gor other meals a la carte is better. Didnt try their japanese restaurant. 4) beach is at the back of resort and really beautiful at sunset. Watersports available. 5) pool is really nice and spacious. They have a poolside bar. 6) jacuzzi is really cool and nice 7) cute kittens all over their property Cons- 1) although it is mentioned 24 hour room service but only provided options of chicken curry or paneer dish after 11 at night. 2) jacuzzi was not working on second day. Over all we had a really pleasant and enjoyable stay. Will definitely return

author: 548dilipp
title: Can't praise enough- Staff and property
text: Poolside room 1st floor - excellent pool view and balcony. Fantastic manicured gardens. Great to see exotic fruit and veg growing! Beach and shacks worthy of any tranquil holiday. Resort offers something for everyone. Best of all are ALL the staff. Well educated, trained and humble. Right down to gardeners. Big thank you to Wallace and Saurab (reception). Neeraj (IT Support). Dining - Mayang, Sarvesh, San jeep, Rohit, Lavinia, especially Battle Pushpanjali. All were exceptional Only downside - Breakfast same almost daily and not to 5* standard. Biggest downside is cost of everything; Taxi, Food, Room, Laundry, etc. Couldn't work out why we were banned from playing cards in the foyer, when Pool and table football is allowed. Weird hotel policy. Not much going on in hotel in evenings. Did one night complain about inconsiderate noisy local guests partying at 3 to 5 in the morning. Obviously lack of security or appropriate authority. Stayed 10 nights - far too long.

author: savithakokatnoor
title: Well maintained property, beautiful beach and best chefs!!!!
text: We were in Planet Hollywood last Dec 2016.. Well to start with, its an AAAHHHMAZZING property, neat and clean, beautifully maintained with friendly staff!!! Best enjoyed - a walk around the property, enjoyed every spot in the resort. Well maintained pool.. open jacuzzi was okish.. But the spot light goes to the CHEFS!! very humble, very cool and will cook anything u asked for in the best way possible!! In particular, the Goan fish and prawns curry.. these 2 people are one reason that added more enjoyment to the stay!! Thank u Chefs Sundar Sudarshan and Jaskaran.. The beach is beautifully maintained by the management!! Some activity was also conducted by them for the kids!! But the rooms were a little clumsy for such a huge property!! Lightings in the rooms were a little irritating (our room was by the pool, in the first floor) plz do not go for the Laundary Services.. They are way too expensive!!!

author: 989pradeepp
title: Relaxation at it's best!!!
text: One of the best beach resorts I have ever been. Difficult to find a fault :) Everything about this place is excellent. Service superb. I have not seen such a smiling staff anywhere. Every resort staff I met just smiles at you and wishes you. That's amazing. The best part is the beach. Its just a couple of minutes by walk and a quite beach. You will enjoy the beach big time. Beach activities like para sailing, speed boat available but privately maintained and not through resort. The pool is brilliantly maintained. 1.2 m depth all through out and separate small pool for kids. Kids have a decent play area as well. Games like Billiards, Foosball, cricket, volleyball, badminton available for free and some chargeable activities like Archery, Paint ball.Food is good as well, but we ventured out more after a couple of meals in the resort. Rooms are maintained exceptionally well.

author: 503arvindk
title: Fun at Planet Hollywood
text: Our recent stay at Planet Hollywood was clearly one of our best stay in Goa. A very good Hotel, Conveniently located not far from Airport, right on the beach. The hotel is made in a manner that you step out of your room, stroll a bit and reach the beach. It is so near that You can do tens of trips in a day from room to Beach. The staff of the hotel is excellent. Rarely I have seen Head Chef and GM of the hotel, interacting with Guests and asking for their choices and comfort. Chef Sundar was so nice and polite and food and specials prepared by him and Team were excellent. Infact we overate a lot for 3 days :) The Front office was very professional. I would recommend Wallance and Simranjeet for being so helpful in check in / out, concierge and for every thing. We had 3 Garden Facing Rooms and One Suite. The facilities in the rooms were great with Massager in every room and a full body recliner Massage machine in suite. The Hollywood theme in the rooms looked good. Thanks Mr. Anand, GM for making our stay so memorable. I would recommend Planet Hollywood for all friends and travelers.

author: travelchic67
title: Birthday treat
text: So I booked this hotel as a birthday treat for myself. I stayed here on my own for 8 nights. The hotel is beautiful, the grounds are spectacular and well cared for. My room which was on the ground floor was lovely however it was tired in places. The flooring in one area was coming up and the wall next to the bed I think was damp as the paint peeled every day. The staff were lovely especially one of the pool guys sorry I don't know his name but nothing was to much trouble. Service was hit and miss at breakfast sometimes it was great other times I was ignored. I didn't eat dinner at the hotel as the beach shack just outside the hotel was great and I had dinner there most nights. I was given a birthday cake and bottle of wine which was a lovely gesture from the hotel. My room was cleaned very well each day and usually first thing when I was at breakfast. Since coming back I have had issues with my bill and I am in dispute via my credit card company. I asked to pay in the local currency and was charged in GBP so lost a large amount in the exchange rate and 3% commission the hotel took. I emailed the hotel when I got home and although they replied to the first email, they are now ignoring me so my bank is disputing this. To be honest this has ruined my thoughts on this hotel. I have still marked the hotel very good as my actual stay was lovely. It's just a shame they didn't do as I asked when checking out and has resulted in this dispute.

author: 85anishk
title: Planet Hollywood Exceptional!
text: There aren't enough superlatives to describe this resort. It really was exceptional. The property is absolutely beautiful and the staff are even more. We had a family reunion at PH with elderly parents. My mum is a strict vegetarian and gosh did they take care of her. Nothing was too much for them. Everything was just perfect. We have travelled the world. Have stayed in 7 star resorts and this hotel and the service was leaps and bounds above anything we have experienced so far. The manager was there every day greeting every single day personally. Every single staff member we bumped into gave us a smile and said Namaste. It was so beautiful. A special thanks goes to Shaanwaz in the dining area. He was incredible. Whatever we asked for was delivered with a smile. He even came up with his own suggestions on what we might like. The hotel was super efficient. There was grace, there was service, there was luxury, there was art, there was music. They deserve a standing ovation!

author: CHEFTB2
title: PH Goa- Perfect Holiday, Class Apart
