text: While away from home, you want to be happy. You want to be comfortable. You want to enjoy youself. You want the place where you are staying to meet your satisfaction. PH Goa scores 100% in all of these. Though I was there only for a day on business, the high level of the experiences extended by Mr. Anand Chatterjee and his team is exceptional. The feeling you get the moment you step in is truly international and we had Mr. Chatterjee and Ms. Moraes personally welcome us. An out of the box surprise element awaits you before night turn down. The property is best enjoyed post sunset for its modern lighting effects. The rooms are comfortable (extra comfort by Leg massager in every room) , personal balcony with each unit makes your level of experience go a notch higher. Though we didn't get time to use the pool, the night look with its base lights are impressive. Breakfast was a decently laid spread and culinary delight. After months I've really enjoyed a good Cappuccino here. The property is relatively new and we hope this high standard of service is maintained. With Mr. Chatterjee around I have no doubts about the high class and exceptional services in years to come.

author: Mattomad
title: Stunning Grounds
text: Ground incredibly well cared for, a truly beautiful series of gardens. If it was just on this, then I would give 5. Staff polite and eager to help. Location very quiet and chilled, no big parties like on North Goa beaches. A very relaxing place. Food so so, breakfast was a bit underwhelming, except for the dosa station. We only had the dinner buffet once and it was ok, but very salty. Our biggest fear was that the resort might be a bit naff as it is part of the PH brand. However, beyond one picture in our room of Michael Jordan and a few Hollywood bits of memorabilia around reception, it was OK. Odd Butlins type moment, was when at the sushi place Fame (their high end restaurant) a game of bingo (ran by staff) started. Very odd and just not fitting at all.... A really atmosphere killer. Also, another point we found frustrating, there was a wedding on the grounds scheduled for the Friday (why not, beautiful grounds). However, our annoyance came from the fact that the staff and some controlling wedding planner were moving people and setting up on Thursday morning from the area that tourists sunbathe by the beach. Not cool, guests need to come first and one office events need to fit around guests, not take precedence over them!

author: SidSolanki
title: Hidden Gen
text: Must stay . Positives : 1. General Manager Mr Anand helming the operations is extremely professional and guest centric . He is constantly meeting customers and makes sure that they have a good experience . We met him for all our meal periods and he made sure we were very comfortable . 2. Staff : the real asset of this hotel is its service staff . Extremely polite , helpful and always willing to go the extra mile to meet guest expectations especially housekeeping , food and beverage manager and his team and front office . 3. Location : if you are looking at a boutique hotel spread over 12 acres , well appointed rooms and suites , white sand beach and clear water , awesome swimming pool and fitness centre this is the place to be . Lastly the exec chef is the highlight of the property . He is there from morning till night and he has personally made sure we get the food we like . Hats off to his comitement and dedication . Overall , the property is very well maintained managed by extremely well trained and experienced people who are focus Sec to delight the guest ! Areas of improvement : 1 the coffe shop feels cramped with very heavy furniture . It is a busy operations and hotel is busy so at times we need to give our order 2-3 times for it to be delivered . Overall an awesome experience in south goa , beautiful beach , excellent hotel well managed by Anand the General manager and his awesome team and guest focus work culture !

author: Jazzydil
title: Fantastic place for family in South Goa
text: We are regulars to Goa. This time drove from Manipal to Goa and stayed at Planet Hollywood. A friend had told about it. Tastefully done place. Rooms are nice and comfortable. Liked the poolside area and their huge lawns. We could walk on to the beach from the lawns which was not at all crowded. The best part was the Restaurant. Have to mention Chef Jaskaran. He was fantastic and acceded to all the demands our kids were making. That guy is bbbkjust too good. Most of the staff was really courteous and good. The only average part was the Reception staff. Not very happy looking and made me fill one form like a government bank even though I had given my visiting card and ID. Usually all big hotels just make you sign the form if you give your business card. But this guy made me fill the form properly before he let me in. Another thing is that they don't have a Parking for guest vehicles where as it is wrongly advertised on their website. We were made to park on the roadside but they told that their gatekeeper will keep an eye on the car. But still it's at owner's risk. All in all I will give them full points for hospitality.

author: bj112014
title: Nice place to relax
text: Stayed for 4 nights in the resort. Resort is new and overall property is well built. Liked the Hollywood theme in reception area and rooms. Located next to park Hyatt and other resorts. Rooms are modern and well designed. Resort has a large pool and gym. Utorda beach is next to the resort. Beach is nice and less crowded. Chairs are provided near the beach for relaxing. Veg north Indian items and tomato basil soup was excellent Planet Dailies restaurant. Staff at Planet Dailies were courteous. Resort was lively during our stay as isl football teams also stayed. Few things could have been better - bathroom cleaning and front desk could have been helpful. Overall good value for money. Recommend this place to unwind.

author: silkyg2014
title: Beautiful!! Just go. go go!!!
text: We visited goa in november 2016 and choosing planet hollywood was the best decision ever!! Its a beautiful resort nested in south goa. The property is huge and well maintained. The USP of the resort is the beautiful, quiet(and clean)beach access it provides. There are also some water sports activities available at beach.It has lush green gardens and a big swimming pool. They were kind enough to give us an early check in. Our room was beautifully designed. The entire property carries a hollywood theme that is admirable. They have some in house activities. Some of which are free but we didn't try any. The breakfast spread is huge and the staff is more than happy to serve you. There is a lot of variety for vegetarians and non vegetarians. The hotel staff was very warm and courteous. A special mention to the reception staff, they were extremely understanding and patient with all our queries. The check out was quick and hassle free. We had a late flight so we kept our bags in the hotel and we were free to stay in property as long as we liked. We hired a bike from Cliffor who gave us some tips on which places to visit and where to go. He charged rs 500 per day. We loved our stay and are definitely coming back!! Its worth it!!

author: suptib2016
title: Mixed reviews
text: Let me start with good first..... excellent property... very serene.... peaceful(which is most needed). Front desk very helpful and warm. Now the bad experience, We went there to celebrate my sons 1st birthday. While booking I had clearly mentioned the date....my requirements..... got confirmation call and email from the staff about the same. But to my disbelief.... no arrangements were made..... major goof up and miscommunication. It spoiled our rest of the trip. Major improvement needed in hospitality and warmness from the staff. Housekeeping is pathetic. The management excepted their lapses and apologised and ensured rest of our trip to be good.

author: lexal_13
title: Great
text: Great place to stay !last time has chance to stay in alila diwa hotel , which was great and this time decide something new .and didn't regret ! It's even better .This hotel is great too . The hotel is very beautiful and exotic it's made really unique .i like hotels with style so I pick it . If u like something different and not common it's a great choice .this hotel have a face .every room is differently decorated .we had standard room garden view .when we come inside we was surprised .the bed pillow had crystals Swarovski :)) ,everything was silky and shiny .bathroom just amazing- the tiles are like pearls sparkling .omg this towels are just super ! So huge white clean and smell gorgeous mmmmmm !!!! there is a foot massages thing in the room ! Strong and amazing , first time I ever see such in hotel .The great thing also was a big balcony with big double sun bed to relax or read ! Wi fi was very fast and can watch a movies online but it's work everywhere but not beach .Would be great to use it on sun beds of the beach .The breakfast was great too ,big variety of everything . European food and Indian food ,fresh orange ,watermelon juices , cheese,eggs,sweets ,fish ,chicken ,sausages ,mango ,watermelon ,papaya pineapple etc .Even such things like milk shake , porridge ,Greek yougurt and other unusual for India things. I wish Indian big companies of people were not so noisy .... .What was the biggest surprise is sun beds ! The are so huge ! Like 3 meters wide :))but there is not enough , they need to put some more sun beds ( 10 more would be great ) . the territory of the hotel is made with love , so big Green and decorated with love and taste .enough place to relax on your own without being bothered by someone .beach is very clean but waves are too huge as always .so need be careful when u swim and not go too far but water is very warm .if u wanna eat outside of the hotel u can go on the beach -there is cheap Indian, Russian , etc cafe . We eat in camron Russian cafe , on left , (1 km walk by beach )was great .actually we always trying eat there in past trip as well ,coz owner control the quality very well ,and never had problems with stomach .Or outside the enter on right 5 minute walk another cheap cafe .but on the beach is better .the pool have jacuzzi and water is warm .so everything was nice and new .guys should clean more carefully the room but it's common in India to clean the room so so ( such things as carpet ,dust etc ) .in general this hotel is great for family with kids and honeymoon and just relax .just amazing if u wanna be a vegetable, and do nothing,since there is no entertainment at all ;)) ! It feel like 5 stars Indian hotel , but to be real 5 stars they should clean room some better,as they do in Thailand for example. People on reception r very nice too ,very polite .i recommend this hotel very much .enjoy!add pics .also I ask hotel please make Russian channels on TV !and be warned lots of drunk Indian people groups sing songs and talk loud like bazar under the balcony near pool ( btw pool amazing beauty at night shine like little stars )until 2-4 am which maybe problem for people who go bed early . So in the end I wanna say I liked almost everything but there were things which annoyed me : 1) wedding parties play too loud music in the garden day time and night , while European guests wanna relax ,I think it's rude play too loud .2) this people from wedding parties scream ,noisy talk and laugh till 2am which is rude to behave like that ( in south goa where people want relax !) 3) while the breakfast , lots of people talk loud noisy and scream like crazy , which is not acceptable to behave so wild in 5 stars hotel .

author: 208ashisht
title: Uber Chic
text: Had a wonderful time during the 5 day stay at the hotel! The Premier Suite has awesome Hollywood'esque upholstery on the red leather couch..absolutely loved it! An electric body massage chair in the living room and an electric leg massage equipment in the bedroom kept me and my wife away from fighting for a massage. A large covered patio with an awesome view of the spa, the swimming pool, the ocean and the sunset. A spacious walk-in closet, jacuzzi in the restroom and a large size bed (Enough for me, wifey and son) in the bedroom. Just request the housekeeping and they will change the satin silk pillow and duvet covers to cotton ones before you decide to hit the sack. My 3.75 yr aged son had the time of his life, spending most of the time hopping around from the the kids swimming pool to the large & spacious jacuzzi to the adult swimming pool (comfortable and safe uniform height of 4 ft throughout) to the kids indoor play area to the kids outdoor play area. With the sprawling resort property we had plenty of leisure walks around and the aesthetic beauty of the resort is unmatched. Right on a white sand extremely clean beach with no hassles. Head chef Jaskaran became a good friend and served culinary delights, Don't burn your appetite on starters and main course as he saves his best for the last. Haven't tasted such delicious desserts...in a while! Desserts are definitely his USP. The cheery on the pie is the management, special thanks to Mr Chaterjee, the manager of property for his overwhelming hospitality! Hasta la vista...! Definitely coming back again.

author: SiddalingaP2
title: Memorable stay at planet hollywood
text: One of the best beach resort we ever stayed and experienced. We enjoyed every moment of our stay, especially it is perfect place to stay with kids. Our kids enjoyed most and were so emotional that they did not want to come out at the time of check out. we stayed here from 8th oct to 12 oct, we stayed in luxury room the balcony facing the pool, best room to stay here. Gorgeous pool, especially after sunset, with beautifully lit lights. The balcony is another highlight with a relaxing bed kind of sofa. The design of the resort is well done going to every minute details. Few points that can be highlighted : 1. Pool is spacious and water is really good. 2. Entrance lobby is attractive 3. Restaurant is well designed and good was taste but bit blonde, can be more spicy 4. Lawns and garden are beautiful 5. Children play area is very nice and cute 6. Best part is the back gate opens to the Beach 7. The beach is very nice to play or relax or walk 8. There is a shower right at the back gate to freshen up after a dip in the sea. 9. Staff is very nice, keeps smile always, helpful : I mean every one We will be back here soon ....love you Planet Hollywood - from my kids

author: AmitV_13
title: Exceptional vacations full of wellness and happiness
text: It isn't a surprise to me that for once I want to write a story instead of short para about the exceptional experience we had at Planet Hollywood Goa .. Lemme still try to narrate in pointers though: 1) Reservation and Booking :Very prompt and responsive 2) Hotel's airport services: Very prompt, personalised and courteous 3) Checkin: Smoothest and fastest i have ever had in Goa. Felt like a business hotel pace 4) Rooms: Well appointed and exactly the way it was promised. Very clean and modern. Huge balcony with very practically thought furniture and in room facilities 5) Food : Now that blew me away. Huuuuuugeeeee variety of health food and other food options . Made to our taste and specs.. Well we were literally in a different space 🚀 all together .. Chef Sundar and his team is just mind blowing . Talk about any cuisine and they can roll it out like back of their hand 6) Fitness and Wellness: This was icing on a cake.. Superbly done up gym with very well informed trainer who helped me experiment a lot with different techniques, clean and nice swimming pool,Spa, Yoga and ..... A private white sand beach which just felt like a dream.... All this very ably packaged and brought with great humility by Mr.Anand (The Hotel GM) who makes sure all guests go so superbly happy.. Well or should i say i had to drag my family off the hotel as they never wanted to go back home ... Love and luck to all...

author: BalkrishnaShroff
title: Great hotel but !!
text: It is about 30 minutes drive from airport in South Goa at Utorda beach. The property is great spread over huge area. Since it has opened a year back everything was in top condition. It has lot of facilities like spa, swimming pool, jacuzzi, gym, children play ground, beach volleyball, beautiful garden, conference room, 2 restaurants and 3 bars. The beach is almost like private and 5 minutes walk to Park Hyatt. The staff was very courteous and they served with a smile on their face. Special thanks to F&B Executive Mr. Nilesh Mohan and Savio who looked after our group very well. Actually this hotel deserves 5* but for few problems. First the veg food was not good at all. My other friends who had non veg found it to be just ok. They were missing Goan non veg very badly. Secondly the access to the hotel was bad. Third my room key got deactivated 4 times during 2 days and every time I had to rush to reception. If they can improve these shortcomings then it can give tough completion to other 5* hotels in South Goa.

author: AmitKacker
title: Awesome property, great food, good pool, what more do you want?
text: When you approach this place, you might think about your decision, but as soon as you enter the property, all those thoughts will vanish. The place is just amazing. Right from its decor, to its rooms, to the pool, to the gardens everything. The hotel is very modern and this is evident in its every aspect. The rooms are a bit small but the bathroom is pretty big. Each room has a foot massager which is godly. Trust me if you are tired, just put your feet in them nd open up a beer and you will feel bliss. The place has loads of activities to keep you busy throughout the day. If you dont want to indulge, just hire a movie from the reception and watch it. The food of the place is just amazing. We went in hearing praises of Chef Sundar, but I must say the other chefs are equal to the task. Chef Umesh prepared a fantastic Mutton Rogan Josh for us. The breakfast spread is huge and hearty. You have everything there that you can ask for. One important thing, since the place has only two floors, there are no lifts and hence access to rooms is via a flight of stairs. Also since there is a huge garden surrounding the hotel, you see a lot of insects etc and some also get access to your rooms which can be a cause of worry.

author: smarttraveller09
title: One place I'd visit all over again
text: After going through much reviews we finalised this property and boy was I happy. I'd recommend you choose this place to stay if you want a peaceful,cozy and attentive get away from the noisy city life. Rooms are spick and span, well maintained and I am 100% sure they put a hell lotta thought into it to make sure their guests can relax and unwind. The pool view room was comfortable, they give u a foot massager and an electric dock and all the amenities that one would expect. Washrooms could have been slightly larger but they do really respect ur privacy. The staff are efficient,polite and courteous, always willing to help with a smile and very much accomodating. Food was kind of a slight let down for me the first day and I thank Jovito for acknowledging it and things turned better. A very big 'Thank You' to chef Navin,Eldrin,Jovito,Dinesh,Sangeeta and Berito for pleasing people like us who are hard to please at times especially when it comes to food. All we needed was to raise our concern and it was well taken care of. Breakfast menu was a bit repetative but delicious though. Pool was large and well maintained,extremely clean, beach is one of the cleanest across Goa. Fab jacuzzi. Loved the manicured lawns and greenery all throughout the property. If you are a traveller who also would like to indulge in activities, do take a bicycle ride across the beach and nearby places. Was a great experience. The fare for transportation is on the higher side. Look for other means to reach the place. Last but not the least Mr Chatterjee needs a mention, appreciated the fact that he would walk into the restaurant every morning and greet all the guests and ask about their stay and comfort. Kudos to the entire team, you guys truly know hospitality with ease and comfort. Loved every bit of it!!!

author: andavank
title: Top notch resort in Goa
text: My wife and I stayed at PH for 4 nights during the long weekend in Aug..what an experience.. The suite we stayed was luxurious, with its own superb massage chair as well as a leg massager. The king size bed was perfect, the outdoor relaxing area was apt for spending lazy afternoons with a beer and music. The bathroom was huge and they had all the amenities laid out. We were specially touched by their personal touch on the napkins etc, which had our names monogrammed..thanks guys The public areas where of top quality, the pool was huge and well maintained. Had separate jaccuzi's as well. The beach was among the cleanest and pristine ones in Goa. Did not try the spa, as I got literally hooked onto the chair massager..refused to give it to me wife when she wanted to use it!! Coming to the food, it was top notch, with the Executive Chef Sundar taking personal care of all the guests. The hotel was full due to the long weekend but the service was impeccable, thanks to a fine young service team. There was food overload, with a few local delicacies in each meal, cooked to perfection. All the meals had a live counter and the dessert spread was good.. Special mention to Khalid / Manju / Chef Ashwin / Chef Pravyn for their attentive and helpful service. We were able to really relax and have a great break due to the professionalism of the entire team of Planet Hollywood, lead by an able GM, Anand Chatterjee. Thank you Anand.. Would recommend this place to anyone planning a relaxing holiday in Goa

author: Abhilasha28
title: Outstanding resort, on the utorda beach
text: A very well done resort, and has something for everybody - those who want to party hard in Goa as well as those who want to spend a quiet day by the beach or the pool. A special mention needs to be made of the pool. It is a giant Olympic size pool that they have. Our room was a pool view room. Was a very well done room. A very pleasant surprise was a leg massager in the room. This was a first for me - I had never seen this before in a hotel room in India or anywhere else in the world. This showed how much care and thought has been put into the hospitality that the resort offers .All other amenities in the room were top class. In fact, they service the room twice in a day. The balcony has a comfortable lounger as also a chair. One gets a view of the sea from the corridor outside the room. The resort has two restaurants _ Fame and Planet Dailies - and the food is excellent. Service at the restaurants as also overall for the resort is almost impeccable. My husband found the fish curry at Planet Dailies better than that at Martin's Corner and that really is something. We didn't avail of any spa service, so cannot offer a feedback for that. Overall, we spent a lovely three days here at the resort and can say that we got full value for our money. The experience was so good that one overlooks a few minor irritants - the resort had a rather erratic newspaper delivery system, we got a paper on the first day and it was missing the next two morning; and second, for our last meal, the staff got my order wrong and actually charged me for the dish that they had not served, which was more expensive than what they served me. However, since we had got free dessert just a day before and overall the holiday was just perfect, I overlooked this minor glitch.

author: P00j
title: Boutique 5 star Hotel Experience!
text: American chain of Hotel and maintaining its standard. Lots of space, really amazing service and most importantly the food is yumm. We stayed at the luxury pool facing rooms; the rooms are comfortable , with a big bathroom and a nice balcony to sit out. The beach is a 3 minute walk and it's nice and clean. The swimming pool is huge and has a baby pool as well as a jacuzzi and a nice bar with food.. perfect for a relaxing holiday. There is a nice play area for the kids with swings and stuff. Special mention that the restaurants and in the in-room dining are very helpful. Making special food for my 3 year old. The chef at the restaurant even made khicdi for my daughter for lunch and didn't even charge us for it. Big thumbs up! We even ordered in pizza one day from Da TiTas and it was a good change. Just make sure you are not there when there is a big convention /conference.. you don't want to deal with hoards of men! The only cons that I can think of are - Definitely need more lights in the rooms - An indoor play area for the kids All in all a great relaxing stay

author: Manish1721
title: A beautiful and secluded property
text: We were a group of 100 people who went to Planet Hollywood to celebrate my uncle and aunt's 25th wedding anniversary. The property is brilliant and the service is something you haven't experienced before. The rooms we stayed in were very spacious and decorated very well. The room has a massager, yes you heard it right! A free massager which can make your legs relax instantly. To top it up you have a sound bar (can be connected via Bluetooth) with unrestricted view of the private beach. The pool is one of the biggest although it's not a Olympic pool and the depth is constant. The pool has a bar and a kids pool is also there to keep the kids busy. The hotel has a lot of open spaces - a huge lawn with kids play area which then leads to the private beach which is manned by lifeguards and ample of security. The food is decent (nothing great) but what will make the experience great is the unparalleled service. Imagine having your breakfast and being served by waiters who will serve you from the live counters. The staff is really warm, eager to heal and always have a smile on their face. Mr. Anand Chatterjee who is the GM makes it a point to spend some time with guests at the breakfast table and check with them how their stay is going- A simple but good gesture. The decor of the hotel is simply fantastic (Hollywood theme) and very well maintained too (only 10 month hotel). Would really recommend the hotel to people who are looking for a quiet but luxurious stay in Goa. Will surely return to the hotel for a little longer stay!

author: acmevp
title: Great potential, but service / attitude / inflexible approach makes the experience not so good
text: Pros: 1. Good location 2. Close to a nice beach 3. Good restaurant staff (baring one as mentioned below) 4. Nice theme Cons: 1. Service is not up to the mark 2. Potential not utilized fully 3. Rooms look good but are not practical 4. Our room had several problems like AC, floor sweating etc 5. Connection between Rooms and lobby / restaurant are not covered, this causes problem during rains 6. All settings (Lights / AC) in rooms reset when the card is removed, this means every time you have to reset the settings after re-entry 7. We went during rains, many guests were stuck inside the hotel most of the time - the hotel should have arranged some interior entertainment 8. Not much for kids to do, indoor play area is lacking 9. Reception staff is not much helpful, shows some attitude at times 10. Staff not flexible, despite being half empty (and off season), reception staff refused (in a not nice manner) a slightly delayed check out 11. Some of the restaurant staff (especially one turbaned Sikh guy) was extremely partial to Punjabis. During dinners, he used to spend most of his time chatting with Punjabi guests ignoring the rest and infact inconveniencing the rest of the guests. Our experience was definitely worth not more than 2 stars, but giving 1 extra star purely for the beach.

author: ho1232019
title: Annual Business Meet- 2016
text: We had organized our annual business meet at Planet Hollywood. this was two nights and three days event. Included in the guest list were the august members of the Board , members of the GMC and CEOs of other companies in the group. A very high-profile annual event , in which the star attraction was the annual R&R night. We had reserved around 70 rooms all inclusive for three nights. Because it's a new property I was hesitant in the first place to do business with them but the staff under the aegis of the GM, Mr.Anand Chatterjee convinced me of their ability and most importantly their willingness to host our ABM. The best thing about Planet Hollywood is the synchronisation amongst all the functions- F&B, Guest Relations, Event Management etc. The staff is hospitable and customer-centric . The Chef ,Mr. Sunder has an amazing hold over his cuisine. He cooks Mutton Roganjosh like a north indian restaurant in Delhi would cook. I appreciate the flexibility of the staff in adapting to last minute demands of a very demanding customer like me. I look forward to organise our half-yearly review in PH in October. The infrastructure is also amazing . This was our third consecutive ABM in Goa and prior to this we in the last two years did in Kenilworth and Ramada.

author: Raghav2599
title: The Second Trip To Planet Hollywood Goa
text: When we arrived we got a very warm welcome from the staff. We were then escorted to our room. The room was at the best of its luxury and comfort at the same time. Then room service served complementary juices and cake. After freshen up we went down for lunch. The lunch had a vast variety of veg,non veg and kids items such as pasta noodles etc.. In short it had every food possible for any age of people from kids to adults. Also a large variety of deserts to choose from. Often kids do not want to eat what their family says such as dal or rice so the chef provides an out of the box pizza or of one of the favourte dal of the kid so he could also enjoy the his stay at the 'PH' Instead of eating what he eats everyday at home. Apart from the restaurant thy other places family could enjoy such as the pool or the spa for the adults and the new kids section where they can play carom and table football. Apart from that the have volleyball court and a beautiful garden to walk at night as the cold wind touches you and you hear the ocean waves across the beach.Kids who like watching T. V a bit too much 'PH' also has a large variety of movie collection for kids as well as youngsters.'PH' staff worked with great enthusiasm and respect. Even there was no chair at the beach the staff shows the respect to provide you with a chair and any other amenities to make you comfortable. No matter what your requirement is or what information you need you always get it on the front desk. In short Planet Hollywood truly gives a piece as you are really in a hollywood place. From the food to all other amenities Planet Hollywood is an experience one should have when they ever travel to GOA.

author: sambjok
title: Beautiful property with its own flaws...
text: As the title says, it's a beautiful property... It has its deficiencies though... Let me write about the good things first. A. It is well situated near the beach... That's a plus considering that it's in South Goa B. Room amenities are excellent... We loved the foot massager... C. Some of the staff were extra helpful... Went beyond their ways to make us comfortable.. This is across all divisions, viz. Dinesh from Front Office, Khalid from the Coffee Shop, Dipak from House Keeping, Clesscy, Tenzin and Carlos from the Spa and most importantly Chef Nagu D. Has a beautiful pool... A functional gym The rooms though are well equipped, require some stringent upkeep... Considering that it's only one year old, the chipped floors, broken furniture fand electrical fixtures are disappointing.... The approach road needs to be looked into as well... Last but not the least, although free parking is being offered, be mentally prepared for your vehicle to be parked on the road outside the property... The cons may look exhaustive but given our experience, the pros outshine them...

author: cheeseysmile
title: PERFECT IN ALL ASPECTS!!
text: Whether you there for a quiet getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city or for a family get together like weddings....THIS IS THE PLACE. We choose this property without a wink for my brothers wedding last week and must say was the best decision ever! From the word go the entire team starting with the GM Mr Anand Chatterjee, were on top of all arrangements. Ms Viveka was a thorough professional and helped us through each and every detail and ensured all was in place on the D-DAY! She genuinely guided us to get in touch with various event coordinators and once that was in place we didn't have to bother at all. The make or break for any wedding is the food and I must say each and every guest raved about the food in every function starting from breakfast. There was not even one thing which was repeated in the 2 days and every function menu was unique. Chef Sunder, Executive Chef and his team created magic. Service across the hotel was top class and people ready to help you at every step....and in a wedding there are many last minute details which the team smilingly carried out. Overall good coordination within the various departments in the hotel. The product itself is very new with spacious, well kept rooms and public areas. We had a different venue for every function giving the uniqueness to every event. The main wedding happened at the beach lawns which was beautiful. The hotel has a beach which can be walked to was most surreal and calm. There are a few shacks where one can laze around or have a small pre wedding party. Would highly recommend this hotel for any gathering that you may have as they know exactly what is the need and how it Is to be done!

author: PallaviJ137
title: Perfect destination for Brother's Wedding!!
text: Ah! Fell in love with the property in the first glance!! We chose the Hotel for my Brother's wedding - a very special occasion made spectacular by Planet Hollywood!! Its a relatively new property so we had our inhibitions but as our interactions progressed with the Hotel Team, our confidence level rose higher and higher. From the approachability and the comfort of the rooms and their proximity to the beach, the beautiful layout, the sumptuous meals and the co-operation of the Hotel Team (Sales Exec. - Ms. Viveka, Security Manager - Mr. Praveen, F&B Manager - Mr. Saurav, Chef-Mr. Sunder Rajan, F&B Dept. - Mr. Kuldeep, Duty Manager - Mr. Rahul Sarda - to name a few) on every aspect of our stay, we had one of the most pleasant and memorable experiences. Meeting expectations is a very rare feat when it comes to weddings but I must say that with respect to Planet Hollywood, the services and the outcome was better than our anticipation !! I strongly recommend Planet Hollywood as the best choice for both a leisure trip as well as a wedding venue. Looking forward to staying with you again. 😊

author: drpvl
title: Great wedding venue
text: A wedding is what took us to Planet Hollywood and it was a truly memorable experience. It is a reasonably new property so everything works fine still. A little out of the way, but once you reach the place the ambience takes over. The hotel, the lobby and the rooms have a classy look about them. All the rooms have a lovely view of the greenery, with many of them having a sit out with a diwan. With all facilities, it has multiple locations for different functions of a wedding. Though the banquet hall is small, perhaps seats about 200 in theatre style, the beach side facilities for a wedding are a treat. ….better than what we had seen in Sri Lanka. The rooms are comfortable, and even have an electric massager for tired feet. The paved walkways are comfortable all around the main property, though for seniors it is a long walk to the beach side and their buggy service is short of vehicles. Further, when the wedding events are held near the beachside, there were no toilets nearby and everyone including elderly people had to walk all the way back ( good 10 to 15 minutes) for the facilities. The pool is large and just 4 feet deep, people were having real fun. Unique feature was an in built Jacuzzi at a height which was a part of the pool. Service was good, they gave free towels and swimwear for those who didn’t have them. The Cigar Lounge is another beautifully designed area. Takes you back to Hollywood and Jayne Mansfield days. Walls decorated with Hollywood greats and exquisite pieces of furniture, it’s a lovely place to have a Cigar or a martini and a cosy chat. The staff is friendly, well meaning, though not all of them trained enough. It took me two hours, 4 telephone calls and 3 trips to the duty manager to get my room done. The food was the usual fare and nothing great to write about.

author: Ayeshahd
title: Cannot get any better
text: So its not the first time I am going to Goa but definitely the very first booking to be done in a five start for me .. Before the trip i had thoughts like what would it be like to be in Goa and not live in a shack with the bare necessities. Upon reaching the hotel we had a quick and easy check in process and thereafter suddenly I was lying on the luxurious bed of the majestic room. My room had the Jurassic Park theme going on and it was semi facing the swimming pool. What got my attention at the earliest was this massaging machine for the legs. I mean, who in the world gets free massages on holidays .. right ??? Well PH gives it to you... Pretty Pretty awesome, I say. The staff here is prompt and happy to please you and make your stay very very comfortable. The property is pretty vast and a very gorgeous space. The swimming pool very inviting and I would recommended a dip for sure even though the vast glorious ocean is right there. The green lawns with the live size Buddha statues makes good evenings walks around the area. The breakfast which is included with your room fare is sumptuous. The food all in all is very good at the hotel as everything seems to be made in house, even their own bread. I strongly recommend a trip here if you are looking to live in South Goa and take a chilled out holiday with nothing hectic on your agenda.

author: 745kayb
title: Loved this place
text: Lovely welcome, shown to our room straight away. We had a room on the ground floor with garden view. It was perfect - large bedroom with twin beds (thought we were getting kingsize but twin was better!). Great bathroom with everything you needed. Best wifi we had during all of our travels in India. Had dinner there on the first night and it was very good. Service can be a bit hit and miss. The left doesn't seem to know what the right is doing amongst the serving staff. Breakfast was very good but again, lack of communication between staff meant I had to pour my own coffee on the first morning, after asking at least 3 staff members for coffee. The pool is wonderful and there was no-one in it! The beach, a short stroll through the grounds, is beautiful, clean and with a few beach shacks. The grounds are beautiful with some lovely plants and really well maintained. Had my nails done at the Spa by a lovely lady called Chericse (sp) - very relaxing and professional. Only downside is you have to get a cab to go anywhere as nothing is within walking distance of the hotel. And as soon as the cab drivers see the blonde hair and white skin, they try to rip you off. It puts you off going anywhere. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would definitely return.

author: ManishaBabra
title: Lovely staff!
text: When we first arrived at the resort we weren't overwhelmed with joy however we were proved very wrong. The pool area is fabulous. The only small issue is the pool is all one depth and it isn't that deep. I am 5ft 2 and it came up to my chest. The rooms, are just that, rooms. They are very clean and tidy but a lot more could be done to make it 5 stars. But they were good and comfortable. The balcony was lovely for chilling out on, and well done on the decent hairdryer! Reasonably priced, food was acceptable as well. Be careful of all the tax which is added. Went to the spa, it's ok, 5 star prices though once tax is added. The staff are lovely and always so kind. Overall I had a fantastic 5 nights here and would recommend this place. A good start... Hopefully they will take on people's comments and continue to improve.

author: SahilPotdar
title: Picturesque, comfortable and classy
text: I stayed here for 3 nights with my wife, and had a really wonderful stay. First, the overall interiors of the whole property are very tastefully done. The USP that makes it stand out from other good hotels is the slightly quirky yet classy interiors. The color themes across the resort are bright without being loud, jazzy without being garish. A good balance. The room itself is pretty large in size, with a nice sitout and the bathroom is also pretty big with uniquely designed interior color theme. The bed and beddings were soft and clean. The grounds of the resort are spread across a large area, yet they dont appear like one wide green expanse. Instead the landscaping and flowers and plants give it a different view from every side. The pathway leading to the beach goes through these greens and is pleasant to walk. The pool itself is big and has awesome lights at night. The triangular shamiana type seats around the pool make for a good view. The resort opens to Utorda beach which is again very very clean. The check in and check out process was also very quick and seamless. The only point I reduced from the highest rating would be that at peak times the rooms are very pricey, and the breakfast spread while being large, could be smaller and have a different selection of items that can replace the left corner which has the steamed fish, cold cuts and yogurt. That section is not very appetizing.

author: runawayzebra
title: Perfect relaxing, luxurious and glamorous stay!
text: My Mother and I visited Planet Hollywood for 4 nights. It was my Mum’s first time visiting India and so I wanted to make sure she had a really comfortable, relaxing holiday and I wanted to make her feel special so what better than to check out Planet Hollywood Goa! I loved the modern, funky and glamorous theme that ran throughout the resort, the stylish swimming pool area was gorgeous, the rooms were spacious, super plush, comfortable and had everything I could ever need - even a leg and foot massager! The bathroom was huge and I loved the lounger/ bed on the balcony. The location was fabulous – in quiet, green, South Goa, not far from the airport and right on Utorda Beach. It’s perfect for a relaxing stay. Utorda Beach is probably one of the best, white sand beaches I’ve seen in Goa, it’s wide, clean, uncrowded and a world away from the noisy parties and markets in busy North Goa. I was really impressed with the resort but what really made the trip extra special was the service from all the staff, we were made to feel like stars right from the moment we arrived and nothing was ever too much trouble. The food was also a big highlight of our stay. We tried both restaurants and I was particularly impressed by the variation of dishes and cuisines available. Planet Dailies has a great buffet breakfast with a good selection of Indian and continental favourites - loved the eggs benedict and masala dosas! Planet Dailies is also a good place for lunch and I enjoyed trying the tandoori and Goan curries. Sitting by the pool at night drinking cocktails and eating sushi at the Fame restaurant was a special experience and the presentation of the food was superb. Also, considering it’s a 5 star resort I thought that the prices for food, drinks and spa treatments were pretty reasonable. Overall, we had a great stay and if you are looking for a luxurious and relaxing but at the same time still modern and funky experience with that added star treatment then I can highly recommend Planet Hollywood

author: premarorajdp
title: Excellent beach front property in Goa
text: This is the best property, I recall from most perspectives. The property itself is huge and have cleanliness and hygiene as top priority. The swimming pool is the largest I have ever seen at any hotel till date. And I really mean it, it is huge. If you or your kids like being in the pool, this is heaven. Especially, my family liked that it is a fixed depth pool and not varying. It gives them good sense of comfort to wander throughout the pool. The rooms are differently and thematically designed. Although, I feel they are a bit smaller in size. The bathrooms are good size and the balcony is very good size to sit out and relax. The walkways and pavements, the green gardens and the kids play area are very well maintained. The walk to the beach is a quick 3 min from the room. The intelligent part is to provide a shower just at the entrance from the beach side. The food is also good quality, although for a few things it might feel a little expensive. But overall, it is very good. The pool side orders and service needs a little improvement, though it doesn't dampen the overall experience at all. Overall a fantastic place to be at, especially if you are on your honeymoon. Or go with a group of friends, to enjoy more. Awesome place for a family vacation.

author: MoumitaDeb
title: PH - True blue funky luxury resort
text: True to it's name the resort is funky with all along Hollywood decor. The resort is supposedly part decorated by Gauri Khan. The resort is situated in the calm neighborhood of Uttorda with the beach just a few minutes walk through the resort walkway. The rooms are decorated with various mood lighting and a gorgeous bed. The highlight is a leg massager coming complimentary in every room. The room is furnished with all the necessary amenities and a fantastic in room audio video system(Philips Sound bar + Blu-Ray player). There's a giant screen at the Heart bar which plays two movies everyday from different Hollywood genre at fixed timings. The funny part of this was that the lightning and the screen looked fascinating however by the time we left i.e., 4days half of the screen was not working(made in china effect maybe) The pool is expansive with a big Jacuzzi and the surrounding of the pool is very relaxing with deck chairs and mini gazebos. The place is very neatly maintained and kudos to the staff for their attentive service. The food however is a small hiccup, considering the lunch & dinner buffets are exorbitantly priced but the spread is pretty ordinary. I understand that this is a 5* property but food section needs a serious look into as the neighboring Kennilworth serves very good buffet spread. We had the breakfast at the resort and then the other meals either at Kennilworth or Zeebop or Martin's Corner etc. There are quite a few restaurants and on beach shacks(Balton's and Lloyd's) which serves decent food. Also I shouldn't forget to mention the arrangement of a sea facing candle light dinner setup done fantastically by the staff, though we did avail this but highly recommended witnessing the ambiance first hand. The Uttorda beach is clean and well maintained with not crowded compared with those of the north goa's beaches. Uttorda beach is the primary reason of staying in south goa. Overall a fantastic experience at the resort with courteous and ready to assist staff. Note: The resort hosts parties at their ground, not sure though about the service in during the time as we left the day the the party was supposed to happen.

author: nitendra
title: Paradise everywhere. A glamorous resort.
text: This is going to be our number one choice for a resort hotel in Goa. If you like movies, especially hollywood, you will fall in love with this place. The lobby welcomes you with nostalgic photos, sketches and autographs of your favorite actors. Each room has a very big balcony/sit-out with a small bed and a nice sitting area. Each room has a wonderful view. Its beach is very nice, which has enough activities and no crowd. The pool is huge and also has a jacuzzi area. The pool lits up at night with small LED lights. The lawns are fabulous with lots of open spaces. They also have a good kids play area. The gym is fully equipped and completely world class. Their breakfast is as lavish as a lunch. The food menu itself is not very big, but the quality of food is very good. The best thing about the hotel is its staff. They will greet you with a smile as soon as you step in and will keep doing so, till you leave - with a heavy heart :-)

author: jspamit
title: Superbbbbb.....
text: After reading all the available reviews on all the available websites, I finalized this resort. And I am happy and satisfied with my decision. All the positive points: 1) The resort is looks very fresh with unique Interior designing. From reception to rooms everything has got Hollywood touch which makes this resort different from other 5 star resorts in Goa. 2) Direct access to the Beach (the main reason behind visiting GOA). Kind of private beach, very safe and secure especially with children. 3) Huge swimming pool with an "ATTACHED" Jacuzzi. A real fun for kids and adults too. 4) Food is good with lots of varieties especially in desserts. A special thanks to Mr. Nilesh and Mr Zovrito for their services. 5) Theme based room with neon lighting with attached balcony. Each room has personalised music system and a leg & foot massager. 6) Last but not the least - a very polite, always smiling courteous staff. Won't list out negative points as nothing is perfect in this world. Will definitely recommend this resort and will visit again in future.

author: Sweety_Rath_CTLI
title: Christmas celeb 2015
text: We visited to celebrate children's vacation this year. 812 and 814 were rooms taken by us. The ambience is too good, but it stops there. If you want to pay for the theme then go ahead. Buffet breakfast is too sad, while options are plenty but none taste like a five star buffet. Sausages are not cooked well, basic like egg counter serves half burnt omelettes, well if they serve . They may also deny because they are running full. You need figure your own table. After second day we realise we need to call the in house dining or reception or housekeeping three times for each activity. And if you are late in the evening, they don't come. We never eat any other meal because of the poor service. Best of all mr. Anand Chatterjee Manager upon receiving feedback will immediately offer you his card and ask to call him if you need discount, complimentary spa sessions etc. If you forget your bad luck, he will not offer. When we spend over 60000 for three nights a 2500/- spa session can be managed and not obliged. It's not on my return list to Goa. Well Goa is!

author: Sumeet2013
title: Awesome Stay & Amazing Service
text: Resort is very new, so rooms and all amenities are very new and clean. Rooms are very nicely designed and everything else inside the resort is picturesque. Every picture you will click will be beautiful. Nice big swimming-pool. Connected to the beach. If you are with kids then it is the perfect place to be. Cons: 1)Transportation is extremely expensive. If possible get a self drive car or bike in advance since everything is very far. Hotel provides bike vendor details but dont have car vendor details. Get the same from Colva Beach which is nearest from the resort. 2) WiFi is paid. I believe 1 hour free service could have been a good gesture. Otherwise a perfect stay. Staff too is very welcoming. Hopefully everything stays same always. All The Best!!

author: Amitcd12
title: New Star is Raising
text: Stayed In Diwali with my family for 3 Nights with all meals package. I felt the difference the moment I chked in the hotel. Very professional staff. The rooms are good, each room has a different Hollywood movie theme. Breakfast,Lunch, Dinner...Awesome! Awesome!! Awesome !!!. Service very prompt and staff and the restaurents very energatic and polite. Had a wonderful time at the Bar with Robert...The Bar Chef and his team. Pool and the landscape is fantastic. The only issue I had during my stay was the Bathroom....wall leakages, water logging in the bathroom and tap leakages. It was the headache of the entire stay. The bathroom water was dripping in the bedroom, but since this is a new property I hope It will be rectified very soon. I would like to request the Hotel Management to have Indoor games facility which people badly needed for those who dont want to go out. Overall its a must visit place in South Goa.

author: ChangerSydney
title: Planet Amazement
text: In South Goa where the beaches are massive, clean and lesser annoying touts than the North. Planet Hollywood is a standout Resort where money was no object in developing a one of a kind dedication to Hollywood. Rooms were simply extraordinary, fitted out with murals or pictures of well known stars; we slept under a mural of Russell Crowe, with Hollywood lighting to boot. The pool was huge, immaculate and the attendants right on their game. At night the pool and manicured grounds came into their own. The big downside was the food and beverage department. For such a grand design, this was a shock. Breakfast was spoiled by a limited choice, staff were openly bullied by their next levels up, ordering was chaos with either nothing coming or doubling up. Becasue of the heirarchical system, communication amongst the many staff was a major failure in their systems and procedures. We had dinner in the main restaurant which was dreadful, overpriced and not what was on the menu. Questioning the staff got a stiif reply I was wrong and the higher price was because they changed my wifes order. It got to the point I met the Manager and then the next day, had to speak to his deputy about refreshing the food as the Chefs seemed oblivious to a quality outcome and their responsibility towards it. But nothing really changed. Pity. So we ate for the rest of the week on the beach. The rest of the staff and all the departments were organised and excellent

author: 603lehar
title: Get spoiled
text: We couldn't got the room as it was full with our dates in goa... so we went for dinner but I must say the hospitality of the staff wat excellent. ... a great applause for the team planet hollywood.... they took us for the round of the resort with full attention. .. the resort was beautiful with huge n beautiful swimming pool beautify garden area with the twinkles of lights. .. the lights of every place was mesmerising. ... now the food was delicious with the superb service of every staff n specially khalid who was taking care of every small need of ours.... made our evening. ... best resort ... keep it up... n all the best

author: 730shiranm
title: A comfortable and personal hotel
text: My mum and I were looking for a quiet getaway for the long weekend during Diwali. A friend recommended Planet Hollywood (PH) and since we got a really good deal on Booking.com, Goa it was! PH is located in South Goa, the other end from Baga and Calangut - the more popular and touristy (read crowded) beaches. This is an ideal place if you are looking for a more self-contained resort...there aren't many beach shacks (about 5 on the beach, compared to whole string on other popular beaches) and not many restaurants either, however Martin's Corner, considered the ultimate in Goan cuisine, is about a 12-15 min drive away. It's located off the main road and there aren't many transport options (taxis and autos) except the very expensive resort cabs. Now back to the actual resort, PH is a large and sprawling beach resort with a gigantic and very enjoyable pool. The rooms are comfortable, clean and above average, with a lovely sit out. Nothing too luxurious or over the top. The resort is very popular with families - so you will have your fair share of noisy children running about, in and outside the pool. The hotel staff go out of their way to make the stay special - the embodiment of 'service with a smile'. And that's what makes it so personal. We enjoyed the food at Planet Dailies, one of the two restaurants on the property. The Lamb Xacuti was exquisite. We made the mistake of asking the hotel to arrange a cab to airport and realized too late that they charge about 300% over what we paid to get there. So if you can, make your own taxi/transport arrangements. But the staff made it worth it with their sunny, sunny smiles!

author: roshroy2014
title: Ph: we love you :)
text: It has been a month since we visited this beautiful hotel and I must say , we can hardly stop recollecting our amazing time there :) The little things you do for the little ones, go a long way to defining a stupendous holiday for the whole family, and that is precisely what this team did for us! The kindness shown to our four year old son, my husband and me, was just so genuine, it did not for once appear or feel, calculated. George, who received us at the airport is still talked about by my son :) his demeanor was so professional and discreet, a wonderful quality for a chauffeur. On arrival, of course it was incredible to meet Ahmed from Egypt, who made the world shrink right down to the familiar. The General Manager's gracious welcome for us, out did anything that we had expected, and I we were very humbled by their gesture. The suite that they so thoughtfully upgraded us to, was beautiful and just so plush! The little things again is what made it special, the baby bowl and spoon, the cute teddy mascot, which is our son's most preferred toy , by the way :) The beach that they have is by far one of the most well maintained, that I recollect seeing in Goa!! It was almost a private stretch of beach and just so very relaxing for the parched city dwelling soul! We loved our long walks on the beach, collecting sea shells, making sand castles and building a treasure trove of memories to last a lifetime. We romped around all over the place, having a time of their lives!! For a family with a younger member, it never felt awkward. Their team ensured that! Right from Chef Sundar, whose food was simple, delicious and exactly what I needed for our son, to Tezab in the restaurant! Jas Karan would always have our son's smoothie made just as we requested, to Medha in IRD who was very efficient and precise. The small gestures of sending a small chocolate mousse for our son, to handing over , probably , dozens of lollipops, to giving a littlte box of macaroons , was a very sweet gesture of their team to make it special for all of us! Overall, we had a most lovely time in this planet of pampering! We most certainly will spread the word so that others discover their wonderful hospitality! This place is one of the finest resorts in Goa and will be a magnet for both couples and families, with their vast spread of experiences on offer. I truly hope my review assists others in deciding on this resort.

author: Liberty_India
title: Amazing Hotel in South Goa
text: Dear Anand, We at Liberty India would like to thank you and your teams, for making our recent event a huge success. Everything happened so smoothly and was in correct flow. Here, we would like to thank the F&B Team Chef Sunder Rajan, Chef Dinesh & Naval at the banquets, the food you provided was really awesome and mouth watering, specially that BBQ Live Counter at the FAME. We would not like to miss Robert & Kuldeep at FAME as well as during the conference, they both were outstanding and above all Saurabh Bhatnagar lead / instructed his team so well that everything was smooth thus making the event a hit J . Saurabh even understood and arranged the special table displays for the conference lunches- a big thank you! Brian & Team at Housekeeping did a commendable job and kept prompt housekeeping services at all times. Front Office Team – Prashant, Joselyn, Ahmad, Russell, Patil and rest of the team, they were so prompt and managed the check-inns & check-outs. Obviously it could not have been happened without the right guidance from Ranvijay. And special thanks to Ranvijay- for staying overnight to ensure smooth check-ins the next day! Richa, you are a star – Thanks for the superlative coordination you did. Last but not the least, “Mr. Anand Chatterjee”. Thank you for the courtesies which you extended to us in making this group a huge success. Without your leadership, this event couldn’t have been a success. If we have left out few names - its not because they did not contribute in a major way, but it’s a case of our bad memory! We look forward to working a lot more with your great team!

author: sanjaygoyal1965
title: Holistic Holiday @ Planet Hollywood
text: It has been a while we were looking for a family vacation. It was our 2nd visit to Goa. Planet Hollywood was the right choice and it was Chef Sunder who gave me that confidence. Airport pick up and check in was seamlessly efficient with cold towel service on arrival was a good add on. Mr. Anand Chatterjee, GM and Corporate Executive Chef Sunder Rajan Sudarsan did come to the lobby to welcome us. Planet has very young and enthusiastic staff always ready to attend you and to respond to guest needs. We checked into the room, it was a delight, the kids just loved it, amenities in the room by far were the best I have come across in the best in class hotel and resorts. Chef offered us homestyle snacks for the kids and they had a feast as they relaxed in the comfort of the large and beautiful room. Room had a surprise element in terms of foot massager and a recliner with so much of comfort that my kids had turn one after another and it was a great addition to our holiday. Chef sunder also sent a surprise platter of chocolate for the kids i will cherish the same for long. Besides this, my little one always used to get his favourite food at the dining table right from Chef's own kitchen. Chef Sunder is all around at all meal time at the restaurant and all of us had a great time on food of our choice and kids were literally spoiled of the choices. Walk to the Beach and the huge green garden and flowers all around was a treat to watch and the best way to relax. I wish there could be some nice seating area for one to sit and relax near the beach. The resort was so comfortable and you will not believe, coming to Goa we did not even step out of the comfort of the resort. Overall, a great vacation, very prompt housekeeping, room service and reception is always very attentive. I wish there can be some more activities for kids, indoor games, a mini theater, kids menu etc. Yes, we can always be more demanding, but these observations are just few suggestions. We will surely come back for yet another relaxing vacation and we strongly recommend the place for traveller for family break - a home away from home.

author: NikhilRajGupta
title: Amazing resort.. Helpful Staff.!!!
text: I researched a lot for resorts in South Goa and stumbled upon this one on Tripadvisor. Since it was only a night stay, i decided to take the game on the basis of the reviews and was pleasantly surprised once i reached there. The staff at reception (specially Ahmed) was enthusiastic and prompt to help. The check-in was fast.. all documents were ready and we were given a quick brief about the property, activities available and the room. The property is well maintained and rooms are quiet different than usual. Our flight was in the evening, but they comforted us by extending the check-out time till evening without any extra charge. Now that's good hospitality. I would have given a rating of 5, however following things needs improvement to reach a niche level: 1) The room service and the service at coffee shop is a bit slow and needs to be tightened up. The servers can be more alert and attentive to prevent any delays. 2) The variety of starters in dinner buffet could be increased. The main course as well didn't had any non-veg curry. Overall, the menu needs to be revisited. 3) The staff could be more trained. It was apparent that this is a new resort and even they appeared clueless about things around them. They need to work upon their communication skills as well. Overall, i was pretty happy with my stay and the staff. Will definitely recommend Planet Hollywood to others and look forward to stay here on my next visit.

author: Moonmee
title: Hospitality Galore @ Planet Hollywood!!!
text: The mention of Goa conjures up different images of golden sand beaches, gorgeous sunsets, swaying palms, nightlife, historic portugese villages and beautiful churches but to us it means sheer hospitality in a serene and canny holiday destination at the Planet Hollywood, a newly opened luxury hotel where charm meets out and out warmth extended by each and every staff including Mr. Anand Chatterjee,the GM, the Food and Beverage Mgr, Mr. Saurabh Bhatnagar and unquestionably the most fabulous personality, the Executive Chef, Mr. Sundar Rajan Sudharsan. Our holiday was made all the more special and indelible by the wonderful Exec Chef who cooked up an exquisite meal along with a birthday cake not only on my special day but during each and every day of our stay there. The rooms and every corner was adorned in a classy hollywood style with pics of hollywood celebs. Housekeeping could have been slightly better and it would have been great if there was complimentary wifi in the room or atleast the lobby. Buffet spread at the planet dailies consisted of a fusion of both Indian and western along with a live counter for dosa and omelet and had a good choice for both breakfast and dinner. Al la Carte options are less but we were privileged to enjoy out of the menu options prepared by the Exec Chef every day which was totally customized to suit our taste buds. And each staff personally ensured we were comfortable and had everything at our table. The beach which is hardly a min walk from the hotel was very clean though there were a few stray dogs and cows too. The swimming pools are great along with jacuzzi and a paid paddle boat for kids which could be rented at INR 350 for 15 mins. However the place lacks any kind of activity for kids. The Pink Spa services are excellent but the ambience could have been better. Reception staffs were also very polite and made sure to greet us everytime they came in contact. They were kind enough to pack the breakfast for us as our flight back home was early morning. Would definitely like to recommend it to anyone who pays more value to service. In other words, it was a splendid and awesome holiday packed with utmost warmth and hospitality which makes it a nostalgic one.

author: ssbrown2015
title: A newly opened hotel with brilliant potential; you've got to go !
text: Great modern architecture set in beautifully landscaped gardens, this place would be ideal for weddings and honeymoons. The walls floors ceilings and lighting have been finished to an excellent standard; make sure you get a good training session on how to use the bedroom lights and the sound system, its really worth it. Each room as far as I could tell has a balcony with a garden view. The pool (with sunken bar, plastic glasses), is super fun and there are baby paddling pools. The gym is top notch (with brilliant music). Eating is Indian focused, we were the only Eurpoeans (apart from the Clarinetest, whom played at meal times; it works !). Though the Head Chef made us Eggs Benedict for breakfast; brilliant. There is a good range of fresh food and home baking, so you will not be disappointed. We ate out once at "Zeebop" beach side restuarant. Go to the beach via the Planet Holywood garden (there is a security person; very polite too), through the gate , turn right if your facing the sea and walk about 300 metres, you will see a rough foot bridge made from tree trunks and sand bags, cross this to the back gate into Zeebop restaurant (brilliant food, sea food par excellence and meats etc). Very rustic, but romantic. The beach is utterly super , clean and relatively peaceful. You might get disturbed once by ladies trying to sell you jewellery, I personally decided not to look on this as a nuisance but bought a little jewellery from them as they are working to make a living. We had a laugh and a photo together and they never bugged me again ! Back to Planet Holywood. The staff are ultra courteous and keen to please from house keeping through to reception and security. It is young so they are not upto speed on routines such as clearing tables after meals or drinks, but its not a big issue. There is a small shop, though I would have hoped they might have had more merchandise with GOA branding. We hired a car & driver for the day (4000 rupees ), and he took us to Candolim up North Island, a super trip to the Fortresses on the coast was had.

author: 288dna
title: Get ready to be pampered like a kid!
text: It was a wonderful stay. Its a brand new resort so all the infrastructure and amenities are in mint condition. This is not just a review, its a heartfelt note of thanks for making my stay a memorable one! Rooms: Well equipped, spacious rooms with a large bed and a sprawling bathroom and a 42" HD tv. What makes the rooms special are that there is mood lighting, awesome outdoor sitting and a 2.1 speaker: All the ingredients to party at the room itself Pool: Big sprawling and clean pool, cool sunbeds and a jacuzzi. Supply of towels was prompt. Location: Though its a bit interior, but its bang on the beach which would be a max 5 min walk from your room (though they also have a buggy service). Its almost a private beach so it was clean with white sands and less crowded.. Since it is quite a bit inside, a rent-a-scooter/car would be handy Food: Being a vegetarian is almost a sin in Goa. But the restaurant had a wide range for me and all my meals were perfect. The breakfast was fresh (which is not the usual case in many-a-place), spread was wide and had a healthy intercontinental mix. Service was awesome and Chef Aswin made sure that our food was perfect Service: Genuinely warm and very prompt. Nothing seems to big a task to them. They pamper you to the fullest and attend to every whim. Housekeeping was a bit slow couple of times, but the end result is good. Special mentions: - Rohtan at Planet Dailies (cafe) who fed use like a baby at 1.30 in the night - Chef Aswin - for making awesome vegetarian food when I thought instant noodles were my only hope - The English chap who plays saxophone at the breakfast (couldn't get his name) - The entire team of Delhi Dynamos (ISL) who were staying over there - celebrity spotting :) A friendly suggestion to the resort: a) All the pillows (though comfortable) were quite big so a couple of regular ones would be helpful b) Mood lighting is good, but 1 regular bright light would make a bit more convenient. Having said that, take nothing away from these guys. It was a very comfortable stay, could be the best resort in Goa. I will look forward to my next visit

author: Divisht
title: Planet Hollywood. Truly a superb Planet.
text: I stayed in this property with my family from 12th to 15th August. Its a new property opened just 2 months back. Everything is new and nice. The interiors are simply a delight . The property has huge manicured lawns and its own beach which is very clean and with proper security personnel and life guards all around.Once in the resort . u'll not feel to go anywhere out. The swimming pool seems awesome after evening. The staff is indeed cooperative and very helpful and always smiling . On the front desk, Ahmed was very helpful right from the check in till our checkout. Russel too helped us every time we needed anything. Food is simply awesome, their breakfast buffet has a plenty of options and everything has been taken care of . They have Planet Daillies which has the buffet, Fame Bar, Heart Bar Justin and Nigel were on their toes and made sure we get everything we need on the table. Rooms and overall property is simply the best in Goa i've seen till now. Dinesh too helped us getting the cab to go for Madgaon City. Just a suggestion that Wifi should be complementary or else the rates should be reasonable. Great hospitality and service. I'll keep on visiting for sure. Cheers to the PH team.

author: 418carloc
title: An absolute Haven in South Goa - MUST visit!
text: Myself and my girlfriend choose to stay at this hotel for our first few nights in Goa. In booking this hotel, we hoped for a luxurious stay that would allow us to recuperate after our long haul flight - and let's just say, we were not disappointed. In fact, our room, the hotel and the facilities were so luxurious that we didn't want to leave! We were in the 'superhero' wing of the hotel and our 'batman' themed room had absolutely everything we needed to be super comfortable and relaxed. The little touches - such as the leg massager, beautiful mood lighting, mini bar, comfy work desk, huge shower, large flatscreen TV and the high quality mattress and bedding - made us very content and we felt like we could have stayed in our hotel room forever. The location of the hotel is just perfect. It's right on Utorda Beach and although we didn't go swimming due to the high waves, we did enjoy lengthly walks on the beach. Facilities at the hotel are top-notch and guests can enjoy one of the biggest swimming pools in all of Goa, a poolside bar and jacuzzi, a steam room, spa, fully equipped fitness centre and indoor and outdoor activities for kids. Its design and general vibe is also quite spectacular. Finally, I have to give the food and the service a mention. Sundar, the head of food at the hotel, has a team of chefs and waiting staff that work insane magic when it comes breakfast, lunch and dinner time. The choices at the breakfast buffet was plentiful and we enjoyed freshly cooked omelettes, pancakes, salads, fresh fruit, bread, cereal, tea/coffee and freshly baked breads among a wide selection of Indian breakfast favourites. Dinner was equally as delicious and, as it was our first few days in India, the chef cooked us up a special meal that consisted of some Goan traditional food. It was amazing. The staff at the hotel really could not have done enough for us during our stay and Anand and his team made us feel so welcome from the minute we walked into the reception area on the first day of our stay. Everyone from the receptionists and the waiting staff at the restaurant to the housekeepers and security guards were lovely and always had a welcoming "good morning" or "good evening" for us. South Goa is really quite beautiful and we cannot wait to return to PH in the future.

author: MadhaviHK
title: Feel like a star !
text: So Hollywood . From the moment you enter the hotel reception area you see this big wall with pictures of some of the most iconic Hollywood artists from the tinsel town. And you feel like being one their own. What a property and right on the beach . Can anyone visiting Goa ask for anything more ? The rooms spell luxury . Satin sheets , music docks and your very own foot massager. The lawns well maintained . The beach within the property and the front office and other staff pleasant. The only few drawbacks - wifi connectivity was not up to the mark . Kept losing my whatsapp connection ever so often . And the hotel should have a better choice in breakfast buffet dishes to live up to it's name. Other than that the service rating would improve considerably if the in room dining staff was prompt with your order . Today I would rate it 3 out of 5 . But nevertheless I had a great time relaxing in the gardens by the beach . Blissfully quiet !!

author: shameel_sham
title: Decent Place to Visit, Give them more time to settle down
text: This is a nice property, not as huge as Holiday INN or Leela in South Goa. but big enough for a few days. The fact that it is new has its advantages and disadvantages. Amongst the advantages is the fact that the rooms are new and everything in the hotel seems fresh. The disadvantages would be in the service and the quality of food. This has much room for improvement. They have only one single restaurant operations (june 2015) which is for all meals - largely a buffet service but if you need anything special please ask the chef. Service is mediocre at the most and they are unable for handle rush hour traffic. One thing that really pissed me off was the number of flies(indoors)- maybe its a goa season thing but irritating, also the staff did not seem bothered. The guy roaming with the electric racket was waiting for the fly to lose its way and land into his racket rather than him going after them...hilarious. The bar menu is very very sad - they only have a limited types of alcohol which is upsetting when you are going for a conference. They have a single variety of red/white wine and their own company bottled beer(and nothing else). While some of the guests went to the local booze shop and bought PIMMS And Baileys etc, I just find it hard to understand why a resort property would not have an elaborate wine list. The rooms are nice and comfy - the pillows are super huge so unless you want to have a neck ache, dont sleep using them. When we complained on day 2 (8 rooms) we got alternate pillows in the evening but even they were not that great. The rooms have all these fancy lights etc - but is like a Sherlock mystery trying to find the appropriate switches, many of them in difficult and non-reachable positions. However good thing - all rooms have massages and boom boxes which is wow. The pool and the gym is the best thing in this hotel, plus the fact that it has an opening into the beach. The property does have potential but they have a long way to go - being an ex hotelier my feedback. Fix your rooms, put in more signs or as a courtesy ask someone to brief the guest on all switches, eg - the switch which controls the blinds in the bathroom was impossible to locate as it was unmarked Add a few more soft pillows Invest in a room service menu - I had to ask them to write stuff on a piece of paper as they did not have the menu Improve on the wine list and other alcohol Improve food quality - overall 3/5 nothing great add some additional entertainment options - you have a large screen in the lobby, why not use that to show some movies Things I really liked The suite is awesome, the massage chair worth the additional money The sound bar in the rooms is a solid investment Seating in the balcony is comfortable Pool and gym very well equipped Banquet service good

author: HPSP123
title: Lovely new resort
text: Planet Hollywood is a newly opened resort on Utorda Beach, away from the hustle and bustle of the crowded Goa beaches. Stayed here for 3 nights and had a very pleasant experience overall. The hotel has a very Hollywood theme to it as noted in its name. Several photos and autographs of Hollywood actors, movie posters and movie quotes are part of the hotel's decor. This is something different from the usual and very fun! The rooms are very spacious and feature a well designed spacious bathroom. The rooms on the ground level open up to a small patio which has chairs to lounge on. Plenty of greenery around. The beach is only a couple of minutes walk away and you can access it from within the resort. This is not like the usual crowded beaches of Goa and much more appealing. Travellers should note that this is a new hotel that has been in operation for less than a month. A lot of the facilities on premises are not yet open including Fame restaurant, some cafes and bars, a disco etc. At present there are no options for meals on hotel premises except Planet Dailies.
