We have had some wonderful service - especially Maureen and her husband Rob, who run the evening outside area so smoothly. They are both stars! It was also lovely to have table service around the pool and grass area and during the entertainment in the evening. Great service! The evening entertainment was mostly great - the Blues brothers and Shaun who sung at the fire show were a particular highlight! My husband and I both try to keep fit and Krista was *amazing*. She runs a whole variety of classes and tailors them to your needs. We also visited the gym which was quite dated and very small so I would recommend doing classes rather than the gym. So why not a 5 for this hotel? There were bin collections for either the hotel or the adjacent building late at night (after 11pm) and early in the morning (before 7am) almost every day which our room was quite close to and this was very noisy. There is only one main seating area on the evenings - so if you don’t want to watch the entertainment, you have no where else to go other than your room. I would also say some carpets need updating obviously that doesn’t impact your trip but does impact your first impression. I also worried about the number of empty bottles that aren’t recycled...the impact must be huge! We are not returners to hotels but we can totally understand why people visit this hotel year upon year.

author: Coeliacgirl18
title: Brilliant hotel! Safe for coeliacs!
text: I’ve just come back from a weeks visit and I have had a brilliant time. The transfer is around 1hr 15- it’s a fully air conditioned coach. There is food in your room if you have a late arrival. Everyday the room has a fresh bottle of water and they come round on the sun-beds and give you cold water in the mornings. Hotel itself is lovely, relaxed, and clean! The sun-beds are comfy and there are so many of them dotted around so no worries about having to get up early ( only if you want one right next to the pool ). The beach is a little cove that is beautiful, it is less than a minutes walk from the hotels sunbeds so there is no need to pay for ones on the beach. The room is really nice, good air con. There is a proper single bed for a group of 3 ( not a rubbish sofa bed!) Food- I am coeliac so require a gluten free diet- IT IS SAFE FOR COELIACS! The buffet is really well labelled of all allergens in the dishes, it is all kept clean and each dish with its own spoon/tongs. The head chef is more than happy to speak to you to accommodate, they have gluten free bread available on request- which they warm up separately for you. Every night you always have a variety of dishes to choose from. The restaurant staff clean away plates very efficiently and Nicolas in particular was always very attentive and friendly. As part of your stay you get a dinner at the a la carte restaurant- this is all fully labelled on the menu and there is plenty you can eat from. Can not fault the hotel- wish we stayed longer!

author: G6623OIjoh
title: Relaxing week
text: Just returned from a lovely week here at the Sea Breeze. The hotel is very clean and well kept. Our rooms were nice with comfy big beds. Great sea view too. The staff are all very welcoming and helpful. We particularly loved the pool bar and our chats with the bar and waiting staff. Thanks to Mark for the lovely Frappes, especially for delivering them to our sunbeds right on queue! Also thanks to Spiros for keeping my Son and his friend amused. A great team at the pool bar and great to be able to sit and sip a cocktail while cooling off in the pool. We all enjoyed the pool party and BBQ, well done to Sian, Amanda and team. The food was plentiful and always a great selection. Thanks to Maureen for looking after us well most evenings, we loved our spot outside. There are plenty of sunbeds and no scrambling for them in the mornings. The grassed area is great, lots of space and a nice breeze. Take a short stroll round to the next bay - Sirina Bay where there is a great beach bar and a nice secluded bay. Seemed to be a popular spot with locals. Would recommend a stay here and hope to return at some point in the future.

author: sian_fach92
title: Can’t wait to go back
text: Some reviews have complained that the hotel was too far away from Protaras. If you want to be surround by lively nightlife stay in Protaras. If you want a relaxing time with fantastic service then book a stay at this hotel. We arrived in the early hours of the morning and were checked in quickly and were given drinks and snacks. Our room was clean and modern and we were excited as we had booked a room with a jacuzzi which was a lovely addition. We pretty much spent the entire week in a bubble of comfort and relaxation being waited on hand and foot. The staff are unbelievably friendly right from the cleaning team to the restaurant staff. We must give a special mention to the poolside bar staff especially Spyros and the main man himself Vangelis aka the little guy with glasses. If these two aren’t there when we come back you may witness a grown man cry. They provided, especially Vangelis, quick service with a bit of banter and were one of the main attractions of the place. There are activities throughout the day so if you find relaxing in the gorgeous pool with a drink all day boring there are other things to do. Finally the food. Even with one of us being a fussy eater there was no problem finding something to eat. Great selection from the buffet, breakfast, lunch and dinner everyday. If you miss a meal then they even have a snack bar with a good menu. In the evening there is some entertainment every night and the evening challenge is always fun. We should also mention the great friendly service from the evening bar staff. If a manager from the hotel reads this please please let us know if you have any deals coming up because the sooner we can come back to you the better.

author: MontegoBleu
title: Just brilliant - loved every minute!
text: We have just returned from a 10 night stay at the Atlantica Seabreeze, I cannot fault anything about our stay here, it was great. The location is excellent, perfect for that relaxing holiday. It is not too far away from the town's (Protaras being the closest) if you feel the need to go exploring, which I did every couple of days, most is walking distance but the bus seemed popular. The staff are wonderful here, they are so very friendly and do their up most to make sure you are happy, nothing is an issue. I have never been to a hotel where every person of staff is so friendly, even down to the room maids, they all say hello and good morning - which really makes a difference. The food is amazing, I am sometimes skeptical of all inclusive food, it can become abit "samey" after a time, but the food was really good. Everything to suit everyone's pallet, not greasy or unhealthy, like I have experienced in other hotels. Please book the Ala Carte restaurant, it's really good and nothing like the all inclusive experience. Pool area is great, again the staff here are fantastic. Swim up pool bar is a nice touch, and is great to swim up of an afternoon and drink the national Cypriot Keo beer, the cocktails were good also. I haven't got any negatives really. Possibly, some nights they seemed to be short staffed which can become noticeable at times when waiting along time for drinks, and it can get very busy in the evening in the reception area where the entertainment is, but they are more than happy to open the pool bar if you want to sit away from the entertainment, which I did find a little annoying after time. Maybe it was just too loud, when the waiter can't hear your order - the music is too loud in my opinion. Another point to mention - Men are required to wear long trousers in the evening for dinner (to some of our party, this was a great shock!) they do let you look in the "lost and found" hotel trousers - but no-one seemed to like these funnily enough...so just be warned, as they are very strict on this policy. All in all a great experience, and would definitely book again to come back to Cyprus and Atlantic Seabreeze.

author: JayneB482
title: Wonderful holiday
text: Have just returned from an 11 night break in this fab hotel. The location is perfect. Far enough away from the busy areas to ensure a peaceful holiday but close enough if/ when you wanted them as their is a bus stop right outside. We were able to get a sun bed no matter what time of day, as we preferred the grassed are which gives you the choice of using the pool or the beach for a swim. Our room ( 314) was at the side of the hotel giving a great view of famagusta in the distance and was great to sit on in the evening with a drink from the bar. The rooms are are well furnished, the bed a great size and the bathroom had complimentary shampoo, conditioner, shower gel if you wanted to use them. There was a kettle with tea/ coffee and milk should you want to use them and these were topped up as you used them. The rooms also have a fridge. The choice of food was amazing, so much to chose from , and I even saw the chef advising which foods were suitable for one guest who didn’t eat animal products. He took the time to take the guest around all foods pointing out which ones would be suitable which was a lovely touch. The pool does get busy and a little noisy ( depending on the guests at the time ) late afternoon, but it was never a problem. I know that there was one group of guests who gave some negative comments just before we arrived but am more than happy to say that we found no evidence to back this up. It is a shame that people feel the need to do this rather than speaking to the hotel whilst they are actually there. We had a fabulous time and would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel. If you are looking for a relaxing place, with great facilities and wonderful food look no further, Enjoy ☀️☀️

author: nastazia2
title: Amazing return visit
text: Returned back from this little gem for yet another amazing visit. Just to clarify a few things from the reviews that I saw below. Some of the comments that I see sometimes make me believe I have visited another hotel. If you do not know that this hotel is outside Protaras, then probably you did not do your homework. It is clearly stated that it is 4km from Protaras main area. The staff of this hotel can not do enough for the guests. Marinos, the maitre is always welcoming everyone with a smile and the staff of the restaurant work tirelessly to make sure that everyone is happy. Same at the main bar and pool bar area. The rooms are combact and just right to be comfortable, with cosy furniture. Tea and coffee always replenished. Clean and comfortable. The food is amazing, with a lot to choose from. The Gala night is the main hit. If you do not find anything to eat, then I have no idea what you do actually eat. Chicken, pork, turkey, rice, potatoes (usually 2 of them on each meal), pasta, roasted pork every Sunday with pudding and roast potatoes, salmon, mussels, roast fish and a large variety of salads and salad bar to choose from and on every meal there are some small salads in small portions to choose from are a small sample of what you can find to eat here. A great number of sunbeds to accommodate all of the guests is available, so no problem in finding one. If you do not like the fact that there are sunbeds everywhere, you can sit on the grass area.. The Management Team is always there and always eager to listen to everyone. The manager asks for feedback and we had a chat with him before leaving. I would strongly recommend this hotel for a nice, quiet, relaxing holiday with nice atmosphere, food and service.

author: AEEJohnson
title: Lovely holiday
text: My partner and I spent a lovely 10 days away in this hotel, 2 weeks after being home we are still pining to go back! The staff were all wonderful and worked hard to ensure everyone had a lovely holiday; even the lady who served the tea and coffee in the mornings seemed really passionate about her job! We found the food to be really good and nice variety each night. We were really impressed with the breakfast and how much was offered. We visited the Culinarium and also really enjoyed that meal which was lovely. The only downside to this meal was there seemed to be a tense relationship between the 2 waiters which was quite obvious at one point, I think another waiter in that area would help make things a bit smoother there. The pool area was really pleasant and it made it much more enjoyable to know there was plenty of sun beds, so you didn’t feel the pressure to get down there early. Mike who worked at the pool bar was real credit to that team and it was obvious how hard he worked. Our room was the only downside for us. Although it was lovely and comfortable, our room was about the service entry, so we were woken late and night and really early in the morning twice during our stay with the rubbish bins coming to collect the hotels rubbish. Not only did we have the loud beeping as the vehicle as it reversed down the long drive, but then also the loud whirring as it collected the rubbish which seemed to go on for about 10-15 minutes. I know this can’t be avoided, but it would have least have been nice to have been made aware of this when we checked in instead of having the rude awakening! I would definitely recommended paying extra for one of the sea view rooms. One thing re the trips offered by TUI, we went on the 4x4 trip to the mountains and to Famagusta, which we did enjoy, but we’re definitely oversold by Helen the rep, especially the latter trip. If you go on this trip, expect more stops and standing around than what is advertised! All in all, we had a really amazing holiday and would definitely come back to this hotel in the future - thanks for a wonderful stay!

author: 74bexg
title: A lovely holiday - relaxing and fun !
text: I would recommend this hotel in a heart beat. Just returned from a two week stay at this lovely hotel. If you want to unwind this is the hotel for you. Staff are wonderful, attentive and friendly. I would especially like to mention the girls in the bar, Yasmin, Olivier and Joanna who provided an excellent service always smiling and kept the drinks flowing. Stavros in the restaurant was full of fun and nothing was too much trouble. Food was lovely, good variety could always find something to eat. The Sunday roast was an excellent touch, with roast potatoes and Yorkshire puddings. A pool party and bar-b-que was fun and broke up the week. Again food was of an excellent standard and tasty. Overall the entertainment was excellent with quizzes; French bowls , volleyball and live singers on an evening. Always had a good atmosphere and we enjoyed a dance ! Management have a strong presence and take an interest in their quests. On our last day the general manager spoke to all quests that were departing- a nice touch. Lovely walks were enjoyed to nearby harbours and churches, we walked an hour each morning, lovely seneary but too hot to walk in the afternoon. This is just personal preference but maybe some music by the pool and more access to water other than the main restaurant and reception before 10am. Thank you for an amazing holiday and lovely memories ! We will return. Bex and Jim Garvie

author: j0diek
title: Best Week!!!
text: Got home from an amazing week at this lovely hotel. Me and my boyfriend had the best time and were very relaxed. We was very impressed with our room and was very thankful to get a bottle of prosecco in our room on arrival as it was our anniversary! The room was clean and cosy, however, our air conditioning was not ver good as we spoke to another couple and they said theres was freezing, but ours didn't make a difference. Besides that, everything else was perfect. The food for breakfast, lunch and dinner was superb, always a variety and catering for all needs. There is a different theme every night which makes it more interesting. All of the staff are very professional and will always be there to help and serve you. The pool was so nice. The sunbeds were the comfiest sunbeds I have ever laid on. Getting a sunbed was not a problem, me and my partner almost always got a comfy sunbed by the pool, but if not there is loads of sunbeds on the grass area. The pool bar is great, nice range of drinks. The only thing I would say about the pool area is a bit of music would be nice :D however, the pool bar staff were amazing, so friendly and funny. The service was 5* as they came round to your sunbeds and took your drinks orders and brought the drinks to you bed. The spa was nice, the indoor pool is freezing!!!! so nice after being in the heat all day. The hotel is right next to a lovely beach, and if you walk down the opposite way there is a lovely empty beach, was no one on it every time we went. Taxi into main town protaras is only 9 euros. I will most definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who wants a relaxing week in a lovely country.

author: mikehZ4303CG
title: Chill out holiday
text: Have just returned from a 11 day holiday where I have to say it was one of the most relaxing holidays I have ever been on. I normally when adding a review nominate certain staff who I felt gave great service at this hotel I would have to nominate everybody they were all the nicest staff I have met from reception, cleaners, waiters, bar staff, cooks, everybody the hotel should be very proud of the service they offer. Bedrooms very clean and tidy bed very comfortable. Food Breakfast excellent choice always hot, excellent service. Lunch again good choice always something to choose very good soup and cheese board. Evening meal again good choice always a roast on offer, mostly pork tbf. But fresh, hot. Afternoon snack bar good choice cooked fresh to order outdoor seating the hotel could do with putting ceiling or floor standing fans was a little overpowering due to heat. Pool bar excellent good choice but selected cocktails not included on all inclusive check before you order. Main bar waitor service from 4pm comfy seating ideal for relaxing. Entertainment was excellent really enjoyed the quizzes, challenges and the acts that performed especially Chic (Rod Stewart) The Blues brothers, and soul and reggae night. Overall if you want really want good food and drink, excellent service this is the hotel for you. Did have one concern if u look at the pictures supplied by hotel, travel agents u get the impression that the beach is part of the hotel it is not. It's a shared beach with the hotel next to it and is quite a walk from toilets and hotel. You also have to pay €2-50 per sunbed and same for parasol which was not a problem but the distance from the hotel is.

author: X9129EHlynnm
title: Second Visit, Even Better!!!
text: Having stayed at this hotel in 2010 for our Silver Wedding Anniversary we decided to visit again for our 33rd Wedding Anniversary after reading all the excellent reviews we booked through Tui for 11 days. The hotel has had a total refurbishment since we last stayed and it looked amazing. We booked a limited sea view room & ended up with a corner room with a good view. The rooms are spotless & cleaned daily with fresh towels daily, only one little negative please get some bigger bath towels, for some of us on the larger side!! The staff are all brilliant & can’t do enough for you. The food was excellent & even the fussiest of eaters would able to find something to please. Plenty of choice, the salad bar which was my favourite always had great choices, hot food was replenished regularly so food was always hot. Breakfast, lunch & dinner - always spoilt for choice. Our biggest surprise at lunch & dinner was when asked for a drinks order if you ordered wine, you got a bottle not a glass!! This was great as you didn’t have to try & find someone for a refill. We weren’t keen on the white wine but the red & rose were good, as was the sparkling wine. We took advantage of the free visit to the Al a carte restaurant which was very nice - eventually!! Our starters were very nice but the main courses were cold!! Neither of us could eat them. This was quickly addressed by the head waiter with fresh meals, unfortunately we weren’t the only ones that evening to receive cold meals which seems to happen on a regular occurrence after reading TA reviews. This hotel is a bus or taxi ride from Protarus town, but if like us you are after peace & quiet this is the place to be. The entertainment staff work hard doing poolside quizzes, handing out puzzle sheets to do around the pool, while having drinks around the pool served to you from the staff, evening entertainment was very good again with an evening quiz & usually a singer A big thank you all the staff for another fantastic holiday, too many to remember names & a very big thank to Helen the Tui Rep & the two girls who ran the entertainment all day & in the evening. Until our next visit......... sooner rather than later!!

author: kimcglasgow
title: Great Holiday
text: Just returned from a 10 day holiday to the Sea Breeze. We had a very relaxing time, the hotel has a very laid back feel to it. We stayed in a side sea view room which got the sun first thing in the morning so was cooler later in the day. The room was bright with a large comfy bed and good air con and wi-fi. Our cleaning lady was lovely, always smiling and did a great job as the room was very clean. Thank you for the bottle of fizz that was left in our room on my birthday. At last a hotel that has enough sunbeds for everyone so no need to get up at the crack of dawn to reserve a bed. We sunbathed on the grass area and liked to go to the beach, about a minutes walk away, and swim in the sea to cool down. We found the food to be of very good quality with plenty of choice at breakfast, lunch and dinner. You can be as healthy or unhealthy as you want. The restaurant manager who greeted everyone and showed us to our table was very friendly, always smiling and asking how our day was. We sat outside for our evening meal and were well looked after by Angelo. He is such a character and kept us all laughing with his banter. The food at the A la Carte was very nice but we thought it lacked atmosphere and to be honest were just as happy at our usual place being entertained by Angelo. I thought the entertainment was good, better than other Sensimar hotels we have stayed at, and particularly enjoyed the George Michael tribute act. The staff all work very hard. Sian and Emily are doing a great job keeping everyone entertained, and Helen, the Tui rep is one of the best reps we have met, very helpful and always around for a chat. We did the Famagusta trip with Mr John which was very interesting and highly recommended. You will find his details at the bus stop outside the hotel. We really enjoyed our holiday at the Sea Breeze Hotel and can't wait to return.

author: Lindabowness
title: Mixed thoughts
text: My husband (who has a walking disability following a stroke) and I have just returned from the Sea Breeze. We agree with many of the comments written. The staff work so hard to ensure everyone is happy. The food was varied and good and everyone in the dining room was friendly and courteous ensuring we had everything we needed. A special mention here to Maureen who served my husband his main course so we could eat together. Our bed was massive and comfortable. There was never any problem getting a sunbed at any time of the day. All good. So why mixed? The pool. We chose the Sea Breeze because it had Roman steps which meant he could leave his walking frame by the pool, walk slowly down the steps holding on to the hand rail, and stand by the side of the pool walking along or doing his exercises. Sadly this was not to be. The hand rail did not even reach the bottom step,it was in the middle of the steps and there was no side of the pool to hold on to.It was totally impossible for him to get in or out without two other guests holding on to each side of him when they saw I was unable to hold him up and get him to a safe place.In other hotels Roman steps have enabled him to walk around in the water and that was why we booked Sea Breeze. I felt I had done my "homework" trying to find a suitable place for our stay but it turned out not to be. The situation could not be changed but I am writing this to ensure that other guests in a similar position do not make the same mistake. A ladder into a pool has two supportive handles which can be held until you are safely in the pool. Roman steps...nothing to get you safely in and to a supportive wall. Very sad for disabled guests who are trying to get the most out of their holiday.

author: KrisMat
title: Nice hotel, room for improvement
text: We stayed at the Sensimar Sea Breeze for 10 nights during May. Overall we thought the hotel was lovely and would recommend it. A few things could do with sprucing up a bit to make it to the Sensimar standard but I think overtime this will happen. Here our are pros & cons of the hotel - Pros - -Nice swimming pool with a swim up bar -Sun beds really comfortable & plenty of them -Friendly staff on the whole with good service. Regularly coming round sunbeds etc to top up drinks -Dinner service works well. Lovely guy (Marinos) always greeted you and took you to your table. Never had to queue for long. They do enforce the long trouser rule for men! -Food was always hot, plenty of it, good quality and choice -The A La Carte was lovely, worth a visit -Spa was lovely and relaxing. I had a massage which was good -Entertainment team try hard and do plan bits for most days. Exercise classes, trips out, experience sessions etc Cons - -WiFi mostly unusable except in the main bar -A little slow with topping up drinks at dinner -Bathroom a bit dated but shower etc all worked well -We had a ground floor room near bins, noisy around 10:30/11:30pm while emptying them. Had one bin emptied at 3:30am. Once complained about this they did say they would look into it as the agreed time with the bin company is around 11pm (which is too late anyway we feel) -Evening entertainment was as described (low key). Although we did feel it was mainly aimed at the middle/older generations. At times we found it a bit boring. -Location is fairly remote. Little within walking distance FYI is you’re looking for late checkout, it was €30 until 4pm, €40 until 5pm, €50 until 6pm.

author: mcaddens
title: Disappointed
text: The Hotel is situated just outside paralimni in a quiet area 15 mins walk and you are in a busier area .. The Atlantica sensimar sea breeze was a disappointment. In general the hotel has had some updating work done I would personally say not done to a high standard, rough around the edges if you look closely but looks nice enough, I did expect more from this hotel. Staff in general were nice enough but we did not interacted with anyone, this to be honest is very unusual for us but no one seemed interested it might be near the end of the season but a friendly smile goes a long way. We sat outside every day for breakfast/lunch/dinner. We noticed one table in particular had a reserved sign on it for the same couple with people being moved from it all week, as the week went on more tables started popping up with reserved signs on them this left empty tables and no one able to sit on them people like to sit out in the terrace for breakfast/lunch or dinner but had to walk by empty tables and go inside and signs started popping up inside too, this should only be for a la carte restaurants. all in all the biggest disappointment is the restaurant, the food is okay and plenty of selection but staffing seems to be an issue at this time of year not many to cover a full service.. staff walk by you and dont ask if you want tea coffee or a top up of any kind you have to do the asking. On Gala nights you wait in a queue to get in the restaurant to be seated but people are coming out of the lift to a line of diners waiting to be seated in an empty dining hall so large bottleneck at door (see pictures) waiting to be taken to a seat, 2 staff do this in a near full hotel !!! Gala night I would rather forget when we got to our seat outside at the side we waited 15 minutes before I had to go look for someone to take a drinks order and the queue for dinner was far too long I just ended up having salad and cheese & biscuits the lack of staff in the restaurant was very obvious and this has let the hotel down. The small things make the difference staff should ask if you would like a top up of coffee/ tea or wine but they don’t. The spa was great would highly recommend. Would I recommend this hotel ?? Yes it can tick boxes if they fix the service would I return maybe if the small things were fixed service should still be there at the end of the season... Not much waiter service during the day either on the lawn area once with water around 10am and maybe another visit virtually non existent still paying top prices for this time of year but lacking on the services.

author: mrstepheni
title: When All Inc is Not What It Seems
text: We arrived for the last 2 weeks of the hotels season so may have some bearing on our experience,however we paid a small fortune for the holiday and expected better. Off to poor start on arrival at 0200 hrs, booked a superior room/view, given a basic room with no extras,too tired to argue,thankfully we were re- housed the following day. Housekeeping was inconsistent to say the least, out of a 14 day stay they missed topping up toiletries,coffee etc,changing towels on 10 Days! All meals are taken in the main buffet restaurant , good choice of hot and cold food at breakfast to suit all tastes. Lunch choices I’d say were average both hot and cold. Evening meal choices similar standard to lunch,you will always find something but not always be hot/ fresh. There 2 additional specialist restaurants,one of which is Italian,the other Greek, you are allowed one free visit to each during the duration of your stay, unfair if you’ve booked for 2 weeks as you get the same as someone staying for a week! Drinks are all local beers,one does say Carlsberg(No way) spirits are non premium,premium brands you pay for. A pool bar is in service during the day until approximately 1800 hrs, again not all drinks all inc, a frozen fruit cocktail was asking 5 Euros. Evening Entertainment is similar to all European venues I’ve been to,tribute acts etc, some better than others. Staff- Front of desk always helpful in replacement items that housekeeping missed - Staff in the main bar area were fine,albeit I do not need to be reminded by certain staff that it is coming to end of season and they will out of work soon,I’ll tip when I believe it is deserved,which we did on numerous occasions,service then got better ! - The guy who welcomes you into the main restaurant morning/noon and night deserves a special mention(Marios), the guy never had a day off while were there,cracking guy. Nice garden area for the sun loungers,plenty of room and no need to get up at the crack of dawn to secure one. No WiFi in the garden areas. All reps were fine,no issues here. As I explained at the start, the Hotel was closing for the season after we left so may have a bearing on our experience as everyone seemed to be winding down, however,people from the U.K. pay a lot money to stay here so standards should reflect this,definitely no more than a scraper 4* Hotel,nearer 3* plus.

author: algy156
title: Coming again? Almost certainly but.....
text: If 3+ were an available rating I, at present, would choose that. Once again, a restful two weeks at the Seabreeze, an hotel I have recommended for some years and will continue to do so as it has so many things going for it. There can be few hotels where the staff looking after you, at all levels, are so cheerful and want you to have an enjoyable holiday and ask you to come back. The Seabreeze is an hotel you want to love. A quiet sunbathing area, where you can always get a bed and brolly. Good food and drink and comfortable rooms. However, it has to be said there are issues that need to be addressed. First there is the staff shortage which particularly affects the main restaurant and the inability to have the Garden Bar open during the evening (strangely notices in various places indicated the Garden Bar opened from 9pm until late – it did not). Other departments may be short of staff but existing staff are doing their best to provide the usual first-class service, all credit to them for their efforts. Any hotel problem, report it to Reception, not the Rep, and it is resolved very quickly. Another problem is the area outside the main restaurant doors and the passageway leading to the pool. Apart from the crowding that occurs at 7pm when many guests wait to enter the restaurant, this area is hot, airless and smelly. From breakfast time throughout the day there is a constant smell of food from the kitchen in this area, which many guests find awful. Whilst queuing here ladies complain that their clothes and hair pick up this smell which is clearly not acceptable. At the very least the installation of a fan and air fresheners would help in the short term. The long-term answer would probably require installation of heavy duty extractor fans in the area. However, think positively, as the general manager has said, these are known areas of concern and will be addressed during the shutdown months. We shall see…….

author: Teeshhampshire
title: Stunning!
text: Didn't think it could get any better as the past 7 years have been outstanding but they managed it! The whole hotel was spotlessly clean, with new seating and decoration in the main bar area making it light and airy and reception was exceellent - smooth and no fuss. Cases taken to our room which was immaculate and kept so by the lovely Maria.. Yet again the food was oustanding as were the restaurant staff and the head chef was always around, usually in the evenings supervising. The new cullinarium, which you could visit once per stay was just superb! Pool area was kept very clean and the bar staff did an excellent job. Shame some of the so called "adults" couldn't be bothered to take glasses and rubbish away when they left! Sunbeds and parasols were available no matter what time you went down , but guests still put towels on them and went out for the day! The evening entertainment on most nights was just outstanding and well worth staying up for! Buses are frequent and inexpensive if you like a "blackpool type" night out in Protaras or elsewhere, as the hotel does not do very loud music as it isn't what most guests want.. It is peaceful and a relaxing atmosphere. The Cypriot council have done a lot to make the paths outside the hotel and sea area safer and a half hour walk either way was great. ALL the staff put themselves out to make the holiday a pleasant and stress free break and couldn't do enough for you. To name names would be very unfair as all do their very best! Will look forward to returning next year and thanks again to all for a lovely two weeks rest! .

author: Amyf1702
title: Amazing holiday
text: Had the most amazing time here! Hotel is gorgeous and the weather was even better! Don’t have any complaints! Staff were all lovely and so attentive, especially Irene on reception. We stayed for 2 weeks, food was to a high standard every meal, there wasn’t one time were I struggled, loads of selection but not too much so nothing spoiled, it was all fresh food and never empty trays, you are served on so all drinks are ordered via staff there. Large selection of drinks on all inclusive, largest option I’ve seen on all inclusive before so many cocktails to choose from which can be deadly if you sit at the pool bar all afternoon! Staff there as well are all lovely and keep hydrated throughout the day! We had a sea view room on level 4! 435! Room was brilliant and with us arriving late we received sandwich’s and fruit and drinks on arrival and also a bottle of champers as part as the superior room! Only downfall was the small shower, shaving legs was a lot of effort! Bedroom was cleaned everyday again high standards all round! Entertainment was great as well something different but enjoyable everynight! the location is brilliant especially if you get cabin fever it’s 10 euros to the portorias strip loads of bars and shops and restaurants there, and 20 euros to Ayia napa/nissi beach we also ventured to the water park again 20 euros! Also we had a late flight on the way out, we weren’t able to keep our room on as was a sea view which is understandable it needed to be cleaned but we was able to move to another room so we could spend another glorious day in the sun and get showered afterwards ready for the flight home! All in all was a lovely chilled holiday! Couldn’t recommend more!!

author: AngleBlue
title: Relaxing friends hotel
text: We have just returned from a lovely relaxing holiday staying at the Sea Breeze. The hotel is fairly small and in a peaceful location. There are buses outside the hotel that take you to Protaras (20 mins) and Ayia Napa (40 mins). Most of the staff are very friendly and the service is of a high standard. For us the only negative about the service was the maitre d' - at dinner time, he rushed of at a speed that you would not want to keep up with, without asking where you would like to sit. We asked for a certain area a few times and he was quite rude to us....not what you expect from a TUI Sensimar hotel. The drinks service isn't good either, you are only asked if you would like a drink as you are seated. The food was very nice with a good variety but a bit repetitive, mainly lamb and beef and for someone like me that prefers chicken, we only had grilled chicken once. We did not eat at lunch time, so cannot commit on the meat choice then. The rooms are nicely decorated and the beds are comfortable. We paid extra for a sea view and it was amazing and worth the extra money. There is plenty of storage for cloths and other bits and pieces. The shower is in the bath and the bath has very high sides which for the less able isn't great. We do not worry about entertainment when we go on holiday but if you do, be warned its quite basic and not great. The drag queen show however was very funny and had everyone laughing. Over all I would recommend this hotel if you want a peaceful area with plenty of space. You could get a sun bed no matter what time you got to the pool, the pool was very clean and a good size. The beach area is to the side of the hotel and is owned by the local council, so you have to pay for sun beds however, you do not need to as its a few mins walk from the hotel. Out side of the hotel there isn't too much to do, this area seems to be built for tourism. If you want to see the ancient history sites of Cyprus, its best to stay in Pathos or Limassol - this hotel is for people who want to spend their holiday relaxing and enjoying the hot sunny weather go Cyprus.

author: 991nickis
title: Not exactly as the brochure says
text: So we came to the above on September 10th and are here until September 17th 2017. This is our first Adults only hotel. The hotel nor the pool are as big as the brochure makes them look! There is no beach directly in front of the hotel you have to walk round to a little cove/bay that belongs to the hotel next door and it's not an Adults only hotel so there are children on the beach ( this wasn't a problem for us) and you will need some sort of footwear you can wear in the sea as it's quite rocky to get into the sea. You can change your "beach/pool" towels every other day? The Greek restaurant they advertise in the brochure has been shut ALL SEASON! The A La Carte is fabulous! The staff are wonderful and really helpful. The entrance from the Road to the hotel is not what we expected! The food in the buffet restaurant is good with a good variety? There is a very chilled, relaxed atmosphere at this hotel, its holidaymakers are mainly British of all types and ages. The rooms are fairly modern and the whole hotel is very clean. The main corridors could do with freshening up and new carpets. The pool could do with re-tiling as its uneven and sharp in places on the bottom ( my husband cut his foot on one of the drains on the bottom of the pool). The fridge in our room when on high still wasn't cool! The tiles in the bathroom could do with re-grouting and the underside of the bath tap was all split. However none of the very small issues would stop me from coming back. If you are coming here anytime soon be prepared it is extremely hot 35/36 degrees but feels more like 39/40. We booked a room with a limited sea view..... our view directly in front of our balcony was the apartments next door car park, if you strained your neck you might get a glimpse of the sea.

author: grayza_9
title: Fantastic Hotel
text: We visited this hotel from 20th August for a 2 week stay. Having just returned i would say this hotel is a fantastic place to stay. We arrived late and were greeted by the reception staff who were curtious and very efficient. We had room 243 which was a partial sea view. The room was spacious and well equipped with plenty of wardrobe space. Tea and coffee making facilities were provided as well as a free safe with plenty of storage and wardrobe space. Air conditioning was great and was much needed in the heat. Rooms were cleaned every day with a large bottle of water placed in the fridge. In terms of food the meals were superb. Breakfast had all the usual choices such as eggs, bacon, sausage etc. Omelettes were made to order and healthy options such as cereal toast and fruit were also readily available. There was a choice of meats most nights and lunch time with even the fussiest of eaters being able to find something they would like. The pool is fantastic and refreshing with sunbeds available round the pool and in the grassed area towards the sea. What makes this hotel so great are the staff who are always smiling even in the extreme heat and work really hard. If you need anything you just need to ask and they are always willing to help. Entertainment was good most nights even if a little short but was a nice touch and got guests involved each evening. The TUI reps Ash, Josefine and Daniel were excellent and very good at what they did. All the staff from the bars, reception and waitress service were some of the friendliest people we have ever met on our travels. One of the nice touches was the bar service through the day providing ice lollies, slush, coffees whilst sunbathing so you didnt even have to leave your sun lounger. All in all a great holiday which i would recommend to anyone and will hope to return sometime soon.

author: 182rikarde
title: Fantastic hotel with amazing staff
text: The hotel is located with a few buildings around it(like a minimarket), but other than that located without much to see or do around. The bus that goes to Protaras and Ayia Napa stops just outside every 15-40min and costs 1.50euro. Every member of staff is very friendly and all worked hard to make your stay as pleasant as possible. The standard rooms were nice and clean, but I question the decision to use bathtubs instead of normal showers. The cleaners did a good job! The pool was nice and clean, and the sunbeds were the best non-exclusive sunbeds I've experienced. Especially the ones around the pool were like soft beds. There were no shortage of sunbeds in the area, but we preferred the ones by the pool, and for those you had to be up early and reserve them with your towels. Some days they are gone as early as 06:30. Was not a fan of the beach in the bay. Was very crowded the the water suffered quite a lot due to the crowd. The poolbar was friendly and quick. It all tasted good, but the drinks were too weak. In my opinion a cocktail should be stronger than a normal glass of wine, but they were not. The restaurant was the strongest part of this hotel in my opinion. The servers were great and quick(the drinks sometimes took longer than they should).The food was amazing, especially the piece of meat they cut for you every dinner(differed between beef, pork and poultry). Quite a big fan of the american pancakes for breakfast as well. The a la carte they offered for free once per stay was good, but not sure if I preferred it over the buffé. All in all, we had a great stay and could absolutely consider coming back!

author: lovaholiday
title: ☀️💥POSITIVELY PERFECT💥☀️
text: I never usually write a review until I get home, but if your reading these reviews and considering this hotel do not hesitate to book. We arrived yesterday (23/08/17) Check in was easy and efficient , and the staff at reception explained everything we needed to know. Room is absolutely wonderful, we have a suite overlooking the pool and sea, rooms are spotless , can't fault anything , furnished to a high standard , Plenty cupboard space , fridge , air con etc, Safe is FREE! Not even a deposit is required! Pool towels are provided, again FREE! Pool area... very clean , and the best bit is you don't have to get up early to grab a bed , there's plenty, the beds are sooooo comfy, clean , and look like new, and they are positioned a good distance apart from other holiday makers, so you have your privacy, and of course being an adults only hotel , peaceful with no children around . We are right on the beach front so you can dunk in the sea and leave your things on bed on grassed area where your sunbed is. Pool bar is open and staff again are quick friendly, obliging and efficient. They even take your drink order while your sunbathing on your bed. Meals are fabulous , the quality of food is outstanding. I'm a fussy eater and my partner is vegetarian and the choice is superb. Tables in restaurant have good distance between them , and your waited on for drinks . Drinks are plentiful , staff can't do enough for you. Every single member of staff work hard, friendly and nothing is a problem. Eva the hotel manager is lovely I could have talked to her all day ! Herself and the rest of the team deserve some recognition and credit for the service they all provide . There are not many hotels that We would return to , but we will certainly return here. We don't want to leave !

author: Choscar31
title: Fantastic pool area
text: Lovely hotel with excellent staff. We enjoyed a relaxing holiday and made full use of the fabulous pool area. The loungers by the pool were the most comfortable I've ever used. The loungers in the garden area were also a lot more comfortable than most and are in plentiful supply. Loungers by the pool were snapped up very early in the morning so you need to be an early riser to secure one! The food was varied and plentiful and there was always something for even the most picky of eaters! (Me!!) Restaurant staff were very efficient, drinks orders were taken promptly and tables cleared very quickly. Likewise, the bar staff were great and very friendly. All staff including reception staff and cleaners, worked tirelessly and are fantastic, a credit to the hotel. The room we had was pleasantly decorated and had ample hanging and storage space, the only problem I had was the balcony, I had paid extra for a limited sea view, which in fairness, I got. However, the description didn't mention that the rest of the view was the hotel car park and an adjacent car park. Although it didn't spoil our experience it was disappointing not to be able to enjoy sitting on the balcony. The sports and entertainment team also did a great job and there was always something to join in with if you are so inclined. On a slightly negative note, the gym equipment was very dated and would benefit from some attention, also, although there were notices asking people to clean machines after use, there was no sanitiser provided and we had to ask spa staff for some. This is not a complaint- just a point to consider. All in all, a very pleasant stay and thanks again to all staff!! We would happily return.

author: leeclaydon
title: Relaxing adult holiday in real style
text: It takes a lot for us to be really and truly impressed but this resort really does deserve the 5 stars it seems to receive on the reviews we read before we came. Both my wife and I haven't been on an adult only holiday before so this was going to be a new adventure for us both! We were very pleasantly surprised at how lovely the hotel, its grounds, food and staff all are here. Set on the beach the hotel looks onto the calming Greek sea which is visible from the pool, bars and restaurants. We opted for one of the hotel superior sea view rooms which are nothing less than stunning. We we're especially pleased to be greeted on arrival from our transfer from the airport (which arrived on time at 1.30am from Gatwick) by friendly cheerful night staff to welcome us to the resort. We were provided refreshments on walking through the door into the reception lobby and had our bags taken up to the room for us. They even lay on a light bite in the room so no one goes hungry before bed! Amazingly thoughtful but gratefully received. Oh and the rooms also have a bottle of bubbly on chill and a bowl of fresh fruit waiting for us! The food here is freshly prepared for each sitting and the variety available is just amazing and all very tasty too! Every thing here is clean and fresh, including the helpful and friendly staff. As well seasoned travellers, this ranks as one of the best hotels we have stayed at yet. One of the reviews I have read said that the staff aren't happy until they have exceeded your expectations. Easy to say but true! My only slight gripe was that the "all inclusive" drinks menu is restricted to a selected selection so it does not include all drinks so isn't technically not truly "all inclusive", but to be fair the selected menu is quite varied and the bar staff are wonderful (especially the chatty team at the pool bar!) Well done "team Sea Breeze", keep up the good work! We fully intend to come back and see you again and will recommend this resort to others.

author: S1430GPkimm
title: Amazing hotel and stay
text: Just got back from a week at the sesimar sea breeze. After staying here now for the third time I can 100% say it is still the best hotel we have stayed at. The food is great, lots of choice. Seating in side and out. The Al a carte restaurant is a must the food is brilliant and service is great. The staff are always bringing you drinks and making sure you are enjoying your self. Also the rooms are fantastic and spacious. One thing more the guests that aren't keen on cats and like to write reviews about the cats at the hotel. There are cats that the hotel look after, but they are no bother. When you are eating outside there was one there this year and she was no bother. I would suggest if the people that don't like cats and think they shudnt be at the hotel they are being raised at. shift yourselves inside!!!! Out the way instead of moaning!!!! When the hotel are doing a good thing by trying to keep these animals safe. Would 100% recommend this hotel to anyone wishing to not have a moan about the cats. It truly is amazing. It couldn't be any better.

author: emilymmac
title: Nice quiet hotel
text: We arrived at the hotel at around midnight and were happy to be provided with sandwiches and drinks on arrival. We were able to find sunbeds every day, though if you want one right next to the pool these always seemed to be reserved from very early on in the morning. We liked the sunbeds on the grassy area as these had more space and were in the middle of the pool and the sea. We never had to wait long for service at the pool bar and there was a wide selection of drinks to choose from. The pool was quite small, which is fine if you just wanted to relax in it with your drinks, but not much space to swim in. I also found the pool to be quite warm but if you walk to the little beach to the right of the hotel the sea was very refreshing and clear so you could see lots of little fish. The food was amazing. All very high quality and better than any all inclusive we have stayed in before. Most of the staff were very helpful, though it did seem to take a while to be able to get a second drink. The evening entertainment was usually for about an hour and was okay for background noise but we found this to be a bit boring. Just outside the hotel there was a bus stop and for 1.50 euros you could get a bus all the way to nissi beach (in just over an hour), passing through pernera, protaras and ayia napa on the way. We took part in the tui trip to the abandoned town of famagusta. We really enjoyed this trip and the host was very friendly and knowledgeable, giving us information on the islands history, would highly recommend. At the end of our holiday we treated ourselves to a couples spa package. This was very relaxing. Included was an hour with a sauna, steam room and Jacuzzi to ourselves, followed by an hour long full body massage which was very relaxing. I would recommend this hotel if you want somewhere quiet to relax that also has easy access (via the bus) to other close by resorts.

author: LorraineG954
title: Beautiful hotel
text: We arrived after delayed flights at around 2.30am with welcome drinks. A very small reception area, and small friendly hotel. We were all really hungry and had sandwiches and fresh juice waiting for us in our rooms. The pool area was beautiful, not easy to get sunbeds around the pool, but the grass area is beautiful and a bit quieter. The same old problem with towels being put in beds at 6am. The waiters around the pool were amazing, catering for every need. The breakfast was really good with lots of choice from boiled, scrambled and fried eggs, pancakes, omelettes freshly cooked, cereals fruit pastries etc. Lunch and dinner were equally varied and we always found something good on the menu. We were allowed one visit to the a l carte in our 2 weeks stay. If you go for 7 10 or 14 days you are only allowed one visit. 2 visits in 2 weeks would have been better. The only downside was, there were flies everywhere during breakfast, and sometimes at lunch. Not sure why but there were really annoying whilst eating. We ventured off a few times and the local towns had some beautiful sites. Would definitely go back to Cyprus but may be upgrade to a hotel with more a l carte restaurants. The staff were all so friendly and couldn't do enough, they would go above and beyond every time. They made our holiday really. A little problem with our checking out, but that was the holiday company and certainly not the hotel.

author: janeeds
title: Superb🌞🌞🌞🌞
text: Right guys where do i start. Stayed here with my husband after looking and looking for a perfect holiday for us because I'm really really fussy. Whilst we were there i still looked on trip advisor at some of the recent reviews and, was absolutely shocked at some of the negative comments. I seriously could only find 1 fault with this hotel and that is location, but right outside hotel is a bus stop and for 1 euro 50 you could go into Protaras where there are loads of shops and bars. First the food was awesome, the restaurant clean, staff were friendly and very quick to take empty plates away. Rooms were spotless,towels changed everyday,if you wanted,also bedding too. All equipped with everything you need shampoos etc, also tea and coffee, a mini fridge, water left everyday. Even 3 pin sockets and usb outlets so no adapters. Spa was awesome. Sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, indoor pool with massage please have one they were fantastic. Outdoor pool and jacuzzi were always lovely and clean with comfortable sun beds especially around the pool. Didn't use the ones on the grass but they looked very comfy too. You don't need to get up at the crack of dawn for a bed, always beds available with people moving etc for shade or sun. Beach very near but not the best and beds and umbrellas charged not by hotel. All in all a wonderful 10 day stay at this amazing hotel where everyone was very accommodating and very friendly nothing too much trouble. We met some lovely friends including holiday makers and staff. In our last day the manager arranged an informal get together asking was there anything that could be improved. I have never known this in all my years of travel thought this showed how far the hotel went to ensure everyone has a fantastic holiday. All in all amazing 👍👍👍

author: jl417
title: A little peace of heaven
text: If you want peace and relaxation, this is the place for you. Relax with a drink by the pool, with a gentle sea breeze. Feel pampered in the luxurious spa (we had facials and massages) located in the hotel. Unlike every other Thomson's hotel I've been too (and I been to many over the years), no one interrupted your peaceful sunbathing with a hard sell. The same was true for the in house entertainment. Plenty of games, 'sports', aqua fit, took place but you weren't hassled into joining in. The hotel also offers some 'classes' such as cocktail making, and a special chef cooking session. Another gesture offered by the hotel was the 11am surprise treat where staff came round offering mini ice creams, iced coffees, melon etc. A different 'surprise' everyday. Nice touch. Evening entertainment was better than a lot of places I've been too. The 'Robbie Williams' singer was a great entertainer ! Also it was lovely to see that everyone made an effort to dress up in the evenings. adding to the evening's atmosphere. As usual all the staff were friendly and welcoming and the food was delicious. Great place to chill out.

author: RyanC21
title: Another great visit
text: Another fantastic stay at sea breeze. Friendly staff all around the hotel, especially the reception and pool bar/lobby bar staff. Compared to my visit in 2016, I think there may have been some staffing issues due to waiting that bit longer to order drinks at lunch and dinner service. The pool was clean and fantastic, I also think the sunbeds had new cushions which we noticed was a change from last year. And also the fact staff would bring around snacks or drinks of a morning. The Spa was amazing. I didn't go last year and regret there. Really recommend the couples offer that they do for 140 euro. Very attentive staff that guide you round the spa and make it a really relaxing experience. A nice touch in the room with a note saying welcome back. Much appreciated that they took the time to check their systems. I think some reviews are unjustified of late, especially regarding chipped plates, I seen a couple during my stay, if that. And even then it is not a problem as there are probably thousands of them on site. The A la carte was an enjoyable experience. Nice ambiance and quiet, nice to sit away from the rest of the guests during the dinner service, I would recommend booking this on your holiday. I would love to be back in 2018. However other holiday plans mean I will be back in 2019.

author: 967elainew
title: Brilliant Hotel and Staff
text: We stayed here from the 21June to the 6th July and absolutely loved it here. The hotel is clean snd tidy and the staff are so friendly and helpful. Nothing is too much trouble. Right from the cleaners to the hotel Manager. A big thank you Johnny the barman who looked after us, Mikaella who saw us to our table, the waitresses who worked so hard. The hotel Manager who always had time for us and listened to what we had to say. The Thomson entertainment and fitness team who were all lovely and anyone I have missed out! We did not have any problems with the wide choice of food and never found it cold. No problems with plates being cleared away, although when very busy a slight delay is to be expected. Men must wear long trousers for the evening meal, so please respect this and don't cause a scene, although I think women should not be allowed shorts either but thats just me, its nice to dress up for dinner (you can always change afterwards). Evening entertainment was usually good or if you want to go out there are plenty of buses, very cheap, or a taxi. There is a washing machine on the Spa level 3 euros, which was a bonus being there for 2 weeks. Pool towels changed 3 times a week from the Spa. Sun beds not a problem we always found one. It was very hot whilst we were there so get one on the grass towards the sea if you want a breeze. Just a short stroll to the beach and sea, which is a public beach. Sea a little rocky so beach shoes a good idea. Beautiful area so go and explore! We would definitely go back.

author: bellabooGreatBritain
title: Fourth visit shame there wont be a fifth!!
text: Out fourth visit, we previously loved this hotel but this years experience has left us with a bad taste in our mouths so for us we won't be returning. As returning guests you don't expect to be given a room over the bins, which incidentally smelled horrendous, and were emptied at midnight, there was no fruit or drink in our room, which was substandard, the bathroom had rust around the plug and a bath mat which should have been thrown away a long time ago. Complained to Joe, he couldn't have cared less, a shrug of the shoulders a " well someone has to stay in that room" and he duly went off to organize an alternative room, no apology at any point!! At least the bins were thereafter cleaned daily, but doing it at 6am???!!!! The dining room has gone completely to pot!! At breakfast literally every single bowl was chipped!!! In the evenings there are huge queues to even get in there, then when you do you're shown to tables which are not laid. An obvious shortage of staff. Marcos or Marios, whatever his name is, is totally rude, rushes off and you're expected to run after him to be shown to an unlaid table! One evening I left my bag at our table , went to get our food only to come back and someone else was sitting at our table, with my bag on it, eating food, because he had seated someone else there, we had to be paraded around the dining room looking for a laid table with hot food and drinks being carried behind us by staff!!!! Again no apology!!! My partner spoke to Joe about it the next day and once again he wasn't interested, his response was take it up with Jake!!! Which leads me nicely onto Jake!! A young man full of his own self importance with no people skills whatsoever, never makes conversation with anyone, strides around the hotel never speaking to guests or attempting to build a rapport! Unfortunately for us the old days when George would seat you, when there wasn't a shortage of staff, when the "real manager" was present and any issues were dealt with quickly, suited us better!! This was not a cheap holiday, at almost £3k we expected better!! Its not all bad, Cristos in the bar is great as was Mikaela who if you were lucky showed you to your table at dinner! Also the young lady who works in the dining room at breakfast time with the green tinted hair, she's amazing as well!!! But for us the negatives outweigh the positives!!

author: gracie5001
title: FANTASTIC
text: I have to say that our second visit to Atlantica Sea Breeze was just as good if not better than our first holiday. Where to start receptionists are amazing I loved them all so helpful and always willing to help with a smile. Bar staff at the pool were on the ball a every single day a fantastic group. Upstairs bar again wonderful and nothing was too much. Rooms have had an uplift, very large, with air con great. Tv, fridge in rooms, fresh water and tea and coffee facilities. Maids were in every single day they worked to a high standard. Dining room well I was never lost for choice. Different food every day and always hot and fresh. Staff all worked to a high standard. The Ale Carte was so special as it was my husbands birthday they put up balloons and banners on table. What more can I say. The entertainment was always varied and good. Animation team were superb they made our holiday with their enthusiasm. Once again. Thank you for a great holiday and we WILL be back..

author: M7230RZstevem
title: A little disappointed
text: Where do I start ! Let's do the good bits: Check in was smooth and courteous. Rooms are adequate without being plush. Pool and local beach are good. Entertainment in the evenings (we liked) but subject to personal opinion. The staff taking drinks orders are pretty good, chatty and efficient. Josephine, part of the entrainment team does her best and is very approachable, she puts herself out to chat with guests day and night. Never a problem getting a sunbed, big plus coming down for brekkie at 09.00 and having no problem getting one. Culinarian restaurant was very good, nice wine and proper vodka. Only one visit per stay, even on a two week hol ?? Ok, now the negatives : Food is passable, we always found something to our liking but never felt spoilt for choice. The waiting service in the restaurant was, frankly, appalling. Most meal times we would have starter plates, main meal and sweet piled up on the table, having, like most around us, giving up waiting for them to be cleared away, this may contribute to the unusual amount of flies around. Most of the waiting staff seemed new and inexperienced, so hopefully they will improve in time. Drink quality is terrible, I know it states local spirits but you couldn't get a 10 year old tipsy on the beer, let alone the meagre measures of spirit. My wife drinks vodka and coke and is normally telling the barman to stop when pouring, don't have that problem here !! To summarise : We stayed at The Pioneer Paphos in 2015 and thought it was fantastic, so good we revisited in 2016, it had changed to a SENSIMAR, good, but not quite as good as the previous year. SEABREEZE is now SENSIMAR and on talking to several people who had visited two years ago, they were scathing in their comments regarding the service in particular. They and we will not be returning mainly due to the food and drink quality.

author: SVMKM
title: Superb
text: Stayed here for 2 weeks. The atmosphere is calm and relaxed . We were excessively impressed by the extreme lengths that the staff went to, to ensure that we enjoyed our stay . The food was good and the restaurant manager was always so visibly working. This is one of the hotels where there is never a need to creep out of your bed before sunrise to reserve a sunbed. Sunbeds are always available. We found the grass area very ideal for sunbeds , there was always a cool breeze and of course the amazing sea views. Excellent bar service , never a queue. We also enjoyed evening intertainment. Our top two entertainers were "Robbie Williams" and Ska Man. We highly recommend the cataraman day trip. It is an all inclusive adults only trip. We were also fond of jumping into a local bus, 15 minute journey to Protaras. The strip is busy enough but not overwhelming. There is a choice of sports bars , live intertainments and restaurants . Back to the hotel , only a couple of niggles. The wifi is not good outdoors and the bathroom is narrow. With a big YES !!! we would go back to Sensimar Seabreeze.

author: Jama360
title: Great starf
text: We spent two weeks here, and had a great time. The staff make this place a fantastic place to stay. I have never seen such happy staff and helpful, from the bar staff to the the restaurant staff. The hotel is a beautiful with everything you need for a KIDS free holiday. The pool area is great with happy friendly staff the Neptune bar is open from 10 am and you can have a drink in the pool. The small beach cove is a great place to swim just be warned it gets over crowded at the weekend. There is a bar next door which plays the same music on a loop, so if you like Bob Marley you will enjoy. My self it got on my wick, but that bad really. The food in the hotel is very good all be it a bit a bit cold, you can have so much choice it's a bit of a confusion. Just be aware the food is not HOT. We had a room that was a partly sea view room, well if you get on the level 3 and happen to get room 301 do yourself a favour and try and change it. The view is shocking. If you get bored of the food check out Thomas's Shack it's fab. It will cost you 8 euro from the the hotel but the food is fantastic and HOT. There are a couple who come round every lunch time from a scuba club. This is worth every penny great fun. Would I stay here again YES

author: nickt29
title: Fantastic Place
text: We got back from the our stay at the Sensimar Sea Breeze last monday and have just waited a few days to see if we still felt the same way at our stay. We arrived at the Sea Breeze at 1.40 am due to a flight delay and were informed that there was sandwiches and a drink in our fridge, we didn't expect much more that at that time of the morning. The room was clean very spacious and the bed was so big that either side of it had different post codes lol. We were in room 118 and had a very limited sea view but it didn't matter as we only slept, showered and changed there but it still was a very good room. The restaurants were clean, very roomy and light , the food was very good and there was plenty of choices and plenty to eat, The only minor thing was the time to clear away the used plates, this was mentioned and it did improve besides that it was good. The staff in the two bars were brilliant especially the pool bar who kept us topped up and were always up for a laugh. The main bar staff were great too always a smile on their face and also have a chat with us. The evening entertainment was really good especially Nick Garvey who sang swing music which had people up dancing. Also the SKA man was very good but was only on for a hour. We had a good evening every night and the bar was open till 0100 which was still all inclusive !!! The daytime entertainment was good too, there was plenty to do and the 2 staff were really good and were very good company. The pool was lovely and there is plenty of sunbeds around the pool and in the garden the pool bar staff come around to see if you want drinks as well. There is a lovely cove next to the hotel which we used every day for a little dip in the sea, there is sunbeds and umbrellas but these are 2.50 euros each, there are some nice walks along the coast, We went on a trip through Thomson in the hotel, it was a 4x4 trip in the trudoss mountains, it was a great trip our driver was George Micheal !!!! we were in a landrover and my rear spent more time off the seat than on it due to the tracks we were using. The lunch we had was fantastic and unlimited wine . Well worth 70 euros. The staff at this hotel could not do enough for us and always had a smile on their face. We like to mention Jacob who was the Thomson main man at the hotel that it maintained the high standards which they have to achieve, Jacob always had a chat with us and was open to ideas like wet wipes available when spare ribs were being served. Overall we loved the hotel and staff, and as for Cyprus this was our first visit and we loved the country, the people and the hospitably, come back again ? yes for sure we will

author: jessr675
title: Our honeymoon!
text: When booking this holiday with Thompson I informed them it was a surprise gift for my husband to be for our honeymoon. I was advised not to book the best room as it was likely we would be upgraded on arrival! This didn't happen of course and despite asking to be upgraded and willing to pay we were told there was nothing available, despite being able to see the hot tub rooms below us and certainly at least 3 of them were not in use throughout our stay! I would have expected a little more to be offered to us given the circumstances but all we had was a free bottle of cava that you could get all inclusive anyway! Despite asking to maybe buy a bottle of Moët I was informed this would be €80!!!!! There was an issue with our late check out as thomson again hadn't booked this despite being told this was all sorted! We also ate in the al a carte one evening and had a bottle of wine from the non all inclusive and were reminded 3 times within 24 hours that we needed to pay for it! Even told to come to reception and we were approached during our lunch to remind us! Totally unacceptable for a €15 bottle of wine! Whilst at the hotel, a friend who we met celebrated her birthday, although there was also some confusion with this also, the staff pulled out all the stops to rectify this for her. Maybe I should have said it was my birthday and not our honeymoon as you seemed to get better treatment for a birthday! I asked for 1 mojito as assumed this was on all inclusive and was charged €7.00!! (Don't bother) The food in the restaurant was sadly cold each night and they were very understaffed for how many people were staying at the hotel. The entertainment was shocking, 1 singer was good and that was it and it lasted for 1 hour each night, no other entertainment for the evening. I have to give the hotel some credit and that is to our lovely bar men John, chris and demitri. They couldn't be more amazing and accommodating if they tried, always making us laugh each night and joining in with the banter :) much better entertainment with them, than what was on offer. The hotel itself was lovely too and the rooms were thoroughly cleaned throughout our stay! Just a little disappointed with the treatment we received as I only intend to have 1 honeymoon in my lifetime and sadly it wasn't one that I will never forget :(

author: 99KimB99
title: Reluctant Reviewer ;))
text: There are times when I am reluctant to post reviews purely for selfish reasons in that I want to keep these places all to myself! Sea Breeze or, to give it the full title by which it is now known, Sensimar Sea Breeze by Atlantica - yes a bit of a mouthful, is one of these! Firstly, my thanks to Eva, Katarina, Josephina and 'Miss Naughty' as nothing was too much trouble and their greeting genuinely warm at all times. A special mention to Gregory for coming to my husband's rescue after he left his tobacco on the coach! Having stayed at the hotel previously we were looking forward to our return and we were not disappointed. Throughout our stay everyone on the hotel's team were superb; friendly, helpful and always with a smile but consumatly professional. The food was excellent with a huge range to cater for even my husband's fussy palate and there was always enough to go around. The facilities at the hotel from the outdoor pool to the spa were kept immaculately clean at all times and there are always plenty of sunbeds, not necessarily the padded comfy ones which were prized around the pool, but on the grassed areas there was always availability. Our room (242) was lovely! The bed is the most comfortable we have slept in apart from our own and was kept spotlessly clean by the lovely Georgia or Miss cleanie-cleanie as she was more affectionately known. The Sea Breeze is just that as at around 7pm each evening I could blow dry my hair within 10 minutes just standing on the balcony! It doesn't last for more than 40 minutes or so but is great for drying the towels and swimwear. Gents, please remember that long trousers are required in the Restaurant in the evenings - they are a little more relaxed in the mornings and at lunch but not for dinner. There is also a Black & White (dress) night where the Management greet you and serve aperitifs to the guests. I could go on and on but all that really remains for me to say is a HUGE 'Thank-You' to everyone! From the bar staff to house-keeping, the Reception team to Management not forgetting Zoe and Leanne from TUI. We are really looking forward to seeing everyone on our return in June 2017!

author: eliseaugier1
title: Very good hotel!
text: Visited Cyprus in October with my mum as a surprise break. Began our holiday at the Atlantica Oasis in Limassol and was offered a transfer to this hotel two days after arriving! So glad we did, beautiful hotel with private beach. Restaurant food was amazing, plenty of choice and very good quality. Staff we very helpful and polite. Plenty of sunbeds and lovely bar seating with a sea view. Adults only which is always a bonus! Rooms were nice and modern, unfortunately we had a view over the carpark but for the little time spent in the room it didn't bother us, just meant we heard the arrivals,some late at night. Special thanks to the bar staff who were amazing. Evening entertainment was good considering it was end of season. Great choice of freshly cooked food from the snack bar outside of meal times and fabulous meal at the al carte restaurant! Not a lot in the local area but we had such a relaxing time we didn't really feel the need to leave the hotel! I had a massage at the spa and again this was good. Overall a great holiday and a lovely hotel. Would definitely recommend!

author: Pinkflamingo11
title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed 12th to 26th October. Clean hotel with bright modern reception. We received a lovely welcome from Irene one of the receptionists when we arrived at 1.40am. Our room was nice with a good view of the bay. Food in the hotel was varied and high quality. Drinks were really nice and staff were really friendly and attentive. Pool bar staff were all lovely and Costas was both entertaining and pleasant. In the main restaurant there were to many to mention but Cristos gave us a lovely welcome every night and all the waiters/waitress clearly worked very hard. John and staff in the main entertainment were superb, friendly and always on the ball. Ellie who worked for the hotel entertainment was a lovely endearing young lady, she was poorly whilst we were there but she tried hard everyday to not let any guests down. The gala dinner was a nice touch and the entertainment was very good. My only sadness was seeing the hotel change in the last week, I felt dreadfully sorry for those that arrived on the 23rd as everything seemed to change from this point and considering they probably paid top prices being school holiday week I didn't think it was fair. You could clearly tell that the hotel was closing the next week and everything was scaled down noticeably when you had been there the previous week. The kittens that lived at the hotel were adorable and without doubt caused a stir amongst the guests many of us were worried as to what would happen to them as the hotel was closing 5 days after we left. To anybody who was there at the same time I am pleased to tell you that all the kittens are now in the Uk they were all adopted by guests and Ellie as mentioned above. I now have one of them living with me, to anyone who remembers I have the little Torti one that lived near the pool bar, she is called Missy and she arrived her in the 19th November iv posted a picture above. Many thanks to Irene who helped locate the necessary people to deal with the adoption and to anyone else at the hotel that helped. We had a lovely holiday but I never go back anywhere as there are to many places in this world to see

author: K5627QXpaulam
title: Excellent hotel in lovely spot
text: We had a brilliant, relaxing holiday in this hotel, last couple of weeks October. We've stayed in many hotels in Cyprus over the years (mainly Paphos area) but decided to give this area a go for a change. We weren't disappointed and as many of the other reviewers have said, the staff are fantastic and probably the hotels biggest asset. So friendly and efficient from booking in at reception, to the dining room (greeted by the friendly restaurant manager on each visit), to the bar staff. Special mention for Georgia, who was great fun, also Raphael and Vangelis. They all worked really hard but were always so friendly and efficient.
