The staff told us that the hotel manager was really good and I think that showed in all aspects of our experience. The hotel is outside Protaras so its quiet (which suited us). Having taken a number of walks along the beach to Protaras we think our hotel looked the nicest. If you want night life there is great public transport in the form of regular and cheap buses. The beach is small but very safe and sheltered so and we could swim every day (which wasn't always the case in Paphos). We tended to lie in the grassed area and stroll down to the beach (half a minutes walk). As others have said the sun-beds in grass area aren't the most comfortable as no mattresses but they were ok as we aren't pool people (pool sun-beds did have mattress's but closer together which isn't our thing). The restaurant food was delicious, it was varied and well cooked with lots of choice. Only suggestion for improvement would be to have the eggs freshly cooked at breakfast as they were always overcooked and I think the scrambled egg was powdered. That was a small point and didn't really bother us, as apart from breakfast, all other meals were delicious. If you want good value and relaxation in an adults only hotel, this is the place for you. We loved it there and have booked it again for next October.

author: johnr526
title: Breezy
text: Stayed here for two weeks in October. Hotel is situated approxiamately 3 miles from Protaras. Bus stop directly outside hotel-- run every 20 mins. Compared with our stay in Cyprus twenty years ago Protaras has changed significantly -- regrettably for the worse being overrun with numerous gift shops and bars rather than the quiet tranquil laid back easy going area we remembered all those years ago. The hotel is run by a very knowledgeable, friendly, approachable manager. He very often took time out to speak to guests and get their opinions of the hotel. Bedrooms. Adequate with comfortable beds. Bathroom with shower over bath were somewhat small and need updating although it is understood some guests still prefer a bath rather than a walk in shower. Food. Plenty of choice. Catered for guests of various nationalities. You certainly wouldn't go hungry! Staff. Have been fortunate to travel to many parts of the world and have to say the staff at The Sea Breeze compare more than favourably with many we have met. It would be unfair to single out any individual as they were all absolutely superb. Nothing was too much trouble for any of them. They are a credit to their employer. Overall a good relaxing holiday.

author: kevinoutandabout
title: Relaxing holiday
text: Stayed at the Sea Breeze for two weeks in October 2016. Hotel overlooks the sea and has access to a public beach in a cove ideal for swimming. Coastal path in both directions and you can walk into Protaras if you are good walkers. Not a great deal at the front of the hotel so if you want nightlife (or shops) away from the hotel you need to hop on a bus. Good sized comfortable room which was clean and well serviced, include free bottled water every day. Buffet restaurant had plenty of options but some repetition on the second week. We visited both A la carte restaurants both providing excellent meals. Guests get one free visit to the Cullinarium but have to pay for the Elia (Greek) restaurant and it is rarely used. When we visited we were the only people there. Surprisingly at most meals in the main restaurant we experienced chipped crockery or glassware which is not expected in a 4 star hotel. Plenty of sun loungers, around the pool or on the grass, but probably not one for everyone as claimed by our rep. The twin luxury beds around the pool were popular and if you want one of them you need to reserve them early! That said many got the shade during part of the day and sun lovers are better off on the grass. The evening entertainment is held in the main lobby bar and if you just want a quiet drink you have to use the Pool Bar (which did not re-open until 9.30pm). The lobby bar has limited seating and visibility of the acts so, in my view, not an ideal location for the entertainment. While the hotel is generally clean it is not spotless. It was surprising to see how grubby all the doors in the public corridors were. Okay, some of the negative points may be a reflection of a long hard season (which was drawing to an end) but we usually go away at this time of the year and have never encountered these issues before. They would not put us off returning to this hotel though.

author: DaveandLynStoneUK
title: Very Good Almost Excellent
text: We arrived at 6.00pm and unfortunately due to a late check-out our seaview room (237) was not ready. The offer of a free drink at an all inclusive hotel is a minimalist offer. However, after us making a further approach to reception and a wait of an hour we were given the swipe card to the room. The room itself was clean and fresh. Huge and comfortable bed with plenty of wardrobe space and hangers. Bathroom had bath with shower over and was OK. Room was serviced by attentive staff daily. Meals in the main restaurant are all buffet style but the choice was always plentiful, varied and hot not the salads. Christos and Andreas look after you here and make sure that there is never to long to wait for a table. Thank you guys. The drinks throughout the Hotel are good. The inclusive wines (Italian in Cyprus?) are better than some we have had. The bars, Neptune Pool bar Costa and Kosta get a mention and the Lobby Bar, John is the man, plus all the staff ensure that you glass is never empty for long. Enjoy the range of inclusive cocktails a good choice to be had. Special mention for Ellie who, when not afflicted by a Cyprus throat, is a great entertainment host. All in all a very good holiday accompanied by the usual Cypriot hospitality and great weather. Thanks to everyone. Antio Sea Breeze until next time.

author: 852beccab
title: Great place to stay.
text: Recently stayed at the Sensimar Atlantica Seabreeze with family to celebrate a birthday and I would rate the 4* hotel just that, one of the best I have stayed in. Staff were friendly and helpful from the minute we go there taking our bags to our rooms our rooms so we could take advantage of the last few hours of the all inclusive bar. Since we had arrived late and missed dinner they gave us sandwiches and juice in our rooms. At midnight there are fresh sandwiches in the main bar did you are feeling peckish. When we arrived up at our rooms the room was very clean, modern with big comfy beds. Free safe, air con, fridge, hair drier towel and toiletries use. Large variety of very tasty food to cater for all for breakfast lunch and dinner with different themed nights so meals don't get repeative. One thing I would point out is that men do have to wear long trousers at night, shorts not acceptable. Staff very attentive in all areas, remembering you and who you are with, what you drink. Large amount of sun beds including 3 day beds ( need to reserve at reception), padded beds by the pool and a large about out standard sun beds on a large grassy area. Plenty of room for everyone. Grounds and hotel well maintained, needed maintenance for a blocked sink in our room and was fixed instantly. Drinks good quality with an extensive cocktail menu. Not a lot in the surrounding area but only a short bus ride to protaras 101 in and 102 back. If you are looking for a relaxing holiday this is the place.

author: Steve141456
title: Quality experience
text: My wife and I stayed at the hotel from the 25/09/16 for a 7 night stay. We had informed the hotel that we were celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary on our stay and received a celebratory champagne and fruit which was a nice gesture. The room was clean with a large double bed. We had a view from our balcony that was part front entrance to the hotel and sea view (room 324). A costructive opionion on the bathroom is that it would have been better to have a walk in shower area than a bath with a shower above it. The shower was only just adequate as it was not powerful enough and too low for anyone at 6 foot in height. The hotel has a very modern entrance to the reception and cocktail bar that is on the same floor The drinks were good including the cocktail and draugh lagers that consisted of Keo, Leon, Carlsberg and Amstel so and good assortment for beer drinkers. The spirits were not branded but my wife's "bailey's" was drank quite easily by her. The main attributes of this hotel is the excellent service offered by all of their staff. Nothing was too much for them and a welcome handshake at evening meal was always given by the restaurant manager. The food is of a very good quality and variety. We could not fault this at all and have stayed in some very good reputable hotels and the food has not made the standard that was delivered by the cooks at sea breeze hotel. The comfortable sunbeds around the pool are very hard to get,but there are plenty around the grass area that are aduequate and service for drinks was never a problem when sunbathing on the grass area so no real hassle. If I was to give some constructive comment is that that the hotel management should consider partly extending the existing pool sun bed hard surface area on to the grass area to allow more comfortable sun beds to be situated and give more guests the chance to have one of theses beds. But, if your are a sun worshipper then some of the beds around the pool go in to semi shade by about 3pm so you will be grateful of the grass area sunbeds due to this. All the sunbeds are supplied with a small table and brolly The evening entertainment was delivered in the cocktail bar area with good comfortable seating to watch the shows that mainly consisted of singers. This was delivered well and was more entertaining than excellent in our opinion If you want a good 7 night stay in a chilled friendly environment then the sea breeze should be your choice Where quality is delivered by staff that work so hard to make your stay so welcoming and rememberable. We will be back next year

author: 204philips
title: relaxing two weeks
text: our room on the fourth floor was fine ... easy check in .. food all ok plenty of options .. al la carte Italian out of this world being free was a plus point .. service was very good ... entertainment could last a little longer being a adult only hotel ... all in all a good hotel . one little issue no sports room for footie etc ... but there is a bar over the road cottage bar . a good sports bar would add to the hotel ... pool darts music .. light snacks ... race nights .. entertainment ... this would keep the younger crowd happy . all in all had a great time .

author: lindy944
title: Very underwhelmed - definitely not a 4 star standard
text: On arrival we were informed that the twin room we had booked would not be available until the next day. We were given a double room with a rather shabby single bed squeezed in. We did not get into our room until late afternoon the next day. The room whilst clean was very basic. The hairdryer was obviously the type that should have been fixed to the wall and was very difficult to use. The fridge was empty! In an all inclusive, I would have expected it to be filled with soft drinks at least. The food was plentiful but not very good quality and most often lukewarm. The dining area was canteen like and a lot of the crockery and glasses were chipped. It was not a relaxing dining experience. Apart from the 2 entertainment girls, who were great, and Josephine the receptionist, the staff were not engaging and seemed to concentrate on the returning guests. The pool area was very nice, with comfortable loungers. However you had to get up very early to sit here as most loungers were taken be 7:30. There were plenty of loungers in the garden area but these were nowhere near as comfortable. I have previously stayed in a fantastic 4 star hotel on the Pathos side of the island. The Seabreeze is certainly not the same standard and does not live up to its 4 Star rating

author: grantl456
title: Mr lewis
text: Right.... Let's start with the room, the room is very modern and nice. We got to our room we got the room most far away on the floor but that wasn't a problem as I suppose someone had to have it. The room over looks the car park but In all fairness you can slightly see the sea in the background. Cleaner comes cleans the room everyday only thing is the decorated pillows and throw just get left on a chair never actually put back on your bed. When I decided to use the hotel shower gel and moisturising cream that never got replaced but only have 1 per a stay overall the rooms are really nice give the room a 8 out of 10 Right now the food the food must be the worst thing about the hotel breakfast is awful bacon is not bacon eggs taste funny and everything is the same we managed to live on pancakes if you like tin fruit with dodgey over sweet yoghurt then you might enjoy it. All the fresh juice is from concentrate and tastes absolutely awful. Lunch is not much better dry horrible you hear everyone complaining about the food sane again desert very dry and everything literally just taste horrible I duno how they even do it to be far surely the head chef must be trying these dishes before they are going out. Afternoon tea we have only ever been twice and both times was absolutely awful again we ate out every night as we couldn't stomach the food wish to be honest we never went all inclusive as it's really not worth it. The Al a Carte resturante was very nice. Was very impressed expect on a two week holiday you can only use it once for free which I think it's a really a con. Drinks are all mainly local drinks and taste horrible I couldn't drink them used to have to have larger drowned in lime. THIS IS A BIG ONE be prepared if your not over the age of 40 you do not get the same treatment as the older lot mainly the 50 plus we would wait agers for drinks mostly not even asked and had to go to the bar ourself as they are to busy pussyfoot round the oldies. This really does need to be looked at as it seriously goes on specially in the resturantes and the main bar area. Entertainment - hardly any music on round the pool very very quite not much entertainment we used to like watching the water aerobics as that was really the only time we would have music on round the pool. At night they was never enough chairs and just one artist on and bingo that's ur entertainment very boring with mainly the artist singing 60s to 80s hence we went out every night. Overall look wise this hotel is a 4 star food wise and drink wise no way near I would think it would struggle to get a 3. I duno how this hotel gets so many good reviews. Anyone below the age of 30 stay away as you will litterally bore to death we had to spend 20 euros a day getting taxis back and forth to protaras and having to draw extra money out as we couldn't stand the drinks or food. Overall wouldn't go back and it is quite far from partaras main strip

author: BeccaBob626
title: AMAZING HOLIDAY!
text: From the second we arrived at the hotel at gone 2am, we were greeted by friendky staff and a drink at reception. We were quickly checked in and staff offered to take our cases to our room. Our fridge had fresh bottled water, fruit, sandwiches and juice cartons. The air con is amazing, the room is large and clean, theres seating with a tabke both inside and outside on the balcony. Theres loads of cupboards, storage and spaces to keep your cases. The dining is great! Breakfast has a big selection of fry up foods, meats and cheeses, cereals/granola, fresh fruit, yoghurt and a chef cooking fresh omlettes as requested! Linch and dinner again had a huge selection of salads, meats and other frsh dishes which chefs cooked as requested. The dessert section has the most amazing cakes ever and is open during both lunch and dinner so expect to come back from your holiday a few sizes bigger! Te A La Carte was incredible, we had the sea bass and beef anf both were cooked amazingly! Portion sizes were generous and the staff were amazing! A 30 second walk outside the hotel and you will find a pub, 2 supermarkets and the bus stop which takes you to Protaras, Aiya Napa and terminates at the Waterworld waterpark. The facilities and classes that are avaliable are always fun and a great way to meet new people! The hotel is located on a lovely beach with loads of fish and rock pools. Everying about our holiday was amazing and the friendlyness of the staff made it a 5* experience for us. Will deffinately be returning and visiting other Sensimar hotels! The only issue we had during our stay was having one of our excursions cancelled. This was not the fault of the hotel but we were not informed until our rep had seen us waiting in the lobby for some time before approaching us and telling us it was cancelled and a message should have been sent to our room the evening before from reception.

author: usermrt840
title: Sunbed problem?
text: There are some great sun beds round the pool. Probably the best of any hotel. But there aren't many and the alternative is to sit on some average ones in some a weird straw-like grass field. Despite some noises around a 1 hour rule on the beds, this is just not enforced, despite direct feedback from a number of guests to hotel staff and Tui reps. Which leads to typical selfish human behaviors with people hogging the best beds for hours at a time, particularly from 6:30 - 10;00+ At the time of writing this review, I'm halfway through holiday so willing to revise rating if I can see some improvement. Other than that, staff are good and food is fine but choice is limited compared to similar hotels. A la carte is good but you only get 1 free visit per stay whether that's 1 week or 2. Surely they could give 1 free a la carte per full week at the hotel, particularly as there are no other food alternatives in the hotel. There is 1 restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Which is because the hotel is small. 1 restaurant, 1 pool. Over gripe is beach towels are limited to 3 clean towels per week. Location. It's a small bus/taxi ride to civilization, but despite being in the middle of nowhere, it still suffers from being small, with a an apartment block butting right up where the pool is. View from our room is the car park, but I have heard others on the other side being disrupted by rubbish disposal and deliveries at all hours. Rooms are ok but nothing special. Wifi is very good. Overall rating of 2/5 is dragged down by the poor policing of sun beds. Otherwise it's probably a 3-3.5. Ok for a quiet break but there are much better hotels out there.

author: JAGoddard
title: Excellent stay
text: We booked a suite at the Sea Breeze and had a super time. The suite was well worth the extra money, with 2 rooms, 2 balconies and 2 bathrooms- it felt like an apartment rather than a hotel room. This suited us as I am 6 months pregnant and was keen to use the aircon during a daytime nap or two! I found the aircon to be adequate as I noted some people have found it not very efficient. The food is excellent and I did not feel I had to worry about ice in drinks or salad washed etc. Lots of choice and good variety of fresh salads. We didn't use the sunbeds by the pool as these were all taken with towels by 8am, however, I bought a lilo to use on the slightly uncomfortable sunbeds on the grass and this suited my bump and I perfectly. I was a little concerned about the sunbeds after reading the reviews but actually the grass ones had a far more pleasant view of the sea, had more space, more shade flexibility and more breeze. We attended some Aqua and fitness training and enjoyed Ellie's enthusiasm! The gym is basic but kept my husbands attention with the free weights. A good range of ages at the hotel. We didn't really see any of the evening entertainment so can't comment as I needed to go to bed early! However the night we wanted to go the the A'l carte restaurant, it was fully booked. Book ahead more than a day! A huge thankyou to the staff and to Jozephine for organising a super room for us in advance.

author: daverawwfc
title: A week at the sea breeze
text: I'm not quite sure why but it wasn't quite what I was expecting from all of the other reviews. The hotel was small but very nice. We had a 4th floor limited sea view room but no matter where your room is as long as you're near a lift you're always close to the reception or pool and restaurant. The food was always nice and plentiful. I would defy anyone to not like anything at any of the meal times. If you're not hungry at the meal times you can get a 'snack' aka massive meal which are very nice. The air con in our room wasn't as cold as we would have liked and it was quite old and the symbols had faded so we had to guess what setting we had it on. The weather was fantastic but unfortunately I suffered badly with prickly heat which of course is not the hotels fault. The WiFi was very good but you have to keep singing in approximately every hour which was quite annoying. The staff as everyone says are very friendly and will do anything to help when they can. The cocktails are brilliant but maybe a bit too strong lol. The sunbed situation was a little bad but we got up around 7am every morning to get a sun bed by the pool because we simply had too or we wouldn't have got one. Protaras is a great town and definitely worth a couple of visits. Plenty of shops and bars etc... the entertainment was okay, the freddie murcury and madness tribute acts were very good. Thank you to all of the staff for giving me and my girlfriend a fantastic summer holiday. Would definitely recommend.

author: TravelqueenUK1
title: 10/10 amazing holiday!
text: I had the best holiday! INCREDIBLE hotel! Staff go above and beyond on every single thing. I could write an essay but to sum up: - food is the best all inclusive I've ever had. Extremely well catered for vegetarians and other dietary requirements. Food hall staff 10/10! Well done George! -pool staff friendly, always offering you drinks and light snacks when on your loungers, nice touch. -good entertainment! -perfect rooms. We even had a private balcony and hot tub. -right outside the bus stop, same price to go anywhere really so is easy for tourists to understand. -extremely clean and well kept. - plenty of sun beds for everyone, no need to reserve. -in hotel spa. Provide towels, nice shower products, dressing gown, slippers, hair dryer, coffee machine, tv, safe, snacks in fridge on arrival, bubbly on arrival. Everyone always looking to assist in anyway possible. Genuinely one of the best holidays I've ever been on. Thank you Sea Breeze! We will be back!

author: WendyH972
title: Fantastic Service
text: Returned from this lovely hotel on Sunday 31st July. We went to this hotel to celebrate a 60th birthday. Before we arrived I had emailed guest relations to enquire if we could put up balloons and banners, and also arrange a birthday cake. I promptly received a lovely email back from Jozefina who arranged the cake and also booked the Italian al a carte restaurant for the evening of the birthday. On the day of the birthday the staff could not have done more to accommodate us. When we arrived at the hotel we were met with cold fresh drinks and very was quickly and efficiently checked in. The rooms are decorated to a very high and modern standard. With excellent air con. If I have one complaint it was the view from our balcony it overlooked the car park, but we hardly used the balcony as the pool area was beautiful. Loads of sun beds,umbrellas and plenty of waiters and waitresses coming round regularly supplying you with drinks. The food in the restaurant and buffet restaurant is definitely the best we have ever had in an all inclusive hotel. There is plenty of choice and it is all 5 star standard. The entertainments team Ellie and Kirsten work very hard with the usual Aqua aerobics, water volley, etc but are not pushy if you just want to sun bathe and relax. All the staff are very friendly and helpful. There is no beach at the hotel it is just rocks. There is a nice sandy public beach literally 1 minute walk from the hotel grounds. The location of the hotel is on the quite outskirts of Protaras. The local bus stops right outside the hotel and runs until 4 am in the morning, or a taxi is about 10 Euros from the centre of Protaras. I would definitely recommend this Adults only hotel and hopefully will be returning soon.

author: Susie2407
title: Relaxing holiday at the Sea Breeze
text: We have just returned from a week here at this beautiful hotel, it is so clean and comfortable but what really makes this place is the staff - they are wonderful and make you feel so welcome! We arrived at 1am in the morning and were greeted by the lovely receptionists, smiling and welcoming. Check in was quick and our bags were taken to our room for us. The room was absolutely spotlessly clean, we had tea & coffee a kettle and a Nespresso machine. The fridge had a 1 litre bottle of water, 2 cartons of juice and 2 packs of (very dry) sandwiches. We were absolutely starving after a long flight which had been delayed and and hour drive to the hotel, we were told that there were snacks available at the bar also. Snacks are available in the lobby bar each evening until 1am and we just missed out as a guest took all the snacks that were left and put them in a bag(presumably to take to their room) we were disappointed that the restaurant had not saved any food for late arrivals and went to bed starving. We have never encountered this before and have always found hotels have hot and cold food available even when we have arrived at 2 am! We did get up early next day to get breakfast! The food at the hotel is very good, lots of choice, everything really fresh and well presented. The restaurant staff are wonderful, so hardworking and always smiling. we didn't try the greek restaurant - it was always empty? Entertainment that we saw was ok, but we are not into bingo etc and preferred to just have a few drinks and go back to our room of an evening. We had booked a jacuzzi room and were so glad we did! Firstly because despite a 'no reserving sunbeds' rule we could NEVER get a sunbed by the pool, they were the same couples on the same beds every day-God knows what time they got up to reserve them. Secondly the week we were there the heat was almost unbearable so sitting in the jacuzzi on our private terrace was fabulous and well worth the money. The hotel is not on the beach - there is a small rocky bay at the end of the gardens with a public beach to the right, we had a hire car and went to Fig Tree Bay which is really close by and is stunning, one of the most beautiful beaches we have ever seen- crystal clear warm water, worth a visit! This was our first visit to Cyprus and were thought it was beautiful but incredibly hot in July, and would love to come back to the Sea Breeze one day.

author: 762kathrynd
title: Great return stay.
text: 2nd year at hotel . What can I say that hadn't been said a thousand times . Anyone else who comes here will find it hard to find ,a more friendly hotel on the island . Staff as many before have said are amazing . Food is perfect great selection of hot and cold , cakes are to die for . Rooms are kept extremely clean ,pool is wonderful but very warm , there is a lovely bay behind hotel . A few rocks under the water but a lot have been removed since last year . If you walk along coast to protaras you will find a lady selling tickets for boat trip to famagusta or Cape greko. Well worth a trip and amazingly only 5 euros . Boat called Shirley Valentine. if you hire beach buggys , just watch out for the idiots on the roads , but well worth a go . Hotel entertainment much improved from last year , don't miss fugitive blues brothers , ska , robbie Williams tribute. Ellie the entertainment manager is a vast improvement from last year . Would like to thank her and all the staff for a wonderful stay . Safe to say we will be back next year .

author: lindan754
title: A great Cyprus holiday
text: We are a party of six , we all enjoyed our stay. Staff excellent , they all go the extra mile to make the stay memorable. Room , kept very clean, view not great because we over looked the apartments next door. But we did not sit on the balcony as it was very hot. Food, very good ,lots of choice and always hot, enjoyed the a'la carte restaurant , thanks Zoe for arranging the second visit. Entertainment , good acts when we were there ,just get up and enjoy the dancing. Pool very clean and very warm. We did not sit round the pool as it was too hot, so sat right at the front under the trees. The hotel has plenty of sun beds but need more shady areas as the sun shades where not always big enough to cover two people. Also they became unstable when it was very breezy. One blew over on my friend and bruised her arm and chest. Staff should come round and warn people as it had happened the week before. Also beds on the grass area need cushions as they are very uncomfortable. Drinks, wines ok, liked the sparkling wine, plenty of choice of other drinks. Bar staff excellent. Tips all get pooled in the tip boxes, nobody was pushy We choose this hotel because it was adults only, it was an excellent choice. Thank you to the Manager and your amazing staff.

author: benrudge1985
title: Good hotel amazing staff.
text: Location fairly quiet and sedate.Supermarket over the road for all your needs which came in quite handy. Rooms, very similar standard to premier inn. Comfy bed,very light and airy. Shower could have been higher I had to crouch to get underneath it ( 6ft 2") Balconies could do with lights on them. Air con was adequate although it would have been nice to have been able to control the temperature. As with all Mediterranean countries rubbish collection is through the night( between 1 & 3am), we had a room (121) above the ramp down to the hotels collection point. It wasn't hugely annoying to us but I can imagine a lighter sleeper may be irritated by it. Food was ok I did tire of the buffet by the end of our week's holiday.George the maitre D really shone for me in the restaurant, always smiling and welcoming as well as working like a trooper. Ala carte food again was ok nothing to write home about. Pool area was nice the beds around the pool are very comfortable, Never really had an issue getting one as long as your up around half 8/9. Hotel provide towels which were perfect for pool use.The hotel do say that no towels are to be put out before 7am and that any towels left out and not used for 2 hours will be removed. This is not the case as on our last day the towels and beds next to us were left out from 9am and not used until around half 4. Sunbeds on the grass were comfortable also and you did get a nice breeze coming off the sea. €20 to use the 4 poster sun beds for the day including 1 cocktail each of your choice. Nice and comfy well worth doing for a day. Beach was small but good, Anyone into snorkelling I'd recommend as the water is generally crystal clear. Hotel staff were superb all of them a real asset to atlantica & leanne the thomson rep based at the hotel is one of the most attentive rep's I've ever had definitely 10/10. All in all I would return to this hotel maybe in a slightly cooler month to really explore the area and cyprus as a whole.

author: 373keithn
title: Will we return?
text: Sea Breeze Hotel Cyprus is on the outskirts of Protaras, there is a bus stop at the entrance and a supermarket across the road which is useful as there is no shop in the hotel. We had a room on the third floor with a full sea view, a king size bed, ample hanging and storage space, a free safe deposit box, free fridge and a television with one English Channel which was BBC world news. The balcony had no side screens which therefore afforded no privacy. The bathroom was small with a very high sided narrow bath which made climbing in and out rather hazardous, the overhead shower was just about adequate. Toiletries were restocked regularly but the towels were an absolute disgrace being old, hard, ragged and frayed. The room was kept very clean. There is a good sized fresh water swimming pool and a jacuzzi which for some reason is time controlled. Around the pool are twin sun beds on solid wooden frames but they are close together making it quite difficult to manoeuvre the umbrellas for those who like shade. They are however very popular and towels start to appear before 6am even some left overnight which surely should be stopped by the management. Arlternatively there is a large sea facing grass area with basic and rather uncomfortable beds but in total sufficient beds for all guests even when the hotel is full. There are six swim up stools at the pool bar and a very pleasant covered area. The staff like their colleagues in every part of the hotel are obliging, efficient and exceptionally friendly. The food is outstanding and plentiful, we enjoyed every meal. In addition to the customary three main meals hot and cold snacks are available throughout the day, a patisserie corner in the Lobby in the a afternoon and a midnight snack. Quite impressive. The A La Carte restaurant one visit free per holiday is well worth a try. Entertainment is mainly male tribute singers and it is very pleasant sitting out on the terrace post dinner with a coffee and brandy listening to the music. Clientele is mainly British and Scandanavian, and we found three Swedish nurses to be ideal holiday companions. Would we return? No, although the staff and food are superb the don't likes outweigh the likes.

author: Relaxbutenjoy
title: Cracking week in the sun
text: We visited in the first week of June - the daily temperature was about 30 degrees and sunny. The customer service with all Atlantica Hotels really is excellent - and this was no exception. There is always someone on hand to get you a drink, help, advise, or just chat - extremely helpful and friendly but it really does set the tone for your holiday. The rooms are clean, airy, light and have everything you need. We had a side balcony with views of a lovely cove and inland Cyprus! Food was good. Ample choice at every sitting (we were all-inclusive) no queues, drinks brought to your table - generally very relaxed. We also had a lovely meal in the a la carte restuarant. Drinks were plentiful - although we did notice that some had to be paid for even if AI, but still the choice was endless really. And again service always with a smile. Entertainment was in the main lobby bar that filled up every night where we had a mix of Freddie Mercury to local Cypriot music - all ok. Lots of activities you can join - Aqua aerobics, yoga, keep fit, water volleyball, etc. All pretty laid back but well organised with the emphasis on fun. Fantastic Spa facilities and the outdoor pool was great - just a pity that people are compelled to leave towels on beds early in the morning to turn up after lunch to use the beds - this a bugbear of mine (and the Brits are the worse!) The hotels location is a little outside Protaras but buses leave and return into the nearby resorts every 20 mins until 4am. The is a lovely coastal walk that goes either way from the hotel where you come to pretty harbours (usual boat rides available) and coves alike. So would we return - a resounding yes! You will enjoy - we had a great holiday. Diets when we get home now!!

author: pingmyride
title: excellent hotel
text: my wife and I have just spent 7 fabulous days at the seabreeze atlantica. it was our first visit to Cyprus and what a great surprise. from the minute we arrived late at night on the 18th may to the minute we left fault could not be found at this hotel. the hotel was spotlessly clean and the staff were the best we have encountered in Europe. they could not do enough to ensure a great relaxing break. the room was cleaned every day, the towels changed and it was all to a very high standard. in our opinion easily a 4* plus. the Thompson /tui staff were also there on hand and also nothing was a problem for them. the sunbeds exceeded the guests and also free to use so no need to get up early to reserve. the pool bar and lounge bars were always fully staffed and waiting to be served was not an issue. the food was good and plentiful with lots of choice but not the greatest. having said that there was always something to eat. the afternoon and evening snacks were also good and plentiful. one disappointment was the drinks, as we were charged for non local items or brands , this was something we were not expecting as our previous 6 holidays to the carribean were all included. however as we are not big drinkers this was easily avoided. everything said in the brochure was exactly as it was in the resort so there were no nasty surprises. all in all a brilliant value for money holiday and we are already looking to book up for two weeks later this year at the same hotel. keep up the great work and well done to everyone concerned

author: 414CarolT
title: I'm pleased I didn't need the wifi! - would I come back NO!
text: Hotel very nice & charming. Rooms made clean and fresh everyday. Bottles of water provided in room. All electric sockets are English. Refuse Lorry emptied bins at midnight or very very early morning. Staff we're always very friendly, nothing too much trouble. Would give all the staff a 5star rating. Sun loungers in the busy season may be difficult to find. Sun lounging area over crowed with sun beds. Positioned very close to edge of pool and jacuzzi. No beach!! Food ok, there is a variety. Salad bar; Cold meat; Meat: cooked (no pink)👍🏻 veg: boiled but still very cruchy; potatoes: good variety and nice; soup: a bit too salty. Puddings: Fresh fruit, gateaux, jelly, ice cream, cheese & biscuits. Every night can get a bit boring. Yoghurt was only available at breakfast. WIFI: practically none existent, as my title says, I'm pleased I didn't need the WIFI, however, my three companions did and were enraged daily. When my husband complained, it was insinuated in the reply, that he was not telling the truth, but he was. Disappointed!

author: Annaok
title: Lovely hotel, great value for money and wonderful staff
text: Stayed first week of May and it was everything we hoped for and more for the fantastic price we got it for. We've never gone all inclusive as prefer to enjoy the local restaurants but the food here was superb. We thought we'd get bored but the selection of food in the buffet was vast and really really tasty. The service from staff was the best I've experienced in a while and is on par to what you'd expect from a 5 star. Really friendly, helpful and efficient without being over the top or stuffy. Rooms were fine, clean and comfortable not super luxurious but of a decent standard. Cleaned on a regular basis. Given fruit and a bottle of bubbly on arrival which was a nice touch. Pool area lovely however getting a sunbed near the pool was practically impossible if you didn't get up at stupid o'clock (we don't, we like a drink or two in the evening). Anytime after 9.00am, you had no chance. However lots available on the grassy area. Lovely little beach next to the hotel, pretty quiet, clear water and lovely sand, couldn't ask for better. WiFi was iffy at best, the only thing I would really criticise and should really improve. Entertainment ok. Location is a bit out of the way but good transport links to busier resorts. Other than that we had a super time and we'd like to thank all the staff that made our holiday so relaxing and memorable. Hopefully we'll be back soon.

author: Teeshhampshire
title: Suoerb Again!
text: An hour transfer depending on the number of stops the coach needs to make. Quick , very efficient check in, nice welcome from all in reception and Jozephina, plus a nice cold welcoming drink.. The rooms are large, very clean and maintained that way every day, by some really lovely ladies. Our lady was Maria and she remembered us from last year!. Also included is an electronic safe and a fridge . Beach towels can be changed 3 times per week at the spa using the card which you are given on arrival. George in the restaurant - who we are sure has 8 pairs of eyes - works so hard to ensure all guests are made to feel they are the only ones in the restaurant and are very happy. The food is excellent and the variety of choices is outstanding as is the quality. The chefs and kitchen staff certainly work very hard indeed. The beach area has been renovated by the government and they intend to do some further removal of the large stones during the winter, which will be great. .but take shoes that you can wear in the sea as it's rocky and difficult without shoes on. Many people also snorkel here so if you've got one pack it. otherwise you can buy one from the supermarket opposite the hotel. There are more staff this year which makes it much better - they are all welcoming and so very friendly and can't do enough for you to make sure your holiday is perfect! Another fabulous two weeks and a hotel that is well run and it shows. The Management team are so good and also approachable. No need to wait till you get home; if there are any minor problems to be sorted. If you don't say they can't help or put it right for you!!! See you for the eight year in 2016.

author: 801valh
title: Excellent Hotel
text: My husband and I have had a very hard year. He has his own business and I work full-time, with a large extended family. Life is always so busy.This is the first time we have been away on our own for over 20 years. I can only say that this hotel is fantastic!! From the moment that we arrived on the 23/09/15 to the time we left the staff were so attentive. Drinks on arrival and Drinks on departure. The food is excellent, with a huge choice. I have never been to a Hotel with such fantastic staff. The Restaurant manager George runs a very tight ship, nothing is to much for him or his staff.The pool and sun bed area's were spotlessly clean.The staff waited on you whist you relaxed on your sun bed. Again nothing was to much for them. They kept asking if you were OK, did you need another drink. They even brought ice cream to you. The pool snacks were amazing ( never experienced anything like it) waiter served and a huge choice. The evening entertainment was really good, Tribute acts and traditional Cyprus dancers.Our sea view room number 336 was immaculate and very modern. We spent a lovely relaxing morning in the Hotel Spa and had a couples massage,The cost was very reasonable and was a real treat for both of us. Our meal in the Italian restaurant (free once during your stay) was superb with a very romantic ambience about it. We felt that this hotel was very high class. If your looking for a break away from a hectic life, then this holiday is for you. We only spent one week there, but feel like we have had a months rest.Thank you so much to all the hard working staff for the best holiday we have ever had!!

author: shawneeNorthants
title: "Our Cyprus favourite , but could be better ! "
text: Back again to our favourite location. A nice new path in the garden . Better access to the small bay ( though you have to pay for these sun beds !) Overall holiday excellent. Staff as usual first class. Accommodation very comfortable, and food quality very good. George Maitre'D is an asset to the company and is aided by Marios in the excellent Italian a'la Carte . But ,as last year , the hotel is still let down by ---- 1) The DRESS CODE ,worse than ever ! Are you aiming to be a 4* or a 3* Hotel !!! Some reviews seem to think that this is an ageist comment? But all the better Hotels have men wearing long trousers ,in the evening!! Your partner makes the effort to look smart !! 2) The volume of the evening entertainment is still far too loud for a relatively small lounge. Going outside to the Neptune pool bar to have a conversation is not my idea of a relaxing evening !!! 3) Sun beds still need replacing! PS -- on a lighter note is green jelly a Cyprus favourite !!!!

author: GrandPoohbaH
title: Typical Atlantica Hotel
text: Been to 3 other Atlantica Hotels and they are all very similar. Will not go into other points raised by majority of guests so just a summation of how our trip went. Pros Restaurant staff are very good well led by the lovely George, they are excellent at cleaning plates away and bringing drinks very quickly. There have been very mixed reviews on the Hotel Entertainment duo "Big City Swell" we have been to many hotels over the last 10 years and this duo are one of the best acts that we have seen. Hotel room was always made up by 10:30 latest and they were very well cleaned, bright and modern. Plenty of sunbeds on grassy area so no need to do the morning sunbed towel run. If you want a bed by the pool then you do need to get up early, but we found that the pool area was far warmer and obviously more noisy (which I will come to later). Very good salad bar for lunch and dinner. Staff were very friendly and efficient. Cons The waiter service down at the grassy area was very hit or miss, we were only asked two times in a week if we wanted a drink, so we went to the bar and picked up our own drinks, if the hotel wants to improve look at putting more staff down at the grassy area as it is very large for just a couple of waiters. We noticed the full week we were there that there were some people were coming from the apartments next door and using the sunbeds and pool as they were free of charge, management should look at issuing all guests with bands (different colours for different board basis) so that the staff could easily see people using beds from outside of the hotel. We found that the cocktails in this hotel were very poor compared to other hotels, the better cocktails you had to pay for. WIFI at times was very poor and many times during the day I just could not get logged on. General We are animal lovers and there were a couple of lovely friendly cats around the outside area of the hotel, please if you are going soon look out for the Black and white cat and also the young kitten (white and ginger) with stumpy tail and please feed these cats. Lastly and unfortunately round the pool for a couple of days(not a hotel issue) there was a group of what I could call juvenile delinquents if they had not been in their 50's and 60's, throwing buckets of water around, spraying members of staff with water, luckily the waitress took it in good spirits, but what else could she do!!. Finally one day a pint of beer was poured over another guest, this group of about 8 thought this was hilarious, sorry if you are reading this and you were one of this group then this type of behaviour maybe more suited to club 18-30 and not a Thompson's Couples Holiday, I think that you should grow up, I know that you will say we were only having a larf, but there is a fine line between having a larf and annoying people.

author: Babsmc
title: 100% - A* again !!
text: My Sister and I returned to the hotel for the 2nd time 2 weeks ago. Greeted at the door like long lost friends by Josephina and the reception staff, who remembered us from last year. A slight hiccup with the room but this appeared to be a fault of Thomsons in the UK and not the hotel and was sorted promptly. A sense of Deja vous as many of the couples were there last year too. The bar staff, headed by Christos and Dimitri, were as attentive as ever. Always a smile and a warm greeting for us with excellent service. Plenty of choice in the restaurant and George, as always, the perfect host. I cannot fault the service and the food in the dining room..The Italian restaurant was superb and Marios and his team couldn't do enough for us. A wonderful dining experience with amazing food and service.. The pool bar, again, excellent service and the little touches of ice cream, fruit and milk shakes, mid morning was a lovely touch. The rooms were cleaned everyday and the maids were always pleasant and polite.Being introduced to the staff at the champagne reception, meant we knew who was responsible for what in the hotel. We cannot fault the holiday at all. The only down side being we had to leave and return to the rain.. Congratulations to all the staff at the Atlantica Sea Breeze. Another 2 extremely satisfied visitors. Hope to see you all next year x

author: paulhK8394TA
title: Fantastic hotel with lovely staff.
text: What a wonderful experience. Our first time in Cyprus. Hotel was lovely. The staff were delightful. Very friendly and accommodating. Always chatty and smiling. They could not do enough for you. The rooms were modern and clean. Every morning we were supplied with fresh bottled water. The restaurant was excellent. Varied and tasty selection of food, very well presented. Always clean with with very attentive staff. The all inclusive drinks were great. Good choice of beers, wines & cocktails. The pool area was lovely. Swim up bar, again with cheerful friendly staff. Never a shortage of sunbeds or umbrellas. All in all a perfect holiday destination. We would not hesitate to go back.

author: 69ashleighm
title: Absolutely lovely hotel for an all inclusive holiday.
text: I cannot really say anything bad about this hotel from my experience. Every thing was absolutely 5 star, the hotel staff were exceptional in the professional approach to holiday makers. Staff in all areas from the cleaners to the bar staff were all very friendly and helpful when ever needed. The service in the restaurant was top notch, with really nice food. Nicest hotel I have experienced for food and I am very fussy eater but they cater for everyone. Stay around the pool bar attended to your needs for drinks all the time, as well As bringing fresh good around on a morning for everyone. Waiters and waitresses in all Of the hotel are on the ball and you are never without a drink. The only thing not all of the cocktails are included in the all inclusive deal. It was quite pricy for food and drinks if you were to go self catering or half board which is one thing to bear in mind when selecting this hotel. The only negative we found was that we were under the impression from thomsons we were staying in protarus. However we were actually 2 villages out of the centre. The hotel was 10 minute taxi drive from protarus city centre where all the entertainment/bars/food was. Costs about 6-10 euro to get there. Ideal if you don't mind staying in the hotel For Your holiday but we do like to go out and about explore. The only thing around the hotel was 1 bar which had all the sports on which the hotel Did not cater for and 2 supermarkets which were reasonably priced. Overall I cannot really complain much as this was a lovely hotel for an all Inclusive get away. The location is not ideal and would be expensive if you were not all inclusive with limited amenities around the hotel.

author: leec817
title: A good holiday
text: We booked this holiday through Thomson between the end of August and the start of September. Firstly, my advice to people would be to book private transfers if you can afford it. It took around 1 hour 45 for the coach transfer due to the location of the hotel and the number of stops before. On arrival, the rooms were good. The bathroom was a little small but functioned well and had everything neccessary. There was a good amount of storage space throughout the room and the bed was large and comfortable. The air conditioning/electrics were quite loud and this was slightly annoying but nothing major. The TV had only one English speaking channel which again was slightly disappointing but overall the room was good and the maids did a very good job of cleaning. The pool area was probably the best aspect of the holiday. The staff were helpful, the pool was clean, a good size and the events co-ordinator did a very good job or providing entertainment around it. The jacuzzi was also a nice feature. There were plenty of sunbeds available and there wasn't really a need of reserving one although it did seem as though the 20 Euro beds were always taken by the same people and therefore we didn't bother asking at reception if we could reserve them as we assumed they had been booked out for our whole holiday. The food overall was decent. It was good quality but perhaps there could have been more choice. The waiting staff were excellent, particularly in the Italian a la carte where Evangelou was very good. We only made use of the snack menu once and the Carbonara was delicious. The wi-fi was quite reliable but a bit slow. I thought the bar area was pretty good and there was a good amount of all inclusive cocktails. There is a good bus service to the local towns which is cheap and operates frequently. Overall, a good holiday and the staff are very good with some small improvements possible.

author: traceyjane66
title: Wonderful experience!
text: Just returned from the Atlantica Sea Breeze! Such a wonderful holiday-I couldn't fault a single thing. The hotel rooms, bars and pool areas were exceptionally clean and looked very well decorated and maintained. The staff couldn't do enough to ensure all our needs were met. The food is the best I have experienced in an all inclusive hotel. Our room was cleaned every day with fresh towels and sheets several times a week. We did have the use of a car but choose to take the bus into town a few times at the cost of 1.50 euros, they come every 10 minutes or so. If you want a relaxing holiday this is the right place for you, adults only and you don't need to leave the complex with a beautiful beach just 2 or 3 minutes from the back of the hotel. I would advise swim shoes as there is the odd rock that can take you by surprise! We did the catamaran luxury sun set cruise which was also just amazing and worth the extra cost. As I said initially you would be hard pushed to find a single fault and I would definitely return. We celebrated our 30th wedding anniversary during our stay and the al la cart team decorated our table beautifully and made a real extra fuss of us and we had champagne left in our room too! Just a great all round experience. Highly recommended on every level! Thank you for a fabulous holiday and the scales pay testament to the excellent food and drink I have consumed in the last two weeks. Thank you to George, Maria, Freedom, Ulga, Marious and all the very committed staff-we had an amazing time. Xxxx

author: Jem1658
title: Amazing Anniversary Break
text: We returned from a week's break in the early hours of Monday morning and I wish we were still there! My husband and I stayed for a week to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary and I don't think we could have chosen anywhere better. The staff, from the most senior to the most junior were brilliant and simply couldn't do enough for you. We arrived around midnight and were greeted warmly by the reception staff. Check-in was smooth and we went to the bar while our luggage was taken to our room. Because we arrived so late sandwiches, fruit and a bottle of wine were awaiting us in our room - this was extremely welcome. Our room was spacious, with plenty of space for our clothes and there were tea/coffee making facilities, including a Nespresso coffee machine. The bed was extremely comfortable and the air conditioning was very welcome and worked well. I emailed the hotel a couple of weeks prior to our stay to ask whether it would be possible to book a table at the Italian a la carte for our anniversary and Jozefina emailed back to confirm the booking. The buffet restaurant had plenty of choice and I defy anyone to say they couldn't find anything to eat! Thanks to George and his team for wonderful service. The pool area was kept spotlessly clean and there were plenty of sunbeds, either round the pool (you have to get up early to get one) or on the lawns. The pool bar staff were great - thanks to Chryso, Olga and the rest of the team. All in all it was a brilliant stay and we will definitely be returning. Mr Panayiotou you should be rightly proud of all your staff.

author: p4fed
title: Chilled Out Holiday!
text: stayed here from 29th July to 12th August. The staff make this hotel. Nothing is any trouble. Any problems with the room are dealt with promptly. The food is good, there is plenty of choice and the Italian is especially good - make sure you take up your once a week allocation. In house entertainment is quite good with the resident duo Alex and Hannah belting out some great numbers. The hotel is spotless, cleaning is constant. My only gripe is that the sun loungers did not have any mattresses which would have made them more comfortable and be careful, they can have a tendency to tip up! There are plenty of sun loungers on the grassed areas you will not have a problem getting one. However, if you are a pool fan you may need to do a 'towel' run. The jacuzzi rooms are based in the ground floor and overlooked from above balconies. Another gripe about the balconies, there is no privacy as they are all open. The area itself is very quiet, two small supermarkets nearby. Protaras is a bus or taxi ride if you want nightlife. It suited us as we were there to have a complete recharge of batteries so to speak. Would recommend it, but not sure if we would go back purely because it takes an hour to get to and I personally prefer shorter transfer times. On the whole a very relaxing holiday - it hit the spot.

author: Derek518
title: Best Holiday Ever
text: This is honestly the best holiday we have ever experienced. We had opted for a Superior room with limited sea view and were not disappointed. The room faced west and was therefore only in sunlight in late afternoon and with very efficient air-con, was perfect. The bed was huge and very comfortable. There was plenty of clothes storage and the bathroom was well appointed. When we arrived at the Hotel, around midnight, we were glad that the reception staff were processing guests very quickly. There was even a table full of complimentary drinks, which were very welcome. The restaurant food was fabulous.....great choices at every meal, with many authentic greek dishes, which I love to cook at home, at dinner. Lovely fresh salads always available and the desserts were "to die for". The Restaurant Manager, George, runs a tight ship and cannot do enough for guests....a truly wonderful man. The Hotel Manager personally welcomes guests at the welcome meeting...the first time we have ever had this. There is a fully stocked pool bar, with a swim up option if you like to use it. The bar area is covered in triangular "sails" which provides welcome shade. The main bar area is an extension of the reception area plus an external balcony with comfortable seating. The bar staff and waiters soon recognised us and were more than pleased to supply my nightly glasses of ouzo.(Thank you Magda) Plenty of sunbeds around the pool, plus loads more on the grass area between the pool and the sea. We had such a fantastic holiday, that we have booked to return, this time for 14 nights, in October 2015. I cannot rate this Hotel and staff high enough...well done all of you

author: crewsy
title: Ideal for couples
text: Location - out of town but excellent for a quiet relaxing holiday,bus stop outside with a regular cheap bus service. Pool Area - clean,plenty of beds and pleasant helpful staff working the area. Beach/Bay - small and busy on the weekends, a bit rocky underfoot and not that clear until you get further out.ok for snorkeling. Restaurant - very welcoming staff,very clean, tables cleared very quickly. Food was excellent no messing around with sauces over your veg just plain and simple. Always plenty of choice and well presented. Always shown to your seat and drinks order taken straight away,i never waited to be seated. Room - we had a Jacuzzi room on the ground floor,nice size room cleaned immaculately, good size terrace with Jacuzzi, two sun loungers,parasol,table and two chairs. Only downside is all the balconies looking over you,perhaps a bigger or different shaped parasol to give you a little privacy without everyone staring at you. Did get towels and shorts dropping onto our terrace regularly. Entertainment - was low key,residential singers and some visiting acts. Bars- plenty of choice of local drinks, you got to pay for some cocktails even if you are all inclusive, which i always think is a bit of a rip off. Staff - Very pleasant,very helpful all throughout the hotel. 5 star service from the staff. Overall - i would recommend this hotel to family, friends and any couples that want a relaxing getaway from it all holiday. I've never gone back to the same hotel but i would this one.

author: 590davidt
title: Great hotel for couples
text: Enjoyed our stay in this lovely hotel. Probably the smallest hotel we have stayed in but probably one of the best. The staff really make an effort and this is what makes the difference. Rooms were spotless as was the hotel. Good variety of food, and we also went into Protaras, about 20 minutes by bus (1.50 euros each) or 10 euros by taxi. We took one Thomson trip - love Cyprus, which took us up into the Troodos mountains, although expensive was good and an excellent meal in a village Taverna. We also took a boat trip from Protaras for 14 euros, a fraction of the Thomson price. Just across the road from the hotel is a shop and a pub which you can book a day's open (English) bus tour for 30 euros which visits Famagusta and takes you across into Northern Cyprus. Very good value for money and very interesting! Seemed to be no trouble getting a sun bed on the grassy area up to about 10am. Most of the guests seem to be English or English speaking, but seemed to be quite a few Russians there when we left. Entertainment wasn't fantastic but enjoyable none the less. I would recommend seeing the Blues brothers act. If you want something more lively there is Protaras or Ayia Napa not too far away. We have put this one down to return to!

author: MarkE455
title: Couldn't fault it. The staff went out of their way to make everyones holiday
text: We've just come back from 10 days at the Atlantic Sea Breeze for our Honeymoon and it exceeded our expectations. The room was modern and had a balcony and a sea view. The coffee maker was a real bonus, loved the fresh coffee in the morning. The maid who serviced the rooms was so cheerful and friendly and always asked if there was anything else she could do. The restaurant service was excellent. George the manager was always there to greet us at Breakfast lunch and dinner, we were always shown to the table and a drinks order taken. The food was always good with plenty of choice. A variety of Salads, Hot Food, soups, deserts , meant there was never a problem finding something good to eat, the problem was not eating to much. The pool and grass sunbathing area is kept clean and tidy. Staff are always walking around collecting empty glasses and serving drinks. The pool is cool and refreshing and the bar stools in the pool help create a relaxed , friendly atmosphere. The beach are is next to the hotel. We found it best to get a sun bed at the bottom of the grass near the beach so we could swim in the bay without having to take all our stuff with us. The bay is rocky so it's useful to have goggles so you can see where you put you're feet. The rocks make it more interesting for swimming and I preferred the bay to the pool. The hotel had a resident duo (Alex and Hannah) who provided the evening entertainment. This was enhanced by additional guest acts. The entertainment was good, the highlights were a Blue's Brothers act and The Soul Man. Watersports and boat trips can be booked at the hotel, at the next bay which is about 20 minutes walk or in Protarus (a bus trip of about 20 minutes , cost 3 Euros return) As an all inclusive couples holiday we would recommend this and will go back again.

author: ros7685
title: Well worth a visit
text: After we arrived in Larnaca but our suitcases didn't, we had to travel to the hotel without any luggage. On arrival at the Atlantica Sea Breeze, Jozefina (the hotel's Holiday Concierge) immediately offered her help to trace our cases. I had previously been in email correspondence with her regarding a couple of questions I had about the hotel and was very impressed with her responses. Fortunately our cases turned up 4 hours later, so we were able to enjoy our holiday from there on. The Atlantica Sea Breeze is a Couples Only hotel with a very friendly atmosphere. We had a side seaview room, which in my opinion had a better outlook than the seaview rooms, as we overlooked a lovely little bay. The rooms were spotlessly clean as was the rest of the hotel. There was always a wide choice of food in the restaurant and the staff overseen by George were always very attentive and on the ball in clearing the tables. The evening entertainment was much better than experienced in other hotels and Alex and Hannah are to be congratulated on the range of their musical repertoire. We did not use the spa but the swimming pool, Jacuzzi and grassed area were always kept spotlessly clean. A nice touch by the hotel is that each day they serve ice cream, melon or smoothies to sunbathers. The hotel have a "Meet the Team" reception, introducing all the heads of departments and also a Farewell drink the evening before you leave when the staff say goodbye. Something I haven't experienced before, but which was appreciated by all who attended. The hotel is a little remote but there is a good bus service to nearby towns with the bus stop just outside the hotel. I would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel.

author: Q1724XHpeterg
title: Fantastic and relaxing hotel
text: This was our second stay at the Atlantica Sea Breeze and there will certainly be more visits. Run under the Thomson Couple banner, it is a great retreat for those who want a peaceful stay, away from children. As grandparents we love the youngsters, but a break away from them is a very welcome change, especially when for once you are the ones who are being waited on! The staff are all wonderful and friendly and will do everything to male sure your stay is just the way you want it to be. The pool and pool bar are very well maintained and there are plenty of sun loungers, which means you can have breakfast peacefully then find a spot to rest should you wish to do so, without any problem, unlike some other hotels, where you need to 'reserve' the loungers by 7 am or miss out altogether. Some all-inclusive hotels have very poor food and drinks, but not the Sea Breeze. The food is of a very high quality with plenty of choices and most drinks are included in the A/I package. The entertainment is usually of a very light standard, which is what most visitors want. The two resident duos we've seen (Ben & Aimee and Alex & Hannah) are very good. Down side - one or two of the imported acts have not been as entertaining as the resident singers (in my view anyway), but that is a very minor gripe. Rooms are clean and the cleaners are very efficient. We've never had any problems with the rooms we've stayed in. And a nice touch this year was a bottle of wine waiting for us as returning guests. Have I had better holidays in my 58 years? I really can't think of any and I know my wife agrees.

author: 25Denny
title: Excellent hotel
text: Just back from a two week stay at the Atlantica Sea Breeze and Ive never stayed in a hotel where they cared so much about their guests. Absolutely nothing was too much trouble for any of the staff, all they cared about was the guests having a first class holiday. I have stayed in 5* hotels but none of them could match this hotel for the food. Massive, massive choice, they cater for all tastes. The a la carte was superb. Nightly entertainment was very good especially when they had Elvis ( oh yes hes alive and kicking ) , the blues bros, and sca etc. The hotel is spotlessly clean in all areas and the pool area and gardens have ample sunbeds so no getting up at the crack of dawn to put your towels out ! We usually went for a sunbed after breakfast and never had any trouble finding one. The staff from top management down are all attentive to your needs. The dining room is large and the tables are a nice distance apart. Theres a laundry room with a washer , iron etc. Although the hotel isn't in the centre of Protaras it is central to visiting other towns. Paralimni is worth a visit. I honestly cannot praise this hotel highly enough. The only fly in the ointment was the hairdresser. I was going to a wedding so booked in to have my hair done. I will be kind and say she wasn't up to standards. Everything else is first class. Don't think twice just book it, you wont be sorry !!!!

author: christophers536
title: One of (if not ) the best holiday we've had
text: We were looking for a relaxing holiday and this is just what we got. Firstly the negatives and reasons for 4 stars. Location very little in the way of early evening walks, no promenade. Man made beach rocky swimming,, entertainment finished at 11 (see below) Now the positives deserving 5 stars. Modern adults only which meant not being dive bombed in the large pool that you could actually swim in. Room very clean, large comfy double bed,plenty of wardrobe space although no drawers, hair dryers not mentioned in the Tompson Web site. Meals buffet style although you can have one al la carte per week but with such variety and good (if not sometimes over eager) service we chose not to have. Food variety was good, quality good and well presented. The restaurant is not at all cramped. All areas are clean and we'll maintained and the pool and bar service exceptional. Seemed to be sufficient sun loungers athough there was still a certain amount of "reservation with towels". Staff friendly throughout more so who were intent on you having a good time. A special mention to the evening bar staff who got to know your favourite drink would keep on replenishing, they worked tirelessly. Back to the entertainment the hotel had a resident band and this would be followed by a live act but when act finishes so does the entertainment, could do with danice music then. Our comments were voiced to the manager at the farewell meeting and he said he would bring it up at the weekly meeting it will be it will interesting to see if things have changed when we revisit which we definitely will do. Regarding location unfortunately no walks but get a 10 euro bus ticket which has lasts 2 hours so you could easily visit the more commercial centres of aya napa, protaras and panera all in one day.

author: thomas01hahhah
title: Did Not Match Expectations
text: This was our 4th visit to a Couples hotel in the last 12 months, and was the most disappointing. Yes the hotel generally is good standard, as would be expected as it has recently been refurbished. Bedrooms, dining room, reception, bar area all to good standard. However, room described as partial sea view, yes if you have a giraffes neck. Could not sit on balcony, overlooking a dilapidated apartment block, watching old granny in room. Woken most mornings by refuse wagon collecting skips. The dining room, food excellent, good range of choice, however , Relax the rules reduces the standards. People sauntering around in flip flops and beach shorts for evening meals is disappointing. Surely the rules for A la Carte dining area should be consistent with the rest of the dining area. Meals on the outside terrace spoilt by persistent smokers, who show no respect for other diners. The terrace area has a similar problem, no escape from them. Terrace area very crowded, what with smokers and "Tribute Acts" more like Phoenix Nights than Cyprus. with restricted space, there is no alternative for a quieter evening. The grassed sunbathing area excellent, good service, only issue again is the apartment block next door, with residents using the hotel to get to the beach next door, which is not the Sea Breeze facility. daytime activities very low key, events are on, however very little awareness of them.

author: grahamj829
title: Top spot on East Coast
text: Just had a week at this hotel and it's hard to fault without being picky. Had booked the Junior suite but on arrival met by Thomson rep and staff were told room not available until next day. Full of apologies showed us another room for the night and claimed it was their best. They were right, room 434 on top floor is spacious, has 5 x the balcony size of any other room(including juniot suite, has outside and inside jaccuzi and is very private! Balcony haf areas of sun and shade from dawn to dusk. Bathroom is small and needs some TLC, shower screen leaked every time used. Hotel in general is very well equiped, plenty of recliners around pool and in the Garden, think it's abit steep to want 20 euros a day for one of the three balinese beds. Garden well kept, staff brilliant, very attentive, humerous and helpful. Entertainment was ok if you like that sort of thing but you can always escape to the relative peace of the garden bar from 2100. Fantastic choice of food and even as a CoeliacI had no problem finding something to eat every meal. Only thing I and some others were unhappy with were the cats wandering around the outside eating area and being fed by misguided souls. The hotel is in a quiet area apart from the beach bar next door which can be lively and loud at the weekend. Buses to Protaris and Ayan Napa leave every 20 mins from just outside hotel and only cost 1.5 euros. Car hire very cheap. Boat tour from next resort (Golden Coast Harbour ) not really worth it as it goes nowhere near the Ghost town of Famagusta. Overall very good hotel complimented by excellent staff.

author: L8705RBjoeh
title: Amazing hotel and staff. You'll not want to leave.
text: Me and my girlfriend visited this hotel in August 14. This was our first couples hotel experience and upon arrival we were made to feel very special. We arrived at the hotel late after delayed flight and being the last drop off. We were told to leave everything at the reception and go to the bar as they had stayed open for our arrival. From that point onwards it only got better. Nothing was an issue for the staff and the Thomson reps Josh and Emma were very helpful. An example of this being, we hired a car and wanted to connect it to an iPod and we didn't have a cable compatible for the car. Josh managed to source one for us. The management were approachable and were always visible. Even taking time out of a busy day to chat as did the reps. The facilities of the hotel are good too. Our room was very comfortable and incredibly clean.This was a nice chilled out break and as many of the other people have said we never wanted to leave. The food was fantastic everyday with many choices and always fresh. Panayiotis and all off his staff have to take credit for this. You will love it here. We would love to go back.

author: SAH09495
title: Didn't want to go home!!
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed here in June 2014 and from the moment we arrived we knew we wouldn't want to go home.. Drinks upon check in and bags taken to your room while you explore! We arrived around 10pm so dinner was already finished but we had sandwiches and fruit left in the fridge in our room along with bottles of water, and also wine and some more fruit - lovely! The room was complete with dressing gowns and slippers and kettle/coffee machine which was a lovely touch! Staff always friendly and helpful, especially the reception staff always happy to advise you of the best places to visit and to phone a taxi for you. Very large pool with swim up bar and plenty of sunbeds! The food was AMAZING always very hot and good quality. Breakfast was of a very high standard and I would go back just for that! The snacks was also extremely good, they was more like main meals!! The only grumble I have is the fact that there seems to be no way for them to tell if they've already sat someone on a table so we found ourselves leaving the table we had been sat at to get our food and coming back to find someone else sitting there which is embracing and awkward! The managers should maybe place something on the table so they know it's already taken.. The hotel is pretty tucked away but only 5 mins in a taxi! The water show is also a must whilst you're here! We would definitely go back but are going to explore other Atlantica and couples hotels first as this one gave us such a good impression!! We went during the world cup so there was also a great atmosphere, the hotel provided a screen playing the martches at the pool bar which was lovely! Honestly you won't regret booking here, it is luxury for the price you pay! Thanks to all of the staff for such an amazing visit!

author: geoff_acook
title: Slightly Disappointed
text: First of all the best bits, the service was very good right from the cleaners to the bar & restaurant staff.The room was nice and clean and was spacious for our needs. No need to get up at 6.00 to put your towells on a bed as there were plenty to go round. We went on some lovely walks either to the left of the front or to the right. Very unspoilt meaning know concrete paths. Now the negatives, WARM FOOD, they kept topping up to high, so the only hot section was at the bottom where the heat was, so by the time you got back to your table is was less than warm. One of the managers was standing right next to me when I added some gravy to my meal, on checking it was less than warm, he just kept saying "60 60". I said "no my friend cold cold". No problem with the food that was cooked in front of you. The entertaiment, the duo HOT LIPS ( what a silly name ) Their acoustic sets were more like heavy metal due to the volume, acoustic music should be played as a back ground so as people can talk before the Cabaret. Once the Cabaret is finished then turn the volume up for Hot Lips finale set. They played by the pool side acouple of times, boy was it loud. These are not just my complaints but quite a few others. Other than that they were very good and just should learn about balance. Over the last 40 years of being in the business I think I know a bit about what I'm talking about. Not enough seating for the evening inside. The question you are asking is would we go back, the answer would be, we don't think so, untill they deal with the above issues

author: S1430GPkimm
title: Amazing hotel
text: Just back from our ten day holiday,don't know where too start everything was brilliant. The food was always great for all inclusive. Loads too choose from and always hot. George in restaurant was lovely,always greeted you with a big smile. The Italian restaurant was excellent,Marius was amazing always checking we where ok,glass never got empty. He is a brilliant member of the team could not ask for more from him. We went twice cause it was that good. We had a limited sea view room which over looked the car park,but could see the sea. Might be a bit disappointed by this when first get there but you get what you pay for 'limited' still the room was so clean,faultless. The maids work so hard and cleaned the room everyday. There is no beach as such on the back of the hotel it very rocky but a short walk away there is a cove. The sea is so clear,really good for snorkelling. Amy and Ben the entertainment were great to watch, needs more seating areas to watch them tho. Sometimes after dinner there was no where to sit,but the outside terrace and cannot always see entertainment from there. All in all the stay and hotel was amazing, already booked for next year and cannot wait too go back .

author: bigneilly
title: Lovely Hotel
