text: We had a trouble free trip after a short delay on the runway in Newcastle due to fighters using the airspace over Cyprus. It's about a forty five minute transfer to the hotel, we were last stop as the Seabreeze is on the edge of Protarus. Faultless reception with drinks while completing registration and waiting for suitcases to be taken to our room. We had paid a small subsidy to have a side sea view which we duly got, having walked round the outside of the hotel I'm not sure that all rooms don't have some sort of sea view. The rooms are nice with two singles joined to make a big double. We took the duvet off an replaced it with the duvet cover as it was quite hot. The room has fridge, safety deposit (included in cost) and tv. The tv only has bbc world service which is a really annoying station which runs through repeats of the same segments over and over. We found there was plenty of storage space and that the air conditioning worked very well. There are loads of sunbeds, most of which are on the grassed area which goes from the edge of the hotel to the beach (some of the sunbeds are past their best and appear a bit scruffy). The restaurant is nice with a good selection of meals from breakfast to evening meal having to cater for a wide range of European visitors. The hotel have relaxed the long trousers rule and now accept long shorts as well. We tried the Italian a la carte which was very nice, we both had the steak which comes in a Dianne sauce unless you ask otherwise. The general restaurant has salad bar, a grill station which does fish and meats, a show cooking section which did nice spaghetti dishes. The main reception area in the bar is where the entertainment takes place with the resident duo (hotlips) and emma the one woman entertainment team singing and quizzing. All of the staff are friendly and helpful as usual in Atlantica hotels. For anyone who hasn't been to Larnca airport for a while you don't have to suffer the cattle market that was the old check in system, the airport has been completely updated with a wide range of shops and restaurants. I can recommend the hotel and will be going back, no doubt, in the future.

author: ladyslw
title: First Trip To Cyprus
text: Having never been to Cyprus before we decided to pick this hotel as it was a Thomson Couples Hotel. It took about an hour from the airport and once we arrived we were given check in forms to fill out and then take up to reception, the staff then very efficiently checked us in and told us about dining times etc. Our room had a partial sea view and was a well appointed very clean room with a very large comfortable bed. Tea and coffee facilities and a free safe are an added bonus, there is also a fridge which can be used, but no mini bar included. The bathroom was clean with bath and overhead shower which had good pressure and always had hot water. The towels need to be updated both in the room and for around the pool as these were looking a bit tired which was a shame as everything else in the rooms were very good. We stayed on an all inclusive basis and this included one meal in the a la carte Italian restaurant. We found the food to be very good, there was not always a vast choice but you could always find something to pick. The restaurant is very nice with good air conditioning which is always a bonus. The bar area and lounge by reception is very clean and modern and we enjoyed sitting up at the bar having a drink in the evenings. However, not all the drinks are included in the all inclusive something I can never understand? The pool area and garden are nice with plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas and we never had a problem getting a sunbed. Looking out to the sea was very relaxing but the beach area is quite rocky so we did not venture down to it. One area they need to improve is the path leading down from the pool area to the garden bar area as it is very uneven and could cause a nasty fall. They also need to put some more screening in with bushes etc to hide the fence to the next hotel, to make it look more attractive. The staff were all friendly and helpful and we enjoyed a very sunny week in September 2014 and would go back for a another relaxing break.

author: 732robynm
title: 99% Perfect - definitely worth a visit.
text: Having just returned from Atlantica Sea Breeze, I wanted to share our experience which was faultless. We stayed at Atlantica Kalliston in Crete last September and this hotel operates with the same top-notch service. The hotel is not 'on the beach' however but 'near the beach' which was fine for my partner who walked over a few times and went snorkelling. He saw a large turtle whilst snorkelling too so keep your eyes peeled and fingers crossed to see such beautiful creatures during your swim. The food was fantastic as was the service when eating in the Italian A La Carte on the one evening, which comes free with your 7 night stay. The mozzarella tartlet (which was not mozzarella) left a lot to be desired for the starter however but am sure that this will be improved for the next season. I do not agree with towels being left on sunbeds at the crack of dawn at any hotel and was disappointed that this was happening at Atlantica Sea Breeze. Some beds were 'reserved' with towels but the occupiers did not arrive until after noon! Another note about the food, the salads are amazing which we had for lunch every day however one suggestion to the hotel would be to add less coriander... can completely ruin a plate of salad sometimes. We used the spa during our stay, I had an express facial and my partner had a Swedish massage. Very highly recommend both treatments which came with the free use of the sauna/steam room. We walked into Protaras very the streets on a cloudy day. was a long way but brilliant to get out and about to look at the local area. We clocked 13km of walking on that day and would recommend, even if you take the buses to see Fig Tree Bay. Overall a fantastic holiday and now looking forward to trying more of the Atlantica hotels in the future. Don't hesitate to book for next season - you won't regret it!

author: Georgefos
title: Fantastic holiday
text: This was our third visit to the hotel and it surpassed our expectations. On arrival we were greeted in reception and offered a refreshing drink and a very warm welcome. Check in was slick and we were soon in our room overlooking the pool area. The staff, Eva, George, Christos, Dimitri (1&2), Olga to name just a few of the many are first class and make you feel very welcome. There is a good selection at all meal times, various dishes, and ample. Big cheer for the blue cheese!!. on every day. You can eat inside and out. There is also an a la carte Italian restaurant and the quality in there was also excellent. The one improvement to the restaurant would be the reinstating of the dress code (long trousers for the evening meal) dropped this year. The entertainment was very good. Emma the entertainment co-ordinator is excellent and we felt the balance of activities was just right. Emma provided the evening entertainment on a couple of evenings and she was excellent. The evening entertainment was on the terrace adjacent to the lobby bar, (in previous years it was in a dedicated area away from the main bar) and we felt this was detrimental to those who wished to enjoy the entertainment and those who wanted to just sit and chat. In summary great hotel,excellent staff.

author: flynnmichael
title: Another Atlantica Gem
text: We have stayed at three different Atlantica hotels now and none have disappointed! We booked 10 months before going in early September but were still too late for sea view rooms. We still had a great time but the rooms like ours with a view over the neighbouring car parks are not conducive to wanting to spend any more time in your room than you have to. Having said that the rooms are very clean, we'll equipped with very comfy beds! The food is out of this world and George and all of the staff are the usual Atlantica top standard. The entertainment is classy and enjoyable and the resident duo are truly talented. Emma provided the day time fun if you wanted to join in but was the jewel in the crown when unleashing her beautiful voice some evenings! So, with all this good news was there anything to criticise? Unfortunately yes but do not let it be a reason for you to not choose this little gem. Our only moan was the litter at the end of the grounds where the hotel meets the sea. We like to find trees to shelter under away from the heat of the sun. Trees can be found at the edge of the grounds near the shore but were sadly ruined by litter and rubbish that seem to get completely missed by the hotel staff. Although there is no beach this is not a problem but you will need to take reef shoes to help you negotiate the rocks in and out of the water. Unfortunately there is also rubbish and litter lurking amongst the rocks. Although I know this ground does not belong to the hotel it wouldn't take much to keep the bit adjacent to the hotel clean if checked every day. I did report this to Josh the Thomson rep. He was more than helpful if you wanted to buy a trip or hire a car but as much use as a chocolate tea pot if you had a suggestion like this.

author: 632sueb
title: Fantastic!!
text: The Sea Breeze is a great addition to the Atlantica Hotels. We had a great holiday from check in to check out, the staff were brilliant, all friendly, cheerful and want to do their best to make your holiday special. The Management team should be very proud of them. Our room was a superior with a sea view, it had been renovated and was certainly of a good standard, the beds are impressive, huge and very comfortable ( the pillows were a little on the firm side). Free wifi, tea and coffee facilities Food was very good with a great selection at every mealtime, catering for all tastes. The Italian a la carte was certainly worth a visit ( free for all inclusive). All areas were clean and attractive, the pool area a good size and many sunbeds in the gardens. My only moan is they are not very comfortable. Although outside of Protaras there is a good bus links to nearby attractions. A couples hotel meant no children and a very relaxed and low key attitude to entertainment. There were some excellent outside entertainers which varied the evenings. This is the first year as an Atlantica Hotel and repeat visitors commented on the improvemnts very positively. I feel this hotel will continue to improve as more areas become renovated and they try out new ideas. A farewell drinks gave the Management the opportunity to find out their guests opinions and the manager seems really keen to make more positive changes next year. Thank you for a great holiday!!

author: Brando28
title: Brilliant
text: Just returned from 10 night stay at this hotel and we both thought it was terrific. On arrival supplied with cold drink easy and efficient check in, the girls at reception are lovely. Went to our room and the cases had already been delivered. Great room 2 floors above reception and very large balcony. The cleaners at the hotel are great and our room was absolutely spotless. Sheets and towels changed regularly. Food was excellent and George the maître de was so polite and always smiling. The waiting staff were also great and worked very hard. There was always great variety of food and even if you were very fussy you would always find something to eat. Bar staff were great and most of them always remembered what you drank. Pool bar was great as well and we used to go there at night after dinner as it was always quiet. The entertainment does need to be improved as it is not everyone's cup of tea. Overall this was a great holiday for us and as the hotel has only been opened this year I believe it will improve even more in the coming years. I would recommend this hotel and will definitely try other atlantica hotels. I left a jacket at the hotel in the lobby and I e-mailed the hotel when I arrived home. Got a reply by return to say they had my jacket and asked for my address so they could post to me. You cannot get better service than that. Thanks to all at the Atlantica Sea Breeze.

author: SuperSumms
title: What a stay
text: Stayed at this hotel for week, but was definitely not long enough. The hotel and staff are a credit to themselves and I must thank them very much for making it such a fantastic holiday. In particular George the maître de,after reading so many things about him on here they are all true he is a machine of politeness, welcome and how he runs the food operation is second to none it is clockwork and his staff are just as efficient as him. Next to thank on a personal note is Christos the chef he would always come and say hello to me and works relentlessly on cooking of course and interacting with guests in such a great manner. But to be fair all the chefs must work hard and it shows in the food. The food here is AMAZING and anyone who says otherwise must have some serious issues. There is always plenty of choice, variation and tastes great. My only problem is I have seriously eaten to much and have now got to sign up to gym. We went to the Italian restaurant and were not disappointed. The steak was incredible and the whole experience is a must if your on the all inclusive. Can I suggest to the management team regarding the dress code (seeing as I am man) for evening dining. I thought some of the males were underdressed (seeing as I liked to make an effort for the misses) with them wearing sports wear. Men should be allowed to wear tailored shorts and perhaps made to have a collared tshirt/ shirt on and ban any sort of sports wear. Banning tailored shorts would be ridiculous! Would I come back? Most definitely and have already looked into it with the better half before writing this and I'm still in the lobby waiting for the transfer. We done the

author: Teeshhampshire
title: Even More Superb!
text: This was our 6th stay at this hotel and due to the change of ownership was even better than before. More staff and all areas bright and with new furniture in the bar. The Management stayed the same and without exception they are all excellent at their jobs and are very well overseen by the general manager who not only knows his job but does it extremely well. Eva, front of house manager along with Katerina, Borina and Anna in reception make you so welcome and hand out a refreshing drink on arrival. The bedrooms are spotless as is the whole hotel despite being full. George the Maitre D is his excellent, charming and welcoming self and his staff do a good job most efficiently. Due to a new head chef the food is just outstanding and modern food containers make sure it is always hot. Plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas mean you do not have to get up at 5am and put towels out!! Treats are handed round each morning by the pool area and glasses and rubbish collected regularly. Olga runs the pool bar when she is on duty there in a most professional manner and never stops dashing around. She even takes only 30 minutes break which is more than some and also is not constantly on her mobile and smoking! A wonderrful 2 weeks break and you would be hard pushed to find fault with any of the staff who work hard to ensure you are well looked after. Our only minor criticism is the fact that the evening dress code was relaxed, but as this has been brought to the attention of the general manager and he has assured guests who spoke to him this will be reviewed, we can rest assured he'll keep his word and hopefully Atlantica group will revert to the previous code of long trousers for the gentlemen and nice dresses the ladies. It may be hot in summer but the airconditioning work a treat! All in all a superb hotel, very well run and a genuine pleasure to stay at. Will be back September 2015 for the 7th time!.

author: MRCKent_UK
title: Atlantica Sea Breeze, honest review
text: First impression on arrival was a bit of a let down. We have definitely stayed in better hotels a lot cheaper than this. Room comfort was OK, when we turned up it had a loose toilet seat, never properly sorted out, just had a bit of paper stuffed in it which almost lasted the week, we could not enter our own code into the safe and nobody ever turned up to sort this out so that was obviously not sortable, not very reassuring. We were on the fourth floor, the first night on returning to the room the corridor had a very strong diesel/gas smell. We reported it to reception, they said maintenance had gone home and it was fine, we slept with the door wide open as we wanted to wake up in the morning. Mentioned it to the Thomson rep the next day, the smell did get better but stayed all week. The thomson reps are not up to much, you never really see a lot of them, entertainment is not great to put it mildly, some acts bought in were OK, some were awful, the sound system is also not up to much, the resident band did their best when they played, but you do not see much of them. The restaurant dress code for the evening is awful, I have seen people better dressed on the beach. As with all buffets it suffers with lukewarm food and the a total lack of hand sanitisation, some of the clientele did not wash their hands after visiting the facilities, makes you wonder every time you pick up a spoon. Desserts were all in the open, but gave the flies somewhere to sit. The italian is worth a visit, very good meal, which was served hot. The waiter in the restaurant are excellent and provide a very good service, the bar staf are good, the bar waiters are OK, one or two should try smiling. Another hotel that suffers from the sunbed rush, you have to bag one by eight am. I have never understood why hotels do not allocate them, we stayed at a hotel in Protaras that did this, they had bought enough in the first place and if you wanted to move you saw the pool man and he sorted it out, fantastic system, not adopted here. Flights were good and the airport is OK, we survived the week. For the Atlantica brand this is a poor example the hotel in Kolympia, Rhodes, and the one in Paphos were far superior, maybe they have dropped to this level now? Makes you think.

author: carmelbs
title: Fantastic Holiday
text: Well, where to start. We arrived at the hotel at around 11 o'clock at night. The check in was quick and precise and we went to our room (429). Very quickly the bell boy brought our cases up and we managed to unpack whilst munching on the sandwiches, fruit and juice that was put in the mini fridge. The room was very clean, although a little on the small side, as was the balcony. This was open and not screened from your neighbour, so, not very private. The bathroom has a shower over bath and was all very adequate as you are not in the room that much. The next morning it was down to breakfast where we were met by George, who was there everyday with a smile and a lovely greeting be it lunch or dinner too. The food was varied every day and although it may not be to your personal taste it was very good and tasty. The staff in the restaurant are a credit to the hotel and very friendly. We had 2 meals in the Italian a la carte restaurant and once again it was very good and well run by Marios. During the day we would chill out in the gardens,although the beach is not sandy there is a little cove adjacent where we would go to cool down in. Initially we were disappointed that there was no beach but actually it was nice not to have sand every where back in your room. We did not do any trips as we like just to relax, but at night we went for walks. The centre of Protaras is about a 45 minute walk each way which we did most nights and very enjoyable. There is a bus service that runs to the town that costs 1.5 € each or a taxi is 10€ one way. All in all we could not fault the holiday and it was everything that we had wanted. Would we go back again? Undoubtably yes is the answer. Once again thank you to all at the hotel for making our best holiday ever.

author: EilsTez1960
title: Fantastic holiday
text: We have just returned from the Atlantica Sea Breeze and could not fault our stay one little bit. The room was cleaned everyday, Bed made, fresh water left each day, The air conditioning was very welcome. There was plenty of food to choose from and was restocked as soon as it was running low. The head water George was brilliant he would not let the standard drop and made sure tables were cleared quickly. The service was faultless. The pool was warm and clean, plenty of sunbeds no one was without one. The gazebo sunbeds was a nice touch which you could hire and have waiter service. The whole staff were friendly, helpful would chat to you if you wanted them too. There was porter service on your arrival with a welcome drink. Our bags were taken up to our room. Even the cleaning staff were friendly and greeted you each morning. Nothing seemed too much trouble. The pool bar had friendly staff and service was spot on. There was a beach but not too big the one directly in front of hotel was rocky and a bit difficult to walk over. The evening entertainment we had was not too great except the Greek dancers. This was the first time in Cyprus and would not hesitate to go back again. You would have to be extremely fussy person not to enjoy this hotel. Anyone going out there we envy you.

author: caroll166
title: A very lovely holiday
text: We have just returned from a 2 week holiday. The staff at the hotel are extremely helpful at all times. When we checked In and allocated our room we went to take a look and noticed this was a side sea view room when I had booked and paid for full sea view superior room. We contacted the reception to explain about the room. We was asked to go to reception and advised to see our rep in the morning, I was not to happy with this only been traveling all day and just wanted to settle in. On returning to the room the receptionist rang and advised us they was changing our room. The porter Pavlos came to our room and took us to the new room which was amazing it was room number 434 this was one of the jacuzzi suites (well impressed). The hotel was lovely and clean and a very good choice on food. The Italian restaurant was very good also. The members of staff which we thought were a credit to Atlantica hotel is Pavlos (portor) on our holiday is was our anniversary ,my husband forgot to take card with him and good not find a nice card around the hotel, Pavlos on his day off got my husband a card for me (which I might add a very nice card) this I thought this was over and above his hotel duties. The receptions Katca was extremely helpful too. The staff who are doing the bars are good. We had a treatment at the spar (run by Alex and his wife) are extremely nice. Our friends came out to spend 1week holiday with us we had a really good time. They booked a junior suite this room was also very nice. This hotel is run very well Atlantica should be proud of their staff they make their guest feel very special. If there is any complaint I could make are I think they should be covers on the sunbeds with pillows to make more comfortable and also pool towels should be changed everyday. Overall I would recommend this holiday very relaxing and staff amazing.

author: mariamC5993IR
title: Excellent hotel
text: Just returned from Sea Breeze and would thoroughly recommend this hotel. The staff were extremely polite and attentive to the guests. We requested adjoining rooms and rooms on a higher floor and although this could not be guaranteed this was fulfilled. George in the main restaurant was an absolute gentleman and the food provided lots of choice throughout our stay. Emma who was the activities organiser worked tirelessly and has a superb voice when leading the evening entertainment. She is definitely an asset for the Thomson team. Guest acts and hot lips the resident duo ensured that the entertainment was varied and engaging throughout our stay. The veranda was a lovely setting for this. Rooms were clean and well decorated and the bed was extremely comfortable with daily cleaning. The open grass sunbathing area provided space and plenty of sun beds which were available until late in the morning. The only negative comments would be the very poor beach area but a short walk or bus ride will soon take you to sandy beaches and the poor TV entertainment, just BBC world news on a continuous loop. As a leading Thomson hotel with predominantly British guests a few more channels would be a benefit. It would be easy to stay in the hotel but there are lots of places of interest very close to the hotel and the bus service is just outside the hotel and at 1.50 euros is very cheap. The Thomson rep could have been more pro active and seemed content to sit at his desk, even when we were leaving, but we explored the area independently. A new addition to the Atlantica group and we will definitely return again.

author: Catchaglobe
title: Fab couples only hotel!
text: Just got back from Thomsons all inclusive couples break. Hotel excellent with very obliging and friendly staff. The bar staff very friendly and the waiting staff very efficient. Rooms very clean, with tea and coffee making facilities. Showers hot. Baths a bit small so we just used shower. Buffet meals very well presented with different main dishes every day both Greek and international. Clean cutlery and plates. Only negative was that if you get room facing west you can be over the sloped delivery area so get woken early by clanging delivery men or lorries reversing slowly back up the slope but a plus point of this side is that you get good view of sea towards the deserted town of Famagusta and lovely sunsets and locals on opposing balconies will give you a friendly wave if you like people watching! Lots of grass for sun loungers and plenty of them. You will need rubberised soles on beach footwear as volcanic flat rocks need to be crossed to enter the sea directly below hotel grassy area. However a sandy bay around 5 min walk provides easier entry to sea and this is where the locals go to swim. Bring your snorkel and mask for lots of fish in clear warm waters! Pool side bar and you can sit on bar stools in the water as well. Lovely bar staff. On departure hotel the manager and lovely friendly George the maître de waved us off which was a nice touch. A champagne end of hol drink was also provided the last evening. Emma the Thomson events rep did a very varied entertainment programme including pool games, local walks and poolside partner massage and yoga sessions. Bring black and white evening clothes for the Saturday night formal entertainment eve.

author: tammypie1
title: Fantastic Hotel & Very Clean
text: We arrived at the hotel to be given a refreshing drink which was lovely, then we checked in which was quick and easy and the porter took out luggage to our room, when we got in our room we noticed that we had been given 2 twin beds as a couple who booked a double was not very happy with this why have twin beds anyway its a couple hotel ?? so we went for a drink while we waited about an hour for a room with a double mattress to be cleaned. once we got in our room it was lovely & very clean and great view, we had the car park side which had the best limited sea views. the food in this hotel is the best food for all inclusive we have had so much choice you never get bored as its different food every day. George is fantastic but i must say when hes not there its a totally different atmosphere, even at breakfast nobody said good morning or even shown us to a table, this only happened a couple of times as George is always there. the staff here are very hard working and very polite some more than others the guy who worked on the pool bar in the evening cant remember his name but i know he was a life guard during the day for his other job.he was the best he looked after us very well. the pool area is lovely clean, drink service to your sun beds, the staff brought melon & smoothies around in the mornings which is a lovely gesture.the Jacuzzi was great had salt water in. the reception staff were very nice especially Anna who was very helpfull. this hotel is a long walk to protaras it is 4 kilometers which would take at least an hour to get too, you would need to get this bus which are every 20 mins or take a taxi which will cost you 10 euro each way. so i would say this hotel is perfect for those who just want to chill and not really do much else,entertainment in the hotel which was great every night, not very lively if you want this sort of holiday you will need to go to Protaras or Ayia Napa 20 euro from hotel each way or the bus which takes an hour. the spa prices we very expensive so we didn't bother.the cleaners do a fantastic job and were every polite. in all rooms you get free wi-fi 50/50 if it works, air-con, free safe & a fridge. hair dryer & coffee making facilities. could have just done with an iron & board added........ we loved this hotel its the best we have stayed in and wished we had booked 2 weeks.. we loved every thing just a few bits that i picked up which would have made the place even better. We will defiantly be back soon...

author: 975dianea
title: This is the truth
text: There are two small negatives. One it is a little too remote (but good cheap bus service) the other is there is NO beach. Other than that the hotel is great. Food, drinks, entertainment and staff are amongst the best I have had. I travel twice a year to all different places and this is definitely in my top five. The staff could not do enough for you. Always pleasant, polite and helpful. There are lots of little extras that make this hotel stand out from the others. All managers are on hand (not hidden in there office) to help and advise. I was in room 242 and had a problem with my air conditioning and it was sorted within 15 minutes. Rooms have everything you want plus big comfortable beds. Food quality was very good and always something different. I was there for two weeks and there was no repetition. Entertainment again did not see the same act other than the resident duo who were very good. Josh and Emma from Thomson were lovely, friendly, fun and very helpful. Thank you Atlantica group for making my holiday one too remember. I can't wait to book with the group again. They certainly know what customer care means.

author: MrsOwen25
title: Amazing honeymoon!
text: Me and my husband recently just got married on the 28th June this year in Britain, and spent a week away at the Atlantica Sea Breeze for our honeymoon, there's only one word to describe this place and it is amazing! From the moment we got here to the moment we left the hotel we were made to feel welcome, from the reception staff to the bartenders at the Neptune pool bar and others, we couldn't hardly fault a thing. We stayed in room 434 the best room of the hotel in my eyes, it was a junior deluxe suite and my goodness it was deluxe! We had our very own jacuzzi hot tub on wooden decking on our balcony, and sun loungers to relax on with table and chairs, our bed was massive! And on arrival we had a bottle of Brut waiting for us in the room, was definitely worth the upgrade for our honeymoon! It had a Stunning view of the pool and sea was absolutely breath taking from our room. Il start with the pool bar where we spent literally every day there! 'Olga' a fantastic bar lady always happy and smiling so lovely to be greeted with such a wonderful personality everyday!, we sat there everyday so she would make us laugh! There was also a lovely gentlemen who helped Olga on a daily basis at the pool bar, we didn't get his name but it started with a 'P' but me and my husband renamed him 'Ted' as he reminded us of a teddy (He did mention he was short and couldn't reach for some things). He was also fantastic bartender they both work fantastically together! thank you for making us have such a great time down the pool everyday. The hotel itself is spotless, the cleaners do an amazing job our room everyday was just fantastic. By the hotel there is a little beach where you can sunbathe or just go for a walk it is truly beautiful you must go down there for a walk! I must add that the sand is not very fine as most beaches are, but it is a beautiful place to sit and watch the world go by. My husband was extremely happy as they had Amstrel and carlsberg beer on tap so that made his holiday! The only thing in our opinion that was a bit of a down side to everything was the food, the options for choice weren't that great, we did find we eat the same thing most nights as there was nothing to our taste, but we're not everyone so you may find it absolutely amazing! But that's just our opinion, the drink selection though was great you couldn't ask for a better selection of cocktails to soft drinks and beers. Overall we had an amazing break, didn't want to come home to rainy Britain after such a stunning week away, so thank you to all the staff at Atlantica Sea Breeze for making our honeymoon extremely special to us. Mr & Mrs Owen

author: Rosskempongreece
title: Atlantica Sea Breeze
text: We stayed here recently, had a wonderful time, the food was great plenty to choose from (buffet style) and once a week Italian a la carte. Which was excellent. There was a Greek one but had to pay for that 25% off the price for all inclusive guests. Pool was good size, grass areas clean. Bad point was people reserving beds and then not turning up till late afternoon..... Same old with most places!! Rooms good size, our view was on the car park. We could of upgraded but not at the price we were quoted. But the sea view rooms looked like they had a great view!!!! Staff as most people say we're excellent. Had a poor check in experience. But guess teething issues. My only real gripe was the dress code change while we were there, from a strict long trouser only to shorts and flip flops. Very poor decision in my opinion. But overall a great place to stay.

author: ellesig2014
title: B E A U T I F U L !
text: We have just returned from a weeks stay at Atlantica Sea Breeze. We travelled over to Cyprus to attend a wedding which was completely beautiful. We have stayed at this hotel in 2012 and had an amazing holiday and recommended it to the wedding couple so the pressure was on for it to be good! It did not let us down and a better place could not have been picked. The hotel welcomed the wedding couple with a lovely message, fruit basket and a bottle of fizz which was such a nice touch! The staff were so professional and friendly, and the food was good. The drinks are really nice, cocktails are included in the all inclusive (except for a few really exotic ones) and the hotel is spotlessly clean at all times. The hotel has recently been renovated and the rooms are really modern, classy and are cleaned to an excellent standard daily. We were on the 4th floor at the end and even though we only booked a limited sea view, stepping out onto the balcony you were faced with the bluest, cleanest sea I have ever seen. The view was stunning! The pool is just perfect, swim up bar, plenty of sunbeds and parasols which can be used right next to the sea. The rocky bay next door is very pretty although it is rocky but having fig tree a 10 minute bus ride away means that this is not even an issue. The service in the restaurant is first class and George always greets guests with a big smile. The bus service to protarus and Ayia Napa is cheap and regular so if you want a bit of different entertainment in the evenings it is easily obtainable. The only thing I could say is they could do with bigger signs on the glass doors in the bar as I saw a few people walk straight into them (Hope your nose is ok now Neil!) Overall, I love this hotel as much as I did when it was Kouzalis. I was so happy to see many of the same staff working there after the Thompson take over as they work tirelessly. We are a young couple and always thought we wouldnt return to the same place on holiday but to be honest, it would be difficult to beat this hotel and this part of Cyprus so I am sure we will be back! Thank You to Atlantica Sea Breeze for making our cousins wedding/holiday/honeymoon so nice. It couldnt have been any more perfect and Thank You for making our holiday so lovely!

author: MargaretI889
title: Lovely Hotel
text: We have just returned from a two week stay at this hotel. Very peaceful location on the outskirts of Pernera with bus stops going both ways outside the hotel entrance. Our room was 210 overlooking the car park & out to sea. Sun on our balcony from first thing in the morning. Rooms were very good with tea/coffee making facilities & safe free of charge. Bed was huge & very comfy with a choice of pillows. All the staff were very friendly, bar staff were very efficient & George & his staff in the restaurant were very attentive. Good choice of food at all meals but it would be nice to see the cold meat & cheese served at breakfast also out at lunch time so you could make a sandwich. Sun beds in the garden area were well spaced out giving couples some privacy. Emma did the daytime activities but did not try to push people into joining in. Evening entertainment was relaxing. Started giving out bowls of nuts in the evening in the bar but it would be good to have a choice of crisps or nuts. Weekly Managers cocktail hour where the Managers of the various areas of the hotel & the General Manager came round to speak to guests, very nice touch. The only negative comments that we have was the towel exchange for the poolside. You need to go to the indoor spa between 10-12 to get clean towels. It means that if you are settled on your sun bed early you have to get up to go & get clean towels. A better idea would be a towel exchange at the poolside between 9-12. Overall an excellent relaxing holiday & would definitely return.

author: plan7
title: not to other atlantica standards
text: we stayed here 1-8th June and as the saying first impressions etc, we arrived late at the hotel around 1230am Monday,we were eventually told when we asked that there were some sandwiches on the end of reception for us. When we looked there was a ham and cheese sandwich in cling film and nothing to drink. Luckily the Hotel rep arrived and in fairness persuaded the staff to reopen the bar and get us one drink. No great welcome there. Being quite tired after a delay some warmth would have been appreciated. I have to compare this welcome to others at Atlantica hotels and it was very below standard. It is also highlighted by a review of the Atlantica Imperial in Rhodes where they were late but a buffet had been kept for them. Believe me the Imperial leaves the Sea Breeze standing. The matter was raised with management who could not see anything wrong with their offerings. If I may suggest, try the Imperial!! When we got to our room it was clean and spacious but when I went to shower next morning there was a large area of rust in the bath around the plug area. Having gone to reception and viewed alternative rooms there was the same problem in those as well. My previous reviews of hotels will show I am not a habitual moaner but this is not 4 star standard to me, I was also told at reception that "housekeeping know all about the baths" Apart from George the clear away service in the restaurant was quite slow and was bar service. Carrying just one plate and leaving your partners or carrying just 2 drinks at a time is also not the fastest way to serve. I also do not find it professional to see reception staff on their mobiles texting whilst working. I know that management will reply to this review but I repeat, try the Imperial to see how standards should be. There are pluses at the hotel, previous complaints about cold food have been rectified and we had no problems, food was tasty and hot. Even when there was a Mexican theme and my wife couldn't really eat anything, George immediately agreed that she could have a bacon sandwich made for her and brought it himself to us. lastly , and this is nothing to do with the Hotel itself, the beach bar next door was in full swing on the weekend we left and the music was really blaring out with heavy bass all day Sat and Sun. I fully accept this is not the fault of the hotel it does though spoil the relaxation somewhat.

author: 614cherylh
title: Fab Honeymoon
text: We have been back from our Honeymoon at the Atlantic Sea Breeze for a little over a week and would like to send our sincere thanks to everyone there for making our two week escape one to remember. From the moment we arrived at the hotel (very late Sunday evening) we were greeted by lovely staff, a trait that continued throughout our two week stay. All of the staff at the hotel are a credit to you, with a special mention to the bar and restaurant staff who took the time to take an interest in the guests and were always pleased to help. Not forgetting the service ladies who kept our room clean and tidy when required and stocked up with the needed facilities It was evident that the hotel has had a recent refurbishments which looks amazingly well presented, our room was lovely (429) and the view from the balcony was beautiful, waking up each morning and looking out across the sea is a sight we miss. Although there were a few negative comments from other quests about the food provided in the hotel prior to our arrival, my husband and I did not experience any of this. The food was lovely at breakfast, lunch, dinner and the snacks in between.. We never experienced cold food and did not feel it was repetitive, there was ample choice from cold salads, warm specialities to carvery meat, there was no reason for anyone to be unhappy in our view. The choice of puddings was limited, however after a meal or two out of the hotel we soon realised that desserts in Cyprus are not really offered and many places provided fresh fruit, just like in the hotel. Food at the Italian Al La Carte restaurant was lovely, we really couldn’t fault it. Our only suggestion would be to provide late arrivals with a small food choice, as we arrived at the hotel late (11.30pm apx.) we were very hungry but there were no facilities for us to eat in the hotel. Maybe a sandwich, etc would suffice. The entertainment team provided was fantastic, offering different activities throughout the day, but not forced upon you.. we participated in cocktail making, French boules, and other such activities. Altered themed live music was available each night and the duo Red Lips were highly entertaining and enthusiastic. On the hotel location, it is based a little outside of Protaras, but it really was perfect for us. A 10 minute bus ride and we were on the beautiful beaches of Fig Tree Bay. We are already talking about our next visit. Thanks again. Mr and Mrs Hawkins.

author: r0yal1871
title: a real gem in the med.
text: a totally relaxing break for my wife and i, the staff could not be more helpful and make it their goal to make your stay as pleasant as possible. food was really good, a different menu every day. the best full english breakfast outside the uk, evenings had a carvery with a different meat every night plus a range of dishes which changed every night,there is a dress code for guys which is long trousers must be worn at evening dinner, where you are welcomed by the lovely and eagle eyed restuarant manager who makes sure his staff are looking after you, i have been to a lot of all inc. hotels and often the meal time has a distinct school meal feel to it, but this doesn't you feel as if you are in a restuarant having a romantic meal with your other. which brings me to the italian and greek restuarants they are special and they certainly made us feel special, you get one visit free during your stay, however you have to pay for your wine which isn't made clear to you until you order your bottle, but the staff in the italian really are attentive and take care to give you a special experience. the beach bar was great the staff there were always up for a joke and a bit of fun. the entertainments manager was always trying to include everyone with different activities which was nice. around the pool during the day, never had a problem with sunbeds and with there being no kids it had a real relaxed and friendly atmosphere, where you can swim up and have a drink from the bar while sat in the pool. our room was 238 over looking the pool and sea, the cleaning staff kept it immaculately all week, we had an expresso and this was topped up when we used our capsules. the bed was so comfy and was around eight feet wide ( not 2 singles pushed together). always had hot water what ever time of day. to work the tv you need to put a 10 euro deposit for the remote control then the channels are limited to bbc world news one music channel and a couple of foreign channels, which is probably the biggest critisism i can find with this hotel ( but then if you are going on holiday as a couple then tv in a room as lovely as this is the last thing you should have on your mind). the location of the hotel is more than walking distance from protarus, but buses run every 20 minutes at 1.5 euros each and they are very reliable, ( tip for the evening is while you wait at the bus stop often a taxi will pull up and tout your business only pay 2 euros per head as they have to travel back to protarus empty otherwise so they would rather take you even they are covering their costs so to speak. return we had for 10 euros, don't pay any more. There are 2 supermarkets/gift shops, and a bar within metres of the complex and a small kebab grill. i have stayed in many 5 stars in egypt and this matches them in many ways, and i for one will be going back........

author: S1CEN
title: Very Pleasant Holiday
text: The hotel is a Thomson Couples Hotel which obviously meant there were no children running around you. It is advertised as Protaras however although the resort can be walked to it would take you about 45 mins to reach the centre however, buses run regularly until the early hours and cost very little. There is a charge of €1.5 for a single journey per adult which seems to be anywhere however, you can purchase a daily bus ticket to use on multiple journeys for €5 each. Our room was on the fourth floor and although we could see the sea from our room we overlooked apartment blocks therefore, we cannot say that we had a good view from our balcony. Other than that our room was spacious, clean, plenty of wardrobe space, king size bed and good bathroom therefore, nothing unpleasant to say. The dining was excellent with ample choice for everyone in the buffet style restaurant. I only heard 1 person moan about the food and in the words of his wife "he is a fussy s*d". One night a week you are allowed to book the Italian restaurant for which both my wife and I found excellent again with a good choice of food on the menu. All the hotel staff were very friendly and went out of their way to attend to your needs with waitress/waiter service at the reception bar and the poolside Neptune bar. There is a resident duo who perform about five evenings a week and guest appearance by other acts. Emma the Thomson events co-ordinator is the most pleasant, talented and joyful person that you could wish to meet and also a trained singer. The young lady gave a couple of performances whilst we were there including operatic which was fantastic. Emma also joined the resident duo on one occasion belting out popular hits which again was excellent. The only downside of our stay would be that we like to take a walk following dinner but it would be a fair walk to see anything worthwhile other than taking a bus for which I have already mentioned. Being a couples hotel everyone was friendly and you got to know many other couples over the week befriending quite a few which made the stay even more pleasant. We would like to express our thanks for their company if they read this review. Regards Ken & Lyn

author: DizzyDucky11
title: Great property poor food
text: Visited the Atlantica in May, booked with Thompson as have stayed at the Atlantica Golden Beach and Atlantica Imperial previously so thought that we knew what to expect. Having previously enjoyed staying at this hotel chain I was left somewhat disappointed with this one.I'll keep it simple: Pro's - the hotel has recently been renovated by Atlantica so the decor was fresh and new throughout, it was also really modern. Grounds were small but reasonable. The rooms were very nice, a good size coffee and tea making facilities with fresh clean linen. The staff were also really friendly and polite and helpful they did make sure that guests felt welcome. Con's - The main problem for us was the food. We felt that it was not the same quality as the other Atlantica properties and was always tepid/cold. The presentation was poor and there was limited choice in food items. Lunch was also limited. We spoke to the rep about this, who then reported it to hotel management. We can only hope this is because we were some of the first guests to stay post renovation and that things will drastically improve. For a 4 star hotel rating the food was not of this standard which was a shame and really did let things down. The specialty Italian restaurant however was good. Also it is worth noting that the hotel is fairly remote with a couple of shops/eating establishments nearby, Protaras is a fair ride away, our personal preference would be to have slightly more going on - not the hotels fault perhaps Thompson didn't convey this very well. Bus services to get around are really brill and easy to use!

author: _kruti_thakrar
title: Nice stay
text: We stayed here 3 nights - the stay was pretty good. Renee is very informative and helpful about the island whether it is places to eat, the best beaches or day trips. We stayed two nights in a a twin room and our final night in a queen double. The twin was quite basic to be honest and a little expensive for what it is. The queen was a gorgeous room. I found breakfast here disappointing mostly due to the staff. The young lady attending was always behind the counter on her phone rather than pro actively attending to guests. We had to ask for a table to be set for us on day one prompting her to clear the others which were left in a mess. There was very little cheese meat or egg left so we had to ask her to bring more of this which took quite a while. She wasn't watching what was there and guests had to go and tell her. On the second day there were so many flies inside the nets for the food we didn't eat much - again I think if she had been paying more attention this wouldn't have happened as the nets hadn't been placed back on the food properly. On the third day again we asked for a table to be set and there were no eggs that day at all! The upside to breakfast was the homemade cake available everyday. In addition the afternoon tea provided was a nice touch and the staff were much friendlier and more efficient. We were also a little disappointed that the hotel staff lost our chocolates which we asked them to move from one room to the other. These things happen so it's not a big deal - but we did get a rather curt 'well we moved them' response when we initially posed the question. Overall a good stay but could be improved .

author: spfreewalkingtour
title: The best of Ilha Grande is here!!
text: This is the best place I've ever stayed! It's a lovely Pousada, with beautiful chalets, in the middle of the green garden of tropical forest.! You wake up listening to the birds, having a delicious breakfast with the nature! All the details were thought here: place to wear your closes, balcony with hammock, big and clean bathroom (awesome shower), very comfortable bed, room with tv, dvd, fridge, air conditioner, a lot of places to put your closes, ventilator - everything well decorated and designed. Even the shampoo in you bathroom is great.! In your room you find "the book", a very useful and helpful manual with all the information you need do know about the island: where to go, what to do, restaurants, bars, attractions, everything!! Your experience will be different after you get some tips from the book! This hotel offers also a "tea of the afternoon", with delicious cakes, cookies, coffee and tea - perfect after a tiring day discovering the island, and makes possible to have a light lunch (like a picnic during your trekking, or appetizers during your boat tour), and then you can spend more to have a special dinner! You also find a great tv room, with a huge smart tv, with Netflix and YouTube, and 700 options of DVD movies - a very good option to entertain the rainy days. All the staff are very very professional and kind, being helpful and polite all the time, making you feel like home.! Rennie is the best host ever!! Talk to her, many stories to tell, great advices and very good energy! Every single penny is worth here! And your experience in Ilha Grande will be much better and more fun if you stay here! I definitely recommend this place!!

author: xena7051
title: Excellence......nothing is too much for Rennie
text: Hi In July we traveled through Brazil and stayed 3 nights at Ilha Grande an Island approx 3 hours south of Rio. We loved the island!!!... a major factor of our love of Ilha Grande was due to staying at Aratinga Inn. Rennie and her excellent team went out of there way to make our stay enjoyable. (she has a great sense of humour as well) The the rooms were spotless and tastefully decorated, then there is the additional extras you receive ....e.g. .the afternoon teas were a real bonus...including amazing cakes etc which we enjoyed coming back later in the afternoon.. after exploring the Island during the day...the breakfasts contained an excellent range of fruits, yogurt, cereals, cooked eggs, rolls...all of the highest quality. Key points around Aratinga Inn....is the friendly service, quality of fixtures ...e.g. the property has a great garden setting...which provides a laid back friendly relax feeling..... Rennie gave us great advise on the Island e.g. where to eat, places to go to...an assisted us with loaning anything we didn't have.....e.g. for beaches and treks The main reason we chose Aratinga Inn, was due to the feedback on Trip advisor.... trust me you won't be disappointed if you stay there..... it may cost slightly a bit more than other places...but its well worth it....those extras made the overall experience amazing. Aratinga Inn is one of those Gems....that once you stay there, then you will agree with all the raves people have given on Trip Advisor.

author: 675PeterH
title: Disappointment
text: Honestly, we cannot understand why Aratinga Inn is rated that high. We also booked it because it was highly recommended on tripadvisor but already booking it we experienced the first disappointment. I asked for a chalet via e-mail since I was not able to book it online. They promptly offered one but when I confirmed the booking the same day I was told that they can no longer offer it as it was booked online by someone else in the meantime. When we arrived at Aratinga Inn, the staff received us very friendly with a cool cotton towel smelling like lemon. Rennie (the owner) and Thomas were incredibly friendly and helpful whenever we got to talk to them. They provided us with beachtowels, bodyboards and a lot of information about what to do, where to eat etc. The breakfast buffet is very good. Unfortunately the "Deluxe Double" room ("Orquidea") was a complete disappointment to us, not because it was very simple but because it was incredibly small. We were not able to open both of our suitcases at the same time nor storing anything into a closet because there was no such thing. The bathroom was tiny as well, whenever we had a shower it was completely flooded. On the bright side, the air-conditioning and the fan worked very well. The high-speed internet did not work in our room. We found it very overpriced (400 R$ per night) and cannot recommend it. We stayed at 5 different places on our trip through the south of Brasil and Aratinga Inn unfortunately was the the worst compared to all the other with a similar price.

author: Zion_9
title: Couldn't have asked for more Rennie
text: We had a fabulous 3 nights at Aratinga inn. Even when booking this place Rennie was so helpful. Provided details on transfers and how to arrive from Rio by bus and boat. We opted for a transfer as our time in Brazil is short. We were picked up promptly from GIG 09:00 and by 11:30 we were on the island. Rennie was so hospitable once we arrived. Nothing is too much trouble. Our room was great we stayed in the Standard twin as everything else was fully booked! Breakfast was just what the doctor ordered and we loved afternoon tea. Although I think I ate a bit too much cake with cream! All in all this place is great, location is not far from town but far enough to feel out of it. The thing that makes this place what it is, is Rennie. From the papaya cream that was provided as my wife got sunburnt, to the recommendations on what to do with our time on the island. Hats off to you Rennie you are where you are from being such a lovely person. Keep up the good work and if anyone out there is debating where to stay. If your after a knowledgable host, who owns a lovely well kept pousada then look no further. Thanks Rennie Garry & Andrea. PS we made it to Paraty and would highly recommend Eliconial to anyone making the onward trip.

author: jamescE6645RH
title: Fantastic
text: The Host Rennie (pronounced Hennie) is all you need in a host. She's charismatic, knowledgeable and patient. She takes the time to explain to you the basics upon arrival and immediately makes you feel at home and in good hands. We stayed for a week over the xmas period and saw Rennie's determination to make the xmas 'orphans' feel at home. On xmas eve, she relieved her staff so that they could spend time with their families and set about the task of organizing a xmas breakfast, complete with champagne mimosas (with frozen strawberry ice cubes), a special breakfast and individually selected gifts for everyone. Rennie was able to muster up a lot of energy (early in the morning) and made everybody feel the xmas spirit. It was at times like these you got a real sense of her community building skills. Throughout our stay, Rennie keenly took an interest in our daily activities and made sure to give us insider tips. The Inn The Aaratinga Inn is beautiful, modern, clean and comfortable. It's located just off the main thoroughfare, so is close to the resturant and bars, but enjoys peace and tranquility. The Island Ilha Grande is a perfect retreat for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. The village of Abraao has a good balance of bars and restaurants, without it feeling too touristy. As we live in New York and are spoilt when it comes to good food, we where pleasantly surprised to find some of the best filet mignon we have eaten (at Dom Mario's) and a wonderfully crafted kebab (at the Kebab House). Just a short boat ride away, you have Lopes Mendes beach (The New York Times rates it as the 3rd best beach in the world) and a hidden gem next door (San Antonio beach). The people on the island are kind and generous. Unlike a lot of tourist destinations, you rarely feel like you're being taken advantage of and crime appears to be non-existent. The Host, The Inn and The Island all combine to create (what we felt was) the perfect holiday.

author: wouters715
title: Great place, great host and great island!
text: We stayed at the Aratinga Inn for three nights in November. We stayed in one of the Frangipani chalets and I can definitely recommend this type of chalet. Upon arrival the host, Rennie, greeted us with a warm welcome. She knows all the good restaurants on the island and knows exactly when and where to go for a day trip. We also really appreciated her focus on the environment. The inn is just amazing! Although located just 5 minutes from central Abraao, it is so quiet and you feel like being in the middle of the rainforest. The chalet was superb, and felt like our little home on the island, including a large bathroom and spacious veranda with hammock. The chalet was VERY clean. The breakfast is very good, with freshly cooked eggs, freshly squeezed juices and a nice selection of bread rolls, fruits and vegetables. Having stayed at the Aratinga Inn I cannot NOT mention the amazing afternoon tea, with coffee, tea and freshly baked cakes. A nice way to relax after a day of hiking and swimming. @Rennie: thank you so much for the amazing stay at your Inn. It takes more than an amazing place and beautiful chalets to make an amazing Inn: an amazing host like you is a crucial ingredient for that!! thanks for that!

author: 589sudips
title: Wonderful honeymoon stay
text: Aratinga Inn was the perfect place to spend a few days on Ilha Grande. We booked the honeymoon package, which includes a bottle of champagne, a bunch of chocolates (more than we could ever eat actually) and a lovely boat ride to Lopes Mendes beach. From the moment we arrived Rennie made sure we had an amazing and stress-free time. We didn't have to open TripAdvisor even once to figure out what to do or where to eat because Rennie had fantastic recommendations for what to do during the day and where to eat. She welcomed us like family and we could tell she takes great pride in her work and in her hotel. Thanks Rennie! We stayed in a chalet, which consists of a pretty small bedroom, a nice bathroom, and a private patio with a hammock and a table with some chairs. In the room we also had a tv and DVD player and took advantage of Aratinga's big library of DVDs to watch movies a couple of evenings. The bathroom was very tidy, although the water tended to fluctuate between being very hot and very cold. There were also a couple of issues with the power going out for a few minutes during the evening, but the hotel's backup generator saved the day. The only other thing that's worth noting is the food - the breakfast and afternoon tea were on point!! Great variety of eggs, fruit, granola, cake, juices, etc. for breakfast and although the tea time had a smaller selection, the food was always great. It was awesome coming home after a long day exploring the island to some snacks, juice, and coffee waiting for you at the hotel. The timing for afternoon tea was ideal especially since we were there during the winter and coincided nicely with sundown, when we wanted to be back at the hotel anyway. Overall we had an amazing time and really enjoyed our time at Aratinga Inn - recommend to anyone saying on the island.

author: snic09
title: A fantastic stay at a fantastic inn on a fantastic island
text: My visit to Ilha Grande was made truly special by staying at this wonderful pousada. Rennie, the Australian innkeeper, is a charming hostess who is passionate about the island and full of excellent tips. She speaks Portuguese and is more than willing to arrange boat trips or whatever else her guests need. She helped me plan a couple of beautiful hikes that are some of the best I have ever done. And she was equally attentive to all of her guests' questions, spending time with everyone to make sure they got the most out of their visit. I have stayed at many inns and B&Bs, and with her enthusiasm, warmth and local knowledge, Rennie is one of the most outstanding innkeepers I've every run across. The pousada itself is in a beautiful jungle setting, just slightly out of town (but no more than 5 minutes walk to anywhere in Abraão). I had a "deluxe suite," which was very small - just large enough for a double bed, small refrigerator and small chest of drawers, but no closet or even room for a chair, and with a tiny bathroom. I was traveling by myself, so I didn't mind the size at all, but most couples would probably find the room too small. On the plus side, the bed was very comfortable, the bed linens and towels of high quality, the room and bathroom were both spotlessly clean and kept that way by the staff, the shower was nice and hot, the morning light through the yellow glass windows was delightful, and there was a nice glimpse of the sea from the veranda. The breakfast was wonderful, with a hot egg dish, assortment of cereals, homemade yogurt, good coffee and freshly made juices. The fruit salad perfumed with passionfruit was impossible to stop eating. Afternoon tea was wonderful to come "home" to after a long day of hiking, with more coffee and fresh juices, as well as a slice or two of cake - different every day, but the guava was the best. In all, I highly recommend this inn, but before you book, I suggest that you communicate with Rennie to make sure the room will be large enough for your needs. The chalets are of course bigger than the "suites" and I suspect they are more suitable for a couple, but I did not see how big they are.

author: Bas_8
title: Fantastic host!
text: Rennie has been an excellent host right from the start. The information sent before was extensive and really handy. She arranged our transport from the airport in Rio de Janeiro and back to the city with a private driver, Paolo, for a decent price. Everything was perfectly organized and all went very smoothly. We should have followed her advice and just get a porter at the harbour to help you with the luggage. We just took the suitcases ourselves up to Aratinga, not realizing that there aren't any paved roads on the island and that it is a pretty steep climb at the end. Well, a good exercise after all. The setting of Aratinga is beautiful and we stayed in the two new chalets, which are nicely furnished, have a big bathroom and shower, very comfy big bed and a terrace with a hammock. There is a nice breakfast in the morning with fresh juices, homemade yoghurt, fruit, bread etc. and lovely high tea in the afternoon with freshly baked cakes. A nice moment to get together with other guests and exchange information. Rennie is doing a fantastic job informing guests of things to do on the island. She also knows the best places to eat and we actually got free caipirinhas wherever we went and told them that we were staying at Aratinga Inn. Her staff is very nice and always smiling and trying to help. Even though it rained a lot when we were there, we just had an excellent time on Ilha Grande thanks to Aratinga Inn and Rennie. We will definitely return.

author: ds0406a
title: Perfect for Rest and Relaxation
text: Our experience at Aratinga Inn was amazing! The pousada itself makes you feel like you're in a jungle paradise with flowers and lush vegetation growing every where. The island of Ilha Grande has a lot to do between hiking, snorkeling, soaking up the sun on the beach. The pousada is pretty centrally located with only a few minutes walk to the water taxi area and not far from the trails. Rennie, the owner of the pousada was great - she was always happy to help and make suggestions on what to do around the island, where to eat, what vendors to use, etc. based on what you were looking for. Rennie (Hennie as she is affectionately known by locals) and her staff were friendly and aimed to please. In fact, we had some trouble with a local vendor who had been very pushy in getting us to secure our return trip to Rio from Ilha Grande at a time that was less than convenient for us. My husband was ill the night before and we tried to call and cancel/reschedule our departure but they didn't answer the phone and then said they couldn't give us a refund because we hadn't given them advance notice. Rennie offered to reimburse us for our ticket and to take it up with the company directly. She is very caring and goes out of her way to help and seems well-respected on the island. Just mention her name at Dom Marios and you'll probably get a free drink or two! We stayed in the Hibiscus suite which is very small, but cozy. The room was very clean and we were welcomed to a guidebook of recommendations prepared by the pousada and chocolates on the bed. They have thought of everything and have sarongs, tennis shoes, bug spray, sunscreen, dvds, you name it, all of which you can use for no extra charge. Its these special touches which really made all the difference. We would gladly stay again.

author: guros494
title: Amazing Aratinga
text: Rennie welcomed us in the best way possible and gave us all the information we could possibly need for our stay. The pousada offers a great breakfast (when we asked for naturelle yoghurt they provided us with that the very next day) and a very delightful afternoon tea with brazilian pastries where we got to know many of the other guests staying at the pousada. The pousada has the greatest location entwined by jungle. The bungalows fit very well into the natural environment and Rennie does what she can not to interfere and leave traces in the nature. Since the island a bit isolated, the staff does many measures to minimize waste through reusing, recycling and reducing. All their products (soap, shampoo, detergent etc.) has been selected with care. they have really thought of everything! The cleanliness in the rooms are great, which is a must because of the humidity on the island. The pousada offers to dry your clothes for a small amount of money (which was crucial as I was sick parts of our stay). They also offer to lend you hair dryer, hiking shoes, towels, sarongs… Again; this pousada has really though of everything! As I mentioned, I was sick parts of our stay, and during that time I was so grateful I chose to stay at Aratinga. Rennie made sure I was comfortable and showed a genuine care for me. I really appreciated that. In all, we could not be more happy with our stay in Ilha Grande. Aratinga offered the best hospitality and Rennies knowledge about the island helped us to get around and decide where to go, where to eat and just as important - where not to. We have already recommended this place to many of our friends and we will continue to do so. Hopefully, we will also return to this magical island one day! Many hugs from Erlend and Guro from Norway to Rennie and the rest of the staff!

author: paztickler
title: Homely, Relaxing beautiful Stay - thank you!
text: Here are reasons you should stay here: 1. Rennie (the host) is wonderful and her staff are lovely - everyone says it on here for a reason and it is true! She's a special person and will go above and beyond to make YOU feel comfortable and safe. She made soup for us all on a rainy day and even upgraded us to make us feel more comfortable. So kind and thoughtful. 2. The nature around the poussada is stunning, lush and green. Hummingbirds fly by next to breakfast, birds surround the area. It is just wonderful. 3. The food is excellent for breakfast and the afternoon tea is another extra touch that really helps after those long nature trails. 4. Again, this goes back to point 1, but Rennie pays attention to details and this is so appreciated when you stay. It's the little things, like heating up our food from the night before so we could have left over Moqueca, or the ultra fast WIFI that she made extra efforts to install. 5. This is not just another INN like in Thailand, you feel like you are treated in a 5 star hotel, but you are in the jungle! In summary, I cannot recommend this place enough. Book in advance otherwise there will be no rooms left!

author: U3175FNrachels
title: So welcoming
text: If I'd known how great the Aratinga Inn was, and how much there is to do on Ilha Grande, I would have happily spent longer than our 4 nights. From the moment you arrive, the owner, Rennie (Australian) makes you feel like a welcome family friend. She is very keen to make sure that you don't waste any time or money doing anything less than the best available on the island. The options are well documented and she is delighted to discuss anything in more detail. When you get back from a hike or a trip, she is genuinely keen to know what you think and to have feedback to pass on to future visitors. The Inn is quite small - about 8 rooms . I wouldn't describe it as luxurious; the footprint of the property isn't that big, but the beds were super comfortable, the sheets high quality, Breakfast was copious and fresh, the afternoon cakes delicious and the rooms spotless. The garden areas are imaginatively planted and humming birds are encouraged next to the breakfast room with feeders. I think that it is worth the little extra for the new bungalows which have a bit more space than the old rooms, roomy terraces with a hammock and lovely new bathrooms. The staff were all smiling, friendly and helpful and those that didn't speak English responded happily to my sign language! My teenagers were delighted with the extensive selection of DVDs to borrow. And the Wifi worked and was free. Don't miss a massage - really excellent. A great place to stay in the paradise that is Ilha Grande. Excellent value for money.

author: sandiegouw
title: Private, romantic, first class service
text: We booked Aratinga because of the fantastic reviews. It did not disappoint. We arrived and immediately noticed the quaint, private charm of the premises. The lobby (open to everyone) had magazines, hammocks, movies, TV, open bathrooms for showering (in addition to the room and helpful after check-out if you have the day to kill hanging at the beach). The premises were very well kept, with great trails around very nice gardens/flowers. We stayed in the Hibiscus suite which was very romantic, had a private table outside with hammock. I've heard that consistent, high pressured running water can be spotty on the island but had no experience with this here. The breakfast and 3pm tea was unbelievable. Not to mention, the smoothies/juice that rivaled anything I've had anywhere travelling. The absolute highlight though was Rennie, the owner and housekeeper of Aratinga. Her charm was immediate and she provided us with all logistics getting from Rio to the Inn (which was unbelievably helpful). And, she gave us our entire itinerary four our two day/two night stay which made the trip even more spectacular. It's like having your own travel agent on the island. Rennie knows everyone on the island so, regardless of what you want to do, she help set it up. Oh, and not sure if she always offered this but our stay included a free schooner ride to Lopes Mendes beach (one of the top beaches in the world according to Trip Advisor). Overall, would highly recommend Aratinga. First rate in every regard.

author: 310karlh
title: A memorable stay on Ilha Grande
text: Aratinga Inn has an almost other worldly quality about it: the little chalets are arranged around stone footpaths and dense but manicured foliage. Our chalet was kitted out with a hammock on our our front porch. When we got to our room, we found delicious bonbons! Also, our host Rennie had an excellent and wide selection of dvds to choose from which was just great especially for winding down before going to bed. The breakfast had a good selection of breads, meats and cheeses, a fresh fruit salad and a hot dish. As you sip your coffee in the half-open air breakfast room, you can watch various birds (including beautiful hummingbirds) drink from several birdfeeders hung just outside. Really lovely. Two things set this place apart from other inns: a booklet given to us which contained VALUABLE tips about what to do, where to eat, etc. on the island, AND the afternoon tea with delicious homemade cakes. The booklet was writien by Rennie with the intention of giving her guests independence to craft their best stay...and it certainly did it for us! The cakes - WOW! Definitely watch out for the coconut cake - we are still talking about it. Finally, the staff at this place were just brilliant. Always helpful! We would not hesitate coming back to Aratinga Inn.

author: avodoc
title: Paradise with 3rd-world plumbing
text: I'm not going to repeat in detail all the much-deserved accolades that have already been given to this place. What really separates this place from almost any other place I've ever stayed is its owner, Rennie. Her advice, attentiveness, kindness and even her vast DVD collection all made a huge difference to the kind of experience we had on Ilha Grande. Of course she has also made many wonderful aesthetic choices in the creation of this little tropical paradise. We spent five nights in the Hibiscus Chalet, which is small but very cozy. We had 3 days of glorious weather and 2 days of rain. We didn't let the rain slow us down, after all, it is a rain forest. The bed was comfortable, the room clean and the bathroom ... well this is where we were reminded that we were on an island off the coast of Brazil. Although modern looking and very clean, the bathroom plumbing does not allow any paper AT ALL to be thrown in the toilet. In fairness, this was the second Pousada in which we stayed, that had with this rule. Secondly the electric shower head never really got much above 80 degrees F if that, even after following the instruction to restrict the water flow. Frankly I got used to both of these "inconveniences" and just figured that's a small price to pay for being in such a beautiful and exotic location. They are building 3 new chalet's that will have gas water heaters. You might want to check to see if they are available when you make a reservation. In any case, I would recommend you book early, the word is out about what a great place this is.

author: MikkelBoesen
title: Aratinga Inn
text: We stayed in Aratinga inn during feb 2013. Aratinga inn was chosen on the numbers of good reviews. We were on the island for 8 days and enjoyed every day of it. You will be treated as if you were a long lost family member by Rennie and feel right at home. The welcome you will get, with open arms, are unforgettable. When you are settled in you will find all the information you need to plan tours and where to eat while you are on the island, cause Rennie have made a guide book of her own experience on the island. The help you can get from Rennie is fantastic it goes from discussions regarding where to go and what to see on Ilha Grande to assisting or actually arrange our bus tickets to Sao Paulo. The place it self is beautiful, the houses and the bungalows are placed around a garden. The common area where you eat breakfast and afternoon tea is half open so you can sit and look out into the garden and watch hummingbirds fly around and feed from the flowers. The rooms are air conditioned and there is a laundry service at the Artinga Inn. As a bonus we go the company of Luci-Lu one of Rennies two cats. It was a vacation we are still trying to get over, cox we have such an urge to go back right away. Aratinga Inn is more then just a Inn, it is Rennies place and that is just what lift it from really good to super excellent. So we have only very, very good things to say about this paradise on the paradise island Ilha Grande. Thanks Rennie and crew for a fantastic vacation.

author: banglocelt
title: Loved it, fantastic place to stay on the amazing Ilha Grande
text: The Aratinga Inn is at a lovely location on Ilha Grande whereby one goes from the beach through the town centre and slightly up a hill. We, an Irish couple on our honeymoon in Brazil, thought it would be the last place we'd find a friendly Australian woman, Rennie, running a beautiful guest house! Rennie has a vast knowledge of the island, is enthusiastic and was always able to help us out with any information/travelling items we needed to ensure our stay was as pleasant as possible.
