The room was very clean, the bed was comfortable and plenty of room to spread out. The downside is the wall AC unit is in the bedroom and since AZ temps have not only been hot but humid, it didn't do such a great job cooling the sitting area. There is a ceiling fan which helped, but not much especially when the temps and humidity are kicking in! i like having a microwave and fridge. Lots of cable channels if you are into channel surfing. The breakfast is good- egg choices and breakfast meats, cereal, oatmeal, waffles and Cinnabons. Coffee was so-so. It was too hot for me to run out and get coffee so I just dealt. Kids all over the buffet like its Disneyland - parents, it's not Disneyland. The happy hour while good in concept was pretty weak, The complimentary beer/wine is nice but all they had for both week nights was chips, salsa, cheese and pretzels. I have been at other holiday inns where they had mini hotdogs, mini pizzas, or even having sour cream would have been a treat. The pool area is small, but I enjoyed it none the less. Hot tub, waterfalls in the pool and lot of seating and umbrellas if you want shade. Towels are cheap and thin so don't be surprised if you will be using 4 or 5 of them! Other upsides are plenty of parking, computer and printer for use, cookies at 7:30pm and close to stores like Albertsons, 99 cents only, and CVS. You can take the shuttle to Old Town and experience the sites. I would stay here again - I might opt out of the suite next time.

author: disruptives
title: Perfect Affordable Hotel - Nice area - Very Kid Friendly - Lots of Freebies
text: This place is amazing. Great stay. We got a room for about $83 out the door on a Friday. They have a great free breakfast and even a free happy hour (on certain days they said). The pool was nice. I have a 2-3 year old who don't like to swim much but there was a long step that allowed them to feel safe, they usually only swim in baby pools. The room was very clean. Our room had a separate closed of living room and two tvs. I thought that was awesome and i didn't expect that. It was nice because there was also a pull out bed in the couch in the living room. The internet is also free. Make sure you become a IGB member for points. There is a very convenient shuttle that picked up my mom from the airport (15 min away) so I didn't' have to go pick her up. The staff was very pleasant and nice. I don't usually do reviews unless I'm blown away, and I am blown away on how great this hotel is run. You would love it. Oh and the Lo Lo's restaurant next store is awesome. The fried chicken and waffles are delicious, my first time eating the combo. I wish I had one of those in Tucson! Will come back again for this short trip up here.

author: Y1795PWamandal
title: Great hotel minus a few minor annoyances
text: This hotel is in a pretty great spot, not in a super busy locale but close enough to walk (or bike to Old Town). Also a very short drive to many popular spots in Scottsdale. Staff was super nice and helpful. Common areas were very well kept & clean. Our room - it was just ok. We were in a room right outside the elevator. So of course there was that noise. It was that or a room with queen bed, so we gladly chose the king room and were ok enduring some hallway noise. Little did we know, the hallway noise was nothing compared to the heating/air conditioning unit. It was LOUD. it rattled, it made squawking noises, and every so often it sounded like someone dragging a shovel across pavement. When it kicked on through out the night, it woke us every single time. The only other complaint we had was due to our schedule, we were up and going between 5:30-6:30 am most days of our stay. Unfortunately breakfast is not served till 6:30 am. Most other IHG hotels we've stayed at for business & vacation serve by 6 am. Just a minor annoyance for us.

author: Dixie5
title: Very pleasantly surprised!
text: I booked two rooms at the Holiday Inn Express in Scottsdale for one night before ourselves and another couple flew out of PHX the following morning. I was looking for somewhere close to Old Town Scottsdale, reasonably priced. I had never stayed at a Holiday Inn Express before (mostly being a Marriott girl), but the price was right so I booked this hotel online. Bottom line - we were blown away. The rooms were large, basically suites, with a separate living area that included mini fridge and microwave. The rooms were very clean with comfy (washable) white bedding, which I always appreciate. But wait, there's more! Free happy hour, which included beer, wine and snacks. We took so much advantage of this we almost felt guilty. After happy hour we caught the hotel's free shuttle to Old Town. After dinner (at Franco's Caffee, which I'd highly recommend) we called the free shuttle and a driver came back to pick us up and return us to the hotel. This was a great service and both the drivers were very nice and friendly. The next morning the hotel offered a free breakfast which sadly we had to miss due to our early flight. If you didn't catch it, there were lots of FREE extras offered at this hotel which made the price even more amazing. We calculated that between happy hour, the free shuttles (rather than using Uber) and the breakfast were valued at about $60-$70 per couple. I would absolutely book here again when in the Scottsdale area. I do have to add that I was charged incorrectly on my credit card, but after making a few calls that was all taken care of by the hotel staff with no issues.

author: mpotter13
title: a rainy weekend in phoenix
text: The front desk staff were very friendly upon arrival. Lance even noticed our room choice & changed it out for 2 queen beds b/c he saw we had our daughter with us. I was very grateful he did that. When we got upstairs to our room and saw it was a suite, I realized she could have slept on the couch but it worked out so much better. That was very thoughtful. The room is comfortable. Bed was soft. I like the variations of the pillows. Our AC is a great noise machine. It sounds like wind on the beach, it's so strong. It could be loud and annoying for some, but for us, we were fine with it. The pool area looks quite nice, and I like the balcony from our room. But it's a rainy weekend, so none of that will be utilized. The water pressure (& immediate warmness) was awesome. Breakfast was pretty standard, but tasty enough. They had soft warm cinnamon rolls that were not stale. It got a little crowded for a bit, but everything worked out. There are plenty of restaurants in the immediate area. And it's very close to Phoenix, which is where we will be spending our time while here.

author: FussyVacationers
title: Hotel guests are treated like royalty
text: I stayed at this hotel for five nights while attending the Barrett-Jackson Collector Car Auction. It is well-situated on the edge of Old Town. The drive from the airport took about 15 minutes. The Barrett-Jackson auction was a similar distance from the hotel. The check in was efficient and there were always two or three friendly staff at the counter to answer questions. Customer service was the strongest aspect of this property . The suite was spacious, clean, but a bit dated. There were no noise distractions. My room was equipped with two large TVs and a full bath. As my suite was situated on the ground floor, there was a small sitting area outside. The complimentary wifi and coffee maker worked well. The bed was comfortable. The hotel has a complimentary shuttle that serves the airport and Scottsdale business district. The operator of the shuttle was friendly and helpful. The hotel also offered complimentary beer, wine, and snacks for 90 minutes a day. Breakfasts were also free of charge. The food was excellent.

author: Dm7958
title: Moms 75th Birthday trip
text: My sister and I took mom someplace warm to party for 5 days. My daughter lives in Scottsdale but we wanted to stay somewhere close to Old Town. This was the perfect location. Well within walking distance but the hotel will shuttle you anywhere within 3 miles. We felt "at home" for 5 days. The coffee was always available and it was good. Nice variety of half n hlaf and flavored creamers. The breakfast was decent. Lots of fresh food choices. The beds were very comfortable. The pool and hot tub were nice. The 2 queen suite was perfect for 3 of us because the extra sitting toom gave us the space we needed to mingle. The wash room outside of the bathroom was unique and appreciated since someone was always fixing their hair or checking their makeup. The staff at the front desk were amazing!!! Thank you. Hope you are finished cleaning up moms feathers from her boa!! It was fun Suggestion to hotel - the french doors between the room serve no purpose. They are clear glass and do not keep out light. The air flow vent above them allow noise through. You can put light blocking materials on the glass or hang curtains.

author: dickda8023
title: Pre tour accommodations
text: We stayed for two nights one on our own and one as part of a tour package. When we arrived at Phoenix Airport, we collected our luggage and called the hotel for a shuttle ride. Our driver arrived shortly after we called. He was friendly, and sociable and we had a pleasant 15-20 minute ride to the hotel. The cost for the shuttle was $10 per person.The check-in process was quick and efficient. We had a suite. The bedroom had 2 large beds, plenty of storage space and a TV. The sitting room had a couch, coffee pot, microwave, Keurig coffee maker, desk and more storage including another large closet. French doors separated the rooms. The toilet/shower-tub and wash sink facilities were near the entrance on the sitting room side. Everything was very neat and clean. The other amenities included a hair dryer, iron and ironing board and free, reliable WiFi. The only thing missing was a room safe. Although the hotel offered access to safe deposit boxes near the check in desk, I find that inconvenient. We did not use the fitness facility but we did use the nicely designed and landscaped pool. In conclusion, the staff was very friendly and helpful. You could buy bottled beer, snacks, etc. from the "mini-store" next to the reception desk and, the hot breakfast buffet was pretty good and included in the room price. I would definitely stay there again.

author: P7993AUdavidd
title: One of the nicest HIX properties I've seen
text: We stayed one night at this hotel while attending an official Elks function in Scottsdale. I must say this may be the best Holiday Inn Express I've seen. The staff stands out as the reason I would stay again. Very friendly and helpful. It is a huge property, five floors. We didn't use the pool so I can't comment there. The breakfast was what is to be expected at a hotel in this class. I didn't care for the turkey sausage. Maybe it was overcooked because it was dry and tough. Everything else was acceptable though. I really liked the fact that the hotel shuttle would take you wherever you wanted to go withing a 7 mile radius. This was a definite plus. The location is not to be beaten - right on the edge of the Old Scottsdale tourist area. If I have to give a negative comment, it is that the room had the smell of a lower class of hotel room. I don't know it it is the cleaning supplies they use or what, but it seems that the rooms in any hotel lower than a Hilton or Sheraton have an unpleasant smell.

author: JackW27
title: Staying here is a MUST
text: What an experience staying at this property. I hope I get the names right here of the front desk attendants. It all started with Dante. He was very accommodating in calling me when the room was available for the early check-in. When I checked-in Shelby assisted me and was polite, kind, and very professional in pointing out all the amenities of the property. I was placed in room 228, and I couldn’t have been happier. This was only a one night stay but the next time I stay here I’ll be sure to make it a longer stay if this room is available. The room was spacious, and spacious doesn’t seem to describe it fully. I was not expecting a suite of this size at a Holiday Express. I have stayed at 5 star properties in several states and I have to say honestly, this suite surpassed them all. The bed room was quiet and large with a door that if it was to get noise you’d be able to close yourself in; the kitchen – not kitchenette – has an updated refrigerator, microwave, toaster, Keurig coffee maker, (a one cup machine but still it was nice). Down the hall was a large bathroom with a walk-in shower and rain drop shower head. The living room was comfortable with a 36” flat screen. The balcony that has 4 chairs and a large table makes it possible to enjoy the outdoors. Had it not been summer-time in Arizona we would have spent more time out there without a doubt. To close this review out, if you are coming to Scottsdale Arizona, and need a sweet suite, and if suite 228 is available – get booked, you will not regret your decision. To the staff, thank you for a job well done and you will see us again in the “near” future.

author: socntytiger
title: Wonderful Hotel at a Great Price
text: We stayed here two nights in April and had a great stay. The room was very spacious. It included a sitting area with a desk and chair, full size sofa, sitting chair, TV, Fridge, and Microwave. This room alone was very large. The other room was the bedroom with a king bed. It was large enough for a bedroom. The air conditioner/heater was in this room and it worked great. Not to loud and you could adjust the temperature and the fan speed. The vanity was outside the bathroom which freed up the shower when my wife was getting ready at the vanity. The shower had plenty of water pressure and hot water. There was plenty of lighting in all rooms. The hotel had plenty of lighted parking. The breakfast was the typical Holiday Inn breakfast, eggs, sausage, muffins, pancakes, cereal, etc. In the evening there was a managers reception where they served nachos, beer, and wine. There was coffee in the lobby 24/7. The pool area was large with plenty of lounge chairs and tables. At $149 for a king suite this was a steal. I suggest you try Organo's pizza about two blocks away. We went there and it was very good and the staff was great too. You also are very close to Old Town Scottsdale which is a nice way to spend a couple of hours.

author: 305claym
title: Not enough bang for the $$$
text: We recently rented two rooms for one night for my daughter's 13th birthday party. She loved it, me not so much. The facility and amenities are nice-plus -- newish, stylish, well-kept rooms and grounds, excellent pool (saline, I believe) with a mini-waterfall for the kids, terrific breakfast selections and eating area. Here are a few things that left a bad taste in my mouth after spending $700 at a Holiday Inn Express: Number 1) I had to spend $700 at a Holiday Inn Express. Sheesh! Okay, I didn't have to, but the nearby resorts in the same price range didn't have the room configurations we needed. I suppose that's both a knock against the HIE (steep price point for a mid-range chain) and a checkmark in the hotel's positive column (more accommodating room plans than nearby resorts). Number 2) Service was inconsistent and depended on which employee I spoke with at any given time. The local guys I dealt with when I paid for the room in person told me one thing re: special requests. A guy at national HIE told me the local guys were wrong. The woman I spoke to at HIE Scottsdale the morning of check-in told me everybody else was mistaken. Everything worked out in the end, but when you're planning a 13th birthday party, you want things to go right, and peace of mind is a plus. 3) The free manager's happy hour is a nice touch, but the night we were there, they were serving Gallo wine out of oversize bottles and Michelob Amber Bock was the closest thing they had to a decent beer. I know I risk coming off as an ungrateful elitist here, but at the prices this place charges per room, you'd think they might spring for something a little bit better. Not even a lot better, just a little. (Credit where it's due: The server was extremely pleasant and helpful.) 4) Parking -- oh, lord. There's an extremely popular LoLo's Chicken and Waffles that shares the same lot, and the situation near the front of the hotel was a buzzing hive of frustrated drivers trying to figure out where they could park without getting towed. 5) Lastly (I promise), we were very clear when we booked the rooms that they were for a 13th bday party, and while we weren't expecting freebies of any sort, an acknowledgement upon check-in -- a card in the room, a greeting from the manager, anything with a personalized touch -- would have made her/our day. Maybe I'm dreaming with No. 5, but that still leaves four other reasons you should shop around before you plunk down your hard-earned $ (excuse me, $$$) here.

author: Last_Girl
title: Great value and great location
text: I've stayed at this location twice for business and for the cost, I'd say that it's a very good value. The location is perfect for my visits - it's close to all of old town Scottsdale and the Fashion Square Mall. The rooms are clean and very large. Both times I've stayed I've had a two room suite. The living room includes a sleeper sofa (not the most comfortable thing in the world, but fine to watch tv on for an hour or two before bed) and a desk with a comfortable chair to work from. They also include a coffee maker, fridge and microwave, which is really nice to have. Wi-if internet access is reliable and available at no additional cost. The beds are always clean and comfortable with plenty of pillows. The first time I stayed on the third and top floor and it was very quiet. This time I was on the second floor, and there was some noise from the guests above me, but nothing persistent or too annoying. I would probably ask for a third floor room tho. Staff is always very friendly and helpful. My one complaint is the showers. The shower curtains don't really prevent water from getting everywhere and there are no fans, so the room steams up quickly. The shower itself looked a little old and stained and could have used a little facelift. Water pressure was good tho! If you are looking for a good value in the Scottsdale area, whether traveling for business or leisure, I would definitely recommend this location.

author: EquityL
title: Friendly accommodating staff
text: 6 of us 2 rooms. 4 adults, 2 kids. A well maintained property with a friendly staff. We had suites which gave us plenty of room. Each room had a fridge, microwave, coffee maker, 2 TV's . Doors between sleeping area and rest of suite. Laundry facility on each floor. Breakfast included which consists of usual Holiday Inn fare. Mgr reception each night and later in the evening, cookies and milk which kids really enjoyed. Pool area is well maintained with some shade from the trees. Plenty of attractions, stores & restaurants in the area. Free WiFi. Security officer on duty during the night. Centrally located. You can't go wrong with this place.

author: Cheryl_Cyr
title: Excellent Choice!
text: My husband and I flew into Phoenix for a conference and we lived in Phx years ago so wanted to stay on the other side of town. This location is perfect. If you are traveling with kids the hotel is about 10 minutes to the Zoo. If you have a college aged kid the hotel is close to Tempe. Shopping is every where. Oreganos Pizza across the street is amazing. As far as the hotel itself. We were greeted as soon as we walked through the door. Check in took all of 5 minutes. The rooms is great, I did not wake up feeling like I needed an allergy pill because of mold. Our room with balcony over looks the pool. The noise level has been very low. We heard kids playing around 2:30 in the afternoon which is no big deal for us. The room is clean, the staff has been amazing. There is always decaf coffee available which is unheard of at most hotels. The parking lot is safe, we have had no trouble at all. Highly recommend this hotel, excellent location, staff, room, service, love it. If there is any con is it because of personal preference in food. I don't care for the folded egg with cheese deal, or biscuits and gravy, or cinnamon rolls, but if you like that sort of thing they have it. There are bananas and apples, and some oatmeal available.

author: BUGI_70
title: What a pleasant stay!
text: Great value for money. Check in/out warm and professional. Complementary fresh water and coffee\tea in the hall. The hotel is quite large with many rooms located on 2 floors. There is a swimming pool and a well organized gym. A shuttle to downtown for guests. Breakfast was included in our rate and despite being a self service and despite plastic cutleries and plates, it was quite good with all the usual breakfast items plus self made pancakes. Breakfast room was perfectly clean and server really polite. Breakfast stops at 9.30 am. Our room was a small suite on the 2nd and last floor, facing the parking lot and it was really silent. We had a small bathroom, a sitting room with a sofa, a desk, a TV and a wardrobe plus fridge and microwave oven. The bedroom was comfortable, with two queen beds, another TV and another wardrobe plus an armchair. Complementary newspaper for guests. No complaints at all. The room and the bathroom were clean. Toiletries included makeup removers and shoe mitt. WiFi was well working. Hotel offers a wide parking lot. Few minutes drive from old Scottsdale and not far from Phoenix.

author: 21MarkA
title: ASU Move In
text: We took our daughter down to ASU to move her into her dorm and we were needing accomodations for ten nights. We have stayed at this hotel before and chose it again because of it's location, ammenities and cleanliness. We have family in Fountain Hills and friends all over the east valley and this made for a perfect location. We usually like to stay in Scottsdale because of its restaurants, shopping, and outdoor activities. For those interested, there is plenty of nightlife nearby within walking distance. We stayed in a suite with two rooms, two queen beds and a sofa sleeper. The room had a refrigerator and microwave, two televisions and a large counter to accommodate food we bought for our extended stay. In addition, a washer and dryer unit close to our room was wonderful. There is a breakfast offered each day with many selections and the cinnamon rolls are a real treat! At night they were offering pancakes which my teenage son especially enjoyed. A very nice pool area in the courtyard helped to cool us off in the 100 plus degree weather we had. The staff was always accommodating at the front desk and the housekeeping staff did an excellent job. Again, we were quite pleased with the cleanliness of the hotel. The hotel was in close enough proximity to ASU to help us easily get our daughter situated in her dorm and visit frequently. Overall, the hotel fit my family's needs perfectly and was an extremely great value for our extended stay.

author: 636traveller
title: Do not book for the middle of june!!!!!
text: Have stayed at this hotel at least 10 times in the last 8 years and it was always enjoyable . HOWEVER stayed at hotel from June 18/19/20. Was not aware when booking online that at this time the Hotel has a boys & girls club staying there. OMG!! What a nightmare!!! The pool was totally taken over by the many, many children & their adult companions. The male adults felt it necessary to drink continually while these children were in the pool from 6:30 am until 10:00 pm. Tried to go to the pool on one occasion and it was not a pleasant experience . No place to sit, no room in the pool, and lewd behavior by some adults! Breakfast bar in the morning was totally out of the question.....couldn't get near it. Laundry facilities were also taken over and impossible to get near! Had some of these guests in the room above us, and they stomped around until 1 or 2 am, and we're away again by 6 am!!! Totally unacceptable! There were so many children in the pool that it had to be closed down & cleaned!!! Please be careful when booking this Hotel in June. I would recommend calling directly to be sure this group is not present!!

author: 134akashr
title: Adequate - but not great
text: I really want to give this property a higher rating but I just can't. Many other reviewers have highlighted the size of the rooms and I have to agree that it is large with a separate seating area. In the room though I failed to locate the safe. We stayed here for 4 nights and on the third night I could not believe that housekeeping had not cleaned our room by 340pm in the afternoon. At that point the kids were tired and relaxing so I just swapped towels. No apologies and no effort to make the room later. The breakfast is average with really no change in the items except for scrambled eggs vs a mini omelette. The eggs seemed quite dry. The coffee and juices were great. I was surprised with the level of waste by the hotel. The hotel uses styrofoam for everything (breakfast and the evening reception) which ends up in the landfill. I am surprised they don't switch to a paper based product that can be recycled. Also it doesn't appear they have any recycling program also, just the standard please hang your towels. We used the shuttle on a few occasions and it was good. The pool and the surrounding area was nice but it can get overcrowded even though it was great for us. The property in general is in good condition and you can get coffee at anytime of the day. Overall though it is adequate and there was really no "wow" moment and that housekeeping incident really put me off.

author: BBcanada123
title: Great stay again!!
text: This hotel has a fantastic location for walking. You can walk old town to restaurants, walk to SF spring training games. The rooms were good. Not great as I do see the age coming in to play but still really good!! The pool area is really nice. It is never too crowded and very clean. They offer a managers reception where we had some very good beer. It was clean, comfortable and the service is very very good. The girls at the front desk have always been super friendly. They let us check in early again.. Very nice when you have travelled all day. Unfortunately IHG points dont let me transfer from airmiles anymore so I may not stay here again after 4 years of a tradition!! This hotel does not seem to come up under Airmiles as some of the other Holiday Inn Expresses do.. I wonder why? Thank you for the great stays in the past. Im hoping IHG and Airmiles offer this property in the future- fingers crossed!!

author: RicoPesto
title: Just Adequate
text: I was looking forward to a morning and afternoon swim as I made a four day reservation here. But I couldn't bear the frigid water. It didn't matter that Scottsdale was in the 80s, the water was so cold I just ended up in the hot tub. Pity,because it's such a nice pool. Our first morning, their coffee makers broke and there was no coffee at the breakfast area. I used the Mr. Coffee in the room but it took about 20 minutes for it to brew. The staff was helpful and friendly and I took advantage of their shuttle, picking me up at the Sonoran Desert Preserve--great perk. (Do not miss the Desert Preserve)! We were on the third floor (303) overlooking the dumpster of the chicken and waffles joint next door and the busy multi-lane Drinkwater and Scottsdale Roads. Lovely. The room was quiet except for the delivery trucks backing up at about 5-7am each morning. By the way, the waffle place sends their sickly sweet odors wafting over the entire Holiday Inn, including the pool which is in a courtyard surrounded by the building. We got used to it after a couple days though. I guess Holiday Inn can't do much about that. As others have said, the breakfast is adequate and includes hot items, ie. scrambled eggs, bacon, biscuits and gravy. We were there for Spring Training baseball and realized that all the hotels capitalize on the demand for rooms in March, but for value (double queen suite), it was barely adequate, especially with the pool heater broken.

author: mhvik
title: Pool heater's on the back burner
text: We chose this hotel for our family based upon the positive family reviews and the fact that the pool was supposed to be heated. We arrived a few days ago to find that it wasn't. Front desk staffers told us the part was ordered and the problem would be fixed the next day. It wasn't. We asked about the pool again the next day (which was 80+ degrees) and they said it would be another day. Somewhat dismissively saying with the warm weather, we might not need a heated pool. (eye-roll here) That might be true mid-day, but after a long day exploring Arizona, the kids wanted to take an evening swim. This morning we asked the front desk again and they said something to the effect that the pool company was giving them the runaround. Unfortunately, this isn't the high level of amenities/service we'd expect from a Holiday Inn Express & Suites. We understand that things break, but it's how you manage your subcontractors (the pool company) and inform your staff how to properly handle those hiccups that are important to a guest's overall experience. Other than the disappointing pool situation, the staff have all been very friendly and courteous. Morning breakfast is on par with what you'd expect. The afternoon Manager's Reception is a nice touch too. Our room (#247) was clean and a pretty good size with 2 queen beds and a pull-out sofa. It's relatively quiet facing the parking lot. The hotel's clean and full of happy SF Giants fans here for Spring Training. I spoke to few of those fans who said they booked the hotel after reading the pool was heated too. Oh well. We're leaving tomorrow for a few days up north and returning Saturday for our family's last night vacation in Arizona. Maybe we'll return to find a heated pool?

author: Cac1234
title: Great Location
text: This hotel is in a great location just a couple blocks from the Old Town area. From there you may take a free trolley or walk to other districts in Scottsdale. The hotel has a shuttle that will take you to locations within 3 miles. They even shuttled us to the lovely Desert Botanical Gardens. For just a few dollars their shuttle picked us up and dropped us off at the airport as well. The hot and cold breakfast had plenty of selections and was convenient. It was well stocked and the staff kept the area very clean. In the afternoon there were complimentary drinks and snacks as well, and in the evening fresh baked cookies and milk. The pool area was very private and nice any time of day. Each day we returned to a spotless room. The entire facility was very clean. We had a problem with our AC unit and the staff found us another room just a couple doors down. They even offered to help us pack and move our things. Now that's service. The queen beds in our second room were much more comfortable than the king size bed we had in the first room. That was the only con. Everyone was very friendly and took pride in their work. We would definitely stay at Holiday Inn Express and Suites Scottsdale Old Town again.

author: mikemK2788ZD
title: Location Is Everything
text: I've stayed here many times. The hotel is located two blocks from Scottsdale Stadium and a few more blocks from Old Town Scottsdale, which makes it perfect for Giants spring training or Arizona Fall baseball. The rooms are true suites, but if you have two beds, the French doors between the bedroom and sitting rooms can't be closed because a bed interferes with a door. The rooms are narrow and somewhat dark. The bathroom is small, with the sink separate immediately across. There is a small refrigerator in the sitting room. Air conditioning has ranged from noisy to quiet, but always efficient. Free breakfast is offered - nothing to write home about - and a complimentary happy hour with beer, cheap wine, and chips and salsa. The staff have always been courteous and helpful. The hotel has a shuttle which will run you short distances in town, and to the airport for a small fee. The place is clean and well maintained. Rates double during March (spring training), but that is standard for the area's hotels. The pool is decent sized, but can get crowded fast in peak times. All in all, a decent place in a great location. If you're not expecting luxury, you wouldn't be disappointed here.

author: purpleladyslippers8
title: Confused by Reviews
text: I booked this hotel based on the awesome reviews it received. However, I was greatly disappointed with this hotel. It definitely was not one of the nicer Holiday Inn Express's I have stayed in. The building seemed quite old with some cosmetic makeovers. Upon entering the room I found the layout odd. As soon as you walked in, the bathroom sink was on the left. As you continued, the room had a plain living area and then a bedroom. The room was pretty dusty but the absolute worst part about my experience was the noise. Unfortunately, I did not fall asleep until 2:30am...the time the people upstairs apparently went to sleep. I was on the bottom floor and the room above me was extremely noisy. Every footstep and movement could be heard and the floor was super creaking. The other significant problem with hotel was the air conditioner. The unit itself spit out cold air however due to the placement of the bed it blocked the air flow. Consequently the room felt stuffy and hot. On the plus side this hotel was semi close to Old Scottsdale. On foot google maps showed it being a 25 min walk. Driving was about 7 minutes. Also, the rate I got was fairly cheap. With the plethora of beautiful hotels in Scottsdale I would not stay here again.

author: MAKT75
title: Perfect vacation
text: We stayed at the Holiday Inn Express Suites Sept 9-12. The rooms and grounds were very clean and fresh. The pool and spa area were great. The best part about our stay was the staff. No matter who we passed, from maintenance, to housekeeping to front desk, we were greeted. Of special note were some of the friendly people at the front desk. Josh, Annie and Chandel were full of advice and knowledgeable about the area. Need some duct tape to repair luggage...no problem. Need additional maps...no problem. Shuttle not available? NO problem, they called "Big Red Ride" for us. The local shuttle service was great. Josh was prompt and friendly. We didn't drive our car downtown at all. The restaurant suggestions were fabulous. The hotel was quiet and a good location.

author: CraigJ835
title: The staff are the key here.
text: I stayed here for business in Sept 14 and was mostly impressed. The hotel was lovely, nothing spectacular but pleasant. It really is the staff that makes this place worth every penny and seem cheap. Firstly even though the hotel advertise ‘Happy Hour’ in the bar etc there is actually no bar at the Hotel so you have to walk to Old Town for a drink (around 10 mins) so beware of that. The hotel itself is very well kept and clean, the cleaners do an amazing job. The check in and reception staff are absolutely the best I have ever had the pleasure to meet, especially Shelby who really couldn't do enough to make your stay excellent. Shelby really deserves special mention and I have e-mailed Holiday Inn personally to let them know of her great work for them. The rooms are lovely, large, welcoming and very nice, I had 2 huge beds, 2 TV’s and a bathroom all to myself which was nice. All the usual things like irons, fridges etc were available. The air con was quite loud through the night but the noise was a far better option than not having it on and absolutely melting... The only negative thing I can possibly say about this hotel was that the breakfast was not nice at all. I just stayed with cereal and fruit as the cooked stuff was truly terrible. There is however a good selection of fruit and enough bread to make toast etc if you want it but anything more substantial and I thoroughly recommend going elsewhere in the mornings ( I actually found a wonderful bagel shop only 5 mins walk away). To sum up. Nice Place, wonderful staff, excellent place generally but could work on the brekkie.

author: MissDebs17
title: Fabulous stay!
text: We recently stayed here for 10 nights and had a fabulous time! We didn't have a car and found it very easy to get around. The shuttle bus collected us from the airport for $10 each and took us around the area within a 3 mile radius for free. This linked into the light rail system so we could get to Phoenix and Tempe. We also used the trolley and the local bus service and a taxi a couple of times! Although it was 105 on our first weekend we managed to fit walking in too! All the staff were wonderful and we felt like part of the family by the time we left! There was plenty of choice at breakfast and we loved taking part in the happy hour. Our room was brilliant with a balcony overlooking the pool. It had a seating area, fridge, microwave and a bedroom. It was great to be able to get the chilled water during the day and coffees/teas whenever we wanted them in the lobby area. We also used the laundry facilities and found it very handy. There is a really good supermarket Albertsons within walking distance to gather supplies. There are lots of restaurants to choose from. So again just a quick Thank You to all the staff who left us with amazing memories and a very happy holiday.

author: LoveOurCanada
title: Amazing gem
text: I spend a great deal of time looking for the best place/best price and found this amazing hotel when looking for a hotel to accommodate our 7 person family before we could check in to our timeshare condo accommodation. We flew in to the Phoenix-Mesa Gateway Airport and drove approx. 20 minutes to Old Town to stay at this hotel. We were very pleased with the location and, during our two day stay, walked to Old Town shops/restaurants in approx. 15 minutes. We spent a lazy afternoon resting by the more-than-ample pool. Rooms were actually mini-suites. We had two queen beds, an arm chair, chest of drawers with a TV and, in an anti-room there was a desk, a sofa bed, a mini fridge, TV, coffee pot - lots of room for our use. Staff were extremely accommodating. Large parking lot. Clean +++ (extremely important to me). A water cooler (with added orange slices) is set up during the hot day time hours. We took part in the Manager's meet and greet - meaning we took in a few alcoholic beverages and some nacho chips with cheese and salsa - free of charge. Free breakfast selection was more than sufficient. Would not hesitate to return and would tell anyone that that this well-priced accommodation is better than higher priced hotels we have stayed in.

author: BBcanada123
title: Great- AS USUAL!!!
text: Let me give a "shout out" to Phylicia at the front desk who provided exceptional service. This hotel is great for spring training and visiting Scottsdale! We walked to Old Town for dinner, walked to spring training. They have a managers reception from 4-7 which consists of beverages and nachos, pretzels. It is a very nice touch. The pool is really nice. The hotel was full and the pool was never crowded. There is shade and sun. The rooms are very clean. I have found the rooms very quiet too, both years we have stayed there. We will be back next year too! I booked with Priority Club/IHG points but IHG took my platnum status away as IHG does not honor transfer points any longer, therefore we did not get an upgrade like last year. With the points, you now have to stay a ridiculous amount of times at their hotels to get to Platnum status. But this Holiday Inns standard room was very nice. I did not miss the upgrade. We did have a balcony before but we just spent more time by the pool instead. I would highly recommend this hotel if you are going to the Scottsdale area. We love it there!!!

author: usdoc1
title: Great stay, But.....
text: The day of arrival was confirmed and upon arrival the clerk welcomed us with a wide grin. I had read about this hotel before I made the reservation. The place was really clean. The rooms are very large and comfortable. Early AM breakfast was a great welcome along with free internet and parking. This hotel is very close to Scottsdale down town and major shopping center. There are numerous restaurants close by. On the negative side, they have a "happy hour" till 7:00 PM. If there is a staff change and the new clerk arrives at her leisure, you will be asked to pay for the drinks and chips -- which happened to us. We did not argue with the desk clerk a minor irritation. Secondly the early AM breakfast is good. Unfortunately there is only one person who is attending to cleaning up the food area and stocking up the food. He seemed to be overwhelmed when the crowd arrives. The cream bottle was empty. The tables needed cleaning up particularly after families with kids who left behind food and sometimes dishes on the table. Hope the management takes note of this and hires more people to take care of these simple chores. Overall I would give a 9/10. If they take care of these minor problems, it would be an outstanding experience.

author: Debj61
title: Super Nice and Very Comfortable
text: I was traveling alone this time and the room I got was wonderful. Upon arriving, I was greeted with smiles and asked to have a room on the 3rd floor which they happily accommodated. Check in was quick and they were always happy to give me directions to anyplace I asked. The staff always seem to be happy, laughing with one another and making the guests feel like they were 'at home'. The room was very clean and each day was all made up before noon. I have stayed at other hotels where I would come back at 5pm only to find the room still not made up. Not the case here. Their housekeeping staff was right on it early. I loved having the hot breakfast each morning and the kitchen staff was always busy cleaning off tables and making sure the food was replenished. Always smiling and saying hello as they worked. The rooms are fabulous as they are suites. Separate room with a sofa and second tv. Nice for those lazy mornings where I wanted to just sit, have some coffee early (before the breakfast room opened) and read my paper while watching local news. Nice to have a fridge and microwave in the room. When staying or 6 nights like I did, it was handy to have that for keeping my water cold and heating up leftover food brought home from a restaurant. Overall this is a great place to stay especially if staying longer than one night. I will be returning with my husband again in the future for a joint vacation and Holiday Day Inn Express Old Town will be the place with no doubt.

author: Slo-Lju
title: Good value, comfort and service
text: This is an all-suite property. It is not the newest, but is well maintained and does not show any serious ageing issues. The check-in clerk was efficient, but with a kind of an attitude at the begining. He then noticed and acknowledged I was a Platinum PC member, after which he became more friendly. All other front desk staff were very professional and friendly as well as staff serving drinks and snacks in the afternoon. I was upgraded to a top-floor pool view double queen suite. The suite awaited me with the A/C on, which is usually not the case in hotels. With temperatures around 110 I really appreciated it. The suite was great, really spacious, comfortable, it even had a small balcony overlooking the pool in the backyard. The suite was clean, but the balcony could use a cleaning. The hotel features "manager's happy hour" in the afternoons during the week, when they serve complimentary snacks, beer and wine. Once they are done with that, they serve cookies and milk. Both of these are a nice touch! Went to use the pool on both of my nights. It is not very large, but was clean and nice as well. Breakfast was the HIE standard, the breakfast room is large, so there are no problems with morning overcrowding. The propery is minutes drive from Scottsdale Oldtown, very conveniently located. If you need a nice place in the area, I highly recommend it.

author: S9238JMpatricial
title: Cookies and Milk!
text: I've been traveling back and forth to Phoenix on a weekly basis for the last month........and I'll continue to do so, for the next few months. I've stayed at the various Holiday Inns (in the area). I keep coming back to this one........ Its kind of becoming my home away from home. The rooms are pretty spacious. Microwave and fridge included! There is a door that closes between the bedrooms and living area. Its kind of nice if you have guests. There are also two TVs in each room. Some of the rooms have balconies - another plus! For the most part, the hotel is pretty quiet. The staff is pretty nice. They always have a smile on their faces when they see you! Breakfast is continental. Standard fare of fresh fruit, yogurt, milk, eggs, cereal, etc. I love the pancake machine and the fresh baked cinnamon rolls. Free drinks for Happy hour with chips & nachos & popcorn. Best of all - Fresh baked cookies at night with milk!!!!

author: Travellingdude2
title: I will stay here next time
text: 1. Strong wifi signal with no interruptions or problems at all ever (which is rare for a hotel) 2. Very friendly staff including front desk, food service, maintenance. 3. Spotless room. 4. Nice pool (which was great on a hot day) 5. Nice breakfast which included eggs- not just the carb loading breakfast of some chains. 6. Quiet 7. Comfortable bed 8. Cookies in the evening 9. Room was a suite with refrigerator and microwave. 10. All that and free beer (or wine) at the reception every evening. Also included were chips, dip and Chilli.

author: VWalk78
title: Friendly, clean, and breakfast too!!
text: My first visit to Scottsdale, Arizona, was for SF Giants Spring Training. I chose this location because it was within walking distance of the park. I was very pleased with everything about our accommodations. Our 2-bed Queen suite was good-sized and very comfortable... loved the cozy beds and pillows! The room setup had glass doors that could easily be closed to separate the bedroom and living-area making an efficient use of space. The room came complete with the amenities that you would expect such as hairdryer, extra towels, toiletries, and coffee-maker. But it also had two flat screen tv's, fridge, microwave, ceiling fan, sitting area, and nice counter area for food prep. The rooms were clean, as were the other areas of the motel. There was a nice pool area complete with hot tub and available towels, a computer area which was easily accessible, and even a small 'store' with food, beverage, and 'oops I forgot' items. The complimentary breakfast provided a lot of food options, both hot and cold. There was a happy hour each evening, which was a fun way to get to know other Giants fans. The staff were all very friendly and helpful, answering our questions about good restaurants or shopping. We used the shuttle service for both the airport and for taking us to one of the other ballparks, and the drivers were all friendly. One evening, we even came back to be greeted by cold milk and cookies waiting in the lobby. What a nice treat! We really had a great time and will definitely stay here again.

author: jayschu
title: Did our homework and found a Gem!
text: While vacationing in Arizona we planned one night in Phoenix to take in a spring training game. Though there were hotels closer to the ballpark we were going to, (there is also a ballpark within walking distance) this hotel seemed to have everything we wanted and was rated very highly onTripadvisor. It was worth the extra drive! The staff was wonderful, very helpful and always smiling! We got into town early and they gave us an early check-in. My husband headed straight to the gym (he's a PE teacher/coach). The gym had everything he needed to get in a good workout and more options than most hotels. I headed straight to the pool. I was very pleasantly surprised to see complimentary ice tea and lemonade available by the exit door to the pool. Along with comfortable lounge chairs, there were pools towels available for use and the pool area was spotless. We really enjoyed the chips/salsa/queso and free soda and drinks at happy hour before leaving for the game. (We were sorry to miss the cookies an milk later in the evening) Our room had everything we needed and more. It was very clean and I especially liked the "firm" and "soft" on the pillowcases. We slept wonderfully; the bed and pillows being very comfortable. Breakfast had a wide variety of cereal, eggs, pancakes, sausage, yogurt, toast, fruit, cinnamon rolls and more. Great stay and definitely our choice for our next visit. Highly recommended! My hope is that the hotel's employees will be taken care of as well on their vacations. Thank you HIE Scottsdale Old Town.

author: CafeLady
title: Excellent Choice in Scottsdale
text: My husband and I only stayed one night, but we had a great experience at this HIE. The landscaping around the property and the outdoor pool area is exceptional. Check in was quick and parking was free with easy access to the rooms. In our room, everything but the bathroom had been updated. The room was very clean. Free WiFi worked well. A separate area outside the bath had an updated sink and granite top.The room had a separate sitting area between the bathroom and bed area that included a flat screen TV, microwave, small fridge, and coffee maker. There was a ceiling fan in the sitting room which seemed odd until I realized the bed area had double glass doors that shut off the bedroom heating/cooling unit.We didn't need to use the fan, but it is probably needed if the bedroom is closed off and someone is sleeping on the sofa bed. Our king bed was very comfortable and that area had it's own flat screen television. Cable channels and in room movies were both available. The fitness center had new equipment and plenty of room for several people to work out at once. Fresh water and towels were laid out. Two large flat panel televisions were available. The lobby is spacious and inviting. Coffee and tea are available all day and iced tea dispensers are set up by the glass doors to the pool area. The pool area was very pretty, clean, and had plenty of chairs and tables. The buffet breakfast was good and included all the usual hot and cold beverages, cereals, breads, some fresh fruit (bananas, apples), eggs, and bacon. There was plenty of seating and a large flat screen television. The in-room checkout was not working, but checkout at the desk was quick and efficient.

author: upstatetraveler_10
title: Not impressed
text: My family and I have stayed at a lot of Holiday Inn Express hotels over the years and have always found them to be newer properties in great condition with consistent standards. This one was a disappointment. First of all, this is not a newer property and was not up to the standards we expected. We stayed in a 2-bed queen suite. The room appeared somewhat run-down. When I tried to open the window to let in some fresh air, it only opened 6 inches and the screen was falling off the window. The interior part of the suite, where the microwave, mini-fridge, sofa bed, sink, and bathroom are located was very stuffy. Despite a ceiling fan, the only ventilation comes from the unit on the far wall at the opposite end of the suite, and it only reached the first room, where the beds are located. The sofa bed was extremely lumpy and in terrible condition...could not be slept on, even by my son who is not picky and had spent two nights that week very happily on a sofa bed in another hotel. The blanket (a Vellux-type blanket) which was given us for the sofa bed had holes in it, was obviously very old, and had a stiff, course texture. One of the glass doors which separate the two rooms of the suite could not be closed without moving one of the beds. The bathroom and kitchen area were clean, but not the carpet...there was debris under the beds and furniture. The AAA rate price we paid in advance was higher than the price they were advertising online while we were there. I questioned this and was told that the first price which pops up online is usually a lower, nonrefundable price, so that's why we were charged more. Looking at the website again now it doesn't look like that's the case...I think we overpaid. I brought up all these concerns to the manager and no effort was made to compensate us for the difficulties. Would definitely not return here.

author: psahaye
title: Bad attitudes a big let down
text: I prefer Holiday Inns as I am a Platinum Elite Member of their loyalty program and for the some basic standards that I can expect at all their hotels.I travelled to Arizona with my wife for the fisrts time and Scootsdale was our first and last stop. We stayed at this hotel for two nights and then one night later in the same week. As Platinum Elite member, the welcome package was nice but the room upgrade was not even mentioned. Upon enquiry, I was told that the room I had was an upgrade from a poolside suite to a poolside suite with patio which meant nothing in December weather. I also noticed that all poolside suites had patios or balconies. The bathrooms were so small that there was just enough room for one person to stand next to the shower and the toilet seat. Upon my return stay, I was not even greeted as a Platinum Elite member and again not given any upgrade. The room was not ready at the time of check in at 2.30 pm and when I protested, the girl at the front desk showed attitude and told me that rooms are gauranteed for 4 pm only even though she knew about my Platinum status by then. I did get the room by 2.50 pm and again it was the same as I booked with no upgrade. I was told that the better ones were all sold out. Now, I am not the one to suffer fools. I aksed her if I will get one if I paid more and she said no as those are sold out. I then told her that I have the website open and two such rooms are available online. She put me on hold and after a long pause, the Manager came on line and asked me what is it that was bothering me. To cut the long story short, I was upgraded to an accessible room though a regular one was still available online and the entire excercise left a bad taste in my mouth. In spite of its good location next to Old Town, Scottsdale, I shall never return to this property again. Now I am seriously worried about the Priority Club Rewards programme and the varying standards of its implementation and monitoring.

author: HollienSophie
title: Our stay in Scottsdale
text: This hotel is one of the best hotels we have ever stayed in. We stayed for 7 nights in total in Sept/Oct. To be honest, we didn't want to leave. All the staff are lovely and so helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and they made us feel very welcome. Our room was EXCELLENT! Loved it. 2 huge beds, 2 TV's, a fridge and microwave. Small shop in hotel foyer area was very handy, ESP when ran out of beer and wine! Pool was excellent, with a joined hot tub. Loved happy 2 hrs at 5pm and all breakfasts good. We will plan to return to Scottsdale, maybe live there, who knows! We would definitely stay here again. Felt like home everyone was so nice. Can't fault anything, only the fact we had to come home! :-) you will not o wrong staying at this hotel.

author: mapleleaf_trvlr
title: Excellent, friendly service
text: We stayed 3 nights on an incredibly hot weekend in June. All the staff provided efficient service with a genuine smile.... front desk, breakfast room, housekeeping. We booked a king suite and found a fantastic rate direct on the hotel website. The room was very hot when we entered and the sitting room hadn't cooled off until the following morning. The wifi worked without any problems and we were in a corner room, furthest from the elevator. Breakfast was the usual Holiday Inn Express fare.... but, they had biscuits and gravy and an automatic pancake maker. I hadn't seen these options at other hotels before. We didn't use the pool as we were out and about all day. The hotel offered happy hour drinks at around 5.... free draught beer and wine! Milk and cookies were offered in the evening. We didn't take advantage of the shuttle. This location is perfect for taking in Scottsdale. We'll definitely stay here again.

author: denverbuffs
title: Great hotel for spring training and family
text: I have been pleasantly surprised at this hotel! I tend to stay in higher end chains so was a littl hesitant about this hotel, but it has exceeded expectations. GREAT location to get to Giants spring training stadium and a 10 min walk to historic old town Scottsdale. So even if you aren't doing baseball, still tons of other close by amenities. Pool small, but nice and plenty of deck space and chairs. No full service restaurant, but free breakfast more than just continental. Pancakes, biscuits and gravy etc. then a complimentary happy hour with nachos, chex mix, beer and wine. Very nice. Plus cookies and milk later. We were here with our two young children and they loved it. Older kids might want a cooler pool but this was great for us. We stayed in a king luxury suite. HUGE room with full fridge and microwave. Big bathroom too. Service good as well. Overall for a family get together for spring training especially I would stay again. If just for a vacation of sun and pool, might pick another spot.

author: maznblu4ever
title: Great hotel, reasonable price
text: We have stayed at this hotel probably a dozen times in the past three years - my husband probably more like three dozen times as he's up there almost monthly for work. We almost always have a superb experience. The staff is friendly (and some of them have been around a long time, which adds to the experience, they remember the repeat-visitors), the facility is clean, and the special extras they do for their customers are out of this world. Happy hour involves snacks and beer, wine, or pop (free). They have a movie theater-style popcorn maker, available at least during happy hour and I think beyond as well. Cookies are put out in the evenings, with milk, and lemonade, iced tea, and coffee are available most of the day (coffee 24 hours, I think). The breakfast is typical HIE fare, which is pretty decent - hot items, good variety of cereal, yogurt, etc. They've done some renovations - the room ones can be inconvenient. Namely, they took out the bar sink in the suite living area and moved the coffee maker to that counter. Our room this past weekend had an electrical outlet there, but last month the room in which my husband stayed did not have one, he was cranky about having to find somewhere else to put the coffee maker (and there's nowhere else particularly convenient). The breakfast area downstairs has made more seating available, which I guess they needed, but it was at some expense of comfort, now it feels quite crowded. In the past we've seen annoyances like the hot and cold pipes were connected backwards to the sink and it took about a day to figure that out. Sometimes the room keys randomly stop working, so you have to get them reissued (although that has been better lately). At the end of the day, though, you get a heck of a bang for your buck staying here. The pool area is a wonderful, clean area with lounge chairs for getting some sun. The beds are comfortable, TV's are HD, internet connection is a good one, and the hotel is in a good location. I've stayed there the night before a plane trip and it's an easy shot to the airport, not to mention close to downtown Scottsdale, Tempe, etc. etc. I would recommend this hotel to anyone in a heartbeat, and it is our hotel of choice when staying in Phoenix!

author: 236barbf
title: Very Nice Hotel, Wonderful Staff
text: My husband and I needed a place to stay near the Pheonix airport prior to leaving the Arizona area. After reading reviews in Trip Advisor, we decided to choose this particular Holiday Inn Express in Scottsdale. We were extremely pleased that we did. The hotel was exceptionally clean, and the lobby was bright and cheerful. Our room was quite comfortable and quiet. (I asked to be put on the highest floor in my reservation, and they were kind enough to honor my request. Highest floor is only 3rd floor by the way!). The breakfast that comes with the room was more than adequate. They actually had an automatic pancake machine that would give you two hot, fresh pancakes in about 45 seconds. Other offerings included scrambled eggs, breakfast sausage patties, bagels, cold cereal, yogurt, and of course, coffee, tea, and juices. For us, though, I believe that the helpful staff members made this hotel stand out from others we have been to. The person who checked us in was more than happy to answer our questions about the local restaurants and provide a map and directions to at least 3 or 4 of them. We did not feel like we were intruding on his time or he was too busy to help us. The breakfast attendant was always available and refilling things on a regular basis; his attentiveness was very much appreciated considering the number of people being served. If we travel back into this area again, we would definitely choose to stay at this Holiday Inn Express.

author: want2bnAZ
title: Great Value - Great Stay
text: As a Hotel General Manager myself in the Orlando market, I can say this property is very well run. The rooms are larger than a typical hotel room, so they worked out well for our family of four. It was very clean and the staff was very outgoing. Everyone seemed to enjoy coming to work. They obviously not only have a great housekeeping staff, but a strong maintenance staff that does a great job with the Preventive Maintenance of the property, everything was in very good condition. Other perks, where the breakfast in the morning. Simple overall, but what I would expect for a select service complimentary hot breakfast. The gentleman that worked this area did a great job of keeping the area tidy and all items well stocked. We also came down and enjoyed a complimentary beer, the kids had soda and chips. If that wasn't enough, they also serve fresh baked cookies in the lobby in the evenings, complete with milk. My kids loved this and looked forward to getting back to the hotel in time to enjoy a cookie and a glass of milk. One individual, that seemed to work every night of our stay was especially helpful (I failed to get his name.) He helped my wife with a charger for her laptop, since she forgot hers at home. He offered several options on things to do in Scottsdale and local places to find a good meal at. At the end of the day, I would stay again and also suggest it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable place to stay in Scottsdale. With all the complimentary perks and strong staff, I do not know how the place remains profitable at the price points they offer and still maintain the property so well, so book your reservation and enjoy your stay. I don't think you will be disappointed.

author: psychcal
title: Pretty typical HI Express: great service, good location, comfy rooms
text: My two kids and I stayed here for two nights at the end of February as part of our first trip to spring training (Go Giants!). When we arrived at the airport we called the hotel and they promptly sent our a free shuttle bus - our driver (Ricky?) was extremely friendly and professional, as was all of the staff we encountered for the rest of our stay (including the housekeeping staff, btw). I don't know Scottsdale well, but I thought the hotel was in a great location - a 10 minute walk to Scottsdale Stadium, a 3 minute drive to Old Town Scottsdale and lots of restaurants/bars, and a 5 minute drive to the big mall. Overall, it was what we typically experience when we stay at this type of hotel. I know that other reviews have complained about the noise but this was not a problem for us at all (note that we were on the top (3rd) floor). We didn't hear a door slam or people talking in the hallway. The room (2 queen bed suite + a twin sofabed) was clean and modern, with one flat screen TV and one CRT TV, a small refrig, microwave, and coffee maker. My 17-year old daughter did say she didn't sleep particularly well on the sofabed. The hotel has a decent sized outdoor pool and jacuzzi, and a small exercise room with about 3-4 machines. The hotel has a complimentary breakfast - others have complained about the size of the breakfast room but I thought it was plenty big, with inside seating in two rooms for about 35-40 people. The breakfast itself is what you normally get at HI Express (cereal, yogurt, bacon, pancakes, etc.). In the afternoon they provided popcorn, nacho fixings, beer and wine. In the evening they had fresh-baked chocolate chip cookies and milk (yum!). I must say that I hesitated to take this room because of some of the previous reviews and almost paid an additional $125 a night to stay at the Gainey. But I'm glad I stayed here. It was the typical HI Express experience: nothing magical or breathtaking but a comfortable place to sleep at night and eat breakfast in the morning before heading out for your activities. Let's put it this way - my kids and I have stayed at a lot of different suite-type places and they never said a word about this one being any different from the others.

author: danzimbo
title: Great hotel - but can be noisy
text: We stayed here at the end of our week long visit to AZ and had booked a jacuzzi suite to top it off. Check in was great - a goodie-bag with a few snacks for being a P.C. member was a nice touch, along with the popcorn machine. We were allocated a great room on the 3 rd floor but we discovered (luckily we checked so early) that the sofa did not fold out - despite having booked 2 Adults 1 child. Initially front desk said that it was a fold-out, but soon called back to apologise as it wasn't. He asked if we minded changing rooms and apologised profusely - asking us not to 'trash' the room we were in in the meantime! New room keys were brought up for a 2nd floor suite. The new room was as nice as the first and we were soon 'at home' there. The jacuzzi bath was great but took a while to fill. The sofa bed was unfortunately SO uncomfortable it was impossible to sleep in it - the mattress springs were palpable without pressure - my daughter ended up bunking with us. Also, the residents upstairs were noisy and you could hear their party going on in the jacuzzi well into the early hours. The hum and vibration of jacuzzi's in nearby rooms might be annoying to some. Breakfast was ok - well catered, but small for the number of rooms. The late check out was easily arranged. I would stay here again if on the 3rd floor - the spacious suites are a big draw for us.

author: lwspilates
title: nice hotel-great value-excellent service
text: We stayed at this hotel for 7 days and got a great weekly rate by calling the hotel directly. The staff was very helpful and upgraded our room to a balcony style room at no charge. Our room was spacious, with two televisions (one was flat screen and one was old-style). The refrigerator and microwave and sink worked fine for our needs. We loved the breakfast (eggs, bacon, awesome cinnamon rolls, coffee, juice) and it kept us full until a late lunch. The pool was nice! The workout room was average, but at least it was there. I brought my road bike and it was a short ride to an amazing golf greenbelt where I rode for miles each day! We loved the Manager's Reception each night at 5 p.m. My 13 year old boy would load up on nachos, cheese and sprite! It's nice that they also provide coffee, tea and lemonade all day long in the lobby. I think it was the extras that sets this place above others at this price range. The free shuttle picked up my husband at the airport and that was helpful. We did laundry once and it was convenient to our room, just down the hallway. I enjoyed reading the USA Today each weekday morning that was placed outside my door. It is close to some seedy-ish places to the south, however, it is also really close to Old Town Scottsdale, Fashion Square and the nicer resorts up north. It is in between but is very safe. We would always drive 4 miles south to In & Out Burger and the Zoo was only 10 minutes away. We would stay there again!

author: beechmi
title: Great staff, great rooms, and great hotel!
text: I was in Scottsdale on business and decided to stay over the weekend with a friend and chose the Holiday Inn Express. We got a great weekend rate, and were pleasantly surprised at what a great hotel this was! The staff was pleasant and helpful, and offered great suggestions on local restaurants. The rooms were comfortable and equipped with small refrigerators, microwaves, coffee/tea, etc. The hotel provided a light hot breakfast and 'happy hour' with snacks in the afternoon. Both were a treat and much appreciated. The pool was clean, cool, and comfortable although a bit small. There was also a jacuzzi and a small exercise room. All was functional and clean. My only complaint is that the rooms did not have central A/C but individual systems in each room. And in order to keep the room cool throughout the night we needed to keep the system running all night and it made a lot of noise so made sleeping a bit difficult. The hotel also offered a free shuttle to/from the airport as well as local businesses. It was a great 'freebie' and a nice touch. The Holiday Inn Express Scottsdale is by no means fancy or plush, but it is very clean, comfortable and convenient. I recommend it!

author: ohnojackdied
title: Looked Great Until We Found Out the Pool Was Closed
text: This was actually a combined business and leisure trip for us--my husband had meetings and my daughter and I planned to enjoy the pool and maybe some sightseeing. We wanted a nice hotel, in a pleasant setting and (important) and great pool. We looked at several and booked this one based on pictures online. The pool looks beautiful. Imagine our disapointment when we were confronted with a sign at the desk saying the pool would be closed 'for maintenance' for 3 of the 4 days we would be there! This resulted in my daughter and I watching guys fill maybe three cracks in the deck while we sat in the 100 degree heat on our balcony, dying to swim. Or during the heat of the day, we just sat inside. A nearby hotel offered the use of their pool, but it was a bit of a walk, and a not-so-nice indoor pool. Finally on our last day, we could swim. The manager I complained to to just shrugged and said they had planned this 'weeks ago, sorry" No real apology. THEN WHY NOT POST THIS ON YOUR WEBSITE? We could have booked an equally nice hotel with a pool we could use. Lesson--if you book online, phone the hotel and speak to someone personnally and ask specific questions about what's important to you. The pool was important to us, we should have phoned them to ask if it would be open the dates we were there. Otherwise it is a nice hotel, with all suites, pretty nice for a Holiday Inn Express, so I would still recommend.

author: IrishKelly57
title: We will always stay here...
text: I have family and friends in Scottsdale, and since our recent stay here, I will always stay here. We booked a suite, which was a bedroom with two queens and a livnig room with a sofa bed. Since I travel with two teens, this allows them to relax separately (two TVs), or together if I want the bedroom. The A/C was incredibly cold, and the beds were extremely comfortable. The bed linens smelled clean and were good cotton. The shower/toilet room is separate from the sink and mirror, which is perfect for us - the boys can shower while I use the sink and mirror. The shower itself was great - I love their showerheads! The room also had a small fridge and a microwave. The pool was clean and the temperature perfect. The breakfast was filling - yogurts, cereal, eggs, bacon or sausage, and biscuits and gravy. The ONLY complaint I have relates to the biscuits - they are always on the hard side because they stay under the heat lamp. But, the gravy takes care of that. Hot cereals , juices, bagels and muffins abound. The coffee could use a bit more strength, but I like mine very strong, so it's probably fine for most people. Beer and wine in the evenings, but I did not take advantage of this as I was doing most of the driving in the evenings. The business center has two computers and free printing. The staff was incredibly cheery and friendly. As I said, we will always stay at this Holiday Inn Express - it's perfect for us.

author: NEPACouple
title: Very comfortable, clean and in a great location
text: I really researched this hotel prior to making our reservations and I'm happy to say that it was all and all a very comfortable, clean and conveniently located place to stay. The first thing we noticed is how clean it was! We were always seeing housekeeping moving about the floors, they cleaned every day, wiping down furniture and mirrors. We actually saw them go out on the balcony and wipe down the chairs and railing..!!! Impressive. The staff was extremely friendly, the beds were out of this world comfortable, rooms were big, and the continental breakfast although not gourmet, certainly a good start. They had little cheese omlets, bacon or sausage, fresh fruit, muffins, etc. Nice although small heated pool and hot tub. Very clean and always plenty of towels. The location is great, minutes from anything you may want to do from shopping, eating, mountain climbing (try echo canyon), to horse back riding. Also only a 2 hour drive to Sedona, which was beautiful. We had a great time and would stay in this hotel again. Of course it's not 4 star but for the price, it is definately above average. Make sure you have a rental car. After you spend a couple hours shopping in Old Town Scottsdale, you'll want to go off to bigger and better things which you'll need a car for.

author: debbiejo
title: Convenient Scottsdale Location
text: I stayed at this hotel right at the beginning of the Super Bowl week and in the AZ high season, so I feel the room was a little higher than I normally like to pay for a Holiday Inn Express. That being said, the hotel is very close to Old Town and Fashion Square Mall and is easy accessible from the airport. Some of the other reviews stated that their rooms were dirty, but my linens were very fresh and my room was clean. The bed was also very comfortable. I always found the maids to be very pleasant. The staff at the front desk checked me in promptly and were always helpful. There is a nightly wine/beer reception from 5-7 and the breakfast in the morning is more than enough to start your day. There were hot choices of eggs and bacon one day and eggs and sausage the next. There was also cereal, toast, muffins, pastries, yogurt and fruit. The gym is small, but adequate. I did not use the pool during my stay, but did see it. It's not huge, but would be fine for a short stay. There is also a business center with 2 computers. The printer was missing an ink cartridge and did not work during my stay, but the front desk printed my boarding pass for me. The one thing I would recommend is to ask for a room away from the Scottsdale Road side. It is a little noisy with traffic. My experience here was fine for a weekend and I would not hesitate to stay here again.

author: travelinCAfam
title: Book it! You can't go wrong!
text: This is a great place to stay. Clean, quiet and spacious. I've done a bit of traveling and this hotel was clean, modern and very surprising. We had a sisters weekend and family wedding and looked for a place convenient to airport, family and wedding sight (Chandler) Yes, the suite rooms offer so much. We appreciated the seperate sitting room so we didn't have to sit on the beds to talk. The mini kitchen made it possible to eat simple meals and snacks in our room. The beds were comfy and it was nice not to have big, old bedspreads, but clean, white bedding. The towels were big, thick and fluffy. The pool was sparkling clean and the deck had plenty of lounge chairs. The breakfast was better than average. The biscuits were good but the gravy wasn't great. The fresh fruit salad was a nice surprise. We had a little trouble with our key cards...we couldn't get into the pool or back into the hotel when we were finished at the pool, but we got that fixed quickly. Starbucks is a block south and a nice selection of restaurants are a few blocks north.Overall, this a great place to stay and I'd stay here again in a heartbeat. All the positive reviews were right! Book it, you'll be glad you did!

author: katybok
title: Mother's Day Treat
text: My sister, niece and I decided to get away for a couple days on the Mother's Day weekend. I booked this hotel for us because of all the great reviews. What a treat to stay at this hotel. The suite was huge with a french door to separate the sleeping area from the "living area". It was "the" largest suite I have ever seen in a hotel room. It had modern, clean furnishings and the beds were made with fresh white linen and a very comfy mattress. It looked so inviting we wanted to take a nap when we got there. There was a fridge, microwave, coffee maker and 2 tv's, which was nice when you have a child with you who wants to watch the Disney channel. The bathroom was spotless with the sink outside the toilet and shower area. They had a beautiful pool and jacuzzi with a cabana bathroom near the pool with fluffy pool towels. One of the nice touches was freshly made coffee at all times in the lobby. The deluxe continental breakfast was ample, with waffles, french toast, oatmeal, big cinnamon buns, and all kinds of juice, fruit and cereals. Breakfast on Sunday was open until 10 a.m. which is really nice for those of us who like to sleep in. And checkout is 12 noon, which gave us time for taking another dip in the pool. All in all, this has to be the best experience we have had in a hotel. We will be back for sure.

author: kristi_89
title: Highly recommended, couldn't be more pleased
text: We stayed at the Holiday Inn Express while my mom had surgery at a nearby hospital. I was extremely impressed with the service, amenities, and value at this hotel. For a rate of $76/night, it was much more than I expected. The rooms were very spacious and clean, with their new "Fresh" bedding which includes extra pillows (firm and soft) and triple-sheeting (instead of a bedspread that is never cleaned!). The room amenities were excellent -- microwave, coffeemaker, refrigerator. I particularly like the "suite" layout with a separate seating area. Oh, and free high-speed Internet! The breakfast buffet was excellent. Lots of choices. We didn't explore the area much, but the hotel is close to Old Town Scottsdale, Scottsdale Fashion Plaza, and tons of restaurants. Very well-located and easy to get around the area. Mostly, however, I was extremely impressed with the staff. My first day there, I had some time to kill and asked for a shuttle ride to and from the mall (they will shuttle you anywhere within 3 miles). They were also happy to give restaurant recommendations. At one point, we had to ask them to call 911 as my mom wasn't doing well, and they handled it very calmly and professionally, and asked after her every time I came back to the hotel. They extended our original reservation several times with no problems, offered late checkout if needed, and were generally very helpful and flexible. I really appreciated that! All in all, I would highly recommend this hotel.

author: DaveAndBetty
title: Attractive Facility and Location
