text: A well-furnished, attractive suite welcomed us on a four-day visit to Scottsdale in March 2006. Our third-floor suite was laid out nicely and equipped with a microwave oven, refrigerator, computer hookup, and two TVs. The suite had two closet areas and ample drawer space. Bathroom towels were plush. The room was clean, and everything worked as it should. The complimentary breakfast served from 6:30 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. was excellent, especially their famous hot cinnamon rolls! While our suite overlooked a bank across the street, inside suites with a balcony or patio overlooked the nicely landscaped small pool area. However, no inside suites, which had a slightly higher rate, were available when we registered. A couple of negatives: The wall air conditioner close to our king-size bed was noisy and drafty. When the unit was set to "fan only" or turned off, the suite felt stuffy. Also, the vending machines ran out of soft drinks on Sunday and were not replenished until Tuesday. Overall: The location was one of the features that originally attracted us to this hotel. Shops and restaurants in Old Town Scottsdale are just several blocks north on Scottsdale Road. In addition, the room rates were reasonable for the area. We enjoyed our visit.

author: Global16889
title: A Wonderful Surprise
text: My husband and I were very pleasantly surprised about the service and quality of the Holiday Inn Express Hotel and Suites, Scottsdale. I found a wonderful rate for the hotel via the internet. The many services listed is what caught my eye. Plus the photos looked great. We were looking for a hotel for an overnight stay in order to catch our flight the next day. We would be in the area for less than 24 hrs. The hotel provided a shuttle service to and from the airport. There was a wonderful breakfast plus a late afternoon Manager's Reception that inclued wine, beer and snacks. In addition they also provided milk and chocolate chip cookies prior to bedtime. The two room suite was well furnished with a comfortable sofa, coffee table, end tables, round table, chairs, microwave, ref. and a very inviting bed. The staff was very nice and eager to please. The pool and hot tub were clean and the courtyard area was nicely maintained. It was a short but wonderful stay. I wished that we could have stayed longer. The location was great as you could walk to shops and restaurants.

author: mailroom2017
title: Perm a beautiful city full of history and mystery.
text: Perm is a beautiful city full of history and mystery. The Ural hotel is one of the older hotels which has been well modernised with a good quality facelift and very good value for money. The rooms are adequate in size, clean, well serviced, with good views from the front. Double glazed windows reduce the sounds that you would expect being situated centrally. There are Samsung LCD televisions and though they have 50 or so channels they are all in Russian but fairly easy to watch and follow. Plenty of lifts, shops in the foyer and a very good coffee/snack area. The receptionists speak very good English and are so helpful. Sadly the staffing in the breakfast is very poor, but a wide choice of food is available. Outside and around the hotel there are many photographic points such as the Bear statue, ‘the photographer’, the ‘ears’ etc. It is an excellent focal point from which to tour with attractive walks, especially by the river where open air restaurants. Tram rides are easy to understand and lead to many attractions a real treat. They also go through areas of beautiful older housing with intriguing architecture that otherwise you would not see. The hotel is surrounded by many restaurants with a very wide choice of cuisines. Some are excellent, but most are totally un aware of customer satisfaction, advertising one thing when you get something totally different if at all. That’s when you find out their understanding of English as if by magic suddenly disappears.

author: FranForest
title: Dirty, hair in bed, and over priced accommodation
text: We stayed in the motel (a two bedroom apartment) on 2 January. We were thankful that we were only there for one night. We checked in late in the afternoon, dropped everything in it and left to explore the area before sunset. By the time we returned to the apartment, we discovered that the apartment was very disappointing: there were hairs on the bed covers in all beds, the dishes in the kitchen were mostly dirty. The bathroom sink was very dirty. I attach a picture of the small towel i used to wipe clean the bathroom sink (just one small wipe). I also attach a couple of pictures of hairs on my bedcover (i did not have the energy to take pictures of all the hairs we found). It was late in the night and they did not have housekeeping or reception after hours. I had to call the staff on the number listed on the door to get some linen. We had to change all the linen ourselves. Had to clean everything in the kitchen so we can use them, and we had to clean the bathroom (the sink, taps etc). It was the very stressful and uncomfortable night for us, as everything in the apartment was so dirty. The staff at the reception (same person who took my call and came in to find the linen for us) was very friendly and tried his best to help us. I complained to the staff at the reception next morning and also send subsequent emails. I am still waiting for a reply. I would give them a zero rating if there is such choice.

author: davolitribe
title: Pricey for what you get
text: We travelled 10 Days around the South Island and this is one of our least favourite places probably because we did not think it was value for money. It was ok but nothing special for over $300 NZ dollars for a 2 bedroom unit. It was clean (but some wear and tear) but very basic. Hot at night so we asked for some fans. Bed mattress is very low quality. Managed to cook pasta and eat out the front of the unit which was nice. You will be woken in the morning to all the helicopters going to the glacier as it is close to their airport. Disability access was good. We are walking distance to town which is small but has everything you need...... cool cafes and the weather was superb. The sun can really beat down. Supermarket no where near as expensive as I thought it would be. Fox glacier not as good as Franz Jose. Access is much more difficult. Interestingly the summer period is their peak time.

author: evancorn
title: Worst accommodation in New Zealand
text: Stay elsewhere! This was literally the only unpleasant experience we had in an otherwise incredible two weeks in New Zealand. The room was dirty. There was food stuck to the appliances, the counters were dirty and there was thick dust all over the vents. The drinking glasses were dirty. The bed was old and thin. Springs were popping up out of the mattress. We're relatively young and in ok shape and we both woke up in a fair amount of pain that persisted into the afternoon. The views that they claim are "unobstructed" and "stunning" were neither. There was no safe in the room, despite being listed in the amenities. The walls are thin and it was VERY noisy. There's a rooster that crows at 6 o'clock in the morning. A rooster! And on top of all this, the staff was rude and unhelpful. We asked to switch rooms and they refused. We wound up leaving after the first night of a two-night booking and stayed at another hotel in the area. You can do much better for the same, if not less money.

author: paulmE7674AM
title: Relaxing Place to Stay
text: Spent two nights here. Nice, clean, comfortable room. Decent sized bathroom. Quiet location. Nice, small in-room kitchenette. Friendly owners. Nice small patios facing the mountains. Great place to stay, close to town. Go into town, get a to-go pizza, and sit outside with a bottle of wine and enjoy the sunset on the mountains. Only gripe would be the room service. They came into room, and all I can tell they did was flip the sheets. Did not carry out trash, or update anything. Also, guests are responsible for cleaning dishes, which frankly makes me a tad nervous of how clean they may be from previous guests (this may be my USA-centric view as it seems a lawsuit waiting to happen if someone got sick). (Service 2-stars below is for this, and not the service of the owners - they were great!) But don't dwell on the above paragraph. The place was great. Would stay there again. And take their advice to go see the glow worms.

author: ADTravelerUae
title: Not a good option at all......
text: We, a family of four including two grown up children stayed in this motel for one night in 1st week of August 2016 while going to greymouth. I booked the motel seeing positive reviews. But was totally disappointed. it's a bit inside from the main road and locationwise not very convenient. The rooms were spacious and furnishing was ok. But, the linens were dirty and the room was smelly. As we stayed there for the night only, we managed somehow. What we disliked most was our experience next morning. The motel has a check out time of 10:00 am. We were out to see the fox glacier in the early morning and was a bit late (10 min!!!, we reached hotel at 10:10 am) to come back to hotel. Immediately upon arrival we approached the lady in the reception requesting 30 minutes to check out. But, to our surprise we were not only refused rudely but were informed that we'll be charged NZD 20 as we were late by 10 minutes. However, another round of discussion yielded 30 minutes of grace period. Such rude behavoir in hospitality industries now a days is not acceptable as there are many options available to thecustomers. I must say it's not worth the money to stay inthis motel as there are so many nice motels around to choose from.

author: tarynandcraig
title: The worst experience I've ever had in a hotel or motel
text: There are a number of reviews noting this owners bad attitude towards over charging and families. My first mistake was not heeding these because it was a peak time and there was not a lot of accommodation left. We were travelling in a group of three adults and two babies. The day before we were due to arrive we called ahead to make sure that the room would be big enough for all of us. We were told that it would and "surely you can suck it up for one night". After we arrived my husband (English) checked in and everything seemed fine. But when I (African) arrived his attitude changed completely. He informed us that in fact the room was not big enough for us, and that we simply couldn't fit. He started yelling this at us when we told him everything else was fully booked. We didn't want to engage in the argument so he followed us out and yelled in the parking lot that he would be charging us anyway. After he had earlier promised that it would be fine, and then told us we couldn't stay there. So he left a family with two babies in a situation where we very well might have had to sleep in the car. In the end we had to drive for 3 hours to find somewhere with a vacancy. Everything about this owners attitude is horrible and possibly racist. I've never encountered anything quite like this before actually. So stay far, far away.

author: davecarter01
title: Nice room, great view
text: We spent two nights here and were pretty happy with everything overall. Arriving when it was dark, we were greeted by friendly staff and check in was a breeze. We had no idea of what the view would be like from our studio room... until the next morning... and wow, what a view. Great to wake up to... or to take in whilst sitting outside enjoying a drink. Views aside, the room was comfortable and clean. We like our beds to be a bit firmer than this one (it had quite a bit of bounce!) and the water pressure in the shower was really low on the first morning (better on the second morning). Not sure why that was. It certainly wasn't from too many people staying in the motel. A few people have mentioned the heating and whilst the heater in our room wasn't a fast mover, we certainly found it to be very effective. The free wi-fi (which we were able to get by booking direct with the motel) was excellent. One thing - and I'm not sure if it was a result of the paddocks down the road or some type of cleaner being used, but the room smelt a little "equestrian"... It is a good walk from the centre of town and whilst we would've been happy to walk the 10 minutes, the cold nights and mornings meant that for us driving was simply a better option. Easy drive from here to Lake Matheson for more great views.

author: BrissieAnnie
title: Fox Friendly
text: We had a great stay here. Always good to spend a few nights in one place in a clean, comfy apartment. The complex is well kept. The apartment was very clean, owners and staff were friendly and helpful. Our self contained apartment had; a queen bed in the lounge/living room, a four seat dining table, lounge, coffee table, and a well equipped small kitchen, and a roomy combined bathroom toilet - no bath, shower only. Second bedroom had two single beds and a large chest of drawers and was a good size. Each room had lots of glass, including glass sliding doors, which made for a light, airy atmosphere, so was pleasant to be able to see the gardens and the mountains. We found the beds good, and slept well. Car parking is directly outside each apartment; which is helpful for loading and unloading suitcases. All apartments are at ground level. We did minor cooking in the kitchen; did note the kitchen is well equipped if you were going to cook. [There is very limited supermarket / grocery shopping available in Fox Glacier, so if, for example, you have kids might be an idea to stock up on food supplies before reaching Fox Glacier township.) Free wifi worked fine for us. No laundry in the apartment; the onsite laundry, which we used, was spotless and had modern appliances. Think I am remembering correctly it was a couple of dollars per wash. For our tropical bones the wall heater warmed the apartment quickly so we were warm and snuggly .... even at one point getting a bit hot, and turned the heat down. If lucky enough to return to Fox Glacier would stay here again without hesitation.

author: AnneP813
title: Lovely motel, modern, comfortable, incredible views
text: Only stayed one night but can highly recommend it. Its on the quiet side of town, The owner was friendly and helpful. The rooms modern and lovely. Great big windows to enjoy the beautiful view. Lovely garden to sit in. Bed very comfortable. . Lovely quiet motel with stunning views. Owner friendly and rooms spotlessly clean and modern. He gave us good advice on where to eat and told us about the glow worm forest which is a highlight of my trip. If you go to glow worm forest don't spoil it by flashing a torch everywhere. We had someone ahead of us spoiling it with their torch. The stone path is fairly easy to follow without a light and as the owner had said, its like walking in the stars. We had been told by a New Zealander to stay at Fox Glacier instead of Franz Joseph which is very touristy. We couldn't agree more. Enjoyed the drive up to the Fox Glacier too. Windy gravel road with great views

author: foreveronward
title: Freezing night
text: After reading reviews of Sunset Motel we were looking forward to our stay. When we arrived we drove through sleet and some snow. We arrived at 5 p.m. with a reservation. They expected our arrival. I had to use a restroom on arrival and the only one I could use was in our room. I ran into the room and was surprised to see the windows open. The temperature overnight dropped to below freezing. We closed the windows and tried the space heater. The space heater was small and did not begin to warm the room. The floors never warmed up and the indoor temp was in the upper 40's and 50's as indicated on my cell phone. They had electric blankets that we huddled under to keep warm. We mentioned this to person that checked us in and he said that they open up the windows to air the rooms. My husband mentioned it the next morning and wondered why the windows were not closed and the space heater started since we had a reservation. She told us we arrived early, even though we arrived at 5 p.m. We decided to not push it and left. All other hotels we stayed while visiting the south island in the winter had heater units mounted on the ceiling that blew warm air down. They had the heaters on and waiting our arrival. If the owners/managers had showed they cared the rooms were cold or a little concern we would have felt better about our stay.

author: 274couldabin
title: Surprise, surprise!
text: After a long drive, we were glad to arrive here to find a property, that quite frankly, was better than I was expecting. In fact, the whole place looked as if it had just been dropped off, fresh from the factory! Isn't it strange that often, just one aspect can make or break a visit to somewhere new? For my wife and I, we were impressed by two. The room faced the valley leading up to the Ccok and Tasman peaks, so the view was gorgeous, and even better, there was a small terrace beyond the sliding doors, so you could experience the view and the fresh air, together. We decided instantly, that we would dine in and enjoy the view for as long as possible. The shops around Fox Glacier were more than capable of providing for our needs. We have just one grumble, and it's the "wifi" thing again. For many travellers nowadays, wifi isn't an optional extra. They need it to keep in touch, and while Sunset wasn't as expensive as big city hotels,the extra costs all add up. Note to owners. Use free wifi as your USP. I don't think you'd be disappointed with the results! Finally, one concern for some travellers. There are two heli pads quite close to the Motel, which could cause you disturbance during the day if you were around. We didn't really mind, but it's worth considering if you'd really prefer silence!

author: LonnieK573
title: Great Place to Stay and wonderful view
text: This place is a 6 on a scale of 1 - 5. It was the best place we stayed at in NZ. I will definitely stay here again when I come back to NZ. Lots of amenities: microwave oven, refrigerator, 2 - burner stove top, hot water heater for tea and coffee, sink, lots of dishes, glasses, silverware, pots and pans and more. Lots of space to store all your stuff and your luggage. Even had a small couch and table. Be sure and get a jar of the local honey in the manager's office. It is delicious and reasonably priced. Bruce the manager was very friendly and helpful. He gave us a pint of milk for our tea and coffee. The Wi-Fi was very reasonable and the cheapest we had in NZ. You get a terrific view of the mountains. This motel was reasonably priced and a "great" value. You won't be disappointed. We stayed there on Aug 26 & 27, 2012. If you take the Cook flat road away from town to Lake Matheson you will get a terrific reflection of the mountains and the restaurant there has good food. If you go down the road a little farther to a parking place, you will get a "super" view of the mountains and glacier. Bruce the manager will tell you all the right places to go. He was terrific.

author: jjwlaus
title: WOW - What a view!
text: Stayed here as our base for exploring the glaciers for two nights. Met by the owner and checked in ok, although the cot that we had ordered on our reservation was forgotten and so we had to set it up ourselves. Got into the room and were met by the most amazing view of Mt Cook. Absolutely stunning view. The weather was a little poor that afternoon so we wathed the clouds changing around the mountain from the lounge. Very cool! The room itself was OK. The bed was probably the low point. It was incredibly soft and needed desperate replacement. The dodgy old bedspread did not held the overall appearance of the room. The bed aside, the room was pretty good. It had reasonable cooking facilities, although the shops in Fox are pretty scarce and the little supermarket does not have a whole lot, so you should stop at one of the major centres on your way and get food. Internet was a bit sketchy with not very good reception available on the wireless. The final thing about this place is the rules. There are rules about everything! One of the more "school" like places I have stayed. Overall, the view makes this motel. It is amazing. The rooms are clean and have pretty much all you need. Would happily stay here again.

author: FlyingTravel
title: Ummm...
text: Stayed at this motel recently on our NZ Sth Island holiday and thought I'd add a review. Location: It's situated pretty much on the periphery of Fox Glacier township. Although very very quiet, it's not really a comfortable walking distance from the centre of town where all the tourist facilities are. So we had to drive back and forth. Room: Upon entering our east facing room, the first comment by everyone was the cow/sheep/horse dung smell in the room. The room was situated right by large paddocks and we guessed that's where the smell came from. So unless one enjoys the "natural smell" of country, then be forewarned if you should get one such room. Fortunately it largely disappeared after a day of airing. Otherwise there's mountain peak view through the top of the window, but it didn't do much for us due to regular cloud cover. Facilities: It's a basic motel room that's relatively clean without anything fancy. The relative young age helps to make it look in reasonable shape. However, the bed mattress was rather soft, to the point of being worn and sagging. Audible squeaks if one moves around. The rooms are serviced by wireless internet at $15/stay. Slowish at night but "unlimited". Overall: I don't think I'd book this place again due to the number of negatives above. There are more convenient picking closer to the centre of town for equal or less money.

author: hillmanblue
title: Well appointed, good facilities, great view & the rooms were warm!
text: Okay we were a little nervous of this one as one or two people have posted so, so reviews, based on the heating, internet access and owners attitude. With this in mind, I came to this motel looking for faults, and I did not find them. Yes there are two heaters ( three if you include the bathroom heater ) however on this Winters day, they are fine to warm up the room. They do not automatically switch off on some kind of timer, except the one in the bathroom which is expected. Internet access is fine, and the price is no more than we have been paying in our tour of New Zealand. There is no upload/download limit so its a good deal, and it works! The owner/manager. I asked the guy a lot of questions and looked for a hint of bad attitude, I found non whatsever. He seemed happy and helpful to me, no problems at all. The rooms are very clean, and yes they do charge $20 if you don't wash up your own crockery. Good! It is no big chore and probably helps keeps the costs down. It's not like you are being asked to scrub the floors with a toothbrush is it? Modern, clean, and we would stay here again. I think the majority of people would enjoy their stay here, unless you have a great aversion to washing up your cup after use!

author: Darlox
title: Great jumping off point for fox glacier activities
text: The Sunset Motel is a nice travel motel just off the main road through Fox Glacier, on the road to Lake Mathieson. We booked a room for the night prior to our glacier hike, and found it to be a lovely stop for the night. Read on for details... LOCATION: While a bit beyond easy walking distance from either downtown Fox Glacier (closer) or Lake Mathieson (farther), it's a matter of just a few minutes drive (or bike) from either. Parking in downtown was not an issue during our stay, so having to drive wasn't a problem at all. But if you're in a camper or otherwise opposed to driving to/from the hotel all the time, you'd better have a bike or be prepared for a bit more of a walk than from many of the other area hotels. ROOMS: The room was larger than we'd expected, and well cleaned. We lucked out and had the end unit, so we had large windows facing two directions, with great views. The partial kitchenette was clean, and had an assortment of teas and coffee for the morning. The bathroom was sizable with an ample supply of hot water. Only one small issue with the room, in that the flat roof is either corrugated metal, or some other plate-like material. We had the misfortune of absolutely foul weather in the evening, and the driving rain on the roof sounded like someone playing marbles above us all night long. Most guests will never encounter a problem, but if truly foul weather is in the forecast, I hope you're a sound sleeper! STAFF: Cannot say enough good things about the desk staff. The two people we interacted with could not have been more helpful in suggesting restaurants and helping us with our questions. We felt very well taken care of throughout our stay. Overall, Sunset was a great choice for us, and a good base of operations for activities around Fox Glacier. If we'd planned to put down roots for more than a few days, we might have wanted something closer into town, but otherwise this is a great option for exploring this beautiful area.

author: Susanne78R
title: Facist hotel, DON't go there if you don't speak Italian
text: The view is amazing but that's it. The receptionist was nice when we arrived. It's seed that a misstake has been made and the reservation was for two, I have paid for three persons. Off course I didn't want to pay extra but ended up paying because there where no reasoning with receptionist that suddenly got very angry and agitated. My kids where afraid and didn't want to stay at the hotel. The Manager, always sitting behind the receptionist only speaks Italian (so he says), never answering a Hi or Good morning but was very chattery with the Italian speaking guests. Than there is the buffé. DON't ENTER if you´re not going to eat. If you sit you pay, ever if you don't eat. They don't tell you that when you check in. Me and my kids entered (not knowing that you have to pay) at a Calabarian evening when they serve grilled pork. I'm a vegan so I never touched the meat only the sallads buffé and my son was having stomach pain and didn't eat anything. I ended up (forced) to pay 90€, that´s a lot more than I have ever paid in any restaurant in Tropea. They claim that they are rude to people that don´t pay but I paid, even when the "robbed" me. They where rude before the discussion about the money. And when I said I will give you bad recession they said, WE DON´T CARE. If you wan't to go there rent a car because it´s a excluded area, and you will be stuck at the hotel.

author: YulaYala
title: A very pleasant stay
text: The hotel is very nice, always clean, the rooms are tidied every day, also the towels are changed every day. We had a nice room with a nice seaview. From the balcony I could see Sicily and the entire gulf with a lovely sunset. I have no idea what you other people eat, to judge this hotel so badly about the food. This hotel has a very good and very tasty mediterranean style food that we are used to eat in this part of Europe (fish, salad buffet, fresh fruit, pasta with vongole or shrimps, crostata pies and croissants and other food). But if you like plastic like or industrial food or everything fried in low level oil then yes, this fresh tasty food (that is served here) is not for you.The breakfast was nice and I have to mention at least 7 different freshly baked cakes or crostata pies that were made by the hotel's owner (a very nice and polite woman). I have never eaten such a good pie made with raw ingredients (and not made only with baking plastic dust as they do in other hotels in the world). On wednesday there was a Calabrian dinner evening with lots of typical local foods (this night is a self service buffet). Such a tasty surprise. The staff is very polite and work tirelessly to please your request. So thanks to all the waiters, Maryana, the reception staff and the cook and also the clenaning ladies. The bus shuttle to the beach is also good, helpful drivers with a good time schedule. The beach is fantastic even if 2 days due to some weather changes we had some wind which on the other hand made wonderful waves. The hotel area is clean and tidy, also the pool with enough sunbeds and umbrellas here or on the beach. some minor things that can bother you is the wifi which is on extra charge so I prefered to watch SAT tv instead on the other hand it was good for me to be at least 7 days in my life with no internet addiction so I could enjoy the nice view from my room every evening that was very relaxing. And ok the beds might be a little small for tall people. Overall I have spent a nice relaxing holiday there with no significant disadvantages.

author: 640raymondl
title: Biggest scam ever!
text: Upon arriving to what seemed to be a very nice hotel, we were told our room was not available. This was the case after having booked our room on expedia 5 months prior and having paid for it in full! How absurd is that !! They wanted to accommodate us in another hotel that was basic to say the least. They were non apologetic and told us if we were not happy to find another hotel on our own. We are a family of 5 who just flew in to Rome from Canada (8 hours) and then drove for another 7 hours to be told this! The Manager/Owner was rude, non apologetic and wasn't even able to look at me when speaking with me. Guilty conscience, I think so. Expedia was not aware of this and was very helpful afterwards in reimbursing us. We made our own plans there after. What terrible customer service! Confirm your room before hand with the hotel directly. The grounds looked very nice but the bad taste left in my mouth was horrendous! I would boycott this place! Good luck to all future clients.

author: AudreyC894
title: Lovely Place for a Relaxing Holiday
text: The hotel is perched on the hillside overlooking the sea in a very picturesque area but the walk up to the hotel is steep. The hotel staff are helpful and friendly. The room was small but clean but the beds were really hard - we were not the only guests to comment on this. The food was very good, plenty of choice. The local Ciro white wine was good and great value (we didn't try the red). If you run out of reading there is a selection of left behind books - ask at reception. There is a lovely pool with bar service. There is a charge for the towel for the pool, best take your own if you don't want to pay. Do take mosquito repellant and/or anti-histamine cream. (My sister got very badly bitten. The beach is lovely and the sea (in September) is warm and there are plenty of deck chairs. The hotel has a shuttle bus to the beach - use this, it is too far to walk in the heat. Locally there are no shops apart from a small mini-market and no local cafes or restaurants as far as we could discover. Nearby Tropea has plenty of shops and restuarants. The hotel has a shuttle bus to Tropea which costs 10 euros return. The train is cheaper (1 euro) but the station is a 30 to 40 minute walk - too far in the heat. There is no local bus service. There is a good selection of excursions further away such as Stromboli or Sicily but they are pricey. Overlall, despite some downsides this a lovely place for a relaxing holiday by the pool or beach. We had a week of glorious sunshine, lovely scenery with good food and wine.

author: IainG253
title: Dissapointing
text: To start with the location and position of the hotel is excellent. The area and views are stunning and the pool and reception area are really very good. Howevert this was where the good news stops. We had a week booked for our honeymoon and were continually dissapointed by the food, service and staff. On arrival I mentioned that it was our honeymoon as we were given a standard room. The recptionist simply picked up a key for a sea view room and slammed it down on the counter for us. The food on the first eveing was terrible. We were late but there is no excuse for the dried, tasteless fair on offer. The following day the food did improve but not substantially, we were in Italy and expected to be sampling great cuisine but were served the same bland tasteless buffet every day. The room was basic and small and the bathroon tiny but it was clean. The balcony was tiny and you could not fit the two chairs provided on it together. We settled the bill a day before we left and were surprised at some of the items included. The fridge in te room was extra per day, the air con was extra as was the safe. It was over 32 degrees every day and this is western europe so you dont really expect to pay extras for basics. In additioan we were charged 10 euros to change £40.00 a commission of over 20%. On the final day we paid the final room bill and again this was incorrect. We challenged this with the staff and were told we had insulted them! If you book the trip to Stromboli it can done 10 Euros a head cheaper in the local town Tropea despite what the Rep may tell you. There were items we simply had not had such as ice creams and extra drinks so keep a record of what you have had. We will be taking this up with Thomas Cook but the message is clear, Italy is beautiful but not at this hotel

author: clarej211
title: Lovely relaxing holiday with amazing views from the Hotel!
text: Our room was nicely decorated and very clean. We had a small balcony with an amazing sea view. The only complaint about the room was that the bed was a bit hard! The pool was lovely and the views from the hotel terrace were just perfect. The food at the hotel was nice with lots of different buffet dishes. You could also choose a starter and a main from the menu. Breakfast was good, again with plenty of choice. We went in May so there was entertainment on just one night......3 guys playing musical instruments and singing who were really good and got everyone up dancing! The beach near the hotel is lovely, as is the one that's a little further (we preferred this one). We found we didn't need the shuttle bus to get to the nearest beach (it really isn't that far!) If you go to the further beach I'd recommend the fresh stone oven pizza from the cafe there and hiring out a peddle boat! We went on two excursions.....Sicily and the Aeolian Islands. The Sicily one was great and when we arrived there was plenty to do there and were left to explore for a few hours. The Aeolian Islands was great value for money and we saw lots of beautiful islands! However, we really wished we'd bought our tickets from Tropea (a lovely nearby town) instead of the Thomas Cook rep. The tickets from Tropea were a lot cheaper and people got picked up in a flashy car to be taken to the port whilst we were picked up really late and then got taken to a coach with an empty fuel tank! We had to wait for an hour on the coach for them to get diesel delivered! Nobody spoke English and we thought we'd miss the boat! It turned out to be a fantastic trip in the end....just a bit of a crazy start! I've complained to Thomas Cook about it who apologised but offered no compensation etc.....so book your Aeolian Island tickets in Tropea! Capo Vaticano is a really beautiful place and if you want a relaxing holiday that's truly Italian then go here!

author: Christine38
title: The sun is shining this Summer in Calabria!
text: We have just returned from the Hotel Sciaron (pronounced SHARON) on the Capo Vaticano, in Calabria. We had the most wonderful holiday with wall -to- wall sunshine. The location of this hotel is unsurpassed in this area. The views were to die for, the food was excellent and the helpfulness of the staff was amazing. The beaches- and there are several around- are beautiful and clean and the water was warm and translucent. Yes, it is quite a walk to the beach(es) but the hotel shuttle is at your beck and call more or less when required - within reason.It is also available for trips to Tropea, the lovely historic town @ 5 kms from the hotel and well worth a visit or two. We hired a car one day and motored down to the Straits of Messina to Scylla ,made famous in Homer's Odyssey. From there we drove up into the forested mountains near Gambarei, where we had a picnic in the pine forests and filled up our water bottles from the mountain springs; much needed as the temperature was in the lower 30s! Another day we did the boat trip to Stromboli and after dining on the island and visiting the Bergman/ Rossellini villa, where they lived whilst making the film" Stromboli", had the most amazing experience of watching from the boat the volcano erupting into the night sky. One of the things to do before you die!! We travelled with Cosmos which was totally satisfactory and met others in the hotel who were from Germany, Sweden, Holland and the UK. Everyone was exceptionally friendly as were the hotel staff. We loved every minute of our stay and will certainly return. However, the season was hotting up and for those who do not like crowds or noisy entertainment, I recommend you avoid July and August when the Italians hit the coast with a vengeance; moreover it is then exceedingly hot. PS The beach shuttle and the umbrellas and deckchairs are free, which for Italy is most unusual!

author: Bee1234
title: Dissappointed
text: HI remotely situated family run. ace location for A quiet vacation with fabulous views. as before a hick to 2 beaches BUt hotel offers schuttle bus. Quiet in May. All good, food, hotel, cleanlines, helpful. food ok but could be hotter! Beautiful setting with fabulous scenery. But not a lot to do in local area. But on leaving unable to settle query with bar bill! Charged on 3 nights for double the amount of cocktails. G&T charged as cocktails! mixed charges so diffiuclt to clarify bill charges. Numerous other guests with similar problems. Not sorted By Hotel. Thomas cook rep informed! Shame a poor end to a nice break! So keep you bill receipts and check your bill!

author: relax630
title: Surprisingly good for the price
text: We stayed two weeks in apartement part, with no meals. First impression upon arrival - extremely positive, which lasted until the last day :) Vast area, nicely decorated and illuminated at night, with well mantained plants. Really fine, clean swimming pool, with easily accessible sunbeds and spectacular view all over the coast. Rich entertainment services by animation team (which in general we didn't took advantage of, maybe because it was in Italian). Free access to tennis court, shadowed car park and shuttle bus to the private beach. The hotel beach is next to Eden Village what makes it the most beautiful beach around :) Lots of free sunbeds and umbrellas for the hotel guests. Special thanks to the Ukrainian guy (shame, but we don't know his name...) who took care of all the beach stuff and also was in charge of residence daily maintance. The apartment very functional and what most important - clean and quite new. All kitchen equipment working ok, living areas ok for four people (nice garden with table plus dining room with enough space). We had apartment nr one, with just one neighbours - quiet and peaceful surroundings, no sounds of animation could be heard at night - only cicadas :) About half an hour walk towards nearest railway station (Ricadi) and rent-a-car (Avis). In summary, we had great time and wonderful italian holidays, with no stress, perfect weather, food and lots of activities! Beautiful beach with crystal clear water, don't forget your swimming, snorkling and beach sport equipment because you will need it there everyday :) Weak points: - about 15 min downhill to the beach, but twice this time back uphill... very steep and long way back to the hotel in case the shuttle bus doesn't come - what unfortunately used to happen... - in case of self-catering stay own/rented car suggested, due to far distance to any shops/restaurants - misunderstanding upon checkout with the reception lady, who charged us for linen cleaning, even though it was already paid and written on the voucher. Only because we had a copy of it we could argue and finally got the money back instantly. - no air conditioning (however we didn't expect one to be) - water staying on the floor in the bathroom after every shower

author: victoria71Berkshire
title: Truly Italian holiday- slightly crazy but we loved it!
text: We have just returned from a last minute holiday about which we had no expectations but we had a wonderful time and would go back tomorrow. Yes it was noisy at times but for our six year old son it was heaven. Nearly all of the staff and guests were Italian ( we wanted this as we enjoy speaking Italian and our son is learning too). The animation team were great- not sure how to describe it without making it sound like a bad holiday camp but they made it for us. Aquagym/dancing/chidren's activities and games round the pool- lots of Italian children being very natural - table football, football,dancing- our son loved it and came home singing in Italian. You have to approach it in the right way - very relaxed and fun without being pushy or over the top. There are quiet times in the morning and after lunch when we had the pool to ourselves but just before lunch and late afternoon is a little crazy. The hotel staff were nice and friendly. The room was enormous- basic but very clean - we slept brilliantly - excellent blackout shutters- very comfy beds- another reviewer complained about having single beds pushed together - we had an enormous bed with two large single matresses- no gap to fall down but no disturbance from other person rolling over! Son had his own area with a single bed. We did not have a/c for which there is a charge but we were provided with a fan which did the trick. The bathroom was good too. Rooms cleaned well every day. You don't need a car - shuttle bus to beach but we did not really go - we did go into Tropea for one evening and I would strongly recommend this - eat watching the sun set over Stromboli and then head out for a passagiata. We did do the Aeolian cruise which was ok - but a bit long- worth it to see the dolphins which is apparently an almost certain event.

author: 874rebeccat
title: It was ok
text: If you don't have kids I wouldn't recommend. I was in a group of four adults, when buying the holiday through Thomas Cook this seemed like it was what we wanted. We really wanted a holiday where we could just get away, not do to much and chill. If it wasn't so kid orientated it would have been great for us. The entertainment was average. The cocktails well i wouldnt even call them that were absolutely disgusting. They werent made fresh it was a juice machine that they just added spirit too. We spent most of our time at the small pool, but the sunbeds werent always plesent to sunbathe on. The food, pretty average with a lot of choice. We only stayed a week and got bored of what was to offer though as it was very similar on some nights to others. The snack bar wasnt the best either, burgers, sausages and chips plus more. If anyone says there is a beach nearby there isnt. It is quite a walk, i enjoyed the walk personally but my older mum didnt the beach is packed with locals, bear that in mind as ita quite a small cove. The other cove next to the hotel has millions of steps and isnt the nicest of water to swim in. The positives, it was clean and the views were to die for. There is a shop on the road nearby and a little shoping market place a short walk which has mini golf, kids entertainment stuff, market shops and restaurants.

author: L3529DAlindad
title: Good October week in the sun
text: On arrival at the Sol Calas we were given a nice friendly welcome from the reception team. We were allocated a lovely modern room on the 3rd floor, which had an amazing sea view. Our room had everything we needed including a mini fridge, hairdryer & tv (although not many British channels to choose from). Our towels were changed every day & the sheets changed twice during our week stay. The weather for our week was amazing. We enjoyed lying on the comfy loungers around the beautiful pool (although the water took your breath away as it was so cold). The entertainment team worked really hard getting people to join in the activities & I especially enjoyed taking part in the exercise & spin classes with Guttar (from Iceland), as he was very encouraging & made the classes fun & enjoyable. The friendly waiting staff worked non stop in the restaurant, clearing the tables. Mixed reviews about the food, although we always managed to find something. Great choice at breakfast and large selection of lovely desserts, salads & breads. Only complaint: we had to ask for butter most days & they seemed to have run out of it the last couple of days. The hotel closed today for the season so the number of staff & guests dwindled as the week went on. Not much to do in the resort, but it does have a lovely beach in the cove 10 mins walk from the hotel. (The sea was actually warmer than the pool!). Would recommend this lovely hotel for anyone wanting a quiet week in the sun.

author: BAHarrison1
title: Average
text: I stayed at this hotel for 4 nights at the end of September. It was just myself (26) and my mum (54) looking for a short girls break and some last rays of sunshine before the winter came. Hotel itself, great views, big pool, sunbeds always available so that was good and fine when wanting to chill, which is exactly what we wanted. The biggest disappointment for me was the food and i am honestly baffled to reviews that think this food is nice and even 'OK'. The reviews we read of food being 'luke warm' is completely true. If you me you like your food piping hot, good luck. The worst part with the food for me was easily the snack bar. I have been on many all inclusive holidays and this was the worst snack bar i have ever seen. My mum picked a toastie up and i have never felt a toastie like it in my life. I can honestly say the bottom of the bread felt as if it had been frozen and left to defrost, it was cold and wet it honestly left us feeling sick. The following day, when waiting for a drink at the bar during the period the snack bar was closed, i noticed all the food is left out. No fresh food made in the hours it's closed. Honestly it was a disgrace! We ate at the restaurant the first night and looked at it another couple but chose to eat out which is the best decision we made. If you're after a chill in the sun this hotel is fine for that, but if you want to eat nice food, avoid this hotel at all costs. Another thing i found extremely odd, this hotel shares the grounds and pool with another hotel owned by the same company, both are all inclusive but you cannot use eachothers facilities. We wanted to watch a football match, this hotel doesn't show football but we were told by the bar staff we could watch it at the other hotel but we'd have to pay for drinks. If it's the same company, why not allow guests to use both, so again we went into town to watch it and had a great time.

author: SeeTheWorld637
title: Nice but small changes could make it great
text: You should know before arrival: • There is a resort tax of €3.30 per person per night. This seems steep and wasn't made clear when booking. Good things: • Hotel generally very pleasant and well maintained. • Beautiful setting on the cliff so you can hear waves breaking on the rocks from your room. • A quiet hotel with largely civilised guests. • Food and drinks are excellent for the price bracket this hotel sits in. • A major highlight for me was they use paper straws in the bars making the all inclusive experience slightly more ecofriendly. There is room for improvement though as they tended to run out and use some plastic still. What could be better: • Ban balls in pools. There was actually only one person with a ball but they were driving everyone max bouncing it everywhere they went. • The sunbeds are in a state of disrepair and need upgrading. • The hotel loses the sun at 16:00 due to its orientation. Not much they can do about that. • Continue to reduce plastic waste by reviewing packaging etc. • Make the safes in rooms free. This is a rip off. By putting a price on security you've lost a star.

author: disneygirltracy70
title: Relaxing break
text: My honest review of sol calas de mallorca. We arrived early but our room was ready for us . our room 2704 was spacious , clean and seved us well. Beds were quite hard but after the all inclusive bar i slept like a baby anyway. Shower was huge and toiletries provided. There is a hairdryer. Plenty of storage and huge tv .large balcony and the best view ever. Bar service was very good and drinks were very good. Snackbar was good and nothing was too much troube for chef there. Restaurant was stunning , amazing view of sea while eating which was nice. Food itself was good , breakfast was the best ive ever had for all inclusive .full english and all the extras like pancakes , waffles etc. All staff work so hard here they are a true credit. Lovely bottle of cava and snacks bought to our room for our anniversary which was nice. My only negatives which didnt bother us but may be big deal to others. They shut pools very early (6pm) No bar service before 10.30am not even for soft drinks or hot drinks. We had a 7.25am pick up for our home journey so would have been nice to have had access to a small selection of breakfast. Would i stay again, probably .

author: smurf_23
title: Brilliant holiday!
text: Absolutely brilliant holiday from start to finish. Transfer from the airport to the hotel was an hour which included one drop opposite. Check in was very straight forward, quick and easy, reception staff were very friendly. rooms were modern and perfect, just what we needed, with air con- which only works when door is closed.. sofa that pulled out into a sofa bed for the little one. Only fault id say was the fact you can only book 4 in a room.. so had to have my niece with me and partner. Pools were very clean, NO INFLATABLES! And they had lifeguards on duty all the time the pool was open. Food was fine plenty to choose from and was hot, couldnt fault any meal times at all! Area is very quiet. A 10 minute walk up the road to shops and a 15 minute walk round to the beach which is beautiful. Booked with thomas cook, so did a mega day which intailed of marineland in the morning and western waterpark in afternoon - which was really good. Are second trip was a boat trip to cala millor, which was supposed to be two hours, turned into six.. entertainment was good for children and some nights adults. Other nights ended up going back to the room as didnt intrest me. Staff were absolutely brilliant, friendly, and helped you with everything. Animation team for the children were absolutely superb! Kids loved spending time with them in the kids cluba and evening entertainment!

author: Alisder
title: Excellent Kids Club
text: We stayed here with our twin boys for a week, just returned. The hotel was modern, clean and has the best views ever! It's a bit of a pain to get to the beach, especially with a pram. Majority of the staff were happy, polite and helpful. There were a couple of times we asked staff for Soy milk or if something was Vegetarian, and they said they would go check and just turned and walked away, and carried on working very rude. Food was fairly terrible; cold and repetitive. We are vegetarian/Vegan and it was extremely difficult to determine what we could eat as it was not labelled very well atall. The elevators are not fit for purpose, 2 main lifts for a 9 storey hotel is ridiculous. They are so small and slow. We could never use them at meal times as we could not fit in with the pram we had to Cary twins and a buggy down 3 floors of stairs. On the other hand, the kids club was great! The staff at the 0-4 club were absolutely fantastic. So happy all the time and great with the twins. They are super attentive and know exactly what to to to distract them if they get a bit cranky. Most of the stars of this review are for the kids club staff. They all deserve a raise 😊

author: 883arjunp
title: Great hotel with great staff!
text: Spent 10 days here with the family. We usually book at Globales Samoa, which is a short walk away - but we could only find Sol at this part of the island this year because of our late booking. But it was definitely for the best. Though it doesn’t look as ‘polished’ as Samoa at a first glance, we absolutely loved our time here to the point we now prefer Sol over Globales. Service is impeccable - everything is kept spotless clean throughout the day and everyone working here seems to actually love being here. All inclusive drinks are very generous with the alcohol and they are served by some genuinely nice staff. Evening entertainment was quite varied and we really enjoyed each event. The fifth star in the review is for Joran, who works in the kids club. My (usually) shy 7yr old son got quite close to Joran over these days and the the kids club became the highlight of his day when Joran was in. Joran would come looking for him and pull him into the club and make sure he was enjoying his time there. I mentioned to Joran at around the start of the holiday that we would be leaving on Saturday and he remembered and came over to bid us farewell the night before. An amazing guy who genuinely cares about the kids in the club (and you can see this in the way he interacts with every kid). Food is great and there is usually very good variety. The one thing I would suggest is fixed is the labelling of the food - they usually don’t match the dishes. Overall, I don’t think my son would forgive me if I booked at another hotel next time - we will definitely be back again soon.

author: cgallduff
title: Great holiday, great hotel, great staff!
text: We had a great holiday here! The hotel is lovely with lots of great places to sit and chill. The pools are nice and there is a huge one but we actually preferred the smaller one as it was less busy. There is a snack bar by the pool which serves divine burgers and chips and cheese and ham toasties. There are also hotdogs, fruit, biscuits etc available. The chefs are really nice and funny too! Our room was a family room and lovely and big and spacious with 2 bathrooms! Both rooms had big TVs and there are loads of channels with current movies from sky premier on there! You just have to follow the instructions to change the language from Spanish to English! The Aircon is also really really good! The only fault was our balcony! It was split into two and there were painfully small so we couldn’t all sit out together! You also don’t get a sea view in the family rooms which I was upset about at first but I actually loved the view in the end as there was so much to look at over the town and a little cove too! There is lots to do in the area despite what others told us. There is a little purpose built holiday area with tonnes of bars, restaurants and shops as well as mini golf and a small fairground! There is a little train you can get which can take you anywhere in the area too if you don’t like to walk but nothing was really too far. We went to two beaches while we were there, the first is about 5 minutes walk along the the coast and the other about 15 in the other direction. They are both amazing! They are coves and you can go out into the water and snorkel and it’s so blue and pretty! Both have beach bars, and the further away one had pedalos and safes you could hire with your loungers...the big one was EXTREMELY BUSY but it was still awesome!

author: hec3sm
title: Amazing hotel at fab fab prices
text: Clean and large family room with walk in shower and comfy sofa bed. Air con works well in fact a little too well. Free WiFi all around hotel,rooms and pool which makes for happy teenagers. Sun beds to the left of the hotel- nearer the sister hotel stay in the sun longer as the beds to the right are in full shade as the sun goes behind the hotel at around 4.30. To get a specific sun bed you will need to be up around 7.30 but don’t have to stay with your bed. Don’t waste money in inflatables and they are not allowed in the pool apart from swimming aids for toddlers/ babies. Life guard will ask you to remove if you try. Small beach if you turn left along the costal path behind the hotel and lovely beach around 15mins walk to the right. Good time to go there when the shade hits your sun bed = best of both worlds. Food is repetitive on a daily basis with the odd different meat thrown in but plenty of options and sofar all cooked well. Breakfast is the best meal, can’t comment on the lunch as the in and out hut offers adequate repetitive food. At busy times you may have to grab a used table and ask staff to clear it for you but they are always obliging. Outside entertainment is great, staff try! Bars always had 2 staff on them so not queuing for long. Although they need a self serve soft drink station as this would help staff and guests. Overall amazing hotel at amazing price and yes I would most definitely return. My photo from our room showing the brochure picture isn’t photoshopped like I thought!!!

author: 632joc
title: Great Holiday
text: I can’t believe some of the other recent reviews I have read- if anyone can find fault in 11 days, I could, but I struggled to find anything wrong here in this great 4 star hotel. On arrival, when checking in, we were given bottled water. Our room was on the 6th floor. We had a spectacular view of the sea (daily sunrise), a clean room with two single beds and sofa bed for the two children ( big enough for two adults!) views from corridor of mountains and sunset. 5 pools to choose from. The lifeguards are great with the children. Food is great- 10 different choices or more at every meal- something to suit everyone. The restaurant is very clean and staff work very hard to cater for and clean up after guests- recently posted pictures do not reflect what I saw in 11 days. The hotel is situated on the cliff with beaches at both sides. We visited both beaches throughout our stay so that we could snorkel, but the children just wanted to get back to the hotel so that they could see the friends that they had made. The hotel has a gym and a shop. The entertainment team were amazing. I can’t speak highly enough about the enthusiasm of Alvaro and the rest of the team who tirelessly attempt to involve all guests in the wide range of activities on offer- I loved waterpolo and pool biking. The entertainment was enjoyable- magician, singers, karaoke, Tina Turner, etc. We met some lovely people, the sun shone, the air conditioned room cooled us overnight........... I could go on and on but all that needs to be said is I can’t wait to return next Summer. We all loved it! I would not hesitate to book this hotel. I can’t believe people can complain about paying 5 euros for charity for a whole afternoon of inflatable water slides or a night of bouncy castles.

author: heggie
title: Awful place never again
text: We stayed at this hotel for 10nights as a family of 4. Staff are friendly and happy and the views are beautiful but that is all. Entertainment is terrible I have a 12 year old daughter and there is nothing at all for this age group to do she was bored stiff as well as my 9year old son very poor. Pools only opens at 10til5 and cold. They do water spots witch is only for adults and is always in the sallow end of the pool so the little children had to get out or go to the deeper side. They had water slides but had to pay €5 in my opinion it’s an all inclusive so why do people have to pay. Evening entertainment is shocking it’s based in the in and out bar with is dark and has nothing to it very poor. Food is disgusting same old things everyday meat that is left over goes in to a curry or stew for tea or the next day same old salad with flys all over birds walking around the restaurant near your food cakes are like water. Breakfast is not nice at all in the end we started going out for a late breakfast and tea as we couldn’t eat in there any longer. Nothing really for kids but chips very poor. Only one lager no other choice so if you don’t like it it’s tuff basically no one at reception told us that we could upgrade to a gold band witch then you could have the branded drinks and the cocktails just the machine stuff witch isn’t nice at all. Don’t find the hotel clean at all the in and out bar is dirty also the toilets in there are disgusting never seen them be cleaned also empty cups and ice cream pots and stuff laying around the pool hardly see anyone come round and tidy up. There is lifeguards round the pool witch there more interested in playing on there phone or chatting to there friends instead of watching what is going on. Only 2lifts witch you can wait for 10 mins to get to where you what to be. Both beaches are beautiful and they have a square of restaurants pubs and shops which all sell the same thing some lovely food up there though. Nothing much else to do other than this on this resort. Me and my family will not be returning to this hotel or resort again. I would advise anyone not to use this hotel.

author: Bondblack
title: Awful food and complacent management - very disappointing
text: Spent 7 nights here last week with my wife and two kids. I will start with negatives as there were too many. The biggest disappointment was the food, every night was chips, cheap fish and pork. On many nights the chips were re-heated and were hard. The fish was tasteless and on some occasions had lot of bones. The alternative was spaghetti and meatballs or bland pasta. The salad was not fresh either and the fruits were old. Desert consisted of various watermelons and small tubs of ice cream. The restaurant serves dinner from 7:00 - 9:00pm and by 8.30pm they close one of the serving areas. There are long queues for drinks as well and the cocktails are an absolute joke. For example, I have never seen a yellow coloured pinacolada before.The drinks were also substandard and everyday they close the most popular slush ice machine The snack bar serves bread rolls ham or cheese and pate. There is also an area that serves chips, burgers and pizza but the daily queue is ridiculous. This is meant to be AI and you should not have long queues for food and drinks. By the way add an extra 100 euros to your spending money because you have to hire the iron, the tv remote, the safe, the kettle and the WiFi which is 24 euros for the week per device. The positives about the hotel are as follows; excellent location within 7-10 minutes walk from a lovely beach; 3 large size pools; nice big complex; most of the staff are nice and helpful. Convenient for families with young kids if you don’t mind having overdone chips everyday. If the management of this hotel weren’t so complacent, it could be so much better. On that basis I will not be returning or recommend as an all inclusive resort as there are much better options in Majorca at the same price or less. I could say a lot more but I don’t want to be overtly critical because we had such a lovely time at the beach every day and also it wouldn’t be fair on those staff who were nice hard working.

author: rach11056
title: Nice break
text: We have just come back from a lovely break from here, we had a great time and met some great people. The hotel is lovely its view’s are amazing, we spent 10 days here and enjoyed every minute ... Food .... The food here is ok not the best very much the same food every night and repeated a lot, the fruit and bread and yoghurts are lovely!! The pizza is rank which we were all totally gutted about... we would look in the restaurant and if we couldn’t put anything together we would go down to the town and get something. There is a fantastic little restaurant called Venecia which is amazing.... Room..... The rooms are lovely clean, air con fab sometimes to cold, the t.v. Is fab with films on in English which was great if u come up to ur room early.... Entertainment.... The entertainment staff are great the mini disco looked great my son is to old but he would always love to go down to the in out bar and watch the shows which were ok sometimes.... The in out bar serves burgers, hot dogs, chips all day, crisps, fruit, sweets, if u catch a burger straight off the grill there nice .... There is a nice little shop on site which sells most things we had a lovely time here, would I go back? No only because we don’t visit the same place twice.

author: jennie82
title: Had so much potential!
text: I wanted so much to give this 5* but the food let it down hugely. We go all inc for the kids, we go through loads of juice/water and all inc is so much easier for breakfast and snacks. So we don’t expect much from the evening meals as we usually eat out at night but this time my mobility issues stoped us from going out at night. The breakfast and lunch was ok they can’t really go wrong with that, and there was always lots of fresh fruit, which I loved. The evening meal was awful. The choice of food the quality of the food was so bad. They repeated the same things over and over. It was even so bad that on one of their nights that they were reusing the old food they had made appetisers that were stale bread (I think it was meant to be crispy) with a mixture of ingredients on top. One of these was a hash brown with half a cherry tomato on top!!!!!! I got chips from the snack bar and they were cold, smelled of stale grease and snapped in half when touched, when I complained I was told they were over cooked, yet not one was burned! The manager I spoke with really didn’t seem all that interested in my complaint and said she would ask the chef how he was cooking them. The chef in the snack bar gave my youngest son a row and took his food off him, my son had got 3 small pieces of cake, one for him his brother and myself, he tried to tell the chef this but he didn’t listen, my husband had been watching him and had to go up and step in. This caused my son to be to scared to go near the snack bar, and totally ruined his (and our) holiday. My son is autistic so going up by himself was such a big achievement for him, only to be treated like this, it’ll take a long time to get him to do anything like that again, over a couple bits of cheap cake (in an all Inclusive hotel!) Kids club was great, my oldest loved it. He wanted to go every day. We only went to the kids disco once as it wasn’t on until 8:30 which was to late for my youngest (who’s 6) but again the boys enjoyed it. The pools are big there was always enough sun beds, could probably do with better ones and more parasols. The rooms were always clean as was the rest of the hotel. It’s just a shame about the food. If they were to spend more on food it would be a fantastic holiday and definitely fitting of their 4* rating.

author: ScottyR74
title: Enjoyable Holiday
text: Spent ten days here and had a good holiday. The hotel is clean, spacious and with terrific views. There's two outside pools and one inside. I tried to get info on the gym before I went, but there wasn't much on the equipment in the gym. So.... The gym consists of two treadmills, two cross trainers, two bikes, one bench, dumbbells up to 14kgs, a seated military press machine, lat pull down machine, seated chest press machine, leg extension machine and a couple of mats. Its ok for the average person into fitness, but anyone who lifts weights will struggle to get a decent workout. Could do with a rack or Smith machine and heavier dumbbells. It's also very hot as there's no air conditioning. The staff are friendly and polite. I was a bit apprehensive about the foid after reading some of the reviews, but I found it to be absolutely fine. Lots of choices, healthy options too, and the food was warm enough. The staff are also very relaxed about the food, you can take bottles of water or fruit, etc away with you and they don't mind. The children's entertainment seemed to be aimed at toddlers rather than children. The songs and dancing suited nursery children than older kids, so maybe could look at that. There's nice coastal walks right beside the hotel which lead to another nice beach which you can swim in. The bus stop is beside the hotel, so you can jump on a bus to Porto Chris to, the caves of drach, etc. Id recommend getting the public bus to Palma, there's an express bus which takes about an hour and it's cheaper than getting an organised bus. Which really just drives around a couple of streets then drops you off the same. I'd recommend the hotel and area, if you go you'll have a nice, enjoyable holiday.

author: H6972AVhelenp
title: Beautiful hotel and sea views
text: This place was simply amazing! After reading reviews about so many moaning about the food we couldn't understand it as we couldn't fault it! It was delicious and so much choice daily, I'm a fussy Eater but I couldn't wait for each meal. The whole hotel was so beautiful with amazing sea views and so clean. Bars and restaurants were only a few minutes in a taxi or about 15 mins walk away. There was quite a few to sit and enjoy at night too. We thought the beach to the right of the hotel was the biggest and was a lovely walk just around the cliff along the sea. We also took a taxi into Cala dor and I'm so glad we did it's stunning there. I'd actually book a holiday to stay there it was so pretty. The only downside if we had to say was the entertainment at night wasn't good. Too much for children but the sister hotel had more. Also if I were to advise the manager I'd say put some of your wonderful bar music on in the evening on the upper floor with terrace which had nice relaxing lighting and seems a few couples enjoyed to relax there at night. We thought a nice bit of bar music in the background would have been good. The lifts are slow but there's a few floors so Most the time we used the stairs especially as we thought it was good exercise too lol ... We loved the place and highly recommend for a holiday. We are looking to go away in September again so are looking to book another Sol hotel in Spain You won't be disappointed with your stay!

author: ketch222
title: Great holiday
text: Just back after 5 days at this hotel. I highly recommend this place.It was fab.Excellent staff on reception-so helpful. Rooms cleaned everyday and staff always said hello to you. Great if you have children. Lovely outdoor pool with lifeguard assistance when/if needed. They are all great with kids. Generally a great atmosphere around the pool. Food was really nice.Fresh fish and fruit daily and cooked in front of you. Lovely beach very nearby(10 min walk) but be careful with the steps going down and they are a killer getting up them unless you're super fit!!! There are only 2 downsides and its not to do with the hotel. The transfer from airport to hotel on the coach was way too long. We ended up 3 hours on the coach as it stops at every hotel dropping people off.before we got to our hotel and by this time we were all tired and hungry and it was late at night. My advise would be to pay for a taxi to get you there. My 2nd downside is wish we had stayed for another week. I will definately be returning next year.

author: lornas955
title: Lovely hotel, just needs a couple of additional bits
text: Firstly the hotel itself is clean, well kept, bright and spacious. Free WiFi throughout the hotel. The rooms are nice, basic but you don’t spend much time in them for them to need to be any different. Beds are comfy. Worth getting a sea view room for the sunsets and boat watching. The coastline is beautiful. The staff are friendly and helpful. Big thanks to the Katmandu staff in particular as they were a huge hit with our two girls (10 & 6) they looked forward to the kids club and evening activities every day thanks to the staff. If you like to keep active there is a small gym and daily sports activities like water Zumba and water polo. You do have to get up reasonably early to catch a decent sunbed (before 0830). The food is very samey, but as long as you expect a mass catered all inclusive buffet that’s what you will get. It’s nothing more or less. Lots of choice and fresh food but it is the same most days. Worth going out to explore the local town in the evening, typical Spanish resort with bars shops and restaurants but it is close by and breaks up the all inclusive options. There are also little coves with beaches if you fancy a change of scenery in the daytime. The only things that let this hotel down are the very small and slow lifts, no kettle in the room. But I’m being picky. Our only real gripe was the hotel camera man that didn’t seem to take no for an answer, little bit annoying. It would also be nice for them to have a spa and maybe a additional bookable restaurant away from the main buffet. Overall we had a great holiday and would recommend for a family with youngish kids (not sure if teenagers would get bored here).

author: NickL2028
title: Good Hotel - But got Cabin Fever!
text: Just returned from a 7 day stay here, and the hotel itself was very, very good! Staff were extremely helpful and polite, the hotel itself was very clean and we have no complaints of the hotel in general. The food was good on the whole, albeit slightly repetitive and boring towards the end. I wouldn’t expect any less from a 4* hotel however, previously staying in 5* hotels there is more variety but that is to be expected. The swimming pool was very good, and big! At the deep end it was 3.5 metres which was a refreshing change from having pools were I could touch the bottom throughout. The only issue we found is that there is very little in the immediate vicinity to do. We headed to both beaches, Cala Domingos being the better beach, however it was absolutely packed and lacked toilet facilities. We ended up getting cabin fever on the third day, sick of sitting by the pool and not being able to explore a nice area casually during the day. We ended up getting taxis to nearby areas. Porto Cristo to the North was beautiful and was 21 euros in the taxi. Beautiful beach and area, with plenty to do with the family. To the south we went to Porto Colom was which was again beautiful, and headed to S’arenal Petit (beach) where all the locals were (always a good sign) - here they had a floating pontoon with a diving board and slide which was great fun! I don’t wish to take anything away from the hotel because it was lovely, it was just lacking in it’s location to keep us active people entertained. If you are here, wake up for sunrise (0630) - it’s truely breathtaking.

author: libbyb848
title: Would Recommend
text: We stayed in Sol Calas De Mallorca for 7 nights in July 2018, it was our first holiday away as a couple and we’ve had a great time. From reading trip advisor reviews we emailed in advance to request a “higher room”, our room was on the 9th Floor with great sea views, it was very clean, modern and spacious. The rooms were cleaned daily and new towels were provided. The only thing we would’ve liked in the room were tea/ coffee facilities, although this wasn’t a big issue it just meant getting out of bed a bit earlier! We would recommended a higher floor, it was quiet with amazing views - wouldn’t recommend for families as the lifts are fairly slow and small (not a big issue though!) Pools were great, they’re shared with the sister hotel next door but we never struggled for a sun bed, we typically got up at 9:30-ish and didn’t have a problem, although you may need to get up earlier if you want a parasol. There are two bars one open plan on the ground floor overlooking the sea, which we spent most nights in. The other is on -1 and has nightly entertainment. The staff were great throughout our stay! All were friendly and accommodating. The food was great, as you’d expect for an all inclusive hotel, varied daily to accommodate for all appetites. We really liked that drinks were on tap as you didn’t have to wait for staff to fetch them, a small criticism was the glasses in the restaurant were tumblers (no wine or pint glasses) which meant you had to get up regularly to refill drinks. The quality of food was very good for an all inclusive, especially local foods ie: fish dishes (the negative reviews about food most likely come from “fussy” eaters, we found we had plenty of choice of high quality food. Whilst we never had any issues with food the chefs seemed to be very accommodating to these issues and we felt these reviews were unfair). Overall we had a lovely time here, thank you to all the staff who made us welcome! We would highly recommend Sol Calas De Mallorca to others.

author: lizzielu89
title: Fantastic holiday
text: What a brilliant hotel!! I had stayed here many years ago and loved it so my expectations were high. It was wonderful from the cleaners to kid entertainment it was brilliant. The rooms are spacious we had a cot in ours as well. These were cleaned every day and towels changed if requested. The swimming pools were lovely and plenty of sun beds good amount of shaded areas and umbrellas The children entertainment was out of this world. My 8 year old and 1 year old loved all of it and how lovely the entertainment Gemma Luis Jorea and Marths are a true credit to this hotel. They went above and beyond I felt. The adult entertainment in the evening was hit and miss but it didn’t bother us. The food we thought was lovely a great variety somethings were repeated but with trying to cater for so many people it’s not surprising. Especially if you have fussy children it made it easier if these was something they would eat. The variety of drinks available was also brilliant even some branded alcohol and cocktails. Fridges full of bottles of water for you to take was fantastic. Especially with fridges in your room. All the staff were so friendly. We really enjoyed this hotel would definitely recommend and would return. You must get up early one day the sunrise is amazing!!!

author: romeroh788
title: Amazing time
text: We are a young family of 3 and this was our first trip abroad. We we're very impressed with the room size and the balcony which was overlooking the main outdoor stage. This was brilliant as our 9 month old baby would be asleep by 9pm. This means we could still enjoy the entertainment as one of us could nip to get some food and a few drinks to bring back to the room. Our little baby slept like an angel as the aircon system was brilliant keeping the room cool at all times and quickly. The kids club was also brilliant and had many different activities and toys for toddlers to play with. We also sat in the grass area when they closed as it was great for our boy to crawl and just walk around and play in. The food was ok for our budget as it cost us just short of £700 for 4 nights. Their was always one item on the menu that fit either mine or my partners appetite. Also with food availble on the grill outside around the clock outside of dining hours. The childrens pool was quite cold as its small so seems the sun doesnt warm it up. However we brought our baby into the large pool and he loved every moment including the zumba classes which we participated in from a distance. The animation team were constantly full of energy which added to the whole experiance. The only negative is the walls are quite thin and you can hear neighbouring rooms both sideways and upstairs. So keep this in mind when next door to people that can't handle their alcohol as I woke up once hearing someone sick 7 times. Although I am a light sleeper and have always lived in a detached house so not use to adjourning sounds. Although my baby didn't wake up as he was fast asleep I must say meeting very nice people from all over the world was also refreshing and it felt like a big family in the same hotel. I would definitely visit the hotel again.

author: krazysteve
title: Last minute cheap break
text: Booked on the Friday and flew Monday. Flight was delayed so when we arrived we where later on at night. Our luggage was put safe and given our all inclusive passes so we could grab some food before the snack bar closed, checked in after a bit of food and a few drinks. Room was comfy and clean, shower, aircon worked well. We where the on 8th floor excellent views. 2 bottles of water sandwiches and fruit on arrival in the room. Wifi pretty good, sometimes a bit vague on the far side of the pool. Lifts, one broke down on first day. not really a big issue as most using the small service lift. Pools clean and refreshing . Beds on main pool better. Food, breakfast best meal of the day, evening meals a bit hit and miss, never went hungry. Bit of a lottery getting hot food depending how long trays had been left out. Snack bar ok. not cordon bleu. Drinks no problems, plastic glasses. Staff friendly and efficient.

author: jordanlC3726CR
title: Not rated a 4*
text: We are staying at this hotel and leave in a couple of days time. The hotel itself we would rate as a three star hotel, although a good one at that. The location cannot be faulted, right on the cliff edge with stunning views. It is in close proximity to two beaches and great places to snorkel (watch out for sharks!) It's pretty clean and modern, there are enough sun beds at the lower pool (old beds) compared to the big pool that it shares with the hotel joined. It is rare to find a bed unless you reserve with a towel early hours. The shared pool is big, the lower pool is much smaller, still decent but quieter so we stayed there most days. The inside pool is freezing but quite refreshing once you get used to it! There is also a gym which we haven't used as of yet but is handy.The lobby bar is where we spent most of our evenings, stuck with mohitos as the drinks are hit and miss.There doesn't seem to be any listed entertainment (at least in the packs they gave us and on billboards) some nights we could hear decent singing from the other hotel but did not venture across (not sure if we are allowed to) The rooms are minimal but clean and modern. The bathroom is well equipped with a powerful shower. No water in fridges on arrival unfortunately, no tea/ coffee facilities which I know not all hotels do but it's something that pleases customers. Some staff are friendly and will go out of their way to say hello, others not so. At breakfast/lunch/dinner there are no staff at the door greeting people and telling you where to sit etc. It seems like you could just waltz in from the street, It's all serve yourself which is fine but some staff service at meal time is something we have experienced in most four stars. The food is very limited, rarely hot unfortunately. I'm veggie and there are one or two options so I opted for salad most days. No wine glasses on tables at dinner (or anywhere?) tinted glasses all around unless you ask for wine at the bar which is not in the restaurant. The lifts are terrible (old, cramped, long waiting time) There are 9 floors in total, hopefully you aren't up on a high floor. Overall, if the weather and location were not on point we would be pretty miserable with the quality. That being said it's not as bad as some people make out, I think it's safe to say we wouldn't come back to this particular hotel chain but Majorca is lovely.
